title: Definition-Guided In-Context Learning for Zero-Shot Spoken Language Understanding
summary: Adapting spoken language understanding (SLU) systems to novel or revised label taxonomies conventionally requires additional labeled data and retraining, creating a bottleneck for real world deployment. While in-context learning with few-shot demonstrations offers an alternative, multi-modal generalization and scaling has been challenging. In this work, we investigate whether natural-language definitions alone can guide zero-shot SLU without demonstration exemplars, finding that symbolic definitions serve as the primary supervisory driver for adapting speech-text models. We operationalize this principle as Definition-Guided In-Context Learning (DG-ICL), a fine-tuning framework that decouples semantic categories from fixed lexical names. By replacing labels with dynamically randomized definitions (arbitrary synthetic tokens in DG-ICL-Sym or permuted vocabulary words in DG-ICL-Flip), DG-ICL avoids lexical shortcuts and encourages the model to ground acoustic representations in contextual definitions. Novel categories can thus be introduced at inference simply by defining them through the instructions. Across three speech-text models (AUDIO FLAMINGO 3, QWEN2-AUDIO, and SALMONN), DG-ICL outperforms standard instruction tuning on held-out tasks under novel symbols (0.663 vs. 0.449 macro-F1 on Audio Flamingo 3; 0.703 vs. 0.620 on Qwen2-Audio; 0.582 vs. 0.399 on SALMONN), while remaining competitive on original labels. Furthermore, counterfactual evaluations demonstrate instruction following abilities, where it is shown that DG-ICL-Sym retains 68% of its performance when definitions contradict pre-trained lexical priors, whereas standard instruction tuning elicits significantly reduced retention of 21%. Finally, we show that DG-ICL enables zero-shot speech clustering into user-defined categories specified on the fly

AI.tldr: 提出Definition-Guided In-Context Learning (DG-ICL)：用动态随机化定义替代固定标签名进行微调，使语音-文本模型摆脱词汇捷径，在新类别上仅凭自然语言定义即可零样本适配SLU。
AI.motivation: SLU系统适配新/修订的标签体系通常需额外标注与重训练；few-shot ICL虽可替代，但多模态泛化与扩展困难。作者想验证：仅靠自然语言定义（无示例演示）能否驱动零样本SLU适配。
AI.method: DG-ICL微调框架：将标签与固定词形解耦，用动态随机化定义替换标签名——DG-ICL-Sym使用任意合成token，DG-ICL-Flip使用置换词表词；由此抑制词汇捷径，迫使模型将声学表征对齐到上下文定义。推理时仅通过在指令中给出定义即可引入新类别。在Audio Flamingo 3、Qwen2-Audio、SALMONN三个语音-文本模型上评测，并做反事实与零样本聚类实验。
AI.result: 新符号下的留出任务macro-F1显著优于标准指令微调：0.663 vs 0.449（Audio Flamingo 3）、0.703 vs 0.620（Qwen2-Audio）、0.582 vs 0.399（SALMONN）；原始标签上保持竞争力。反事实评估中定义与预训练词汇先验冲突时，DG-ICL-Sym保留68%性能，标准指令微调仅21%。此外DG-ICL支持按即时指定的用户自定义类别进行零样本语音聚类。
AI.conclusion: 符号化定义是语音-文本模型类别适配的主要监督信号；解耦标签与词形可消除词汇捷径、增强指令遵循，并支持零样本类别扩展与聚类，为SLU标签体系快速更新提供无需示例的可行路径。

title: Thakaa at AlexandriaX-2026: Who Gets the Final Say? Assigning Output Authority in Dialectal Arabic Machine Translation and Error Detection
comment: First place in all four evaluated settings of the AlexandriaX-2026 shared task. 22 pages, 4 figures. Published in Proceedings of The Fourth Arabic Natural Language Processing Conference: Shared Tasks
summary: We report first-place systems for all four evaluated AlexandriaX-2026 settings: both English-to-dialect translation tracks, cross-dialect translation, and translation-error detection. In unconstrained translation, our minimum Bayes risk (MBR) selection restricts output authority: four local systems can supply the translation, while seven additional systems contribute only reference evidence. Candidate-constrained MBR beats the strongest complete candidate in all 13 dialects and gains 1.2554 macro spBLEU overall, reaching 33.4891. It also surpasses a retrospective oracle selecting the best whole candidate system per dialect. In the constrained track, country-routed LoRA adapters over a shared NileChat-3B-Base backbone incorporate the released Libyan and Sudanese supervision absent from the training and development splits, raising macro spBLEU from 29.5969 to 30.4233. Post-evaluation, a single adapter trained on all released Alexandria data reaches 30.4733 macro spBLEU; averaging model weights across three training seeds raises this to 30.9726 while retaining one model for inference. For cross-dialect translation, nonparallel target-dialect retrieval guides deliberation, raising Gemma-4-31B-IT without fine-tuning from 24.6898 to 28.4011 spBLEU. For translation-error detection, GPT-5.5 proposes semantic error regions, while MARBERTv2 controls their character boundaries and corroborates additional spans, raising Overall from 0.4691 to 0.4982.

AI.tldr: 该文报告了AlexandriaX-2026全部四项评测设置的冠军系统：英译方言、跨方言翻译与翻译错误检测。核心手段为候选约束的最小贝叶斯风险(MBR)选择、按国家路由的LoRA适配器、非平行目标方言检索引导推理，以及GPT-5.5与MARBERTv2的分工式错误检测。
AI.motivation: 面向AlexandriaX-2026的四个评测赛道（两条英译方言、跨方言翻译、翻译错误检测），需要构建在多方言上稳健且能有效利用受限外部系统的系统；同时需解决训练/开发集缺失利比亚与苏丹方言监督、以及单系统候选质量瓶颈的问题。
AI.method: 非约束翻译：采用候选约束MBR，仅4个本地系统可提供译文，另7个系统仅作参考证据；约束赛道：在共享NileChat-3B-Base主干上挂载按国家路由的LoRA适配器，引入发布但未出现在训练/开发集中的利比亚与苏丹监督，并进行三种子权重平均；跨方言：用非平行目标方言检索引导推理，零微调作用于Gemma-4-31B-IT；错误检测：GPT-5.5提出语义错误区域，MARBERTv2控制字符边界并补充额外片段。
AI.result: 非约束赛道：候选约束MBR在全部13个方言上优于最强完整候选，宏平均spBLEU提升1.2554至33.4891，并超过按方言选最优整系统的事后oracle。约束赛道：宏平均spBLEU由29.5969升至30.4233；评测后单适配器覆盖全部Alexandria数据达30.4733，三种子权重平均进一步提升至30.9726且推理仅需一个模型。跨方言翻译：Gemma-4-31B-IT由24.6898升至28.4011 spBLEU。错误检测：Overall由0.4691升至0.4982。
AI.conclusion: 限制输出权限的候选约束MBR、路由式LoRA适配器与权重平均、检索引导的跨方言推理、以及生成模型与判别模型分工的错误检测流程，均能带来一致且可观的性能提升，构成四个赛道的第一名方案。

title: Self-WSP: Can Language Models Improve Themselves Through Weight-Space Programming?
summary: Frontier language models can now read and edit the weights of a neural network much like code and thereby improve a small model, an approach known as Weight-Space Programming (WSP). We further explore applying WSP to a language model itself, which we call Self-WSP. Specifically, Qwen3.5-0.8B reads its own weights, proposes an edit, and then continues with the edited weights as both problem solver and editor. We find many cases of genuine self-improvement. Self-edits can raise GSM8K accuracy from 11.8% to 62.2% and MATH500 accuracy from 7.0% to 32.2%, sometimes by changing only 16 parameters, and in some cases repeated self-editing keeps improving the model. A closer look, however, reveals that these gains lack interpretability. The model shows little understanding of the edits it makes, and WSP driven by random search sometimes performs comparably. Self-WSP thus holds promise as a path toward recursive self-improvement (RSI), but realizing this promise requires further exploration.

AI.tldr: 本文将权重空间编程（WSP）应用于语言模型自身（Self-WSP），发现模型能通过自我编辑权重实现真实自提升（GSM8K 11.8%→62.2%，MATH500 7.0%→32.2%），但增益缺乏可解释性，随机搜索可达到类似效果。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型已具备读写神经网络权重的能力（WSP），可借此改进小模型；作者进一步追问：模型能否对自身权重进行编辑以实现递归自我改进（RSI），以及这种自我改进是否真实且可理解。
AI.method: 提出 Self-WSP：以 Qwen3.5-0.8B 为对象，模型读取自身权重、提出编辑方案，随后以编辑后的权重同时充当问题求解者与编辑者，并迭代进行自我编辑；辅以对编辑量（如仅改动 16 个参数）与随机搜索基线的对照分析。
AI.result: 存在大量真实的自我改进案例：GSM8K 由 11.8% 提升至 62.2%，MATH500 由 7.0% 提升至 32.2%，有时仅改动 16 个参数，且重复自我编辑可持续提升。但增益缺乏可解释性：模型对自身编辑理解有限，随机搜索驱动的 WSP 有时表现相当。
AI.conclusion: Self-WSP 展示了通向递归自我改进的潜力，但其机制尚不可解释、增益来源存疑，要实现该前景仍需进一步探索。

title: Grammar Sparsity Sets How Transformers Learn Random Languages
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Principles of Generative Modeling
summary: We study language acquisition by transformers trained on the Random Language Model: a synthetic hierarchical grammar with random production rules, whose sparsity is controlled by a single parameter and whose conditional entropies are known exactly. On depth-two grammars, we find that sparsity sets both the order and the speed of learning. Dense grammars are learnt one level at a time: a token is predicted from its sibling after $t\propto V$ steps and from the full context only after $t\propto V^{3}$, so the two stages are separated by a plateau that widens with $V$. Sparse grammars are learnt all at once, at $t\propto\sqrt V$, with a smaller exponent than even the first stage of a dense one. The exponents $1$ and $1/2$ already appear at depth one, where we derive them for a linear model trained with Adam.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Transformer在"随机语言模型"（具有随机产生式、稀疏度由单一参数控制的合成层级文法）上的语言习得过程，揭示稀疏度同时决定学习顺序与学习速度。
AI.motivation: 理解神经网络（尤其是Transformer）如何进行语言习得，需要可控、理论可分析的合成文法；现有真实语言数据难以精确刻画条件熵与稀疏度的影响，因此构建条件熵可精确计算的随机语言模型来分离稀疏度这一关键因素。
AI.method: 构造Random Language Model：一个层级文法，其产生式随机、稀疏度由单一参数控制、条件熵可精确求解；在深度为1和2的文法上训练Transformer，并用Adam训练的线性模型在深度1处解析推导学习指数。
AI.result: 在深度2文法上，稀疏度同时决定学习顺序与速度：稠密文法逐层学习——先经过 t∝V 步学会用兄弟token预测，再经过 t∝V^3 步学会利用完整上下文，两阶段之间出现随词表规模V增宽的平台期；稀疏文法则一次性学成，时间为 t∝√V，其指数甚至小于稠密文法的第一阶段。指数1和1/2已在深度1出现，并可由Adam训练的线性模型解析推导。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏度是决定Transformer语言习得动力学（阶段顺序、平台期、时间尺度指数）的核心控制参数；简洁的随机层级文法与线性模型解析结果共同刻画了习得过程中的幂律时间标度。

title: Position-Skipped Distillation of Sparse-Attention Indexers: Train Short, Serve Long
summary: Top-k sparse attention relies on an indexer, a lightweight per-layer module that ranks cached tokens so attention covers only the k highest-scoring ones. Indexers are usually distilled from dense attention at the full serving length, so every training step pays for long-context dense attention. We show that when an indexer is distilled on short sequences, its failure to generalise to longer contexts is driven mainly by rotary positional encoding (RoPE), not by degraded content matching. We propose position-skipped distillation: the indexer and the frozen teacher see short sequences whose position IDs contain a randomly placed gap, so neither ever processes more than the short training length. On DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Qwen3-30B-A3B, an indexer distilled on 8K tokens this way matches a 32K-distilled indexer to within about 0.5 perplexity up to 32K, and on DeepSeek-V2-Lite matches a 64K-distilled indexer at 64K with roughly 6x less training compute per token. On Llama-3.1-8B it trails the stronger 32K run by 0.6 perplexity, and at 64K simple position compression is often as good, so the main gain is training cost rather than quality. We also quantise indexer keys to 3-4 bits without retraining and score them with a fused integer kernel: at 4 bits, perplexity changes by at most 0.05 and the scan is 1.6-2.2x faster than half precision. In a current serving engine, the indexer speeds up decoding only for long contexts with multiple concurrent streams.

AI.tldr: 提出位置跳跃蒸馏（position-skipped distillation）：在短序列上为索引器与冻结教师注入随机位置间隔，使Top-k稀疏注意力索引器无需长上下文密集注意力即可泛化到长上下文，并配合3–4bit量化整数内核降低索引开销。
AI.motivation: Top-k稀疏注意力依赖逐层轻量索引器对缓存token排序，但索引器通常在完整服务长度上用密集注意力蒸馏，每步训练都需付出长上下文密集注意力的高昂代价；而仅在短序列上蒸馏的索引器无法泛化到更长上下文。
AI.method: 诊断出短序列蒸馏索引器长上下文失效的主因是旋转位置编码（RoPE）而非内容匹配退化。据此提出位置跳跃蒸馏：索引器与冻结教师只处理短序列，但其位置ID中插入随机间隔，从而二者均不处理超过短训练长度的序列。另将索引器key在无需重训练下量化至3–4 bit，并用融合整数内核打分。
AI.result: DeepSeek-V2-Lite与Qwen3-30B-A3B上，8K蒸馏索引器在至32K范围内与32K蒸馏索引器困惑度差距约0.5以内；DeepSeek-V2-Lite上在64K时与64K蒸馏索引器相当，每token训练算力约省6倍。Llama-3.1-8B上落后32K强基线0.6困惑度，且64K时简单位置压缩常同样有效，故主要收益是训练成本而非质量。4bit量化困惑度变化≤0.05，扫描比半精度快1.6–2.2倍。实际服务引擎中，索引器仅在长上下文且多并发流时加速解码。
AI.conclusion: 索引器短序列蒸馏失效主因是RoPE；位置跳跃蒸馏以显著更低训练算力逼近长上下文蒸馏效果，量化可进一步降低索引开销；但质量提升有限、端到端服务加速条件受限，核心价值在于训练与索引成本节约。

title: How Reliable is AI-Generated Audio Description? A Multilingual Expert Evaluation
summary: Audio description (AD) makes visual media, such as video, accessible to blind or low-vision (BLV) audiences, but the high cost of professional production limits coverage. Due to recent advances in AI, numerous approaches to automatically generate intermediate AD scripts and/or final AD audios have been proposed. We present an expert evaluation of AI-generated AD scripts for movies in Italian and German that compares two AI systems, a GPT-4o- and a Qwen-based pipeline, against human-authored descriptions. Professional audio describers rated description quality and annotated errors using a detailed error taxonomy that includes content, character, fluency and coherence errors. The results show that while GPT-4o outperforms the Qwen models, both AI systems still fall short of human professional quality: the generated descriptions show substantially higher error rates and lower quality ratings. Based on the error annotations, we identify two key areas that require improvement: 1) character references, which includes both issues with identification and coherent naming, and 2) content errors and hallucinations, where the AD misrepresents or invents events. These error types are particularly critical, as they directly affect the viewer's ability to follow the narrative.

AI.tldr: 本文对意大利语和德语电影的AI生成音频描述（AD）脚本进行专家评估，比较GPT-4o流水线与Qwen流水线同人工撰写描述的质量差异。
AI.motivation: 专业AD制作成本高，限制了视障（BLV）受众对视频等视觉媒体的可及性；近年AI方法可自动生成AD脚本与音频，但其质量是否可用尚缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 由专业音频描述员依据含内容、角色、流畅性与连贯性四类错误的细粒度错误分类体系，对GPT-4o与Qwen两种AI系统生成的AD脚本及人工描述进行质量评分与错误标注。
AI.result: GPT-4o优于Qwen模型，但两种AI系统均未达到人类专业水平：生成描述的错误率显著更高、质量评分更低。错误集中体现为两类核心问题：1）角色指称（识别与命名一致性）；2）内容错误与幻觉（错误表述或虚构事件）。
AI.conclusion: AI生成AD尚不能替代专业人工描述；未来改进应重点针对角色指称一致性与内容幻觉，因其直接影响观众对叙事的理解。

title: Meddies-PII: A Multilingual Framework for Personally Identifiable Information Extraction in Clinical De-identification
summary: Multilingual PII extraction in clinical text is limited by scarce governed data and by synthetic corpora whose construction is thinly documented. We present a large multilingual dataset covering seventeen languages, including seven Southeast Asian languages, and nine PII labels. We also document a detailed generation pipeline and release the complete prompts, catalogues, checks and label maps. A compact 350M-parameter BIOES token classifier trained on the resource achieves the highest score on all fifteen public benchmarks, significantly ahead of the strongest of four public systems on fourteen of them, with a mean exact-match F1 of 0.827 against 0.672 for the strongest system. We also tested it, without adaptation, on multilingual benchmarks, including two human-annotated German and Spanish clinical-style corpora, where it is competitive with the best public systems once annotation conventions are aligned, and is best in four of ten MultiGraSCCo languages; the results show that performance transfers across public benchmarks. We also analyse the data and find almost no near-duplicates and no text overlap between training and any evaluation set. The dataset, benchmark, model, generation framework and evaluation code are planned for public release upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出覆盖17种语言（含7种东南亚语言）、9类PII标签的大规模多语言临床文本数据集，公开完整生成流程，并用350M参数的BIOES序列标注模型在15个公开基准上取得最优表现（平均exact-match F1 0.827，最强公开系统为0.672）。
AI.motivation: 临床文本中的多语言PII抽取受制于两类问题：一是受治理的（可合规使用）真实数据稀缺；二是合成语料的构建过程文档化不足，难以复现与评估。因此需要一个大规模、多语言、流程透明的资源来支撑该任务。
AI.method: 构建覆盖17种语言（含7种东南亚语言）与9类PII标签的数据集；详细记录合成生成流水线，并公开全部prompt、类别目录（catalogue）、校验规则与标签映射；训练一个紧凑的350M参数BIOES标注式token分类器；在15个公开基准及多语言基准（含两个人工标注的德语、西班牙语临床风格语料与MultiGraSCCo）上做零适配评测；并进行数据质量分析（近重复检测、训练-评测集文本重叠检测）。
AI.result: 模型在全部15个公开基准上均取得最高分，在其中14个上显著优于四个公开系统中的最强系统；平均exact-match F1达0.827（最强公开系统0.672）。零适配迁移至多语言基准后，在标注规范对齐后与最佳公开系统相当，并在MultiGraSCCo的10种语言中有4种最优，表明性能可跨公开基准迁移。数据分析显示语料几乎不存在近重复，训练集与任何评测集之间无文本重叠。
AI.conclusion: 一个紧凑的350M模型配合流程透明的大规模多语言合成数据，即可在临床PII抽取上超越更大的公开系统，并具备跨基准、跨语言的迁移能力；发布包含数据集、基准、模型、生成框架与评测代码在内的完整资源（拟于录用后公开）。

title: Endpoint-Conditioned Process Value: What an Endpoint-Blind Process Score Adds Once Terminal Status and Cost Are Known
summary: Trajectory metrics promise information beyond final-answer accuracy, but no one has measured what a process score adds once an evaluation knows the outcome and the cost. We build that comparison: a sealed consequence needing an artifact neither agent nor judge ever sees, an operational baseline of terminal status and cost, and judge scale and evidence access as experimental factors. On 1,255 trajectories over 158 test-generation tasks in 7 Python repositories, the answer is gated on the judge. Four judges from 4B to 14B, one reasoning before scoring, add nothing an interval separates from zero; a Qwen3 32B judge on identical trajectories adds +0.050 AUC (95% CI [+0.020, +0.081]) and survives a refitting bootstrap ([+0.013, +0.095]). Most of what it adds is recoverable from eight behavioural counters, so a harness should log them (the judge adds +0.020 beyond them). What the judge is shown moves it further: disclosing the terminal verdict inflates its standalone discrimination by +0.103, while reference disclosure and tool-output redaction move it by nothing an interval separates from zero. A process metric reported without the judge's scale and evidence access does not identify a quantity. We release the protocol, the sealed-endpoint harness, and all trajectories.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统测量了"过程分/轨迹指标"在评价已掌握结果与成本信息之后的增量价值，发现增量几乎完全取决于评判模型规模：4B–14B 评判器增量与零不可区分，仅 Qwen3 32B 带来 +0.050 AUC，且其中大部分可由8个行为计数器复现。
AI.motivation: 轨迹指标被宣称能提供超越最终答案正确率的信息，但此前无人测量：在评估已已知终端结果(outcome)与成本(cost)的条件下，过程分究竟还能增加多少信息。作者希望建立严格的对照框架，检验过程分是否为独立于结果与成本的额外信号。
AI.method: 在7个Python仓库的158个测试生成任务、共1,255条轨迹上构建对照实验。（1）采用"密封终点(sealed endpoint)"：需要一个智能体与评判器都未曾见过的产物，作为无法作弊的后果度量；（2）以终端状态与成本构成操作化基线；（3）将评判器规模与证据访问(evidence access)作为实验因子：4个4B–14B评判器（含一个先推理后打分者）与Qwen3 32B对比；（4）以AUC及自助法重抽样(refitting bootstrap)检验增量显著性；（5）用8个行为计数器做可比基线；（6）操纵披露内容：是否披露终端结论、是否披露参考答案、是否对工具输出做脱敏。
AI.result: 4个4B–14B评判器带来的增量与零无可分辨差异；同一批轨迹上Qwen3 32B评判器增加 +0.050 AUC（95% CI [+0.020, +0.081]），通过重拟合自助法检验（[+0.013, +0.095]）。该增量大部分可由8个行为计数器恢复，评判器仅在此基础上再添 +0.020。披露终端结论使其单独判别力膨胀 +0.103；披露参考答案与工具输出脱敏的影响与零不可区分。结论受评判器门控(gated on the judge)。
AI.conclusion: 过程指标并非一个自明的量：脱离评判器的规模与证据访问条件，无法识别其所测内容。实践中应优先记录8个行为计数器作为低成本、可复现的基线，并仅在具备足够规模评判器时再叠加其信号。作者公开了协议、密封终点harness与全部轨迹。

title: Beyond Omission: Measuring Critical-Information Fulfillment of Large Language Models in Bengali and English
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Data, rubrics, responses, scores and code: https://github.com/HeyAvijitRoy/multilingual-trustworthiness-study
summary: Evaluations of multilingual trustworthiness often ask whether a model leaves out information that a user needs. We examine whether that question is sufficient. Using 157 matched tasks written in English (EN), natural Bengali (BN) and Bengali-matrix Bengali-English code-switching (BN-CS), we scored 1,413 responses from three models (GPT-6.1 Sol, Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma 4 12B) against required information units (RIUs) fixed before any model was run. The scoring separates outright omission from content that is present but incorrect, insufficient or only partly met. The prespecified primary estimand, the domain-equal paired difference in critical omission rate (BN - EN), showed no detectable difference (+0.003, 95% CI -0.014 to +0.015), with omission near zero in every condition. The Bengali deficit appeared in fulfillment instead. Critical coverage was 0.050 lower in Bengali (95% CI 0.022 to 0.079) and strict complete-task success 0.093 lower (95% CI 0.055 to 0.131); both gaps came from the two open-weight models, and Sol showed none. Code-switching recovered part of the loss in RIU coverage (+0.028, 95% CI 0.012 to 0.045). On these data, an omission count alone would have shown no language gap. The automated judge passed prespecified agreement gates after a documented failed first attempt. A blind native-speaker rating of 60 study responses agreed with it on RIU scores (alpha 0.84) and critical RIUs (98% exact) but fell short on Bengali RIU agreement (alpha 0.77) and on the unsupported-content check (93% exact), and a blind check of its reason codes agreed on whether a critical unit was omitted for 79 of 81 units. Data, rubrics, responses, scores and code are released.

AI.tldr: 在157组匹配任务（英、孟加拉语、孟英代码转换）上评估三个模型，发现省略率无语言差异，但孟加拉语存在"信息覆盖不足"缺口，仅靠省略计数会漏掉语言差距。
AI.motivation: 多语言可信度评估通常只问"模型是否遗漏了用户需要的信息"，作者质疑这一单一指标是否充分，需检验省略之外（存在但错误/不充分/部分满足）的失败模式是否隐藏了跨语言差异。
AI.method: 构建157组匹配任务（EN、自然孟加拉语BN、BN矩阵BN-EN代码转换）；预先固定必需信息单元（RIU），对3个模型（GPT-6.1 Sol、Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma 4 12B）的1413条回答评分，区分"完全省略"与"存在但不正确/不充分/部分满足"；主要估计量为域均衡配对的临界省略率差（BN−EN）；辅以领域均衡的临界覆盖率、严格全任务成功率分析；采用自动评判器（首次尝试失败后通过预设一致性门槛），并用盲评母语者（60条回答）进行效度验证。
AI.result: 临界省略率BN−EN差为+0.003（95%CI −0.014~+0.015），各条件下省略率近零，无显著差异。孟加拉语缺口体现在完成度：临界覆盖率低0.050（95%CI 0.022~0.079），严格全任务成功率低0.093（95%CI 0.055~0.131）；两者均来自两个开放权重模型，Sol无缺口。代码转换挽回部分RIU覆盖损失（+0.028，95%CI 0.012~0.045）。盲评与自动评判在RIU得分（α=0.84）与临界RIU（98%完全一致）上吻合，但孟加拉语RIU一致性较低（α=0.77）、无支撑内容检查93%一致；理由码在81个单元中79个判断一致。
AI.conclusion: 仅统计省略会得出"无语言差距"的错误结论；多语言可信度评估须纳入覆盖充分性与严格任务成功等完成度指标，才能揭示真实差距。缺口集中于开放权重模型而非Sol，代码转换可部分缓解。数据、评分标准、回答、分数与代码均已公开。

title: Reducing Permutation Sensitivity in Multimodal Large Language Models via Shared Positions and Attention-Only Distillation
summary: In this paper, we conduct a systematic study on improving permutation robustness while preserving accuracy. First, we categorize permutation bias phenomena into four representative scenarios. Then, we take the multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) dataset as an example under text-option reordering scenario to analyze the root cause of permutation bias. Based on this root cause analysis and set encoding strategy, we investigate shared positions with blocked cross-unit attention (SP-B) and extend this design to bidirectional cross-unit attention (SP-V) for modality exchange. However, these structural changes may reduce predictive accuracy. To recover model capability across different scenarios under the SP structure, an attention-only distillation from frozen native models is proposed. Shared positions reduce permutation sensitivity, and attention-only distillation improves accuracy under the shared-position structure. Across all three models, our method is comparable to or better than majority voting in macro-average all-permutation accuracy, and outperforms supervised fine-tuning by 1.95-4.20 percentage points. This work provides valuable insight into permutation bias mitigation and model capability recovery.

AI.tldr: 提出"共享位置"结构(SP-B/SP-V)与仅注意力蒸馏,在降低排列敏感性的同时恢复精度。
AI.motivation: 模型存在排列偏置(permutation bias),即对输入单元(如选项)顺序敏感,影响鲁棒性;需在保持准确率的前提下提升排列鲁棒性。
AI.method: 将排列偏置现象归纳为四类代表性场景;以多选题问答(MCQA)的文本选项重排场景为例做根因分析;基于根因与集合编码策略,设计带阻塞式跨单元注意力的共享位置结构(SP-B),并扩展为双向跨单元注意力(SP-V)以支持模态交互;为弥补结构改动带来的精度损失,提出对冻结原生模型的仅注意力蒸馏。
AI.result: 共享位置降低排列敏感性,仅注意力蒸馏在共享位置结构下提升精度;三个模型上宏平均全排列准确率与多数投票相当或更优,较监督微调高出1.95–4.20个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 共享位置+仅注意力蒸馏可有效缓解排列偏置并恢复模型能力,为排列鲁棒性研究提供思路。

title: SupportChain: Trace-Calibrated Aggregation of Quote-Grounded Reasoning Chains for Multi-Hop RAG with Small Readers
summary: Strong results in multi-hop retrieval-augmented question answering come from graph indexes read by models of 70B parameters or more, and building such an index calls a large language model over the whole corpus. We present SupportChain, which splits a question into hops, binds each hop's answer to a sentence quoted from a retrieved passage, estimates how reliable each execution is from its own trace, and merges several executions by the support of their answers, the pooled reliability of the executions that agree, stopping once support is high enough. With a 9B reader under the HippoRAG~2 protocol, SupportChain reaches 63.0 F1 on MuSiQue, above the best earlier result of 59.2, which used a 20B reader. With the same reader and embedder, it is significantly better than HippoRAG~2 on all five datasets, by up to 17.2 F1, and it builds no index. Merging by support is significantly better than majority voting, and than letting the reader choose among the candidates, on three of the five datasets and level with both on the other two. The reliability model needs only 100 answered training questions.

AI.tldr: SupportChain 用“分跳推理+句子级答案绑定+自估可靠性+按支持度合并”替代图谱索引，用 9B 读者在 MuSiQue 上取得 63.0 F1，超过此前依赖 20B 读者的最好结果 59.2，且在五个数据集上显著优于 HippoRAG 2，且无需构建索引。
AI.motivation: 现有多跳检索增强问答的强结果依赖 70B 以上模型读取图索引，而图索引本身需用大模型处理整个语料库，成本高。作者希望在不构建索引、使用较小读者模型的前提下获得更强的多跳问答性能。
AI.method: SupportChain 将问题拆分为多个跳（hop）；每一跳的答案必须绑定到从检索段落中引用的句子，从而提供可验证依据；根据每次执行的自身轨迹估计其可靠性；对多次执行按答案支持度合并——将答案一致的执行可靠性加总，达到足够支持度即停止。
AI.result: 在 HippoRAG 2 协议下使用 9B 读者，MuSiQue 上达 63.0 F1（此前最佳为 20B 读者的 59.2）；相同读者与嵌入器下，在全部五个数据集上显著优于 HippoRAG 2，最高提升 17.2 F1；按支持度合并显著优于多数投票与让读者自选候选（三个数据集上显著更好，另两个持平）；可靠性模型仅需 100 个带答案的训练问题。
AI.conclusion: 无需图索引、依赖较小读者模型的多跳检索增强问答可超越高成本大规模模型方案；支持度合并优于常规集成与自选择策略，且可靠性估计数据效率高。

title: Edit-Induced Dependency Mismatch: Propagation Omissions, Recovery, and Evaluation Blind Spots in Coding Agents
summary: During iterative code modification, coding agents may continue to rely in subsequent reasoning on outdated dependency judgments whose text remains fixed in the context, leading to errors in subsequent reasoning and leaving consumer defects undetected by the original task evaluations, thereby exposing blind spots in the tested benchmarks. We study actual agent execution trajectories collected on benchmark tasks: deepseek-v4-flash runs on DeepSWE and SWE-bench Verified, supplemented by Qwen3.8-Flash cases on FeatureBench. Focusing on edit-induced consumer obligations, a full-corpus blinded human audit of the DeepSWE runs identifies terminal mismatches, including diagnoses whose task scope remains disputed. Following supplementary execution checks, all retained DeepSWE terminal events have execution support. The audit also shows that recovery within a trajectory can coexist with terminal omissions in the same run. The process analysis links the presentation of relevant consumer code to explicit dependency judgments and subsequent synchronization actions recorded in the trajectories. An explicit dependency-review prompt reduces terminal omissions under the tested conditions, supporting re-derivation of consumer obligations after edits. Local replays of selected DeepSWE cases show that synchronizing the diagnosed consumers restores the target behavior while the listed controls continue to pass. Cross-benchmark execution counterexamples show that the original task evaluations do not fully detect edit-induced dependency mismatches: patches pass those evaluations, yet additional execution checks confirm unintended defects along existing consumer paths. These findings support measuring task scores, terminal propagation states, and recovery separately.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究迭代式代码修改中，代码智能体因依赖判断在上下文中被"冻结"而在后续推理中沿用过时判断，导致消费者缺陷未被原任务评测捕获的问题。
AI.motivation: 迭代修改代码时，一旦智能体在上下文中写出依赖判断文本，后续推理会持续依赖这份过时判断，产生错误并留下消费者缺陷；而现有基准的原始任务评测无法发现这些缺陷，形成评测盲区。论文旨在揭示并量化这一盲区，并区分任务得分、终端传播状态与恢复能力三类指标。
AI.method: 收集真实执行轨迹：deepseek-v4-flash 在 DeepSWE 与 SWE-bench Verified 上运行，辅以 Qwen3.8-Flash 在 FeatureBench 上的案例。围绕"编辑诱发的消费者义务"，对 DeepSWE 全部运行做全语料盲审人工审计，识别终端不匹配事件；并辅以执行校验确认终端事件有执行支撑。过程分析将相关消费者代码的呈现与轨迹中显式依赖判断、后续同步动作关联。另做显式依赖审查提示的干预实验，以及对选定 DeepSWE 案例的本地重放（同步已诊断消费者后验证目标行为恢复、对照项仍通过），并做跨基准执行反例检验。
AI.result: 审计发现终端不匹配事件，包括任务范围仍有争议的诊断；经补充执行检查后，保留的 DeepSWE 终端事件均有执行支撑。审计还显示同一轨迹内的局部恢复可与终端遗漏并存。过程分析表明消费者代码的呈现与显式依赖判断及后续同步动作相关；显式依赖审查提示在测试条件下减少终端遗漏。本地重放显示同步已诊断的消费者可恢复目标行为，对照项继续通过。跨基准执行反例显示补丁虽通过原始评测，但额外执行检查确认了沿既有消费者路径的非预期缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 原始任务评测不能完全检测编辑诱发的依赖不匹配；应分别度量任务得分、终端传播状态与恢复能力，并在编辑后重新推导消费者义务。

title: Grounding Collaborative Agents in Group Cognition
summary: Collaborative agents joining an ongoing team rely on shared context to connect multi-party interaction histories with downstream coordination decisions. Existing work typically focuses either on retrieving historical facts from conversation logs, which surfaces isolated evidence without capturing who knows or owns what, or on evaluating end-to-end interactions, which conflates preparation with execution and lacks direct supervision because a team's history has no single ground-truth summary. To bridge this gap, we formulate group briefing, the task of reconstructing task-relevant group cognition across participants' expressed beliefs, group dynamics, and grounding gaps, and introduce a four-domain benchmark of 1,351 requests and 9,975 verified reference points paired with a two-stage evaluation pipeline combining reference-point coverage and downstream collaboration simulation. Using this pipeline, we show that GroupBrief, a simple task-guided approach that iteratively probes the message history and synthesizes a structured brief without offline memory indexing or graph construction, outperforms ten retrieval and agent-memory baselines in overall coverage with gpt-5.4-mini, while benchmarking nine language models reveals that prospective friction remains harder to recover than past state across model scales. We further use reference-point coverage as a feedback signal for harness optimization, refining GroupBrief's retrieval and synthesis instructions while keeping model weights frozen. On held-out Test projects, GroupBrief (optimized) improves coverage by 2.54 percentage points for gpt-5.4-mini and 12.88 for gpt-5.6-luna, achieving 64.46% and 68.42% preference over no brief in downstream simulations. These results establish our benchmark and evaluation pipeline as a foundation for measuring and optimizing how collaborative agents ground in group cognition.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"群体简报（group briefing）"任务与四领域基准（1,351条请求、9,975个验证参考点）及两阶段评测管线，证明简单任务引导方法GroupBrief优于十种检索/智能体记忆基线，并可仅通过提示词优化（冻结权重）进一步提升覆盖率与下游协作表现。
AI.motivation: 协作智能体加入进行中的团队时需依赖共享上下文将多方交互历史与后续协调决策连接起来。现有工作要么只从对话日志检索孤立事实、无法刻画"谁知道/拥有什么"，要么只评估端到端交互，把准备与执行混为一谈，且团队历史不存在单一真值摘要，缺乏直接监督信号。
AI.method: 形式化定义group briefing任务：在参与者的表达信念、群体动态与grounding gaps上重建任务相关的群体认知。构建四领域基准（1,351条请求、9,975个已验证参考点），配套两阶段评测管线：参考点覆盖率 + 下游协作仿真。提出GroupBrief——任务引导式迭代探查消息历史并合成结构化简报，无需离线记忆索引或图构建；并以其覆盖率为反馈信号对harness（检索与合成指令）做优化，模型权重保持冻结。
AI.result: 在gpt-5.4-mini下，GroupBrief整体覆盖率优于十种检索与智能体记忆基线；对九个语言模型的基准测试显示，跨模型规模"前瞻性摩擦（prospective friction）"比"过去状态"更难恢复。优化后GroupBrief在留出测试项目上覆盖率分别提升2.54个百分点（gpt-5.4-mini）和12.88个百分点（gpt-5.6-luna），下游仿真中相对无简报的偏好率为64.46%与68.42%。
AI.conclusion: 该基准与评测管线为测量与优化协作智能体如何ground于群体认知提供了基础，并表明无需微调模型、仅凭覆盖率反馈的提示词层优化即可显著提升群体简报质量与下游协作效果。

title: GlobalHRBench: Does Changing the Question Language Change the Legal Answer?
summary: Language matters when deploying LLM agents across borders, especially in law, where the governing rules must hold across working languages. Does changing the language of a legal question change answer accuracy? We introduce GlobalHRBench, pairing 240 employment-law problems across eight jurisdictions and eight languages while fixing facts, applicable law and required conclusions. We evaluate nine models on all 1,920 prompts in independent, closed-book, single-answer trials, scoring legal correctness, completeness and answer-language compliance. GPT-6.1 Sol leads at 76.2% strict passes, with a 5.8% relative best-to-worst language decline, compared with 42.2% for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Kimi K3.1 Pro and Claude Sonnet 5.5 reverse order between English and Chinese. A four-model study on 16 paired families compares closed-book answers with governing evidence, added cross-jurisdiction distractors and removal of a governing passage. Governing evidence corrects legal errors and shortens reasoning on recovered answers, yet recognizing an evidence gap does not ensure correct application of the rules that remain. These findings motivate multilingual training for accurate, efficient and evidence-supported answers, and deployment evaluation in the user's working language.

AI.tldr: 提出 GlobalHRBench，用 8 个法域 × 8 种语言的 240 道劳动法题（固定事实、准据法与结论）检验语言切换对法律问答准确率的影响，发现模型间语言鲁棒性差异显著，并揭示"识别证据缺口≠正确适用剩余规则"。
AI.motivation: 跨国部署 LLM 智能体时语言差异不可忽视，法律领域尤甚：准据规则须在各工作语言下保持一致。核心问题：改变提问语言是否改变法律答案的正确性？现有基准未在固定事实与准据法的前提下系统考察语言效应。
AI.method: 构建 GlobalHRBench：240 道劳动法问题，覆盖 8 个法域、8 种语言，事实、适用法律与所需结论均受控。9 个模型在 1,920 条提示上进行独立、闭卷、单答案测试，评分维度为法律正确性、完整性与答案语言合规性。另对 16 组配对族做四模型研究，对比闭卷回答与：给出准据证据、加入跨法域干扰项、删除关键条款三种设置。
AI.result: GPT-6.1 Sol 以 76.2% 严格通过率领先，最佳到最差语言间相对下降 5.8%；DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 仅 42.2%。Kimi K3.1 Pro 与 Claude Sonnet 5.5 在中英文之间出现名次反转。证据实验表明：准据证据可纠正法律错误并缩短被恢复答案的推理链，但模型仅在识别证据缺口并不足以保证正确适用剩余规则。
AI.conclusion: 语言是法律智能体部署的关键变量，模型间语言鲁棒性差距悬殊。应开展多语言训练以产出准确、高效且有证据支撑的答案，并按用户的实际工作语言进行部署评测。

title: StutterStigma-TR: A Novel Turkish Dataset and Target-Aware BERT Framework for Stuttering-Related Stigma Detection
summary: Computational research on disability-related ableist harm remains limited, and condition specific resources for stuttering-related stigma are particularly scarce. This study introduces StutterStigma-TR, a Turkish dataset of 6,019 public X/Twitter posts annotated as Stigmatizing, Non-stigmatizing/contextual, or Supportive using a speech and language therapy-informed protocol with independent lived-experience evaluation. We also propose StutterStigma-BERT, a BERTurk-based target-aware framework that combines explicit target marking, target-span representation, target-conditioned context, character-level and handcrafted orthographic information, and gated discourse cues. The framework is evaluated in complementary three-class and binary settings using controlled three-seed ablation analyses and final 20-seed robustness evaluations. Under the common training protocol, Gated Discourse-OrthoTarget trained with cross-entropy is selected as the final configuration for both tasks based on internal-validation Macro-F1. Across 20 random seeds, the final three-class model achieves a mean Macro-F1 of 73.54%, while the final binary model achieves 85.17% using validation-selected decision thresholds. Task adapted harmful-language comparators are additionally evaluated under the common training protocol, and the proposed model obtains the highest mean Macro-F1 among them. For the primary three-class task, matched backbone analyses show higher internal validation Macro-F1 with BERTurk than with TurkishBERTweet or Turkish Mamba, while substantial train-validation separation persists across all three backbones. Separate direct-transfer and zero-shot experiments examine performance without StutterStigma-TR supervision. Across the task-adapted, direct-transfer, and zero-shot comparisons, the condition-specific supervised systems retain the strongest aggregate performance.

AI.tldr: 该文构建土耳其语口吃污名数据集StutterStigma-TR（6,019条X帖子，三分类标注），并提出基于BERTurk的目标感知框架StutterStigma-BERT，在三分类与二分类任务上分别取得73.54%与85.17%的平均Macro-F1。
AI.motivation: 针对残障相关能力主义伤害的计算研究有限，口吃相关的特定条件资源尤为稀缺，缺乏可用的口吃污名检测数据与方法。
AI.method: 构建StutterStigma-TR土耳其语数据集，采用言语治疗知情协议并结合独立的生活经验者评估进行三分类标注（污名化/非污名化-语境化/支持性）；提出StutterStigma-BERT，融合显式目标标记、目标跨度表示、目标条件上下文、字符级与手工正交特征及门控话语线索；采用三种子消融与20种子鲁棒性评估，并设置任务适配、直接迁移与零样本对比实验。
AI.result: Gated Discourse-OrthoTarget + 交叉熵为最终配置；20种子下三分类平均Macro-F1为73.54%，二分类为85.17%（验证集选择阈值）；在任务适配的有害语言对比系统中平均Macro-F1最高；同骨干对比中BERTurk内部验证Macro-F1优于TurkishBERTweet与Turkish Mamba，但三者均存在明显训练-验证间隔。
AI.conclusion: 特定条件的有监督系统在任务适配、直接迁移与零样本比较中均保持最强综合性能，表明口吃专项监督数据与目标感知建模不可替代。

title: Ontology-Compiled 2D Clinical State Fields with Bidirectional Diffusion Encoders for Zero-Training Cross-Ontology Medical Coding
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 4 main tables, 5 supplementary tables. Code available at https://github.com/ZeqiangWangAI/OCSF
summary: Healthcare systems continually revise clinical taxonomies, update reimbursement schedules, and harmonize cross-border registries. Existing automated coding models bind clinical text understanding to fixed vocabulary-specific heads, requiring manual relabeling and retraining whenever code sets change. We introduce Ontology-Compiled 2D Clinical State Fields (OCSF), a vocabulary-free framework that decouples clinical document reading from target ontology indexing so one trained encoder can switch across arbitrary medical vocabularies in seconds without target training. A single-pass bidirectional diffusion-pretrained encoder and vocabulary-free decoder map each clinical note into a fixed-dimension two-dimensional state matrix with zero code-specific parameters. Any target ontology is compiled offline on CPU from public text descriptions into a scale-invariant Tikhonov deconvolution operator that suppresses sibling-code interference while preserving source decision thresholds. Trained solely on English MIMIC-IV ICD-9 discharge summaries and evaluated without target tuning across 58,706 held-out test notes and five unseen ontologies spanning English ICD-10, MS-DRG, Spanish, Greek, and Chinese (115-185,458 codes), OCSF reaches 63.15% Micro-F1 on in-domain ICD-9 (outperforming a matched closed-vocabulary classifier and eliminating late-epoch tail overfitting) and transfers directly to 26,085 English ICD-10 codes (29.23% recall at gold cardinality), MS-DRG groups, and multilingual terminologies, compiling up to 185,458 codes in under 10 seconds on CPU with sub-millisecond GPU readout.

AI.tldr: 提出OCSF——一个"词汇无关"的临床文本自动编码框架，将对文本的理解与目标本体索引解耦：单一编码器生成固定的二维状态矩阵，任意目标本体可离线编译为Tikhonov反卷积算子，从而在数秒内切换编码体系而无需在目标上训练。在英文ICD-9上训练后，直接迁移至ICD-10、MS-DRG及中西希等多语种本体，最多编译185,458个编码耗时不足10秒（CPU）。
AI.motivation: 现有自动编码模型将临床文本理解绑定在固定的、词汇特定的输出头上，一旦临床分类体系更新、报销编码修订或跨域登记库统一，就必须人工重新标注并重训练。作者希望实现"一次训练、任意本体"的可切换编码，消除对目标词汇的标注与训练依赖。
AI.method: OCSF：①单遍（single-pass）双向扩散预训练编码器 + 词汇无关解码器，将每条病历映射为固定维度的二维状态矩阵，不含任何编码专属参数；②任意目标本体由公开文本描述在CPU上离线编译为尺度不变的Tikhonov反卷积算子，抑制同级（sibling）编码干扰并保留源域判决阈值；③仅用英文MIMIC-IV的ICD-9出院小结训练。
AI.result: 在58,706条留出测试病历、五个未见本体（英文ICD-10、MS-DRG、西班牙语、希腊语、中文，规模115–185,458码）上不做目标调优：域内ICD-9达63.15% Micro-F1，优于匹配的闭集分类器并消除后期训练尾部过拟合；直接迁移至26,085个英文ICD-10码（金标准基数下召回29.23%）及MS-DRG分组与多语种术语；最多185,458个码在CPU上编译<10秒，GPU读出为亚毫秒级。
AI.conclusion: 将"读文本"与"编目标本体"解耦的范式可行：词汇无关的固定状态表示配合离线编译的算子，使单一模型可免训练切换任意大规模、多语种临床编码体系，且编译与推理开销极低，具备面向编码体系持续演进的部署价值。

title: How Relations Impose Embedding-Space Structure
summary: Language models are known to encode simple relations, such as synonymy, in the geometry of their representations. It is unclear whether they also encode complex patterns of relationships such as those that drive analogy. We present a simple method, with no learned parameters, based on comparing the internal structural arrangements between disparate domains, to test this. Using our method we find over multiple models that representations are arranged consistently to encode complex relationship similarities. Models align distant representation clouds so that facets of meaning are easily comparable under simple mappings. Our work extends mechanistic accounts of representation space to the relative arrangement of representations that may be only weakly related to one another, showing that representation geometry is far richer than previously thought. Code and data: https://github.com/lcowley7/embedded_relationships

AI.tldr: 提出一种无学习参数的简单方法，通过比较不同域之间内部结构排列，检验语言模型表征几何是否编码类比驱动的复杂关系模式。
AI.motivation: 已知语言模型在表征几何中编码同义等简单关系，但尚不清楚是否编码类比这类复杂关系模式。
AI.method: 基于比较不同域之间内部结构排列的简单方法，不含任何学习参数，并在多个模型上进行检验。
AI.result: 多个模型中表征的排列方式一致地编码了复杂关系相似性；模型能对齐相距较远的表征云，使语义侧面在简单映射下易于比较。
AI.conclusion: 将表征空间的机制性解释拓展到可能仅弱相关的表征之间的相对排列，表明表征几何比以往认为的更为丰富；代码与数据已公开。

title: MedCoast: Semantic Abstraction of Reasoning Trajectories for Test-Time Biomedical Question Answering
summary: Biomedical question answering often requires multi-step reasoning under limited inference budgets. While test-time search methods such as Tree-of-Thought can improve reasoning performance, directly searching over free-form language is computationally expensive and highly redundant, as many reasoning trajectories contain semantically equivalent intermediate steps expressed in different surface forms. We introduce MedCoast, an offline-to-online reasoning framework that converts sampled chain-of-thought trajectories into a compact space for structured process supervision. Offline, we recursively cluster semantically similar reasoning steps under shared prefixes to construct an abstract reasoning tree that captures recurring clinical reasoning patterns. We then derive node-level supervision from progress toward correct solutions, and train a lightweight process reward model (PRM) to evaluate partial reasoning states. At inference time, the learned critic guides test-time exploration by prioritizing promising reasoning prefixes. Across seven biomedical QA benchmarks, MedCoast often improves over self-consistency under fixed inference budgets, with gains of up to 15 points. Despite using a reward model more than 50 times smaller, MedCoast achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art reward models in several settings, highlighting its potential for resource-constrained biomedical reasoning.

AI.tldr: MedCoast将采样的思维链轨迹转化为紧凑的抽象推理树，离线做节点级过程监督训练轻量PRM，在线用该critic引导测试时探索，在固定推理预算下提升生物医学问答推理性能。
AI.motivation: 生物医学问答需要有限推理预算下的多步推理；Tree-of-Thought等测试时搜索虽有效，但在自由形式语言空间搜索计算昂贵且高度冗余——许多推理轨迹含语义等价但表述不同的中间步骤。
AI.method: 离线阶段：在共享前缀下递归聚类语义相似的推理步骤，构建刻画重复临床推理模式的抽象推理树；由通向正确解的过程进度推导节点级监督信号，训练轻量过程奖励模型（PRM）评估部分推理状态。推理阶段：学到的critic对候选推理前缀排序，优先探索有希望的推理前缀以引导测试时探索。
AI.result: 在七个生物医学QA基准上，固定推理预算下常优于self-consistency，提升最高达15个百分点；奖励模型规模小于50倍以上，在多种设置下性能可与最先进奖励模型相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过抽象推理树实现结构化过程监督，可有效压缩冗余搜索空间并以轻量PRM引导测试时搜索，为资源受限场景下的生物医学推理提供可行方案。

title: BIRD-Persona: A Persona-Aware Benchmark for SQL and pandas Analytics Code Generation
summary: Production text-to-code systems use large language models to turn natural-language analytics requests into executable SQL and pandas code. Existing benchmarks cover both tasks but do not isolate when performance diverges between them. We introduce BIRD-Persona, a persona-stratified extension of BIRD-Python that adds novice and expert rewrites to tasks with matched SQL and pandas ground truth, along with schema variants and task-structure annotations. Across 1,534 tasks, nine models, and 245,592 evaluations, SQL outperforms pandas for eight of nine systems. The gap varies by condition: expert, schema-explicit prompts improve both paradigms but help SQL more; schema representations have mixed, model-dependent effects; and selected-column burden widens the gap while subqueries do not. By making user phrasing a controlled benchmark dimension, BIRD-Persona supports persona-aware and paradigm-aware evaluation of natural-language analytics systems. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/optum-cognition-lab/BIRD-Persona.

AI.tldr: 提出 BIRD-Persona 基准，通过人格分层（新手/专家改写）与匹配的 SQL/pandas 真值，隔离性地考察文本到代码系统在 SQL 与 pandas 两种范式上的性能差异及其条件依赖性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准虽覆盖 SQL 和 pandas 两类任务，但未隔离出二者性能何时出现分歧；用户表述风格（人格/措辞）这一因素也缺乏受控的实验维度。
AI.method: 在 BIRD-Python 基础上构建人格分层扩展：为具有匹配 SQL 与 pandas 真值的任务增加新手与专家两种改写，并加入 schema 变体与任务结构标注；在 1,534 个任务、9 个模型、245,592 次评测上进行受控对比。
AI.result: 九个系统中有八个 SQL 优于 pandas；差距随条件变化：专家且 schema 显式提示对两种范式均有提升但更利于 SQL；schema 表示方式影响不一且依赖模型；选择列负担扩大差距，而子查询不扩大。
AI.conclusion: 将用户措辞作为受控基准维度，可支撑人格感知与范式感知的自然语言分析系统评测；数据集已公开。

title: Information Access and Gain-Loss Framing in Six Large Language Models and Human Decision Makers
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures. Code and model outputs: https://github.com/aadycm/Humans-Vs-LLM-Research
summary: A risky choice can be described by what will be saved or what will be lost, and people often choose differently depending on that wording. We test whether six large language models (LLMs) show this gain-loss framing effect, and whether it shrinks when they can first read more about the options. GPT-4.1, GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Qwen3 235B and Llama 4 Maverick made 11,519 choices across four risk scenarios, each in its original wording, two paraphrases and a mirrored version in the opposite wording. Before choosing, a model could open up to 0, 2, 3 or 4 of seven information cards. With no cards, all six models showed large framing effects: the share choosing the safe option was 27 to 79 percentage points lower under loss than under gain wording. The gap was smaller at 2 cards than with no cards in every model. Against a 10-point threshold set in our analysis plan, GPT-4.1 fell within it at 4 cards and Qwen3 only at 2 cards; in the plan's pooled comparison over all versions, GPT-4.1 was within it from 2 cards and GPT-4o from 3. GPT-4o-mini and Llama 4 Maverick kept gaps of 28 to 66 points with cards, and for GPT-4o-mini and Qwen3 the gap grew again from 2 to 4 cards. Part of the drop from 0 to 2 cards may reflect a change in prompt format, and most card content counted against the risky option, which may favor the safe choice. In an exploratory comparison with 198 students who saw the same scenarios and cards but opened cards one at a time and chose how many, decisions made after opening 0 or 1 cards showed a 19-point difference between the gain scenarios, asked first, and the loss scenarios, asked later, and no clear difference appeared in decisions made after opening more, though this design cannot show that cards reduced framing in people. With these cards, in the balanced comparison 17 of 18 card gaps were below the model's no-card gap, but few were within the threshold.

AI.tldr: 研究测试六个大语言模型在得失框架效应下的表现，发现无信息时框架效应显著，提供信息卡后效应普遍缩小，但多数模型仍超出预设阈值。
AI.motivation: 检验LLM是否表现出人类经典的得失框架效应（gain-loss framing effect），以及在获得更多选项信息后该效应是否减弱，从而评估模型决策的稳定性与信息利用能力。
AI.method: GPT-4.1、GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Qwen3 235B、Llama 4 Maverick在四个风险情境中共做出11,519次选择，每个情境含原始措辞、两个改述版本及相反措辞的镜像版本；选择前可打开0–4张（共7张）信息卡。另与198名学生进行探索性对照（逐张打开、自选数量）。以分析计划中预设的10个百分点阈值为判据。
AI.result: 无卡片时六个模型均出现大幅框架效应，损失措辞下选安全项的比例比获益措辞低27–79个百分点；2张卡片时各模型差距均小于无卡片。按10点阈值，GPT-4.1在4张卡时、Qwen3在2张卡时达标；汇总比较中GPT-4.1从2张卡、GPT-4o从3张卡达标。GPT-4o-mini与Llama 4 Maverick即便有卡片仍保持28–66点差距，且GPT-4o-mini与Qwen3从2到4张卡差距反而回升。0→2张卡的下降部分可能源于提示格式变化，且多数卡片内容不利于风险选项。学生实验中，打开0或1张卡后获益（先问）与损失（后问）情境相差19点，更多卡片后无明显差异，但该设计无法证明卡片在人身上降低了框架效应。
AI.conclusion: 信息卡在均衡比较中使18个卡片差距中的17个低于对应无卡片差距，说明额外信息可部分削弱LLM的框架效应，但极少落入预设阈值，效应减弱有限且不稳定，且受提示格式与卡片内容偏向影响。

title: SnakeTranslate: Weakly Supervised Policy Learning from Offline Parallel Text for Simultaneous Translation
summary: Adaptive simultaneous translation requires reliable prefix translation and timely READ/WRITE decisions, but ordinary parallel corpora provide no action annotations. We present SnakeTranslate, which adapts loss-derived alignment to sampled causal histories for jointly learning both capabilities. The framework supports supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on parallel text and on-policy distillation (OPD) with reverse Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence on student-generated translations. At inference, source and target tokens form one append-only interleaved history, enabling incremental decoding with cache reuse. On FLEURS, NTREX128, and WMT24++, our 4B model improves quality--latency trade-offs over streaming policies applied to the same offline-tuned backbone, with further gains from OPD. It also compares favorably with larger translation models at low and moderate latency, while higher-latency quality gaps remain on WMT24++.

AI.tldr: SnakeTranslate 将损失导出的对齐适配到采样的因果历史上，联合学习前缀翻译与 READ/WRITE 决策，在 FLEURS、NTREX128、WMT24++ 上改善质量—延迟权衡。
AI.motivation: 自适应同声传译需要可靠的前缀翻译和及时的 READ/WRITE 决策，而普通平行语料不提供任何动作标注，导致决策能力缺乏直接监督信号。
AI.method: 把由损失导出的对齐信息适配到采样的因果历史上，以联合学习翻译与决策；框架同时支持基于平行文本的监督微调（SFT）与基于学生自生成译文、采用反向 KL 散度的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）；推理时源语言与目标语言 token 构成单一仅追加的交错历史，实现增量解码与缓存复用。
AI.result: 在 FLEURS、NTREX128、WMT24++ 三个基准上，4B 模型相较应用于同一离线微调骨干的流式策略具有更优的质量—延迟权衡，OPD 带来进一步增益；在低与中等延迟下优于更大规模翻译模型，但在 WMT24++ 上高延迟区间仍存在质量差距。
AI.conclusion: 以对齐派生监督替代人工动作标注可有效联合习得前缀翻译与读写决策，交错增量解码配合 OPD 在中小延迟区间具备竞争力，高延迟质量差距为后续改进方向。

title: Distributionally-Verifiable Rewards for Human-Behavior Simulation
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate survey respondents in social-science research. A useful simulator should predict individual responses, reproduce population response distributions, and capture demographic differences. Common training approaches struggle to balance these goals: exact-match rewards encourage the model to concentrate on the most frequent human response, which is contradictory to the goal of distributional alignment. Meanwhile, aggregate distribution matching can look good even when demographic information is ignored. To this end, we introduce Distributionally-Verifiable Rewards (DVR), a reinforcement-learning reward that uses demographic group distribution gaps to guide individual responses, designed by aligning policy generated frequencies with human response frequencies within each question-group margins. We evaluate the method using the OpinionQA dataset and find that comparing with accuracy-only RLVR, DVR preserves per-response accuracy while reducing JSD by 34.5% in-distribution and 14.6% on held-out questions, with higher DPC point estimates on both splits. Comparing KL-SFT with the demographics-blind marginal further shows that low JSD is insufficient to establish fidelity to population heterogeneity, highlighting that accuracy, distributional fit, and demographic structure should be evaluated together.

AI.tldr: 提出分布可验证奖励DVR，用人口统计分组内的分布差距引导强化学习，兼顾个体准确率、整体分布拟合与人口统计差异。
AI.motivation: 大模型日益用于模拟社会调查受访者，理想模拟器需同时满足三点：预测个体回答、复现总体响应分布、捕捉人口统计差异。现有训练方法难以平衡：精确匹配奖励使模型集中于最高频回答，与分布对齐目标矛盾；而聚合分布匹配即使忽略人口统计信息也可能表现良好。
AI.method: 提出DVR（Distributionally-Verifiable Rewards）强化学习奖励：在每个问题—分组边际内，将策略生成频率与人类响应频率对齐，利用人口统计组间分布差距指导个体响应生成。在OpinionQA数据集上评测。
AI.result: 相比仅用准确率的RLVR，DVR在保持逐响应准确率的同时，将JSD在分布内降低34.5%、在留出问题上降低14.6%，两个划分上的DPC点估计均更高。与KL-SFT的方法对比以及对人口统计盲边际的分析表明，低JSD不足以证明对群体异质性的忠实度。
AI.conclusion: 准确率、分布拟合与人口统计结构应联合评估；DVR提供了兼顾三者的可行路径。

title: Medical Specialty Prediction from Bangla Patient Narratives: A Comparative Study of ML, DL, Transformers, and LLMs
comment: Accepted and presented at the 3rd International Conference on Sustainable Development Through Excellence in Higher Education: Contemporary Global Perspectives
summary: Timely access to appropriate medical specialists remains a bottleneck in Bangladesh's healthcare system, as patients describe symptoms in informal Bangla rather than clinical terms, leading to ineffective referrals. This paper compares four model families for predicting medical specialties from Bangla patient narratives: six machine learning (ML) models using hybrid TF-IDF features, four deep learning (DL) models using Word2Vec embeddings trained on the corpus, four fine-tuned transformers, and five large language models (LLMs) evaluated zero-shot. From a corpus of 3798 patient records covering 20 specialties, we retained the five with the most records (Medicine, Gynecology, Dermatology, Pediatrics, Gastroenterology) and split the resulting 2730 records 80:20 into training and test sets shared by all families. The best transformer was XLM-RoBERTa (86.26% accuracy, 86.21% macro-F1), the best ML model was SVM (84.98%, 84.92%), the best DL model was Bidirectional GRU (80.77%, 80.83%), and the best LLM was Gemini (90.29%, 90.15%). Holm-corrected paired McNemar tests show SVM significantly outperforming Bi-LSTM (adjusted p = 0.004), whereas the Gemini-versus-Grok gap does not survive correction (adjusted p = 0.104), and neither the strongest transformer versus the weakest LLM (Grok) nor SVM versus the strongest transformer reaches significance. A tuned classical model is thus statistically indistinguishable from the strongest transformer, so accuracy rankings alone should not be read as evidence of one family's superiority. The findings provide a comparative baseline for Bangla medical text classification.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统比较四类模型族（TF-IDF机器学习、Word2Vec深度学习、微调Transformer、零样本LLM）在孟加拉语患者叙述的科室分类任务上的表现，并强调仅凭准确率不能断言模型族优越性。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国患者以非正式孟加拉语描述症状而非临床术语，导致转诊效率低下、专科可及性受限，需要自动从患者叙述中预测合适科室。
AI.method: 基于3798条、覆盖20个专科的患者记录语料，取记录最多的5个专科（内科、妇科、皮肤科、儿科、消化科）共2730条，按80:20划分统一训练/测试集；比较6个混合TF-IDF机器学习模型、4个基于语料训练的Word2Vec深度学习模型、4个微调Transformer以及5个零样本评估的LLM，并采用Holm校正的配对McNemar检验进行显著性分析。
AI.result: 最佳Transformer为XLM-RoBERTa（86.26%准确率，86.21% macro-F1）；最佳ML为SVM（84.98%，84.92%）；最佳DL为BiGRU（80.77%，80.83%）；最佳LLM为Gemini（90.29%，90.15%）。Holm校正后，SVM显著优于Bi-LSTM（校正p=0.004），而Gemini与Grok的差距不显著（校正p=0.104），最强Transformer与最弱LLM（Grok）之间、SVM与最强Transformer之间均不显著。
AI.conclusion: 调优后的经典模型在统计上与最强Transformer无显著差异，因此准确率排序本身不能作为某一模型族优越的证据；研究为孟加拉语医学文本分类提供了比较基线。

title: Beyond Free-Form Generation: Measuring Interface Composition in Competitive NLP Systems
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EACL 2027
summary: Systems with decoder LLMs can combine free generation with scoring, ranking, or selection. We measure these documented interface combinations with five annotation fields linked to source evidence. The corpora comprise 517 solutions from 42 Kaggle competitions involving NLP and 76 participant systems from 26 SemEval, TREC, and WMT task years. Among eligible generation systems with decoder LLMs, 18 of 55 Kaggle systems and 17 of 20 Shared Task systems are hybrid: free generation coexists with a constrained interface. The remaining systems use free generation alone. Giving each competition or task year equal weight yields hybrid shares of 0.327 and 0.876. Within Eedi, 21 eligible systems with decoder LLMs have five exact interface profiles; ten LLM Science Exam systems share one interface class and have four profiles. Across Kaggle, the eligible systems with decoder LLMs span 18 exact interface profiles, revealing variation within broad task and backbone categories. These estimates characterize documented public systems selected using our selection criteria and include interfaces throughout the complete pipeline, including intermediate stages. The data are available at https://github.com/xiaoxinchenn/nlp-interface-composition.

AI.tldr: 该文实证测量了含解码器LLM系统的"接口组合"（自由生成与约束接口共存的程度），在517个Kaggle方案和76个共享任务系统中发现混合接口普遍存在，且在各竞赛/任务年内加权后混合占比分别为0.327与0.876。
AI.motivation: 含解码器LLM的系统既能自由生成，也能进行打分、排序或选择，但这两类接口在实践中如何组合尚缺乏系统性的测量与刻画。
AI.method: 构建与源证据关联的五个标注字段，对来自42个Kaggle竞赛（涉及NLP）的517个方案，以及来自26个SemEval、TREC、WMT任务年度的76个参赛系统进行接口标注；统计合格系统中"混合接口"（自由生成与约束接口共存）的比例，并按竞赛/任务年等权计算份额，同时统计精确接口剖面数量。
AI.result: 合格生成系统中，55个Kaggle系统里18个、20个共享任务系统里17个为混合接口；等权后混合份额为0.327和0.876。Eedi中21个合格系统有五种精确接口剖面；LLM Science Exam的10个系统同属一个接口类、共四种剖面；Kaggle合格系统跨越18种精确接口剖面，显示在宽泛任务与骨干类别内部仍存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 混合接口在公开的含解码器LLM系统中广泛存在，且覆盖完整流水线（含中间阶段）；上述估计仅刻画按既定筛选准则选出的已公开系统，数据已开源。

title: HyperHarness: Learning to Generate Personalized Agent Harnesses from User Histories
summary: Personalized LLM agents rely on an agent harness, the surrounding memory and control code, to connect user history with downstream decisions. Existing methods typically employ either a single shared memory workflow across all users, which is efficient to deploy but cannot adapt how evidence is retrieved and interpreted across diverse histories, or per-user harness optimization, which customizes behavior for each user but requires costly repeated candidate evaluation at deployment and suffers from sparse, noisy supervision in raw logs. To address this trade-off, we present HyperHarness, a framework that learns a shared history-to-harness generator to synthesize executable, user-specific retrieval and answer-guidance code directly from user histories. Given a user's permitted history, HyperHarness prompts a construction LLM to write personalized retrieval and guidance functions, while downstream task scores across training users supervise iterative refinements to the shared generator without reference harnesses or answering-model updates. At deployment, the frozen generator constructs a harness for each unseen user in a single pass from history alone, eliminating per-user task-scored search. Across three benchmarks (PersonaMemv3, Mem-PAL, and MemoryCD) and three answering models (Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.8-27B, and GPT-5.6-Luna), HyperHarness achieves the highest aggregate score in seven of nine settings and ranks second in the remaining two, improving over the strongest baselines by up to 5.95 points while cutting matched answer-time tokens by 90.32% over long-context prompting. Analyses show that optimization tailors context allocation to each executor, transfers to unseen user clusters, and amortizes adaptation costs.

AI.tldr: HyperHarness 学习一个共享的 history-to-harness 生成器，从用户历史自动合成可执行的个性化检索与回答引导代码，部署时单次前向即可为未见用户构建 harness，避免逐用户搜索。
AI.motivation: 个性化 LLM agent 依赖 agent harness（记忆与控制代码）连接用户历史与下游决策。现有方法存在权衡：全局共享记忆工作流部署高效但无法适配多样历史的证据检索与解读方式；逐用户 harness 优化虽个性化，但部署时需昂贵的重复候选评估，且原始日志中监督信号稀疏、噪声大。
AI.method: 提出 HyperHarness：用构建 LLM 依据用户被允许的历史，提示生成个性化的检索函数与回答引导函数；再由训练用户上的下游任务得分监督共享生成器的迭代精炼，无需参考 harness 或更新回答模型。部署时冻结生成器仅凭历史一次生成 harness，消除逐用户任务打分搜索。
AI.result: 在 PersonaMemv3、Mem-PAL、MemoryCD 三个基准与 Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3.8-27B、GPT-5.6-Luna 三个回答模型组合的 9 个设置中，7 个取得最高综合得分、其余 2 个位列第二；相较最强基线最高提升 5.95 分，并在匹配回答下将回答时 token 相比长上下文提示削减 90.32%。分析显示优化能按执行器定制上下文分配、迁移到未见用户簇、并摊销适配成本。
AI.conclusion: 学习共享生成器而非共享工作流或逐用户优化，可同时获得个性化与可摊销的部署效率，是解决个性化 agent 记忆-控制代码适配权衡的有效范式。

title: CANDOR: A Multilingual Provenance-Documented Corpus for Dysarthric Speech Research
comment: 33 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to Language Resources and Evaluation
summary: CANDOR assembles 61 corpora across 17 languages and five aetiological classes plus a mixed/other group. Its register counts 2,057 speakers classified as dysarthric and 19,538 healthy controls. The collection contains 4,469.7 hours of audio, including 1,178.8 hours in the dysarthric subset. Counts use speech-impairment labels where available and diagnosis labels otherwise. The collection includes 732 dysarthric speakers across 14 non-English languages; 194 speakers use six languages unsupported by Qwen3-ASR, the model underlying its non-English baselines. We document composition, chain of custody, licences and transfer terms, while distinguishing corpus-level provenance from participant-level consent records, which we hold for few constituents. Among 31 dysarthric-bearing corpora, open licences cover 29.0% of corpora, 10.5% of speakers and 8.2% of hours. Excluding the English Speech Accessibility Project raises the open hour share to 31.2%, showing its dependence on this collection's composition. CANDOR cannot be redistributed as a single audio resource; we specify public, restricted and conditional artefacts. Severity labels available in 15 corpora do not provide a validated cross-corpus mapping. Within the non-English ASR baselines, only Mandarin yields a real-speech estimate meeting our evaluation criteria. It differs sharply from the synthesis result and remains imprecise; an English challenge result uses a different model and protocol. CANDOR provides a documented basis for research on under-represented languages while making constraints on evaluation, comparability and sharing explicit.

AI.tldr: CANDOR 是一个由 61 个语料库、17 种语言组成的构音障碍语音资源集合，合计 2,057 名构音障碍说话人与 19,538 名健康对照、4,469.7 小时音频（其中构音障碍子集 1,178.8 小时），并系统记录了组成、来源链、许可与转移条款及评估约束。
AI.motivation: 构音障碍语音研究缺乏跨语料库、跨语言的整合性资源与可追溯的元数据，导致语言覆盖不足、许可与共享边界不清、评估结果难以比较。本文旨在为资源匮乏语言的研究提供有据可依的基础，并显式化评估、可比性与共享方面的约束。
AI.method: 汇集 61 个语料库、覆盖 17 种语言与五个病因类别（另设混合/其他组）；标签在可得时采用言语障碍标签，否则采用诊断标签；记录组成、保管链（chain of custody）、许可证与转移条款，并区分语料库级来源与参与者级知情同意记录；统计开放许可覆盖率，并进行去掉英语 Speech Accessibility Project 后的敏感性分析；依据 15 个语料库中的严重度标签检验跨语料库映射的有效性；在非英语基线中仅对真实语音进行符合评估标准的 ASR 估计，并与合成语音结果对照。
AI.result:
共 2,057 名构音障碍说话人与 19,538 名健康对照，4,469.7 小时音频（构音障碍子集 1,178.8 小时）；732 名构音障碍说话人分布于 14 种非英语语言，其中 194 人使用六种 Qwen3-ASR 不支持的语言。31 个含构音障碍语料库中，开放许可仅覆盖 29.0% 的语料库、10.5% 的说话人和 8.2% 的小时数；剔除英语 Speech Accessibility Project 后开放小时占比升至 31.2%。参与者级同意记录仅对少数构成部分持有。15 个语料库的严重度标签缺乏经验证的跨语料库映射。非英语 ASR 基线中仅普通话给出满足评估标准的真实语音估计，其结果与合成语音结果差异显著且仍不精确；英语挑战赛结果使用不同模型与协议。</result>
<｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter name="conclusion" string="true">CANDOR 无法作为单一音频资源再分发，而按公开、受限与附条件三类制品进行界定。它为资源匮乏语言的研究提供了有文档依据的基础，同时明示了评估、可比性与共享方面的限制。

title: Thakaa at StanceEval-2026: Inference-Time Target Grounding for Arabic Stance Detection
comment: 5 pages, 3 tables. ArabicNLP 2026 shared task. Published in Proceedings of The Fourth Arabic Natural Language Processing Conference: Shared Tasks
summary: StanceEval-2026 tests Arabic stance classification under target shift, with evaluation targets absent from the labelled task data. We test two ways to supply target information at inference time. For Track 1, we retrieve eight labelled Women Driving demonstrations from the external ArabicStanceX corpus and score the three label tokens with Gemma-4-31B-IT. For the unseen-target track, we prepend cached target context prompted to be factual and non-evaluative, then fuse label predictions and label-token scores from multiple LLMs, with final assignments constrained by published class totals. The systems obtain 85.22 and 91.78 Favg2 on Tracks 1 and 2, ranking sixth and fourth in the final standings. On held-out ArabicStanceX tweets, direct prompting scores 79.45 Favg2; eight random Women Driving demonstrations raise it to 84.78, and similarity retrieval reaches 89.04. Across three target-held-out Mawqif evaluations, a fixed target card raises Gemma-4-31B-IT from 86.54 to 86.93, whereas QLoRA lowers Gemma-4-12B-IT from 84.43 to 83.77. In these separate public evaluations, same-target demonstrations and retrieval improve performance, factual target context provides small, target-dependent gains, and the tested source-only adapter does not improve.

AI.tldr: 论文在StanceEval-2026阿拉伯语立场分类任务（含目标迁移的未见目标赛道）上，采用推理期演示检索与目标上下文注入两类目标信息供给策略，结合多LLM标签预测与分数融合，在Track 1/2分别取得85.22与91.78 Favg2（第6、第4名）。
AI.motivation: 立场分类在目标迁移下性能脆弱：评测目标未出现在带标签训练数据中，模型缺少目标相关信息。论文探究在推理阶段补充目标信息的两种可行途径（同目标演示、事实性目标上下文），并检验微调适配器是否有效。
AI.method: Track 1：从外部ArabicStanceX检索8条Women Driving同目标带标签演示，用Gemma-4-31B-IT对三个标签token打分。未见目标赛道：前置缓存的目标上下文（提示为事实性、非评价性），融合多LLM的标签预测与标签token分数，并以公开类别总数约束最终指派。另做消融：直接提示、8条随机演示、相似度检索；以及固定目标卡片与QLoRA的对比。
AI.result: Track 1/2 Favg2为85.22/91.78。ArabicStanceX留出集：直接提示79.45，8条随机演示84.78，相似度检索89.04。三个目标留出的Mawqif评测：固定目标卡片使Gemma-4-31B-IT由86.54升至86.93，QLoRA使Gemma-4-12B-IT由84.43降至83.77。
AI.conclusion: 同目标演示与相似度检索带来显著提升，事实性目标上下文仅提供小幅且依赖目标的增益，仅源域训练的QLoRA适配器未带来改进。

title: From Vanishing Gradients to Recursive Self-Improvement: Evaluating the Most Influential Papers in Large Language Model Evolution (1997-2026)
summary: The rapid proliferation of Large Language Model (LLM) research makes it increasingly difficult to distinguish incremental refinements from true paradigm shifts. This review evaluates 22 of the most influential publications spanning nearly three decades (1997-2026), organized through a causal, chronologically anchored taxonomy centered on the author's birth year (1999). Beginning "before 1999" with how recurrent neural networks (RNNs) forgot earlier context (much like forgetting Chapter 1 by the time a reader reaches Chapter 9), we trace how Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks introduced a "bouncer" mechanism of forget, input, and output gates to selectively preserve long-term memory. We then examine how Word2Vec turned language into vector mathematics (king - male + female ~ queen), why sequential RNNs hit a parallelization wall, and how the Transformer's all-to-all attention weights launched the modern LLM era alongside a quadratic bottleneck. Next, we analyze why scaling parameters alone leaves capacity under-trained unless data scales equally (Chinchilla), how Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) left alignment superficial, and how that gap compounded into adversarial jailbreaks and single-direction refusal subspaces (J-space), where instructing a model not to think of a restricted concept surfaces it much like the human "red ball" paradox. Finally, we synthesize the current state of AI (2024-2026), encompassing recursive model collapse, autonomous reasoning-model jailbreak agents, machine-speed agentic intrusions, and closed-loop recursive self-improvement (AIDE^2).

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇横跨1997–2026年、以作者出生年（1999）为时间锚点的因果式综述，通过22篇代表作梳理LLM从RNN/LSTM、Word2Vec、Transformer、Chinchilla缩放、RLHF对齐到越狱与递归自改进的演进脉络。
AI.motivation: LLM研究论文激增，增量改进与范式转变难以区分；需要一个具有因果逻辑与时间锚点的综述框架，帮助读者（尤其是新入门者）理解各环节"为什么出现、解决了什么、又遗留了什么"。
AI.method: 因果式、按时间排序的分类学综述：选取22篇高影响力文献，以"前一工作的遗留缺陷→下一工作的解决方案"为链条组织内容，并以作者出生年1999为叙事分界，辅以类比（如"俱乐部保安"门控、国王-男人+女人≈女王、"红球"悖论）降低理解门槛。
AI.result: 形成一条主线：RNN长程遗忘→LSTM门控→Word2Vec语义向量化→RNN并行化瓶颈→Transformer全连接注意力（附带二次复杂度瓶颈）→缩放定律与Chinchilla的数据-参数配比→RLHF浅层对齐→越狱与单方向拒绝子空间（J-space）→2024–2026的模型递归崩溃、自主越狱智能体、机器速度的智能体入侵与闭环递归自我改进（AIDE²）。
AI.conclusion: 综述以因果链条而非编年罗列刻画LLM发展，指出当前瓶颈已从架构/算力转向对齐深度与自主体安全；J-space与递归自我改进等议题提示对齐需从表面行为约束走向机制层面治理。

title: CompareDR: Benchmarking Deep Research Reports from Individual Quality to Comparative Merit
summary: Deep research systems can produce reports with different evidence, analyses, and conclusions for the same query. A reader deciding which findings to rely on needs to know how well each report meets the task requirements and which differences matter to the answer. A score for a single report can summarize its quality, but it does not identify which contributions make one report more useful than another. We introduce CompareDR, a benchmark that combines task-specific pointwise audits with guideline-based pairwise comparisons. We use passage-linked report representations to locate relevant differences and selective evidence verification to check claims that could affect the judgment. The benchmark comprises 40 Chinese and English tasks from three existing benchmarks, 360 reports from nine systems, 1,099 human-reviewed evaluation criteria, and human preferences elicited through blinded comparisons of 80 report pairs. The hybrid evaluator matches 69 of these 80 preferences (86.25%, Cohen's $κ=0.746$). The benchmark supports both comparisons of research systems and examination of the evidence and analyses behind those judgments.

AI.tldr: 提出CompareDR基准，将任务特定的逐点评测与基于准则的成对比较相结合，以判定深度研究报告的质量与差异。
AI.motivation: 同一查询下深度研究系统生成报告的证据、分析与结论各异，单报告打分只能概括质量，无法指出哪些贡献使一份报告优于另一份；读者需要知道报告是否满足任务要求、以及哪些差异真正影响答案。
AI.method: 构建CompareDR基准：以段落链接的报告表示定位相关差异，并以选择性证据核验检查可能影响判断的论断；评测包含任务特定逐点审计（pointwise audit）与基于指南的成对比较（pairwise comparison）的混合评估器。
AI.result: 基准含40个中英文任务（来自三个现有基准）、9个系统的360份报告、1,099条人工审核评测准则，以及80对盲评报告对的人工偏好；混合评估器在80个偏好中匹配69个（86.25%，Cohen's κ=0.746）。
AI.conclusion: 该基准既支持研究系统间的比较，也支持对判断背后证据与分析过程的审查。

title: Character Information in Language Models: A Prompt-Independent Word Store and a Late, Question-Driven Signal That Grows With Scale
summary: Linear probes recover character properties of a word from a language model's hidden states, but a probe at the answer position cannot say whether the property was stored with the word or produced because the prompt asked for it. We separate the two with a word-position baseline: the same held-out-word probe applied to the query word's own tokens in a sentence that asks nothing. Across 16 open-weight models from seven families (0.6B--14B) and eleven character tasks, the word tokens encode \texttt{first\_letter}, \texttt{last\_letter} and \texttt{most\_frequent\_letter} above a word-only nuisance floor in all 16 models, and about 70\% of that signal is already present in the token embedding. Asking the question adds a second signal at the answer position. Its size grows with model scale for all four prompt-sensitive tasks (Holm-corrected permutation $p \leq 0.018$, also within model families), and the growth is confined to the late layers: restricted to the first quarter of the network, the slope is indistinguishable from zero. Small models' answer positions hold less linearly decodable signal than their word-level store; large models' hold more. Four controls bound these claims. Measured against the nuisance floor, the question-free signal that a majority-baseline analysis counts as retained largely disappears (\texttt{last\_letter}: $-0.01$). Count tasks become measurable only after length, repetition and query-letter shortcuts are removed by design. A pre-registered test finds that a question placed before the word does not change the word's own encoding beyond what an arbitrary prefix change does. Representation--readout gaps show no robust scaling once probe saturation is accounted for. Pre-registered criteria, a fixed estimator (held-out layer selection, cold-start folds) and all analysis code accompany the paper.

AI.tldr: 文章提出词位置基线，将语言模型隐状态中字符属性信号区分为"词记忆存储"与"提问诱发产生"两部分，并在16个开源模型、11项字符任务上系统量化其规模、来源(嵌入层vs后层)与随模型规模的缩放规律。
AI.motivation: 答案位置的线性探针能读出词的字符属性，但无法区分该属性是随词本身被存储，还是因提示提问而被"生产"出来；需要一种无提问的对照来分离两种信号来源。
AI.method: 以查询词自身token在"不含任何提问"的句子中作为词位置基线，施加同一留出词探针；覆盖7个家族16个开源模型(0.6B–14B)与11项字符任务；采用固定估计器(留出层选择、冷启动折)、预注册标准、Holm校正置换检验，并设置滋扰基准与四项对照(多数基线对比、去除长度/重复/查询字母捷径、词前提问的预注册测试、探针饱和校正)。
AI.result: 全部16个模型的词token在first_letter、last_letter、most_frequent_letter上均超过仅词扰基准，约70%信号已存在于token嵌入中；提问在答案位置新增第二信号，其规模随模型增大而对四项提示敏感任务显著增长(p≤0.018，家族内亦成立)，且增长局限于后层(前四分之一网络斜率与零不可区分)；小模型答案位置的可解码信号少于其词级存储，大模型则更多。对照显示：多数基线分析所谓"保留"的免提问信号在扰基准下基本消失(last_letter为−0.01)；计数任务须先去除三种捷径才可测；词前提问不改变词自身编码超过任意前缀变更；探针饱和校正后表征–读出差距无稳健缩放。
AI.conclusion: 字符属性大部分以词级形式存储并可线性读出，提问仅在深层叠加一个随规模增长的第二信号；既有基于答案位置的结论中包含大量由基线/捷径/饱和造成的伪信号，报告应纳入词位置基线与预注册控制。

title: When 1+1 $\neq$ 2: Benchmarking Civil-Time Reasoning in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of EACL 2027. Code and dataset available at: https://github.com/CivilTime-Bench/CivilTime-Bench
summary: Calendar arithmetic is non-linear. When 1:59 AM + 1 minute occurs during daylight saving spring-forward, the result is 3:00 AM, not 2:00 AM, as the hour is skipped. We introduce CivilTime-Bench, a benchmark for civil-time reasoning covering daylight saving transitions, non-hour offsets, date-line crossings, and ISO week boundaries. With 60,011 training and 10,500 evaluation examples under strict output-contract evaluation, we benchmark seven LLMs (six instruction-tuned models and Llama-3.1-8B base) and find: zero-shot exact match varies substantially across models, contract-aware prompting often improves format compliance but yields inconsistent accuracy gains, few-shot in-context learning provides model-dependent improvements, and fine-tuning achieves 74.6--86.6% EM on synthetic evaluation but only 36.6--45.2% on HumanTime-500 for models with valid results on both splits, highlighting substantial limitations in generalization. We release the benchmark and code.

AI.tldr: 提出 CivilTime-Bench 基准，评测 LLM 对民用时间（夏令时、非整点偏移、日期变更线、ISO 周边界）的算术推理能力，发现微调后合成集可达 74.6–86.6% EM，但在 HumanTime-500 上仅 36.6–45.2%，泛化不足。
AI.motivation: 日历算术具有非线性：夏令时春进时 1:59 AM 加 1 分钟得 3:00 AM 而非 2:00 AM。现有 LLM 评测缺乏对民用时间规则的系统性考察，需要专门基准揭示模型在时区与日历规则上的推理短板。
AI.method: 构建 CivilTime-Bench，覆盖夏令时转换、非整点偏移、日期变更线跨越与 ISO 周边界；含 60,011 条训练样本与 10,500 条评测样本，采用严格的输出契约评测。评测 7 个 LLM（6 个指令微调模型 + Llama-3.1-8B base），比较零样本、契约感知提示、少样本上下文学习与微调四种设置。
AI.result: 零样本精确匹配跨模型差异显著；契约感知提示常提升格式合规但对准确率增益不稳定；少样本 ICL 提升因模型而异；微调在合成评测集上达 74.6–86.6% EM，而在 HumanTime-500 上仅 36.6–45.2%（两集合均有效结果的模型）。
AI.conclusion: LLM 在民用时间推理上存在明显局限，合成训练上的高精度难以迁移到真实人类时间数据，泛化能力不足；作者开源基准与代码以推动后续研究。

title: The Answer Is Not the State: Trajectory-Level Corrigibility in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models generate tokens at many positions on a shared canvas, making unfinished responses appear revisable. We find a counterexample: after the final answer is reopened, previously generated rationale can reconstruct the old decision despite newly available evidence. We isolate this effect by comparing reopening the answer alone with reopening both rationale and answer, and by exchanging rationales between paired trajectories. On a 150-question source-disjoint benchmark, reopening both regions makes decisions follow the evidence currently present--whether correct or deliberately corrupted--across Dream, LLaDA, and iLLaDA. On a new 100-question free-form short-answer evaluation, the same effect remains strong in LLaDA and iLLaDA but is negligible in Dream. Coherent transplanted rationales steer rebuilt decisions, while token-level attribution improves which positions to reopen without producing a compact repair. Corrigibility therefore depends on retained rationale state, not answer openness alone.

AI.tldr: 扩散语言模型的"可修正性"依赖保留的推理依据状态：仅重开答案会导致旧推理重建旧决策，同时重开推理与答案才会依据当前证据决策。
AI.motivation: 已有观点认为扩散语言模型因在共享画布上多位置生成、未完成回复看似可修正；作者要检验这种可修正性是否真实——尤其当最终答案被重新开放后，模型能否依据新证据更新决策。
AI.method: 发现反例：答案重开后，先前生成的推理依据仍可重建旧决策。通过两组对照隔离效应：(1) 仅重开答案 vs 同时重开推理与答案；(2) 在配对轨迹间交换推理依据。在150题来源不相交基准上测试 Dream、LLaDA、iLLaDA，并新增100题自由形式短答案评测；辅以连贯推理依据移植实验与 token 级归因分析。
AI.result: 同时重开推理与答案时，决策跟随当前证据（无论正确或被故意污染），在 Dream、LLaDA、iLLaDA 上均成立；在100题自由形式短答案评测中，LLaDA 与 iLLaDA 效应仍强，Dream 则几乎可忽略。连贯移植的推理依据能引导重建决策；token 级归因可改进"重开哪些位置"的选择，但未能形成紧凑修复。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型的可修正性取决于保留的推理依据状态，而非答案开放性本身；仅靠重开答案不足以纠错，评测与修复需同时考虑推理区域。

title: PCC: Pivotal Channel Compensation for Layer Pruning of Large Language Models
summary: Treating independent layers as the minimal pruning unit allows layer pruning to efficiently eliminate many redundant parameters and achieve high compression rates. Layer pruning has become a promising and prevalent structured pruning technique for large language models (LLMs). However, multi-layer removal can lead to significant performance degradation for LLMs. Although some works have explored various compensation methods for pruned layers, they are inefficient and costly. Observing that the expression of a large proportion of information is concentrated on a small number of pivotal channels, we propose a novel post-pruning compensation method for layer pruning, called pivotal channel compensation (PCC). PCC can achieve significant performance improvement by compensating for a small number of channels through learnable linear transformations at the pruning interface. Besides, we propose a new evaluation metric, called channel-wise average performance improvement (CAPI), which can measure the efficiency of channel-wise compensation. Our experimental results across various LLMs demonstrate that PCC can achieve significant and consistent improvements and high CAPI on language modeling and zero-shot question answering for the state-of-the-art cross-layer and consecutive-layer pruning methods. Compared with existing compensation methods, PCC can achieve competitive results with fewer additional parameters and less training cost.

AI.tldr: 提出关键通道补偿（PCC）——一种针对层剪枝的后补偿方法，仅用少量可学习线性变换补偿少数关键通道即可显著恢复LLM性能，并提出通道级平均性能提升（CAPI）指标。
AI.motivation: 层剪枝以整层为最小单元，可高效去除大量冗余参数、获得高压缩率，但多层移除会造成LLM性能显著下降；现有对剪枝层的补偿方法效率低、成本高。
AI.method: 观察到大部分信息表达集中于少数关键通道，据此提出PCC：在剪枝接口处对少量关键通道施加可学习线性变换进行补偿；同时提出CAPI指标度量通道级补偿的效率。
AI.result: 在多种LLM上，PCC对最先进的跨层与连续层剪枝方法在语言建模和零样本问答任务上均取得显著且一致的性能提升与较高CAPI；相比现有补偿方法，以更少附加参数和更低训练成本取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: 关键通道补偿为层剪枝提供了一种低成本、高效率的后补偿方案，验证了通道稀疏性假设在层剪枝恢复中的有效性。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation in the Agentic Era: Tradition, Present, and Prospect
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) couples frozen language models with external, updatable knowledge, so that generation is grounded in retrieved evidence rather than in parametric memory alone. This work maps RAG in the agentic era by joining them on a single lifecycle axis, from offline indexing through pre-retrieval, retrieval, post-retrieval, and orchestration over these stages. It treats indexing and orchestration as first-class components and agentic workflows as a paradigm of their own, and it covers the agentic work that has appeared since those reviews. Beyond these components, it covers evaluation, applications, and the questions that remain open for future exploration. From tradition to present and beyond, this work systematically reviews RAG from a perspective of the agentic era.

AI.tldr: 本文从"智能体时代"视角系统综述检索增强生成（RAG），以单一生命周期为主线组织索引、预检索、检索、后检索与编排各环节，并涵盖评估、应用与开放问题。
AI.motivation: RAG将冻结语言模型与可更新的外部知识耦合，使生成以检索证据为依据而非仅依赖参数化记忆；随着智能体（agentic）范式兴起，已有综述未将其纳入统一框架，亟需梳理智能体时代RAG的全貌。
AI.method: 采用系统综述方法，以RAG生命周期为统一轴线：离线索引→预检索→检索→后检索→跨阶段编排；将索引与编排视为一等领域组件，把智能体工作流作为独立范式，并对既有综述之后出现的智能体相关工作加以覆盖。
AI.result: 构建了面向智能体时代的RAG统一分类框架，沿生命周期轴整合各组件，并系统整理了评估方法、下游应用及开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了"从传统到当下及未来"的RAG系统化综述视角，强调以生命周期为轴、以索引与编排为一等公民、以智能体工作流为独立范式，为后续研究提供结构化参考。

title: Make Position Uninformative: Exchangeable Self-Distillation Flattens the Lost-in-the-Middle Curve
summary: Retrieval-augmented language models answer well when the relevant document comes first or last and poorly when it sits in the middle. Some fine-tuning recipes lift the middle by lowering the start. We show how training contexts teach positional bias. With a uniform answer slot and shuffled distractors, the optimal reader ignores position. Building on this result, Exchangeable Self-Distillation (ExSD) trains a small adapter on shuffled contexts to reproduce the model's answer when it reads the answer document alone. It needs no gold answers and only a few thousand examples. On six models from 1.5B to 32B parameters, ExSD raises both average and worst-position accuracy against the frozen model, including on a held-out test split. In controlled LoRA comparisons, it significantly improves both criteria over Pos2Distill. Against CORD, mean differences are not significant, while worst-position accuracy improves significantly in the 20- and 30-document settings. ExSD also matches or beats gold-answer fine-tuning, changes behavior on other tasks far less, and transfers to unseen tasks. Head probes show greater reliance on content over position.

AI.tldr: 提出Exchangeable Self-Distillation (ExSD)：在打乱干扰项的上下文中，让小型适配器复现模型单独阅读答案文档时的输出，从而消除检索增强语言模型的"中段丢失"位置偏差，无需金标答案，仅需数千样本。
AI.motivation: 检索增强语言模型存在显著位置偏差：相关文档位于首尾时回答好，位于中间时表现差。已有微调方法通过"降低开头表现"来抬高中间表现，属于此消彼长的权衡，而非真正消除偏差。作者希望从理论上说明训练上下文如何塑造位置偏差，并据此设计无偏训练目标。
AI.method: 首先理论分析：在答案槽位均匀分布、干扰项随机打乱的条件下，最优读取器应忽略位置信息。据此提出ExSD——用打乱的上下文训练一个小适配器，使其输出对齐"模型仅阅读答案文档时"的答案分布，作为自蒸馏目标；不依赖金标答案，样本量仅数千。在1.5B–32B共六个模型上评测，并与Pos2Distill、CORD、金标微调做对照，辅以注意力头探针分析。
AI.result: 六个模型（1.5B–32B）上，ExSD相对冻结模型同时提升平均准确率与最差位置准确率，且在留出测试集上成立。受控LoRA对比中，两项指标均显著优于Pos2Distill；对比CORD，均值差异不显著，但在20与30文档设置下最差位置准确率显著提升。ExSD达到或超过金标答案微调，对其他任务的行为改变更小，并可迁移至未见任务。头探针显示模型更依赖内容而非位置。
AI.conclusion: 位置偏差可由训练上下文诱导，也可通过可交换（打乱）上下文上的自蒸馏被有效削弱；ExSD以低数据、无标注成本实现更稳健的位置无关读取，且副作用小、具迁移性。

title: Modeling Perceived Promptness in Simultaneous Interpreting from Quality, Structure, and Timing Signals
summary: Simultaneous interpreting requires interpreters to convey the source accurately while keeping pace with it in real time. Timing measures such as segment-onset delay capture part of this requirement, but may not fully reflect how professional evaluators judge promptness. We investigate whether these judgments can be explained by timing alone or whether the interpreted output provides additional information. Our dataset contains 622 Chinese-English and English-Chinese segments from 16 source speeches and seven interpreters. Two senior professional interpreters rated each segment for language quality (LQ), expressiveness (EXP), and perceived latency (LAT), which we also refer to as professional promptness. On held-out source speeches, onset delay alone achieves a Pearson correlation of r = .318 with LAT ratings. Combining predicted LQ and EXP with delay improves the correlation to r = .475. Lexical and structural features provide a stronger signal, reaching r = .632 when combined with delay and r = .658 when predicted quality is also included. These results suggest that professional promptness judgments reflect properties of the interpreted output beyond when the interpreter begins speaking. The additional contribution of predicted quality over structural features, however, is modest. Although the two evaluators differ in how strongly quality relates to LAT, cross-evaluator predictions remain positively correlated with LAT ratings. The overall pattern also holds when each interpreter is held out in turn.

AI.tldr: 口译"及时性"的专业评分不止取决于译员开口延迟（onset delay），译出内容的语言质量与词汇/结构特征能显著提升对感知延迟（LAT）的预测。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多用片段起始延迟等时间指标衡量同传的及时性，但这类指标能否解释专业评审对"及时"的判断尚不清楚；作者希望区分"仅靠时间"与"译出文本本身提供额外信息"两种解释。
AI.method: 构建622个中英/英中同传片段数据集（16篇源语讲话、7名译员）；两名资深职业译员对每段评分语言质量(LQ)、表达性(EXP)与感知延迟(LAT，即专业及时性)。在留出源语讲话上做预测实验，比较onset delay单独、加预测LQ/EXP、加词汇与结构特征、以及再叠加预测质量的Pearson相关；并做评审者差异分析与留一译员交叉验证。
AI.result: 仅用onset delay：r=.318；加预测LQ与EXP：r=.475；词汇/结构特征叠加延迟：r=.632；再叠加预测质量：r=.658。两位评审者与LAT的关系强度不同，但跨评审者预测仍与LAT正相关；留一译员时整体模式保持一致。
AI.conclusion: 专业"及时性"判断反映的是译出内容的属性，而非仅开口时间；词汇与结构特征贡献最大，预测质量的增量较小，说明及时性感知与译语呈现方式密切相关，可靠度跨评审者与跨译员均具稳健性。

title: Digital Twins for Multi-Agent Systems: When to Trust, What to Change
summary: Digital twins of agent networks need to flag unreliable forecasts and help users choose interventions. Both decisions depend on what happens over several steps: an error can spread through the network, and an edit whose trajectory is easy to predict may still yield a poor collective outcome. We ask when information about error propagation improves failure detection and whether a learned twin can select effective network edits despite imperfect forecasts. We propose Propagation-Aware Validation for Networked Digital Twins (PAV-Twin). Its monitor combines Jacobian-based propagation features with recent errors and ensemble disagreement to estimate the risk that a forecast exceeds an error threshold. Its planner simulates each candidate edit and ranks the edits by their predicted collective outcomes. In simulations, the monitor gained 0.13 in area under the precision-recall curve on larger oscillator networks with familiar topologies and 0.09 on larger networks with held-out topologies, relative to a graph baseline without propagation features. Gains were small in contractive consensus. Giving the graph baseline the same features narrowed the gap.
