In a separate planning study, ensemble simulation recovered about 99% of the possible improvement over random intervention selection in oscillators and nearly all of it in consensus. With a simplified oscillator twin, selecting by predicted outcome also gave lower regret than selecting by trajectory fidelity. These results show when propagation features help flag unreliable forecasts and why the quality of intervention choices should be measured directly.

AI.tldr: 提出PAV-Twin框架：监控器用Jacobian传播特征、近期误差与集成分歧估计预测超阈值风险；规划器通过模拟候选编辑按预测集体结果排序。传播特征在大型/未见拓扑振荡器网络上提升失效检测约0.13/0.09 AUPRC，但在收缩性共识网络中收益微小；集成模拟可恢复约99%的随机干预改进量。
AI.motivation: 智能体网络的数字孪生需标记不可靠预测并辅助选择干预措施，二者均依赖多步演化：误差会在网络中传播，且轨迹易预测的编辑仍可能导致较差的集体结果。核心问题是：误差传播信息何时能改进失效检测，以及学得的孪生在预测不完美时能否选出有效网络编辑。
AI.method: PAV-Twin由两部分组成：(1) 监控器融合基于Jacobian的传播特征、近期误差与集成分歧，估计预测误差超过阈值的风险；(2) 规划器对每个候选编辑进行模拟，依据预测的集体结果排序。对比基线为不含传播特征的图基线，并做"给基线同等特征"的消融；规划研究对比随机干预选择与按轨迹保真度选择。
AI.result: 大型振荡器网络（熟悉拓扑）AUPRC提升0.13，留出拓扑提升0.09；收缩性共识网络中收益较小；给予图基线相同特征后差距缩小。规划研究中，集成模拟在振荡器中恢复约99%的可得改进，共识中几乎全部；简化振荡器孪生下，按预测结果选择比按轨迹保真度选择遗憾更低。
AI.conclusion: 传播特征的价值取决于网络动力学特性（振荡传播型收益大，收缩共识型收益小），且主要源于特征本身而非模型结构；干预选择质量应直接以集体结果/遗憾衡量，而非轨迹保真度。

title: Digital Knockoffs
summary: Social simulations often use language model agents to represent people who differ on several measurable traits. However, describing a trait profile in a prompt does not guarantee the agent will express each trait at its intended level. We propose a method that calibrates agents to multidimensional profiles using activation steering: (i) extract steering directions for each trait, (ii) learn a shared mapping from steering strengths to measured trait scores, and (iii) search for a steering intervention for each target. We use Bayesian optimization for this search and evaluate the method on the Big Five personality scores of 500 OpenPsychometrics respondents. In each of five rounds, the assigned interventions yield lower mean absolute error across respondents than the prompting and steering baselines. Further, the model's responses to a given intervention yield the same trait profile regardless of whose target motivated it, so a poor match for one respondent can be the best match for another. When we match each respondent to the closest profile found across all tested interventions, Bayesian optimization yields 16.6% lower mean absolute error than uniform random search at the same evaluation budget. Our method thus offers a way to build social agents whose measured traits dovetail with those of the people they seek to represent. Whether this closer fit translates to improved predictions of downstream behavior remains an open question.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于激活引导（activation steering）的方法，将语言模型智能体校准到多维人格画像：先为每个特质提取引导方向，再学习引导强度到实测特质分数的共享映射，最后用贝叶斯优化为每个目标搜索引导干预，从而让智能体的实测特质与所代表个体更贴合。
AI.motivation: 社会模拟常用语言模型智能体代表在多种可测量特质上存在差异的人，但仅在提示词中描述特质画像并不能保证智能体按预期水平表达每个特质，因此需要一种能将智能体实际行为校准到目标多维画像的方法。
AI.method: 采用激活引导的三步流程：(i) 为每个特质提取引导方向；(ii) 学习从引导强度到实测特质分数的共享映射；(iii) 对每个目标使用贝叶斯优化搜索引导干预。在500名OpenPsychometrics受访者的大五人格分数上评估，并与提示（prompting）与引导（steering）基线对比，同时与同等评估预算下的均匀随机搜索对比。
AI.result: 五轮评估中，每次分配的干预在受访者上的平均绝对误差均低于提示与引导基线；同一干预下模型输出的人格画像与“由谁的目标驱动”无关，因此对某受访者匹配较差的干预可能对另一受访者是最佳匹配。将每位受访者匹配到所有测试干预中最接近的画像时，贝叶斯优化在同等评估预算下比均匀随机搜索的平均绝对误差低16.6%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可构建实测特质与其所代表个体相吻合的社会智能体；但更贴近的画像匹配是否能转化为对下游行为的更好预测，仍是待研究问题。

title: KMed-31B Technical Report
summary: We present KMed-31B, a medical large language model post-trained from an open-weight model for on-premises deployment with limited hardware. Post-training a model for diverse medical tasks remains difficult, because improving one kind of task can lower performance on another. We attribute this to differences between tasks in expected output and available feedback. Medical question answering and diagnosis prediction have reference answers, whereas clinical inquiry has no single correct response and is judged with rubrics. We therefore divide medical training tasks into four categories by these two properties, train one specialist per category with a reward that its feedback supports, and integrate the specialists into a single student with Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation (MOPD$^2$). For clinical inquiry, we build Synthetic Health Dialogue, a simulated corpus of consultations with lay users and clinicians whose patient cases span common clinical presentations in primary care. Relative to its base model, KMed-31B raises HealthBench Hard from 22.95 to 41.87 and HealthBench Professional from 37.92 to 50.20 in non-thinking mode, and from 23.80 to 51.48 and from 41.97 to 59.18 in thinking mode, while its scores on four multiple-choice medical benchmarks are maintained or slightly improved. KMed-31B has the highest unadjusted HealthBench Hard score among the compared models, including proprietary ones, and scores higher on HealthBench Professional than every open-weight model we compare, including models with more than ten times as many total parameters. Applied to another base model, Qwen3.8-27B, the same training recipe also raises both HealthBench scores. We describe the training recipe, data construction, and settings in detail so that institutions requiring on-premises deployment can develop medical models from open-weight foundations.

AI.tldr: 提出按“输出形式/反馈类型”划分医学任务并各自训练专家，再用多教师同策略增量蒸馏（MOPD²）整合为单一学生模型KMed-31B，可在有限硬件上本地部署，HealthBench评分大幅提升。
AI.motivation: 面向硬件受限的本地化部署场景，基于开放权重模型后训练医学大模型。核心难点是多任务后训练中的任务冲突：提升一类任务会损害另一类任务表现。作者将其归因于任务在期望输出形式与可用反馈信号上的差异——医学问答和诊断预测有参考答案，而临床问诊无唯一正确答案、需用评分量表（rubric）评判。
AI.method: 1) 以“是否有参考答案”和“反馈形式”两个属性将医学训练任务分为四类；2) 每类训练一个专家模型，使用与其反馈机制相匹配的奖励信号；3) 通过多教师同策略增量蒸馏（Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation, MOPD²）将专家整合为单一学生模型；4) 构建Synthetic Health Dialogue合成语料，模拟与普通用户及临床医生的问诊对话，病例覆盖基层常见临床表现。
AI.result: 相对基座模型，非思考模式下HealthBench Hard由22.95升至41.87、HealthBench Professional由37.92升至50.20；思考模式下分别由23.80升至51.48、41.97升至59.18；四项医学选择题基准持平或小幅提升。在对比模型中取得最高未调整HealthBench Hard分数（含闭源模型），HealthBench Professional优于所有对比的开放权重模型（含参数量超十倍者）。同一训练配方应用于另一基座Qwen3.8-27B亦提升两项HealthBench分数。
AI.conclusion: 任务冲突可通过“按反馈类型划分专家+多教师蒸馏整合”的配方有效缓解；论文详细给出训练配方、数据构建与设置，供需本地部署的机构基于开放权重模型开发医学模型。

title: Grammar-as-a-Draft: More Tokens per Speculative Decoding Step on Grammar-Constrained Structured Outputs
summary:
Under structured outputs (JSON schemas, regexes, tool calls), speculative drafters do not see the grammar constraint and repeatedly propose invalid keys, delimiters, and indentation, while the grammar engine already knows which tokens must come next.
  We present Grammar-as-a-Draft (GaaD), which treats the grammar as a second drafter. Before each verify step, the scheduler merges the drafter's proposal with grammar-forced tokens into one draft row: matching tokens stay as GRAMMAR, the proposal is cut where it leaves the forced path, and forced tokens fill the rest of a row wider than the drafter's proposal. The verify step accepts GRAMMAR drafts without computing their logits, composing with any drafter with no new kernels or compilation on the critical path. Because grammars fix text rather than tokens, committing canonical forced tokens changes the output distribution relative to grammar-masked target decoding.
  We implement GaaD in vllm-torchtpu and an independent Rust serving runtime, evaluating on TPU v7x with MTP, DFlash, and n-gram drafters on a JSON character-profile benchmark. GaaD raises average acceptance length from 2.06 to 5.43 (MTP, Qwen3.5-0.8B), 1.99 to 5.31 (MTP, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B), 1.57 to 4.13 (DFlash, Qwen3-4B), and 1.30 to 3.64 (n-gram, Qwen3-4B), decoding 2.66-2.81x faster at batch size 1 and 1.14-1.70x at batch size 64. In Rust, MTP+GaaD is 2.23x faster on Qwen3.5-0.8B, 2.02x on Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8, and 1.22x at 128 concurrent requests. Under mixed traffic (25-50% structured), GaaD finishes the workload 1.03-1.23x sooner (structured requests 2.2-3.2x sooner) while plain-text TPOT rises 7-42%. We also show grammar-masked greedy decoding can pick non-canonical tokenizations, so GaaD can yield different valid outputs that an fp32 reference finds equally likely.

AI.tldr: GaaD将语法引擎视为第二drafter，在verify前把语法强制token合并进草稿行，使TPU/Rust上的结构化输出投机解码接受长度提升2-3倍、解码加速1.14-2.81x。
AI.motivation: 结构化输出（JSON schema、正则、工具调用）下，投机drafter看不到语法约束，反复提出非法键、分隔符与缩进，而语法引擎本身已知道下一步必须出现哪些token，这部分强制路径未被利用。
AI.method: 提出Grammar-as-a-Draft：把语法当作第二个drafter。每次verify前，调度器将drafter提议与语法强制token合并为一行草稿：一致部分标记为GRAMMAR，提议在偏离强制路径处截断，强制token填充行余下部分，使行长于原提议。GRAMMAR草稿无需计算logits即可被接受，可搭配任意drafter，无需新kernel或关键路径编译。由于语法固定的是文本而非token，提交规范化强制token会相对语法掩码目标解码改变输出分布。实现于vllm-torchtpu与独立Rust serving runtime。
AI.result: 在TPU v7x上以MTP、DFlash、n-gram drafter在JSON字符profile基准评测：平均接受长度由2.06→5.43（MTP, Qwen3.5-0.8B）、1.99→5.31（MTP, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B）、1.57→4.13（DFlash, Qwen3-4B）、1.30→3.64（n-gram, Qwen3-4B）；batch=1解码加速2.66-2.81x，batch=64为1.14-1.70x。Rust侧MTP+GaaD在Qwen3.5-0.8B上2.23x、Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8上2.02x、128并发1.22x。混合流量（25-50%结构化）下整体提前1.03-1.23x完成，结构化请求提前2.2-3.2x，纯文本TPOT上升7-42%。
AI.conclusion: 语法可作为零成本额外drafter显著提升结构化输出的投机接受率与吞吐，且与任意drafter正交组合；但会带来纯文本TPOT开销，并因规范化强制token使输出分布与语法掩码贪婪解码不同（fp32参考显示两者同等可能，均为合法输出）。

title: Language Model Harnesses can be Compositional Generalizers
summary: Modern language models (LMs) are post-trained and deployed as agents inside a "harness", but standard harness designs accumulate context that the neural network is forced to generalize to, making training for long-horizon tasks expensive and time-consuming. We study an alternative emerging path: training inherently neurosymbolic LM harnesses, which externalize and manage context programmatically to compose existing LM capabilities. We hypothesize that training around these harnesses can offer a better return on compute by enabling compositional generalization, as they can learn to decompose complex problems so that every observation their neural LM receives is locally in-distribution, even when the full task is novel. We find that harnesses like the Recursive Language Model (RLM) learn such decompositions readily under reinforcement learning post-training: (1) we demonstrate that training only on short tasks can generalize to tasks 2-64$\times$ longer while the base neural LM improves less, and (2) training on one domain transfers to novel domains that share latent structure. On messier, complex tasks, we find that we can target individual LLM calls within a harness by generating and training on easier, synthetically generated surrogate environments with fake tool / sub-calls, a technique we call surrogate harness training. From this finding, we train RLM-27B on synthetic data, and show it improves Qwen3.8-27B in the same RLM harness on a hard suite of long-context tasks like CTC-Bench and ExpertLongBench by 26.9% on average while using $\sim$2$\times$ fewer tokens at inference time. Finally, we show that harnesses can compose over these newly learned decompositions using recursive sub-harness calls.

AI.tldr: 论文研究通过训练"神经符号化"的LM harness（如递归语言模型RLM）来实现组合泛化：在短任务上训练即可迁移到2–64倍更长的任务，并跨域迁移；提出"代理harness训练"，用合成假工具/子调用数据微调，得到RLM-27B，在CTC-Bench、ExpertLongBench等长上下文任务上平均提升26.9%，推理token减少约2倍。
AI.motivation: 标准harness设计会累积上下文，迫使神经网络泛化到不断增长的上下文中，使长程任务训练昂贵且耗时；作者希望探索以程序化方式外置和管理上下文、复用现有LM能力的神经符号harness训练路径，以提升算力回报。
AI.method: 以RLM（Recursive Language Model）为代表的神经符号harness为对象，用强化学习后训练学习任务分解，使神经LM接收的每个观测都局部同分布；通过仅在短任务上训练检验长程泛化与跨域迁移；进一步提出surrogate harness training，即构造带虚假工具/子调用的、更简单的合成代理环境，定向训练harness中单次LLM调用；据此用合成数据训练RLM-27B。
AI.result: 仅在短任务上训练即可泛化到长2–64倍的任务，且优于基座神经LM的提升；单一域训练可迁移到具有相同潜在结构的新域；RLM-27B在CTC-Bench、ExpertLongBench等长上下文任务套件上，相对Qwen3.8-27B在同一RLM harness下平均提升26.9%，推理token使用约减少2倍。
AI.conclusion: 围绕harness进行训练能通过组合泛化获得更好的算力回报；harness可借助递归子harness调用在这些新学到的分解上继续组合，形成可扩展的神经符号智能体框架。

title: EmoRouter: Adaptive Modality Cascading for Multimodal Emotion Recognition
comment: Accepted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research, 2026
summary: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) involves detecting the underlying emotion behind each utterance within a conversation, which is essential for emotionally aware human-computer interaction. While omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) demonstrate strong capability for MER by jointly processing modalities including text, audio, and vision, different modality combinations yield different prediction outcomes across utterances: acoustic and visual inputs can help recover annotated labels missed by text-only inference, but can also turn correct predictions into errors. Processing all modalities for every utterance is also computationally expensive. To this end, we introduce EmoRouter, a training-free, model-agnostic framework for adaptive modality cascading that selects an exit tier for each utterance along a predefined modality order. The routing is guided by prediction-uncertainty estimates derived from Conformal Prediction. EmoRouter routes each utterance through a sequence of increasing-cost modality levels and exits at the first level when the model is confident in the emotion. To determine when to exit, we propose Conformal Set Contraction, a structural calibration criterion that calibrates the per-tier CP error budgets used for these exit decisions. Comprehensive evaluations on 4 MER benchmarks and 3 Omni-LLMs reveal that EmoRouter matches or outperforms the full modalities while reducing inference latency by 67.9--94.5%. Furthermore, EmoRouter demonstrates high transferability across different models, validating its robustness. Code is available at https://github.com/tianyi-lab/EmoRouter.

AI.tldr: EmoRouter：免训练、模型无关的自适应模态级联框架，用共形预测引导逐句早退出，在保持或超越全模态效果的同时降低推理延迟67.9–94.5%。
AI.motivation: Omni-LLM 可联合处理文本、音频、视觉做对话级情感识别，但不同模态组合对不同话语有利有弊：声学与视觉可纠正纯文本误判，也可能把正确预测变为错误；且对每句话都处理全部模态计算代价高。
AI.method: 提出 EmoRouter，沿预设模态顺序为每句话选择退出层级，路由依据共形预测（CP）得到的预测不确定性；并提出 Conformal Set Contraction，一种结构性校准准则，用于校准各层级 CP 误差预算以支持退出决策。方法免训练、模型无关。
AI.result: 在 4 个 MER 基准、3 个 Omni-LLM 上评估，EmoRouter 达到或超过全模态性能，同时降低推理延迟 67.9–94.5%；并展现良好的跨模型可迁移性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过不确定性驱动的自适应模态级联，可在不训练、不修改模型的前提下实现 MER 的效率—精度权衡，具备实用性与通用性。

title: When Rubrics Do Not Decide: Silent Value Completion in LLM Evaluation
comment: When grading criteria clash (e.g., shorter vs. more thorough), LLM judges secretly make up their own tiebreaker rules to pick a winner without telling you. This paper catches that hidden guesswork and stops it. (12 main pages with proof in appendix)
summary: Multi-criterion LLM judges often evaluate responses without specifying how conflicting criteria resolve, leaving the winner undetermined even under exact criterion scores. Issuing a strict verdict without declaring the required trade-off premise constitutes silent value completion. We introduce TradeoffBench to isolate this failure by separating rule execution from response scoring. On authoritative criterion vectors, six open-weight non-reasoning judges pass all dominance and equality controls yet pick unsupported winners on 9%-81% of 1,345 conflicts. All 577 order-stable choices follow an explicitly banned majority rule. Reasoning-enabled configurations drop anonymous-vector violations to 2 in 9,720 judgments under an explicit rule, yet cannot bridge omitted trade-offs or divergent component scoring. On raw TradeoffBench text with unspecified trade-offs, GPT-6.1-sol omits its completion premise in 29.8% of 400 verified conflicts. Even under an explicit rule on four-rater-consensus MultiPref conflicts, four reasoning judges still issue strict verdicts on 16/45 (GPT-6.1-sol) up to 35/46 and 25/29 (open-weight judges) of valid presentations. We propose identified-first evaluation, decoupling specification support, explicit completion, and target agreement. In MultiPref human-score audits, peer-mean substitution raises directional disagreement from 0.6% to 28.8% on 2,707 shared targets. A single-peer ablation confirms a 29.38-point gap on 2,175 targets, ruling out averaging as the cause. In HUMAINE, declared partial trade-offs add 2.5 percentage points of coverage, yet newly decided pairs incur 3.9% disagreement versus 0.9% for Pareto. Reliable LLM judging, therefore, requires auditing, specification support, declared trade-offs, and human target agreement separately.

AI.tldr: 多准则 LLM 裁判在准则冲突时缺乏显式取舍前提，即使给出精确准则分数也无法确定胜者；本文提出 TradeoffBench 并主张"先识别后评测"的分解评测框架。
AI.motivation: 多准则 LLM 裁判常在未声明冲突准则如何取舍的情况下直接给出严格判定，属于"隐式价值补全"（silent value completion）；现有评测混合了规则执行与响应打分，无法隔离该失效模式。
AI.method: 构建 TradeoffBench，将规则执行与响应打分分离；在权威准则向量上设置支配性与相等性控制实验，测试六个开源非推理裁判；对比启用推理的配置与显式规则；并在 MultiPref（含四评分者共识）和 HUMAINE 数据上做事后审计，包括同行均值替换与单同行消融实验。
AI.result: 六个开源非推理裁判通过全部支配/相等控制，但在 1,345 个冲突中 9%–81% 选出无依据胜者，577 个顺序稳定选择全部遵循被明令禁止的多数规则；显式规则下推理配置的匿名向量违规降至 9,720 次判定中的 2 次，但仍无法弥补被省略的取舍与分量打分分歧；GPT-6.1-sol 在 400 个文本冲突中 29.8% 未声明补全前提；MultiPref 四评分者共识冲突中，四名推理裁判仍在 16/45 至 35/46、25/29 的有效呈现上给出严格判定；同行均值替换使方向不一致从 0.6% 升至 28.8%，单同行消融显示 29.38 个百分点差距，排除平均化归因；HUMAINE 中声明部分取舍仅增 2.5 个百分点覆盖率，新判定对不一致率 3.9%，而 Pareto 仅 0.9%。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的 LLM 裁判评测必须分别审计规范支持、显式补全声明、人类目标一致性，不能以单一胜率指标衡量。

title: Can Open LLMs Clear Sanctions-Screening Alerts? A Pre-registered Test on Public Sanctions Lists with Turkish Name Variants
comment: 13 pages, 4 tables. Pre-registered. Code, synthetic customers and all model outputs: https://github.com/mhuyut/llm-sanctions-alert-triage
summary: Sanctions screening raises name-based alerts that are mostly false positives, and level-1 analysts clear them by checking the customer's date of birth and name against a written policy. We test whether open-weight language models that a bank can run on its own premises can perform this level-1 disposition. From the UK and EU sanctions lists (7,103 natural persons) we built 12,200 synthetic customers: listed persons under six name conditions, including Turkish spellings of Arabic-origin names and Turkish romanisations of Cyrillic names, and two date-of-birth conditions, plus namesakes, near-name customers and a general population. A deterministic fuzzy and embedding screen raised 7,383 alerts, which three open models served on domestic infrastructure and three rule baselines dispositioned under the same policy. The models sent far fewer innocent customers to level 2 than a rule that applies the policy's date clause: 0.6 to 16.9 per 1,000 screened customers against 24.4, and they stated the date-of-birth status correctly in 98.3% to 98.5% of alerts. They also failed to escalate 1.5% to 2.2% of the listed persons. The pre-registered non-inferiority test against the rule was met, but only because of a construction error we found after the analysis: 21 customers in the "minor discrepancy" condition had dates that conflict under the policy. Without them the rule misses no listed person and no model meets the margin. The misses had model-specific causes: one model read minor date discrepancies as conflicts, one declared word-order and typing variants to be different names, and one discounted alerts that its own rationale said to escalate. Fuzzy matching found 69% of the Turkish spellings of Arabic-origin names; adding embeddings raised this to 74%. Open LLMs can cut level-1 workload, but on this evidence only behind a deterministic date check and with every name doubt escalated.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了可在银行内部部署的开源权重语言模型能否执行制裁筛查中的一级（level-1）处置。结果显示，模型可大幅减少误报、降低一级工作量，但其漏报风险使其只能在确定性日期核验之后使用，且一切姓名疑问必须上送。
AI.motivation: 制裁筛查产生的基于姓名的警报绝大多数为误报，需由一级分析师依据书面政策比对客户出生日期与姓名逐一处理，工作量大。作者希望验证银行可在自有基础设施上运行的开源模型能否承担这一处置任务，并评估其相对规则基线的准确性（尤其是漏报风险）。
AI.method: 从英国与欧盟制裁名单（7,103 名自然人）构建 12,200 名合成客户：列入人员在六种姓名条件（含阿拉伯语源姓名的土耳其拼写、西里尔字母姓名的土耳其转写）与两种出生日期条件下，另加同名者、近似姓名客户及一般人群。以确定性模糊匹配加嵌入筛查产生 7,383 条警报，由三个部署于本地基础设施的开源模型与三个规则基线在相同政策下处置，并进行预注册的非劣性检验。
AI.result: 模型每千名受筛客户仅将 0.6–16.9 名无辜客户送二级处理，规则（适用政策日期条款）为 24.4；模型在 98.3%–98.5% 的警报中正确陈述出生日期状态。但模型漏升级 1.5%–2.2% 的列入人员。预注册非劣性检验虽通过，却源于事后发现的构造错误：21 名"轻微差异"客户日期与政策冲突，剔除后规则零漏报而无一模型达到边际。漏报原因具有模型特异性：模型分别将轻微日期差异判为冲突、把词序与拼写变体判为不同姓名、或未升级其自身理由已提示应升级的警报。模糊匹配识别 69% 阿拉伯语源姓名的土耳其拼写，加入嵌入后升至 74%。
AI.conclusion: 开源大模型可削减一级筛查工作量，但证据表明其只能置于确定性日期核验之后使用，并须将所有姓名疑问一律升级上送；其漏报风险不可忽视。

title: Estimating Silenced Tokens in Quantized LLMs
comment: Accepted to Findings of EACL 2027. 10 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables
summary: Quantization is the standard way to shrink large language models, and it is usually judged by perplexity and task accuracy. We ask a different question: after quantization, which words can the model still say at all? A token is silenced when no hidden state can make it the top choice of the output layer, so a greedy decoder can never produce it. We give a simple, scalable way to estimate how many tokens a quantized output head silences, combining three checks: a direction that lets a token win (so it is safe), an upper bound on how close a token's row is to being trapped inside the others, and an exact match that proves a token can never win. Each count is therefore a certified range: exact matches give its lower end and flagged tokens can only raise its upper end. In nearly all settings we report down to 3 bits the two ends coincide, so the counts are exact. Across three open models we find that quantization silences tokens: on large-vocabulary models it already appears at 8-bit precision, up to a few hundred previously reachable tokens on a 1B-parameter model, and grows as precision drops, while a small-vocabulary model resists until 3 bits. The loss is far from uniform across languages: on a multilingual vocabulary the silenced tokens are overwhelmingly non-Latin (Korean, Chinese, Thai, Arabic and Hebrew), even though Latin tokens dominate the vocabulary. Silencing is thus a measurable, language-sensitive side effect that standard averages miss, and it should be reported alongside them.

AI.tldr: 提出量化后"输出头静默token"现象，用三重检验给出被静默token数的认证区间（多数设置下精确），发现8bit即出现、且对非拉丁语言严重不均衡。
AI.motivation: 现有量化评估只看困惑度与任务准确率，忽略了更基础的问题：量化后模型是否还能输出某些token。若某token的隐藏状态无法使其成为输出层top-1，则贪心解码永远无法产生它，这是一种被平均值掩盖的语言敏感副作用。
AI.method: 定义"静默token"：不存在任何隐藏状态使其成为输出层最大logit。提出可扩展的估计方法，结合三项检验：(1)构造一个能让该token获胜的方向（证明其安全）；(2)给出token行接近被其他行"包夹"程度的上界；(3)证明该token永不可能获胜的精确匹配。由此得到认证区间：精确匹配给下界，被标记token只可能抬高上界。
AI.result: 在几乎所有设置下（低至3 bit），区间两端重合，计数为精确值。三个开放模型中：大词表模型在8 bit即出现静默，1B参数模型可达数百个原可达token，且随精度降低而增加；小词表模型直到3 bit才受影响。静默分布极不均衡：多语言词表中被静默token以非拉丁文字（韩、中、泰、阿拉伯、希伯来）为主，尽管拉丁token占据词表多数。
AI.conclusion: Token静默是量化可测量、对语言敏感且被标准平均指标遗漏的副作用，应作为常规报告项与困惑度、任务准确率并列。

title: HGDNA: Overlapping k-mer Tokenization for Efficient Autoregressive Genomic Language Models
summary: The domain of genomic language models (gLMs) has advanced rapidly, with models pretrained on diverse multi-species genomic corpora demonstrating their remarkable capabilities. While the effect of simple nucleotide-level tokenization on long-context modeling is well established, overlapping k-mer tokenization remains underexplored in causal pretraining, despite its rich neighborhood information. Here, we thoroughly revisit overlapping tokenization and introduce HGDNA, a hybrid linear-attention gLM with causal language modeling (CLM) pretraining and a shared token-prediction interface for downstream adaptation, using a species-classification auxiliary task and shared class tokens. HGDNA delivers competitive performance across sequence classification and frozen-embedding evaluations, supporting both short-range and long-range tasks with 30M parameters and 19B pretraining tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/Sophie10001b/HGDNA

AI.tldr: 提出HGDNA：采用重叠k-mer分词、混合线性注意力架构的基因组语言模型，经因果语言建模预训练并以共享token预测接口适配下游任务，30M参数即在一系列任务上取得有竞争力表现。
AI.motivation: 多物种基因组语料预训练的gLM发展迅速，核苷酸级分词对长上下文建模的影响已被充分研究，但重叠k-mer分词（含丰富邻域信息）在因果预训练中的作用仍缺乏系统探索；同时下游适配方式与长/短程任务兼顾仍需改进。
AI.method: 系统重新审视重叠k-mer分词；构建HGDNA——混合线性注意力架构的gLM，采用因果语言建模（CLM）预训练；设计共享token预测接口用于下游适配，结合物种分类辅助任务与共享class token；模型规模30M参数、19B预训练token。
AI.result: 在序列分类与冻结嵌入评估中表现具有竞争力，可同时支持短程与长程任务。
AI.conclusion: 重叠k-mer分词在因果预训练中具价值，混合线性注意力+CLM预训练+共享token预测接口的轻量配置（30M参数）即可高效适配多类基因组任务，为gLM分词与架构设计提供参考。

title: Operational Runbooks as Living Documents: A Longitudinal Study of Document Evolution under Assisted Post-Incident Revision
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the 2026 ACM Symposium on Document Engineering (DocEng 2026). Includes appendices
summary: Operational runbooks increasingly function as living documents within operational workflows: they are maintained by people, used in incident support, and continuously revised as organizational knowledge changes. Yet little is known about how such document collections evolve over time in production settings, or which interpretable signals are useful for monitoring document change. We analyze 17 weeks of version-controlled runbook snapshots produced during post-incident revision with machine-assisted review and human oversight. We quantify document evolution using lightweight linguistic and structural signals grounded in prior work on procedural language, technical communication, and document organization. Correlation analysis shows mixed patterns of association, including both positive and negative relationships, with effect sizes ranging from negligible to moderate and varying across corpora. Temporal summaries further distinguish comparatively stable signals from revision-sensitive ones, supporting monitoring of document maintenance workflows rather than one-shot quality judgments. An illustrative analysis on public GitHub product documentation shows that signal behavior differs across corpora, reinforcing the need for context-aware interpretation. These results identify which metric classes provide stable anchors and which provide edit-sensitive indicators for managing operational documentation as an engineered document resource.

AI.tldr: 论文分析了17周版本控制下的运维runbook快照，用轻量级语言与结构信号量化文档演化，发现信号相关性呈现正负混合、效应量从可忽略到中等，且时间摘要可将稳定信号与修订敏感信号区分开来。
AI.motivation: 运维runbook已从静态文档变为在生产工作流中被持续维护、修订的"活文档"，但缺乏对这类文档集合在生产环境中如何随时间演化的认识，也缺乏可用于监控文档变化的可解释信号。
AI.method: 对17周内、事后复盘修订（机器辅助审查+人工监督）产生的版本控制runbook快照进行分析；基于程序性语言、技术写作与文档组织等既有工作，构造轻量级语言学与结构信号；进行相关性分析与时间序列摘要，并在公开GitHub产品文档上做示例性对照分析。
AI.result: 相关性呈混合模式（正负关系并存），效应量从可忽略到中等且跨语料变化；时间摘要可区分相对稳定的信号与对修订敏感的信号；GitHub公共文档上的示例分析显示信号行为在不同语料间存在差异，需情境化解读。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出哪些指标类别可作为稳定锚点、哪些可作为对编辑敏感的指示器，从而支持将运维文档作为工程化文档资源来管理和监控，而非做一次性质量判定；同时强调跨语料解读需考虑上下文。

title: Population-Based Post-Training for Large Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is one of the most popular post-training paradigms for large language models. RLVR typically trains a single model under hyperparameters chosen before training begins, while researchers tune hyperparameters across consecutive runs. We introduce Population-Based Post-Training (PBPT), which trains several models in parallel and lets the training process do the tuning through population-based training. PBPT periodically evaluates models on a validation set. High-performers are duplicated and their hyperparameters perturbed to explore new configurations. Low-performers stop training and are replaced by these copies. On reasoning benchmarks (Enigmata, Nemotron) and interactive tool-use environments (Gaia2, AppWorld), PBPT produces stronger agents than compute-matched groups of independent RLVR learners. Furthermore, PBPT is able to recover from poor initial hyperparameters, automatically discovering better settings over the course of training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Population-Based Post-Training（PBPT），将群体进化式的种群训练引入可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）后训练，让训练过程并行地自动完成超参数调优。
AI.motivation: 传统 RLVR 通常在训练前固定一组超参数训练单个模型，超参数调优依赖研究者在多次串行实验间手动调整，成本高且初始设置不佳时难以挽回。
AI.method: PBPT 并行训练多个模型，周期性在验证集上评估：表现好的模型被复制，并对副本超参数施加扰动以探索新配置；表现差的模型停止训练并被这些副本替换，从而在训练过程中实现种群式（population-based）超参数搜索。
AI.result: 在推理基准（Enigmata、Nemotron）和交互式工具使用环境（Gaia2、AppWorld）上，PBPT 训练出的智能体优于算力匹配的独立 RLVR 学习器群体；同时 PBPT 能够从较差的初始超参数中恢复，在训练过程中自动发现更优设置。
AI.conclusion: 将种群训练与 RLVR 结合可把超参数调优内嵌到后训练流程中，在同等算力下获得更强智能体，并提升对初始超参数的鲁棒性。

title: NoHairCache: Calibrate-Once KV Cache Eviction with One Power-Law Exponent
summary:
The decay exponent $α$ in KV-cache eviction is an intrinsic property of the model: calibrated once on a single corpus, it transfers directly across domains. Attention-based accumulation (H2O) and recency-based sliding windows (StreamingLLM) are two dominant eviction frameworks, often treated as unrelated, but we show that they are the two endpoints of a single power-law family: by scoring each token as $s_i = A_i \cdot (t-i)^{-α}$, where $A_i$ is cumulative attention and $α$ controls the age penalty, H2O and StreamingLLM correspond to $α=0$ and $α\to\infty$, respectively (with StreamingLLM additionally hard-coding an attention-sink patch).
  The no-hair mechanism of \citet{xiang2026nohair} bounds the admissible range of $α$, and the measured exponents agree: calibrating once on WikiText yields $[0.556, 0.822]$ for a representative model (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct). The per-model ranges are consistent across five models (410M--1.5B) and independently match the optimal regions from perplexity sweeps.
  \textsc{NoHairCache} achieves the lowest perplexity across three datasets (WikiText, PG19, and arXiv) without per-dataset tuning, outperforming both H2O and StreamingLLM ($p < 0.05$ on all three datasets, with $0.06$--$0.10$ PPL gains over StreamingLLM at budget $512$). On downstream four-way multiple-choice QA, it matches or outperforms StreamingLLM across all nine (task, budget) cells, retaining $98.2\%$ of full-cache accuracy on NarrativeQA at $25\%$ retention versus $91.1\%$ for StreamingLLM; per-cell McNemar tests are not significant, so QA is corroborating only. We release our calibration script and drop-in scorer upon publication.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示 KV-cache 驱逐中 H2O（注意力累积）与 StreamingLLM（滑动窗口）是统一幂律打分族 s_i = A_i·(t−i)^{−α} 的两个端点（α=0 与 α→∞），并提出 NoHairCache：利用 no-hair 机制界定 α 的有效范围，只需在单一语料上标定一次即可跨域迁移，从而在不做逐数据集调参的情况下取得更优困惑度与可比的 QA 表现。
AI.motivation: 现有两类主流 KV-cache 驱逐框架——基于注意力累积的 H2O 与基于近因的滑动窗口 StreamingLLM——通常被视为互不相关的独立方法，缺乏统一理论视角；同时驱逐策略往往需要针对数据集调参，缺乏可迁移的、有理论约束的超参数选择依据。
AI.method: 将 token 打分统一为 s_i = A_i·(t−i)^{−α}（A_i 为累积注意力，α 控制年龄惩罚），指出 H2O 对应 α=0、StreamingLLM 对应 α→∞（并额外硬编码 attention-sink 补丁）；借助 no-hair 机制给出 α 的可行区间约束，并在 WikiText 上一次性标定（代表性模型 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 得到 [0.556, 0.822]），检验其在五个模型（410M–1.5B）上的一致性，并与困惑度扫描得到的最优区间交叉验证；据此实现 NoHairCache 打分器。
AI.result: 在 WikiText、PG19、arXiv 三个数据集上，NoHairCache 无需逐数据集调参即取得最低困惑度，显著优于 H2O 与 StreamingLLM（三数据集均 p<0.05；预算 512 时相对 StreamingLLM 提升 0.06–0.10 PPL）；在下游四选一 QA 的九个（任务, 预算）单元中均达到或超过 StreamingLLM，NarrativeQA 在 25% 保留率下保持全缓存精度的 98.2%（StreamingLLM 为 91.1%），但逐单元 McNemar 检验不显著，故 QA 仅为佐证性证据。
AI.conclusion: H2O 与 StreamingLLM 可统一为幂律年龄惩罚族的两个极端；α 是模型的内在属性、单语料标定即可跨域迁移，且其可行范围受 no-hair 机制约束并与经验最优区间吻合。NoHairCache 以此实现免调参的驱逐打分，在困惑度上稳健领先、在 QA 上不劣于基线，为 KV-cache 驱逐提供了统一、可解释且可复用的参数化框架。

title: Seeing Is Not Acting: WARD Diagnoses the Evidence-to-State-to-Action Gap in Longitudinal Clinical Agents
summary: Large language models for longitudinal clinical care must revise their assessments and actions as patient information accumulates. However, benchmarks centered on isolated responses or final task outcomes provide limited insight into intermediate failures in evidence use, state updating, and action selection. We introduce WARD, a benchmark for evaluating how clinical agents translate accumulating evidence into patient-state judgments and timely, safe actions. WARD comprises 4,560 clinical tasks across seven clinical output domains, organized into 240 checkpoints from 40 longitudinal clinical trajectories spanning 95 hospitalizations. Its Longitudinal Track evaluates these tasks under controlled cumulative evidence. Its Interactive Track evaluates end-to-end, tool-mediated clinical management across 271 verifiable evidence items and 141 reference transitions. Across 12 models with scorable checkpoint outputs, evidence recognition consistently outpaces downstream state and action decisions, with linked-evidence nonresponse reaching 74.47--90.90\%. Models also struggle to retain and update information over time, while in the Interactive Track only 11.46\% of executed actions advance a reference transition. These results reveal a persistent evidence-to-state-to-action gap and highlight the need for process-level evaluation of longitudinal clinical agents.Code and data: https://github.com/Dingsuper-creator/WARD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WARD 基准，从过程层面评估纵向临床智能体如何将累积证据转化为状态判断与及时安全行动，揭示出"证据—状态—行动"之间存在持续性鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 纵向临床诊疗中的大模型需随患者信息累积不断修正评估与行动，但现有基准多关注孤立回答或最终任务结果，难以洞察证据使用、状态更新与行动选择等中间环节的失败。
AI.method: 构建 WARD 基准：含 4,560 项临床任务、覆盖 7 个临床输出域，由 40 条纵向临床轨迹（95 次住院）组织为 240 个检查点。分两条赛道：Longitudinal Track 在受控累积证据下评估任务；Interactive Track 通过工具中介评估端到端临床管理，含 271 个可验证证据项与 141 个参考转移。
AI.result: 在 12 个具可评分检查点输出的模型中，证据识别能力持续优于下游状态与行动决策，关联证据无响应率达 74.47%–90.90%；模型难以随时间保留与更新信息；Interactive Track 中仅 11.46% 的执行动作推进了参考转移。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示持续的"证据—状态—行动"鸿沟，强调对纵向临床智能体开展过程级评估的必要性。代码与数据已开源。

title: ContextFact: Remembering Facts in Context for Long-Term Conversational Agents
summary: Agents built on large language models must maintain continuity across repeated interactions with users. However, long-term conversations scatter facts across turns and sessions, making it difficult to retrieve the right evidence with enough context. Memory for such conversations must therefore preserve facts with their context while keeping evidence selectively accessible. We first study how memory construction and retrieval-unit boundaries affect answerability and evidence access. Reading the entire memory bank reveals gaps that cannot be resolved by retrieval selection alone, showing that some context must be preserved during memory construction. Adjacent-turn grouping improves evidence access at matched unique-turn budgets, while wider windows do not consistently help. This motivates keeping fact-specific context local while organizing cross-session evidence separately. We propose ContextFact, which links context-preserving fact memories with source-grounded entity representations. Within sessions, it gathers the context needed to interpret each fact. Across sessions, it aligns recurring referents and revisits the source dialogue to reconstruct coherent entity representations linked to the supporting facts. At query time, ContextFact retrieves fact and entity views, reranks them independently, and uses entity-linked expansion to surface related facts; complete entity representations then provide organized cross-session evidence. With Qwen3.5-27B as the backbone, ContextFact achieves state-of-the-art performance while using only $21\%$ of the evidence tokens consumed by the strongest evaluated baseline, obtaining $86.49\%$ overall judge accuracy on LoCoMo and $91.00\%$ on LongMemEval-S. Controlled ablations support context-preserving fact boundaries and source-grounded entity reconstruction, while entity readout improves multi-hop accuracy beyond adding more facts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ContextFact记忆框架：以保留上下文的“事实记忆”结合源对话溯源的实体表示，在会话内为每个事实保留解释所需上下文、跨会话对齐指代并重建实体表示；检索时对事实与实体双视图分别重排并做实体链接扩展。在Qwen3.5-27B骨干下仅用21%证据token即达SOTA，LoCoMo 86.49%、LongMemEval-S 91.00%。
AI.motivation: 长期对话中事实散落在多轮多次会话中，仅靠检索选择难以补齐缺失上下文；需要研究记忆构建与检索单元边界如何影响可回答性与证据获取，从而设计兼顾“保留事实上下文”与“证据可选择性访问”的记忆机制。
AI.method: 先做边界诊断实验：整库读取暴露检索无法弥补的缺口，相邻轮分组在同等唯一轮预算下提升证据访问，过宽窗口无稳定收益。据此提出ContextFact：(1) 会话内为每个事实构建上下文保留型事实记忆；(2) 跨会话对齐重复指代并回访源对话，重建与事实链接的实体表示；(3) 查询时检索事实视图与实体视图，独立重排，经实体链接扩展召回相关事实，并由完整实体表示提供跨会话组织化证据。
AI.result: 骨干Qwen3.5-27B下取得SOTA，证据token消耗仅为最强基线21%；LoCoMo总体评判准确率86.49%，LongMemEval-S 91.00%。消融验证上下文保留型事实边界与源溯源实体重建的作用，实体读出在不多加事实的情况下提升多跳准确率。
AI.conclusion: 长期对话记忆应在构建阶段局部保留事实上下文、在跨会话层面以源溯源实体表示组织证据，而非仅依赖检索选择；该双视图“事实+实体”设计在显著降低证据token开销的同时提升整体与多跳问答表现。

title: Benchmarking and Adapting LLMs for English-Swedish Medical Question Answering
summary: Large language models do well on English medical exams, but less is known about Swedish. This matters most for small open models that hospitals can run locally. To reduce this gap, we first build an item-aligned English-Swedish benchmark from ten medical multiple-choice datasets; each Swedish item keeps the options and answer of its English source. A conservative refinement loop repairs the translations: open models from three families find errors, ground them in a Swedish medical term base, and keep a model-written edit only if blind judges vote for it. On this benchmark, small models lose much more accuracy in Swedish than large ones, especially when they answer without reasoning. Second, we ask whether English data and open teacher models can close this gap. We translate the training data, let teachers write reasoning traces, and fine-tune two small students on gold answers or traces in English, Swedish, or both. Training on reasoning traces that include Swedish closes the gap and lifts the 1.2B student from 23.5\% to 52.0\% in Swedish, slightly above a 20B open model in its fast mode, with a sixth of its memory. We release the benchmark, its edit history, and the code.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了英瑞对齐的医学多选题基准，并提出用英瑞双语推理轨迹微调小模型以缩小瑞典语医学能力差距。
AI.motivation: 大模型在英文医学考试上表现优异，但瑞典语等小语种能力知之甚少，这对医院本地部署的小型开源模型尤为关键，需要量化并弥合这一差距。
AI.method: (1) 基于10个医学多选题数据集构建条目对齐的英瑞双语基准，瑞典语题目保留英文原题的选项与答案；采用保守精修循环：三家模型家族的开源模型找错、以瑞典医学术语库为依据、仅在盲审投票通过时保留模型改写。(2) 翻译训练数据，由开源教师模型生成推理轨迹，在英文、瑞典文或双语的金答案或轨迹上微调两个小模型。
AI.result: 基准上，小模型在瑞典语下的准确率损失远大于大模型，无推理作答时尤为明显。含瑞典语的推理轨迹训练可弥合差距，1.2B学生模型瑞典语成绩从23.5%提升至52.0%，略超20B开源模型快速模式，且内存仅为其六分之一。
AI.conclusion: 英瑞对齐基准与双语推理轨迹微调可有效提升小型开源模型的瑞典语医学能力，作者开源基准、编辑历史与代码。

title: What Counts as Attack Success? Evaluating Harmfulness in Red Teaming LLMs
summary: Judging whether a model response is harmful requires contextual and normative choices, yet red-teaming studies often delegate this judgment to automated evaluators. We examine how harmfulness criteria are specified in red-teaming research and how they carry through to reported results. Reviewing 76 papers, we find that many adopt their criteria from prior datasets, classifiers, or judge prompts rather than defining harmfulness themselves. Applying evaluators from these papers to identical outputs, we find that they can reach different judgments on the same response, which can change conclusions when comparing models. These differences arise partly because evaluators draw the boundary of harm in different places: some count any response that does not refuse, while others count only output that could plausibly cause harm. We argue that red-teaming studies should state their harmfulness criteria and report how they chose and validated their evaluators to support more reliable measurement and interpretation.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统考察红队研究中"有害性"标准的界定方式及其对结论的影响：76篇论文多沿用已有数据集、分类器或评判提示而非自行定义；将不同论文的评估器用于同一批输出时，会对同一回答给出不同判定，进而改变模型比较结论。差异源于对"伤害边界"的划法不同（"未拒绝即有害" vs "可能导致伤害才算有害"）。作者呼吁明确陈述有害性标准并报告评估器的选择与验证过程。
AI.motivation: 判断模型回答是否有害涉及语境与规范性选择，但红队研究通常把这一判断外包给自动评估器。既有研究缺乏对有害性标准如何被指定、又如何传导至报告结果的系统审视，导致测量可信度与结论可比性存疑。
AI.method: 对76篇红队论文进行文献综述，梳理有害性标准的来源（先前数据集、分类器、评判提示等）；随后抽取这些论文中的评估器，应用于完全相同的模型输出，比较其判定差异及其对模型间比较结论的影响，并分析分歧来源。
AI.result: 同一回答在不同评估器下可得到不同有害性判定，且这种差异足以翻转模型比较的结论；分歧部分源于有害性边界的设定不同：部分评估器将任何未拒绝的回答计为有害，另一些仅统计可能造成实际伤害的输出。
AI.conclusion: 红队研究应明确陈述其有害性判定标准，并报告评估器的选择依据与验证方式，以支持更可靠的测量与解释。

title: VADE: A Verifiable Agent Data Engine from Professional Sources
comment: 40 pages, 6 figures, 32 tables. Project page: https://tiger-ai-lab.github.io/VADE/
summary: Language agents have shown their practical value, particularly in software engineering, where abundant public code and executable tests support training and evaluation at scale. Extending this success to other professional domains, such as law and finance, is not straightforward: many agent tasks involve open-ended analysis, making outcomes hard to verify and, in turn, hard to use as scalable supervision. As a result, high-quality tasks in these domains are still largely expert-authored, making them expensive to scale and limiting their use for training. To address this bottleneck, we introduce VADE, a data engine that automatically constructs verifiable analysis tasks from public sources used in professional practice. VADE exploits a simple asymmetry: professional analyses are difficult to solve because the relevant evidence must first be found and interpreted, but much easier to verify once that evidence is fixed. During task synthesis, the engine constructs a reference analysis from source evidence and asks an independent agent to reproduce its conclusions from the same evidence without seeing it. Only after the analysis is verified is it compiled into an open-ended task with an item-level scoring contract, allowing the same task to support both evaluation and training. We apply VADE across four professional domains; in an independent expert review of 186 finance tasks, 93.5% meet a high bar for source fidelity, answer correctness, and evaluation fairness. In finance, these tasks expose substantial remaining model errors, particularly unsupported facts and inferences, while training on verified solver trajectories improves held-out performance and yields gains that transfer to public finance benchmarks such as Finance Agent Benchmark v2. Together, these results suggest a practical path toward scalable, verifiable supervision for open-ended professional tasks.

AI.tldr: VADE 是一个数据引擎，利用"专业分析难解但易验"的不对称性，从公开来源自动合成可验证的开放式分析任务，在四个专业领域（含金融）生成可用于评测与训练的高质量任务。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体在软件工程中受益于大量公开代码与可执行测试，可实现规模化训练与评测；但法律、金融等专业领域的任务多为开放式分析，结果难以验证，无法作为可扩展的监督信号，导致高质量任务依赖专家撰写，成本高、难扩展、难以用于训练。
AI.method: 提出 VADE 数据引擎：任务合成时，先从源证据构建参考分析，再让独立智能体在相同证据（但不看参考分析）下复现其结论；验证通过后，将分析编译为带逐项评分契约（item-level scoring contract）的开放式任务，使同一任务同时支持评测与训练。
AI.result: 在四个专业领域应用；186 个金融任务的独立专家评审中，93.5% 在来源忠实度、答案正确性与评测公平性上达到高标准。金融任务暴露出模型显著残余错误，尤其是不受支持的事实与推断；基于已验证求解轨迹的训练提升了留出集表现，并迁移至 Finance Agent Benchmark v2 等公开金融基准。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，该路径为开放式专业任务提供了可扩展、可验证的监督方案，缓解了专家标注瓶颈，并使合成任务兼具评测与训练价值。

title: Reading the Tea Leaves, Again: Can Large Language Models Predict Language Model Training Runs?
comment: 63 pages, 9 figures, 40 tables; supplementary material (11 pages) as an ancillary file. Code and data: https://github.com/colinzhaoust/read-tea-leaves
summary: LLM agents now propose research ideas and run the experiments that test them, but they train every run to its end, whereas a researcher reads a run's configuration and the beginning of its curve and stops the runs that show no promise. Reading a run this way takes more than describing or implementing a training method: it takes knowing what a design choice does to a run. We build Tea Leaves to measure this knowledge on 682 real training runs across pretraining, fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning (RL): a forecaster sees the first 20% of a run with its configuration, description, and code, and predicts the rest. Across 11 LLMs and a range of forecasting baselines, the strongest LLMs match or exceed the best curve fitter on smooth loss curves (skill 0.66 against 0.62) and lead on noisy RL reward curves (0.43 against 0.13). What bounds every forecaster is what the log carries: on sparsely logged community runs all methods lose most of their skill, and none reliably flags a failing run in advance. Beyond the curve, information helps and effort does not: related runs in the prompt cut the error on loss curves by 39%, and knowledge of training dynamics lets the strongest LLMs order all 36 pairs of runs that differ by a described code change, which the early curves do not separate, whereas tools add little. This knowledge can be learned from logged runs: a small open model trained on public runs matches the best LLM on loss curves. Applied to the progress curves of research agents, the same reading ranks tasks by their remaining headroom, although for a single agent run it does not improve on the last value. We release the benchmark, the trained readers, and their training data to test and train LLMs' understanding of training and to help research agents decide which runs deserve their compute.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Tea Leaves基准，用682个真实训练运行（预训练、微调、强化学习）检验LLM能否像研究者一样“读曲线”预判运行走势；强LLM在平滑loss曲线（skill 0.66 vs 0.62）和噪声RL奖励曲线（0.43 vs 0.13）上领先最佳曲线拟合器，但性能受日志稀疏性与失败运行可识别性限制；且相关信息比工具更重要，该能力可由小型开源模型习得。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM agent能提出研究想法并执行实验，但往往把每次运行训练到底，缺乏研究者“看配置与前段曲线即早停无望运行”的能力；这种能力不仅是描述或实现训练方法，而是理解设计选择对训练轨迹的影响，此前缺少可量化评测的手段。
AI.method: 构建Tea Leaves基准，覆盖682个真实训练运行（预训练/微调/RL）；设定预测任务：给定一个运行的前20%曲线及其配置、描述与代码，预测剩余曲线；评测对象包括11个LLM与多种曲线拟合基线；开展消融分析（提示中加入相关运行、注入训练动力学知识、使用工具、在公开运行上训练小型开放模型），并迁移到研究agent的进度曲线上按剩余提升空间排序任务。
AI.result: 最强LLM在平滑loss曲线上持平或超过最佳曲线拟合器（skill 0.66 vs 0.62），在噪声RL奖励曲线上明显领先（0.43 vs 0.13）。上限受日志信息量约束：社区稀疏日志下所有方法skill大幅下降，且无方法能可靠提前识别失败运行。消融显示“信息有效、努力无效”：提示中加入相关运行使loss曲线误差降低39%；具备训练动力学知识的强LLM能对36对仅由代码改动区分的运行全部正确排序，而早期曲线无法区分；工具增益有限。在公开运行上训练的小开放模型在loss曲线上达到最佳LLM水平。应用于研究agent进度曲线时可按剩余headroom排序任务，但单次agent运行预测不优于最后值基线。
AI.conclusion: “读训练曲线”的知识可被基准化测量，并可从日志运行中学习，且主要依赖信息而非工具；论文公开基准、训练好的reader及其训练数据，用于检验与训练LLM对训练过程的理解，并帮助研究agent决定哪些运行值得投入算力。目前对稀疏日志与失败运行的提前预警仍是开放挑战。

title: Parameter-Efficient Vocabulary Expansion via Cross-Lingual Embedding Alignment
summary: Continual pretraining with vocabulary expansion is often used to make large language models (LLMs) more effective and efficient at handling new languages. However, when LLMs are extended to many languages simultaneously, the number of model parameters increases significantly. In addition, the newly added tokens do not receive the same number of training steps as the tokens in the original vocabulary, which sometimes causes vocabulary expansion to yield only limited performance improvements. We propose leveraging the semantic equivalence between words in the model's primary language and those in the extended vocabulary to transfer learned representations. In this paper, we introduce MATE, a parameter-efficient vocabulary expansion method that enables effective cross-lingual transfer with 8 times fewer additional parameters per token. MATE reduces the average tokenization compression ratio and delivers improvements on multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 MATE，一种参数高效的词表扩展方法，利用主语言与扩展语言词间语义等价实现跨语言表示迁移，每个新词仅需约 1/8 的新增参数。
AI.motivation: 多语言持续预训练常通过词表扩展提升 LLM 对新增语言的处理效果，但存在两个问题：一是同时扩展多语言时参数量显著增加；二是新增 token 的训练步数远少于原词表 token，导致扩展收益有限。
AI.method: 核心思路是挖掘模型主语言词与扩展词表中词之间的语义等价关系，据此将已学表示迁移至新词。基于该思想设计 MATE 方法，降低每个新增 token 所需的附加参数量（约为基线的 1/8），并与词表扩展式持续预训练结合使用。
AI.result: MATE 降低了平均分词压缩比（tokenization compression ratio），并在多个基准测试上取得性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 语义等价驱动的表示迁移可有效缓解参数膨胀与新 token 欠训练问题，为多语言词表扩展提供了一种参数高效且有效的方案。

title: Sánchez, Feijóo, or Abascal? Speaker Attribution and Ideological Congruence in LLM Personas Reading Posts on X of the Leaders of the Three Main Parties of the 29N General Election in Spain
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures, 31 tables. Code and configuration: https://github.com/VictorMYeste/spanish-political-communication
summary: Source cues are central to political communication, yet reception studies with large language model (LLM) personas as synthetic audiences have not tested whether personas respond to who speaks and not only to what is said. With Spain's general election of 29 November 2026 in mind, we run a speaker-attribution experiment using 1,075 anonymised X posts by the leaders of PSOE, PP and VOX on four topics (the economy and employment, household costs, immigration and corruption) and 791 distinct value-grounded, LLM-generated personas. Each post was assigned to 300 topic-selected persona profiles, 150 grounded in the Inglehart-Welzel cultural map and 150 in Moral Foundations Theory, under four conditions: no author, Sánchez, Feijóo or Abascal, yielding 322,470 complete persona-post quartets. Naming any leader lowered support for identical text, with the penalty for Abascal nearly twice as large as those for Sánchez and Feijóo. The penalty follows the persona's elicited left-right self-placement (ideological congruence): left personas spare Sánchez and right personas spare Feijóo, although ideology was never in the message-evaluation prompt. Corruption posts were penalised under every name, whereas on other topics the ideologically closest leader generally produced little or no penalty. The leader order matches public opinion in 48 CIS barometers (2022-2026) in all three groups and the sign of all twelve differences, but fits barometers before the model's 2024 knowledge cutoff better than recent ones. Our findings demonstrate that LLM personas evaluate political speakers through systematic, value-congruent priors: however, while they replicate human candidate rank-orders across survey barometers, this alignment is ordinal rather than quantitative, highlighting their utility for controlled source-effect experiments though not as substitutes for empirical public opinion surveys.

AI.tldr: 本研究用791个基于价值观的大模型人格作为合成受众，对1075条西班牙政党领导人匿名推文做来源归因实验（322,470组人格-帖子配对），发现署名任何领导人都会降低对同一文本的支持，且惩罚强度随人格的左右意识形态呈现系统性的价值一致性偏向，其排序与48份CIS民调一致但仅为序数层面吻合。
AI.motivation: 既有大模型人格受众的接收研究多关注"说了什么"，尚未检验其是否对"谁在说"产生反应；作者希望验证LLM人格能否作为可控的合成受众，用于来源效应实验。
AI.method: 以西班牙2026年11月大选为背景，选取PSOE、PP、VOX三党领导人的1075条匿名X帖子（涵盖经济就业、家庭开支、移民、腐败四议题）与791个由Inglehart-Welzel文化地图和道德基础理论锚定的LLM人格。每条帖子分配给300个按议题筛选的人格（各150来自两种价值框架），设置无署名、Sánchez、Feijóo、Abascal四种条件，共322,470组完整配对；并将结果与2002–2026年48份CIS民调比对。
AI.result: 署名任何领导人均降低对相同文本的支持，Abascal的惩罚约为Sánchez与Feijóo的近两倍；惩罚遵循人格自陈的左右立场（意识形态一致性），左翼人格对Sánchez、右翼人格对Feijóo惩罚更小，尽管意识形态并未出现在消息评估提示中。腐败议题在所有署名下均受惩罚，其他议题上意识形态最接近的领导人几乎不产生惩罚。三位领导人的排序及全部12项差值符号与48份CIS民调一致，但对2024年知识截止前的民调拟合优于近期民调。
AI.conclusion: LLM人格通过系统性的价值一致先验评估政治说话者，可在受控来源效应实验中复现人类候选人的序数排序，但不具备定量等价性，不能替代实证民意调查。

title: Refine, Don't Reinvent: RASA-Bench for Source-Grounded Hindi Prose Refinement
comment: Accepted to EACL 2027. 22 pages, 8 figures. Project page: https://abdur75648.github.io/rasa-bench
summary: For a producer of Hindi creative prose, drafting is cheap and editing is not: a machine-written episode, story, or essay reads as under-written and flat, laced with translationese, and it sometimes quietly alters what the source says. RASA-Bench targets that editing task across three Hindi prose forms, measuring how well a model refines an under-written AI draft, a task distinct from writing from scratch. Across 2,050 drafts and eight refiners (16,400 rewrites), a four-layer protocol credits a rewrite only after it passes a faithfulness check against its own source, then ranks the survivors by holistic editorial preference through per-form Bradley-Terry fits whose centered coefficients are standardized before equal-weight averaging. Staying faithful proves to be a decisive test that behaves differently by form: gate-failure rates range from 9.1% on short stories to 29.5% on audio fiction, and the drift that disqualifies a rewrite shifts from events and identity in narrative to claims and evidence in essays. A 600-case human audit puts gate agreement at 0.925 (0.91 to 0.94 across forms), whereas subjective preference is form-sensitive and least settled for essays, among human readers no less than the model judge. The benchmark, evaluation protocol, and Hindi prose diagnostics are available at https://abdur75648.github.io/rasa-bench.

AI.tldr: 提出RASA-Bench，面向印地语创作性散文的"AI草稿精修"任务，构建2,050份草稿、8个精修模型共16,400次改写，采用"忠实性门控+分体裁Bradley-Terry偏好排序"的四层评估协议。
AI.motivation: 对印地语创作性散文而言，起草成本低而编辑成本高：机器生成的情节、短篇或议论文往往显得欠润色、平板、带翻译腔，且会悄悄改变原文内容。既有工作多聚焦"从零生成"，缺乏对"精修欠润色的AI草稿"这一独立任务的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建覆盖三种印地语散文体裁的RASA-Bench；四层评估协议：改写须先通过与自身源文的忠实性门控检验，幸存者再经由分体裁的Bradley-Terry模型拟合得到整体编辑偏好排序，中心化系数标准化后等权平均；并辅以600例人工审计。
AI.result: 忠实性门控是决定性检验且体裁异质：门控失败率从短篇小说的9.1%到音频小说的29.5%；导致失格的漂移在叙事中集中于事件与人物身份，在议论文中转为论断与证据。人工审计门控一致率为0.925（各体裁0.91–0.94）；主观偏好对体裁敏感，议论文最不稳定，人类读者与模型评判者皆然。
AI.conclusion: RASA-Bench将"精修"确立为独立于"生成"的可测任务，表明忠实性约束与主观编辑偏好应分开评测，且后者需按体裁区别对待；基准、协议与印地语散文诊断工具已公开。

title: Which Loopholes Get Found? Predicting Reward Hacking of LLM Judges Before RL Training
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Code and run summaries: https://github.com/justLxy/which-loopholes-get-found
summary: A policy trained against an LLM judge can learn to exploit its loopholes. Static probes show that such judges accept degenerate answers like a lone "{" or "Thought process:", but not which flaw a policy will find. In GRPO the first loophole to be exploited can be predicted before training from each pattern's exposure, the product of the starting policy's propensity to produce it and the judge's false-positive rate (FPR). To test exposure causally, we seed the patterns into fine-tuning at three doses in a Latin square. Across 36 GRPO runs with seven judges, the first exploited pattern had the highest exposure in all 12 runs with exploitation and the highest FPR in only 6. Predictions recorded before training held in three of four runs with one pattern masked by rule. When only two patterns were seeded, at 3% to 3.8% of the fine-tuning data and chosen so that exposure disagreed with FPR alone or propensity alone, exposure named the first exploited pattern and its onset window in all six runs. Exploitation occurred only on hard prompts, where an accepted exploit gets a large group-normalized advantage. Auditing exposure before RL therefore identifies the loophole a policy will likely exploit first.

AI.tldr: 提出用"暴露度"（exposure = 策略生成某作弊模式倾向 × 评判器对其实假阳率）在RL训练前预测GRPO中首个被利用的评判漏洞，并通过拉丁方播种实验因果验证。
AI.motivation: 静态探针只能表明LLM评判器会接受退化答案（如孤立的"{"或"Thought process:"），却无法说明被优化的策略实际会先利用哪个漏洞；需要一种训练前可计算、可预测首个被利用漏洞的指标。
AI.method: 定义暴露度为起始策略产生该模式的倾向与评判器假阳率(FPR)的乘积；用拉丁方设计将模式以三档剂量播种进微调数据做因果检验；共36次GRPO运行、7个评判器；并构造两模式条件下暴露度与单一FPR或单一倾向相矛盾的对照实验。
AI.result: 12次发生利用的运行中，首个被利用模式均在暴露度上最高，但仅6次FPR最高；规则屏蔽一模式时，训练前预测在4次运行中有3次成立；仅播种两模式时（占微调数据3%–3.8%），暴露度在全部6次运行中正确指出首个被利用模式及其出现窗口。利用只发生在难提示上，此时被接受的作弊答案可获得较大的组归一化优势。
AI.conclusion: RL前审计暴露度可识别策略最可能首先利用的漏洞，为LLM评判器的漏洞检测与防御提供训练前预警手段。

title: Reducing Authorship Attribution Risk in Student Texts Through Style-Conditioned Rewriting
summary: Building NLP applications for education is constrained by data scarcity due to student privacy concerns and data regulations. To address this, we propose a style-aware approach to rewriting student forum posts that retains analytical value while reducing identifiability. Our method isolates content, structure, and style as separate conditioning channels and aggregates over student-disjoint exemplar partitions within style clusters, extending Differentially Private In-context Learning (DP-ICL) with cluster-restricted retrieval. Across three educational NLP datasets, our approach achieves high style fidelity, preserves downstream task performance, and reduces authorship attribution risk relative to the original student-written texts, including against a dedicated authorship-attribution model.

AI.tldr: 提出一种风格感知的重写方法，将学生论坛帖子的内容、结构与风格解耦为独立条件通道，并在风格簇内对与学生互斥的示例分区做聚合，将DP-ICL扩展为簇受限检索。在三个教育NLP数据集上，该方法实现高风格保真度、保持下游任务性能，并降低作者归属风险（包括针对专门的作者归属模型）。
AI.motivation: 教育NLP应用受限于数据稀缺，根源是学生隐私顾虑与数据法规限制。需在保留分析价值的同时降低文本可识别性。
AI.method: 风格感知重写：将内容、结构、风格分离为独立条件通道；在风格聚类内，对与学生不相交的示例分区进行聚合；在DP-ICL基础上引入簇受限检索（cluster-restricted retrieval）。
AI.result: 在三个教育NLP数据集上：风格保真度高；下游任务性能得以保持；相较于原始学生文本，作者归属风险降低，且对专门的作者归属模型同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过风格解耦条件化与簇受限的隐私保护上下文检索，可在缓解教育NLP数据稀缺的同时实现隐私—效用平衡。

title: Escriba-OCR: A 1B Vision-Language Model for Error-Preserving Transcription of Handwritten Portuguese Essays
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. Model: https://huggingface.co/tardellirs/Escriba-OCR-1B ; code and benchmark: https://github.com/tardellirs/escriba-ocr
summary: Feedback tools and research on learner writing need transcriptions of handwritten essays that keep exactly what the student wrote: misspellings, line breaks, struck-through words and insertions. Vision-language models (VLMs) read handwriting well, but they also tend to rewrite it into correct language. We measure this on BRESSAY, 1,000 handwritten Brazilian Portuguese essays, with a benchmark that adds error preservation, invented errors, edit-markup precision and recall and line structure to the character error rate (CER) and uses paired bootstrap confidence intervals. We restrict the study to open-weight models that schools can run on their own hardware. Of 22 open baselines, the best, Qwen3-VL 235B-A22B, reaches 5.6% CER on the 199 test pages; none reproduces the edit markup reliably, and every VLM replaces 39-78% of the words absent from a Portuguese dictionary with dictionary words. We fine-tune LightOnOCR-3-1B on the 647 training pages in 85 minutes on one GPU. The resulting Escriba-OCR-1B reaches 2.06% CER, 3.5 points below the best baseline (95% CI [-4.2, -2.9]); under the ICDAR 2024 competition metric it reaches 2.1% CER, below the best published page-level results (2.2-2.4%). It recovers 67% of insertions and 77% of illegible deletions, and reproduces the line structure of 97% of the pages, but still normalises 60% of likely misspellings. Three seeds agree within 0.04 CER points, and quantised to 4 bits the model runs on an ordinary CPU at about one minute per page. On 40 letters of another corpus it matches its base model (without that model's appended comments) but misreads unseen words more often; weight interpolation recovers half the gap. A teacher's review finds that 45% of the judgeable apparent corrections are errors in the BRESSAY ground truth, so dictionary-based scores likely understate preservation. We release the model, the benchmark code and the review data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BRESSAY 基准与 Escriba-OCR-1B 模型，衡量并改善视觉语言模型在转录手写作文时"过度规范化"（改写拼写错误、丢失编辑标记）的问题。
AI.motivation: 写作反馈工具与研究需要"逐字忠实"的手写作文转录，须保留拼写错误、换行、删改痕迹；然而现有 VLM 虽识别能力好，却倾向于把文本改写为规范语言，且学校可本地部署的开源模型在此问题上缺乏系统评测。
AI.method: 构建 BRESSAY（1,000 篇巴西葡萄牙语手写作文）基准，在 CER 之外增加错误保留率、虚构错误、编辑标记精确率/召回率、行结构等指标，并采用配对 bootstrap 置信区间；仅评测可本地运行的开源权重模型。随后在 647 页训练集上以单卡 GPU 微调 LightOnOCR-3-1B（85 分钟），得到 Escriba-OCR-1B；另用 40 封其他语料信件做跨语料测试，并做教师人工复核。
AI.result: 22 个开源基线中最佳者 Qwen3-VL 235B-A22B 在 199 页测试集上 CER 5.6%，但无一能可靠复现编辑标记，且所有 VLM 将 39–78% 的非词典词替换为词典词。Escriba-OCR-1B 达 2.06% CER，较最佳基线低 3.5 点（95% CI [-4.2, -2.9]）；ICDAR 2024 指标下 CER 2.1%，优于已发表最佳页面级结果（2.2–2.4%）。恢复 67% 插入、77% 不可辨删除，97% 页面行结构复现正确，但仍规范化 60% 疑似拼写错误。三个随机种子差异在 0.04 CER 点内；4 bit 量化后可在普通 CPU 上约一分钟/页运行。跨语料信件上与基模型相当（无其后附评论）但生词误读更多，权重插值可弥补约一半差距。教师复核发现可判定"更正"中 45% 实为 BRESSAY 标注错误，说明基于词典的评分可能低估了保留能力。
AI.conclusion: 轻量微调即可在开源可部署模型上大幅提升手写转录的忠实度与效率，但拼写错误规范化仍是未解难点；同时现有词典化评测与人工标注存在偏差，需更严谨的基准与标注。作者公开模型、基准代码与复核数据。

title: Tool-to-Self: Internalizing Visual Tool Capabilities via Scaffolded Reinforcement Learning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly rely on external visual tools to access fine-grained visual evidence, but repeated tool execution incurs substantial inference overhead and deployment dependencies. Moreover, conventional tool-use RL can improve visual-task performance, yet the resulting tool gains are often unstable. Motivated by this, we propose Tool-to-Self (T2S), a tool-scaffolded reinforcement learning framework that turns external visual tools into temporary training scaffolds. T2S cold-starts tool-use ability and observation prediction from tool-repairable examples, then progressively anneals tool execution on a per-tool basis during RL. By combining answer-correctness and observation-consistency rewards with privileged on-policy self-distillation from actual tool observations, T2S effectively teaches the model both to reproduce tool outputs and to reason from them. Experiments across diverse visual perception and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over both explicit tool-use models and implicit zooming models while enabling tool-free inference with reduced latency.

AI.tldr: T2S：把外部视觉工具当作可退出的训练脚手架，通过冷启动+RL中逐工具退火，实现无工具推理且性能稳定的VLM。
AI.motivation: VLM依赖外部视觉工具获取细粒度视觉证据，但重复调用带来推理开销与部署依赖；且常规工具使用RL带来的性能增益往往不稳定。
AI.method: 提出工具脚手架式强化学习框架T2S：(1) 从工具可修复样本冷启动工具使用与观测预测能力；(2) 在RL阶段按工具粒度逐步退火（anneal）工具执行；(3) 采用答案正确性奖励与观测一致性奖励，并结合来自真实工具观测的privileged on-policy self-distillation，使模型既能复现工具输出又能基于其推理。
AI.result: 在多样化视觉感知与推理基准上，相较显式工具使用模型和隐式缩放（zooming）模型均取得一致提升，同时支持无工具推理并降低延迟。
AI.conclusion: 外部视觉工具可作为阶段性训练脚手架，训练后被移除，从而获得稳定增益、无工具依赖与更低推理延迟的VLM。

title: From Reward Engineering to Data-Centric Reinforcement Learning for Effective Agentic Visual Tool Use
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly use external visual tools to acquire evidence during reasoning, yet learning when to invoke these tools remains challenging. Existing tool-use reinforcement learning (RL) methods often rely on call-contingent rewards to encourage beneficial tool use, but such reward engineering can distort the task objective and lead to degenerate calling behaviors. We argue that effective tool-use learning requires identifying not merely which questions are difficult, but which failures are attributable to missing visual evidence and can therefore be corrected through tool observations. We propose AOVO, a data-centric framework that enables MLLMs to learn effective tool use through perception attribution and policy-adaptive data sampling (PADS), without introducing tool-specific rewards. It counterfactually probes the model's reasoning states to identify observation-sensitive questions, distinguishing them from reasoning-dominated ones. PADS then periodically estimates category-level observation effects from recent policy rollouts and dynamically reallocates the training distribution toward questions where visual observations provide informative learning signals, while optimizing solely for final-answer correctness. Experiments across diverse visual perception and multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over competitive tool-use MLLMs, with causal analysis further validating the data-centric perspective for learning effective visual tool use.

AI.tldr: 提出AOVO数据-centric框架，通过反事实探测识别"观察敏感"问题并按类别动态重分配训练分布，在无工具专用奖励的前提下让MLLM学会有效调用视觉工具。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用RL依赖"调用即奖励"（call-contingent reward），会扭曲任务目标并导致退化性调用行为。作者认为关键在于区分哪些失败源于缺失视觉证据、可被工具观察纠正，而非仅区分问题难易。
AI.method: AOVO包含两部分：(1) 感知归因——对模型推理状态做反事实探测，识别observation-sensitive问题，并与推理主导型问题区分；(2) 策略自适应数据采样（PADS）——周期性从近期策略rollout中估计类别级观察效应，动态将训练分布向观察能提供有效学习信号的问题倾斜，仅以最终答案正确性为优化目标，不引入工具专用奖励。
AI.result: 在多个视觉感知与多模态推理基准上，相较有竞争力的工具使用MLLM取得一致性提升；因果分析进一步验证了数据-centric视角对学习有效视觉工具使用的合理性。
AI.conclusion: 有效工具使用学习应着眼于"可被观察纠正的失败"，通过数据分布调控而非奖励塑形来实现，AOVO为此提供了可行且经验有效的范式。

title: Muted Distillation: Sealing Reasoning from Teacher Unlocks Token-Efficient Agents
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is commonly adopted as one of the components in post-training of large language models (LLMs), but in multi-turn agentic tasks we find that the student model increases their reasoning lengths after training. Our empirical analysis shows that the reasoning token lengths is affected by how much the student can distract the teacher's scores. We introduce Muted Distillation (MD), a simple variant of OPD that hides the student's reasoning from the teacher, so the teacher judges what the student does without the interference of student's reasonings. MD takes a few lines of code and adds no extra data or hyperparameters. On the knowledge-work benchmarks OfficeQA Pro and SpreadsheetBench, it reduces output tokens per episode by 57\% and 53\% compared with standard OPD, making the student more concise than it was before training. At the same time, it matches OPD's accuracy on OfficeQA Pro and improves pass@1 by 4.8 points on SpreadsheetBench.

AI.tldr: 在多轮智能体任务中，On-policy distillation（OPD）会导致学生模型推理长度膨胀；作者发现该现象源于学生推理对教师评分的干扰，并提出 Muted Distillation（MD），即在教师评分时隐藏学生的推理内容。MD 仅需数行代码、不增加数据与超参，可在保持或提升精度的同时显著压缩输出长度。
AI.motivation: OPD 作为 LLM 后训练组件被广泛采用，但在多轮智能体任务中观察到学生模型训练后推理长度反而增加，造成输出冗余与推理成本上升；作者希望定位这一长度膨胀的成因并加以消除。
AI.method: 通过实证分析发现学生的推理 token 长度受"学生能在多大程度上干扰教师打分"影响；据此提出 Muted Distillation（MD）：一种 OPD 的简单变体，在教师评分阶段屏蔽学生的推理过程，使教师仅依据学生的行为（动作/输出）而非其推理内容进行评判。实现上仅需数行代码，不引入额外数据或超参数。
AI.result: 在知识工作类基准 OfficeQA Pro 与 SpreadsheetBench 上，相比标准 OPD，MD 将每回合输出 token 数分别降低 57% 与 53%，使学生比训练前更简洁；同时精度在 OfficeQA Pro 上与 OPD 持平，在 SpreadsheetBench 上 pass@1 提升 4.8 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 学生推理长度膨胀与"学生推理对教师评分的干扰"相关，在蒸馏时将推理与行为解耦即可抑制该效应；MD 以极低实现成本同时实现输出精简与精度不降或提升，为多轮智能体后训练的 OPD 提供了一种轻量改进方案。

title: PAWP-TTS: Phoneme-Aware Weight Programming for Compact Bilingual English-Nepali Speech Synthesis
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Code: https://github.com/Firojpaudel/PAWP_TTS | Audio Demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/Firoj112/pawp-tts-demo | Models: https://huggingface.co/Firoj112/pawp-tts-1.5m and https://huggingface.co/Firoj112/pawp-tts-300k
summary: This paper presents PAWP-TTS, a compact non-autoregressive text-to-speech system for English, Nepali, and English-Nepali code-mixed speech at 24 kHz, with no language model at inference. Deterministic pronunciation knowledge lives in a rule- and lexicon-based bilingual frontend that preserves native Nepali contrasts and avoids Hindi phonology, so the network only models acoustics. Counting every learned inference tensor, including the waveform decoder, PAWP-1.5M (1,490,390 parameters, 5.98 MB) reaches 1.50% English and 1.75% Nepali character error rate under a single ASR recognizer, and 5.04% / 4.02% Nepali / English phoneme error rate (PER) on 600 untouched test utterances. Decoder-centric 281K-parameter models (1.1 MB) stay intelligible across three independent seeds, with equal-budget dense models (5.53 +/- 0.08% NE, 5.34 +/- 0.28% EN PER) outperforming K=2 cross-layer shared-basis models (6.35 +/- 0.11% NE, 6.57 +/- 0.47% EN PER). Fixing a frontend/label version mismatch nearly halved Nepali PER, more than any architectural or weight-level change. The paper then studies weight-space programming: inspection-guided, zero-training weight edits. Under strict controls (validation-only selection, one-shot test, paired bootstrap, matched random and same-parameter gradient baselines), edits show real selectivity (27:1 on word-boundary pauses with 96 weights; zero cross-lingual collateral inside language-gated residuals) but no accuracy gain beyond controls. Two apparent targets proved to be label or phonology artifacts. Code, ONNX graphs, and CC BY 4.0 weights are released.

AI.tldr: PAWP-TTS是一个无语言模型、非自回归的紧凑型TTS系统，覆盖英语、尼泊尔语及英尼语码混合语音（24 kHz），将发音知识放在规则+词典的双语前端，网络只建模声学；1.49M参数模型达1.50%英文/1.75%尼泊尔文字符错误率，并系统研究零训练的权重空间编程及其选择性。
AI.motivation: 面向资源受限场景，构建极紧凑、推理时无需语言模型的TTS；同时作者希望检验"检查引导、零训练权重编辑"能否在严格控制下产生真实、可归因的行为改变。
AI.method: 1) 架构：非自回归PAWP-TTS，解码器为中心，含波形解码器在内的全部可学习张量共1,490,390参数（5.98 MB）；对比281K参数（1.1 MB）的三种随机种子与等预算稠密模型、K=2跨层共享基模型。2) 前端：规则与词典驱动的英-尼双语前端，保留尼泊尔语原生对立、排除印地语音系，发音与声学解耦。3) 评测：单一ASR识别器下的字/音素错误率，600条未触碰测试语音；前端/标签版本不匹配的消融。4) 权重空间编程：仅验证集选点、一次性测试、配对bootstrap，并设匹配随机与同参数梯度基线。
AI.result: PAWP-1.5M 达1.50%英文/1.75%尼泊尔文字符错误率，尼/英PER 5.04%/4.02%；281K模型三个种子均保持可懂度；等预算稠密模型（NE 5.53±0.08%，EN 5.34±0.28% PER）优于K=2共享基模型（6.35±0.11%，6.57±0.47% PER）；修正前端/标签版本不匹配使尼泊尔语PER近乎减半，影响大于任何架构或权重层改动；权重编辑在词边界停顿上以96个权重实现27:1选择性、语言门控残差内无跨语言连带损伤，但相对对照无精度提升，两个"表面目标"实为标签或音系伪影。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的非自回归设计配合强前端，可在无推理期语言模型下实现低错误率的双语与码混合TTS；前端一致性的收益超过架构或权重层面的微调；权重空间编程表现出可测的选择性但不带来超出对照的精度增益，提示此类结果需严格基线与伪影排查。

title: Detectable Epistemic Attack Layers: A Coverage Theorem and Standardized Harness for Conversation-History Integrity
comment: 36 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Harness, protocol texts, and pre-registration: https://github.com/fahrellgiovanny/conversation-history-integrity
summary: Conversation history is infrastructure: deployed language models rely on application layers to store and reinject prior turns, and that stored state is writable. We formalize session-level contamination by attack layer, state a coverage theorem, and measure its scope: each deployment-layer verification tier covers exactly its layer and is sound with respect to the others; instruction overrides are not detectable without false positives; and composite vectors evade per-fragment verification. A standardized harness applied to eight mechanism families across 3,249 sessions and three model families makes these claims checkable. First, pattern-based detection pays a measured false-positive price: the classic defenses flag 35 to 50 percent of benign sessions, and the naive refusal floor reaches only 2.4 percent attack-cell adoption while destroying 33 to 100 percent of benign turns, whereas provenance-gated channel separation achieves adoption at or below 1.2 percent with zero false positives and zero utility loss. Second, in the exploratory instruction-override extension, the gates' boundary is a cliff: directives rephrased without shape markers bypass them at control-equivalent rates, 47.7 to 49.5 percent against 0.0 percent for the shaped class, placing that class in the model-internal lane. Third, the deterministic core is storage-layer detection at 126 of 126 per model with zero false positives. External anchors reproduce published attack pressure, with PoisonedRAG falling from 70 to 0 percent under the full stack. For practitioners: authenticate stored history and content provenance with deterministic tiers, scope instruction-layer mitigation to provenance-gated designs whose measured benign cost is zero, and monitor composition at the trajectory level rather than per fragment. All protocols and acceptance criteria are pre-registered; the stack and harness are released.

AI.tldr: 论文将对话历史视为可写、可被污染的“基础设施”，形式化定义会话级（session-level）污染，提出覆盖定理，并通过标准化测试框架验证：确定性存储层检测可达126/126零误报，溯源门控通道分离把攻击采纳率压到≤1.2%且零误报零效用损失，而指令层防护存在“悬崖”边界。
AI.motivation: 部署中的语言模型依赖应用层存储并重注入历史轮次，而该状态可写，构成会话级污染风险。现有防护按层割裂部署，缺少形式化刻画其覆盖范围与可检测边界的理论，也缺少可复现、可检验的评测手段。
AI.method: 按攻击层形式化会话级污染，提出覆盖定理：每层验证仅覆盖自身层、对其他层可靠；指令覆盖在无误报下不可检测；复合向量可规避逐片段验证。构建标准化harness，覆盖8类机制家族、3,249个会话、3个模型家族，含溯源门控通道分离、模式匹配检测、朴素拒答基线、确定性存储层检测，并叠加外部锚点（PoisonedRAG）复现攻击压力；协议与验收标准预注册。
AI.result: 模式检测在35%–50%良性会话上误报；朴素拒答下限仅2.4%攻击采纳率却破坏33%–100%良性轮次；溯源门控通道分离≤1.2%采纳率、零误报、零效用损失。指令覆盖探索中，无形态标记的改写指令绕过率47.7%–49.5%，而有形态标记类为0.0%。确定性核心存储层检测达126/126（每模型）且零误报。完整栈下PoisonedRAG由70%降至0%。
AI.conclusion: 实践建议：对存储历史与内容溯源使用确定性分层认证；将指令层缓解限定于实测零良性代价的溯源门控设计；在轨迹层面而非片段层面监控组合。防护应承认层级边界，指令层属模型内部赛道，不应依赖形态匹配。

title: The Humming Revachol: A Dialogue Network Analysis of Narrative Power in Disco Elysium
summary: This study applies social network analysis to the narrative RPG Disco Elysium to examine how narrative power is distributed among its characters. A directed, weighted character-mention network of 73 NPCs is constructed from the game's complete dialogue script, with characters identified and annotated across five social attributes. Narrative power is operationalised through four dimensions: attention, authority, discursive initiative, and embeddedness. Non-parametric statistical tests examine differences across gender, age, race, class, and ideology. The findings suggest that narrative power is largely independent of social identity categories and is more closely associated with character narrative functions, while structural embeddedness reflects the socio-organisational contexts in which characters are situated. These findings show that dialogue-network analysis can reveal structural patterns of representation that visibility counts alone would miss.

AI.tldr: 该研究对叙事RPG《极乐迪斯科》完整对话脚本构建73个NPC的有向加权共现网络，以注意力、权威性、话语主动性、嵌入性四维度操作化"叙事权力"，并用非参数检验考察性别、年龄、种族、阶级、意识形态差异，发现叙事权力主要由角色的叙事功能而非社会身份决定。
AI.motivation: 既有对游戏角色代表性的度量多依赖"出场/可见度计数"，难以刻画角色在对话结构中实际占据的结构位置与话语权分配。作者希望用社会网络分析揭示仅凭可见度统计会遗漏的叙事代表性结构模式。
AI.method: 基于游戏完整对话脚本构建节点为73个NPC的有向加权"角色提及网络"，对角色标注五类社会属性；将叙事权力操作化为注意力、权威性、话语主动性、结构嵌入性四个维度；采用非参数统计检验比较性别、年龄、种族、阶级、意识形态各组的差异。
AI.result: 叙事权力在很大程度上与社会身份类别相互独立，而与角色的叙事功能关联更紧密；结构嵌入性则反映了角色所处的社会—组织语境。
AI.conclusion: 对话网络分析能够揭示可见度计数所无法捕捉的代表性结构模式，为游戏叙事中的权力与代表性研究提供了可迁移的结构化分析方法。

title: Do More Roles or Larger Models Improve LLM Fact-Checking? A Controlled Study on Fixed Evidence
summary: A fact-checking system can spend more computation on a claim by using a larger model, by asking the same model several times, or by a multi-role Tribunal: two roles propose quoted findings, code checks the quotations, an auditor that does not see the proposed relation judges each one, and code derives the verdict or abstains. We compare these options on identical fixed evidence, without retrieval: 300 AVeriTeC claims, each with its annotated question--answer items mixed with items written for other claims, read by judges of four open-weights models from three families, a vote of five, and six assignments of models to the Tribunal's roles. The 9B judge was right on 186 claims and the 27B judge of the same family on 156; the larger judges declined to decide far more often and were no more accurate when they decided. The vote reached 196 and the 9B judge with its verdict replaced by Tribunal certificates 195, at a similar cost; the Tribunal alone reached 153 to 164, because it abstained on almost half of the claims. A hearing's outcome followed the auditor's model and was nearly indifferent to the proposers'. A larger auditor, or one of another family, made certificates neither more often correct (77% to 81%) nor more independent of the judge. As a replacement, certificates improved every judge by 3 to 10 points and overturned four to five in a hundred of its correct verdicts. With the annotated evidence withheld, judges and Tribunal still decided on 7% to 14% of the claims.

AI.tldr: 在固定证据下对比"更大模型""同一模型多次投票""多角色Tribunal(提案-引文核查-盲审-裁决/弃权)"三种算力分配方式：更大模型并不更准，投票与Tribunal证书可将9B判官从186/300提升至196/195。
AI.motivation: 事实核查系统可通过增大模型、多次采样或引入多角色Tribunal来投入更多算力，但缺乏在完全相同证据条件下的受控比较，无法判断哪种算力投放最有效。
AI.method: 在无检索、证据固定的300条AVeriTeC主张上（每条含标注问答项与来自其他主张的干扰项），以来自3个模型族的4个开源权重模型作判官；设置五票投票；Tribunal由两角色提出带引文的发现、代码校验引文、不看所提关系的审计员逐条评估、代码推导结论或弃权，共测试6种模型-角色分配。
AI.result: 9B判官正确186条，同族27B判官仅156条；更大模型弃权更多，且在作出判断时并不更准。五票投票达196条，9B判官加Tribunal证书替换其结论达195条，成本相近；Tribunal单独仅153–164条，因近半数主张弃权。听证结果主要取决于审计员模型，对提案者模型几乎不敏感；更大或异族审计员既未提高证书正确率（77%–81%），也未提高其相对判官的独立性。作为替代机制，证书使每个判官提升3–10个点，并使每百条正确判决中4–5条被推翻。撤回标注证据后，判官与Tribunal仍在7%–14%的主张上作出判定。
AI.conclusion: 扩大模型规模不能替代算力分配设计：投票与结构化证书的收益更高；Tribunal的价值在于作为证书生成器而非独立判定器，其结果由审计员主导；系统在证据缺失时存在残留判定倾向，需对弃权行为加以校准。

title: Explainable Emotion and Mental Health Reasoning in Large Language Models Using Theories of Emotion
summary: Advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled a wide range of applications. However, their ability to simulate human-like behavior and reasoning remains unclear. While emotion detection is a better-established Natural Language Processing (NLP) task, existing approaches primarily focus on directly classifying text into predefined emotion classes, often overlooking the appraisal process that explains why an individual experiences a particular emotion in a given situation. In this work, we propose Psychology-based Chain-of-Thought (PsyCoT) reasoning, a theory-driven prompting strategy grounded in the Schachter-Singer and Cognitive Appraisal theories of emotion. We propose and evaluate PsyCoT for subjective NLP tasks, including emotion analysis, emotion intensity prediction, stress analysis, and depression severity identification. Our evaluation covers four levels of classification complexity: binary, multiclass, multi-label, and ordinal scaling, spanning 11 languages. We assess the performance of five state-of-the-art LLMs across these selected subjective NLP tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that PsyCoT prompt variants improve the standard chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting across the evaluated tasks. Across all evaluated tasks, PsyCoT yields F1 score gains ranging from 0.5% to 28.1%, depending on the model, task, and language configuration.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于心理学理论的思维链提示策略 PsyCoT，在四类主观NLP任务、11种语言上评估五种LLM，相比标准CoT带来0.5%–28.1%的F1提升。
AI.motivation: LLM已广泛用于各类应用，但其模拟人类行为与推理的能力尚不清楚；现有情感检测等任务多直接将文本分类到预定义情绪类别，忽略了"为何在此情境下产生该情绪"的评价（appraisal）过程，缺乏理论支撑的解释性推理。
AI.method: 提出 Psychology-based Chain-of-Thought（PsyCoT），一种理论驱动的提示策略，基于 Schachter-Singer 情绪理论与认知评价理论；将其用于情感分析、情绪强度预测、压力分析、抑郁严重程度识别等主观NLP任务，覆盖二分类、多分类、多标签、序数标度四个复杂度层级，跨11种语言，对5种先进LLM进行评测。
AI.result: PsyCoT各变体在所评估任务上均优于标准CoT；在不同模型、任务与语言配置下，F1提升幅度为0.5%至28.1%。
AI.conclusion: 将心理学评价理论引入思维链提示可有效增强LLM在主观NLP任务上的推理与分类表现，且跨任务类型、分类复杂度与多语言场景具备一定普适性。

title: Group-Balanced Supervised Fine-Tuning for Knowledge-Intensive Domains
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) weights every supervised token equally, so on knowledge-dense corpora the loss budget follows token count rather than importance: on a legal QA benchmark, citation strings absorb 81% of the supervised loss weight budget while the answers being taught absorb 5%. We present Group-Balanced SFT (GB-SFT), which equalizes the loss budget across the semantic roles of tokens within a target sequence. With one tunable dial and one structural switch, GB-SFT contains standard SFT, class- and span-level balancing as corners whose geometry we characterize exactly. On benchmarks in law, medicine, code, and mathematics, we show across model families that: (i) GB- SFT injects new knowledge better than uniform SFT, pointwise token weighting, memory editing, and matched-budget data mixing; (ii) it matches the injection of masking out everything but the knowledge payload while retaining the citation recall that masking destroys (0.98 vs. 0.38); and (iii) role-aware grouping carries the gain: label-free partitions recover at most a third of it, an LLM tagger nearly all where the groups are lexically distinctive; and and (iv) the budget governs what fine-tuning breaks as well as what it learns, acting as a monotone lever on the safety-guardrail erosion SFT causes, at matched task accuracy. We release two new contamination-controlled knowledge-injection benchmarks with validated ground truth.

AI.tldr: 提出Group-Balanced SFT (GB-SFT)，将监督损失的预算按token的语义角色均等化，而非按token数分配，从而提升知识注入效果并可控调节安全护栏侵蚀。
AI.motivation: 标准SFT对每个监督token等权，导致在知识密集语料上损失预算被冗余内容（如法律QA中的引用字符串占81%）占据，而真正要教的目标答案仅占5%，学习效率低下。
AI.method: GB-SFT在目标序列内按token的语义角色分组，将损失预算在各角色（如引用、答案、知识载荷）间均等分配；方法由一可调旋钮和一结构开关构成，标准SFT、类别级与span级平衡均为其几何角落的特殊情形，作者精确刻画了其参数空间几何。
AI.result: 在法律、医学、代码、数学基准上跨模型族验证：(i) 知识注入优于均匀SFT、逐点token加权、记忆编辑与等预算数据混合；(ii) 达到仅保留知识载荷掩码的注入效果，同时保留引用召回（0.98 vs 0.38）；(iii) 角色感知分组是关键，无标签划分最多恢复三分之一增益，LLM标注器在词汇可区分时几乎全部恢复；(iv) 预算同时决定微调学到什么与破坏什么，在同等任务准确率下单调调节安全护栏侵蚀。
AI.conclusion: 监督损失预算的语义角色分配是SFT知识注入与副作用的统一控制变量；GB-SFT以简洁双层参数化统一现有加权范式，并提供两个受污染控制的知识注入基准。

title: Decoding Transformer Dynamics via Koopman Subspaces
summary: We apply Koopman operator theory and Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) to characterise how large language models (LLMs) process different input topics. Treating the layer-to-layer evolution of hidden states as a dynamical system, we fit a linear Koopman operator and take the subspace spanned by its dominant modes as a per-topic spectral fingerprint. Four findings emerge. First, the depth map is near-linear: a single linear operator predicts each next-layer state to within approx. 18% relative error (interior variance explained approx. 0.99). Second, over the 57 MMLU subjects the fingerprint is topic-discriminative, matching the MMLU taxonomy at 0.72 nearest-neighbour purity and each subject's semantic neighbourhood at 0.75 any-hit@3. Third, it is a reproducible signature (split-half self-retrieval approx. 0.97$). Finally, these findings are consistent across seven base models (Qwen2.5 0.5-7B, Llama-3 1-8B), with a suggestive trend of alignment rising with MMLU accuracy. The spectral fingerprint thus provides a probe of how transformers process different topics across depth. Code is available at https://github.com/DeepK/koopman-llm-eacl27.

AI.tldr: 将LLM层间隐状态演化视为动力系统，用Koopman算子/DMD提取各主题的主模态子空间作为"谱指纹"，发现深度映射近似线性、指纹具主题判别性与可复现性，并跨7个基础模型一致。
AI.motivation: 需要一个刻画Transformer随深度如何处理不同输入主题的可解释性探针，现有方法缺乏对层级动力学全局结构的低维线性刻画。
AI.method: 应用Koopman算子理论与动态模态分解，把逐层隐状态演化当作动力系统，拟合线性Koopman算子，取主导模态张成的子空间作为各主题的谱指纹；在57个MMLU学科上评估判别性，并与语义邻域对照。跨7个基础模型（Qwen2.5 0.5–7B、Llama-3 1–8B）验证。
AI.result: (1) 深度映射近似线性：单个线性算子预测下一层状态相对误差约18%，内部方差解释度约0.99；(2) 指纹具主题判别性：最近邻纯度0.72对应MMLU分类体系，语义邻域any-hit@3为0.75；(3) 可复现：分半自检索约0.97；(4) 七模型一致，且对齐度与MMLU准确率呈上升趋势。
AI.conclusion: 谱指纹可作为跨深度探测Transformer主题处理机制的探针；深度动力学近似线性且主题信息在低维谱子空间中稳定可辨。代码已开源。

title: RES: Accelerating Diffusion Language Models with Rolling Entropy Sampling
summary: A diffusion language sampler makes two choices for every position in its denoising window: where the next token comes from, and when the position is committed to the KV cache. Using the entropy-bound sampler in DiffusionGemma, we study two extremes of the second choice. Committing each token as soon as it is accepted removes the chance to revise it, which hurts when the entropy bound is relaxed to trade accuracy for speed. When accepted tokens are frozen, macro accuracy falls from 73% to 20% as the bound is relaxed, while the unfrozen sampler stays near 70%. Committing a whole block at once wastes computation, since tokens converge in a largely left-to-right order and more than half of the window holds already-final tokens by twenty denoising steps.
