These findings motivate the Rolling Entropy Sampler (RES), which commits a contiguous accepted prefix once it reaches a minimum length and keeps positions farther ahead open to revision. Unlike earlier rolling samplers, RES runs on uniform diffusion, where accepted tokens can still change, and it needs no training. Across seven benchmarks, RES increases tokens per forward pass from 19.3 to 25.5, while macro accuracy goes from 80.7% to 78.8%, and it extends the speed-quality Pareto frontier beyond what tuning the entropy bound alone reaches.

AI.tldr: 提出Rolling Entropy Sampler (RES)：只提交连续已接受前缀、后续位置仍可修正，在无训练、均匀扩散下把每前向token从19.3提至25.5，宏准确率80.7%→78.8%。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型的采样器需同时决定"下一个token来自何处"与"何时写入KV cache"。尽早提交（frozen）剥夺了修正机会，放宽熵界换速度时准确率从73%崩到20%；整块提交则因token大体按左到右收敛、二十步后窗口内过半已是最终token而浪费算力。因此需要兼顾可修正性与计算效率的提交策略。
AI.method: 以DiffusionGemma中的熵界采样器为基线，考察提交时机的两个极端（逐token即时冻结、整块提交）。据此设计RES：当连续接受前缀达到最小长度时整体提交至KV cache，其前方位置保持开放可修正；该采样器运行于均匀扩散（uniform diffusion），无需训练，区别于以往滚动采样器。
AI.result: 冻结策略下放宽熵界使宏准确率由73%降至20%，非冻结采样器维持在约70%；RES在七个基准上使每前向传播token数由19.3升至25.5，宏准确率由80.7%降至78.8%，并将速度–质量Pareto前沿推至单纯调熵界之外。
AI.conclusion: 提交时机是扩散语言采样中被忽视的关键自由度；前缀滚动提交在无需训练的前提下实现了速度与质量的更优权衡，拓展了Pareto前沿。

title: What Makes Good Data for Training Coding Agents? A Systematic Study on SWE-Gym
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Code at https://github.com/Arist12/SWE-Gym-Verified and dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Arist12/SWE-Gym-Verified
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) trains coding agents on software tasks whose hidden tests decide the reward, yet task collections check these tests only against the reference fix. We ask what makes a task good training data, focusing on the correctness of its reward labels. We audit SWE-Gym with two LLM families, and a suspected error counts only if execution reproduces it. We find that unsolved often means mislabelled: 74% of the tasks that a 9B base model never solves have a test that rejects correct fixes (a false negative), versus 20% of those it sometimes solves. We repair or remove such tasks, and the audited tasks that remain train better policies. At equal size and matched difficulty, models trained on them score 2.4 and 2.7 points higher on held-out tasks from SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro than models trained on the original tasks, whereas simply dropping the never-solved tasks shows no such gain. We further find that wrong patches that pass (false positives) make up about a quarter of all passing patches, and that new tests that catch a quarter of them do not change held-out scores detectably. A pass rate shows whether a task yields reward, not whether that reward is right, so the reward labels themselves must be checked. To this end, we release SWE-Gym-Verified with its 1,087 audited tasks, every verdict with its executed evidence, our training sets, and the full audit pipeline.

AI.tldr: 论文审计 SWE-Gym 的奖励标签正确性，发现 74% 的从未被解出的任务实为测试误标（假阴性，拒绝正确修复），修复/剔除后审计数据集训练效果显著优于原数据，并发布 SWE-Gym-Verified（1,087 个已审计任务）及完整审计流水线。
AI.motivation: RL 训练编码智能体依赖隐藏测试决定奖励，但现有任务集仅在参考修复上校验测试，从未验证测试对"其它正确修复"是否也给出正奖励。作者因此追问：什么样的任务才是好的训练数据，核心落在**奖励标签是否正确**，而非任务通过率。
AI.method: 用两个 LLM 家族对 SWE-Gym 做审计，疑似错误必须经**执行复现**才计为错误：检测测试拒绝正确修复（假阴性/FN）与错误补丁通过测试（假阳性/FP）；随后对问题任务修复或剔除，在等规模、难度匹配条件下比较训练出的策略，并单独检验"直接丢弃从未被解出任务"与"新增测试捕获 FP"两种对照干预。
AI.result: 1）9B 基座从未解出的任务中 74% 存在 FN 测试，而有时可解的任务仅 20%；2）修复/剔除后在 SWE-bench Verified 与 SWE-bench Pro 留出任务上分别高出 2.4 与 2.7 分，等规模丢弃从未解出任务则无增益；3）假阳性补丁约占全部通过补丁的四分之一；4）新测试能捕获其中四分之一 FP，但留出分数无可测变化。
AI.conclusion: 通过率只反映任务是否产生奖励，不反映奖励是否正确，因此必须直接审计奖励标签本身；"难解/未解"任务往往是被误标而非真难。作者发布 SWE-Gym-Verified（1,087 个审计任务）、每条判定及其执行证据、训练集与完整审计流水线。

title: Laya-IsoToken: Day-One Clinical Codebook Switching via Closed-Form Operator Compilation
comment: 21 pages, 6 main figures, 4 main tables, 1 algorithm, 2 supplementary figures, 6 supplementary tables. Code available at https://github.com/ZeqiangWangAI/Laya-IsoToken
summary: Healthcare systems periodically revise diagnostic and procedural classifications (ICD-9 to ICD-10/11), update hospital reimbursement groupers (MS-DRG), and deploy clinical coding across languages. Supervised coding networks bind clinical text encoders to fixed per-code classifier weights, forcing hospitals to re-annotate tens of thousands of records before switching codebooks, whereas standalone large language models incur high latency and hallucinate invalid codes. Here we show that day-one clinical codebook switching becomes feasible without target-labeled notes when local clinical evidence reading is decoupled from a strictly frozen multilingual concept space. Laya-IsoToken trains a clinical span reader once on source records with zero per-code classifier parameters, separating text evidence from historical disease prevalence. Given only public target code descriptions, closed-form matrix compilation aligns distributional shifts, compensates for paraphrased definitions, and deduplicates sibling codes in under three seconds, while a pre-deployment geometric residual routes unfamiliar concepts to offline language model verification. Across 32,804 MIMIC-IV ICD-9 discharges, Laya-IsoToken matches published supervised baselines (62.6% Micro-F1) while reducing active calibration error by 32%. Switched with zero target training notes to 13,783 unseen-patient ICD-10 discharges, MS-DRG groups, and multilingual cohorts, it outperforms biomedical dense retrievers, semantic crosswalks (+5.4 F1 points on ICD-10, paired $d_z = 0.49$, $p < 0.001$), and official US CMS equivalence mappings (+3.5 points, $p < 0.001$) at 9.4 ms per admission. Pairing this reader with an offline 31B verifier across 1,000 full discharge summaries lifts zero-training ICD-10 coding to 40.6% Micro-F1 (57.0% category F1, $d_z = 0.66$, $p < 0.001$) with 0.0% invalid code hallucinations.

AI.tldr: 提出Laya-IsoToken：将临床证据读取与冻结的多语言概念空间解耦，无需目标标注即可实现ICD-9→ICD-10/MS-DRG/多语言的"第一天"编码本切换，9.4 ms/次、零无效编码幻觉。
AI.motivation: 医院更换编码本（ICD-9→10/11、MS-DRG、跨语言）时，监督式编码网络把文本编码器绑定到固定的逐码分类权重，必须重新标注数万份病历；而独立大模型延迟高且会生成无效编码。目标是实现无目标标注的病历编码本迁移。
AI.method: Laya-IsoToken在源域病历上一次性训练临床span reader，且不含逐码分类器参数，从而把文本证据与历史疾病流行率分离；仅用公开的目标编码描述，通过闭式矩阵编译对齐分布漂移、补偿释义差异并对兄弟编码去重（<3秒）；部署前用几何残差将陌生概念路由至离线LLM验证。另配31B离线验证器。
AI.result: 在32,804条MIMIC-IV ICD-9出院记录上达到62.6% Micro-F1，匹配已发表监督基线，主动校准误差降低32%。零目标训练迁移至13,783条未见患者ICD-10、MS-DRG分组及多语言队列，优于生物医学稠密检索器、语义crosswalk（+5.4 F1，d_z=0.49，p<0.001）和CMS官方等价映射（+3.5，p<0.001），9.4 ms/次；配31B验证器在1,000份完整出院小结上达40.6% Micro-F1（类别F1 57.0%，d_z=0.66，p<0.001），无效编码幻觉0.0%。
AI.conclusion: 解耦"证据读取"与"冻结概念空间"可使临床编码本切换在无目标标注下即时可行，兼顾精度、效率与零幻觉，替代需重新标注的监督编码管线。

title: Language models compress human preference geometry while political structure remains prompt-sensitive
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, 34 pages of supplementary material
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to construct synthetic publics. Prior work has documented errors in individual responses, population heterogeneity, and prompt robustness, but whether these failures reflect a common loss of fidelity or distinct properties of synthetic populations remains unclear. We tested this using matched pairwise policy choices from 1,991 Chilean, 843 French, and 434 Brazilian adults replayed through three open-weight model families. Across a 27-condition Chilean grid and cross-country factorial replications, no condition jointly reproduced individual choices, population heterogeneity, and political organization. The most consistent result was compression of the latent preference space: synthetic participant variance was only 0.4-10.5% of the corresponding human reference in the primary comparisons and remained below human variance in all 270 matched refits. Political structure was much more sensitive to how choices were elicited. Reversing proposal position changed 12.3-31.2% of decoded choices. Explicitly labeling the endpoints of the numeric left-right self-placement scale changed 20.5-28.1% of choices and moved an independent proposal-level measure of left-right cleavage toward the human pattern in all three settings. Yet matched agreement improved by only 3.1-4.2 percentage points and participant geometry remained compressed. In Chile, the same intervention compressed the synthetic population further. These results separate political legibility from population fidelity: language models can recover salient political divisions while failing to preserve the breadth of human preference variation. Synthetic-public fidelity is therefore a property of the checkpoint, prompt, and setting, not of a checkpoint alone, and must be evaluated separately at individual, population, and political-structure levels.

AI.tldr: 该文检验大语言模型构建的"合成公众"在个体选择、群体异质性与政治结构三层面能否同时复现人类。基于智利(1,991)、法国(843)、巴西(434)成人的匹配成对政策选择，在三个开源权重模型家族、27条件网格与跨国因子复制中，无任何条件同时复现三者。最稳健的发现是潜在偏好空间被压缩：合成被试方差仅为人参照的0.4–10.5%，全部270次匹配重拟合均低于人类方差。政治结构对测量方式高度敏感（选项位置反转改变12.3–31.2%的选择；标注左右量表端点改变20.5–28.1%并改善左右分化度量），但个体一致性仅提升3.1–4.2个百分点。结论：政治可读性与群体保真度可分离，合成公众保真度是检查点、提示与情境的联合属性。
AI.motivation: 已有研究记录了合成公众在单个回答错误、群体异质性和提示鲁棒性上的失败，但不清楚这些失败是同一保真度损失的体现，还是合成群体各自独立的特性；因此需要将个体、群体、政治结构三个层面解耦评估，并检验是否有条件能同时满足三者。
AI.method: 使用1,991名智利、843名法国、434名巴西成年人的匹配成对政策选择数据，通过三个开源权重模型家族重放；设计27条件的智利条件网格及跨国因子复制；对选项位置进行反转、对左右自评数值量表的端点进行显式标注作为操纵；以方差比衡量群体异质性、以解码选择翻转率与proposal层面左右分化指标衡量政治结构、以匹配一致率衡量个体保真度，并做270次匹配重拟合进行稳健性检验。
AI.result: 没有任何条件同时复现个体选择、群体异质性与政治组织。合成被试方差仅为人参照的0.4–10.5%，270次匹配重拟合中方差全部低于人类。选项位置反转改变12.3–31.2%的解码选择；标注左右量表端点改变20.5–28.1%的选择，并使独立proposal层面的左右分化度量在三个情境中均向人类模式靠拢；但匹配一致率仅提升3.1–4.2个百分点，被试几何结构仍被压缩，且在智利该干预反而进一步压缩了合成群体。
AI.conclusion: 政治可读性与群体保真度是两种可分离的性质：语言模型能恢复显著的政治分野，却无法保留人类偏好变异的广度。合成公众保真度属于检查点、提示与情境的联合属性而非单一检查点属性，必须在个体、群体与政治结构三个层面分别评估。

title: Taking the PULSE of Enterprise Workflows: Evaluating Persistent Project-State Understanding
summary: Enterprise agents must maintain an up-to-date understanding of work distributed across heterogeneous artifacts, evolving over time, and unevenly visible to different collaborators. We formulate this challenge as persistent project-state understanding (PPSU) and introduce PULSE, a benchmark of 1,573 questions over 30 enterprise project histories. PULSE constructs deterministic, time-indexed project state and documented collaborator views from source-linked records, and evaluates three families of questions: open loops, project evolution, and view gaps. Across retrieval agents, graph- and memory-augmented retrieval, long-context, and oracle conditions, we find substantial headroom for current systems. Retrieval and extraction account for the largest share of the gap, but providing explicit project state on top of gold evidence yields further substantial gains, showing that PPSU cannot be reduced to retrieval alone. Further analysis shows that questions requiring information to be reconciled across multiple parts of the project history remain difficult even when the relevant evidence is provided, while project-state synthesis and perspective conditioning remain persistent challenges. These results motivate enterprise agents that explicitly maintain and reconcile temporally grounded state across sources, actors, and time.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“持久化项目状态理解”（PPSU）任务与PULSE基准（30个项目历史、1573个问题），系统评测显示当前智能体存在显著差距：检索/抽取是最大瓶颈，但即便给定金标证据，跨历史片段的信息整合、项目状态合成与视角条件化仍具挑战，说明PPSU不能被简化为检索问题。
AI.motivation: 企业智能体需对分散在异构工件、随时间演化、且不同协作者可见性不均的工作保持最新理解，现有评测缺乏对此类“持久化项目状态理解”能力的系统刻画与度量。
AI.method: 将挑战形式化为PPSU，构建PULSE基准：基于来源可溯记录构造确定性的、按时间索引的项目状态及有文档依据的协作者视图；设计三类问题（开放循环、项目演化、视图差异）；在检索智能体、图/记忆增强检索、长上下文及oracle条件下进行对比评测。
AI.result: 当前系统存在大幅提升空间；检索与抽取贡献了差距的最大部分；在金标证据之上额外提供显式项目状态仍带来显著增益；需跨项目历史多部分进行信息调和的题目即使在提供相关证据时依然困难，项目状态合成与视角条件化持续构成瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: PPSU无法仅靠检索解决；需构建显式维护并调和跨来源、跨行动者、跨时间的时间锚定状态的企业智能体。

title: Contrastive On-Policy Distillation via Dual-Branch Supervision
summary: For on-policy distillation (OPD), more capable models are a natural choice as teachers. However, higher task performance does not necessarily imply greater teachability. A controlled token intervention study suggests that even a model weaker than the student can serve as an informative contrastive reference. Building on this observation, we propose Contrastive On-Policy Distillation (cOPD), which provides dual branch supervision by contrasting strong teacher, weak teacher, and student predictions at student generated prefixes. Our analysis explains how this three way comparison helps select token candidates associated with better or worse reasoning outcomes under an idealized model. We evaluate cOPD across diverse teacher student configurations spanning different training stages, parameter scales, and model families, on tasks including mathematical reasoning, instruction following, and question answering with abstention. cOPD achieves the best or top-tier performance among the evaluated baselines across all three tasks, improving overall Pass@16 on mathematical reasoning by up to 7.51\% over the strongest baseline. Further analyses show that cOPD suppresses undesirable response patterns and suggest that it facilitates exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出对比式在线策略蒸馏（cOPD）：在student生成的前缀上同时比较强教师、弱教师与学生三方预测，构成双分支监督；即使弱于学生的模型也可作为有信息量的对比参照。该方法在数学推理、指令遵循、带弃答的问答三类任务上取得最优或一流表现，数学推理整体Pass@16较最强基线最高提升7.51%。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏通常默认选用能力更强的模型作教师，但任务性能更高并不必然意味着"更易教"。作者通过受控的token干预实验发现，即便比学生更弱的模型也能提供有信息量的对比参照，因此教师"强弱"之差本身可作为监督信号来源。
AI.method: cOPD在student生成的prefix上对比强teacher、弱teacher与student的预测，形成双分支监督；并在理想化模型设定下给出理论分析，说明这种三方比较如何帮助筛选与更优/更差推理结果相关联的token候选；配合分析验证其抑制不良回答模式、促进探索的作用。
AI.result: 在跨训练阶段、参数规模与模型家族的多种teacher–student配置下，于数学推理、指令遵循、带弃答问答三类任务评估：cOPD在所有任务上达到最优或前列水平，数学推理整体Pass@16相对最强基线最高提升7.51%。消融与分析显示其压制不良响应模式，并提示其促进探索。
AI.conclusion: 教师的选择不应仅以能力上限为标准，"强弱对比"信息可转化为有效蒸馏信号；cOPD为在线策略蒸馏提供了一种兼顾监督质量与探索的通用框架。

title: Legal Is Not Good: A Pre-Registered Benchmark of Low-Cost Language and Decision Models on a New Strategy Game
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Pre-registered protocol (v1-v5, all amendments committed before the games they govern). Engine, benchmark harness, agents and protocol: https://github.com/federicolucca/hexfolk, tag bench-v1. Companion to arXiv:2610.32955 and arXiv:2611.21393. No frontier model; paid pairings limited to 50 games by budget
summary: Measure Before You Train argued that an agent's decisions should be measured against ground truth, under a protocol fixed in advance, before anyone trains or replaces the model behind them. We carry the method to a second, very different domain, a turn-based strategy game, and ask a deliberately modest question: how well do low-cost agents play under a pre-registered protocol? hexfolk is a minimal two-player 4X game written for this purpose, so no model has seen its rules or positions. A deterministic engine, one agent interface, a referee that never corrects an illegal or late move, and per-decision logs make every game replayable; questions and expected answers were committed before the games, on held-out seeds with mirrored seats and 95% Wilson intervals. Two small open language models (8B and 3B) lose every game to a few-line rule player. Answering in free text they are invalid on 98% of their decisions; constrained to legal moves they never play an invalid one, yet they lose to the uniformly random player (the 8B model wins 10.0 [4.3, 21.4]% of games), refuting our expectation that they would beat it; the result survives a control that shuffles the order of the options. Two native decision models never play an invalid move and both beat random; one loses all 50 games to the rule player, the other is not distinguishable from it in 50 games and beats a one-step search. The paid agents make tens to over a hundred model calls per game; against the same opponents a free 60 ms-per-move search, which makes none, outplays every paid model by the full range of the scale. Two 7-8B models served locally behave the same way. No frontier model is included.

AI.tldr: 将"训练前先度量"方法论迁移到自研极简4X回合制游戏hexfolk,用预注册协议评估低成本智能体,发现开放语言模型在合法约束下仍输给随机策略,而免费的60ms搜索智能体在整区间上胜过所有受测付费模型。
AI.motivation: 作者希望把此前"训练或替换模型之前,须在预先固定的协议下以ground truth度量智能体决策"的主张,推广到第二个差异极大的领域(回合制策略游戏),检验低成本智能体在预注册协议下的真实棋力,并给出可复现的评测范式。
AI.method: 自建最小双人4X游戏hexfolk,使任何模型都未见过其规则与局面;采用确定性引擎、统一智能体接口、从不纠正非法或超时着法的裁判,以及逐决策日志以保证对局可回放。问题与预期答案在对局前提交,基于留出随机种子、镜像座位与95% Wilson置信区间。对比对象包括:两个小型开源语言模型(8B、3B)、仅含数行的规则玩家、均匀随机玩家、两个原生决策模型、一步搜索,以及每步60ms的免费搜索智能体;并设置打乱选项顺序的对照实验。
AI.result: 两个小模型对规则玩家全败;自由文本作答时98%的决策非法,约束到合法着法后无非法着法,但仍输给均匀随机玩家(8B胜率10.0 [4.3, 21.4]%),该结果在选项顺序打乱对照下依然成立,推翻了作者预期。两个原生决策模型均无非法着法且都胜过随机:其一50局全败于规则玩家,另一在50局内与规则玩家不可区分,并胜过一步搜索。付费智能体每局需数十至上百次模型调用,而零调用的60ms/步搜索在整区间上胜过所有付费模型;本地部署的两个7-8B模型表现相同;未纳入前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: 在未见过的领域与预注册协议下,低成本语言模型即使被约束为输出合法着法,棋力仍低于随机基线,更远逊于规则玩家与极廉价搜索;而60ms/步的无模型搜索全面优于全部受测付费模型。这说明"训练前先度量"的协议可作为低成本、可回放的评测标准,并警示以语言模型替代搜索或规则智能体前须先完成此类基准度量。

title: ComplexIF: A Challenging Multi-Turn, Multi-Constraint Instruction-Following Benchmark
summary: As frontier LLMs saturate existing instruction-following benchmarks, measuring further progress requires harder tests that remain faithful to real use. In practice, users often combine several constraints, add them at different turns of a conversation, and expect all of them to hold in the assistant's response. We introduce ComplexIF, a challenging benchmark for this setting, together with the automatic pipeline that generates it. The pipeline expands seed requests into multi-turn conversations, weaves constraints into their turns, and keeps only tasks that a strong model can solve, so difficulty can be raised by adding constraints or turns while every task stays solvable. ComplexIF's two splits test complementary sides of instruction following: a verifiable split of format constraints, checked by programs, and a rubric split of semantic instructions, such as a tone or an audience, checked with an LLM judge. Across 14 proprietary and open-weight models, even the strongest satisfies every constraint on fewer than half of the verifiable tasks, and no model leads on both splits.

AI.tldr: 提出ComplexIF基准及自动生成管线，用多轮对话中交织的多重约束评测前沿LLM的指令遵循能力，含程序校验与LLM评审两个split；14个模型中最强者在可验证任务上全满足率不足一半。
AI.motivation: 现有指令遵循基准已被前沿LLM饱和，需要更贴近真实使用、难度更高的测试。真实场景中用户常组合多个约束、在不同对话轮次追加约束，并要求助手回复同时满足；而现有基准缺乏这种多约束、多轮、持续可解且高难度的评测设置。
AI.method: 构建ComplexIF基准及其自动生成管线：将种子请求扩展为多轮对话，将约束编织进各轮次，并用强模型可解性过滤保留任务，从而可通过增加约束或轮次提升难度而保持任务可解。基准分两个互补split：可验证split为格式约束、由程序检查；评分标准（rubric）split为语气、受众等语义指令、由LLM评审判断，相对现有基准更难。
AI.result: 在14个闭源与开源权重模型上评测，即使最强模型也仅在不到一半的可验证任务上满足全部约束；且没有模型在两个split上同时领先，说明两项能力存在权衡。
AI.conclusion: ComplexIF提供了难度可调、保持可解、贴近真实多轮多约束场景的指令遵循评测，揭示前沿LLM在复杂约束遵循上仍有显著差距，格式类与语义类指令遵循能力不相关，需分别评测与改进。

title: Where Do Fact-Checking Errors Arise? Separating Retrieval, Search Control and Judgement in Evidence-Grounded Verification
summary: An evidence-grounded fact-checker can fail because it does not find the evidence or because it does not use it; end-to-end accuracy does not tell the two apart. We present a protocol that follows the reference evidence from the store to the verdict and separates retrieval, search control, judgement and verdict validation. We assess 293 claims from FEVER, FEVER 2.0 and AVeriTeC with one open-weights 9B model under two evidence conditions: small stores of annotated evidence, where discovery is easy, and the full source collections. In the control condition a single hybrid retrieval pass delivers complete reference evidence for 226 of 228 evidence-bearing claims, and adaptive controllers and a tool agent spend two to nine times as many model calls without a consistent gain. Of 34 decisive claims labelled as lacking evidence, 33 have the complete evidence in the packet: in 15 the judge abstains, and in 18 validation rules overturn a decisive verdict. On AVeriTeC these rules lower single-pass accuracy by six points, to 65.0% (balanced accuracy 57.6%). Ten judges from eight model families also show abstentions and validation conversions on fixed packets. Against the full stores hybrid single-pass accuracy falls by 17 to 29 points. Wikipedia evidence recovery declines; AVeriTeC recovery changes from annotated answers to cited pages and is measured separately. No controller recovers the accuracy loss. The agent also shows no resolved gain on 714 further Wikipedia claims. Evidence recovery, judgement and validation should be measured separately before an error is attributed to search.

AI.tldr: 提出一个从证据库到判决的端到端协议，将检索、搜索控制、判断、判决校验四个环节分开评估。结果表明：错误主要来自判断与校验环节而非检索，复杂控制策略与工具代理无稳定增益，应分环节测量后再归因。
AI.motivation: 端到端准确率无法区分事实核查失败是"没找到证据"还是"找到了却没用/用错"，导致错误被误归因于检索，从而误导方法设计。
AI.method: 构建可追踪参考证据流向的分环节协议（检索→搜索控制→判断→判决校验）；在FEVER、FEVER 2.0、AVeriTeC的293条claim上，用单一开源9B模型，在两种证据条件下（小规模标注证据库 vs 完整源集合）对比单次混合检索、自适应控制器与工具代理；并跨10个模型/8个模型家族检验鲁棒性。
AI.result: 小库条件下单次混合检索为228条含证据claim中的226条提供完整参考证据；自适应控制器与工具代理多耗2–9倍模型调用却无一致增益。34条被判"无证据"的决定性claim中33条证据完整：15条判断器弃答，18条被校验规则推翻决定性判决。AVeriTeC上校验规则使单次准确率降6个百分点至65.0%（平衡准确率57.6%）。10个判断器在固定证据包上同样出现弃答与判决转换。完整库条件下混合单次准确率下降17–29点，Wikipedia证据恢复率下降，无控制器能挽回；714条额外Wikipedia claim上工具代理亦无显著收益。
AI.conclusion: 证据恢复、判断与校验必须分别测量，再判断错误是否源于搜索；提升检索复杂度并非瓶颈所在。

title: MERIT: Experience-Guided Memory for Long-Horizon Persona-Specific Persuasive Dialogue
summary: Effective long-horizon persuasion in recurring goal-oriented settings requires more than factual memory: it must track how a user's trust, negotiation behavior, and strategic receptiveness evolve across interactions. Existing persuasive dialogue systems are largely single-session, static, and unimodal, while cross-session memory systems, though temporally aware, retain only factual content and overlook persuasion-specific dynamics. We propose MERIT (Memory-augmented Experience-Rationale for Iterative Temporal persuasion), which pairs a graph-based memory of four persuasion-specific memory types with a per-persona experience rationale library that records which strategies succeed for each user and why. Together they enable adaptive persuasion through prompt composition alone, with no parameter updates. To support this setting, we introduce PERSIST (PERSona-driven InSurance Interactions over Time), a dataset of 60 curated personas spanning 10+ years of motor insurance renewal interactions, with probabilistic life events that shift negotiation behavior and receptiveness across sessions, verified through strict human-in-the-loop annotation. MERIT surpasses memory and experience-based baselines on every metric across two policy backbones, reaching persuasive-appeal scores of 4.10 and 4.74 (out of 5).

AI.tldr: 提出MERIT框架，将四类说服专用记忆类型的图结构记忆与按人格索引的经验理据库结合，实现无需参数更新的跨会话自适应说服；同时构建PERSIST数据集（60个人格、10年以上车险续保交互），在两个策略骨干上全部指标超越基线。
AI.motivation: 面向目标导向的重复性交互场景，有效长程说服不仅需要事实记忆，还需追踪用户信任、谈判行为与策略接受度的跨会话演化。现有说服对话系统多为单会话、静态、单模态；跨会话记忆系统虽具备时间感知，却只保留事实内容，忽视说服特有动态。
AI.method: MERIT将图结构记忆（含四种说服专用记忆类型）与逐人格的"经验理据库"配对，后者记录对每个用户何种策略有效及其原因；二者通过提示组合（prompt composition）驱动自适应说服，无需任何参数更新。配套构建PERSIST数据集：60个精编人格，跨越10年以上车险续保交互，通过概率性生活事件在各会话间改变谈判行为与接受度，并经严格人在回路标注验证。
AI.result: 在两个策略骨干模型上，MERIT在全部指标上均超越基于记忆与基于经验的基线，说服力得分分别达4.10与4.74（满分5）。
AI.conclusion: 说服专用记忆类型与人格化经验理据的结合可有效建模长程说服动态，且通过提示组合即可实现自适应，避免参数微调；PERSIST为跨会话说服研究提供了可控、可验证的基准场景。

title: Diversity in Unity, Theory in Practice: Hierarchical Multitask Benchmarks for Chinese Minority Languages
summary: Despite the rapid advancement of LLMs, their performance on linguistically and culturally diverse minority languages within a unified national context remains underexplored. We present CMiLBench, a collection of hierarchical multitask benchmarks designed to translate theoretical notions of "diversity in unity" into practical evaluation for three representative Chinese minority languages: Tibetan, Mongolian, and Uyghur. CMiLBench comprises 24,663 instances across 5 difficulty levels and 17 tasks spanning foundational ability, cultural specificity, and safety alignment. We adopt existing dataset adaptation, minority knowledge construction, and high-resource benchmark translation to construct CMiLBench. We assess 14 state-of-the-art commercial and open-source LLMs with a hybrid framework that integrates automatic metrics and LLM-as-a-Judge scoring. The comparative experimental results reveal the gap between theoretical capability and practical utility. CMiLBench serves as a foundational and scalable evaluation resource to bridge the digital language divide and promote the informatization and intelligentization of low-resource Chinese minority languages.

AI.tldr: 提出CMiLBench——面向藏、蒙、维三种中国少数民族语言的分层多任务基准，含5个难度等级、17项任务、24,663条实例，并评测了14个主流LLM，揭示理论能力与实际效用的差距。
AI.motivation: LLM发展迅速，但其在统一国家语境下语言与文化多样化的少数民族语言上的表现仍缺乏系统探索；现有评测难以把"多元一体"的理论概念转化为可操作的评测。
AI.method: 构建CMiLBench：涵盖基础能力、文化特异性与安全对齐三类维度，分5个难度层级、17项任务，共24,663条实例；通过既有数据集改写、少数民族知识构建与高资源基准翻译三条路径构造数据；采用自动指标与LLM-as-a-Judge相结合的混合评测框架，对14个商用与开源SOTA模型进行评估。
AI.result: 对比实验显示各模型在理论能力与实际可用性之间存在明显差距，跨难度层级与任务类型表现不均衡。
AI.conclusion: CMiLBench可作为基础性、可扩展的评测资源，助力弥合数字语言鸿沟，推动低资源少数民族语言的信息化与智能化。

title: KernelShift: Benchmarking Kernel Optimization Across Evolving Hardware
comment: 26 pages, 9 figures, 22 tables. Project page: https://cmu-l3.github.io/kernel-shift/
summary: Efficient AI computation depends on hardware that evolves over time, shifting the strategies needed to implement performant code. For CPU kernels, a key evolving factor is the set of available architectural extensions, which expose specialized hardware instructions that change the techniques used to optimize kernels. We study how effectively coding agents use these new, potentially unfamiliar extensions to write fast code. We introduce KernelShift, a benchmarking pipeline and a set of environments for evaluating coding agents in kernel optimization across evolving CPU architectures. Its agent-assisted, human-verified pipeline turns code repositories into benchmark instances, and its environments let agents optimize code with feedback from the target hardware. Using this pipeline, we construct 99 kernels from real-world, actively developed repositories (ncnn, llama.cpp, Arm SIMD Loops, and KleidiAI), including inference workloads derived from real model executions. KernelShift supports incorporating new kernels and hardware configurations as libraries and processors evolve. We evaluate agents with proprietary and open-weight models across progressively newer architectural extensions (Arm Neon, SVE, SVE2, and SME2), examining how performance changes as hardware evolves. On established extensions, agents beat the auto-vectorized compiler everywhere (2.4-19.8x) and exceed general-purpose libraries such as ncnn (getting up to 2.74x over its Neon kernels), but fall behind Arm's hand-tuned KleidiAI kernels (0.70x). In end-to-end inference of two LLMs, agent-written kernels achieve a 1.3-1.6x prefill speedup over llama.cpp's fast path. However, current agents do not yet reliably adapt to new extensions that require unfamiliar programming models, such as SME2's matrix tiles.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 KernelShift：一个将真实代码仓库自动转换为 CPU kernel 优化基准的流水线与环境集合，覆盖不断演进的 Arm 架构扩展（Neon、SVE、SVE2、SME2），用于评测编码 agent 在硬件演进中编写高效 kernel 的能力。
AI.motivation: 高效 AI 计算依赖随时间演进的硬件，新架构扩展引入的专用指令会改变 kernel 优化方式。现有工作不清楚编码 agent 能否有效利用这些新颖、可能陌生的扩展来写出高性能代码，因此需要一个贴合真实仓库、可随硬件演进的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 agent 辅助、人工验证的流水线，将代码仓库转为基准实例，并提供可访问目标硬件反馈的优化环境；据此从 ncnn、llama.cpp、Arm SIMD Loops、KleidiAI 等活跃仓库构建 99 个 kernel（含真实模型推理负载）。框架支持持续加入新 kernel 与硬件配置，并用闭源与开源权重模型在逐代扩展（Neon→SVE→SVE2→SME2）上进行评测。
AI.result: 在成熟扩展上，agent 全面优于自动向量化编译器（2.4–19.8x），并超过 ncnn 等通用库（对其实测 Neon kernel 最高 2.74x），但落后于 Arm 手工调优的 KleidiAI（0.70x）。在两种 LLM 端到端推理中，agent 编写的 kernel 相较 llama.cpp 快速路径取得 1.3–1.6x 的 prefill 加速。然而面对需要陌生编程模型的新扩展（如 SME2 的 matrix tile），当前 agent 尚不能可靠适配。
AI.conclusion: KernelShift 提供了可扩展、随硬件演进的 kernel 优化评测基础设施。结果表明 agent 已能超越编译器与通用库、并在真实 LLM 推理中获得明显加速，但在利用全新编程范式的架构扩展上存在显著短板，是未来 agent 能力的重点改进方向。

title: Single-Coordinate Activation Steering for Controllable Social Stance in Language Models
summary: Steering one neuron of a small language model can impose a topic or a quirk without training, yet replications show that many published single-neuron recipes are fragile or nonspecific. This paper asks whether an interpersonal stance can be controlled in this manner. The stance studied is a distant crush, a chatbot character that is guarded, intermittently warm and inconsistent. In Qwen3.5, 4B, contrasting activations on hand-written guarded and eager replies identified neuron 7515 of layer 9 as a candidate for controlling this stance. Increasing this neuron activation made the characters replies more distant. Three language models rated this change as stronger than the effects of changing randomly selected neurons, and a blind human comparison supported the finding. Changing the interventions direction between messages also shifted replies between warmer and more distant styles. This suggests that a language model conversational stance can be personalized without finetuning.

AI.tldr: 通过在Qwen3.5-4B中定位单个神经元（第9层第7515号），可无训练地调控聊天角色“疏离暗恋者”的人际姿态。
AI.motivation: 单神经元调控虽能施加话题或习惯，但已有复现显示许多单神经元方案脆弱且缺乏特异性；本文探究人际姿态（一种介于防备与间歇性温暖之间的“疏离暗恋”人设）能否以同样方式被控制。
AI.method: 在Qwen3.5-4B上，用人工撰写的“防备”与“热切”回复做激活对比，定位第9层第7515号神经元为候选控制单元；施加激活干预并比较不同干预方向，采用三个语言模型评分与盲测人类对比作为评估。
AI.result: 提高该神经元激活使角色回复更疏离；三个模型评分显示其效应强于随机选取神经元的干预，盲测人类比较亦支持该结论；在消息间翻转干预方向可使回复在更温暖与更疏离风格间切换。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型的对话姿态可无需微调而被个性化调控，但结论基于单一模型与单神经元，普适性与稳健性仍需检验。

title: LM2 Compiling a Language Model into Another Model Weights
summary: Deploying a conversational model and a specialist together could avoid maintaining a separate specialist service. We present LM2, which embeds a trained story generator into a larger conversational model. The larger model handles the conversation and invokes the generator for story requests. We constrain the generator arithmetic during training so its calculations can be compiled directly into added model layers. We compare this approach with QwenPU, which executes the stories260K language model on an embedded processor. LM2 requires one host token per generated character, compared with approximately 25,000 for QwenPU. However, its story generator predicts held out text less well, i.e. 1.145 bits per character versus 0.894 for stories260K, where lower is better. The Qwen3.5, 0.8B implementation occupies 18.1 GB and generates the same characters as a standalone integer implementation of the inner model in the tested runs. These results illustrate a tradeoff between host-token cost and text-prediction performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LM2：将训练好的故事生成器嵌入更大的对话模型，通过训练期算术约束使其计算可直接编译进新增网络层；与在嵌入式处理器上运行 stories260K 的 QwenPU 相比，LM2 每个生成字符仅需 1 个 host token（QwenPU 约 25,000），但预测性能较差（1.145 vs 0.894 bits/char）。
AI.motivation: 部署对话模型与专用专家模型并存需维护独立的专家服务，成本与复杂度高。作者希望把专用生成器直接内嵌到对话模型内部，从而省去单独维护专家服务的开销。
AI.method: 提出 LM2：把训练好的故事生成器嵌入更大的对话模型，由大模型负责对话并在收到故事请求时调用该生成器。训练时对生成器施加算术约束，使其计算能够直接编译为新增的模型层。对比基线为 QwenPU，即在嵌入式处理器上运行 stories260K 语言模型。实现基于 Qwen3.5 0.8B。
AI.result: LM2 每个生成字符仅需 1 个 host token，而 QwenPU 约需 25,000 个。代价是故事生成器对留出文本的预测更差：1.145 bits/char，stories260K 为 0.894（越低越好）。Qwen3.5 0.8B 实现占用 18.1 GB，在测试运行中生成字符与独立的整数版内层模型一致。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 host-token 开销与文本预测性能之间存在权衡：LM2 以极低的 host-token 代价换取较弱的生成质量，嵌入式方案则以高通信/调用开销保留更强生成能力。

title: ESGPT: A Data-Centric ESG Language Model with Unified Instruction and Benchmark Resources
summary: ESG analysis requires complex language understanding across diverse sources, including corporate reports, news, and disclosures, for tasks such as ESG relevance detection, action interpretation, impact analysis, and question answering. However, existing ESG datasets are fragmented by task and source, with heterogeneous formats and annotation schemes, limiting their use for training general-purpose ESG LLMs and unified evaluation. In this work, we construct ESG-Instruct, a 30,000-instance ESG instruction dataset built from public ESG resources, and ESGU-Bench, an ESG understanding benchmark covering six representative ESG tasks. Based on these resources, we further develop ESGPT, an 8B ESG-specialized LLM, and evaluate it against diverse open-source and API-based LLMs. Experimental results show that general-purpose LLMs exhibit substantial performance variation across ESG tasks, while ESGPT, despite its relatively small scale, achieves the best performance on multiple ESG tasks. This work provides unified data and benchmark resources for training and evaluating ESG-specialized LLMs.

AI.tldr: 构建ESG-Instruct指令数据集与ESGU-Bench基准，并训练8B规模的ESG专用大模型ESGPT。
AI.motivation: ESG分析需跨企业报告、新闻、披露等多源文本进行复杂语言理解（相关性识别、行动解读、影响分析、问答等），但现有ESG数据集按任务与来源割裂、格式与标注异构，难以支撑通用ESG大模型的训练与统一评测。
AI.method: 基于公开ESG资源构建30,000条ESG-Instruct指令数据集；构建覆盖六类代表性ESG任务的ESGU-Bench评测基准；在此基础上开发8B参数的ESG专用大模型ESGPT，并与多种开源及API大模型进行对比评测。
AI.result: 通用大模型在各ESG任务上表现波动显著；ESGPT虽规模较小，却在多个ESG任务上取得最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为ESG专用大模型的训练与评测提供了统一的数据与基准资源，并验证了领域专用小模型在ESG任务上的竞争力。

title: SHAKTI: Evidence-Grounded Conversational AI for Nutrition and Health
summary: Large language models (LLMs) answer many diet and health questions but can state unsupported claims and cite sources that do not support them. We present SHAKTI (Smart Health Advisor for Knowledge-based Tailored Interventions), a conversational assistant that answers only from retrieved scholarly papers and exact food-composition data, and evaluate it with retrieval, generation, grounding, efficiency and contextawareness metrics. We indexed 484,368,086 OpenAlex works, searched exactly on a GPU for evaluation (10,065 NFCorpus, BioASQ, SciFact and PubMedQA questions) and through a compressed 230-million-abstract index in deployment. On 1,000 stratified questions, we compared single-shot, multi-hop, corrective and deep-research retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with Claude Sonnet. SHAKTI adds conversational query rewriting, USDA FoodData Central lookups, source-link checks and online verification of quotes and numbers. It was tested in 36 scripted conversational turns, a 248-question memory-depth test and a 38-question load test. Claims were checked by a Claude Opus judge against exactly the text the system saw. MedCPT reranking of hybrid retrieval gave the best MRR (0.21) and MAP@100 (0.14). Across existing RAG methods, faithfulness was 0.95-0.96, claim hallucination 0.5-0.8% and context precision up to 0.98; the deep-research agent answered 73.2% of BioASQ questions correctly. In conversation, SHAKTI reached a context-awareness score of 97.1%, faithfulness 95.5%, 1.9% unsupported claims, no contradicted claims and 229/229 working source links; it resolved references to the first question after 16 unrelated questions. An answer cost 14,716 tokens (US$0.06) with a median latency of 24 s. Large-scale retrieval with agentic evidence selection and mechanical verification yields auditable, low-hallucination nutrition answers.

AI.tldr: SHAKTI 是一个仅基于检索到的学术论文与精确食物成分数据作答的对话式健康/营养助手，通过对话式查询改写、USDA 数据查询、来源链接校验与引文/数字在线核验来降低幻觉，并在检索、生成、grounding、效率与上下文感知等维度进行了大规模评测。
AI.motivation: LLM 能回答饮食与健康问题，但常给出无依据的断言并引用不支持其结论的来源，缺乏可审计性与低幻觉保障。
AI.method: 索引 484,368,086 条 OpenAlex 文献，评测时在 GPU 上精确检索 10,065 个 NFCorpus/BioASQ/SciFact/PubMedQA 问题，部署时使用压缩的 2.3 亿摘要索引；在 1,000 个分层问题上用 Claude Sonnet 对比单步、多跳、纠错式与 deep-research 四类 RAG；SHAKTI 额外加入对话式查询改写、USDA FoodData Central 查询、来源链接检查及引文与数字在线核验。测试包括 36 轮脚本化对话、248 题记忆深度测试和 38 题负载测试；声明由 Claude Opus 评判器对照系统实际可见文本核查。
AI.result: 混合检索经 MedCPT 重排后取得最佳 MRR（0.21）与 MAP@100（0.14）。现有 RAG 方法 faithfulness 为 0.95–0.96，claim 幻觉率 0.5–0.8%，context precision 最高 0.98；deep-research 代理正确回答 73.2% 的 BioASQ 问题。对话中 SHAKTI 上下文感知得分 97.1%、faithfulness 95.5%、无依据声明 1.9%、无被反驳声明、229/229 来源链接有效，并能在 16 个无关问题后仍正确解析指向首个问题的指代。单次回答耗 14,716 tokens（约 US$0.06），中位延迟 24 秒。
AI.conclusion: 大规模检索配合代理式证据选择与机械化核验，可生成可审计、低幻觉的营养学答案。

title: Language models seek help despite guaranteed score losses in question answering
summary: At the highest waiting cost in a multiple-choice question-answering task, all 7 tested open-weight language models still consult an expert even though a correct expert answer earns fewer points than an incorrect independent answer. Pooling over expert accuracy and fixed-fee combinations gives help-seeking rates of 20.8% to 94.1% across models. We test 2,291 questions across 54 combinations of expert accuracy and consultation costs, comparing observed decisions with an expected-score baseline based on independently measured and calibrated model confidence. Help-seeking rates vary across conditions with the same expected consultation score. Fine-tuning reduces decision regret by 59% to 87% on held-out questions within the training range but increases inconsistency at matched expected consultation scores. In a separate task, external routing improves scores by 0.180 to 0.273 points per question with candidate answers held fixed.

AI.tldr: 该研究用多选题问答任务考察7个开源权重语言模型在咨询专家与独立作答之间的求助决策，发现即便在最不利的成本条件下模型仍会求助，但决策整体偏离期望分数基线，微调可降低决策后悔却加剧同一期望分数下的不一致性。
AI.motivation: 检验语言模型能否根据专家准确率与咨询成本做出理性求助决策，而非盲目依赖或回避外部专家，并将其与基于校准置信度的期望分数基线比较。
AI.method: 在7个开源权重模型上测试2,291道多选题，覆盖专家准确率与咨询成本的54种组合；将观测决策与基于独立测量并校准的模型置信度所计算的期望分数基线对比；另设微调实验（样本内测试与留出题）及一项保持候选答案固定的外部路由任务。
AI.result: 在最高等待成本下，全部7个模型仍咨询专家，尽管正确专家答案得分低于错误独立答案；汇总各组合求助率为20.8%–94.1%；相同期望咨询分数条件下求助率随条件变化；微调将留出题决策后悔降低59%–87%，但在匹配期望分数下增加了不一致性；外部路由每问题提升0.180–0.273分。
AI.conclusion: 模型的求助行为并非完全符合期望分数最优，存在系统性偏离与情境依赖的不一致性；微调能提升决策质量但未解决期望分数匹配下的行为不稳定，外部路由可在答案候选不变时带来稳定增益。

title: Training-Free Interventions for Hallucination in Large Language Models
summary: A frozen language model can give a wrong answer because a fact is unavailable, a reliable passage is ignored, or an unsupported claim survives generation. We review 116 works on inference-time hallucination intervention and its foundations. We trace the development from retrieval and controllable generation to methods that act on input evidence, token scores, internal representations, completed claims, or the decision to answer. For each family we compare its source of evidence, model access, preparation cost, and the task on which a correction can be established. For activation steering, we distinguish estimating a subspace from applying a state-dependent edit and separate interventions on the prompt from those on the generated prefix. Published comparisons show why faithfulness to a source, factual correctness, informativeness, and answer coverage must be measured separately. Applications in time-sensitive question answering, document synthesis, and visual grounding identify when source authority, evidence availability, or capability preservation limits a reported gain.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统梳理了116项关于推理时幻觉干预及其基础的工作，涵盖检索、可控生成、激活引导等五类方法族，并按证据来源、模型访问权限、准备成本与可验证任务进行横向比较，强调忠实性、事实正确性、信息量与答案覆盖率需分别度量。
AI.motivation: 冻结语言模型产生错误答案的成因多样——事实缺失、忽略可靠段落、或生成中出现无支撑主张，需要系统厘清推理时干预手段的谱系与边界。
AI.method: 综述式研究：将方法分为作用于输入证据、token 分数、内部表征、已完成主张、是否作答决策等族类；对激活引导进一步区分子空间估计与状态相关编辑，并区分作用于提示与作用于已生成前缀的干预；跨族比较证据来源、模型访问、准备成本与可建立纠正的任务。
AI.result: 已有对比研究表明，对来源的忠实性、事实正确性、信息量与答案覆盖率必须分开测量；在时效性问答、文档合成与视觉定位等应用中，来源权威性、证据可获得性与能力保持会限制报告增益。
AI.conclusion: 推理时幻觉干预需按统一的证据来源—模型访问—成本—可验证任务框架评估，并采用多维指标分别度量，避免单一指标掩盖干预的局限。

title: GraphSeer: Multimodal Knowledge Graph Relational Image Retrieval with MLLMs
summary: Multimodal knowledge graphs (MMKGs) store entities with photos and names and link them by facts. MMKG methods predict links between known entity IDs, and image retrievers, from CLIP to MLLM embedders, return entities that look like a query photo or match its description. Neither answers a common question about a new photo: which graph entity is related to the one shown, such as the team of a pictured player or the city of a landmark. We call this knowledge graph relational image retrieval (KRIR): given a photo and a natural-language relation, retrieve the related MMKG entity, which rarely resembles the photo, whether the depicted entity is in the graph (known) or not (unseen). We build three benchmarks from YAGO, Wikidata and in-the-wild OVEN photos. The task hides two hops: recognising which graph entity is shown, and recalling what it is connected to. GraphSeer bridges them inside one multimodal LLM: it links the photo to the graph, reads the facts of the best match, and retrieves with the hidden state at which the model is about to say the answer. An unseen entity has no facts of its own, but every candidate answer does, so a listwise verifier reads the other end of the graph: it re-ranks the top candidates by their facts and photos in one forward pass, and the facts matter far more than the photos. With Qwen3.5-27B, GraphSeer improves MRR on known entities by 24.2-70.0% over an MLLM embedder fine-tuned on the same data with the same budget. When it also fuses and verifies the embedder's candidates, it improves MRR on unseen entities by 12.5-25.6%, and on known entities it beats KG-completion models given the ground-truth entity ID.

AI.tldr: 论文提出知识图谱关系图像检索（KRIR）任务，并给出单模型统一方案GraphSeer：在多模态LLM内部完成“照片→图实体→关系事实→答案实体”的两跳推理，在三项新基准上显著优于微调嵌入模型与KG补全模型。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态知识图谱（MMKG）方法分为两类：链接预测只针对已知实体ID之间的关系，图像检索（从CLIP到MLLM嵌入器）只返回与查询照片外观或描述相似的实体。二者都无法回答关于一张新照片的常见问题——"图中实体与哪个图实体相关"（如球员所属球队、地标所在城市），因为答案实体在视觉上与照片几乎不相似，且被查询实体可能不在图中（unseen）。
AI.method: 构建基于YAGO、Wikidata及真实场景OVEN照片的三个KRIR基准。将任务显式分解为两个隐藏跳步：识别照片对应的图实体、回忆其关联实体。提出GraphSeer，在同一多模态LLM中桥接两跳：先将照片链接到图、读取最佳匹配实体的事实，并取模型"即将输出答案"处的隐状态进行检索；针对无自身事实的unseen实体，设计listwise验证器，在单次前向中对Top候选按候选方的事实与照片重新排序（事实权重远高于照片），并可融合与验证嵌入器的候选。
AI.result: 以Qwen3.5-27B为基座，在相同数据与预算下，GraphSeer在known实体上MRR较微调MLLM嵌入器提升24.2%–70.0%；融合并验证嵌入器候选后，unseen实体MRR提升12.5%–25.6%；在known实体上亦优于给定真实实体ID的KG补全模型。
AI.conclusion: KRIR是一个有价值且此前被忽视的任务；把实体识别与关系回忆两跳统一到单个多模态LLM的隐状态检索中，辅以基于候选端事实的listwise验证，可同时有效处理known与unseen实体，并优于纯嵌入检索与KG补全两类基线。

title: VistaTree: Question Answering over Long Multimodal Documents with Image-Derived Summary Trees
summary: Answering questions over long multimodal documents requires locating relevant evidence across pages containing text, tables, and figures. When the document exceeds the model's context window, selective retrieval becomes necessary. We introduce VistaTree, a document question-answering agent that builds a summary tree directly from rendered page images. VistaTree segments documents into contiguous page spans, recursively groups them into a topic hierarchy, and refines sibling summaries to distinguish neighboring sections. At query time, the agent uses node summaries to select relevant nodes and reads the corresponding pages, using hierarchical navigation when the full outline exceeds the context budget. Experiments on MMLongBench-Doc and LongDocURL evaluate answer quality and retrieval cost using a locally hosted vision-language model, and quantify the performance gap between global and hierarchical access to the index.

AI.tldr: 提出 VistaTree——直接从渲染页面图像构建摘要树的文档问答智能体，支持长篇多模态文档的选择性检索与分层导航。
AI.motivation: 长多模态文档（含文本、表格、图）问答需要在多页间定位证据；当文档超出模型上下文窗口时，必须进行选择性检索。现有方法多依赖解析后的文本，难以直接利用页面视觉信息。
AI.method: 从渲染的页面图像直接构建摘要树：将文档切分为连续页段，递归聚合为话题层级，并对同级摘要进行精炼以区分相邻章节。查询时智能体依据节点摘要选择相关节点并读取对应页面；当完整大纲超出上下文预算时，采用分层导航访问索引。
AI.result: 在 MMLongBench-Doc 与 LongDocURL 上，使用本地部署的视觉语言模型评估答案质量与检索成本，并量化"全局访问索引"与"分层访问索引"之间的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 基于页面图像构建摘要树并结合分层导航，可在上下文受限条件下实现长多模态文档的高效证据检索与问答，同时揭示分层索引对性能的影响。

title: Can Speech LLMs Recognize When Audio Evidence Is Insufficient? A Diagnostic Study and a Pre-Generation Probing Mitigation
comment: 18 pages, 6 tables. Accepted as a poster at SSPP 2026 (SMILES School Projects & Proceedings). Preprint also available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24347252. Code: https://github.com/ladnlav/slm-audio-evidence
summary: Speech large language models are usually evaluated on questions that have answers. We ask what they do when a recording establishes none, and whether the standard way of finding out is sound. Diagnosed on synthesized speech the answer looks clear: Qwen2-Audio fabricates an answer to 92.5% of unanswerable questions, while an ASR cascade reading the same recordings reaches 2.5% hallucination at 6.7% over-refusal, placing the failure in reasoning rather than in perception. The identical protocol on 376 native SQuAD 2.0 questions over human-read recordings removes that conclusion: the cascade hallucinates on 67.7% against the end-to-end model's 69.8%, at a higher over-refusal cost. A paired subset asking the same questions of a synthesized and a human recording of each passage localises the effect in the ASR stage -- the end-to-end model's abstention behaviour does not move with the speaker, the cascade's goes from 11.1% to 65.9%. Reliance on synthesized speech has been named as a limitation of audio benchmarks but not quantified; we quantify it, and show it large enough to reverse a finding. Since no prompt we tested repairs the residual failure, we transfer pre-generation attention probing to the multimodal setting. A probe over frozen prompt representations reaches 0.773 AUROC at predicting which unanswerable questions the model will answer anyway, where semantic entropy over ten sampled generations is at chance: the model fabricates the same answer every time, so sample disagreement cannot see a failure it is confident about.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语音大模型在"无答案"问题上的表现，并指出合成语音评测会反转结论；进而用预生成注意力探针检测幻觉。
AI.motivation: 语音大模型通常在"有答案"的问题上被评测，对其面对不可回答问题时的行为缺乏研究；同时现有音频基准依赖合成语音，这一局限虽被提及但未被量化。
AI.method: 在合成语音与376道SQuAD 2.0原生人类朗读问题上分别测试Qwen2-Audio与ASR级联；构造配对子集（同一问题的合成与真人录音）定位效应来源；将预生成注意力探针迁移到多模态场景，并与10次采样的语义熵对比。
AI.result: 合成语音下Qwen2-Audio对92.5%不可回答问题编造答案，ASR级联幻觉率2.5%、过度拒答6.7%；换成人类录音后，级联幻觉率67.7%，端到端模型69.8%，结论反转。配对实验显示端到端模型拒答率不随说话人变化，级联从11.1%升至65.9%，效应定位于ASR阶段。探针AUROC达0.773，语义熵仅为随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 合成语音依赖足以反转评测结论，需被量化与警惕；残余幻觉无法通过提示词修复，且模型对编造答案高度自信，采样不一致性无法检测，而预生成探针可有效预测。

title: Automatic Construction of Persian E-Commerce Dialogue Datasets for Conversational Product Search
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables. Submitted to ACM Transactions on Asian and Low-Resource Language Information Processing (TALLIP). Code and data: https://github.com/farinfr/persian-cps-dialogues
summary: Conversational product search lets users find products through a multi-turn dialogue instead of a single keyword query, but Persian lacks the large conversational datasets needed to train and evaluate such systems; existing Persian e-commerce dialogue resources cover few categories and small catalogs. We present a framework that builds such a dataset automatically from a real e-commerce catalog and release the resulting dataset. The framework crawls 12,926 products in seven categories of the Digikala marketplace, groups them into 170 semantically coherent clusters, and selects the question the assistant asks at every turn with the Regularized Partition Balance (RPB) score. The RPB score accounts for feature coverage, the probability that the user can answer and the number of values, and generalizes entropy-based question selection. An LLM then verbalizes each question plan into a natural Persian dialogue. In a simulation on the full catalog, the RPB score needs 0.11 fewer turns than the strongest entropy baseline when the difficulty of answering differs between features, and is practically equivalent to it when it does not. Using only a free LLM API, we generated 1,000 requirement-driven dialogues covering all 170 clusters, with turn-level feature annotations; automatic checks and an LLM judge confirm their consistency with the catalog, while their realism is lower than that of the first, GPT-4o-generated version. Code and data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出从真实电商目录自动构建波斯语多轮对话式商品搜索数据集的框架，发布覆盖7类12,926商品、170个语义簇的1,000条对话，并提出RPB问题选择得分。
AI.motivation: 波斯语缺乏大规模对话式商品搜索数据集，现有波斯语电商对话资源类别少、目录规模小，无法支撑系统的训练与评测。
AI.method: 爬取Digikala平台7个类目12,926件商品并聚为170个语义一致的簇；用Regularized Partition Balance (RPB)得分逐轮选择助手提问，该得分综合特征覆盖率、用户可回答概率与取值数量，并推广了基于熵的提问选择；再由LLM将提问计划表述为自然波斯语对话。
AI.result: 全目录模拟中，当特征间回答难度不同时，RPB比最强熵基线少用0.11轮，难度无差异时基本持平；仅用免费LLM API生成覆盖全部170簇、带轮级特征标注的1,000条需求驱动对话，自动检查与LLM评判确认其与目录一致，但真实感低于GPT-4o生成的首版。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明可依托真实电商目录低成本自动化构建大规模波斯语对话式搜索数据集，RPB提问策略在异质难度下更高效，代码与数据公开。

title: LLM-Based Assistant for Dog Care Guidance
summary: This study investigates whether domain grounding through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) can enhance the accuracy and reliability of pet care advice generated by large language models (LLMs). We curated a dataset of breed-specific dog care information and used it to develop two systems: a RAG pipeline based on TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0, and a fine-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B model adapted using LoRA. Both systems were evaluated on 15 dog care questions. The RAG model achieved a perfect average score of 2.0, outperforming the fine-tuned model (mean = 1.47). Statistical analyses, including Welch's t-test, Mann-Whitney U, and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests (all p < 0.05), confirmed the significance of the performance gap. Our findings suggest that retrieval-based domain grounding leads to more accurate, consistent, and trustworthy responses than standalone fine-tuning in specialized LLM applications.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较RAG与LoRA微调在宠物护理建议生成中的领域落地效果，RAG（2.0分）显著优于LoRA微调（1.47分）。
AI.motivation: 探究领域接地（domain grounding）能否提升LLM在专业领域（宠物犬护理建议）中的准确性与可靠性，并比较两种主流领域适配手段的优劣。
AI.method: 构建犬种特异性护理数据集；实现两个系统：基于TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0的RAG流水线，与使用LoRA适配LLaMA-3.2-1B的微调模型；在15个护理问题上评测，并采用Welch t检验、Mann-Whitney U检验与Wilcoxon符号秩检验进行统计显著性分析。
AI.result: RAG模型平均得分2.0（满分），显著高于微调模型的1.47；三项统计检验均显示p<0.05，性能差距具有统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: 在专业化LLM应用中，基于检索的领域接地比单纯微调能产生更准确、更一致、更可信的响应。

title: Dual-Side Uncertainty Estimation: Calibrating Data and Model Uncertainty into a Shared Probability Space
summary: Multimodal user intention analysis infers latent goals from heterogeneous behavioral observations but faces cross-modal input mismatch and output semantic errors. Existing uncertainty estimators focus on input reliability or output confidence and often reduce token uncertainty to simple statistics, overlooking structured dependencies. We propose DUE (Dual-Side Uncertainty Estimation), which jointly estimates input-side aleatoric and sentence-level epistemic uncertainty. From a single generation, Dirichlet perturbations of cross-layer representations produce an ordered token uncertainty sequence. A sequence-aware Normal-Inverse-Gamma estimator uses this sequence to quantify epistemic uncertainty and confidence in its estimate. Evidential multimodal alignment captures aleatoric uncertainty from noisy, incomplete, or inconsistent inputs. DUE calibrates both heterogeneous scores into a shared error-probability space and sequentially fuses them to estimate overall generation risk. Experiments demonstrate strong performance in input-mismatch detection, output semantic-error detection, and overall reliability estimation without repeated generation.

AI.tldr: DUE 从输入与输出双侧联合估计多模态意图分析中的不确定性：用 Dirichlet 扰动跨层表示生成有序 token 不确定序列并结合序列感知 NIG 估计器量化句级认知不确定性，用证据式多模态对齐刻画输入侧偶然不确定性，再将两类异构分数校准到统一错误概率空间并按序融合以估计整体生成风险，无需重复生成。
AI.motivation: 多模态用户意图分析需从异构行为观测推断潜在目标，面临跨模态输入失配与输出语义错误两类问题；现有不确定性估计器要么只关注输入可靠性、要么只关注输出置信度，且常把 token 不确定性压缩为简单统计量，忽略了其结构化依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出双侧不确定性估计框架 DUE：1）单次生成中通过对跨层表示施加 Dirichlet 扰动得到有序 token 不确定性序列；2）采用序列感知的 Normal-Inverse-Gamma 估计器基于该序列量化认知不确定性及其置信度；3）通过证据式多模态对齐捕获由噪声、不完整或不一致输入引起的偶然不确定性；4）将两类异构分数校准到共享的错误概率空间，并按序融合得到整体生成风险。
AI.result: 实验表明，在输入失配检测、输出语义错误检测以及整体可靠性估计三项任务上均取得较强性能，且无需重复生成。
AI.conclusion: 输入侧与输出侧不确定性可联合建模，保留 token 不确定性序列的结构化信息有助于提升多模态意图分析的可靠性估计；单次生成即可实现有效的风险度量，兼顾效率与准确度。

title: Don't Sleep, Keep Watch: Proactive Perception for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) built on vision-language models are increasingly entrusted with long-horizon tasks in live desktop, web, and mobile environments, where the screen keeps changing on its own. However, current CUAs lack real-time situational awareness: they perceive the environment through discrete snapshots, and the substantial inference latency of VLMs, compounded by highly dynamic interfaces, opens a perception-action gap in which the observed state frequently becomes stale before the corresponding action is executed. To bridge this gap, we present NightWatch, a plug-and-play framework that endows any CUA with continuous, temporally grounded perception without changing the agent's model, prompt, or action space. NightWatch couples the VLM agent with NightWatch-0.8B, a lightweight System-1 model that performs streaming monitoring of the interface state and keeps the agent synchronized with the evolving environment at low computational cost and latency, thereby grounding each decision in the current state rather than an outdated snapshot and reducing both stale actions and idle waiting while preserving task success. Experiments on desktop and dynamic web environments (OSWorld-Verified and DynaCU-Bench) show that NightWatch, driven by a watcher of only 0.8B parameters, reduces non-reasoning wall-clock time by 33% and wasted time by 53% on OSWorld while keeping task success on par, raises success on DynaCU-Bench from 39.5% to 44.2% with the large VLM agent, and is more efficient than passive-watching baselines such as AOI and PUSV under the same screenshot-only input, as well as a System-1 decision model more than $30\times$ its size. Overall, NightWatch demonstrates that the timing of perception is as critical as its content, marking a step toward agents that maintain continuous awareness of their environment rather than perceiving it turn by turn.

AI.tldr: NightWatch 是一个即插即用框架，为计算机使用智能体（CUA）配备轻量级 System-1 监控模型 NightWatch-0.8B，实现流式界面状态监测，将智能体的决策建立在当前实时状态而非过期快照之上，从而弥合感知—动作延迟鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉语言模型的 CUA 缺乏实时态势感知：仅通过离散快照感知环境，加之 VLM 推理延迟高与界面高度动态，导致"感知—动作鸿沟"——执行动作时所观测状态往往已过期，造成陈旧动作与无效等待。
AI.method: 提出即插即用的 NightWatch 框架，不改变智能体的模型、提示词或动作空间。将 VLM 智能体与 NightWatch-0.8B（轻量 System-1 模型）耦合，由后者对界面状态进行低成本、低延迟的流式监控，保持智能体与动态环境的同步。
AI.result: 在 OSWorld-Verified 上，非推理实际耗时（wall-clock）降低 33%、浪费时间降低 53%，任务成功率持平；在 DynaCU-Bench 上，大 VLM 智能体成功率从 39.5% 提升至 44.2%。在仅用截图的相同输入条件下，效率优于 AOI、PUSV 等被动观察基线，并优于规模超其 30 倍的 System-1 决策模型。
AI.conclusion: 感知的"时机"与感知的"内容"同等关键；NightWatch 是迈向持续环境感知（而非逐轮感知）智能体的一步。

title: Multimodal LLMs Know the Game but Assume the Real World
comment: 32 pages, 12 figures, 26 tables. Code: https://github.com/GaoJianXin05/RuleCraft ; data and model answers: https://huggingface.co/datasets/GGjx/RuleCraft
summary: Multimodal large language models can state the rules of a video game, but do they apply them when they only see the game? We introduce RuleCraft, 1,240 image questions over 155 Minecraft rules with outcomes verified in the game engine, each asked in text, on the image with the game named, and on the bare image. Six widely used models know the rules and recognize the game, yet answer the bare image by real-world physics: naming the game raises their accuracy on rules where the game departs from reality by 8.2-19.8 points on a main set and by 33.8-52.7 on a hard stress-test set. Their errors pick the real-world outcome, the gap is largest where the game leaves a scene unchanged, and reasoning traces state the game's rule, then answer by reality. On the main set, naming the game mostly swaps the real-world default for the game's. The pattern holds with reasoning, recurs in two more games, and persists on questions the models themselves take to be about the game; one neutral sentence asking for the rules of the world shown recovers much of the gap. Evaluations that name the game measure knowledge of its rules, not world selection.

AI.tldr: 提出RuleCraft基准（1,240个图像问答，覆盖155条Minecraft规则，三种提问设置），揭示多模态大模型在仅看图像时会用现实世界物理而非游戏规则作答，并指出命名游戏会显著改变其"世界选择"。
AI.motivation: 现有评测常在问题中显式命名游戏，模型可依赖其已掌握的规则知识作答，从而无法区分"知道规则"与"应用规则"。作者希望探究：当模型只看到游戏画面时，是否会真正调用该世界的规则进行推理。为此需要构建答案可由游戏引擎验证、且能分离"规则知识"与"世界选择"的评测集。
AI.method: 构建RuleCraft数据集：1,240个图像问题，覆盖155条Minecraft规则，每条规则的结果均在游戏引擎中验证。同一问题以三种方式提问：纯文本、图像+游戏名称、仅图像。测试六个主流多模态模型，并进行推理轨迹分析、跨游戏迁移检验，以及一个中性提示句（询问所示世界的规则）的干预实验。
AI.result: 六个模型均知道规则且能识别游戏，但在仅图像条件下依赖现实物理作答。命名游戏使准确率在Depart-from-reality主集上提升8.2–19.8个点，在困难压力测试集上提升33.8–52.7个点。错误多指向现实世界结果；差距在游戏场景保持不变的规则上最大；推理轨迹先陈述游戏规则再按现实作答。中性提示句可恢复大部分差距。
AI.conclusion: 显式命名游戏的评测衡量的是对规则的知识，而非世界选择能力。模型具备规则知识却默认采用现实物理先验，且在推理模式下同样存在。评测设计与提示措辞应谨慎处理上下文线索，以避免混淆"知道"与"应用"。

title: LITMUS - Literature Informed Testbed for Mapping Usecases and Synthesizing Risk-Cards
summary: The proliferation of large language models (LLMs) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in real-world applications has heightened the need for systematic, safety-oriented deployment frameworks. Existing approaches typically prioritize the construction of datasets and risk cards around the LLM and AI architecture itself, yet they provide scant consideration for the specific use-case that drives model selection. This omission is problematic because any practical AI deployment begins with a detailed use-case description that informs the assessment of contextual hazards. In this paper, we introduce a structured pipeline that, given a use-case, automatically produces a tailored dataset and an accompanying risk card. The process ensures that identified risks are tightly coupled to the use-case, and it offers traceable evidence from peer-reviewed literature to substantiate each risk to use-case relationship. Prior claim-verification methods (FActScore, FactReasoner) have been validated for factual claims. Risk-relevance is a hypothetical claim about possible harm, and whether evidence retrieval can meaningfully assess such claims remains untested. Literature-Informed Testbed for Mapping Use-cases and Synthesizing (LITMUS) risk cards are the first systematic attempt to characterize this adaptation. We evaluated the pipeline using the MIT Risk Taxonomy and achieved a 0.91 F1-score with a list of 320 samples from the benchmark risk dataset that was considered. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in generating robust, evidence-based risk assessments for LLM deployments.

AI.tldr: 提出 LITMUS 流水线：给定一个用例，自动生成定制化数据集与风险卡片，并为每项风险—用例关联提供可追溯的同行评议文献证据；在 MIT Risk Taxonomy 上评估取得 0.91 F1。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM/AI 安全部署方法多以模型架构为中心构建数据集与风险卡片，忽视驱动模型选择的特定用例；而实际部署总从用例描述出发来判断上下文危害，这一缺失使风险评估与真实应用脱节。同时，现有事实性核验方法（FActScore、FactReasoner）仅验证事实断言，而"风险相关性"属于关于潜在伤害的假设性断言，证据检索能否有效评估此类断言尚属未验证问题。
AI.method: 设计结构化流水线：以用例为输入，自动产出定制数据集与配套风险卡片；将识别出的风险与用例紧密耦合，并检索同行评议文献作为每项风险—用例关系的可追溯证据。作者称 LITMUS 风险卡片是刻画"证据检索适配风险相关性判断"这一问题的首次系统性尝试。评估采用 MIT Risk Taxonomy，并以基准风险数据集中 320 个样本构成列表进行测试。
AI.result: 在 MIT Risk Taxonomy 与 320 条基准样本上取得 0.91 的 F1 分数，表明该方法能为 LLM 部署生成稳健、基于证据的风险评估。
AI.conclusion: 面向用例的、文献证据驱动的风险卡片生成流水线可行且有效，可弥补以架构为中心方法的不足，并首次系统检验了证据检索对假设性风险断言的评估能力。

title: The Temporal Residual: Fast and Effective Retrofitting of Latent Feedback into Pretrained Language Models
summary: A transformer language model computes a deep hidden state for every token but uses it only to sample that token. Existing latent-feedback designs, which feed hidden states back across tokens, are mostly built in during pretraining and gain little when added to a pretrained model. We introduce the temporal residual, a second residual stream that every sublayer reads and writes and that is carried from each token to the next. It adds 2,752 parameters to a 4.2B-parameter model and starts exactly at the pretrained network. Retrofitted onto Qwen3.5-4B-Base with 5B tokens of training, it beats a standard model trained on the same data by 7, 13 and 5 points on AIME 2024, AIME 2025 and AMC 2023, writes shorter solutions, and stays ahead at matched training compute. The separate stream matters: prior designs that feed state into the existing stream recover at most 40% of the gain when retrofitted. Validation loss can mislead: the recipe with the lowest loss gains nothing at decoding. Trained with filler tokens in place of reasoning, the model reasons in its hidden state: its GSM8K accuracy with no visible reasoning rises from 21% to 40%, and falls back when the carried state is zeroed.

AI.tldr: 提出"时间残差"（temporal residual）——一条跨 token 传递的独立残差流，仅增加 2,752 个参数即可在预训练模型上有效改造，显著提升数学推理表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 transformer 对每个 token 计算深层隐藏状态却仅用于采样该 token，跨 token 的隐藏状态反馈设计多在预训练阶段内置，迁移到已预训练模型时收益甚微。
AI.method: 引入第二条残差流，每个子层均可读写，并从当前 token 传递到下一个 token；该流从预训练网络状态精确起步（恒等初始化），在 Qwen3.5-4B-Base 上用 5B token 进行改造训练。
AI.result: 在 AIME 2024、AIME 2025、AMC 2023 上分别比同数据训练的标准模型高 7、13、5 分，解答更简短，并在等训练算力下保持领先；既往将状态注入原残差流的设计最多只能恢复约 40% 的增益；验证损失会误导——最低损失配方在解码时毫无增益；用填充 token 替代推理文本训练后，GSM8K 无显式推理准确率从 21% 升至 40%，清零携带状态后回落。
AI.conclusion: 独立的跨 token 状态流是关键，且几乎零参数成本即可改造预训练模型；模型可在隐藏状态中完成推理，验证损失并非可靠的选择指标。

title: FiRE: Fine-grained Ranking Evaluation for Machine Translation
comment: 25 pages, 5 figures, accepted at ICML 2026. Wenyang Gao and Yinghao Yang contributed equally to this work. Our code is available at https://github.com/wygao8/FiRE-MT
summary: Developing reliable machine translation (MT) systems hinges on our ability to distinguish superior translations from inferior ones. However, existing evaluation paradigms, whether limited to coarse overall rankings or misaligned with human preferences, fail to deliver interpretable, fine-grained feedback in reference-free settings. We present a Fine-Grained Ranking Evaluation method (FiRE) that leverages off-the-shelf large language models to perform criterion-driven pairwise comparison across three complementary dimensions: faithfulness, fluency, and consistency of style, instead of producing a single holistic judgment. To enable rigorous meta-evaluation of evaluation paradigms in the absence of any suitable testbed, we construct the first human-annotated, reference-free benchmark for fine-grained ranking evaluation, achieving substantial inter-annotator agreement. Through meta-evaluation on this benchmark and existing MQM datasets, FiRE demonstrably outperforms regression-based and error-analysis metrics in aligning with human comparative judgments, while providing more informative insights into translation quality. Finally, our examination of LLM evaluator biases (position and self-enhancement) and their handling of tied cases offers guidance for more nuanced MT evaluation. Code and benchmark resources are available at https://github.com/wygao8/FiRE-MT.

AI.tldr: 提出FiRE，利用现成LLM在无参考设定下做准则驱动的成对比较（忠实、流畅、风格一致三维度），并构建首个细粒度排序评测人工基准，验证其与人类判断一致性优于回归类和错误分析类指标。
AI.motivation: 现有MT评测范式局限于粗粒度整体排序，或与人类偏好不一致，难以在无参考设定下给出可解释、细粒度的反馈。
AI.method: FiRE基于现成大语言模型，将整体判断分解为忠实度、流畅度、风格一致性三个互补维度的准则驱成对比较；同时构建首个无参考、人工标注的细粒度排序评测基准（标注者间一致性高），用于元评测。
AI.result: 在该基准与现有MQM数据集上，FiRE与人类比较判断的对齐程度优于回归类指标和错误分析类指标，并能提供更具信息量的质量洞察；同时分析了LLM评估器的位置偏置与自我增强偏置及其对平局的处理。
AI.conclusion: 准则驱动的细粒度成对排序是更可靠、可解释的MT评测路径，偏置分析为更细致的评测设计提供指导；代码与基准已开源。

title: LeanReviewBench: Semantic Alignment Review in Mathematical Lean Projects
summary: Lean verifies that a proof establishes its formal proposition, but whether that proposition preserves the mathematical content of an informal source requires separate review. In project-scale formalizations, this correspondence can depend on definitions and constraints distributed across many declarations. We introduce LeanReviewBench, a benchmark for project-level semantic alignment review containing 197 versioned inputs collected from 18 real Lean projects, with 87 aligned and 110 misaligned reference judgments. Each input binds an informal mathematical target to selected formal declarations and an extracted dependency context. Construction combines development-history discovery, independent target binding, reconstruction under a common Lean environment, and Astra annotation with human review of uncertain cases. The collection spans diverse mathematical domains and includes 69 historical pairs. We evaluate six language models with Direct and ReForm prompts on all 197 inputs against final human-reviewed reference labels. GPT-6.1 Sol with Direct prompting achieves the highest reported accuracy of 0.827 and misalignment-detection F1 of 0.844; the effects of prompting vary across models. LeanReviewBench provides a testbed for reviewing semantic correspondence in existing mathematical formalization projects. LeanReviewBench is available at https://github.com/MechMath/LeanReviewBench.

AI.tldr: 提出LeanReviewBench基准，用于项目级语义对齐审查，包含来自18个真实Lean项目的197条版本化输入，评估六个语言模型在形式化命题是否保持非形式数学内容上的判断能力。
AI.motivation: Lean只能保证证明建立了其形式命题，但该命题是否保留非形式来源的数学内容需要单独审查；在项目级形式化中，这种对应关系依赖大量分散声明的定义与约束，缺乏系统评测手段。
AI.method: 构建LeanReviewBench：每输入将非形式数学目标绑定到选定的形式声明及抽取的依赖上下文；构建流程结合开发历史挖掘、独立目标绑定、统一Lean环境下重构，以及Astra标注与不确定样例的人工复核；共197条输入（87对齐、110错位），覆盖多数学领域，含69个历史配对。以Direct与ReForm两种提示评估六个语言模型，对照最终人工复核标签。
AI.result: GPT-6.1 Sol配Direct提示取得最高准确率0.827，错位检测F1为0.844；提示方式的效果因模型而异。
AI.conclusion: LeanReviewBench为审查既有数学形式化项目中的语义对应提供了测试平台，并已公开。

title: Unlocking the Power of Loops in Pretrained LLMs with Loop Residuals
summary: Looped Transformers iterate a shared block of layers to increase computation without adding parameters, offering stronger performance and test-time scaling. However, this power has so far required training from scratch and yielded only modest gains for LLMs. Finetuning existing models into loops is far cheaper, yet also brings only marginal gains over SFT. We propose LoopRes, an effective, scalable, and simple approach that turns loops into significant and consistent gains for pretrained LLMs. Building on Attention Residuals, LoopRes lets each looped layer attend directly to the outputs of earlier loops. Since these outputs are iterates of the same layers and become harder to tell apart, we give each a trainable loop-aware key that encodes its structural identity. Attending to all earlier loops also lets layers skip intermediate ones, so we restrict each layer to a residual window of the latest W loops, forcing every loop to build incrementally on recent ones. Across 6 pretrained LLMs from 3 model families and 9 benchmarks, LoopRes delivers significant and consistent gains: at 2x compute, it improves Qwen3-1.7B-Base by 29.1% over SFT, more than doubling the gain of the state-of-the-art baseline. The gains hold on larger models up to 30B and across all three families. More importantly, from 1.7B to 8B, LoopRes scales more steeply than SFT as compute grows, reaching a higher ceiling while needing less compute on long outputs. These results establish LoopRes as an effective looping approach, delivering both better performance and better test-time scaling.

AI.tldr: 提出 LoopRes：在预训练 LLM 微调阶段引入带"循环感知键"与残差窗口的 Attention Residuals，使循环复用层从边际增益变为显著且可扩展的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 循环 Transformer 可增加计算而不增参数，但以往需从头训练且对 LLM 增益有限；微调现有模型成循环虽更廉价，却仅略优于 SFT。核心问题是循环层输出为同一组层的迭代，彼此难以区分，且可直接关注早期循环而跳过中间循环。
AI.method: 基于 Attention Residuals，让每个循环层直接关注此前各循环的输出；为每个循环输出附加可训练的循环感知键（loop-aware key）以编码其结构身份；并将注意范围限制为最近 W 个循环的残差窗口，强制逐循环增量式累积。
AI.result: 在 3 个模型家族、6 个预训练 LLM、9 个基准上取得显著一致增益：2 倍计算下 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 较 SFT 提升 29.1%，为 SOTA 基线的两倍以上；增益在最大 30B 模型及三个家族上均成立；1.7B 至 8B 随计算增长扩展更陡，上限更高且长输出所需计算更少。
AI.conclusion: LoopRes 是有效、可扩展且简洁的循环微调方法，同时改善性能与测试时扩展性，确立循环复用作为预训练 LLM 后训练的有效路径。

title: From Rewarding What Models Say to How They Think: Attention Process Reward Model for LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an important component in large language models (LLMs). However, existing RL approaches focus on final outputs or textual solution trajectories, leading to coarse-grained rewards and unreliable reasoning. Such paradigms focus mainly on what the model outputs while overlooking how the model internally reasons. Therefore, can we reward how a model thinks internally rather than merely what it says? We first reveal the problem of textual reward aliasing in existing reward modeling approaches. Motivated by this, we propose the Attention Process Reward Model (APRM), which assigns internal rewards based on hidden states and attention maps to capture high-quality reasoning patterns. With only approximately 46M parameters, APRM is trained using ranking and counterfactual objectives, and its reward guides RL optimization while being periodically updated to handle distribution shifts. Integrated with representative RL methods, APRM achieved an average pass@8 gain of 2.88\%. Our results demonstrate the promise of incorporating internal reasoning signals into RL for LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出关注模型内部推理过程的注意力过程奖励模型APRM，用隐状态与注意力图提供细粒度内部奖励来改进LLM强化学习。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM强化学习方法多基于最终输出或文本解题轨迹进行奖励，奖励粒度粗、推理不可靠，且只关注模型"输出什么"而忽略"内部如何推理"。作者指出存在"文本奖励混叠"问题。
AI.method: APRM（Attention Process Reward Model）基于隐藏状态和注意力图分配内部奖励，以捕捉高质量推理模式；仅约46M参数，采用排序（ranking）与反事实（counterfactual）目标训练；其奖励引导RL优化，并周期性更新以应对分布漂移。
AI.result: 与代表性RL方法集成后，APRM平均取得2.88%的pass@8提升。
AI.conclusion: 将内部推理信号引入LLM强化学习具有良好前景。

title: Does the Mixer Matter ? Paired-Seed Ablations of Tiny Bilingual Language Models
summary: We report paired-seed architecture ablations from the development of Sophea Artemis, our in-house Greek-English model family. Every arm trains on the same 3B targets with a shared tokenizer and recipe; models range from 54M to 759M total parameters and roughly 54M to 124M active parameters. The main finding is that, at this tiny scale, stored capacity matters far more than mixer design. On a fixed held-out test, replacing the dense feed-forward blocks of a recurrent/attention hybrid with sixteen routed experts, at nearly the same approximate active parameters, lowers loss by 0.079 (Greek) and 0.112 (English) nats per target, and doubling to 32 experts lowers it by a further 0.022 and 0.031, at every paired seed. Reusing a four-layer block three times recovers about 40-44% of the gap between a shallow and an independently deep model, consistent with looped-Transformer results. In contrast, the choice among grouped-query attention (GQA), Gated DeltaNet (GDN) hybrids and a Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) hybrid moves loss by only about 0.01-0.02 nats; a 1:1 GDN/GQA hybrid is the one dense variant that improves on GQA in both languages at every held-out seed. In bits per character, Greek and English held-out losses are similar despite a 74.49%/25.51% training split, and synthetic mathematics, which comes from a collection outside the training sources, is the hardest Greek test component and gains least from added experts. Cached decoding needs its own qualification: trained models passed cached-versus-full logit checks only under a fixed-reduction inference policy, which itself changes 1.4-2.8% of next-token argmax choices relative to native evaluation. All results are conditional on one recipe and scale.

AI.tldr: 在54M–759M总参数量的小规模希腊语-英语模型中，"存储容量"（MoE专家数）对loss的影响远大于混合器设计；循环复用层可部分替代深度；GQA/GDN/KDA选择影响很小。
AI.motivation: 作者在自研希腊语-英语模型族Sophea Artemis的开发中，希望厘清在极小规模下哪类架构决策真正驱动性能：是混合器（注意力/循环）设计，还是存储容量（MoE），并给出成对种子消融的可靠证据。
AI.method: 统一3B token目标、共享tokenizer与训练配方，模型总参数54M–759M、激活参数约54M–124M；成对种子消融：(1)将循环/注意力混合体的稠密FFN替换为16路路由专家（近似同激活参数），再增至32路；(2)四层块复用三次的循环深度；(3)GQA、Gated DeltaNet混合、Kimi Delta Attention混合及1:1 GDN/GQA混合的对比；并做缓存解码与原生评估的logit一致性检验。
AI.result: 16专家使留出loss降低0.079（希）/0.112（英）nats，32专家再降0.022/0.031，所有成对种子一致；四层块复用三次可填补浅层与独立深层模型差距的约40–44%，与looped-Transformer结论一致；混合器选择仅带来约0.01–0.02 nats差异，1:1 GDN/GQA是唯一在两种语言所有留出种子上均优于GQA的稠密变体；按bits per character，尽管训练比例为74.49%/25.51%，希英留出loss相近；合成数学（域外来源）是最难的希腊语测试成分且从专家扩容中获益最少；缓存解码仅在固定归约推理策略下通过一致性检查，该策略改变1.4–2.8%的next-token argmax选择。
AI.conclusion: 在此极小规模与单一配方下，参数存储容量（专家路由）是主导性能因素，循环深度复用是次优杠杆，而混合器设计边际影响有限；域外数学任务难以通过专家扩容改善；缓存解码须以固定归约策略单独校准。结论仅限于该配方与规模。

title: Interrogation Protocols for AI Control
comment: 26 pages (8 main + references and appendix), 21 figures, 4 tables. Under review. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/interrogation-protocols-A11B/
summary: As the intelligence of an AI agent increases relative to a trusted monitor, so does the risk that the monitor will fail to understand the agent's actions or to evaluate them confidently. We introduce interrogation protocols to a high-stakes AI control setting, and allow the monitor to ask the untrusted agent questions about confusing actions. For interrogation to improve safety, a weaker model must be able to distinguish misleading explanations produced by an attack policy from genuine ones produced by an honest policy. We find that on a held-out subset of BashArena, an interrogation protocol improves safety at a 1% audit budget from 72.6% for an actions-only baseline, which does not use interrogations, to 79.5% (+7.0 pp [+0.9, +20.1], 95% paired bootstrap interval), but most of this uplift can be captured by having a trusted model state a specific concern. More broadly, our work suggests that interrogating agents can improve safety, allowing monitors to catch more attacks at a larger capability gap.

AI.tldr: 提出"审讯协议"(interrogation protocols)引入高风险AI控制场景，让监控者向不可信智能体追问困惑行为的解释；在BashArena上1%审计预算下将安全性从72.6%提升至79.5%，但大部分增益可由可信模型直接陈述特定疑虑来获得。
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体相对于可信监控者的能力增强，监控者理解智能体行为或自信评估其行为的风险上升，仅凭观察动作的监控在能力差距扩大时可能失效，因此需要更主动的信息获取手段。
AI.method: 在高风险AI控制设定中引入审讯协议，允许监控者对可疑动作向不可信智能体提问；核心检验是较弱模型能否区分攻击策略产生的误导性解释与诚实策略产生的真实解释；在BashArena的留出子集上，以1%审计预算比较"仅动作"基线与审讯协议，并做消融——由可信模型直接陈述特定疑虑。
AI.result: 安全性从仅动作基线的72.6%提升到79.5%（+7.0个百分点，95%配对bootstrap区间[+0.9, +20.1]）；但该提升的大部分可由可信模型陈述具体疑虑所捕获。
AI.conclusion: 审讯智能体可提升安全性，使监控者能在更大的能力差距下发现更多攻击；但审讯带来的增益在很大程度上可被更简单的"可信模型提出特定疑虑"机制替代。

title: When Does Continual Pre-Training Help? An Empirical Study of Decoupled Knowledge and Generation Trajectories in Clinical LLMs
comment: EAccepted at EACL 2027 (Main Conference). 26 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables
summary: Continual pre-training (\textit{CPT}) is a standard route for domain adaptation, yet existing studies typically track pre-training loss or multiple-choice question answering (\textit{MCQA}) accuracy alone, offering only a narrow view of how adaptation unfolds. We jointly track factual knowledge via \textit{MCQA} and open-ended behavior via pairwise preference rankings across $18$ checkpoints for each of eight instruction-tuned \textit{Qwen} models ($0.5B$ to $8B$), adapted to German medicine with \textit{CPT} and \textit{SLERP} merging. The two axes converge at consistently different rates, with preference rankings reaching $90\%$ of their total gain after a median of $1.7B$ tokens versus $3.5B$ for \textit{MCQA}. A judge-free token-distribution measure reaches this threshold at $1.9B$ tokens. Per-aspect scores indicate that these early preference gains largely reflect surface alignment, meaning models can sound domain-appropriate before their factual knowledge catches up. Larger adapted models close more of the gap to unadapted next-tier generalists, whereas preference gain per FLOP falls by about an order of magnitude across our size range. We therefore argue that judge-based preference scores, which can plateau while \textit{MCQA} knowledge is still improving, should not be used alone to infer adaptation convergence or domain readiness.

AI.tldr: 论文追踪8个Qwen模型（0.5B–8B）在德语医学CPT中的18个检查点，发现开放式偏好排序比MCQA准确率更早收敛（中位数1.7B vs 3.5B tokens），早期偏好收益主要是表层对齐所致，故不应用偏好分数单独判断适应收敛。
AI.motivation: 现有CPT研究通常只追踪预训练损失或MCQA准确率，视角单一，无法刻画领域适应过程的全貌，尤其忽略了开放式生成行为的变化轨迹。
AI.method: 对8个指令微调Qwen模型（0.5B–8B）用CPT与SLERP合并适配德语医学领域，每个模型追踪18个检查点；同时用MCQA衡量事实知识、用成对偏好排序衡量开放式行为，并引入无评判者（judge-free）的token分布度量作为对照，辅以分维度（per-aspect）评分与FLOP效率分析。
AI.result: 偏好排序在1.7B tokens中位数即达到总增益的90%，MCQA需3.5B；judge-free token分布度量在1.9B达到同阈值。分维度得分显示早期偏好提升主要反映表层对齐，模型可先"说得像"而事实知识尚未跟上。更大模型对未适配的下一档通用模型的差距缩小更多，但每FLOP偏好增益在尺寸范围内下降约一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 基于评判者的偏好分数可能在MCQA知识仍在提升时即饱和，因此不应单独用作判断适应收敛或领域就绪度的依据，需与事实知识指标联合评估。

title: Feedback-Driven Prompt Refinement for Educational AI: Affective Trajectory Estimation and Bloom's Taxonomy Classification
summary: Contribution: This study has shown that a shared prompt-refinement procedure, guided by distinct affective and cognitive feedback signals, can improve held-out reference agreement and multi-label classification while reducing affective-generation variability without executor parameter updates. Background: Industry 4.0 has increased demand for personalized technical education across interconnected computing and engineering domains, while prompt sensitivity and generation variability have complicated dependable interpretation of instructional dialogue and learning outcomes. Research Questions: The study has examined whether task-specific feedback can improve affective-reference agreement, generation consistency, and cognitive classification without updating executor parameters. Methodology: A secondary language model has revised executor prompts using executor-output discrepancies against model-generated affective references for four dialogues and annotated Bloom labels for 70 learning outcomes; separate sets of 100 EduTalk conversations and 1,000 outcomes have supported held-out comparisons. Small refinement sets, unvalidated affective references, and absent learner-outcome measures have constrained interpretation. Findings: Affective mean absolute error has decreased from 0.742 to 0.702 and mean generation standard deviation from 0.307 to 0.238, while Bloom micro-F1 has increased from 0.687 to 0.893 and exact-match subset accuracy from 0.418 to 0.636. These findings have supported prompt refinement as a candidate approach for developing adaptive technical instruction, while its effects on workforce learning remain to be established.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种共享的提示精炼流程，利用情感与认知两类反馈信号，在不更新执行器参数的前提下提升参考一致性、生成稳定性与多标签分类性能。
AI.motivation: 工业4.0背景下跨计算与工程领域的个性化技术教育需求上升，而提示敏感性与生成变异性使教学对话与学习结果的可靠解读变得困难。
AI.method: 由次级语言模型依据执行器输出与模型生成情感参考之间的差异（4段对话）以及标注的Bloom标签（70条学习结果）来修订执行器提示；另以100段EduTalk对话与1,000条学习结果作为留出集进行对比评估。
AI.result: 情感平均绝对误差由0.742降至0.702，生成标准差均值由0.307降至0.238；Bloom微F1由0.687升至0.893，子集精确匹配准确率由0.418升至0.636。
AI.conclusion: 提示精炼可作为开发自适应技术教学的候选方法，但其对劳动力学习成效的影响仍待验证；研究受限于精炼集规模小、情感参考未经校验以及缺乏学习者结果测量。

title: When Video Verifier Scores Mislead: Capability Assessment and Verifier Selection
summary: Video verifiers judge whether a candidate answer or trajectory agrees with a video, and are themselves chosen by a score. We show that this score depends on two choices in the test, the type of negative and the judgment interface, strongly enough to reverse conclusions about what a model can do and which verifier to deploy. We separate the two with controlled constructions that have exact truth conditions: endpoint-matched negatives, wrong only in their internal states, and a truth-switch test, in which the same two candidates swap correctness between two videos. Under direct judgment, where the verdict is read from answer scores, models that reject a visibly wrong start fall to near chance against endpoint-matched negatives. When the frames disclose each event, writing out reasoning before the answer lifts three of four models from under 10% to 70-100% on the truth-switch test, and staged inputs trace the direct failure to one step, composing events into states. But when the event must first be found, on human-validated natural video, the same change brings no significant gain under a protocol common to all models and can lower accuracy if one candidate denies that the event occurs. The negative type also changes which verifier is selected: one chosen on event-denial negatives is 8.9 points less accurate against negatives that keep the event and change a detail, the errors a generator mostly makes, and recovers about half as much accuracy when it reranks that generator's answers. A verifier should be evaluated on the errors it will face, and neither a low direct score nor a gain from reasoning should be read as a property of the model alone.

AI.tldr: 视频验证器的评测分数同时取决于负样本类型与判定接口，二者足以反转"模型能力"与"该部署哪个验证器"的结论；验证器应在其实际会遇到的错误上被评测，低分或推理带来的增益都不能被视为模型本身的固有属性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频验证器依赖单一分数做评价与选型，但该分数可能混淆了测试设计（负样本类型、判定接口）与模型真实能力，导致对模型能力和部署选择的结论不可靠。
AI.method: 构造具有精确真值条件的受控实验：（1）端点匹配负样本（仅内部状态错误、首尾帧与正样本一致）；（2）真值切换测试（同一对候选在两个视频间互换正确性）；（3）分级输入以定位失败环节；（4）直接判定（从答案分数读判决）与先写推理再作答的接口对比；（5）在人工校验的自然视频上使用统一协议复验；（6）比较基于事件否认负样本选出的验证器在"保留事件、改细节"负样本上的表现及重排序收益。
AI.result: 直接判定下，能拒绝明显错误开头的模型面对端点匹配负样本时准确率降至接近随机；当帧显式披露每个事件时，先写推理使四个模型中三个在真值切换测试上从不足10%提升到70–100%，分级输入将直接失败定位到"把事件组合成状态"这一步；但在需先定位事件的自然视频上，同样改动在统一协议下无显著增益，若某候选否认事件发生甚至会降低准确率。负样本类型也改变验证器选择：以事件否认负样本选出的验证器，在"保留事件、改细节"（生成器最常见的错误）上准确率低8.9分，用于重排序时仅恢复约一半的准确率增益。
AI.conclusion: 验证器的评测必须匹配其部署时将面对的错误分布；直接判定的低分与推理带来的增益都依赖于负样本类型和判定接口，不能作为模型固有属性的证据。

title: From Point Clouds to Engineering Models: Benchmarking Agentic 3D Reconstruction in the Built Environment
summary: Coding agents can translate 3D measurements into CAD geometry, but reconstructing engineering models for the built environment demands semantic interpretation and consistent construction constraints beyond surface fitting. We formulate scene-level Scan-to-BIM (Building Information Modeling) as an agentic 3D coding task and introduce S2Bench, comprising public and proprietary scans of 128 real-world scenes across five domains, paired with expert-curated reference models spanning diverse spatial scales.
