A shared framework lets agents measure scans in Python, build class-labeled components in a live CAD/BIM kernel, and iteratively refine their code. We also propose parallel asynchronous collaboration, where a lead delegates versioned tasks, continues modeling while workers execute, and integrates revision-bound proposals. Evaluating five agents and a collaborative team across 1,028 reconstructions shows that scan-to-model residuals directly guide geometric repair, whereas inferring semantic classes and construction relations requires joint geometric, visual, and engineering reasoning that agents struggle to ground and verify. Consequently, the leading agent fits scan geometry closely ($96\%$ coverage within $5\,\text{cm}$) yet reaches only $63\%$ mIoU, and no agent passes all engineering checks on more than $38\%$ of scenes. Coverage and engineering conformance drop with scene scale, whereas running a smaller model as a team improves all three axes with greater coverage gains on larger scenes. The project page is available at https://tumcms.github.io/S2Bench.github.io/

AI.tldr: 该论文将场景级Scan-to-BIM形式化为智能体3D编码任务，提出S2Bench基准（128个真实场景，含公开与私有扫描，跨5个领域），并给出统一框架与并行异步协作方法。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体可将3D测量转换为CAD几何，但建成环境的工程模型重建需要语义解释与一致的构造约束，超越单纯的表面拟合，现有基准与方法难以评估这一能力。
AI.method: 将Scan-to-BIM定义为智能体式3D编码任务；构建S2Bench，包含5个领域128个真实场景的公开/私有扫描及专家标注的参考模型，覆盖多空间尺度。提供共享框架：智能体在Python中测量扫描、在实时CAD/BIM内核中构建带类别标签的构件、迭代精修代码。并提出并行异步协作机制：lead分配版本化任务，在worker执行时继续建模，并整合受修订版本约束的提案。共评估5个智能体与1个协作团队，1,028次重建。
AI.result: 扫描到模型的残差可直接指导几何修复，而语义类别与构造关系的推断需要几何、视觉与工程推理的联合，智能体难以落地与验证。最强智能体在5cm内覆盖率达96%，但mIoU仅63%；无任何智能体在超过38%的场景上通过全部工程检查。覆盖度与工程一致性随场景尺度下降；以团队方式运行较小模型可三轴同时提升，且在大场景上覆盖增益更大。
AI.conclusion: 场景级Scan-to-BIM的瓶颈不在几何拟合而在语义与工程约束的接地与验证；基准与协作框架为智能体式BIM重建提供了可量化的评估与改进路径。

title: Same Executions, Different Gaps: Judgment Rules in Web-Agent Evaluation
summary: Success-rate gains guide the development of web agents. Yet knowing which agent ranks first does not tell us how much confidence to place in its reported advantage. We study the comparison itself: how success is defined, what evidence supports the judgments, and how the difference between agents is estimated. On fixed web-agent executions, changing a judge from predicting likely completion to requiring recorded support can remove most of a reported lead without changing the ranking. This effect persists when unresolved completion is distinguished from supported failure. Controlled source additions explain how missing relations between task requirements, objects and observations can conceal a difference or create an apparent advantage. We also find that making both agents' score estimates more accurate can make their difference less accurate, because their original errors partly canceled. To estimate a chosen outcome difference, we combine judge predictions with reference labels for sampled task pairs. Across four released execution systems, regression fitted on the same 50 labeled pairs reduces estimation error relative to direct paired sampling. The results give agent researchers a practical basis for assessing claimed improvements: make the comparison target explicit, retain the evidence needed to check it, and use paired labels to estimate the difference directly.

AI.tldr: 本文研究web agent成功率比较本身：明确"成功"定义、保留判断证据、并直接用配对标签估计差异。
AI.motivation: web agent的开发依赖成功率增益来指导，但仅知排名第一无法判断其报告优势的可信度；需要审视比较过程本身（成功如何定义、证据如何支撑判断、差异如何估计）。
AI.method: 在固定的web agent执行记录上，将评判标准从"预测可能完成"改为"要求有记录证据支撑"；区分"未解决的完成"与"有证据支撑的失败"；通过受控的源信息添加分析任务需求—对象—观察之间缺失关系的影响；并采用将评判预测与抽样任务对的参考标签相结合的回归方法估计所选结果的差异。
AI.result: 改为要求证据支撑可消除报告的大部分领先优势（排名不变），该效应在区分未解决完成与支撑失败后依然存在；缺失关系可掩盖差异或造成虚假优势；提高两agent分数估计的准确度反而可能降低其差值的准确度（原误差部分抵消）；在四个公开执行系统上，用同样50个标注对拟合回归相比直接配对抽样降低了估计误差。
AI.conclusion: agent研究者应：明确比较目标、保留可核查的证据、并用配对标签直接估计差异，以此作为评估声称改进的实践基础。

title: HighwayVerse: A Chain-of-Inspection Benchmark for Highway Infrastructure Anomaly Understanding
summary: Practical highway infrastructure inspection entails progressive diagnostic reasoning from visual perception to maintenance decisions, yet existing benchmarks remain confined to isolated tasks, leaving Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) insufficiently evaluated across sequential inspection stages. Meanwhile, current datasets focus primarily on highway pavement defects, falling short of real-world inspection across diverse infrastructure components such as highway pavements, guardrails, glare screens, and drainage systems. To address these gaps, we formulate the Highway Infrastructure Inspection Progression Chain (HIIP-Chain), spanning Anomaly Detection, Anomaly Recognition, Condition Analysis, and Maintenance Resolution, and introduce HighwayVerse. HighwayVerse comprises 14,143 real-world Ground and Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) inspection records spanning 100 and 17 anomaly categories, respectively, with 84,858 expert-reviewed question-answer pairs. We evaluate 12 open-source and closed-source MLLMs using the chained metric Final, which credits a correct maintenance decision only when all preceding diagnostic stages are completed correctly. Results show that although models achieve relatively high accuracy when initially judging whether an anomaly is present, their markedly lower Final scores expose struggles across downstream recognition, analysis, and decision-making. This discrepancy indicates that current MLLMs do not fully comprehend specific highway anomaly patterns beyond superficial initial judgments. Furthermore, we propose LaneRAG, a training-free retrieval-augmented framework that provides hierarchical reference guidance achieving consistent performance improvements across diverse MLLMs. Our dataset, evaluation benchmark, and source code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出高速公路基础设施巡检渐进链 HIIP-Chain 与数据集/基准 HighwayVerse（14,143 条真实地面与无人机巡检记录、100+17 类异常、84,858 条专家审核问答），并评估 12 个 MLLM，发现初始异常判断准确但端到端决策差距大；进一步提出免训练检索增强框架 LaneRAG。
AI.motivation: 现有基准局限于孤立任务，无法评测 MLLM 在"视觉感知→养护决策"多阶段序贯推理上的能力；同时现有数据多聚焦路面缺陷，缺乏护栏、防眩屏、排水系统等多部件的真实巡检覆盖。
AI.method: 构建四阶段递进链 HIIP-Chain（异常检测、异常识别、状况分析、养护处置）；构建真实地面与无人机巡检数据集 HighwayVerse；提出链式指标 Final（仅当前序各阶段均正确才计入正确决策）；提出免训练的分层检索增强框架 LaneRAG。
AI.result: 在 12 个开源与闭源 MLLM 上评测：模型在"是否存在异常"的初始判断上准确率较高，但 Final 分数显著偏低，暴露下游识别、分析与决策环节的薄弱，说明模型仅停留在表层判断而未真正理解异常模式；LaneRAG 在各模型上带来一致性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 将巡检建模为序贯诊断链可更真实反映 MLLM 的实际能力，链式指标能揭示孤立任务评测所掩盖的短板；分层参考引导的检索增强是提升多阶段巡检推理的有效且无需训练的手段。

title: Beyond Self-Consistency: Recursive Self-Improvement at Test Time
summary: Large language models (LLMs) that continue improving after deployment (e.g., recursive self-improvement) offer a promising path toward general intelligence. Current test-time methods pursue this goal on unlabeled questions, primarily relying on self-consistency: they generate independent solutions and use majority voting to select an answer or construct training targets. This leaves earlier reasoning unused at inference and can reinforce an incorrect majority during training. Humans instead build on earlier attempts to preserve useful reasoning, correct mistakes and improve their problem-solving strategies. Following this principle, we propose Test-Time Recursive Self-Improvement (TT-RSI), a label-free framework for improving LLMs at test time through two mutually reinforcing components: (1) In-Context RSI repeatedly re-solves each question using the full previous solution as a reference, letting the model decide whether and how to use it so that inference compute builds on earlier reasoning. (2) In-Weight RSI distills successive refinements into the model's weights, enabling progress beyond an initially wrong majority and theoretically bringing the first attempt toward the model's infinite-step refinement limit. The updated model answers better and refines more effectively, generating stronger references for subsequent training. Extensive experiments show that TT-RSI improves average accuracy by +13.89% over the base model and outperforms the strongest self-consistency-based method by +4.79% under the same test-time scaling budget.

AI.tldr: 提出TT-RSI，一种无标签的测试时递归自我改进框架，通过上下文内递归重解与权重内蒸馏两个互补组件，让模型在推理时累积利用早期推理并超越错误多数，平均准确率较基座提升13.89%。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时方法主要依赖自一致性（生成独立解并多数投票），存在两个缺陷：推理阶段早期推理被浪费，训练阶段可能强化错误的多数答案。人类则会基于先前尝试保留有用推理、纠正错误并改进策略。
AI.method: (1) In-Context RSI：将上一轮完整解答作为参考反复重解同一问题，由模型自行决定是否及如何使用参考，使推理算力建立在早期推理之上；(2) In-Weight RSI：将连续的改进蒸馏进模型权重，理论上使首次尝试向其无限步精炼极限靠近。二者相互强化：更新后的模型答得更好、精炼更有效，为后续训练提供更强参考。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TT-RSI相对基座模型平均准确率提升+13.89%；在相同测试时扩展预算下，比最强的基于自一致性的方法高出+4.79%。
AI.conclusion: 无标签的测试时递归自我改进能够有效利用推理历史并突破错误多数瓶颈，为模型部署后持续自我改进提供了可行路径。

title: Serialization and the Character-System: Measuring Narrative Concentration in French Fiction (1800--1940)
comment: Computational Humanities Research Conference (Manchester, january 7-9) 24 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables
summary: Every novel divides a finite quantity of narrative attention among its characters, and whether the shape of that division, between a narrative organized around a single figure and one spread across a crowd, has a history is far less settled than the abundance of critical commentary on protagonists might suggest. We operationalize Woloch's notion of the character-system, the distribution of narrative attention across a novel's cast structured by the tension between "the one" and "the many", as the inequality (Gini coefficient) of the PageRank distribution over a character network. We trace this measure of structural concentration across 12,011 French novels published between 1800 and 1940, drawn from the Hors d'usage corpus of Gallica fiction. Over the long nineteenth century the trajectory is U-shaped, with concentration declining to a trough in the 1850s-1860s and rising again through the turn of the century. The change is small, comparable to the difference between a novel built on two co-equal protagonists and one built on a single protagonist, but it is robust to the character cutoff, corpus density, cast size, and author effects. Detective and adventure fiction are less concentrated than the average novel of their period. Literary history reads the roman-feuilleton either as the novel of a superior hero or as a form of proliferating episodes, and on this structural measure our results support the second reading. Across the age of the feuilleton (1840-1914), authors whose careers were structured by newspaper serialization distribute centrality more evenly than a literary control, net of period, genre, and canon. Because such claims are only as trustworthy as the networks they rest on, we also evaluate the extraction pipeline against manually annotated novels, at the levels of cast and character identity.

AI.tldr: 该论文将Woloch的"人物系统"操作为人物网络中PageRank分布的基尼系数,追踪12,011部1800–1940年法国小说的叙事注意力集中度,发现其呈U形轨迹,并可用于检验连载小说(roman-feuilleton)的文学史争论。
AI.motivation: 关于小说的人物关注分配(围绕单一主角还是分散于群像)是否具有历史性,学界虽有大量主角研究,却缺乏系统性、可量化的证据。作者希望以可操作的结构指标检验这一文学史问题,并解决roman-feuilleton是"优越英雄小说"还是"情节增殖形式"的争论。
AI.method: 以人物网络PageRank分布的基尼系数测量结构集中度(即"一"与"多"之间的张力);在Gallica Hors d'usage语料库12,011部1800–1940年法国小说上计算该指标;进行稳健性检验(人物截断、语料密度、人物规模、作者效应);将连载作家与文学对照组比较(控制时期、体裁、经典性);并用人工标注小说在人物表与人物身份两个层面评估抽取流程。
AI.result: 集中度在长19世纪呈U形:降至1850–1860年代的低谷,随后在世纪之交回升,变化幅度相当于"双主角小说"与"单主角小说"之差;侦探与冒险小说低于同期平均;在连载时代(1840–1914),以报纸连载为主的作者比对照组分配更均匀(控制时期、体裁、经典性后仍成立);结果支持roman-feuilleton的"情节增殖"解读而非"单一英雄"解读。
AI.conclusion: 叙事注意力的结构集中度具有可测量的历史轨迹,人物网络指标可作为检验文学史假说的有效工具;结论的可靠性依赖于网络抽取质量,因此对抽取流程进行了人工标注层面的验证。

title: When Tools Fail, Agents Fabricate: Silent Failure and Verification-First Oversight in Tool-Using LLM Agents
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development. 12 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables
summary: Tool-using LLM agents must recover when a tool call fails, by retrying, switching tools, or revising their plan. We study how agents fail when tools fail, using RetryRealistic, a sandboxed yet realistic testbed for controlled fault injection in which agents operate on a real OS filesystem with genuine permission enforcement, SQLite databases, a deterministic local HTTP server, and a constrained shell, across 8 tools, 9 fault types with controlled persistence, and 30 multi-step tasks. Evaluating four agents over 2,100 faulted runs against ground truth, we find that recovery is unreliable (19-68% correct) and frequently silent: 6-26% of runs end in a confident fabrication, a wrong answer asserted as fact. The failure mode is governed more by the fault type than by the model: faults that return partial data drive fabrication (up to 38%), while hard denials drive honest failure. The mechanism is what we call silent ingestion: the agent accepts faulted data as valid on first contact without retrying or flagging the problem, then builds a fabricated answer on top of it. We show that fabrication is reducible: a verification-first Monitor, grounding checks in structured tool outputs and issuing corrective directives rather than hard blocks, raises correct recovery from 45.6% to 56.3% and cuts fabrication from 17.3% to 10.8%. Removing chain-of-thought increases fabrication (+8.3pp), so deliberation guards against silent ingestion. We release RetryRealistic, the fault-injection toolkit, and all annotated traces at https://github.com/Kingsford-Group/RetryRealistic

AI.tldr: 提出 RetryRealistic 测试床，系统研究工具调用失败时 LLM 智能体的恢复能力，揭示"静默摄入"导致的自信编造失效模式，并用验证优先的 Monitor 显著降低编造率。
AI.motivation: 工具使用型 LLM 智能体在工具调用失败时必须能通过重试、切换工具或修订计划来恢复，但现有工作缺乏在真实环境下可控注入故障的系统评估，智能体在工具失败时如何失效尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建 RetryRealistic 沙箱测试床：真实 OS 文件系统及权限强制、SQLite 数据库、确定性本地 HTTP 服务器、受限 shell，覆盖 8 种工具、9 类故障（含可控持续性）、30 个多步任务；对 4 个智能体执行 2,100 次故障运行并与标准答案对比；提出验证优先的 Monitor（基于结构化工具输出做接地校验并发出纠偏指令而非硬阻断）；并做移除思维链的消融。
AI.result: 恢复可靠性低（仅 19–68% 正确），且常为静默失败：6–26% 的运行以"自信编造"（将错误答案断言为事实）告终。失效模式主要由故障类型而非模型决定：返回部分数据的故障导致编造（最高 38%），硬性拒绝则导致诚实失败。机制为"静默摄入"——首次接触即接受故障数据为有效、不重试不标记，再在其上构建虚构答案。Monitor 将正确恢复率从 45.6% 提升至 56.3%，编造率从 17.3% 降至 10.8%；移除思维链使编造增加 8.3pp。
AI.conclusion: 工具失败下的恢复是当前智能体的薄弱环节，编造风险由故障类型主导且可通过"先验证后使用"的监控机制显著缓解；思维链式推理是抑制静默摄入的重要防线。作者开源 RetryRealistic、故障注入工具包及全部标注轨迹。

title: Specialized Large Language Models for Markovian Reasoning: Structural Cache Compression, Transition Pretraining, and Dual-Loop Transformers
summary: Standard autoregressive large language models attend to the growing history of generated tokens, making the key-value (KV) cache a central memory and throughput bottleneck in long-chain reasoning and multi-branch sampling. Yet an important class of reasoning problems is naturally first-order Markovian: the next step depends on a sufficient representation of the current state, rather than on the raw sequence of all earlier steps. We develop a unified design paradigm for Markovian-reasoning specialized large language models. At the cache level, the Markovian state interface transforms history-dependent KV storage into constant-size state transfer with respect to the number of reasoning steps. At the learning level, we reformulate long-chain prediction as independently trainable one-step transition objectives, with explicit state bottlenecks, distillation, invariance, and drift-consistency losses. At the architectural level, we introduce a dual-loop Transformer: an outer loop advances the reasoning state, while an inner recurrent-depth loop allocates adaptive computation to each transition through shared weights and explicit memory tokens or recurrent matrix states. We connect this architecture to a three-region cache, step-relative positions, truncated backpropagation, branch-aware checkpoints, and a transition-centric evaluation protocol. The organizing principle is simple: the optimal reasoning system need not remember everything; it must carry forward exactly what the future needs. This principle opens a path toward specialized reasoning engines whose memory footprint is decoupled from reasoning-chain length.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向马尔可夫式推理的专用大语言模型统一设计范式，将KV缓存从随推理步数增长的历史存储转变为常数规模的"状态"传递，使内存占用与推理链长度解耦。
AI.motivation: 标准自回归LLM需关注不断增长的历史token，KV缓存成为长链推理与多分支采样中的核心内存与吞吐瓶颈；而一类重要推理问题本质上是马尔可夫性的——下一步仅依赖当前状态的充分表示，而非全部历史原始序列，因此无需保留全部历史。
AI.method: 三个层面统一设计：(1) 缓存层——马尔可夫状态接口，把依赖历史的KV存储转化为关于推理步数恒定大小的状态转移；(2) 学习层——将长链预测重构为可独立训练的单步转移目标，引入显式状态瓶颈、蒸馏、不变性与漂移一致性损失；(3) 架构层——双环Transformer，外环推进推理状态，内环以递归深度循环、共享权重与显式记忆token或递归矩阵状态为每次转移分配自适应计算；并配套三区缓存、步相对位置、截断反向传播、分支感知检查点与以转移为中心的评测协议。
AI.result: 该文为设计范式/框架性工作，未报告具体实验指标；其主张的收益是推理状态内存占用与计算接口的常数化，从而缓长链推理和多分支采样中的KV缓存瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 核心原则为"最优推理系统不必记住一切，只需精确携带未来所需之物"，据此可构建内存足迹与推理链长度解耦的专用推理引擎。

title: Seeing Right, Writing Wrong: Where Short Chain-of-Thought Breaks Spatial VQA
summary: Asking a vision-language model (VLM) to think step by step often makes it worse at spatial questions, even though the image stays in context. We show that short chain-of-thought (CoT) turns a perception problem into a transcription problem. Once a VLM writes a spatial relation, its answer follows that sentence instead of the image, so whether CoT helps or hurts depends largely on whether the written relation is more accurate than answering directly. Studying 15 open VLMs (2B-38B) and six frontier closed models, we rule out token count, turn format, and visual forgetting in open models and trace the failure through three stages. First, writing re-weights visual cues, weakening a "lower is closer" shortcut in all 13 open models tested but also discarding valid cues, which produces false relations. Second, the written text takes over. With the model's own conclusion-removed rationale held fixed, swapping in an opposite-depth image moves the answer by 2-9 points on rendered twins (vs. up to 77 for direct answers) and by 3.0-3.4 points on average on natural photographs (vs. 20.5-69.6). Third, the concluding sentence can invert even a true relation, mainly on converse questions. Together, false relations and conclusion mis-mapping account for four in five CoT losses. Scale does not remove this bottleneck: Qwen3-VL-32B shows the same pattern. Frontier closed models are not hurt: they write relations as accurately as they answer, and three of six re-check the image after writing. The three queried with reasoning off lock in like open models, so re-grounding co-occurs with answer-turn reasoning; we identify answer-step re-grounding as the step open VLMs lack. In a single-model pilot, fine-tuning on fixed rationales with image-determined labels restores it on natural photographs. We open-sourced all our datasets and code at https://ming-zch.github.io/seeing-right-writing-wrong.

AI.tldr: 短链式思维（CoT）会把空间感知问题转化为"转写问题"：VLM一旦写出空间关系，答案就跟随该句子而非图像，因此CoT是否有益取决于写出的关系是否比直接作答更准确；该瓶颈源于"假关系"与"结论映射错误"两处，且规模扩大无法消除，而前沿闭源模型通过"答案步重接地"规避。
AI.motivation: 观察到对VLM进行逐步推理（CoT）常使其在空间类问题上表现更差，尽管图像始终在上下文中。作者希望揭示这一反直觉现象的机制，解释CoT何时有益、何时有害。
AI.method: 研究15个开源VLM（2B–38B）与6个前沿闭源模型；排除token数量、轮次格式、视觉遗忘等解释；通过三阶段分析失败路径：(1) 写作重加权视觉线索，(2) 固定模型自身去除结论的推理文本、替换相反深度图像做干预实验，(3) 分析结论句的映射；并在自然照片与合成"孪生"图像上量化；单模型试点用图像确定标签的固定rationale微调。
AI.result: 写作会削弱"越低越近"的捷径（13个开源模型均如此）同时丢弃有效线索，产生假关系；固定推理文本后，替换相反深度图像仅使答案移动2–9分（孪生）/3.0–3.4分（自然照片），而直接作答时移动高达77分/20.5–69.6分，说明文本主导；假关系与结论误映射合计占CoT损失的4/5；Qwen3-VL-32B同样如此，规模不解决；闭源模型写出关系与作答同样准确，6个中3个在写作后重新检查图像，关闭推理后则如同开源模型被锁定。
AI.conclusion: CoT在空间任务中的失效本质是"感知转写化"，瓶颈在于开源VLM缺乏"答案步重接地"；该步骤与答案轮推理共存。用图像确定标签的固定rationale微调可在自然照片上恢复重接地能力。作者开源了数据集与代码。

title: CLOSE: A Calibrated Label-free Online Self-Evaluating Verifier for Object Hallucination in Vision-Language Models
comment: 41 pages (8-page main text and appendix), 25 figures, 24 tables
summary: Vision-language models frequently describe objects absent from the image because of language priors. Yet the model itself is already a strong judge of its own output: asked separately whether an object is present, it rejects 44%-62% of its hallucinations, and its yes probability reaches an AUROC of 0.90-0.95 without training. This judgment, however, is not directly usable: (1) its probabilities lack a common scale across models; (2) for the remaining 38%-56%, the model still answers yes with probabilities that overlap those of real objects, so no threshold separates them. We therefore propose CLOSE, a Calibrated Label-free Online Self-Evaluating verifier that enforces this judgment during generation. Its threshold is a quantile of a memory rather than a probability and thus depends only on ranks; the memory is cold-started from unlabeled images and updated online. A scorer self-trained on pseudo-labels from four hidden-state signals is fused with self-asking by rank to separate what self-asking leaves mixed. Refused objects are rolled back and banned through a laddered back-off, and a recognition table intercepts their reappearance under other wordings. On COCO, refusing 20% and 40% of object mentions reduces the CHAIRs of LLaVA-1.5-7B by 42% and 87% (F1 +1.9 and -6.1 points); refusing 20% and 35% reduces the reachable hallucinations of Qwen3-VL-8B (official counts minus CHAIR-script miscounts) by 79% and 96% (F1 +0.5 and -5.3). An external vocabulary further extends the check beyond the official vocabulary.

AI.tldr: 提出CLOSE，一种免校准、无需标签的在线自评估验证器，抑制视觉语言模型生成中的语言先验幻觉。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型常因语言先验描述图中不存在的物体，但模型本身具备较强的自判断能力（单独询问某物体是否在图中，可拒绝44%-62%的幻觉，无需训练其yes概率AUROC即达0.90-0.95）。然而该判断不可直接用：概率缺乏跨模型的统一尺度；对剩余38%-56%的幻觉，模型仍以与真实物体重叠的概率回答"是"，无法用阈值分离。
AI.method: CLOSE在生成过程中强制施加该自判断：阈值取记忆库的分位数而非概率，仅依赖秩；记忆库由无标签图像冷启动并在线更新；将基于四种隐状态信号伪标签自训练的评分器与"自我询问"按秩融合，以分离后者混淆的样本；对拒绝物体执行回滚并采用阶梯式回退禁止，识别表拦截其换词重现。另用外部词表扩展检查范围。
AI.result: COCO上，拒绝20%和40%物体提及使LLaVA-1.5-7B的CHAIRs分别降低42%和87%（F1 +1.9和-6.1）；拒绝20%和35%使Qwen3-VL-8B的可达幻觉（官方计数减去CHAIR脚本误计）分别降低79%和96%（F1 +0.5和-5.3）。
AI.conclusion: 利用模型自身的判断力，配合基于秩的校准阈值、在线记忆库与多信号融合，可在无需训练和标签的条件下有效抑制幻觉；但高拒绝率下F1下降，提示幻觉抑制与召回间存在权衡。

title: VidRouteBench: A Benchmark for Budgeted Video-Generation Routing
summary:
Text-to-video generators differ by two orders of magnitude in price, and a cheap configuration of a strong model is often good enough for a prompt. Routing prompts across such arms (model x sampling configuration) should buy quality at fixed budget, but no dataset supports studying it: public video-preference sets contain only closed models, one configuration each.
  We release VidRouteBench: 16 arms from 7 open families spanning 121x in measured cost ($0.0025-$0.298 per clip), 27,110 clips (1,421 A800-hours) over 1,625 grouped prompts, a quality score frozen after calibration against human preferences (68.7% CV accuracy vs 66.2% for the best single scorer), per-clip scores on 9 identifiable quality dimensions, repeated seeds, an encrypted test split, and a sealed newest family for cold start. The evaluator compares a router against the best prompt-agnostic mixture of arms, not the best single arm. Per-prompt specialisation here is real and predictable (oracle gap 0.642, 47% reproducible across seeds, prompt-arm interaction F=4.47 at p=1.6e-63), unlike LLM-routing arms, where the same pipeline finds none.
  We then propose OPMU (one probe, many utilities): label a new arm on K probe prompts, predict its 9 dimensions once, and serve any scenario utility by scalarising afterwards. Over 215 utility directions OPMU Pareto-dominates the prompt-agnostic baseline for 94% of directions versus 90% for per-scenario routers, with no per-scenario retraining. Three baselines fail instructively: bag-of-words features lose almost all routing gain in the low-data regime (0.009 vs 0.168); crediting a new arm with its probe average is harmful (-3.32 recovery) although it is the strong baseline on RewardBench-style arms (0.786); Chebyshev scalarisation does not help, our cost-utility front being convex.

AI.tldr: 论文发布 VidRouteBench（16 个视频生成 arm、121 倍成本跨度、2.7 万条片段、1,625 个分组提示词），证明提示词级路由在文生视频上真实可学，并提出 OPMU：用 K 个探针提示词标注新 arm 的 9 个质量维度，之后通过标量化即可服务任意效用方向。
AI.motivation: 文生视频模型间价格差达两个数量级，强模型的廉价配置对许多提示词已足够，理论上按提示词在"模型×采样配置"之间路由可在固定预算下换取质量；但现有公开视频偏好数据集只含闭源模型、每个模型仅一个配置，无法支撑该研究。
AI.method: 构建 VidRouteBench：7 个开源家族共 16 个 arm，实测成本跨度 121 倍（$0.0025–0.298/片段），27,110 条片段（1,421 A800 小时）覆盖 1,625 个分组提示词；质量分经人工偏好校准后冻结（交叉验证准确率 68.7%，最佳单评分器 66.2%），提供 9 个可识别质量维度的逐片段分数、重复种子、加密测试集与一个密封新家族用于冷启动。评测基线为最佳 prompt-agnostic arm 混合而非最佳单 arm。随后提出 OPMU：在 K 个探针提示词上标注新 arm，一次性预测其 9 维分数，再按场景效用标量化以服务任意效用。
AI.result: 提示词级特化真实且可预测：oracle gap 0.642，47% 可在不同种子间复现，提示词-arm 交互 F=4.47（p=1.6e-63）；而 LLM 路由臂上同一流水线未发现此类效应。在 215 个效用方向上，OPMU 于 94% 的方向 Pareto 支配 prompt-agnostic 基线（逐场景路由为 90%），且无需逐场景重训。三个基线失败具启发性：词袋特征在低数据区间几乎丢失全部路由增益（0.009 vs 0.168）；用探针均值给新 arm 记分有害（-3.32 recovery），尽管它在 RewardBench 式 arm 上是强基线（0.786）；Chebyshev 标量化无益，因成本-效用前沿为凸。
AI.conclusion: 提示词级路由在文生视频中是可学习、可泛化的任务；将 arm 表征为多维质量画像、再按效用标量化的 OPMU 范式在广效用方向上优于逐场景路由，并优于若干朴素迁移策略。VidRouteBench 为成本感知路由研究提供了首个含多 arm、多配置与成本标注的公开基准。

title: Elicitation format changes zero-shot classification accuracy in a medical vision-language model: a two-center evaluation on colorectal histopathology
comment: 34 pages, 6 figures; Supplementary Table S1 and Supplementary Material S2 in ancillary files. Corrects one result reported in the companion preprint "Diagnosing Verbalized Confidence in a Medical Vision-Language Model for Selective Prediction on Colorectal Histopathology Patches" (Sinhal et al., arXiv, 2026)
summary: Background. Verbalized confidence from a hosted medical vision-language model is usually treated as packaging around an unchanged prediction. Methods. We held a nine-class colorectal histopathology prompt fixed except for the requested response format and evaluated MedGemma-27b-it on 10,004 validation and 7,180 external-center PathMNIST patches, with preregistered endpoints, randomized ties, and random floors recomputed for each patch set. Results. Requesting probabilities over all nine classes instead of a ranked top-3 reduced accuracy by 14.8 points on validation, -0.1475 [-0.1594, -0.1353], and 13.4 at the external center, -0.1341 [-0.1484, -0.1196], against chance accuracy of 0.1111. The nine-class prompt uniquely forbade commentary, reasoning, and a chosen answer; removing that prohibition at matched cardinality and token budget recovered +0.1878 [+0.1623, +0.2134] and +0.1911 [+0.1648, +0.2181], while changing cardinality with the prohibition absent moved accuracy by -0.0013 [-0.0300, +0.0280] and -0.0214 [-0.0494, +0.0071]. The nine-class format returned no parseable distribution on 7.6 and 7.7 percent of patches, mostly zero vectors in the two least-textured classes, and deferring these failures first explained its measurable selective-prediction gain. Across four vision-capable models, accuracy did not grade the cost: two models matched on accuracy differed five- to sevenfold. First-token logit entropy routed better than any elicited signal, +0.1820 [+0.1722, +0.1974] versus +0.0493 [+0.0377, +0.0649] relative to each signal's random floor. Conclusions. Response format changes a medical vision-language classifier, and the operative component here was the instruction suppressing an answer. Use logits when available; otherwise request a short ranked list without prohibiting reasoning or a chosen answer.

AI.tldr: 在固定九分类结直肠病理提示词、仅改变回复格式的条件下，MedGemma-27b-it 的准确率因要求"九类概率分布且禁止推理/给出答案"而下降约14–15个百分点；移除该禁止条款可恢复约19个百分点，而改变类别数本身几乎无影响。首token logit熵的路由效果显著优于任何模型自报置信度。
AI.motivation: 业界通常把托管医疗视觉语言模型输出的"言语化置信度"（verbalized confidence）视为对既定预测的包装，默认其不改变预测本身。作者要检验这一默认假设：仅改变回复格式（是否要求九类概率、是否禁止推理与给出答案）是否会实质改变分类器行为，并评估不同置信度信号用于选择性预测/路由的实际价值。
AI.method: 采用预先注册终点、随机化平局处理、并为每个patch集重算随机基线的方法。提示词除回复格式外完全固定。在10,004个验证集与7,180个外部中心PathMNIST patch上评估MedGemma-27b-it；对比九类概率分布与top-3排序两种格式；在类别基数与token预算匹配下移除"禁止评论/推理/给出答案"条款；统计不可解析分布（主要为两类纹理最少类别的零向量）；并在四个具备视觉能力的模型上比较准确率—代价关系及各置信度信号（含首token logit熵）相对随机基线的路由增益。
AI.result: 要求九类概率而非top-3使验证集准确率下降14.8点（-0.1475 [-0.1594, -0.1353]），外部中心下降13.4点（-0.1341 [-0.1484, -0.1196]），随机准确率为0.1111；九类提示是唯一同时禁止评论、推理和给出答案的格式。在类别基数与token预算匹配下移除该禁止条款，分别恢复+0.1878 [+0.1623, +0.2134]与+0.1911 [+0.1648, +0.2181]；而在无禁止条款时改变类别基数仅带来-0.0013 [-0.0300, +0.0280]与-0.0214 [-0.0494, +0.0071]。九类格式在7.6%与7.7%的patch上未返回可解析分布，多为两类低纹理类别的零向量，且先行剔除这些失败样本即解释了其可测量的选择性预测增益。四个模型中准确率并不能刻度化代价：两模型准确率相当但代价相差五至七倍。首token logit熵的路由效果优于任何自报信号，相对各自随机基线为+0.1820 [+0.1722, +0.1974]对+0.0493 [+0.0377, +0.0649]。
AI.conclusion: 回复格式会改变医疗视觉语言分类器的表现，本研究中起作用的成分是指令中对"给出答案"的抑制，而非类别基数或输出概率形式本身。实践建议：有logit时使用logit（尤其首token熵）；否则应请求简短的排序列表，且不要禁止推理或明确给出答案。

title: Quantizing Diffusion LLMs under Parallel Decoding: Commitment Risk and the Parallelism Tax
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are served with accelerated decoders that cache context and commit, in one step, every masked position whose confidence clears a threshold. Yet post-training quantization of dLLMs has so far been calibrated and evaluated under fixed-step samplers without caching. We study W4A4 quantization under the deployed decoder and find that the decoder determines both where quantization harms accuracy and what it costs. Irreversible errors enter chiefly through forced commitments, made when no position clears the threshold: they are a minority of commitments but carry most quantization-induced flips. Quantization also levies a parallelism tax, extra forward passes per response: by compressing top logit gaps, it pushes positions below the threshold while leaving predictions largely intact. We propose DECAL, which reweights layer-wise calibration by a commitment-risk prior measured on the deployed decoder, and an argmax-preserving commit temperature that recovers the tax. On LLaDA and Dream, DECAL attains the best average accuracy among W4A4 methods, with lower run-to-run variance than the closest existing calibration method.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究部署态（缓存+置信度阈值提交）解码器下的dLLM W4A4量化，指出强制提交是主要误差来源、并存在"并行度税"，提出DECAL方法予以缓解。
AI.motivation: 现有dLLM后训练量化均在固定步数、无缓存的采样器下校准与评估，与实际部署的加速解码器不一致，无法刻画量化在真实解码路径上的误差与代价。
AI.method: 在部署解码器下分析W4A4量化：发现不可逆误差主要经"强制提交"（无位置过阈值时被迫提交）进入；量化压缩top logit gap导致更多位置跌破阈值，产生额外前向次数（并行度税）。据此提出DECAL：以部署解码器上测得的提交风险先验对逐层校准进行重加权，并引入保argmax的提交温度以回收并行度税。
AI.result: 在LLaDA与Dream上，DECAL在W4A4方法中取得最佳平均精度，且运行间方差低于最接近的现有校准方法。
AI.conclusion: dLLM量化必须置于部署解码器下校准与评估；误差定位（强制提交）与代价刻画（并行度税）共同构成有效的量化优化目标，DECAL据此同时提升精度与稳定性。

title: Seeing Is Locating: Spatial Awareness and Geographic Bias in Decision Language Models
summary: Decision models, which output probability distributions over candidate labels instead of generating text, are increasingly used as classifiers and evaluators for inputs associated with real-world locations. However, it remains unclear whether they can leverage spatial context and whether their predictions are geographically biased. We introduce GeoDecisions, a multimodal benchmark for evaluating the spatial awareness and geographic bias of decision models. GeoDecisions comprises two tasks: (1) geo-aware image classification, and (2) location rating on objective and subjective topics. Evaluating six decision models against supervised task-specific models, we find that spatial awareness requires vision: textual coordinates alone provide insufficient context for classifying everyday photos and satellite images. We also find substantial geographic bias. On everyday photos, despite achieving higher accuracy, open-weight decision models exhibit more spatially clustered errors than supervised models. Moreover, across all five subjective topics, every decision model gives lower ratings to locations with lower socioeconomic conditions. Finally, we propose a training-free method that combines decision models with a location prior to improve their spatial awareness without substantially increasing performance bias. Our code is available at https://github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/GeoDecisions.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoDecisions多模态基准，评估决策模型（概率分布输出型模型）的空间感知与地理偏见，发现空间感知依赖视觉、存在显著地理偏见，并提出免训练的位置先验方法。
AI.motivation: 决策模型（输出候选标签概率分布而非生成文本）正被广泛用作与真实地理位置相关输入的分类器和评估器，但其能否利用空间上下文、预测是否存在地理偏见尚不清楚，缺乏系统评测手段。
AI.method: 构建GeoDecisions多模态基准，包含两项任务：(1) 地理感知图像分类；(2) 客观与主观主题上的地点评分。将6个决策模型与监督式任务专用模型对比，并分析错误的空间聚集性；进一步提出一种免训练方法，将决策模型与位置先验结合。
AI.result: 空间感知依赖视觉：仅凭文本坐标无法为日常照片和卫星图像分类提供足够上下文。日常照片上，开放权重决策模型虽准确率更高，但错误的空间聚集性比监督模型更强。在全部5个主观主题上，所有决策模型均对更低社会经济条件的地点给出更低评分。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型存在明显地理偏见与空间感知缺陷；所提免训练的位置先验融合方法可在不显著增加性能偏见的前提下提升空间感知能力。代码已开源。

title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Contrastive Decoding for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Contrastive decoding (CD) mitigates object hallucination in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by contrasting token distributions under different conditions to adjust token scores. However, existing generative and discriminative benchmarks primarily measure final task scores, which can be confounded by candidate filtering, changes in generation trajectories, and response biases, making it difficult to isolate the effects of the underlying contrastive adjustments. To address these limitations while complementing existing evaluations, we introduce CONCOR (Contrastive Correction Evaluation), a controlled benchmark that directly evaluates the competition between ground-truth and different types of hallucinated candidates using the Contrastive Grounding Margin (CGM). CGM also enables analysis of directional consistency, composition, and reliability of contrastive corrections. Our evaluation reveals that existing CD methods exhibit distinct correction behaviors: some consistently favor ground-truth candidates, whereas others produce strong corrections but also introduce more errors. Crucially, these differences help explain their contrasting responses to increased contrast strength, which improves some methods while degrading others. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating the contrastive correction itself, rather than relying solely on final-output performance, and CONCOR provides a controlled and interpretable framework for understanding and improving CD methods for hallucination mitigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CONCOR 基准，用对比真值裕度（CGM）直接评估对比解码方法对真值与幻觉候选的对比修正能力，揭示不同 CD 方法的修正行为差异及其与对比强度响应的关系。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式与判别式基准只衡量最终任务分数，受候选过滤、生成轨迹变化和响应偏差干扰，难以隔离对比解码（CD）中底层对比调整本身的效果。
AI.method: 提出 CONCOR（Contrastive Correction Evaluation）受控基准，基于 Contrastive Grounding Margin（CGM）直接评估真值候选与不同类型幻觉候选之间的竞争，并据此分析对比修正的方向一致性、组成与可靠性。
AI.result: 评估显示现有 CD 方法呈现不同修正行为：部分方法稳定偏向真值候选，另一些虽产生强修正却引入更多错误；这些差异可解释各方法对提高对比强度的相反响应——有的提升、有的退化。
AI.conclusion: 应评估对比修正本身而非仅依赖最终输出性能；CONCOR 提供了受控、可解释的框架，用于理解并改进缓解幻觉的 CD 方法。

title: SAEPO: Sparse-Autoencoder-Guided Credit Assignment for Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has demonstrated strong performance in improving large language model (LLM) reasoning, yet its credit-assignment signal remains coarse. Outcome verifiers provide scalable supervision by judging whether a completed response is correct, but they do not directly indicate which intermediate reasoning tokens contribute to success or failure. As a result, policy optimization can be inefficient, especially when training base models directly from sparse outcome feedback. In this paper, we introduce SAEPO, a Sparse AutoEncoder-guided token-level credit assignment method for outcome-supervised Policy Optimization. Rather than treating correctness only as a rollout-level (sequence-level) signal, SAEPO uses a pretrained sparse autoencoder (SAE) to build token-level semantic representations within reasoning trajectories; it scores each token based on the SAE concepts (e.g., penalizing wrong "final-answer" tokens but rewarding correct "reasoning-process" tokens), learned in an unsupervised manner, to achieve fine-grained credit assignment. SAEPO is a plug-in advantage-shaping module compatible with various policy optimization algorithms. We instantiate SAEPO with both GRPO and GSPO, covering token-ratio and sequence-ratio policy-gradient objectives, and evaluate SAEPO across three LLM backbones on six math and two code benchmarks. Empirical results show that SAEPO improves both the math and code benchmark averages over the matched baselines, with gains of up to 6.63% and 5.57%, respectively. On Qwen3-1.7B-Base, training curves also show faster early accuracy growth. Feature and token-level analyses suggest that the SAE-derived signal favors question-relevant concepts and reasoning tokens.

AI.tldr: SAEPO：利用预训练稀疏自编码器（SAE）概念构建token级语义表示，对推理轨迹中每个token进行细粒度信用分配，作为即插即用的优势整形模块提升RLVR训练效率。
AI.motivation: RLVR依赖结果验证器提供序列级正确性信号，信用分配粒度过粗，无法指出哪些中间推理token贡献成败，导致策略优化低效，尤其在稀疏结果反馈下直接训练基座模型时更为明显。
AI.method: 用预训练SAE在推理轨迹内构建token级语义表示，基于无监督学到的SAE概念为每个token打分（如惩罚错误的"最终答案"token、奖励正确的"推理过程"token），实现token级信用分配；该方法作为优势整形插件，可兼容GRPO、GSPO等策略优化算法（覆盖token-ratio与sequence-ratio两类目标）。
AI.result: 在3个LLM基座、6个数学与2个代码基准上评估：数学与代码基准平均分较对应基线分别提升最高6.63%和5.57%；Qwen3-1.7B-Base上早期准确率增长更快；特征与token级分析显示SAE信号偏向与问题相关的概念和推理token。
AI.conclusion: SAEPO通过SAE概念驱动的token级信用分配有效缓解结果级监督的粗粒度问题，作为通用优势整形模块可稳定提升数学与代码推理性能，并加速早期收敛。

title: SARA: An Auditor-in-the-Loop LLM Recommender for Sustainability Reports
comment: Accepted at IEEE BigData 2026 as poster paper. 5 pages, 2 figures, 1 table
summary: Auditing corporate sustainability reports requires assurance professionals to map a company-specific checklist drawn from roughly 1,700 regulatory requirements onto the relevant passages of lengthy, repeatedly revised draft reports and to judge compliance. We present SARA (Sustainability Reporting Assistant), a human-in-the-loop recommender system delivered as a Microsoft Word add-in that recommends, for each requirement, the passages addressing it and predicts a compliance verdict while keeping the auditor in full control. SARA casts auditing as content-based recommendation over a fixed regulatory taxonomy and makes per-requirement large language model (LLM) matching cheaper, faster, and more accurate through topic-prediction filtering: on expert-annotated reports, it reduces matching cost about sixfold and runtime by 42% versus feeding the full report to the LLM. It is in production use across PwC Germany's sustainability-assurance practice.

AI.tldr: 提出SARA（Sustainability Reporting Assistant），一个以Microsoft Word插件形式交付的人在回路推荐系统，针对约1700条监管要求逐条推荐报告中相关段落并预测合规结论，通过主题预测过滤显著降低LLM匹配成本与耗时，已在PwC德国可持续性鉴证实践中投入使用。
AI.motivation: 企业可持续性报告的鉴证工作需要把源自约1700条监管要求的企业专属清单映射到冗长且反复修订的报告文本上并判断合规性，人工成本高、效率低，需要自动化辅助但仍须保持审计师的控制权。
AI.method: 将审计任务建模为固定监管分类体系下的基于内容的推荐问题；采用人在回路设计，以Word插件形式集成到审计师工作流；对每条要求使用LLM进行段落匹配，并引入主题预测过滤机制先缩小候选段落范围，再执行逐条要求的LLM匹配与合规结论预测。
AI.result: 在专家标注的报告上，相比将完整报告直接输入LLM，匹配成本降低约6倍，运行时间减少42%，且准确性更高。
AI.conclusion: SARA证明将LLM匹配与主题预测过滤相结合、并以人在回路方式嵌入现有文档工具，可有效支撑大规模监管要求到报告段落的映射与合规判断，并已具备实际生产部署价值。

title: When Does Reasoning Help Entity Disambiguation? Small LLMs In-Domain and Under Shift
summary: Entity disambiguation (mapping ambiguous mentions in text to entities in a knowledge base) is a foundational step in tasks such as knowledge graph construction, question answering, and information extraction. Recent work has applied LLMs to this problem, achieving stateof-the-art performance. Notably, reasoning LLMs have been shown to perform entity disambiguation in a true zero-shot fashion, generalizing across knowledge bases and domains. However, it is unclear whether this capability survives, or remains competitive, with smaller LLMs, where entity disambiguation has typically relied on reranking rather than reasoning. We ask when reasoning is worth its cost at small scale. We compare pointwise, listwise, and reasoning-based candidate-selection components within a classical coarse-to-fine entity disambiguation pipeline, across the classical, few-shot and true zero-shot settings. The reasoning paradigm is trained with distillation and reinforcement learning recipes. The benefit of reasoning grows with domain shift: negligible in-domain, decisive in the true zero-shot setting. We show that two distinct factors are at work: the reranker's uncertainty over the candidates locates where the paradigms disagree, while shift governs which is right when they do.

AI.tldr: 论文研究小规模LLM做实体消歧时"推理是否值得其成本"，比较pointwise、listwise与推理式候选选择组件，发现推理的收益随领域漂移增大：域内可忽略、真零样本条件下起决定作用，并指出重排器的不确定度决定范式分歧位置、领域漂移决定分歧时谁正确。
AI.motivation: 推理型LLM已能在实体消歧中实现真零样本并跨知识库、跨领域泛化，但小规模LLM上该能力能否保持、是否仍具竞争力尚不清楚；小模型上实体消歧通常依赖重排而非推理，因此需要回答"小规模下推理何时值得其成本"。
AI.method: 在经典粗到细实体消歧流程中，对比pointwise、listwise与基于推理的候选选择组件，覆盖经典、few-shot与真零样本三种设置；推理范式采用蒸馏与强化学习配方训练。
AI.result: 推理的收益随领域漂移而增长：域内几乎可忽略，真零样本设置下具有决定性作用。进一步表明两个独立因素在起作用——重排器对候选的不确定度定位了各范式产生分歧的位置，而领域漂移决定分歧出现时哪种范式是正确的。
AI.conclusion: 小规模LLM上的推理式实体消歧并非普遍优于重排，其价值取决于领域漂移程度；候选不确定度与领域漂移共同刻画了推理何时应被启用。

title: TAP: Policy Interfaces for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models denoise a masked canvas, making them a natural setting for selective generation decisions such as answering, waiting, clarifying, or refusing. We introduce TAP-DiLM, which adds a typed policy variable to masked diffusion LMs, and study how this policy should be attached to the denoising process. Across BERT-base, MDLMOWT, LLaDA-8B, and Dream-7B, we compare shared-vocabulary slots, dedicated slot heads, and CLS-based external heads. The results reveal a clear interface-backbone interaction: dedicated heads provide robust policy learning across scales, while sharedvocabulary heads can be effective when the LM-head geometry is favorable. A simple LMhead sharpness probe predicts when sharedhead policy internalization is reliable, giving a practical diagnostic for interface selection. Causal clamp and slot-injection tests show that dedicated policy slots can influence body denoising through feedback, especially at 8B scale. Safety-refusal experiments further show that TAP-DiLM supports competitive typed refusal behavior when trained with diverse unsafe prompts.

AI.tldr: 提出 TAP-DiLM：在掩码扩散语言模型中引入类型化策略变量，系统比较三种策略接口（共享词表槽位、专用槽位头、CLS 外部头），揭示接口与骨干的交互规律，并给出基于 LM-head 锐度的接口选择诊断方法。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型以去噪掩码画布的方式生成，天然适合"回答/等待/澄清/拒绝"这类选择性生成决策；但如何把类型化策略变量接入去噪过程尚不清楚，缺乏接口设计的系统研究。
AI.method: 在 BERT-base、MDLMOWT、LLaDA-8B、Dream-7B 上对比三类策略接口：共享词表槽位（shared-vocabulary slots）、专用槽位头（dedicated slot heads）、基于 CLS 的外部头；并提出 LM-head 锐度探针（sharpness probe）预测共享头策略内化是否可靠；辅以因果钳制（causal clamp）与槽位注入测试，以及安全拒答实验。
AI.result: 存在明显的"接口—骨干"交互：专用头在各规模下均能稳健学习策略；共享词表头仅在 LM-head 几何有利时有效。LM-head 锐度探针可预测共享头内化的可靠性。因果钳制与槽位注入显示专用策略槽位能通过反馈影响主体去噪，在 8B 规模尤为明显。TAP-DiLM 在多样化不安全提示训练下具备有竞争力的类型化拒答行为。
AI.conclusion: 策略接口不应一概而论，需与骨干匹配；专用头更稳健，共享头需满足几何条件，可用锐度探针做实用诊断；类型化策略槽位可反馈影响去噪，并支持有效的类型化拒答。

title: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
summary: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. However, the library is laborious to create and maintain, and frozen when new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild. Human practitioners, by contrast, cope with insufficient tools by fashioning new ones from familiar parts and reusing them across tasks. Inspired by this, we propose ToolSmith, an automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library. We evaluate ToolSmith on three in-domain multimodal search benchmarks and ten out-of-domain benchmarks under a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol. ToolSmith consistently improves over the base library across deployed agents of varying scales, with larger backbones reaping greater gains, demonstrating the scalability of the approach. Our code and data are available at https://threesr.github.io/toolsmith/.

AI.tldr: ToolSmith：一种自动工具生成框架，在多模态搜索智能体的精简基础工具库之上自动"生长"并复用新工具模块，在三个域内与十个域外基准上均优于基础工具库。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态搜索智能体依赖人工构建的小型搜索与视觉工具库，构建维护成本高，且面对新查询类型、证据格式与失败模式时工具库被"冻结"、无法扩展。人类实践者则会用熟悉部件临时拼装新工具并跨任务复用，作者由此获得启发。
AI.method: 提出自动工具生成框架 ToolSmith：以精简的基础工具库为起点，通过自动生成新模块并在任务间复用，实现工具库的持续生长与复用，而非依赖手工设计。评估采用 VLM-as-a-Judge 协议，覆盖 3 个域内多模态搜索基准与 10 个域外基准。
AI.result: 在多种规模的已部署智能体上，ToolSmith 均稳定优于基础工具库；骨干模型越大收益越显著，体现出方法的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 自动工具生成与复用可替代人工工具库的繁重构建，并具备随模型规模放大的良好可扩展性；代码与数据已公开。

title: Look Back, Draft Ahead: Corrective Prefix Attention for Parallel Speculative Decoding
summary: Parallel speculative decoders propose an entire token block at once, yet one early inconsistency can cause the target to reject its remaining suffix. We introduce Corrective Prefix Attention (CPA), which combines prefix-aware selection with autoregressive supervision to improve these parallel drafts. CPA lets each candidate attend to earlier choices within the block. Fixed candidate shortlists allow all pairwise interactions to be computed before selection, reducing the sequential walk to table lookups, accumulation and lightweight scoring rather than repeated neural evaluations. An auxiliary autoregressive loss trains the shared backbone on clean prefixes without adding an inference pass. Across eight math, code and dialogue benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B targets on Ascend NPUs, CPA commits 13--15\% more tokens per verification round than DSpark and 25--26\% more than DFlash. Its mean speedups reach $3.35\times$ and $3.37\times$ under greedy decoding and $2.86\times$ under sampling for both targets. Ablations support both components, while capacity sweeps demonstrate that greater acceptance alone does not guarantee faster decoding. These results motivate correcting parallel proposals with causal information while keeping sequential computation inexpensive.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Corrective Prefix Attention (CPA)，让并行起草的候选token块内部进行前缀感知交互并结合自回归监督，在极低串行开销下提升并行投机解码的接受长度与加速比。
AI.motivation: 并行投机解码器一次性提出整个token块，但块内早期出现的一个不一致就会导致目标模型拒绝其后续整个后缀，造成草稿浪费与接受长度偏低。
AI.method: CPA包含两部分：（1）前缀感知的候选选择——固定候选短名单，使块内每个候选可关注块内更早的选择，所有成对交互在选择前一次性预计算，将串行过程降为查表、累加与轻量打分，而非重复神经评估；（2）辅助自回归损失——在干净前缀上训练共享主干，且不增加额外推理前向。
AI.result: 在Ascend NPU上，以Qwen3-4B与Qwen3-8B为目标模型，覆盖8个数学、代码与对话基准：每轮验证提交的token数比DSpark多13–15%、比DFlash多25–26%；贪心解码平均加速3.35×与3.37×，采样解码为2.86×。消融验证两组件均有效；容量扫描表明仅提高接受率并不必然带来更快解码。
AI.conclusion: 应以因果信息修正并行提案、同时保持串行计算廉价；接受率提升需与开销共同权衡才能转化为实际解码加速。

title: DKnown-Jev-2: Article-Level Answer-Evidence Classification and Efficient Inference with a Pre-trained Language Model
summary: Evidence selection in normative knowledge question answering requires determining whether a candidate article contains content that directly supports an answer under the applicable conditions of the question. We present DKnown-Jev-2, an article-level answer evidence classifier designed for evidence integration across multiple paragraphs. The model jointly encodes question conditions, article metadata, and paragraph content, and uses a pointer-style classification head to predict Answer Evidence (AE) and Non-answer Evidence (NE) in a single forward pass. Ona manually annotated test set of 972 evaluation instances, DKnown-Jev-2 achieves 91.77% accuracy and 91.28% macro-F1, outperforming Jev by 2.16 and 2.37 percentage points, respectively, while reducing both evidence misses and non-evidence false positives. The test set contains 317 multi-paragraph instances, with a maximum body length of 9,322 characters. Shared article encoding and non-autoregressive classification support low-latency inference. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method for article-level evidence selection in normative knowledge question answering.

AI.tldr: 提出文章级答案证据分类器DKnown-Jev-2，用于规范性知识问答中判断候选条文是否包含支持答案的内容，在972条评测实例上取得91.77%准确率与91.28%宏F1。
AI.motivation: 规范性知识问答的证据选择需要判断候选条文在问题适用条件下是否直接支持答案，而该任务涉及跨段落证据整合，现有方法在此场景下存在证据漏检与误报问题。
AI.method: DKnown-Jev-2联合编码问题条件、条文元数据与段落内容，采用指针式分类头，在单次前向传播中同时预测答案证据（AE）与非答案证据（NE），并通过共享条文编码与非自回归分类实现低延迟推理。
AI.result: 在人工标注的972条评测实例上达到91.77%准确率与91.28%宏F1，较Jev分别提升2.16和2.37个百分点，同时减少证据漏检与非证据误报；测试集含317条多段落实例，正文最长9,322字符。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了所提方法在规范性知识问答文章级证据选择任务上的有效性。

title: S-Mind: Internalizing Multi-View Geometry for Spatial Intelligence
summary: Spatial intelligence, the ability to reason about 3D space from visual observations, becomes essential as multimodal large language models (MLLMs) move into the physical world. Beyond perceiving each view, it rests on two cornerstones of human cognition: fusing multiple views into one coherent 3D scene and mentally transforming that scene to new viewpoints as reasoning unfolds. Yet our spatial probes reveal that MLLMs largely lack both capabilities, even after spatial fine-tuning. We therefore present S-Mind, which internalizes multi-view geometry within the MLLM through a compact set of spatial tokens. It supervises these tokens to hold the fused 3D scene and re-emits them to re-express this scene from every viewpoint the reasoning adopts. Across four spatial benchmarks, S-Mind improves its Qwen3.5 backbones by up to 22.26 points and surpasses frontier general models such as GPT-6-Astra (+0.45), Kimi-K3.1-Pro (+1.97), and GLM-5.3-Flash (+7.80) in average accuracy. Moreover, the same probes confirm that it acquires both capabilities, reaching fusion and transformation accuracies of 65.11% and 82.17%, against at most 16.02% and 37.28% for the baselines. At inference, S-Mind also runs about 100x faster than a tool-based agent on the same backbone. Instilled through these spatial tokens during training, spatial capability becomes intrinsic to the backbone and persists even when the tokens are withheld, offering a promising path toward spatial intelligence in MLLMs.

AI.tldr: S-Mind 通过一组紧凑的空间 token 将多视角几何内化进 MLLM，使融合 3D 场景与视角变换两项能力成为骨干网络的内在能力，并在四个空间基准上显著提升准确率、推理速度约为工具型智能体的 100 倍。
AI.motivation: MLLM 走向物理世界需要空间智能，其两大认知基石是把多视角融合为一致的 3D 场景、以及在推理过程中对该场景进行心理视角变换。但作者的空间探针实验显示：MLLM 即便经过空间微调，也普遍缺乏这两种能力。
AI.method: 提出 S-Mind：用一小组紧凑的空间 token 在多模态大模型内部化多视角几何。对这些 token 施加监督，使其承载融合后的 3D 场景；并在推理采用每个新视角时重新发射这些 token，以从该视角重新表达场景。
AI.result: 在四个空间基准上，S-Mind 使 Qwen3.5 骨干最高提升 22.26 分，平均准确率超过 GPT-6-Astra（+0.45）、Kimi-K3.1-Pro（+1.97）、GLM-5.3-Flash（+7.80）等前沿通用模型。探针显示融合与变换准确率达 65.11% 与 82.17%，基线最多仅 16.02% 与 37.28%。推理速度约为同骨干工具型智能体的 100 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练期的空间 token 注入，空间能力成为骨干网络的内在属性，即使在推理时撤除这些 token 仍然保持，为 MLLM 的空间智能提供了一条有前景的路径。

title: Evaluating Persona Consistency in LLM User Simulators Without External Reference Annotations
summary: Standard evaluations assess LLM-simulated personas against an external ground truth, such as community trait annotations, but that reference is unavailable when the persona is inferred only from a short, task-oriented chat. We ask how persona consistency can be evaluated without such a reference, and propose a self-anchored internal-consistency diagnostic: the persona describes itself once and acts twice. A Likert self-report supplies a soft internal anchor; two behavioral profiles come from constrained scenario choices scored without a judge and from open-ended responses judged by an LLM. Consistency is the correlation between the self-report and each behavioral profile, in a shared six-facet BFI-2 space. The framework compares persona-construction strategies by assessing how consistently their elicited responses reflect their self-reported traits. Across ordinary-user chats (WildChat and LMSYS) and well-documented personas with community annotations (the Personality Database, PDB), profile-enriched representations agree with the anchor more closely than a raw-dialogue baseline. On PDB, this self-anchored ordering reproduces the community-annotation ordering. The pattern is stable across answering and judge models.

AI.tldr: 提出"自锚定内部一致性"诊断框架：人格先自述一次（李克特自评作为软锚点）、再行为两次（受限情景选择+开放式回答），以自评与各行为画像在BFI-2六维度上的相关性衡量一致性，无需外部真值即可评估LLM人格化的一致性。
AI.motivation: 传统人格化评估依赖外部真值（如社区特质标注），但当人格仅由简短、任务导向的聊天记录推断时，此类参照不可得，因此需要一种无外部参照的一致性评估方法。
AI.method: 构建自锚定内部一致性诊断：人格自我报告一次（李克特量表，构成软内部锚点）；行为画像两次——受限情景选择（无评判者打分）与开放式回答（LLM评判）；一致性定义为自评与各行为画像在共享的BFI-2六维空间中的相关性。据此比较不同人格构建策略（profile-enriched表征 vs. 原始对话基线），在WildChat、LMSYS普通用户聊天及PDB社区标注人格上进行验证。
AI.result: 在普通用户聊天（WildChat、LMSYS）与有社区标注的人格（PDB）上，profile-enriched表征与锚点的一致性均高于原始对话基线；在PDB上，自锚定排序复现了社区标注排序；该模式在回答模型与评判模型变化下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 自锚定内部一致性可作为缺乏外部真值时评估人格一致性的可行诊断，且其排序与外部标注排序一致，具备作为代理指标的效力。

title: DUET: Dual-MDL Unsupervised Entropy-Trie Segmentation for Low-Resource Languages
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 20th Conference of the European Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics (EACL2027 main)
summary: Morphological segmentation, the task of decomposing words into constituent morphemes, becomes particularly challenging under extreme data scarcity, a regime that can arise in language documentation and linguistic reasoning. This difficulty stems from existing approaches' reliance on annotated data, external resources, or recurring patterns that emerge only in larger corpora. To address this limitation, we propose Dual-MDL Unsupervised Entropy-Trie Segmentation (DUET), a deterministic unsupervised algorithm that decouples structural candidate generation from statistical candidate ranking. DUET combines branching entropy with recursive paradigm discovery to generate linguistically plausible candidate segmentations, then ranks them using a dual minimum description length (MDL) criterion: a corpus-level objective rewards morpheme reuse, while a construction-tree objective guards against over-segmentation. On the SIGMORPHON 2023 interlinear glossing shared task, DUET outperforms unsupervised baselines in Morpheme F1 under both the standard and simulated extremely low-resource settings, while providing broader candidate coverage. Augmenting prompts with DUET segmentations improves performance on a linguistic reasoning benchmark, yielding the best overall results among the evaluated segmentation methods.

AI.tldr: 提出DUET——一种确定性的无监督形态切分算法，将候选生成与候选排序解耦，结合分支熵与递归范式发现生成候选，并用双重MDL准则排序，在极低资源下优于无监督基线。
AI.motivation: 形态切分在极端数据稀缺场景（如语言记录、语言学推理）下尤为困难，因为现有方法依赖标注数据、外部资源或仅在大规模语料中才出现的重复模式。
AI.method: DUET（Dual-MDL Unsupervised Entropy-Trie Segmentation）：确定性无监督算法。先将结构候选生成与统计候选排序解耦；用分支熵配合递归范式发现生成语言学上合理的候选切分；再用双重最小描述长度（MDL）准则排序——语料级目标奖励语素复用，构造树级目标防止过度切分。
AI.result: 在SIGMORPHON 2023释义行间注释共享任务上，DUET在标准与模拟极低资源设置下，Morpheme F1均优于无监督基线，并提供更广的候选覆盖；在提示中加入DUET切分可提升语言学推理基准表现，在评估的切分方法中取得最佳整体结果。
AI.conclusion: 解耦候选生成与排序、结合熵驱动的候选生成与双重MDL排序，是一种在极低资源下无需标注或外部资源的有效形态切分范式，并可迁移增强下游语言学推理任务。

title: Voyag: Joint Multi-Intent Detection and Execution-Relation Classification for In-Vehicle Voice Assistants
summary: An in-vehicle voice assistant must decide not only which intents an utterance contains but also how co-active intents may be executed: concurrently, in a fixed order, or not at all without arbitration. We present Voyag, a single-forward decision model that jointly predicts ten controlled vehicle-intent slots and a three-way execution relation (parallel, sequential, mutually exclusive) over each co-active intent pair. Voyag combines a multilingual ModernBERT-style encoder (mmBERT-base, 306.9M parameters), a typed per-slot choice head, and a lightweight GroupCalibration relation head (1.61M parameters) that consumes marker hidden states, pooled context, explicit resource-requirement profiles, and symmetrized outer-product conflict features. All objectives are optimized in one joint loss: soft cross-entropy over slot choices, focal cross-entropy over relations, and a mutex-consistency penalty. On a synthetic Chinese vehicle-life benchmark with semantic scene-level splits and a leakage audit (30,017 / 3,473 / 5,000 groups), validation-only selection yields 0.9893 slot accuracy and 0.0526 expected calibration error over 50,000 slot decisions. Conditioned on gold intents, the relation head reaches 0.8548 accuracy, 0.8473 macro-F1, and 0.6062 mutually-exclusive recall over 4,000 pairs; end to end with one encoder forward it reaches 0.8530 accuracy and 0.8464 macro-F1. Against a two-stage rule pipeline, the aggregate end-to-end gain is small and borderline, so we claim no aggregate advantage; the learned head's advantage lies in sequential and parallel recall where surface rules are blind. We report rule baselines with a tautology disclosure and a held-out thermal conflict failure.

AI.tldr: Voyag：单次前向的联合决策模型，同时预测10个受控车辆意图槽与共激活意图对的三类执行关系（并行/顺序/互斥），并给出诚实的对比结论。
AI.motivation: 车载语音助手不仅要识别话语包含哪些意图，还要决定共激活意图如何执行（并发、固定顺序、或需仲裁才能执行）。现有做法（如两阶段规则流水线）缺乏对意图间执行关系的统一建模。
AI.method: 多语言ModernBERT式编码器（mmBERT-base，306.9M）+ 类型化的逐槽选择头 + 轻量GroupCalibration关系头（1.61M，输入为标记隐藏态、池化上下文、显式资源需求画像、对称化外积冲突特征）。联合损失：槽选择软交叉熵 + 关系焦点交叉熵 + 互斥一致性惩罚。数据为合成中文车生活基准，按语义场景级划分并做泄漏审计（30,017/3,473/5,000组）。
AI.result: 仅用验证集选择：50,000次槽决策上槽准确率0.9893、ECE 0.0526。金标意图条件下关系头：准确率0.8548、宏F1 0.8473、互斥召回0.6062（4,000对）；端到端单次编码：准确率0.8530、宏F1 0.8464。相对两阶段规则流水线的总体端到端增益小且处于临界，作者明确声明不主张总体优势。
AI.conclusion: 学习式关系头的价值集中在规则盲区——顺序与并行关系的召回；同时披露规则基线的同义反复问题及一个留出的热冲突失败案例，结论审慎、可复现意识强。

title: OpenViVE: New Benchmark and Dual-Stream Co-Attention Framework for Vietnamese Visual Entailment
summary: Visual Entailment (VE) determines whether a textual hypothesis is entailed, contradicted, or unverifiable from an image. However, existing VE benchmarks are largely English-centric and do not capture Vietnamese-specific linguistic distinctions or culturally grounded visual contexts. To address this gap, we introduce OpenViVE, the first large-scale native Vietnamese VE benchmark, containing 62,268 balanced image-hypothesis pairs from 10,378 culturally grounded images. OpenViVE is constructed using an Artifact-Aware Hybrid LLM-Human Pipeline that combines constrained generation, human validation, and PMI-guided refinement. The pipeline substantially reduces hypothesis-only shortcuts, with Contradiction accuracy dropping from 96% to 66% after artifact refinement. We further evaluate a dual-stream PhoBERT-ConvNeXt framework with bidirectional co-attention to align visual evidence with Vietnamese hypotheses. The framework achieves 84.84% accuracy and 84.90% macro-F1 on the test set, while PhoBERT consistently outperforms multilingual XLM-R variants. These results highlight the importance of language-specific encoding and explicit cross-modal interaction for Vietnamese VE.

AI.tldr: 论文提出首个大规模原生越南语视觉蕴含基准OpenViVE（62,268对图文假设，源自10,378张文化相关图像），并给出PhoBERT-ConvNeXt双流双向共注意力基线，取得84.84%准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉蕴含（VE）基准以英语为中心，缺乏对越南语特有语言差异与文化语境视觉场景的覆盖，导致该语言下的VE评估缺位。
AI.method: 构建"感知伪影的LLM-人工混合流水线"：约束生成+人工校验+PMI引导精炼，以抑制"仅依赖假设"的捷径；并设计PhoBERT-ConvNeXt双流框架，通过双向共注意力对齐视觉证据与越南语假设。
AI.result: 精炼后仅假设捷径显著减弱，Contradiction准确率由96%降至66%；该框架测试集准确率84.84%、宏F1 84.90%，且PhoBERT稳定优于多语言XLM-R变体。
AI.conclusion: 语言特定编码与显式跨模态交互对越南语VE至关重要，OpenViVE为低资源语言的跨模态推理研究提供了可靠评测基础。

title: CocoonBench: Can Multilingual Search Agents Escape Language Information Cocoons?
summary: Multilingual search agents can access the global Web, yet may remain trapped in a language environment with insufficient evidence; we refer to this failure as a language information cocoon. However, existing search benchmarks largely operate within a single language, especially English, overlooking entity connections across multiple languages. We introduce CocoonBench, a benchmark that evaluates whether multilingual search agents can escape such language information cocoons. CocoonBench mines answer-centered relational paths from a frozen Wikidata-derived graph and selects clue sets that are individually necessary and jointly identify a unique answer. Using language-specific entity names, it records each task's minimum language cover, removes direct identifiers, and renders each task as matched prompts in three languages together with its construction certificate and provenance. Across 10 state-of-the-art models, mean accuracy on CocoonBench ranges from 33.8% (DeepSeek-V4-Flash) to 69.7% (Claude-Opus-4.8), leaving even the strongest system below 70%. The same construction certificates support path-aligned trajectory analysis, enabling diagnosis of model failures in language routing, evidence-path recovery, and answer use. The result shows that escaping a language cocoon requires more than switching languages: successful cross-lingual search depends on both covering the correct languages and connecting the evidence found across them.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CocoonBench 基准，用于评测多语言搜索智能体能否摆脱"语言信息茧房"（因单语言环境导致证据不足）。作者从冻结的 Wikidata 衍生图挖掘以答案为中心的关系路径，选取单独必要且联合唯一确定答案的线索集，记录最小语言覆盖并去除直接标识，生成三语言匹配提示。10 个前沿模型平均准确率仅 33.8%–69.7%，最强系统仍低于 70%。
AI.motivation: 现有搜索基准多在单一语言（尤其英语）内评测，忽视跨语言实体关联，无法检验智能体是否被困于证据不足的语言环境；作者将此失败模式定义为"语言信息茧房"，并指出缺少可诊断该问题的多语言基准。
AI.method: 基于 Wikidata 衍生图构建基准：挖掘以答案为中心的关系路径，筛选"各自必要、联合唯一"的线索集；利用各语言实体名称计算任务的最小语言覆盖（minimum language cover），移除直接标识符，产出三语言匹配提示及构造证书（construction certificate）与溯源信息；证书同时支持路径对齐的轨迹分析。
AI.result: 10 个 SOTA 模型平均准确率为 33.8%（DeepSeek-V4-Flash）至 69.7%（Claude-Opus-4.8），最强系统仍低于 70%；路径对齐分析可定位模型在语言路由、证据路径恢复与答案使用三方面的失败。
AI.conclusion: 摆脱语言茧房不只是"换语言"：成功跨语言搜索需同时覆盖正确语言并将分散证据有效连接；CocoonBench 提供了可诊断、可溯源的多语言搜索评测框架。

title: Synthetic Twins: Closing the Gap Between TTS Test Sets and Real Recordings in Turkish ASR Evaluation
summary: Speech synthesized by text-to-speech engines is a low-cost substitute for recorded test sets in automatic speech recognition, yet an off-the-shelf synthetic test set is worth only a few dozen real recordings for estimating the real error rate of a recognizer. This paper examines which properties of real recordings are missing from synthetic speech and how much of the gap can be closed. For 507 Turkish Common Voice recordings, synthetic twins are built: a ladder of synthetic copies that adds, one factor at a time, the pitch of the speaker, a clone of the same speaker, the real recording channel and the speaking rate. At each step, the agreement between ASR behaviour on the copy and on the real recording is measured. Across three zero-shot cloning engines and panels of six and 19 recognizers, the speaker clone is the step that improves agreement on which sentences are hard, raising the Spearman correlation from .41 to .55 for Chatterbox. Matching the channel or adding generic noise corrects the error level when the synthetic speech is easier than real speech. The twin with the highest worth is equivalent to 70 to 122 real recordings, depending on the recognizer panel, compared with about 9 for a stock voice. The findings replicate on VoxForge, a second corpus in which speaker identity is known rather than inferred: the clone raises sentence agreement from .31 to .50 and the worth from 8 to about 50 recordings. Agreement on which sentences are hard is distinct from agreement on how hard they are. The paper concludes with a practical recipe and a reporting checklist for synthetic ASR test sets.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究合成语音作为ASR测试集时相比真实录音缺失哪些特性、以及能弥补多少差距。通过对507条土耳其语Common Voice录音构建"合成孪生"阶梯（逐步加入说话人音高、说话人克隆、真实信道、语速），测量合成副本与真实录音上ASR行为的一致性。结果显示说话人克隆是最关键因素，可将"哪些句子难"的一致性相关系数从.41提升到.55；匹配信道可校正错误水平。最优孪生测试集的价值相当于70–122条真实录音（原声仅约9条），并在VoxForge上复现。
AI.motivation: TTS合成语音是录制测试集的低成本替代品，但现成合成测试集的效用仅相当于几十条真实录音，无法可靠估计识别器真实错误率。因此需要弄清真实录音中哪些属性在合成语音中缺失，以及能缩小多少差距。
AI.method: 基于507条土耳其语Common Voice录音构建合成孪生阶梯：逐一加入说话人音高、同一说话人克隆、真实录音信道、语速等因素，逐步测量合成副本与真实录音上ASR行为的一致性。实验覆盖三种零样本克隆引擎与6/19个识别器组成的评测组合，并在说话人身份已知的VoxForge语料上复现。
AI.result: 说话人克隆是提升"哪些句子难"一致性的关键步骤，使Chatterbox的Spearman相关从.41升至.55；匹配信道或加入通用噪声可在合成语音偏易时校正错误水平。最优孪生相当于70–122条真实录音（对比原声约9条）。VoxForge上克隆将句子一致性从.31提至.50，价值从8升至约50条录音。
AI.conclusion: "哪些句子难"的一致性与"有多难"的一致性是可区分的两个维度；论文提出实用配方与合成ASR测试集的报告清单。

title: Empirical Margin Sensitivity: An Interventional Neuron-Level Probe of Post-Trained Medical LLMs
summary: Medical post-training raises benchmark accuracy, but accuracy does not show which internal components a model's decisions depend on, or whether components that support one benchmark also support another. We apply the weight-space intervention paradigm of ROME and MEMIT at the granularity of one MLP down-projection column. Our measurement, Empirical Margin Sensitivity (EMS), replaces each coordinate magnitude of a column by its mean while preserving the column's sign pattern and L1 scale, and records the resulting change in the logit margin between the correct option and its hardest-wrong competitor. This isolates the margin's dependence on a column's fine-grained coordinate structure while the column stays in place. We discover high-EMS columns (anchors) on MedQA in ten public checkpoints (four general-purpose bases and six medical post-trained variants) across the Gemma, Llama, Qwen, and AFM families, and measure the same columns on MedMCQA and PubMedQA. Mean-ablating each discovered anchor set lowers MedQA accuracy in all six post-trained models, by 6 to 28 points. In the two pure-SFT checkpoints, crushing anchors raises the PubMedQA margin on correctly answered items (negative EMS), and anchors with this property sit significantly deeper than the same model's other anchors; the four checkpoints trained with RL or mixed recipes show positive PubMedQA EMS and no significant depth shift. The depth association recurs in each of three held-out checkpoints. Because the checkpoints differ in data and pipeline as well as objective, we report these as per-checkpoint observations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Empirical Margin Sensitivity (EMS)，在单个 MLP down-projection 列的粒度上度量模型决策对权空间细粒度结构的依赖，发现高 EMS 的"锚列"对 MedQA 精度至关重要，且纯 SFT 检查点在 PubMedQA 上出现负 EMS 与更深锚列，RL/混合训练检查点则没有。
AI.motivation: 医疗后训练虽提升基准准确率，但准确率无法揭示模型决策依赖哪些内部组件，也无法判断支撑某一基准的组件是否同样支撑另一基准，因此需要一个比准确率更细粒度的机制层面度量。
AI.method: 沿用 ROME/MEMIT 的权空间干预范式，将其细化到单个 MLP down-projection 列的坐标级：把列中每个坐标幅值替换为该列均值，同时保留列的符号模式与 L1 尺度；以正确选项与最难错误选项之间的 logit margin 变化作为 EMS。在 Gemma、Llama、Qwen、AFM 四个家族的十个公开检查点（四个通用基座、六个医疗后训练变体）的 MedQA 上发现高 EMS 锚列，并在 MedMCQA、PubMedQA 上对同一批列进行测量。
AI.result: 均值消融每个发现的锚列集，六个后训练模型 MedQA 精度全部下降 6–28 点。两个纯 SFT 检查点中，压制锚列反而提高正确作答项上的 PubMedQA margin（负 EMS），且这类锚列显著更深；四个 RL 或混合配方训练的检查点则呈正 PubMedQA EMS，无显著深度偏移。该深度关联在三个留出检查点上重复出现。
AI.conclusion: 单列坐标结构层面的 EMS 能揭示准确率之外的组件级依赖，锚列对 MedQA 具有因果性作用；跨基准的组件复用模式与训练目标（纯 SFT vs. RL/混合）相关，但因检查点在数据与流程上亦不同，作者仅将其作为逐检查点观察报告，而非普遍结论。

title: DiscernBench: Evaluating Cooperative Discernment of LLM Agents in Institutional Settings
comment: 33 pages, 11 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB)
summary: The deployment of large language models in operational settings demands evaluation of judgment under institutional constraint. We introduce DiscernBench, a benchmark for evaluating cooperative discernment: the ability of an agent to determine whether to comply with, refuse, or escalate a request in an institutional setting. DiscernBench comprises scenarios derived from real-world incident reports across domains such as aviation, law enforcement, and emergency management. We evaluate eight LLMs across three decision-making configurations and analyze both final decisions and the intermediate judgments produced during multi-agent deliberation. Under disagreement, Final Responders exhibit model- and role-dependent aggregation patterns in which a lone specialist recommendation can disproportionately influence the collective decision, a phenomenon we term Minority-Signal Override. Role-specialized multi-agent deliberation raises average over-escalation from 3.79% under direct single-agent judgment to 28.27%, with the direction and magnitude of minority-signal influence varying substantially across models and specialist roles. These results reveal distinct collective decision behaviors that are not captured by final-answer accuracy alone. Trustworthy multi-agent systems therefore require evaluating not only individual specialist reasoning, but also how conflicting judgments are transformed into collective decisions. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Disha1001/DiscernBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 DiscernBench 基准，用于评估智能体在制度约束下对请求"遵从／拒绝／上报"的合作性辨别能力；并揭示多智能体角色分工审议会显著提高过度上报，且少数专家意见可不成比例地左右集体决策（Minority-Signal Override）。
AI.motivation: 大模型进入实际运营场景后，需在制度约束下判断该遵从、拒绝还是上报请求，但现有评测多只看最终答案准确率，忽视集体决策过程中中间判断如何被聚合，缺乏针对"合作性辨别"的系统基准。
AI.method: 构建 DiscernBench，场景取自航空、执法、应急管理等领域的真实事件报告；评测 8 个 LLM 在 3 种决策配置下的表现，同时分析最终决策与多智能体审议中的中间判断，考察分歧下的聚合模式。
AI.result: 分歧情形下 Final Responder 呈现随模型与角色变化的聚合模式，单一专家建议可过度影响集体决定（Minority-Signal Override）；角色分工的多智能体审议将平均过度上报率从单智能体直接判断的 3.79% 提升至 28.27%，且少数信号影响的方向与幅度因模型和专家角色差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 仅看最终答案准确率无法刻画多智能体系统的集体决策行为；可信的多智能体系统评测需同时考察个体专家推理与冲突判断的聚合机制。

title: PRIMEAPE: A Multilingual Benchmark for Fine-Grained Meta-Evaluation of Judge Models
summary: Large language models increasingly serve as judges of other models, shaping benchmark rankings and model development. Yet, a judge whose rationale consistently supports its verdict may still disagree with human preferences. To study this, we introduce PRIMEAPE, a multilingual benchmark for evaluating judge verdicts and rationales. PRIMEAPE provides 2,205 response pairs covering 243 instructions in English, French, Spanish, Urdu, Hindi, Norwegian Bokmål, and Yoruba, with 11k human annotations of preferences and rationales across relevance, naturalness, truthfulness, safety, and overall quality. Our evaluation of twelve open- and closed-weight judges reveals that aggregate performance conceals differences across languages and criteria, while requesting rationales does not consistently improve agreement with human preferences. Judges also favor the first position, longer responses, and responses from related models, with effects that vary across criteria and languages. Crucially, judges can justify verdicts that disagree with human preferences while maintaining consistency between their verdicts and rationales. These findings show that consistency with a judge's own verdict does not establish alignment with human judgment. PRIMEAPE enables assessment of both, providing a foundation for more reliable multilingual judges. We release our benchmark and all annotation materials under the CC BY-NC 4.0 license at github.com/Toloka/primeape.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多语言基准PRIMEAPE，同时评估LLM裁判的判定（verdict）与理由（rationale），发现裁判可自洽地为其偏离人类偏好的判定辩护，且聚合性能掩盖了跨语言、跨维度的差异。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被用作其他模型的裁判，影响排行榜与模型研发。但一个理由始终支持其判定的裁判，仍可能与人类偏好不一致；现有评测通常只看与人类偏好的聚合一致率，缺乏对"判定—理由"双重对齐的检验。
AI.method: 构建PRIMEAPE多语言基准：2,205个回答对、243条指令，覆盖英语、法语、西班牙语、乌尔都语、印地语、挪威博克马尔语和约鲁巴语；标注约1.1万条人类偏好与理由注释，维度包括相关性、自然性、真实性、安全性及整体质量。对12个开源与闭源裁判进行评估，考察聚合一致率、理由提供的影响、位置/长度/同源模型偏差，以及判定与理由的自洽性。
AI.result: 聚合指标掩盖了语言间和评价维度间的差异；要求给出理由并不稳定提升与人类偏好的一致率。裁判偏向首位答案、更长回答及同类模型生成的回答，且偏好程度随语言与维度变化。关键结果是：裁判能够在判定与理由高度自洽的情况下，给出与人类偏好相悖的判定。
AI.conclusion: 与裁判自身判定的一致性不能作为与人类判断对齐的证据；需同时评估判定与理由。PRIMEAPE为更可靠的多语言裁判提供评测基础，基准与全部标注材料以CC BY-NC 4.0许可发布（github.com/Toloka/primeape）。

title: Counting Symbols on Technical Drawings: A Benchmark and Verified Rewards for MLLMs
summary: Today's MLLMs can count objects in natural images. However, when asking them how many bolt holes appear in a mechanical drawing or how many nitrogen atoms are in a chemical structure, they often struggle. Counting in technical drawings remains challenging, as objects can be small, densely packed, or even implied by drawing conventions. To study this problem, we introduce CountDrawBench, a benchmark including floor plans, electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, and molecular structures, with 1,574 counting questions and instance-level annotations where available. Besides evaluation, we introduce Code-Verified RL, a reinforcement learning framework that teaches MLLMs to count with executable feedback. Our method combines three complementary rewards: a count reward that checks the final answer, an instance-matching reward that verifies object locations, and a zoom-based reward that checks counting consistency across local image regions. All three are integrated into a unified GRPO objective. Extensive experiments reveal that even leading MLLMs struggle on CountDrawBench, with the best evaluated model achieving only 59.3% accuracy. Our method improves Qwen3.5-9B from 49.3% to 54.3% accuracy, outperforming all evaluated open-source baselines. These results establish CountDrawBench as a challenging testbed for technical drawing understanding and demonstrate the value of code-verified rewards in these tasks. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出技术图纸计数基准 CountDrawBench 与基于可执行反馈的 Code-Verified RL 框架，用计数、实例匹配、局部缩放一致性三类奖励统一到 GRPO 中训练 MLLM，将 Qwen3.5-9B 从 49.3% 提升至 54.3%。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 在自然图像计数上表现良好，但在机械图纸的螺栓孔、化学结构中的氮原子等技术图纸场景中计数困难：目标小、密集排布，且常由制图约定隐含表示。现有评测与训练方法缺乏针对该场景的基准与可验证监督信号。
AI.method: 1) 构建 CountDrawBench 基准，涵盖平面图、电气原理图、机械图纸与分子结构，共 1,574 个计数问题，并提供实例级标注；2) 提出 Code-Verified RL 框架，通过可执行代码验证提供反馈；3) 设计三类互补奖励：答案正确性的 count reward、验证目标位置的 instance-matching reward、以及基于局部区域裁剪的 zoom-based 一致性奖励；4) 将三类奖励整合进统一的 GRPO 目标函数。
AI.result: 领先 MLLM 在 CountDrawBench 上普遍表现不佳，最佳评测模型仅 59.3% 准确率；所提方法将 Qwen3.5-9B 从 49.3% 提升至 54.3%，优于所有评测的开源基线。
AI.conclusion: CountDrawBench 可作为技术图纸理解的高难度测试平台，验证了代码可验证奖励在该类任务中的有效性；代码与数据将在论文接收后公开。

title: LimeTree: Linear-Memory Graph Neural Networks over Tree-Graphs for Resource-Efficient Language Modeling and Context Extrapolation
summary: The search for computationally efficient alternatives to the Transformer has yielded numerous architectures in recent years; however, most exhibit severe weaknesses in associative recall-such as key-value (KV) retrieval-and length extrapolation, where even standard Transformers struggle. This paper introduces LimeTree, a linear-complexity architecture in both memory and compute for sequence modeling. By integrating synthetic KV retrieval tasks directly into standard language modeling training, LimeTree achieves strong perplexity alongside reliable recall. Two variants were evaluated on WikiText-103 and PG-19 under strict compute constraints. On WikiText-103, LimeTree reaches a token-level perplexity of 19 in just 6 hours on four Quadro RTX 8000 GPUs, while maintaining 100\% KV retrieval accuracy even when extrapolating from a training context length of 512 to an evaluation length of 16,384. On PG-19, the model achieves a token-level perplexity of 13 in 35 hours on a single RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU with minimal hyperparameter tuning. These results position LimeTree as a competitive linear-complexity alternative to Transformers, combining superior perplexity and training throughput with robust in-context retrieval and length extrapolation.

AI.tldr: LimeTree是一种内存与计算均为线性复杂度的序列建模架构，通过将合成KV检索任务融入语言模型训练，同时获得强困惑度与可靠的关联召回能力，并显著超越Transformer外推极限。
AI.motivation: Transformer的高效替代架构虽多，但普遍在关联召回（如键值KV检索）和长度外推上表现严重不足，甚至标准Transformer在这些方面也很吃力。作者希望在严格算力约束下兼顾效率、困惑度、检索与长序列外推。
AI.method: 提出LimeTree，一种内存与计算均为线性复杂度的架构；关键在于将合成的KV检索任务直接嵌入标准语言建模训练中，使模型在常规训练同时习得可靠的召回能力。在两个模型变体上于WikiText-103和PG-19数据集、严格算力约束条件下进行评估。
AI.result: WikiText-103上，LimeTree在4块Quadro RTX 8000 GPU上仅用6小时达到token级困惑度19，且在训练上下文长度512、评估长度16,384的外推场景下保持100%的KV检索准确率；PG-19上，在单块RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU上35小时达到token级困惑度13，且仅需极少的超参调优。
AI.conclusion: LimeTree可作为Transformer的有竞争力线性复杂度替代方案，在困惑度、训练吞吐、上下文内检索与长度外推方面均具优势。

title: Semantic-aware Decoding for Diverse Text-to-SQL under Schema Ambiguity
summary: Real-world text-to-SQL systems often face schema ambiguity, where a question can map to multiple plausible schema elements. To support downstream disambiguation, SQL generation systems should include diverse interpretations among their top-k predictions. However, large language models (LLMs) typically favor a single interpretation, producing highly skewed outputs. We propose Semantic-aware Logit Adjustment (SLA), a training-free decoding method that promotes diverse SQL generation by adjusting token logits based on semantic similarity between schema elements. Unlike prior approaches that rely on reasoning-intensive prompting or task-specific fine-tuning, SLA is efficient, model-agnostic, and easy to deploy. Experiments show that SLA consistently improves interpretation coverage over standard decoding and remains competitive with existing diversity-oriented methods at substantially lower inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练解码方法SLA，通过按schema元素语义相似度调整token logits，提升text-to-SQL在schema歧义下的多样解释生成能力。
AI.motivation: 真实text-to-SQL场景存在schema歧义，同一问题可对应多个合理schema元素；下游消歧需要top-k预测中包含多样解释，但LLM倾向单一解释、输出高度偏斜。已有方法依赖推理密集的prompting或任务特定微调，成本高。
AI.method: Semantic-aware Logit Adjustment（SLA）：免训练解码方法，在解码时依据schema元素间的语义相似度调整token logits，以促进多样的SQL生成。具备高效、模型无关、易部署的特点。
AI.result: 实验显示SLA相较标准解码持续提升解释覆盖率，并在显著更低推理成本下与现有面向多样性的方法保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: SLA以轻量、无需训练的解码干预有效缓解LLM输出偏斜问题，为schema歧义下的多样SQL生成提供了可部署方案。

title: Task-Dependent Linguistic Measures in Aphasia Discourse: A Comparative Analysis of Narrative, Descriptive, and Procedural Speech
summary: Background: Transcript-based measures such as word counts, lexical diversity and disfluency rates are widely used to describe language ability in aphasia. Each measure comes from a specific elicitation task, and studies use different tasks, so values from different tasks may not be comparable. Aims: To test whether discourse tasks change these measures within the same speakers, and whether the measures follow a gradient from Procedural to Descriptive to Narrative discourse. Methods & Procedures: Baseline transcripts from 61 adults with chronic post-stroke aphasia were taken from the Fridriksson-2 corpus in AphasiaBank (POLAR trial, ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03416738). Each speaker produced a Procedural (Sandwich), a Descriptive (Broken Window) and a Narrative (Cinderella) sample in one session. A rule-based pipeline extracted 13 measures, 10 of which were common enough to test. Friedman, Page and Wilcoxon tests with false discovery rate correction were used, with a speaker-grouped Random Forest classifier as a supporting check. Outcomes & Results: Total words and number of different words followed the full gradient, but the step from Procedural to Descriptive was small. For most other measures, Narrative stood apart, while Descriptive and Procedural did not differ. Among the 31 speakers with at least 25 words in every task, filler rate, repetition rate and total disfluency density were higher in Narrative than in both other tasks. The classifier reached an accuracy of 0.61 (always guessing the most common task would give 0.41), mainly by recognizing Narrative samples. Conclusions: Discourse tasks are not interchangeable, and expressing disfluencies per word does not remove the task effect. The task should be reported with every measure, and values should be compared only within the same task.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于61名慢性卒中后失语症患者的Fridriksson‑2语料，检验三种话语任务（程序性三明治、描述性破窗、叙事性灰姑娘）对13项基于转写的语言指标的影响。多数指标上叙事任务显著区别于另两类任务，表明话语任务不可互换，指标值应在同一任务内比较。
AI.motivation: 词汇量、词汇多样性和不流利率等基于转写的指标被广泛用于描述失语症语言能力，但每项指标来自特定诱发任务，而不同研究采用不同任务，导致跨任务的指标值可能不可比。作者希望检验同一说话者内部话语任务是否改变这些指标，以及指标是否沿程序性—描述性—叙事的话语梯度呈现规律。
AI.method: 从AphasiaBank的Fridriksson‑2语料（POLAR试验）中提取61名慢性卒中后失语症成人的基线转写。每名说话者在同一次会话中完成程序（三明治）、描述（破窗）和叙事（灰姑娘）三种样本。采用基于规则的流程提取13项指标，其中10项频次足够可做统计检验。使用Friedman检验、Page检验和Wilcoxon检验并进行错误发现率校正，另以按说话者分组的随机森林分类器作为辅助验证。
AI.result: 总词数和不同词数沿完整梯度变化，但程序到描述这一步差异较小。对多数其他指标，叙事任务单独区别于其他两类，而描述与程序无显著差异。在三种任务中词数均不少于25的31名说话者中，填充词率、重复率和总不流利密度在叙事中高于另两类任务。分类器准确率为0.61（始终猜测最常见任务的基线为0.41），主要依赖识别叙事样本。
AI.conclusion: 话语任务不可互换；以每词为单位表达不流利并不能消除任务效应。报告任何指标时应同时说明所用任务，且指标值只应在相同任务内进行比较。

title: UMAMI: A Multimodal Benchmark Dataset for Evidence-Grounded Dietary Decisions
comment: 40 pages, 15 figures, 16 tables. Dataset, code, and dashboard: https://umami-benchmark.github.io
summary: Dietary decisions require identifying a food's nutrient content and considering individual dietary needs, but recognizing food from an image alone does not provide this information. Visually similar foods can have different nutrient profiles, so selecting the wrong food record can lead to incorrect decisions even when nutrient rules are applied correctly. Furthermore, satisfying nutrient constraints does not necessarily establish a food's relevance to a person's intake. Evaluating these challenges together requires connecting food images, nutrient records, and individual intake histories. To support this evaluation, we introduce UMAMI (Unified Multimodal Assessment of Meals and Intake), a multimodal dataset and benchmark linking independently collected food images with nutrient profiles and respondent health and intake records. Using this dataset, we construct three diagnostic tasks covering visual nutrient question answering, personalized food recommendation, and condition-aware food substitution. Paired instances and input controls examine how visual identity and respondent context affect decisions. Our experiments identify errors in both food-record selection and nutrient-rule application, while showing that higher rule compliance does not necessarily improve alignment with subsequent recorded intake. These findings highlight the need to evaluate how multimodal systems select and use structured evidence for dietary decisions. The dataset, code, and dashboard are available at https://umami-benchmark.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UMAMI多模态数据集与基准，将独立采集的食物图像、营养档案与受访者健康/摄入记录关联，构建三个诊断任务以评估多模态系统在膳食决策中的表现，发现系统在食物记录选择与营养规则应用两方面均出错，且规则遵从度提升未必改善与真实摄入记录的一致性。
AI.motivation: 仅凭图像识别食物无法提供营养信息，视觉相似的食物营养档案可能不同，选错食物记录即便规则应用正确也会导致错误决策；同时满足营养约束也不等于食物与个人摄入相关。现有评测缺乏将食物图像、营养记录与个体摄入史三者联通的手段。
