AI.method: 构建UMAMI（Unified Multimodal Assessment of Meals and Intake）多模态数据集与基准，将独立采集的食物图像与营养档案及受访者健康与摄入记录关联；设计三个诊断任务：视觉营养问答、个性化食物推荐、条件感知的食物替代；采用配对实例与输入控制实验，考察视觉身份与受访者上下文对决策的影响。
AI.result: 实验识别出食物记录选择与营养规则应用两类错误；配对设置显示视觉身份和受访者上下文显著影响决策；并发现更高的规则遵从率并不必然带来与后续记录摄入更好的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 评估膳食决策类多模态系统需超越规则遵从指标，重点关注其如何选择并利用结构化证据；UMAMI为这一方向的诊断性评测提供了数据、代码与可视化面板支持。

title: Hard to Translate, Harder to Detect: Human Analysis Remains Essential in AI Meme Translation
comment: 39 pages, 1 figure, 21 tables. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23504282; code: https://github.com/olzama/hard-to-find
summary: We present a dataset and evaluation setup for a problem in creative machine translation: translating culturally loaded passages that carry much of a text's meaning and humor that may depend on subtle or implicit discourse. We study Soviet comedy quotations that function as memes in Russian-language communication. Off-the-shelf difficulty estimators do not find these passages; current models searching the web find most but not all of them, but their own analyses of the difficulty do not help translation as well as a human-validated one. Given a brief human-validated analysis of why each passage is difficult, older models improve modestly; the strongest current translators (GPT-6 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5) improve more, and in human evaluation GPT-6 Sol comes close to the approved references on most films. Newer models have thus become much better at using such an analysis while still not reliably producing it themselves. We release (1) a dataset of five films' Russian subtitles with their audience-selected culturally salient passages, human-validated analyses, and reference translations (into English, Galician, and Spanish), together with every full-film LLM translation and evaluation produced in this study; and (2) an item-level MQM-style evaluation protocol that measures translator and evaluator noise to set the number of runs the evaluation needs, and whose automatic version tracks human judgment of these passages, which reference-free neural metrics do not, whether they score the whole text or the passages alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了俄语苏联喜剧引语（作为网络模因使用的文化负载段落）数据集与评测协议，研究显式"难点分析"对机器翻译的帮助，发现当前强模型能有效利用人工验证的分析但无法自行可靠生成，并发布MQM式条目级评测协议。
AI.motivation: 创造性机器翻译中的文化负载段落（其意义与幽默依赖隐含话语）难以被现有难度估计器识别，且无参考神经指标无法反映此类翻译质量，缺乏专门数据与评测方法。
AI.method: 构建五部电影俄语字幕数据集：标注观众选择的文化显著段落、人工验证的难点分析和英/加利西亚语/西班牙语参考译文，并保留全部整片LLM翻译与评测记录；设计条目级MQM式评测协议，通过测量译者与评测者噪声确定所需运行次数，并提供可追踪人类判断的自动版本。
AI.result: 现成难度估计器无法找出这些段落；联网检索模型能找到大部分但非全部，且其自生成分析不如人工验证分析有用。给定人工验证分析后，旧模型小幅提升，GPT-6 Sol与Claude Opus 5.5提升更明显；人工评估中GPT-6 Sol在多数影片上接近获批参考译文。无参考神经指标（无论整篇或仅段落评分）均无法追踪人类判断，而自动MQM版本可以。
AI.conclusion: 更强的新模型已能很好利用显式难点分析，但仍不能可靠自行产出该分析；数据集与带噪声控制、与人工判断一致的条目级评测协议已公开，为文化负载创造性翻译研究提供基准。

title: NoeVera: Can Knowledge Guide Experiments and Experiments Refine Knowledge?
summary: With the growing demand for large language model (LLM) services, optimizing LLM serving systems is becoming increasingly complex, and the bottleneck is no longer predicting how a given configuration will perform. The harder problem is deciding what to investigate: which mechanisms matter for a workload, which configurations are worth testing, and what evidence a decision still needs. In this work, we present NoeVera, an agentic Second Brain that goes beyond just one-shot retrieval by turning papers, code, benchmarks, and experimental results into a persistent, provenance-preserving knowledge base with three planes: source evidence, reusable synthesis, and agent memory. Decision-aware retrieval assembles compact evidence packs, role-specific agents reason over them and invoke a simulator (Vidur or GAUSS) whenever quantitative support is needed, and every finding is written back as a scoped evidence record, so knowledge guides experiments and experiments refine knowledge. In configuration search over four serving scenarios, NoeVera comes within 5% of the optimum in a median of 6-7 simulator calls, versus 9 for Bayesian optimization and 15 for a knowledge-free agent with the same tools; on A100 GPUs, its representative configurations deliver ~1.30x vLLM-default throughput and meet every scenario's latency objective. When reused, provenance-preserving evidence records over-generalize on only 8% of applicability traps, versus 28% for a general-purpose agent memory. On the held-out 48-task split of a 72-task benchmark, NoeVera scores 29% higher than an equally equipped agent and 36% higher than its single-call retrieval counterpart (0.80 vs. 0.62 and 0.59), and even when baselines receive NoeVera's own prompts, a statistically significant part of its evidence-evolution advantage remains.

AI.tldr: NoeVera是一个"智能体第二大脑"系统，通过建立保留溯源信息、包含源证据/可复用综合/智能体记忆三层平面的持久知识库，将检索、角色化推理、模拟器调用与证据回写结合，显著提升LLM服务系统配置搜索与决策的效率与准确性。
AI.motivation: LLM服务系统优化日益复杂，真正的瓶颈已不是"预测给定配置的性能"，而是"决定该研究什么"——哪些机制对某工作负载重要、哪些配置值得测试、决策还缺什么证据。传统一次性检索无法支撑这种持续、有据可依的决策过程。
AI.method: 构建三层平面知识库（源证据、可复用综合、智能体记忆），保留溯源；采用决策感知检索组装紧凑"证据包"；由角色专用智能体推理，并在需要量化支撑时调用模拟器（Vidur或GAUSS）；所有发现以带作用域的证据记录回写，形成"知识引导实验、实验精炼知识"的闭环。
AI.result: 在四个服务场景的配置搜索中，NoeVera中位数6-7次模拟器调用即达最优5%以内（贝叶斯优化9次、无知识智能体15次）；A100上代表性配置吞吐约为vLLM默认的1.30倍并满足各场景时延目标；复用证据记录时仅在8%的适用性陷阱上过度泛化（通用智能体记忆为28%）；72任务基准的48任务留出集上得分0.80，比同等装备智能体高29%、比单次检索高36%。
AI.conclusion: 将论文、代码、基准和实验结果组织为具溯源、带作用域、可持续演化的知识库，能显著减少决策所需实验次数、提升配置质量并抑制过度泛化；即使基线使用相同提示词，证据演化带来的优势仍有统计显著性。

title: When Does Optical Context Compression Pay Off? A Decode-Aware Cost Analysis of Reasoning VLMs
summary: Rendering long text as images lets a vision-language model (VLM) read a document with fewer input tokens, and evaluations often count mainly these prefill tokens. We show that for reasoning models this accounting is incomplete. Across five models and two long-context benchmarks, reading the rendered document makes the model think longer: decode length grows by 1.5-3.5x on the four general-purpose VLMs tested, and under typical output pricing this decode tax makes image input more expensive than text for two of the five models on QuALITY. Unrecoverable information loss is not sufficient to explain the tax at moderate compression: Qwen's OCR of the same images recovers 98.7% of words, and feeding Kimi-K3 its own transcription as text restores text-mode reasoning length and accuracy. Whether compression pays off reduces to an exchange rate, (1-1/c)/(r-1), that must exceed the workload's price-weighted ratio of output to input tokens; this accounting decomposition shows why Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash can benefit and Qwen and GLM cannot. None of the training-free signals we test predicts the tax before generation. As a practical heuristic, an image-first policy that sends only inputs with a per-input compression ratio of at least 1.6 to images and falls back to text once image-mode reasoning costs as much as the input's prefill saving cuts the bill by 6-14% on Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at an accuracy cost of 0.3-1.2 points; on QuALITY, asking for a reasoning budget on both paths is a stronger lever.

AI.tldr: 长文档渲染为图像虽压缩prefill token，但对推理模型会触发1.5–3.5倍的decode长度膨胀（"decode tax"）；成本权衡由汇率(1-1/c)/(r-1)决定，并给出image-first策略。
AI.motivation: 以往VLM长文档评测主要计prefill token，忽略图像输入对推理（decode）长度的影响，导致对图像渲染方案的成本收益评估不完整。
AI.method: 在5个模型、2个长上下文基准上对比文本与图像输入的prefill/decode长度与成本；用Qwen OCR复算词覆盖率、用Kimi-K3自转录回填做因果验证；提出成本分解式(1-1/c)/(r-1)与workload的价格加权输出/输入token比对比；测试多种training-free信号能否事前预测decode tax；提出image-first路由启发式（压缩比≥1.6走图像，decode成本超过prefill节省则回退文本）及reasoning budget。
AI.result: 4个通用VLM上decode长度增长1.5–3.5倍；在QuALITY上，按典型输出定价，5个模型中2个的图像输入总成本高于文本。Qwen对同图OCR恢复98.7%词，Kimi-K3读自转录文本可恢复文本模式的推理长度与准确率，说明中等压缩下信息丢失不足以解释该税。无任一training-free信号可事前预测。image-first策略在Kimi-K3与DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash上降费6–14%，精度损失0.3–1.2点；QuALITY上对两条路径设reasoning budget是更强杠杆。
AI.conclusion: 图像化长文本的成本评估必须计入decode tax；是否划算取决于压缩比、输出/输入价格比与decode膨胀因子的汇率关系；实操上可用压缩比阈值路由加reasoning budget控制成本。

title: CLASP: Deciding Structure and Claims Before Decoding for Whole-Slide Pathology Report Generation
summary: Whole-slide pathology report generation has advanced through stronger slide encoders, retrieved knowledge, and, recently, slide-level multimodal LLMs. However, these generators leave every report-level choice to the decoder: how long the report is, how it is organised, and which findings it states and where. On the standard PathText-BRCA benchmark, we find that these choices dominate n-gram overlap, as reports from the query's hospital selected without learning approach the state of the art, while decoders under-generate and fall back to the most frequent findings. We present CLASP, a decide-then-decode generator that makes these choices explicitly, once per slide. Before decoding, an Exemplar Structure Prior (ESP) takes the sentence plan and length from reports of image-similar cases, a Calibrated Claim Decision (CCD) selects the findings from calibrated slide posteriors, and a Claim-to-Sentence Placement (CSP) assigns each finding to a planned sentence. A Plan-Conditioned Decoder (PCD), refined by structure-anchored sequence training, then writes the report under these decisions. With 35M parameters, CLASP outperforms retrained report generators and slide-level LLMs of up to 7B parameters, matches the strongest published results, and generalises to lung cancer from unseen hospitals. Its decisions change what the reports state, not only their length, transfer to an LLM decoder, and can withhold what H&E cannot show: withholding receptor status leaves 23% fewer contradictions with clinical records than the same network without decisions.

AI.tldr: CLASP提出"先决策后解码"的全切片病理报告生成框架，将报告长度、组织方式与所见内容的选择显式化，以35M参数超越7B级模型并匹配最强已发表结果。
AI.motivation: 现有切片级多模态LLM把所有报告级选择（长度、结构、陈述哪些所见及其位置）都交给解码器隐式决定。在PathText-BRCA基准上，这些选择对n-gram重叠的影响甚至超过模型学习本身：仅按查询所属医院挑选报告（不经学习）即可接近SOTA，而解码器却倾向于欠生成并回退到最高频所见。因此需要把这些选择显式化。
AI.method: CLASP由四部分组成，每张切片仅决策一次：①示例结构先验ESP，从图像相似病例报告中提取句子计划与长度；②校准声明决策CCD，基于校准后的切片后验选择要陈述的所见；③所见—句子放置CSP，将每个所见分配到计划中的句子；④计划条件解码器PCD，在结构锚定的序列训练下依据上述决策撰写报告。
AI.result: 35M参数的CLASP优于重新训练的报告生成器和最大7B参数的切片级LLM，匹配最强已发表结果，并可泛化至未见医院的肺癌数据；其决策改变报告实际陈述的内容而非仅长度，可迁移到LLM解码器，且能抑制H&E无法显示的项——隐去受体状态后，与临床记录的矛盾较无决策的同网络减少23%。
AI.conclusion: 报告级选择应作为显式、可校准的决策模块前置到解码之前，而非交由解码器隐式承担；这一范式以极小参数量获得强性能、跨癌种与跨机构泛化能力，并提升与临床记录的一致性。

title: EMIP: Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform
summary: Experimental platforms that enable multiple participants to engage in spoken dialogue and perform physical actions concurrently in a shared environment are important for studying cooperation between humans and embodied AI agents. In this paper, we propose EMIP (Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform), a virtual environment platform built on Minecraft. Through an Internet-based client-server architecture, EMIP connects multiple humans and multiple AI agents to the same virtual environment and supports full-duplex speech communication and simultaneous physical interaction. It provides interfaces based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for environmental observation, physical action execution, and audio input and output, enabling researchers to develop their own agent control methods using large language models (LLMs). Additional features include centralized control of an agent group through a single EMIP agent client, collaborative object transportation by multiple agents, and experimental support functions such as recording and retrieving observation histories. By integrating these features into a reusable platform, EMIP aims to support research on human-human, human-agent, and agent-agent cooperation under different participant configurations and agent control methods. Usage examples illustrate concurrent speech and physical action, task coordination, and overlapping speech. The source code for the platform is publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/AI-Humans-Lab/EMIP-Embodied-Multi-Party-Interaction-Platform).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EMIP：一个基于 Minecraft 的虚拟环境平台，通过客户端-服务器架构支持多人类与多 AI 智能体在同一共享环境中进行全双工语音对话与并发物理交互，并提供基于 MCP 的观察、动作与音频接口，以支撑人-人、人-智能体、智能体-智能体的多方可具身协作研究。
AI.motivation: 研究人类与具身 AI 智能体的协作，需要一个能让多名参与者同时进行语音对话并并发执行物理动作的共享实验平台；现有环境在多方语音、并发交互与可复用性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 构建于 Minecraft 之上的虚拟环境平台 EMIP，采用基于互联网的客户端-服务器架构接入多个人类与多个 AI 智能体，支持全双工语音通信与同步物理交互；提供基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的环境观察、物理动作执行、音频输入输出接口，使研究者可用 LLM 自行开发智能体控制方法；并包含单客户端集中控制智能体群组、多智能体协同搬运物体、观察历史记录与检索等实验支持功能。
AI.result: 平台实现上述功能并开源（GitHub 地址已公开）；使用示例展示了并发语音与物理动作、任务协调以及语音重叠等交互情形。
AI.conclusion: 通过将上述特性整合为可复用平台，EMIP 可支持在不同参与者配置与不同智能体控制方法下开展人-人、人-智能体、智能体-智能体协作研究。

title: Deneb-Vritra: Descriptions, Edges and Names Examined by Blocking Via Restoring Token Representations and Attention
summary: Laya is a 421M-parameter encoder that answers a question about a text in one pass: each answer option, written as a name plus a description, gets a marker token, and one score is read from the network at each marker. We first confirm that such models can follow an option's name when it contradicts the description; the question is where in the network this happens. We locate it. On 951 synthetic questions we move each name onto another option's description and count how often the model picks the option with the right name (the name shortcut): 53% for the released checkpoint, 59% for our fine-tune v1, 11% for a fine-tune with name randomisation. On a 320-item sample, blocking attention from each marker to its own name tokens in layers 14 to 17 of 28 cuts v1's shortcut from 67% to 16% (19% on two schemas held out from component selection) while accuracy with the original names stays at 90%; blocking marker edges to the question, other options or text has no effect. No single head matters (largest effect 9 points), and restoring clean marker states undoes the swap from layer 16. Attention mass tracks the window by layer but not by head. Repeated on 5 checkpoints (released, fine-tuned, name-randomised, and a pair trained without two schemas), the knockout finds similar layers; in the name-randomised ones, blocking the description edges instead brings the shortcut back to 56-58%, so the read persists and is outvoted. Marker states decode the name from layer 0; a one-direction probe erasure changed nothing but was weaker than a random edit. Copying layers 0-13 or 14-27 of a name-randomised sibling into a fine-tune recovers 66% and 65% (v1); 21% and 45% (pair A) of its shortcut reduction. 9 of the 12 predictions we could score, written before running, failed. Head sweeps cover 5 of 5 checkpoints; data are synthetic and LLM-labelled; one architecture.

AI.tldr: Laya 是 421M 参数的单遍编码器问答模型，在 951 道合成题上发现其存在"名称捷径"（53–59%），并通过逐层注意力阻断定位到第 14–17 层 marker→自身名称 token 的注意力通路为关键机制，跨 5 个 checkpoint 可复现。
AI.motivation: 先确认此类模型在选项名称与描述矛盾时确实会跟随名称，进而要回答"这一行为发生在网络何处"，即对名称捷径进行机制级定位，而非仅观察行为。
AI.method: 将每个选项（名称+描述）赋予一个 marker token，在 marker 处读取分数；构造 951 道合成题，把名称移到另一选项的描述上并统计"名称捷径"率；以注意力阻断（knockout）分别屏蔽 marker 对自身名称、问题、其他选项及文本的注意力；做 head sweep、marker 状态探针/擦除、跨 checkpoint 及跨层复制实验。
AI.result: 名称捷径率：released 53%、fine-tune v1 59%、名称随机化微调 11%。320 题样本上，阻断第 14–17 层（共 28 层）marker→自身名称的注意力使 v1 从 67% 降至 16%（两个留出 schema 上 19%），而原名准确率仍保持 90%；阻断至问题/其他选项/文本的边缘无效。无单头起决定作用（最大 9 点）。跨 5 个 checkpoint 阻断定位到相似层；名称随机化模型中改为阻断描述边可把捷径拉回 56–58%，说明读取仍在但被否决。marker 状态自第 0 层即可解码名称；单向探针擦除无效但弱于随机编辑。跨层复制可部分恢复捷径削减（v1 66%/65%，pair A 21%/45%）。预注册的 12 项可评分预测中 9 项失败。
AI.conclusion: 名称捷径由第 14–17 层 marker 对其自身名称 token 的分布式（非单头）注意力介导，跨 checkpoint 稳健；该读取在被随机化训练时依然存在，只是被后续计算否决，表明"读取"与"使用"可分离。结论受限于合成数据、LLM 标注、单一架构，且多项预测未成立，需谨慎外推。

title: INSEP: Refusal-Direction Inseparability as a Defense Against Abliteration
summary: Abliteration is a widely used white-box attack against the safety alignment of large language models (LLMs). It elicits harmful behavior by estimating a refusal direction in the model's activation space and projecting that direction out of the residual-stream write-out matrices. We propose INSEP, a defense that fine-tunes the model to reduce the separability of harmful and benign activations along the refusal direction. Abliteration estimates this direction as a difference in class means and projects it out. Reducing separability weakens the signal the attack relies on. An adversarial eigendecomposition selects the most separable prompt subsets. A low-rank adapter reduces their separation along that direction. Behavioral losses preserve the base model's refusal and the quality of its benign responses during training. We benchmark INSEP against six published defenses under five attacks, across eight LLMs from 1B to 14B parameters and several model families. Beyond response harm, we measure coherence, directness, over-refusal, and MMLU, to distinguish robust refusal from low harm produced by evasive or degraded responses. INSEP ranks first on the mean composite score across all eight base models while retaining utility, in the largest abliteration-defense evaluation reported to date.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 INSEP 防御方法，通过微调降低有害与良性激活在“拒绝方向”上的可分性，从而削弱 abliteration 白盒攻击所依赖的信号。在 8 个 1B–14B 模型、6 种已发表防御、5 种攻击的基准上，INSEP 在全部 8 个基座模型的平均综合得分上排名第一并保持实用性。
AI.motivation: Abliteration 是一种广泛使用的白盒攻击：在激活空间中估计拒绝方向，并将其从残差流写回矩阵中投影去除，从而诱发有害行为。现有防御缺乏对此类攻击的系统性抵抗手段，且已有评估常仅看响应危害度，难以区分“真正稳健的拒绝”与“因回避或退化回复导致的低危害”。
AI.method: INSEP 以微调为核心：1）针对 abliteration 以类均值差估计拒绝方向的特点，降低有害/良性激活沿该方向的可分性，使攻击所依赖的信号被削弱；2）采用对抗性特征分解，筛选出最具可分性的提示子集作为训练目标；3）用低秩适配器（LoRA 类）压缩这些子集在该方向上的分离度；4）配合行为损失，训练中保持基座模型的拒绝能力与良性回复质量。
AI.result: 在 1B–14B 参数、多个模型家族的 8 个 LLM 上，对 6 种已发表防御与 5 种攻击进行对比。除响应危害度外，还评估连贯性、直接性、过度拒答与 MMLU，以区分稳健拒绝与因回避/退化导致的低危害。INSEP 在全部 8 个基座模型的平均综合得分上排名第一，同时保持实用性；据称是迄今规模最大的 abliteration 防御评估。
AI.conclusion: 通过降低拒绝方向上的类间可分性来削弱攻击信号，是一种有效且可保持效用的 abliteration 防御思路；INSEP 在多模型、多攻击、多指标的评测中综合表现最优。

title: GameAnything: From Any Inspirations to Playable Game Worlds
summary: AI-driven game development holds the potential to transform diverse human inspirations into interactive experiences. However, existing systems and benchmarks primarily focus on explicit development specifications, with limited support for adapting multimodal references and evaluating actual gameplay experiences. We introduce GameAnything, an open-source agentic platform that transforms multimodal inspirations into playable extensions of existing games through iterative development. GameAnything integrates coding agents with an independent playtesting critic, persistent development state, and reusable experience memory to support continuous refinement. We further present GameAnything-Bench, a benchmark spanning diverse reference modalities, game creation objectives, and gaming environments, with exploratory gameplay testing to assess both functional correctness and gameplay quality. Evaluations of nine coding agent configurations reveal that current agents can adapt reference content but still struggle with playable interactions and precise modifications. Moreover, multimodal references improve content fidelity, while iterative refinement yields substantial but varying improvements across agents. These findings highlight both the potential and remaining challenges of inspiration-driven game development.

AI.tldr: GameAnything：将多模态灵感转化为可玩游戏扩展的开源智能体平台，并发布 GameAnything-Bench 基准，评估九种编码智能体配置。
AI.motivation: 现有系统与基准主要聚焦显式开发规范，缺乏对多模态参考适配的支持，也缺少对真实游戏体验的评估，难以实现从多样人类灵感到交互体验的转化。
AI.method: 提出 GameAnything 开源智能体平台：集成编码智能体与独立试玩评审器（playtesting critic）、持久化开发状态、可复用经验记忆，通过迭代开发将多模态灵感转化为既有游戏的可玩扩展。同时构建 GameAnything-Bench 基准，覆盖多种参考模态、游戏创作目标与游戏环境，采用探索性试玩测试评估功能正确性与游戏品质。
AI.result: 对九种编码智能体配置的评测显示：现有智能体可适配参考内容，但在可玩交互与精确修改方面仍显不足；多模态参考提升内容保真度；迭代细化带来显著但因智能体而异的改进。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了灵感驱动游戏开发的潜力与剩余挑战，为智能体化游戏创作与评测提供了开放平台与基准。

title: SAE-Audit: Clinical-Trial Prediction via Inference-Time Optimization of Black-Box LLMs Audited by Sparse Autoencoder Evidence
comment: Codes are publicly available at: https://github.com/JunboShen/SAE-Audit
summary: Clinical trials are costly and often take years to complete, making early outcome prediction valuable for trial planning. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast clinical-trial outcomes, yet their predictions remain unreliable and their rationales may not faithfully reflect the evidence underlying their answers. On tasks such as predicting whether a registered clinical trial will complete or terminate early, frontier LLMs perform only modestly above chance in our experiments. We introduce SAE-Audit, which optimizes a black-box LLM at inference time with evidence obtained from a deployable open model. A frozen sparse autoencoder (SAE) on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is converted into a vocabulary of clinical concepts. Sparse probes fitted on past trials determine which concepts are associated with the outcome. For a new protocol, the concepts detected by the probe are written as evidence, each with the direction and strength of its association with the outcome, and the LLM being audited optimizes its answer in the light of this evidence. Without additional training, SAE-Audit raises balanced accuracy of deepseek-v4-flash by 9.6--12.0 points on five clinical-trial prediction tasks and raises GPT-5.6-terra by 8.0 points on trial completion, exceeding other agentic inference-time optimization methods by a large margin. As an auxiliary, SAE probes module within SAE-Audit is itself accurate and auditable, providing natural-language explanations directly derived from verified concept contributions and protocol evidence, without requiring additional LLMs at inference time. SAE-Audit provides verifiable, concept-level evidence for more accurate and auditable clinical-trial prediction. It can also be embedded into biomedical AI agents such as Biomni to optimize their performance.

AI.tldr: 提出SAE-Audit：利用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上的冻结稀疏自编码器（SAE）构建临床概念词表，配合在历史试验上拟合的稀疏探针，将概念关联的方向与强度写成可核查证据，在推理时引导黑盒LLM优化答案；无需额外训练，即可在五项临床试验预测任务上显著提升平衡准确率。
AI.motivation: 临床试验成本高、周期长，早期结局预测对试验规划有价值。LLM已被用于预测试验结局，但预测不可靠，且其推理理由未必忠实反映真实依据；在"试验能否完成/提前终止"等任务上，前沿LLM仅略高于随机水平。
AI.method: SAE-Audit：1）将Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上的冻结SAE转化为临床概念词表；2）在过往试验上拟合稀疏探针，确定与结局相关的概念；3）对新方案，把探针检测到的概念连同其与结局关联的方向和强度写成证据；4）被审计的LLM据此证据在推理阶段优化答案。全过程无需训练，且SAE探针模块本身可解释、可审计，不依赖额外LLM。
AI.result: 无需额外训练，SAE-Audit在五项临床试验预测任务上使deepseek-v4-flash的平衡准确率提升9.6–12.0个百分点，使GPT-5.6-terra在试验完成预测上提升8.0个百分点，大幅超过其他agentic推理时优化方法。
AI.conclusion: SAE-Audit为临床试验预测提供可验证、概念级的证据，兼顾准确性与可审计性；其SAE探针模块可直接由验证过的概念贡献与方案证据生成自然语言解释；该方法还可嵌入Biomni等生物医学AI智能体以提升其性能。

title: Trallie: from Free-Form Text to Structured Data with LLMs
summary: Trallie is an open-source framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to perform information extraction (IE) from natural language sources with or without user guidance. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on extensive labeled datasets or domain-specific training, Trallie enables the conversion of unstructured data into structured formats with minimal or no representative examples. The framework is designed with three key objectives: (i) reducing manual annotation by harnessing prompt-based zero-shot and few-shot capabilities of modern LLMs, (ii) flexibly parsing diverse document formats (i.e., HTML, PDF, TXT, and JSON), and (iii) improving accessibility for non-expert users by automatically inducing schemas from document collections, which can then be refined for extraction. We evaluate Trallie with open-weight LLMs on FDA 510(k) documents and on movie and university websites from SWDE. It outperforms previously reported systems when the target attributes are provided for text extraction and is competitive when it must discover attributes for the schema automatically. The project is available at https://github.com/PiSchool/trallie

AI.tldr: Trallie是一个开源框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）从自然语言文档中执行信息抽取（IE），支持零样本/少样本提示，并可自动归纳抽取schema，在多格式文档上优于或匹配已有系统。
AI.motivation: 传统信息抽取依赖大量标注数据或领域特定训练，成本高且难以迁移；同时文档格式多样、非专业用户难以自行设计抽取schema。
AI.method: 基于提示的零样本与少样本LLM抽取，减少人工标注；支持HTML、PDF、TXT、JSON多格式解析；通过从文档集合中自动归纳schema并允许用户细化，降低非专家使用门槛。在FDA 510(k)文档及SWDE的电影与大学网站上用开放权重LLM进行评测。
AI.result: 在给定目标属性的文本抽取任务上优于此前报道的系统；在需自动发现schema属性的情形下性能具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: Trallie证明了以LLM提示为核心、结合schema自动归纳的轻量级信息抽取框架，可在极少或无示例条件下实现多格式文档的结构化转换，具备实用性与可扩展性。

title: Learn the Effects, Not the Examples: Implicit ICL via Attention Patching
summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables language models to adapt to new tasks from demonstrations, but repeatedly including multiple examples increases context length and inference cost. Many existing implicit ICL methods encode demonstrations as fixed vectors, limiting adaptation of the intervention to individual queries and token positions. We propose Attention-Patching, an implicit ICL method that models contextual changes in self-attention outputs through task-specific updates to attention output projections. Using query-answer pairs processed with and without a fixed demonstration set, Attention-Patching fits layer-wise affine transformations from non-contextual attention representations to the demonstration-induced output changes. Across 12 classification benchmarks and four model families, Attention-Patching achieves higher average accuracy than the evaluated implicit ICL baselines while maintaining performance comparable to explicit ICL at near zero-shot inference cost. Further experiments on diverse generation tasks demonstrate its applicability to autoregressive multi-token generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Attention-Patching：通过层级别仿射变换建模示范集引起的自注意力输出变化，实现免重复拼接示例的隐式上下文学习（ICL），在12个分类基准、4个模型家族上平均准确率优于同类隐式ICL基线，推理开销接近零样本。
AI.motivation: 显式ICL需反复拼接多个示例，导致上下文变长、推理成本上升；现有隐式ICL方法将示例编码为固定向量，无法针对具体查询与token位置调整干预，适配性不足。
AI.method: 利用同一批query-answer对分别在“带固定示范集”与“不带示范集”条件下前向，提取非上下文注意力表征与示范诱导的注意力输出变化，逐层拟合从前者到后者的仿射变换（即对注意力输出投影做任务特定的更新/补丁），从而在推理时以参数化方式复现示范效应。
AI.result: 在12个分类基准与4个模型家族上，平均准确率高于所评估的隐式ICL基线，性能接近显式ICL，而推理成本接近零样本；在多种生成任务上验证了其可推广至自回归多token生成。
AI.conclusion: 以层级别注意力输出仿射补丁替代固定示例向量，可在低推理开销下实现查询与位置相关的隐式ICL，兼具分类与生成任务的有效性。

title: Auxiliary Clues Aware's Geometry Problem Solving
summary: Geometry Problem Solving (GPS) serves as a rigorous test of the complex reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), particularly when solutions require auxiliary constructions absent from the input diagram. However, explicit diagramming methods suffer from unstable image generation quality and cascading errors, while existing implicit attention mechanisms primarily focus on visible elements, limiting their ability to support reasoning that requires additional geometric constructions. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{AuxCA} (Auxiliary-Clues-Aware GRPO), a reinforcement learning framework that helps models learn transferable auxiliary-construction strategies that can be applied beyond the training domain without explicit diagram generation at inference time. Specifically, we introduce Auxiliary Clues Dependency (\textbf{ACD}) to quantify the influence of auxiliary visual clues on token generation and integrate it into GRPO through fine-grained advantage weighting. Furthermore, we incorporate an auxiliary incentive reward to encourage the effective use of auxiliary geometric clues in correct solutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AuxCA-8B outperforms the explicit-plotting baseline Bagel-Canvas and achieves competitive performance with leading proprietary models on auxiliary-dependent plane geometry problems. Improvements on analytic geometry, solid geometry, and external benchmarks further suggest that the learned strategies can transfer beyond the training domain. Code is available at https://github.com/fukua23/AuxCA

AI.tldr: 提出AuxCA强化学习框架，让MLLM学习可迁移的辅助线构造策略，无需推理时显式绘图即可提升几何题求解能力。
AI.motivation: 几何题求解（GPS）是检验MLLM复杂推理能力的严格基准，尤其当解题需要图中不存在的辅助构造时。显式绘图方法受图像生成质量不稳定与级联错误困扰；现有隐式注意力机制主要关注可见元素，难以支撑需要额外几何构造的推理。
AI.method: 基于GRPO的强化学习框架AuxCA：(1) 提出辅助线索依赖度（ACD），量化辅助视觉线索对token生成的影响，并以细粒度优势加权方式融入GRPO；(2) 引入辅助激励奖励，鼓励在正确解中有效利用辅助几何线索；(3) 推理阶段不进行显式图形生成。
AI.result: AuxCA-8B在依赖辅助线的平面几何问题上优于显式绘图基线Bagel-Canvas，并与领先闭源模型表现相当；在解析几何、立体几何及外部基准上的提升表明策略可跨训练域迁移。
AI.conclusion: 通过强化学习习得可迁移的辅助构造策略，可在不显式绘图的前提下显著改善MLLM的几何推理表现，并具备跨域泛化能力。

title: Efficient Memory-Constrained Video Object Segmentation via Subspace Optimization
summary: Memory-based architectures for video object segmentation (VOS) have achieved remarkable performance by maintaining dense feature representations from past frames in a streaming Memory Bank. However, storing these features over time incurs substantial memory overhead and computational cost. In this work, we identify significant temporal redundancy in memory representations, where consecutive frames exhibit highly overlapping low-rank subspaces that remain stable over time. Building on this observation, we propose Memory Subspace Iteration (MSI), a training-free, model-agnostic plugin that exploits temporal subspace stability to efficiently compress streaming memory features. Extensive experiments on standard VOS benchmarks demonstrate that MSI preserves segmentation accuracy across multiple architectures while reducing the memory bank footprint by up to 25%. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Hai-Anh-LE/MSI_WACV2027.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、模型无关的插件MSI，利用记忆特征的时间子空间稳定性压缩流式记忆库，在保持多种VOS架构精度的同时将记忆开销降低至多25%。
AI.motivation: 基于记忆的视频目标分割方法需在Memory Bank中保存大量历史帧密集特征，随时间累积带来显著显存开销与计算成本；作者发现连续帧的记忆表示存在高度重叠、随时间稳定的低秩子空间，即存在显著时间冗余。
AI.method: 先分析记忆表示的时间冗余与低秩子空间稳定性，据此提出Memory Subspace Iteration（MSI）：一种training-free、model-agnostic的即插即用模块，通过迭代利用时间子空间稳定性对流式记忆特征进行压缩。
AI.result: 在标准VOS基准上的大量实验表明，MSI在多种架构上保持分割精度，同时将记忆库占用最多降低25%。
AI.conclusion: 记忆特征的时间子空间稳定性可作为有效压缩依据，MSI以无需重训练、与模型无关的方式在精度与效率间取得良好折衷，为VOS记忆机制的高效化提供了通用方案。

title: Latent-Predisposition Personas for Heterogeneous and Reliable LLM Survey Simulation
summary: LLM personas are used to simulate survey publics, which should reproduce not only answer distributions but also within-person coherence and stability. Drawing on mass belief systems research, we show that persona-conditioned LLMs produce over-constrained publics. Across three model families and three U.S. surveys, opinions on unrelated issues are 1.6-4.6 times as correlated as among humans, and party identification explains 2.5-7.6 times as much answer variance. Common remedies (temperature, diversity instructions, backstories) weaken these correlations by making answers more random. On Qwen, their ten-day test-retest reliability falls to 33-59% of the human level, and when made consistent they lose correlation fit. We propose Latent-Predisposition Personas (LPP), whose persons differ stably, not randomly. Each persona receives political engagement, value priorities, and party-relative issue deviations that grow as engagement falls. Answers are sharpened and calibrated to toplines and party crosstabs. At selected operating points, LPP is never significantly worse than any baseline and far more reliable. At matched human-level reliability, it has the lowest correlation error in all six model-survey combinations, also at a lower target. Errors still exceed those between human samples, and gains on framing effects and a frontier closed model are partial.

AI.tldr: 本文指出人格化LLM模拟调查公众时会产生"过度约束"的公众：政治立场对无关议题的相关性达人类的1.6-4.6倍，常用补救手段只是增加随机性而损害重测信度。作者提出"潜在倾向人格"(LPP)，令个体稳定而非随机地差异化，在各操作点上不劣于基线且更可靠。
AI.motivation: 用LLM人格模拟调查公众，理想上应同时复现答案分布、个体内一致性与跨时间稳定性。但现有方法借鉴大众信念体系研究后发现：人格条件化模型把态度组织得过于紧密，且常规缓解措施（温度、多样性指令、背景故事）以牺牲信度为代价降低相关性，无法兼顾。
AI.method: 在三个模型家族、三项美国调查上量化过度约束（跨议题相关倍数、党派认同解释方差倍数、Qwen十天重测信度），并检验三类常规补救。提出LPP：为每个人格赋予政治参与度、价值优先级及"随参与度下降而增大的党派相对议题偏离"，答案经锐化并校准至边际分布与党派交叉表。
AI.result: 无关议题相关性为人类的1.6-4.6倍，党派认同解释方差为2.5-7.6倍；常规补救使Qwen重测信度降至人类33-59%且失去相关拟合。LPP在选定操作点上不显著劣于任何基线且更可靠；在匹配人类信度时，六个模型-调查组合的相关误差均最低，亦在更低目标下成立。
AI.conclusion: "稳定而非随机"的个体差异是协调分布拟合、相关结构与信度的关键。LPP优于常规补救，但误差仍高于人类样本间差异，在框架效应与前沿闭源模型上的改进为部分有效。

title: Parsing Visual Latents for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning
summary: Spatial reasoning across multiple views requires inferring the 3D relations between objects and the camera from 2D observations, which depends on cross-view correspondence and scene geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) do not reliably extract. Pretrained vision encoders already capture this information in their latent features, with CLIP linking objects to image regions, DINOv3 matching semantics across views, and VGGT encoding multi-view geometry. However, VLMs do not benefit from these features when we present them directly in context as grayscale feature images. We therefore propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that parses latent features into explicit spatial evidence for VLMs. In LatentParse, an analyst VLM probes the features of all three encoders with predefined tools that locate objects, track them across views, and measure motion between views. It then distills the results into a concise text report, which is provided together with the images to the VLM to answer the question. We evaluate LatentParse on MMSI-Bench, MV-RoboBench and SPAR-Bench, where it improves all five VLMs over the photo-only baseline by 0.7-2.4 percentage points on average. On MMSI-Bench, it raises Qwen3.8-27B from 34.4% to 39.5%, with the largest improvements of 19.2 percentage points on the camera-related questions. These results suggest that latent features become useful for spatial reasoning once they are parsed into relation evidence, without training. Code is available at https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 LatentParse，用分析型 VLM 调用工具探测 CLIP/DINOv3/VGGT 的潜特征，转写为文本空间证据供 VLM 做多视图空间推理。
AI.motivation: 多视图空间推理需从 2D 观测推断物体与相机的 3D 关系，依赖跨视图对应与场景几何，而 VLM 难以可靠提取。预训练视觉编码器（CLIP 关联物体与图像区域、DINOv3 跨视匹配语义、VGGT 编码多视图几何）的潜特征已含此信息，但直接以灰度特征图放入上下文对 VLM 无益。
AI.method: 免训练框架：分析型 VLM 使用预定义工具（定位物体、跨视图跟踪、测量视图间运动）探测三类编码器特征，将结果蒸馏为简洁文本报告，与图像一并输入目标 VLM 作答。
AI.result: 在 MMSI-Bench、MV-RoboBench、SPAR-Bench 上，五个 VLM 相对纯图像基线平均提升 0.7–2.4 个百分点；MMSI-Bench 上 Qwen3-27B 由 34.4% 升至 39.5%，相机相关问题最大提升 19.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 潜特征一旦被解析为显式关系证据，即可在无需训练的情况下服务于 VLM 的空间推理。

title: CART: Clustering-based Analysis of Recurring narratives for Taxonomy construction
summary: We present CART, a computational pipeline for extracting political narratives from parliamentary discourse and organizing them into a data-driven taxonomy without relying on predefined narrative categories. It encodes parliamentary discourse using semantic representations, filters relevant and reliable content through unsupervised confidence estimation, extracts narrative statements using LLMs, and uses narrative clustering and cluster analysis to construct a narrative taxonomy. Applied to Greek Parliament proceedings surrounding the 2023 Tempi train crash, it identifies ten recurring narrative families concerning responsibility attribution, institutional failure, railway safety, accountability, privatization, and the political interpretation of the tragedy. Our results demonstrate how combining unsupervised learning with LLM narrative extraction enables large parliamentary corpora to be transformed into interpretable, data-driven taxonomies of political narratives.

AI.tldr: CART：一种无需预定义叙事类别的议会话语政治叙事提取与分类流水线
AI.motivation: 现有政治叙事研究依赖预设叙事类别，难以适用于大规模议会语料，缺乏数据驱动的可解释分类体系。
AI.method: CART流水线：语义表示编码议会话语→基于无监督置信度估计过滤相关内容→用LLM抽取叙事陈述→通过叙事聚类与聚类分析构建叙事分类体系；在2023年Tempi火车事故相关希腊议会记录上应用。
AI.result: 识别出十个反复出现的叙事族，涉及责任归属、制度失灵、铁路安全、问责、私有化及对悲剧的政治解读。
AI.conclusion: 无监督学习与LLM叙事抽取相结合，可将大规模议会语料转化为可解释、数据驱动的政治叙事分类体系。

title: Disclosure Bias in AI Reviewers
summary: AI models increasingly help to review papers, and many conferences and journals now require authors to state how they used AI. Does this AI-use statement change how an AI reviewer rates a paper, and could it change which papers are accepted? In a preliminary study, we varied only the AI-use statement of 150 ICLR 2027 submissions, in up to nine versions adapted from real statements: from no AI, through writing help and coding, to an AI research agent and an AI author. Six AI reviewers rated the versions: the decision model Jev and the language models Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 4 Argon. Across 23,652 reviews, we find that every reviewer rates papers lower on average when the statement says AI did all the work than under a statement of no AI use. The AI research agent statement lowers the rating significantly for Jev, Sonnet and Argon. We find no evidence of a disclosure bias for AI assistance: for writing help, coding and research help, no reviewer's rating differs significantly from its rating under a statement of no AI use. Whether the observed penalty changes which papers are accepted depends on more than the size of the penalty: on how finely and how consistently the reviewer separates the papers near the acceptance boundary, on whether the penalty is spread over all papers or concentrated on a few, and possibly on how many other papers disclose AI use.

AI.tldr: 研究通过改变150篇ICLR 2027投稿的AI使用声明（最多9种版本），用6个AI审稿模型共产生23,652条评审，发现审稿人普遍对"AI完成全部工作"的声明给予更低评分，但对写作、编程、研究辅助等声明无显著惩罚，且该惩罚是否影响录用取决于审稿人区分边界论文的精细度与一致性等因素。
AI.motivation: AI已广泛参与论文评审，会议与期刊普遍要求作者披露AI使用情况，但尚不清楚AI使用声明本身是否会偏倚AI审稿人的评分，进而改变录用结果。
AI.method: 初步研究：仅操纵150篇ICLR 2027投稿的AI使用声明，构造最多9个版本（改编自真实声明），覆盖无AI、写作辅助、编程、AI研究代理、AI作者等层级；由6个AI审稿者（决策模型Jev及Claude Haiku 5.5、Claude Sonnet 5.5、Gemini 3.8 Flash、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Gemini 4 Argon）对各版本评分，共收集23,652条评审。
AI.result: 在"AI完成全部工作"声明下，所有审稿者的平均评分均低于"无AI使用"声明；"AI研究代理"声明使Jev、Sonnet与Argon的评分显著下降；对写作辅助、编程与研究辅助，无任何审稿者的评分相对无AI声明出现显著差异，即未发现AI辅助披露偏倚。
AI.conclusion: 是否因该惩罚改变录用结果，不仅取决于惩罚幅度，还取决于审稿人在录用边界附近区分论文的精细度与一致性、惩罚是均匀分布于所有论文还是集中于少数论文，以及可能有多少其他论文披露AI使用。研究属初步性质，受限于AI审稿者与特定声明构造。

title: HandXFM: Semantic-Structural Distillation for Hand Radiograph Foundation Models
summary: Hand radiographs support diverse clinical tasks, including skeletal maturity assessment, rheumatoid arthritis scoring, abnormality screening, and anatomical localization, yet existing models are typically trained separately for each task and dataset. We present HandXFM, a domain-specific foundation model that leverages cross-modality knowledge for comprehensive hand X-ray understanding. HandXFM distills semantic priors from BiomedCLIP and structural cues from a chest X-ray Vision Transformer (ViT) through a unified alignment framework, integrating complementary medical knowledge in an interpretable way. After pretraining, HandXFM can be adapted to a range of musculoskeletal tasks, including bone age estimation, SvH score prediction, abnormality detection, joint localization, bone segmentation, and visual question answering. It consistently outperforms task-specific and single-expert baselines, achieving up to 0.11 improvement in Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) for bone age prediction and a 12\% accuracy gain in abnormality classification. Moreover, HandXFM generalizes to unseen datasets and yields cross-attention maps linking clinical terms to anatomical regions. These results demonstrate that multi-expert distillation effectively unifies semantic and structural supervision within a single pretrained model, establishing HandXFM as an interpretable and generalizable foundation model for hand radiograph analysis.

AI.tldr: HandXFM是一个面向手部X光的领域特定基础模型，通过跨模态知识蒸馏整合语义与结构先验，可适配多种肌肉骨骼任务并实现可解释与可泛化表现。
AI.motivation: 现有手部X光模型通常针对单一任务与单一数据集分别训练，缺乏通用性；作者希望构建统一的基础模型，综合不同模态医学知识以支持多任务手部影像理解。
AI.method: 提出HandXFM：在统一对齐框架下，从BiomedCLIP蒸馏语义先验、从胸片ViT蒸馏结构线索，以可解释方式融合互补医学知识进行预训练；预训练后可微调适配骨龄估计、SvH评分预测、异常检测、关节定位、骨分割与视觉问答等任务。
AI.result: 持续优于任务专用与单专家基线，骨龄预测PCC最高提升0.11，异常分类准确率提升12%；可泛化到未见数据集，并产生将临床术语与解剖区域关联的交叉注意力图。
AI.conclusion: 多专家蒸馏能在单一预训练模型中有效统一语义与结构监督，使HandXFM成为可解释、可泛化的手部X光分析基础模型。

title: ReCoRain: Reliability-Coupled Content and Noise Conditioning for Event-Guided Video Deraining
summary: Event-guided video deraining depends on reliable cross-frame correspondences, yet events generated by scene motion, rain, and sensor noise can provide ambiguous matching evidence. In diffusion-based restoration, an incorrect match can transfer unrelated content and correlate initial noise between unrelated scene locations. We propose ReCoRain, an event-guided residual video diffusion framework that couples temporal content transfer and noise correlation through a common assessment of correspondence reliability. This assessment combines RGB appearance, interval-event evidence, and forward-backward motion consistency. The content path aggregates neighboring features according to alignment reliability, while the noise path uses composed backward motion fields and their associated reliability estimates to regulate initial-noise sharing across the latent sequence. We use the same conditional noise construction during residual flow-matching training and inference, incorporating temporal noise coordination into the learned restoration process. Temporal supervision matches motion-compensated inter-frame differences in restored and clean videos under the same teacher-estimated flow and visibility mask, accommodating legitimate appearance changes. ReCoRain achieves 32.09 dB PSNR on NTURain-Syn and 28.73 dB on RainSynLight25. Enabling reliability gates in both paths reduces warping error by 33.0% relative to disabling both gates.

AI.tldr: ReCoRain：以“对应关系可靠性”为共同枢纽，将时间内容传递与噪声相关性耦合的事件引导残差视频扩散去雨框架。
AI.motivation: 事件引导视频去雨依赖可靠的跨帧对应关系，但由场景运动、雨滴与传感器噪声共同产生的事件会给出模糊的匹配证据。在扩散式复原中，错误匹配会传递无关内容，并使本不相关场景位置的初始噪声产生相关性，破坏生成质量。
AI.method: 提出可靠性评估，融合RGB外观、区间事件证据与前向-后向运动一致性。内容路径依据对齐可靠性聚合邻域特征；噪声路径用组合的后向运动场及其可靠性估计，调控潜序列中初始噪声的共享。残差flow-matching训练与推理采用同一条件噪声构造，将时间噪声协调嵌入学习式复原过程；时间监督在同一教师估计光流与可见性掩码下，对齐复原视频与干净视频的运动补偿帧间差异，以容纳合法外观变化。
AI.result: NTURain-Syn 上达到 32.09 dB PSNR，RainSynLight25 上达到 28.73 dB PSNR；两条路径同时启用可靠性门控相对全部关闭时，warping误差降低33.0%。
AI.conclusion: 统一的对应可靠性评估可同时约束内容传递与噪声相关性，是提升事件引导扩散视频去雨的有效机制，消融结果验证了双路径门控的显著贡献。

title: Rethinking Visual Token Retention in Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Autoregressive Large Vision-Language Models solve multimodal reasoning tasks by retaining hundreds or thousands of visual tokens, allowing every generated token to attend to the visual tokens at any time during the generation process. However, whether continuous access to these visual tokens is necessary remains poorly understood. In this work, we investigate how visual token influence evolves along two dimensions: generation time and transformer depth. Using long-form visual reasoning benchmarks and multiple model scales, we first analyze the attention dynamics across generation time and transformer depth. We identify a temporal and depth-wise structure in the use of visual information. Visual attention peaks during the initial generation steps and then rapidly declines as attention shifts toward previously generated reasoning tokens. Across depth, visual influence is concentrated in intermediate layers and becomes very weak in the final layers. We further verify these observations with causal intervention that removes all visual tokens across generation time and model depth. These interventions confirm that visual-token dependence in multimodal reasoning is neither temporally persistent nor uniformly distributed across transformer depth. Thus, retaining the complete visual context at every layer and decoding step may be unnecessary. Our experiments demonstrate that we can remove up to 59\% of tokens from the full input prompt across generation time and 11\% across all transformer layers, while incurring only a very small performance drop. On video benchmarks, up to 65\% of the input prompt tokens can be removed during generation without affecting performance.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了视觉token在生成时间与Transformer深度两个维度上对LVLM推理的影响，发现视觉依赖既不持续于时间也不均匀分布于深度，据此可在保持性能的前提下大幅裁剪视觉token。
AI.motivation: 自回归大型视觉语言模型通常保留数百至数千个视觉token，使每个生成token在任意时刻都能关注视觉token；但持续访问完整视觉token是否必要尚不清楚，作者希望揭示视觉信息使用的时序与深度结构，以判断保留全部视觉上下文的冗余性。
AI.method: 使用长形式视觉推理基准与多种模型规模，先分析生成时间与Transformer深度上的注意力动态；再用因果干预（在特定生成步或层移除全部视觉token）验证观察结果；并据此进行跨生成时间和跨层的视觉token裁剪实验，在图像与视频基准上评估性能影响。
AI.result: 视觉注意力在初始生成步达到峰值，随后迅速下降并转向已生成推理token；深度上视觉影响集中于中间层，在最后层非常弱。因果干预确认视觉token依赖既非时间持续也非深度均匀。实验中可在生成过程中移除完整输入提示最多59%的token、跨所有Transformer层移除11%，性能仅轻微下降；视频基准上生成中最多移除65%的输入提示token而不影响性能。
AI.conclusion: LVLM在多模态推理中对视觉token的依赖具有时序性和深度局部性，在每个解码步和每一层保留完整视觉上下文可能不必要，为视觉token的动态稀疏化与高效推理提供了实证依据。

title: Robust Trajectory Prediction Under Sensing and V2X Noise: Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies
summary: Anticipating the future behavior of surrounding objects is key for the safe and efficient navigation of autonomous vehicles. State-of-the-art Transformer-based interaction-aware trajectory prediction models are typically trained and evaluated on large-scale, highly curated datasets obtained by filtering any object detection and tracking noise through extensive offline post-processing. However, in real-world deployments, the detected objects' state (position, heading, and speed) estimates are inherently affected by sensing and localization uncertainties. These uncertainties can be even higher for connected and automated vehicles receiving information from other road users through Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communications. In this paper, we first investigate the sensitivity of five state-of-the-art Transformer-based interaction-aware trajectory prediction models to realistic noisy object state estimates. Numerical results show that prediction accuracy degrades by up to a 6x factor as the noise level increases, highlighting the models' sensitivity to the mismatch between the noise conditions encountered during training and those experienced at deployment. We then show that retraining models on a more realistic noise-augmented dataset is a more effective strategy to mitigate the impact of noisy object state estimates on trajectory prediction accuracy than using denoising modules at the input. Retrained models limit the prediction accuracy degradation below a 1.5x factor. The noise-augmented dataset is openly released to support further research.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了Transformer交互感知轨迹预测模型对真实噪声目标状态估计的敏感性，并发现噪声增强重训练比输入端去噪模块更有效，可将精度退化从6倍限制在1.5倍以内。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer交互感知轨迹预测模型在高度精选、经离线后处理滤除检测与跟踪噪声的大规模数据集上训练评估，而真实部署中目标状态（位置、航向、速度）估计受感知与定位不确定性影响，V2X场景下噪声更大，训练与部署噪声条件不匹配导致模型脆弱。
AI.method: 首先评估五个SOTA Transformer交互感知轨迹预测模型在现实噪声目标状态估计下的敏感性；随后比较两种缓解策略——在输入端使用去噪模块与在噪声增强数据集上重训练模型。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，随噪声水平上升预测精度最多退化6倍；在噪声增强数据集上重训练可将精度退化限制在1.5倍以内，效果优于输入端去噪模块。该噪声增强数据集已公开释放。
AI.conclusion: 噪声增强重训练是缓解噪声目标状态估计对轨迹预测精度影响的更有效策略，并公开数据集以支持后续研究。

title: NOVA: Normalization-Aware Output-Guided Attention Acceleration for Video Diffusion Transformers
summary:
Video diffusion transformers (vDiTs) have become the main backbone for video generation. The quadratic cost of self-attention limits their efficiency at high resolutions and long durations. Existing sparse attention methods often rely on preserving high attention weights. However, these criteria do not fully capture the fidelity of the final value-weighted output, whose error depends jointly on changes to the attention numerator and the softmax denominator.
  We propose NOVA, a coarse-to-fine sparse attention framework that first approximates the full normalized output using size-weighted key/value centroids. Building on this estimate, we construct a residual proxy that accounts for coupled numerator-denominator errors by centering value contributions around the estimated output. This proxy guides the selection of query-key blocks for refinement under a predefined block budget for each query cluster. Selected blocks are evaluated through exact token-level computation, while the remaining blocks contribute through their centroids under a shared softmax normalization. On five vDiTs, NOVA achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS among sparse attention methods, improving PSNR by up to 1.55\,dB over the strongest baseline, while delivering up to 1.82$\times$ end-to-end speedup on an H100 GPU.

AI.tldr: NOVA 提出一种由粗到细的稀疏注意力框架，通过尺寸加权的 K/V 质心近似完整归一化输出，并用残差代理择块精算，在五个 vDiT 上取得最优 PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS 与最高 1.82× 加速。
AI.motivation: vDiT 的自注意力二次复杂度限制了高分辨率与长时长视频生成的效率；已有稀疏注意力方法以保留高注意力权重为准则，但该准则无法准确反映最终 value 加权输出的保真度，因为误差同时取决于注意力分子与 softmax 分母的变化。
AI.method: 粗到细稀疏注意力：先用尺寸加权的 key/value 质心近似完整归一化输出；再以估计输出为中心重构 value 贡献，构造可同时刻画分子-分母耦合误差的残差代理；该代理在每个 query 簇的固定块预算下指导 query-key 块选择，被选块做精确 token 级计算，其余块以质心形式在同一 softmax 归一化下贡献。
AI.result: 在五个 vDiT 上，NOVA 的 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 均为稀疏注意力方法中最优，PSNR 较最强基线最高提升 1.55 dB，H100 GPU 上端到端加速最高 1.82×。
AI.conclusion: 以最终归一化输出误差（而非原始注意力权重）为稀疏化准则更契合生成保真度需求；结合质心近似与残差代理的块级选择性精算，可在显著加速的同时保持甚至提升视频生成质量。

title: ROSE-SAM3: Response-Oriented Prompt Selection for Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures, 7 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
summary: In open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) of remote-sensing imagery, class-name prompts can miss objects with varied appearances, while richer descriptions can activate competing classes. We propose Response-Oriented Prompt Selection for SAM 3 (ROSE-SAM3), a training-free framework that selects descriptions using frozen SAM 3 responses on unlabeled target-domain images. We screen candidate descriptions for coverage beyond the native prompts while protecting reliable native class responses, retaining candidates that pass these checks on at least four of five image folds. An offline directed acyclic graph (DAG) search then evaluates candidate combinations and builds a compact PromptBank for each class. Each bank retains the native prompts and adds selected descriptions, which we call residual prompts. At inference, the bank is fixed, and Semantic-Instance Cooperative Head (SICH) uses instance evidence to refine semantic responses before assigning pixel labels. We also introduce RS-OVSS-C to evaluate robustness under six image corruption families across eight remote-sensing datasets, preserving their class vocabularies and reference labels. ROSE-SAM3 achieves 57.3% mean mIoU across eight clean benchmarks and 54.7% on RS-OVSS-C, achieving state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/YanghuiSong/ROSE-SAM3.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架ROSE-SAM3，利用冻结SAM3在目标域图像上的响应筛选提示描述，并用DAG搜索构建紧凑PromptBank，配合SICH头实现遥感开放词汇语义分割，取得免训练方法SOTA。
AI.motivation: 遥感开放词汇语义分割中，单一类名提示难以覆盖外观多样的目标，而丰富描述又易激活竞争类别，导致提示词设计两难；同时缺少面向图像退化的鲁棒性评测基准。
AI.method: 免训练框架：用冻结SAM3在无标注目标域图像上的响应筛选候选描述，在保证原生类别响应可靠的前提下校验其覆盖增益，要求候选在5个图像折中至少4折通过；再用离线DAG搜索评估描述组合，为每类构建紧凑PromptBank（原生提示+残差提示）；推理时冻结PromptBank，由语义-实例协作头SICH利用实例证据精化语义响应后赋像素标签；并提出RS-OVSS-C基准，涵盖8个遥感数据集的6类图像退化。
AI.result: 在8个干净基准上平均mIoU达57.3%，在RS-OVSS-C上达54.7%，为免训练方法中的最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于响应驱动的提示筛选与组合搜索可有效扩展开放词汇分割的文本侧覆盖，且无需训练即可领先同类方法；代码已开源。

title: You Only Think Once: Rescuing Hybrid Vision-Language Models Lost in Thought
summary: Thinking at length before answering is expected to strengthen the visual reasoning of vision-language models (VLMs), yet hybrid VLMs often get lost in thought: their thoughts loop or exhaust the budget without an answer, so thinking can score below answering directly. Existing early-exit methods watch a thought for the moment its answer is ready and force the answer out of it, but in a hybrid VLM that moment often never comes. We find that the remedy is not to stop a failing thought earlier, but to stop taking its answer: once a thought is given up, the model's own direct answers decide. Based on this, we propose **YOTO (You Only Think Once)**, a method that answers first and thinks at most once. YOTO draws direct answers until a probe-weighted vote settles; only an unsettled problem receives a single thought, which a failure head on the hidden state monitors and stops as soon as it predicts failure, handing the problem back to direct answers. At a matched 20k-token budget, YOTO is up to 5.9 points more accurate than the strongest early-exit baseline, using one failure-head threshold across model sizes. Keeping the released weights frozen, it adds only two linear probes. On the full MathVision benchmark, YOTO improves Qwen3.5-2B from 40.1% to 57.3% and Qwen3.5-4B from 68.3% to 73.7%, above the 72.8% that Qwen3.5-9B, a model more than twice its size, reaches with thinking. Its gains carry over to five further benchmarks and a second model family. These results suggest that hybrid VLMs reason better by answering first and thinking once than by thinking longer.

AI.tldr: 提出 YOTO（You Only Think Once）：混合式 VLM 先给直接答案，仅在投票未收敛时思考一次，并由失败头提前终止失败思考、交还直接答案决策。
AI.motivation: 长思考本应增强 VLM 视觉推理，但混合式 VLM 常"想过头"：思考陷入循环或耗尽预算仍未给出答案，导致思考反而不如直接作答。现有 early-exit 方法假定"答案已就绪的时刻"必然存在并强制输出，而该时刻在混合 VLM 中往往不会出现。
AI.method: 核心思路是不提前终止失败思考，而是不再采纳其答案。流程：(1) 持续采样直接答案，直至探针加权投票收敛；(2) 仅对未收敛问题分配一次思考；(3) 在隐状态上挂接失败预测头，一旦预测失败即终止思考并回退到直接答案。权重冻结，仅新增两个线性探针，跨模型尺寸共用同一失败头阈值。
AI.result: 在 20k token 匹配预算下，比最强 early-exit 基线最高提升 5.9 个百分点。MathVision 全量基准上，Qwen3.5-2B 由 40.1% 升至 57.3%，Qwen3.5-4B 由 68.3% 升至 73.7%，超过两倍规模 Qwen3.5-9B 带思考的 72.8%。增益可迁移至另外五个基准及另一模型家族。
AI.conclusion: 混合式 VLM 更应"先答、少想"：先给直接答案、最多思考一次，优于延长思考；失败头驱动的终止—回退机制是有效且轻量的解法。

title: LightOnOCR for AMNLT: Reading Chant Notation and Lyrics in One Pass, from Single Staves to Whole Pages
summary: Aligned music notation and lyrics transcription (AMNLT) asks for the notes of a chant, its sung text and the assignment of syllables to notes in one output. Fuentes-Martínez et al., who defined the task, found that the one vision-language model they tested fell far behind specialised recognisers. We fine-tune LightOnOCR-3-1B, a page OCR model with one billion parameters, end to end, vision encoder included, to write a staff as a GABC string whose letters denote staff positions. Trained on the published AMNLT training split alone, it more than halves the best published aligned music and lyrics error rate (AMLER) on Solesmes, the one directly comparable dataset (9.9 against 21.0 %); on Einsiedeln and Salzinnes, measured in a different encoding, its figures are also lower. The benchmark does not measure generalisation to unseen manuscripts: while the pitch error on AMNLT validation stays between 1.7 and 1.9 %, on 200 staves from five unseen manuscripts it falls from 24.9 to 1.3 % as we add chant aligned through CantusDB, Transkribus ground truth and silver staves kept only where two readers agree. Trained also on multi-staff images, it reads whole pages without staff detection (pitch error 3.3 to 3.8 % on validation and test pages, 1.9 % on pages of unseen manuscripts). Remaining errors include Gothic F clefs read as C clefs, notes dropped with abbreviated or illegible text and lower accuracy on pages with small notation. Controlled ablations are needed to explain the gains.

AI.tldr: 微调十亿参数的页面OCR模型LightOnOCR-3-1B端到端输出GABC谱面字符串，在Solesmes上将已发表最佳AMLER减半（9.9% vs 21.0%），并可无谱表检测地整页识别。
AI.motivation: AMNLT任务要求同时输出音符、歌词及音节—音符对齐；先前测试的单一视觉语言模型远逊于专用识别器，需验证通用页面OCR模型经端到端微调能否胜任。
AI.method: 将LightOnOCR-3-1B（含视觉编码器）端到端微调，使其把谱表写成字母表示谱表位置的GABC字符串；仅用公开AMNLT训练集训练，并补充经CantusDB对齐的圣咏、Transkribus真值以及仅在双读者一致时保留的银色标注谱表；另训练多谱表图像以实现整页读取而无需谱表检测。
AI.result: Solesmes上AMLER为9.9%（对比21.0%）；Einsiedeln与Salzinnes（不同编码度量）也更低。AMNLT验证集音高错误1.7–1.9%，但在5份未见手稿的200个谱表上高达24.9%；随数据补充降至1.3%。整页模式下验证/测试页音高错误3.3–3.8%，未见手稿页1.9%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在直接可比基准上大幅超越现有水平，并具备整页识别能力；但基准未衡量对未见手稿的泛化（需数据补充才显著改善），残余错误包括哥特式F谱号误读为C谱号、文字缩写或不可辨导致音符丢失、小号谱面准确率偏低，且增益来源仍需受控消融实验解释。

title: UbiEnlight: User-Perception-Aware Real-Time Low-Light Video Enhancement on Mobile Devices and Smartglasses
summary: Low-light video capture is now common on smartphones and wearables, yet dynamic illumination coupled with mobile/werable user motion causes noise, blur, and flicker that make videos hard to perceive and use, especially for users with night blindness and near-eye displays. Prior work enhances frames with post-hoc temporal constraints or optimizes videos directly; however,low-light and motion degradations are spatiotemporally coupled, so post-hoc consistency after per-frame restoration often leaves flicker and motion artifacts. We present UbiEnlight, the first diffusion-transformer-based on-device system for real-time, temporally stable low-light video enhancement. UbiEnlight builds on two insights: (1) illumination and structure separate more robustly in the frequency domain, enabling a spectrum-guided diffusion transformer that injects Fourier amplitude/phase priors to correct illumination while anchoring structure without optical flow; and (2) user perceptual tolerance varies by context, motivating a perception-aware controller that adapts sampling depth, attention reuse, and frame caching at runtime. We implement UbiEnlight on smartphones and smartglasses, and evaluate it against state-of-the-art baselines. UbiEnlight improves temporal stability by up to 54.76% under dynamic/extreme conditions while sustaining real-time on-device performance.

AI.tldr: UbiEnlight：首个基于扩散Transformer的端侧实时低光视频增强系统，利用频域先验解耦光照与结构，并以感知容忍度自适应调度采样深度/注意力复用/帧缓存，在手机与智能眼镜上实现实时且时间稳定的增强。
AI.motivation: 智能手机与可穿戴设备低光视频采集普遍，但动态光照与用户运动导致噪声、模糊与闪烁，影响可感知性与可用性（尤其夜盲用户与近眼显示）。已有方法要么逐帧复原后加事后时间约束，要么直接优化视频；然而低光与运动退化在时空上强耦合，事后一致性校正仍残留闪烁与运动伪影，且难以满足端侧实时需求。
AI.method: 两点核心设计：(1) 频域分离更稳健——提出频谱引导的扩散Transformer，注入傅里叶振幅/相位先验，在无需光流的前提下纠正光照并锚定结构；(2) 用户感知容忍度随场景变化——设计感知感知控制器，在运行时自适应调整采样深度、注意力复用与帧缓存，以在质量与实时性间折中。
AI.result: 在智能手机与智能眼镜上实现并对比SOTA基线：动态/极端条件下时间稳定性最高提升54.76%，同时保持端侧实时性能。
AI.conclusion: 以频域先验解耦时空耦合退化、以感知自适应控制算力分配，可同时达成时间稳定与端侧实时，为移动/可穿戴低光视频增强提供可行范式。

title: BehaviorICL: Task-Conditioned Decoder States for Visual In-Context Learning
summary: The usefulness of an in-context demonstration for a vision-language model (VLM) depends on both the query image and the task posed about it. We study whether the frozen target VLM's own decoder states, read before answer generation, can select such demonstrations. BehaviorICL represents each image and task by a task-conditioned processing signature, the hidden states at the final input position across all decoder layers. Its training-free variant, BehaviorICL-Raw, averages cosine similarities between corresponding layer states and passes the retrieved examples with their reference answers to the same VLM. When the same NICO++ images are asked about their object or their context, Raw retrieves largely different demonstrations for the two questions and outperforms an image retriever given task-matched demonstrations on both VLMs. Across two VLMs and eight classification and visual question answering datasets, Raw gives the highest average accuracy among training-free retrievers on both VLMs and exceeds RICES with a CLIP ViT-L/14 encoder by 3.83 points on Qwen and 1.85 on InternVL. A lightweight shared projection, BehaviorICL-Proj, brings further gains on classification. Analyses of extraction text, decoder depth and bank answers help explain these gains, and attention analysis describes how the task text shifts attention at the extraction position toward the classified object. These results support the target VLM's internal states as a practical basis for visual in-context learning.

AI.tldr: 提出BehaviorICL，利用冻结的目标VLM在答案生成前的解码器隐状态（任务条件处理签名）来检索与查询图像和任务都匹配的上下文示例，无需训练即可显著提升视觉上下文学习效果。
AI.motivation: 上下文示例对VLM是否有用同时取决于查询图像和所提任务，但现有检索器（如图像检索器或RICES式CLIP编码器）仅依据图像相似度选择示例，忽略了任务条件，导致检索到的示例与任务不匹配。
AI.method: 将每个图像与任务表示为"任务条件处理签名"，即冻结目标VLM在所有解码器层最后一个输入位置的隐状态。训练无关变体BehaviorICL-Raw对各层状态的余弦相似度取平均，直接检索并用同一VLM作答；在此基础上引入轻量共享投影BehaviorICL-Proj以进一步提升分类性能。
AI.result: 在NICO++上，对同一图像分别询问物体或上下文时，Raw检索出显著不同的示例，且在两个VLM上均优于任务匹配的图像检索器；在两个VLM、八个分类与VQA数据集上，Raw在训练无关检索器中平均准确率最高，相比使用CLIP ViT-L/14编码器的RICES在Qwen上高3.83分、InternVL上高1.85分；Proj在分类任务上进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 对提取文本、解码器深度与示例库答案的分析解释了性能增益，注意力分析表明任务文本使提取位置的注意力转向被分类物体；结果支持将目标VLM内部状态作为视觉上下文学习的实用检索基础。

title: Multimodal Violence Understanding and Temporal Retrieval in Movies with Adaptive Audio-Visual Fusion
summary: Violence in films and streaming media remains a concern for audience protection and creates substantial workload for manual content classification. Existing violence-detection methods often rely on limited modalities or short video clips, making it difficult to capture complementary evidence and localise violent events in long, untrimmed videos. In this study, we develop a framework for multimodal video understanding that classifies violence severity, predicts multiple violence types, and locates violent events in time. We combine temporally aligned visual and audio features extracted using pretrained encoders through attention-based adaptive fusion, followed by Transformer-based temporal modelling. Our framework supports three complementary tasks: video-level violence-severity classification, multi-label violence-type prediction, and temporal localisation of violent events. We evaluate the framework on the XD-Violence benchmark and examine its cross-domain performance using AIRTLab. On XD-Violence, our multimodal model achieves 93.27\% severity-classification accuracy and a micro-F1 score of 88.60\% for multi-label violence-type prediction, outperforming the corresponding unimodal configurations. We achieve a mean temporal intersection-over-union (tIoU) of 0.5075 for temporal localisation. Our cross-domain experiments reveal performance degradation under different recording conditions, while our movie case studies demonstrate the framework's potential to retrieve potentially violent scenes for further review. Our results highlight the practical value of multimodal intelligent systems in supporting human reviewers with the identification, classification, and temporal retrieval of violent content in films and streaming media.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个多模态视频理解框架，融合时序对齐的视觉与音频特征，通过注意力自适应融合与Transformer时序建模，同时完成暴力严重程度分类、多标签暴力类型预测与暴力事件时间定位三项任务。
AI.motivation: 影视与流媒体中的暴力内容既涉及观众保护，也带来繁重的人工标注负担；现有暴力检测方法多依赖单一模态或短视频片段，难以获取互补证据，也难以在长而未裁剪视频中定位暴力事件。
AI.method: 用预训练编码器提取时序对齐的视觉与音频特征；采用基于注意力的自适应融合，随后用Transformer进行时序建模；框架统一支持三个互补任务：视频级暴力严重程度分类、多标签暴力类型预测和暴力事件时间定位。
AI.result: 在XD-Violence基准上，多模态模型严重程度分类准确率达93.27%，多标签暴力类型预测micro-F1为88.60%，优于对应单模态配置；时间定位平均tIoU为0.5075。跨域实验（AIRTLab）显示不同录制条件下性能下降；电影案例研究表明框架可检索潜在暴力场景以供复核。
AI.conclusion: 多模态智能系统在辅助人工审核者对影视及流媒体暴力内容进行识别、分类与时间检索方面具有实际价值；跨域泛化仍是局限。

title: Fairness Evaluation for Diffusion and Flow Models Should Account for the Generation Path: Implications for Clinical Imaging
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 GenAI4Health Workshop Position Paper Track
summary: Medical image generation models are often evaluated using images produced by a single sampling procedure. However, diffusion and flow models can use different numbers of sampling steps, sampling schedules, or numerical solvers without changing their trained parameters. These changes may affect the generated images and the clinical measurements derived from them. We argue that fairness results obtained under one sampling procedure should not be assumed to hold under another, particularly when changes in sampling affect clinical task errors differently across patient groups. Building on previous work on medical image quality, accelerated sampling, generation dynamics, and generative model fairness, we examine why the sampling procedure should be considered part of the evaluated system. We define subgroup differences in clinical task error across sampling procedures and provide a mathematical example showing that two groups can have identical outputs under the exact dynamics and a reference sampler but different errors under an alternative sampler. We also extend this result to stochastic generation under shared noise. An exploratory experiment with an age-conditioned image generation model illustrates how changing the number and timing of sampling steps can alter image-derived measurements, although these differences do not establish clinical unfairness. We therefore argue that fairness evaluation should assess the sampling procedure used in practice and examine intermediate generation states when they help explain differences in clinically relevant errors across patient groups. Analysis code is available here https://github.com/rdharini2001/generation-path-fairness

AI.tldr: 医疗图像生成模型的公平性评估不应只基于单一采样流程；采样步数、调度与求解器的变化会改变临床测量误差，且可能对不同患者亚组产生不同影响，因此采样流程应视为被评估系统的一部分。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像生成模型的评估通常在固定采样流程下进行，但扩散/流模型可在不改变训练参数的情况下调整采样步数、采样调度或数值求解器。这些变化会影响生成图像及其衍生的临床测量，现有研究未考虑"某一采样流程下的公平性结论能否迁移到另一采样流程"。
AI.method: 在既有医学图像质量、加速采样、生成动力学与生成模型公平性工作的基础上，将采样流程纳入被评估系统的界定；定义跨采样流程的临床任务误差亚组差异指标；构造数学示例说明两组在精确动力学与参考采样器下输出相同、但在替代采样器下误差不同；并将结论推广至共享噪声下的随机生成；最后用年龄条件图像生成模型做探索性实验，考察采样步数与时间安排变化对图像衍生测量的影响。
AI.result: 数学示例表明，尽管两亚组在精确动态与参考采样器下输出一致，在替代采样器下可产生不同的临床任务误差；该结论可扩展至共享噪声的随机生成情形。探索性实验显示，改变采样步数与时间安排会改变图像衍生测量，但作者明确指出这些差异尚不足以确立临床层面的不公平。
AI.conclusion: 公平性评估应针对实际部署中使用的采样流程，并在有助于解释亚组间临床相关误差差异时考察生成的中间状态；不应假设单一采样流程下的公平性结论可泛化到其他采样设置。代码已公开。

title: Task-Agnostic Incremental Vision-Language Object Detection via Prompt Augmentation and Distribution-Aware Fusion
summary: Incremental Vision-Language Object Detection (IVLOD) empowers pre-trained open-vocabulary detectors to continuously learn new visual concepts from sequential tasks without forgetting foundational knowledge. However, existing methods predominantly rely on oracle task identities during inference, severely limiting their open-world practicality. In this paper, we formalize Task-Agnostic IVLOD (TA-IVLOD), a more realistic setting where such priors are unavailable, requiring the model to simultaneously recognize classes from all learned tasks. This unconstrained setting exposes severe performance degradation due to cross-task semantic interference and parameter conflicts. To tackle these challenges, we propose TADA, a novel modular framework. Specifically, TADA introduces Stochastic Prompt Augmentation to mitigate semantic interference via training-time noise injection, and Test-Time Distribution-Aware Fusion to dynamically weight class-specific LoRA experts, effectively resolving parameter conflicts. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms baselines in standard IVLOD and yields substantial improvements in the rigorous TA-IVLOD setting on the ODinW-13 benchmark, while effectively preserving zero-shot generalization on the MS COCO dataset. The code is available at https://github.com/yonghanjiang/TADA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出任务无关增量视觉-语言目标检测设定 TA-IVLOD，并提出模块化框架 TADA，通过随机提示增强和测试时分布感知融合解决跨任务语义干扰与参数冲突。
AI.motivation: 现有增量视觉-语言目标检测（IVLOD）方法在推理时依赖已知的任务身份（oracle task identities），难以用于真实开放世界场景；若去掉该先验，模型需同时识别所有已学任务的类别，会出现严重的跨任务语义干扰与参数冲突，导致性能显著下降。
AI.method: 提出模块化框架 TADA：1）Stochastic Prompt Augmentation，在训练阶段注入噪声以缓解跨任务语义干扰；2）Test-Time Distribution-Aware Fusion，在测试时动态加权各类别的 LoRA 专家，以解决参数冲突。同时将无任务先验的设定形式化为 TA-IVLOD。
AI.result: 在 ODinW-13 基准上，TADA 在标准 IVLOD 与更严格的 TA-IVLOD 设定下均显著优于基线，并在 MS COCO 上有效保持零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: TADA 通过提示增强与分布感知的专家融合，有效缓解无任务身份设定下的语义干扰与参数冲突，为更贴近实际的开放世界增量检测提供了可行方案，同时不损害基础零样本能力。

title: Dual-Stream Event-to-Video Reconstruction
summary: Event cameras capture brightness changes with high temporal resolution and dynamic range, but converting event streams into videos remains fundamentally ill-posed due to the lack of absolute intensity information. Resolving this ambiguity calls for a brightness reference that complements the intensity changes recorded by events. Inspired by the complementary spatial and temporal processing of the parvocellular and magnocellular pathways in human vision, we propose EvDualDiff, a dual-stream framework that combines a brightness reference from temporal-mapping events with motion-event cues for video reconstruction. Conditioned on both streams, our video diffusion model autoregressively reconstructs long sequences from a single temporal map. Photometric constraints and finetuning on self-generated rollouts reduce accumulated drift. At the hardware level, our approach requires only a minimal light-modulation mechanism on the lens of an event camera. We build this setup and collect a dataset comprising temporal-mapping events, motion events and synchronised ground-truth RGB frames. Experiments on a public benchmark and on our collected EvDual dataset demonstrate that EvDualDiff outperforms existing event-to-video reconstruction methods in fidelity, perceptual quality and video-level realism. The code and dataset will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出EvDualDiff双流框架，利用时间映射事件提供亮度参考、运动事件提供运动线索，结合视频扩散模型实现从事件流重建长序列视频。
AI.motivation: 事件相机仅记录亮度变化、缺乏绝对强度信息，事件流到视频的转换本质上是病态问题，需要额外的亮度参考来消解该歧义。
AI.method: 受人类视觉小细胞通路（空间/亮度）与大细胞通路（时间/运动）互补处理启发，设计双流架构：一路由时间映射事件给出亮度参考，一路由运动事件提供运动线索，作为条件驱动视频扩散模型；以单一时间映射自回归重建长序列，并采用光度约束及在自生成 rollout 上微调以抑制漂移；硬件上仅需在事件相机镜头加装简易光调制机制。
AI.result: 构建了相应硬件装置并采集EvDual数据集（含时间映射事件、运动事件及同步RGB真值）；在公开基准与自建数据集上，该方法在保真度、感知质量和视频级真实感方面均优于现有事件到视频重建方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入互补的亮度参考流并结合扩散模型与漂移抑制策略，可有效缓解事件视频重建的病态性；方法硬件成本低，代码与数据集将开源。

title: OrthoLatentCAD: Orthographic Spatial Latents for Hand-Drawn CAD Program Generation
summary: Freehand orthographic drawings capture early design intent, yet recovering executable sketch--extrude CAD programs from raster front, right, and top views remains challenging: noisy, dimension-free 2D layouts must be reconciled into an ordered construction history. We introduce Hand2CAD, a benchmark of 215K ABC-derived synthetic orthographic-drawing--CAD program pairs and 1,000 real three-view sets drawn by CAD-trained participants. Recovering CAD programs from orthographic drawings requires both cross-view geometric reasoning and alignment between visual features and program representations. We propose OrthoLatentCAD to address these two challenges. It fuses local geometry with global context on canonical planes, exchanges evidence between paired plane lines indexed by the same shared-axis coordinate, and maps the spatial representation to ordered program latents through queries inherited from a frozen CAD autoencoder. Across the evaluated one- to three-view configurations, OrthoLatentCAD outperforms protocol-matched baselines in procedural accuracy, compiled geometry, and CAD-kernel validity while benefiting from additional views. Without real-data fine-tuning, it also outperforms the baselines on held-out real drawings. We will release the dataset, code, and evaluation scripts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Hand2CAD 基准（215K 合成三视图-挤出CAD程序对 + 1000 组真人手绘三视图）与方法 OrthoLatentCAD，实现从栅格三视图直接恢复有序 sketch-extrude CAD 程序。
AI.motivation: 手绘正交视图能捕捉早期设计意图，但从无标注、无尺寸的栅格三视图重建可执行的 sketch-extrude CAD 程序仍困难：需将噪声2D布局对齐为一个有序的建模历史。核心难点是跨视图几何推理，以及视觉特征与程序表示之间的对齐。
AI.method: 构建 Hand2CAD 数据集（215K ABC 衍生的合成正交图-CAD程序对，以及 1000 组由受训者绘制的真实三视图）。提出 OrthoLatentCAD：在规范化平面上融合局部几何与全局上下文；在同一共享轴坐标索引的成对平面线之间交换证据；并借助从冻结 CAD 自编码器继承的查询，将空间表示映射为有序的程序隐变量。
AI.result: 在 1–3 视图配置下，OrthoLatentCAD 在程序准确率、编译几何与 CAD 内核有效性上均优于协议匹配的基线，且随视图增加而受益；在未用真实数据微调的情况下，于留出真实手绘样本上亦超过基线。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了手绘三视图到 CAD 程序的可复现基准与强基线方法，验证了跨视图几何推理与冻结自编码器潜空间对齐的有效性，并将公开数据集、代码与评测脚本。

title: LoopSeek: Decoupling System One Search from System Two Answering for Long Video Understanding
summary: Long video question answering requires finding relevant evidence before reasoning over it. With a limited frame budget, single-pass frame selection can miss critical evidence, while adaptive search often relies on repeated text generation to decide where to look. We introduce LoopSeek, a framework that decouples evidence search from answer generation through a division of labor between a non-thinking System I and a generative System II. Our key insight is that search can be expressed as a sequence of small, typed decisions, allowing System I to find the evidence that System II needs. Four System I role agents navigate a tree of video windows and coordinate through probability outputs to select frames, assess evidence, and revise the search without generating text. To align search with System II, System I learns from annotated evidence on questions that System II answers correctly only from that evidence, and the verifier's evidence estimates steer the search without calling System II, which stays frozen and answers once from the selected frames. On five long-video benchmarks, with a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B reading 32 frames, LoopSeek improves average accuracy from 53.5 to 63.9 over the uniform baseline and takes 32--80\% less GPU time per question than agentic methods.

AI.tldr: LoopSeek 提出 System I / System II 分工框架，将证据搜索表达为一系列小型类型化决策，由非生成式 System I 在视频窗口树上选帧，冻结的 System II 仅在选中帧上作答一次。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答需先定位相关证据再推理。在有限帧预算下，单次选帧易漏掉关键证据；自适应搜索又常依赖反复文本生成来决定下一步看哪里，代价高、GPU 时间开销大。
AI.method: 框架解耦证据搜索与答案生成。System I 由四个角色智能体在视频窗口树上导航，通过概率输出协同完成选帧、证据评估与搜索修正，全程不生成文本。为与 System II 对齐，System I 从"System II 仅凭该证据即可答对"的样本上的标注证据中学习；验证器的证据估计直接引导搜索而无需调用 System II，后者保持冻结，仅在选中帧上回答一次。
AI.result: 在五个长视频基准上，冻结的 Qwen3-VL-8B 读取 32 帧时，平均准确率由均匀采样的 53.5 提升至 63.9，且每题 GPU 时间比智能体方法少 32%–80%。
AI.conclusion: 将搜索简化为非生成式的类型化决策序列，可在不牺牲答案生成质量的前提下显著提升长视频问答准确率并大幅降低推理开销，验证了"搜索—生成"分工范式的有效性。

title: OKB-CFM: Observation-Keyed Barycentric Conditional Flow Matching for Unpaired Sparse-to-Dense Cardiac Shape Completion
summary: Completing cardiac segmentations from sparse cine magnetic resonance labels is challenging because acquired planes do not uniquely determine the underlying anatomy and patient-matched dense annotations are rarely available. We propose observation-keyed barycentric conditional flow matching for completion between clinically unpaired cohorts. Independently trained variational autoencoders represent sparse observations and dense shapes. A fixed memory associates simulated sparse keys with their source dense encodings, enabling candidate retrieval within the sparse latent space. A matching network aggregates the retrieved values into a query-dependent barycentric endpoint, toward which an endpoint-conditioned flow transports the sparse encoding. Individual candidate values provide alternative completion endpoints. On 327 real unpaired inputs, the method obtains encoder-feature Fréchet and squared maximum mean discrepancy scores of 7.93 and 2.02 after scaling by 10,000 and 10,000,000, respectively, corresponding to reductions of 47.0\% and 94.2\% relative to contrastive unpaired translation. On a 34-file simulated test partition, evaluation against dense-VAE-reconstructed references yields a five-class mean Dice of 0.889, squared Chamfer distance of 6.15 square voxels, 95th-percentile surface distance of 3.88 voxels, and average symmetric surface distance of 1.50 voxels. These results characterize cohort-level feature agreement, observed-label consistency, and reconstruction under the stated reference construction. By complementing routine cine-based functional assessment with inferred multi-chamber anatomical context, this framework provides a basis for investigating how chamber morphology and spatial relationships relate to cardiac function.

AI.tldr: 提出"观测键控重心条件流匹配"，实现临床非配对队列间由稀疏电影MRI标注补全致密心脏分割。
AI.motivation: 稀疏电影MRI标注的采集层面无法唯一确定潜在解剖结构，且缺乏与患者匹配的致密标注，致使稀疏到致密的分割补全困难。
AI.method: 分别训练变分自编码器表示稀疏观测与致密形状；固定记忆库将模拟稀疏键与其源致密编码关联，在稀疏潜空间检索候选值；匹配网络将检索值聚合为查询依赖的重心端点，以端点条件流将稀疏编码输运至该端点，各候选值提供备选补全端点。
AI.result: 327例真实非配对输入上，编码器特征Fréchet距离与平方MMD分别为7.93（×10,000）和2.02（×10,000,000），较对比非配对翻译降低47.0%与94.2%；34例模拟测试划分上，五类平均Dice为0.889，平方Chamfer距离6.15体素²，95百分位表面距离3.88体素，平均对称表面距离1.50体素。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了队列级特征一致性、观测标签一致性与既定参考构建下的重建性能；该框架在常规电影功能评估之外补充推断的多腔解剖背景，为研究腔室形态及空间关系与心功能关联提供基础。

title: WorldWeave: Rethinking Embodied Navigation through Cross-Task World Modeling
summary: Mobile embodied agents continuously alter their observations through their own motion, while external dynamics further shape future interactions. Different mobile embodied tasks therefore capture complementary patterns of state evolution, yet jointly learning world dynamics across such interactions remains less explored. We investigate this problem through Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) and Embodied Visual Tracking (EVT), which respectively involve navigation toward a stationary goal and interaction with a moving target. We propose WorldWeave, a cross-task world model that couples shared predictive dynamics with task-specific adaptation. Instead of conditioning state transitions on heterogeneous physical actions, WorldWeave learns latent actions from observed state changes via inverse-forward dynamics, establishing a shared transition representation across tasks. The resulting future-state predictions are adaptively integrated into task-specific representations for downstream decision making. Experiments across multiple VLN and EVT benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over specialized baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出WorldWeave，一种跨任务世界模型，通过逆-正向动力学从观测状态变化中学习潜在动作，将共享的状态转移表示与任务特定适配耦合，统一建模VLN（VLN，导航至静止目标）与EVT（具身视觉跟踪，跟随运动目标）两类移动具身任务，在多个基准上稳定优于专用基线。
AI.motivation: 移动具身智能体的观测既受自身运动影响，也受外部动态影响；不同移动具身任务（如VLN与EVT）各自捕获互补的状态演化模式，但跨此类交互联合学习世界动力学仍研究不足。直接以异构物理动作作为状态转移条件难以跨任务共享。
AI.method: WorldWeave由共享预测动力学与任务特定适配构成：不从异构物理动作条件化状态转移，而是借助逆动力学-正向动力学框架，从观测到的状态变化中推断潜在动作，建立跨任务共享的转移表示；再将由此产生的未来状态预测自适应地融合进任务特定表示，用于下游决策。
AI.result: 在多个VLN与EVT基准上的实验显示，方法相对各自专用基线取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 以潜在动作作为跨任务共享的状态转移抽象，可有效实现移动具身任务的联合世界建模，并通过任务特定适配保持下游性能，验证了跨任务动力学共享的可行性与收益。

title: Reconstruction-Guided Dual-Branch Learning for LiDAR Anomalous Object Detection
summary: Detecting unexpected objects is essential for autonomous driving safety. Most existing LiDAR anomaly detectors rely on semantic discrimination, which primarily captures category-discriminative features but may overlook deviations from broader feature relationships in normal scenes. Reconstruction offers a complementary perspective by assessing consistency with learned normal patterns. However, pointwise reconstruction errors alone struggle to distinguish anomalies from normal variability in complex outdoor point clouds. We propose Structured Residual Reasoning (SRR) to extract additional anomaly evidence from residual structure across feature channels, time sequences, and geometric space. We further establish that semantic discrimination and normal-pattern reconstruction capture fundamentally different yet complementary anomaly evidence: category compatibility and consistency with learned normal patterns, respectively. At matched background false-positive rates, SRR recovers more objects missed entirely by the semantic branch while producing fewer false positives in normal-only scenes. Building on this finding, we propose Reconstruction-Guided Dual-Branch (RGDB) learning, in which SRR-derived normal-pattern consistency cues guide a semantic-conditioned anomaly decoder to complement reconstruction-based predictions during training. At inference, the two branches jointly exploit their complementary anomaly evidence. Experiments show that standalone SRR establishes a strong reconstruction-based baseline without semantic labels from the target-scene training data, while RGDB achieves state-of-the-art performance on the STU validation set.

AI.tldr: 提出结构化残差推理(SRR)从特征通道、时间序列与几何空间的残差结构中提取异常证据，并进一步设计重建引导双分支(RGDB)框架，融合语义判别与重建一致性两类互补证据，在STU数据集上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有LiDAR异常检测器多依赖语义判别，只能捕捉类别区分性特征，忽略正常场景中更广泛的特征关系偏离；重建方法虽提供互补视角，但逐点重建误差难以在复杂室外点云中区分异常与正常波动。
AI.method: 提出SRR，跨特征通道、时间序列与几何空间三个维度挖掘残差结构作为额外异常证据；论证语义判别（类别兼容性）与重建（正常模式一致性）提供本质不同且互补的证据；据此提出RGDB学习，在训练中以SRR导出的正常模式一致性线索引导语义条件异常解码器，推理时双分支联合决策。
AI.result: 在匹配背景误报率下，SRR比语义分支找回更多被完全漏检的目标，且在纯正常场景中误报更少；单独SRR无需目标场景训练数据的语义标签即构成强重建基线；RGDB在STU验证集达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 语义判别与重建一致性是互补的异常证据来源，通过结构化残差推理与双分支融合可显著提升LiDAR异常检测的召回与精度。

title: Centerline-Guided Multi-Class Road Surface Segmentation
summary: Road-surface extraction from satellite imagery supports geo- graphic mapping, but a binary mask leaves road axes, transverse extent, and junction structure implicit. Learning these proper- ties together is challenging because narrow corridors, merging roads, and occlusions require different geometric cues. We present a centerline-guided multi-class segmentation framework that makes these dependencies explicit. A hierarchical encoder sup- plies shared features, while predicted centerline features and soft probabilities condition specialized regular, intersection, and over- pass decoders. A two-component width branch supplies transverse geometry to regular-surface decoding, and learned feature fusion produces the complete road mask. Unlike independent prediction heads or a fixed union of component masks, this design exchanges geometric information during decoding while retaining separately inspectable outputs. Evaluation of the four-semantic-output con- figuration on CHN6-CUG achieves 65.53% complete-surface IoU, improving on a binary SegFormer-B4 baseline by 1.01 percentage points and reducing false-positive pixels by 11.94%. The results support geometry-aware surface refinement and a richer raster representation for road-map inspection.

AI.tldr: 提出中心线引导的多类道路分割框架，将路面、中心线、交叉口、立交等几何属性显式解耦并协同解码，在CHN6-CUG上实现65.53%完整路面IoU。
AI.motivation: 传统二值掩膜隐式丢弃了道路轴线、横向宽度与交叉口/交叉结构信息，而狭窄廊道、汇流与遮挡需要不同几何线索，难以在单一二值输出中联合学习。
AI.method: 分层编码器提供共享特征；以预测的中心线特征与软概率作为条件，驱动专用的常规路面、交叉口与立交解码器；双分量宽度分支为常规路面解码提供横向几何；经学习式特征融合生成完整路面掩膜，同时保留可单独检查的多语义输出。
