AI.result: 四语义输出配置在CHN6-CUG上达到65.53%完整路面IoU，较二值SegFormer-B4基线提升1.01个百分点，误检像素减少11.94%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持几何感知的路面细化，并提供更丰富的栅格表示用于路网制图检查；相比独立预测头或固定并集，解码阶段的信息交互提升了多属性联合建模能力。

title: Decoding Frozen Vision Representations for Training-Free Few-Shot Pineapple Detection
comment: Accepted in WACV HARVEST Vision Workshop 2027
summary: Few-shot object detection in agricultural imagery is hampered by dense vegetation, repeated patterns, and scarce annotations. We present a training-free detector that turns dense features from frozen visual foundation models directly into detections, without fine-tuning, a learned head, or external proposals: a whitened foreground-background direction estimated from annotated support images scores every query patch, and the score field is decoded with an adaptive threshold and support-derived geometry. We also test whether predicted relative depth can be fed directly to RGB-pretrained frozen encoders. On aerial pineapple imagery, the detector outperforms PET-DINO and GeCo2 at every evaluated support size; at K=40, predicted depth alone reaches 92% of the RGB performance with DINOv2, and RGB-depth fusion lowers counting error for both encoders. We release the Pineapple Plantation dataset (4,908 aerial frames, 1,995 annotated with 17,609 boxes, predicted depth, leakage-aware splits) and analyse transfer to two further agricultural datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练少样本农业目标检测器：用冻结视觉基础模型特征+白化前景-背景方向打分，自适应阈值解码；并验证预测深度可直接输入RGB预训练冻结编码器，发布菠萝种植园数据集。
AI.motivation: 农业图像少样本目标检测受密集植被、重复纹理模式与标注稀缺制约；现有方法依赖微调、学习检测头或外部候选框，成本高且迁移困难。
AI.method: 无需微调、学习头或外部proposal：从带标注support图像估计白化的前景-背景判别方向，对每个query patch计算得分场，再用自适应阈值与由support导出的几何先验解码检测框。另测试将预测相对深度直接输入RGB预训练的冻结编码器，并评估RGB-深度融合。
AI.result: 在航拍菠萝图像上，各支持样本量K下均优于PET-DINO与GeCo2；K=40时，仅用预测深度（DINOv2）达到RGB性能的92%；RGB-深度融合降低两种编码器的计数误差。发布Pineapple Plantation数据集（4,908帧航拍图像，1,995帧含17,609框标注、预测深度、防泄漏划分），并分析向另外两个农业数据集的迁移。
AI.conclusion: 冻结基础模型特征配合免训练线性判别方向即可有效实现少样本农业检测，预测深度可作为RGB预训练编码器的可用输入模态；数据集与跨数据集迁移分析为后续研究提供基准。

title: GC-GS: Optimizing 3D Gaussian Splatting with Gradient Conflict as a Geometry Signal
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is commonly optimized with multiple reconstruction losses, which naturally forms a multi-objective optimization problem. This issue becomes more pronounced when perceptual losses are introduced to improve visual quality, as different objectives may impose competing update directions on Gaussian primitives and make it difficult to simultaneously improve fidelity, perceptual quality, and representation efficiency. Based on this view, we reformulate 3DGS training as a multi-objective optimization problem and derive selective conflict-aware position updates that reduce interference between competing objectives while preserving the contribution of each loss. We further observe that gradient conflicts persist throughout training and are most severe in Gaussian position parameters, indicating that objective conflict is closely tied to geometry optimization. We therefore treat position-gradient conflict as a geometry-aware signal to guide densification and pruning. Experiments show that our method achieves better rendering performance while improving representation compactness and rendering efficiency over existing 3DGS variants.

AI.tldr: 该论文将3DGS训练重构为多目标优化问题，提出选择性冲突感知的位置更新，并以位置梯度冲突作为几何感知信号指导致密化与剪枝，实现更优渲染质量与更紧凑高效的表示。
AI.motivation: 3DGS常使用多种重建损失联合优化，天然构成多目标优化问题；引入感知损失以提升视觉质量后，不同目标对高斯图元施加相互竞争的更新方向，难以同时兼顾保真度、感知质量与表示效率。
AI.method: 将3DGS训练形式化为多目标优化问题，推导出选择性冲突感知的位置更新，在保留各损失贡献的同时减少竞争目标间的干扰；进一步发现梯度冲突贯穿训练始终且在位置参数上最为严重，据此将位置梯度冲突作为几何感知信号来引导高斯致密化与剪枝。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比现有3DGS变体，该方法在获得更好渲染性能的同时，提升了表示紧凑性与渲染效率。
AI.conclusion: 目标冲突与几何优化紧密相关，基于冲突感知的位置更新与致密化/剪枝策略可有效协调多目标优化，兼顾渲染质量与表示效率。

title: CHORD: Closed-loop Human-Object Rectified-flow Decomposition
summary: Text-driven 3D human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires synthesizing whole-body human and object motions that stay coupled through contact. Yet existing generators either entangle the core variables that govern an interaction (object pose, contacting regions, and limb posture) with dozens of subordinate joints, or plan only end-effectors or coarse trajectories. No stage of generation holds the interaction in a form that is both settled and observed, which leaves contact to external guidance, post-hoc refiners, or internal guidance without a surface measurement. We present CHORD, a two-stage rectified-flow framework that settles the interaction in a compact plan and observes that plan against the object surface while it is being generated. First, Draft uses twelve part tokens per temporal patch to jointly plan the 6-DoF object trajectory, contact states, and the end and middle joints of every kinematic chain. At each flow step, Draft decodes the expected interaction from the closed-form clean estimate, measures it against the object surface, and routes this feedback to the responsible part token with zero extra network evaluations. Second, Full keeps this plan unchanged and infills the remaining body and finger joints. On InterAct, CHORD reduces FID by 33% and lifts hand contact F1 from 0.730 to 0.834, while its feedback improves contact on unseen objects and transfers plug-and-play to existing HOI generators.

AI.tldr: CHORD：两阶段rectified-flow框架，先用12个部件token联合规划物体6-DoF轨迹、接触状态与各运动链末端/中间关节，并在每个flow步用闭式干净估计对物体表面做接触测量、零额外网络评估地回传至责任token，再保持该计划不变地补全其余身体与手指关节。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动3D人-物交互生成存在两类问题：一是把决定交互的核心变量（物体位姿、接触区域、肢体姿态）与大量从属关节纠缠在一起，二是一旦只规划末端执行器或粗粒度轨迹。生成过程中没有任何阶段以"既已确定又可被观测"的形式持有交互，导致接触只能依赖外部引导、事后精修或缺乏表面测量的内部引导。
AI.method: 两阶段rectified-flow框架。第一阶段Draft：在每个时间patch上用12个部件token联合规划6-DoF物体轨迹、接触状态以及每条运动链的末端与中间关节；在每个flow步从闭式干净估计中解码期望交互，对物体表面测量接触，并将反馈路由到对应的部件token，零额外网络评估。第二阶段Full：保持该计划不变，补全剩余身体与手指关节。
AI.result: 在InterAct上FID降低33%，手部接触F1从0.730提升至0.834；其反馈机制在未见物体上改善接触，并可即插即用地迁移到现有HOI生成器。
AI.conclusion: 将交互在紧凑计划中"确定下来"并在生成过程中持续对物体表面"观测"，是无需外部引导或事后精修即可获得紧耦合全身接触的有效范式，且该反馈可跨模型复用。

title: GlaucomaMarker - Biomarker-Grounded Glaucoma Vision-Language Model
summary: Glaucoma is a leading cause of irreversible blindness. In the current clinical setting, glaucoma diagnosis is generally conducted by assessing optic disc cupping and asymmetry. Vision-language models (VLMs) have been utilized in recent years for glaucoma, mostly trained on fixed templates or AI-generated captions, as no public text describes the biomarkers. Our proposed framework, GlaucomaMarker, hypothesizes that retinal structural biomarkers can ground glaucoma-based VLMs. It converts public segmentation masks into sentences describing eleven biomarkers, to teach retinal foundation models to read them. We applied this framework to RETFound (GlaucomaMarker-R) and FLAIR (GlaucomaMarker-F), training on 9,778 images that yielded 45,190 image-text pairs. On a real-world clinical cohort, GlaucomaMarker-F detects glaucoma with an AUROC of 0.905, against 0.848 for FLAIR, and both read the biomarkers where baselines stay near random guessing. Since the biomarker text is computed from existing masks, it comes at no extra cost.

AI.tldr: 提出GlaucomaMarker框架，将公开分割掩码转换为描述11种生物标志物的句子，用于训练视觉-语言模型，使视网膜基础模型能够"阅读"青光眼结构标志物。
AI.motivation: 青光眼是不可逆失明的主要病因，临床诊断依赖视盘凹陷与不对称性评估。现有视觉-语言模型多基于固定模板或AI生成描述训练，缺乏描述标志物的公开文本，导致模型难以真正对接到临床生物标志物。
AI.method: 假设视网膜结构生物标志物可作为青光眼视觉-语言模型的 grounding 基础。将公开分割掩码转换为描述11种生物标志物的文本句子，构建9,778张图像对应的45,190个图文对，并将该框架应用于RETFound（GlaucomaMarker-R）与FLAIR（GlaucomaMarker-F）两个视网膜基础模型。
AI.result: 在真实临床队列上，GlaucomaMarker-F检测青光眼的AUROC为0.905，优于FLAIR的0.848；两个模型均能正确解读生物标志物，而基线模型接近随机猜测水平。由于标志物文本由现有掩码计算得出，不产生额外成本。
AI.conclusion: 基于分割掩码自动生成的生物标志物文本可有效实现青光眼视觉-语言模型的 grounding，在提升诊断性能的同时具备零额外标注成本的优势，为利用结构先验训练医学视觉-语言模型提供了可行路径。

title: eSPG: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Event Speckle Plethysmography
summary: Non-contact measurement of vital signs such as heart rate (HR) is valuable for patient monitoring and rescue operations. However, existing methods struggle with ambient illumination and motion, and have been demonstrated only at distances of tens of meters. Here we introduce event speckle plethysmography (eSPG), which illuminates a body part with a low-power (0.5-5 mW) laser and captures the resulting dynamic speckle pattern using an event camera. Event cameras, with their high dynamic range, temporal resolution, and sensitivity to intensity changes, are well-suited to capturing rapid speckle fluctuations that encode the physiological signal, even under challenging illumination and imaging conditions. We demonstrate HR estimation at 1 km with a mean absolute error of 5 beats per minute, and 90% of estimates satisfy an AAMI-defined HR estimation criterion. This distance exceeds previous remote plethysmography demonstrations by an order of magnitude and previous speckle plethysmography demonstrations by over three orders of magnitude. We also study and characterize robustness to motion and ambient illumination. Our theoretical analysis and experimental results demonstrate that resolving dynamic speckle fluctuations enables accurate heart rate estimation even at kilometer-scale distances, establishing a new direction toward robust, non-contact physiological monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出事件散斑体积描记法(eSPG)：用0.5–5 mW低功率激光照射身体部位，以事件相机捕捉动态散斑,在1 km距离实现心率估计(MAE 5 bpm,90%满足AAMI标准)。
AI.motivation: 非接触生命体征测量对监护与救援有价值，但现有方法受环境光照与运动干扰，且仅验证在数十米量级；散斑体积描记的测距能力有限。
AI.method: 以低功率激光(0.5–5 mW)照射体表，产生随血流搏动变化的动态散斑；利用事件相机高动态范围、高时间分辨率与对光强变化敏感的特性，直接捕捉快速散斑起伏所编码的生理信号，并辅以理论分析与对运动、环境光照鲁棒性的实验表征。
AI.result: 在1 km距离实现心率估计，MAE为5 bpm，90%的估计满足AAMI心率估计准则；测距较此前远程体积描记提升一个数量级，较散斑体积描记提升三个数量级以上。
AI.conclusion: 分辨动态散斑波动可在公里级距离实现准确心率估计，为鲁棒、非接触生理监测开辟新方向。

title: DeFlowCritic: Dense Latent Reward Alignment for Text-to-Image Flow Matching Models
summary: Online reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for aligning text-to-image flow matching models with complex user intent. However, existing methods typically rely on sparse rewards computed only from final decoded images. This delays credit assignment across the denoising trajectory and makes training computationally expensive. Moreover, simply combining multiple rewards does not reliably produce a Pareto trade-off, where gains in compositional accuracy often degrade aesthetic quality. In this work, we propose DeFlowCritic, an efficient online RL framework based on Dense Latent Reward Alignment. Unlike prior work, our method provides dense supervision on intermediate latents, enabling early-stage guidance for the denoising trajectory. To achieve this, we introduce an internal critic that evaluates noisy latents using features extracted directly from the diffusion model, a representation inherently better suited for latent-space reward estimation than standard image encoders. We construct a high-quality reward-modeling dataset with continuous scores for critic training, capturing compositional correctness on high-quality reference images. The resulting dense reward enables efficient online RL training and inference-time scaling. Experiments show that our method achieves a superior balance between prompt faithfulness and visual quality on GenEval2 and T2I-CompBench++ benchmarks. The approach also generalizes across text-to-image flow matching models, including SD3.5-Medium, SD3.5-Large, and FLUX.1-dev.

AI.tldr: 提出 DeFlowCritic，一个基于密集潜空间奖励对齐（Dense Latent Reward Alignment）的高效在线 RL 框架，通过对去噪轨迹中间潜变量提供密集监督改善文生图流匹配模型的提示词遵循度与视觉质量平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有在线 RL 方法仅依赖解码后最终图像的稀疏奖励，导致跨去噪轨迹的信用分配被延迟、训练计算开销大；且简单叠加多奖励难以获得可靠的 Pareto 权衡，组合准确性提升常以美学质量下降为代价。作者希望用中间潜变量的密集监督实现早期引导，提升训练效率与多目标平衡。
AI.method: 核心为内部评论器（internal critic）：利用扩散模型自身提取的特征评估加噪潜变量，因该类表示比标准图像编码器更适合潜空间奖励估计。为此构建了含连续分数的高质量奖励建模数据集用于 critic 训练，分数刻画高质量参考图上的组合正确性。所得密集奖励用于高效在线 RL 训练及推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）。
AI.result: 在 GenEval2 与 T2I-CompBench++ 上，方法在提示词忠实度与视觉质量之间取得更优平衡；并具备跨模型泛化性，可适用于 SD3.5-Medium、SD3.5-Large 与 FLUX.1-dev 等文生图流匹配模型。
AI.conclusion: 密集潜空间奖励信号能有效缓解稀疏奖励带来的信用分配延迟问题，内部 critic 借助扩散模型内部表征实现高效潜空间奖励估计，为文生图流匹配模型的在线 RL 对齐提供了可泛化且可复用的方案。

title: FastD4RT: Training-Free Acceleration of Dynamic 4D Reconstruction and Tracking
summary: Query-based 4D reconstruction models such as D4RT encode a video once into a global scene representation and obtain outputs by decoding independent point queries. However, inference is often influenced by dense outputs and long videos. Although D4RT separates encoding from decoding, a dense output still requires one decoder query for every pixel of every frame, and a long video is still encoded as many overlapping segments. In this work, we analyze the inference cost of D4RT and show that a large part of it is redundant. In particular, we find that the later decoder blocks attend to a small set of tokens shared by all queries. Based on these findings, we propose FastD4RT, a training-free framework that accelerates D4RT. By exploiting the smoothness of the outputs over time and across pixels, FastD4RT encodes and decodes only at sparse anchors and recovers the remaining outputs via interpolation. It decodes the remaining queries against a shared token set selected once per segment. We further characterize the errors introduced by both components. Experimental results show that FastD4RT accelerates D4RT by about 5 times on average across all its tasks with competitive accuracy, and further improves accuracy on long videos. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lycheemeng/fastd4rt.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 FastD4RT 框架，利用输出在时间与像素上的平滑性，仅在稀疏锚点编解码并用插值恢复其余输出，同时为每个片段共享一次选定的 token 集，平均约 5× 加速且精度有竞争力。
AI.motivation: D4RT 类基于查询的 4D 重建模型虽将编码与解码解耦，但推理仍受密集输出与长视频制约：密集输出需对每帧每像素做一次解码器查询，长视频被编码为多个重叠片段；作者分析发现推理成本中很大一部分是冗余的。
AI.method: 先剖析 D4RT 的推理开销，观察到后段解码器块仅关注一小组被所有查询共享的 token；据此提出免训练加速框架 FastD4RT：(1) 利用输出在时间与跨像素上的平滑性，只在稀疏锚点处编码与解码，其余输出通过插值恢复；(2) 每个片段仅选取一次共享 token 集，剩余查询针对该集合解码；并对两个组件引入的误差进行刻画。
AI.result: 在 D4RT 的全部任务上平均约 5 倍加速，精度具竞争力，且在长视频上精度进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: D4RT 推理存在大量冗余，通过稀疏锚点+插值与共享 token 集的免训练策略可在不损失精度的情况下显著加速，并在长视频场景中获益。

title: UACR: Uncertainty-Aware Collaborative Routing for Explainable Industrial Anomaly Inspection
summary: Industrial anomaly inspection requires not only accurate anomaly discrimination but also trustworthy explanations for operators, while satisfying the strict latency constraints of online inspection. Existing methods, however, typically apply a fixed computational path to all samples, making it difficult to strike a good balance among detection accuracy, inference efficiency, and interpretability. To address this issue, we propose UACR, an uncertainty-aware collaborative routing framework for explainable industrial anomaly inspection. UACR aims to deliver reliable anomaly decisions together with operator-facing explanations under the online inspection budget, while adaptively allocating computation so that ambiguous cases receive deeper scrutiny. The framework consists of two stages. Stage I, Offline Training and Routing Hyperparameter Search, learns the anomaly inspection modules and calibrates the uncertainty estimator that drives routing. Stage II, Uncertainty-Aware Adaptive Routing, collaboratively dispatches each input across inspection paths according to its estimated uncertainty. Experimental results on multiple public datasets show that UACR achieves over 5.16% improvement in accuracy compared to the baseline method, while reducing latency by over 31.5%. It also enhances the interpretability of industrial detection by over 15%.

AI.tldr: 提出UACR：一种不确定性感知的协同路由框架，用于可解释工业异常检测，在在线时延预算下自适应分配算力，兼顾准确率、效率与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 工业异常检测既需准确判别与可信解释，又受严格在线时延约束；现有方法对所有样本采用固定计算路径，难以在检测精度、推理效率与可解释性之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 两阶段框架。阶段I离线训练与路由超参搜索：学习异常检测模块并校准驱动路由的不确定性估计器；阶段II不确定性感知自适应路由：依据估计不确定性将各输入协同分发至不同检测路径，模糊样本获得更深层计算。
AI.result: 在多个公开数据集上，相较基线方法准确率提升超过5.16%，时延降低超过31.5%，工业检测可解释性提升超过15%。
AI.conclusion: 通过不确定性驱动的协同路由实现按样本自适应分配计算，可在在线预算内同时提升检测精度、降低延迟并增强可解释性，为可解释工业异常检测提供有效方案。

title: CAR3T: Generalizable Calibration-Guided Reference-View Attention Reuse for Multi-View 3D Transformers
summary: Feed-forward multi-view 3D reconstruction relies on global attention for cross-view aggregation, but the attention cost grows quadratically with the number of views, making inference increasingly expensive for larger inputs. Existing acceleration methods compress tokens or sparsify attention, potentially losing geometric detail or restricting cross-view aggregation while leaving redundancy among attention outputs underexploited. We observe similar cross-view attention distributions in certain layers, revealing an opportunity to reduce repeated global aggregation through output reuse. However, the layers suitable for reuse vary with the input, and reusing one layer alters the features received by later layers. Similarity at individual layers therefore cannot characterize the combined effect of multiple reuse decisions on output drift. To address these challenges, we propose CAR3T, a training-free framework combining reference-view attention output reuse with offline risk calibration and online dynamic layer selection. Calibration models cumulative reuse risk, while online selection adapts reuse to each input under a calibrated budget. CAR3T retains all input tokens and attends to the keys and values of all views, reducing the core attention computation in selected layers from quadratic to linear. Experiments on VGGT, DA3, and $π^3$ show forward speedups up to $1.41\times$ with at most 100 views and $1.75\times$ on longer sequences, with accuracy trade-offs across backbones and datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架CAR3T，通过参考视角注意力输出复用、离线风险校准与在线动态层选择，将前馈多视角3D重建中跨视角注意力的二次复杂度在选定层降为线性，在VGGT、DA3、π³上取得最高1.41×（≤100视角）和1.75×（更长序列）的加速。
AI.motivation: 前馈多视角3D重建依赖全局注意力进行跨视角聚合，其代价随视角数二次增长，大输入下推理昂贵。现有加速方法压缩token或稀疏化注意力，可能损失几何细节或限制跨视角聚合，且未充分利用注意力输出间的冗余。作者观察到某些层存在相似的跨视角注意力分布，提示可通过输出复用减少重复的全局聚合。
AI.method: 提出CAR3T免训练框架：结合参考视角注意力输出复用、离线风险校准与在线动态层选择。由于可复用层随输入变化、复用某一层会改变后续层接收的特征，单层相似度无法刻画多次复用决策对输出漂移的联合影响；因此用离线校准建模累积复用风险，在线选择在已校准预算下为每个输入自适应决定复用层。方法保留全部输入token并仍对所有视角的key/value进行注意力计算，仅将选定层的核心注意力计算由二次降为线性。
AI.result: 在VGGT、DA3和π³上的实验显示：最多100个视角时前向加速最高1.41×，更长序列上最高1.75×；不同骨干与数据集上存在精度权衡。
AI.conclusion: 跨视角注意力输出的层间冗余可被安全利用以加速多视角3D重建；结合累积风险校准与在线层选择，可在免训练条件下实现可变输入自适应的加速，但需在速度与精度间权衡。

title: VG3R: Video Generation Model for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
summary: Video generation models are widely used as 3D priors for novel view synthesis and 3D scene generation. Fine-tuned for perception, generation models also excel at dense prediction such as depth estimation. However, methods that apply video generation models to 3D reconstruction either predict depth without cameras or generate geometry and estimate cameras through many iterative denoising steps, which makes them slower. In this paper, we present $\textbf{VG3R}$, which turns a pretrained video generation model into a feed-forward 3D reconstruction model. Our key observation is that such a model already captures the depth and camera motion of a video, but not in the form required for reconstruction. We introduce two components: $\textit{clip-level shift prediction}$, which corrects depth distortion caused by the unknown shift in decoded inverse depth, and a $\textit{multi-layer camera head}$, which predicts per-frame cameras parameters by combining features across transformer blocks. Using Wan2.1 as its video backbone, VG3R reconstructs a scene and estimate the camera of every frame without iterative denoising. It achieves the lowest ATE and reconstruction errors among methods built on video generation models, runs about 4 and 14 times faster than Aether and Geo4D. VG3R also demonstrates competitive depth estimation and 3D reconstruction performance compared with geometry foundation models. Project page: https://github.com/KTH-RPL/VG3R

AI.tldr: VG3R 将预训练视频生成模型改造为前馈式 3D 重建模型，通过 clip 级 shift 预测与多层相机头，在无需迭代去噪的情况下同时重建场景并估计逐帧相机，速度与精度均优于现有视频生成模型方法。
AI.motivation: 现有将视频生成模型用于 3D 重建的方法存在缺陷：要么仅预测深度而不恢复相机，要么需通过大量迭代去噪步骤生成几何并估计相机，导致推理缓慢。作者认为预训练视频生成模型本身已内隐捕获了视频的深度与相机运动信息，只是其形式不适合直接用于重建。
AI.method: 以 Wan2.1 为视频骨干，引入两个模块：(1) clip 级 shift 预测，用于校正解码逆深度中未知 shift 导致的深度畸变；(2) 多层相机头，融合多个 transformer 块的特征以预测每帧相机参数，实现无迭代去噪的前馈式重建。
AI.result: 在基于视频生成模型的方法中取得最低 ATE 与重建误差，推理速度分别约为 Aether 的 4 倍、Geo4D 的 14 倍；深度估计与 3D 重建性能可与几何基础模型相媲美。
AI.conclusion: 验证了预训练视频生成模型可直接转化为高效前馈 3D 重建器，兼具精度与速度优势，为视频生成先验在几何任务中的应用提供了新路径。

title: VICA: Video Contextual Agreement for AIGC Video Detection and Localization
summary: The rapid advancement of AI-generated content (AIGC) video generation and editing technologies has raised growing societal concerns about the authenticity and reliability of digital videos. Existing video detection methods primarily exploit temporal inconsistencies through holistic frame-level representations, whereas manipulation localization methods focus on artifacts within individual spatial regions. However, holistic representations may obscure localized artifacts through global feature aggregation, while region-centric approaches may overlook disagreements between individual regions and their surrounding spatiotemporal context. To address these limitations, we propose VIdeo Contextual Agreement (VICA), a unified framework that masks individual video regions and leverages a frozen V-JEPA model to predict their representations from the surrounding spatiotemporal context. Complementary masking ensures complete regional coverage, while context-conditioned predictions establish references for assessing regional agreement with the broader video context. By comparing predicted and observed representations, VICA derives spatial residuals that characterize intra-frame discrepancies and bidirectional temporal residuals that capture inconsistencies across preceding and subsequent frames. These residuals characterize contextual disagreements, providing a shared forensic representation for both tasks and shifting the focus from identifying isolated manipulation artifacts to assessing regional agreement with expectations inferred from the broader video context. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VICA achieves state-of-the-art performance on both tasks across multiple benchmarks, with strong generalization to unseen video generators and editing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出VICA统一框架，通过掩码区域并由冻结的V-JEPA从时空上下文预测其表示，比较预测与观测表示得到空间与双向时间残差，作为视频真伪检测与篡改定位的共享取证表示，在两任务多个基准上达SOTA并具强泛化性。
AI.motivation: AIGC视频生成与编辑技术发展引发对视频真实性的担忧。现有视频检测方法依赖整体帧级表示挖掘时序不一致，会因全局特征聚合而掩盖局部伪影；篡改定位方法聚焦单个空间区域的伪影，却忽视区域与其周围时空上下文的不一致性。两类方法各有盲区，缺乏统一视角。
AI.method: VICA对视频区域进行互补掩码以保证区域全覆盖，利用冻结的V-JEPA模型从周围时空上下文预测被掩码区域的表示；将预测表示与观测表示对比，得到刻画帧内差异的空间残差，以及刻画前后帧不一致性的双向时间残差。这些残差构成上下文不一致性度量，作为检测与定位两任务的共享取证表示。
AI.result: 在多个基准上于视频真伪检测与篡改定位两项任务均取得state-of-the-art性能，并对未见过的视频生成器和编辑方法表现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将取证焦点从识别孤立篡改伪影转向评估区域与由更广视频上下文推断出的期望之间的一致性，为两类任务提供统一表示，验证了上下文一致性建模范式的有效性。

title: Close the Loop on the Retrievability Gap
summary: A frozen vision-language encoder now guides image restoration and later indexes what it produced. Over a fixed set of eighteen pansharpening systems on one WorldView-III test set, the fidelity index that ranks them, $Q2^n$ with a reference and HQNR without one, picks the less retrievable of two systems one time in three and one in two; the disagreement lies between the pixel-supervised and the language-conditioned family, and even the best system falls short of the reference, small objects first. We call this the retrievability gap and trace it to the area weighting of position-averaged losses. LEDGER closes the loop around the encoder: it indexes the input into a set of named concepts, generates, re-encodes the output alone with the same frozen encoder, and minimises a set-level soft-Jaccard loss on the coverage of that set, a label-free target available at test time, so that every present concept of a scale receives a gradient share independent of its area. Measured outside the loop by label-grounded probes, held-out retrievers, language-free evaluators, detectors and human raters, LEDGER matches or exceeds the strongest baselines in fidelity on four sensors, raises retrieval by seven to nine points within its vocabulary and two to five outside it, closes two thirds of the reduced-resolution gap to the reference, lifts extraction on raw SpaceNet imagery above the vendor product in each of four cities, and transfers to existing generators as a training-only loss at no inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可检索性鸿沟"（retrievability gap）现象：用于引导图像复原的冻结视觉-语言编码器，在后期索引其输出时与像素级保真度指标（Q2^n/HQNR）的系统排序不一致；并提出LEDGER——以概念集合覆盖的soft-Jaccard损失闭合编码器回路，消除面积加权偏置。
AI.motivation: 冻结的视觉-语言编码器既为图像复原提供引导，又用于检索其产物。在18个全色锐化系统的固定对比中，保真度指标（有参考的Q2^n、无参考的HQNR）在1/3与1/2的情形下选出可检索性较差的系统，分歧主要出现在像素监督族与语言条件族之间；即使最优系统也逊于参考，且小目标最先受影响。作者将此归因于位置平均损失的面积加权问题。
AI.method: LEDGER围绕冻结编码器构建闭环：将输入索引为一组命名概念；仅对生成的输出用同一冻结编码器重新编码；在该概念集合覆盖率上最小化集合级soft-Jaccard损失。目标无标签、测试时可用，使每个尺度上出现的概念获得与面积无关的梯度份额。并在环外以标签锚定探针、留出检索器、无语言评测器、检测器与人工评分进行评估。
AI.result: 四个传感器上保真度匹配或超越最强基线；在其词表内检索提升7–9点，词表外2–5点；缩小三分之二的降分辨率差距；在四个城市的原始SpaceNet影像上提取效果均超过厂商产品；可作为仅训练损失迁移到现有生成器，推理零开销。
AI.conclusion: 位置平均损失的面积加权是保真度指标与可检索性脱节的根源；以集合级概念覆盖损失闭合编码器回路，可在无标签条件下同时改善保真度与可检索性，并具良好迁移性与零推理成本。

title: Seeing the Invisible: How Vision-Language Models Read, Predict and Trace Radio Fields
summary: Operating in the physical world requires reasoning beyond what cameras directly capture. In a city, radio signals are invisible to the lens, yet their strength is governed by the buildings and streets an image does show. Given only these visible structures, can vision-language models (VLMs) infer the invisible radio field they shape? Probing true physical reasoning requires exact fields in real cities, alongside controlled interventions where a single physical factor changes. We build a label-free engine that turns any coordinate on Earth into a ray-traceable city, simulates matched single-factor counterfactuals, and computes every answer exactly. This yields RadioVISTA, a benchmark and training dataset for visual reasoning about invisible fields. Physically, a radio field is the sum of its propagation paths, yet across six continents we uncover a striking field-path dissociation: frontier VLMs accurately judge where a field is strong, but fail to tell whether a single direct or one-wall path exists. Open models fail even earlier at reading the field itself, and are systematically wrong, scoring below random guessing even when credited for any of four attempts. On unseen cities, fine-tuning brings a 9B open model close to frontier proprietary models on fields, yet neither supervised nor reinforcement fine-tuning improves path tracing. Supervising only final answers teaches models to approximate the field, yet leaves single-path geometry out of reach.

AI.tldr: 提出 RadioVISTA 基准与数据集，用可光线追踪的城市模拟器生成精确无线电场的单因素反事实样本，揭示前沿视觉语言模型存在"场-路径解离"现象：能判断场强弱却无法识别单条传播路径，且微调无法改善路径追踪。
AI.motivation: 物理世界推理需超越图像直接可见内容。城市中无线电信号不可见，但其强度由图像中可见的建筑与街道结构决定。检验真正的物理推理需要真实城市的精确场分布以及对单一物理因素进行控制干预的数据，而现有资源缺失。
AI.method: 构建无标注引擎：将地球任意坐标转化为可光线追踪的城市，模拟匹配的单因素反事实，并精确计算所有答案。据此生成 RadioVISTA 基准与训练数据集，覆盖六大洲，用于关于不可见场的视觉推理评测。评测前沿及开源 VLM，并比较监督微调与强化微调效果。
AI.result: 发现显著的"场-路径解离"：前沿 VLM 能准确判断场强位置，却无法判断单条直射路径或单次反射路径是否存在；开源模型在读取场本身阶段即失败，系统性错误，即使给予四次尝试中任一正确计入，得分仍低于随机猜测。在未见城市上，微调使 9B 开源模型在场预测上接近前沿闭源模型，但监督与强化微调均未提升路径追踪能力。
AI.conclusion: 仅监督最终答案使模型学会近似场分布，却无法掌握单路径几何。表明当前 VLM 的物理推理依赖表层场统计而非传播几何机制，路径级物理推理仍是开放难题。

title: RALC: Risk-Controlled Local Adoption of Segmentation Updates with Few Calibration Images
summary: Fine-tuning a road-scene segmenter for rain and nighttime driving can introduce errors on normal daytime images. With few labeled normal images for calibration, a whole-image risk check may reject changes that would pass if adopted locally. Risk-Controlled Adoption of Label Changes (RALC) selects local changes from a fixed model update, using confidence differences and an image score to form nested candidates. On each normal calibration image, RALC measures how many more errors each candidate makes than the original model, assigning zero loss when errors stay the same or fall. At test time, each replacement can add at most one error, so the replacement count bounds the net increase without test labels. RALC combines this candidate-dependent bound with recorded calibration losses to select the largest set that passes the risk check. If the models and adoption rules are fixed before calibration and normal calibration and test images are exchangeable, the expected per-image loss stays within budget. On held-out BDD100K, we evaluated three weight-interpolated updates with 10 additional normal images per calibration draw. At a common fixed budget, adverse-scene mIoU was 1.89--3.19 percentage points higher with RALC than with whole-image adoption, while measured mean normal loss was also higher. After matching this loss post hoc at 1,000 pixels per image, RALC still led by 1.135--2.428 points. Selecting changes in $8\times8$-pixel cells recovered 93--98% of this advantage. With 250 calibration images at the original budget, both rules adopted all three updates in full.

AI.tldr: RALC提出一种"局部采纳"的风险控制规则：在少量正常图像校准下，从固定模型更新中挑选局部改动，使正常图像期望损失不超过预算，同时在雨天/夜间场景获得更高mIoU。
AI.motivation: 针对雨天与夜间路景分割微调后的模型会引入正常白天图像上的误差；而标注的正常图像很少，整图级风险检查会拒绝那些若局部采纳本可通过的改动。
AI.method: 基于置信度差异与图像分数构造嵌套候选改动；在每张正常校准图上统计每个候选相对原模型的额外错误数，误差不增时记零损失；测试时每个替换至多增加一个错误，故替换数量给出无标签的净损失上界；将该候选相关上界与校准损失结合，选出通过风险检查的最大集合（在8×8像素单元内选择改动）。
AI.result: 在held-out BDD100K上，对三个权重插值更新、每次校准抽10张额外正常图像：相同固定预算下，恶劣场景mIoU比整图采纳高1.89–3.19个百分点，但正常损失也更高；事后在每图1000像素处匹配损失后，RALC仍领先1.135–2.428点；8×8像素单元选择保留93–98%的优势；250张校准图时两规则均完整采纳全部三个更新。
AI.conclusion: 局部化的风险控制采纳可在极少正常校准图像下兼顾正常场景风险预算与恶劣场景性能提升；其保证依赖模型与采纳规则预先固定、校准与测试图像可交换的假设。

title: Separating Module Gain From Transport Plan Contribution in Audio-Visual Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition
summary: A cross-modal routing module can improve over its backbone while its transport plan accounts for no demonstrable part of that improvement. In ABVnet with DFEW, Sinkhorn cross-modal routing (SCR) exceeds the retrained baseline by 0.87 unweighted average recall (UAR) points, a resolved difference, yet sits 0.17 points above an individually trained, parameter-matched pooled variant, an unresolved difference that establishes no equivalence; under the development protocol the comparison with the baseline reverses. Separating the two needs comparisons a module-against-backbone test cannot supply: parameter-matched variants changing only the plan rule, and interventions replacing the plan without retraining. The evaluation covers MMA-DFER and ABVnet on DFEW and MAFW, and MMA-DFER on CREMA-D, with a single training run per configuration and paired fold intervals. ABVnet with DFEW motivated the follow-up after the broader results were available. Replacing the plan everywhere with a uniform one reduces UAR by 0.72, whereas permuting its rows gives an unresolved difference of -0.20 UAR points; permutation is less damaging by 0.51 UAR points, a resolved contrast. Replacing the plan with the product of its own marginals, preserving both marginals and removing only frame-specific mixtures, reduces UAR by 0.70. These reductions concern reliance at inference; attribution of the module gain to the transport plan remains unestablished. Under the 1.5 fold-dependence widening, the baseline gain remains resolved, whereas the replacement reductions and the paired contrast are unresolved.

AI.tldr: 该研究以参数匹配变体与免重训练干预检验跨模态路由模块的增益是否来自传输计划本身，结论是：模块对外部基线有效，但增益无法被归因于传输计划。
AI.motivation: 跨模态路由模块常被报告优于骨干网络，但其增益是否真由传输计划（transport plan）贡献缺乏证据；模块对基线的比较无法回答这一问题。
AI.method: 在MMA-DFER与ABVnet上，于DFEW、MAFW及CREMA-D上评估；每配置单次训练、配对折区间。采用两类补充比较：(1) 参数匹配的变体，仅改变计划规则（均匀计划、行置换计划、边际乘积计划）；(2) 不重训练的推理期干预，直接替换计划。
AI.result: ABVnet+DFEW上，Sinkhorn跨模态路由（SCR）较重训基线提升0.87 UAR（显著），但仅高于参数匹配池化变体0.17（不显著，无法确立等价性）；开发协议下与基线的比较反转。推理期替换计划：均匀计划降0.72 UAR，行置换降0.20（不显著），置换比完全替换少损伤0.51（显著）；边际乘积计划降0.70。在1.5倍折依赖放宽下，基线增益仍显著，而替换效应与配对对比均不显著。
AI.conclusion: 上述降幅仅反映推理期对计划的依赖，模块增益向传输计划的归因仍未确立；模块-基线比较不足以支撑机制性结论，需参数匹配变体与无重训练干预共同检验。

title: Seeing Beyond Pixels: Radar Feature Generation from Images and Sparse Returns
summary: Camera-radar fusion benefits from complementary visual and geometric information but often relies on complete radar representations, leading to substantial computing overhead. However, the extent to which visual information can compensate for limited radar measurements remains insufficiently explored. Therefore, we propose Vision-informed Radar Token Generation (VRTG), which exploits cross-modal information to generate task-relevant radar features from camera images and sparse radar measurements. Specifically, VRTG first leverages image-derived object cues to select a limited number of informative radar points. It then establishes calibrated one-to-one associations between visual objects and radar returns, using matched measurements to refine object ranges while retaining visual estimates for unmatched objects. Finally, the associated object features and visual context are transformed into radar tokens compatible with existing camera-radar fusion networks. Experiments on RADIal demonstrate that VRTG achieves 90.76\% vehicle-detection F1 and 86.68\% free-space mIoU using only four radar points per frame, approaching the performance of the full-radar model.

AI.tldr: 提出VRTG，用相机图像信息引导生成任务相关的雷达token，仅需每帧4个雷达点即可接近完整雷达模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 相机-雷达融合虽能互补视觉与几何信息，但通常依赖完整雷达表示，计算开销大；而视觉信息能在多大程度上补偿有限雷达测量，尚缺乏充分探索。
AI.method: VRTG分三步：①利用图像派生目标线索选取少量有信息量的雷达点；②建立视觉目标与雷达回波之间经过标定的一对一关联，用匹配测量精化目标距离，未匹配目标保留视觉估计；③将关联目标特征与视觉上下文转换为与现有相机-雷达融合网络兼容的雷达token。
AI.result: 在RADIal数据集上，每帧仅用4个雷达点即达到90.76%车辆检测F1与86.68%自由空间mIoU，接近完整雷达模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 视觉信息可有效补偿稀疏雷达测量，通过跨模态生成任务相关雷达token显著降低雷达表示的计算开销。

title: PhoneQC: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Order-Level Smartphone Trade-in Inspection
summary: As vision-language models enter remote smartphone trade-in, sellers already upload six views and a diagnostic screen, which makes it easy to treat the human quote as a step a model can take over. A model may mark a crack or read the screen, yet the quote is a staff form: appearance fill stays near 0.25, and the closed models that score a little higher do so only on the orders they answer, so human appraisal remains necessary. Two obstacles stand in the way. (1) Single-view defect sets and attribute benchmarks do not score an order-level form under a fixed input contract, so a box or a leaked field can be mistaken for a finished quote. (2) The unread half of the form is the staff fields, and a model left to emit boxes or captions does not learn them. We present PhoneQC, a 335-order iPhone-heavy cut that ranks systems by a 0 to 100 form score (Score100) only inside matched protocols (images alone; images plus a detector sidecar), with a declared upper bound that is not ranked as a peer. As a case study on that board, field-only LoRA freezes the backbone, adapts attention projections, and supervises staff fields while leaving the defect list empty; the adapter sees the same images as the zero-shot model. On image-only T1 the 3B model rises from 26.6 to 33.3 at coverage 0.928; without the empty-blocker item the open ranking still favors the adapter, while the remaining gap to a person stays large on this cut.

AI.tldr: 提出 PhoneQC 评测基准（335 单 iPhone 为主的订单），用 0–100 的订单级表单得分 Score100 在匹配协议下排序系统，并以 field-only LoRA 作为案例验证。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型进入二手手机回收场景后，存在误把"定位裂纹/读屏幕"当作"完成报价"的风险：单视图缺陷集与属性基准无法在固定输入契约下评测订单级表单，且表单中人工填写的字段（staff fields）在仅输出框或描述的训练下学不到。
AI.method: 构建 335 订单的订单级表单评测与 Score100 打分体系，仅在匹配协议（仅图像；图像 + 检测器 sidecar）内排序，并声明一个不参与排序的上界；案例采用 field-only LoRA：冻结主干、适配注意力投影、监督 staff 字段而缺陷列表留空。
AI.result: 在 image-only T1 上，3B 模型从 26.6 提升至 33.3，覆盖率 0.928；去除 empty-blocker 项后开放排序仍偏向该适配器，但与人工之间的差距依旧显著。
AI.conclusion: 订单级报价尚不能由模型替代人工，需在固定输入契约下用表单级评分评估并明确覆盖与上界，人工评估仍不可少。

title: Is It the Agent or the Retry? Separating Selection from Agency in Text-to-Image Generation
summary:
Agentic text-to-image systems wrap generators in loops of planning, routing, verification and refinement, and report large gains on compositional benchmarks, almost always relative to a single sample. We ask how much of the gain survives against Single-tool Rejection Retry (\ours): the strongest generator already in the system's pool, an off-the-shelf verifier, and retries that stop at the first accepted image under the system's own budget. Auditing four recent systems with official evaluators, we find that on GenEval SRR matches the accuracy of OctoT2I (0.962 vs.\ 0.96), recovers 63 to 90% of the gain of GEMS depending on the verifier, and exceeds GenPilot by 12 points with 2.3 generations per image; the effect persists with generators not tuned to the benchmark and on T2I-CompBench++. A closed-form analysis predicts the accuracy of SRR at every budget and shows that its gain is capped by the verifier's likelihood ratio. The same analysis also exposes genuine agentic gains: on GenEval 2, even the best of five samples chosen by the evaluator stays 15 points below the score GEMS reports (12 at the upper end of its 95% interval). We prove a ceiling on the accuracy that routing across generators can add, bracket it between one and three points on OctoT2I's own pool, and show that what OctoT2I's routing buys is compute (about 2.5
  less than SRR at equal accuracy), not accuracy. In our offline distillation experiments selected samples teach the generator no more than random ones, which a short information argument explains. We end with a reporting checklist for agentic generation papers.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Single-tool Rejection Retry (SRR) 基线：用系统池内最强生成器+现成校验器，在相同预算下"拒绝-重试"直到首个通过样本。审计四个 Agentic T2I 系统后发现，其组合性基准上的增益大部分可被 SRR 复现；真正的 agentic 增益仅体现在 GenEval 2 等更难任务与计算效率上，并给出理论上限与报告清单。
AI.motivation: 当前 Agentic 文生图系统（规划、路由、验证、精炼构成的循环）报告的增益几乎都相对于单次采样，缺乏与"简单但强"基线的公平对比，因此难以判断增益究竟来自 agentic 架构还是来自更多采样预算与验证器筛选。
AI.method: 1) 构建 SRR 基线：池内最强生成器 + 现成校验器 + 首个接受即停的重试，匹配各系统自身预算（如 2.3 次生成/图）；2) 用官方评测器复现 GenEval、T2I-CompBench++、GenEval 2 上的四个系统；3) 闭式分析预测任意预算下 SRR 准确率并给出校验器似然比决定的上限；4) 证明跨生成器路由的准确率增益上界；5) 离线蒸馏实验对比"精选样本"与"随机样本"的训练效果；6) 提出报告清单。
AI.result: GenEval 上 SRR 达 0.962，与 OctoT2I 的 0.96 持平，回收 GEMS 增益的 63%–90%（依校验器而定），并以 2.3 次生成/图超出 GenPilot 12 分；结论在非基准调优生成器与 T2I-CompBench++ 上稳健。GenEval 2 上，即便校验器从五个样本中挑最优，仍比 GEMS 低 15 分（其 95% 区间上端也低 12 分），说明存在真实 agentic 增益。路由的准确率增益被界定在 1–3 分，OctoT2I 的路由实际换来的是约 2.5 倍计算节省而非准确率。离线蒸馏中精选样本与随机样本效果无差异。
AI.conclusion: 多数 Agentic T2I 在组合性基准上的报告增益可由单一生成器+校验器重试基线复现，属"采样+筛选"而非架构性收益；真实收益集中于更困难基准与计算效率。基准对比必须匹配预算、报告校验器质量，并附报告清单。

title: Scale-Aware Reference Attention for Mannequin-to-Model Gown Generation
summary: Formal gowns are sold online with photos of models wearing them, and buyers zoom in to inspect sequins, lace and beading. Image editors can turn a photo of a gown on a mannequin into a convincing photo of a person wearing it, but they receive every reference photo without any notion of its magnification, and the fine detail of the gown is lost when the output is viewed up close. We propose scale-aware reference attention (SARA), which tells an open diffusion transformer the zoom level of the output and of every reference photo, biases the attention of the output toward references of a similar zoom level, uses macro photos of the fabric as references, and is trained on a mix of whole-garment and zoomed targets. To train and evaluate it, we introduce Kiss3000, a dataset of 915 high-resolution mannequin photos and 2274 on-model photos of formal gowns with cross-domain pairs and splits by style, and zoom-crop evaluation, which compares garment crops at full, half and local scale without pixel alignment and judges local fidelity with two vision-language models gated on control crops. With this protocol, Nano Banana Pro at 4K, the highest-resolution commercial editor we test, loses or redraws local detail on 14 of 20 test gowns. At 1536x2048 pixels, both judges prefer SARA over a LoRA fine-tuning baseline on 18 test items and the baseline on 6 (p=0.023), and over the base model on 26 against 4 (p=5.9e-5), while SARA keeps the gown design as often as the baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出尺度感知参考注意力（SARA），让扩散Transformer感知输出与每张参考图的放大倍率，并偏向匹配尺度的参考，从而实现高分辨率服装细节保真；同时发布Kiss3000数据集与缩放裁剪评测协议。
AI.motivation: 在线礼服的细节（亮片、蕾丝、珠饰）需要放大检视，但现有图像编辑方法对参考图的放大倍率一无所知，输出放大后细节丢失或被重绘。即便最高分辨率的商用编辑器（Nano Banana Pro，4K）在20件测试礼服中也有14件丢失或重绘局部细节。
AI.method: 提出SARA（scale-aware reference attention）：向开放式扩散Transformer注入输出图与每张参考图的缩放级别，使输出注意力偏向相似缩放级别的参考；使用织物的微距照片作为参考；在整件服装与放大目标混合数据上训练。构建Kiss3000数据集：915张高分辨率假人模特照片与2274张真人模特礼服照片，含跨域配对并按风格划分。提出zoom-crop评测：在整体、半局部和局部尺度比较服装裁剪，无需像素对齐，并由两个视觉语言模型在控制裁剪门控下评判局部保真度。
AI.result: 在1536x2048像素下，两个评判模型在18件测试项上更偏好SARA而非LoRA微调基线、在6件上更偏好基线（p=0.023）；与基座模型相比为26对4（p=5.9e-5）。同时，SARA保持服装设计的成功率与基线相当。
AI.conclusion: 尺度感知的参考注意力与微距参考能显著提升局部细节保真度，且不牺牲设计保持性；缩放裁剪评测协议可有效衡量多尺度细节生成质量。

title: ORDO: Fine-Grained Motion Understanding in Video LLMs via Order-Dependent Supervision
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: Video large language models (video LLMs) answer a wide range of questions about real videos, yet they remain weak at fine-grained motion such as whether an object speeds up or slows down. Existing methods train these models on synthetic motion clips, on order pretext tasks such as reordering shuffled clips, or with rewards that compare ordered and perturbed frames. None of them requires that the label be unrecoverable from the frames once their order is discarded, so a model can fit such data from static cues without learning to use frame order. We propose ORDO, a framework that builds this requirement into the training data. We define order-necessary supervision as data in which the unordered set of frames has the same distribution under competing labels, and we realise it for motion attributes with three constructions, time-reversal pairing, matched spatial extent and uniform interval coverage. A procedural curriculum of six motion primitives instantiates these constructions, and low-rank adapters of the language model are trained on it with an answer-level objective and self-distillation replay on real videos. With 4,000 synthetic clips, ORDO raises the mean accuracy over four motion benchmarks by +7.6, +4.9 and +5.1 points on Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3-VL-8B and Molmo2-8B, while the same training with shuffled frames changes it by less than one point. Code and generator will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出ORDO框架，通过构造"顺序必要性监督"数据（无序帧集在竞争标签下同分布），使视频LLM必须依赖帧序才能学会细粒度运动判别。
AI.motivation: 现有视频LLM在细粒度运动（如物体加速/减速）上表现薄弱；已有做法依赖合成运动片段、打乱片段重排等顺序借口任务或对比有序/扰动帧的奖励，但这些数据在丢弃帧序后标签仍可从静态线索中恢复，模型可"走捷径"而不真正利用帧序。
AI.method: 将需求内建于训练数据：定义order-necessary supervision，即无序帧集合在竞争标签下分布相同；用三种构造实现——时间反转配对、匹配空间范围、均匀间隔覆盖；以六种运动原语的程序化课程实例化，仅训练语言模型低秩适配器，采用答案级目标并在真实视频上做自蒸馏回放。
AI.result: 仅用4,000个合成片段，在四个运动基准上平均准确率分别提升+7.6、+4.9、+5.1点（Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3-VL-8B、Molmo2-8B）；而同等训练但打乱帧序时变化不足1点，验证增益确实来自帧序利用。
AI.conclusion: 数据构造（而非数据量或任务形式）是让视频LLM习得顺序依赖运动表征的关键；打乱帧序的对照实验证明性能提升源于对帧序的利用。

title: Domain-Specific Self-Supervised Learning for Cuneiform Sign Representation
comment: Accepted at the VisionDocs Workshop at WACV 2027
summary: Recognizing cuneiform signs is challenging: sign shapes vary across historical periods, scribal practices, and preservation conditions, while expert annotations are scarce. We study whether domain-specific self-supervised pretraining yields better cuneiform sign representations than generic natural-image pretraining. We pretrain a masked autoencoder, CuneiMAE, on over 900K unlabeled sign crops and compare it with ImageNet-pretrained MAE, CLIP, and DINOv2 on a 218-class sign recognition benchmark. CuneiMAE learns substantially stronger frozen representations (43.7% linear-probe accuracy vs. 25.2% for ImageNet-MAE), with gains over ImageNet-MAE on cross-period transfer. Under fine-tuning, CuneiMAE outperforms ImageNet-pretrained baselines on our internal benchmark, with the largest gains when labels are scarce (+20.4 pp over ImageNet-MAE with 1% of labels). On an external benchmark, CuneiMAE reaches 69.9% top-1 accuracy after fine-tuning, about 8 pp above the ResNet-18 baseline from prior work. Explicit structural priors, such as edge-guided masking and part bottlenecks, do not improve over standard masked reconstruction. Overall, domain-specific self-supervision shows strong performance on cuneiform recognition tasks, particularly when labels are limited.

AI.tldr: 提出领域自监督预训练模型 CuneiMAE，在90万+楔形文字字符图像上训练掩码自编码器，显著优于ImageNet预训练的MAE/CLIP/DINOv2，尤其在标签稀缺场景。
AI.motivation: 楔形文字符号辨识困难：字形随历史时期、书吏习惯和保存状况变化，且专家标注稀缺。作者希望验证领域特定的自监督预训练能否学到比通用自然图像预训练更好的楔形文字符号表征。
AI.method: 在90万余张无标注字符裁剪图上预训练掩码自编码器 CuneiMAE；与 ImageNet 预训练的 MAE、CLIP、DINOv2 在218类符号识别基准上对比，评估线性探测、跨时期迁移与不同标注比例下的微调性能；并测试边引导掩码、部件瓶颈等显式结构先验。
AI.result: 冻结表征显著更强：线性探测 43.7% vs. ImageNet-MAE 25.2%；跨时期迁移有增益；微调后在内部基准优于 ImageNet 预训练基线，1% 标注下较 ImageNet-MAE 提升 20.4 个百分点；外部基准微调后 top-1 达 69.9%，较先前 ResNet-18 基线高约 8 个百分点。边引导掩码、部件瓶颈等结构先验未带来提升。
AI.conclusion: 领域特定自监督在楔形文字识别任务上表现优异，尤其在标签有限时；标准掩码重建已足够，额外结构先验收益不明显。

title: When Local Semantics Disagree: Learning to Detect Fake News through Weakly Supervised Cross-Modal Reasoning
summary: The rapid proliferation of multimodal social media content has made fake news detection a pressing challenge for the vision-language community. Most existing approaches rely on coarse global similarity between text and images, which overlooks subtle, uneven cross-modal inconsistencies -- such as sentiment-scene mismatches, object-level manipulations, or semantic dissonance between visual and textual cues. Moreover, these models treat all inconsistencies as equally informative, ignoring domain-specific variation in how such conflicts manifest, which limits both generalization and interpretability. To address these challenges, we propose DMIL, a dual-branch multiple instance learning framework that formulates multimodal fake news detection as a weakly supervised learning problem. Each news article is treated as a bag of visual and textual instances processed through two complementary branches: an embedding-space branch that aggregates global semantics via expert-guided modality fusion, and an instance-space branch that models cross-modal inconsistencies across local-to-global granularities. A retrieval-augmented, domain-adaptive router further contextualizes inconsistencies using retrieved domain exemplars and dynamically fuses multi-level cues. Extensive experiments on public misinformation benchmarks demonstrate that DMIL achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance and demonstrates strong discriminative capability against fake news across different domains.

AI.tldr: 提出双分支多实例学习框架DMIL，将多模态假新闻检测建模为弱监督问题，通过嵌入空间与实例空间两条互补分支捕捉细粒度跨模态不一致性，并用检索增强的域自适应路由器动态融合多层级线索，在公开基准上取得有竞争力的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态假新闻检测方法依赖文本与图像间的粗粒度全局相似度，忽略了细微且不均匀的跨模态不一致（如情感-场景错配、对象级操纵、语义失谐）；同时将所有不一致视为同等信息量，忽视不同领域冲突表现方式的差异，限制了泛化性与可解释性。
AI.method: DMIL为双分支多实例学习框架：将每篇新闻视为由视觉与文本实例构成的"包"；嵌入空间分支通过专家引导的模态融合聚合全局语义；实例空间分支在局部到全局粒度上建模跨模态不一致；并引入检索增强、域自适应的路由器，利用检索到的域样例为不一致性提供上下文，动态融合多层级线索。
AI.result: 在多个公开虚假信息基准上实验表明，DMIL取得具有竞争力的SOTA性能，并在不同领域对假新闻展现出强判别能力。
AI.conclusion: 将假新闻检测转化为弱监督多实例学习，并显式建模细粒度、领域相关的跨模态不一致，可有效提升检测性能与跨域泛化能力。

title: Plan Big, Paint Small: Semantic-Aware Computation Allocation for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion streams a video chunk by chunk, but large AR models are too slow for real-time use. We ask where in an AR rollout a large model is actually needed. Pairing Krea-Realtime-14B with Self-Forcing-1.3B, which share their latent space and denoising schedule, we find that the order of the two models matters: when the 14B model generates only the first chunk and the 1.3B model continues, the rollout keeps 95\% of the 14B model's semantic advantage, whereas the reverse allocation keeps 16\% at about ten times the cost. The large model decides what the video shows; the small model only has to carry it forward. We turn this into BigSmall, a training-free planner--renderer sampler. The 14B model plans the opening chunk and sketches the chunks in which content changes, which preserves motion, and the 1.3B model renders the rest; a faster variant, BigSmall, plans only the opening chunk. A cross-model KV cache that is approximate, windowed and lazy lets the planner leave and re-enter the rollout at low cost. On VBench, BigSmall is $3.02\times$ faster than the 14B model at an unchanged semantic score and motion, and $1.55\times$ faster than SDVG, which lets the small model draft first; BigSmall reaches $3.77\times$ at the same semantic score, trading away 10\% of the motion. On minute-long videos (LoCoT2V-Bench), where the 14B model degrades when it reads its own long history, BigSmall is $3.14\times$ faster than the 14B model and scores higher ($+1.78$).`

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的BigSmall规划-渲染采样器：大模型只规划首个chunk（及内容变化处），小模型持续渲染，配合跨模型近似KV缓存，在保持语义与运动的同时实现约3倍加速。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散逐块生成，但大模型过慢难以实时。作者追问：在一次AR rollout中，究竟哪里真的需要大模型？
AI.method: 以共享隐空间与去噪调度的Krea-Realtime-14B与Self-Forcing-1.3B配对实验，发现模型顺序决定效果；据此设计免训练planner–renderer采样器BigSmall：14B规划首块并草绘内容变化块以保留运动，1.3B渲染其余；并引入近似、窗口化、惰性的跨模型KV缓存，使规划器低代价进出rollout。另有仅规划首块的快速变体。
AI.result: 14B仅生成首块、1.3B续接可保留95%语义优势，反序仅16%且约10倍开销。VBench上BigSmall比14B快3.02倍且语义分与运动不变，比SDVG快1.55倍；快速变体达3.77倍加速、损失10%运动。分钟级LoCoT2V-Bench上比14B快3.14倍且分数+1.78（14B读取自身长历史时性能退化）。
AI.conclusion: 大模型决定视频内容、小模型负责延续；将计算按"规划/渲染"角色分配即可在几乎不损质量下大幅加速，并缓解长视频中自回归模型的长期历史退化问题。

title: TOGO: Take One Image Editor, Get One Video Editor for Free
summary: Instruction-based image editors are trained on millions of edit pairs and follow instructions far more reliably than current video editors. We show that this ability can be transferred to video editing without any training. Our key observation is that a growing number of image editors and video generators share the same latent space. Their velocity fields can therefore be combined at sampling time: the difference between the editor's velocity under the instruction and under a neutral prompt, which we call the \emph{edit velocity}, can be added to the sampler of a video model. Added naively, however, it blurs the video, alters the background and flickers. An analysis of the edit velocity explains why. It is small and reliable only at coarse scales and high noise levels, not concentrated on the edited object, and uncorrelated across frames. From these properties, we derive a simple guidance operator that amplifies the edit velocity and restricts it in noise level, space, and time. The video model then turns the incoherent per-frame signal into a temporally coherent edit. Our method, TOGO, combines Qwen-Image-Edit with the Wan2.1 video model without training or fine-tuning. On FiVE-Bench, it raises the edit success rate from 47.0\% (the same video model without the editor) to 65.6\%, above the best published method (59.2\%). At the same time, it maintains the background PSNR and obtains the best LPIPS and SSIM of all methods. Because the video editor is assembled at inference time, it can be upgraded to any newer image editor that shares the latent space with no cost.

AI.tldr: TOGO 通过在采样阶段组合共享潜空间的图像编辑器与视频生成器的速度场，并设计放大与约束引导算子，实现免训练、免微调的视频编辑，在 FiVE-Bench 上把编辑成功率从 47.0% 提升到 65.6%，超越最优已发表方法（59.2%）。
AI.motivation: 基于指令的图像编辑器经海量编辑对训练，指令遵循能力远强于现有视频编辑器；而视频编辑缺乏同等质量的训练数据与模型，因此希望把这部分能力迁移到视频领域，且不引入额外训练成本。
AI.method: 核心观察：越来越多图像编辑器与视频生成器共享同一潜空间，因此其速度场可在采样时组合。定义"编辑速度"为编辑器在指令下与中性提示下的速度之差，并将其注入视频模型采样器。直接叠加会导致画面模糊、背景改变与闪烁；分析表明编辑速度仅在粗尺度、高噪声水平下小而可靠，不集中在被编辑对象上，且帧间不相关。据此设计简单引导算子，在噪声水平、空间与时间三个维度上放大并限制编辑速度，由视频模型把逐帧不一致信号转化为时间连贯的编辑。最终方法 TOGO 将 Qwen-Image-Edit 与 Wan2.1 组合，全程无需训练或微调。
AI.result: 在 FiVE-Bench 上编辑成功率由 47.0%（同视频模型不使用编辑器）提升至 65.6%，超过最佳已发表方法（59.2%）；同时保持背景 PSNR，并在所有方法中取得最优 LPIPS 与 SSIM。
AI.conclusion: 由于视频编辑器在推理阶段即被"组装"，任何共享同一潜空间的更新版图像编辑器都可零成本替换升级，方法具备良好的可扩展性与复用性。

title: CrossPanel: Exposing the Answer-Evidence Gap in Scientific Figure Understanding
summary: A correct answer to a scientific-figure question can conceal an incorrect account of the experiment. Reading evidence across panels requires keeping each observation attached to the object and conditions that give it meaning. We introduce CrossPanel, a benchmark of 2,650 human-reviewed questions that exposes this answer-evidence gap. Its tasks combine parallel observations or follow dependent queries, while a response audit separates object selection, experimental conditions, cross-panel binding, and local readout. Across 15 vision-language models on 251 diagnostic questions, 8.42%-56.64% of correct answers contain explicit factual errors. The audit distinguishes coherent readings of the wrong target from incorrect readings of the right one. Controlled interventions then test how these failures can be repaired: verified object-condition hints, which withhold the requested measurement, raise Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's target-query success by 22.81 percentage points on 57 questions, while additional image tiles alone yield little improvement. Other models benefit most from combining both forms of assistance. These findings identify experimental attribution as a distinct requirement alongside local perception, and make both measurable beyond final-answer accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CrossPanel 基准（2,650 道人工复核题目），揭示科学图表问答中"答案正确但证据解释错误"的答案-证据鸿沟：15 个视觉语言模型中 8.42%–56.64% 的正确答案含明确事实错误，并将失败拆解为对象选择、实验条件、跨面板绑定与局部读取四环节。
AI.motivation: 科学图表问题中，最终答案正确并不意味着对实验的解释正确。跨面板阅读证据要求每个观察都与赋予其意义的对象和实验条件保持绑定，而现有评测仅以最终答案准确率为指标，无法暴露"答对但归因错误"的问题，导致模型能力被高估、错误被掩盖。
AI.method: 构建 CrossPanel 基准：2,650 道人工复核问题，任务形式包括并行观察组合与依赖式追问；设计响应审计（response audit），将模型回答分解为对象选择、实验条件、跨面板绑定和局部读取四个可分离维度；在 251 道诊断性题目上评测 15 个视觉语言模型；并通过受控干预（经核验的对象-条件提示、额外图像分块）检验失败的可修复性。
AI.result: 在 251 道诊断题上，15 个模型中 8.42%–56.64% 的正确答案包含显式事实错误；审计可区分"对错误目标的一致解读"与"对正确目标的错误解读"两类失败。干预实验中，经验证的对象-条件提示（不提供所测数值）使 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 在 57 道题上的目标查询成功率提升 22.81 个百分点，而仅增加图像分块改善甚微；其他模型在两种辅助结合时收益最大。
AI.conclusion: 实验归因是与局部感知并列的一项独立能力要求，其失败无法由最终答案准确率反映；CrossPanel 及其审计框架使二者均可被度量，并表明针对性的对象-条件引导可有效修复归因错误，单纯提升输入分辨率或视觉切分不足以解决该问题。

title: SemGuard: Semantics-Decoupled Watermarking for Gaussian Splatting
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (under review)
summary: Gaussian Splatting provides an efficient representation for high-fidelity rendering of static and dynamic 3D scenes, motivating the copyright protection of Gaussian assets. In CLIP-guided Gaussian watermarking, a universal message decoder pretrained on textual watermark representations is subsequently applied to visual features containing both watermark information and scene-dependent semantics. However, text-only pretraining does not explicitly account for the semantic interference encountered during watermark extraction. To address this challenge, we propose SemGuard, a simple yet effective semantics-decoupled watermarking framework that learns to suppress scene-dependent semantic interference during universal message decoder pretraining. Specifically, SemGuard combines message-related CLIP text features with message-independent visual features extracted from unwatermarked scene images, constructing training representations with controllable semantic interference relevant to the target Gaussian assets. A progressive semantic interference curriculum gradually increases the contribution of visual features, allowing the decoder to first learn reliable message representations and then adapt to increasingly strong scene-dependent semantic interference. After pretraining for a given message length and semantic image pool, the decoder is frozen and reused across multiple Gaussian assets whose visual semantics are covered by the pretraining data. Experiments on static and dynamic Gaussian Splatting assets demonstrate improved rendering fidelity alongside reliable watermark extraction, while evaluations on static assets further show enhanced robustness against image-space distortions.

AI.tldr: 提出 SemGuard，一种语义解耦的 CLIP 引导高斯泼溅水印框架，通过在通用消息解码器预训练阶段主动学习抑制场景相关的语义干扰，实现高保真渲染下的可靠水印提取。
AI.motivation: 高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splatting）可高效高保真渲染静态与动态 3D 场景，其资产亟需版权保护。现有 CLIP 引导高斯水印中，通用消息解码器仅用文本水印表示预训练，却被应用于同时含水印信息和场景语义的视觉特征，未显式建模语义干扰，导致提取性能受限。
AI.method: 将消息相关的 CLIP 文本特征与从无水印场景图像中提取的消息无关视觉特征组合，构造语义干扰强度可控的训练表示；采用渐进式语义干扰课程学习，先让解码器学得可靠消息表示，再逐步增大视觉特征权重以适配更强的场景相关语义干扰。针对给定消息长度与语义图像池完成预训练后冻结解码器，并在其预训练数据语义覆盖的多个高斯资产上复用。
AI.result: 在静态与动态高斯泼溅资产上，方法在保持渲染保真度的同时实现可靠的水印提取；在静态资产的进一步评测中，对图像空间失真表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并课程化抑制场景语义干扰，可有效提升通用消息解码器的可迁移性与水印提取可靠性，为高斯泼溅资产版权保护提供简洁有效的方案。

title: Self-prediction residuals improve single-pass detection of wrong-object boxes in grounded vision-language models
comment: 35 pages, 5 figures; supplementary material included (65 pages). Code: https://github.com/chen4study-hub/spred
summary: Grounded vision-language models write boxes as text, and the mean probability of their coordinate tokens says little about whether a box is right. We study a single-pass signal for boxes on another object, which matter when only the object counts. A linear map, fitted per model to its own answers without labels, reads a box from the hidden state before writing. Its disagreement with the written box, the self-prediction residual, flags boxes on another object although the read-out is far less accurate; the residual's weight was fixed with labels on two models. On a replication list of 1,200 RefCOCOg test items, the residual, averaged over six models, raises the detection of these errors for each of fifteen single-pass scores, by 0.026 to 0.049 in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) on a label-free probe and probes trained on 2,000 labelled items. Over all errors, adding it to the label-free probe moves AUROC, averaged over the models, by less than 0.02 (95% interval). With a fifth of answers reviewed, the share of all errors caught moves from 0.518 to 0.524, that of boxes on another object from 0.505 to 0.607 (post hoc): the residual changes which errors are found, not how many, and in cost-weighted recall it breaks even when such a box costs about 0.86 times another error, and its gain is positive in point estimate at equal costs. These gains come from RefCOCOg lists of MS-COCO images.

AI.tldr: 提出"自预测残差"（self-prediction residual）：用逐模型、无标签拟合的线性映射从隐藏状态读出框，与写出的框比对，可有效检测"框在别的物体上"的错误，并对15种单次打分普遍提升AUROC。
AI.motivation: Grounded视觉语言模型以文本形式输出坐标框，坐标token的平均概率难以反映框是否正确；尤其当只关心物体本身时，"框在另一个物体上"（box on another object）这类错误缺乏可靠的单次信号。
AI.method: 为每个模型单独拟合一个线性映射（不使用标签），在写出坐标之前从隐藏状态中读出框；将该读出框与实际写出的框的差异定义为自预测残差。在1,200条RefCOCOg测试项上评测，残差取六个模型平均，分别叠加到15种单次分数上，并在无标签探针与用2,000条标注数据训练的探针上比较。
AI.result: 对每种单次分数均提升对"框在另一物体上"错误的AUROC，提升0.026–0.049；对全部错误，加入残差后AUROC平均变化在±0.02以内（95%区间）。审查1/5答案时，总错误捕获率0.518→0.524，框错位捕获率0.505→0.607（事后分析）。残差改变的是被发现的错误类型而非数量；在成本加权召回下，当该类错误成本约为其他错误的0.86倍时打平，等成本下点估计为正收益。
AI.conclusion: 自预测残差是一种廉价、几乎无标注成本的单次误差检测信号，专门增强对物体错位框的识别，但对总体错误率与总体捕获量提升有限；结论基于MS-COCO图像的RefCOCOg列表，泛化性有待验证。

title: When Fog Becomes a Weapon: Atmospheric Attacks on Visible-Infrared Vision-Language Models
comment: 11 pages, 8 figures. Supplementary material (23 pages) is available as an ancillary file
summary: Existing adversarial attacks on vision-language models (VLMs) and cross-spectral perception primarily rely on conspicuous, unnatural artifacts, such as vivid adversarial patches or active light beams, that lack physical stealthiness, whereas prior weather attacks largely overlook how one atmosphere simultaneously affects heterogeneous sensors. This raises a key scientific question: can a purely natural, shared fog environment simultaneously disrupt complementary visible and thermal infrared cues without artificial surface modifications? We introduce Fog Manipulation Attack (FMA), a zero-gradient attack that optimizes a common 3D fog state to induce simultaneous semantic failures in visible-infrared VLMs. FMA links shared, depth- and layer-aware atmospheric propagation along scene paths with band-specific imaging physics---visible airlight scattering and thermal path radiance---allowing one realistic fog state to erode both modalities' distinct cues. Experiments show that FMA more than doubles simultaneous failure rates over fidelity-matched random fog, transfers to captioning and VQA, and removes cross-modal compensation, where restoring a clean companion view recovers 64%--74% of lost dual-input VQA answers.

AI.tldr: 提出Fog Manipulation Attack（FMA）：一种零梯度攻击，通过优化一个共享的3D雾状态，同时破坏可见光-红外VLM的语义识别能力。
AI.motivation: 现有对VLM与跨光谱感知的对抗攻击依赖显眼、不自然的伪影（如对抗patch、主动光束），缺乏物理隐蔽性；而以往天气攻击多忽视同一大气环境对异质传感器的联合影响。核心问题是：能否仅用纯自然的共享雾环境，在无人工表面修改的情况下同时破坏可见光与热红外的互补线索。
AI.method: FMA为免梯度攻击，优化一个公共3D雾状态；将沿场景路径的共享、深度与分层感知的大气传播模型，与波段特定成像物理（可见光airlight散射、热红外路径辐射）相耦合，使单一真实雾状态同时侵蚀两种模态各自的特有线索。
AI.result: 相比保真度匹配的随机雾，FMA将同时失效的比率提升一倍以上；可迁移到captioning与VQA任务；并消除跨模态补偿——恢复干净伴随视图可挽回64%–74%的双输入VQA答案。
AI.conclusion: 纯自然、共享的雾环境即可作为隐蔽的物理对抗攻击手段，同时破坏可见光-红外VLM的互补线索并削弱跨模态冗余补偿，揭示了多传感器系统在自然环境扰动下的脆弱性。

title: Analyzing Atypical Local Features in Museum Artifacts using Generative Image Inpainting
summary: This study proposes a method for analyzing local visual features in museum artifacts that may appear atypical or unexpected. Objects in the same category often share a similar overall shape, while local details such as patterns, decorations, and facial expressions may reflect regional or cultural characteristics. We use the appearance distribution learned by an image generation model as a reference for what is generally expected within an artifact category. For each target region, we exclude images from that region and fine-tune a generative model using only images from the remaining regions. We then mask selected parts of artifact images from the target region and ask the region-excluded model to complete them. If the completed result differs greatly from the original image, the masked part may contain features that are difficult to predict from the appearance learned from other regions. We measure this difference using LPIPS and treat it as reconstruction difficulty for the generative model. We conduct experiments on images of kokeshi dolls, drums, and masks from the collection of the National Museum of Ethnology. For each category, we select several target regions, build region-excluded LoRA models, and perform inpainting on predefined local parts. The results show that typical shapes and simple decorations are often reconstructed consistently, whereas some region-specific colors, patterns, cord arrangements, and painted details are replaced with more common appearances. These results suggest that region-excluded inpainting can serve as an exploratory tool for finding region-specific local visual features in museum artifact images.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于“区域排除”生成式修复的方法，用于发现博物馆藏品中 atypical、区域特有的局部视觉特征。
AI.motivation: 同类别器物整体形制相似，但纹样、装饰、面部表情等局部细节往往承载区域或文化差异；现有方法缺少一种以“类别内普遍预期”为参照、系统识别异常局部特征的手段。
AI.method: 以图像生成模型学到的外观分布作为类别内“预期外观”参照。对每个目标区域，排除该区域图像，仅用其余区域图像微调生成模型（region-excluded LoRA），再对目标区域器物图像的选定局部进行掩码，令其修复；用 LPIPS 度量修复结果与原图的差异，作为生成模型的重建困难度指标。
AI.result: 在国立民族学博物馆的小芥子人偶、鼓、面具三类图像上，对若干目标区域构建区域排除 LoRA 并做局部修复。典型形制与简单装饰常被一致重建；而部分区域特有的颜色、纹样、绳饰排列与彩绘细节会被替换为更常见的外观，LPIPS 差异较高。
AI.conclusion: 区域排除式修复可作为探索性工具，用于发现博物馆藏品图像中区域特有的局部视觉特征，为文化差异的定量与可视化分析提供新思路。

title: Where the Image Sits: Vision-Text Order Bias in Jev
summary: Jev-style system-1 decision models read a choice from a single prefill. They restrict the next-token distribution to the supplied option labels and return a distribution over the options, with no generation and no parsing. Recent work shows that generative vision-language models are sensitive to the relative order of image and text tokens. We ask whether that sensitivity reaches this Jev-style readout. The answer is always read at the end of the prompt, so moving the image changes the distance from the visual evidence to the decision, but never the position at which the decision is read. Using four placements---prefix, pre-question, pre-options, and suffix---and holding the option listing fixed, we measure argmax flips, total variation, accuracy, calibration, and label marginals. Suffix placement flips 41.0% of decisions and lowers accuracy by 18.6 points. Averaged over the four slots, the curve is monotone, not U-shaped. That shape differs from prior results on generative vision-language models. The effect survives a battery of controls. We also introduce prefix--question averaging (P+Q), a two-forward readout that averages the prefix and pre-question distributions. It is at least as accurate as prefix and outperforms the prior baselines. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/Youzhi333/Visual_Tex_Order_Bias_Jev.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"Jev式"系统1判别模型（单次prefill、仅读取选项标签分布）是否对图文token相对顺序敏感，发现suffix放置导致41.0%的决策翻转、准确率下降18.6个百分点，且随位置变化呈单调而非U形曲线，并提出P+Q双前向读出去缓解该偏差。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明生成式视觉语言模型对图像与文本token的相对顺序敏感，但尚不清楚这种敏感性是否会传导到Jev式判别读出——该读出始终在prompt末尾读取答案，移动图像只改变视觉证据与决策点的距离，而不改变读取位置。作者希望检验这一受限读出下顺序偏差是否依然存在及其形状是否与生成式模型一致。
AI.method: 固定选项列表，设置四种图像放置位置（prefix、pre-question、pre-options、suffix），测量argmax翻转率、总变差、准确率、校准度与标签边缘分布；加入多项控制实验验证效应稳健性；并提出prefix–question averaging（P+Q）双前向读出，对prefix与pre-question两处分布取平均。
AI.result: suffix放置使41.0%的决策发生翻转，准确率下降18.6个百分点；跨四个位置的效应曲线呈单调变化而非U形，与生成式视觉语言模型的已有结论不同；该效应在多组控制下依然显著；P+Q读出至少与prefix读出一致准确，并优于既有基线。
AI.conclusion: 图像-文本顺序偏差会渗透到Jev式系统1判别读出中，且其位置效应形态与生成式模型存在差异；通过简单的双前向平均（P+Q）可部分缓解该偏差，代码与数据已公开。

title: Beyond Output Suppression: Mitigating Privacy Risks in LVLMs via Visual Intrinsic Privacy Erasure
summary: Large vision-language models can extract personally identifiable information from images, making privacy protection essential for their deployment in perception-oriented tasks. Existing targeted fine-tuning and model-editing methods usually suppress sensitive answers by aligning the model toward safe responses. In this paper, we show that such protection can be illusory: although the fine-tuned model refuses to disclose private information under normal decoding, privacy leakage still occurs in sentence completion scenarios. This indicates that existing algorithms only change the model's output distribution, but the model still retains the ability to perceive private information. Private information therefore still remains inside the model. To address this problem, we propose Visual Intrinsic Privacy Erasure (VIPE), which targets privacy-related visual representations to weaken the model's ability to perceive sensitive information. VIPE constructs paired privacy-sensitive and privacy-masked images, uses their internal feature residuals to identify privacy-related visual components, and suppresses these components before they are perceived by the model. To preserve benign visual representations, the erasure objective projects feature differences onto a relaxed benign subspace and adaptively controls the erasure strength. VIPE compels the model to ignore the extraction of sensitive information in the visual representation space, thereby blocking the source of privacy leakage more fundamentally rather than merely altering the model's output distribution. Experiments on Qwen2.5-VL and LLaVA-OneVision show that VIPE substantially alleviates prefix-triggered privacy leakage while maintaining competitive utility on general visual-language benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文指出已有I-PII（图像个人隐私信息）抑制方法只是"表面保护"，提出VIPE方法从视觉表征层面抹除隐私感知能力，从源头阻断泄露。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）能从图像中提取个人可识别信息（PII），在感知类任务部署中隐私保护至关重要。现有targeted fine-tuning与model-editing方法通过让模型对齐到安全回答来抑制敏感答案，但这种保护可能是"虚假的"：正常解码下模型会拒答，但在句子补全场景下仍会泄露隐私。这说明现有算法只改变了输出分布，模型仍保留感知隐私信息的能力，隐私信息依旧存留于模型内部。
AI.method: 提出Visual Intrinsic Privacy Erasure（VIPE），针对隐私相关的视觉表征削弱模型的敏感信息感知能力：(1) 构建隐私敏感图像与隐私掩蔽图像的配对，利用其内部特征残差定位隐私相关视觉成分；(2) 在这些成分被模型感知之前加以抑制；(3) 为保留良性视觉表征，将擦除目标投影到松弛的良性子空间，并自适应控制擦除强度。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL与LLaVA-OneVision上的实验表明，VIPE显著缓解了前缀触发（prefix-triggered）的隐私泄露，同时在通用视觉语言基准上保持了有竞争力的效用（utility）。
AI.conclusion: 仅在输出分布层面做对齐无法真正移除隐私感知能力；VIPE通过在视觉表征空间迫使模型忽略敏感信息提取，从更根本的层面阻断隐私泄露源，而非仅改变模型输出分布，实现隐私擦除与通用能力的较好平衡。

title: Urban State Representation for Autonomous Mobility: A Survey of Multimodal Perception, Architectures, Datasets, and Benchmarks
comment: Accepted to the UrbanState Workshop at WACV 2027. 8 pages + references + 5-page supplementary appendix. Code and data: https://github.com/binayksingh/Awesome-Urban-State-Representation
summary: Cities are sensed by many platforms at once: on-board cameras, LiDAR and radar on autonomous vehicles, roadside units at intersections, drones and satellites overhead, and the GNSS traces of millions of trips. Yet most learned representations are built for one platform, one city, and one task. We survey this fragmented landscape through a single lens, the Urban State Representation (USR): a georeferenced, layered, time-varying, uncertainty-aware state that any sensing platform can write to and any downstream task can read from. We (i) formalize USR and five desiderata for it, and relate it to bird's-eye-view (BEV) features, occupancy, vectorized maps, neural fields and 3D Gaussians, scene graphs, road-network graphs, language tokens, and world-model latents; (ii) organize sensing platforms, cross-view (ground-aerial) matching, fusion operators, 3D geometric foundation models, end-to-end and vision-language-action models, and generative world models and data engines in one taxonomy that spans sensors to decisions; (iii) compile 26 urban datasets and simulators across ego, cooperative (V2X), aerial, trajectory, and language settings, with a metric glossary, a cross-benchmark results snapshot, a trend analysis, and a platform-coverage gap analysis; and (iv) review applications and propose, as an outlook, USR-5, a five-test protocol with explicit references and one aggregate score for measuring whether a state is shared, together with a research agenda of six open problems covering cross-city and cross-sensor transfer, uncertainty, efficiency, sim-to-real evaluation, and governance. This survey is an entry point for computer vision, autonomous driving, transportation, and urban computing researchers; the paper list, datasets, and USR-5 code are at https://github.com/binayksingh/Awesome-Urban-State-Representation.

AI.tldr: 该综述以"城市状态表征（USR）"为统一视角，将多平台城市感知与学习表征研究整合为一个可跨平台读写、地理参照、分层、时变且不确定性感知的状态框架，并给出分类体系、数据集汇编、基准分析与评测协议展望。
AI.motivation: 城市被车载相机、LiDAR、雷达、路侧单元、无人机、卫星及GNSS轨迹等多平台同时感知，但现有学习表征多为单一平台、单一城市、单一任务而构建，形成碎片化格局，缺乏统一、可复用的城市状态抽象。
AI.method: 综述性研究：(i) 形式化USR并给出五项desiderata，将其与BEV特征、occupancy、矢量化地图、神经场与3D高斯、场景图、路网图、语言token、世界模型latent建立关联；(ii) 构建覆盖从传感器到决策的统一分类法，涵盖感知平台、跨视角（地-空）匹配、融合算子、3D几何基础模型、端到端与VLA模型、生成式世界模型与数据引擎；(iii) 汇编26个城市数据集与仿真器（自车、V2X协同、空中、轨迹、语言五类设定），附指标术语表、跨基准结果快照、趋势分析与平台覆盖缺口分析；(iv) 综述应用并提出USR-5五测试协议与六项开放问题。
AI.result: 形成一套USR概念框架与五维期望属性；一张贯穿传感与决策的分类体系；26个数据集/仿真器的系统汇编及指标术语表、跨基准结果快照、趋势与覆盖缺口分析；以及可量化的USR-5评测协议（含显式参考与聚合得分）与包含跨城市跨传感器迁移、不确定性、效率、sim-to-real评估、治理等六个开放问题的研究议程。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为计算机视觉、自动驾驶、交通工程与城市计算研究者提供统一入口，主张以共享的城市状态表征替代平台专用表示，并通过USR-5协议与研究议程推动跨平台、跨城市、跨任务的可比较与可迁移研究；论文列表、数据集与代码已开源。

title: Tangent incompleteness under coupled image transformations: margin reconstruction and decision consequences
summary: Can accurate responses to individual geometric image transformations recover their combined effect on a classifier's decision? For identity-aligned bilinear resampling, coordinatewise assembly may fail at first order. Projecting the implemented transformation onto a fixed logit-margin gradient, we derive a linear term plus signed absolute-value ridges. An exact even--odd identity and ridge-cancellation conditions characterize the missing information. Under independent parameter laws, a noncancelling off-coordinate ridge obstructs even unrestricted additive fits. The coupled correction has $O(s^2)$ projected error, versus a possible $Θ(s)$ axiswise defect; transfer to realized network margins requires local smoothness. Projected RMS errors fall by 82.96% on CIFAR-10 and 82.38% on ImageNetV2 relative to axiswise assembly; realized fixed-pair margin RMS errors fall by 39.75% and 42.73%. The representation prospectively identifies nine strict nonadditive network-margin sign configurations and permits exact minimization of a three-parameter threat surrogate, with conditional selection-regret guarantees. In an independent CIFAR-10 search, coupled-selected transformations uncover 51 top-1 changes versus 41 for axes. On 256 independent ImageNetV2/ConvNeXt-Tiny images and 16,384 transformed decisions at the prespecified scale $s=.40$, multiclass top-1 flip-prediction errors fall from 11.97% to 10.23% (paired improvement 1.74 percentage points; 95% interval [0.93, 2.61]). Directional finite differences are slightly more accurate (10.00%) at higher measured model-construction cost. These results connect first-order sampling interactions to margin reconstruction, decision prediction, and threat selection, without claiming finite-scale network certification.

AI.tldr: 本文研究双线性重采样下多维几何变换对分类器决策的联合效应能否由各轴单独响应重构，指出坐标逐轴组装在一阶意义下会失效，提出耦合修正方案。
AI.motivation: 针对身份对齐的双线性重采样，逐坐标（axiswise）组装单轴响应可能在一阶上无法恢复组合变换对logit-margin的效应，需要刻画缺失信息并给出可证明的耦合修正。
AI.method: 将实际实现的变换投影到固定的logit-margin梯度上，推导出一阶线性项加带符号绝对值"脊"（ridges）的表示；给出精确的奇偶恒等式与脊抵消条件；在独立参数分布下分析不可抵消的非坐标脊对加性拟合的阻碍，并给出O(s²)投影误差与Θ(s)逐轴缺陷的对比；进一步构造三参数威胁代理的最优最小化与条件选择遗憾保证，并在CIFAR-10/ImageNetV2上做实证与多类top-1翻转预测实验。
AI.result: 投影RMS误差较逐轴组装在CIFAR-10下降82.96%、ImageNetV2下降82.38%；实际固定对margin的RMS误差分别下降39.75%和42.73%；识别出九种严格非可加的margin符号配置；CIFAR-10搜索中耦合选择发现51次top-1改变（逐轴41次）；在s=.40的16,384个变换决策上，多类top-1翻转预测误差由11.97%降至10.23%（配对改善1.74个百分点，95%区间[0.93, 2.61]）；方向有限差分可达10.00%但建模成本更高。
AI.conclusion: 结果将一阶采样交互与margin重构、决策预测及威胁选择联系起来，证明耦合修正在理论与实证上均优于逐轴组装；但作者明确不主张有限尺度下的网络认证保证。

title: Cyclic Discrete Diffusion: A Novel Multi-Class Segmentation Refinement Technique
summary: We cast image segmentation refinement as a discrete diffusion process. To solve this task we introduce Cyclic Discrete Diffusion (CDD), a novel forward-reverse formulation with a cyclic label topology that maps a discrete label set to the uniform distribution and back. Instead of injecting Gaussian noise as is done for continuous diffusion, CDD evolves segmentation masks through label jumps: at each step, every pixel either remains in its current class or jumps to the next label with a fixed rate. This jump-or-stay mechanism defines a finite-state Markov process with bounded forward and reverse steps, featuring analytically consistent and tractable reverse dynamics. CDD operates natively in a multi-class label space, enabling joint refinement of all classes in a single pass without requiring class-wise decomposition, as commonly needed in prior binary refinement approaches. The proposed formulation admits a finite and controllable number of refinement steps, for which we analyze the convergence properties through spectral gap analysis. We evaluate CDD across diverse segmentation tasks, including multi-class semantic, instance-level, and binary segmentation refinement. Our method consistently improves both region accuracy and boundary quality across multiple backbones and datasets.

AI.tldr: 将图像分割细化建模为离散扩散过程，提出循环离散扩散（CDD），在标签空间中以"跳转或保持"机制演化掩码，实现多类联合细化并具备可分析的收敛性。
AI.motivation: 现有分割细化方法多依赖二值化、逐类分解处理，难以在多类标签空间中联合细化；连续扩散注入高斯噪声的方式与离散标签空间不匹配。
AI.method: 构建带有循环标签拓扑的前向-反向公式，将离散标签集映射到均匀分布再还原。每步中每个像素以固定速率保持当前类别或跳转到下一标签，形成有限状态马尔可夫过程，正反向步数有界且反向动力学解析一致、可处理；通过谱隙分析研究收敛性。
AI.result: 在多类语义分割、实例级分割与二值分割细化任务上，跨多种骨干网络与数据集，区域精度与边界质量均获得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: CDD 原生支持多类标签空间的一次性联合细化，细化步数有限可控，为离散分割细化提供了理论可分析且通用的新范式。

title: Gradient-Free Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision Models via Agentic Coding
summary: Adapting a vision model to new classes from a few labeled images usually relies on gradient fine-tuning, which is unstable with so few images. We ask whether a coding agent can replace gradient descent for this task. We propose the Agent edit, a method in which a coding agent writes a program that sets the new class weights in the class head of a frozen COCO-trained detector, with no gradient step. The agent runs the detector on the labeled images a limited number of times and sees how much its edit lowers COCO mAP; the program rebuilds the weights without the agent. In the same head and with the same labels, the Agent edit outperforms full-decoder fine-tuning at five shots on 2 of four fine-grained sets, by 11.2 and 12.3 F1 points, and ties on the rest. At ten shots, fine-tuning ties with or outperforms it. Moreover, when the new classes are scored jointly with the COCO classes, the AP of the COCO class to which they belong falls by up to 33.3 points, and limiting that loss lowers F1 on the new classes. Most of the agent's programs share three parts, which we write as a formula that needs no agent. A classifier on frozen backbone features reaches a higher F1 than every method inside the head on every set. Hence a coding agent can replace gradient descent only in part: inside the head and at five shots.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"Agent edit"：用编码智能体编写程序直接设定冻结检测器分类头中新类权重，不做任何梯度更新；在5-shot设定下部分超越全解码器微调，但存在COCO类AP大幅下降的代价，分析表明可由公式化程序与冻结特征分类器替代。
AI.motivation: 少样本（few labeled images）条件下用梯度微调适配视觉模型不稳定，作者追问编码智能体能否替代梯度下降完成新类适配。
AI.method: 在COCO训练的冻结检测器的分类头上，让编码智能体有限次运行检测器、观察编辑对COCO mAP的影响，编写程序重设新类权重，无梯度步；随后分析智能体程序共性，提炼为无需智能体的公式，并与冻结骨干特征上的分类器对比。
AI.result: 在同一分类头与相同标签下，5-shot时Agent edit在4个细粒度数据集中的2个上比全解码器微调分别高11.2和12.3 F1，其余持平；10-shot时微调持平或更优。新类与COCO类联合评分时所属COCO类AP最多下降33.3点，抑制该损失会降低新类F1。多数智能体程序含三个共同部分。冻结骨干特征分类器在每个数据集上F1均高于头内所有方法。
AI.conclusion: 编码智能体仅能部分替代梯度下降：局限于分类头内部且仅在5-shot条件下；头外使用冻结特征分类器效果更优。

title: Intervene or Trust CLIP? Competence-Gated Adaptation for Source-Free Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning
summary: Source-free cross-domain few-shot learning (SF-CDFSL) adapts a pre-trained vision-language model such as CLIP to a distant target domain from a handful of labeled images, without access to source data. Recent methods improve the fine-tuning of CLIP with token-level interventions and apply them in the same way to every target domain. In this paper, we find that whether an intervention helps depends on how well frozen CLIP already recognizes the target domain: in 5-way 1-shot tasks, intervening improves accuracy by 0.72 points where frozen CLIP misclassifies most support images, but lowers it by 1.31 points where frozen CLIP already classifies them well, and the support set of a single episode suffices to tell the two cases apart; a bias-variance analysis explains both. Based on this finding, we propose Competence-Gated Adaptation (CoGA), which measures frozen CLIP's accuracy and margin on the labeled support set and decides, before training, whether to intervene on the visual tokens or to trust CLIP by fusing the adapted prediction with the frozen one. CoGA adds no trainable parameters and uses no query labels. On the four BSCD-FSL target domains, CoGA achieves the best average accuracy, 59.56% (1-shot) and 68.96% (5-shot), outperforms ATHA and TIR by at least 2.82 and 1.39 points on the same episodes, and consistently improves three further backbones, three parameter-efficient fine-tuning frameworks and five further target domains.

AI.tldr: 提出 Competence-Gated Adaptation (CoGA)：依据冻结 CLIP 在支持集上的识别能力（准确率与 margin）在训练前决定是否对视觉 token 进行干预或融合冻结预测，无新增可训练参数，在 BSCD-FSL 四域上取得最佳平均精度。
AI.motivation: 现有 SF-CDFSL 方法对所有目标域一律施加相同的 token 级干预，但作者发现干预是否有益取决于冻结 CLIP 对目标域本身的识别水平：5-way 1-shot 下，在冻结 CLIP 误分类多数支持样本时干预带来 +0.72 点提升，而在其已能正确分类时反而下降 1.31 点，且单个 episode 的支持集即可区分两种情况；偏差-方差分析可解释该现象。
AI.method: CoGA 在训练前利用带标签支持集测量冻结 CLIP 的准确率与 margin，据此门控决策：或对视觉 token 施加干预，或将适配预测与冻结预测融合（trust CLIP）。方法不增加可训练参数，且不使用 query 标签。
AI.result: 在 BSCD-FSL 四个目标域上取得最佳平均精度 59.56%（1-shot）与 68.96%（5-shot）；在同一 episode 上相较 ATHA 与 TIR 至少高出 2.82 与 1.39 点；并在另外三个骨干、三种参数高效微调框架及五个额外目标域上均稳定提升。
AI.conclusion: 干预的收益具条件性，应以冻结模型的域内胜任度作为门控依据；CoGA 作为一种零额外参数、无需 query 标签的通用适配策略，具备良好的骨干与框架可迁移性。

title: VTree: Question-Driven Growth of Hierarchical Memory for Agentic Long-Video Understanding
summary: Long videos spanning tens of minutes to hours far exceed the context window of today's vision-language models, and the standard remedy of sparse uniform frame sampling discards exactly the fine-grained evidence that specific questions depend on. Existing video agents explore on demand but re-explore from scratch for every question and discard their exploration state once an answer is produced, so per-question cost scales with video length. Hierarchical-memory methods instead fix the scope of each depth in advance and deepen along a pre-committed pyramid rather than toward the question. We observe that a video's coarse structure (where its scenes and topics begin and end) is question-independent, whereas which part a question must zoom into, and how deep, is question-dependent.
