We propose VTree, which builds a coarse hierarchical memory tree over a video once and then, for each question, grows branches only where that question needs depth. The growth is globally routed so any part of the timeline is reachable, sufficiency-gated so drilling stops when the evidence suffices, and query-conditioned so a branch unfolds into the sub-intervals that answer \emph{this} question. Crucially, every expansion is written back into the video memory, allowing later questions to reuse previously discovered structure and evidence without repeating the corresponding expansion process. Across five long-video understanding benchmarks, VTree consistently improves the accuracy of diverse vision-language backbones while substantially reducing the context length and execution time required for each question.

AI.tldr: VTree提出一种"一次建树、按问题生长"的长视频理解框架：先构建与问题无关的粗粒度分层记忆树，再针对每个问题沿全局路由按需加深分支，并以证据充分性作为停止条件，同时将扩展结果写回记忆供后续问题复用。
AI.motivation: 长视频时长数十至数小时，远超当前视觉语言模型的上下文窗口。稀疏均匀采帧会丢弃问题所依赖的细粒度证据；现有视频智能体按需探索，但每个问题都从头重新探索、作答后丢弃探索状态，导致单问题成本随视频长度线性增长；分层记忆方法则预先固定各深度范围，沿预设金字塔加深而非朝问题方向加深。
AI.method: 关键观察：视频的粗粒度结构（场景与话题的起止位置）与问题无关，而问题需要放大哪一部分、需要多深则依赖于问题本身。VTree据此先对视频一次性构建粗粒度分层记忆树；对每个问题仅在需要深度处生长分支。扩展具备三个性质：（1）全局路由，保证时间轴任意位置可达；（2）充分性门控，证据足够即停止下钻；（3）查询条件化，使分支展开为回答"当前问题"所需的子区间。更重要的是，每次扩展均写回视频记忆，使后续问题可复用已发现的结构与证据，避免重复扩展。
AI.result: 在五个长视频理解基准上，VTree对多种视觉语言骨干模型均能一致提升准确率，同时显著降低每个问题所需的上下文长度与执行时间。
AI.conclusion: 将视频固有结构（与问题无关）的计算一次性摊销、将细粒度证据检索按问题条件化并按需付费，并通过记忆写回实现跨问题复用，是兼顾长视频理解精度与效率的有效范式。

title: When Recognition Meets Discovery: Learning Need Not Be Entangled in One Representation Space
summary: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to recognize known classes while discovering novel categories from unlabeled data containing both old and novel samples. Existing methods typically optimize recognition and discovery within a shared representation space, implicitly assuming that the same representation geometry can serve both objectives. Through controlled spectral analysis, we uncover a striking asymmetry: old-class discrimination is increasingly concentrated in the dominant singular directions, while novel-class structure is better preserved in the complementary residual space. More importantly, strengthening the former can even degrade the latter, revealing that recognition and discovery compete for representation capacity rather than merely for optimization weight. Motivated by this observation, we propose Dual-Space Spectral Routing, which dynamically decomposes the representation via online SVD and routes supervised recognition and unsupervised discovery to complementary discriminative and general subspaces. We further exploit their distinct responses to old and novel samples to construct a dual-space novelty signal, which guides Subspace Relation Aggregation (SRA) for organizing candidate novel categories. Extensive experiments across multiple GCD baselines, backbones, and benchmarks demonstrate a consistently improved recognition-discovery balance without introducing additional inference parameters. Code will be open source.

AI.tldr: 论文发现GCD中识别与发现在表示能力上存在竞争，提出双空间谱路由（Dual-Space Spectral Routing），将识别与发现分配到互补的主/残差子空间，并用双空间新颖性信号引导子空间关系聚合，在无额外推理参数下提升识别-发现平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有GCD方法在共享表示空间中同时优化识别与发现，隐含假设同一表示几何可同时服务两个目标。作者通过受控谱分析发现显著不对称性：旧类判别集中于主导奇异方向，新类结构更好保留在互补的残差空间；且增强前者会损害后者，说明二者是在竞争表示能力而非仅竞争优化权重。
AI.method: 提出双空间谱路由：通过在线SVD动态分解表示，将监督识别路由至判别子空间、无监督发现路由至通用（残差）子空间；利用两空间对旧/新样本的不同响应构造双空间新颖性信号，引导子空间关系聚合（SRA）组织候选新类。
AI.result: 在多个GCD基线、骨干网络和基准上实验，一致改善识别-发现平衡，且不引入额外推理参数。
AI.conclusion: 识别与发现对表示几何的需求互补而非共享，谱空间分解为GCD提供了有效且轻量的解耦范式。

title: Schedule, Rank, Profile: Continuous Evaluation of LLM Agents in Games
summary: Games are a robust test for large language model agents: they require sequential decisions, adversarial or cooperative interaction, state tracking, reasoning under uncertainty, and long-horizon planning. However, a one-time game benchmark can go stale as models, prompts, environment implementations, and evaluation policies change, and refreshing it is costly: full round-robin evaluation scales poorly in the number of model pairs, and the resulting outcomes live on incompatible per-game scales. We present a framework for continuous evaluation of LLM agents in game settings, organized around three coupled components. First, an adaptive scheduler that maps pairwise Bradley-Terry uncertainty to reduced per-pair match targets, concentrating budget on comparisons that remain unresolved. Second, a Unified Leaderboard (ULB) that reduces heterogeneous outcomes to pairwise evidence and fits a game-balanced Bradley-Terry model by minorization-maximization with bootstrap intervals, so that high-throughput games cannot dominate the aggregate ranking. Third, a game skill-profile methodology that scores each game along diverse skill dimensions, making the capability coverage of the suite explicit and turning game selection into a design decision rather than an artifact of availability. In this paper, we specify the research design and outcome reduction of the current implementation and evaluate the framework on a ten-game suite spanning perfect-information board games, imperfect-information games, and social/language settings, reporting LLM capability profiles, evaluation-cost savings across model-refresh cycles, and an empirical Pareto frontier relating model performance to inference cost. As deployed, the scheduler saved 61.7% of episodes; it counted each episode in the two team games as four records, overstating their savings, and the other eight games save 61.9%.

AI.tldr: 提出一个面向LLM智能体博弈评测的持续评测框架，含自适应调度器、统一排行榜（ULB）与游戏技能画像三部分；在十款游戏上验证，调度器节省61.7%的episode（非团队游戏61.9%）。
AI.motivation: 一次性博弈基准会随模型、提示、环境实现和评测策略变化而过时，而刷新成本高：全循环赛在模型对数量上扩展性差，且各游戏结果尺度互不兼容。
AI.method: 三组件耦合框架：(1) 自适应调度器，将成对Bradley-Terry不确定性映射为降低后的每对比赛目标，把预算集中于未决比较；(2) 统一排行榜ULB，将异构结果归约为成对证据，用minorization-maximization拟合游戏均衡的Bradley-Terry模型并给出bootstrap区间，抑制高吞吐游戏主导排名；(3) 游戏技能画像方法，沿多技能维度为每款游戏打分，使能力覆盖显式化。另给出研究设计与结果归约规范。
AI.result: 在覆盖完全信息棋盘游戏、非完全信息博弈及社交/语言场景的十款游戏套件上评估，报告LLM能力画像、跨模型刷新周期的评测成本节省，以及模型性能与推理成本的经验Pareto前沿；调度器实际节省61.7%的episode，但两款团队游戏按每条episode计4条记录而高估其节省，其余八款游戏节省61.9%。
AI.conclusion: 持续评测框架可行且显著降低刷新成本，但结果归约中的记录计数口径会扭曲节省率估计，需在团队类游戏中修正；技能画像把游戏选择从可得性驱动转为设计决策。

title: PruneNAS: Constraint Aware Neural Architecture Search based Pruning
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, British Machine Vision Conference, Lancaster, 2026
summary: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has achieved state-of-the-art performance across diverse tasks, but its high computational cost remains a major barrier. We introduce PruneNAS, a novel framework that integrates structured pruning into NAS to efficiently explore high-performing architectures while leveraging pretrained models. Unlike conventional NAS methods that train each candidate from scratch, PruneNAS generates a candidate pool by pruning pretrained networks at multiple granularity levels and formulates the selection as a global optimization problem using training-free importance metrics. This approach enables rapid evaluation of candidate architectures under strict resource constraints, dramatically reducing search time from hundreds of GPU hours to mere minutes. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that PruneNAS discovers compact, high-accuracy architectures that nearly halve the computational cost (MACs) of prior methods on ResNet-50, while also showing strong generalization on object detection tasks with YOLO. Our method bridges structured pruning and NAS, offering a practical solution for resource-constrained model deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出PruneNAS框架，将结构化剪枝与神经架构搜索结合，通过对预训练网络多粒度剪枝生成候选池并用免训练重要性指标做全局优化选择，将搜索时间从数百GPU小时降至数分钟。
AI.motivation: 传统NAS需对每个候选架构从头训练，计算成本极高，成为其应用的主要障碍。
AI.method: 利用预训练模型，在多个粒度层级上剪枝生成候选架构池；采用免训练（training-free）重要性指标将候选选择建模为全局优化问题，在严格资源约束下快速评估候选架构。
AI.result: 在标准基准上发现紧凑且高精度的架构，在ResNet-50上将MACs近乎减半，搜索时间从数百GPU小时降至数分钟，并在YOLO目标检测任务上展现良好泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法打通了结构化剪枝与NAS，为资源受限场景下的模型部署提供了实用方案。

title: OmniDecisionBench: Evaluating and Benchmarking the Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models
summary: Multimodal System One models answer visual tasks with typed decisions and native probabilities, yet no holistic evaluation compares them with general VLMs or maps either class's capability boundaries. We introduce OmniDecisionBench, a holistic benchmark of multimodal System One models. Its main evaluation assigns 45 datasets (192,975 records) to five capability families and twelve primary angles across four typed interfaces, scoring accuracy and candidate-probability calibration. A validation layer adds three single-factor diagnostics varying visual presentation, textual evidence sufficiency, and target dataset. Across three System One models and two general VLMs, three regularities emerge. First, strengths depend on angle and metric: System One models lead discrete tasks overall with lower ECE15 on most perception, reading, and reasoning angles (Jev 1.14: 80.14% accuracy, 4.50% ECE15), while general VLMs lead ordinal grading and outperform Jev 1.14 among the three models tested on direct Box grounding. Second, multi-image and abstract reasoning bound every model, where confidence rather than accuracy separates them. Third, reliability shifts with the input: rendering only options nearly triples Jev 1.14's selective risk at nearly flat mean signed bias, and donor risk cutoffs often exceed target risk across unseen datasets and task families. OmniDecisionBench thus maps which model class suits each angle and where reliability ends. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/Glax147/OmniDecisionBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 OmniDecisionBench，对多模态 System One 模型与通用 VLM 进行整体能力与可靠性评测，覆盖 45 个数据集、五类能力族、十二个主视角与四类类型化接口，同时评估准确率与候选概率校准。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态 System One 模型以类型化决策与原生概率作答，但缺乏与通用 VLM 的整体对比评测，两类的能力边界与可靠性边界也未被系统刻画。
AI.method: 构建基准：主评测将 45 个数据集（192,975 条记录）映射到五类能力族与十二个主视角，覆盖四种类型化接口，同时打分准确率与候选概率校准；另设验证层，包含三个单因素诊断，分别改变视觉呈现、文本证据充分性与目标数据集。
AI.result: 评测 3 个 System One 模型与 2 个通用 VLM 得三条规律：(1) 优势依赖视角与指标——System One 整体在离散任务领先，多数感知、阅读、推理视角 ECE15 更低（Jev 1.14：80.14% 准确率、4.50% ECE15），通用 VLM 在序数评分上领先，并在直接 Box 定位上优于 Jev 1.14；(2) 多图与抽象推理是所有模型的瓶颈，区分度来自置信度而非准确率；(3) 可靠性随输入变化——仅渲染选项使 Jev 1.14 的选择性风险近乎增至三倍而平均有符号偏差基本持平，源域风险阈值在未见数据集与任务族上常高于目标域风险。
AI.conclusion: OmniDecisionBench 给出按视角选择模型类别的依据，并明确各类模型可靠性的终止边界；代码与数据集将开源。

title: Guarding with Judgment: Learning to Intervene for Multimodal Safety
summary: When visual context makes an ordinary request unsafe to answer as asked, a blanket refusal may leave the user's need unresolved. Choosing how to help requires distinguishing an established hazard from a condition that still needs verification, a distinction that binary safety labels leave unspecified. We formulate this decision through four actions: allow, warn, review, and refuse. To ground these decisions in verifiable evidence, we build a corpus of 20,126 training audits and the JudiBench benchmark, connecting each action to diagnostic judgments, source evidence, and controlled context changes. Our guard, JudiAct, separately states what the source establishes, what condition governs the help, and how the rules apply. It then checks these three brief review items against the original inputs to predict diagnostic labels and a handling action. Supervised training learns individual judgments while comparing label assignments across related cases. A second stage swaps one review item at a time, using the resulting audit feedback to refine review generation. On JudiBench, JudiAct improves request and answer Macro-F1 by more than 28 percentage points over its 4B backbone. Across nine public benchmarks, it outperforms state-of-the-art guards on the mean delivered-answer score in both pre-generation and post-generation settings, cutting MM-SafetyBench attack success from 40.78% to 25.30%.

AI.tldr: 论文将"视觉上下文导致请求不安全"的处理从二元拒答扩展为allow/warn/review/refuse四类动作，构建20,126条训练审计语料与JudiBench基准，提出JudiAct守卫：显式陈述源证据、治理条件与规则适用三项审查要点，经监督训练与审查项替换式二阶段优化，在JudiBench上较4B骨干提升请求与回答Macro-F1超28个百分点，并在九个公开基准上优于SOTA守卫。
AI.motivation: 当视觉上下文使普通请求"照原样回答"变得不安全时，一刀切拒答会使真实需求未被解决。要选择如何帮助，需区分"已确立的危害"与"仍需核验的条件"，而二元安全标签无法刻画这一差异。
AI.method: 以allow、warn、review、refuse四种动作形式化该决策；构建20,126条训练审计语料与JudiBench基准，将每个动作与诊断判断、来源证据及受控上下文变更相连接。模型JudiAct分别陈述"源证据确立了什么""支配该帮助的条件""规则如何适用"三项审查要点，并对照原始输入核验后预测诊断标签与处置动作；监督训练学习单项判断并在相关案例间比较标签分配，第二阶段逐项替换审查要点、利用审计反馈精炼审查生成。
AI.result: 在JudiBench上，JudiAct相较其4B骨干将请求与回答的Macro-F1提升逾28个百分点；在九个公开基准上，无论生成前还是生成后设置，平均"已交付答案"得分均优于SOTA守卫，并将MM-SafetyBench攻击成功率从40.78%降至25.30%。
AI.conclusion: 以四类处置动作替代二元标签、并以可核验证据支撑审查推理，可在不牺牲有用性的前提下提升多模态安全守卫的细粒度决策能力与鲁棒性。

title: Beyond Single-Turn Privacy: Training-Data Leakage in Conversational RAG
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is known to reduce training-data leakage in single-turn interactions, but whether this protection persists over multi-turn conversations is unclear. We introduce CRELT (Conversational RAG Extraction Leakage Trajectory), a reusable framework that tracks, turn by turn, the real contact details from the training data that a RAG system discloses. CRELT separates retrieval, conversation history, and attack strategy through a full-factorial design, uses a retrieval corpus verified to contain none of the target PII, and counts an item as leaked only when it is absent from the model input at the turn it is produced. In our main experiment, this criterion excludes 29-53% of raw matches that were already present in the input. Across GPT-J-6B, Pythia-6.9B, and Pythia-12B, targeting real Enron contact details, retrieval reduces disclosure under both full and cleared history, consistent with prior single-turn results. A length-matched control with random passages reproduces 91-99.5% of this reduction under cleared history and 47-78% under full history, so much of it comes from the added context rather than from what is retrieved. With retrieval enabled, however, retaining full conversation history increases disclosure by a factor of 3.6-4.9, while retaining only one previous turn already restores disclosure to approximately the full-history level. With retrieval, clearing the history reduces disclosure by 72-79%, but does not eliminate it. These results show that single-turn privacy audits can substantially underestimate training-data leakage in conversational RAG systems and that conversation-history policy is a critical dimension of privacy evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出CRELT框架逐轮追踪多轮对话RAG中的训练数据PII泄露，发现保留对话历史会使泄露增至3.6–4.9倍，单轮隐私审计严重低估泄露风险。
AI.motivation: RAG在单轮交互中可减少训练数据泄露，但其保护在多轮对话中是否持续尚不清楚；现有隐私审计多以单轮为准，可能低估会话场景下的泄露风险。
AI.method: 构建CRELT（Conversational RAG Extraction Leakage Trajectory）可复用框架，逐轮记录被披露的真实训练数据联系方式；以全因子设计分离检索、对话历史与攻击策略；检索语料经验证不含目标PII；仅当某条目在该轮模型输入中缺失却被输出时才算作泄露；主实验覆盖GPT-J-6B、Pythia-6.9B、Pythia-12B，目标为Enron真实联系人信息，并设置长度匹配的随机段落对照。
AI.result: 严格判定标准排除29–53%已存在于输入的原始匹配；检索在完整与清空历史下均降低披露，与单轮结论一致；随机段落长度匹配对照在清空历史下复现91–99.5%的降幅、完整历史下复现47–78%，说明降幅很大程度来自附加上下文而非检索内容本身；启用检索时，保留完整历史使披露增至3.6–4.9倍，仅保留一轮历史即接近完整历史水平；清空历史使披露下降72–79%但未能消除。
AI.conclusion: 单轮隐私审计会显著低估会话式RAG的训练数据泄露；对话历史策略是隐私评估的关键维度，需在多轮设置下开展泄露测量与策略设计。

title: Who Sent It or How It Moved? Sender Shortcuts in Cryptocurrency Anti-Money-Laundering Benchmarks, Audited on Elliptic2 and Elliptic++
summary: Two public benchmarks dominate graph-based anti-money-laundering (AML) research on Bitcoin: the transaction-level Elliptic dataset, extended as Elliptic++, and the subgraph-level Elliptic2. In both, a label is assigned according to the entity that sends the funds. We ask whether models trained on these benchmarks learn how laundering moves or merely who sent the money, and we propose a diagnostic protocol to tell the two apart: a sender lookup baseline, a novelty baseline, a sender-disjoint split with a leakage check, and a decomposition of performance into sender, receiver and intrinsic signal. On Elliptic2 the task largely reduces to classifying the sender. Under the standard random split, a no-learning lookup of sender history reaches a PR-AUC of 0.954, against 0.975 for gradient boosting on 456 features; our reimplementation of RevClassify reproduces its reported 0.97 and falls to 0.126 without sender information. When senders are held out, performance drops to 0.746, and the subgraph's own structure, transactions and receivers fall from 0.619 to 0.186. On Elliptic++ the same protocol finds the shortcut negligible: sender history reaches only 0.340 against 0.986 for the full model (3.5 against 10.1 times the test prevalence), adding it to the full model raises PR-AUC by less than 0.004 in every seed, and the transaction's own features keep 0.883 when sending addresses are held out. We trace the difference to the unit of sender identity: Elliptic2 senders are entity clusters that recur across many labeled subgraphs, whereas Elliptic++ senders are individual addresses, and fewer than half of test transactions have a sending address seen in training. A shared sender-based label rule thus produces a severe shortcut in one benchmark and a negligible one in the other, so the diagnostic must be run on each benchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出一套诊断协议（发送方查表基线、新颖性基线、发送方不相交划分与泄漏检查、性能分解），检验比特币反洗钱基准上的模型是否只是学到"谁在转账"而非洗钱模式。结果显示Elliptic2存在严重捷径（查表PR-AUC 0.954 vs 全特征0.975），Elliptic++几乎无此问题（0.340 vs 0.986），差异源于发送方身份粒度：实体聚类 vs 单个地址。
AI.motivation: 两个主流比特币图反洗钱基准（Elliptic++ 与 Elliptic2）均按"发送资金的实体"打标签，作者质疑在此基础上训练的模型究竟学到了洗钱资金流动规律，还是仅学到了发送方身份，因而需要一个能区分二者的诊断方法。
AI.method: 构建诊断协议：①发送方历史查表基线（不学习）；②新颖性基线；③发送方不相交（sender-disjoint）划分并做泄漏检查；④将性能分解为发送方、接收方与内在信号三部分。在两个基准上分别运行，并复现RevClassify作为对照。
AI.result: Elliptic2：随机划分下查表基线PR-AUC 0.954，456特征的梯度提升为0.975；复现RevClassify达0.97，去除发送方信息后跌至0.126；留出发送方后降至0.746，子图自身结构/交易/接收方信号由0.619降至0.186。Elliptic++：查表仅0.340（全模型0.986，分别为测试流行率的3.5与10.1倍），在每种随机种子下将发送方历史加入全模型提升不足0.004；留出发送地址后交易自身特征仍保持0.883。
AI.conclusion: 同一"基于发送方"的标签规则在不同基准上后果差异悬殊，根源在发送方身份单元：Elliptic2的发送方是跨大量已标注子图反复出现的实体聚类（形成严重捷径），Elliptic++的发送方是单个地址且不足一半测试交易拥有训练集见过的发送地址（捷径可忽略）。因此该诊断必须逐基准执行，不能跨基准类推。

title: Reinforcement Learning from LLM-Generated (Suboptimal) Demonstrations
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved substantial progress across many domains, but training an agent \textit{tabula rasa} remains highly sample-inefficient. A common remedy is to initialize the agent using a neural network pretrained on demonstrations. However, collecting demonstrations is expensive, and the demonstrations themselves can be suboptimal. In this work, we use a large language model (LLM) to generate an advice policy that produces demonstration data with effectively no human cost. We use this data to warmstart a DQN agent, and use the advice policy itself to guide exploration during training. Because LLM-generated advice is often suboptimal, we further introduce a value warmstart method that initializes the agent to recognize promising states from the advice policy's behavior, without directly copying its actions. To characterize the robustness of this method, we systematically perturb individual sub-skills of an LLM-generated advice policy for a long-horizon, sparse-reward task. Degraded advice still meaningfully accelerates learning relative to unaided baselines. These results suggest that LLM-generated advice, though suboptimal, can be a cheap alternative to costly human demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 该论文用大语言模型生成建议策略，无需人工演示即可为DQN提供热启动，并提出价值热启动以规避复制次优动作的问题，在稀疏奖励长时程任务上验证了其加速学习的效果与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 强化学习从零训练样本效率低，常用示范数据初始化智能体，但示范采集成本高且可能次优。作者希望用LLM生成示范与探索引导，以近乎零人力成本替代昂贵的人工演示。
AI.method: 用LLM生成一个建议策略（advice policy）产生示范数据，直接用于DQN的行为热启动，并在训练中由该策略引导探索；针对LLM建议常次优的问题，提出价值热启动（value warmstart），让智能体从建议策略行为中识别有前景的状态而不直接复制其动作。为评估鲁棒性，作者对LLM建议策略的各个子技能逐一施加扰动。
AI.result: 在一个长时程、稀疏奖励任务上，即使建议策略的单个子技能被系统扰动、建议质量下降，仍相较无辅助基线显著加速学习。
AI.conclusion: LLM生成的建议虽然次优，但可作为低成本替代人工演示的手段有效加速RL训练，并具备一定鲁棒性。

title: Rethinking Closed-Ended Medical VLM Evaluation: From Stable Wrongness to Counterfactual Answer Sensitivity
summary: As medical VLMs are increasingly evaluated for clinical decision-support scenarios, knowing when to trust their predictions is critical. Closed-ended medical VQA has become a common benchmark format because it enables automated scoring. Yet, systematic investigation into whether this format changes the reliability problem remains scarce. We identify a failure mode that we call stable wrongness: models can produce incorrect yes/no answers that remain confident and repeatable even when patient-specific visual evidence is removed or mismatched. This failure violates the premise behind sampling-stability uncertainty methods, including recent hallucination-aware calibration (HAC) variants: disagreement is informative only when errors are unstable. When shortcut-driven errors are themselves stable, sampling agreement can remain deceptively high. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce Counterfactual Answer Sensitivity (CAS), which shifts reliability estimation from answer stability to evidence sensitivity. CAS uses cross-modal counterfactual interventions, such as text-only, black, and corrupted images, to audit whether a committed yes/no answer remains supported when visual evidence is invalidated. Across 7 VLMs and 3 benchmarks, CAS outperforms the best HAC-family scores across all evaluated settings, achieving a macro-averaged AUROC gain of +0.150 for error detection. Mechanistic analysis further shows that CAS recovers hidden errors in the HAC-confident region and that its strongest standalone signal is counterfactual decision-boundary shift rather than hard prediction stability. Our findings suggest that closed-ended evaluation should test visual dependence, not only answer stability, in safety-critical medical contexts.

AI.tldr: 论文识别出医疗VLM在封闭式VQA中的"稳定错误"失效模式：模型在视觉证据被移除或错配时仍给出高置信、可重复的错误是非答案，从而破坏基于采样稳定性的不确定性方法（如HAC）的前提。为此提出反事实答案敏感性（CAS），从"答案稳定性"转向"证据敏感性"来估计可靠性。跨7个VLM、3个基准上，CAS在误差检测上宏观平均AUROC提升+0.150，并揭示其最强信号是反事实决策边界偏移而非硬预测稳定性。
AI.motivation: 医疗VLM日益用于临床决策支持，需判断何时信任其预测；封闭式医疗VQA因可自动评分成为常见评测格式，但该格式是否改变可靠性问题缺乏系统研究。核心动机是发现"稳定错误"：模型依赖捷径产生高置信且可重复的错误，使采样一致率虚高，导致HAC等基于分歧/稳定性的不确定性估计失效（分歧仅在错误不稳定时才有信息量）。
AI.method: 提出反事实答案敏感性（CAS）：将可靠性估计从答案稳定性转向证据敏感性。通过跨模态反事实干预——纯文本输入、黑图、损坏图像——检验已承诺的yes/no答案在视觉证据被无效化时是否仍被支持；并做机制分析，比较反事实决策边界偏移与硬预测稳定性等信号。
AI.result: 在7个VLM和3个基准的所有评测设置中，CAS均优于最佳HAC族分数，误差检测宏观平均AUROC提升+0.150；机制分析显示CAS能恢复HAC高置信区域中被掩盖的隐藏错误，且其最强单信号为反事实决策边界偏移而非硬预测稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 稳定性一致性不足以衡量医疗VLM可靠性；安全攸关场景下的封闭式评测应检验模型对视觉证据的依赖（视觉依赖性），而非仅看答案稳定性。CAS为无标注可靠性审计提供了可行路径。

title: A Nepali-Accented English Evaluation Dataset for Automatic Speech Recognition
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems perform strongly on native-English benchmarks, yet their accuracy degrades sharply when the input speech comes from under represented non-native accents. Nepali-accented English is particularly under-served: existing resources either focus on native Nepali speech, cover broader multi-accent settings without dedicated Nepali evaluation, or provide only limited Nepali-accent coverage. This paper presents a Nepali-accented English evaluation dataset designed to support robust ASR benchmarking under accent mismatch. The corpus was collected through a web-based platform that did not collect directly identifying metadata and contains recordings from 57 speakers. Each session follows a fixed 22-prompt protocol consisting of 11 phonetic prompts, 10 domain prompts, and 1 spontaneous prompt, providing complementary coverage of pronunciation, topical vocabulary, and natural speaking style. In addition to transcribed speech, the dataset includes participant metadata for coarse exploratory subgroup analysis and speaker-level manual recording-quality labels. Manual quality assessment shows that 50.9% of sessions are clean and 42.1% contain only mild noise. As a descriptive reference, open-source ASR baselines are substantially worse on this corpus than the corresponding LibriSpeech test-clean values reported in official model cards, reaching 38.15-55.00% WER on the collected set versus reported 2-4% WER on LibriSpeech test-clean. These baseline results position the corpus as a practical held-out resource for evaluating accent robustness and out-of-distribution generalization on Nepali-accented English.

AI.tldr: 该文发布了尼泊尔口音英语评测数据集：57名说话者、22个固定提示（11音素+10领域+1自由）的网页采集，人工标注录音质量（50.9%干净、42.1%轻度噪声）；开源ASR基线在该语料上WER达38.15–55.00%，远高于LibriSpeech test-clean的2–4%，可作为口音鲁棒性与分布外泛化的留出评测资源。
AI.motivation: ASR在native-English基准上表现强，但在代表性不足的非母语口音上准确率急剧下降；尼泊尔口音英语尤其缺乏服务——现有资源或聚焦母语尼泊尔语、或覆盖多口音但不含专门尼泊尔评测、或尼泊尔口音覆盖有限。因此需要一个面向口音失配的稳健评测数据集。
AI.method: 通过网页平台采集，不收集直接身份元数据，共57名说话者；每场会话遵循固定22提示协议（11个音素提示、10个领域提示、1个自发言语提示），分别覆盖发音、主题词汇与自然语体；除转写语音外，还提供用于粗粒度探索性子组分析的参与者元数据与说话者级人工录音质量标签。
AI.result: 人工质量评估显示50.9%会话为干净、42.1%仅含轻度噪声；作为描述性参照，开源ASR基线在该语料上WER为38.15–55.00%，而官方模型卡中LibriSpeech test-clean对应值为2–4%。
AI.conclusion: 该语料可作为实用留出资源，用于评测尼泊尔口音英语的口音鲁棒性与分布外泛化能力。

title: Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness: How Context and Skills Shape Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Autoresearch agents, which autonomously design, run, and refine experiments, are accelerating scientific progress, particularly in AI research. However, existing agents rely on harnesses that combine multiple mechanisms, making it difficult to determine how individual components contribute to performance. We systematically study harness design for long-horizon, self-evolving autoresearch agents along two dimensions: context management, which determines what an agent retains from its past attempts, and skill management, which governs how it stores and reuses lessons from those attempts. Across MLE-Bench and KernelBench with gpt-oss-120b, gpt-6-luna, and gpt-6-sol, we isolate the effects of individual harness design choices by evaluating each against a recency-truncation baseline within a shared agent framework. For context management, we find that preserving individually accessible records of past attempts is more effective than maintaining a rolling summary, with context folding performing best across all six settings and improving upon the baseline by up to 19.2%. For skill management, selectively discarding persistently unused lessons is more effective on average than consolidating them or promoting them to standing rules. Building on these findings, we combine context folding and skill deletion in MLEvolver, which achieves a 72.7% medal rate on MLE-Bench Lite and a 94% $\mathrm{fast}_1$ score on KernelBench Level 3, substantially outperforming AIDE and OpenEvolve under the same inference budget. Overall, our study distills design principles for preserving experimental history and curating reusable lessons in autoresearch harnesses, paving the way for agents that turn accumulated experience into sustained progress.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究长程自演化自动驾驶科研智能体的harness设计，将其拆为上下文管理与技能管理两个维度，通过受控实验确定最佳设计，并据此提出MLEvolver，在MLE-Bench Lite和KernelBench Level 3上显著优于AIDE与OpenEvolve。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶科研智能体（autoresearch agents）依赖集成多种机制的复合harness，难以厘清各组件对性能的独立贡献，因此亟需对harness设计进行解耦、可归因的系统研究。
AI.method: 沿两个维度展开：上下文管理（智能体对历史尝试的保留方式）与技能管理（经验教训的存储与复用）。在统一智能体框架内，以recency-truncation为基线，逐一隔离评估单个设计选择；测试平台为MLE-Bench与KernelBench，模型为gpt-oss-120b、gpt-6-luna、gpt-6-sol，共六种设置组合。
AI.result: 上下文管理方面，保留可单独访问的历史尝试记录优于滚动摘要，其中context folding在全部六种设置中表现最佳，相较基线最高提升19.2%；技能管理方面，选择性删除长期未被使用的经验平均优于合并（consolidation）或提升为常驻规则。整合二者得到MLEvolver，在MLE-Bench Lite上达到72.7%奖牌率，在KernelBench Level 3上取得94%的fast₁分数，在相同推理预算下大幅超过AIDE与OpenEvolve。
AI.conclusion: 研究提炼出自动驾驶科研harness的设计原则——以可寻址方式保留实验历史、并精选可复用经验（含主动遗忘），为将累积经验转化为持续进展的智能体奠定基础。

title: Internalized Experience: How Training Data Shapes Memory Formation in LLMs
summary: Parametric memory enables large language models (LLMs) to retain information from past experience and reuse it in subsequent tasks. Yet how training data supports the internalization of reusable task rules remains unclear. We introduce FSMem (Finite-State Machine Memory), a state-transition framework for constructing training data and studying how data content and organization shape memory formation. We evaluate rule reuse across synthetic worlds, classical planning, and code execution through valid-action identification and execution-outcome prediction, complemented by next-operation prediction in code. Our experiments reveal several systematic learning patterns. Under matched training conditions, even unchanged task rules become harder to internalize when learned alongside a larger variety of action types; by contrast, scaling the training data to provide broader state-action coverage generally improves rule learning. We further find that training at a single execution depth produces depth-specialized behavior, with models performing best when training and test executions have similar lengths. Motivated by this finding, we construct cumulative corpora that combine short and long trajectories, which can outperform long-trajectory-only training while using fewer training tokens. Together, these results demonstrate that the same task rules can be internalized differently depending on how execution experience is constructed, and that understanding these learning patterns can guide the design of more effective training data for parametric memory.

AI.tldr: 提出FSMem（有限状态机记忆）框架，将训练数据构造形式化为状态转移，研究数据内容与组织形式如何影响LLM参数化记忆的形成，并发现三条系统性学习规律。
AI.motivation: 参数化记忆使LLM能保存并复用过去经验，但训练数据如何支撑“可复用任务规则”的内部化机制尚不清楚，缺乏可控的数据构造与分析框架。
AI.method: 提出FSMem状态转移框架用于构造训练数据；在合成世界、经典规划、代码执行三类任务上，通过有效动作识别、执行结果预测及代码中的下一步操作预测进行评估，并控制变量比较动作类型多样性、状态-动作覆盖度、执行深度与语料组织方式的影响。
AI.result: (1) 在训练条件匹配时，动作类型多样性越大，即使任务规则不变也越难内部化；而扩大数据规模以提升状态-动作覆盖度通常改善规则学习。(2) 单一执行深度训练导致“深度特化”，训练与测试轨迹长度相近时性能最佳。(3) 基于此构造的累积语料（短+长轨迹混合）可优于仅用长轨迹训练，且消耗更少训练token。
AI.conclusion: 同一任务规则会因执行经验的构造方式不同而以不同方式被内部化；揭示这些学习模式可为设计更高效的参数化记忆训练数据提供指导。

title: MobileGrail: Learning Compact Guardrails for On-Device deployable Mobile GUI Agent Safety
summary: Runtime guardrails protect mobile GUI agents by assessing each proposed action before execution, but existing guardrails rely on cloud hosted large multimodal models, exposing every screen to a remote server, including private information such as payments, messages, and medical records. We propose MobileGrail, an on-device deployable model that addresses both. It maintains a recurrent task state that retains only the evidence subsequent safety decisions depend on, so that authorization and execution progress persist beyond the short context. To intervene early while keeping the safety boundary precise, it learns two labels, unsafe and block: unsafe marks the action that commits a violation, whereas block may be issued at any step of an intervention window, which spans from the first action that the user's authorization no longer explains to the committing action itself. To support training, we build an environment of 32 applications whose backends verify the effect of every action, supplying verified labels for supervision and rewards for reinforcement learning to calibrate intervention timing. We also build MobileVeto, an offline benchmark of unsafe trajectories largely on held-out applications, each paired with a benign counterpart. On MobileVeto, MobileGrail built on Qwen3.5-2B intercepts 76.2% of violations, up from 64.5% for its prompted backbone, while reducing premature intervention from 58.6% to 5.2%, outperforming the cloud-based OS-Sentinel on both. We further conduct online evaluation on GhostEIBench, where MobileGrail guarding a Qwen3.8-27B agent reduces fully successful attacks from 13 to 3 of 110 tasks while raising task completion from 48 to 58. Quantized to 4 bits, MobileGrail runs on a Snapdragon 8 Elite at a median latency of 4.7 s, comparable to the 5.1s of cloud-hosted Gemini 3.8 Flash.

AI.tldr: MobileGrail 是一个可端侧部署的移动 GUI 智能体运行时防护模型，通过循环任务状态与"unsafe/block"双标签机制，在保护隐私的同时实现更精准、更早的不安全行为干预。
AI.motivation: 现有运行时防护依赖云端大模型，需将每一屏内容上传服务器，泄露支付、消息、医疗记录等隐私信息；且需在长任务中保持授权与执行进度的连贯判断，并在精确安全边界下尽早干预。
AI.method: 提出 MobileGrail：维护仅保留后续安全决策所需证据的循环任务状态，突破短上下文限制；学习两类标签——unsafe（标记实际违规的提交动作）与 block（可在整个干预窗口内任意步骤发出，窗口始于用户授权不再能解释的首个动作）；构建含 32 个应用、由后端验证每步动作效果的环境以提供验证标签与强化学习奖励，校准干预时机；另构建 MobileVeto 离线基准，包含主要来自留出应用的不安全轨迹及其良性对照。
AI.result: 在 MobileVeto 上，基于 Qwen3.5-2B 的 MobileGrail 拦截 76.2% 的违规（提示式基线为 64.5%），过早干预从 58.6% 降至 5.2%，两项均优于云端 OS-Sentinel；在 GhostEIBench 在线评测中，保护 Qwen3.8-27B 智能体使完全成功攻击由 110 个任务中的 13 个降至 3 个，任务完成率由 48 提升至 58；4 bit 量化后在骁龙 8 Elite 上中位延迟 4.7 s，与云端 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的 5.1 s 相当。
AI.conclusion: 端侧可部署的运行时防护可在不牺牲隐私的前提下同时提升拦截率与干预时机精度，并保持与云端方案相当的延迟，验证了本地化 GUI 智能体安全护栏的可行性。

title: Dimension Is Free, Horizon Is Not: When Evolution Strategies Rival Policy Gradients for LLM Fine-Tuning
summary: Policy gradient (PG) methods such as GRPO dominate LLM fine-tuning, yet recent work showed that Evolution Strategies (ES) also scale to fine-tuning models with billions of parameters. Which method needs fewer samples, and on which tasks, remains unclear. We view the two methods as estimators of the same gradient that differ in where they explore. Because ES perturbs parameters, its noise grows with the number of parameters, and because PG samples actions, its noise grows with the number of generated tokens. Only noise along the directions that change the reward slows learning. The cost of ES then depends on the effective dimension, the number of independent skills a task requires rather than its parameter count, while the cost of PG depends on the effective horizon, which counts only the tokens that share both credit and weights with the reward-carrying ones. We train both methods on a synthetic task where the number of skills and the effective horizon can be varied separately. PG is cheaper when the horizon is short, ES becomes cheaper once it is long enough, and this crossover moves to longer horizons as the number of skills grows. We then measure the effective horizons of 20 NLP, math reasoning, and agentic tasks and compare the two methods with Qwen2.5-7B. PG leads on short-horizon tasks, the two tie on the moderate-horizon math ones, and no task has a horizon in the regime where the theory predicts an ES advantage. Terminal-Bench has a far longer horizon. There, in a preliminary comparison with Qwen3.5-4B, ES without any credit assignment reaches a higher success rate than the PG checkpoint released with Tmax, as the theory predicts. ES should thus have the advantage on long-horizon tasks with few independent skills and a nonvanishing reward signal. Current benchmarks are only at the onset of this regime, so ES should become more competitive as agentic tasks grow longer.

AI.tldr: 该文把PG与ES视为同一梯度的两种估计器，用"有效维度（技能数）"与"有效视界（共享信用与权重的token数）"刻画二者噪声来源，理论上预测短视界PG更省样本、长视界ES更省，并用合成实验与20个真实任务验证。
AI.motivation: GRPO等策略梯度方法主导LLM微调，但已有工作显示ES也能扩展到数十亿参数模型；此前缺乏对"哪种方法更省样本、在何种任务上"的统一理解，作者希望给出可解释的成本理论并实证检验。
AI.method: 将PG与ES统一为同一梯度的估计器，区别仅在于探索位置：ES扰动参数，噪声随参数规模增长；PG采样动作，噪声随生成token数增长；只有改变奖励方向上的噪声才拖慢学习。据此提出ES成本取决于有效维度（任务所需的独立技能数量），PG成本取决于有效视界（与奖励携带token共享信用与权重的token数）。构造技能数与有效视界可独立调节的合成任务进行对照实验，并测量20个NLP、数学推理与智能体任务的有效视界，用Qwen2.5-7B比较两方法；另在Terminal-Bench上用Qwen3.5-4B做初步对比。
AI.result: 合成任务中，短视界时PG更省，视界足够长后ES更省，且技能数增多会使交叉点移向更长视界。真实任务测量显示PG在短视界任务领先，中等视界的数学任务二者持平，没有任何任务落入理论预测ES占优的区域。Terminal-Bench视界远更长，初步对比中无任何信用分配的ES成功率高于Tmax发布的PG检查点，符合理论预测。
AI.conclusion: ES应在"长视界、少量独立技能且奖励信号不消失"的任务上占优；当前基准仅处于该区域的起点，随着智能体任务变长，ES有望更具竞争力。

title: Learning Heterogeneous Reasoning in Large Language Models: From Mode Compatibility to Local Bottlenecks
summary: Post-training large language models routinely pools reasoning trajectories from diverse teachers or algorithms, yet it remains unclear whether standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can learn such heterogeneous strategies without explicit mode conditioning. We study the learnability and local bottlenecks of heterogeneous reasoning through a formal mixture formulation and controlled experiments. We first formalize the representational compatibility of the optimal autoregressive model with latent reasoning mixtures: the target next-token distribution weights modes by their prefix posteriors and concentrates on a single mode once alternative modes assign negligible likelihood to the prefix. In a verifiable symbolic graph-search environment with paired breadth-first and depth-first search trajectories, no consistent disadvantage is observed for unlabeled mixed SFT relative to homogeneous or labeled baselines under matched token budgets while preserving both modes. Scaling across 0.6B--14B models and data budgets largely eliminates global mode confusion, shifting the primary bottleneck to local state-tracking transitions. Because a local mistake affects the final outcome only when subsequent reasoning is sensitive to that step, we find that only a small fraction of local errors are outcome-determining \emph{Critical Reasoning Nodes (CRNs)}, and that single-step repairs at these nodes rescue failing trajectories across symbolic search and natural language benchmarks whenever the model has sufficient downstream competence to complete the remaining derivation. Our environment is open-sourced at https://github.com/Bowen1911/Symbolic_graph_env.

AI.tldr: 研究异质推理（多教师/多算法轨迹混合）在标准SFT下的可学习性与局部瓶颈：混合SFT可同时保留多种模式，全局模式混淆随规模消失，瓶颈转移到局部状态跟踪，且仅少数局部错误是决定结果的"关键推理节点"（CRN）。
AI.motivation: 后训练常把来自不同教师或算法的推理轨迹混合用于SFT，但标准SFT能否在无显式模式条件下学习异质策略尚不明确，需厘清其可学习性与失败瓶颈所在。
AI.method: 给出混合情形的形式化表述：论证最优自回归模型与潜在推理混合的表示相容性——目标下一词分布按各模式的前缀后验加权，当其他模式对前缀赋予可忽略似然时集中于单一模式；并在可控的可验证符号图搜索环境（配对BFS/DFS轨迹）中做实验，在匹配token预算下比较无标签混合SFT与同质/带标签基线，并扩展到0.6B–14B模型与不同数据预算。
AI.result: 在匹配token预算下，无标签混合SFT相对同质或带标签基线未见一致劣势，且保留两种模式；规模（0.6B–14B）与数据预算扩展基本消除全局模式混淆，主要瓶颈转为局部状态跟踪转移；只有小部分局部错误在后续推理对该步敏感时决定最终结果，即"关键推理节点（CRN）"，对这些节点做单步修复可在符号搜索与自然语言基准上挽救失败轨迹（前提是模型具备完成剩余推导的下游能力）。
AI.conclusion: 异质推理混合可由标准SFT有效学习，全局模式混淆并非根本障碍；真正的瓶颈是局部的状态跟踪错误，而其中仅少数CRN决定成败，因此针对CRN的单步修复是高效的后训练/纠错方向。环境已开源。

title: Adopting AI Technologies without Traps: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework
summary: AI technologies and AI agents play increasingly important roles in human society, including in education, economics, and research. Adopting AI technologies can bring immediate, and sometimes tremendous, rewards such as through productivity boost, but they can also bring negative effects including but not limited to losses of job and training opportunities, and cognitive capability declines. Thus, it is important to investigate the optimal ways of adopting AI technologies without different traps. In this paper, we develop a general multi-agent Markov decision process (MDP) based reinforcement learning (RL or MARL) modeling framework for determining and analyzing optimal adoption of AI technologies. This framework can model the long-term dynamic effects of AI adoption, and lead to finding the optimal AI adoption strategies. In our modeling framework, the negative effects of AI adoption are modeled by undesirable state transitions or negative rewards in the MDPs. The proposed multi-agent RL MDPs incorporate both human agents and AI agents. The key idea of our models is that incorporating AI technologies may not only increase the immediate rewards for AI agents but also alter the states of the involved human and AI agents. In particular, we apply this framework to analyzing AI offloading leading to skill erosion, to analyzing optimal human resource structures for a firm adopting AI, and to analyzing the economic equilibria in the trading/employment among human and AI agents. Since the multi-agent MDP based RL technique is from control, machine learning and AI, this research is essentially using an AI technique to determine the optimal ways of adopting or co-existing with AI without traps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于多智能体马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的强化学习建模框架，用于确定并分析AI技术的最优采用策略，以规避AI采用带来的长期负面效应（如失业、技能退化、认知能力下降等），并应用于AI卸载致技能侵蚀、企业人力资源结构优化与人类—AI交易/就业经济均衡三类问题。
AI.motivation: AI技术与AI智能体在教育、经济与科研中作用日益重要，采用AI可带来生产率提升等即时且巨大的收益，但也可能造成失业与培训机会丧失、认知能力下降等负面后果。因此需要系统研究如何以最优方式采用AI、避免各类“陷阱”，尤其需要考虑AI采用的长期动态影响，而非仅关注即时收益。
AI.method: 构建通用的多智能体马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）强化学习（RL/MARL）建模框架：将人类智能体与AI智能体共同纳入多智能体RL-MDP；AI采用的负面效应通过不良状态转移或负奖励建模；核心思想是引入AI技术不仅可能提升AI智能体的即时奖励，还会改变所涉及的人类与AI智能体的状态。该框架能够刻画AI采用的长期动态效应，并求出最优AI采用策略。框架被应用于三个场景：AI卸载导致技能侵蚀的分析、采用AI的企业最优人力资源结构分析、人类与AI之间交易/就业的经济均衡分析。
AI.result: 框架可建模AI采用的长期动态效应并导出最优采用策略；在三个应用场景中分别刻画了AI卸载引发的技能侵蚀、企业采用AI时的人力资源结构优化，以及人类与AI之间交易与就业的经济均衡。由于MARL技术源于控制、机器学习与人工智能领域，该研究本质上是用AI技术来确定与AI共存或采用AI的最优方式以规避陷阱。
AI.conclusion: 基于多智能体MDP的强化学习是分析AI技术最优采用与人类—AI共存的通用且有效的建模范式，能够将即时收益与长期负面效应纳入统一优化目标；该“以AI研究AI采用”的思路为规避AI采用陷阱、指导政策与企业决策提供了系统性方法。

title: Small data machine learning: the trilemma of low-sample tabular regimes
summary: Small tabular datasets leave few observations for choosing a model and assessing its predictions. We examine these competing demands in controlled simulations and on six public datasets, using SmallGBM and SmallMLP as fixed-configuration case studies. Three results illustrate why the choice of evaluation matters. First, at n = 100, five-fold cross-validation overstated the gain from tuning XGBoost by 0.063 ROC-AUC on random labels, while tuning improved independent-test ROC-AUC by 0.0078 on a Gaussian mixture. Second, when 20% of binary training labels were flipped, the median within-trial ROC-AUC loss was 0.0210 for SmallGBM and 0.0778 for a fixed 200-tree XGBoost configuration. A separate regression experiment showed the sensitivity of squared-error training to heavy-tailed responses. Third, in a heteroscedastic regression experiment, locally weighted SmallMLP intervals covered about one percentage point more test responses than ordinary split conformal intervals at both tested dimensions. Their mean widths also increased. On a Gaussian classification task with linear log odds, logistic regression achieved the highest mean ROC-AUC at all seven training sizes. These experiments identify settings in which a small-data model helps and quantify the cost of its assumptions.

AI.tldr: 通过受控模拟与六个公开数据集，以SmallGBM和SmallMLP为固定配置案例，考察小样本表格数据中"选模型"与"评估预测"之间的张力，并用三组实验说明评估方式的选择如何改变结论。
AI.motivation: 小规模表格数据集观测极少，可用于选择模型和评估其预测的样本不足，两种需求相互竞争；同时现有评估流程（如交叉验证调参、固定配置、区间校准）在小数据下的可靠性缺乏量化证据。
AI.method: 在受控模拟与六个公开数据集上进行实验，采用固定配置的SmallGBM与SmallMLP作为案例，对比五折交叉验证与独立测试集、不同树数XGBoost配置在标签翻转下的表现、平方误差训练对重尾响应的敏感性、局部加权与普通分裂保形区间的对比，以及七种训练规模下的逻辑回归基线。
AI.result: n=100时五折交叉验证在随机标签上把XGBoost调参增益高估0.063 ROC-AUC，而高斯混合上独立测试的调参增益仅0.0078；20%二分类训练标签翻转下，试验内ROC-AUC损失中位数SmallGBM为0.0210、固定200棵树XGBoost为0.0778；异方差回归中局部加权SmallMLP区间覆盖率提高约一个百分点但平均宽度增加；线性对数几率高斯分类任务中逻辑回归在全部七个训练规模下平均ROC-AUC最高。
AI.conclusion: 小数据场景下评估设计（CV对独立测试、配置固定性、损失函数与区间方法）会实质性改变模型选择结论；研究明确了小数据模型可获益的具体情境，并量化了其假设带来的代价。

title: OWE-Bench: A long-horizon benchmark for measuring real-world engineering
comment: 35 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables. Code: https://github.com/Mercor-Intelligence/OpenWorldEngineer ; data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mercor/OpenWorldEngineer ; leaderboard: https://openworldengineer.mercor.com
summary: We present OWE-Bench (OpenWorldEngineer-Bench), a benchmark of 26 long-horizon engineering tasks written by domain experts in software engineering, physical engineering, machine learning, and scientific computing. Tasks range from optimizing kernels and designing an aircraft, to identifying the faults responsible for an earthquake. Each task requires significant domain knowledge and engineering work, with models averaging hundreds of millions of tokens per task. Solutions are scored on practical measures such as speed, cost and accuracy, both on provided cases the agent could test against and on hidden cases that an engineer would expect from the task description. The best-performing frontier model so far, Claude Fable 5.2, scores 54.6% and averages 211 million tokens per task. We highlight two findings. First, when models are given more time, they use more test-time compute and achieve higher scores. Models also scale differently with test-time compute: GPT-6 Astra achieves higher scores at shorter time limits and at equal token use, while Claude Fable 5.2 uses more tokens at longer limits to achieve the highest overall score. Second, each model scores lower on hidden cases than on the provided cases, by an average of 18 points, which we call the deployment gap. Models also fail to predict the deployment gap, overestimating their performance on hidden test cases by an average of 21 points. We hope that OWE-Bench grounds progress toward agents whose engineering solutions perform as well in deployment as they do in testing.

AI.tldr: 提出 OWE-Bench，一个由领域专家撰写的 26 项长时程工程任务基准，覆盖软件工程、物理工程、机器学习与科学计算；最佳模型 Claude Fable 5.2 得分 54.6%，并揭示"时间投入缩放差异"与"部署差距"两大发现。
AI.motivation: 现有基准难以衡量智能体在真实长时程工程任务中的能力：这类任务需要大量领域知识与工程工作量（单任务消耗数亿 token），且评估应贴合工程实践中的速度、成本、准确率，并需区分"给定可见用例"与"工程上应预期的隐藏用例"。
AI.method: 构建专家撰写的 26 项长时程工程任务（如核优化、飞行器设计、地震断层归因）；每任务消耗平均数百亿至数亿 token；按速度、成本、准确率等实用指标打分，同时在提供的可见测试用例与隐藏用例上评估；并分析不同模型随测试时计算量的缩放行为及性能预测偏差。
AI.result: 最强前沿模型 Claude Fable 5.2 得分 54.6%，平均每任务 211M token。发现一：给予更多时间时模型增加测试时计算并提升得分，但缩放方式不同——GPT-6 Astra 在更短时限下及等 token 用量时得分更高，Claude Fable 5.2 则在更长时限下以更多 token 取得总体最高分。发现二：所有模型在隐藏用例上的得分平均低 18 分（"部署差距"），且模型无法预测该差距，平均高估隐藏用例表现 21 分。
AI.conclusion: OWE-Bench 为"工程方案在部署中与测试中同样有效"的智能体研究提供评估基石，指出测试与部署性能不一致及模型自我评估失准是关键待解问题。

title: Weight Averaging at Small Budgets Confounds Formula-Labeled Pretraining in Microstructure-Property Regression: A Pre-Specified Study with Post Hoc Rechecks
summary: Closed-form physics formulas can label synthetic microstructures at no cost, so supervised pretraining on those labels is an alternative to self-supervised pretraining when labels are scarce. One pre-specified protocol tests this on two public simulated benchmarks, two-phase conductivity and short-fiber stiffness: a ConvNeXt-Small is pretrained on 150,000 synthetic images by formula regression or masked reconstruction and fine-tuned on 100, 400, or 1,600 labels. Five fine-tuning seeds from one formula checkpoint have mean residual correlations of 0.994 (conductivity) and 0.999 (stiffness). On conductivity the formula network compresses its predictions (slope 0.64) and has four times the 400-label error of ImageNet initialization. Two confounds interact: the generator renders the low-conductivity phase with the opposite contrast polarity, and the exponential moving average (EMA; decay 0.995, no bias correction) still holds 16% of the initial weights after the 400-label schedule. Without the EMA the slope is 0.97, and over three subsets and five seeds the mismatched checkpoint has 1.4 times the ImageNet error (0.0119 versus 0.0084). Three pretraining runs per polarity leave the comparison inconclusive: matched means (0.0086, 0.0111, 0.0118) fall below mismatched means (0.0119, 0.0120, 0.0123) in aggregate (0.0105 versus 0.0121) but overlap on two of three subsets, and the matched spread (0.0032) exceeds the mismatched spread (0.0004). On stiffness without the EMA, formula pretraining lowers the 100-label error by 18% versus ImageNet over five seeds, including a re-initialized head, while ImageNet seeds also correlate at 0.992. Weight averages that start at the pretrained weights can dominate small-budget comparisons and should be rechecked at the last weights.

AI.tldr: 用闭式物理公式对合成微结构图像进行监督预训练（公式回归），并与掩码重建、ImageNet初始化在少标签微调下对比；结果受图像极性失配与EMA权重平均混淆，仅在刚度任务的100标签预算下公式预训练稳定优于ImageNet。
AI.motivation: 少标签微调场景缺乏标签，自监督预训练是常见方案；而闭式物理公式可零成本地为合成微结构生成标签，因此作者想检验"公式回归监督预训练"能否作为自监督预训练的替代方案，并在预先设定的协议下与ImageNet初始化对比。
AI.method: 在两个公开模拟基准（两相电导率、短纤维刚度）上使用ConvNeXt-Small，在150,000张合成图像上用公式回归或掩码重建预训练，再在100/400/1,600个标签上微调；每个公式检查点用5个微调种子，并做3次不同极性的预训练重复实验，同时考察EMA（decay 0.995、无偏差校正）与生成器低电导相极性翻转的影响。
AI.result: 电导率任务：5个种子残差相关0.994（刚度0.999）；公式网络预测被压缩（斜率0.64），400标签误差为ImageNet初始化的4倍。EMA在400标签调度后仍保留16%初始权重，去除后斜率升至0.97，错配检查点误差为ImageNet的1.4倍（0.0119 vs 0.0084）。三次极性匹配重复实验的聚合均值为0.0105 vs 错配0.0121，但在3个子集中的2个上区间重叠，且匹配组离散度(0.0032)大于错配组(0.0004)，结论不确定。刚度任务在无EMA时，公式预训练将100标签误差较ImageNet降低18%（5种子，含重初始化头），ImageNet种子相关亦达0.992。
AI.conclusion: 公式监督预训练在刚度低标签预算下有小幅但稳定的收益，而在电导率任务上受极性失配与EMA残留初始权重双重混淆，无法得出确定结论；起始于预训练权重的权重平均会主导小预算比较，应在最终权重（last weights）上重新核对。

title: EVD-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for EEG-to-Image Decoding
summary: EEG-to-image decoding recovers visual information from non-invasive brain recordings, providing a window into human perception. However, comparisons across systems are confounded by a variable that is rarely reported as such: which participants' data the system was allowed to use. The same Top-1 score on a 200-way gallery may come from a per-participant system, a pooled model over all participants, or a model that never saw the test participant---cases that differ by more than most architectural changes between the methods being compared. We present \bench, a benchmark on THINGS-EEG2 that standardizes the gallery and EEG input, matches training budgets across systems within each regime, and compares three participant-access regimes: within-subject, joint-subject, and strict leave-one-subject-out, with unlabeled target calibration reported separately. All three settings evaluate concept-level zero-shot retrieval: the 200 test concepts are disjoint from the 1,654 concepts used for EEG--image fitting and validation. We compare retrieval across access regimes and use zero-EEG and matched-wrong EEG controls to assess dependence on correct EEG--stimulus pairing. We vary trial averaging, gallery size and difficulty, and training data coverage, and compare target adaptation and visual feature targets. We also assess sensitivity to EEG window length and channel count, robustness to input perturbations, and confidence calibration. These results establish participant-access regime as a necessary reporting dimension alongside gallery, repetition, and visual target.

AI.tldr: 提出基准 \bench（基于 THINGS-EEG2），将"参与者数据访问机制"标准化为可比较的报告维度，统一画廊、EEG 输入与训练预算，对比 within-subject、joint-subject 与 strict LOSO 三种机制。
AI.motivation: EEG 到图像解码领域跨系统比较存在严重混淆因素：各系统是否使用了被测试参与者的数据很少被明确报告。相同 200-way Top-1 分数可能来自单人系统、全部参与者池化模型或从未见过测试参与者的模型，其差异往往大于方法间多数架构改动带来的差异。
AI.method: 构建 \bench 基准：统一检索画廊与 EEG 输入，在各机制内匹配训练预算；设定三种参与者访问机制（within-subject、joint-subject、strict leave-one-subject-out），并将无标签目标域校准单独报告；采用概念级零样本检索（200 个测试概念与 1,654 个拟合/验证概念不相交）；设置零 EEG 与匹配错误 EEG 对照以检验对正确 EEG–刺激配对依赖；变化 trial 平均、画廊规模与难度、训练数据覆盖度，比较目标域自适应与视觉特征目标；并评估 EEG 窗口长度与通道数敏感性、输入扰动鲁棒性及置信度校准。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅说明完成上述多因素系统对比与消融，包括访问机制间检索性能比较、对照条件下的配对依赖性验证，以及敏感性、鲁棒性与校准分析。
AI.conclusion: 参与者访问机制应与画廊规模、重复次数和视觉目标并列，成为 EEG-to-image 解码研究必须报告的维度；该基准为跨系统比较提供受控、可比的评测协议。

title: Trustworthy Speech-Based Autism Screening under Class Imbalance with Uncertainty-Aware HuBERT Ensembles
comment: Accepted version. To appear in IEEE Xplore
summary: Early screening of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is critical for timely clinical intervention, although establishing reliable speech based screening systems remains problematic due to limited clinical data, class imbalance, and the need for reliable uncertainty estimation. We propose an uncertainty-aware ASD screening framework based on self-supervised HuBERT representations, combining Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) crossvalidation, balanced k-bagging, and Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout. Multiple HuBERT models are fine-tuned on balanced subsets, with predictions combined through probability-based ensemble averaging and aggregated at the subject level. Experiments on the Child Pathological Speech Database (CPSD) show strong performance, achieving 86.30% balanced accuracy and 93.74% ROC-AUC at the utterance level, and 95.04% and 96.30%, respectively, at the subject level. Furthermore, predictive entropy effectively reflects classification reliability: incorrectly classified segments show higher entropy than correctly classified ones (0.4605 $\pm$ 0.2314 vs. 0.1717 $\pm$ 0.1830), with a significant correlation with errors (r = 0.3981, p = 7.38 x 10 -170 ) and an error-detection ROC-AUC of 0.8359. These results demonstrate the potential of the proposed framework as a robust and uncertainty-aware computer-aided tool for ASD screening.

AI.tldr: 提出基于HuBERT自监督表征的不确定性感知ASD语音筛查框架，结合LOSO交叉验证、平衡k-bagging与MC Dropout，在CPSD上取得语句级86.30%平衡准确率与93.74% ROC-AUC，受试者级达95.04%与96.30%；预测熵可有效反映分类可靠性（错误片段熵0.4605±0.2314 vs 正确0.1717±0.1830，错误检测ROC-AUC 0.8359）。
AI.motivation: ASD早期筛查对及时临床干预至关重要，但基于语音的筛查系统受限于临床数据不足、类别不平衡以及缺乏可靠的不确定性估计。
AI.method: 以自监督HuBERT表征为基础：多个HuBERT模型在平衡子集上微调（balanced k-bagging），采用留一受试者交叉验证（LOSO）防止受试者泄漏，用Monte Carlo Dropout获取不确定性，通过基于概率的集成平均融合预测并在受试者层面聚合；以预测熵作为可靠性度量。
AI.result: 在Child Pathological Speech Database（CPSD）上，语句级平衡准确率86.30%、ROC-AUC 93.74%；受试者级分别为95.04%和96.30%。错误分类片段熵显著高于正确片段（0.4605±0.2314 vs 0.1717±0.1830），熵与错误显著相关（r=0.3981，p=7.38×10⁻¹⁷⁰），错误检测ROC-AUC为0.8359。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可作为稳健且具不确定性感知能力的计算机辅助ASD筛查工具。

title: mini-psych-agent: Evaluating Human-Like Behavior in LLM Agents through Interactive Psychological Environments
summary: A Large Language Model (LLM), its harness, and the test-time compute budget jointly determine its behavior. Consequently, the same underlying model, embedded in different agentic workflows or allocated different amounts of test-time compute, can exhibit markedly different performance. Psychologists face an analogous challenge when evaluating human performance: the same person may behave differently under different incentives and levels of deliberation. Psychological tasks therefore provide an ideal testbed for studying such behavioral variation. However, when adapted to LLMs, these tasks are typically text-transcribed, replaying fixed, language-rendered experiments as static prompts. This format is ill-suited to agent evaluation, where actions can alter future observations and task states. Conversely, although dynamic environments are prevalent in the evaluation of LLM agents, they rarely ask whether the resulting behavior is human-like. Here, we bridge this gap by transforming psychological tasks into dynamic environments in which agents can interact and by using a learned human-policy model to evaluate how compatible the resulting behavioral trajectories are with human behavior. Across these environments, we find that this compatibility varies with an LLM's agentic configuration and the psychological task, and that memory raises it mainly by making choices more predictable rather than more human-like. These findings motivate a more holistic evaluation of LLM agents in psychology-inspired environments, accounting for both the backbone model and its agentic scaffold.

AI.tldr: 将心理学任务改造为可供智能体交互的动态环境，并用学习到的人类策略模型衡量LLM智能体行为轨迹与人类行为的契合度，发现该契合度随智能体配置与任务类型变化，且记忆主要通过提升可预测性而非拟人性来提高契合度。
AI.motivation: LLM的行为由模型本体、其harness（智能体工作流）与测试时计算预算共同决定，同一模型在不同配置下表现差异显著，这与心理学中同一人在不同激励与思虑水平下行为变化的情境相似。然而现有两类研究存在缺口：把心理学任务迁移到LLM上时通常做文本转录、以静态提示回放固定实验，无法支持动作改变后续观测与任务状态的智能体评测；而LLM智能体常用的动态环境又很少检验行为是否"像人"。因此需要一个能同时刻画动态交互与人类行为可比性的评测框架。
AI.method: 把心理学任务转化为智能体可交互的动态环境（动作会影响后续观测与任务状态），并训练一个人类策略模型（human-policy model），用以量化智能体行为轨迹与人类行为的兼容性/契合度；在此框架下系统改变LLM的智能体配置（agentic configuration）与任务，并考察记忆（memory）机制对契合度的影响来源。
AI.result: 在多个心理学动态环境中，行为与人类的契合度随LLM的智能体配置和具体心理学任务而变化；记忆能够提升契合度，但主要机制是使选择变得更可预测，而非使行为更接近人类。
AI.conclusion: 对LLM智能体的心理学评测应更整体化（holistic），同时考虑骨干模型与其智能体脚手架（agentic scaffold），而非仅评估基座模型；心理学启发的动态环境为研究智能体行为的类人程度提供了有效测试床。

title: The Effect of Security-Focused Prompts on Reported Findings: A Controlled Experiment on 400 AI-Generated Web Applications
summary: Agentic coding tools turn a specification into a running web application, so their defaults for authentication, sessions, input validation, and dependencies become its security posture. This study asks whether appending a fixed block of OWASP-aligned security requirements to the prompt changes what such tools produce, by how much, and with what side effects. Each of 100 frozen specifications was realized four times: two agentic tools (Claude Code, Codex CLI) crossed with two prompts sharing a byte-identical functional core, without (A) and with (B) the security block. A fixed static and dynamic pipeline scanned the 400 applications, yielding 6,721 triaged findings, analyzed with count and logistic mixed models and with a dependency diff. The block cut findings per application by a third (incidence-rate ratio 0.65, 95% CI 0.60-0.71), equally through both tools, and roughly doubled the declared dependency surface, so variant-B applications carried more high-severity dependency advisories. Adjusted for that surface the advisory rate did not rise (flat per application, 18% lower in aggregate), while high-severity findings in first-party source fell by nearly half. Security-focused prompting is therefore an inexpensive and portable improvement, but it enlarges the dependency surface that has to be audited against it, an effect of library selection rather than of the security requirements themselves.

AI.tldr: 在提示词中附加固定的OWASP安全需求块，可使智能体编码工具生成应用的漏洞数减少约三分之一，且效果跨工具一致；但会扩大依赖面，需配套审计。
AI.motivation: 智能体编码工具将规格说明直接转化为可运行Web应用，其认证、会话、输入校验与依赖的默认设定即构成应用的安全姿态；因此需明确安全需求提示能否、以多大幅度改变输出，并考察其副作用。
AI.method: 对100个冻结规格各实现4次（Claude Code、Codex CLI × 无安全块A/有安全块B，两者功能内核逐字节相同），共400个应用；用固定静态+动态流水线扫描，得到6,721条已分诊发现，采用计数与逻辑混合模型分析，并做依赖差异对比。
AI.result: 安全块使每应用发现数降低约三分之一（发生率比0.65，95% CI 0.60–0.71），两工具效果相当；声明依赖面约翻倍，故B变体携带更多高危依赖公告。按依赖面校正后公告率未上升（每应用持平，总体低18%），而第一方源码中的高危发现减少近一半。
AI.conclusion: 面向安全的提示是一种低成本、可移植的改进；但它扩大了须据此审计的依赖面，该效应源于库选择而非安全需求本身。

title: CausalNTP: A World-Model Recipe for Causal Next-Token Prediction under Noisy Training-data
summary: This paper shows that transformer networks trained with next-token prediction (NTP) and gradient descent do not learn to make predictions using only causally-relevant tokens in the left context, irrespective of the causal ordering of tokens during training, and identifies the learning deficiencies responsible. We introduce a causal world-model setup, for which, we characterize the Bayes-optimal predictor under the causal view of the data. We then prove that, a function that distills its predictions to non-causal views of data, when realized under Occam's Razor, recovers the true causal predictor. Based on this analysis we propose CausalNTP, a practical training algorithm that approximates this theoretical recipe and trains transformers to depend only the causally relevant tokens in left-context. Empirically in the world-model setup, CausalNTP achieves out-of-distribution generalization that vanilla NTP cannot due to its theoretical limits, regardless of data and model scale. We show similar gains and behavior in the natural language question-answering setting as a proof-of-concept.

AI.tldr: 论文指出标准下一词元预测（NTP）训练的 Transformer 无法仅依赖左文中的因果相关词元进行预测，由此提出理论刻画与实用算法 CausalNTP。
AI.motivation: 作者关注的缺陷是：即便训练数据的词元因果顺序被正确设置，用梯度下降训练的 NTP Transformer 仍会利用左文中非因果相关的词元作为预测捷径（虚假相关），导致其不具备真正的因果预测能力，从而在分布外泛化上失效。
AI.method: 1）构建一个因果世界模型（causal world-model）设定，在数据因果视角下刻画贝叶斯最优预测器；2）证明在奥卡姆剃刀约束下，将预测蒸馏到非因果数据视图的函数能够恢复真正的因果预测器；3）据此提出 CausalNTP——一种逼近该理论配方、使 Transformer 仅依赖左文因果相关词元的实用训练算法。
AI.result: 在世界模型实验中，CausalNTP 获得了 vanilla NTP 因理论局限而无法达到的分布外泛化能力，且该优势与数据和模型规模无关；在自然语言问答设定中作为概念验证也观察到类似的性能增益与行为。
AI.conclusion: 标准 NTP 训练在因果预测上存在固有的学习缺陷，仅靠调整词元因果顺序无法解决；通过理论指导的蒸馏式训练目标（CausalNTP）可有效引导模型聚焦因果相关词元，显著提升分布外泛化，为因果可靠的序列建模提供了可行路径。

title: Engram: Multi-Stage Memory for Agentic Tuning of Heterogeneous Models
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can now tune neural networks, yet without cross-session memory they spend costly trials rediscovering known lessons. Reuse is difficult because production models differ in architecture, training setup and inference budget. We present Engram, a memory system that links past trial outcomes with the hypotheses and rationale behind them and assesses whether this evidence applies to the current model. An online agent curates evidence at the decision points where it is needed: Initial Guidance supplies validated lessons at the start, Session Retrieval supplies related past sessions before each batch of hypotheses is generated, and Trial Candidate Review checks each trial candidate against matching past trials. Between sessions, an offline agent distills validated lessons, making the memory self-improving. On two ads models, Engram reaches the 32-trial result of a no-memory control with 47% fewer trials and also ends with a better model on average.

AI.tldr: Engram 是一个面向 LLM 智能体调参的跨会话记忆系统，将历史试验结果与假设及理由关联，并判断证据是否适用于当前模型，从而减少重复试错。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体虽能调优神经网络，但缺乏跨会话记忆，会在每次会话中重复发现已知经验，代价高昂；而生产模型在架构、训练配置和推理预算上各不相同，导致历史经验难以直接复用。
AI.method: 提出 Engram 记忆系统，将过去的试验结果与其背后的假设和理由相链接，并评估这些证据对当前模型的适用性。在线智能体在关键决策点进行证据组织：Initial Guidance 在开始时提供已验证的经验；Session Retrieval 在每批假设生成前检索相关历史会话；Trial Candidate Review 将每个试验候选与匹配的历史试验进行比对。会话之间由离线智能体提炼已验证经验，使记忆具备自我进化能力。
AI.result: 在两个广告模型上，Engram 以少 47% 的试验次数达到无记忆基线第 32 次试验的效果，且最终模型的平均表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化地复用与校验跨会话经验，Engram 显著提升了 LLM 智能体神经网络调优的样本效率与最终质量，说明带适用性判断的记忆机制是实现经验复用的关键。

title: Persuasion from Within: Model-Based Insider Attacks in Multi-Agent LLM Debate and Consensus
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems for collective decision-making, such as multi-agent debate and consensus games, in which agents exchange messages and update their answers over multiple rounds and a resolution mechanism aggregates them into a final outcome. Most multi-agent LLM frameworks assume that every participant shares the system objective. In practice, however, a malicious agent can join as a legitimate member of the group and persuade the other agents toward a hidden adversarial goal. We formalize such attacks as a sequential decision-making problem in which the insider seeks to degrade the utility of the collective outcome. We propose a model-based insider attack that learns to persuade a group of agents: the insider first learns a world model of the benign agents from offline trajectories and then uses it both to train a persuasion policy and to plan its messages. In two case studies involving a numerical consensus game and a multi-agent debate, the learned insider is the most effective and the stealthiest attack we evaluate, outperforming both prompt-based and trained LLM persuaders from prior work. The attack also transfers to other target models, larger groups, and unseen datasets, and remains effective under existing Byzantine-resilience defenses. The learned insider also enables a new defense: adversarially training benign agents on the attack data largely removes both our attack and the strongest prior persuasion attack. These results show that combining world models with reinforcement learning and planning is an effective route to both attacking and hardening language-based multi-agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文将"内部恶意智能体诱导多智能体LLM集体决策偏离"形式化为序贯决策问题，提出基于世界模型的内部攻击方法：先用离线轨迹学习良性智能体世界模型，再据此训练说服策略并进行消息规划，实现最优且最隐蔽的攻击，并可用于对抗训练防御。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体LLM框架（辩论、共识博弈等）普遍假设所有参与者共享系统目标，但实际中恶意智能体可作为合法成员加入并引导他人走向隐藏的对抗目标；已有基于提示或训练的说服攻击在有效性和隐蔽性上仍有不足，需要更强的攻击建模以揭示风险并指导防御。
AI.method: 将内部攻击形式化为最小化集体结果效用的序贯决策问题；提出基于模型的内部攻击（model-based insider attack）：先从良性智能体的离线轨迹中学习其世界模型，再利用该模型同时（1）训练说服策略（强化学习）与（2）进行消息规划；在数值共识博弈与多智能体辩论两个案例中评估，并与基于提示的说服者及先前训练的LLM说服者对比，同时测试迁移性与现有拜占庭鲁棒防御下的表现，最后用攻击数据对良性智能体进行对抗训练。
AI.result: 在两个案例研究中，所学内部攻击在有效性与隐蔽性上均优于基于提示和已训练的先验LLM说服攻击；攻击可迁移到其他目标模型、更大规模的群体和未见数据集，且在现有拜占庭鲁棒防御下依然有效；以攻击数据进行对抗训练可基本消除本文攻击及最强的先验说服攻击。
AI.conclusion: 将世界模型与强化学习、规划相结合，是攻击并加固基于语言的多智能体系统的有效路径：既产生了目前最强、最隐蔽的内部说服攻击，也提供了可落地的对抗训练防御手段。

title: Mitigating Backdoors in Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models because they can predict multiple tokens in parallel rather than generating tokens sequentially. However, recent studies have shown that MDLMs are vulnerable to backdoor attacks: when an input contains an attacker-chosen trigger, a backdoored model generates a targeted output, such as malicious code, while otherwise behaving normally. Despite this threat, backdoor defenses for MDLMs remain largely underexplored. We present UNMASK, the first defense framework for MDLMs that detects trigger-containing inputs, localizes the trigger tokens, and removes the backdoor from the compromised model. UNMASK exploits two fundamental properties of backdoor triggers, specificity and dominance, to assign a suspiciousness score to each input token. By leveraging two distinctive capabilities of MDLMs, parallel token prediction and token reconstruction at arbitrary positions, UNMASK computes these scores both effectively and efficiently. We further provide a theoretical analysis supporting the design of UNMASK. Evaluations across 40 settings spanning two attacks and four models show that UNMASK detects 99.3% of trigger-containing inputs at a 5% false-positive rate, substantially outperforming the strongest adapted baseline, which achieves 54.8%. UNMASK also achieves over 99% trigger-localization accuracy and reduces the average attack success rate from 95% to 1%, while largely preserving the model's utility on clean inputs.

AI.tldr: UNMASK 是首个面向掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）的后门防御框架，利用触发器的特异性与主导性对输入 token 打可疑度分数，实现触发输入检测、触发器定位与后门移除。
AI.motivation: MDLM 虽可并行预测多 token，但已被证明易受后门攻击：含攻击者触发器的输入会诱发恶意输出（如恶意代码），而正常输入表现正常。针对 MDLM 的后门防御研究仍严重不足。
AI.method: 利用后门触发器的两个基本属性——特异性（specificity）与主导性（dominance）——为每个输入 token 计算可疑度分数；借助 MDLM 的两项特性（并行 token 预测、任意位置 token 重建）高效且有效地完成打分；并给出支持该设计的理论分析。框架统一覆盖触发输入检测、触发器 token 定位与受感染模型的后门去除。
AI.result: 在覆盖 2 种攻击、4 个模型的 40 组设置上：5% 假阳性率下检测出 99.3% 的含触发器输入（最强适配基线仅 54.8%）；触发器定位准确率超过 99%；平均攻击成功率由 95% 降至 1%，同时基本保持模型在干净输入上的效用。
AI.conclusion: UNMASK 表明 MDLM 固有的并行预测与任意位置重建能力可被有效转化为后门防御优势，在检测、定位与移除三个层面均显著优于现有基线，为该方向提供了首个系统性防御范式。

title: Automated Neural Network Auditing (ANNA) for Energy Market Settlements: A Machine and Reinforcement Learning-Based Approach
comment: Energy Market Settlements, Automated Auditing, Neural Networks, Anomaly Detection, Reinforcement Learning, Machine Learning
summary: The integration of segmented energy markets into Independent System Operators (ISOs) like CAISO and MISO has increased settlement complexity. Automated transaction processing creates challenges for evaluating accuracy, compliance, and financial integrity. Traditional rule-based manual auditing is inefficient, error-prone, and cannot handle the data volume from automated markets.This research proposes Automated Neural Network Auditing (ANNA), a machine and reinforcement learning framework for settlement auditing via anomaly prioritization. ANNA integrates statistical anomaly detection, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), clustering, and Deep Q-Network (DQN) reinforcement learning to flag potentially anomalous transactions from historical market data. The approach is evaluated as an analyst-support tool for prioritizing transactions needing further audit review.ANNA was tested against traditional statistical methods, clustering-based techniques, and supervised/reinforcement learning models. The study used three years of CAISO settlement data over 63 million source records across 32 charge codes and multiple counterparties. After preprocessing, approximately 2.9 million labeled transactions formed the working dataset, with model-specific subsets used for training and evaluation. Performance was assessed using precision, recall, computational efficiency, and false-negative detection.ANNA outperforms traditional methods by identifying hidden relationships in settlement data, while standard deviation thresholds, K-Means, KNN, and Q-Learning performed poorly across key metrics. The result is a scalable solution integrating machine and reinforcement learning for automated auditing of energy market settlements, contributing computationally efficient anomaly prioritization to settlement-auditing workflows.

AI.tldr: 提出ANNA框架，结合统计异常检测、KNN、聚类与DQN强化学习，对CAISO电力市场结算交易进行异常优先级排序，作为分析师辅助审计工具。
AI.motivation: 分段式能源市场并入ISO（如CAISO、MISO）后结算复杂度上升，自动化交易处理使准确性、合规性与财务完整性评估困难；传统基于规则的人工审计效率低、易出错，难以应对自动化市场的数据规模。
AI.method: ANNA为机器学习与强化学习框架：集成统计异常检测、K近邻（KNN）、聚类与深度Q网络（DQN）强化学习，从历史市场数据中标记潜在异常交易，用于优先级排序。实验使用CAISO三年结算数据（6300万条源记录、32个收费代码、多个交易对手），预处理后约290万条带标签交易构成工作数据集，并采用模型专属子集训练与评估；对比传统统计方法、聚类方法及监督/强化学习模型，指标为精确率、召回率、计算效率与漏检（假阴性）检测。
AI.result: ANNA通过识别结算数据中的隐藏关系优于传统方法；而标准差阈值、K-Means、KNN与Q-Learning在关键指标上表现较差。
AI.conclusion: ANNA为能源市场结算自动审计提供了可扩展的机器学习与强化学习融合方案，为结算审计流程贡献了计算高效的异常优先级排序能力。

title: Aligning Judge Models to Be Logically Consistent Multi-Rule Interpreters
summary: Technical governance of AI models will soon require them to reason over and follow thousands of rules from different jurisdictions. However, as we show in this work, presenting an entire ruleset to a judge model---rather than asking it to judge one rule at a time---changes the way the model interprets the requirements, making it reach conclusions that conflict with its rule-by-rule judgments. We call this challenge multi-rule inconsistency and find that models are more lenient when judging rules embedded within the full ruleset than when judging rules separately. For example, we find that when a safety-critical rule prohibiting a model from pursuing objectives other than those it was given appears in a larger ruleset, all tested judge models are less likely to deem it violated. We examine several methods for reducing inconsistency, including prompting, consistency training using GRPO, and iterative rule refinement. As in human statutory interpretation, surrounding rules shape how a rule is interpreted. Unlike the legal setting, however, these interactions are currently happening implicitly inside the judge model's reasoning. We argue that multi-rule interactions must be measured and handled explicitly by ruleset designers to prevent undetected shifts in interpretation from causing downstream alignment failures.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示并命名了"多规则不一致"问题：将整份规则集一次性交给裁判模型，会使其解释规则的方式变化，对每条规则的判定与单独逐条判定相冲突（整体更宽松）；并比较了提示词、GRPO一致性训练、迭代规则精炼等缓解方法。
AI.motivation: AI模型的技术治理将要求模型在推理时遵循来自不同司法辖区的数千条规则，实际部署中不可避免地要把整套规则集一并呈现给裁判模型；而既往评测通常按单条规则逐一判断，忽视了规则集上下文对模型解释行为的系统性影响，可能导致未被察觉的解释漂移与下游对齐失败。
AI.method: 实证对比"整份规则集一次性输入"与"逐条规则单独判定"两种设置下裁判模型的判定差异，并将该现象定义为多规则不一致；以安全关键规则（禁止模型追求给定目标之外的其他目标）为典型案例检验其在不同规模规则集中的判定概率变化。随后评估三类缓解手段：提示工程、基于GRPO的一致性训练、迭代式规则精炼。
AI.result: 在整份规则集条件下，所有被测试的裁判模型对安全关键规则的违规判定概率均下降，即整体判定更宽松，与逐条判定结果冲突；所考察的缓解方法可在一定程度上降低不一致，但类比人类成文法解释，周边规则本就塑造单条规则的含义，这种交互目前隐式发生在裁判模型的推理内部。
AI.conclusion: 规则间交互效应必须由规则集设计者显式测量与处理，而非依赖模型隐式消化，以防止解释漂移在无监控情况下引发下游对齐失败；规则集设计需将"规则集合语境下的语义偏移"纳入评测与治理流程。

title: From Patterns to Threats: A Deep Learning Model for Anomaly Detection in Cyber-Physical Systems
summary: Cyber-physical systems increasingly rely on interconnected sensing, communication, and control components, creating a need for reliable detection of abnormal behavior. This study proposes a Deep Autoencoder for anomaly detection using the Edge-IIoTset dataset. After preprocessing the full dataset, 2,219,201 observations and 38 numerical features were retained. The proposed model employed a 38-24-12-6-12-24-38 encoder-decoder architecture and was trained exclusively on normal observations to learn representative patterns of expected system behavior. Anomaly decisions were based on reconstruction error, with the classification threshold selected independently from validation data by maximizing the F1-score. To assess model stability, five independent runs were conducted using different random seeds, and results were reported as mean plus or minus standard deviation. The proposed Deep Autoencoder achieved an accuracy of 0.9195 plus or minus 0.0061, precision of 0.9602 plus or minus 0.0204, recall of 0.7348 plus or minus 0.0095, F1-score of 0.8325 plus or minus 0.0121, ROC-AUC of 0.8825 plus or minus 0.0339, and PR-AUC of 0.8640 plus or minus 0.0286. Compared with a Simple Autoencoder baseline, the proposed model improved recall and F1-score while reducing the false positive rate. The results demonstrate that the proposed reconstruction-based representation learning approach can provide an effective and reproducible method for detecting anomalous behavior in cyber-physical environments.

AI.tldr: 提出深度自编码器（38-24-12-6-12-24-38）在Edge-IIoTset上做重构误差异常检测，5次随机种子结果：准确率0.9195±0.0061、F1 0.8325±0.0121、ROC-AUC 0.8825±0.0339，优于简单自编码器基线。
AI.motivation: 信息物理系统（CPS）日益依赖互联的感知、通信与控制组件，需要可靠地检测异常行为；作者希望验证基于重构式的表征学习能否提供有效且可复现的异常检测方法。
AI.method: 使用Edge-IIoTset数据集，预处理后保留2,219,201条观测、38个数值特征；构建对称深度自编码器（38-24-12-6-12-24-38），仅用正常样本训练以学习期望行为模式；以重构误差作为异常分数，阈值在验证集上独立选取并以最大化F1为准；用5个不同随机种子独立运行，报告均值±标准差；与简单自编码器基线对比。
AI.conclusion: 基于重构误差的深度表征学习可为CPS环境提供有效、可复现的异常行为检测方法；但召回率（0.735）相对偏低，且ROC-AUC波动（±0.034）提示稳定性仍有改进空间。

title: STEdgeFormer: MCU and NPU Deployable Transformer Architecture
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, Neurips 2026 workshop- SLM Agents
summary: Transformer-based sequence models have achieved strong performance in language and time-series modeling, but self-attention remains computationally and memory intensive for deployment on resource-constrained edge accelerators. We propose STEdgeFormer, a lightweight, hardware-aware sequence architecture designed for efficient execution on embedded neural accelerators. STEdgeFormer combines polynomial mixture layers and DyT normalization with an accelerator-aware causal memory block, replacing pairwise self-attention with compact causal aggregation. On TinyStories, the fully NPU-supported STEdgeFormer (MW) achieves a perplexity of 7.39 with 4.12M parameters and 6.51 MB RAM, with an end-to-end latency of 40 ms. In comparison, the standard 4.12M-parameter configuration achieves a lower perplexity of 6.79 but requires CPU fallback for unsupported operators, resulting in 1450 ms latency. Vanilla Transformer, on the other hand, achieves a perplexity score of 5.71 using a 4.40M-parameter model, but it cannot be deployed on the hardware. On downstream tasks, STEdgeFormer achieves 94% accuracy on ECG5000 and 93% accuracy on Speech Commands with 1.39M parameters. These results demonstrate that hardware-aware architectural choices and operator compatibility can have a substantial impact on practical inference latency, beyond model size and task accuracy alone. Rather than targeting state-of-the-art accuracy on individual benchmarks, STEdgeFormer is designed to provide a deployable sequence modeling architecture under the memory, computational, and operator constraints of embedded neural accelerators.

AI.tldr: 提出面向嵌入式神经加速器的轻量序列架构 STEdgeFormer，以多项式混合层、DyT 归一化和加速器感知因果记忆块替代自注意力，在 TinyStories 上实现全 NPU 部署、40 ms 端到端延迟。
AI.motivation: 自注意力在算力与内存上开销大，难以部署于资源受限的边缘加速器；且现有模型的部分算子不被 NPU 支持，导致 CPU 回退，实际推理延迟显著恶化。作者的目标不是刷榜单精度，而是在嵌入式加速器的内存、算力与算子约束下提供可部署的序列建模架构。
AI.method: STEdgeFormer 由三部分构成：多项式混合层（polynomial mixture layers）、DyT 归一化，以及加速器感知的因果记忆块（accelerator-aware causal memory block）；以紧凑的因果聚合替代成对自注意力，并保证算子与 NPU 兼容。
AI.result: TinyStories 上：全 NPU 支持的 STEdgeFormer（MW）以 4.12M 参数、6.51 MB RAM 取得困惑度 7.39，端到端延迟 40 ms；同等 4.12M 参数的标准配置困惑度更低（6.79），但因不支持算子需 CPU 回退，延迟达 1450 ms；原生 Transformer 以 4.40M 参数取得 5.71 困惑度却无法部署。下游任务：ECG5000 准确率 94%，Speech Commands 准确率 93%，参数仅 1.39M。
AI.conclusion: 硬件感知的架构选择与算子兼容性对实际推理延迟有实质性影响，其作用超出模型规模与任务精度本身；STEdgeFormer 提供了一种在嵌入式加速器约束下可部署的序列建模方案，而非追求单项基准的 SOTA 精度。

title: FormaFin: Verifiable Financial Analysis with Solver-Guided Reinforcement Learning
summary: Formally verifying financial analyses generated by large language models (LLMs) remains challenging as financial rules are largely expressed in natural language and rarely have corresponding formal specifications. Training language models to formalize these rules is hindered by the scarcity of labeled data and reliable training signals, while confidential financial data favor small models that run locally. We introduce FormaFin, a framework that trains small open language models to translate financial rules into reusable SMT formulas. FormaFin integrates teacher distillation with reinforcement learning using an SMT solver to compute rewards from numerical thresholds stated in financial rules. We evaluate FormaFin on corporate loan monitoring, in which lenders check borrowers' financial figures against loan agreements. To evaluate our framework, we curate \bench{}, a benchmark containing 143 loan agreements and 2,527 questions covering compliance, earnings cushion, and debt capacity. Our results show that a 7B formalizer achieves 94.8\% accuracy, outperforming open LLMs up to ten times larger. Across three model families, accuracy ranges from 92.6 to 96.8\%. Our framework also detects 95.6 to 99.7\% of errors in other LLMs' financial analyses. We make FormaFin and \bench{} publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出FormaFin框架，用教师蒸馏+SMT求解器奖励的强化学习训练小型开源模型，将财务规则翻译为可复用SMT公式，用于形式化验证LLM生成的财务分析。
AI.motivation: 财务规则多由自然语言表述、缺乏形式化规范，标注数据稀缺且训练信号不可靠，同时金融数据涉密更倾向本地运行的小模型，因此形式化验证LLM财务分析十分困难。
AI.method: FormaFin结合教师蒸馏与强化学习，以SMT求解器根据规则中数值阈值计算奖励，训练小型开源语言模型把财务规则翻译为可复用的SMT公式；并在企业贷款监控任务上评测，构建含143份贷款协议、2527个问题（覆盖合规、盈利缓冲、债务能力）的基准集。
AI.result: 7B形式化器达94.8%准确率，优于至多十倍规模的开源LLM；三个模型系列准确率92.6%–96.8%；可检测其他LLM财务分析中95.6%–99.7%的错误。
AI.conclusion: 小型本地模型经蒸馏与求解器奖励强化学习后，可高效将财务规则形式化为SMT公式，实现可靠的财务分析形式化验证，并开源框架与基准。

title: Improving the Improver: Semantic PID Control for Medical Agent Self-Improvement
summary: High-stakes vertical medical tasks, such as postoperative pathological staging and long-term survival prediction, demand multi-step clinical reasoning over heterogeneous evidence under weak supervision and high outcome uncertainty. While we first orchestrate CliAgent, a domain-tailored clinical agent workflow that systematically grounds predictions in multi-modal patient evidence, manually designed medical agents remain constrained by static, brittle rules. Moreover, existing recursive self-improvement (RSI) methods suffer from feedback ambiguity and severe development-set overfitting when evolving agents in high-noise medical domains. Focusing on improving the improver, we propose Semantic PID-RSI, an evidence-guided control-theoretic framework for medical agent self-improvement. Inspired by PID control, our improver evaluates candidate modification batches via three diagnostic roles: P isolates current clinical failure modes, I synthesizes longitudinal evidence from past trials, and D estimates response dynamics and regression risks (D-pre/D-post). Selected plans are compiled into behavior contracts for staged probing and independent adoption judging. Instantiated and validated on challenging oncology tasks (pT/pN staging and survival prognosis), evolving CliAgent with Semantic PID-RSI on a 3B-activated open-weight model achieves substantial gains (up to +6.27 C-index points), outperforming overfitting-prone RSI baselines and approaching the performance of frontier proprietary models (e.g., GPT-6 series) equipped with CliAgent.

AI.tldr: 提出 Semantic PID-RSI，一个受 PID 控制启发的证据引导式递归自我改进框架，用于在强噪声医疗领域自动进化临床智能体（CliAgent），在肿瘤 pT/pN 分期与生存预后任务上显著超越易过拟合的 RSI 基线，逼近前沿闭源大模型水平。
AI.motivation: 高风险纵向医疗任务需要在弱监督、高不确定性下对异构证据进行多步临床推理；人工设计的临床智能体依赖静态、脆弱规则，而现有递归自我改进（RSI）方法在医疗高噪声场景中面临反馈歧义与严重的验证集过拟合，因此需要改进"改进器"本身。
AI.method: 先构建 CliAgent——将预测锚定于多模态患者证据的领域定制化临床智能体工作流；再提出 Semantic PID-RSI，借用 PID 控制思想，通过 P/I/D 三种诊断角色评估候选修改批次（P 定位当前临床失效模式，I 综合历史试验的纵向证据，D 估计响应动态与回归风险，含 D-pre/D-post），选中方案编译为行为契约，经分阶段探测与独立采纳判定后落地。
AI.result: 在 3B 激活规模的开源权重模型上，CliAgent + Semantic PID-RSI 于 pT/pN 分期与生存预后等肿瘤任务取得最高 +6.27 C-index 点提升，优于易过拟合的 RSI 基线，并接近搭载 CliAgent 的前沿闭源模型（如 GPT-6 系列）。
AI.conclusion: 将控制论式的语义反馈（比例—积分—微分诊断）引入医疗智能体的自我进化，可有效缓解反馈歧义与验证集过拟合，使小规模开源模型在高风险临床推理任务上获得稳健且显著的性能提升。

title: MMMem: Self-Improving Agents with Task-Aware Multimodal Experience Consolidation
summary: AI agents accumulate conversations, images, and documents through long-term interactions with users. Answering later questions often requires connecting evidence across these records, yet the resulting understanding is rarely retained, allowing mistakes to recur on related questions. Existing multimodal memory methods largely focus on storing and retrieving records, with limited mechanisms for learning from completed tasks and consolidating task-specific experience. We therefore propose MMMem, a task-aware multimodal memory framework that extracts and consolidates experience from completed tasks through four complementary strategies. First, source-linked multi-view memory organizes original text, images, and rendered pages alongside generated scene images that combine clues across records for retrieval. Second, source-generated tasks support knowledge alignment at two levels: warm-up consolidates source knowledge into task-relevant experiences in external memory, while self-training adapts the model's parametric knowledge to task demands. Third, the same vision-language model distills completed tasks into experiences that record the task context, conclusion, and support links. Finally, task-aware retrieval recalls source views and relevant experiences for answering and verification, while source-supported reuse guides long-term retention.
