Across three memory benchmarks and two vision-language readers, MMMem outperforms eight baselines. With Qwen3.5-9B, MMMem achieves relative gains of 36.9%, 17.6%, and 15.2% over the best-performing baselines on LoCoMo, Mem-Gallery, and LooGLE v2, respectively. Ablations show consistent gains from training and memory warm-up, while case studies illustrate how individual components work in practice.

AI.tldr: 提出任务感知多模态记忆框架MMMem，通过四类互补策略从已完成任务中提取并固化经验，在三个记忆基准上显著超越八个基线。
AI.motivation: AI智能体在长期交互中累积对话、图像与文档，但跨记录整合证据所获得的理解很少被保留，导致相关问题上的错误反复出现；现有方法多聚焦存储与检索，缺乏从完成任务中学习并固化任务经验的机制。
AI.method: MMMem包含四部分：(1) 源链接多视图记忆，将原始文本、图像与渲染页面与融合跨记录线索生成的场景图像一并组织以便检索；(2) 源生成任务实现双层知识对齐——预热阶段将源知识固化为外部记忆中的任务相关经验，自训练阶段使模型参数化知识适配任务需求；(3) 同一视觉语言模型将完成任务蒸馏为记录任务上下文、结论与支撑链接的经验；(4) 任务感知检索召回源视图与相关经验用于作答与验证，源支撑复用引导长期保留。
AI.result: 在三个记忆基准与两种视觉语言阅读器上，MMMem优于八个基线。使用Qwen3.5-9B时，在LoCoMo、Mem-Gallery与LooGLE v2上相对最佳基线分别取得36.9%、17.6%和15.2%的提升；消融实验显示训练与记忆预热均带来稳定增益，案例分析展示了各组件的实际作用。
AI.conclusion: MMMem通过将任务经验显式蒸馏并固化于多模态记忆，弥补了以往仅存储检索的不足，实现了可复用、可验证的长期多模态记忆，并取得显著性能提升。

title: AutoSECO: Automated Skill Evolution for Cross-Problem Combinatorial Optimization with General-Purpose LLM Agents
summary: General-purpose large language model (LLM) agents can develop complete solvers for combinatorial optimization problems. Their specialization, however, often relies on workflows engineered for individual problems, limiting the reuse of development expertise. We propose AutoSECO, an automated skill evolution method that learns reusable solver-development guidance from experience. The challenge is that external evaluation measures the completed solver, while the skill guides decisions during development. AutoSECO connects this feedback to guidance deficiencies by tracing performance shortfalls through solver code and recorded development decisions. Revisions are expressed as general instructions and retained only if a fresh solver developed under the revised skill achieves a lower mean evaluation gap. Evolved solely on the traveling salesperson problem (TSP), the skill guides fresh agents in developing solvers for capacitated vehicle routing, job-shop scheduling, and three-dimensional bin packing without further skill evolution. On TSP, the final mean benchmark gap is 0.52\%, compared with 0.98\% for the skill-evolution baseline SkillOpt. Across all four problems, the evolved skill achieves better aggregate results than no skill guidance, the initial skill, and SkillOpt. The same frozen skill also supports solver development under alternative model--harness configurations. These findings suggest that solver-development experience can be retained as reusable expertise for general-purpose LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 AutoSECO，一种从经验中学习可复用求解器开发指导的自动化技能演化方法，仅用 TSP 演化、可零样本迁移至 CVRP、JSP、3D-BP 等组合优化问题。
AI.motivation: 通用 LLM 智能体可为组合优化问题开发完整求解器，但现有专门化依赖针对单个问题定制的工作流，开发经验难以复用。核心难点在于：外部评价衡量的是成品求解器，而技能需指导开发过程中的决策，二者存在反馈错位。
AI.method: AutoSECO 通过追踪求解器代码与记录的开发决策，将性能差距回溯并归因到具体指导缺陷；修改以通用指令形式表达，且仅在"依据修订技能新开发的求解器取得更低平均评估差距"时才保留（即基于全新求解器的验证式保留）。
AI.result: 仅在 TSP 上演化技能，即可引导新智能体开发 CVRP、作业车间调度、三维装箱的求解器而无需进一步演化。TSP 上最终平均基准差距为 0.52%，优于技能演化基线 SkillOpt 的 0.98%；在四个问题上总体结果均优于无技能指导、初始技能与 SkillOpt；同一冻结技能在替代的模型—执行框架配置下同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 求解器开发经验可作为可复用专业知识被通用 LLM 智能体保留，实现跨问题与跨配置的技能迁移。

title: Wactorz: Self-Writing LLM Agents That Discover, Repair, and Migrate at the Edge
comment: 5 pages. 2 figues. Extended version of a paper accepted to the AAAI-27 Demonstrations Program. Code: https://github.com/waldiez/wactorz
summary: Most LLM agent frameworks build a crew that runs a task and exits. Physical environments (e.g., homes, labs, factory floors) need agents that stay up for months, survive their own bugs, and run on whatever hardware is already next to the sensors. We present Wactorz, an open-source runtime in which LLM-generated agents are long-lived, supervised actors: a planner turns a chat request into Python, compiles it into a new actor at runtime, and a supervisor restarts that actor alone, with its state intact, when it crashes. All coordination rides on MQTT, so agents can be spawned on, and live-migrated between, edge nodes such as a Raspberry Pi, and every internal event is a topic external systems can subscribe to. The recorded demo builds a camera-to-lamp automation from one chat request, adds a second agent that is auto-wired to the first by topic and carries a deliberate division-by-zero, watches that agent repair its own code without losing its count, then deploys a fresh Raspberry Pi node and live-migrates the agent onto it, in under four minutes of wall-clock time and \$0.13 of model usage. This extended version adds what the two-page demonstration paper could not: the Wiring view of the topic graph, Wactorz as a library for hand-written agents, how trained models are stored, sent to nodes and replaced, the security model, and the system's limitations.

AI.tldr: Wactorz 是一个开源运行时，将 LLM 生成的智能体建模为长生命周期、受监督的 actor：planner 把聊天请求转成 Python 并在运行时编译为新 actor，supervisor 在崩溃时单独重启该 actor 并保留其状态；所有协调通过 MQTT 完成，故 agent 可在树莓派等边缘节点上生成与热迁移，内部事件均为外部可订阅的 topic。演示在 4 分钟内以 $0.13 模型开销完成从聊天请求构建摄像头-台灯自动化、自动接线第二个 agent 并在除零崩溃后自修复且不丢计数、再部署新树莓派节点并热迁移。扩展版补充主题图 Wiring 视图、作为手写 agent 库的用法、模型存储/分发/替换、安全模型与系统局限。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM agent 框架多为"组建 crew、跑完任务即退出"的短时进程模型；而物理环境（家居、实验室、工厂车间）要求 agent 持续运行数月、能承受自身 bug 崩溃，并运行在传感器旁的既有硬件（如树莓派）上。论文因此需要一种面向长期在线、可容错、可部署于边缘设备的新型 agent 运行时。
AI.method: 提出 Wactorz 运行时：(1) 以 actor 模型组织 LLM 生成 agent，planner 将对话请求翻译为 Python 代码，在运行时编译为新的 actor；(2) supervisor 负责故障隔离，崩溃时仅重启该 actor 并保持其状态（如计数器）；(3) 采用 MQTT 作为统一协调总线，agent 的生成、通信与跨节点热迁移均基于 topic，所有内部事件以 topic 形式对外暴露以支持外部订阅，新 agent 可按 topic 自动接线；(4) 提供 Wiring 视图可视化 topic 图，并支持作为库编写手写 agent、模型的分发与替换、以及安全模型设计。
AI.result: 录制的演示在一次聊天请求下构建了摄像头到台灯的自动化，并新增一个通过 topic 自动接线的第二 agent，该 agent 含刻意植入的除零错误，演示中其自行修复代码且未丢失计数，随后部署新的树莓派节点并将 agent 热迁移过去，整体耗时不足 4 分钟实际时间、模型调用花费 $0.13。
AI.conclusion: Wactorz 证明了以受监督 actor + MQTT 总线为核心的长生命周期 LLM agent 运行时在边缘物理环境中可行且成本低廉，兼顾容错、状态保持与热迁移能力；扩展版进一步补充可视化、库化使用、模型管理与安全模型，并明确讨论了系统局限。

title: Distilling Visual Agents from Limited Interaction Experience
summary: How much interaction experience is needed to distill a capable visual agent? We study learning from few tasks and recorded interaction histories. Our framework selects representative trajectories using skill-context coverage and ordered visual-decision similarity. On-policy distillation (OPD) learns through fresh interaction on selected tasks or fresh student responses at fixed histories. Across Navigation, Sokoban, and spatial mapping, even one online training task supports transfer to other tasks. Four fixed trajectories raise a 4B student's success from 49.17% to 82.08% on standard Navigation and from 60.16% to 85.55% on Sokoban, recovering over 90% of the measured gap to a 27B teacher on these panels. On an independent Navigation panel, replay improves success from 45.83% to 76.67%, retaining 91.36% of the same-task online gain without new interaction during optimization. Training repetitions, matched supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and a 9B extension further support the value of compact experience.

AI.tldr: 该工作研究"少量任务与少量交互历史"能否蒸馏出有能力的视觉智能体，提出基于技能-上下文覆盖与有序视觉决策相似度的代表性轨迹选择，并结合on-policy蒸馏，在极少数据下实现强迁移。
AI.motivation: 视觉智能体通常依赖大量在线交互与任务数据来蒸馏大模型能力，成本高。作者追问：所需交互经验的下限是多少——能否仅用少量任务与录制的交互历史完成有效蒸馏。
AI.method: 框架包含两部分：(1) 轨迹选择——用skill-context coverage（技能-上下文覆盖）与ordered visual-decision similarity（有序视觉决策相似度）挑选代表性轨迹；(2) On-policy distillation（OPD）——在选定任务上做新鲜交互，或在固定历史下采样学生的新响应进行蒸馏。并在Navigation、Sokoban、空间建图三类任务上验证。
AI.result: 仅1个在线训练任务即可迁移到其他任务；4条固定轨迹使4B学生成功率在Navigation上从49.17%升至82.08%、Sokoban上从60.16%升至85.55%，恢复与27B教师差距的90%以上；在独立Navigation面板上，replay将成功率从45.83%提升到76.67%，在优化期间无新交互的情况下保留了同任务在线收益的91.36%。训练重复次数、匹配的SFT对照与9B规模扩展进一步支持紧凑经验的价值。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的、经选择的交互经验配合on-policy蒸馏即可大幅提升小规模视觉智能体，接近大教师水平；固定历史replay可替代在线交互，显著降低数据与交互成本。

title: VeriLadder: A Multi-Agent Specification Refinement System for Tool-Verified Verilog Datasets
summary: Training data is a bottleneck in AI, especially for large language models (LLMs) that write Verilog, because register-transfer-level (RTL) code is rarely published and existing datasets mostly check code for syntax, not instruction correctness. This paper presents VeriLadder, a five-level Verilog dataset, and the multi-agent framework that builds it, in which LLM agents write and revise specifications, and EDA tools (a synthesizer and a formal equivalence checker) decide what is accepted. Its levels follow an engineer's checks. Level 1 labels designs from two large Verilog corpora, namely RTLCoder and PyraNet, with synthesis results, failure causes, critical warnings and post-synthesis metrics. 28% of RTLCoder designs fail synthesis and are kept as negatives. Level 2 grades each instruction on four specification qualities, and low grades predict failed rebuilds. Level 3 rewrites each instruction into a refined specification and accepts it only if an LLM from another model family, reading only that specification, writes a circuit formally equivalent to the original. This raises the share of rebuildable designs from 26.1% to 78.2%, keeping every failed specification with its counterexample. Levels 4 and 5 add verified paraphrases and one-fact variants, hard negatives that differ only in one behavior from the verified design. VeriLadder labels the synthesizability of 716,627 designs and, from RTLCoder, provides 11,247 refined specifications, 32,393 paraphrases and 8,397 one-fact variants. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct on VeriLadder raises functional pass@1 from 31.7% to 50.0% on VerilogEval v2 and from 35.0% to 45.2% on RTLLM v2. The dataset and fine-tuned models are publicly available.

AI.tldr: VeriLadder：五级Verilog数据集及多智能体构建框架，用EDA工具（综合+形式等价检查）判定样本是否合格，标注716,627个设计的可综合性，微调Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct使VerilogEval v2功能pass@1从31.7%升至50.0%。
AI.motivation: 面向Verilog生成的LLM训练数据存在瓶颈：RTL代码公开少，现有数据集只检查语法而非指令/功能正确性。
AI.method: 多智能体框架中LLM智能体撰写与修订规格，EDA综合器与形式等价检查器裁决接受与否。L1为RTLCoder与PyraNet设计打综合标签（结果、失败原因、关键警告、综合后指标），保留28%综合失败样本作负例；L2按四项规格质量打分；L3将规格改写为精炼规格，仅当另一模型家族LLM仅凭该规格生成与原电路形式等价时才接受；L4/L5加入验证过的改写与"单事实"变体作为难负例。
AI.result: 可重建设计占比由26.1%提升至78.2%；标注716,627个设计的可综合性，从RTLCoder提供11,247条精炼规格、32,393条改写、8,397条单事实变体。微调后VerilogEval v2功能pass@1由31.7%→50.0%，RTLLM v2由35.0%→45.2%。
AI.conclusion: 以EDA工具为准绳、分级递进的数据构建范式可显著提升Verilog生成数据的指令正确性与难负例质量；数据集与微调模型已公开。

title: EvoViM: Recursively Self-Evolving Visual Agents for Exploration with Deferred Queries
summary: Multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents have shown promising capabilities in task-oriented environments. However, they still struggle when queries are deferred until after exploration, requiring them to retain visual evidence before knowing which details will matter. We introduce EvoViM, a recursively self-evolving framework in which a frozen multimodal model turns its own interaction experience into one visual program for memory and skills. The program retains images and computes directly on pixels, and its operations decide how this evidence is used in each task. During memory evolution, the same model traces failures in its visual trajectories to the operations that lost or misused evidence and revises them. It also rewrites the notes and analysis tools that guide later revisions, which then build on earlier findings and skip changes that have already failed. We evaluate EvoViM with three multimodal models on six tasks covering visual matching, spatial recall, and sequential decision-making, including three tasks with deferred queries. Across the six tasks, EvoViM improves the average score over AutoMem, the strongest baseline in the main comparison, by 31.3-47.6 points on held-out episodes. Programs written once from the initial environment instructions perform substantially worse, highlighting the value of interaction experience in shaping how visual evidence is retained and used. Code and dataset are available at https://evovim.github.io/.

AI.tldr: EvoViM是一个递归自进化框架，让冻结的多模态大模型把自身交互经验转化为统一的"视觉程序"，用于记忆与技能，从而在延迟查询场景下更好地保留和使用视觉证据。
AI.motivation: MLLM智能体在任务型环境中表现良好，但当查询在探索之后才给出（deferred queries）时，它们难以在不知道哪些细节重要之前保留视觉证据，尽管具备多模态理解能力，可靠性不足。
AI.method: 提出EvoViM：模型参数冻结，自生成并递归修订一个视觉程序（visual program）；程序保留图像并直接在像素上计算，其操作决定每项任务中证据的使用方式。记忆进化阶段，同一模型在视觉轨迹中追溯失败，定位导致证据丢失或误用的操作并加以修订；同时重写指导后续修订的笔记与分析工具，使新修订建立在已有发现之上，并跳过已失败的改动。
AI.result: 在6个任务（视觉匹配、空间回忆、序贯决策，其中3个为延迟查询）上，用3个多模态模型评估。EvoViM在held-out episodes上相较最强基线AutoMem平均分提升31.3–47.6分。仅依据初始环境指令一次性编写的程序表现明显更差，说明交互经验对视觉证据保留与使用至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 自进化式的视觉程序能有效将交互经验沉淀为可复用的记忆与技能，显著提升延迟查询任务表现；交互经验而非静态指令是决定视觉效果的关键因素。

title: Human-in-the-Loop Runbook Improvement with Agentic Support Automation
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Accepted manuscript of the paper published in the proceedings of the 2025 IEEE 7th International Conference on Cognitive Machine Intelligence (CogMI)
summary: Operational support is an important component of production software services. Support requests are often emergent and can come in many forms such as customer escalations or unplanned service interruption. Engineers across organizations have been successful in implementing automation to help streamline support processes but many solutions remain in the hands of human operators. A successful strategy to improve operator response times is to maintain up-to-date runbooks which are documents enumerating triage steps and remediation procedures in the face of identified incidents. This paper is an investigation into an operational system which incorporates Agentic AI into a runbook based incident resolution pattern. The bot uses information in the runbook corpus along with some system-specific tooling to guide the manual operator through the mitigation process then evaluate the outcome and suggest edits to the runbook where it found gaps and in its ability to triage the situation. By using the runbook as a medium to bridge humans and automation, the process maintains explainability and can be decoupled from the agent system. This paper demonstrates a collaboration between human operators and Agentic AI with results from an 17 week study involving 232 production incidents. We conclude with lessons on integrating LLMs into DevOps workflows, related work in AI-assisted operations, and guidance for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 论文研究将 Agentic AI 嵌入基于 Runbook 的运维事件处置流程，通过 17 周、232 起生产事件的实验验证人机协作模式。
AI.motivation: 运维支持请求常具突发性（客户升级、非计划中断），虽已有自动化实践，但大量解决方案仍依赖人工操作。维护最新 Runbook（分诊与修复步骤文档）是提升响应速度的有效策略，然而如何让人与自动化在运维流程中有效协作、同时保持可解释性仍是问题。
AI.method: 构建一个融合 Agentic AI 的运维系统，将 Runbook 作为人机交互媒介：Bot 结合 Runbook 语料与系统专用工具，引导人工操作员完成缓解流程，评估处置结果，并在发现 Runbook 存在缺口或分诊能力不足处提出修订建议；借助 Runbook 实现可解释性，并使流程与 Agent 系统解耦。
AI.result: 开展为期 17 周、涵盖 232 起生产事件的协作研究，演示了人工操作员与 Agentic AI 的协同效果。
AI.conclusion: 总结了将 LLM 集成到 DevOps 工作流的经验教训，梳理了 AI 辅助运维的相关工作，并给出了可复现性指导。

title: Diversity over Scale: Recursive Self-Improvement with Ensembles of Small Open-Weight Models
summary: The advancement of large language models (LLMs) has significantly enhanced the capabilities of agents across various tasks. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) loops, in which a language model repeatedly rewrites a program and builds on its previous version, now perform well in machine-learning tasks, but they rely on frontier models and hundreds of calls per run. Small open-weight models are far cheaper, yet when used alone, their programs often crash and their improvements stall. We propose DiVE (diverse models evolve), an ensemble method for RSI that aims to improve creativity and diversity of generated solutions. DiVE uses three components: a shared memory, a failure log, and best-idea-wins rounds. This allows models to write candidate solutions from the same context and retain the best idea at each iteration. On 22 MLE-bench Lite competitions, an ensemble of five 8-12B open-weight models has 25.4% less test error than its average member and 16.7% less than Llama 3.3 70B, and comes within 7.1% of Qwen 3.5 122B-A10B at 75% of its cost. Diversity among small models can thus stand in for part of the scale that RSI relies on.

AI.tldr: 提出DiVE（diverse models evolve）——一种面向递归自我改进（RSI）的多模型集成方法，通过共享记忆、失败日志与"最佳想法胜出"轮次让多个中小开源模型协同演化程序，在MLE-bench Lite上以更低成本逼近甚至接近大模型性能。
AI.motivation: RSI循环（模型反复重写程序并在上一版本基础上迭代）在机器学习任务上表现优异，但依赖前沿大模型且每次运行需数百次调用，成本高昂。小型开源权重模型便宜得多，但单独使用时程序经常崩溃、改进停滞。作者希望用小模型的多样性来替代RSI所依赖的部分规模优势。
AI.method: DiVE包含三个组件：(1) 共享记忆（shared memory），(2) 失败日志（failure log），(3) "最佳想法胜出"轮次（best-idea-wins rounds）。多个模型基于同一上下文各自写候选解，每轮迭代保留最优想法并在此基础上继续，从而提升所生成解的创造性与多样性。
AI.result: 在22个MLE-bench Lite竞赛上，由5个8–12B开源权重模型组成的集成，测试误差比其成员平均水平低25.4%，比Llama 3.3 70B低16.7%，并在仅为其75%成本的情况下与Qwen 3.5 122B-A10B相差7.1%以内。
AI.conclusion: 小模型之间的多样性可以在一定程度上替代RSI所依赖的规模，从而以更低成本获得接近大模型的程序自我改进效果。

title: SMAD: A Semantics-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Unsupervised Time-Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) lacks a one-size-fits-all detector for heterogeneous data and anomaly types. Existing automation is limited by implicit objectives, potentially unreliable historical knowledge, or high computational costs. More fundamentally, it selects how to detect anomalies without explicitly defining what to detect. We propose SMAD, an LLM-based multi-agent framework that translates anomaly intent into executable, testable detection pipelines. Rather than selecting detectors against an implicit target, SMAD establishes a natural-language semantic contract grounded in measurable time-series properties, specifying target event patterns, expected score responses, and validation questions. This contract governs both detector construction and evaluation: LLM agents propose pipelines, while contract-matched synthetic interventions provide label-free evidence from the target series to assess semantic coverage and guide iterative self-refinement. A semantics-aware ensemble integrates validated candidates and attributes each alert to contributing detectors and supporting evidence. On univariate and multivariate TSAD benchmarks, SMAD improves detection performance over the strongest baseline by 11.5% and 9.6%, respectively, while outperforming general-purpose coding agents at 2-5x lower language-model token cost.

AI.tldr: 提出SMAD，一个基于LLM多智能体的时间序列异常检测框架，通过自然语言"语义契约"把异常意图转化为可执行、可验证的检测流水线，并在单变量/多变量基准上分别比最强基线提升11.5%和9.6%。
AI.motivation: 异构数据与异常类型下不存在通用检测器；现有自动化方法受限于隐式目标、可能不可靠的历史知识或高昂算力成本。更根本的问题是：它们只选择"如何检测"，却没有明确界定"检测什么"。
AI.method: 以自然语言语义契约（锚定可度量的时间序列性质，规定目标事件模式、期望分数响应与验证问题）同时约束检测器构建与评估；LLM智能体提出候选流水线，契约匹配的合成干预在目标序列上提供无标签证据，评估语义覆盖度并驱动迭代式自我改进；最终用语义感知集成整合通过验证的候选，并对每条告警归因到贡献检测器及支撑证据。
AI.result: 在单变量与多变量TSAD基准上，检测性能分别较最强基线提升11.5%与9.6%，同时在语言模型token成本低2-5倍的情况下优于通用编码智能体。
AI.conclusion: 显式定义"检测什么"（语义契约）而非仅优化"如何检测"，是实现可靠、可解释、低成本自动化TSAD的有效路径；合成干预与语义感知集成兼顾了无标签验证与告警可解释性。

title: Decision models for UAVBench and the viability of edge deployment
summary: Small language models are often proposed for reasoning onboard a drone. However, a good benchmark score does not tell us whether a model will actually run, and run usefully, on an edge computer. In this paper we study three related questions using the UAV decision benchmark, UAVBench. First, are small structured decision models good candidates for these tasks? Second, can an ordinary local machine (a Mac) screen candidate models before we test them on physical devices? Third, what software and resource limits govern deployment? Our main Mac evaluation covers 24 model configurations on the same 2,000 validated multiple-choice questions from UAVBench. These include 20 size-and-precision configurations of 11 generative models, plus four open-weight structured decision models that received no additional UAVBench-specific training. A structured decision model, H2O Lightning 4B, achieved the highest accuracy we observed, scoring 77.65% on the Mac. This shows that these models are well suited to this kind of task. However, when we tried to deploy the decision models, we ran into conversion and runtime limits on the edge devices we tested, which we describe in detail. To test local screening, we ran matched evaluations of two generative models on both the Mac and a Qualcomm RB3 board. The accuracies did not match exactly, but the ranking did. LFM2 2.6B ranked above Qwen2.5 1.5B on both platforms. This supports using a local machine to shortlist candidates. That said, individual answers still differed between platforms, so testing on the actual hardware remained necessary.

AI.tldr: 该论文基于UAVBench基准，用Mac对24种模型配置进行筛选评测，发现结构化决策模型H2O Lightning 4B精度最高（77.65%），但边缘设备部署受转换与运行时限制；Mac与RB3板的模型排名一致但逐题答案存在差异。
AI.motivation: 高基准分数并不能说明模型能否在无人机边缘计算设备上实际、有效地运行，因此需要回答三个问题：小型结构化决策模型是否适合UAV决策任务、普通本地机器能否预先筛选候选模型、以及部署受何种软件与资源限制。
AI.method: 在Mac上对24种模型配置评测，包括11个生成式模型的20种尺寸-精度组合，以及4个未经UAVBench特定训练的开源结构化决策模型，统一使用UAVBench中2,000道经验证的多选题；同时将两个生成式模型在Mac与Qualcomm RB3板上进行配对评测，并实际尝试在边缘设备部署决策模型。
AI.result: 结构化决策模型H2O Lightning 4B取得最高准确率77.65%；部署决策模型时在测试的边缘设备上遇到模型转换与运行时限制；Mac与RB3板配对评测中准确率不完全一致，但模型排序一致（LFM2 2.6B均高于Qwen2.5 1.5B），逐题答案存在平台差异。
AI.conclusion: 结构化决策模型适合此类UAV决策任务；可用普通本地机器对候选模型进行初筛排序，但由于逐题答案存在差异，最终仍需在真实硬件上验证；边缘部署还受模型转换与运行时限制约束。

title: Selection Policies for Equal-Byte Mixed-Precision Quantization of Small Language Models
summary: Can changing which matrices receive 2, 4, or 8 bits improve a small language model without increasing its parameter storage? I compare two parent-selection rules in the same genetic algorithm: a binary-tournament variant and an Alternis-inspired rule. A separate baseline samples repaired random allocations without crossover or mutation. All three use the same MLX affine quantizer, byte ceiling, initialization and candidate allowance within each study. An exploratory study on Qwen3.5-2B evaluates 90 allocations per run. The main study on Qwen3-1.7B evaluates 500 distinct allocations per run over 10 paired seeds. Against uniform four-bit, tournament reduces held-out next-token negative log-likelihood (NLL) by 0.0616 on AG News and 0.0152 on IMDb on average, improving all 10 seeds on each corpus at identical parameter storage. Alternis improves five seeds and ties five on AG News; on IMDb its mean gain is near zero. Random returns uniform four-bit in every seed. The tournament representative answers 156 of 400 ARC-Challenge questions correctly versus 163 for uniform; no accuracy gain is demonstrated on this subset. The result favors this tournament variant for text prediction under the tested protocol, not for compression ratio or task accuracy.

AI.tldr: 在参数量（存储）不变的约束下，用遗传算法为各权重矩阵分配2/4/8比特混合量化方案；二元锦标赛父代选择在Qwen3-1.7B上稳定降低留出集NLL，但未提升ARC-Challenge准确率。
AI.motivation: 探索在不增加参数存储的前提下，仅改变"哪些矩阵用2/4/8比特"这一量化位宽分配，能否改善小型语言模型的性能；并比较不同父代选择规则（二元锦标赛 vs Alternis启发式规则）与随机基线在统一协议下的效果差异。
AI.method: 同一遗传算法框架下比较两种父代选择规则：二元锦标赛变体与Alternis启发式规则，另设无交叉、无变异的修复随机分配基线。三者共享同一MLX仿射量化器、字节上限、初始化与候选配额。探索性研究Qwen3.5-2B每轮评估90个分配；主研究Qwen3-1.7B每轮评估500个不同分配，跨10个配对随机种子；以留出集下一词NLL为指标，并在ARC-Challenge子集上检验准确率。
AI.result: 相对统一4比特：锦标赛在相同参数存储下平均降低留出NLL 0.0616（AG News）与0.0152（IMDb），两个语料上各10个种子全部改善；Alternis在AG News上5种子改善、5种子持平，IMDb上平均增益接近零；随机基线在每个种子均回退到统一4比特。锦标赛代表模型在ARC-Challenge上答对156/400，统一4比特为163/400，该子集未显示准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持该锦标赛变体在测试协议下用于文本预测（NLL）的位宽分配优化，而非压缩率或下游任务准确率的提升；其收益限于特定协议与语言建模指标，泛化到任务精度尚未得到证据。

title: GERF: A Token-Efficient Multimodal Retrieval Framework for Schema-Guided Scientific Information Extraction
summary: Scientific information extraction (IE) is a fundamental component of AI for Science, transforming experimental knowledge embedded in scientific literature into structured and traceable data for evidence synthesis, scientific database construction, and data-driven discovery. However, critical experimental details are often distributed across text, tables, figures, captions, and surrounding discussion, making them difficult to recover using conventional text-only extraction. Existing LLM-based and multimodal RAG pipelines typically rely on full-document context or coarse page-level retrieval, introducing substantial irrelevant evidence and high textual and visual token costs. We propose GERF, a Graph-based Evidence Retrieval Framework for token-efficient, schema-guided multimodal scientific IE. GERF represents each article as a heterogeneous evidence graph that connects schema fields, text chunks, figures, and figure-derived content through semantic and structural relations. Using schema fields as retrieval anchors, GERF combines direct semantic retrieval, Random Walk with Restart, and null-aware evidence expansion to construct compact, field-specific multimodal evidence packages. Visual interpretation is applied only to graph-selected figures, avoiding indiscriminate processing of the entire document. We evaluate GERF from two complementary perspectives: evidence retrieval quality and pipeline-level input-token consumption. On the expert-annotated SOFC-Exp corpus, GERF retrieves gold-supported evidence for 94.55% of the evaluated field instances, providing broad field-level evidence coverage for downstream extraction. In the token comparison, GERF reduces average input-token usage by 73.40% relative to full-context processing and uses fewer tokens than the evaluated page-level pipelines.

AI.tldr: GERF：一种基于异构图证据检索的框架，以schema字段为锚点定位文本与图表的证据，实现token高效的多模态科学信息抽取。
AI.motivation: 科学文献中的关键实验细节分散于正文、表格、图、图注与讨论中，纯文本抽取难以还原；现有LLM与多模态RAG流程依赖全文上下文或粗粒度页面级检索，引入大量无关证据，文本与视觉token开销高。
AI.method: 将每篇文章构建为异构图证据图，节点包括schema字段、文本块、图及图衍生内容，边为语义与结构关系；以schema字段作为检索锚点，融合直接语义检索、带重启随机游走（RWR）与null-aware证据扩展，生成紧凑的字段专属多模态证据包；仅对图中选中的图执行视觉解析，避免全文图像处理。
AI.result: 在专家标注的SOFC-Exp语料上，GERF为94.55%的评估字段实例检索到金标支撑证据；相较全文上下文处理，平均输入token降低73.40%，且少于所评估的页面级流水线。
AI.conclusion: 以schema为锚的图结构证据检索可在保证字段级证据覆盖率的同时显著压缩多模态输入成本，为科学信息抽取提供高性价比范式。

title: Event-Driven Parameter Dynamics for Spatiotemporal Parameter-Update Application in Deep Learning
summary: Standard neural network training typically applies optimizer-generated update signals to model parameters at every iteration. This work introduces a spatiotemporal view of parameter updating and proposes Event-Driven Parameter Dynamics (EPD), which separates candidate-update generation from their application through an intermediate state with accumulation, event-triggered release, and reset. In a canonical coordinate-wise instantiation, accumulation produces temporal integration, release imposes a spatial budget, and reset separates successive inter-release intervals, while conventional dense updating is recovered as a boundary case. Across four model--optimizer configurations on CIFAR-100, EPD maintains final performance close to conventional training even when only a small fraction of coordinates are released at each step, including the 1\% regime. Matched-control experiments further show that temporal accumulation, state-dependent selection, and post-release reset each contribute to the observed behavior. Together, these results identify parameter-update realization as a controllable dimension of optimization and provide a concrete basis for studying its temporal and spatial organization separately from candidate-update generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出事件驱动参数动力学（EPD），将“更新信号的生成”与“更新信号的应用”解耦，借助中间状态的累积、事件触发释放与重置实现参数更新的时空组织，在CIFAR-100上以极小释放比例仍保持接近常规训练的性能。
AI.motivation: 常规神经网络训练在每个迭代都把优化器生成的更新信号直接作用于全部参数，参数更新的“实现方式”这一维度长期被忽视。作者希望从时间与空间两个角度重新审视参数更新，将候选更新的生成与其实际应用分离，从而把“更新实现”作为一个可独立调控的优化维度来研究。
AI.method: 提出EPD框架：引入中间状态，包含累积、事件触发释放和重置三个环节。给出逐坐标的典型实例化：累积对应时间积分，释放施加空间预算（仅释放部分坐标），重置分隔相邻两次释放之间的区间；常规稠密更新作为其边界情形被包含在内。并在CIFAR-100的四种模型—优化器组合上进行验证，同时设置匹配对照实验。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100的四个模型—优化器配置上，即使每步仅释放很小比例的坐标（包括1%的极端情形），EPD的最终性能仍接近常规训练。匹配对照实验表明，时间累积、状态依赖的选择机制以及释放后的重置，各自都对观察到的行为有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 研究将参数更新的实现识别为优化的一个可控维度，为在独立于候选更新生成的前提下，分别研究其时间组织与空间组织提供了具体基础。

title: PseuDRAGON: Knowledge-Guided Local LLMs for Financial-Data Pseudonymization in Closed Networks
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Accepted as a full paper in the AI for Intelligent Financial Technologies (AIFT) track of the 42nd ACM/SIGAPP Symposium on Applied Computing (SAC 2027). Gwangui Hong and Seonho An contributed equally
summary: Staff pseudonymizing financial data in closed networks must interpret abbreviated column names, identify personal information, and choose processing methods. Local language models can assist, but may give different labels for the same input. PseuDRAGON keeps confirmed judgments and corrections outside a fixed model and reuses them through exact-name lookup and learned rules. For expert review, the workflow searches institutional policy, national privacy law, then international sources. Across 92 columns from one institution, rules increase reuse under the same approval checks from 75 to 83 labels without reuse errors when all training judgments are available. With 25% of the training judgments, withholding non-PII rules for unseen names eliminated the extra PII misses in replay at the cost of lower reuse. Revising or withdrawing approvals rebuilds derived rules, and tests on synthetic records verify that selected methods produce the specified outputs. In three paired runs, the history-first baseline cut automated identification time by 83.0% on average versus no reuse.

AI.tldr: PseuDRAGON 将专家确认与修正的判断存于固定模型之外，通过精确名称查找与学习规则复用，实现金融数据列名匿名化标签的一致复用。
AI.motivation: 封闭网络中匿名化金融数据的员工需解读缩写列名、识别个人信息并选择处理方式；本地语言模型可辅助但同一输入可能给出不同标签，缺乏一致性。
AI.method: 将已确认判断与修正在固定模型之外沉淀，经精确名称查找与学习规则复用；专家复核按机构政策、国家隐私法、国际来源的顺序检索；审批的修订或撤回触发派生规则重建。
AI.result: 某机构92列上，在全部训练判断可用时，规则使同一审批检查下的复用标签由75增至83且无复用错误；仅用25%训练判断时，对未见名称暂缓非PII规则消除了重放中的额外PII漏标，但复用率下降；合成记录测试验证所选方法产出指定输出；三次配对运行中历史优先基线较无复用平均减少83.0%的自动识别时间。
AI.conclusion: 外部化判断复用可在不牺牲审批校验的前提下提升标签一致性与效率，但规则泛化需在复用率与PII漏标间权衡。

title: CLIP-FMoE: Scalable CLIP via Fused Mixture-of-Experts with Enforced Specialization
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have emerged as a promising approach for scaling deep learning models while maintaining computational efficiency. However, existing MoE adaptations for Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) models suffer from significant computational overhead during sequential training and degradation of zero-shot capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose CLIP-FMoE, a novel approach that integrates MoE architecture into CLIP fine-tuning. Our method uses Isolated Constrained Contrastive Learning, a pipeline that trains specialized experts on cluster-based data partitions to accelerate expert specialization. Additionally, we introduce a Fusion Gate mechanism to mitigate catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained knowledge. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves consistent improvements on downstream tasks while preserving zero-shot capabilities. Furthermore, our method demonstrates robust performance across varying context lengths, making it particularly suitable for diverse real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 提出CLIP-FMoE，将混合专家（MoE）架构引入CLIP微调，通过隔离约束对比学习与融合门机制，兼顾下游任务性能与零样本能力。
AI.motivation: 现有面向CLIP的MoE适配方案存在两大缺陷：顺序训练带来的显著计算开销，以及预训练零样本能力的退化。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分：(1) Isolated Constrained Contrastive Learning——在基于聚类的数据划分上分别训练专用专家，以加速专家特化；(2) Fusion Gate融合门机制——缓解对预训练知识的灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 多基准实验表明，该方法在下游任务上取得一致性提升，同时保持零样本能力，并在不同上下文长度下表现出鲁棒性能。
AI.conclusion: CLIP-FMoE为CLIP的高效MoE微调提供了可行方案，在提升下游适配效果的同时保留泛化能力，适用于多样化的实际应用场景。

title: VeriWorld: A Verifiable Visual SWE-Bench for Spatial Reasoning in 3D Environments
comment: 32 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track. Code at https://github.com/VITA-Group/VeriWorld and dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/yanyanzheng96/VeriWorld
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for spatial tasks such as navigation and manipulation, where they must infer geometry and object relationships from visual input in order to act correctly. Existing benchmarks usually test perception and reasoning in isolation, making it hard to tell whether failures come from visual understanding, downstream reasoning, or the bridge between them. We introduce VeriWorld, a benchmark for spatial reasoning in interactive 3D environments with executable actions and deterministic verification. For task families where all three channels are well-defined, we evaluate matched visual, structured, and combined input conditions on the same instance, environment, and verifier; families without a clean visual/structured/combined split are reported separately. This design supports controlled comparisons of perception, reasoning, and their interaction. Using this setup, we uncover two diagnostic findings. First, models often perform much better when task-relevant information, such as object identity, current state, or target location, is given explicitly than when it must be read from the rendered scene, revealing a recurring visual-to-structure gap. Second, action-space and harness design can change outcomes even under the same task and information condition, showing that interaction protocol is itself a confounding variable. VeriWorld is open-sourced to support reproducible and fine-grained evaluation of spatial reasoning in VLMs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出VeriWorld——一个面向交互式3D环境的VLM空间推理基准，通过可执行动作与确定性验证器，在同一实例上对比视觉、结构化、组合三种输入条件，以分离视觉理解、下游推理及其耦合环节；研究发现"视觉到结构鸿沟"与"动作空间/评测框架设计"两大混杂因素。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM被广泛用于导航、操作等需从视觉推断几何与物体关系的空间任务，但现有基准通常将感知与推理割裂测试，无法判断失败究竟源于视觉理解、下游推理，还是二者之间的衔接；同时缺乏对同一实例的可控对比手段。
AI.method: 构建VeriWorld基准：交互式3D环境、可执行动作、确定性验证器；对三类通道（视觉/结构化/组合）均定义清晰的任务族，在同一实例、同一环境、同一验证器下评测匹配的视觉、结构化与组合输入条件；无法干净切分三通道的任务族单独报告。以此实现感知、推理及其交互的受控比较。
AI.result: 得到两项诊断性发现：(1) 当任务相关信息（物体身份、当前状态、目标位置）被显式给出时，模型表现显著优于需从渲染场景中读取信息的情形，即反复出现的"视觉—结构鸿沟"；(2) 在相同任务与信息条件下，动作空间与评测框架（harness）设计仍会改变结果，说明交互协议本身即为混杂变量。
AI.conclusion: VeriWorld开源以支持可复现、细粒度的VLM空间推理评测；其核心贡献在于将感知、推理与交互协议解耦，揭示视觉到结构的信息损失与协议敏感性是影响评测结论的关键因素。

title: ReVAgent: Multi-Agent Reasoning-Intensive Video Generation
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Ruize Han is the corresponding author
summary: A central challenge in generating instructional videos for reasoning-intensive topics is to show how and why the state changes at each step. Even when an animation renders successfully, the depicted object relationships and state transitions can conflict with the explanation, making the reasoning difficult to follow. We present ReVAgent, a multi-agent framework that solves a problem, generates keyframes for its explanation, and synthesizes an instructional video. The agents share the execution record of a solution program, reuse intermediate results and constructions in the scenes, and check rendered keyframes to guide revisions to the solution or the scenes. We also introduce a multidimensional rubric for assessing whether generated videos present the problem clearly, organize the steps coherently, and use visuals to explain the reasoning. We calibrate a multimodal judge using human ratings and apply it to instructional videos for mathematics and algorithms. In the evaluated samples, ReVAgent presents multi-step reasoning coherently and uses diagrams to show how key operations lead to subsequent states.

AI.tldr: ReVAgent：基于多智能体框架生成推理密集型教学视频，让动画关键帧与解题步骤的解释保持一致。
AI.motivation: 为推理密集型主题生成教学视频的核心难点在于：需展示每一步状态"如何"及"为何"变化。即使动画成功渲染，其呈现的物体关系与状态转移也可能与讲解相冲突，导致推理难以跟随。
AI.method: 提出多智能体框架ReVAgent：解题、生成讲解关键帧、合成教学视频。各智能体共享解题程序的执行记录，复用中间结果与场景中的构造，并检查渲染出的关键帧以指导对解法或场景的修订。同时引入多维评分标准（问题呈现清晰度、步骤组织连贯性、视觉解释推理的有效性），并用人工评分校准多模态评判器。
AI.result: 经校准的多模态评判器应用于数学与算法教学视频评估；在所评估样本中，ReVAgent能连贯呈现多步推理，并用图示说明关键操作如何导向后续状态。
AI.conclusion: 通过执行记录共享、关键帧渲染反馈闭环与多维评估体系，ReVAgent有效提升了推理密集型教学视频中步骤与视觉的一致性。

title: Fin-RSI: A Unified Library of Financial Skills, Checks, and Self-Improvement for LLM Agents
summary: As large language models (LLMs) become more capable, financial agents need tools they can readily discover and use. Yet financial software is fragmented across libraries with different interfaces and conventions, making it difficult to build reliable agent workflows. We present Fin-RSI, a unified Python library of financial skills, checks, and self-improvement designed for LLM agents. It brings together tools for market analysis, forecasting, portfolio construction, and trading research through shared interfaces across models and agent frameworks. Agents can find suitable tools from natural-language requests, reuse tested implementations, and improve generated programs through checking and feedback. Developers can extend the library with new tools without rebuilding integrations for each model. Across 20 open-weight models on six trading-position tasks, tool discovery increased the proportion of episodes producing valid programs from 9.7% to 29.2%; for models with at least 14 billion parameters, it rose from 23.6% to 64.6%. We release the library and benchmark as a shared resource for the community and plan to expand its tools and task coverage as financial agents evolve.

AI.tldr: Fin-RSI 是一个面向 LLM 智能体的统一金融技能 Python 库，通过工具发现、复用与自检反馈提升金融程序生成的有效率。
AI.motivation: 金融软件分散于接口与约定各异的多个库中，LLM 智能体难以发现并可靠使用工具，导致构建稳定金融工作流困难。
AI.method: 构建统一 Python 库，集成市场分析、预测、组合构建与交易研究工具；以共享接口兼容多种模型与智能体框架；支持自然语言请求检索工具、复用已验证实现，并通过检查与反馈改进生成程序；开发者可扩展新工具而无需为每个模型重建集成。
AI.result: 在 20 个开放权重模型、六项交易持仓任务上，工具发现将产生有效程序的任务回合比例从 9.7% 提升至 29.2%；参数量 ≥140 亿的模型从 23.6% 提升至 64.6%。
AI.conclusion: Fin-RSI 有效提升金融智能体程序生成可靠性，并作为库与基准开放给社区，后续将随金融智能体演进扩展工具与任务覆盖。

title: Do You Even Know What I Want? Improving LLMs Ability to Detect Hidden User Intent
summary: As with conventional AI agents, a common source of misalignment between Large Language Models (LLMs) and their human users is misspecified goals. Often, this happens when the human has skewed beliefs about the system's model and provides it with information that causes behavior different from what they expected, with potentially unwanted side effects. To ensure goal alignment, one solution would be for the LLM to ask the human questions about their objectives. However, it has been well-documented that LLMs most often provide default responses to user requests rather than try and ask questions to clarify their true intent. In this paper, we address these challenges by adapting a novel formulation for the objective misspecification problem to work with LLMs. We then test if LLMs that are prompted to ask questions about a user's true underlying objectives are better at identifying them compared to those that do not. We evaluate our method using four state-of-the-art LLMs tested on five standard IPC domains, showing that for some domains, asking questions greatly improved model performance.

AI.tldr: 本文将目标误设定问题的形式化框架适配到大语言模型场景，检验"主动提问"能否帮助LLM识别用户真实目标，在4个SOTA LLM与5个IPC标准领域上验证：部分领域中提问显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: LLM与用户的对齐偏差常源于目标误设定：用户对系统模型持有偏差信念，提供的信息使模型行为偏离其预期并产生非期望副作用。理论上LLM应通过提问澄清意图，但已有研究表明LLM倾向于对用户请求给出默认响应，而非主动追问真实意图。
AI.method: 作者将一种新的目标误设定问题形式化方法改造为适用于LLM的版本，并设计对比实验：一组LLM被提示就用户真实潜在目标进行提问，另一组不提问，比较二者识别真实目标的准确程度。实验覆盖4个SOTA LLM，在5个标准IPC领域上评测。
AI.result: 实验表明，在部分IPC领域中，提问显著提升了模型性能，说明主动澄清机制在缓解目标误设定方面有效，但提升效果具有领域依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 主动提问是缓解LLM目标误设定、改善人机目标对齐的可行途径，但其收益并非在所有任务领域一致成立，需结合具体领域特性评估。

title: MetaSkill: Reusable Problem-Solving Methods for Adaptive Skill Orchestration in LLM Agents
comment: 16 pages, including appendices. The MetaSkill library is provided as ancillary material
summary: Reusable skills provide specialized procedures, but large language model (LLM) agents must still determine how to organize and adapt their use. We introduce MetaSkill, a two-layer framework for reusing problem-solving methods across tasks and domains. The method layer selects from 26 curated methods and binds abstract roles to task objects. The execution layer uses the instantiated method to identify intermediate objectives, coordinate native skills, and guide repair or method reselection. On 89 SkillsBench tasks and 995 ToolHop examples, MetaSkill outperforms the evaluated baselines in all six configurations, with accuracy gains of 3.51-13.48% over the strongest baseline. Ablations support explicit method-guided orchestration beyond direct method injection and further gains from method reselection.

AI.tldr: MetaSkill 是一个两层框架：方法层从 26 个精选方法中选择并将抽象角色绑定到任务对象，执行层用实例化方法确定中间目标、协调原生技能并指导修复或方法重选，从而在跨任务与跨域场景中复用问题求解方法。
AI.motivation: 可复用技能只提供专门化流程，LLM 智能体仍需自行决定如何组织与适配这些技能的使用，缺乏对方法层面复用的显式组织机制。
AI.method: 两层框架：方法层从 26 个精选方法中选取，并将抽象角色绑定到任务对象；执行层基于实例化后的方法识别中间目标、协调原生技能，并指导失败修复或方法重选。
AI.result: 在 89 个 SkillsBench 任务与 995 个 ToolHop 样例上，MetaSkill 在全部六种配置中均优于所评估的基线，相较最强基线准确率提升 3.51%–13.48%；消融实验表明显式方法引导的编排优于直接注入方法，方法重选可带来进一步增益。
AI.conclusion: 显式的方法级编排（而非直接注入方法）是技能复用的关键，方法重选机制进一步提升了跨任务与跨域的问题求解表现。

title: Correlated by Construction: Endpoint Choice and the Validation of Protein Screening
summary: Machine learning for protein engineering depends on functional measurements collected at screening scale, but the designs those measurements rank are deployed in processes that run elsewhere. Whether a miniaturized assay remains informative under the conditions of use is usually assumed rather than demonstrated. We describe an automated production and screening platform and test the transfer of its solution-phase metal-affinity measurements to immobilized rare-earth separation. Primary pKd-derived separation factors tracked those measured on covalently immobilized protein across 82 protein-metal-pair measurements from 35 proteins, with pairwise Spearman correlations of 0.878 to 0.923 (pooled Pearson $r$ = 0.836; Spearman $ρ$ = 0.869). Separation factors at a fixed metal pair are insensitive to the ordering shared across the lanthanide series, so these coefficients report protein-specific correspondence directly; permutation of protein identity confirms it, giving a mean scrambled correlation of 0.003 and, for the 17 proteins measured on all three pairs, $r$ = 0.917 against 0.001 ($p \approx 0.001$). Profiles compared as profiles behave differently. An independent comparison against published LAMBS profiles for the same protein backbones (417 proteins, 5,212 paired measurements) reproduced normalized raw elution at $r$ = 0.870, but reassigning protein identity still reached 0.840. High profile-level agreement across assay formats is largely attributable to metal preferences shared across the series rather than to protein identity. Transfer can be demonstrated, but the endpoint decides whether a correlation shows it: a pairwise contrast removes the shared ordering; a normalized profile retains it, and needs a null that reassigns protein identity.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验了自动化平台中溶液相金属亲和性测量能否迁移到固定化稀土分离场景，发现基于pKd的成对分离因子与固定化蛋白测量高度相关（Spearman 0.878–0.923），而整体谱图（profile）层面的高一致性主要来自整系列共有的金属偏好而非蛋白身份本身。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质工程机器学习依赖筛选规模的测量数据，但被排序的设计最终在别处（如固定化分离过程）使用；微型化实验在其使用条件下是否仍具信息量，通常只是被假设而非被验证。作者要检验跨测定格式的可迁移性。
AI.method: 搭建自动化生产与筛选平台；将溶液相金属亲和性测量（pKd派生的分离因子）与共价固定化蛋白上的测量进行对比，覆盖35种蛋白、82个蛋白-金属组合；采用成对Spearman/Pearson相关，并通过随机置换蛋白身份构造零假设；另与已发表的LAMBS谱图（417种蛋白、5212对测量）进行独立对比，区分成对对比与归一化谱图两种端点。
AI.result: 成对比较中，pKd派生分离因子与固定化测量高度对应：成对Spearman为0.878–0.923（合并Pearson r=0.836；Spearman ρ=0.869）；随机置换蛋白身份后平均相关仅0.003，对17种在三对金属上均有测量的蛋白，r=0.917 vs 0.001（p≈0.001）。而谱图层面，与LAMBS对比时归一化原始洗脱重现r=0.870，但重分配蛋白身份仍达0.840。
AI.conclusion: 可迁移性可以被证明，但取决于端点的选择：成对对比可去除整系列共有的排序，直接反映蛋白特异性对应；归一化谱图保留了共有排序，其高一致性主要归因于金属偏好而非蛋白身份，必须使用重分配蛋白身份的零假设才能正确解读相关性。

title: When Learned IDS Model Selection Collapses to a Static Choice: A Measurement Study at the Edge
summary: Runtime model selection trades detection quality against energy and latency. However, comparing a selector only with a more costly static detector conflates detector choice with the benefit of adaptation. We present a framework for analysis and physical measurement that combines a pairwise reward criterion, matched static controls, paired blocks, a fixed load-prevalence factorial design, and reporting of actions outside training support. On one Raspberry Pi 4B with four frozen TON-IoT detectors, tabular Q-learning and a deep Q-network (DQN) both select LightLR throughout. A retrospective audit using validation data only rules out preference reversals for MedRF versus LightLR and HeavyMLP versus LightLR. However, TinyDT has a higher reward than LightLR in seven of the 2,500 windows, so the audit does not establish global LightLR optimality. We also evaluate a causal DeadlineGuard rule under a fixed factorial design with three arrival rates (50, 100, and 4,000 rows/s) and three attack prevalences (0.10, 0.50, and 0.90). Compared with Static-MedRF, DeadlineGuard saves 43.7 J per 500-s run (2.98%; 95% paired CI 41.4--46.0 J) and eliminates all 512 deadline misses among 5,000 windows, at a cost of 1.373 percentage points in F1. Outside training support, Tabular-Q's deterministic tie-breaking rule selects TinyDT, resulting in a false-positive rate of 67.76%. These single-board results motivate joint audits of reward attainability, realized actions, attribution against matched static controls, service feasibility, and default actions outside training support.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一套结合成对奖励准则、匹配静态对照、配对区组与固定负载-流行率析因设计，并报告训练支撑集外动作的分析与物理测量框架，用于评估运行时检测器选择。在单板Raspberry Pi 4B上，Q-learning与DQN始终选择LightLR，审计未证实其全局最优；DeadlineGuard相较Static-MedRF节能43.7 J并消除全部截止期违约，但F1下降1.373个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有工作将运行时选择器仅与代价更高的静态检测器比较，混淆了检测器选择与自适应收益，缺少匹配静态对照与严格实验设计，难以判定选择器自身是否真正有效。
AI.method: 构建分析与物理测量框架：成对奖励准则、匹配静态对照、配对区组、固定负载-流行率（3种到达率×3种攻击流行率）析因设计，并报告训练支撑集外的动作；在单台Raspberry Pi 4B上以四个冻结的TON-IoT检测器比较表格Q学习与DQN，并对因果DeadlineGuard规则做对照评估。
AI.result: 两种RL选择器全程选择LightLR；基于验证数据的回溯审计排除MedRF、HeavyMLP相对LightLR的偏好反转，但TinyDT在2500个窗口中有7个奖励更高，故未确立LightLR全局最优。DeadlineGuard每500 s运行较Static-MedRF节省43.7 J（2.98%，95%配对CI 41.4–46.0 J），消除5000个窗口中全部512次截止期违约，代价为F1下降1.373个百分点。训练支撑集外，Tabular-Q的确定性平局规则选中TinyDT，假阳性率达67.76%。
AI.conclusion: 单板结果说明，运行时选择评估须联合开展奖励可达性、实际动作、匹配静态对照下的归因、服务可行性以及训练支撑集外默认动作五方面的审计。

title: Particle Belief Representations for Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability
summary: Particle filters flexibly represent complex, multimodal beliefs but expose them as weighted, unordered sets incompatible with conventional fixed-dimensional policies. We study particle-belief encodings as inputs to reinforcement-learning policies while holding belief estimation and policy optimization fixed. We compare statistical summaries, cumulant-generating-function (CGF) features, and permutation-invariant set encoders. Trainable encoders are learned end-to-end or pretrained through belief reconstruction or task-specific prediction. Across eight tasks, pooling-based set encoders and gradient CGF features are reliable end-to-end, while the Set Transformer achieves the highest performance with appropriate pretraining. Task-specific pretraining helps when its target captures decision-relevant belief structure, whereas reconstruction pretraining and latent alignment provide more selective benefits. For selecting and training particle-belief encoders in partially observable Markov decision processes, our results show that an encoding that reconstructs the belief well is not necessarily a good input for control.

AI.tldr: 在保持信念估计与策略优化不变的前提下，系统比较将粒子信念编码为RL策略输入的多种方案（统计摘要、CGF特征、置换不变集合编码器），并考察端到端训练与多种预训练方式的影响。
AI.motivation: 粒子滤波能灵活表示复杂多模态信念，但其输出为加权、无序的集合，与常规定维策略网络输入不兼容，因此需要研究何种粒子信念编码最适合作为控制策略的输入。
AI.method: 以粒子信念编码为受控变量，控制信念估计与策略优化不变；对比统计摘要、累积量生成函数（CGF）特征及置换不变集合编码器（池化类与Set Transformer）；可训练编码器采用端到端学习，或通过信念重建、任务特定预测、潜空间对齐等目标进行预训练；在八个任务上评测。
AI.result: 基于池化的集合编码器与梯度CGF特征在端到端设置下表现稳定可靠；Set Transformer在合适预训练下取得最高性能；任务特定预训练在其目标能捕捉决策相关信念结构时有效，而重建预训练与潜空间对齐的收益更具选择性。
AI.conclusion: 在POMDP中选择与训练粒子信念编码器时，能很好重建信念的编码未必是好的控制输入；编码器设计应面向决策相关性而非单纯的重建保真度。

title: EA-Bench: Measuring information and action efficiency under imperfect instructions
summary: Personal agents help users complete everyday work across digital applications. Many standard benchmarks assume that users provide sufficient information to solve a task. However, agents often encounter incomplete, distracting, or inconsistent information in practice. To systematically study agent inefficiency under such imperfect information, we introduce Efficient Action (EA)-Bench, which evaluates both tool calls and user interactions in work-related tasks. To our knowledge, it is the first benchmark to jointly evaluate tool-call efficiency and user-interaction efficiency under controlled missing, redundant, and conflicting information. We construct 63 base-task instances adapted from existing work-related benchmarks. To guide perturbation design and quantify task requirements, we represent workflows as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) and examine node-level dependencies to identify where information can be withheld, contradicted, or supplemented with distractors. We use a two-stage validation process combining AI-assisted checks with expert screening to select 232 conditions from 792 initial candidates. We organize these tasks into Easy and Hard tracks by task complexity. Experiments show that imperfect information can reduce accuracy and increase tool-use and user-interaction costs. More concerning, several models obtain apparently correct outcomes by guessing user-specific values without confirmation, revealing potential execution unreliability in current models under imperfect user information.

AI.tldr: 提出EA-Bench，首个在缺失/冗余/冲突信息下联合评估工具调用效率与用户交互效率的基准，基于DAG建模工作流并以两阶段验证从792个候选中筛出232个条件，实验表明不完整信息会降低准确率并抬高工具与交互成本，模型还会不经确认猜用户特定值。
AI.motivation: 现有标准基准默认用户提供充分信息，但真实场景中信息常不完整、含干扰或自相矛盾，代理在此类不完美信息下的低效与不可靠行为缺乏系统评估手段。
AI.method: 构建63个改编自工作类基准的基础任务实例；将工作流表示为有向无环图（DAG），分析节点级依赖以确定信息可被隐去、矛盾化或注入干扰的位置；采用AI辅助检查与专家筛选的两阶段验证，从792个候选条件中选出232个；按任务复杂度划分Easy与Hard赛道。
AI.result: 不完美信息既降低任务准确率，又增加工具使用与用户交互成本；多个模型通过未经确认地猜测用户特定取值来获得表面正确的结果，暴露执行不可靠性。
AI.conclusion: EA-Bench 填补了不完美信息下代理效率评测的空白，揭示当前模型存在"猜值代替澄清"的隐患，为提升个人代理在真实信息条件下的效率与可靠性提供评测基础。

title: Shallow may be better: Physics-Constrained Lightweight Networks for High-Throughput Particle Image Velocimetry
summary: Convolutional networks for optical flow typically adopt progressively deeper pyramidal encoders under the assumption that larger receptive fields improve motion estimation. For particle image velocimetry (PIV), however, tracer-particle displacement between frames is bounded by the acquisition geometry, allowing network depth to be derived from the physically admissible displacement rather than inherited from general-purpose architectures. Using a layer-by-layer analysis of spatial-support growth, we derive its explicit upper bound and show that deeper architectures substantially exceed the support required for PIV, compromising training stability, spatial resolution under particle loss, and inference efficiency. Based on this analysis, we develop LIMA3, a lightweight pyramidal displacement estimator with 589,000 trainable parameters. Across synthetic and experimental benchmarks, LIMA3 matches the accuracy of established learned and classical methods with at least an order of magnitude less memory and substantially higher throughput, while retaining the physically expected coarsening of spatial resolution as tracer information is lost. Its linear memory scaling enables megapixel processing within embedded memory budgets, such that LIMA3 can reach over 900 image pairs per second at $640\times480$~pixel on an RTX 5090 and 99 image pairs per second on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. The spatial-support analysis provides a transferable design principle for compact optical-flow architectures and bounded-window attention, offering an alternative to compressing oversized general-purpose networks and enabling efficient operation alongside image acquisition.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析空间支撑增长的上界，论证PIV任务所需的网络深度应由物理可容许位移决定，据此提出轻量金字塔位移估计器LIMA3（58.9万参数），以至少一个数量级的更少内存和更高吞吐达到与已有方法相当的精度。
AI.motivation: 光流卷积网络通常沿用逐步加深的金字塔编码器，假定更大感受野总能改善运动估计。但在粒子图像测速（PIV）中，示踪粒子帧间位移受采集几何约束而有界，因此网络深度应可由物理可容许位移推导，而非从通用架构继承。过深架构会超出PIV所需空间支撑，损害训练稳定性、粒子丢失下的空间分辨率与推理效率。
AI.method: 对空间支撑（感受野）的逐层增长进行解析分析，推导其显式上界；据此设计LIMA3——一个仅含589,000可训练参数的轻量金字塔位移估计器。
AI.result: 在合成与实验基准上，LIMA3精度与既有学习型及经典方法相当，内存至少降低一个数量级、吞吐显著更高；并保留粒子信息丢失时空间分辨率按物理预期的粗化行为。其线性内存缩放使兆像素图像可在嵌入式内存预算内处理：RTX 5090上640×480分辨率下超过900图像对/秒，NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上达99图像对/秒。
AI.conclusion: 该空间支撑分析为紧凑光流架构与有界窗口注意力提供了可迁移的设计原则，可作为压缩超大通用网络的替代方案，并支持与图像采集协同的高效运行。

title: OSLA: Observation-Aware Local Alignment and Cross-Scene Relation Learning for Any-Scenario Person Re-Identification
summary: Any-Scenario Person Re-Identification (AS-ReID) aims to retrieve identities across spectral modalities and aerial-ground viewpoints using a unified model. However, changes in viewpoint and spectrum can make local correspondences unreliable, while conventional sampling may omit cross-camera positive relations needed for training. To address these challenges, we propose OSLA, an observation-aware framework built on supervised CLIP-ReID that combines Local Identity Alignment (LIA) and Cross-Scene Relation Learning (CSR). Specifically, LIA uses historical identity observations and competing-identity information to select reliable cross-scene local correspondences while allowing unmatched regions. Local-to-global distillation transfers identity knowledge from correctly classified historical local features into the global representation. CSR couples observed-cell sampling with spectrum-grouped ranking to jointly organize and optimize cross-camera relations. Sampling across two cameras and two spectra provides same- and cross-spectrum positives, while ranking constrains positive-negative scores separately by gallery spectrum on the final retrieval descriptor. Both modules operate only during training, preserving the original visual encoder and retrieval descriptor at inference. Experiments on WHU-MARS-1000 and WHU-MARS-2337 demonstrate that OSLA achieves absolute Rank-1 gains of 5.0% and 4.8% over UAD, respectively, under the AS-ReID protocol. The code will be available.

AI.tldr: OSLA：面向任意场景行人重识别的观测感知训练框架，通过局部身份对齐与跨场景关系学习提升统一模型性能。
AI.motivation: AS-ReID 需用统一模型跨光谱、跨空地视角检索，但视角与光谱变化导致局部对应不可靠，且常规采样会遗漏训练所需的跨相机正样本关系。
AI.method: 基于监督 CLIP-ReID 构建观测感知框架，含两模块：局部身份对齐（LIA）利用历史身份观测与竞争身份信息筛选可靠的跨场景局部对应并允许未匹配区域，经局部到全局蒸馏将正确分类的历史局部特征知识迁移到全局表示；跨场景关系学习（CSR）将观测单元采样与按光谱分组排序耦合，双相机双光谱采样获得同谱与跨谱正样本，并在最终检索描述符上按图库光谱分别约束正负分数。两模块仅训练时启用，推理保持原视觉编码器与检索描述符。
AI.result: 在 WHU-MARS-1000 与 WHU-MARS-2337 上，AS-ReID 协议下相较 UAD 的 Rank-1 绝对提升分别为 5.0% 与 4.8%。
AI.conclusion: OSLA 以训练期的局部对齐与关系学习弥补对应不可靠与采样不足问题，在不改变推理结构的前提下显著提升 AS-ReID 检索性能。

title: Following the Error Through a Compressed Network:An Angular Measure for FFN Weight Compression in ViT-L/16
summary: We study the compression of the 48 feed-forward network (FFN) matrices of the Vision Transformer ViT-L/16 to 2--8 bits with four schemes: a per-token grid, a fixed Gaussian Lloyd--Max table, a table fitted to the matrix, and a random-sign Hadamard rotation followed by the fixed table. We evaluate on 50,000 images. At 4 bits the top-1 accuracy of the four schemes lies within 0.8 points of the float32 model, while the agreement with its predictions ranges from 98.4\% to 94.4\%. We use the angular error between the compressed and the float32 residual stream, followed through the blocks, as a portable measure that ranks the schemes as the final classification does and shows where the ranking is built: with rotation the angle grows close to the square root of the number of blocks, the signature of independently accumulating errors, while the other schemes are amplified in the later blocks. The same measure shows that a scheme that is better on one block in isolation can be worse in the whole network. To address this inconsistency we introduce an angular measure of the spectrum of the output of a block, which in isolation orders the schemes as the whole network does where they diverge most. We support these observations with real samples and with statistically generated ones. The scope is one model, the FFN weights only, and float evaluation of compressed weights; no speed-up is claimed. The error measures and the sample generation, however, can be applied to other models and precisions.

AI.tldr: 研究ViT-L/16的48个FFN矩阵压缩到2–8位，比较四种方案，提出用残差流的角度误差作为可移植度量，并引入块输出谱的角度度量来解释单块与全网排序的不一致。
AI.motivation: 量化压缩方案通常只报告最终精度，缺乏能在层/块级别追踪误差传播、且可迁移到其他模型与精度的诊断度量；同时存在"单块最优方案在全网中反而更差"的不一致现象，需要解释。
AI.method: 对ViT-L/16全部48个FFN权重矩阵做2–8位压缩，四种量化方案：逐token网格、固定高斯Lloyd–Max码表、按矩阵拟合的码表、随机符号Hadamard旋转+固定码表。在50,000张图像上评估。以压缩后与float32残差流之间的角度误差逐块跟踪作为可移植度量；并引入块的输出谱的角度度量。
AI.result: 4位时四种方案top-1与float32相差在0.8个百分点内，预测一致率为98.4%–94.4%。角度误差给出的方案排序与最终分类一致，并能定位排序形成的位置：有旋转时角度约随块数平方根增长（独立累积误差的特征），其余方案在靠后块被放大。谱角度度量在方案分歧最大的孤立场景下复现全网排序。用真实样本与统计生成样本验证。
AI.conclusion: 误差度量与样本生成方法可推广到其他模型和精度；结论局限于单一模型、仅FFN权重、压缩权重的float评估，不宣称加速。

title: ViewAgent3D: A Training-Free Multi-View Pipeline for 3D Scene Understanding
summary: 3D scene understanding tasks are often approached by building explicit 3D scene representations or by training specialized multi-modal models over point clouds, voxels, or scene graphs. We take a complementary view: for many queries, the main bottleneck is not the absence of a stronger 3D representation but the selection of a small subset of multi-view RGB views that actually makes the query answerable. We present a training-free, query-conditioned multi-view pipeline that performs diverse tasks using only 2D images and a set of tools used purely for inference. Our method first decomposes each query into a set of concepts that identify unique attributes that assist with reasoning. This drives a coarse-to-fine evidence selection process: a coarse retrieval selects and scores all views, a diversity-aware selector reduces redundancy, and a reranking stage helps shortlist views by target visibility or answerability. The resulting evidence is optionally grounded for queries that benefit from explicit localization, and a self-verification step helps refine the final response, especially for open-ended cases. Despite using no task-specific training and no explicit 3D representations at inference time, our approach provides approximately 10% gain on 3D VQA and 5% gain on dense captioning and Embodied QA while being applicable across different scenarios. We further propose a unique judge-based evaluation system, motivating a judge who takes into account many semantically correct or partially correct answers, thereby improving holistic scene understanding.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种免训练、查询条件化的多视图RGB证据选择流程，用纯2D图像与推理期工具完成3D场景理解任务，在3D VQA上约提升10%、稠密描述与具身问答上约提升5%。
AI.motivation: 现有3D场景理解多依赖显式3D表示（点云、体素、场景图）或专门训练的多模态模型。作者认为对许多查询而言，瓶颈不在3D表示强弱，而在于能否选出使查询可回答的一小部分多视图RGB视角。
AI.method: 免训练、查询条件化的多视图pipeline：先将查询分解为识别独特属性、辅助推理的概念集合，驱动由粗到细的证据选择——粗检索对所有视图打分，多样性感知选择器去冗余，重排序阶段依据目标可见性或可回答性筛出候选视图；对需要显式定位的查询做可选grounding，并以自验证步骤精炼最终回答。推理期不使用任务特定训练与显式3D表示。另提出基于judge的评估体系，容纳语义正确或部分正确的多种答案。
AI.result: 3D VQA约10%增益，稠密描述与Embodied QA约5%增益，且可适用于不同场景；judge式评估改善了整体场景理解的评价合理性。
AI.conclusion: 证据选择（而非更强3D表示）是3D场景理解的关键瓶颈；无需任务特定训练与显式3D表示的2D多视图证据选择流程即可跨任务取得稳定提升，并配套提出更宽容的judge式评估协议。

title: Learning Continuous Scene Depth Representations via Cross-Modal Gaussian Rendering
summary: Depth super-resolution with color guidance is a fundamental problem in geometric scene understanding that aims to reconstruct high-resolution depth using structural cues from color images. In practical RGB-D systems, the resolution gap between depth and color images often varies, requiring flexible upsampling factors. However, many existing methods are designed for predefined integer scales. Although implicit methods support arbitrary-scale reconstruction, they typically rely on computationally demanding per-pixel neural decoding and may struggle to recover sharp depth boundaries and fine structures. To this end, we propose a cross-modal Gaussian rendering framework that learns continuous depth representations for arbitrary-scale depth super-resolution. Specifically, we first construct hierarchical Gaussian representations for progressive depth reconstruction, with explicit spatial support defined by learnable Gaussian primitives. Building on this representation, we design a Structure-Aware Gaussian Aggregation module that combines spatial weights with cross-modal feature affinities to reduce aggregation across depth discontinuities. We then develop a Scale-Adaptive Gaussian Rendering module that adapts Gaussian spatial kernels to the target pixel footprint. To further facilitate cross-modal learning, we propose a training strategy that gradually introduces higher-frequency guidance information during training. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method at both in-distribution and out-of-distribution upsampling scales.

AI.tldr: 提出跨模态高斯渲染框架，用连续深度表示实现任意尺度深度超分辨率。
AI.motivation: 实际RGB-D系统中深度与彩色图像分辨率差往往变化，需要灵活的任意上采样因子；现有方法多针对预设整数尺度，隐式方法虽支持任意尺度但依赖逐像素神经解码、计算昂贵且难以恢复锐利深度边界与精细结构。
AI.method: 1) 构建分层高斯表示，由可学习高斯基元定义显式空间支撑，实现渐进式深度重建；2) 设计结构感知高斯聚合模块（Structure-Aware Gaussian Aggregation），将空间权重与跨模态特征亲和度结合，抑制跨深度不连续区域的聚合；3) 设计尺度自适应高斯渲染模块（Scale-Adaptive Gaussian Rendering），使高斯空间核适配目标像素足迹；4) 提出渐进引入高频引导信息的训练策略以促进跨模态学习。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在分布内与分布外上采样尺度下均有效。
AI.conclusion: 以高斯基元为载体的连续深度表示可在避免逐像素神经解码开销的同时支持任意尺度上采样，并借助结构感知聚合与尺度自适应渲染更好地保持深度边界与细节。

title: Beyond Full-Context Accuracy: Context-Marginalized Evaluation of Test-Time Structure-Aware Inference in EEG-to-Image Retrieval
summary: Test-time structure-aware inference can improve cross-subject EEG-to-image retrieval by exploiting relations among unlabeled test queries, but it also makes predictions depend on query-set composition. Existing evaluations typically report accuracy under a single full-query context, leaving unclear whether gains and comparative conclusions hold as context changes. We introduce Context-Marginalized Retrieval Evaluation (CMRE), which repeatedly evaluates each target query in sampled contexts using the corresponding rows of a fixed query-gallery similarity matrix. CMRE distinguishes structural exploitability, quantified by gains over independent retrieval, from context robustness, measured by same-query Top-1 context consistency. Under leave-one-subject-out evaluation on THINGS-EEG2 across six frozen representations and six structure-aware inference rules, structure-aware inference improves full-context Top-1 accuracy by up to 20.40 percentage points over independent retrieval. However, the rule selected under full-context evaluation is no longer optimal in 17 of 24 representation-context-size conditions (70.8%). Selecting the full-context winner incurs an average loss of 2.70 percentage points and a maximum loss of 8.29 percentage points under reduced contexts. Representation rankings are likewise inference- and context-dependent: the ordering under independent retrieval is not consistently preserved under structure-aware inference. Moreover, larger retrieval gains do not necessarily imply greater context robustness, showing that retrieval effectiveness and prediction stability provide complementary views of structure-aware inference. Full-context accuracy captures one operating point of context-dependent inference. CMRE complements it by characterizing how structural gains, context consistency, and comparisons of rules and representations change with query context.

AI.tldr: 提出上下文边缘化检索评估（CMRE），在采样上下文中重复评估每条 query，区分"结构可利用性"与"上下文鲁棒性"；发现全上下文下选出的最优推理规则在70.8%条件下并非最优，平均损失2.70、最大8.29个百分点，且表示排序随推理规则与上下文变化。
AI.motivation: 测试时结构感知推理利用无标签测试 query 间关系提升跨被试 EEG-to-image 检索，但使预测依赖 query 集构成；现有评估多在单一全 query 上下文中报告精度，无法判断增益与比较结论是否随上下文改变而成立。
AI.method: 提出 CMRE：基于固定的 query-gallery 相似度矩阵，将每个目标 query 重复置于采样上下文中评估（复用对应矩阵行）。以相对独立检索的增益量化结构可利用性，以同一 query 的 Top-1 上下文一致性度量上下文鲁棒性。在 THINGS-EEG2 上做留一被试交叉验证，覆盖 6 种冻结表示与 6 种结构感知推理规则。
AI.result: 全上下文下结构感知推理较独立检索最高提升 Top-1 达 20.40 个百分点；但全上下文选出的规则在 17/24（70.8%）的"表示×上下文规模"条件下不再最优，直接沿用带来平均 2.70、最大 8.29 个百分点损失。表示排序依赖推理规则与上下文：独立检索下的顺序在结构感知推理下不能稳定保持。检索增益更大不必然意味着上下文鲁棒性更强，二者为互补视角。
AI.conclusion: 全上下文精度仅刻画上下文相关推理的一个工作点；CMRE 作为补充，刻画结构增益、上下文一致性以及规则与表示比较如何随 query 上下文变化，建议结构感知推理的评估与选择需考虑上下文敏感性。

title: Seeing 3D Occupancy Through Scene-Adaptive Projection
summary: Vision-based 3D occupancy prediction infers voxel-wise geometry and semantics from multi-view images, where 2D-to-3D view transformation is a crucial step. Many existing methods adopt a backward-projection paradigm, projecting uniformly distributed 3D reference points onto image planes to aggregate multi-view features. However, their scene-agnostic sampling patterns overlook the non-uniform distribution of scene geometry, allocating many references to empty space and reducing sampling efficiency under a fixed sampling budget. To address this challenge, we propose SAP, a scene-adaptive projection framework that leverages depth-based geometric priors to guide view transformation. Specifically, we back-project metric depth maps predicted by a frozen depth model into 3D space to obtain geometric priors. To leverage these priors, we design a Scene-Adaptive Projection Encoder comprising two complementary components. First, Prior-Guided Reference Generation constructs a hybrid reference set for feature sampling, allocating references within prior-supported height regions and retaining full-range sampling where valid support is unavailable. Furthermore, to account for potential spatial misalignment caused by depth estimation errors, Radial-Structured Feature Aggregation explores multiple candidate locations through learned radial offsets to aggregate potentially displaced feature evidence. Extensive experiments on Occ3D demonstrate that SAP achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently improves results across diverse occupancy frameworks.

AI.tldr: 提出场景自适应投影框架SAP，利用深度几何先验引导2D-to-3D视图变换，在固定采样预算下提升占用预测的采样效率，在Occ3D上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有反向投影范式将均匀分布的3D参考点投影到图像平面聚合多视图特征，其场景无关的采样模式忽视了场景几何的非均匀分布，导致大量参考点被分配给空白空间，固定采样预算下采样效率低。
AI.method: 将冻结深度模型预测的度量深度图反投影至3D空间获得几何先验，并设计场景自适应投影编码器：1) 先验引导参考点生成，在先验支持的高度区域内分配参考点，无有效支持处保留全范围采样，构建混合参考集；2) 径向结构特征聚合，通过可学习径向偏移探索多个候选位置，以缓解深度估计误差导致的空间错位。
AI.result: 在Occ3D上取得SOTA性能，并在多种占用预测框架上一致提升效果。
AI.conclusion: 基于深度先验的场景自适应视图变换可有效提升采样效率与占用预测精度，且具备良好的框架通用性。

title: CAMA: Calibrated Anti-Collapse Marginal Alignment for Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
summary:
Test-time adaptation (TTA) updates a model using unlabeled test data to help it handle distribution shifts. However, prior work has found that image corruption causes a vision-language model (VLM) to produce more similar features for different images, a phenomenon known as feature compression. Under compression, entropy minimization, the most common TTA objective, can cause the model to favor a few classes and perform worse than before adaptation. Despite these observations, a detailed analysis of how these failures are connected and an effective strategy for preventing them are still lacking.
  In this paper, we first analyze why entropy minimization fails for VLMs. We then propose CAMA, a new test-time adaptation objective that maximizes batch mutual information to encourage confident predictions for individual images while maintaining diverse predictions across the batch. CAMA also estimates a reference class distribution early in the test stream and aligns each batch's average prediction with this reference during adaptation. We prove that feature compression biases the predictions and that entropy minimization amplifies this bias into collapse, whereas CAMA is guaranteed to preserve every class. Across standard corruption benchmarks, we observe collapse on nearly every VLM backbone evaluated. CAMA prevents collapse in every observed case and, in turn, achieves the best accuracy on every backbone. Quantitative and qualitative analyses confirm that CAMA reverses the feature compression behind the collapse, and ablations show that each of its components contributes.

AI.tldr: 针对VLM在测试时适应(TTA)中因特征压缩导致熵最小化失效的问题，论文分析其机理并提出CAMA目标，通过最大化批互信息并引入参考类别分布对齐，理论上保证各类别不被丢弃，实验中在全部骨干与损坏基准上防止了崩溃并取得最优精度。
AI.motivation: 现有TTA常用熵最小化目标，但视觉语言模型在图像损坏下会产生特征压缩（不同图像特征趋于相似），使熵最小化偏向少数类别、适应后性能反而下降。此前工作仅观察到这些现象，缺乏对失败机理之间联系的细致分析，也缺少有效的防止策略。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析熵最小化为何对VLM失效，并证明特征压缩会偏置预测、熵最小化将该偏置放大为类别崩溃；2) 提出CAMA：最大化批互信息，既鼓励单张图像的置信预测，又保持批内预测的多样性；3) 在测试流早期估计参考类别分布，适应过程中将每批平均预测与参考分布对齐；4) 理论上证明CAMA可保证保留每个类别。
AI.result: 在标准损坏基准上，几乎所有评估的VLM骨干都出现崩溃；CAMA在所有观测情形下均防止了崩溃，并在每个骨干上取得最佳准确率。定量与定性分析表明CAMA逆转了导致崩溃的特征压缩，消融实验验证了各组件均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 特征压缩是VLM测试时适应失败的关键诱因，熵最小化会放大其偏置导致类别崩溃；以批互信息最大化结合参考分布对齐的CAMA可从原理上保持类别多样性，是一种有效且理论有保障的TTA目标。

title: VideoJSON: A Minimal Harness Beats Purpose-Built Memory for Ultra-Long Video Understanding
summary: Answering questions over days or weeks of video requires searching for scattered clues across long timelines. Existing video agents rely on complex memory graphs and fixed retrieval pipelines, which restrict how the agent can search. We propose VideoJSON, a minimal harness for ultra-long video understanding that keeps the memory simple and lets a coding agent write its own search programs. During indexing, a vision-language model turns each minute of video into a single JSON record containing a dense caption and structured fields such as events, entities, places, and speech transcripts. At query time, the agent writes Python or Bash programs in a sandboxed container to filter, link, and read these records over multiple steps, without task-specific training or raw video access. On four ultra-long video benchmarks, VideoJSON with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash outperforms MAGIC-Video by 7.0, 20.0, and 24.75 points on EgoLifeQA, Ego-R1-Bench, and MM-Lifelong Week, and beats the best prior EgoMemReason score by 12.6 points. Across four policy models of increasing capability, VideoJSON's average score rises by up to 11.58 points over the weakest model, compared with at most 5.50 points for MAGIC-Video. Ablations show that both agentic code search and the structured JSON records drive these gains, while adding hourly summaries, extra tools, or video access changes the average score by less than 1.5 points. In addition, fine-tuning Qwen-3.5-Flash on 64 VideoJSON trajectories from an unrelated 100-hour livestream improves its MM-Lifelong scores by up to 8.25 points. Code will be open-sourced after publication.

AI.tldr: VideoJSON：将超长视频每分钟压缩为一条含密集描述与结构化字段的JSON记录，让编码智能体在沙箱中自写Python/Bash检索程序，在四个超长视频基准上显著超越MAGIC-Video等方法。
AI.motivation: 跨数天/数周视频的问答需要检索分散于长时序中的线索。现有视频智能体依赖复杂记忆图和固定检索流程，限制了智能体的搜索方式自由度与可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出极简harness：索引阶段用VLM把每分钟视频转成单条JSON记录（密集描述+events、entities、places、speech transcripts等结构化字段）；查询阶段智能体在沙箱容器中编写Python/Bash程序，多步过滤、链接、读取这些记录，无需任务特定训练，也无需访问原始视频。
AI.result: 在四个超长视频基准上，VideoJSON配合DeepSeek V4.1 Flash在EgoLifeQA、Ego-R1-Bench、MM-Lifelong Week上分别比MAGIC-Video高7.0、20.0、24.75分，比此前最佳EgoMemReason高12.6分。四个能力递增的策略模型上，平均分提升最多11.58分（MAGIC-Video最多5.50分）。消融显示智能体代码搜索与结构化JSON记录共同驱动增益，而增加小时级摘要、额外工具或视频访问的变动小于1.5分。用100小时无关直播的64条轨迹微调Qwen-3.5-Flash，MM-Lifelong最多提升8.25分。
AI.conclusion: 简单记忆+智能体自主编写代码检索是超长视频理解的有效范式；记忆结构与工具复杂度并非关键，结构化记录与代码式搜索是核心增益来源，且具备跨域可迁移性。

title: ENGRAM: Reliability-Weighted Latent Fusion and Occlusion-Aware Layered Readout for Video World Models
summary: Camera-conditioned video world models aim to generate 3D-consistent videos from a single image along specified camera trajectories. However, set-union updates in latent spatial memory leave repeated observations unconsolidated, while frontmost-only readout limits simultaneous access to stored evidence at different depths. To address these limitations, we present ENGRAM, a latent spatial memory framework combining reliability-weighted latent fusion and occlusion-aware layered readout. Specifically, recursive fusion integrates geometrically and visually compatible observations in a channel-normalized latent space, consolidating repeated evidence into a shared scene representation. Layered readout exposes multiple depth-ordered latent candidates with their reliability and availability at each target cell. This gives the generator access to information from multiple surfaces as visibility changes. Explicit camera rays provide viewpoint information independently of memory coverage, while geometric consistency constraints guide memory updates. Memory retrieval uses a single projection at latent resolution, avoiding intermediate RGB rendering and VAE re-encoding. We adapt a pretrained video generator using only 256 training scenes. On 100 RealEstate10K test scenes, ENGRAM improves novel-view-synthesis and closed-loop PSNRs over Spatia by 0.82 and 4.48 dB, respectively. On a 200-case WorldScore evaluation subset, it achieves an average score of 67.78, exceeding Spatia by 3.31 points. Project page: https://wchkoutian.github.io/engram-website/.

AI.tldr: ENGRAM提出可靠性加权潜空间融合与遮挡感知分层读取的潜空间记忆框架，提升相机条件视频世界模型的3D一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有相机条件视频世界模型的潜空间记忆存在两点缺陷：集合式并集更新使重复观测未被整合；仅读取最前层限制了同时访问不同深度的证据。
AI.method: 提出ENGRAM：在通道归一化潜空间中做递归融合，整合几何与视觉一致的观测为共享场景表示；分层读取在每个目标单元输出多个按深度排序的潜候选及其可靠性与可用性；显式相机射线提供与记忆覆盖无关的视角信息，几何一致性约束引导记忆更新；记忆检索在潜分辨率下单次投影完成，避免中间RGB渲染与VAE重编码；仅用256个训练场景适配预训练视频生成器。
AI.result: 在100个RealEstate10K测试场景上，新视角合成与闭环PSNR分别较Spatia提升0.82 dB和4.48 dB；在200例WorldScore评测子集上平均得分67.78，超Spatia 3.31分。
AI.conclusion: 通过融合式潜记忆与遮挡感知分层读取，可在极少训练数据下显著增强相机条件视频生成的3D一致性与多表面可见性处理能力。

title: SceneTether: Activity-Gated Value Anchoring for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Image Animation
summary: Long-horizon image animation must keep the scene fixed while natural material (e.g., water, smoke, or fire) continues to move. Autoregressive video generators read recent frames for temporal continuity, but this history also carries accumulated appearance errors, and sparsifying it disrupts motion. We introduce SceneTether, a training-free attention-read policy that keeps where attention reads recent memory but changes what appearance that memory returns. SceneTether keeps every key of the newest latent, blends its low-activity values toward co-located source-image values, and leaves high-activity values untouched so motion can evolve; an activity map estimated from the first generated latents and then frozen decides where to blend. It adds no denoising evaluations and leaves the cache-update rule unchanged. On a Causal Forcing++ generator, SceneTether raises source-support PSNR by 5.15 dB over its framewise Echo host across two seeds with 1.5x its late activity, and by 7.31 dB over spatial Echo-Forcing on a preselected four-minute subset. At equal recent-memory coverage, value anchoring alone adds 8.14 dB. A post-hoc pixel composite with the same map matches static fidelity but retains nearly twice the moving-region color drift, and viewers in a small blinded study preferred SceneTether for its natural scene and motion preservation. Project page: https://minar09.github.io/scenetether/

AI.tldr: SceneTether 是一种免训练的注意力读取策略：保持自回归生成器读取最近潜变量的键，但把低活跃区域的 value 向源图像同位值融合，从而在长时段动画中固定场景、保留自然运动。
AI.motivation: 长时段图像动画要求场景固定而水、烟、火等自然材质持续运动。自回归视频生成器依赖近期帧维持时间连续性，但历史中累积了外观误差，简单稀疏化历史又会破坏运动。
AI.method: 提出 SceneTether，一种免训练的 attention-read 策略：仅改变记忆返回的"外观"而保留注意力读取位置。保留最新潜变量的全部 key，将其低活跃度 value 向源图像同位 value 混合，高活跃度 value 保持不变以允许运动演化；混合位置由首个生成潜变量估计并冻结的活跃度图决定。不增加去噪评测次数，缓存更新规则不变。
AI.result: 在 Causal Forcing++ 生成器上，相比逐帧 Echo 基线，source-support PSNR 提升 5.15 dB（两个随机种子，后期活跃度为其 1.5 倍）；在预选四分钟子集上比 spatial Echo-Forcing 提升 7.31 dB；相同近期记忆覆盖下，仅 value 锚定即带来 8.14 dB 增益。同图后处理像素合成在静态保真度上相当，但运动区域颜色漂移近乎翻倍；小规模盲测中受试者更偏好 SceneTether 的场景与运动保真度。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在注意力读取端对 value 做锚定、而非稀疏化历史键，是抑制外观漂移同时保持自然运动的有效且无需训练的手段。

title: ReMiC: Representation-Driven Token Pruning for 3D VLMs via Minimax Hierarchical Clustering
summary: 3D vision-language models (3D VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in 3D scene understanding and spatial reasoning. However, their reliance on multi-view inputs produces long visual token sequences, imposing substantial computational overhead during inference. Existing pruning methods often rely on token salience or feature diversity as proxies for representativeness, without explicitly modeling the representation gap between the original token set and the retained subset, thereby leading to suboptimal representation of the original scene. In this paper, we propose ReMiC, a training-free, representation-driven token pruning framework based on minimax hierarchical clustering. ReMiC treats retained tokens as prototypes for the original observations, formulating pruning as minimizing the maximum representation error under a fixed token budget. Local prototype initialization allocates tokens according to regional representation needs, while global prototype refinement updates the selected prototypes using cross-region information to further reduce the maximum representation error. Extensive experiments conducted on three representative 3D VLMs across five 3D scene understanding benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of our method. Notably, by retaining only 10% of visual tokens, ReMiC preserves 93.2% of the performance of Video-3D LLM and achieves a $2.04\times$ faster inference speed.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、以表示误差为核心的ReMiC令牌剪枝框架，用最小最大化层次聚类将剪枝建模为在固定预算下最小化最大表示误差，仅保留10%视觉令牌即可保持93.2%性能并提速2.04倍。
AI.motivation: 3D视觉语言模型依赖多视角输入，产生超长视觉令牌序列，推理开销大；现有剪枝方法仅以令牌显著性（salience）或特征多样性作为代表性代理指标，未显式建模原始令牌集合与保留子集之间的表示差距，导致场景表示次优。
AI.method: ReMiC：将保留令牌视为原始观测的原型，把剪枝形式化为固定令牌预算下最小化最大表示误差的问题，基于minimax层次聚类求解；包含局部原型初始化（按区域表示需求分配令牌）与全局原型精炼（利用跨区域信息更新所选原型以进一步降低最大表示误差）。整体为训练无关（training-free）框架。
AI.result: 在三个代表性3D VLM与五个3D场景理解基准上实验，验证了方法的有效性与泛化性；在Video-3D LLM上仅保留10%视觉令牌即可保持93.2%性能，推理速度提升2.04倍。
AI.conclusion: 以显式表示误差（minimax聚类）替代显著性/多样性启发式，是3D VLM视觉令牌剪枝的有效且可泛化的免训练方案，显著降低多视角长序列的推理成本。

title: StateBind: Exposing the Symbol-to-State Binding Gap in Visual Measurement
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at MMM 2027. Code: https://github.com/mqingcs/StateBind
summary:
Reliable vision systems should connect numerical claims to visible evidence. In visual measurement, this requires mapping candidate values to image-specific physical states. StateBind-200 augments 200 real images with human-refined local geometry and matched Numeric, Calibrated, and Physicalized interfaces. Across a 128-image held-out evaluation and 6,696 controlled calls, physicalizing identical candidates raises three-model majority accuracy from 75.54% to 91.13%, a source-image-balanced gain of +15.30 points. Calibration and additional reasoning leave most of the gap intact; target localization can succeed despite incorrect value-lattice binding, with a larger burden for two-endpoint ruler spans. An independent 40-image geometry audit yields a 0.08-tick median target discrepancy and preserves the main effect under disagreement sensitivity.
  We further propose Factorial StateBind, a training-free selective verifier. Two VLMs propose target and lattice components, an independent VLM validates their evidence, and valid combinations are resolved deterministically. A precision mode selected on 69 development images combines component validity, four-way agreement, and state separation. Applied unchanged to held-out evaluation, this high-precision evidence gate reaches 91.67% candidate precision across 36/128 images (28.12%) and 9.68% of ordered cells. The results identify instance-specific symbol-to-state binding as a distinct reliability bottleneck and provide an interpretable evidence gate for numerical visual claims.

AI.tldr: 论文提出StateBind-200基准与Factorial StateBind验证器，指出"数值—物理状态绑定"是视觉测量可靠性的独立瓶颈，通过物理化候选值使三模型多数投票准确率从75.54%提升至91.13%，并以免训练证据门控实现91.67%的候选精度。
AI.motivation: 可靠视觉系统需将数值性断言与可见证据对应。现有视觉测量中，候选数值往往脱离图像特定物理状态（如刻度格、参考跨度），而这究竟是标定问题还是符号—状态绑定问题尚不明确，也缺乏可解释的验证机制。
AI.method: 构建StateBind-200数据集：200张真实图像，配有人工精修局部几何与对齐的Numeric、Calibrated、Physicalized三种接口；在128张留出图像、6,696次受控调用上做对照实验，并进行40张图像几何审计与分歧敏感性分析。同时提出Factorial StateBind：免训练选择性验证器，两个VLM分别提出目标与格点分量，独立VLM校验证据，有效组合确定性求解；精度模式在69张开发图像上选定，融合分量有效性、四向一致性与状态分离。
AI.result: 物理化相同候选值将三模型多数准确率由75.54%提至91.13%（源图像均衡增益+15.30点）；标定与额外推理未能弥合大部分差距；目标定位可在数值—格点绑定错误时成功，双端点尺跨度负担更大。几何审计中位目标偏差0.08 tick。验证器在留出集上覆盖36/128图像（28.12%）、9.68%有序单元，候选精度91.67%。
AI.conclusion: 实例特定的符号—状态绑定构成独立于标定与推理的可靠性瓶颈；Factorial StateBind提供了免训练、可解释的高精度证据门控，为数值性视觉断言提供可信验证路径。

title: Benchmarking Foundation Models for Bone Scaffold Pore Detection: A Comparative Analysis of Few-Shot Performance
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the Australasian Data Science and Machine Learning Conference (AusDM 2026)
summary: Evaluating the mechanical properties of bone scaffolds conventionally requires destructive testing or costly Finite Element Analysis, while deep learning alternatives are constrained by the scarcity of labeled biomaterial imaging data. This study introduces the first expert-annotated, pixel-dense dataset of biopolymer bone-scaffold SEM images, spanning five magnification series, and uses it to benchmark two state-of-the-art pre-trained foundation models under a 12-shot fine-tuning regime.
