SAM3, an instance segmenter, and YOLOv26, a bounding-box detector, feed the predicted pore geometry to regression heads that estimate Young's modulus and compressive yield strength. Our central finding is that both models fail by pore density rather than magnification: YOLOv26's predicted pore counts saturate and porosity estimation collapses on the most crowded frames, whereas SAM3 over-fragments sparse pore fields and merges adjacent pores in dense ones, producing eight catastrophic failures against three for YOLOv26. Averaged across the 44-image evaluation set, YOLOv26 achieves lower porosity error (19.9% vs. 23.1% MAE), higher precision, and a higher F1 score, whereas SAM3 offers pixel-level instance segmentation that YOLOv26's bounding boxes cannot reproduce. We conclude that model selection should be driven by pore density rather than SEM magnification alone.

AI.tldr: 该文构建首个专家标注、像素级密集标注的5个倍率系列生物聚合物骨支架SEM图像数据集，并在12-shot微调下基准测试SAM3（实例分割）与YOLOv26（框检测）两种基础模型，将预测孔几何送入回归头估计杨氏模量与压缩屈服强度。核心发现：模型失效由孔隙密度而非放大倍率驱动。
AI.motivation: 骨支架力学性能评估传统上依赖破坏性试验或昂贵有限元分析；深度学习替代方案受限于带标注生物材料影像数据的稀缺。因此需要一个像素级密集标注的SEM数据集，并厘清预训练基础模型在该任务上的适用边界。
AI.method: 构建首个专家标注、像素级密集的骨支架SEM数据集（覆盖5个倍率系列）；在12-shot微调范式下评测SAM3（实例分割器）与YOLOv26（边界框检测器）；将预测的孔隙几何特征输入回归头，估计杨氏模量与压缩屈服强度；在44张图像的评估集上比较孔隙率误差、精确率、F1及灾难性失效次数。
AI.result: 两模型均因孔隙密度而非放大倍率失效：YOLOv26在最密集帧上孔数预测饱和、孔隙率估计崩溃；SAM3对稀疏孔场过度碎片化、对密集孔场合并相邻孔，产生8次灾难性失效（YOLOv26为3次）。平均而言，YOLOv26孔隙率MAE更低（19.9% vs. 23.1%）、精确率与F1更高；SAM3则提供YOLOv26边界框无法复现的像素级实例分割。
AI.conclusion: 模型选择应依据孔隙密度而非仅凭SEM放大倍率；检测器在孔隙率定量上更稳健，分割器在需要像素级形态信息时更合适。

title: VideoGym: An Adaptive RL Environment for Long-Video Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) trains video agents to locate sparse evidence for long-video question answering through structured memory retrieval and temporal re-observation. This training, however, faces a long-tail modality distribution in the data. In our source pool, text-heavy questions account for 58% of samples, compared with 15% graph-heavy, 17% visual-heavy, and 10% time-range questions. Fixed-distribution RL therefore allocates fewer rollouts to underperforming question types. Reweighting these types could increase their sampling frequency but repeatedly reuses the same finite banks of original questions. To solve this problem, we introduce VideoGym, a curriculum-based RL environment that jointly constructs video-grounded training tasks and allocates rollouts among them. Within the environment, a memory-augmented VideoAgent is trained to coordinate retrieval from text, graph, and visual memories with temporal re-observation. Across episodes, VideoGym adapts VideoAgent's training distribution online: it casts per-period sample selection as an adversarial bandit over (modality, mode) arms and applies the EXP3 update to shift sampling toward arms with low answer accuracy. To supply the augmented-mode arms, a TaskGenerator-Verifier pipeline produces harder variants of existing questions that remain answerable within the same video. Across five long-video benchmarks, VideoGym lifts RL accuracy from 60.4% to 64.8% on average and by up to 10.5 pp on underrepresented graph-heavy questions with 3.3x sample efficiency. Together, these results show that task expansion and adaptive allocation can improve video agent learning from limited, imbalanced training data.

AI.tldr: VideoGym 提出一种课程式强化学习环境，联合构造视频任务并在线分配 rollout，用 EXP3 对抗赌博机机制与 TaskGenerator-Verifier 管线缓解长尾模态分布问题，在五个长视频基准上平均准确率 60.4%→64.8%。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答的 RL 训练数据存在长尾模态分布（文本类 58%，图类 15%、视觉类 17%、时间区间类 10%），固定分布采样使表现差的题型获得较少 rollout；简单重加权又会反复复用有限的原始题目储备。
AI.method: 构建 VideoGym 课程式 RL 环境：训练记忆增强的 VideoAgent 协同文本/图/视觉记忆检索与时间再观察；将分段样本选择建模为 (modality, mode) 臂上的对抗赌博机并用 EXP3 更新向低准确率臂倾斜；由 TaskGenerator-Verifier 管线生成同视频内可答的更难变体以供给增强模态臂。
AI.result: 在五个长视频基准上平均 RL 准确率由 60.4% 提升至 64.8%，欠表示的图类问题上最高提升 10.5 个百分点，样本效率提升 3.3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 任务扩展与自适应分配相结合，可在有限且不均衡的训练数据条件下改进视频智能体的学习效果。

title: Causal Dioramas: Controllable Video Generation, Revision and Editing via Intervention
summary: Two centuries ago, an early cinema-like theater called the Diorama could already control its scenes at will. Today's video generation models produce videos of near-cinematic quality, yet they still lack this controllability. This limitation stems from the inherent semantic gap between text and pixels, since a prompt can describe a video only coarsely and leaves its details and relations beyond control. We bring this ability to video generation with Causal Dioramas, modules that decompose a video into a concept graph of variables that can be intervened on individually. Each instruction is translated into an intervention on the concept graph, modifying the specified concepts and their dependents. A connector then conveys this intervention to the video generator, which reuses the original noise to produce a counterfactual video while preserving all other content. Building on Causal Dioramas, we develop a unified framework for controllable generation, counterfactual revision of generated videos and editing of real videos. We outperform both open-source and commercial models in controllability on T2V-CompBench, CoVEBench and OpenVE-Bench.

AI.tldr: 提出 Causal Dioramas：将视频分解为可单独干预的概念图变量，把指令翻译为概念图干预并经连接器传递给生成器，复用原始噪声产出反事实视频，统一实现可控生成、生成视频反事实修正与真实视频编辑。
AI.motivation: 当前视频生成模型画质接近电影级，但缺乏类似两百年前 Diorama 剧场那种"随意控制场景"的能力。根源在于文本与像素之间的语义鸿沟：提示词只能粗略描述视频，细节与元素间关系无法控制。
AI.method: 1) 将视频分解为概念图（concept graph），图中变量可被单独干预；2) 每条指令被翻译为对概念图的干预，修改指定概念及其依赖变量；3) 由 connector 将该干预传递给视频生成器；4) 生成器复用原始噪声，生成反事实视频并保持其余内容不变。
AI.result: 在 T2V-CompBench、CoVEBench 和 OpenVE-Bench 三个基准上，可控性优于开源与商业模型。
AI.conclusion: 基于 Causal Dioramas 构建了统一框架，同时支持可控视频生成、已生成视频的反事实修正以及真实视频编辑，验证了概念图干预范式的通用性与优越性。

title: Teacher-Guided Multimodal Dual Representation Reconstruction for Egocentric Human Activity Recognition
summary: Multimodal Egocentric Human Activity Recognition (Ego-HAR) leverages complementary cues from first-person vision (V) and inertial sensor data (S) to recognize daily activities, where video mainly captures appearance and object-related context while inertial signals capture motion cues that video may miss. However, existing pre-training methods typically supervise the fused representation with a single joint objective, which may underemphasize the complementarity between the two modalities and limit the model's ability to learn from distinct modality-oriented signals. To address this issue, we propose Multimodal Dual Representation Reconstruction (MDR2), a teacher-guided pre-training framework in which frozen, label-informed video and inertial teachers each provide dense, modality-specific targets to a multimodal student trained on temporally sparse inputs. On the EvIs-Kitchen dataset, MDR2 improves noun/verb F1-macro over the supervised M-Baseline by 9.20/6.17 points at K=4 video key frames and by 1.21/1.82 points at K=32. These results show that MDR2 consistently achieves higher mean recognition performance across the evaluated video-observation settings under the unified backbone setting, with more pronounced gains under sparse inputs.

AI.tldr: 提出教师引导的多模态双重表征重建预训练框架MDR2，用冻结的视频与惯性教师分别提供模态特有稠密目标，缓解单一联合目标对模态互补性强调不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有Ego-HAR预训练方法通常用单一联合目标监督融合表征，可能低估视觉与惯性模态间的互补性，限制模型从模态特有信号中学习。
AI.method: 视觉（V）与惯性（S）两个冻结且带标签信息的教师模型，分别向在多模态时间稀疏输入上训练的学生模型提供稠密的模态专属重建目标，形成双表征重建的教师引导预训练。
AI.result: 在EvIs-Kitchen数据集上，K=4关键帧时名词/动词F1-macro较监督M-Baseline提升9.20/6.17个点；K=32时提升1.21/1.82个点。
AI.conclusion: 在统一骨干设置下，MDR2在各视频观测设置中均取得更高的平均识别性能，且在稀疏输入下增益更显著，验证了模态专属教师目标对互补性建模的有效性。

title: Every IVUS Frame in Its Place: A Zero-Install Browser Tool for Registering Intravascular Ultrasound to the Coronary Angiogram, and a Path to Angiography-Only Plaque Imaging
comment: 19 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables. Live tool with one-click demo: https://menonpg.github.io/ivus-xa-registration/?demo
summary: Intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) shows plaque composition, calcium and stent apposition that the coronary angiogram cannot, but relating each IVUS cross-section to its position on the angiogram is still largely done in the operator's head. Commercial co-registration is tied to vendor consoles and to set-up at acquisition, so archived angiograms and pullbacks cannot be co-registered, and paired data for training AI models remain scarce. We present a semi-automatic registration tool that runs entirely in a web browser, with no installation and no upload. The clinician picks a contrast-filled reference frame (aided by automatic contrast and cardiac-phase analysis), selects or traces the vessel centerline (aided by Frangi vesselness and minimal paths), and pins the pullback ends and visible landmarks; a monotone piecewise-linear map then places every IVUS frame on the vessel, and each case exports as a frame-level training record. The original Python analysis runs unchanged in WebAssembly and videos are decoded frame-accurately with WebCodecs. On 6 angiographic runs the in-browser analysis was bit-identical to the server pipeline on identical frames; browser decoding differed by at most 2 grey levels, suggested reference frames agreed in all runs and the default automatic centerline in 4 of 6. A 546-frame pullback decoded in 5.3 s. On 36 phantoms with known ground truth, the clinician-guided trace stayed inside the lumen along 87-99% of the vessel, whereas the fully automatic centerline fell from 83% to 0% as noise rose and contrast fell. In a registered Left Main case, one side-branch landmark moved mid-pullback positions by 17.5% of the segment. We map where AI can enter each step, up to predicting a virtual IVUS from the angiogram alone, and make the tool freely available online with a one-click demo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个完全在浏览器中运行、无需安装与上传的半自动IVUS–造影配准工具，临床医生选取参考帧、中心线与标志点后，用单调分段线性映射把每一帧IVUS定位到血管上，并将每例导出为帧级训练记录。
AI.motivation: IVUS可显示斑块成分、钙化与支架贴壁等造影无法呈现的信息，但将每个IVUS横断面与造影上的位置对应目前多靠术者心算；商用配准方案绑定厂商主机且需在采集时完成设置，导致存档造影与回撤数据无法配准，AI训练所需的配对数据稀缺。
AI.method: 纯浏览器端半自动配准：自动对比度与心动周期分析辅助选取造影参考帧；Frangi血管增强与最小路径辅助选取/描绘血管中心线；由术者固定回撤两端及可见标志点；以单调分段线性映射将全部IVUS帧安置于血管上，每例导出帧级训练记录。原Python分析经WebAssembly原样运行，视频用WebCodecs逐帧精确解码。
AI.result: 6例造影上浏览器分析结果与服务器流程逐位一致；浏览器解码灰度差异最多2级；建议参考帧在全部6例中一致，默认自动中心线在4/6例中一致；546帧回撤解码耗时5.3 s。36个已知真值的体模中，临床引导描迹在87–99%血管长度内保持于管腔内，而全自动中心线随噪声升高、对比度下降由83%跌至0%。一例左主干配准中，单个分支标志点使回撤中段位置偏移达该段的17.5%。
AI.conclusion: 该工具实现了无需安装、无需上传的浏览器内半自动配准，规避了厂商绑定与采集时设置的限制，使存档数据可被利用，并批量产出帧级配对记录；论文还梳理了AI可介入各步骤的位置（直至仅由造影预测虚拟IVUS），工具已在线免费开放并提供一键演示。

title: ReSUL: Learning Regional Sensor Utility for Robust Multisensor Semantic Segmentation
summary: A corrupted sensor observation is not necessarily useless: misalignment can place informative scene structure at the wrong location. Robust multisensor segmentation must determine where to retain this evidence, where to exclude it, and where repair can recover its value. We introduce Regional Sensor Utility Learning (ReSUL), which learns these choices through their effect on segmentation risk. ReSUL compares full-sensor predictions, sensor-exclusion paths, and a re-registration path for displaced thermal inputs. A router predicts each path's signed reduction in category-balanced Brier risk relative to a fixed reference, then uses these estimates to allocate spatial mixture weights. This supervision connects spatial allocation to measurable task benefit without requiring fault labels at inference. MFNet experiments compare project-trained models under eleven clean and disturbed input conditions. ReSUL ranks first in 10 of 11 conditions in both ImageNet-1k and ImageNet-22k comparisons. Under severe thermal displacement, it reaches 54.58% and 55.63% mIoU, exceeding the strongest competing method in each group by 7.19 and 5.63 percentage points. Fixed-bank MFNet ablations show that utility supervision improves all eleven condition means over task-only routing. These results support learning how to use disturbed observations through their regional prediction benefit. Code is available at https://github.com/D-ST-Sword/ReSUL.

AI.tldr: 提出Regional Sensor Utility Learning (ReSUL)，通过估计各处理路径对分割风险的符号化降低来学习区域传感器效用，从而在保留、排除与重配准受损热红外输入之间进行空间自适应加权。
AI.motivation: 受损（如错位）传感器观测并非无用，错位可能把有信息量的场景结构放到了错误位置。鲁棒多传感器分割需判断何处保留该证据、何处排除、何处通过修复恢复其价值。
AI.method: ReSUL比较全传感器预测、传感器排除路径，以及针对位移热输入的再配准路径；路由器预测每条路径相对固定参考在类别平衡Brier风险上的符号化下降，并据此分配空间混合权重。该监督将空间分配与可测量的任务收益直接关联，推理时无需故障标签。
AI.result: MFNet上11种干净与受扰条件中，ReSUL在ImageNet-1k与ImageNet-22k两组比较中均于10/11条件排名第一；严重热位移下mIoU达54.58%与55.63%，分别超出各组最强对比方法7.19与5.63个百分点。固定bank消融显示效用监督在全部11个条件均值上优于仅任务型路由。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，应以区域预测收益为依据学习如何使用受损观测，而非简单地信任或丢弃传感器。

title: DynFlux: Learning to Dynamically Balance Consensus and Conflict in Multimodal Emotion Recognition
summary: Multimodal emotion recognition remains challenging due to the intrinsic heterogeneity of different modalities. Effectively leveraging both cross-modal consensus (consistency) and conflict (inconsistency) is essential, as they jointly provide complementary cues that enhance emotion understanding from diverse perspectives. Traditional multimodal methods often suffer from semantic ambiguity and rarely explicitly model the interplay between cross-modal consensus and conflict. Moreover, existing approaches struggle to capture and exploit the dynamic interactions between these two complementary factors. To overcome these limitations, we propose DynFlux, a model guided by a temporal heterogeneous graph that encodes both consensus and conflict relationships across modalities. DynFlux introduces a dedicated graph branch that explicitly captures cross-modal dependencies through sparse temporal graphs, and modulates the conventional multimodal emotion recognition pipeline at three hierarchical stages: adaptive feature modulation during feature extraction, guided aggregation modulation during feature integration, and fusion strategy modulation at the multimodal fusion stage. Through this design, DynFlux dynamically balances cross-modal consensus and conflict, enabling richer and more robust emotion understanding. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets confirm that DynFlux consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, and its generality is further validated on multimodal intent recognition and multimodal sarcasm detection tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出DynFlux模型，用时间异构图显式建模跨模态共识与冲突，并在三个层级调制多模态情感识别流程，在基准数据集上优于SOTA，并可泛化到多模态意图识别与讽刺检测。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感识别受模态异质性困扰；跨模态共识（一致性）与冲突（不一致性）共同提供互补线索，但传统方法存在语义歧义、很少显式建模二者交互，且难以捕捉其动态关系。
AI.method: DynFlux以时间异构图为核心，引入专门的图分支，通过稀疏时间图显式捕捉跨模态依赖；在三层级调制常规流程：特征提取阶段的自适应特征调制、特征整合阶段的引导聚合调制、多模态融合阶段的融合策略调制，从而动态平衡共识与冲突。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明DynFlux持续优于现有SOTA方法；其泛化性在多模态意图识别和多模态讽刺检测任务上得到进一步验证。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并动态平衡跨模态共识与冲突能带来更丰富、更鲁棒的情感理解，且该框架具备跨任务的通用性。

title: CoopOcc: Cooperative 3D Semantic Occupancy Perception via Multi-Agent and Cross-Modal Fusion
summary: Semantic occupancy perception has emerged as a promising paradigm for jointly modeling 3D scene geometry and semantic information. However, this unified representation cannot compensate for missing information caused by occlusion and sensor coverage. Multi-agent cooperation alleviates this limitation, but information from different agents is not equally useful across spatial regions. Meanwhile, feature representations from each agent form the basis of reliable multi-agent fusion. Cross?modal fusion constructs such representations by integrating complementary semantic and geometric information. Despite this complementarity, jointly establishing reliable 3D correspondence across agents and preserving modality-specific structures remains challenging. To address these limitations, we propose CoopOcc, which performs cooperative 3D semantic occupancy perception through multi-agent and cross-modal fusion. CoopOcc uses ego?query cross-agent attention (EQCA) to selectively aggregate aligned features across agents, and anchor-based bidirectional feature interaction (ABFI) for cross-modal exchange at matched coordinates. We further construct SemanticVVSim, a simulation dataset, and establish a unified benchmark. For simulation-to-real transfer, we propose confidence-aware hierarchical occupancy and relational distillation (CHORD). CoopOcc performs best overall among ten evaluated methods on SemanticVVSim. On Occ3D-nuScenes, CHORD improves performance using knowledge from SemanticVVSim. The code is available at https://github.com/LOTEAT/CoopOcc.

AI.tldr: 提出CoopOcc，通过多智能体与跨模态融合实现协同3D语义占据感知；并构建仿真数据集SemanticVVSim与统一基准，提出CHORD蒸馏方法支持仿真到真实迁移。
AI.motivation: 语义占据感知统一建模3D几何与语义，但遮挡与传感器覆盖导致信息缺失；多智能体协同可缓解该问题，然而不同智能体信息在空间各区域的有用性不均，且跨模态融合中如何跨智能体建立可靠3D对应并保留模态特有结构仍具挑战。
AI.method: CoopOcc包含两个核心模块：ego-query cross-agent attention (EQCA)，用于选择性聚合跨智能体的对齐特征；anchor-based bidirectional feature interaction (ABFI)，在匹配坐标处进行跨模态双向交互。此外构建仿真数据集SemanticVVSim并建立统一基准；针对仿真到真实迁移，提出confidence-aware hierarchical occupancy and relational distillation (CHORD)。
AI.result: 在SemanticVVSim上，CoopOcc在十个对比方法中综合表现最优；在Occ3D-nuScenes上，CHORD利用SemanticVVSim知识提升了性能。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体与跨模态融合结合可有效提升3D语义占据感知；配套仿真数据集、基准与蒸馏方法为仿真到真实迁移提供可行路径。

title: Adversarial Attacks Expose Path-Dependent Failures in Discrete Medical Image Tokenizers
comment: 21 pages, 9 figures, 18 tables. Accepted at the GenAI4Health Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026, Sydney
summary: Discrete image tokenizers convert medical images into token sequences that downstream models either decode into an image for a classifier (the reconstruction path), classify directly (the token path), or feed to a generative multimodal model. We ask whether imperceptible input perturbations can break these systems through the tokenizer alone. We evaluate four tokenizers on three imaging modalities and extend the strongest attack to a deployed generative model. Our central finding is path-dependence: the same tokenizer fails in opposite ways depending on how its output is used. A supervised attack collapses diagnostic accuracy on the reconstruction path, with ROC AUC falling to $\leq 0.013$ at $ε=2/255$ on all four tokenizers, while sparing the token path. An unsupervised, label-free attack does the reverse; its damage concentrates in the multi-codebook tokenizers, worst in MedITok, whose token-path AUC falls from 0.919 to 0.239. The same label-free attack transfers to LLaVA-Med, a frozen medical vision-language model built on MedITok, making it report proliferative diabetic retinopathy in a healthy retina or call a malignant lesion benign, without access to the question, answer, or language-model gradients. Harm is driven by how far the attack moves the tokenizer's internal representation, not by how many tokens change: on the learned-codebook tokenizers, a control attack that changes nearly all tokens but moves the representation less leaves every path and answer intact. Domain-specific pretraining does not provide robustness: MedITok has the best clean accuracy yet is the most fragile, more so than UniTok, its general-domain counterpart. None of six candidate defenses repairs every failure mode, and several fail once the attacker optimizes against the defense directly. Medical tokenizer robustness must therefore be evaluated per downstream path, against an adaptive adversary.

AI.tldr: 医学图像离散分词器的脆弱性呈"路径依赖"：同一分词器在重建路径与token路径上的失效方式相反，监督攻击击垮前者、无监督攻击击垮后者，且无监督攻击可零知识迁移至LLaVA-Med做出错误诊断。
AI.motivation: 医学图像离散分词器（tokenizer）的输出可被下游以三种方式使用（解码重建后分类、直接对token分类、输入生成式多模态模型），但此前缺乏对"仅通过分词器即可否被不可感知扰动攻破"及攻击效应是否随下游路径不同的系统研究。
AI.method: 在三种成像模态上评估四种分词器；提出/施加两类攻击：有监督（利用标签）攻击与无监督、无标签攻击；将最强攻击迁移至基于MedITok的冻结医学视觉语言模型LLaVA-Med（无问题、答案与语言模型梯度访问）；并以"改变token数量但表示位移较小的对照攻击"检验危害机制；另评测六种候选防御及其自适应攻击下的表现。
AI.result: 有监督攻击在ε=2/255下使重建路径ROC AUC降至≤0.013（四种分词器均如此），但基本不损伤token路径；无监督攻击反之，其破坏集中于多码本分词器，MedITok最严重，token路径AUC由0.919降至0.239；该无监督攻击迁移至LLaVA-Med，使其在健康视网膜上报告增殖性糖尿病视网膜病变、将恶性病变判为良性。危害由分词器内部表示位移幅度决定而非token改变比例（近乎全token改变但表示位移小的对照攻击完全不损伤各路径）。MedITok干净精度最高却最脆弱，甚至劣于通用域UniTok。
AI.conclusion: 领域预训练不带来鲁棒性；六种候选防御均无法修复全部失效模式，且部分在自适应攻击下失效。医学分词器鲁棒性必须按下游路径分别、并针对自适应对手进行评估。

title: Center-Aware Ordinal Learning for Prostate Cancer Grading from Histopathology Images
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures. Accepted as an oral presentation at SPIE Medical Imaging 2027
summary: Prostate cancer grading from histopathology whole-slide images (WSIs) is complicated by the ordered nature of ISUP grades, class imbalance, and center-dependent variations in staining, tissue preparation, and scanning. Most weakly supervised methods treat grade groups as independent categories and may therefore learn representations that do not transfer reliably across institutions. We propose a center-aware ordinal learning framework that combines a pretrained pathology encoder with attention-based multiple instance learning. The framework uses an Earth Mover's Distance loss to account for ordinal errors, an ordinal supervised contrastive objective to align same-grade slides across centers while separating grades according to disease severity, and curriculum learning to reduce the dominance of benign cases. We evaluate the framework on approximately 9,100 biopsy WSIs from the two-center PANDA dataset. The proposed framework achieves an accuracy of 0.842 and a quadratic weighted kappa of 0.958 on the held-out test set. Its main benefit is observed in cross-center transfer: when a linear probe is trained on Karolinska representations and evaluated on Radboud, accuracy increases from 0.643 to 0.823 and quadratic weighted kappa from 0.899 to 0.930. Performance remains stable in the reverse direction. UMAP projections further show improved mixing between centers while preserving an ordinal grade trajectory. These results suggest that combining ordinal and center-aware objectives produces more transferable slide representations for multi-center prostate cancer grading.

AI.tldr: 提出中心感知的有序学习框架（病理预训练编码器+注意力MIL，EMD损失、有序监督对比、课程学习），在PANDA约9,100张活检WSI上达准确率0.842、QWK 0.958，跨中心迁移显著提升。
AI.motivation: 前列腺癌ISUP分级具有有序性，且存在类别不平衡与中心间染色、制片、扫描差异；多数弱监督方法把分级组当作独立类别，学到的表征难以跨机构可靠迁移。
AI.method: 以预训练病理编码器结合基于注意力的多实例学习（弱监督）；采用Earth Mover's Distance损失建模有序误差，引入有序监督对比目标使同级别切片跨中心对齐、按疾病严重程度分离不同级别，并用课程学习降低良性病例的主导影响。在PANDA双中心数据集约9,100张活检WSI上评估。
AI.result: 留出测试集准确率0.842、二次加权kappa 0.958；跨中心迁移受益最明显：Karolinska表征上训练线性探针并在Radboud评估，准确率由0.643升至0.823，QWK由0.899升至0.930；反向迁移性能稳定；UMAP显示中心间混合改善且保留有序分级轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 联合有序目标与中心感知目标可产生更具可迁移性的切片表征，适用于多中心前列腺癌分级。

title: BReD: BEV Residual Diffusion for Feed-Forward Road Gaussian Reconstruction
summary: Accurate road surface reconstruction is essential for autonomous-driving mapping and simulation, but existing methods trade reconstruction quality for cross-scene inference. Optimization-based methods recover detailed surfaces through costly per-scene optimization, while feed-forward methods lack road-specific constraints and often produce large elevation errors. We propose \textbf{BReD}, a feed-forward framework for reconstructing road elevation, appearance, and semantics from calibrated six-camera sequences. BReD first estimates coarse elevation through LiDAR-supervised depth learning and BEV lifting, using only cameras at inference. A lightweight BEV residual diffusion model then conditions elevation refinement on a camera-derived depth--elevation discrepancy and elevation-aware image features. Diffusion-indexed perturbations expose the model to different discrepancy corruption levels during training, while inference performs one deterministic refinement from the clean discrepancy. The refined elevations are temporally aggregated to anchor road-aligned Gaussians, whose attributes are predicted by a geometry-prior-guided decoder without test-time optimization. On four held-out nuScenes scenes, BReD achieves 7.34 cm elevation RMSE and 90.92\% semantic mIoU, compared with 14.43 cm for RoGS without test-time LiDAR and 8.88 cm for its test-time-LiDAR-assisted variant; both RoGS variants require per-scene optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出前馈框架BReD，仅用六相机序列即可重建道路高程、外观与语义，在nuScenes四个留出场景上达到7.34 cm高程RMSE与90.92%语义mIoU，无需测试时优化。
AI.motivation: 道路表面精确重建对自动驾驶建图与仿真至关重要，但现有方法难以兼顾质量与跨场景推理效率：基于优化的方法需逐场景昂贵优化才能得到细节表面，前馈方法缺乏道路特定约束且高程误差大。
AI.method: 采用前馈式流水线：（1）通过LiDAR监督的深度学习与BEV提升获得粗高程，推理阶段仅用相机；（2）以轻量BEV残差扩散模型，基于相机导出的深度—高程差异与高程感知图像特征进行高程细化，训练中用扩散索引扰动模拟不同差异损坏程度，推理时从干净差异做一次确定性细化；（3）对细化高程做时序聚合，锚定道路对齐高斯，其属性由几何先验引导的解码器预测，无测试时优化。
AI.result: 在四个留出的nuScenes场景上，高程RMSE为7.34 cm、语义mIoU为90.92%；对比RoGS无测试时LiDAR的14.43 cm及其测试时LiDAR辅助变体的8.88 cm（两者均需逐场景优化）显著更优。
AI.conclusion: BReD以纯相机前馈推理实现了优于需逐场景优化方法的高程精度与语义质量，验证了扩散式高程细化与道路对齐高斯表示在跨场景道路重建中的有效性。

title: Don't Test Where You Trained: Geographic Overlap Inflates End-to-End Driving Scores
summary: In NAVSIMv1, the standard benchmark for end-to-end driving, $89.6\%$ of the test scenes lie within 4m of a training scene. We show that this geographic overlap inflates the reported scores. We propose a geographically disjoint split of NAVSIMv1 and an evaluation that compares models trained on either split on the same scenes, which neither has seen in training. All sensor-based models we test, DiffusionDrive, Latent TransFuser, and DrivoR, lose 3.4 to 6.1 PDMS points on these scenes, mainly by leaving the road and coming close to other objects, against 1.5 points for a baseline without sensors. The loss concentrates where a training drive of the original split passed the same place. At all other places, models trained on the original split are no better than those trained on the geographic split. Models trained on the original split predict road geometry that no camera can see. The gap persists when the auxiliary map loss is removed, so the models memorize locations even without being supervised to. On nuScenes, the geographic split cuts SparseDrive's mapping accuracy by $59\%$ and also degrades its planning. Driving scores on logged scenes thus partly measure how well a model remembers the test locations. We release the split to evaluate generalization to new places.

AI.tldr: 论文指出NAVSIMv1测试集中89.6%的场景距训练场景4m以内，地理重叠虚高了报告分数；作者提出地理不重叠的数据划分与同场景对比评估协议，发现所有基于传感器的模型掉3.4–6.1 PDMS点，主要源于驶离道路与近距离接近其它物体，而划分本身在无重叠区域并无优势，说明现有分数部分测的是位置记忆而非泛化。
AI.motivation: 端到端驾驶基准NAVSIMv1的测试场景与训练场景存在严重地理重叠（89.6%在4m内），使得报告的PDMS分数可能被"记住测试地点"所抬高，缺乏对驶向新地点的真实泛化能力的度量。作者希望量化这种地理泄漏的影响，并提供可信的泛化评估方式。
AI.method: 提出NAVSIMv1的地理不相交（geographically disjoint）划分；设计评估协议：将分别在原始划分与地理划分上训练的模型放到同一批两者均未见过的新场景上比较，控制场景变量；测试DiffusionDrive、Latent TransFuser、DrivoR等传感器模型及无传感器基线；进一步移除辅助地图损失以检验记忆是否依赖监督；在nuScenes上对SparseDrive做建图精度与规划的迁移验证。
AI.result: 原始划分训练的传感器模型在未见场景上损失3.4–6.1 PDMS点，无传感器基线仅损失1.5点；性能下降集中在原划分训练轨迹曾经过的地点，其他位置原始划分训练并不优于地理划分训练；模型能预测相机不可见的道路几何，且移除辅助地图损失后差距依然存在（无监督下的位置记忆）；nuScenes上地理划分使SparseDrive建图精度下降59%，规划亦退化。
AI.conclusion: 基于日志场景的驾驶分数部分衡量的是模型对测试地点的记忆而非泛化能力；地理泄漏是端到端驾驶基准中的系统性偏差。作者发布该地理划分以支持面向新地点的泛化评估。

title: DINO-KNN: Training-Free Multiclass In-Context Segmentation via Nearest Neighbors
summary: In-context segmentation (ICS) segments a target image given a few annotated reference images. Recent training-free methods built on frozen foundation models segment one class at a time and gain little from additional references. We study the multiclass, multi-reference setting and ask how far a simple joint decision rule can go. We introduce DINO-KNN, which stores every labeled reference patch of a frozen DINOv3 encoder in a single memory and labels each target patch by a distance-weighted vote of its k nearest neighbors. All classes are predicted in a single pass, with one label per pixel, without training or a mask decoder. We evaluate on eight datasets, four natural and four medical, with R=1 to 15 reference images and three reference seeds. DINO-KNN achieves the best average mIoU at every R; it is the best method on six of the eight datasets from R=3 and on seven of the eight from R=7. Its accuracy continues to grow with the number of references, from 37.8 mIoU at R=1 to 56.2 at R=15, while the strongest baseline, INSID3, rises from 36.1 to 42.9. DINO-KNN is also 2.1x faster than INSID3. The code will be made public.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 DINO-KNN：将冻结 DINOv3 编码器的所有已标注参考图块存入单一记忆库，对目标图块以 k 近邻距离加权投票一次性完成多类分割。
AI.motivation: 现有基于冻结基础模型的免训练 ICS 方法逐类分割，且增加参考图收益甚微；作者研究多类、多参考设置下简单联合决策规则能达到的上限。
AI.method: 冻结 DINOv3 提取 patch 特征，将所有带标签参考 patch 汇入一个共享记忆库；目标 patch 通过 k 近邻的距离加权投票获得唯一标签，单次前向即输出全部类别，无需训练与 mask decoder。
AI.result: 在 8 个数据集（4 自然、4 医学）、R=1~15、3 个参考种子下，各 R 均取得最高平均 mIoU；R≥3 时 6/8 数据集最优，R≥7 时 7/8 最优；mIoU 由 R=1 的 37.8 升至 R=15 的 56.2（最强基线 INSID3 仅 36.1→42.9），且速度快 2.1 倍。
AI.conclusion: 简单的联合 kNN 决策规则即可在免训练多类多参考 ICS 中显著超越逐类基线，并具备随参考数量持续增益与高效率的特性；代码将公开。

title: Med-Agentic: Distilling Agentic Medical Reasoning with Internalized Meta-Capabilities
summary: Large language models (LLMs) in expert domains face a trade-off between agentic tool use, which externalizes expertise behind brittle multi-turn runtimes, and end-to-end specialization, which internalizes expertise only implicitly at task-level granularity. We propose internalized meta-capabilities: atomic, parametrically internalized, and composable reasoning units that an LLM can select and combine within a single chain-of-thought (CoT). We instantiate this idea as Med-Agentic for medical visual diagnosis, where the model emits a capability-tagged structured CoT in one forward pass, turning capability invocation into tagged token generation rather than external tool calls. For training, Med-OPD performs multi-teacher on-policy distillation with token-level dual-factor teacher routing conditioned on both the image and the active capability tag, strictly generalizing per-prompt teacher routing. We show that this routing gives an unbiased estimator of the same expected teacher-KL gradient. Across public medical imaging datasets spanning nine anatomies and eight modalities, Med-Agentic consistently improves in-distribution and out-of-distribution diagnostic accuracy over the strong competitors.

AI.tldr: 提出"内化元能力"框架，将原子化专家能力参数化内化到单个CoT中，实例化为Med-Agentic（一次前向生成带能力标签的结构化推理链），并用Med-OPD多教师on-policy蒸馏（token级双因素路由）训练，在9类解剖、8种模态上稳定超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 专家领域LLM存在两难：agentic工具使用将专业能力外置为脆弱的多轮运行时；端到端专精化仅在任务粒度上隐式内化专家知识，缺乏可解释与可组合的推理单元。
AI.method: 定义内化元能力为原子、参数化内化、可组合的推理单元，模型在单条思维链内选择与组合。以医学视觉诊断实例化Med-Agentic：一次前向pass输出能力标签化的结构化CoT，将"调用工具"转为"生成标签token"。训练采用Med-OPD多教师on-policy蒸馏，教师路由同时以图像与当前能力标签为条件（token级双因素），严格推广per-prompt路由，并证明该路由是同一期望教师-KL梯度的无偏估计。
AI.result: 在覆盖九种解剖、八种模态的公开医学影像数据集上，Med-Agentic在分布内与分布外诊断准确率上均一致优于强竞争方法。
AI.conclusion: 以标签化CoT替代外部工具调用、以双因素路由的多教师蒸馏作为训练机制，可实现可组合专家能力的内化，兼顾单次推理的效率与跨域泛化性。

title: Dynamics-Guided Conditional MeanFlow from Regional Interaction to Internal Revision and Its Application to CT Imaging
summary: Conditional image enhancement requires spatially varying corrections, yet fixed-depth models allocate similar computational budgets regardless of where additional refinement is needed. Although one-step flow models reduce inference costs and iterative restoration methods introduce subsequent corrections, how predicted transformation dynamics can guide internal feature refinement remains underexplored. We introduce IRCMF, a dynamics-guided Conditional MeanFlow framework that combines regional interaction with recurrent internal revision. The decoder predicts signed interval velocity and a learned velocity-change cue. A soft-region graph aggregates contextual information for velocity estimation, while a dynamics-conditioned graph establishes regional relationships to guide recurrent bottleneck updates. The revised features are processed by the shared decoder to recompute velocity, establishing feedback between transformation dynamics and internal representations. An actor-critic policy controls regional updates and further revisions to balance enhancement quality and computational cost. We evaluate IRCMF on two computed tomography (CT) datasets, NLST for STANDARD-to-LUNG kernel enhancement and LDCT-and-Projection-data for simulated low-to-routine-dose enhancement. With nine decoder evaluations, IRCMF achieves slice-level PSNR of $36.24 \pm 3.49$ dB and SSIM of $0.97 \pm 0.01$ on NLST, and PSNR of $32.45 \pm 1.97$ dB and SSIM of $0.84 \pm 0.05$ on LDCT-and-Projection-data. The learned policy reduces average decoder evaluations to 4.42 and 3.45, respectively, lowering per-slice latency from 97.00 to 51.82 ms and from 97.12 to 41.95 ms, with PSNR reductions of only 0.20 and 0.06 dB.

AI.tldr: 提出IRCMF，一种由变换动力学引导的条件MeanFlow框架，通过软区域图与动力学条件图指导瓶颈特征的循环修订，并用actor-critic策略自适应控制区域更新与修订次数，在CT核增强与低剂量增强任务上以更少解码器评估实现高保真。
AI.motivation: 条件图像增强需要空间变化的校正，但固定深度模型对各区域分配相同计算预算，无法在真正需要细化的区域投入更多算力；同时，现有一步流模型虽降低推理成本、迭代复原方法虽引入后续校正，但如何利用预测的变换动力学指导内部特征细化仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: IRCMF由解码器预测有符号区间速度与可学习的速度变化线索；软区域图聚合上下文信息用于速度估计，动力学条件图建立区域间关系以引导瓶颈特征的循环更新；修订后的特征经共享解码器重新计算速度，形成变换动力学与内部表征之间的反馈；最后由actor-critic策略控制区域更新与进一步修订，以平衡增强质量与计算成本。
AI.result: 在NLST（STANDARD-to-LUNG核增强）与LDCT-and-Projection-data（模拟低剂量到常规剂量增强）上，九次解码器评估时NLST达PSNR 36.24±3.49 dB、SSIM 0.97±0.01，LDCT达PSNR 32.45±1.97 dB、SSIM 0.84±0.05；学习到的策略将平均解码器评估次数降至4.42与3.45，单层延迟由97.00降至51.82 ms、由97.12降至41.95 ms，PSNR仅下降0.20与0.06 dB。
AI.conclusion: 动力学引导的内部循环修订与自适应策略可在显著降低计算成本与延迟的同时保持增强质量，验证了以变换动力学指导特征细化的有效性。

title: Choose What Returns: Object-Aware KV Memory for Selective Recall in Interactive Video Generation
summary: Interactive long-video generation lets users build a story through successive prompts and reuse earlier characters and settings under new instructions. Existing memory methods retain past content, yet they often fail at precise selective recall, returning the wrong appearance of a person, mixing different people, or keeping an unrequested background. Based on our analysis of memory form and retrieval, we introduce an object-aware key--value (KV) memory framework for a frozen autoregressive diffusion generator. It keeps the original KV of tracked object regions, selects background KV outside them by attention-scores, and links each memory with a readable record of its source scene and observed appearance. An LLM selects the requested records, and a memory integrator supplies their KV for generation under the current prompt. We also introduce a six-scene evaluation that tests selective attribute modification, time-specific appearance recall, and multi-object composition, in which each person's requested past appearance changes across requests. Experiments show that our framework more reliably preserves each person's identity while reproducing their requested past appearance than existing memory methods, under both explicit scene references and natural-language cues.

AI.tldr: 提出面向冻结自回归扩散生成器的对象感知KV记忆框架，实现交互式长视频中精确的选择性回忆与人物复用。
AI.motivation: 交互式长视频生成需在新指令下复用既往人物与场景，但现有记忆方法难以做到精确选择性回忆，常出现人物外观错误、不同人物混淆或保留未请求背景的问题。
AI.method: 基于对记忆形式与检索的分析，构建对象感知的键值（KV）记忆：保留被跟踪对象区域的原始KV，对对象外背景按注意力分数选取KV，并为每条记忆关联可读的来源场景与观察外观记录；由LLM选择所需记录，再由记忆整合器在当前提示下提供其KV用于生成。
AI.result: 在自建的六场景评测（选择性属性修改、特定时间外观回忆、多对象组合，且各人物被请求的过往外观随请求变化）中，无论显式场景引用还是自然语言线索，本框架在保持人物身份与复现其被请求过往外观上均比现有记忆方法更可靠。
AI.conclusion: 对象级KV记忆结合LLM检索与整合，可有效解决长视频生成中的选择性回忆问题，提升身份一致性与外观可控性。

title: Vision-Language Truck Driving Advisories Grounded in Provincial Rules and Forecast Risks
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. This manuscript has been submitted to the 38th IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IV 2027)
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can generate context-aware driving advisories, but their outputs may conflict with road conditions or traffic rules, and they typically address a hazard only once it is visible. This matters for long-haul trucking, where heavy trucks need long stopping distances and a single trip may cross several jurisdictions with different traffic regulations. This paper proposes a data generation and distillation framework that integrates structured scene understanding, risk forecasting, and traffic-rule retrieval to generate truck driving decisions and natural-language advisories, with a consistency check on every record. The records, written by an 8B teacher, are then used to distill a 3B-parameter student model for onboard deployment. We also introduce a dashcam dataset covering four Canadian provinces, comprising 11,142 annotated lane-marking frames and 9,494 driving segments. On held-out driving data across all four provinces, the student passes the consistency check in 94.6% of the segments, against 20.2% for the untuned 8B teacher, and announces 26.2% of the risks in the next 10 to 30 seconds before they appear. Of the generated advisories, 97.7% conform to the provincial traffic rules and guidance. These findings suggest that the framework can produce rule-conforming training data for compact driving advisory models.

AI.tldr: 提出数据生成与蒸馏框架，结合场景理解、风险预测与交规检索生成卡车驾驶决策与自然语言提示并做一致性校验，用8B教师数据蒸馏3B学生模型上板部署，并发布加拿大四省行车记录仪数据集，学生一致性通过率达94.6%。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型生成的驾驶提示可能与路况或交规冲突，且通常只在危险可见后才响应；长途重卡制动距离长、单程跨多个法规辖区，需要更早的风险预警与合规提示。
AI.method: 构建数据生成与蒸馏框架：整合结构化场景理解、风险预测与交通规则检索，生成卡车驾驶决策与自然语言提示，并对每条记录做一致性校验；由8B教师模型生成记录，蒸馏至3B学生模型用于车载部署；同时构建覆盖加拿大四省的行车记录仪数据集（11,142帧车道线标注、9,494个驾驶片段）。
AI.result: 在四省留出驾驶数据上，学生模型一致性校验通过率94.6%（未调优8B教师为20.2%）；在风险出现前10–30秒提前播报26.2%的风险；生成提示中97.7%符合省级交通规则与指引。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可为紧凑型驾驶提示模型产出符合规则的训练数据，并支持车载部署。

title: Two Actions from One State: Fork Futures Teach JEPA World Models to Compare
summary: JEPA world models are trained to predict logged transitions but used to compare counterfactual actions from one state. The logged behavior data show one action per state, and under a local linear approximation we prove the action response is unidentified along any direction the policy never varies within a state. We therefore supplement behavior data with measured outcomes of alternative actions from the same state. Our fork futures execute two actions from one restored state, and their outcome difference cancels the state term, identifying the action response on the sampled span. The resulting model, Fork-JEPA, matches predicted to measured differences, anchors the logged successor with behavior prediction, and adds a lookback head that keeps the predecessor recoverable, all at training time, leaving planning unchanged. On three visual control tasks, behavior-only training leaves the predicted action effect no better than a constant guess. Fork-JEPA makes it readable and raises planning success by up to 14\% over LeWM, its base model. Where the action response changes across hidden zones, it nearly doubles cross-zone success, and 1,024 fork pairs beat 1.2M extra behavior steps. Our project is available at https://fork-jepa.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 指出JEPA世界模型用单动作日志训练却用于反事实动作比较时的可辨识性缺陷，提出用"分叉未来"补充同状态下替代动作的实测结果以识别动作响应，得到Fork-JEPA，在视觉控制任务上显著提升规划成功率。
AI.motivation: JEPA世界模型以日志转移数据训练，但在规划时需要从同一状态比较反事实动作。日志行为数据中每个状态只观测到一个动作，在局部线性近似下，作者证明：沿策略在同一状态内从未变化的方向，动作响应不可辨识，因此仅凭行为数据学到的动作效应可能形同常数猜测。
AI.method: 在行为数据之外补充"同状态替代动作"的实测结果：fork futures 从一个恢复的状态执行两个动作，其结局差抵消状态项，从而在采样张成的方向上识别动作响应。模型Fork-JEPA在训练时：(1)对齐预测差与实测差；(2)用行为预测锚定日志后继状态；(3)加入回看头保持前驱可恢复；规划阶段不做改动。
AI.result: 在三个视觉控制任务上，仅用行为数据训练时预测的动作效应不优于常数猜测；Fork-JEPA使其可读，规划成功率较基座LeWM最高提升14%；在动作响应随隐藏区域变化的场景下跨区域成功率近乎翻倍；1,024对分叉数据优于额外120万行为步。
AI.conclusion: 从可辨识性与因果识别视角揭示并修复了世界模型动作响应学习的数据缺陷；同状态双动作的差分测量是高效的数据增强方式，仅改变训练而不改规划接口，即可显著提升反事实规划性能。

title: Alignment under Hard Negative Re-Pairing: Cross-Modal Similarity, Scale and Retrieval
comment: 52 pages, including references and supplementary material
summary: Do vision and language models represent the world alike? That question hides three: what structure each modality has, whether the two modalities organize images and their captions alike, and whether a model ranks an image's own caption highly. Centered kernel alignment (CKA) and neighborhood agreement answer the second, yet matching and model selection use them as if they identified individual pairs and answered the third. To test this reading, we introduce hard negative re-pairing: every image receives the caption of a similar image, and nothing else changes. Although no image keeps its own caption and annotators judge a majority of the substituted captions wrong, CKA stays higher than under a random re-pairing that keeps 80% of the original pairs. In all 22 image-text models we test, neighborhood agreement loses far less than top-one retrieval, which collapses. The reason is scale: these diagnostics pool over many neighbors, matching and retrieval are decided among the nearest ones, and an exact decomposition shows that near-neighbor pairs contribute almost nothing to CKA. In the matching problems we test, an exact maximizer of CKA would not return the original pairing. On COCO and Flickr30k, the model with the highest diagnostic value retrieves worse on held-out data than the model chosen by validation recall, even where the two correlate positively. What re-pairing removes is the informative part: that share tracks retrieval on both datasets and ranks encoder pairs before alignment training. A diagnostic should be reported with its question and its scale, and tested against hard negative re-pairing.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示CKA与邻域一致性等视觉-语言表征诊断指标"尺度错配"问题：这些指标池化大量邻居，而匹配与检索只在最近邻间决策，故不能用于配对识别与模型选择。提出"硬负例重配对"检验，发现重配对后CKA仍高于保留80%原配对的随机重配对，且22个图像-文本模型中邻域一致性几乎不降而top-1检索崩塌；COCO/Flickr30k上诊断值最高的模型在留出数据上检索弱于按验证召回选择的模型。重配对所移除的"信息性部分"才与检索相关。
AI.motivation: 现有研究把CKA与邻域一致性当作能识别单个图文对、并能回答"模型是否给图像自身 caption 高排名"的指标，用于匹配与模型选择；但这类指标本质是池化统计量，其尺度与逐对匹配/最近邻检索的尺度不一致。作者希望检验这种解读是否成立，并厘清诊断指标究竟测的是什么。
AI.method: 提出硬负例重配对（hard negative re-pairing）：为每张图像分配一张相似图像的caption，其他条件不变（无图像保留自身caption，且多数替换caption被人评为错误）。对比随机重配对（保留80%原配对）。在22个图像-文本模型上比较CKA、邻域一致性与top-1检索的表现；给出CKA的精确分解以量化近邻对贡献；在匹配问题上检验CKA精确最大化是否返回原配对；在COCO与Flickr30k上用留出检索与验证召回做模型选择对比；并分析重配对"移除的信息性部分"与检索的相关性及在训练前的编码器配对排序能力。
AI.result: 硬负例重配对下CKA仍高于保留80%原配对的随机重配对；22个模型中邻域一致性下降远小于top-1检索（后者崩塌）。精确分解显示近邻对CKA贡献近乎为零。所测匹配问题中CKA的精确最大化不会返回原始配对。COCO与Flickr30k上，诊断值最高的模型在留出数据上检索劣于按验证召回选择的模型，即便二者正相关。重配对移除的"信息性部分"在两个数据集上均与检索相关，并能在对齐训练前对编码器对排序。
AI.conclusion: CKA与邻域一致性不能识别单个图像-文本对，也不能直接回答"是否给自己的caption高排名"，因此不宜作为匹配或模型选择的依据。诊断指标应与其所回答的问题及尺度一并报告，并用硬负例重配对进行检验。

title: Learning a Rule Bank to Revise 3D CT Reports with Independent Evidence
summary: Vision--language models can generate fluent radiology reports from 3D chest CT scans, yet they may still omit abnormalities or misstate findings. Independent image analysis using models separate from the report model provides additional observations, but acting on uncertain evidence may introduce new errors. We propose an agent system that learns a revision policy represented as an executable rule bank for each report model. Inspired by experience banks, the agent proposes and refines rules using revision outcomes across development cases. During inference, the retained rules guide local edits using independent classifier predictions and quantitative image measurements without retraining the report model. Unedited sentences are preserved, and each change is linked to the rule that triggered it. On CT-RATE, revision increases CE-F1 by 11.5 points for SelfCue-KD and 0.9 points for NV-Reason-CT, with gains across five draft-sampling seeds. SelfCue-KD's CT-FineBench score also increases by 15.2 points. Draft-only rule learning yields limited gains, while the two image-evidence sources provide complementary benefits for abnormality detection. Measurements also supply numerical details missing from the drafts. These results support learning model-specific rules to control how independent image evidence informs report revision. Code is available at https://github.com/renjie-liang/CT-RuleBank.

AI.tldr: 提出一种智能体系统，为每个报告模型学习以可执行规则库表示的修订策略，在不重训报告模型的前提下，用独立分类器预测与定量图像测量指导局部编辑，并保持未编辑句子不变、每处修改可追溯到触发规则。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型虽能从3D胸部CT生成流畅的放射报告，但仍会遗漏异常或错误表述发现。独立图像分析可提供额外观察，但直接依据不确定证据行动可能引入新错误，因此需要可控地决定独立图像证据如何影响报告修订。
AI.method: 借鉴经验库思想构建智能体：在开发集上依据修订结果提出并精炼规则，形成每个报告模型专属的可执行规则库；推理阶段用保留的规则结合独立分类器预测与定量图像测量，对报告进行局部编辑；不重训报告模型，未编辑句子原样保留，每处改动关联触发规则。
AI.result: 在CT-RATE上，修订使SelfCue-KD的CE-F1提升11.5分、NV-Reason-CT提升0.9分，且在五个草稿采样种子下均有增益；SelfCue-KD的CT-FineBench分数提升15.2分。仅基于草稿的规则学习增益有限，而两种图像证据来源在异常检测上互补，测量值还补充了草稿缺失的数值细节。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持学习模型特定规则来控制独立图像证据如何参与报告修订，从而在保留原文可控性的同时提升报告准确性。

title: Video-as-Weights: Compiling a Video Once into Parametric and Token Memory
summary:
Vision-language models (VLMs) represent videos as thousands of visual tokens, creating a large key-value cache whose memory grows with video length. At the same time, small VLMs that fit on limited hardware understand video far worse than large models. Existing compression methods shorten visual tokens into a brief prompt to save memory, yet the small model still processes them through fixed weights and cannot close this capability gap.
  To address both challenges, we introduce Video-as-Weights (VaW), which compiles a video once without seeing any question into the parametric and token memory of a frozen interpreter VLM. Specifically, a compiler VLM watches the video, and a single weight decoder jointly generates the interpreter's LoRA weights and optional prefix tokens from every compiler layer, enabling both same-model compilation and strong-to-weak transfer across model sizes and depths.
  Across six video QA benchmarks, a 0.8B interpreter beats full in-context reading by 1.7 points when compiled by itself and by 4.3 points with a 9B compiler, reducing context from up to 8,192 visual tokens to 64 prefix tokens while using 5.5x less memory than the video's key-value cache. Generated weights add 3.9 points over token compression alone, and all-layer decoding outperforms layer-wise generation by 2.9 points. Mechanistic analysis shows that with prefix tokens, the weights mainly alter attention queries and MLP down projections to guide retrieval and store a baseline summary, whereas without tokens, they shift to attention output projections to write video content directly into the residual stream.

AI.tldr: 提出 Video-as-Weights (VaW)：一次性将视频"编译"成冻结解释器 VLM 的 LoRA 权重与少量前缀 token，把视频上下文由数千视觉 token 压缩为 64 个前缀 token，小模型自编译超全上下文 1.7 分，9B 编译 0.8B 时提升 4.3 分。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型以数千视觉 token 表示视频，KV cache 内存随长度线性增长；而可部署于受限硬件的小模型视频理解能力远逊于大模型。现有 token 压缩方法把视觉内容压成简短提示，但小模型仍以固定权重处理，无法弥合能力差距。故需同时解决"内存"与"能力"两个问题。
AI.method: VaW 采用"编译—解释"架构：编译 VLM 观看视频且无需给定问题，单次前向将视频编译进参数与 token 记忆。一个统一的权重解码器联合生成解释器的 LoRA 权重与可选前缀 token，输入取自编译器的每一层输出；支持同模型自编译及跨规模、跨深度的强→弱迁移。解释器 VLM 保持冻结。
AI.result: 六个视频问答基准上：0.8B 解释器自编译较全上下文 in-context 阅读提升 1.7 分，由 9B 编译器编译时提升 4.3 分；上下文由最多 8,192 视觉 token 降至 64 前缀 token，内存较视频 KV cache 减少 5.5×。生成权重在纯 token 压缩基础上再增 3.9 分；全层解码优于逐层生成 2.9 分。机制分析显示：带前缀 token 时权重主要改变注意力 query 与 MLP down projection，用于引导检索并存储基线摘要；无 token 时权重转向注意力输出投影，将视频内容直接写入残差流。
AI.conclusion: VaW 将视频从"长上下文输入"重构为"模型参数记忆"，在显著降低内存与上下文长度的同时提升小模型视频 QA 性能，且强→弱编译可传递大模型能力；机制分析揭示前缀 token 与纯权重两种模式在写入位置上的功能分工，为高效的视频理解提供了新范式。

title: RecallWorld: Episodic Memory for Persistent Embodied Video World Models
summary: Video world models generate plausible novel views but often lack persistent memory, failing to preserve a place's geometry and appearance when an agent revisits a scene. A central challenge is how previous views should be effectively used for creating memory. Reconstructing them independently underutilizes geometric constraints between nearby views, while repeatedly reconstructing a growing history can propagate later prediction errors into earlier geometry. We introduce RecallWorld, a persistent embodied video world model that jointly reconstructs short multi-view episodes into Scenelets while keeping geometry independent across episodes. Starting from a single source image, camera-aware ray lifting places perspective and native fisheye images in a common world frame, retaining wide-field content for perspective generation. Each generated segment extends the Scenelet memory and conditions subsequent generation. Coverage-based retrieval selects complementary Scenelets from the full history, while target-view visibility is resolved geometrically before appearance fusion, providing consistent memory conditioning for guiding subsequent generation. Across four datasets, RecallWorld improves revisit PSNR over the strongest evaluated baseline by 2.6 dB on partial revisits and 3.9 dB on full cycles, demonstrating substantially stronger preservation of scene identity across exploration and return.

AI.tldr: RecallWorld：以"Scenelet"为单位的持久化具身视频世界模型，通过短多视图联合重建+跨episode几何独立，结合覆盖度检索与几何可见性解析实现一致的场景记忆。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型生成的新视角虽然合理，但缺乏持久记忆：智能体回到同一地点时无法保持几何与外观一致。核心问题是"如何有效利用历史视角构建记忆"——独立重建各视图忽略了邻近视图间的几何约束，而不断重建增长的完整历史又会把后期预测误差回传到早期几何中。
AI.method: 提出RecallWorld：(1) 将短的多视图episode联合重建为Scenelet，同时保持各episode间几何独立，避免误差跨段传播；(2) 从单张源图像出发，用相机感知的射线提升（ray lifting）把透视图像与原生鱼眼图像放入统一世界坐标系，保留宽视场内容用于透视生成；(3) 每生成一段即扩展Scenelet记忆并作为后续生成的条件；(4) 基于覆盖度（coverage）的检索从完整历史中选取互补的Scenelet；(5) 在appearance fusion之前先用几何方法解析目标视图可见性，为后续生成提供一致的记忆条件。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上，重访PSNR相比最强对比基线在部分重访场景提升2.6 dB、在完整循环场景提升3.9 dB，显著增强了探索与返回过程中场景身份（scene identity）的保持能力。
AI.conclusion: 以片段化Scenelet作为记忆单元的持久化世界模型，配合检索与几何可见性解析，可有效缓解视频世界模型的记忆缺失与误差累积问题，实现长程重访时的几何与外观一致性。

title: VUOD: A Versatile Unsupervised Outlier Detection Framework for Natural, Industrial, Medical Images and Beyond
summary: Unsupervised outlier detection that automatically identifies whether visual systems involve anomalous images is a significant research topic. However, most approaches are limited to natural images because they rely on frozen and pre-trained feature extractors. So that their performance cannot be maintained in practical scenarios, especially for industrial inspection and medical imaging. In this work, we first revisit this task and then introduce a versatile unsupervised outlier detection framework to enrich the application domains. The core idea of this framework is to improve feature discriminativess via exploiting intrinsic distribution priors. Evaluated on 3 domains and 14 benchmark datasets, our proposed solution achieves state-of-the-art performance and significantly outperforms existing methods. More importantly, we show its plug-and-play property that can be integrated into diverse visual applications to improve their robustness, such as image classification and 3D reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通用无监督离群点检测框架，通过利用内在分布先验提升特征判别性，摆脱对冻结预训练特征提取器的依赖，在3个领域14个基准上达到SOTA，并具备即插即用特性。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督离群点检测方法依赖冻结的预训练特征提取器，因而局限于自然图像，在工业检测、医学影像等实际场景中性能难以维持。作者因此重新审视该任务，希望构建可跨领域通用的检测框架。
AI.method: 提出一个通用的无监督离群点检测框架，核心思想是利用数据的内在分布先验来增强特征判别性（feature discriminativeness），而非单纯依赖预训练特征；框架被设计为即插即用模块，可嵌入多种视觉应用中。
AI.result: 在3个领域、14个基准数据集上评估，取得state-of-the-art性能，显著优于现有方法；同时验证了其即插即用特性，可提升图像分类、3D重建等视觉应用的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作拓宽了无监督离群点检测的适用领域，说明基于内在分布先验的特征增强是跨领域通用的有效途径，并可作为通用组件提升下游视觉系统的鲁棒性。

title: LoopSight: Looped Vision Transformers with Gated Prediction Memory
summary: Looped vision transformers extend computation for visual reasoning by repeatedly applying a shared Transformer core. A challenge is to preserve useful prediction information across loop iterations while allowing the computation state to evolve. In this paper we introduce LoopSight, a looped vision transformer that uses Gated Prediction Memory (GPM) to maintain a persistent prediction state for readout, separate from the core's evolving computation state. At each iteration, a cross-attention gate uses the core's candidate features, the previous prediction state, and the current task state to control writes at the patch and channel level. The model decodes its prediction from the updated memory. We condition the shared core on the current iteration using asymptotic loop encoding and train the model by supervising its prediction at loop counts sampled from a truncated Gaussian distribution. LoopSight outperforms LoopViT across three model scales on ARC-AGI-1 and ARC-AGI-2. On ARC-AGI-1, LoopSight-Small achieves 67.4% pass@2, a gain of 6.6 percentage points over LoopViT-Small with comparable parameter counts and FLOPs. LoopSight also outperforms LoopViT on Visual Sudoku and ImageNet classification. Further analyses on ARC-AGI-1 show that LoopSight preserves more already-correct predictions and maintains more stable readout features as its computation state continues to evolve. The code will be released at https://github.com/feufhd/LoopSight.

AI.tldr: LoopSight 通过在循环视觉Transformer中引入门控预测记忆（GPM），将用于读出的持久预测状态与核心演化计算状态解耦，在 ARC-AGI 等任务上显著优于 LoopViT。
AI.motivation: 循环视觉Transformer通过反复应用共享Transformer核心来扩展视觉推理计算量，但存在一个核心难题：如何在允许计算状态持续演化的同时，跨循环迭代保留有用的预测信息，避免已正确的预测被后续迭代破坏。
AI.method: 提出 LoopSight，使用门控预测记忆（GPM）维护独立于核心计算状态的持久预测状态用于读出。每次迭代中，交叉注意力门结合核心候选特征、上一轮预测状态与当前任务状态，在 patch 级和通道级控制写入，并从更新后的记忆解码预测；同时用渐近循环编码（asymptotic loop encoding）让共享核心感知当前迭代次数，训练时从截断高斯分布采样的循环次数上对预测进行监督。
AI.result: 在 ARC-AGI-1 和 ARC-AGI-2 上，LoopSight 在三种模型规模下均优于 LoopViT；ARC-AGI-1 上 LoopSight-Small 达到 67.4% pass@2，在参数量与 FLOPs 相当的情况下比 LoopViT-Small 提升 6.6 个百分点。在 Visual Sudoku 与 ImageNet 分类上同样优于 LoopViT。分析表明 LoopSight 能保留更多已正确预测，并在计算状态持续演化时维持更稳定的读出特征。
AI.conclusion: 将预测读出状态与循环计算状态解耦并配合门控写入，是提升循环视觉Transformer推理性能与稳定性的有效设计，代码将开源。

title: Simple Baselines for Fetal Brain Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Bioinformatics and Biomedicine (BIBM)
summary: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) offers a promising approach to fetal brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) analysis, where pathological data are scarce. Existing methods rely mainly on brain age prediction or image reconstruction, but are limited by noisy gestational age (GA) labels, lack of lesion localization, or poor cross-domain generalization. We propose FetalBUAD, a UAD framework based on voxel-level brain age estimation. A joint multi-task network predicts global brain age, voxel-level brain age maps, and brain segmentation to establish an internal biological brain age reference, reducing reliance on clinically recorded GA. Uncertainty-aware voxel-level brain age gap maps are then used for anomaly localization. Experiments on 1,317 internal fetal brain MRI volumes and an external benchmark demonstrate state-of-the-art anomaly detection performance and improved cross-domain generalization. FetalBUAD also generates anatomically interpretable maps that localize diverse fetal brain abnormalities. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/birthlab/FetalBUAD.

AI.tldr: 提出FetalBUAD，一种基于体素级脑龄估计的无监督胎儿脑MRI异常检测框架。
AI.motivation: 胎儿脑MRI病理数据稀缺，现有无监督异常检测(UAD)方法依赖脑龄预测或图像重建，受噪声大的孕龄(GA)标签、缺乏病灶定位、跨域泛化差等问题限制。
AI.method: 构建联合多任务网络，同时预测全局脑龄、体素级脑龄图和脑分割，从而建立内部生物学脑龄参考以降低对临床GA的依赖；再用不确定性感知的体素级脑龄差(age gap)图进行异常定位。
AI.result: 在1317例内部胎儿脑MRI体数据及一个外部基准上取得最优异常检测性能，并提升跨域泛化能力；可生成解剖学可解释的异常定位图。
AI.conclusion: FetalBUAD通过体素级脑龄估计实现无需GA标签的胎儿脑异常检测与定位，兼顾泛化性与可解释性，代码已开源。

title: Open Vision Banana: An Open Framework for Unified Visual Perception through Generation in RGB Space
summary: Vision Banana showed that a closed image generator, instruction-tuned to paint perception outputs as RGB images, becomes a generalist vision model. Does this carry over to \emph{open} generators, and if not, what fails? We answer with \textbf{Open Vision Banana (OVB)}, an open framework that adapts the 7B diffusion generator of Qwen-Image-2.1 into one instruction-driven model for metric depth, semantic, instance, and referring segmentation, using a single shared low-rank adapter and public data. Each task is a \emph{task contract} whose RGB encoder, instruction, and decoder share one specification and are checked before training. Studying 42 externally evaluated checkpoints from two 100k-update runs, six exact weight-space merges, and eight controlled shorter runs, we find that the gap to the closed system is specific and measurable. Geometry is learned early while absolute scale is not: median-aligned NYUv2 $δ_1$ stays at 0.89--0.93 throughout training as unaligned $δ_1$ wanders between 0.11 and 0.50. The scale is not committed by a single sample: a ten-seed ensemble lifts unaligned $δ_1$ from 0.348 to 0.516 without retraining. Depth and 2D segmentation compete for the shared adapter, and weight merging moves along this trade-off without escaping it. Finally, lower validation flow loss comes with lower Cityscapes accuracy (Spearman $ρ\approx-0.9$ between loss reduction and mIoU), so the loss cannot select checkpoints. We release code, contracts, training data, and all evaluation outputs.

AI.tldr: 将闭源生成器的"绘画式"通用视觉范式迁移到开源生成器，构建Open Vision Banana（OVB），并系统诊断其失败模式：几何可学但绝对尺度不收敛、深度与分割争用共享适配器、验证损失无法用于选模。
AI.motivation: Vision Banana已证明：把感知输出渲染为RGB图像的指令微调闭源图像生成器可成为通用视觉模型。作者要回答该结论能否迁移到开源生成器，若不能，具体失效环节是什么。
AI.method: 基于Qwen-Image-2.1的7B扩散生成器，用单一共享低秩适配器与公开数据，将度量深度、语义/实例/指代分割统一为一个指令驱动模型；每个任务以"任务契约"定义（RGB编码器、指令、解码器共享同一规范并在训练前校验）。实验包括两次10万步训练的42个外部评测检查点、6次精确权重空间合并、8次受控短训练。
AI.result: 几何早期即被学会但绝对尺度未确定：中位对齐NYUv2 δ1全程稳定在0.89–0.93，而未对齐δ1在0.11–0.50间波动；十种子集成无需重训即把未对齐δ1从0.348提升至0.516。深度与2D分割争用共享适配器，权重合并仅沿该权衡移动而不能脱离。验证flow loss越低Cityscapes精度越低（loss下降与mIoU的Spearman ρ≈−0.9），故loss不可用于选模。
AI.conclusion: 开源生成器上该范式部分成立但存在可度量的具体差距；尺度不确定性可通过集成缓解，任务间适配器竞争与损失—精度反相关是核心瓶颈。作者开源代码、契约、训练数据与全部评测输出。

title: A Closed-Form Temporal Readout for Surgical Triplet Recognition
summary: Surgical triplet recognition requires identifying which instrument performs which action on which anatomical target, and following these interactions as they unfold over time. The task is challenging because several triplets can occur at once, their components span very different durations, and the evidence for an interaction is rarely complete in a single frame. We introduce STRIDE, a post-hoc temporal readout that adds temporal context to any trained recogniser. It averages the recogniser's features and logits over a few fixed temporal windows and combines them with the current frame through ridge regression, solved in closed form on a CPU. Applied as a plug-and-play readout to nine existing methods, STRIDE improves $AP_{IVT}$ in 24 of 27 method-dataset pairs, by up to 7.4 points. Moreover, we propose a simple pipeline consisting of an adapted foundation vision encoder with a linear classifier and STRIDE. Across thirteen encoders, STRIDE improves 37 of 39 encoder-dataset pairs by up to 7.2 points. STRIDE reduces false alarms by 41%, at the cost of a slower response at interaction boundaries. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出STRIDE，一种后处理式时间读出模块，通过多尺度时间窗特征/对数平均与岭回归闭式解为任意已训练的手术三元组识别器注入时序上下文，在24/27个方法-数据集组合上提升AP_IVT最多7.4点，并降低41%误报。
AI.motivation: 手术三元组识别需判定"哪把器械对哪个解剖目标执行哪种动作"并跟踪其时间演化。难点在于：多个三元组同时发生、各组分持续时间跨度极大、单帧证据往往不完整。已有识别器多为逐帧/短窗建模，缺乏对时序证据的有效聚合手段。
AI.method: STRIDE是即插即用的后处理时间读出：对已训练识别器，在若干固定时间窗上平均其特征与logits，再与当前帧表示通过岭回归（ridge regression）融合，回归系数在CPU上以闭式解求得，无需重新训练或修改原模型。另提出"适配的基础视觉编码器+线性分类器+STRIDE"的简洁流水线。
AI.result: 作为即插即用读出应用于9种现有方法，在24/27个方法-数据集对上提升AP_IVT，最高+7.4点；在13种编码器上，39个编码器-数据集对中37个提升，最高+7.2点；误报率降低41%，代价是交互边界处响应变慢。
AI.conclusion: 显式、轻量的时序证据聚合（多窗平均+岭回归融合）可普遍增强手术三元组识别，且与骨干和原方法解耦；主要局限为时间边界响应延迟，作者将公开代码。

title: Click and Count: Multimodal Prototype Adaptation for Class-Agnostic Object Counting
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 2027 IEEE Symposium Series on Computational Intelligence (IEEE SSCI 2027). Code: https://github.com/ameniifi/Click-and-Count
summary: We propose a multimodal, class-agnostic, density-based object counting framework that specifies the object of interest through visual exemplars, a text description, or both, within a single iterative refinement pipeline. Existing counters typically fall into two groups: methods that fuse two modalities, a hand-drawn bounding box and a text description, to specify the target object, and single-modality methods that rely on either a box exemplar or text alone. A few recent methods replace the box with a point or click. We expand a single click into a precise object mask via a frozen visual-prompt segmentation model, feeding an iterative prototype-refinement process that also fuses a text description at every refinement step. We make two contributions: first, a click-derived exemplar extraction module that removes the bounding-box requirement of prior exemplar-based counters; second, a per-step text-fusion mechanism that combines visual and textual prompts throughout refinement. Combined with text guidance, our model achieves state-of-the-art counting accuracy, outperforming prior click-based counting methods across all metrics and surpassing the box-exemplar base architecture in mean absolute error. The code is available at github.com/ameniifi/Click-and-Count.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态、类别无关、基于密度图的目标计数框架，用点击替代手绘框，并通过冻结的分割模型将单击扩展为精确掩码，在迭代原型细化中逐步融合文本描述。
AI.motivation: 现有计数方法分为两类：融合框+文本双模态的方法，以及仅依赖框样例或仅文本的单模态方法；近期少量方法用点/点击替代框。作者希望彻底去除对手绘边界框的依赖，同时让视觉与文本提示在整个细化过程中共同发挥作用。
AI.method: 1) 点击驱动样例提取模块：用冻结的视觉提示分割模型将一次点击扩展为精确目标掩码，取代边界框样例；2) 逐步文本融合机制：在迭代原型细化的每一步同时融合文本描述；整体为单一迭代细化流水线，支持视觉样例、文本或两者组合指定目标。
AI.result: 结合文本引导后达到当前最优计数精度：在所有指标上优于此前基于点击的计数方法，并在MAE上超过基于框样例的基线架构。
AI.conclusion: 验证了“点击+文本”多模态迭代细化范式的有效性，可在无需手绘框的条件下实现高精度类别无关计数；代码已开源。

title: GALILEO: Geometric RoPE with Galilean Key Transport for Dynamic Scenes
summary: Geometry-aware rotary positional encodings, such as RayRoPE, help attention reason about the 3D spatial relationships between tokens and the query camera. However, they implicitly assume a static scene, encoding each key at its observed position regardless of when it was captured. For dynamic scenes with temporally separated input views, this mismatch places the same moving object at a different position in each input frame, so it can be rendered at an inaccurate position. While temporal encodings inform attention when a token was observed, they do not resolve where its content should be at the query time. We introduce a simple and general approach that aligns positional encodings with dynamic scene geometry through Galilean transport. Before positional encoding, each key's 3D position is transported to the query time using its estimated velocity and the temporal offset. By modifying only key positions, our method integrates directly with existing encodings, including RayRoPE and URoPE, without altering their formulations. Velocities can be obtained from arbitrary sources. By default, we estimate them from token correspondences within the network. Integrated into LVSM, our method improves dynamic view synthesis on Syn4D, dynamic Objaverse, and real-world Stereo4D videos over baselines. Ablations show that encoding velocities as token features yields smaller gains, while attention visualizations reveal that our method attends to query-time locations of moving content, unlike RayRoPE. Beyond view synthesis, our method also reduces tracking errors on dynamic objects in a pretrained 3D point tracker and improves moving-vehicle generation in a video generator.

AI.tldr: 提出 Galilean transport：在位置编码前用估计速度与时间偏移将每个 key 的 3D 位置传输到查询时刻，修正几何感知位置编码（RayRoPE、URoPE）在动态场景中的静态假设，仅改 key 位置即可即插即用。
AI.motivation: RayRoPE 等几何感知旋转位置编码隐式假设场景静态，将每个 key 编码在其被观测的位置。对时间上分离的多视角动态场景，同一运动物体在不同帧处于不同位置，导致渲染位置不准；而时间编码只告诉注意力"何时被观测"，无法回答内容在查询时刻"应在何处"。
AI.method: 基于 Galilean 变换：利用估计速度与时间偏移，将每个 key 的 3D 位置传输至查询时刻后再做位置编码，仅修改 key 位置、不改动原有编码公式，可直接与 RayRoPE、URoPE 组合。速度来源任意，默认从网络内部 token 对应关系中估计。
AI.result: 集成到 LVSM 后在 Syn4D、动态 Objaverse 与真实 Stereo4D 视频上优于基线；消融显示将速度作为 token 特征编码收益更小；注意力可视化显示该方法关注运动内容的查询时刻位置，而 RayRoPE 不然。此外在预训练 3D 点追踪器上降低动态物体跟踪误差，在视频生成器中改善运动车辆生成。
AI.conclusion: 动态场景下几何位置编码的失配可通过查询时刻的空间-时间位置对齐解决；该方法简单、通用、即插即用，并可推广到视图合成之外的点跟踪与视频生成任务。

title: Improving semantic equivalence in research-level math formalization
comment: Accepted at the 6th Math-AI workshop at NeurIPS'26
summary: Formalizing mathematics in Lean is never a word-for-word translation of a paper: a Lean formalization changes definitions, strengthens hypotheses, splits arguments, and adds lemmas the paper never mentions. It stands to reason that a model that is good at autoformalization must be a good predictor of how a natural language source must differ from its faithful Lean formalization. With that in mind, we collect 4{,}076 audited examples of such changes from 832 Lean projects that formalize research-level mathematics, and use them to ask a practical question: how well can a model \emph{write} Lean inside a real research-level project that may contain tens of thousands of lines of code, and does training on discrepancies between natural language sources and their faithful Lean formalizations help? Our training set consists of 3{,}431 tasks from 141 repositories, and the test set consists of 645 tasks from the remaining 27 repositories. Training on in-project Lean nearly doubles complete proofs ($11\% \to 20\%$) and raises the share of statements in gold agreement with the project's own formalization by nearly a third ($30\%$ to $39\%$). The gain comes from the pairs themselves: an adapter trained only to predict how the Lean will differ, or a model told the difference in advance, barely helps. Training on where formalizations depart from their sources is thus an effective way of improving semantic equivalence in research-level formalization.

AI.tldr: 论文从832个研究级Lean项目中收集4,076个经审核的“自然语言源与忠实Lean形式化之间的差异”样本，训练模型在真实大型项目中书写Lean；训练后在项目内Lean上可将完整证明率从11%提升到20%，与项目自身形式化在陈述上的一致率从30%提升到39%。
AI.motivation: Lean形式化并非逐字翻译：它改变定义、强化假设、拆分论证、补充论文未提及的引理。作者据此假设：擅长自动形式化的模型应能预测自然语言源与其忠实Lean形式化之间的差异，并检验这种能力是否有助于在真实研究级项目中写Lean。
AI.method: 从832个形式化研究级数学的Lean项目中收集4,076个经审核的差异实例；训练集为来自141个仓库的3,431个任务，测试集为来自其余27个仓库的645个任务；对比训练在项目内Lean上、仅训练预测差异的适配器、以及预先告知模型差异这几种设置。
AI.result: 在项目内Lean上训练几乎使完整证明数翻倍（11%→20%），并使陈述与项目自身形式化达到gold agreement的比例提升近三分之一（30%→39%）。增益主要来自差异样本对本身：只训练预测差异的适配器，或提前告知模型差异，几乎无帮助。
AI.conclusion: 训练模型识别形式化偏离自然语言源之处，是提升研究级形式化中语义等价性的有效途径。

title: Emotion-Aware and Context-Grounded Dialogue Agents for Personalized Video Game Interactions
summary: We present ChatNPC, a game companion that dynamically personalizes its responses in real time based on players' emotional shifts to enhance user immersion. The model integrates sequential data, leveraging the dynamic nature of streams to benefit from player information, spoken lines, and in-game context. We leverage recent progress in LLMs' tool-calling capabilities to extract vital information from memory and recognize potential constraints for accurate reasoning, thereby tackling the complexity of NPC conversation scenarios. The task is divided into a game sentinel-guided agent (SeGent), a memory capability, and a chat planning tool for reasoning instantiation. The approach uses a lightweight game template as an information framework, with relevant details and a thorough reasoning layout. We conduct extensive experiments on a newly developed game dataset for in-game context NPC dialogue and demonstrate that ChatNPC sequentially captures players' emotional shifts over time; responses are more naturalistic and human-like with appropriate conversational cues, pauses, and sighs; and utterances remain faithful to the dynamics of in-game context and player actions, supporting narrative continuity.

AI.tldr: ChatNPC：基于LLM工具调用与记忆机制的实时情感自适应游戏NPC伴侣，通过SeGent、记忆模块与聊天规划工具实现情节连贯、自然拟人的动态个性化对话。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏NPC对话难以根据玩家情感变化实时个性化，且NPC对话场景复杂（需兼顾玩家信息、台词与游戏上下文），影响沉浸感。
AI.method: 提出ChatNPC，整合序列数据流以利用玩家信息、台词与游戏内上下文；借助LLM工具调用能力从记忆中提取关键信息并识别约束以支持准确推理。任务拆分为三部分：游戏哨兵引导的智能体（SeGent）、记忆能力、用于推理实例化的聊天规划工具；并以轻量级游戏模板作为信息框架，配合相关细节与完整推理布局。同时构建了新的游戏内上下文NPC对话数据集。
AI.result: 在新数据集上的实验表明：ChatNPC能按时间序列捕捉玩家情感变化；回复更自然拟人，含恰当的对话线索、停顿与叹息；话语忠于游戏上下文动态与玩家行为，保持叙事连续性。
AI.conclusion: ChatNPC验证了LLM工具调用结合记忆与规划在游戏NPC个性化对话中的有效性，可提升沉浸感与叙事连贯性。

title: Who Makes the Decision? Auditing an Agentic LLM Pipeline for Illicit Cryptocurrency Transaction Monitoring
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. Accepted to the 3rd Workshop on Big Data Analysis AND Illicit Trends (BANDIT) at IEEE BigData 2026
summary: Agentic pipelines that combine graph detectors, deterministic rules, retrieval-augmented generation and an LLM judge are being proposed to monitor illicit cryptocurrency flows and to write regulation-citing justifications for analysts. They are evaluated on end-to-end accuracy or on the quality of those justifications, and neither shows which component made a decision. We audit such a pipeline on the Elliptic++ Bitcoin dataset with decision-source attribution, a trace-level protocol with three layers: per-case actual causation, interventional Shapley credit, and mediation of upstream risk scores. A deterministic wallet-score override carries about 94% of the credit for flags, and a verification gate cancels most of the judge's own flags, which fall on licit transactions. Testing the judge alone over 76 evidence bundles, four backbones and two prompts, we find that it follows an injected risk score on the anonymous transaction features it is given, although stronger models decide correctly when the facts are explicit; that a context too short for the system prompt leaves it with no verdict at all; and that it cites regulatory clauses that do not apply, which a substring-based citation check accepts. Hiding the score does not fix the judge, because evidence gathered with the score visible still encodes it. For illicit-activity monitoring, an LLM's justification should therefore not be read as evidence of which component flagged a transaction.

AI.tldr: 该论文对用于监控非法加密货币流动的LLM智能体流水线做决策来源归因审计，发现钱包分数硬规则覆盖贡献约94%的标记信用，LLM裁判多数自身标记被验证门取消，且其引用与判据不可靠。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体流水线（图检测器+确定性规则+RAG+LLM裁判）仅以端到端准确率或理由质量评估，无法揭示是哪个组件做出了决策，导致LLM生成的监管引用式理由可能被误当作标记依据的证据。
AI.method: 在Elliptic++比特币数据集上审计该流水线，提出"决策来源归因"的轨迹级协议，含三层：逐案例实际因果、干预式Shapley信用分配、上游风险分数的中介分析；并对LLM裁判做受控实验：76个证据包×4个骨干模型×2种提示，检验其是否跟随注入的风险分数、上下文长度影响及引用核验（子串匹配）的可靠性。
AI.result: 确定性钱包分数覆盖约承担94%的标记信用；验证门取消了裁判自身的多数标记，且这些标记落在合法交易上；裁判在仅给定匿名交易特征时跟随注入风险分数，更强模型在事实显式时能正确判断；系统提示被截断时裁判无任何结论；裁判引用不适用的监管条款而子串式引用检查仍通过；隐藏分数无效，因可见分数时收集的证据已编码该信息。
AI.conclusion: 在非法活动监控中，LLM的理由与引用不应被视为哪一组件标记了交易的证据；需采用决策来源归因而非仅端到端指标来衡量与验证智能体流水线。

title: When do stored facts become available in looped transformers?
summary: Looped transformers do not acquire new knowledge during a forward pass. Prior work shows that they store as many bits in their weights as non-looped models. It remains unclear how recurrence makes this knowledge available during inference. We study this question using synthetic factual recall and multi-hop reasoning, measuring depth-resolved readable information in bits with native readouts and tuned lenses. Under final-loop supervision, single-hop facts become readable progressively: heavier memorization loads delay retrieval despite comparable final readable information. Untied baselines of equal unrolled depth concentrate retrieval near the end of their stacks, whereas looped models expose facts earlier. This delay is not intrinsic to the tested recall tasks: training with supervision and depth-specific readouts at every loop makes near-final information readable after the first loop in all tested configurations. Representational analysis shows value-related structure emerging within states organized by the query key. We then study multi-hop chains whose facts are stored in the weights rather than given in the prompt. Intermediate entities become decodable in chain order, and aligned transitions show next-entity structure developing while current-entity structure remains dominant. Interventions in a released six-recurrence model establish a causal role for these representations. Counterfactual replacements of a probe-defined entity component at a single prompt position redirect downstream bridge entities and the final answer. Conversely, replacements from queries that reach the same entity through different preceding relations, preserving the remaining relation suffix, retain the original answer in over 99.5\% of tested cases. These results distinguish a training-dependent schedule for factual recall from the causal role of retrieved-entity representations in subsequent composition.

AI.tldr: 循环（looped）Transformer在前向传播中并不获取新知识；本文通过合成事实召回与多跳推理任务，用按深度解析的"可读比特数"量化循环如何让权重中存储的知识在推理时可用。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明循环模型权重中存储的信息量与无循环模型相当，但"循环如何在推理阶段使这些知识变得可用"这一问题尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用合成事实召回与多跳推理任务，结合原始读出（native readout）与调优透镜（tuned lens）测量逐层/逐循环的可读信息量；对比等展开深度的非权重共享（untied）基线；进行表征分析与因果干预实验（在已发布的六次循环模型中做反事实替换）。
AI.result: 1）在末轮监督下，单跳事实随循环渐进变得可读，记忆负载越重检索延迟越大，但最终可读信息量相当；2）非共享基线将检索集中在堆栈末端，循环模型更早暴露事实；该延迟并非任务固有——每轮都加监督与深度特定读出后，首轮循环后信息即可读；3）表征中按query key组织的状态内涌现值相关结构；4）多跳链中中间实体按链序可解码，对齐转移显示下一实体结构发展而当前实体结构仍占主导；5）在单一提示位置替换探针定义的实体成分可改变下游桥接实体与最终答案，而来自不同前序关系但指向同一实体的替换在超过99.5%的情况下保留原答案。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了两件事：事实召回的时序/调度依赖于训练方式，而检索到的实体表征在多跳组合中具有因果作用。循环本身不增加知识，但通过训练决定的读取调度与实体表征的因果机制影响推理时的知识可用性。

title: Blind to What They Can Fix: A Detection Gap in Self-Improving Agents
summary: AI agents can write programs that carry out a task without calling a model at every step, so the task runs fast and its logic stays open to inspection. Agents improve these programs by running them, studying their failures, and revising the code, a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI). We ask whether this process also yields runtime checks that can be trusted. In five task domains, with up to seven author models, agents bring their programs to high scores. Yet when the environment changes, the checks they were told to write stay silent on half or more of the resulting failures in four domains. These failures can be detected and repaired: a monitor built from records of normal runs catches most of them in three domains, and the same agents usually repair them once called. The checks do not examine the recorded relations that reveal the failures, and the strongest agent writes checks that catch most of them once told that its checks are the only thing that calls it back. An unreported failure stays unrepaired, which limits what self-improvement is worth in autonomous operation. Evaluations of self-improvement should measure not only scores but also whether a system notices its own failures.

AI.tldr: 智能体通过递归自我改进（RSI）把程序分数推高，但其生成的运行时检查在环境变化时对半数以上失败保持沉默；这些失败可被正常运行记录构建的监视器检出且可被修复，因而自改进评估应同时度量"能否察觉自身失败"。
AI.motivation: AI智能体可写出无需每步调用模型的高效程序并迭代改进（RSI），但核心担忧是：这一过程产出的运行时检查是否可信。若检查失效而失败未被报告，就不会被修复，从而限制自主运行中自我改进的价值。
AI.method: 在五个任务域、最多七个作者模型上开展实验：让智能体编写程序、运行、分析失败并改写代码；随后改变环境分布，检验其被要求编写的运行时检查对新增失败的检出率。进一步尝试两类补救：一是用正常运行的记录构建监视器（anomaly/monitor），二是提示智能体"其检查是唯一回调机制"以诱导更强的检查编写；并测量被提示后的修复率。
AI.result: 智能体在原始环境下达到高分数；但环境变化后，在四个任务域中检查对至少一半（半数以上）的失败保持沉默。这些失败是可检测、可修复的：基于正常运行记录的监视器在三个域中捕获大部分失败，且同一批智能体在被指出后通常能修复。检查失败的原因在于其未审视能揭示失败的关系记录；最强的智能体在被明确告知"检查是唯一回调途径"后，其检查能捕获大多数失败。
AI.conclusion: 未被报告的失败不会被修复，这削弱了自我改进在自主运行中的实际价值。自改进评估不应只看任务分数，还应度量系统是否察觉自身失败（失败自检能力）；运行时检查的可靠性是RSI可信度的关键短板。

title: Neural Agent Compiler: Learning to Schedule Soft Dependencies
summary: Large language model agents accomplish complex tasks by coordinating multiple reasoning steps and tool operations, which form dependencies among their operations. Existing orchestration methods primarily consider hard dependencies that determine when an operation can legally begin, but overlook soft dependencies, i.e., information that is not required for execution but may improve an already executable operation. We identify soft-dependency scheduling as an important problem in agent execution. To this end, we introduce Neural Agent Compiler (NAC), a learned scheduler that predicts the task-quality and resource consequences of three execution modes and selects the highest-utility legal mode at a scheduling boundary. NAC represents the executable continuation, pending information event, and resource state in a shared memory, and uses a utility function to adapt the consequence predictions to different resource preferences. Across AppWorld, WebShop, and $τ^2$-bench, NAC achieves 276/417 AppWorld task completions, a 74.69 WebShop Task Score, and 59/100 $τ^2$-bench successes. Additional studies show that the learned scheduler reduces execution work, establishing soft-dependency scheduling as a promising solution for orchestrating tool-using agents.

AI.tldr: 提出神经代理编译器（NAC），通过预测三种执行模式的任务质量与资源后果，在调度边界选择效用最高的合法模式，实现软依赖调度。
AI.motivation: 现有编排方法只考虑硬依赖（决定操作何时可合法开始），忽视了软依赖——即非执行必需但能改善本已可执行操作的信息，因此软依赖调度是代理执行中的重要问题。
AI.method: NAC是一个学习式调度器：在共享内存中表示可执行后续、待定信息事件与资源状态，预测三种执行模式的任务质量和资源后果，并用效用函数将后果预测适配到不同资源偏好，从而选择效用最高的合法模式。
AI.result: 在AppWorld上完成276/417个任务，WebShop任务得分74.69，τ²-bench成功59/100；消融/额外研究表明学习式调度器减少了执行工作量。
AI.conclusion: 软依赖调度是编排工具使用型代理的一种有前景的解决方案。

title: Post-Training Agents for Long-Document Reasoning
comment: Accepted at the Third Workshop on Long-Context Foundation Models (LCFM) at NeurIPS 2026. 14 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables
summary: Professional documents are a long-context workload that retrieval-style benchmarks do not capture. In a ten-domain enterprise collection, a task's evidence is spread across a source document of median length 27 pages (mean 48.8, maximum 873); a third of tasks rest mainly on charts, drawings, and maps; and 70.9% require two or more reasoning hops. We post-train Kimi-K2.7, an open-weight foundation model, at its full context window on 1,465 expert-authored tasks with atomic rubrics from that collection, training rank-32 adapters with one round of privileged-context on-policy self-distillation followed by two rounds of rubric-reward reinforcement learning. We render each PDF as text for training and as extracted text plus selected page images at evaluation. The smoothed RL training reward rises from 0.37 in the first tenth of the run to 0.67 in the last. On the 100-task GDP.pdf holdout, served in a 262,144-token window, strict pass (all rubric criteria met) more than doubles after the second round, from 11.0% to 24.5%, with gains across input lengths up to 240K tokens. Mean tokens generated stay flat (9,803 to 9,733), so the gain does not come from longer outputs. GPT-5.6 Sol's leaderboard strict pass is 30.7% at a measured 3,422 tokens. On 220 out-of-domain GDPval tasks, where the model runs as a long-horizon tool-using agent, mean rubric reward rises from 0.571 to 0.746 after the third round and zero-credit tasks fall from 54 to 10, while messages per task fall 18%, from 70.9 to 58.2. In paired trajectories, the third round replaces a context-thrashing retry loop with one up-front check of all sources, and verification extends from checking that files exist to checking what they contain. We argue that long-context evaluation of agents should report accuracy jointly with tokens and turns, and that datasets of long documents should ship text and image renderings alongside each PDF.

AI.tldr: 对开源权重模型Kimi-K2.7在全上下文窗口上做后训练，用专家撰写的1,465个长文档任务提升其长上下文专业文档能力。GDP.pdf留出集严格通过率由11.0%升至24.5%，token生成量基本不变，并在GDPval智能体任务上提升奖励、减少无效重试。
AI.motivation: 检索式基准无法刻画专业长文档这一负载：证据跨越多页、大量任务依赖图表与图纸、多数需要多跳推理。作者希望直接在全上下文窗口内训练与评估智能体的专业文档处理能力。
AI.method: 构建十领域企业文档集合与原子化评分标准（1,465 个专家撰写任务）；对 Kimi-K2.7 训练 rank-32 适配器：先做一轮特权上下文在线自蒸馏，再做两轮基于评分标准的强化学习。训练时将 PDF 渲染为文本，评估时使用提取文本加选定页面图像。
AI.result: RL 平滑奖励从训练前段 0.37 升至末段 0.67。100 任务 GDP.pdf 留出集（262,144 token 窗口）严格通过率经第二轮由 11.0% 增至 24.5%，在最长 240K 输入上均有效；平均生成 token 基本持平（9,803→9,733），说明增益非来自更长输出。GPT-5.6 Sol 排行榜严格通过率为 30.7%（3,422 token）。220 个域外 GDPval 智能体任务：平均评分奖励 0.571→0.746，零分任务 54→10，每任务消息数降 18%（70.9→58.2）。
AI.conclusion: 第三轮训练将"上下文反复重试"替换为一次性全源检查，验证从"确认文件存在"升级为"确认文件内容"。作者主张：长上下文智能体评估应同时报告准确率、token 与轮次；长文档数据集应在 PDF 之外同时提供文本与图像渲染。

title: Context-Grounded Skill Internalization for Vision-Language Agents
comment: 30 pages, 13 figures, 23 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Skill internalization offers a way for agents to learn useful behaviors from skills and use them without explicit guidance in context at inference time. A common approach is to generate demonstration trajectories with the skill in context and then fine-tune the same model on its own trajectories with the skill removed. However, this leads to the problem that the model may learn to reference the removed skill, which we named as context misalignment (CoMi). In this work, we first analyze agent behaviors related to CoMi under this common pipeline. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ARC-AGI-1, skill-removed fine-tuning consistently results in CoMi: 12.2-46.0% of test trajectories reference the removed skill. To address this problem, we develop Context-Grounded Skill Internalization (CGSI). CGSI uses a sentence detector to identify unsupported references and then masks or rewrites the selected sentences before fine-tuning. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of CGSI and reveal two key findings. (i) Compared with directly fine-tuning with the skill removed, CGSI reduces CoMi at test time by 72.5-94.6% while preserving task success. (ii) Compared with existing reinforcement learning-based skill-internalization baselines, CGSI achieves comparable performance with substantially less training time. CGSI also significantly reduces processing costs compared with large-scale trajectory auditing and correction.
