AI.tldr: 论文指出"技能内化"常用流程（带技能生成轨迹后去技能微调）会导致模型在推理时仍引用已移除的技能，称为上下文错位（CoMi）；提出CGSI，通过句子检测器识别缺乏依据的引用并在微调前屏蔽或改写这些句子，将测试时CoMi降低72.5–94.6%且保持任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 技能内化旨在让智能体习得并内化技能行为，使其在推理时无需上下文中显式引导即可使用。常见做法是用上下文中的技能生成示范轨迹，再在移除技能的自身轨迹上微调同一模型。但该流程存在隐患：模型可能学到去引用那个已被移除的技能，导致测试时出现对不存在技能的指涉，作者将其命名为上下文错位（CoMi）。
AI.method: 先在ALFWorld、WebShop、ARC-AGI-1三个环境上系统分析该常见流程下的CoMi行为；随后提出Context-Grounded Skill Internalization (CGSI)：利用句子检测器识别轨迹中缺乏上下文中依据（unsupported）的技能引用句子，在微调前对这些句子进行屏蔽（masking）或改写（rewriting），从而消除错位监督信号。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，去技能微调一致产生CoMi，12.2–46.0%的测试轨迹出现对已移除技能的引用。CGSI相比直接去技能微调，将测试时CoMi降低72.5–94.6%，同时保持任务成功率；相比现有基于强化学习的技能内化基线，以显著更少的训练时间达到可比性能；相比大规模轨迹审计与修正方案，也大幅降低处理成本。
AI.conclusion: 去技能微调中的上下文错位是技能内化的系统性缺陷；通过在微调前对无依据引用句子做检测与屏蔽/改写，CGSI以低成本、短训练时间有效缓解CoMi并保持任务表现，为技能内化提供了简洁高效的解决方案。

title: Differential Proteomics to XAI Rules: A SHAP-FOL-ILP Modeling for Lung Adenocarcinoma
summary:
Background: We developed an interpretable workflow linking paired differential proteomics, sparse logistic regression, SHAP attribution, and first-order logic (FOL) rule learning in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD).
  Methods: We analysed 213 CPTAC-LUAD tissue samples (111 tumour, 102 adjacent-normal) from 111 patients, including 102 matched pairs. Protein effect estimation and testing used the same complete pairs, with Benjamini-Hochberg correction. Sparse logistic regression used five-fold stratified patient-grouped nested cross-validation. Preprocessing and model selection were confined to training data, with feature selection repeated within inner folds. A separate five-fold patient-grouped evaluation tested SHAP-guided inductive logic programming (FOL/ILP) using training-derived evidence and discretisation.
  Results: Quality control retained 9,518 proteins. At FDR below 0.05 and an absolute mean paired log-ratio difference of at least 1, 378 were differentially abundant (40 increased, 338 decreased). The sparse classifier yielded ROC-AUC 0.9997, average precision 0.9998, accuracy 0.9906, and balanced accuracy 0.9906. FOL/ILP yielded held-out accuracy 0.9765, balanced accuracy 0.9767, precision 0.9818, recall 0.9730, and F1 0.9774. HSPA12B, PALM2-AKAP2, STARD13, and PPM1F had non-zero coefficients in all five classifier folds. The most frequent Horn clause occurred in two of five folds. All others occurred once.
  Conclusions: The workflow connects proteomic classification, attribution, and symbolic rules. Performance reflects tumour-versus-adjacent-normal discrimination within one cohort. Biomarker and clinical claims require independent validation, repeated assessment of rule stability, and further biological annotation.

AI.tldr: 构建了一个可解释流程，将配对差异蛋白质组学、稀疏逻辑回归、SHAP归因与一阶逻辑（FOL）规则学习串联，用于肺腺癌（LUAD）肿瘤与癌旁正常组织的判别，分类性能极高（AUC 0.9997），FOL规则留出准确率0.9765，但规则跨折稳定性有限。
AI.motivation: 蛋白组学分类器虽性能优异但缺乏可解释性，而符号规则可读性强却缺少与统计建模、归因的衔接。作者希望建立一条从差异分析到可解释符号规则的端到端工作流，以提升模型透明度。
AI.method: 使用213例CPTAC-LUAD样本（111例肿瘤、102例癌旁，含102对配对），配对效应估计与检验采用BH校正；稀疏逻辑回归采用五折分层、患者分组、嵌套交叉验证，预处理与特征选择仅在训练折内进行并在内层折重复；另设独立五折患者分组评估，用训练集证据与离散化检验SHAP引导的归纳逻辑编程（FOL/ILP）。
AI.result: 质控后保留9,518个蛋白；FDR<0.05且配对log ratio绝对值差异≥1时得378个差异丰富蛋白（40上调、338下调）。稀疏分类器ROC-AUC 0.9997、平均精度0.9998、准确率0.9906、平衡准确率0.9906；FOL/ILP留出准确率0.9765、平衡准确率0.9767、精确率0.9818、召回率0.9730、F1 0.9774。HSPA12B、PALM2-AKAP2、STARD13、PPM1F在全部五折中系数非零；最频繁的Horn子句仅出现于两折，其余各出现一次。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流实现了蛋白质组分类、归因与符号规则的贯通；性能仅反映单队列内肿瘤与癌旁的判别能力，生物标志物与临床结论需独立验证、规则稳定性重复评估及进一步生物学注释。

title: Deep Discriminative Feature Fusion of Convolutional and Attention-Based Recurrent Representations for Subject-Independent ECG Stress Recognition
summary: Stress has become a significant concern because of its negative impact on both physical and mental health and therefore drives the need for reliable automated systems to assess stress levels. Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals provide a non-invasive and objective measure of physiological stress responses and have emerged as a promising modality for continuous stress monitoring. While deep learning techniques have achieved encouraging results in ECG-based stress detection, many studies focus only on one type of feature representation, and therefore limit their ability to capture both the morphological patterns and temporal dynamics embedded in ECG signals. To address this limitation, in this paper, we propose three deep learning-based feature fusion frameworks for ECG-based stress classification. These are Residual Feature Fusion (RFF), Bidirectional Feature-Wise Cross-Attention Fusion (BFCAF), and a novel Cross-Attention Residual Fusion (CARF) framework that combines the strengths of residual learning and bidirectional cross-attention within a unified architecture. A 1D Convolutional Neural Network (1D-CNN) and a BiLSTM-Attention network are used to extract complementary morphological and temporal representations from ECG signals, respectively. The proposed fusion frameworks leverage these heterogeneous representations to improve feature interaction, information preservation, and stress discrimination. The proposed frameworks are evaluated using subject-independent Leave-One-Subject-Out Cross-Validation (LOSOCV) on the RML and WESAD datasets for three-class stress classification. Experimental results show that the proposed feature fusion methods consistently improve performance over individual CNN and BiLSTM models, with CARF achieving the highest accuracies of 83.1% and 77.91% on the RML and WESAD datasets, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出RFF、BFCAF与CARF三种深度学习特征融合框架，融合1D-CNN形态特征与BiLSTM-Attention时序特征用于ECG压力三分类，CARF在RML和WESAD上分别取得83.1%和77.91%的最高准确率。
AI.motivation: 压力对身心健康有负面影响，需要可靠的自动化压力评估系统；ECG可无创、客观反映生理压力响应，适合连续监测。但现有深度学习方法多仅使用单一种类特征表示，难以同时捕获ECG的形态学模式与时间动态特征。
AI.method: 构建三种特征融合框架：残差特征融合（RFF）、双向特征级交叉注意力融合（BFCAF），以及统一结合残差学习与双向交叉注意力的交叉注意力残差融合（CARF）。特征提取端分别用1D-CNN提取形态学表示、BiLSTM-Attention提取时序表示，融合框架增强异构特征交互与信息保留。在RML与WESAD数据集上采用被试独立留一交叉验证（LOSOCV）进行三分类评估。
AI.result: 三种融合方法均稳定优于单独的CNN与BiLSTM模型；CARF表现最佳，在RML与WESAD上准确率分别为83.1%与77.91%。
AI.conclusion: 异构特征融合（尤其结合残差学习与双向交叉注意力）能有效提升ECG压力分类性能，验证了形态与时序特征互补融合的有效性，为连续压力监测提供了可行方案。

title: WASP: Continual Weight Adaptation for Streaming LLM Personalization
summary: Personalized large language models (LLMs) should continually adapt to users' evolving preferences. Yet extracting preference changes from noisy interaction histories while supporting inexpensive updates remains challenging. We introduce WASP (Weight Adaptation for Streaming Personalization), a recurrent framework that captures fine-grained preferences directly from raw user interactions and generates personalized LoRA adapters without expensive per-user optimization. Specifically, WASP achieves this by training a shared hypernetwork that maintains a compact user representation and outputs adapter weights in a single forward pass. As new interactions arrive, WASP updates this representation without reprocessing full interaction history, enabling continual adaptation with per-update costs independent of history length. Experiments on personalization benchmarks and chronological interaction streams show that WASP sustains high-quality personalization over long horizons under fixed compute and storage budgets. Together, these results support efficient streaming personalization and facilitate privacy-preserving on-device deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出WASP框架：用共享超网络从原始交互流中维护紧凑用户表示，单次前向生成个性化LoRA权重，每步更新代价与历史长度无关。
AI.motivation: 个性化LLM需适应用户偏好的持续演变，但从噪声交互历史中提取偏好变化困难，且逐用户优化更新成本高、随历史增长而不可扩展。
AI.method: 循环式（recurrent）框架：训练一个共享超网络，维护压缩的用户表示（user representation），一次前向即输出该用户的LoRA适配器权重；新交互到达时仅增量更新用户表示，不重处理完整历史，从而支持持续适应且单次更新成本与历史长度无关。
AI.result: 在个性化基准与按时间顺序的交互流上，WASP在固定算力与存储预算下于长时程仍保持高质量个性化效果。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持高效流式个性化，并有利于隐私保护的原设备（on-device）部署。

title: iFeST: An Iterative Motion Correction Framework for Fetal Brain Diffusion MRI via Frequency-Spatial-Temporal Modeling
summary: Fetal brain diffusion magnetic resonance imaging (dMRI) is a pivotal non-invasive tool for assessing the development of brain connectivity and microstructure. However, the prolonged acquisition times and complex sampling requirements render dMRI highly susceptible to unpredictable fetal motion. Existing motion correction methods typically process each dMRI volume independently and focus on inter-slice motion. Such strategies fail to utilize the coherent information between dMRI volumes along different diffusion directions and lack the ability to restore the intra-slice corruption. To address these limitations, we proposed iFeST, an iterative framework that combines frequency (k-space), spatial, and temporal (inter-slice) modeling for fetal brain dMRI motion correction. At each iteration, iFeST integrates information across diffusion directions into fiber orientation distributions (FODs). These distributions encode local fiber orientations within each voxel and serve as microstructural priors for intra-slice restoration and inter-slice alignment in the next iteration. To train the framework, we developed a fetal brain dMRI motion simulator that synthesizes compound motion artifacts from FODs. Evaluation on simulated datasets demonstrated that iFeST outperformed four inter-slice networks in motion estimation and three intra-slice networks in image restoration. Further validation on a real-world dataset confirmed significantly better volume reconstruction and FOD estimation than conventional pipelines. Overall, iFeST provides a learning-based framework for fetal dMRI motion correction, restoring motion-corrupted data and improving microstructural reconstruction for downstream diagnostic applications.

AI.tldr: iFeST：融合频率-空间-时间迭代建模的胎儿脑dMRI运动校正框架，利用FOD作为微结构先验实现层内修复与层间对齐。
AI.motivation: 胎儿脑dMRI采集时间长、采样复杂，极易受不可预测胎动影响；现有方法对每个dMRI体独立处理、仅关注层间运动，未利用不同扩散方向体数据间的相关信息，且无法修复层内损坏。
AI.method: 提出iFeST迭代框架，结合k空间（频率）、空间与时间（层间）建模。每次迭代将跨扩散方向信息整合为纤维方向分布（FOD），作为体素内局部纤维取向的微结构先验，用于下一轮层内修复与层间对齐；并构建胎儿脑dMRI运动仿真器，由FOD合成复合运动伪影用于训练。
AI.result: 在仿真数据集上，运动估计优于四种层间网络，图像修复优于三种层内网络；在真实数据集上，体数据重建与FOD估计显著优于传统流程。
AI.conclusion: iFeST为胎儿dMRI运动校正提供了基于学习的框架，可修复运动损坏数据并改善微结构重建，服务下游诊断应用。

title: Beyond Unit Tests: Path-Aware Rubric-Guided LLM Autograding of Notebooks
summary: Jupyter notebooks support open-ended, multi-step assessments in which students build one logical flow across interdependent steps, combining code, written analysis, and generated outputs such as plots. These reflect authentic scientific practice but are hard to grade consistently, since students may make different yet equally valid choices at each step, so a later answer can only be judged in light of the choices a student made earlier. We present an LLM-based autograder for such flow-structured notebook questions. It generates a rubric from a reference solution, then applies a softening pass that relaxes criteria tied to the reference so legitimate alternative paths are not penalized. Each question group is graded in a single model call, so later answers are judged against the student's own earlier choices, using question-type tags and schema-constrained, low-temperature outputs. Evidence is scored multimodally: code, text, numerical outputs, and figures from code cells. We deployed the tool in a machine-learning course, integrated with Gradescope, with a pre-submission format check and prompt-injection defenses, and evaluate it both in that live course and against archived submissions graded by staff in earlier terms. We report agreement, cross-model variance, cost, student perceptions, and injection resilience. With low-temperature models, agreement with human scores is often strong, including on the open-ended items the design specifically targets, while run-to-run stability depends sharply on the model's temperature support.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于LLM的Jupyter笔记本自动评分器，面向"流程结构化"多步问题：由参考解生成评分标准，再经"软化"处理以容纳合理替代路径；每个问题组一次性评分，使后续答案基于学生自身先前选择评判，并多模态评分代码、文本、数值与图表；已在机器学习课程中与Gradescope集成实部署并验证。
AI.motivation: 开放的Jupyter笔记本多步评估要求学生跨越相互依赖的步骤构建统一逻辑流，融合代码、文字分析与图表输出，贴近真实科研实践；但评分一致性困难：学生在各步骤可能做出不同却同样有效的选择，后续答案必须结合其先前选择才能判断，人工评分难以规模化且信度低。
AI.method: 1) 从参考解自动生成评分标准（rubric）；2) 增加"软化"环节（softening pass），放宽与参考解绑定的判据，避免惩罚合法替代路径；3) 以问题组为单位单次模型调用评分，使后续答案对照学生自身先前选择；4) 使用问题类型标签、schema约束解码与低温度输出；5) 多模态证据打分：代码、文本、数值输出与代码单元生成的图像；6) 与Gradescope集成，含提交前格式检查与提示注入防御；7) 在真实课程及历史已人工评分存档上双轨评估。
AI.result: 报告与人工评分的一致性、跨模型方差、成本、学生感知及注入鲁棒性。低温度模型下与人工评分一致性常较强，包括设计所针对的开放式题目；但运行间稳定性高度依赖模型对温度参数的支持情况。
AI.conclusion: LLM自动评分可有效支持流程结构化笔记本问题的评分，关键在于软化评分标准、组内上下文评分与低温度约束；方法在真实课程中具备可用性与成本可行性，但对模型温度支持差异带来的稳定性问题需谨慎对待。

title: X-AQA: Unifying Action Quality Assessment with Multimodal Large Language Models and Multi-Domain Learning
summary: Action Quality Assessment (AQA) aims to evaluate the quality of human actions, yet existing methods are predominantly developed and evaluated on individual datasets with different task formulations and assessment criteria. We introduce X-AQA, the first unified training and evaluation framework for general-purpose AQA with multimodal large language models (MLLMs). We construct X-AQA-40K, a training corpus comprising 40,163 samples from 22 data sources across four domains: competitive sports, fitness exercises, rehabilitation, and general skills. We convert heterogeneous annotations into a unified question-answering format, incorporating dataset-specific annotation guidelines and official scoring rules when available. Using this corpus, we fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B to develop a single MLLM capable of handling diverse AQA tasks. We further establish X-AQA-Bench, which evaluates both in-distribution (ID) performance on datasets represented during training and out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization on four held-out datasets. The resulting model outperforms all evaluated open-source MLLMs on X-AQA-Bench and achieves competitive performance relative to proprietary MLLMs. Ablation studies further demonstrate that multi-domain joint training and explicitly providing assessment criteria in prompts both improve OOD generalization. X-AQA establishes a unified foundation for advancing general-purpose AQA across diverse real-world domains. Data and models are released at \hyperlink{https://huggingface.co/collections/Kelly0510/x-aqa}{here}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出X-AQA，首个面向通用动作质量评估（AQA）的多模态大模型统一训练与评测框架，构建X-AQA-40K训练语料与X-AQA-Bench基准，微调Qwen3.5-9B得到单一通用AQA模型。
AI.motivation: 现有AQA方法多在单一数据集上开发与评测，任务形式与评估标准各异，缺乏跨数据集、跨领域的统一训练与评测平台，难以支撑通用AQA研究。
AI.method: 构建X-AQA-40K语料（40,163样本，来自22个数据源，覆盖竞技体育、健身锻炼、康复、通用技能四领域），将异构标注统一转换为问答格式，并纳入数据集专属标注指南与官方评分规则；基于该语料微调Qwen3.5-9B，得到可处理多样化AQA任务的单一MLLM；建立X-AQA-Bench，同时评测训练内数据集的分布内（ID）性能与四个留出数据集上的分布外（OOD）泛化。
AI.result: 所得模型在X-AQA-Bench上优于所有对比的开源MLLM，并相对专有MLLM取得有竞争力的表现；消融实验表明多领域联合训练与在提示中显式提供评估标准均能提升OOD泛化。
AI.conclusion: X-AQA为跨多样真实领域推进通用AQA建立了统一基础，数据与模型已开源发布。

title: MatHarness: Towards Long-Horizon Open-ended AutoResearch for Computational Materials Science
summary: Materials science research is a non-linear, long-horizon process. Existing scientific agents, however, largely rely on specific task execution or predefined workflows, rendering them brittle in open-ended settings. To bridge this gap, we present MatHarness, an agent harness designed for open-ended, long-horizon computational materials research spanning the complete lifecycle from initial ideation to manuscript writing. MatHarness couples three mechanisms: execution robustness through pre-flight verification, expert-distilled skills, and just-in-time auditing; epistemic adaptability through persistent research artifacts and an evolving scientific mental model; and collective intelligence through a heterogeneous multi-agent round table under targeted human oversight. We evaluate MatHarness on adsorbate-induced surface segregation in Cu-Zn alloys, an open question in methanol-synthesis catalysis. Over a multi-week trajectory consuming roughly 10^3 GPU-hours (50 production DFT relaxations prescreened by 171 machine-learning-potential evaluations) the system revised its plan six times, recovered autonomously from failed calculations, and had an independent auditor overturn one of its own over-attributed claims before publication. Within the sampled metallic dilute-limit models, the validated DFT analysis supports an adsorbate-induced tendency toward greater surface Cu exposure at both composition endpoints, with facet- and coverage-dependent exceptions. These results were compiled into a complete manuscript with human involvement concentrated in specification, approval, and strategic steering gates. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/PrentisAI/pippin.

AI.tldr: MatHarness 是一个面向开放式、长周期计算材料研究的智能体框架，涵盖从构思到论文撰写的全流程，并在 Cu-Zn 合金吸附物诱导表面偏析问题上完成端到端验证。
AI.motivation: 材料科学研究是非线性、长周期过程，而现有科学智能体多依赖特定任务执行或预定义工作流，在开放式场景中鲁棒性差、易失效。
AI.method: 提出 MatHarness，耦合三类机制：（1）执行鲁棒性——飞行前验证、专家蒸馏技能、即时审计；（2）认知适应性——持久化研究产物与持续演化的科学心智模型；（3）集体智能——异构多智能体圆桌讨论，辅以有针对性的人类监督。
AI.result: 在 Cu-Zn 合金吸附物诱导表面偏析问题上开展多周轨迹实验，消耗约 10^3 GPU 小时（50 次生产级 DFT 弛豫，经 171 次机器学习势评估预筛）。系统六次修订计划、自主从失败计算中恢复，独立审计者在发表前推翻其一项过度归因的结论。在采样的金属稀释极限模型内，DFT 分析支持两个成分端点均存在吸附物诱导的表面 Cu 富集趋势，并存在晶面与覆盖度相关的例外。
AI.conclusion: MatHarness 可支撑开放式长周期材料研究并产出完整手稿，人类参与集中于规格设定、审批与战略引导环节；代码已开源。结果受限于金属稀释极限采样模型。

title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
summary: Multimodal foundation models can play video games well when the game waits for them, but often fail when it keeps running. We find that much of this gap lies in the harness, which decides what the model sees, what it remembers, and how its outputs become actions over time. Existing harnesses such as VISTA improve the first two, yet turn each model call into at most one action, so the agent acts only as often as its model thinks. We introduce AutoPILOT, which changes the third: in each model call, the model can send a primitive action, start an open-loop macro, or write a closed-loop controller that keeps playing from the screen without further model calls until it hands control back. To evaluate agents in real-time games, we build AFK-Bench, 120 diverse browser games grouped by how they respond to inaction and playable in real time or with the clock paused. With GPT-6.1 Sol under the same budgets, AutoPILOT reaches 68.6% real-time success against 38.3% for VISTA, and on GameWorld it keeps 80.0% in real time while VISTA drops from 84.1% to 42.9%. Its gains hold across models, and it reaches VISTA's final success rate at a fifth of its API cost. Our results suggest that how a harness turns model outputs into actions over time is a central yet underexplored part of agent design, and we hope AutoPILOT and AFK-Bench will serve as a foundation for agents in a world that does not wait.

AI.tldr: 论文指出多模态基础模型在实时游戏中表现不佳的瓶颈在于"执行框架（harness）"如何将模型输出随时间转化为动作。作者提出 AutoPILOT，允许单次模型调用输出原始动作、开环宏或闭环控制器，并构建 AFK-Bench 实时评测基准。
AI.motivation: 现有模型在"游戏等待模型"的回合制设定下表现良好，但在持续运行的实时游戏中常失败。作者认为差距主要源于 harness：它决定模型看到什么、记住什么、以及输出如何随时间变为动作。已有 harness（如 VISTA）改进了前两点，但每次模型调用最多产生一个动作，导致智能体的行动频率受限于模型思考频率，无法匹配实时环境的时间尺度。
AI.method: 提出 AutoPILOT，核心是改变"输出到动作"的映射：每次模型调用可（1）发送单条原始动作；（2）启动开环宏（open-loop macro）；（3）编写闭环控制器（closed-loop controller），在不调用模型的情况下持续依据屏幕画面决策，直到交还控制权。同时构建 AFK-Bench，包含 120 款多样化浏览器游戏，按"对无动作的响应方式"分组，支持实时模式与暂停时钟模式。
AI.result: 在相同预算下使用 GPT-6.1 Sol：AutoPILOT 实时成功率 68.6%，VISTA 为 38.3%；在 GameWorld 上 AutoPILOT 实时保持 80.0%，而 VISTA 从 84.1% 降至 42.9%。增益在多种模型上稳定成立，且 AutoPILOT 以约五分之一的 API 成本达到 VISTA 的最终成功率。
AI.conclusion: harness 如何随时间将模型输出转化为动作，是智能体设计中关键但研究不足的一环。AutoPILOT 与 AFK-Bench 可为面向"不会等待的世界"的智能体研究提供基础。

title: Can Your AI Twin Meet People for You? It Can Hold a Conversation. But What Does It Need to Judge Like You?
summary: Should your AI twin go meet people on your behalf? We built LLM twins of 710 real people from their other conversations in the CANDOR corpus, sent them to meet each other in 5,680 simulated first conversations, and checked every rehearsal against what the real people said after meeting for real (355 held-out, participant-disjoint pairs, against baselines that include each person's rating history). The rehearsals work: a twin's conversation predicts real liking ($ρ$=0.277), carries information that questionnaires and rating history do not have (partial $ρ$=0.16 [0.05, 0.26]), and recovers most of what the same reader gets from the real conversation (0.321). Swap controls show that this signal travels through the conversation, not through the persona card. What, then, does a twin need to judge like you? Not your voice: making twins talk more like their owners, with person-specific activation steering and a LoRA trained on their own speech, did not help in a pre-specified test and lowered accuracy in an exploratory second round (-0.183 [-0.294, -0.066]). Nor simply your stated ratings: a persona-prompted twin that holds the conversation does not yet carry its owner's judgment, and when told its owner's past ratings it anchors on them instead of weighing them. Learning helps: a small appraisal head trained on other real conversations, which combines the twin's post-call answers with its owner's rating history, lifts rehearsal-based prediction above the history baseline out of fold (+0.059 [0.001, 0.115], against +0.022 without the twin's answers; pre-specified primary contrast +0.056 [-0.001, 0.111]). We propose an attribution protocol for twin-based social simulation and identify learned appraisal as the component twins need next.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了710名真实个体的LLM“数字分身”（twin），让其在5,680场模拟初次对话中相互见面，并以真实会面后的喜好评分作为检验标准。结果显示分身对话能预测真实喜好（ρ=0.277），且携带问卷与评分历史之外的增量信息（偏相关ρ=0.16）；但模仿本人说话风格无效甚至有害，直接喂入过往评分会导致锚定效应；真正有效的是在他人真实对话上训练的小型“评价头”，融合分身通话后回答与本人评分历史，可将预测提升至历史基线之上（+0.059）。
AI.motivation: 检验“AI分身能否代替本人进行社交试探（rehearsal）”这一设想是否成立，并进一步探究分身要准确复现本人的社交判断究竟依赖什么成分——是语言风格、显式偏好，还是习得的评价能力。
AI.method: 基于CANDOR语料中个体的其他对话构建710个LLM分身，开展5,680场模拟初次对话；在355对参与者互斥的留出配对上，以真实会面后的喜好评分作为金标准，对比问卷、评分历史等基线。采用交换控制（swap controls）分离对话内容与人格卡（persona card）的贡献；分别测试人物特定激活引导（activation steering）、基于本人语音的LoRA微调、人格提示、注入历史评分等干预；并提出一个在他人真实对话上训练的小型评价头（appraisal head），整合分身通话后回答与本人评分历史。
AI.result: 分身对话可预测真实喜好（ρ=0.277），并携带问卷与评分历史之外的增量信息（偏相关ρ=0.16，95%CI [0.05, 0.26]），可恢复同一读者从真实对话中获取信号的约0.321；交换控制表明信号经由对话内容而非人格卡传递。风格模仿（激活引导+LoRA）在预注册检验中无收益，探索性第二轮反而降低准确率（−0.183 [−0.294, −0.066]）；人格提示的分身无法承载本人判断，告知历史评分则产生锚定。评价头可将基于试探的预测提升至历史基线之上（折外+0.059 [0.001, 0.115]，无分身回答时为+0.022；预注册主对比+0.056 [−0.001, 0.111]）。
AI.conclusion: 分身式社交试探是有效的，且其预测力来自交互对话本身而非人格描述；分身要“像本人一样判断”，关键在于习得的评价（learned appraisal），而非语言风格模仿或显式偏好注入。作者据此提出针对分身社交模拟的归因协议，并将学习式评价列为分身下一步最需补足的组件。

title: The Retry Tax: Why Static Same-Task Retries Can Cost More per Completion
summary: Retrying an agent after failure can complete more tasks while increasing the cost per completion. We study a static policy that stops at verified success or an attempt cap and otherwise resets the original prompt and workspace without passing feedback to the next request. Under stationary task success probabilities, independent attempts conditional on the task, and a common attempt cost, easier tasks tend to succeed earlier. When task success probabilities differ, the unresolved mix shifts toward harder tasks. Specializing classical survivor selection, we show that cost per completion is at least as high as in one-shot serving and that marginal cost per additional completion is nondecreasing wherever the completion increments are positive. These are different quantities: one averages spending over all completions, while the other prices the completions added by another attempt. We then arrange each task's existing benchmark runs in different orders, stop each sequence at verified success or the attempt cap, and average the resulting completion and spending at each supported cap. For one OpenHands configuration, replay estimates completion of 59.7 percent with one attempt and 70.0 percent with four, while cost per completion rises from about USD 0.70 to USD 1.32. The recorded trade-off describes fixed configurations on the available tasks. Choosing a cap requires comparing the additional spending with the application's value for the additional completions.

AI.tldr: 重试可提高任务完成率，但单位完成成本上升；成本增量的边际性非递减。
AI.motivation: 智能体重试失败任务能完成更多任务，但同时抬高每次完成的成本，实践者需要在尝试上限与成本之间做权衡，而缺少对"单位完成成本"与"边际完成成本"这两个不同量的形式化刻画。
AI.method: 定义静态重试策略：仅在验证成功或达到尝试上限时停止，否则重置原始提示与工作区且不传递反馈。在任务成功概率平稳、给定任务下各次尝试独立、单次尝试成本相同的假设下，借助经典幸存者选择（survivor selection）分析未解决任务构成向难题漂移；并将基准中各任务的既有运行序列按不同顺序重排，在每个尝试上限处截断至验证成功或上限，对完成数与支出取平均以获得replay估计。
AI.result: 单位完成成本不低于一次性服务，且在完成增量为正处边际成本非递减。某OpenHands配置下，replay估计1次尝试完成率59.7%、4次为70.0%，单位完成成本由约0.70美元升至1.32美元。
AI.conclusion: 所得权衡反映现有任务上固定配置的表现；上限选择取决于额外支出与应用对额外完成的价值比较。

title: DoppelVet: Comparative Safety Verification for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Self-evolving agents improve by retaining feedback as reusable memories or skills, but every mistaken approval can shape many future behaviors. Two updates can provide exactly the same evidence to a verifier yet produce opposite safety outcomes, so the verifier cannot distinguish them from that evidence alone. We introduce DoppelVet, a verification framework that checks proposed updates before they enter an agent's persistent state. Without access to safety labels, DoppelVet constructs an alternative that matches every signal used by the existing verifier. It replays both updates from the same state and directly compares their behaviors in both presentation orders before deciding whether to retain the candidate. We evaluate DoppelVet on DoppelVet-Grid and DoppelVet-Tool, covering executable programs and natural-language memories. Across nine open-weight and proprietary verifiers, DoppelVet raises mean harmful-update detection AUC from 0.762 to 0.940 on DoppelVet-Grid and from 0.681 to 0.826 on DoppelVet-Tool, outperforming VaG and AgentDoG 1.5. On DoppelVet-Grid, it reduces trajectories experiencing degradation from 30.39% to 0.43% over a ten-generation self-update loop and leaves no final degradation.

AI.tldr: DoppelVet：在更新进入智能体持久状态前进行验证，通过构造"证据等价但安全结局相反"的替代更新并双向回放对比，显著提升有害更新检测能力并抑制自我演化中的退化。
AI.motivation: 自我演化智能体把反馈固化为可复用记忆或技能，一旦错误批准被保留，会长期影响后续行为；而两个更新对验证器呈现完全相同的证据却可能产生相反的安全后果，仅凭证据本身无法区分，故需在持久化前进行验证。
AI.method: 提出DoppelVet验证框架：在无安全标签条件下，针对现有验证器使用的每一信号构造一个与之匹配的替代更新（doppelgänger），从同一状态出发按两种呈现顺序回放候选更新与替代更新，并直接比较二者行为，据此决定是否保留候选更新。
AI.result: 在DoppelVet-Grid与DoppelVet-Tool（分别覆盖可执行程序与自然语言记忆）上，跨9个开源与专有验证器，有害更新检测平均AUC由0.762升至0.940（Grid）、由0.681升至0.826（Tool），优于VaG与AgentDoG 1.5；十代自我更新循环中退化轨迹占比由30.39%降至0.43%，最终无退化残留。
AI.conclusion: 以行为对比替代标签监督的更新前验证可有效区分证据等价的更新，大幅提升安全性并保障智能体长期自我演化的稳定性。

title: Learning from Another Angle: Rotation-Based Test-Time Training for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on vision-language tasks but often remain vulnerable to distribution shifts due to their fixed parameters during inference. While Test-Time Training (TTT) offers a pathway for dynamic adaptation, existing approaches suffer from prohibitive computational overhead due to multiple sampling and the risk of error reinforcement from biased self-generated supervision. In light of this view, we propose RoTTT (Rotation-based Test-Time Training), a simple and efficient TTT approach that enables instance-specific refinement at inference time. For each test instance, RoTTT performs a small number of gradient updates by predicting the rotation angle of the input image. The known rotation angles naturally serve as a reliable self-supervised signal, enabling lightweight and stable adaptation without requiring additional annotations. Extensive experiments across multiple vision-language benchmarks demonstrate that RoTTT consistently improves performance across different MLLMs, providing a practical and efficient paradigm for on-the-fly MLLM adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出 RoTTT，一种基于图像旋转角度预测的轻量测试时训练方法，用少量梯度更新实现 MLLM 的实例级自适应。
AI.motivation: MLLM 推理时参数固定，面对分布偏移鲁棒性不足；现有 TTT 方法需多次采样导致计算开销巨大，且自生成监督存在偏差、易错误强化。
AI.method: 对每个测试样本，让模型预测输入图像的旋转角度，并以已知旋转角作为可靠的自监督信号，仅执行少量梯度更新完成实例级微调，无需额外标注。
AI.result: 在多个视觉-语言基准上，RoTTT 对不同 MLLM 均能稳定带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: RoTTT 为 MLLM 的在线自适应提供了一种简单、高效且实用的范式。

title: When Wrong Answers Remain Unsettled: Failure Dynamics in Recurrent Reasoners
summary: When a recurrent reasoner returns a wrong answer, is its computation finished or merely stopped? We test this on a trained Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM; 27M parameters, Sudoku-Extreme) by running the recurrence for one more inference budget and comparing with an unperturbed control. Solved answers persist (0.95 of 512 endpoints). Wrong answers mostly do not: 0.42 of near-miss answers (n=170) and 0.18 of all 512 wrong endpoints keep their answer. Perturbations from 0.05x to 20x the terminal-update scale barely change these rates, so the measurement reflects continued recurrence, not noise sensitivity. The solved-above-wrong ordering also holds in five further settings (a second seed, TRM, Maze, GRAM-guided TRM, N-Queens), but a fixed 1/2 persistence threshold does not, and neither do HRM's endpoint-spectrum and fast-versus-slow predictability patterns, which are not universal diagnostics. Perturb-and-reselect (known from prior work) is consistent with this: frozen noise gains 4.8 accuracy points (197 gained, 2 lost), but compute-matched extended depth gains 5.6 and Sudoku symmetry augmentation 34.6, so noise is not the best use of the budget. Conclusions are limited to finite horizons and one primary HRM checkpoint; they do not exclude asymptotic attractors.

AI.tldr: 通过"额外推理预算"扰动实验区分HRM的错误答案是"计算完成"还是"仅被停止"：正确解高度持久、错误解大多不持久，且该"解对优于解错"的排序在多种设置下稳健，但固定阈值与频谱/快慢诊断并非通用。
AI.motivation: 针对循环推理模型（HRM）给出错误答案时，其循环计算究竟是已收敛"完成"还是被人为预算"截断停止"，缺乏直接实证判据；作者希望用可控的续算实验检验这一点。
AI.method: 在训练好的HRM（27M参数，Sudoku-Extreme）上，将循环再做一轮推理预算，与未扰动对照比较答案持久率；并做0.05x–20x终端更新尺度的扰动扫描以排除噪声敏感性解释；另在五个设置（第二随机种子、TRM、Maze、GRAM引导的TRM、N-Queens）复现排序，并检验1/2持久阈值、端点频谱与快慢可预测性等诊断的普适性；同时对比perturb-and-reselect、等算力加深度、Sudoku对称性增强三种预算用法。
AI.result: 512个端点中正确解持久率0.95；近失错误答案（n=170）仅0.42持久，全部512个错误端点仅0.18持久。扰动幅度0.05x–20x几乎不改变这些比率，说明是持续循环而非噪声敏感。"解对优于解错"的排序在五个附加设置中成立；但固定1/2持久阈值不成立，HRM的端点频谱与快慢可预测性模式也不具普适诊断力。预算利用上：冻结噪声+4.8点（197增2损），等算力扩展深度+5.6点，Sudoku对称增强+34.6点。
AI.conclusion: 错误答案更多是"被停止"而非"计算完成"，正确解则接近已收敛；但严格阈值与特定诊断指标不可跨设置泛化。结论限于有限时间视界与单一主HRM检查点，不排除存在渐近吸引子。

title: StudioBench: Benchmarking Agentic Multimodal Large Language Models for Productive Audiovisual Creation
comment: 27 pages, 14 figures. Project page: https://openraiser.github.io/StudioBench/ and code: https://github.com/openraiser/StudioBench . Equal contribution: Xinglong Xu, Yuxia Zhu. Corresponding authors: Asher Qin, Jingxuan Wei, Cheng Tan
summary: Video generators can now render convincing short clips, yet complete audiovisual works require coordinating visuals, sound, and editing across multiple stages. Existing benchmarks focus on individual generators or video agents under narrower production settings, leaving end-to-end creation by general multimodal large language models (MLLMs) underexplored. We introduce StudioBench, a benchmark comprising 160 tasks across eight video genres and five task types, spanning diverse audiovisual production requirements. Models produce minutes of finished audiovisual content using 33 atomic generation, editing, and inspection tools, without shell access or workflow templates. We evaluate the delivered films, while analyzing reconstructed workflow graphs to characterize production behavior and diagnose failures. Across seven MLLMs, explicit requirements are nearly saturated, yet production quality varies substantially in picture clarity and composition, object structure, motion, and lip sync. All models spontaneously organize multi-stage production workflows without predefined templates. However, higher-quality models exhibit more selective production workflows, whereas additional tool calls alone show little association with quality. These findings identify the missing quality loop of effective inspection, selection, and revision as a key bottleneck in productive audiovisual creation.

AI.tldr: 提出StudioBench基准：160个任务、8类视频体裁、5种任务类型，要求通用多模态大模型在仅有33个原子工具（生成/编辑/检查）、无shell与流程模板条件下端到端制作数分钟完整视听作品，并对成片与重建的工作流图双重评估。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型已能生成逼真的短视频片段，但完整视听作品需要跨多个阶段协调画面、声音与剪辑。现有基准多聚焦单一生成器或受限制作场景下的视频智能体，缺乏对通用MLLM端到端创作能力的考察。
AI.method: 构建StudioBench基准，覆盖8种视频体裁、5类任务类型共160个任务；模型须使用33个原子工具（生成、编辑、检查）完成数分钟成片制作，禁用shell访问与工作流模板。评估既包括对交付成片的质量评判，也通过重建工作流图刻画制作行为并诊断失败原因；在7个MLLM上进行测试。
AI.result: 显式要求基本被满足（近乎饱和），但在画面清晰度与构图、物体结构、运动、口型同步等方面制作质量差异显著；所有模型均能自发组织多阶段制作流程，无需预定义模板；质量更高的模型倾向于更具选择性的工作流，而单纯增加工具调用次数与质量关联很弱。
AI.conclusion: 指出端到端视听创作的关键瓶颈在于缺失的"质量闭环"——即有效的检查、选择与修改环节，而非工具调用数量或流程模板。

title: Does a Frontier Large Language Model Know What It Can Solve? A 100-Conjecture Calibration Study
comment: Accepted at the 6th AI-Math Workshop at NeurIPS'26
summary: How does confidence correlate with actual performance in large language models, when attacking open research-level math problems? We address this question by studying the performance of ChatGPT 5.6 Sol Ultra on a set of 100 open conjectures in geometric analysis. By construction, the model first selected open problems in geometric analysis that it assessed that it had at least a 50\% chance of proving or disproving, and then assigned a probability of success to each question. 13 questions were then excluded after an audit, and the model was asked to resolve the remaining 87 problems. Its mean stated resolution probability was $0.617$, versus an observed rate of $0.103$ (Brier score $0.351$, ECE $0.513$), thereby demonstrating that the model was systematically over-confident in its self-assessment. However, the scores retained ranking signal (AUROC $0.714$). The model was highly overconfident in probability magnitude but did more often than not assign a high probability of success to the problems that it did resolve, than the problems that it did not. Hence, its probabilities were numerically mis-calibrated but directionally correct. All proofs have been formalized in Lean, thereby verifying correctness, and have been run through a semantic equivalence pipeline to ensure semantic equivalence between the formalized and informal statements. These are exploratory campaign outcomes, not fixed-budget success probabilities. The certificates prove formal statements; for a couple of questions, some geometric inputs are assumed in the lean proofs.

AI.tldr: 研究 ChatGPT 5.6 Sol Ultra 在 100 个几何分析公开猜想上的自评置信度与实际表现的关系：平均自报成功概率 0.617，实际仅 0.103（Brier 0.351、ECE 0.513），存在系统性过度自信，但仍保留排序信号（AUROC 0.714），即"数值失准但方向正确"。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型在攻击开放研究级数学问题时的置信度与实际表现是否相关，即模型自我评估的可信度问题。
AI.method: 让模型先从几何分析中自行挑选其评估至少有 50% 把握证明或否证的 100 个公开猜想，并为每题赋予成功概率；经审计剔除 13 题后，对剩余 87 题进行求解。用 Brier 分数、ECE 衡量校准性，用 AUROC 衡量区分度；所有证明在 Lean 中形式化验证，并经语义等价流水线确保形式化陈述与原始陈述语义一致。
AI.result: 平均自报解决概率 0.617，实际解决率 0.103；Brier 0.351、ECE 0.513，显示严重过度自信；但 AUROC 0.714，说明概率仍具排序信号，模型更倾向于对已解决的问题给出高概率，属"数值未校准、方向正确"。
AI.conclusion: 模型的概率自评为数值上严重过度自信但方向性有效；结果属探索性战役（campaign）产物，而非固定预算下的成功率估计；证书仅证明形式化陈述，个别问题的 Lean 证明中假设了部分几何输入。

title: Similarity-Constrained Reweighting for Complex Query Answering on Knowledge Graphs
summary: Machine learning models for Complex Query Answering (CQA) on knowledge graphs estimate the likelihood of answers that are not reachable via direct traversal. Recent work has proposed extending such queries with soft entity constraints, which require the target variable to be similar or dissimilar to specified sets of entities. We study a more general formulation where similarity constraints are specified on an arbitrary variable in a query, and introduce SCORE: a computationally efficient and interpretable method for incorporating similarity constraints on an arbitrary variable of a query. SCORE is based on a lightweight and interpretable score adjustment function that only requires tuning two hyperparameters on a validation set. Our experiments show that SCORE effectively incorporates preferences while maintaining strong query answering performance. It significantly improves ranking quality when constraints apply to the target variable and performs effectively in the more general case involving constraints on intermediate variables, and its performance remains robust when applied to several existing methods for CQA. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/dfdazac/score.

AI.tldr: 提出SCORE，一种计算高效且可解释的方法，可将软相似性约束施加于复杂查询的任意变量上。
AI.motivation: 现有CQA方法仅支持对目标变量施加软实体约束（实体相似/不相似集合），缺乏对任意变量施加相似性约束的统一建模。
AI.method: 采用轻量级可解释的分数调整函数，只需在验证集上调两个超参数，将相似性约束融入现有CQA模型的答案打分中。
AI.result: 约束作用于目标变量时显著提升排序质量；在作用于中间变量的一般情形下同样有效；对多种现有CQA方法均鲁棒适用，同时保持较强的查询回答性能。
AI.conclusion: SCORE为CQA中任意变量的相似性约束提供了通用、高效、可解释的解决方案，且易于与现有方法组合。

title: Scalar Tuned Lens Summaries Offer Limited Incremental Value for Mid-Generation Abstention
summary: Mid-generation abstention aims to stop an unpromising response before spending its remaining computation budget. Intermediate transformer states may help predict eventual correctness, but whether scalar summaries of their vocabulary predictions add useful evidence is less clear. We compare Tuned Lens entropy and divergence features with final-state and raw intermediate-state probes under matched, causal evaluation. Across eight instruction-tuned models on MATH-500, raw intermediate states improve ranking, whereas scalar-only probes usually trail the final-state baseline. Scalar hybrids have positive exceptions, but their advantage over position-matched permutation controls is small. Cross-fitted residual comparisons further show that gains over a final-state probe need not require aligned scalar features. Actual stopping runs on two model sizes and two benchmarks reveal a separate accuracy--computation trade-off, with token savings overstating wall-time savings for scalar policies. The evidence supports a restricted empirical conclusion about these scalar features, not a general negative claim about intermediate representations.

AI.tldr: 该文在匹配的因果评估下比较Tuned Lens熵/散度等标量特征与原始中间状态探针在生成中途弃答中的价值，结论为原始中间状态更能提升排序，标量特征单独使用通常不如最终状态基线，仅个别混合情形有小幅优势。
AI.motivation: 生成中途弃答需在消耗剩余计算前识别无望回复；中间Transformer状态可能预示最终正确性，但对其词表预测的标量摘要（如熵、散度）是否提供额外有效证据尚不明确。
AI.method: 在八种指令微调模型、MATH-500上，采用匹配且因果的评估，对比Tuned Lens熵与散度特征、最终状态探针、原始中间状态探针及标量混合探针；并引入位置匹配的置换对照与交叉拟合残差比较；另在两个模型规模、两个基准上运行实际停止策略，考察准确率—计算权衡与词元节省与实际时间节省的差异。
AI.result: 原始中间状态改善排序，而仅标量探针通常落后于最终状态基线；标量混合存在正向例外，但相对位置匹配置换对照的优势很小；残差比较显示超越最终状态探针的增益并不必然依赖对齐的标量特征；实际停止中词元节省高估了标量策略的墙钟时间节省。
AI.conclusion: 证据支持关于这些标量特征的有限实证结论，而非对中间表征的一般性否定；同时揭示准确率—计算权衡中词元指标与实际耗时的不一致。

title: A statistical measure of trust in generative AI
summary: Trustworthiness is a crucial issue for generative AI, as modern models can produce convincing and confident responses even when their outputs are incomplete, unsupported, or wrong. The frequent absence of ground-truth knowledge or labels complicates verification of generative AI outputs. To address this issue, we propose a trustworthiness framework grounded in model-internal confidence calibrated against an external expert reference. We estimate per-token trustworthiness of a student generative model as the statistical typicality of each generated token relative to an expert model's distribution, where the expert is used as a distributional reference rather than as a source of factual verification labels. To this end, we introduce an AI ontology calibrator that leverages the student model's internal latent features and token-level output statistics to compute expert-reference acceptance scores. Combined with traditional token-level confidence, entropy, and perplexity statistics, calibrator scores yield a compact set of $15$ response-level indicators for correctness classification. Evaluated across BF program generation, mathematical problem solving, and medical question answering, combined calibrator and traditional indicators provide complementary reliability signal which could be used to build detectors of untrustworthy outputs and hallucinations. Remarkably, our experiments show that these detectors are transferable across domains, although transferability is not always symmetric.

AI.tldr: 提出一种以"专家模型分布"为参考的可信度框架，用AI本体校准器计算逐token的专家接受分数，与传统置信度/熵/困惑度组合成15个响应级指标，用于跨领域检测不可信输出与幻觉。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI即使输出不完整、无依据或错误，也能给出自信且有说服力的回答；而真实标签或标准答案常常缺失，使输出验证困难。因此需要不依赖事实核验标签的可信度度量。
AI.method: 将学生模型逐token可信度定义为该token相对专家模型分布的统计典型性，专家仅作分布参考而非事实核验标签源。设计AI本体校准器（AI ontology calibrator），利用学生模型内部隐特征与token级输出统计计算"专家参考接受分数"；再与token级置信度、熵、困惑度统计融合，形成15个紧凑的响应级指标，用于正确性分类。
AI.result: 在BF程序生成、数学问题求解和医学问答三类任务上验证：校准器指标与传统指标提供互补的可靠性信号，可构建不可信输出与幻觉检测器；检测器具有跨领域可迁移性，但迁移性并不总是对称。
AI.conclusion: 以专家模型分布为参考、结合模型内部特征与输出统计的可信度框架，可在无真值标签条件下为生成输出提供有效且互补的可靠性信号，并支持跨领域迁移，但迁移的方向性需谨慎对待。

title: Temporal Logic Tensor Networks: Foundations of Temporal Reasoning in Neural Networks
summary: In dynamic scenes---football matches, traffic streams, surgery, or assembly---actions unfold at fundamentally different time scales: in football, a kick happens in milliseconds, a possession lasts seconds, and complex events such as a successful pass followed by a goal combine multiple atomic actions over extended durations. Models trained solely on visual data struggle to learn effectively across different time scales, lacking a principled way of reasoning across fine-grained instants and broader intervals. Neither point-wise nor purely interval semantics suffices: the former fragments events into frame-level snapshots lacking overall event identification; the latter treats intervals as atomic truth-values, ignoring state trajectories. We introduce Temporal Logic Tensor Networks (tLTN), a differentiable neuro-symbolic framework addressing this duality via a formal, multi-sorted logic where events and states are structurally interdependent. Extending Interval Logic Tensor Networks (ILTN), tLTN grounds state predicates as fuzzy truth-value paths over time points, while events are first-class entities with learnable trapezoidal fuzzy durations and differentiable Allen-style relations. A compositional semantics fuses static, event-structural, and state-dynamic satisfaction into a single differentiable LTN grounding. Crucially, the modalities constrain each other bidirectionally: the interval layer dictates where point-wise constraints (e.g., Until, Since) are evaluated, restricting them to event-defined spans; conversely, the point-wise layer validates interval relations, rejecting them if underlying state dynamics contradict the relation. Through controlled synthetic examples, we show when single-modality learning fails and how this localization reduces frame-level computational cost on long traces.

AI.tldr: 提出tLTN，一个多排序可微神经符号框架，将事件与状态结构化关联：状态谓词为时间点上的模糊真值路径，事件为一等实体（可学习梯形模糊时长与可微Allen关系），实现点语义与区间语义的双向互约束。
AI.motivation: 动态场景中动作跨越差异极大的时间尺度（毫秒级踢球、秒级控球、多原子动作组合的长时事件），仅用视觉数据训练的模型难以跨尺度学习，缺乏在细粒度时刻与较宽区间之间推理的原则化机制。纯点语义将事件碎片化为帧级快照、丢失整体事件识别；纯区间语义把区间当作原子真值、忽略状态轨迹。
AI.method: tLTN扩展Interval Logic Tensor Networks，采用事件与状态结构相依的多排序形式逻辑。(1) 将状态谓词基底化为时间点上的模糊真值路径；(2) 将事件作为一等实体，赋予可学习梯形模糊时长和可微Allen风格区间关系；(3) 构造组合语义，将静态、事件结构性与状态动态满足度融合为单一可微LTN grounding；(4) 实现双向约束：区间层决定点式约束（Until、Since）的求值范围并限制于事件定义的时间跨度，点式层反过来校验区间关系，若底层状态动态与该关系矛盾则拒绝。
AI.result: 通过受控合成实验表明单一模态学习在何种情形下失败，并验证该定位机制可降低长轨迹上的帧级计算开销。
AI.conclusion: tLTN以统一的可微逻辑框架桥接点式与区间语义，使事件结构与状态动态相互验证，为跨时间尺度的动作理解提供了原则化、可计算的神经符号方案。

title: FinEvo: Recursive Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Financial Modeling
summary: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have expanded their role in high-value productivity tasks, including financial analysis and modeling, while enabling models to play an increasingly active role in their own improvement. This motivates two complementary lines of inquiry: can financial modeling capabilities provide a foundation for model self-evolution, and can self-evolution, in turn, advance financial capabilities? We introduce FinEvo, a self-evolution framework that integrates autonomous experience construction with financial capability improvement. FinEvo prepares financial models, iteratively evolves challenges through self-play, and learns from the resulting interactions using executable rewards, relying on the same model throughout. An end-to-end execution with Qwen3.6-27B shows that solving feedback supports both increasing reasoning demands and identifying specification issues that executable checks can miss. Learning from these experiences raises whole-task success from 22.73 to 29.09 on held-out within-source tasks and from 13.13 to 19.19 on SpreadsheetBench 2 Financial. Comparable gains across task sources and evaluation settings, together with improvement on a task category absent from training, suggest that FinEvo strengthens underlying financial modeling capabilities shared across tasks. These findings support self-evolution as a path toward broader financial competence, advancing the empirical exploration of recursive self-improvement (RSI) in professional domains. Code is available at https://github.com/pcj-sudo/FinEvo.

AI.tldr: 提出 FinEvo 自进化框架，将自主经验构建与金融建模能力提升相结合，验证自我进化可作为通向更广泛金融能力的路径。
AI.motivation: LLM 在高价值生产力任务（金融分析与建模）中的作用扩大，并越来越多参与自身改进，由此引出两个互补问题：金融建模能力能否为模型自进化提供基础；自进化能否反过来提升金融能力。
AI.method: FinEvo 框架：准备金融模型、通过 self-play 迭代演化挑战、基于可执行奖励（executable rewards）从交互中学习，全流程使用同一模型；以 Qwen3.6-27B 完成端到端执行，反馈既支持提升推理难度，也用于识别可执行校验难以发现的规格问题。
AI.result: 整任务成功率在同源留出任务上由 22.73 提升至 29.09，在 SpreadsheetBench 2 Financial 上由 13.13 提升至 19.19；跨任务来源与评估设置均取得可比增益，且在训练中未出现的任务类别上也有提升。
AI.conclusion: FinEvo 强化了跨任务共享的底层金融建模能力，支持"自进化是通向更广泛金融能力路径"的假设，推动了递归自我改进（RSI）在专业领域的实证探索。

title: Unlearning Model Identity: Ablating LoRA Weights from Question-Based Identity Tuning
summary: Large Language Models are trained on diverse corpora containing outputs from proprietary teacher models and provider-curated sources. Models subsequently inherit embedded self-identity traits, persistently asserting specific proprietary names. Service providers of open-weight models frequently require the removal of model identity for downstream applications, such as custom interfaces, without exposing provider affiliations to end-users. Effective identity modification is therefore critical for customized model alignment and deployment. This study proposes a method to localize parameter-level representations of self-identity within low-rank adaptation modules to perform targeted weight ablation. By generating probing questions designed to elicit self-naming outputs and fine-tuning the base model on these responses, the approach identifies and ablates high-magnitude weights within the parameter set. Experimental results demonstrate that distilled identity traits reside within a localized subset of low-rank weights, achieving a complete removal rate in Qwen3.5-2B and a 10% rate in Gemma4-E2B while preserving general task capabilities. These findings confirm that ablating top-tier adaptation weights suppresses distilled self-identification without compromising broader model performance.

AI.tldr: 通过在LoRA模块中定位并消融高幅值权重，可定向移除大模型蒸馏继承的自我身份标识，同时保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: 开源权重模型的下游应用方常需去除模型自报的专有身份名称，以避免向终端用户暴露提供方归属，因此需要有效的身份修改与定制化对齐手段。
AI.method: 构造能诱发自我命名输出的探测性问题，在对应回复上微调基座模型，从而在低秩适配（LoRA）模块中定位自我身份的参数级表征，并对参数集中的高幅值权重执行定向消融。
AI.result: 身份特质集中于局部一小部分低秩权重；Qwen3.5-2B达到100%移除率，Gemma4-E2B为10%，且通用任务性能得以保留。
AI.conclusion: 消融顶层适配权重可抑制蒸馏获得的自我身份识别，且不损害模型整体表现，验证了基于权重消融的身份修改可行性。

title: Agent Money Benchmark: Can AI Agents Be Trusted to Spend Money?
summary: Giving an AI agent a wallet lets it buy data and services on a client's behalf. Trust then depends on how it spends money and what that spending achieves. We introduce Agent Money Benchmark (AMB) to test whether agents spend a client's money well, starting with purchases of information for financial decisions. We link seller quotes and payments to final answers, evaluating 12 models on 80 payment tasks with simulated sellers and 76 research questions using live data. Purchases settled in USDC on Solana mainnet via x402, a protocol for paying per web request. Three of the 12 models passed 79 of 80 payment tasks without payment or budget errors. Nine fell for a seller's trap at least once; repeat charges and above-list quotes accounted for 79% of scam events. We estimate waste from data and inference costs, counting failed payment tasks in full and research answers in proportion to missed points. With spending split equally between tracks, estimated waste ranged from \$21.0 per \$100 for Claude Fable 5.2 to \$70.8 for GPT-6 Luna.

AI.tldr: 提出 Agent Money Benchmark (AMB)，通过在 Solana 主网上以 USDC/x402 真实结算，评估 AI 智能体是否"把钱花得好"，涵盖支付任务与信息购买研究任务。
AI.motivation: 赋予智能体钱包后，其可信度取决于花钱方式与所获结果，但此前缺乏同时衡量支付正确性与购买收益的基准，因此需要一个端到端基准来检验智能体的资金使用效率。
AI.method: 构建 AMB：将卖家报价与支付记录链接到最终答案；12 个模型在 80 个模拟卖家支付任务和 76 个使用实时数据的研究问题上评测；支付通过 x402 协议（按网页请求付费）在 Solana 主网以 USDC 结算；以失败支付任务全额计费、研究答案按失分比例计算数据与推理成本浪费。
AI.result: 12 个模型中 3 个在 80 个支付任务中通过 79 项且无支付或预算错误；9 个模型至少一次落入卖家陷阱，重复扣费与高于标价的报价占诈骗事件的 79%；在两条赛道各占一半支出的设定下，估算浪费从 Claude Fable 5.2 的每 100 美元 21.0 美元到 GPT-6 Luna 的 70.8 美元。
AI.conclusion: 智能体的"花钱能力"存在显著差异与安全脆弱性（对陷阱和超额报价缺乏防御），AMB 提供了可量化的浪费度量，可将资金效率作为智能体评测的关键维度。

title: From atomic events to material degradation across metre and year scales
summary: Material degradation emerges from microscopic events whose consequences accumulate over years, yet mechanism-resolved simulations remain confined below engineering timescales. The challenge is not just the sheer number of events: atomistic evolution is dominated by recurrent local motion, with only a tiny fraction driving lasting structural change. This distinction is not encoded in an instantaneous atomic configuration. Locally indistinguishable states can exhibit different event competition, escape times, and long-horizon outcomes, revealing missing kinetic context as a critical information bottleneck. This context spans space and time: the future consequence of a local transition depends on its surrounding defect environment and the kinetic history leading to its current state. To solve this, AtomWorld reconstructs a predictive kinetic state from multiscale structural observations and trajectory history, distinguishing transient fluctuations from microscopic pathways that drive persistent structural evolution. Learning operates only over transitions admitted by the underlying kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) process, preserving event legality, state evolution, and physical time. Across BCC Fe-Cu precipitation, FCC Ni-Cr-Al ordering, and HCP Zr-H interstitial transport, restoring kinetic context consistently advances persistent evolution while maintaining physical fidelity and transferring to unseen conditions. In irradiated reactor-pressure-vessel steel, this approach achieves up to 420-fold greater persistent evolution under matched event budgets. Combined with scalable execution, it successfully extends mechanism-resolved trajectories to service-year timescales across metre-scale heterogeneous domains.

AI.tldr: AtomWorld从多尺度结构观测与轨迹历史中重建预测性动力学状态，区分瞬态涨落与驱动持久结构演化的微观路径，在KMC约束下学习，将机理分辨模拟拓展至服役年尺度。
AI.motivation: 材料退化源于微观事件的长期累积，但机理分辨模拟受限于远低于工程时间尺度的可达范围。瓶颈不仅在事件数量巨大，更在于瞬时原子构型中不包含"动力学上下文"：局域不可区分的状态可能具有不同的事件竞争、逃逸时间与长时程结局，其行为依赖周围缺陷环境与到达该状态的动力学历史，构成关键信息瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建AtomWorld模型，将多尺度结构观测与轨迹历史结合，重建预测性动力学状态表示，从而区分瞬态涨落与驱动持久演化的微观通路。学习仅在底层动力学蒙特卡洛（KMC）过程允许的跃迁上展开，保证事件合法性、状态演化一致性与物理时间对应；并配合可扩展执行方式，用于大尺度异质域的长时程推演。
AI.result: 在BCC Fe-Cu析出、FCC Ni-Cr-Al有序化与HCP Zr-H间隙输运三类体系中，恢复动力学上下文一致地促进了持久演化，同时保持物理保真度并可迁移至未见条件。在辐照反应堆压力容器钢中，在相同事件预算下实现最高约420倍的持久演化提升；结合可扩展执行，成功将机理分辨轨迹延伸至服役年尺度、覆盖米级异质区域。
AI.conclusion: 动力学上下文是制约微观机理模拟跨越时间尺度的核心瓶颈；通过KMC约束下的动力学状态重建，可在不牺牲物理一致性的前提下大幅提升有效演化效率与可迁移性，为材料长期退化预测提供可行途径。

title: ESM-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Whether AI Agents Understand Earth System Model Physics and Code
summary: AI coding agents that modify Earth System Model (ESM) code must preserve both software interfaces and the physical assumptions encoded in them. We introduce ESM-Bench, a benchmark of 60 developer-commit tasks from 6 repositories: Noah-MP, CLM5, SUMMA, ParFlow, MOM6, and VIC. The v5 corpus contains 17 physics-based bug fixes, 16 process-representation modifications, 13 parameterization-scheme selections, and 14 parameter-optimization tasks. Each task includes a scientific objective, parent-commit source files, a reference diff, and three stored prompt variants. An artifact audit confirms that all 60 reference diffs apply to their supplied starting files. We define an eight-item patch-review rubric and audit five archived patch fixtures against the implemented local checkers. None of the five fixture diffs applies to its supplied starting files, yet three text-pattern checkers return a pass. A ParFlow expression replay disagrees with the reference slopes, and a MOM6 pattern check detects an omitted update. Inspection also identifies a retained VIC reference assignment that overwrites the intended vegetation-specific albedo. These findings expose limits of reference patches and local proxies as correctness evidence. The release provides a reproducible corpus and diagnostic tools; complete expert validation, comparative agent performance, and full-model execution remain unmeasured on v5.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ESM-Bench，一个面向地球系统模式（ESM）代码修改的 AI 编码智能体基准，涵盖 6 个仓库的 60 个开发者提交任务，并通过人工审查与本地检查器揭示参考补丁与文本代理检查作为正确性证据的局限。
AI.motivation: AI 编码智能体在修改 ESM 代码时，不仅要保持软件接口，还要保持接口中隐含的物理假设；现有基准缺少针对这一双重约束的评测数据与诊断工具。
AI.method: 从 Noah-MP、CLM5、SUMMA、ParFlow、MOM6、VIC 六个仓库构建 60 个开发者提交任务（v5 语料含 17 个物理类 bug 修复、16 个过程表征修改、13 个参数化方案选择、14 个参数优化任务），每个任务包含科学目标、父提交源文件、参考 diff 和三种提示变体；开展产物审计，定义八项补丁审查量表，并用已实现的本地检查器审计五个存档补丁样例（含 ParFlow 表达式重放、MOM6 模式检查、VIC 人工检查）。
AI.result: 产物审计确认全部 60 个参考 diff 均可应用于其提供的起始文件；但五个样例 diff 均无法应用，其中三个纯文本模式检查器仍返回通过；ParFlow 表达式重放结果与参考斜率不一致，MOM6 模式检查发现遗漏的更新，人工检查还发现一处保留的 VIC 参考赋值会覆盖目标植被特异反照率。
AI.conclusion: 参考补丁与基于文本的本地代理检查不足以作为正确性证据，需结合物理语义层面的验证；v5 版本尚未完成专家全面验证、智能体性能对比和全模式运行，这些仍属未测量项。

title: DeCo: Decoupled Traffic State Modeling with Cross-Variable Coordination
summary: Accurate forecasts of traffic flow, occupancy, and speed are essential for congestion management and travel planning. These variables exhibit distinct spatiotemporal patterns, and their coupled dynamics characterize the evolution of traffic conditions, such as the onset and dissipation of congestion. Existing methods often either neglect this coupling or struggle to capture the distinct dynamics of all three variables within a unified model. In this paper, we propose DeCo, a decoupled traffic state modeling framework with cross-variable coordination for forecasting flow, occupancy, and speed. Specifically, DeCo first trains a dedicated forecaster for each variable to specialize in its unique spatiotemporal dynamics. It then estimates a residual correction for each forecast by jointly leveraging the predicted trajectories and recent observations of all three variables, thereby exploiting cross-variable coupling and mitigating systematic prediction errors. We extend the flow-only PeMS03 and PeMS07 benchmarks to all three variables on their original sensors and release the aligned data. Experiments on PeMS03, PeMS04, PeMS07, and PeMS08 show that DeCo achieves the lowest mean absolute error for every variable on every dataset, up to 4.9% below RAGC, the strongest baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/lixus7/DeCo.

AI.tldr: 提出DeCo解耦式交通状态建模框架，先为流量、占有率、速度各训练专用预测器，再用跨变量协调估计残差修正，在四个PeMS数据集上对每个变量均取得最低MAE。
AI.motivation: 交通流、占有率与速度呈现各自不同的时空模式，其耦合动态刻画拥堵的发生与消散；现有方法要么忽略这种耦合，要么难以在统一模型中同时刻画三者的差异化动态。
AI.method: DeCo采用两阶段解耦建模：第一步为每个变量训练独立预测器以专注其独特时空动态；第二步利用三变量的预测轨迹与近期观测联合估计残差修正，从而挖掘跨变量耦合、缓解系统性预测误差。
AI.result: 将仅含流量的PeMS03、PeMS07基准扩展到原始传感器上的三变量并对齐数据；在PeMS03、PeMS04、PeMS07、PeMS08上，DeCo对每个变量、每个数据集均取得最低MAE，最高较最强基线RAGC降低4.9%。
AI.conclusion: 解耦专业化预测加跨变量残差修正，是兼顾变量特异性与耦合关系的有效建模范式，并提供了三变量对齐基准与开源代码。

title: Semantic repeatability and reproducibility of GPT-5 and Gemini 3 Flash on H5N1 One Health questions
summary: Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) has re-emerged as a One Health concern since 2024, and the public is increasingly consulting large-language-model (LLM) chatbots for health information during outbreaks. Before a chatbot's accuracy can be meaningfully assessed, its consistency must first be understood, so that any single response can be trusted as a fair representative of the model's behavior. We characterized the semantic repeatability and reproducibility of GPT-5 (OpenAI) and Gemini 3 Flash (Google) on 15 H5N1 One Health questions sourced from social media discourse by adopting and extending a centroid-based evaluation framework. Each question was submitted 30 times and reformulated using five Chain-of-Thought (CoT) variants with 30 runs each, yielding 5,400 responses. Pairwise cosine similarity was computed on MPNet embeddings, with sensitivity analyses across three additional transformers. Statistical inference combined standard nonparametric tests (paired Wilcoxon and Friedman with Holm--Bonferroni correction) with inter-embedding agreement statistics (ICC(2,k) and Cronbach's $α$) introduced here as a methodological addition. Both models produced high mean consistency (0.93--0.97, rescaled to {[}0, 1{]}). GPT-5 showed reproducibility significantly higher than repeatability (W = 3.0, p = 0.0003), whereas for Gemini 3 Flash the two metrics were statistically indistinguishable (W = 42.0, p = 0.33). Differential Diagnosis ranked among the top two CoT framings for consistency in both models. The tested chatbots behave as semantically stable sources on H5N1 One Health questions, and the developed consistency evaluation framework is portable to other domains.

AI.tldr: 研究采用质心（centroid）嵌入评估框架，对GPT-5与Gemini 3 Flash在15个H5N1 One Health问题上的语义可重复性与可复现性进行刻画，共生成5,400条回答；两模型一致性均高（0.93–0.97），GPT-5的可复现性显著高于可重复性，Gemini 3 Flash两者无显著差异，且Differential Diagnosis（鉴别诊断）式CoT框架在一致性上表现最佳。
AI.motivation: H5N1自2024年再度成为One Health关注点，公众在疫情暴发期间越来越多地向大语言模型聊天机器人咨询健康信息。作者认为，在评估聊天机器人的准确性之前，必须先理解其一致性，这样任何单次回答才能被视为模型行为的公平代表。
AI.method: 从社交媒体话语中采集15个H5N1 One Health问题；每个问题直接提交30次，并以5种Chain-of-Thought（CoT）变体重述，每种30次运行，共获得5,400条回答。对MPNet嵌入计算成对余弦相似度，并在另外三个transformer上做敏感性分析。统计推断结合配对Wilcoxon检验与带Holm–Bonferroni校正的Friedman检验，并引入嵌入间一致性统计量ICC(2,k)与Cronbach's α作为方法学补充。
AI.result: 两模型平均一致性均高（0.93–0.97，重标度至[0,1]）。GPT-5的可复现性显著高于可重复性（W=3.0，p=0.0003）；Gemini 3 Flash的两项指标无统计学差异（W=42.0，p=0.33）。在一致性方面，Differential Diagnosis框架在两个模型中均位列前二。
AI.conclusion: 所测试的聊天机器人在H5N1 One Health问题上表现为语义稳定的信息源；所开发的一致性评估框架可迁移至其他领域。

title: Categorical Foundations of AI Agents
summary: We follow the idea of separating intelligence from execution and give the categorical foundations of AI agents: the transformers, the agents, and the orchestrations and choreographies of AI agents are categorized, and which also include their coalgebras and algebras.

AI.tldr: 本文以"智能与执行相分离"为出发点，为AI智能体建立范畴论基础：将Transformer、智能体以及多智能体的编排（orchestration）与协同（choreography）分别范畴化，并给出其对应的余代数与代数结构。
AI.motivation: 现有AI智能体（尤其是基于Transformer的大模型智能体及多智能体系统）多为工程化实现，缺乏统一的数学形式化描述。作者受"智能与执行分离"思想启发，希望借助范畴论为智能体及其组合方式提供严格的抽象基础。
AI.method: 采用范畴论方法：将Transformer视为一类范畴对象/态射；将智能体范畴化以刻画其状态与交互；进一步对多智能体的编排（orchestration）与协同（choreography）建模为范畴结构，并为其分别构造余代数（coalgebra，刻画状态转移与观测）与代数（algebra，刻画组合与合成）表示。
AI.result: 摘要仅给出框架性结论：Transformer、智能体、编排与协同均获得了范畴化的统一表述，且各自具备相应的余代数与代数结构；但未提供具体定理、案例或实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了AI智能体的范畴论基础，为"智能—执行分离"下的智能体建模与多智能体组合提供了形式化语言；后续需补充具体的数学定理、实例（如具体Transformer架构的范畴表示）与实际智能体系统的对应验证。

title: Reward Blindness: A Theoretical Framework for Diagnosing Reinforcement Learning Reward Limitations in Text-to-SQL
summary: Text-to-SQL systems let users without programming expertise query relational databases in natural language. Reinforcement learning has become the dominant way to train such systems, yet progress is still judged by a single number, execution accuracy, which counts correct queries but says nothing about which kinds of semantic error survive training. This paper develops a theoretical framework that examines text-to-SQL from the perspective of reward design. We introduce Reward Error Sensitivity, a measure of how strongly a reward function separates queries that contain a given error type from queries that do not, and prove a Reward Blindness theorem: when this sensitivity is zero, policy-gradient training carries no systematic signal for removing that error. Using fourteen published finegrained error signals for four text-to-SQL systems on the BIRD benchmark, we build error profiles and estimate sensitivities for common reward designs. Predicate and result-level errors are the most frequent, firing on up to 27 percent of queries, while structurally deep errors such as suboptimal joins persist at 5 to 12 percent. Each reward family has a distinct and predictable set of blind spots, and inexpensive database-level checks that need no language model calls detect 45 to 60 percent of semantic errors. Controlled training simulations confirm that executiononly reward leaves output-preserving errors untouched, whereas a signal-grounded reward removes them even when the detectors are noisy.

AI.tldr: 论文从奖励设计视角提出"奖励误差敏感性"度量与"奖励盲区定理"，证明当奖励对某类语义错误的敏感性为零时策略梯度训练缺乏消除该错误的系统信号；在BIRD基准上用14种细粒度错误信号刻画4个系统的错误画像，发现谓词级与结果级错误最频繁（可达27%），各奖励族有可预测盲区，无需LLM的廉价数据库级检查可检出45–60%的语义错误。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL强化学习训练仅用单一执行准确率（execution accuracy）评价，无法揭示训练后哪些类型的语义错误仍然残留，缺乏对奖励函数本身性质的理论刻画。
AI.method: 提出理论框架：定义奖励误差敏感性（Reward Error Sensitivity），衡量奖励函数对含特定错误类型查询与不含该错误查询的区分强度；证明奖励盲区定理（Reward Blindness theorem）。在BIRD基准上，对4个Text-to-SQL系统使用14种已发表的细粒度错误信号构建错误画像并估计常见奖励设计的敏感性，并进行受控训练仿真。
AI.result: 谓词与结果级错误最频繁，最高出现在27%的查询上；结构深层错误（如次优join）持续存在于5%–12%；每类奖励族具有明确且可预测的盲区；无需语言模型调用的廉价数据库级检查可检出45%–60%的语义错误；仿真显示仅执行准确率奖励无法纠正输出保持型错误，而信号锚定的奖励即使检测器含噪声也能将其消除。
AI.conclusion: 单一执行准确率不足以反映训练对语义错误的消除能力；奖励设计的敏感性决定可学习到的错误类型，应引入细粒度、信号锚定的奖励与低成本数据库级检查，以系统性消除语义错误。

title: Second-Order Dynamics in Noisy RNNs Produce Exploration and Temporal Compression in Replay
summary: Biological neural networks (like the hippocampus) can internally generate "replay" resembling stimulus-driven activity. Recent computational models of replay use noisy recurrent neural networks (RNNs) trained to path-integrate. Replay in these networks is described as Langevin sampling, but this theory alone fails to capture the environmental exploration and temporal compression observed in real biological replay. To close this gap, we re-examine spontaneous noisy RNN activity ("replay") as Langevin sampling, one timestep at a time, from a time-series distribution resembling lived experiences (unlike previous works which defined sampling as Monte Carlo inference over a static distribution). We provide a normative second-order Langevin sampling framework wherein spike-frequency adaptation drives spatial exploration at the cost of speed, and momentum via dendritic input differentiation drives temporal compression. We numerically verify our framework via simulations of noisy RNNs trained on 2D triangular and T-maze navigation activity, and others trained on place cell activity of synthetic rats. Crucially, we observe that simultaneous adaptation and momentum increases both replay exploration and speed, and provide one of the first accounts for biologically plausible temporal compression in rate-based RNN replay. Our findings encourage experiments into whether dendritic input differentiation, or other mechanisms, may support temporal compression in memory circuits like the hippocampus.

AI.tldr: 该文将噪声RNN中的自发"回放"重新诠释为沿类经历时间序列分布的逐时刻Langevin采样，提出二阶Langevin框架，用脉冲频率适应解释空间探索、用树突输入微分（动量）解释时间压缩，并在三角/T迷宫及位置细胞数据上数值验证。
AI.motivation: 现有基于噪声RNN的回放模型仅用Langevin采样解释，视其为对静态分布的蒙特卡洛推断，无法解释生物回放中的环境探索性与时间压缩现象，因此需要一个能同时刻画二者的规范理论框架。
AI.method: 把自发噪声RNN活动视为从类似真实经历的时间序列分布中逐时间步的Langevin采样；构建二阶Langevin采样框架：脉冲频率适应（spike-frequency adaptation）驱动空间探索但牺牲速度，树突输入微分产生的动量驱动时间压缩；在训练于二维三角迷宫、T迷宫导航活动及合成大鼠位置细胞活动的噪声RNN上进行数值仿真验证。
AI.result: 仿真表明该框架可复现回放特性；关键在于适应与动量同时存在时，回放的探索性与速度同时提升，并首次为基于速率型RNN的回放提供了生物学合理的时间压缩解释。
AI.conclusion: 二阶Langevin框架统一解释了回放中的探索与时间压缩；建议实验检验树突输入微分或其他机制是否在海马等记忆环路中支持时间压缩。

title: Layer-Level Control of Language Model Execution in Agent Frameworks
summary: Agent frameworks typically orchestrate language models through prompt-and-response interfaces. We propose a harness design that exposes intermediate model states and layer-level execution controls to the agent runtime. By connecting state collection, policy fitting, and execution, the design enables policies to allocate computation within and across models based on intermediate states. We demonstrate the approach with a prototype that learns stitching bridges and state-conditioned execution policies from paired model states, then applies them during inference to select among continue, exit, and stitch. For dispatcher supervision, we select the least-computation action whose full-vocabulary next-token prediction matches the source model's full-depth prediction, using continue when neither early action matches. We train these components on a frozen proxy corpus of 5,000 typed-decision items authored using source texts sampled from WildChat conversations, then evaluate the prototype on JevBench measuring task accuracy, agreement with full-model predictions, and end-to-end latency including runtime overhead. Preliminary results show an approximately 15% reduction in mean latency while maintaining task accuracy comparable to full-model inference.

AI.tldr: 提出一种向智能体运行时暴露模型中间状态与层级执行控制的"harness"设计，使策略能依据中间状态在模型内部及模型之间分配计算量；原型通过"继续/退出/拼接"三类动作实现约15%平均延迟降低且保持任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体框架多以"提示—响应"接口编排语言模型，运行时无法观测中间状态，也无法控制层级执行，因而难以按需动态分配计算资源。
AI.method: 设计暴露中间状态与层级执行控制的harness，串联状态采集、策略拟合与执行；原型从成对模型状态中学习"拼接桥接"与状态条件执行策略，推理时在continue、exit、stitch中选择；调度器监督采用"最小计算且全词表下一token预测与源模型全深度预测一致"的动作，均不匹配时用continue；在5000条由WildChat对话采样的源文本构造的冻结代理语料上训练，并在JevBench上评测。
AI.result: 在JevBench上以任务准确率、与全模型预测的一致性及含运行时开销的端到端延迟为指标，初步结果显示平均延迟约降低15%，任务准确率与全模型推理相当。
AI.conclusion: 将中间状态与层级执行控制显式暴露给运行时，可支持状态驱动的计算分配策略，在几乎不损准确率的前提下降低延迟；但结果为初步原型阶段，仍需更广泛验证。

title: MH-RAG-DIVE: Dynamic and Cost-Efficient Multi-Hop RAG Evaluation via Tree-Cached Dialogue Simulation
comment: This preprint was accepted for presentation at the 19th International Conference on Agents and Artificial Intelligence (ICAART27)
summary: Quality assessment is essential for determining whether changes to a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system improve or maintain its performance. However, existing evaluation approaches often rely on single-turn or single-hop interactions and therefore do not capture the complexity of multi-hop, multi-turn conversations. We introduce MH-RAG-DIVE, a dynamic interactive user simulation framework designed to evaluate RAG systems in more complex multi-hop and multi-turn settings. The framework extends RAG-DIVE with a Context Discoverer, which identifies documents that can be combined to generate multi-hop questions within an ongoing conversation. To address the high computational cost of dynamic user simulation, we further introduce a Conversation Cacher, which reuses turns from previous evaluation runs while preserving the dynamic nature of the evaluation. We evaluate the framework across six distinct RAG configurations and compare its results with the original RAG-DIVE evaluation and the static, human-created CLAPNQ dataset. Our experiments show consistent performance trends across the evaluation approaches, while the more complex multi-hop and multi-turn setting exposes additional challenges for RAG systems. Furthermore, the Conversation Cacher substantially reduces token consumption, demonstrating its potential to make dynamic evaluation more cost-efficient. Finally, we apply MH-RAG-DIVE to an industrial RAG system with domain-specific data, demonstrating its applicability to real-world evaluation scenarios. Overall, our results show that the proposed approach provides a more complex and cost-efficient framework for evaluating RAG systems. All code and experimental data are publicly available in our GitHub repository (https://github.com/Daniel-Innsbruck/MH-RAG-DIVE).

AI.tldr: 提出MH-RAG-DIVE，一个面向多跳、多轮对话场景的RAG系统动态交互式用户模拟评估框架，并引入Conversation Cacher降低评估成本。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG质量评估多依赖单轮或单跳交互，无法刻画多跳、多轮对话的复杂性，难以判断系统改动是否真正提升或维持性能。
AI.method: 在RAG-DIVE基础上扩展：加入Context Discoverer，在持续对话中识别可组合生成多跳问题的文档；加入Conversation Cacher，复用以往评估运行的对话轮次，在保持动态性的同时降低开销。在6种RAG配置上，与原始RAG-DIVE及静态人工构建的CLAPNQ数据集对比，并应用于工业级领域数据RAG系统。
AI.result: 各评估方法呈现一致的性能趋势；更复杂的多跳多轮设置暴露出RAG系统的额外挑战；Conversation Cacher显著降低token消耗；框架成功应用于工业领域数据场景。
AI.conclusion: MH-RAG-DIVE提供了更复杂且更具成本效益的RAG评估框架，代码与实验数据已开源。

title: Could This BE Any More Wrong? Teaching VLMs to Know What They Don't Know in Document Extraction
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, 10 tables. Accepted at the AI4Finance Summit at ICAIF '26 (7th ACM International Conference on AI in Finance), Milan, Italy. An extended version with a revised experimental protocol will follow
summary: Vision-Language Models can extract structured fields from scanned financial documents, yet they provide no indication of when a field might be wrong. We derive per-field confidence estimates from the token log-probabilities the model already produces, via a token-to-span alignment procedure that maps logprobs onto each extracted value within the structured JSON output. Evaluated on two benchmarks (CORD v2 receipts, Kleister NDA legal contracts) with three VLM families, the minimum token probability per field achieves Area Under the ROC Curve (AUROC) 0.74-0.91 for error detection, far exceeding verbalized confidence (0.53-0.56). The uncertain fields form a natural training curriculum: fine-tuning via Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) improves accuracy from 78.5% to 87.5% on CORD (67 examples) and from 70.7% to 75.1% on multi-page NDA contracts (259 examples), while substantially improving error detection on Kleister NDA (AUROC 0.70 to 0.85, Area Under the Accuracy-Rejection Curve (AUARC) 0.78 to 0.92). The loop requires no annotation beyond the training-split ground truth, demonstrating that confidence-guided curriculum selection transfers to complex multi-page documents when combined with native multi-image training. A frontier model (Claude Sonnet 4) used as a pseudo-label judge achieves ~92% reward agreement with ground truth on both benchmarks, suggesting this loop can operate without human annotation.

AI.tldr: 从VLM已有的token对数概率中提取字段级置信度，用于错误检测并驱动GRPO课程学习。
AI.motivation: VLM可从扫描财务文档中抽取结构化字段，但不提示哪些字段可能出错；同时依赖人工标注的成本高。
AI.method: 提出token-to-span对齐，将token logprob映射到结构化JSON的每个字段值，取字段内最小token概率作为置信度；将不确定字段构成课程，用GRPO微调。
AI.result: CORD v2与Kleister NDA上三族VLM：最小token概率AUROC 0.74–0.91，远超语言化置信度0.53–0.56；GRPO使CORD准确率78.5%→87.5%（67例）、多页NDA 70.7%→75.1%（259例），Kleister NDA错误检测AUROC 0.70→0.85、AUARC 0.78→0.92；Claude Sonnet 4作伪标签评判者与真值奖励一致率约92%。
AI.conclusion: 置信度引导的课程选择结合原生多图训练可迁移到复杂多页文档，且除训练集真值外无需额外标注，伪标签评判者提示可免除人工标注。

title: When Do Better Visual World Models Make Better Plans? Decision-Aligned Selection for Latent Planning
comment: Supplementary material will be included in the next version
summary: Visual world models enable goal-conditioned planning by predicting the outcomes of candidate actions in latent space. However, planning depends on how well a model ranks candidates, whereas training optimizes how accurately it predicts each one. We identify the Decision-Relevant Residual (DRR), the part of the cost error that can reorder candidates, and show that the more training reduces the DRR, the more it improves selection (Spearman $ρ= 0.82$, vs. $0.61$ for prediction error). Building on this insight, we introduce Decision-Aligned Selection (DAS), a plug-in selection rule that scores candidates by the standardized consensus of several independently trained checkpoints, which averages out their checkpoint-specific residuals. Across two model families (LeWorldModel and DINO-WM) and five tasks, DAS selects better actions than single checkpoints in 12 of 18 configurations and outperforms training one model three times longer in 14 of 18. In closed loop, DAS improves success over single checkpoints in 6 of 9 pre-registered LeWM comparisons.

AI.tldr: 论文指出视觉世界模型训练优化的是预测精度，而规划依赖候选排序，二者不一致；为此提出"决策相关残差(DRR)"刻画能改变候选顺序的误差成分，并据此提出DAS选择规则——用多个独立训练检查点的标准化共识打分，从而在多数配置中提升动作选择与闭环成功率。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界模型通过潜在空间预测候选动作结果来做目标条件规划，但规划效果取决于模型对候选的排序能力，而训练目标优化的是每个候选的预测精度，二者存在错配。作者希望找出误差中真正影响排序的部分，并据此改进选择。
AI.method: 1) 定义决策相关残差DRR：代价误差中可能导致候选重新排序的部分，并分析其与选择质量的相关性；2) 提出Decision-Aligned Selection (DAS)：一种即插即用的选择规则，对多个独立训练的检查点进行标准化共识打分，以抵消各检查点特有的残差。
AI.result: DRR降低与选择改善的相关性为Spearman ρ=0.82，高于预测误差的0.61；在LeWorldModel与DINO-WM两个模型族、五个任务上，DAS在18个配置中的12个优于单检查点，在18个中的14个优于将单模型训练时长增至三倍；闭环实验中，在9个预注册LeWM比较中的6个提升成功率。
AI.conclusion: 规划质量应直接以排序/决策对齐为目标来度量与优化；DRR是更贴合决策的误差指标，DAS作为无需重训练的集成式选择规则可有效提升候选选择与闭环性能。

title: STRIDE: Strategy-to-Tactics Retrieval-Guided Skill Disclosure and Evolution for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Skill-augmented reinforcement learning enables LLM agents to reuse task-solving knowledge across episodes, but existing systems typically expose agents to a flat skill pool and update skills only from coarse, episode-level outcomes. This conflates two distinct uses of experience: a stable strategy that should frame the whole episode, and tactical know-how that should be retrieved only when the agent reaches a local execution gap. We propose STRIDE (Strategy-to-Tactics Retrieval-guided skIll Disclosure and Evolution), a framework that brings progressive skill disclosure into agentic reinforcement learning. STRIDE keeps the selected strategy visible as episode context, exposes a compact tactic menu, and loads full tactic content only after an explicit retrieval action. This interface turns each retrieval into an event-level credit unit: the same event provides process feedback for learning when to retrieve and supplies evidence for skill-bank evolution. On ALFWorld, STRIDE achieves a 92.7% average success rate with Qwen3-4B and a 94.9% average success rate with Qwen3-8B. On WebShop, it improves over the strongest reproduced skill-augmented baseline by 4.5 score points and 1.9 success-rate percentage points. These results show that skill reuse is most effective when persistent strategies preserve global task structure and tactics are disclosed only at local decision bottlenecks.

AI.tldr: STRIDE将渐进式技能披露引入智能体强化学习，区分全程可见的策略与按需检索的战术，并把每次检索作为事件级信用单元用于学习与技能库演化，在ALFWorld与WebShop上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有技能增强强化学习系统将技能以扁平技能池形式暴露给智能体，且仅依据粗粒度的回合级结果更新技能，混淆了两类经验用途：应框定整个回合的稳定策略，以及仅在局部执行缺口时调用的战术性知识。
AI.method: 提出STRIDE框架：选定的策略作为回合上下文持续可见；仅暴露精简的战术菜单；只有在显式检索动作后才加载完整战术内容。该接口将每次检索转为事件级信用单元，同一事件既提供"何时检索"的过程反馈用于学习，又为技能库演化提供证据。
AI.result: ALFWorld上Qwen3-4B平均成功率92.7%，Qwen3-8B达94.9%；WebShop上相较最强复现技能增强基线提升4.5分值和1.9个百分点成功率。
AI.conclusion: 当持久策略保留全局任务结构、战术仅在局部决策瓶颈处披露时，技能复用最为有效。

title: Memphis: A Case Study in Seeding an Agent Task from a Model's Real-World Attempt
comment: 23 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Task, code, trials and data: https://github.com/ia03/memphis-task
summary: Agent benchmarks are usually made harder by scaling up the data their tasks are built from, yet models that do well on them still fail at real work. We propose building simulated tasks from a model's own attempt at an open-ended task in the real world, so that the model's failures in the simulation resemble its failures in reality. As a case study, we had GPT-6.1 Sol manage two human workers in Cairo over chat for five shifts, with a budget of 7,000 Egyptian pounds, to build as many USB desk lamps as it could. It built two. From the real-world attempt's transcript, we build Memphis, an evaluation in a model-simulated world. Memphis is hard: GPT-6.1 Sol delivers 1.0 lamp per trial on average and repeats its real-world mistakes, buying too few stands and giving up the search for them. With a one-page hint on where to buy parts and who can wire them, it delivers 9.2. Claude Opus 5.5 delivers 2.2 without the hint and 4.6 with it. We release the task, the trials, the audits, and a redacted record of the real-world evaluation.

AI.tldr: 从模型自身在真实开放任务中的失败轨迹出发构建仿真基准，使仿真中的失败与真实失败对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准主要靠扩大数据规模提升难度，但与真实工作能力脱节：高分模型在现实中仍失败。作者希望基准难度来自任务本身的开放性而非数据量。
AI.method: 案例研究：让 GPT-6.1 Sol 通过聊天管理两名开罗工人、预算 7,000 埃及镑、历时五个班次制作 USB 台灯（实际只做出 2 个）；基于该真实尝试的对话记录构建模型仿真世界中的评测 Memphis。
AI.result: Memphis 很难：GPT-6.1 Sol 平均每次试验交付 1.0 盏灯，并复现现实中的错误（支架买太少、放弃寻找）；给一页提示（去哪买零件、谁能接线）后提升至 9.2 盏。Claude Opus 5.5 无提示 2.2、有提示 4.6。
AI.conclusion: 基于真实失败轨迹构建的仿真基准能忠实复现模型缺陷，且对提示高度敏感，可作为难度真实、可诊断的智能体评测范式；并公开任务、试验、审计与脱敏的真实评测记录。

title: TamperCert: A Benchmark for Detecting Text Tampering in Degree Certificates
summary: Degree certificates play a critical role in high-stakes decisions such as university admission, immigration, and hiring. The issuing institution vouches for the holder, so a forged certificate may let its bearer pass these checks. Degree certificate forgery is increasingly prevalent. Yet, many assume that it is easy to spot. Reported cases show otherwise: in 2024, the business school of the University of Hong Kong found that about 30 master's students had enrolled with forged academic credentials. Few studies have looked at how to detect forged degree certificates, partly because public benchmarks are scarce. We present TamperCert, a benchmark built from 400 real degree certificates issued by 38 universities. Each certificate was subjected to 11 publicly available tampering methods to alter the holder's name and further processed with four additional post-processing techniques, resulting in over 20,000 forged images. We evaluate 13 detectors, a commercial multimodal large language model (MLLM), and detectors trained on TamperCert.Our findings reveal that no detector is reliable for every tampering method. Consequently, a determined forger may still evade detection. Moreover, the commercial MLLM misses most forgeries made by general-purpose generative models, and post-processing, such as resizing an image or photographing it with a camera, severely degrades detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TamperCert —— 一个基于 38 所高校 400 份真实学位证书、经 11 种篡改方法与 4 种后处理生成的逾 2 万张伪造图像的基准，评估了 13 种检测器与一个商用 MLLM，发现无单一检测器对所有篡改手段可靠，后处理会严重削弱检测性能。
AI.motivation: 学位证书在学校录取、移民、招聘等高风险决策中具有凭证作用，伪造现象日益普遍（如 2024 年香港大学商学院约 30 名硕士生持伪造学历入学），但检测研究稀少，主要障碍是缺乏公开基准数据集。
AI.method: 构建 TamperCert 基准：采集 38 所大学签发的 400 份真实学位证书，对每份证书的持有人姓名施加 11 种公开可得的篡改方法，并进一步使用 4 种后处理技术，共生成 2 万余张伪造图像；在此基础上评测 13 种检测器、1 个商用多模态大模型（MLLM）以及在 TamperCert 上训练后的检测器。
AI.result: 没有任何检测器能对所有篡改方法保持可靠，有决心的伪造者仍可规避检测；商用 MLLM 对通用生成模型产生的伪造大多漏检；缩放图像、用相机翻拍等后处理会严重降低检测效果。
AI.conclusion: 现有学位证书伪造检测方法尚不足以应对真实场景，亟需更鲁棒的检测技术与公开基准；TamperCert 为该方向提供了可复现的评测平台，并揭示后处理鲁棒性与跨篡改方法泛化是未来关键挑战。

title: RadioWorld: Transferring World Models to Radio-Frequency Radiance Fields
summary: Electromagnetic (EM) wave propagation in the physical world constitutes a Radio-Frequency (RF) radiance field, providing rich information for 6G communication and sensing. However, existing neural RF field methods suffer from three fundamental limitations: (1) they predominantly rely on per-scene optimization and cannot generalize to unseen scenes; (2) they require costly reference RF measurements in each target scene; and (3) they degrade severely when extrapolating beyond the vicinity of reference measurements. To overcome these limitations, we present RadioWorld, a general framework that adapts a world model to synthesize RF radiance fields directly from physical scene geometry and transceiver locations, without requiring any reference RF measurements at inference. Specifically, RadioWorld couples two specialized modules within a dual-stream Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture: a Scene-Understanding Transformer that encodes 3D scene geometry and transceiver locations to extract environment-aware global EM propagation features, and a Field-Generation Transformer that attends to these features to synthesize the RF radiance field with the local query conditions. We also establish UrbanRF-Bench, a large-scale ray-traced benchmark spanning 657 urban scenes and 32,850 RF radiance fields across seven global cities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RadioWorld significantly outperforms specialized baselines and accurately synthesizes RF fields at arbitrary locations in unseen cities. Code, datasets, and checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出RadioWorld，用世界模型从场景几何与收发机位置直接合成RF辐射场，无需参考测量即可泛化到未见场景与城市。
AI.motivation: 现有神经RF场方法存在三重局限：依赖逐场景优化、无法泛化到未见场景；每个目标场景需昂贵参考RF测量；在参考测量范围外推时性能急剧下降。因此需要一种可从物理场景几何直接、免测量地生成RF辐射场的通用框架。
AI.method: RadioWorld采用双流Mixture-of-Transformers（MoT）架构，耦合两个专用模块：Scene-Understanding Transformer编码3D场景几何与收发机位置，提取环境感知的全局EM传播特征；Field-Generation Transformer以该特征为条件，结合局部查询条件合成RF辐射场。同时构建UrbanRF-Bench大规模射线追踪基准，覆盖7个全球城市、657个城市场景、32,850个RF辐射场。
AI.result: 大量实验表明RadioWorld显著优于专用基线方法，并能在未见城市中对任意位置准确合成RF场。
AI.conclusion: 将世界模型范式引入RF场建模，可实现免参考测量、跨场景跨城市泛化的RF辐射场合成，为6G通信与感知提供可扩展的场合成方案，并配套发布基准、代码与权重。
