title: One-shot is Enough: Boosting SAM for Medical Image Segmentation through Structured Information Modeling
summary: In recent years, Foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) have demonstrated strong generalization capabilities, but because they are primarily pre-trained on natural images, they perform poorly when faced with medical images. With sufficient labeled medical data, this challenge is somewhat alleviated. However, the difficulty and high cost of acquiring large amounts of labeled data make one-shot learning a highly attractive research paradigm. But within this paradigm, SAM struggles to fully extract its potential multi-granular information, leading to a sharp decline in performance. To address this, we propose OB-SAM, a one-shot enhancement framework for medical image segmentation. It aims to maximize the utilization of information from a single sample from the perspective of structured modeling. Specifically, we first designed a Multi-Frequency Decoupling (MFD) module, which divides features into different frequency domain components, allowing each branch to focus on information expression at different semantic levels, thereby alleviating overfitting and enhancing feature representation capabilities. Secondly, we introduce a Progressive Feature Integrator (PFI) module to promote complementary fusion among multi-level features, thereby avoiding the dominant effect of a certain level of feature in the fusion process. Furthermore, we propose an Selective Context Filtering (SCF) Module that adaptively selects key contextual information by modeling the contrast relationship between the foreground and background, thereby achieving precise localization of the lesion area. Extensive experiments across seven diverse datasets validate that OB-SAM achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出OB-SAM一次性（one-shot）医学图像分割增强框架，从结构化建模角度最大化单样本信息利用，在七个数据集上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: SAM等基础模型在自然图像上泛化性强，但在医学图像上表现差；大规模标注医学数据获取困难且昂贵，使one-shot学习成为有吸引力的范式，而SAM在该范式下难以充分挖掘多粒度信息，性能显著下降。
AI.method: 包含三个模块：(1) 多频解耦模块（MFD），将特征按频域成分划分，使各分支聚焦不同语义层级，缓解过拟合、增强表征；(2) 渐进式特征整合器（PFI），促进多层级特征互补融合，避免某一层级特征在融合中占主导；(3) 选择性上下文过滤模块（SCF），通过建模前景—背景对比关系自适应选择关键上下文，实现病灶区域精确定位。
AI.result: 在七个多样化数据集上的大量实验表明，OB-SAM取得了最先进（state-of-the-art）的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化建模充分挖掘单样本信息，可有效提升SAM在one-shot医学图像分割中的表现。

title: Learning Land-Surface Hydrology World Model from Satellite Observations
summary: A world model should tell us not only what will happen, but what would happen under a different action. Learned Earth models now forecast remarkably well, yet forecast skill says little about what their state means or how it responds to a changed driver. We build LandWM, a world model of land-surface water in which rain is the action, learned from seven years of SMAP and CYGNSS observations: physical observation operators tie its latent state to soil water, and a mass-conserving balance governs how that state responds to rain. Over the U.S. Southern Great Plains, the model, never shown a soil-moisture value, tracks 28 in-situ probes as well as the operational SMAP Level-4 product, even from CYGNSS alone, and a storm added to the forcing of a station's cell wets its soil as natural storms wet the probes. Replace either piece and the forecasts stay, but the meaning goes: with neural operators, only a probe fitted to the stations finds the soil water; with a generic recurrent transition, rain on a single cell barely moves it. Yet when the same rain covers the whole region the two transitions swap roles, and the conserving one responds too weakly. Grounding makes a world model readable; its response to actions must be tested under more than one kind of intervention.

AI.tldr: LandWM 是一个以降雨为"动作"的陆面水世界模型，用物理观测算子将隐状态锚定到土壤水、用质量守恒约束状态对降雨的响应；虽未见过任何土壤湿度真值，其精度可比业务化 SMAP L4 产品，且能对人为注入的风暴做出符合物理的湿润响应。
AI.motivation: 现有地球系统学习模型预报技巧高，但预报得分并不能说明其隐状态的物理含义，也无法说明它如何对改变的驱动（干预/动作）作出响应。作者希望构建"可读"的世界模型：不仅预报未来，还要能回答"在不同动作下会发生什么"，并以土壤水为对象检验这种可解释性与动作响应能力。
AI.method: 基于 SMAP 与 CYGNSS 七年观测学习陆面水世界模型 LandWM：以降雨作为动作输入；用物理观测算子把隐状态与土壤水（土壤湿度）显式连接，用质量守恒（水量平衡）约束状态对降雨的转移。在美南大平原（SGP）用 28 个原位探针验证；并做消融/替换实验——将观测算子换成神经算子、将守恒转移换成通用循环转移——以及不同干预方式（单格点加暴雨 vs 全区域加同等降雨）下的响应测试。
AI.result: 模型从未观测土壤湿度数值，却能在 SGP 追踪 28 个原位探针，精度与业务化 SMAP Level-4 相当，仅用 CYGNSS 亦可达到；在站点网格上人为加入一场风暴，其土壤湿润方式与自然风暴下探针的表现一致。替换任一部分后预报技巧仍在，但状态含义丢失：用神经算子时，只有一个针对站点拟合的探针才能反演出土壤水；用通用循环转移时，单格点降雨几乎不改变状态。然而当同一降雨覆盖整个区域时，两种转移角色互换，且守恒转移响应过弱。
AI.conclusion: 物理接地（观测算子+守恒动力学）使世界模型的状态"可读"，可被独立探针解读并对动作做出语义正确的响应；但仅凭预报技巧无法判别这一点。对动作的响应必须在多种干预形式（局地 vs 区域尺度）下检验，因为不同耦合方式会产生相反的行为。

title: Controlled One-Click Benchmarking and Post-Fusion Recalibration for Support-Conditioned Medical Segmentation
comment: Accepted at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)
summary: Sparse-prompt medical segmentation is hard to compare when prompts, supports, thresholds, and splits differ. This paper uses a controlled one-click protocol: each test image receives one positive foreground click, training-only support, validation-only checkpoint selection, and no test-time threshold tuning. We propose {Support-Aware Recalibration (SAR)}, a late post-fusion recalibration block for MultiverSeg that combines large-kernel spatial gating with squeeze-and-excitation channel recalibration after support--query fusion. BUSI, NerveUS-BP-present, and Kvasir-SEG are evaluated with matched 697 foreground-present sample budgets, shared splits/clicks, and threshold-free Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC. Compared with a protocol-matched raw-support MultiverSeg baseline, the main SAR configuration shows favorable mean Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC performance on BUSI, NerveUS-BP-present, and Kvasir-SEG, while reducing logged training time in this implementation. These controlled results indicate that late post-fusion recalibration is useful under a leakage-controlled one-click protocol.

AI.tldr: 论文在受控"单击"协议下评测稀疏提示医学分割，并提出支持感知重校准模块SAR，在三个数据集上取得更好的阈值无关指标。
AI.motivation: 稀疏提示（sparse-prompt）医学分割研究中，提示形式、支持样本、阈值与数据划分各不相同，导致结果难以公平比较。本文旨在建立一个受控可比的单击评测协议，并在该协议下提升MultiverSeg的分割表现。
AI.method: 提出Support-Aware Recalibration（SAR）：一个用于MultiverSeg的后融合晚期重校准模块，在support-query融合之后结合大核空间门控与squeeze-and-excitation通道重校准。评测采用受控单击协议：每张测试图仅一个正向前景点击、仅用训练集作为support、仅用验证集选择checkpoint、不做测试时阈值调优；在BUSI、NerveUS-BP-present、Kvasir-SEG上以匹配的697张前景样本预算、共享划分与点击、以及阈值无关的Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC进行评测。
AI.result: 与协议匹配的raw-support MultiverSeg基线相比，主SAR配置在BUSI、NerveUS-BP-present和Kvasir-SEG上取得更优的平均Dice-AUC/IoU-AUC，同时在该实现中减少了记录的训练时间。
AI.conclusion: 在泄漏受控的单击协议下，晚期后融合重校准是一种有效的改进手段；受控评测为稀疏提示医学分割提供了更公平的比较基础。

title: SENSA: Visual-to-Brain Generation with Individualized Subject-State Transfer and Adaptation
summary:
Visual-to-brain encoding predicts neural responses to visual stimuli, supporting visual cognition research and neural decoding. However, challenges in disentangling shared from image-specific activity, together with inter-subject distribution shifts and representational heterogeneity, limit accurate encoding and cross-subject generalization with limited calibration data.
  We introduce SENSA, a structured continuous neural response generation framework that separates shared activity from image-dependent responses and calibrates a compact subject state. An independent response prior captures shared activity, while complementary visual descriptors drive separable sensor-time bases and a shared Response Refiner. Subject-Adaptive Factor Transport adjusts the spatiotemporal expression of shared bases, while Source-Grounded Residual Memory predicts image-dependent corrections in source-response coordinates. Together, they personalize a frozen generator using limited paired support.
  Experiments demonstrate that the generation backbone outperforms recent generators across three datasets, with image-identity perturbations confirming stimulus specificity. Using only 400 paired images, electroencephalography (EEG) and the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD) calibration achieve residual Pearson correlations of 0.1091 and 0.2995, respectively, demonstrating effective brain-response generation and cross-subject adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出SENSA框架，将共享活动与图像特异响应解耦，并用紧凑受试者状态实现少样本跨被试适配，提升视觉到大脑响应的编码精度与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉到大脑编码需区分共享与图像特异活动，但被试间分布漂移、表征异质性及校准数据有限，导致编码精度低、跨被试泛化差。
AI.method: SENSA为结构化连续神经响应生成框架：独立响应先验捕获共享活动；互补视觉描述子驱动可分的传感器-时间基与共享Response Refiner；Subject-Adaptive Factor Transport调制共享基的时空表达；Source-Grounded Residual Memory在源响应坐标下预测图像相关修正，从而以少量配对支持集个性化冻结生成器。
AI.result: 生成主干在三个数据集上优于近期生成器，图像身份扰动验证了刺激特异性；仅用400对图像校准，EEG与NSD的残差Pearson相关分别为0.1091与0.2995。
AI.conclusion: SENSA在解耦共享与特异响应的同时实现有效的脑响应生成与跨被试适配，支持少校准数据条件下的视觉认知研究与神经解码。

title: MQCODet: Modality Quality-Guided Collaborative Optimization for UAV-Based RGB-T Tiny Pedestrian Detection
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based RGB-thermal (RGB-T) remote sensing provides complementary visual and thermal information for pedestrian perception under complex aerial observation conditions. However, detecting tiny pedestrians in UAV-based RGB-T imagery remains challenging due to cross-modal spatial heterogeneity, manifested as modality quality imbalance and spatial position misalignment. Existing RGB-T detectors primarily address these challenges at the feature fusion stage, without establishing an effective coupling between feature fusion and object localization, potentially resulting in suboptimal detection performance. To address this limitation, we introduce a Modality Quality-Guided Collaborative Optimization Detector (MQCODet), which extends modality quality from a fusion prior to a localization supervision cue. Specifically, we propose a Dynamic Calibration and Region-Aware Fusion (DCRF) module that progressively refines cross-modal spatial alignment and performs region-aware fusion to generate reliable multi-scale features and a scene-level modality quality prior. We further design an Efficient Contextual Interaction (ECI) encoder to enhance multi-scale feature interaction while preserving fine-grained spatial details. Moreover, we propose a Modality-Aware Adaptive (MAA) loss that incorporates the modality prior and object scale to adaptively balance spatial consistency and geometric similarity for localization supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MQCODet surpasses state-of-the-art methods on two UAV-based RGB-T tiny pedestrian detection benchmarks while achieving real-time inference on the edge platform.

AI.tldr: 提出MQCODet，将模态质量从融合先验扩展为定位监督线索，用于无人机RGB-T微小行人检测。
AI.motivation: 无人机RGB-T微小行人检测面临跨模态空间异质性，表现为模态质量不均衡与空间位置错位；现有方法仅在特征融合阶段处理，未在融合与目标定位间建立有效耦合，导致检测性能次优。
AI.method: 设计三个组件：(1) 动态校准与区域感知融合（DCRF）模块，逐步精化跨模态空间对齐并进行区域感知融合，生成可靠多尺度特征与场景级模态质量先验；(2) 高效上下文交互（ECI）编码器，增强多尺度特征交互并保留细粒度空间细节；(3) 模态感知自适应（MAA）损失，结合模态先验与目标尺度，自适应平衡空间一致性与几何相似性以监督定位。
AI.result: 在两个无人机RGB-T微小行人检测基准上优于现有SOTA方法，并在边缘平台实现实时推理。
AI.conclusion: 通过将模态质量先验与定位监督耦合，MQCODet有效缓解跨模态空间异质性，兼顾精度与边缘端实时性。

title: Spatially Grounded Latent Lookahead for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary:
Vision-language-action (VLA) models benefit from strong semantic representations that support object recognition and instruction understanding. However, precise manipulation also depends on resolving object locations and workspace relations, and on selecting actions with an estimate of how the scene will evolve. Existing geometry-aware methods make the current scene more explicit, while predictive methods model future observations or representations. Yet future information is often neither grounded in a control-relevant spatial state nor directly used to guide action generation. We introduce Spatially Grounded Latent Lookahead (SG-LL), which uses the grounded present as the reference for predicting an actionable near-future representation. A frozen spatial teacher first distills geometric priors into policy-connected spatial tokens. A current-conditioned bottleneck then learns a compact latent that captures future information relative to the present scene. This latent is predicted from the current policy context and initial Action Expert features, without access to future observations or the spatial teacher. Finally, zero-initialized residual fusion incorporates the predicted latent into the Action Expert to refine action generation. Experiments on LIBERO-Plus, CALVIN, and three real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improvements over
  in both simulation and real-robot settings.

AI.tldr: 提出SG-LL（Spatially Grounded Latent Lookahead），以\"空间 grounded 的当前状态\"为参照预测可执行的近未来潜表示，并将其残差式注入Action Expert以精化动作生成。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型语义表征强但缺乏精确的物体位置与工作空间关系解析；几何感知方法只显式化当前场景，预测类方法虽建模未来观测/表征，但未来信息往往未锚定于控制相关的空间状态，也未直接用于指导动作生成。
AI.method: 三部分：(1) 冻结的空间教师将几何先验蒸馏到与策略相连的空间token；(2) 以当前场景为条件的bottleneck学习捕捉相对当前状态的未来信息的紧凑潜变量，该潜变量由当前策略上下文与初始Action Expert特征预测，推理时不访问未来观测与空间教师；(3) 零初始化残差融合将预测潜变量注入Action Expert以精化动作生成。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Plus、CALVIN及三个真实机器人操作任务上，相较基线在仿真与真机设置下均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 将未来信息表征为以空间grounded当前状态为参照的可执行潜变量，并直接用于动作生成，是提升VLA精细操作性能的有效途径，且具备仿真到真机的可迁移性。

title: ViTrust: Learning 3D Observation Trust for Deformable Physical World Models
summary: Learning deformable physical world models requires dynamics that generalize beyond observed motion. Accurate reconstruction alone does not ensure accurate future prediction, motivating us to learn how observations should influence physical identification. However, visual reliability alone does not determine how informative an observation is about physical dynamics. We propose ViTrust to learn 3D observation trust, determining how strongly each tracked point influences physical identification. Its key design is a visual-contact trust adapter that combines pointwise spatiotemporal evidence with interaction history on a persistent contact graph to predict time-varying observation weights. A single-stage, shared-forward objective jointly optimizes these weights and physical parameters through weighted geometry and correspondence losses, with constraints to prevent observation-weight collapse. All learning uses only the observed prefix. The fitted physics remains fixed for future prediction under supplied controls. Experiments on real-world sequences demonstrate improved future prediction over the evaluated baselines, alongside qualitative demonstrations of novel-control rollouts and cross-object transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出ViTrust，学习3D观测信任权重，决定每个跟踪点对物理辨识的影响强度，以提升可变形物理世界模型的未来预测泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 仅靠精确重建不足以保证准确的未来预测，需要学习观测应如何影响物理参数辨识；而视觉可靠性本身并不能决定观测对物理动力学的信息量。
AI.method: 设计视觉-接触信任适配器，将逐点时空证据与持久接触图上的交互历史结合，预测时变观测权重；采用单阶段共享前向目标，通过加权几何与对应损失联合优化权重与物理参数，并加入约束防止权重塌缩；仅使用观测前缀学习，拟合后物理固定用于给定控制下的未来预测。
AI.result: 在真实序列实验中，未来预测优于所评估基线，并定性展示了新控制条件下的rollout与跨物体迁移。
AI.conclusion: 以3D观测信任为桥梁，可将观测信息量显式建模并端到端融入物理辨识，从而改善可变形物体的未来动力学预测与泛化。

title: Not All Directions Are Flat: Decomposed-Gradient Flatness for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Many applications of novel view synthesis, such as augmented reality and robotics, can afford only a few input views, since dense capture is costly. With such sparse views, however, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) overfits the training views and degrades at unseen viewpoints. Among the approaches to this problem, flat-minima optimization treats the Gaussians as trainable parameters and steers training toward flat minima, which generalize better, by perturbing the Gaussians with random noise or along the training gradient. However, these perturbations ignore their direction relative to the other training views. Interestingly, we find that the direction of the perturbation determines whether it improves generalization. Specifically, we decompose the gradient of each training view into a component parallel to the average gradient of all views, on which the views agree, and an orthogonal component, on which they disagree. Perturbing along the orthogonal component improves generalization, whereas perturbing along the parallel component does not. We further find that the flatness correction often opposes the reconstruction gradient, shrinking or even reversing the reconstruction step. Based on these findings, we propose DecoFlat, which perturbs each Gaussian along the orthogonal component together with random noise. Furthermore, we introduce a conflict-aware correction, which removes the part of the flatness correction that opposes the reconstruction gradient, and a rescheduling of the spherical-harmonics color, which suppresses the overfitting of view-dependent appearance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DecoFlat, as a plug-in optimizer, consistently improves vanilla 3DGS and a wide range of sparse-view 3DGS methods.

AI.tldr: 针对稀疏视角下3DGS过拟合问题，作者发现梯度扰动方向决定泛化效果：沿正交（各视角分歧）分量扰动有益，沿平行（各视角一致）分量扰动无效，据此提出 DecoFlat 插件式优化器。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角（仅少量输入视图）是新视角合成的常见设定，但 3DGS 在稀疏视图下会过拟合训练视角、在新视角退化。现有平坦极小值（flat-minima）优化通过随机噪声或沿训练梯度扰动高斯参数以追求更好泛化，但这些扰动忽略了其相对于其他训练视图的方向性。
AI.method: 核心观察：将每个训练视图的梯度分解为与所有视图平均梯度平行的分量（视角间一致）和正交分量（视角间分歧），扰动沿正交分量可提升泛化、沿平行分量则无效；并发现平坦性修正常与重建梯度相抗。据此提出 DecoFlat：(1) 每个高斯沿正交分量加随机噪声进行扰动；(2) 冲突感知修正，剔除平坦性修正中与重建梯度相反的部分；(3) 球谐颜色重调度，抑制视角相关外观的过拟合。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，DecoFlat 作为插件式优化器，可稳定提升原始 3DGS 以及多种稀疏视角 3DGS 方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 梯度扰动方向是稀疏视角泛化的关键因素；沿视角分歧方向扰动、去除与重建冲突的平坦性修正、并重调度球谐颜色，可有效缓解 3DGS 稀疏视角过拟合，且方法具有良好的即插即用通用性。

title: ArgsWorld: Unifying 3DGS Scene Reconstruction, Generation and Extrapolation with Autoregressive Diffusion Transformer
summary: Autoregressive diffusion world models deliver strong video generation performance, yet they typically output only RGB frames rather than explicit 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scene representations, creating a gap between learned visual world dynamics and usable 3D assets for downstream robotics, simulation and rendering. To bridge this gap, we introduce ArgsWorld, an autoregressive diffusion model that also produces an explicit 3DGS scene. For each generation chunk, the diffusion transformer jointly processes clean historical image latents and noisy latents for new views. It keeps the historical image latents fixed and refreshes the scene features so that the Gaussian representation can be revised as new regions come into view. Our 3D Self-Forcing Distillation trains the model on its own generated histories using a mixture of single-view and multi-view data. Distribution matching supervises direct image latents and latents of Gaussian renderings at both generation and additional cameras. ArgsWorld unifies 3D scene reconstruction from posed images, scene generation from image or text prompts, and scene extrapolation across camera segments with disconnected endpoints. Experimental results demonstrate that ArgsWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple 3D scene modeling tasks. Project page: https://m4a1tastegood.github.io/ArgsWorld/

AI.tldr: ArgsWorld 是一个自回归扩散世界模型，在生成 RGB 视频帧的同时输出显式 3D 高斯溅射（3DGS）场景表示，统一了基于位姿图像的 3D 重建、图像/文本提示下的场景生成以及跨相机段的场景外推。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归扩散世界模型虽然视频生成能力强，但只输出 RGB 帧，缺乏显式的 3DGS 场景表示，导致学到的视觉世界动态与下游机器人、仿真和渲染可用的 3D 资产之间存在鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出 ArgsWorld：每个生成块中，扩散 Transformer 联合处理干净的历史图像潜变量与新视角的噪声潜变量；固定历史图像潜变量并刷新场景特征，使高斯表示能随新区域进入视野而修正。采用 3D Self-Forcing Distillation，用单视图与多视图混合数据在模型自身生成的历史上训练；分布匹配同时监督直接图像潜变量与高斯渲染（在生成相机及额外相机上）的潜变量。
AI.result: 作者称在多个 3D 场景建模任务上取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
AI.conclusion: ArgsWorld 将显式 3DGS 输出融入自回归扩散世界模型，弥合视觉世界动态建模与可用 3D 资产之间的差距，并统一了重建、生成与场景外推三类任务。

title: Learning Optical Flow with Task-Oriented Feature Adaptation
summary: Learning-based optical flow estimation approaches generally rely on both inter-frame correspondence evidence and intra-frame contextual guidance, yet features from general-purpose image encoders may not fully support these roles. Strongly activated but weakly discriminative channels can outweigh more informative ones when computing inter-frame feature similarity, while context feature affinities can be low within motion-coherent regions yet high across motion boundaries. To address these mismatches, this study proposes TO-Flow, a task-oriented feature adaptation framework that aligns matching and context features with their respective requirements through dedicated channel modulation and spatial reorganization approaches. An affinity-based soft partition distinguishes motion-region interiors from boundary-adjacent regions to guide both processes. Channel modulation uses simulated flow refinement to assess whether each channel assigns higher similarity to estimated correspondences than to nearby competing candidates. The resulting similarity differences are aggregated within each region type and averaged across iterations to derive channel weights that emphasize informative channels and suppress ambiguous ones. Spatial reorganization combines affinity-guided feature attraction and repulsion from coarse to fine to simultaneously improve consistency within motion-coherent regions and distinctiveness across motion boundaries, with feature resampling mitigating boundary blurring during cross-scale fusion. Extensive experiments on the MPI Sintel, KITTI 2015, Spring, and LayeredFlow datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and general applicability of TO-Flow across diverse iterative refinement architectures as well as supervised and unsupervised training paradigms. The source code will be publicly available at https://mias.group/TO-Flow upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出TO-Flow任务导向特征适配框架，通过通道调制与空间重组使匹配特征与上下文特征分别满足光流估计需求。
AI.motivation: 通用图像编码器提取的特征不完全适配光流任务：强激活但弱判别性的通道会在帧间相似度计算中压过更有信息量的通道；上下文特征的亲和度在运动一致区域内部偏低、在运动边界处偏高。
AI.method: 基于亲和度的软分区区分运动区域内部与边界邻域，指导两个过程。通道调制利用模拟光流细化评估各通道是否给估计对应点更高相似度而非邻近竞争候选，将相似度差按区域类型聚合并在迭代间平均，得到通道权重以强化有信息通道、抑制歧义通道。空间重组在由粗到细尺度上结合亲和度引导的特征吸引与排斥，提升运动一致区域内一致性与跨运动边界区分性，并用特征重采样缓解跨尺度融合中的边界模糊。
AI.result: 在MPI Sintel、KITTI 2015、Spring与LayeredFlow数据集上的大量实验表明，TO-Flow在多种迭代细化架构以及监督与无监督训练范式下均有效且具通用性。
AI.conclusion: TO-Flow通过任务导向的特征适配纠正匹配与上下文特征的失配，可即插即用地提升多类光流框架性能，代码将公开。

title: Dynamic Spectrum Re-parameterized Convolution for Cost-free Image Enhancement
summary: Image enhancement spans degradations with distinct spectral characteristics. Standard convolutions use fixed kernels, whereas dynamic convolutions gain adaptability at additional inference cost. We propose Dynamic Spectrum Re-parameterized Convolution (DSRC), a plug-and-play module that learns task-adaptive spectral responses during training while retaining standard convolution at inference. DSRC decomposes convolution kernels into frequency bands, applies learnable high/low-pass modulation, and incorporates lightweight residual branches. Owing to the linearity of these operations, all training-time components are analytically fused into a single kernel for inference. Experiments on low-light enhancement, underwater enhancement, and image super-resolution show consistent PSNR gains and generally improved or preserved SSIM and LPIPS across twelve backbone-task configurations, with unchanged deployed parameter counts and theoretical FLOPs, and no additional inference operators.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用的动态频谱重参数化卷积（DSRC），训练时学习任务自适应频谱响应，推理时通过解析融合还原为标准卷积，在不增加部署参数与FLOPs的前提下提升多种图像增强任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 图像增强涉及光谱特性各异的退化类型。标准卷积使用固定卷积核，缺乏自适应性；动态卷积虽具适应性，但带来额外推理开销。因此希望在保持推理效率（甚至零额外成本）的同时获得任务自适应的卷积能力。
AI.method: DSRC 将卷积核分解为多个频段，施加可学习的高通/低通调制，并引入轻量级残差分支。由于这些操作均为线性，训练期的所有组件可在推理时解析地融合为单一卷积核，从而在部署阶段完全等价于标准卷积。
AI.result: 在低光照增强、水下增强与图像超分辨率三类任务、共十二种骨干-任务配置上，PSNR 稳定提升，SSIM 与 LPIPS 总体改善或持平；部署参数量与理论 FLOPs 保持不变，且推理解算无额外算子。
AI.conclusion: DSRC 以重参数化方式将动态频谱调制能力引入训练，并以零推理代价落地为标准卷积，是一种可即插即用、兼顾性能与部署效率的通用增强模块。

title: Neutron Imaging Enhancement for Lithium Batteries Based on Swin-Transformer and Image Fusion
summary: Neutron imaging is highly sensitive to light elements such as lithium and is therefore valuable for non-destructive testing (NDT) and analyzing internal structural evolution in lithium batteries. However, limited neutron-source flux and detector performance often result in images with mixed noise, low contrast, and blurred edges, hindering accurate assessment of battery internal states. To address these issues, this paper proposes a lithium-battery neutron image enhancement method combining an improved Swin-Transformer with spatial-domain image fusion. First, an improved Swin-Transformer incorporating Multi-Dconv Head Transposed Attention (MDTA) and Global Response Normalization (GRN) extracts and reconstructs image features to suppress high-density white spots and Gaussian-Poisson mixed noise. Second, guided filtering and a gradient-adaptive mask are used for selective edge enhancement, while Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) improves local contrast. Finally, a spatial-frequency (SF)-based local block-weighted fusion mechanism adaptively combines the edge-enhanced and contrast-equalized images to preserve microscopic details while suppressing noise. Experiments show that, compared with BM3D, DnCNN, and GAN, the proposed method achieves strong performance in full-reference and no-reference evaluations. Its best PSNR and SSIM reach 33.0517 dB and 0.9637, respectively, while the NR-IQA and Natural Image Quality Evaluator (NIQE) scores are as low as 0.1794 and 4.0974. The method reduces artifacts and over smoothing, improving the visual fidelity and structural identifiability of lithium-battery neutron images.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合改进Swin-Transformer与空域图像融合的锂电池中子图像增强方法，在多个全参考与无参考指标上优于BM3D、DnCNN和GAN。
AI.motivation: 中子成像对锂等轻元素高度敏感，适用于锂电池无损检测与内部结构演化分析；但中子源通量有限、探测器性能受限，导致图像存在混合噪声、低对比度与边缘模糊，影响电池内部状态的准确评估。
AI.method: 1) 改进Swin-Transformer：引入Multi-Dconv Head Transposed Attention（MDTA）与Global Response Normalization（GRN），提取并重建图像特征，抑制高密度白斑与高斯-泊松混合噪声；2) 引导滤波结合梯度自适应掩膜进行选择性边缘增强，CLAHE提升局部对比度；3) 基于空间频率（SF）的局部分块加权融合机制，自适应融合边缘增强图与对比度均衡图。
AI.result: 在PSNR与SSIM上最优分别达33.0517 dB和0.9637；无参考NR-IQA低至0.1794，NIQE低至4.0974；相比BM3D、DnCNN、GAN表现更强，减少伪影与过平滑现象。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可提升锂电池中子图像的视觉保真度与结构可辨识性，兼顾微观细节保留与噪声抑制。

title: ClothCast: Generative Cloth World Modeling under Partial Observability
summary: World models support robotic manipulation by predicting how the scene evolves under a planned action. For garments this prediction is notoriously difficult: deformations are complex, and self-occlusion leaves much of the cloth unobserved. Planned gripper trajectories provide a useful motion prior because cloth held by a gripper moves with it, while the remaining deformation must be predicted. We introduce ClothCast, a world model that applies this prior to the cloth's points and learns the residual motion. ClothCast takes one RGB-D observation, the camera pose, the robot's own model and the planned gripper trajectories, with no cloth mesh or material parameters. It lifts the observation to a layered point set that includes hypothesized occluded layers, carries the points with a blended rigid prior derived from the gripper poses, and predicts the residual motion with a video-diffusion point-flow model. Over entire 4- to 11-second episodes at 10 Hz, the moved points are rendered into depth, from which a geometry-conditioned completion model synthesizes RGB; after release, a hand-designed settling step replaces the learned motion. We further release ClothCastBench, 10,000 simulated dual-arm cloth-manipulation episodes with the ground-truth cloth mesh, including occluded layers, at every frame. On 492 held-out episodes, ClothCast achieves 2.5x lower sequence-averaged visible-surface Chamfer distance than Flex-π, the strongest baseline in geometry (14.0 mm vs. 35.6 mm), and 3.7 dB higher cloth-region PSNR than Cosmos-Predict2.5, the strongest baseline in cloth PSNR. On a 50-episode ablation subset, the rigid prior alone, applied to ClothCast's learned initial geometry with the same post-processing, already outperforms both geometry-capable baselines, and the learned residual lowers its error by about a third.

AI.tldr: ClothCast是一个用于布料操作的机器人世界模型，利用夹爪轨迹作为运动先验，将观测提升为含遮挡层的分层点集并预测残余变形，显著优于几何与图像基线。
AI.motivation: 布料形变复杂且自遮挡导致大部分布料不可观测，使基于世界模型的场景演化预测极为困难；同时夹爪轨迹本身蕴含强运动先验（被夹持布料随夹爪运动），可被利用来降低预测难度，且现有方法通常依赖布料网格或材质参数，泛化受限。
AI.method: 输入单帧RGB-D、相机位姿、机器人自身模型与规划的夹爪轨迹，无需布料网格或材质参数；将观测提升为包含假设遮挡层的分层点集；基于夹爪位姿构造混合刚体先验带动点运动，再用视频扩散点流模型预测残余运动；长时（4–11秒、10Hz）情节中将点渲染为深度，经几何条件补全模型合成RGB；释放后用手工设计的稳定化步骤替代学习运动。同时发布ClothCastBench（1万条仿真双臂布料操作情节，含逐帧真值网格与遮挡层）。
AI.result: 在492条留出情节上，序列平均可见表面倒角距离为14.0mm，较最强几何基线Flex-π（35.6mm）降低2.5倍；布料区域PSNR较最强图像基线Cosmos-Predict2.5高3.7dB。50条情节消融显示：仅用刚体先验（作用于学习到的初始几何并采用相同后处理）即已优于两个具备几何能力的基线，学习到的残余运动进一步将误差降低约三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 夹爪轨迹提供的刚体运动先验是布料世界模型的有效且强力的基础，学习残余变形可进一步提升精度；ClothCast在几何与外观指标上均超越现有基线，并配套提供大规模含遮挡层真值的基准数据集。

title: PrimiTok: Learning to Diversify and Allocate Primitives for Visual Tokenization
summary: Unifying visual understanding and generation requires representations that preserve both semantic information and fine-grained image details. Continuous tokenizers trained primarily for semantic alignment may omit fine-grained reconstruction details, whereas discrete tokenizers face information loss from codebook quantization. Conventional multi-codebook designs assign every token the same number of codewords regardless of local content. We instead view codewords as reusable visual primitives whose allocation and composition adapt to each token. We introduce PrimiTok, a compositional visual tokenizer that represents each visual token through adaptive allocation and weighted composition of learned codebook primitives. PrimiTok integrates two complementary components: Diverse Quantitative Primitives (DQP), which encourages diversity among sub-codebook centroids to reduce redundancy, and a Dynamic Primitive Allocator (DPA), which selects primitives according to token complexity. Embedding quantization error supervises how many primitives are selected from each sub-codebook, and DPA aggregates them with input-dependent weights. Joint reconstruction and image--text contrastive learning encourage the resulting representations to retain visual fidelity and semantic alignment. Experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction and semantic alignment over SOTA baselines, with further evaluations on multimodal understanding and visual generation.

AI.tldr: PrimiTok将码字作为可复用视觉基元，按token复杂度自适应分配并加权组合，结合多样性码本与量化误差监督，联合重建与对比学习，在重建、语义对齐、多模态理解与生成上超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉tokenizer难以同时保留语义与细粒度细节：连续tokenizer偏重语义对齐而忽略重建细节，离散tokenizer受码本量化信息损失影响；且传统多码本设计对每个token分配相同数量码字，忽视局部内容差异。
AI.method: 提出组合式视觉tokenizer PrimiTok，将码字视为可复用的视觉基元，按token自适应分配与加权组合。包含两部分：Diverse Quantitative Primitives（DQP）增强子码本质心多样性以降低冗余；Dynamic Primitive Allocator（DPA）依据token复杂度选择基元，以嵌入量化误差监督各子码本的选取数量，并用输入相关权重聚合。训练结合重建与图文对比学习。
AI.result: 实验显示在重建质量与语义对齐上优于SOTA基线，并在多模态理解与视觉生成任务上进一步验证有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应基元分配与加权组合，PrimiTok统一了视觉理解与生成所需表示，兼顾保真与语义对齐。

title: CT-Navigator: Towards Interpretable and Generalizable CT Understanding through Agentic Perception and Tool-Invocation
summary: Clinical computed tomography (CT) interpretation inherently requires progressive visual exploration, where radiologists navigate from whole scans to individual slices and regions of interest and interact with external tools when necessary. However, existing 3D medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) typically connect a specialized 3D visual encoder to a language model, without fully leveraging the native 2D visual and agentic capabilities of generalist MLLMs. Trained on large-scale one-hop CT instruction-following data, these models also have limited ability to perform iterative reasoning and explicitly ground their conclusions in visual evidence, limiting their support for traceable CT interpretation. To solve these problems, we propose \textbf{agentic perception} as an alternative paradigm inspired by radiologists' interpretation workflows. We introduce \textbf{CT-Navigator}, a framework that harnesses generalist MLLMs' 2D visual and agentic capabilities to progressively ground CT interpretation in explicit, traceable visual evidence through hierarchical visual exploration and radiology tool invocation. To build these capabilities, we curate 8,904 visual chain-of-thought (V-CoT) trajectories for cold-start agentic supervised fine-tuning. We then optimize the policy through reinforcement learning on 33,219 questions, with data selection and dynamic rollout sampling prioritizing informative learning signals. Finally, we introduce CTNavi-Bench, a 3D CT visual question answering benchmark comprising 7,000 questions spanning anatomical regions throughout the human body. CT-Navigator achieves 79.50\% accuracy on CTNavi-Bench, surpassing the strongest baseline by 17.59\%, and demonstrates strong generalization across three external CT benchmarks. The code, model, and benchmark will be released on \href{https://github.com/fyb99/ct_navigator}{GitHub}.

AI.tldr: 提出"agentic perception"新范式与CT-Navigator框架，利用通用多模态大模型的2D视觉与智能体能力，对CT进行分层视觉探索与工具调用实现可追溯解读，在自建CTNavi-Bench上达79.50%准确率，超最强基线17.59%。
AI.motivation: 现有3D医学MLLM通常将专用3D视觉编码器直接接到语言模型上，未充分利用通用MLLM的2D视觉与智能体能力；且基于大规模单跳CT指令数据训练，缺乏迭代推理与视觉证据定位能力，难以支持可追溯的CT解读。临床CT阅片本身是从整体扫描到单层与ROI的渐进式探索过程。
AI.method: 受放射科医生阅片流程启发，提出agentic perception范式。构建CT-Navigator框架：通过分层视觉探索与放射工具调用，将解读逐步锚定在显式可追溯的视觉证据上。训练分两阶段：先用8,904条视觉思维链（V-CoT）轨迹做冷启动智能体监督微调，再在33,219个问题上进行强化学习优化策略，并通过数据筛选与动态rollout采样优先选择高信息量学习信号。同时构建CTNavi-Bench（7,000个问题，覆盖全身解剖区域的三维CT VQA基准）。
AI.result: CT-Navigator在CTNavi-Bench上取得79.50%准确率，较最强基线提升17.59%；并在三个外部CT基准上展现出较强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 利用通用MLLM的2D视觉与智能体能力进行渐进式、工具增强的CT探索，可有效提升三维医学影像推理性能与证据可追溯性；代码、模型与基准将开源。

title: PartPO: Part-Level Policy Optimization for Shape-to-Program Generation
summary: We present PartPO, a reinforcement learning method for generating structured shape programs from 3D point clouds. Existing shape-to-program models are trained with supervised learning on procedurally generated data and generalize poorly to more diverse shapes, while reinforcement learning from execution feedback assigns a single scalar reward to a long program that builds many parts, making credit assignment difficult. PartPO instead builds on a core property of the task: shape programs are self-describing, with each semantically named part produced by its own code block. It segments each generated program by its parts and applies part-level rewards only to the code of the corresponding part, a category reward only to the object name, and a shape-level reward to the whole program. The required part supervision is obtained without manual annotation, by grounding part names on target meshes with an open-vocabulary segmentation model prompt-tuned on the model's own outputs. Applied to MeshCoder, PartPO improves reconstruction accuracy and execution success on ShapeNetCore and ABO over the base model, rejection-sampling fine-tuning and trajectory-level RL, and generalizes to the unseen HSSD dataset. Code will be released at https://github.com/HannuoZ/PartPO.

AI.tldr: PartPO：面向三维点云生成结构化形状程序的强化学习方法，按部件切分程序并施加部件级奖励以解决信用分配问题。
AI.motivation: 现有 shape-to-program 模型在程序化生成数据上做监督学习，对多样形状泛化差；而基于执行反馈的强化学习把单一标量奖励赋给构建多部件的长程序，信用分配困难。
AI.method: 利用形状程序"自描述"特性：每个语义命名部件由独立代码块生成。按部件切分生成程序，仅对对应部件的代码施加部件级奖励，对物体名称施加类别奖励，对整程序施加形状级奖励。部件监督无需人工标注——用开放词汇分割模型在目标网格上grounding部件名称，并以模型自身输出prompt-tune该分割模型。
AI.result: 应用于 MeshCoder，在 ShapeNetCore 与 ABO 上相对基座模型、拒绝采样微调及轨迹级 RL 均提升重建精度与执行成功率，并泛化到未见过的 HSSD 数据集。
AI.conclusion: 部件级奖励分解+自动部件监督是缓解长程序信用分配的有效途径，可提升形状程序生成的质量与泛化性。

title: Training-Free 3D Editing via Feature-Divergence Localization and Trajectory Correction
summary: Modifying 3D assets requires enacting targeted structural transformations while strictly preserving the geometric identity of unedited regions. While recent probability flow models enable training-free editing, bounding these modifications within a high-dimensional latent space presents severe mathematical challenges. Current inversion-free trajectories rely on global velocity updates, which often cause spatial bleed into preserved structures and induce trajectory under-commitment, causing edits to stall mid-path. To resolve these dual failures, we introduce FocusFlow, a segmentation-free framework that structures the integration trajectory into two disjoint phases. During early coarse structure formation, FocusFlow applies Feature-Divergence Localization (FDL) to spatially gate the velocity field using intrinsic cross-attention. Once coarse structure has formed, FocusFlow applies Reference Generation Guidance (RGG), a trajectory-correction term that drives convergence to the target shape by pulling the trajectory toward an explicit clean-latent target. Evaluated on the joint Google Scanned Objects and PartObjaverse-Tiny benchmarks, FocusFlow obtains the best preservation scores and the largest edit magnitude among compared methods, suggesting that it can reduce the traditional preservation-modification trade-off. By providing stable, localized geometric control without manual spatial annotations, this phase-scheduled approach lowers technical barriers to the modification of synthetic 3D media.

AI.tldr: 提出FocusFlow，一种无需分割的3D资产编辑框架，将积分轨迹划分为两阶段：早期用特征散度定位（FDL）空间门控速度场实现局部编辑，后期用参考生成引导（RGG）校正轨迹收敛到目标形状，在保持未编辑区域几何一致性的同时获得更大编辑幅度。
AI.motivation: 现有无训练的概率流编辑在高维潜空间中难以约束修改范围：基于全局速度更新的无反转轨迹会导致空间"渗漏"污染应保留结构，并出现轨迹欠承诺（under-commitment）使编辑中途停滞。作者旨在同时解决这两类失效。
AI.method: FocusFlow将积分过程分为两个不相交阶段。第一阶段（粗结构形成期）采用Feature-Divergence Localization (FDL)，利用内在交叉注意力对速度场进行空间门控，实现无分割的编辑区域定位。第二阶段（粗结构形成后）引入Reference Generation Guidance (RGG)，作为轨迹修正项，将轨迹拉向显式的干净潜变量目标以驱动收敛。整体为无需人工空间标注、无需训练的分割无关框架。
AI.result: 在Google Scanned Objects与PartObjaverse-Tiny联合基准上评测，FocusFlow在对比方法中取得最佳保留分数（preservation）与最大编辑幅度，表明其可缓解传统的"保持-修改"权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过阶段调度的局部几何控制，FocusFlow在无手动空间标注条件下提供稳定、局部化的3D编辑能力，降低合成3D媒体修改的技术门槛；结果提示保留性与编辑强度可同时提升。

title: TesseraFlow: Scalable Video Diffusion for Dynamic Medical Imaging Inverse Problems
summary: Generative priors are state-of-the-art for modeling medical images in image reconstruction tasks, but reconstruction with video priors takes tens of seconds to minutes per frame. Latent priors inherit the errors of their autoencoder, the memory of pixel-space whole-frame priors grows with the frame size, and pixel-space patch priors are slow for two reasons. First, their deep networks process every frame at full resolution at every sampling step, even though early steps resolve only low frequencies. Second, their samplers spend many network evaluations per sampling step on overlapping windows, multiple re-noising rounds, or backpropagation through the prior. We introduce TesseraFlow, a complex-valued pixel-space flow prior that reduces the first cost. A global encoder reads a low-resolution view of every frame once per sampling step. A single shallow decoder operates on this view during early steps and on full-resolution space-time tiles during later steps, so no network processes a whole frame at full resolution. Our sampler, ReTile, addresses the second reason. We use randomized grid shifting at every sampling step along with re-noising, which acts as a stochastic gradient instead of computing overlapping tiles, so a single network pass per sampling step suffices. On its own, ReTile speeds up an existing global-context patch prior by 6-9x, and our prior adds a further 3-5x speedup. TesseraFlow reconstructs about one 256x256 frame per second, 20-367x faster than patch and latent video priors, and can match or exceed the best generative baseline on cardiac, brain, and abdominal MRI and lung CT, at a fraction of its GPU time.

AI.tldr: TesseraFlow是一种复数像素空间流先验，配合ReTile采样器，将医学图像重建速度提升至约1帧/秒（256×256），比视频/潜空间先验快20-367倍。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像重建中：视频先验每帧需数十秒至数分钟；潜空间先验继承自编码器误差；像素空间整帧先验显存随帧尺寸增长；像素空间块先验慢，原因有二——(1)每步采样都在全分辨率处理整帧，而早期步骤只解析低频；(2)采样器在重叠窗口、多次重加噪、对先验反向传播上消耗大量网络评估。
AI.method: 提出TesseraFlow复数像素空间流先验：全局编码器每采样步仅读取每帧的低分辨率视图一次，单一浅解码器在早期步骤作用于该低分辨率视图、在后期步骤作用于全分辨率时空瓦片，使任何网络都不处理全分辨率整帧。配套采样器ReTile：每步采用随机网格平移+重加噪，以随机梯度替代重叠瓦片计算，使每步仅需一次网络前向。
AI.result: ReTile单独使现有全局上下文块先验加速6-9倍，TesseraFlow再额外带来3-5倍加速。整体重建约1帧256×256/秒，比块先验与潜空间视频先验快20-367倍；在心脏、脑、腹部MRI与肺部CT上匹配或超越最佳生成基线，且GPU时间仅为其中一小部分。
AI.conclusion: 通过低频-高频分阶段解码与随机平移采样，TesseraFlow与ReTile在显著降低计算成本的同时保持甚至提升重建质量，为高效医学图像重建提供了可行方案。

title: Recurrent Point Transformer via Test-Time Training
summary: Real-world point clouds are not naturally bounded: 3D scans grow as sensors move through rooms, LiDAR surveys extend across forest plots, and 4D captures can span thousands of frames. Yet most point-cloud encoders are designed for fixed-size inputs, forcing inference-time cropping or tiling that loses long-range context and requires ad-hoc output stitching. We formulate arbitrary-extent point-cloud segmentation as recurrent sequence-of-chunks processing and introduce PoinTTT, a recurrent point-cloud encoder built on Point Transformer V3 (PTv3). PoinTTT augments PTv3 with residual Large Chunk Test-Time Training (LaCT) layers in both the encoder and decoder. Each LaCT layer maintains compact fast weights as recurrent state: tokens from each chunk update the fast weights, which are then applied to produce chunk features and passed to the next chunk. This design allows PoinTTT to train on fixed-size chunks while processing scenes of arbitrary spatial or temporal extent, with activation memory bounded by the chunk size. A pilot study on ScanNet and nuScenes shows that recurrent TTT improves segmentation over PTv3 baselines. On FOR-instanceV2, PoinTTT achieves state-of-the-art forest semantic segmentation of 87.9 mIoU with nearly constant memory. On HOI4D, online full-sequence recurrent inference carries state across clips rather than resetting at benchmark boundaries, reaching 42.6 mIoU; a matched full-sequence Mamba control reaches approximately 39.9. These results suggest that test-time training is a practical primitive for scalable spatial and temporal point-cloud understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出PoinTTT：在PTv3编码器与解码器中嵌入残差式大块测试时训练（LaCT）层，以紧凑快速权重作为循环状态，实现任意空间/时间尺度点云分割，激活内存受块大小约束。
AI.motivation: 真实点云无固定边界（3D扫描随传感器移动增长、LiDAR覆盖大片林区、4D捕获可达数千帧），而多数点云编码器面向固定尺寸输入，推理时需裁剪或分块，导致丢失长程上下文并需额外拼接后处理。
AI.method: 将任意尺度点云分割建模为块序列的循环处理；基于Point Transformer V3，在编码器与解码器中加入残差LaCT层；每层维护紧凑快速权重作为循环状态，逐块用token更新快速权重，再作用于生成该块特征并传递至下一块；训练用固定大小块，激活内存受块大小限制。
AI.result: ScanNet与nuScenes预实验显示循环TTT优于PTv3基线；FOR-instanceV2上森林语义分割达87.9 mIoU（SOTA）且内存近恒定；HOI4D在线全序列循环推理达42.6 mIoU，跨片段保持状态，匹配的全序列Mamba对照约39.9 mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 测试时训练可作为可扩展空间与时间点云理解的一种实用基础原语。

title: PSC-Gen: Physical Sequence Conditioning for Video Generation via Agentic Visual Planning
summary: Recent advances in video diffusion models have enabled the synthesis of high-fidelity, visually compelling videos. However, despite being trained on internet-scale video data, understanding underlying physical laws and generating physically plausible dynamics remain challenging. To mitigate this, conditioning video generators on explicit physical reasoning has emerged as a promising direction. Nevertheless, existing conditioning approaches often fail to incorporate detailed physical guidance into generation, resulting in physically implausible motion or visual artifacts. We propose PSC-Gen, a training-free framework that employs an agentic approach to synthesize visual conditions and inject their core dynamics via low-frequency filtering. By iteratively planning physical states and verifying generated keyframes, our Physics Agent constructs visually and physically consistent keyframe sequences. We then interpolate these keyframes into a continuous physical sequence and inject only its low-frequency components, steering the video model to preserve physical dynamics while synthesizing fine visual details. Qualitative and quantitative evaluations across physics-informed and robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that PSC-Gen faithfully follows instructions and generates physically plausible videos.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架PSC-Gen，借助智能体方式合成视觉条件并通过低频滤波注入核心动力学，使视频扩散模型生成符合物理规律的视频。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型虽在海量视频上训练，但仍难以理解物理规律、生成物理上合理的动力学；现有显式物理推理条件化方法难以将细粒度物理引导注入生成过程，导致运动不真实或视觉伪影。
AI.method: 免训练框架：Physics Agent迭代规划物理状态并验证生成的关键帧，构建视觉与物理一致的关键帧序列；将其插值为连续物理序列，仅提取并注入低频分量来引导视频模型，在保持物理动力学的同时合成精细视觉细节。
AI.result: 在物理信息与机器人操作基准上的定性与定量评估表明，PSC-Gen能忠实遵循指令并生成物理合理的视频。
AI.conclusion: 通过智能体式物理条件合成加低频动力学注入，可在无需训练的情况下有效提升视频生成的物理合理性。

title: Complementary Geometry in Gaussian Splatting
summary: Gaussian Splatting has achieved high visual quality in novel view synthesis, but the accuracy of its rendered geometry remains a challenge. In particular, the rendered depth is computed as an opacity-weighted average along each ray, which may not correspond to the actual scene surface. In this paper, we observe that depth predictions from different views of the same frozen Gaussian representation exhibit complementary errors, allowing us to improve novel-view geometry using information from other views without modifying the original representation. Based on this observation, we propose REVEAL, a general framework that selectively refines novel-view depth using complementary geometric information. Specifically, we first reproject depth predictions from source views to the target view and combine them using robust multi-view consensus. We then introduce a learned selection mechanism to determine whether the candidate depth is more accurate than the original prediction, based on the expected reduction in depth error. In addition, we introduce RIG, a real-world benchmark captured with synchronized RGB-D cameras, which provides ground-truth depth for evaluating both static and dynamic reconstruction models. Experiments on 6 Gaussian Splatting backbones across 3 benchmarks show that REVEAL consistently improves depth accuracy while maintaining comparable rendering quality.

AI.tldr: 提出REVEAL框架，利用多视角互补几何信息选择性修正高斯溅射新视角深度，并构建RIG真实数据集基准。
AI.motivation: 高斯溅射渲染深度为沿射线的透明度加权平均，可能与真实场景表面不符，几何精度不足；作者观察到同一冻结高斯表示在不同视角下的深度预测存在互补误差，可借此在不修改原始表示的前提下提升新视角几何。
AI.method: 将源视角深度重投影至目标视角，通过鲁棒多视角一致性融合生成候选深度；引入基于深度误差期望下降的学习式选择机制，判断候选深度是否优于原始预测；同时提出RIG——由同步RGB-D相机采集的真实基准，为静态与动态重建模型提供真值深度。
AI.result: 在3个基准、6个高斯溅射骨干网络上实验，REVEAL持续提升深度精度，同时保持可比的渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: 多视角互补几何可在不重训表示的情况下有效修正渲染深度，REVEAL作为通用后处理框架具良好泛化性，RIG为真实场景几何评测提供支撑。

title: RAVEC: Reward-Aligned Visual Evidence Correction
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves multimodal reasoning, but response-level feedback provides limited guidance on which intermediate decisions to correct. Visual interventions reveal sensitivity to image content, yet this sensitivity alone does not establish reward alignment or support across questions. We introduce RAVEC (Reward-Aligned Visual Evidence Correction), which selects visual corrections using local and cross-question reward support and jointly determines their strengths within each response. Paired Visual Evidence Contrast (PVEC) compares predictions from an exponential moving average teacher at the same sampled response prefix under the original image and a version with its annotated evidence region suppressed, yielding signed correction directions. Credit-Risk Allocation (CRA) screens these directions using local reward alignment and reward support from other questions, excluding all responses to the source question. It then solves a response-level budgeted allocation problem, assigning additional cost to directions that locally reduce predictive entropy. The resulting signed visual loss augments Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) during training. Inference uses only the original image and question. Across ten multimodal benchmarks, RAVEC achieves the highest average accuracy among the compared methods with both 3B and 7B Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct models, outperforming GRPO by 2.67 and 1.39 percentage points, respectively. Component ablations support the combined design of evidence alignment, credit qualification, and risk-aware allocation. The project is available at https://yangjj007.github.io/ravec/.

AI.tldr: 提出RAVEC框架，利用局部与跨问题奖励支持筛选视觉证据修正方向并在响应内分配强度，作为附加损失增强GRPO，在十个多模态基准上以3B/7B Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct取得最高平均准确率（较GRPO分别+2.67、1.39个百分点），推理时仅需原图与问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态可验证奖励强化学习仅提供响应级反馈，难以指导应纠正哪些中间决策；现有视觉干预虽显示对图像内容的敏感性，但这种敏感性本身不能确立奖励对齐性，也难以跨问题泛化支持。
AI.method: RAVEC（Reward-Aligned Visual Evidence Correction）：1) PVEC（Paired Visual Evidence Contrast）在相同采样响应前缀下，比较EMA教师对原图与抑制标注证据区域图像的预测，产生带符号的修正方向；2) CRA（Credit-Risk Allocation）用局部奖励对齐与来自其他问题（排除源问题全部响应）的奖励支持筛选方向，并求解响应级预算分配问题，将额外代价分配给能局部降低预测熵的方向；3) 所得带符号视觉损失在训练中增强GRPO。
AI.result: 在十个多模态基准上，RAVEC在3B与7B Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct上平均准确率均为对比方法中最高，分别较GRPO提升2.67与1.39个百分点；消融实验支持证据对齐、信用资格判定与风险感知分配三者的组合设计。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉证据干预转化为经奖励对齐筛选的细粒度修正信号，可在保持推理仅用原图与问题的前提下有效提升多模态推理性能，验证了证据对齐、信用筛选与风险分配联合设计的必要性。

title: From Dense to Sparse: Morton-Ordered Sparse Mapping for Efficient 3D Mesh Generation
summary: Unified 3D understanding and generation require compact sequences preserving spatial structure. Dense grids yield long sequences, while serialization can separate spatial neighbors. We propose Sparse Proximity Aware Compression (SPAC), a shared sparse SDF vocabulary combining sparse encoding with reversible spatial merging. A Sparse SDF VQ-VAE quantizes near-surface features while retaining explicit coordinates, using reconstruction supervision for surface fidelity and detail. 3D Byte-Pair Encoding (3D-BPE) merges recurring face-adjacent patterns using relative offsets before serialization. Macro tokens expand exactly into leaf tokens and coordinates. After Morton serialization, a shared LLM reads geometry for captioning and predicts tokens that decode into meshes for text-conditioned generation. With fixed geometry, architecture, and band width in voxels, sparse encoder cost grows approximately quadratically with resolution. 3D-BPE reduces mean complete LLM sequence length by 45.4 percent, including coordinates, text, and control tokens. SPAC achieves strong results in both 3D captioning and text-conditioned mesh generation. Ablations show gains over leaf tokens and Morton 1D-BPE in both tasks. The project page at https://yangjj007.github.io/spac/ .

AI.tldr: SPAC提出共享稀疏SDF词表，将稀疏编码与可逆空间合并结合，统一3D理解与生成，3D-BPE使LLM平均完整序列长度减少45.4%。
AI.motivation: 统一3D理解与生成需要紧凑且保留空间结构的序列；稠密网格序列过长，而序列化又会割裂空间邻接关系。
AI.method: 提出SPAC：稀疏SDF VQ-VAE量化近表面特征并保留显式坐标，以重建监督保证表面保真与细节；3D-BPE在序列化前用相对偏移合并重复的面邻接模式，宏token可精确展开为叶子token与坐标；经Morton序列化后由共享LLM读取几何做描述并预测token解码为网格以支持文本条件生成。
AI.result: 在固定几何、架构与体素带宽下，稀疏编码器开销随分辨率近似二次增长；3D-BPE将包含坐标、文本与控制token的平均完整LLM序列长度减少45.4%；在3D描述与文本条件网格生成上均取得强结果，消融显示优于叶子token与Morton 1D-BPE。
AI.conclusion: SPAC以共享稀疏SDF词表和可逆空间合并实现紧凑且保留空间结构的3D表示，有效统一理解与生成任务。

title: Why Adaptive Optimizers Struggle with Large Convolution Kernels
summary: Large convolution kernels enlarge the receptive fields of ConvNets at a modest computational cost, but they are notoriously difficult to train. Existing large-kernel networks therefore rely on costly training techniques, such as parallel small-kernel branches with batch normalization. In this paper, we trace this difficulty to adaptive optimizers such as Adam, which normalize the update of every weight separately. Since input features rarely average to zero, all weights of a kernel share a common gradient, and these optimizers move the mean of a $k\times k$ kernel $k$ times as far as a single parameter. We find this mean amplification in widely used ConvNets and vision transformers, and show that it can force the maximal learning rate to fall as $1/k^2$. We further prove that the basis of the discrete cosine transform (DCT) isolates the mean and is the only orthonormal basis that diagonalizes every stationary gradient statistic with mirrored boundaries. We therefore train large kernels through their DCT coefficients and convert them back after training. The resulting method, DCT-Rep, requires only a few lines of code and adds no parameters, no inference cost and negligible training overhead. Extensive experiments on image classification, object detection, semantic segmentation and image restoration show that DCT-Rep consistently improves large-kernel ConvNets and vision transformers, by $+0.79\%$ top-1 accuracy for a large-kernel ConvNeXt-T and $+0.43\%$ for ViT-S/16 on ImageNet-1K, $+1.4$ box AP on COCO, $+1.2$ mIoU on ADE20K and up to $+0.4$ dB on image deblurring, where the gain grows with the kernel size.

AI.tldr: 该论文将大卷积核难以训练的根源归因于Adam等自适应优化器对权重的逐元素更新所导致的"均值放大"效应，并据此提出通过DCT基参数化大核（DCT-Rep），无需额外参数与推理开销即可显著提升大核ConvNet与ViT的性能。
AI.motivation: 大卷积核能以较小计算代价扩大感受野，但训练困难，现有大核网络不得不依赖并行小核分支+BN等昂贵训练技巧。作者希望找到训练困难的真正原因并给出简洁有效的解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 分析：指出Adam等自适应优化器对每个权重单独归一化更新，而输入特征均值很少为零，使k×k卷积核所有共享同一共同梯度（近似常数信号），优化器对核的均值更新幅度是单个参数的k倍，即"均值放大"，可使最大学习率按1/k²下降；在ConvNet与ViT中验证该现象。2) 理论：证明DCT基能隔离均值分量，且是唯一在镜像边界下对角化所有平稳梯度统计量的标准正交基。3) 方法DCT-Rep：在DCT系数空间训练大核，训练后反变换回原参数空间。仅需几行代码，无额外参数、无推理开销、训练开销可忽略。
AI.result: 在图像分类、目标检测、语义分割、图像复原上一致提升大核ConvNet与ViT：ImageNet-1K上ConvNeXt-T +0.79% top-1、ViT-S/16 +0.43%；COCO +1.4 box AP；ADE20K +1.2 mIoU；图像去模糊最高+0.4 dB。增益随卷积核尺寸增大而增大。
AI.conclusion: 大核训练困难主要源于自适应优化器下的均值放大而非架构本身；通过DCT基训练可有效消除该问题，DCT-Rep是一种零推理成本、即插即用的通用改进方案。

title: Ego-HMB: Human Motion Bridging from Egocentric Images via A Motion Bridge Diffusion Model
summary: We introduce Egocentric Human Motion Bridging, a task that generates a coherent 3D human motion sequence from two endpoint egocentric images. Unlike conventional motion in-betweening, which requires structured 3D endpoint poses, this setting uses raw first-person observations available from wearable devices in VR/AR and robotics. It presents challenges due to viewpoint variations, partial body visibility, and temporal ambiguity under cross-modal endpoint constraints. To address these challenges, we propose Ego-HMB, a unified diffusion-based framework that learns endpoint pose estimation and temporally consistent motion infilling within a single model through two training stages. First, Egocentric-to-Canonical Pretraining uses a hierarchical curriculum with progressively increasing temporal spans to strengthen endpoint pose priors. Second, Motion Bridge Diffusion Training incorporates endpoint and physics awareness, diffusing from neighboring poses to promote temporal continuity while preserving global endpoint constraints. Extensive experiments compare our approach with one-stage methods that directly generate motion from two egocentric images and two-stage pipelines that combine endpoint pose estimation with motion interpolation. Ego-HMB consistently outperforms these baselines in endpoint accuracy and motion generation quality. Code is available at https://github.com/gaogehan/Ego-HMB.

AI.tldr: 提出 Ego-HMB，一个基于扩散的统一框架，从两张端点第一人称图像生成连贯三维人体运动序列（Egocentric Human Motion Bridging 任务）。
AI.motivation: 传统运动插值需结构化三维端点姿态，而可穿戴设备（VR/AR、机器人）只能提供原始第一人称观测；该设定面临视角变化、身体部分可见性、跨模态端点约束下的时间歧义等挑战。
AI.method: 单模型两阶段训练：① Egocentric-to-Canonical Pretraining，用时间跨度递增的分层课程强化端点姿态先验；② Motion Bridge Diffusion Training，引入端点感知与物理感知，从邻近姿态扩散以提升时间连续性并保持全局端点约束。
AI.result: 与一阶段方法（直接由两图生成运动）及两阶段流水线（端点姿态估计+运动插值）相比，在端点精度与运动生成质量上均稳定领先。
AI.conclusion: 验证了在单一扩散模型中统一端点姿态估计与时间一致运动补全的可行性，为第一人称可穿戴场景下的运动生成提供有效方案。

title: SpatialDuet: Bayesian task routing between a metric expert and a geometry expert for spatial intelligence
summary: Embodied assistants and wearable devices need 3D spatial reasoning, and their limited hardware restricts them to small vision-language models (VLMs). Small spatial VLMs acquire different abilities from their training: a model trained on large spatial question sets estimates object and room sizes well, whereas a model with a 3D geometry encoder is better at relative directions and absolute distances. Instead of training a single model for all spatial tasks, as published methods do, we build one system that uses each frozen model for the tasks it handles best. We propose SpatialDuet, which pairs a metric expert with a geometry expert under a Bayesian task router. The metric expert is a data-driven spatial VLM run with three training-free modules: training-aligned sampling, metric-aware minimum Bayes risk decoding and per-type metric calibration. The geometry expert is a VLM with a 3D geometry encoder. For each question type, the router estimates from labelled development questions how likely each expert is to be better, and pools their answers with that probability as weight, in log space for numeric answers and over the option distributions for multiple-choice answers. Extensive experiments on four spatial benchmarks covering video and single images validate SpatialDuet; it outperforms the best published small VLMs by 3.17% on VSI-Bench and, excluding a model trained on CV-Bench-style data, by 1.44% on CV-Bench, without training any model weight.

AI.tldr: SpatialDuet 将冻结的“度量专家”与“几何专家”小模型按题型经贝叶斯路由器加权融合，无需训练权重即在空间推理基准上超越现有小型 VLM。
AI.motivation: 具身助手与可穿戴设备硬件受限，只能用小型视觉语言模型（VLM），但单一模型难以胜任全部 3D 空间任务：在大量空间问答上训练的模型擅长估计物体与房间尺寸，而带 3D 几何编码器的模型擅长相对方向与绝对距离。已发表方法倾向于训练一个通才模型，忽略了不同模型能力互补这一事实。
AI.method: 提出 SpatialDuet：一个度量专家 + 一个几何专家，由贝叶斯任务路由器调度。度量专家是数据驱动的空间 VLM，配三个免训练模块——训练对齐采样、度量感知的最小贝叶斯风险解码、按题型的分类型度量校准；几何专家是带 3D 几何编码器的 VLM。路由器基于带标注的开发集问题，按题型估计各专家更优的概率，并以该概率为权重在对数空间（数值答案）或选项分布上（多选答案）融合两专家答案。
AI.result: 在覆盖视频与单图像的四个空间基准上验证：VSI-Bench 上比最佳已发表小型 VLM 高 3.17%；CV-Bench 上（排除在 CV-Bench 类数据上训练过的模型）高 1.44%；全程不训练任何模型权重。
AI.conclusion: 利用冻结小模型的能力互补性并以题型级贝叶斯路由融合，可在零权重训练下提升小型 VLM 的 3D 空间推理表现，为受限硬件上的具身空间智能提供了一条轻量、可扩展的集成路线。

title: Supply the Global, Supervise the Local: Combining Representation Conditioning and Alignment in Diffusion Transformers
summary:
A pretrained image representation helps train a diffusion transformer in several roles, including as an alignment target, which the model's hidden states learn to match, as in representation alignment (REPA), and as a condition, an extra input describing the image to be generated. Combined, they would give the model an input and a target, but whether they conflict is unknown. To test this, we let the condition carry only part of REPA's target: we split the representation of each image patch into an image-level (global) part, shared by all patches of the image, and a within-image (local) part, the patch's difference from the image-level part, and use one token carrying the image-level part as the condition. Then, the two roles overlap on the image-level part, where they could conflict, while only REPA supervises the within-image part, where we can see whether the token helps REPA.
  We find that the token and REPA together teach both the image-level part and the within-image part, the main source of REPA's FID improvement, far more than the sum of what each teaches alone, so they cooperate rather than conflict. These findings give one design rule for combining REPA with an image-level condition, supply the global, supervise the local, which we implement as Global-Condition REPA (GC-REPA): REPA with the token as an extra input; the token carries no information beyond REPA's target and is drawn at sampling from a separately trained token prior. GC-REPA greatly accelerates convergence: on ImageNet 256*256, SiT-XL/2 + GC-REPA reaches REPA's 4M- and SiT-XL/2's 7M-iteration FIDs within 200K and 100K iterations (20 and 70 fewer).

AI.tldr: 论文发现REPA（表征对齐）与图像级条件在DiT中并不冲突而是协同，提出"全局给条件、局部给监督"的设计规则，实现为GC-REPA，大幅加速收敛。
AI.motivation: 预训练图像表征在扩散Transformer中可充当对齐目标（REPA）和额外条件输入。两者合用相当于同时提供输入与目标，其是否冲突未知，需实验检验。
AI.method: 将每个图像块的表征分解为图像级（全局）部分（全图共享）与图内（局部）部分（块相对全局的差）。仅用携带全局部分的token作为条件；REPA对齐全局与局部部分。对比单独与联合效果。据此实现GC-REPA：REPA加该token作为额外输入，token不携带超出REPA目标的信息，采样时由单独训练的先验生成。
AI.result: token与REPA联合同时教会全局与局部部分（后者是REPA提升FID的主要来源），效果远超两者单独之和，表明协同而非冲突。ImageNet 256×256上，SiT-XL/2+GC-REPA在200K迭代达到REPA 4M迭代的FID，在100K迭代达到SiT-XL/2 7M迭代的FID（分别少20和70倍迭代）。
AI.conclusion: REPA与图像级条件可协同；推荐规则为"全局给条件，局部给监督"，GC-REPA显著加速收敛且不引入额外信息泄漏。

title: SilentWAM: Planning in the Masked State of a Diffusion World Model
summary: World-action models learn from future prediction, but accessing their future representations directly at test time can require costly frame generation. Methods that generate future frames before planning incur additional forward passes, while future co-training methods omit explicit future predictions at inference. We introduce \method, a planner that reads the hidden states of masked future tokens without decoding future frames. We pretrain MMaDA-Parallel-M on driving video using frame-level masked world modeling, which predicts a masked suffix of future frames and explicitly includes inputs with all future frames masked. Learned planning queries attend to these masked positions and the observed context, and a continuous head predicts the trajectory in the same forward pass. With a single front camera, \method reaches 92.0 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 89.3 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, with an end-to-end latency of 60.3\,ms.

AI.tldr: 提出一种规划器，直接读取掩码未来token的隐状态而无需解码未来帧，实现单前视相机下的高精度低延迟端到端轨迹规划。
AI.motivation: world-action模型依赖未来预测，但在测试时获取未来表征代价高：生成未来帧再规划需额外前向计算；而未来协同训练方法在推理时又缺失显式未来预测。因此需要一种既能利用未来建模收益、又避免测试期解码开销的方案。
AI.method: 先预训练MMaDA-Parallel-M：在驾驶视频上用帧级掩码世界建模，预测未来帧的掩码后缀，并显式引入所有未来帧全掩码的输入；规划查询（planning queries）通过与这些掩码位置及观测上下文做注意力交互，由连续头在同一前向传播中输出轨迹。
AI.result: 仅用单个前视相机，在NAVSIM v1上达到92.0 PDMS，在NAVSIM v2上达到89.3 EPDMS，端到端延迟60.3 ms。
AI.conclusion: 验证了“读隐状态、不解码”这一范式可兼顾未来world modeling的表征优势与推理效率，在不生成未来帧的前提下取得高规划性能与低延迟。

title: GAG-Net: Graph-Based Anatomical Guidance Network for Pharyngeal Area Segmentation in VFSS Images
summary: Diagnosing sarcopenic dysphagia typically requires costly supplementary imaging such as CT or MRI to assess muscle atrophy, burdening elderly patients. The pharyngeal area at rest (PA_rest), measurable directly from videofluoroscopic swallowing study (VFSS) images, is a promising biomarker that could eliminate this dependency, but repeated manual measurement has limited its adoption. PA_rest segmentation is further complicated by indistinct soft-tissue boundaries and clinical rule-based delineation criteria that data-driven models capture only imprecisely. We formulate automated PA_rest segmentation as a clinically defined measurement task, translating an implicit clinical measurement into an explicit landmark specification and annotation protocol developed with a rehabilitation medicine specialist. Applying this protocol, we constructed, to our knowledge, the first dataset for this task: 2,255 single-center VFSS frames from 137 patients, with PA_rest contours and seven landmarks verified by a senior specialist. We then introduce GAG-Net, an automated rest-frame measurement pipeline combining deformable convolutions, for irregular pharyngeal boundaries, with a graph-based anatomical guidance module that models the geometric dependencies among landmarks prescribed by the delineation rules. On a patient-level held-out test set (237 frames, 67 patients), GAG-Net achieved the lowest area measurement error (mean absolute percentage error: 8.17% against specialist-verified references; patient-level ICC 0.97) and the highest Dice score (0.8862) among all evaluated methods, with 67.2% fewer parameters and 74% less training memory than the two-stage JOINED model. Integrating clinician-defined anatomical knowledge may enable automated PA_rest measurement from VFSS images alone, supporting quantitative assessment of sarcopenic dysphagia without supplementary imaging.

AI.tldr: 提出自动化测量静息咽面积(PA_rest)的临床定义分割任务与首个数据集，并设计结合可变形卷积与图结构解剖引导的GAG-Net，在VFSS图像上实现高精度、低资源消耗的PA_rest自动测量。
AI.motivation: 诊断肌少性吞咽障碍通常依赖CT/MRI等昂贵补充影像评估肌肉萎缩，加重老年患者负担；VFSS图像中可直接测得的静息咽面积PA_rest是有潜力的替代生物标志物，但人工重复测量成本高、且软组织边界模糊与临床规则化勾画标准使数据驱动模型难以精确习得，限制了其推广。
AI.method: 将该任务形式化为“临床定义测量任务”，把隐式临床测量转化为显式关键点规范与标注协议（由康复医学专家共同制定）；构建首个该任务数据集：来自137例患者的2255帧单中心VFSS图像，含PA_rest轮廓与7个关键点，经资深专家核验；提出GAG-Net：可变形卷积应对不规则咽部边界，图结构解剖引导模块建模勾画规则所规定的关键点几何依赖。
AI.result: 在患者级留出测试集（237帧、67例）上，GAG-Net取得最低面积测量误差（MAPE 8.17%，参照专家核验值；患者级ICC 0.97）与最高Dice（0.8862）；相较两阶段JOINED模型参数量减少67.2%、训练显存减少74%。
AI.conclusion: 融合临床医生定义的解剖知识可使仅凭VFSS图像实现PA_rest自动测量，为无需补充影像的肌少性吞咽障碍定量评估提供支持。

title: XShot: Cross-Shot Video Object Insertion from a Reference Video
summary: We present XShot, a framework for cross-shot video object insertion, which adds objects to a shot by watching another shot of the same scene. Video productions show a scene through many shots, and objects added to one shot must appear consistently in the others. Most video editors take the appearance of new objects from reference images and their location from a text prompt, a mask or an edited keyframe, leaving this consistency to the user. XShot reads both from a reference video of another shot, which need not be aligned with the target, and needs no mask, box or camera pose. We build on a video Diffusion Transformer and formulate the task as in-context generation over the reference video, a few images of the objects and the target video. A geometry-aware cross-shot attention estimates the epipolar geometry between the two shots from the model's own correspondences and uses it to guide where the target reads the reference and the exemplars. We train XShot with an erase-and-restore data engine: objects are erased from one shot of a film or a multi-camera recording and restored from another shot of the scene. Experiments show that XShot places objects more accurately and renders them more faithfully than open-source and commercial video editors, while leaving the rest of the shot intact.

AI.tldr: XShot是一个跨镜头视频物体插入框架，通过观看同一场景的另一镜头来向目标镜头添加物体，无需掩码、框或相机位姿，实现跨镜头一致性。
AI.motivation: 视频制作中同一场景由多镜头呈现，添加到一个镜头的物体必须在其他镜头中保持一致。现有编辑工具从参考图像取外观、从文本提示/掩码/编辑关键帧取位置，把跨镜头一致性留给用户处理，效率低且难以保证。
AI.method: 基于视频Diffusion Transformer，将任务建模为对参考视频、少量物体图像与目标视频的上下文（in-context）生成；提出几何感知的跨镜头注意力，利用模型自身对应关系估计两镜头间的极线几何，指导目标镜头从参考与示例中读取信息；采用“擦除-恢复”数据引擎训练：从影片或多相机录制的一个镜头擦除物体，再由另一镜头恢复。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比开源与商业视频编辑器，XShot物体放置更准确、渲染更忠实，同时保持镜头其余部分不变。
AI.conclusion: XShot以参考镜头为唯一输入实现免对齐、免标注的跨镜头视频物体插入，借助极线几何约束的跨镜头注意力与擦除-恢复训练策略，在准确性和保真度上优于现有视频编辑方法。

title: Div3DAfford: Diverse 3D affordance grounding
summary: 3D affordance grounding aims to localize 3D regions specified by an interaction query. Existing methods predict a single affordance mask, overlooking the inherent diversity of human-object interactions. We introduce diverse 3D affordance grounding, a new task that requires predicting multiple plausible regions for a given object and affordance query. We then propose Div3DAffordNet, a transformer-based set prediction model capable of generating diverse affordance regions. To address the scarcity of diverse 3D affordance data, we develop an automated pipeline leveraging 2D generative models and 3D reconstruction techniques to synthesize 3D affordances, followed by lightweight human verification (reducing the annotation time by 72X), yielding the Div3DAfford benchmark. Extensive experiments show Div3DAffordNet effectively captures multi-mask affordance regions. Our method achieves the SOTA affordance grounding performance in the multi-mask setting, reducing GED-SIM from 0.745 to 0.492, while maintaining competitive single-mask performance on the standard benchmark of 19.0 mIoU.

AI.tldr: 提出多样化3D可供性定位新任务Div3DAfford，设计基于Transformer集合预测的Div3DAffordNet，并构建自动化合成+人工校验(标注时间缩短72倍)的Div3DAfford基准，在多掩码设置下将GED-SIM从0.745降至0.492，单掩码19.0 mIoU。
AI.motivation: 现有3D可供性定位方法仅预测单一可供性掩码，忽略了人-物交互固有的多样性，无法为同一对象与可供性查询给出多个合理区域。
AI.method: 定义多样化3D可供性定位任务；提出Div3DAffordNet——基于Transformer的集合预测模型，可一次生成多个多样性可供性区域；在数据方面，构建自动化流水线，利用2D生成模型与3D重建技术合成3D可供性，再经轻量人工校验(标注时间减少72倍)，得到Div3DAfford基准。
AI.result: 实验表明Div3DAffordNet能有效捕捉多掩码可供性区域；在多掩码设置下取得SOTA，GED-SIM由0.745降至0.492，同时在标准基准上保持有竞争力的单掩码性能(19.0 mIoU)。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将3D可供性定位从单解范式推进到多解范式，任务、模型与基准三方面协同贡献，验证了多样性建模的可行性与有效性。

title: Eidetic Code World Model
summary: Executable code can preserve a world's structural layout, yet video renderers frequently alter the appearance of previously visited places once they leave the camera view. We present Paintress, a code-conditioned world model that couples an executable geometric proxy with an independently parameterized 3D Gaussian appearance memory in a shared metric coordinate frame. While the proxy enforces structural and visibility constraints, 3D Gaussians capture the visual realization synthesized by emitted observations. To balance stable incremental fusion with consistent readout, Paintress separates writing from reading: newly emitted frames update a persistent raw Gaussian map under confidence-gated selection, whereas a cloned reader copy is globally refined against the observation archive and rendered with coverage masks to condition generation. We also introduce Expedition-33, a benchmark for generated-appearance retention across 11 static scenes, five route families, and 15, 30, and 60 s target absences (165 settings per system). Excluded from the opening image, targets are synthesized during a shared prefix and scored against each system's own first visit at matched return cameras. Across ten systems (1,650 videos), Paintress achieves 0.1220 ROI-LPIPS, 0.0613 MAE, and 52.12% detail retention (vs. 0.2731, 0.1401, and 10.91% for CWM), with lower discrepancy at 60 s (0.1630) than CWM, AgentGarten, and Lyra 2.0 achieve at 15 s.

AI.tldr: Paintress 提出代码条件世界模型，将可执行几何代理与独立参数的 3D 高斯外观记忆耦合于共享度量坐标系，并通过"写读分离"实现稳定的增量融合与一致回读，从而缓解重访场景的外观漂移。
AI.motivation: 可执行代码虽能保留世界的结构布局，但视频渲染器在已访问区域离开相机视野后常改变其外观，导致返回时出现外观不一致（生成外观保持性差）。
AI.method: 耦合可执行几何代理与独立参数化的 3D 高斯外观记忆，共享同一度量坐标系：代理约束结构与可见性，高斯捕捉由输出观测合成的视觉实现。写入与读取分离：新生成的帧在置信度门控选择下更新持久原始高斯图；克隆的读取器副本针对观测档案全局精修，并用覆盖掩码渲染以条件化生成。另构建 Expedition-33 基准，覆盖 11 个静态场景、5 类路线、15/30/60 s 目标缺席，每系统 165 组设置。
AI.result: 在 10 个系统共 1,650 个视频上，Paintress 取得 ROI-LPIPS 0.1220、MAE 0.0613、细节保持率 52.12%（CWM 为 0.2731、0.1401、10.91%）；在 60 s 缺席时差异为 0.1630，低于 CWM、AgentGarten、Lyra 2.0 在 15 s 时的水平。
AI.conclusion: 将结构代理与外观记忆解耦、并分离写入与读取，能显著提升长时缺席后重访场景的外观保持性与一致性，在多项指标与对比系统上取得领先。

title: CivilCADBench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Understanding, Reconstructing, and Designing Civil Engineering Drawing Sets
summary: Civil infrastructure is designed, built, and maintained through engineering drawing sets, yet preparing and revising them remains labour-intensive and calls for automation. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are promising candidates, but assessing them requires a benchmark grounded in real engineering practice. We introduce CivilCADBench, a benchmark for understanding, reconstructing, and designing civil engineering drawing sets, built from real infrastructure drawings and source CAD files containing over 250,000 CAD entities. Unlike parametric 3D CAD models, these drawings are dense, layered, and multi-sheet; and since prints are lossy projections with no pixel trace of layers, a file can print correctly yet remain wrongly organised. CivilCADBench comprises three task families of increasing difficulty: understanding tasks are evaluated with 2,183 expert-reviewed questions ranging from single sheets to whole sets, while reconstruction and design tasks are agentic, requiring models to rebuild printed pages as editable CAD files, either as single pages or entire drawing sets, and to produce new designs. These tasks are performed across 232 pages, 28 sets, and 19 design tasks, and evaluated by a deterministic scorer that compares model outputs with the designers' source files on geometry, layers, text, and dimensions. We evaluate seven frontier MLLMs on CivilCADBench, and find that they read and redraw printed content accurately but recover the file structure poorly: the best model scores above 90% in understanding and single-page reconstruction, yet only 60% on layer assignment and 48% on design. Grounded in real engineering practice, CivilCADBench exposes both the capabilities and the limitations of frontier models in professional civil engineering, laying a foundation for next-generation models and agentic systems for intelligent civil engineering.

AI.tldr: 提出CivilCADBench——基于真实土木工程图纸与CAD源文件构建的基准，用于评测多模态大模型对图纸集的理解、重建与设计能力，并揭示前沿模型"能读懂、画得像，但结构恢复差"的核心短板。
AI.motivation: 土木基础设施的设计、建造与维护依赖工程图纸集，但其编制与修改高度依赖人工，亟需自动化。MLLM是有潜力的候选方案，然而缺少贴合真实工程实践的评测基准：现有基准多基于参数化3D CAD模型，而真实工程图纸是密集、分层、多图纸的二维打印投影，打印件无图层像素痕迹，导致"打印正确但文件组织错误"的隐蔽缺陷无法被现有基准捕捉。
AI.method: 构建CivilCADBench，源自真实基础设施图纸及含25万+CAD实体的源文件。设计三类难度递增任务：(1)理解任务——2,183道专家审核问题，覆盖单图至整套图纸；(2)重建任务——智能体需将打印页面重建为可编辑CAD文件（单页/整套）；(3)设计任务——生成新设计。规模为232页、28套图纸、19项设计任务，采用确定性评分器，将模型输出与设计师源文件在几何、图层、文本、标注四个维度上比对。评测7个前沿MLLM。
AI.result: 模型在"读取与重绘"上表现优异，"恢复文件结构"上明显薄弱：最佳模型在理解与单页重建上超过90%，但图层分配仅约60%，设计任务仅48%。即"能读懂、画得像，但结构恢复差"。
AI.conclusion: CivilCADBench扎根真实工程实践，同时暴露了前沿模型在专业土木工程中的能力与局限，为下一代模型与智能体系统提供评测基础；未来改进重点应放在图层语义、结构组织与设计生成能力上。

title: Learning How a Body Moves: Few-Shot Body Inference for Visual World Models of Animated Characters
summary: Two visually identical animated characters can respond differently to the same action command because their body dynamics differ. For example, a stiff blob and its bouncy twin reach different heights when both receive the jump command. Given only the first frame and the action command, a visual world model has no information to distinguish these twins, because their initial appearances are identical. We therefore propose an in-context world model that encodes clips of a character's other actions into a body representation, using a contrastive loss to separate look-alike characters. We introduce ToonTwins, a benchmark of 144 2D cartoon characters that run, jump, fall, turn and crouch. Its characters form look-alike groups of four that differ only in their dynamics profile, and we also evaluate the model on 32 animated animals from DeformingThings4D. Even with a body code from these clips, the latent pixel world model we tested recovered at most 25 percent of the twins' jump height difference. On new shapes, our model identified the correct twin in 85.9 percent of cases, compared with 76.7 percent for a transformer baseline that reads the same clips without a body summary, and in a controlled ablation the contrastive loss gave more than half of this gain. On the animated animals, it reduced the mean path prediction error by 8.5 percent against a model without body information.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出in-context world model,用角色其他动作片段编码"身体表征",并以对比损失区分外观相同的角色,同时构建ToonTwins基准。
AI.motivation: 视觉完全相同的动画角色因身体动力学不同,对同一动作指令会产生不同响应;而仅凭首帧和指令,世界模型无法区分这些"双胞胎",缺乏身体动力学身份信息。
AI.method: 提出in-context world model:将角色其他动作的片段编码为身体表征(body code),并采用对比损失将外观相似但动力学不同的角色在表征空间中分离。构建ToonTwins基准(144个2D卡通角色,执行run/jump/fall/turn/crouch,组成4个仅动力学profile不同的相似组),并在DeformingThings4D的32个动画动物上评测。
AI.result: 所测潜像素世界模型最多仅恢复双胞胎跳跃高度差的25%;新形状上正确识别双胞胎的比例为85.9%,高于读取同样片段但无身体摘要的transformer基线(76.7%),消融显示对比损失贡献超过一半增益;在动画动物上相对无身体信息模型将平均路径预测误差降低8.5%。
AI.conclusion: 显式身体表征与对比学习能有效帮助世界模型区分外观相同但动力学不同的角色,提升跨形状泛化与动力学预测;但潜在像素世界模型对动力学差异的恢复能力仍有限,存在较大提升空间。

title: Omni-H3-Image: Constrained Foundation Priors Usher in a New Era of All-in-One Blind Image Restoration
summary: Off-the-shelf unified image models such as 33B MiniMax-H3-Image, FLUX.1-Kontext, and Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 synthesize crisp textures yet collapse to 11.33-16.74 dB PSNR across 429 degraded public restoration scenes due to spatial drift, chromatic hallucination, and semantic fabrication. We present Omni-H3-Image (Omni-H3), an approximate three-stage constrained posterior projection framework over unmodified MiniMax-H3-Image and Qwen3-VL-32B using only a 0.92M-parameter auxiliary weather pre-conditioner (<0.003% of backbone weights). Omni-H3 unifies blind physics-VLM sensing with exact-32 px lattice anchoring, joint affine-Wiener-Butterworth projection in opponent YCbCr space, and closed-loop Z=4 text verification with sub-Nyquist abstention. Across 925 blind tasks against 11 external SOTA baselines -- five public benchmarks (N=647), Dev-160, and a held-out locked_test suite (N=118) -- Omni-H3 recovers +4.73 dB degraded-scene PSNR over Base H3 (21.47 vs. 16.74 dB; +6.27-10.14 dB over other omni backbones) while winning overall #1 DISTS (0.207), #1 NIQE (4.45), and #1 Edge-F1 (0.807) on all 429 degraded public scenes (MUSIQ 66.8 vs. 40-44 for discriminative SOTA), 76.59 dB on CBSD68 Clean, -91.6% Urban100 chroma drift, #1 2K Dev Non-Clean DISTS (0.202), and #1 locked_test 2K DISTS (0.173) and 132-ROI SubCER, cutting pre-annotated 132-ROI SubCER from 0.456 to 0.319 under non-Qwen RapidOCR (PP-OCRv4) (with recognizer-dependent tradeoffs under TrOCR-large-str).

AI.tldr: 提出 Omni-H3，一个在未修改的 MiniMax-H3-Image 与 Qwen3-VL-32B 之上叠加的三阶段约束后验投影框架，仅用 0.92M 参数辅助模块，在 429 个退化场景上将 PSNR 从 16.74 dB 提升至 21.47 dB，并在 DISTS、NIQE、Edge-F1 等指标上取得综合第一。
AI.motivation: 现成统一图像模型（如 33B MiniMax-H3-Image、FLUX.1-Kontext、Qwen-Image-Edit-2511）虽能生成清晰纹理，但在退化图像复原场景中因空间漂移、色度幻觉与语义捏造而严重崩塌，PSNR 仅 11.33–16.74 dB。
AI.method: 基于未修改的 MiniMax-H3-Image 与 Qwen3-VL-32B 主干，仅训练 0.92M 参数（<0.003% 主干权重）的天气预条件器，构建近似三阶段约束后验投影：①盲物理-VLM 感知 + 精确 32px 格点锚定；②对手 YCbCr 空间中的仿射-Wiener-Butterworth 联合投影；③Z=4 文本闭环校验与亚奈奎斯特弃权机制。
AI.result: 在 925 个盲任务、11 个外部 SOTA 基线上：退化场景 PSNR 较 Base H3 提升 +4.73 dB（21.47 vs 16.74 dB），较其他 omni 主干领先 6.27–10.14 dB；429 个退化公开场景上 DISTS 0.207、NIQE 4.45、Edge-F1 0.807 均居第一，MUSIQ 66.8（判别式 SOTA 为 40–44）；CBSD68 Clean 达 76.59 dB；Urban100 色度漂移降低 91.6%；2K Dev Non-Clean DISTS 0.202、locked_test 2K DISTS 0.173 均第一；132-ROI SubCER 由 0.456 降至 0.319（PP-OCRv4 下）。
AI.conclusion: 以极低参数开销的约束后验投影即可显著抑制统一图像模型在复原任务中的空间漂移、色度幻觉与语义捏造，实现感知与保真度双重领先；文本保真收益依赖识别器，存在 TrOCR-large-str 下的权衡。

title: PointNeXt Adapter Improved Model for BIM Component Defect Association under Construction Images and Design Model Attributes
summary: Construction site defect analysis increasingly requires linking field evidence to the correct BIM object, because a crack, spalling area, missing sleeve or misaligned support is useful for quality control only when it is connected with component identity, location, responsibility and design intent. This paper proposes a PointNeXt Adapter improved model for BIM component defect association under construction images and design model attributes. The method aligns site image crops, local point cloud patches, BIM component identifiers, geometry attributes, material categories, installation stage, inspection distance, viewpoint quality and source reliability tags into component level inspection windows. PointNeXt learns local geometry and deviation from as built point evidence, while the adapter injects BIM attributes so the same geometric irregularity can be interpreted differently for structural, envelope, MEP and embedded components. The fusion head outputs component link, defect class, defect probability, confidence, dominant evidence and recommended review action. A synthetic multisource BIM inspection dataset is used to evaluate repeated layouts, occlusion, sparse point clouds, registration errors and unseen component arrangements. Results show that attribute aware point learning improves association accuracy, defect recall and confidence calibration compared with image only, point only, simple fusion and adapter free baselines. The framework is positioned as traceable BIM issue review support, requiring manual confirmation and staged field validation before operational deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出一种PointNeXt Adapter改进模型，将施工图像与BIM属性对齐到构件级检查窗口，实现现场缺陷与BIM构件的可追溯关联，并在合成多源数据集上验证其优于纯图像、纯点云、简单融合及无适配器基线。
AI.motivation: 施工缺陷（裂缝、剥落、缺套管、支撑错位等）只有在与构件身份、位置、责任归属和设计意图建立联系后，才对质量控制有意义；现有方法难以将现场证据准确映射到正确BIM对象。
AI.method: 构建构件级检查窗口，对齐现场图像裁剪、局部点云块、BIM构件标识、几何属性、材料类别、安装阶段、检查距离、视角质量与来源可靠性标签；用PointNeXt学习局部几何与实建偏差，并通过Adapter注入BIM属性，使相同几何异常在结构、围护、MEP及预埋构件中可有不同解释；融合头输出构件链接、缺陷类别、概率、置信度、主证据与建议复核动作。
AI.result: 在合成多源BIM检查数据集上（覆盖重复布局、遮挡、稀疏点云、配准误差和未见构件布置），属性感知点学习相比纯图像、纯点云、简单融合和无适配器基线，在关联准确率、缺陷召回率和置信度校准方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 该框架定位为可追溯的BIM问题复核支持工具，运行部署前仍需人工确认与分阶段现场验证。

title: Inference Dynamics: Image Classifiers Keep Using Visual Cues After They Are Removed
summary: Image classifiers are typically evaluated by their final predictions, treating inference as a static image-to-label mapping. Reliability, however, also depends on whether a model can relinquish evidence after that evidence disappears. We reveal a counterintuitive phenomenon: removing a local visual cue from its original location may not remove its influence on the prediction. Once captured by early layers, the cue can become distributed across later representations, making ``no longer visible'' different from ``no longer relied upon.'' We introduce Inference Dynamics, a process-level framework for tracing how cue influence evolves and remains withdrawable across network depth. Given an image and a matched cue-removed reference, we replace cue-aligned states in the original branch with their reference counterparts at successive layers and measure recovery toward the cue-free prediction. The resulting trajectory separates evidence locality from decision-level withdrawability. Across datasets and architectures, we find locality declines before withdrawability collapses: cue-induced information becomes less concentrated at its original support while its effect remains active, before entering an evidence lock-in stage.
