Consequently, fixed late-stage correction may alter the final readout without removing accumulated cue dependence. We therefore propose Evidence Reset, which selects an input-dependent layer before lock-in and reconstructs cue-aligned states toward their cue-free counterparts. Our results establish evidence withdrawability as a process-level dimension of classifier reliability and suggest a new intervention principle: correction depth should follow the dynamics of evidence rather than be fixed in advance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"推理动力学(Inference Dynamics)"框架，从过程层面对图像分类器的证据可撤回性进行追踪，揭示局部线索的影响会先失去局部性、再进入"证据锁定"阶段，并据此提出"Evidence Reset"干预方法。
AI.motivation: 现有图像分类器评估只看最终预测，把推理视为静态的图像到标签映射。但可靠性还取决于模型能否在证据消失后放弃该证据。作者发现反直觉现象：移除原始位置的局部视觉线索，并不一定消除其对预测的影响——线索一旦被浅层捕获，就会在后续表示中扩散，导致"不再可见"不等于"不再被依赖"。因此需要从过程层面刻画证据影响如何随网络深度演化与可撤回性。
AI.method: 提出 Inference Dynamics 过程级框架：给定原图与匹配的去线索参考图，在逐层位置用参考分支的对应状态替换原分支中与线索对齐的状态，测量预测向"无线索预测"的恢复程度，得到轨迹，从而把"证据局部性"与"决策级可撤回性"分离。基于所发现的"锁定"现象，进一步提出 Evidence Reset：选择一个依赖输入的、位于锁定之前的层，将线索对齐状态向无线索对应状态重构。
AI.result: 跨数据集与架构的实验显示：局部性先下降，而可撤回性随后才崩塌——线索信息在其原始支撑位置上的集中度降低，但其效应仍然活跃，之后进入"证据锁定(evidence lock-in)"阶段。因此固定地在后期层做修正，可能改变最终读出却无法消除已累积的线索依赖。
AI.conclusion: 论文将"证据可撤回性"确立为分类器可靠性的过程级维度，并提出新的干预原则：修正深度应遵循证据的动力学，而非预先固定；Evidence Reset 通过在锁定前选取输入相关层进行重构，比固定晚期修正更有效地移除线索依赖。

title: AdapToC: A Unified Framework for Multi-Task Visual Token Communication
summary: Pretrained discrete visual tokenizers supply compact latents for synthesis, recognition, and embodied perception, yet wireless token streaming remains fragile. Under fading and noisy pilots, hard cyclic redundancy check (CRC) erasures turn corrupted blocks into missing tokens while frozen decoders amplify edge errors, which can collapse unequal error protection (UEP) into a binary choice between strong coding and omission under severe fading. Soft bit posteriors break this collapse. We present AdapToC, a single-pass transceiver that restores multi-tier rate-distortion tradeoffs without altering tokenizer weights or differentiating through pixel decoders. We align codebook geometry to the channel via offline frequency-weighted Pseudo-Gray relabeling and Halton dispersion to contract bit and burst errors with zero overhead. Because soft recovery pulls intermediate rates onto the three-tier convex hull, our unit-gated AdaLN sender schedules protection tiers across channel budgets, while our pilot-calibrated receiver feeds factorized codebook posteriors into a ConvNeXt-attention restorer with CRC bypass. We co-train AdapToC solely in latent space via counterfactual utility estimation and codebook cross-entropy regularization. On identical VQGAN-f16 tokens, AdapToC outperforms TONIC and adaptive TokenCom+AMC, cuts multi-SNR Rayleigh LPIPS from 0.6551 to 0.3312 within the frozen-tokenizer PSNR ceiling, and saves 43.8% Rician-K6 symbols at matched quality. Our single-pass restorer runs 8.3x faster than iterative resampling, raises accuracy while accelerating decoder-free recognition 20.6x, and improves fidelity plug-and-play across TiTok, VAR, and zero-shot NuPlan.

AI.tldr: AdapToC 是一种单遍无线视觉 token 收发系统，通过在潜在空间利用软比特后验恢复多层级率失真权衡，在冻结 tokenizer 条件下显著优于 TONIC 与 TokenCom+AMC。
AI.motivation: 预训练离散视觉 tokenizer 产生的紧凑潜变量在无线流式传输中很脆弱：衰落与导频噪声下，硬 CRC 擦除会把损坏块变成缺失 token，冻结解码器又放大边缘错误，使不等错误保护（UEP）在严重衰落时退化为"强编码"或"直接丢弃"的二元选择。
AI.method: 1) 离线频率加权 Pseudo-Gray 重标号 + Halton 离散化，将码本几何对齐信道，零开销抑制比特与突发错误；2) 单元门控 AdaLN 发送端在信道预算下调度多保护层级；3) 导频校准接收端将因子化码本后验送入带 CRC 旁路的 ConvNeXt-attention 恢复器；4) 仅在潜空间通过反事实效用估计与码本交叉熵正则联合训练，不修改 tokenizer 权重、不穿透像素解码器求导。
AI.result: 在相同 VQGAN-f16 token 上，多 SNR Rayleigh 条件下 LPIPS 从 0.6551 降至 0.3312（处于冻结 tokenizer 的 PSNR 上限内）；等质量下 Rician-K6 节省 43.8% 符号；单遍恢复器比迭代重采样快 8.3 倍；无解码器识别加速 20.6 倍且精度提升；在 TiTok、VAR 与零样本 NuPlan 上即插即用提升保真度。
AI.conclusion: 软比特后验打破硬擦除导致的 UEP 二元坍缩，使中间速率落入三层凸包；AdapToC 以单遍、低复杂度方式实现稳健且可迁移的无线视觉 token 流传输。

title: UNIFY: Unified Learning with One Model via Batch Norm Switching
summary: Neural networks are typically trained separately for individual datasets or tasks, resulting in many task-specific models. This redundancy increases memory footprint, deployment costs, and energy consumption limiting their scalability. We propose UNIFY, a unified learning framework that enables a single model to jointly learn and perform inference across multiple datasets via Batch Normalization Switching (BNS). Instead of maintaining separate models for each dataset, UNIFY shares the parameter-intensive backbone while maintaining dataset-specific BN statistics and parameters, along with dataset-specific classification heads. We validate our framework using five datasets (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet) across six Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) of different sizes (SqueezeNet 1.1, WideResNet-40-2, WideResNet-16-8, ResNet-18, ResNet-34, ResNet-50). Notably, a single UNIFIED ResNet-34 trained on these datasets achieves accuracies of 99.53%, 94.84%, 96.12%, 80.32%, and 67.67%, respectively, outperforming the average performance of the corresponding independently trained task-specific models while reducing the memory footprint by approximately 4.94x, from 428.30 MB (five separate models) to 86.71 MB (one unified model). UNIFY aims not only to consolidate (K) models into a single model but also to enhance model-effectiveness by leveraging complementary knowledge across datasets. It paves the way for scalable, efficient, and unified learning capable of handling diverse image classification tasks. Code is available at: https://github.com/saktx/UNIFY.

AI.tldr: 提出UNIFY统一学习框架，通过批归一化切换(BNS)让单个模型联合学习并在多数据集上推理，共享骨干参数、保留数据集专属BN统计与分类头，显著降低内存并提升平均精度。
AI.motivation: 神经网络通常针对单个数据集或任务分别训练，产生大量任务专用模型，导致内存占用、部署成本和能耗冗余，限制可扩展性。作者希望将K个模型整合为单一模型，并借助跨数据集互补知识提升模型有效性。
AI.method: UNIFY框架采用Batch Normalization Switching (BNS)：共享参数密集的骨干网络，同时为每个数据集维护专属的BN统计量与BN参数，以及数据集专属分类头；单模型联合训练并在推理时按数据集切换BN与分类头。在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet五个数据集与六种CNN（SqueezeNet 1.1、WideResNet-40-2、WideResNet-16-8、ResNet-18/34/50）上进行验证。
AI.result: 单个UNIFY ResNet-34在五个数据集上分别达到99.53%、94.84%、96.12%、80.32%、67.67%的准确率，超过对应独立任务专用模型的平均性能；内存占用从428.30 MB（五个独立模型）降至86.71 MB（单一统一模型），约降低4.94倍。
AI.conclusion: UNIFY不仅实现K模型到单模型的整合，还通过跨数据集互补知识提升模型有效性，为面向多样图像分类任务的可扩展、高效统一学习提供了可行路径。

title: Seeing Is Not Planning: Spatiotemporal Planning and Plan Repair in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Planning in a visual world means reading the layout, foreseeing how the state will change, and following the task rules all at once. When a plan fails, a model should also use what went wrong to fix it. We call these two abilities spatiotemporal planning and plan repair, and test them with Railbound-Bench. A model sees a railway puzzle, adds tracks under a budget, and submits one complete layout; a simulator then moves all cars at once and decides whether the layout works. After a failure, the model sees what happened and may submit a new layout, up to five attempts in total. On the 200-puzzle main set, the best of nine models solves 59.5% within five attempts, the next 39.5%, and the other seven at most 10.0%; a 1,000-puzzle extended set with a wider range of difficulty is far easier, at 90.9% for the best model. Controlled studies on 180 fixed puzzles show that knowing the task is not the same as using it. GPT-6.1 Terra copies 97.2% of boards exactly and, given a correct layout as text, predicts all four requested future states in 91.3% of cases, yet only 22.8% of its first layouts work. Planning fails more often as the cars' routes interact, even among puzzles that a search solver finds equally easy. Visual feedback removes the reported fault in 175 of 417 first revisions, but only 43 of these revisions solve the puzzle, and at an equal budget of 40k tokens it does no better than fresh retries. The code and data are open-sourced on GitHub at https://github.com/liaoyanqing666/Railbound_Bench.

AI.tldr: 提出 Railbound-Bench 铁路解谜基准，测试多模态模型的时空规划与计划修复能力；九个模型中最佳者五次内仅解出59.5%，第二名39.5%，其余≤10.0%，且视觉反馈修复效率低。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界中的规划需同时读取布局、预判状态演化并遵循任务规则，失败后还应利用错误信息修复计划。现有基准缺乏对"时空规划+计划修复"这一组合能力的系统评测，故构建专用基准。
AI.method: 构建 Railbound-Bench：模型观察铁路谜题，在预算内添加轨道并提交一份完整布局，模拟器同时驱动所有车厢判定是否可行；失败后可见运行结果并重交，最多五次。主集200题，另设1000题扩展集（难度跨度更大，含更容易题）。并进行180道固定题的受控实验，比较"知道任务"与"使用任务"、文本化前瞻预测、路线交互程度影响、以及视觉反馈修复与等预算（40k tokens）重试的对比。
AI.result: 主集上最佳模型五次内成功率59.5%，次优39.5%，其余七个≤10.0%；扩展集最佳达90.9%。受控实验中 GPT-6.1 Terra 精确复制棋盘97.2%、给定正确布局文本时预测四种未来状态准确率91.3%，但首次布局仅22.8%可行；车厢路线交互越强失败率越高（即便搜索求解器认为难度相同）；视觉反馈在417次首次修订中有175次消除了所报故障，但仅43次真正解题，且在40k tokens等预算下不优于重新尝试。
AI.conclusion: 模型在布局理解与状态预测上表现良好，但将其转化为可行规划、并利用反馈有效修复计划的能力显著不足；路线交互是规划失败的关键因素，视觉反馈的修复收益有限。代码与数据已开源。

title: RSWP: Robust SO(3)-Equivariant Watermarking for Panoramic Images
summary: Robust watermarking for panoramic imagery is impeded by the topological mismatch between spherical signals and planar representations. Conventional methods fail under $SO(3)$ viewing rotations due to non-linear geometric warping and struggle with viewport extraction, which typically necessitates computationally expensive inverse remapping. To address these challenges, we propose RSWP, a watermarking framework grounded in icosahedral group theory. Leveraging the property that the icosahedral group ($\mathcal{I}_{60}$) serves as the largest discrete subgroup of $SO(3)$, we decompose spherical rotations into tractable local planar rotations and combinatorial facet permutations. Accordingly, we introduce a decoupling architecture that embeds watermarks into discrete facets and a theoretically guaranteed Equivariance-to-Invariance decoding paradigm. By employing an equivariant feature extractor followed by a permutation-invariant sorting module, this paradigm rigorously synchronizes rotation-distorted features. Moreover, the dual-extractor design inherently supports direct, blind watermark retrieval from partial 2D renderings without geometric calibration. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RSWP achieves state-of-the-art robustness against continuous $SO(3)$ rotations and viewport transformations while preserving high visual fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出基于二十面体群理论的球面全景图像水印框架 RSWP，通过"嵌入-解码解耦"与"等变到不变"范式，实现对 SO(3) 连续旋转和视口变换的鲁棒盲水印提取。
AI.motivation: 全景球形信号与平面表示之间存在拓扑失配，传统水印方法在 SO(3) 视角旋转下因非线性几何畸变而失效；视口提取通常需计算昂贵的逆映射，难以实现直接盲提取。
AI.method: 以二十面体群 I₆₀（SO(3) 最大离散子群）为基础，将球面旋转分解为局部平面旋转与面片置换；设计解耦架构，在离散面片上嵌入水印；引入理论可保证的"等变到不变"解码范式——先使用等变特征提取器，再经置换不变的排序模块对齐旋转畸变特征；双提取器设计支持无需几何标定地从部分 2D 渲染图直接盲提取。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，RSWP 在连续 SO(3) 旋转与视口变换下达到 SOTA 鲁棒性，同时保持较高视觉保真度。
AI.conclusion: 利用二十面体群的离散子群结构可有效弥合球面与平面表示间的拓扑鸿沟，解耦嵌入与等变-不变解码为全景图像水印提供了高鲁棒、免标定的实用方案。

title: Exploring Attention-Driven Deep Learning for Accurate Lung Nodule Segmentation
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted manuscript of a paper published at IEEE EMBC 2025
summary: This study explores the application of various deep learning models for the segmentation of lung nodules using LIDC-IDRI. Unlike traditional approaches that utilize the full dataset, our work emphasizes the efficacy of training models on a filtered subset of 356 samples. Novel configurations, including attention mechanisms and advanced preprocessing strategies, were employed to optimize segmentation accuracy. Among the models evaluated, the DPL nkNet50 with a Channel Attention Bridge and ResNet backbone demonstrated the highest performance with a Dice score of 0.86, significantly outperforming conventional architectures. This work underscores the potential of leveraging data efficiency and tailored architectures in achieving robust segmentation performance, paving the way for improved computer-aided diagnosis in clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 本文基于LIDC-IDRI数据集，探索多种深度学习模型用于肺结节分割，重点验证在仅356例过滤子集上训练的有效性；其中带Channel Attention Bridge与ResNet骨干的DPL nkNet50取得最高Dice 0.86。
AI.motivation: 传统方法依赖全量数据集训练，本文意在验证数据效率（小规模过滤子集）与定制化架构结合的可行性，以提升分割性能并服务于临床计算机辅助诊断。
AI.method: 在LIDC-IDRI上选取过滤后的356例样本；引入注意力机制等新颖配置与高级预处理策略；评估多种深度分割模型，其中DPL nkNet50采用Channel Attention Bridge与ResNet骨干。
AI.result: DPL nkNet50（Channel Attention Bridge + ResNet骨干）表现最佳，Dice达0.86，显著优于传统架构。
AI.conclusion: 数据效率与定制化架构可共同实现稳健的肺结节分割性能，为临床计算机辅助诊断提供可行路径。

title: MSBench: Benchmarking Script-Controlled Multi-Shot Text-to-Video Generation
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) models can now generate visually plausible short clips, but multi-shot generation requires a different set of skills: composing multiple shots with intended cut timing, transition style, camera language, and cross-shot continuity. How far this multi-shot output can be controlled from text remains unmeasured: existing benchmarks either evaluate single shots or, when they provide shot-level scripts, typically check whether the requested shots appear but not when they change or how they are joined. We introduce MSBench, a benchmark for controllable text-driven multi-shot video generation built around structured Scene-Entity-Shot mini-scripts that specify each shot's time span, camera state, content, and outgoing transition. MSBench defines a four-dimensional hybrid evaluation framework spanning Visual Quality, Dynamic Quality, Semantic Alignment, and Cross-Shot Consistency with 11 sub-metrics. Experiments on 14 commercial and open-source systems show that visual quality does little to separate the systems, whereas multi-shot control does: many models cut mainly on scene changes and render requested gradual transitions as hard cuts. Human evaluations further validate MSBench, with its system ranking reaching a Spearman correlation of 0.87 with human preferences. The project page is available at https://totalhuang.github.io/MSBench-page/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MSBench，一个面向可控文本驱动多镜头视频生成的基准，基于Scene-Entity-Shot结构化迷你剧本，定义四维11项指标评估体系，并在14个系统上验证其区分度与人类一致性（Spearman 0.87）。
AI.motivation: 现有T2V模型能生成逼真短视频，但多镜头生成需要切分时机、转场风格、镜头语言与跨镜头连续性等额外能力。现有基准或只评测单镜头，或仅检查请求镜头是否出现，而不考察"何时切换"与"如何衔接"，因此多镜头文本可控性尚未被量化。
AI.method: 构建MSBench基准，采用Scene-Entity-Shot结构化迷你剧本，明确每镜头的时段时间跨度、相机状态、内容与出画转场；并设计四维混合评测框架（视觉质量、动态质量、语义对齐、跨镜头一致性），共11项子指标。
AI.result: 在14个商业与开源系统上实验：视觉质量几乎无法区分各系统，而多镜头控制能力差异显著——多数模型主要按场景变化切换，并将要求的渐变转场渲染为硬切；人工评估验证MSBench系统排序与人类偏好Spearman相关达0.87。
AI.conclusion: MSBench填补了多镜头文本可控性评测的空白，揭示当前系统在镜头时序与转场控制上的普遍短板，并证明该基准与人类判断高度一致，可作为多镜头T2V生成的有效评估工具。

title: FP-Prune: Rethinking Visual Token Pruning from an Information Gain Perspective
summary: Visual token pruning can reduce the inference cost of vision language models, but its effectiveness depends on preserving complementary visual information under a limited token budget. A central challenge is to quantify the additional information a candidate token contributes beyond the retained set, a contribution that conventional scores based on attention or similarity struggle to capture directly. In this work, we revisit visual token pruning from the perspective of information gain and use mutual information to characterize the incremental value of candidate tokens. We further establish theoretically that frame potential serves as an effective surrogate for mutual information. Building on this observation, we propose FP-Prune, a training-free visual token pruning method that iteratively removes tokens with low information gain to preserve as much complementary visual information as possible. Experiments on three widely used VLMs and eight datasets demonstrate that FP-Prune outperforms baseline methods in both accuracy and inference efficiency. Further analysis shows that the surrogate objective closely aligns with model performance. Our work provides theoretical grounding and an effective method for visual token pruning.

AI.tldr: FP-Prune：以帧势（frame potential）作为互信息的代理指标，实现免训练的视觉token剪枝，保留互补信息，在准确率与推理效率上优于基线。
AI.motivation: 视觉token剪枝可降低VLM推理成本，但其效果取决于在有限token预算下保留互补视觉信息。核心难点在于量化候选token相对已保留集合的额外信息量，而基于注意力或相似度的传统打分难以直接刻画这种增量贡献。
AI.method: 从信息增益视角重新审视视觉token剪枝，用互信息刻画候选token的增量价值；理论上证明帧势可作为互信息的有效替代指标；据此提出免训练的FP-Prune，迭代移除信息增益低的token以最大化保留互补视觉信息。
AI.result: 在3个常用VLM与8个数据集上的实验表明，FP-Prune在准确率与推理效率两方面均优于基线方法；进一步分析显示该代理目标与模型性能高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为视觉token剪枝提供了理论依据与有效方法，说明基于信息增益的代理目标能够指导互补信息的高效保留。

title: Where Does Personalization Reside in Photo Editing? Evidence from One Photographer's Lightroom History
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables. Code and aggregate results are provided as ancillary files
summary: Personalized photo-editing systems must infer both a photographer's recurring preferences and the intent of a particular shoot, yet these signals are rarely evaluated separately. We study interpretable Lightroom adjustments in a longitudinal, private dataset of 3,193 edited photographs from 41 catalogs by one professional photographer, with holdouts formed at the batch level. We compare absolute and prior-relative targets, image-conditioned predictors, and estimators that receive a small set of edits from the target batch. Residual prediction improves validation error, but its advantage on held-out batches is small and not significant under a batch-clustered bootstrap (0.592 vs 0.582 EV exposure MAE). In a batch-shared protocol, closed-form shrinkage using 4, 8, or 16 same-batch anchors reaches 0.466, 0.457, or 0.453 EV with the best estimator at each k, compared with 0.586-0.592 EV for the prior-only baseline; the paired reductions are significant under a batch-clustered bootstrap. Learned anchor-conditioned heads do not improve on this closed-form estimator, and a negative-trained prior already yields a low cold-image false-edit rate, leaving little benefit for an additional gate. The recommended estimator is closed-form and auditable, and it requires only a handful of same-batch edits. A render-space check against 383 native Lightroom exports reproduces the ranking: at k=8, online EB lowers Delta E00 against the prior by 0.41 (p=0.042), and the photographer's true parameters lower it by 0.78 (p=0.034). An appendix extends the action space from six to thirteen global controls: a same-batch median look lowers rendered chroma toward the export, while a per-photograph residual head again fails to transfer. The study is limited to one photographer and does not claim that slider accuracy measures aesthetic preference.

AI.tldr: 在单一专业摄影师3193张照片的纵向私有数据集上，比较绝对/相对先验目标与图像条件预测器，发现批次内少量锚点驱动的闭式收缩估计器最优且可审计，残差学习在跨批次泛化上优势不显著。
AI.motivation: 个性化修图系统需同时推断摄影师的长期偏好与单次拍摄意图，但两类信号鲜有分开评估；同时希望找到既准确又可解释、可审计的估计方法。
AI.method: 使用41个目录、3193张照片的纵向私有数据集，按批次划分留出集；对比绝对值与先验相对目标、图像条件预测器、以及接收目标批次少量编辑的估计器；批次共享协议下用4/8/16个同批锚点做闭式收缩（在线经验贝叶斯）；并用383张原生Lightroom导出做渲染空间Delta E00验证。
AI.result: 残差预测提升验证误差但在留出批次上优势小且不显著（曝光MAE 0.592 vs 0.582 EV）；批次共享协议下k=4/8/16时MAE降至0.466/0.457/0.453 EV（先验基线0.586–0.592 EV），配对降幅在批次聚类bootstrap下显著；学习式锚点条件头未超越闭式估计；负例训练先验已使冷启动图像低误编辑率，额外门控收益有限；渲染空间验证k=8时在线EB相对先验降低Delta E00 0.41（p=0.042），真实参数降低0.78（p=0.034）。
AI.conclusion: 推荐采用闭式、可审计的收缩估计器，仅需少量同批编辑；学习式残差头跨批次迁移失败。附录将动作空间扩展至13个全局控制，同批中位外观可降低渲染色度，而逐照片残差头仍不迁移。研究限于单一摄影师，且不主张滑块精度即美学偏好。

title: CFANet: Learning Conflict-Free Weather Adapters for All-Weather Image Restoration
summary: All-weather image restoration aims to recover clean images from diverse weather degradations such as rain, haze, and snow. Most existing all-in-one methods handle different weather types with a unified network or rely on single-label weather modeling. However, real-world adverse weather is often compositional, where multiple known weather primitives may coexist in a single image. To this end, we propose Conflict-Free Adapter Network (CFANet) for open-compositional all-weather image restoration. CFANet first employs a Weather Mixture Router (WMR) to predict non-exclusive composition weights for rain, haze, and snow from shallow features. Guided by these weights, a Shared-Private Weather Adapter (SPWA) dynamically composes a common adapter with weather-private adapters inside each Conflict-Free Adapter Block, preserving shared restoration capability while providing weather-specific residual adaptation. Moreover, a lightweight Natural Color Adapter (NCA) performs constrained color calibration to improve color fidelity and visual naturalness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves competitive adverse weather image restoration performance and benefits downstream visual tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/wenchao-tech/CFANet-main

AI.tldr: 提出无冲突适配器网络CFANet，用于开放组合式全天候图像复原，通过天气混合路由与共享-私有天气适配器处理多天气共存的情况。
AI.motivation: 现有全天候复原方法多用统一网络或单标签天气建模，但真实恶劣天气常是组合式的，多种已知天气基元可能在同一图像中共存，统一建模难以兼顾共享能力与天气特异性。
AI.method: 1) 天气混合路由WMR从浅层特征预测雨、雾、雪的非互斥组合权重；2) 共享-私有天气适配器SPWA以权重动态组合公共适配器与天气私有适配器，在各无冲突适配器块内保留共享复原能力并提供天气特定残差适配；3) 轻量自然色彩适配器NCA进行受约束的色彩校准以提升色彩保真与自然度。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法在恶劣天气图像复原上取得有竞争力性能，并有利于下游视觉任务。
AI.conclusion: CFANet以组合权重建模多天气共存，实现开放组合式全天候图像复原，兼顾共享与特异性能力并改善下游任务表现；代码已开源。

title: Inclusive Hand Pose Estimation via Topology-Aware Distillation and Progressive Kinematic Reasoning
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics (TVCG)
summary: Hand pose estimation aims to recover the spatial configuration of hand joints from visual observations and serves as a fundamental perception module for downstream systems that rely on complete and topologically consistent hand representations. Most existing methods are developed under the assumption of fully articulated hand structures and tend to produce unstable or implausible predictions when parts of the kinematic structure are persistently absent, resulting in degraded performance or even system failure despite available partial observations. To study this challenge, we construct IncNYU, a physiologically constrained benchmark that simulates structural incompleteness through morphological modification of complete hand models and retains reference locations for both intact and synthetically removed regions. Based on this benchmark, we propose InsHaPE, an Inclusive Hand Pose Estimation framework designed to remain robust under structural incompleteness while preserving performance on standard, fully articulated hands. Built on hierarchical kinematic modeling, InsHaPE introduces two complementary components. First, a topology-aware distillation strategy transfers joint-level and relational priors from fully articulated hand representations, providing anatomically consistent initialization under missing structures. Second, a progressive kinematic reasoning module performs structured inference along the kinematic chain, enabling complete and anatomically consistent pose estimation under severe structural variations. Extensive experiments on NYU/IncNYU, together with external validation on MSRA, demonstrate that InsHaPE improves robustness under structural incompleteness while maintaining competitive performance on complete hands. System-level evaluations further show that InsHaPE improves robustness for downstream applications that require fixed-topology hand pose representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IncNYU基准与InsHaPE框架，用于在结构不完整（部分关节/手指持续缺失）条件下实现鲁棒且解剖一致的手部姿态估计，同时保持完整手上的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有手部姿态估计方法多基于完整关节结构假设，当运动链中部分结构长期缺失时预测不稳定甚至失效，而实际部分观测仍可用；因此需要研究结构不完整条件下的鲁棒估计问题。
AI.method: 构建IncNYU生理约束基准，通过对完整手模型进行形态学修改模拟结构缺失，并保留完整与合成移除区域的参考位置；提出InsHaPE框架，基于分层运动学建模，包含两个互补组件：一是拓扑感知蒸馏策略，从完整手表示迁移关节级与关系先验，为缺失结构提供解剖一致初始化；二是渐进式运动链推理模块，沿运动链进行结构化推断。
AI.result: 在NYU/IncNYU上大量实验并在MSRA上外部验证，表明InsHaPE在结构不完整下鲁棒性提升，同时在完整手上保持有竞争力性能；系统级评估显示其提升了对固定拓扑手部表示有需求的下游应用的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过基准构建与拓扑感知蒸馏、渐进运动学推理相结合，可有效应对结构性不完整的手部姿态估计问题，兼顾缺失结构鲁棒性与完整手性能。

title: ArborNet: Volume- and skeleton-aware completion of tree quantitative structure models from incomplete point clouds using anchor-conditioned graph learning
summary: Terrestrial laser scanning (TLS) enables 3D reconstruction of trees and quantitative structure models (QSMs) for estimating woody volume and structural traits. However, occlusion in single-station or sparsely sampled TLS causes incomplete branch observations and biased volume estimates. Existing point-cloud completion methods recover plausible geometry but do not explicitly preserve branch topology, cylinder radii, or woody volume. We propose ArborNet, a volume- and skeleton-aware framework for completing tree structures in the QSM domain. Each tree is represented as a TreeQSM cylinder graph encoding cylinder geometry, branch level, parent-child topology, and branch identity. A multi-relation graph encoder propagates information across parent, child, and intra-branch connections. An anchor-conditioned decoder generates missing cylinders through terminal-branch continuation and new-branch generation. Geometry, existence, branch, radius, axis-smoothness, and volume losses encourage structural consistency. During inference, generated cylinders are selected under predicted level-wise missing-volume budgets. We evaluate ArborNet on DART-simulated TLS trees and urban TLS trees from Hong Kong, using single-station QSMs as partial inputs and multi-station QSMs as references. Under budget-constrained inference, ArborNet achieves mean total-volume relative error of 0.081% and mean level-wise volume error of 0.676% against reference QSMs, while reducing skeleton geometry error relative to evaluated point-cloud completion baselines. These errors quantify agreement with reference QSMs, not accuracy against destructively measured woody volume. Ablation results show that joint volume supervision is particularly important for volume control. These results demonstrate the potential of QSM-domain completion to recover explicit woody structure while constraining geometry and volume.

AI.tldr: 提出ArborNet，在QSM（圆柱图）域内补全树木结构，融合多关系图编码与体量预算约束解码，实现骨架拓扑与木材体积一致性补全。
AI.motivation: 单站或稀疏采样的地面激光扫描（TLS）存在遮挡，导致枝条观测不完整、体积估计有偏。现有点云补全方法只恢复"看似合理"的几何，不显式保持枝条拓扑、圆柱半径与木材体积，因而体积偏差无法控制。
AI.method: 将每棵树表示为TreeQSM圆柱图，编码圆柱几何、枝级、父子拓扑与枝身份；用多关系图编码器在父、子、同枝连接上传播信息；用锚点条件解码器通过"末端枝延伸"和"新枝生成"产生缺失圆柱；训练损失含几何、存在性、枝、半径、轴平滑性与体积损失；推理时在预测的分级缺失体积预算下筛选生成圆柱。
AI.result: 在DART仿真TLS树和香港城市TLS树上评估（单站QSM为部分输入、多站QSM为参考）：预算约束推理下，总积相对误差均值0.081%，分级体积误差均值0.676%，骨架几何误差低于所比较的点云补全基线。作者强调该误差反映与参考QSM的一致性，而非对破坏性实测木材体积的精度。消融显示联合体积监督对体积控制尤为关键。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明QSM域补全可在约束几何与体积的同时恢复显式木材结构，为遮挡条件下树木体积估计提供新思路。

title: Bridging Blind Spots With Words: Decentralized Multi-View Spatial Reasoning via Language-Constrained Communication
summary: As multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) get increasingly used as collaborative partners across embodied robotics, AR/VR, and multi-user systems, spatial reasoning is now often distributed across agents with partial environment visibility, necessitating spatial reasoning integration. Prior work in language-mediated spatial integration is however strictly limited to simplified two-agent scenarios. To address this gap, we first formalize the general problem of decentralized multi-view spatial reasoning, where N agents observe distinct viewpoints, exchange budget-constrained natural language messages, and collaborate to enable a listener to answer spatial queries. We then introduce a novel multi-view spatial benchmark to isolate queries that demand non-trivial multi-view integration. Through an extensive empirical study, we discover that the penalty of restricting decentralized spatial reasoning to natural language with limited budget is far smaller than suggested by prior two-agent literature. Nevertheless, we observe that substantial headroom still remains for multi-agent spatial reasoning in this setting, as evidenced by a significant gap between current centralized performance and an oracle best-of-K ceiling. Moreover, we show that reinforcement learning with credit assignment substantially bolsters the decentralized model, effectively closing the gap with the centralized baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文形式化"去中心化多视角空间推理"问题：N个智能体各自观测不同视角，通过预算受限的自然语言消息交流，使听者能回答需多视角整合的空间查询；并提出新基准，发现语言+预算限制的代价远小于双智能体文献预期，但多智能体仍有显著提升空间，信用分配的强化学习可弥合与集中式基线的差距。
AI.motivation: 多模态LLM日益作为具身机器人、AR/VR与多用户系统中的协作伙伴，空间推理常分散于仅具部分环境可见性的多个智能体之间，因此需要空间推理的整合。然而已有的语言介导空间整合研究局限于简化的双智能体场景，缺乏对通用多智能体设定与可隔离多视角整合需求的评测。
AI.method: 1) 形式化去中心化多视角空间推理问题：N个智能体观测不同视角，交换预算受限的自然语言消息，协作使听者回答空间查询；2) 构建新的多视角空间基准，专门隔离需要非平凡多视角整合的查询；3) 开展大规模实证研究，比较集中式性能与oracle best-of-K上限；4) 采用带信用分配的强化学习提升去中心化模型。
AI.result: 将去中心化空间推理限制为预算受限自然语言所带来的性能损失，显著小于先前双智能体文献所暗示的程度；但多智能体空间推理仍存在大量提升空间，表现为当前集中式性能与oracle best-of-K上限之间存在显著差距；带信用分配的强化学习能显著增强去中心化模型，有效弥合其与集中式基线的差距。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将语言介导空间整合从双智能体推广到通用N智能体去中心化设定，并提供隔离多视角整合的基准；结果表明语言与预算约束的代价被高估，而信用分配的强化学习是缩小去中心化与集中式差距的有效手段。

title: Single-Transformer Latent Diffusion
summary: Latent generative models typically rely on three separate networks: an encoder that tokenizes pixels, a generator that models the latent distribution, and a decoder that maps latents back to pixels. UNITE recently merged the first two into a single generative encoder trained in one stage, but its decoder remains a separate network. We ask whether this last network can be folded in too, so that one diffusion transformer encodes, generates, and decodes. Simply letting the shared backbone decode does not help. What makes it work is to cast all three modes as position-aligned sequence maps over one fully shared backbone, distinguished only by a mode token and the timestep. The resulting model, UNIFIED, is simple: one network trained from scratch in a single stage with only reconstruction and flow-matching losses, without adversarial losses or pretrained encoders (e.g., DINO). On ImageNet-1K 256x256 at matched parameters, UNIFIED improves gFID over UNITE at three sizes (~60M, ~115M, and ~215M) and reaches 2.08 with 215M parameters, the lowest among compared models under 250M parameters. On text-to-image generation, UNIFIED-B (218M) reaches a GenEval score of 0.87 at 512x512, exceeding single-stage pixel diffusion models with around one billion parameters. Full unification of latent diffusion is thus not merely feasible but beneficial.

AI.tldr: UNIFIED 将编码、生成、解码三种模式统一到单一扩散 Transformer 中，仅用重构与流匹配损失单阶段训练，在 ImageNet-1K 256×256 上优于 UNITE，并在 215M 参数下达到 2.08 gFID。
AI.motivation: 潜空间生成模型通常依赖编码器、生成器、解码器三个独立网络。UNITE 已将前两者合并为单阶段训练的生成式编码器，但解码器仍独立。作者追问：能否把最后一个网络也折叠进来，使一个扩散 Transformer 同时完成编码、生成与解码；同时发现"让共享主干直接解码"并不奏效。
AI.method: 将编码、生成、解码三种模式统一表述为同一完全共享主干上的位置对齐序列映射，仅通过 mode token 与时间步加以区分；模型从头训练，单阶段，仅使用重构损失与流匹配损失，不使用对抗损失，也不依赖预训练编码器（如 DINO）。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-1K 256×256、参数量匹配条件下，UNIFIED 在 ~60M、~115M、~215M 三档规模上 gFID 均优于 UNITE；215M 参数下达到 2.08，为 250M 参数以下对比模型中的最低值。文生图任务中 UNIFIED-B（218M）在 512×512 下 GenEval 得分为 0.87，超过约十亿参数的单阶段像素扩散模型。
AI.conclusion: 潜扩散的完全统一不仅可行而且有益：单一网络即可端到端承担编码、生成与解码，且在质量与参数效率上均获得提升。

title: RAGA: Refreshable Animatable Gaussian Avatars from a Single Photo
summary: Avatars created from a single photo are fixed once made: regions the photo never showed, such as the back of a garment, are hallucinated and remain that way. We present Refreshable Animatable Gaussian Avatars (RAGA), a full-body Gaussian avatar that is created from a single image in about one second and can be refreshed whenever new images of the same person become available, without retraining or gradient-based optimization. RAGA maps each new observation into canonical UV space, accumulates it as visibility- and angle-weighted running sums, and re-decodes the fused map with the same decoder used for the photo. Although this decoder is trained only on single images, it makes use of the fused evidence. On 163 clips from five datasets, RAGA created from one photo outperforms LHM, LHM++ and IDOL, including on three datasets never used in training. Refreshing from later frames adds 0.49 dB PSNR overall and 0.68 dB on views turned at least 135° from the photo, where SSIM and LPIPS also improve. Given the same 16 images on all clips, LHM++ gains 0.15 dB, against 0.48 dB for RAGA. Creating an avatar takes 1.08 s and animating it 48.1 ms per frame on a laptop RTX 3080 GPU, with body fitting and matting included in creation and pose estimation included in animation. Code will be released on GitHub.

AI.tldr: RAGA 是一种基于单张图像、约1秒即可生成的可刷新全身高斯化身，无需重训或梯度优化即可融合后续新观测，显著提升未见视角质量。
AI.motivation: 单图生成的化身一经建立即固定，照片未覆盖区域（如衣物背面）只能靠幻觉填补且不可更新；希望在新图像可用时以极低成本刷新化身。
AI.method: 将新观测映射到规范化UV空间，以可见性与角度加权的运行和（running sums）进行累积融合，再用与单图生成相同的解码器重新解码融合图；该解码器虽仅以单图训练，但能利用融合证据。
AI.result: 在5个数据集共163段序列上，单图生成的RAGA优于LHM、LHM++与IDOL（含3个未参与训练的数据集）；刷新后整体+0.49 dB PSNR，相对照片转角≥135°视角+0.68 dB，SSIM与LPIPS亦提升；同等16张图像下LHM++仅+0.15 dB，RAGA达+0.48 dB；创建耗时1.08 s，动画48.1 ms/帧（RTX 3080笔记本GPU，含人体拟合与抠像、姿态估计）。
AI.conclusion: RAGA 以无优化、可累积更新的融合机制实现单图全身高斯化身的低成本持续刷新，在质量与效率上均具优势，代码将开源。

title: AlignHand: Multi-View Hand Reconstruction from a Frozen Monocular Prior
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Project page and code: https://ada-zy2425.github.io/AlignHand/
summary: Modern monocular hand estimators recover detailed 3D meshes from individual images, yet effectively leveraging their predictions across multiple views remains challenging. Independently predicted meshes can disagree in scale, placement, and articulation, limiting the integration of complementary multi-view information. Hence, we present AlignHand, a calibrated multi-view framework that builds on a frozen monocular hand reconstruction prior to align and enhance its predictions. Specifically, AlignHand refines cross-view joint observations and estimates their reliability to establish a shared metric reference for alignment. Once the meshes are brought into a common frame, their complementary surface evidence is selectively fused across anatomical regions, followed by pixel-aligned refinement that predicts bounded residual displacements from local image features. This global-to-local integration enables AlignHand to exploit complementary observations while preserving the strong monocular prior. Extensive experiments on DexYCB-MV, HanCo, and HO3D-Eval-MV demonstrate that AlignHand achieves the lowest MPVPE and MPJPE among the compared methods under the respective evaluation protocols, reducing MPVPE by 30.1%, 29.1%, and 8.0%, respectively, compared with a matched geometry baseline.

AI.tldr: AlignHand：在冻结的单目手部重建先验之上构建标定多视图框架，先建立共享度量参考完成跨视角对齐，再按解剖区域选择性融合表面证据并进行像素对齐的残差细化，在三个多视图数据集上取得最低的MPVPE与MPJPE。
AI.motivation: 单目手部估计器虽能由单张图像恢复精细3D网格，但多视角预测在尺度、位置与关节姿态上不一致，独立预测的网格无法直接融合互补信息，限制了多视图整合的收益。
AI.method: 提出AlignHand：(1) 细化跨视角关节观测并估计其可靠性，建立共享度量参考以实现网格对齐；(2) 网格统一到公共坐标系后，按解剖区域选择性融合互补的表面证据；(3) 由局部图像特征预测有界残差位移，进行像素对齐细化。整体采用由全局到局部的整合方式，并保持冻结的单目先验。
AI.result: 在DexYCB-MV、HanCo和HO3D-Eval-MV上，按各自评测协议均取得对比方法中最低的MPVPE与MPJPE；相对匹配的几何基线，MPVPE分别降低30.1%、29.1%和8.0%。
AI.conclusion: 通过可靠对齐加区域级选择性融合与有界残差细化，可在不破坏强单目先验的前提下有效利用多视图互补信息，显著提升三维手部重建精度。

title: PIAE: Physics-Informed Continuous Autoencoding for Compact 3D Human Motion
summary: Temporal compression reduces the sequence length that motion generators must model, but can damage articulated detail and global trajectory. These errors have unequal consequences: root-velocity and heading errors propagate through trajectory recovery and affect the placement of the entire body. We propose PIAE, a physics-informed continuous autoencoder that allocates a fixed token budget between explicitly retained kinematic signals and complementary learned features. At 8 x temporal compression, each 256-dimensional token contains 224 learned values and a 32-dimensional physical carrier. The complete token conditions neural decoding, while a parallel recovery path constrains selected outputs. On the official HumanML3D benchmark, PIAE achieves 8.936 mm global MPJPE, an 82.0% reduction relative to a same-width learned-only model. The benefit extends beyond trajectory restoration: facing-local neural-body error before analytical correction decreases by 76.6% in a frozen-checkpoint validation diagnostic, and supplying the same true trajectory to both models preserves the body-quality advantage. Targeted root-only and explicit-root hybrid controls establish strong trajectory-aware comparisons; alternative carriers reveal that torso references favor position accuracy, whereas stance anchors favor support quality. With the original 8 x AEs frozen, matched text-to-motion generators predict every carrier value and improve FID from 0.506 to 0.163. Frozen reconstruction also transfers to AIST++ without adaptation. The compressed carrier interface reduces measured generation time by 27.8% relative to its 1 x counterpart. Together, these findings demonstrate that selective preservation can use a fixed representation budget more effectively, improving neural articulated reconstruction and downstream generation in compact human motion.

AI.tldr: PIAE 是一种物理信息驱动的连续运动自编码器，将固定 token 预算拆分为“显式保留的运动学载波”和“学习特征”两部分，在 8× 时间压缩下显著提升全局轨迹与关节重建精度，并改善下游文本驱动生成与生成速度。
AI.motivation: 时间压缩可缩短运动生成器需建模的序列长度，但会损害关节细节与全局轨迹。这两类误差后果不均等：根速度与朝向误差会经轨迹恢复传播，影响整个身体的定位。因此需要在有限表征预算下选择性地保留关键物理信号。
AI.method: 提出 PIAE（physics-informed continuous autoencoder）：在固定 token 预算中显式分配一部分维度作为“物理载波”。8× 压缩下，每个 256 维 token 含 224 维学习值与 32 维物理载波。完整 token 作为神经解码的条件，同时并行的恢复路径对选定输出施加约束。对比实验包括仅根节点控制、显式根混合控制，以及不同载波（躯干参考点 vs. 支撑锚点）。
AI.result: HumanML3D 官方基准上全局 MPJPE 达 8.936 mm，相较同宽度纯学习模型降低 82.0%；冻结检查点诊断中，解析校正前的面向局部神经-身体误差下降 76.6%；向两模型提供相同真值轨迹时，身体质量优势仍保留。冻结原 8× AE 后，匹配的文本到运动生成器可预测全部载波值，FID 由 0.506 降至 0.163；冻结重建无需适配即迁移至 AIST++；压缩载波接口使实测生成时间较 1× 版本减少 27.8%。不同载波中，躯干参考利于位置精度，支撑锚点利于支撑质量。
AI.conclusion: 选择性保留能在固定表征预算下更有效地利用容量，改善神经关节化重建与紧凑人体运动的下游生成；物理载波接口在精度、可迁移性与效率上均带来收益。

title: KineState-SWAM: A Surgical World Action Model with Explicit Kinematics and Causal Interaction Dynamics
summary: Existing surgical world models often leave implicit how instrument motion drives localized tissue responses and how interaction history informs subsequent actions. We introduce KineState-SWAM, a surgical world-action model coupling action prediction and video generation through a persistent interaction state, separating kinematically determined instrument motion from learned scene evolution. A flow-matching policy predicts joint trajectories conditioned on interaction state, robot configuration, and task instruction. Kinematic Geometry Conditioning converts these trajectories into surface-motion tokens and spatially aligned instrument renderings using calibrated URDF kinematics. Causal Interaction Dynamics recurrently updates the state through geometry-guided attention and motion-aligned feature transport, carrying interaction history into subsequent action predictions without intermediate video synthesis. The State-Geometry Adapter combines state-dependent spatial modulation with localized geometric residuals to guide video generation. Interaction-aware supervision emphasizes tissue responses near instrument working regions. We introduce dVRK-Chole5.2k, comprising 5,255 videos spanning 17 surgical tasks. Experiments demonstrate improved action accuracy and video fidelity over evaluated baselines within matched action-conditioning settings. Ablations support preserving and transporting interaction states for long-horizon prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出 KineState-SWAM，一种通过持久交互状态耦合动作预测与视频生成的手术世界-动作模型，将运动学决定的器械运动与学习到的场景演化分离。
AI.motivation: 现有手术世界模型未显式刻画器械运动如何驱动局部组织响应，以及交互历史如何影响后续动作。
AI.method: 流匹配策略以交互状态、机器人构型与任务指令为条件预测关节轨迹；运动学几何条件化（KGC）将轨迹经标定 URDF 转为表面运动 token 与空间对齐的器械渲染；因果交互动态（CID）借助几何引导注意力与运动对齐特征传输递归更新状态；状态-几何适配器结合状态调制与局部几何残差引导视频生成；交互感知监督聚焦工作区组织响应。
AI.result: 在匹配动作条件设置下，动作精度与视频保真度优于对比基线；消融验证交互状态的保留与传输对长时程预测有效；发布 dVRK-Chole5.2k 数据集（5,255 段视频、17 项任务）。
AI.conclusion: 显式持久交互状态是提升手术世界模型长时程动作-视觉一致性的关键。

title: Task-Conditioned Detail Allocation for Synthetic Segmentation Data
summary: Synthetic images sharing a segmentation label can differ in their training value. We propose Task-Conditioned Detail Allocation (TCDA) to select useful candidates and locally edit some remaining images. We ask whether image details provide class-specific cues in the regions marked by the label. We train a small task reference on frozen image features from real training images. We compare its class responses before and after blurring each candidate, and score how well these response changes align with the labeled regions. This detail allocation score ranks candidates from the same source. Comparing their response--label alignment with that of the real source image also guides repair decisions and, in multiclass tasks, the choice of regions to edit. Selected candidates and accepted repairs are used for training with the original labels and the unchanged downstream segmenter. Experiments on camouflaged object detection, degraded salient object detection, and adverse-condition semantic segmentation show that our selection outperforms equally sized random and label-agreement subsets. Combining selection and repair improves over real-only training by up to 0.019 in $S_α$ on COD10K and 2.86 mIoU points on ACDC.

AI.tldr: 提出任务条件细节分配（TCDA）方法，利用细节-标签对齐度对合成图像进行筛选与局部修复，用于下游分割训练。
AI.motivation: 共享同一分割标签的合成图像训练价值存在差异，需要从中挑出有用样本并对部分保留样本做局部编辑。
AI.method: 在真实图像冻结特征上训练小型任务参考模型；比较每个候选图像模糊前后类别响应变化，并度量该变化与标注区域的对齐程度，得到细节分配分数；再与真实源图像的响应-标签对齐度比较，指导修复决策及多分类任务中的编辑区域选择。筛选与接受的修复样本沿用原标签训练，下游分割器不变。
AI.result: 在伪装目标检测、退化显著目标检测与恶劣条件语义分割上，筛选优于等量随机子集与标签一致性子集；筛选+修复相较仅用真实数据训练，在COD10K上S_α最多提升0.019，在ACDC上mIoU提升2.86点。
AI.conclusion: 图像细节在标注区域内提供类别特定线索，可作为合成数据价值评估与局部修复的判据，且无需修改下游分割器。

title: Language Models Steer on Injected Uncertainty Tokens, but Fail to Self-Monitor In Situ
summary:
Prompting language models to verbalize stepwise numerical confidence during generation is an increasingly popular approach for triggering backtracking and error correction in agentic reasoning. This strategy presupposes two capabilities: (1) in-situ monitoring fidelity (does confidence drop when an error occurs?) and (2) downstream steering control (does an uncertainty token causally steer the model to repair its error?). We evaluated four open-weights models (Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, and Phi-4, 14.7B) across 15,200 math benchmark attempts, isolating 2,017 reasoning errors within each model's capability frontier. Applying 27,568 counterfactual continuations across these failure points, we demonstrate a consistent decoupling between monitoring and control.
  On monitoring, all four models fail to detect their own errors. Verbalized confidence does not distinguish mistake steps from sound reasoning, yielding near-chance within-position AUROCs between 0.500 and 0.561. Even at a model's first reasoning error, trajectory confidence remains saturated at 95.1% to 99.9%, with noticeable drops ($\ge 10$ points) appearing on fewer than 9% of errors in Llama and under 1.6% in the other three models. In contrast, models respond readily to external uncertainty: injecting a low-confidence tag (10%) at the error step significantly increases downstream correction across all models (+3.7 to +22.5 points over format-matched 95% certainty; all $p \le 0.0022$), reaching up to 38.5% under active rethinking instructions. However, injecting doubt onto already-correct steps causes models to discard valid reasoning, reducing solve rates by up to 22.8 points. Inference-time self-correction is thus bottlenecked by in-situ error detection rather than downstream repair capacity: models readily steer toward recovery when prompted with doubt, yet fail to self-monitor during generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过大规模反事实干预实验，证明LLM的"口头化置信度"存在监控与控制的解耦：模型无法在推理过程中检测自身错误，但对外部注入的不确定性信号高度敏感并会据此纠错。
AI.motivation: 让语言模型在生成过程中逐步口头表达数值置信度，被视为触发回溯与错误修正的流行手段。但该策略隐含两个未被验证的前提：原位监控保真性（出错时置信度是否下降）与下游引导控制（不确定性token是否因果性地驱动模型修复错误）。本文旨在分离并检验这两个能力。
AI.method: 评估四个开源权重模型（Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Phi-4 14.7B），在15,200次数学基准尝试中，于各模型能力前沿内隔离出2,017个推理错误；在这些失败点上施加27,568次反事实续写，并通过在错误步注入10%低置信标签（对比格式匹配的95%确定标签）做因果干预，考察监控与控制的分离。
AI.result: 监控方面：四个模型均无法识别自身错误，口头置信度不能区分错误步与正确推理，同位置AUROC仅0.500–0.561（接近随机）；在首个推理错误处轨迹置信度仍饱和于95.1%–99.9%，置信度下降≥10个点的错误在Llama中不足9%、其余三模型低于1.6%。控制方面：注入低置信标签显著提升下游纠正（较95%确定性提升+3.7至+22.5点，p≤0.0022），在主动反思指令下达38.5%；但对已正确步骤注入怀疑会导致丢弃有效推理，求解率最多下降22.8点。
AI.conclusion: 推理时自我纠错的瓶颈在于原位错误检测，而非下游修复能力：模型在被提示怀疑时能有效转向恢复，却无法在生成过程中自我监控。口头化置信度作为纠错触发机制的前提不成立。

title: SayWhen: Set-Valued Semantic Commitment for Low-Regret Early Speech
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop PTA: From Pretrained Representations to Acting Agents
summary: Speaking early turns a prediction into an irreversible public commitment. We introduce SayWhen, a test-time controller that selects a task-directed act shared across typed continuation plans and controls its release as speech. A persistent veto blocks playback when intervening transcripts invalidate the candidate. We define regret-free early speech (RFES) to measure supported pre-endpoint releases without scored incompatibility. On a 72-prefix branching diagnostic, the generated-plan frontier attains 6.0% RFES with zero observed mean regret, versus 8.2% RFES and 0.068 regret for Matched Top-One. Measured planner latency constrains this path; a deterministic retail schema attains 31.7% RFES, compared with 32.0% for the complete policy. In a separate 30-task $τ$-Voice simulation, schema-derived candidates with cached text-to-speech (TTS) audio attain 21/30 task-level RFES. Eligible audio begins 1.51 seconds before the user-audio endpoint among the 22 tasks with early speech, or 1.11 seconds over all 30 tasks with zero for tasks without eligible early speech. Semantic veto and endpoint waiting each pass 16/30 tasks. Together, the studies demonstrate a controlled coverage-compatibility trade-off and schema-based pre-endpoint operation, making the supported public commitment an explicit unit of voice-agent control.

AI.tldr: 提出SayWhen测试时控制器，将"提前发声"建模为不可逆的公开承诺，通过持久否决机制控制任务导向行为的释放时机。
AI.motivation: 语音智能体若过早发声，会把预测转化为不可撤销的公开承诺；需明确何时释放语音，以避免与后续证据冲突而产生后悔。
AI.method: SayWhen控制器在跨类型的延续计划中选取共享的任务导向动作，并控制其作为语音的释放；当介入的转写文本使候选失效时，持久否决阻止播放。定义"无悔提前发声"(RFES)指标。
AI.result: 72前缀分支诊断中，生成计划前沿RFES为6.0%、平均后悔为0，Matched Top-One为8.2%与0.068；确定性零售模式RFES达31.7%（完整策略32.0%）。30任务τ-Voice仿真中，模式候选配缓存TTS达21/30任务级RFES；有提前发声的22个任务中合规音频提前1.51秒，全部30任务平均1.11秒；语义否决与端点等待各通过16/30。
AI.conclusion: 研究展示了可控的覆盖—兼容性权衡与基于模式的端点前运行，使"受支持的公开承诺"成为语音智能体控制的显式单元。

title: Automatic Occupational Coding through Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Annually 1.9 million deaths and 89.7 million disability-adjusted life years are caused by exposure to agents during work (e.g., welding fumes, silica dust, and noise pollution). To improve worker health, high-quality exposure assessments are crucial. Therefore, free-text job descriptions from large-scale occupational cohorts are manually standardized through occupational classifications and linked to hazardous exposures using Job Exposure Matrices (JEM). However, manual coding is slow, unreliable (i.e., 44-89% inter-coder reliability), and costly, due to i) short, ambiguous free-text job descriptions, ii) classifications containing hundreds to thousands of categories, and iii) the absence of gold standards. With 46%-79% accuracy, state-of-the-art automatic occupational coding tools achieve classification performance on human level. However, their performance drops to 17-26% on out-of-distribution datasets. Furthermore, their supervised architectures limit them to occupational classifications present in the training set. Consequently, JEM using other classifications are incompatible, leaving vital exposure-response associations unexplored. Our Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework, OPERAG, enables classification into any occupational classification without expert-labelled databases. It retrieves coding index information and combines this with Large Language Model-based classification. Validated on AsiaLymph's 36,062 real-world job descriptions, OPERAG achieved 42.6% occupational classification accuracy on the 4th coding level, substantially outperforming existing tools and approaching human coders' 51-56% inter-coder reliability. Using two JEM named ALOHA+ and SHOCK, 89.9-98.6% accuracy was achieved on exposure assessment. OPERAG approaches human-level, universal occupational classification, enabling efficient and effective large-scale exposure assessment to improve worker health.

AI.tldr: OPERAG：基于检索增强生成（RAG）的职业编码框架，无需专家标注数据库即可将自由文本岗位描述分类到任意职业分类体系，并在真实队列数据上接近人类编码员水平，实现大规模暴露评估。
AI.motivation: 职业暴露每年造成190万死亡和8970万伤残调整寿命年，高质量暴露评估依赖将队列中的自由文本岗位描述人工标准化为职业分类，再通过职业暴露矩阵（JEM）关联危害。但人工编码慢、成本高、编码者间信度仅44–89%；现有自动编码工具虽在分布内达46–79%准确率、声称达人类水平，却在分布外数据上骤降至17–26%，且其监督式架构只能分类训练集中出现过的分类体系，导致使用其他分类体系的JEM无法兼容，阻断关键暴露-反应关联研究。
AI.method: 提出OPERAG检索增强生成框架：先检索编码索引（coding index）信息，再结合大语言模型进行分类，从而无需专家标注数据库即可支持任意职业分类体系。在AsiaLymph队列的36,062条真实岗位描述上验证，并使用ALOHA+与SHOCK两个JEM进行暴露评估验证。
AI.result: 在第4级编码层级上达到42.6%的职业分类准确率，显著优于现有自动工具，并接近人类编码员51–56%的编码者间信度；在ALOHA+和SHOCK两个JEM上的暴露评估准确率达89.9–98.6%。
AI.conclusion: OPERAG朝人类水平、通用化的职业分类迈进一步，可高效、有效地支撑大规模暴露评估，助力改善劳动者健康；其免标注、跨分类体系的特性突破了监督式方法的可迁移性瓶颈。

title: Triage Accuracy of Jev and Open-Weight System One Decision Models and Their Use for Early Emergency Recognition in Symptom-Assessment Applications
summary: Laypeople increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for triage advice, but LLMs answer in variable free text, which makes it hard to evaluate them for use in medical devices. Decision models, which assign a probability to each predefined triage category, may be easier to evaluate. To test their triage accuracy, we evaluated 16 decision models (14 open-weight, 2 proprietary) on 233 synthetic and 10,000 real-world cases, yielding 163,728 total assessments. The best models triaged 72.1% of synthetic cases correctly and agreed with an existing algorithm in 56.1% of real-world cases. They were more promising for recognising emergencies early: given only demographics, chief complaints, risk factors and red-flag answers, the best model reached an AUROC of 0.87. At a 5% error margin, it could decide for or against emergencies for about half of users. Decision models should therefore not replace triage engines but could shorten symptom assessments at setting-specific error margins.

AI.tldr: 评估16个决策模型（14开源、2闭源）在233个合成病例和10000个真实病例（共163728次评估）上的分诊准确性：最佳模型合成病例正确率72.1%，真实病例与现有算法一致率56.1%；仅用人口学、主诉、危险因素和红旗症状信息时急诊识别AUROC达0.87，在5%误差下可为约半数用户判定是否急诊。
AI.motivation: 普通人越来越多地使用大语言模型获取分诊建议，但LLM以自由文本作答、输出多变，难以作为医疗器械进行评估与监管。相较之下，为每个预设分诊类别输出概率的决策模型更易量化评估，因此需系统检验其分诊准确性。
AI.method: 选取16个决策模型（14个开放权重、2个闭源专有），在233个合成病例与10000个真实世界病例上测试，累计163728次评估；以合成病例正确率和与现有分诊算法的一致性衡量分诊准确性，并考察在仅提供人口学信息、主诉、风险因素与红旗问题回答时的急诊识别能力（AUROC）及给定误差边界下的可判定比例。
AI.result: 最佳模型在合成病例上分诊正确率72.1%，在真实病例上与现有算法一致率56.1%；急诊早期识别表现更优，最佳模型AUROC为0.87，在5%误差边界下可对约一半用户做出是否急诊的判定。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型尚不足以取代分诊引擎，但可在特定场景设定的误差边界内用于缩短症状评估流程。

title: Learning What to Change: State-Verified Reinforcement Learning for Educational Agents
summary: Persistent tutoring agents do more than answer questions: they manage course files, practice records, and learner profiles that govern future lessons. In such stateful settings, knowing what to teach does not guarantee knowing what to change. We identify a pervasive failure mode, content-state decoupling, where agents deliver pedagogically sound responses while silently corrupting workspace state through unwarranted updates, missed prerequisites, or unintended side effects. Text-level judges overlook these state errors, whereas isolated tool-call checks break down because whether a write action is valid depends jointly on the learner request, prior state, and execution order. We propose State-Verified Reinforcement Learning, which supervises online policy optimization directly through verifiable workspace transitions. Within isolated sandboxes that snapshot state around every tool call, a deterministic verifier audits tool effects, workflow ordering, and native auto-sync side effects, pairing graded partial credit with a hard gate that zeroes episode reward upon any critical violation. Whenever no critical violation occurs, an evidence-grounded judge scores actual saved artifacts rather than agent claims. We pair 1,000 verifiable training instances with an independently authored, human-reviewed evaluation benchmark of 60 tasks spanning 11 educational categories and 16 native tools. After online GRPO training, Qwen3.8-27B raises category-weighted strict success on our benchmark from 51.47% to 80.74% (+29.27 points), cutting content-pass-only execution failures from 45.6% to 13.7% and required state-check failures from 63 to 1 across 180 trials. The resulting policy outperforms seven reference baselines by over 20 points while reducing output tokens by 17-39% across seven of eight external benchmarks without regressing on general reasoning or tool use.

AI.tldr: 论文识别出有状态教学智能体中的"内容—状态解耦"失效模式：回答教学正确但静默破坏工作区状态；提出以可验证工作区状态转移监督在线RL(State-Verified RL)，使严格成功率从51.47%提升至80.74%。
AI.motivation: 持久化教学智能体不仅答题，还管理课程文件、练习记录与学习者画像，这些状态决定后续教学。此背景下"知道教什么"不等于"知道改什么"：智能体可能给出教学上合理的回答，却通过无依据的更新、遗漏前置条件或意外副作用静默污染工作区状态。文本级评审看不到状态错误；孤立检查工具调用也失效，因为写操作是否合法取决于学习者请求、先前状态与执行顺序三者联合。
AI.method: 提出State-Verified Reinforcement Learning(SVRL)，直接用可验证的工作区状态转移监督在线策略优化。在每个工具调用前后对状态做快照的隔离沙箱中，由确定性验证器审计工具效果、工作流顺序与原生自动同步副作用；采用分级部分信用与硬性门控相结合——出现任何关键违例即将整段episode奖励置零。在无关键违例时，由证据锚定(evidence-grounded)的评审对实际保存的产物而非智能体自述打分。使用1,000条可验证训练实例，并独立编写、人工复核60个任务、覆盖11个教育类别与16个原生工具的评测基准。
AI.result: 经在线GRPO训练后，Qwen3.8-27B在自建基准上的类别加权严格成功率由51.47%升至80.74%(+29.27点)；"仅内容通过"的执行失败率由45.6%降至13.7%；180次试验中必需状态检查失败次数由63降至1。所得策略在七个参考基线上领先20点以上，同时在8个外部基准中的7个上输出token减少17–39%，且通用推理与工具使用能力无退化。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，对有状态智能体而言，以可验证的状态转移为监督信号比文本级评判或孤立工具调用检查更有效；分级+硬门控的奖励设计能显著压缩状态类失败，并在不牺牲泛化能力的前提下提升效率。

title: Can Cities Have Personalities? Introducing the SCD City Personality Assessment
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures. Supplementary research materials: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24466311
summary: Descriptions of cities are shaped by human experience and institutional narratives. We introduce the SCD City Personality Assessment (SCD-CPA), a method that instantiates document-grounded ChatGPT city personas and interrogates each with an identical 24-statement instrument inspired by the four-pair structure of the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator. Rather than asking a general-purpose model to characterize cities freely, we configure a separate document-grounded conversational agent for each city and use alternative evidence portraits to compare documentary inputs. The resulting four bipolar dimensions and four-letter summaries use independently defined urban concepts and scoring rules. Tokyo, New York, and Paris form the methodological evaluation (33 assessments across repeated sessions, three GPT-6 effort settings, and alternative portraits): Tokyo's original portrait yielded 85.4% exact within-setting item agreement, while evidence substitutions shifted some dimension strengths. A five-city application to Shanghai, Dubai, Mumbai, Lagos, and Sao Paulo (15 assessments) yielded 77.8% exact and 99.4% within-one-point cross-setting agreement, indicating consistency under the tested configurations. By treating each city conversational agent as a reproducible, evidence-conditioned experimental configuration, SCD-CPA makes documented city-character perceptions comparable and exposes their sensitivity to source selection. Although the documentary evidence is explicitly controlled, the model's internal interpretation of that evidence cannot be fully observed. We also examine the robustness of SCD-CPA across three AI reasoning-effort settings. The observed consistency suggests that the methodology is relatively insensitive to the tested configuration differences and provides a framework for evaluating its stability as future generations of AI models become available.

AI.tldr: 提出SCD-CPA方法：为每座城市构建"文档接地"的ChatGPT人格代理，用同一套受MBTI四对结构启发的24题量表进行测评，从而把城市性格感知变成可复现、可比较的实验配置。
AI.motivation: 城市描述既受人类经验塑造，也受制度性叙事影响，具有主观与来源依赖性。直接让通用大模型"自由描述城市"缺乏可控性与可比性，需一种能显式控制文献证据来源、并能量化其对城市性格判断影响的方法。
AI.method: SCD City Personality Assessment (SCD-CPA)：为每座城市配置独立的、以文档为证据基础的对话代理（persona），再用相同的24条陈述量表（借鉴Myers-Briggs Type Indicator四对维度结构）逐一提问；四个双极维度的概念与计分规则均独立定义，输出四字母类型摘要；并通过替换"证据画像"（alternative evidence portraits）来比较不同文献输入的影响。评估分两阶段：东京、纽约、巴黎的方法学评估（33次测评，覆盖重复会话、三种GPT-6推理努力设置与替代画像）；上海、迪拜、孟买、拉各斯、圣保罗的五城市应用（15次测评）。
AI.result: 东京原始画像在同设置下达85.4%的题项完全一致率；证据替换会改变部分维度的强度。五城市应用取得77.8%的完全一致率与99.4%的"一分以内"跨设置一致率，说明在所测试的配置下结果稳定，且方法对三种推理努力设置相对不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 把每个城市对话代理视为可复现、受证据条件约束的实验配置，可使基于文献的城市性格感知变得可比，并揭示其对来源选择的敏感性。局限在于：文献证据虽被显式控制，模型对证据的内部解读无法完全观测。该方法为未来AI模型代际更替下的稳定性评估提供了框架。

title: MedUIGym: Evaluating and Training GUI Agents for Clinical Workflows
summary: Automating clinical workflows requires vision-language agents that can navigate dense graphical user interfaces (GUIs) in electronic health records (EHRs) and execute precise actions, yet many medical agents still rely on text or structured tool calls. In this work, we introduce MedUIGym, a scalable interactive environment comprising 15,739 tasks from 17 benchmark sources across six clinical task families for training and evaluating clinical GUI agents. In MedUIGym, agents perceive EHR states from screenshots and execute mouse-and-keyboard actions, as well as a paired native-tool interface over identical clinical data. The environment verifies both final answers and required clinical actions, and supports parallel trajectory collection for training. Benchmarking twelve vision-language models shows that current agents struggle across diverse clinical workflows, and simply increasing reasoning effort fails to yield consistent gains. Furthermore, MedUIGym supports offline learning from GUI trajectories and online reinforcement learning from task rewards. After training, both Qwen3.5 models perform better on in-domain clinical tasks and generalize to tasks from external sources. By unifying tasks from existing benchmarks, dual-interface evaluation, and GUI trajectory collection, MedUIGym provides a testbed for studying how vision-language agents complete clinical tasks through the EHR's graphical interface. Our project page is available at https://github.com/yitong-qiao/MedUIGym.

AI.tldr: 提出 MedUIGym：一个可扩展的临床 GUI 交互环境，含 17 个基准来源、6 类临床任务共 15,739 个任务，基于 EHR 截图进行鼠标键盘操作，并配有等价数据的原生工具接口，用于训练与评测视觉语言临床智能体。
AI.motivation: 自动化临床工作流需要能在电子病历（EHR）密集图形界面上导航并执行精确动作的视觉语言智能体，但现有医疗智能体多依赖纯文本或结构化工具调用，缺乏贴近真实 GUI 交互的训练与评测平台。
AI.method: 构建 MedUIGym：统一整合 17 个基准来源、6 类临床任务族的 15,739 个任务；智能体从截图感知 EHR 状态并执行鼠标键盘动作，同时提供同数据上的成对原生工具接口；环境同时校验最终答案与必需临床动作，支持并行轨迹采集；评测 12 个视觉语言模型，并支持从 GUI 轨迹的离线学习与基于任务奖励的在线强化学习。
AI.result: 十二个视觉语言模型在多样临床工作流上普遍表现不佳，单纯提升推理投入（reasoning effort）并不能带来稳定增益；经离线/在线训练后，两个 Qwen3.5 模型在域内临床任务上提升，并能泛化到外部来源任务。
AI.conclusion: MedUIGym 通过统一现有基准任务、双接口评测与 GUI 轨迹采集，为研究视觉语言智能体如何经由 EHR 图形界面完成临床任务提供了可扩展测试床与训练基础设施。

title: Habitats: A Framework for Open-Ended Evolution of Agent Objectives
comment: To be published in the Managing Agents that Manage Agents Workshop on Responsible Use of Meta-Agents at the Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (2026)
summary: Designing what an agent should optimize can be as difficult as optimizing the agent itself. Existing language-model-based reward-generation methods typically refine objectives for predefined tasks and couple the decision of what to explore with the synthesis of how to implement it, potentially narrowing the resulting behavioral repertoire. We introduce Habitats, a framework for open-ended evolution of executable agent objectives. Habitats maintains a population of reward-policy pairs and evaluates every policy under every population reward, producing a cross-fitness matrix that exposes self-mastery, transfer, and functional diversity. A population-level Planner uses this information to select parent rewards and issue targeted mutation directives, while a separate Mutator translates those directives into validated reward programs. We evaluate Habitats in a discrete Card Sandbox and three continuous-control environments (Cart-Pole, Hopper, and Cheetah) against Independent Generation and Direct Mutation baselines. Across four environments and three random seeds, Habitats achieves the highest macro-averaged final Specialist Quality and Behavioral Diversity, with final diversity reaching 1.8x that of Direct Mutation and 2.5x that of Independent Generation. Finally, across ten downstream objectives unseen during evolution, frozen Habitats policy libraries achieve higher paired win rates than size-matched Direct Mutation and Independent Generation libraries at 10,000 adaptation episodes, while also surpassing task-specific policies trained from scratch for 20,000 episodes. These results suggest that separating population-level planning from reward synthesis enables the discovery of diverse, learnable, and reusable behaviors.

AI.tldr: Habitats框架通过分离"群体级规划"与"奖励程序合成"，实现智能体目标的开放式进化，获得高质量、多样化且可复用的行为库。
AI.motivation: 现有基于语言模型的奖励生成方法针对预定义任务精炼目标，并将"探索什么"与"如何实现"耦合在一起，导致行为库狭窄。作者希望以开放式方式自动发现多样、可学习、可复用的行为目标。
AI.method: 维护奖励-策略对种群，用每个种群奖励评估每条策略，构建交叉适应度矩阵以揭示自我掌握、迁移性与功能多样性；群体级Planner据此选择父代奖励并发出定向变异指令，独立的Mutator将指令翻译为经验证的奖励程序。在离散Card Sandbox与连续控制环境（Cart-Pole、Hopper、Cheetah）中与Independent Generation和Direct Mutation基线对比。
AI.result: 四个环境、三个随机种子下，Habitats的宏观平均最终专家质量与行为多样性均最高，最终多样性为Direct Mutation的1.8倍、Independent Generation的2.5倍。在10,000个适应回合下，冻结的策略库在10个演化中未见的下游目标上配对胜率更高，并超过从零训练20,000回合的任务专用策略。
AI.conclusion: 将群体级规划与奖励合成解耦，能够发现多样、可学习且可复用的行为，为开放式智能体目标进化提供了有效范式。

title: Genome-to-Image Translation: Reconstructing Escherichia coli Morphology from Genomic Sequences
summary: Antimicrobial resistance in Escherichia coli is established in routine practice by culture-based susceptibility testing, which is slow relative to the clinical need for an early treatment decision. Resistance status also leaves a measurable trace in cell morphology, and whole-genome sequencing of clinical isolates is increasingly available, which raises the question of whether colony appearance can be predicted directly from an isolate's genome. We formulate this as a conditional image-generation problem. The assembled contigs of each isolate are encoded into a single 768-dimensional vector by a frozen genomic language model through a segment-contig-isolate aggregation hierarchy, and a conditional Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty synthesizes colony images from this embedding together with the applied antibiotic and the resistance label. We train on 167,356 single-cell images from 22 clinical blood isolates imaged under azithromycin, ciprofloxacin, tetracycline, and a no-drug control, compare seven pretrained convolutional backbones inside the generator, and select ConvNeXt-Tiny on distributional image-quality metrics. The synthetic images are then assessed extrinsically: added to a reduced real training set, they improve per-antibiotic resistance classification, with a significant gain in resistant-class recall.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个条件图像生成框架，用冻结的基因组语言模型将分离株contig编码为768维向量，再以条件WGAN-GP结合抗生素与耐药标签合成菌落图像，合成图像可提升耐药分类性能。
AI.motivation: 大肠杆菌耐药性目前依赖培养法药敏试验，速度慢、难以满足早期治疗决策需求；而耐药状态在细胞形态上留下可测痕迹，且临床分离株全基因组测序日益可得，因此作者探究能否直接由基因组预测菌落表观形态。
AI.method: 将问题建模为条件图像生成：(1) 通过"片段–contig–分离株"的层次聚合，用冻结的基因组语言模型把每个分离株的组装contig编码为单一768维向量；(2) 使用带梯度惩罚的条件Wasserstein GAN，以该嵌入、施加的抗生素和耐药标签为条件合成菌落图像；(3) 数据为22株临床血源分离株在阿奇霉素、环丙沙星、四环素及无药对照下的167,356张单细胞图像；(4) 比较生成器中7种预训练卷积骨干，依据分布型图像质量指标选用ConvNeXt-Tiny；(5) 通过将合成图像加入缩减的真实训练集，以逐抗生素耐药分类进行外在评估。
AI.result: 在7种骨干中ConvNeXt-Tiny在分布型图像质量指标上表现最佳；将合成图像加入缩减的真实训练集后，逐抗生素耐药分类性能提升，其中耐药类召回率获得显著增益。
AI.conclusion: 基因组嵌入可条件化生成具有生物学相关性的菌落图像，合成数据在数据受限场景下可作为有效的增强手段改善耐药分类，尤其提升对耐药类的识别能力；该"基因组→形态→分类"的条件生成路线为快速耐药表型推断提供了新思路。

title: Grower-in-the-loop AI for Deployable Precision Fertilisation in Sustainable Agriculture
summary: In agriculture, typically over half of the applied nitrogen fertiliser is lost to water and to air. Precision fertilisation aims to reduce these losses while maintaining yield and quality, yet existing tools struggle to capture farm-specific challenges in determining optimal nitrogen rates. Static recommendations are common and overlook on-farm constraints, such as delays due to weather or machinery availability, or change in budgets. Each constraint governs when and how growers apply fertiliser in practice. Here we present a grower-in-the-loop framework for winter wheat in England, combining baseline fertilisation planning from a machine learning-derived nitrogen-response curve with in-season adaptation via a large language model. We evaluated the framework using data from long-term experiments (LTEs), replicated field trials, and farm deployments. Retrospective model validation using LTEs confirmed low economic decision-loss across multiple seasons. Using field and farm trials, baseline schedules were shown to match standard-practice yields with less nitrogen, whereas in-season adjusted schedules additionally retained grain quality standards. Given this enhanced performance, in-season adaptation absorbed weather, machinery and budget constraints to keep recommendations executable. The framework therefore shows promise for translating static recommendations into adaptable, grower-informed decisions for sustainable fertiliser management.

AI.tldr: 提出"种植者参与循环"（grower-in-the-loop）框架：用机器学习氮响应曲线生成小麦基线施肥方案，再用大语言模型在生长季内动态调整，实证表明可减氮保产并保持籽粒品质，同时使建议在天气、机械与预算约束下可执行。
AI.motivation: 农业中过半施氮量经水、气途径流失；精准施肥旨在减产损而保产质，但现有工具难以刻画农场特定约束（天气或机械导致的延误、预算变化）。静态推荐方案普遍且忽略田间实际约束，而每项约束都决定种植者实际何时、如何施肥。
AI.method: 构建面向英格兰冬小麦的种植者参与循环框架：以机器学习导出的氮响应曲线生成基线施肥计划，并在生长季内通过大语言模型进行适应调整；评估依托长期试验（LTE）、重复田间试验及农场实际部署数据。
AI.result: 基于长期试验的回顾性模型验证显示多季经济决策损失较低；田间与农场试验中，基线方案以较少氮量达到常规实践产量，季内调整方案额外保持籽粒品质标准；季内适应可吸收天气、机械与预算约束，使建议保持可执行。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有望将静态推荐转化为可适应、由种植者参与决策的方案，服务于可持续肥料管理。

title: SchemaCaps: When a Compatible Tool Update Silently Widens an AI Agent's Authority
comment: Author's accepted version (without the publisher's layout). Accepted at ICAART 2027; final version published by SCITEPRESS. Artefact: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24233014
summary: The tools users approve for their AI agents keep changing their JSON input schemas. Of 8 surveyed MCP clients and scanners, none is observed or documented to re-approve a tool whose input schema widens (two not determinable). We define non-amplification over the coordinates visible in the schema (declared arguments and undeclared fields, on effective values) and a re-binding rule decided by subschema inclusion, trusting no field labels by default and conservative up to its checker and tested case analysis. Evidence: a Coq proof of composition; 48 regression tests; an exact-reference benchmark, where the reviewed version of the rule silently re-bound 27 amplifying changes, now fixed; and a pilot on 604 releases of 39 public MCP servers. There, 412 of 580 compatible schema changes widen some coordinate, yet compatibility re-binds them silently. The authors' adjudicated double annotation finds at least 76 that add or widen an authority-bearing argument (66 of the 84 a name-based labeller flags, plus 10 it misses). On existing tools, the rule asks 645 re-approvals, against 1,197 for pinning the input schema (2,004 with descriptions) and 617 for compatibility. Behaviour change behind an identical schema remains out of reach.

AI.tldr: 现有MCP客户端在工具输入schema变宽时不会重新审批，存在权限放大风险；作者提出基于子schema包含的"非放大"定义与重绑定规则，并给出形式化验证与实测证据。
AI.motivation: 用户批准AI agent所用工具的JSON输入schema会持续变化，而调研的8个MCP客户端/扫描器中无一被观察到或文档记录会在schema变宽时重新审批（2个无法判定），导致已批准工具可能被静默扩大权限。
AI.method: 在schema可见坐标（声明参数与未声明字段，基于有效取值）上定义"非放大"性质，并设计由子schema包含关系决定的重绑定规则：默认不信任字段名，对检查器及其测试用例分析保持保守；配套Coq组合性证明、48个回归测试、精确参照基准，并在39个公开MCP服务器的604个发布版本上做试点。
AI.result: 精确参照基准显示，规则早期版本静默重绑定了27个放大性变更，现已修复。试点中580个兼容性schema变更里有412个扩大了某坐标，却仍被兼容性静默重绑定；双人裁定标注发现至少76个新增或扩大了承载权限的参数（其中66个被基于名称的标注器命中，另有10个被其漏检）。在既有工具上，该规则要求645次重新审批，而固定输入schema需1,197次（含描述则2,004次），仅按兼容性需617次。
AI.conclusion: 以子schema包含为核心的保守重绑定规则能在可控审批成本下拦截schema放大带来的权限提升，但无法覆盖schema不变而行为改变的情形，这一局限仍未解决。

title: Intent-Conditioned Argument Mediation for Tool-Using LLM Agents: Blocking Trusted-but-Unauthorized Arguments
comment: Accepted at ICAART 2027; final version published by SCITEPRESS. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24233094
summary: LLM agents turn a user's request and retrieved content into tool calls, and a call can reach the wrong recipient, endpoint, file or participant. Argument-level provenance blocks such values when they come from untrusted content, but accepts a trusted value that the user never requested. IntentFlow, a mediation layer between an unmodified planner and its tools, checks each authority-bearing argument against an intent contract and a provenance policy. On a synthetic benchmark of 200 attacks (oracle intent and injection labels, declared roles), attack success falls from 50.5% with provenance alone to 12.0% [8.2-17.2%]; every remaining success alters a content or payload field. IntentFlow wrongly blocks none of 200 paired benign tasks and 4 of 50 hard ones. On 50 trusted-but-unauthorized attacks, provenance-only mediation executes all 50 and IntentFlow none; a CaMeL-style check also blocks all 50 but rejects 16 of 50 benign tasks. On an offline AgentDojo-derived replay, IntentFlow blocks all 20 attacks at 75% benign success, as does a CaMeL-style check; a Progent-style allowlist blocks 19 and keeps all benign tasks. With one live planner and the same oracles, the mediator blocked all 17 corrupted calls proposed in 110 attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出 IntentFlow 中介层，在不可修改的规划器与工具之间，用"意图契约+来源策略"校验每个携带权限的调用参数，将攻击成功率从仅用来源校验的 50.5% 降至 12.0%，且几乎无误拦截。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体把用户请求与检索内容转化为工具调用，可能误发到错误接收方、端点、文件或参与者。仅做参数级来源校验（provenance）能阻止不可信内容带来的值，却无法拒绝"可信但用户从未请求"的值，因此需要补充意图层面的授权检查。
AI.method: IntentFlow 作为规划器与工具之间的中介层，对每个承载权限的参数同时依据意图契约（intent contract）与来源策略（provenance policy）进行校验。在 200 条攻击（含 oracle 意图与注入标签、已声明角色）的合成基准上评测，并与仅来源方案、CaMeL 式检查、Progent 式白名单对比；另做 AgentDojo 派生的离线重放与单真实规划器的在线实验。
AI.result: 攻击成功率由仅来源校验的 50.5% 降至 12.0%[8.2-17.2%]，剩余成功均改变了内容或载荷字段；200 个配对良性任务零误拦，50 个困难任务误拦 4 个。对 50 个"可信但未授权"攻击，仅来源方案全部执行、IntentFlow 全部拦截；CaMeL 式检查虽也全拦但在良性任务上误拒 16/50。AgentDojo 重放中 IntentFlow 拦截全部 20 个攻击且良性成功率 75%，CaMeL 式亦全拦，Progent 式白名单拦截 19 个且保留全部良性任务。在线实验中，中介层拦截 110 次攻击中提出的全部 17 个受损调用。
AI.conclusion: 参数级来源校验不足以防范"可信但越权"的调用；引入意图契约与来源策略的双重校验可在保持良性可用性的同时显著降低攻击成功率，代价是少量困难任务误拦，且残余风险集中在内容型字段。

title: Skill-Composer: Requirement-Driven Skill Selection from Multiple Marketplaces
summary: Agent skills have become the primary vehicle through which agents reuse specialized capabilities, yet public skill marketplaces provide skills with individual items: a query, whether matched through keyword or embedding similarity, returns a list of single skills ordered by relevance or by popularity. Such an interface cannot answer the question a developer actually faces: which set of skills should be installed to cover a task's complete requirement? The highest-ranked skills are often functionally redundant, while capabilities that are genuinely required remain uncovered. In this paper, we argue that skill acquisition should be reframed from ranking to set selection. We propose Skill-Composer, an agent-native framework that selects a non-redundant skill bundle for the user requirement, which aims to cover all available required capabilities and report any gaps. Specifically, it clarifies user requirements into atomic requirement points, retrieves and merges candidate skills across fragmented marketplaces, decomposes each candidate's capabilities, and progressively discards overlapping ones, so that each retained skill provides different capabilities. This moves the decision of which skills to acquire from the developer to the agent itself. We position this reframing and sketch its workflow.

AI.tldr: 论文主张将智能体技能获取从"技能排序"重构为"技能集合选择"，提出Skill-Composer框架，为用户需求选出无冗余、覆盖完整能力并报告缺口的技能包。
AI.motivation: 现有公开技能市场以单项技能为单位、按相关度或流行度返回排序列表，无法回答开发者真正关心的问题——应安装哪一组技能才能覆盖任务的完整需求；且高排名技能常功能冗余，真正必需的能力反而未被覆盖。
AI.method: Skill-Composer为智能体原生框架：(1) 将用户需求澄清为原子化需求点；(2) 跨碎片化技能市场检索并合并候选技能；(3) 分解每个候选技能的能力；(4) 逐步剔除重叠技能，使保留的每个技能贡献不同能力，并报告未覆盖的能力缺口。
AI.result: 本文为立场/定位性工作，提出"从排序到集合选择"的重构视角并勾勒工作流程，摘要中未给出定量实验结果。
AI.conclusion: 技能获取的决策权应从开发者转移到智能体自身；以集合选择替代单技能排序，可实现非冗余、能力全覆盖并可报告缺口的技能包获取。

title: JaxNaviSim: A GPU-Accelerated, Data-Driven Simulator and Learning Benchmark for Maritime Navigation
summary: Coordinating vessels through the shared waterways of busy ports grows more challenging as vessel traffic increases. Port authorities need realistic simulations to assess how arrival schedules, anchorage assignments, and routes affect vessel throughput and navigation safety. Existing AIS-based trajectory models predict a vessel's track from its past trajectory in an open-loop fashion. They do not simulate step-by-step responses to other ships or test whether a vessel collides or reaches its goal. To address this problem, we introduce JaxNaviSim, a data-driven simulator and learning benchmark coupling Automatic Identification System (AIS) data with fast, controllable traffic simulation, in which learned models steer vessels through recorded traffic. First, we release a dataset of ~141 million AIS records from over 30K vessels across eight high-density regions of the Singapore Strait, among the world's busiest waterways, with ~6.7 million vessel-hours. Unlike several existing AIS datasets which mostly cover open seas, ours captures close-quarters vessel traffic in the narrow strait. Second, we define a navigation task for each recorded vessel trajectory. A model steers that vessel every 10 s from its recorded state to its anchoring point or region exit, while surrounding ships follow their recorded tracks or are steered by the model. We implement a JAX simulator that runs these tasks in large batches on a GPU. We also incorporate multiple vessel dynamics models and sea surface currents. Finally, we benchmark imitation learning (IL), offline and online RL, and include Predictive Action Refinement (PAR) as a safety baseline that cuts collision rates to 1-3%. The comparison shows that low tracking error does not ensure arrival, and learned policies can reach most destinations yet collide in 20-45% of episodes.

AI.tldr: 提出 JaxNaviSim：将新加坡海峡约1.41亿条 AIS 记录与 GPU 加速的可控交通仿真结合的数据驱动仿真器与学习基准，并系统评测 IL、离线/在线 RL 及安全基线 PAR。
AI.motivation: 港口船舶流量增长使航道协调愈发困难，港务部门需要可评估到港计划、锚地分配与航线对吞吐量和航行安全影响的真实仿真。现有基于 AIS 的轨迹模型以开环方式由历史轨迹预测航迹，无法逐步响应其他船舶，也无法检验是否碰撞或抵达目标。
AI.method: 1) 发布新加坡海峡八个高密度区域、3万余艘船、约1.41亿条 AIS 记录（约670万船时）的数据集，侧重狭窄海峡内的近距离交通；2) 为每条记录轨迹定义导航任务：模型每10秒操控目标船从记录状态驶向锚点或区域出口，周围船舶按记录轨迹行驶或由模型操控；3) 实现 JAX 仿真器，支持 GPU 大批量并行，并集成多种船舶动力学模型与海表流；4) 基准测试模仿学习、离线与在线 RL，并引入 Predictive Action Refinement (PAR) 作为安全基线。
AI.result: PAR 将碰撞率降至 1–3%；对比显示低跟踪误差并不能保证抵达，学习到的策略虽能到达多数目的地，但在 20–45% 的回合中发生碰撞。
AI.conclusion: 闭环、可控、可批量并行的 AIS 耦合仿真为船舶导航策略提供了更贴近真实的安全评估基准；跟踪精度不足以作为导航成功指标，需以抵达率与碰撞率为核心评价，安全精化机制对降低碰撞至关重要。

title: Reproducible by Seed? Not on GPUs: Batch-Dependent Non-Determinism in Text-to-Image Models
summary: In text to image AI models, fixing the prompt and the random seed is widely assumed to fix the image. We show that it does not on GPUs. We evaluate six text-to-image models (diffusion and autoregressive) under four numerical precisions and quantizations on three GPU types (RTX A6000, RTX 6000 Ada, and H100 NVL), across up to 100 prompts per set for all six models. For each configuration we compare, with the prompt and seed fixed, the image generated alone with the image generated inside a batch, and we also compare across GPUs. Every replay control reported here is bit-exact, so the variation is not random noise: the execution setting, mainly the batch composition and the GPU, decides the output. The effect is large and model dependent. Structural similarity between the single-image and the batched output falls to 0.580 for an autoregressive model in bf16 and to 0.551 with int8. For a second autoregressive model in bf16 it falls to 0.261 with sampled decoding and to 0.229 with greedy decoding, and for an fp8 diffusion model to 0.68. A diffusion model in bf16 stays close to the batch-1 output (0.96-0.98) but changes every image. In most cases the batched image is a different but equally valid image; in some, such as prompts with digits and counters, it is visibly worse. Cross-GPU differences are of the same order as the batch effect: for one autoregressive model in bf16 compared across two GPU architectures (RTX 6000 Ada versus RTX A6000), no image is bit-identical and the cross-GPU LPIPS (0.355 to 0.383) matches the batch effect within one GPU (0.347 to 0.381). The consequences are direct: seeds do not make results reproducible, benchmarks and image-quality comparisons that mix batch sizes or hardware can be biased, and safety audits and A/B tests on generated images need the serving setup reported.

AI.tldr: 在GPU上固定prompt与随机种子并不能保证文本到图像模型输出可复现：批组成与GPU型号会决定生成结果，且差异幅度可大到破坏语义正确性。
AI.motivation: 业界普遍假设"固定prompt+固定种子=固定图像"，作者要检验这一假设在真实GPU推理环境下是否成立，并量化执行设置（批组成、GPU架构、数值精度）对输出的影响，以此揭示基准评测、图像质量比较与安全审计中潜在的偏差来源。
AI.method: 覆盖6个文本到图像模型（扩散与自回归）在三种GPU（RTX A6000、RTX 6000 Ada、H100 NVL）与四种数值精度/量化配置下的推理实验，每组每模型最多100条prompt。对每个配置，在prompt与种子固定的条件下，对比"单图生成"与"批内生成"的图像，并进行跨GPU对比；所有replay控制均为bit-exact，以排除随机噪声，用结构相似度（SSIM）与LPIPS作为度量。
AI.result: 单图与批内输出的SSIM显著下降：某自回归模型bf16降至0.580、int8降至0.551；另一自回归模型bf16下采样解码为0.261、贪心解码为0.229；某扩散模型fp8为0.68；bf16扩散模型仍保持0.96–0.98但每张图都有变化。跨GPU差异与批效应同量级：某自回归模型bf16在RTX 6000 Ada与RTX A6000间无一张bit-identical，跨GPU LPIPS 0.355–0.383，与单GPU内批效应0.347–0.381相当。多数情况下批内图像是"不同但同样有效"的图像，但在含数字与计数器的prompt上明显变差。
AI.conclusion: 种子不构成可复现性保障；混合批大小或硬件的基准评测与图像质量比较会被系统性偏置；对生成图像的安全审计与A/B测试必须报告serving配置（批组成、GPU型号、数值精度）。

title: Revisiting LLMs as Context Engineers
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are used in more and more new tasks, context engineering becomes a fundamental method to efficiently steer LLMs by constructing instruction prompts or metadata without intensive training. A growing number of LLM context engineering (LCE) approaches automate the task by casting the LLM itself as the engineer that draws generalizable instructions or experiences from offline trials as context. Although these methods resemble how humans learn from experiences, it remains unclear \textbf{when and how} LLMs can engineer effective context from data. To answer the question, we first establish a benchmark composed of datasets with different reasoning patterns. We compared different LCE methods with different LLM families in 8B size, showing that there is no single winner for all tasks, even compared with simple baselines like chain-of-thought. Even when scaling model capabilities via more parameters or generation iterations, LCEs do not consistently boost existing performance. Across all datasets and models, the performance gains of LCEs are negatively correlated ($r=-0.5, p\le 0.05$) with the diversity of the failure modes of reasoning trajectories. Investigating how LCEs work, we find that (1) the improvement in instruction adherence can explain some success of LCEs; (2) one major bottleneck is whether LLMs can extract effective experiences out of natively diverse failures. Through this study, we uncover the limited capabilities of LCEs in abstracting principled contexts from diverse failure modes and understand how LCEs work, providing guidelines for future work.

AI.tldr: 论文系统考察LLM上下文工程（LCE）在何时、如何有效：构建覆盖不同推理模式的基准，比较多种LCE方法与8B规模模型家族，发现不存在普适最优方法，性能增益与失败模式多样性显著负相关（r=-0.5），并提出指令遵循提升可部分解释其成功，而从多样化失败中提取有效经验是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 上下文工程可在不进行密集训练的情况下高效引导LLM，已有工作将LLM自身作为"工程师"从离线尝试中提炼可泛化指令或经验作为上下文，但这类方法何时、如何真正生效尚不清楚，缺乏系统性的实证刻画。
AI.method: 构建包含不同推理模式数据集的基准；在不同任务上对比多种LCE方法与不同8B规模LLM家族，并纳入chain-of-thought等简单基线；通过扩展模型参数规模与生成迭代次数检验可扩展性；对失败轨迹的失败模式多样性进行量化并与性能增益做相关性分析；进一步剖析LCE的作用机制（指令遵循度、经验提取质量）。
AI.result: 没有单一LCE方法在所有任务上占优，某些情况下不及chain-of-thought等简单基线；增大模型参数或增加生成迭代并不能稳定提升性能；在所有数据集与模型上，LCE性能增益与推理轨迹失败模式多样性呈显著负相关（r=-0.5, p≤0.05）；指令遵循能力的提升可部分解释LCE的成功；主要瓶颈在于LLM能否从天然多样化的失败中抽取有效经验。
AI.conclusion: LCE从多样化失败模式中抽象出有原则性上下文的能力有限；研究揭示了其工作机制与边界条件，为未来上下文工程方法设计提供了指导准则。

title: Automated Call for Action: RAG-Based Environmental Law Enforcement Screening System
summary: Environmental law inspectors face a structural issue in identifying potential violations from data: they often do not have the capacity to deal with large volume of data present in the emission events. This paper examines to what extent an LLM-based system can support evidence assembly and permit-based screening of such events, using the coke plants of a steel producer and a regional environmental service as a case. A simple puff-trajectory model aligns air quality measurements, weather and citizen complaints with each emission event. A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline then retrieves facility-specific permit conditions and generates event reports and a period report with an investigation recommendation. Across 74 events from March 2025, plant-aware re-ranking reduced reports citing the other plant's conditions from 58.1% (hybrid retrieval) to 0% by rule-based plant labels, while maintaining high RAGAS and LLM-judge metrics. GPT-5-mini performed comparably to GPT-5.1, whereas GPT-5-nano scored lower on legal grounding and legal faithfulness.
