In an evidence ablation, removing air quality (AQ) data changed judge scores and period recommendations most; citation overlap changed only slightly under any removal, and removing complaint details had no measurable effect. This suggests a need for rules and guidelines that link complaints to incidents and permit conditions, so that community reports can count as evidence. The results support screening of events that may need further investigation. Design implications for involving environmental service experts are derived.

AI.tldr: 本文评估基于LLM的系统在排放事件证据汇集与基于许可证筛查中的支持能力，以钢铁企业焦化厂与区域环境服务机构为案例：用简易烟羽轨迹模型对齐空气质量、气象与投诉数据，再以RAG检索设施许可证条款并生成事件报告与调查建议。
AI.motivation: 环境执法检查人员面临结构性问题：排放事件数据量大，难以人工识别潜在违规；且证据分散在监测、气象、投诉与许可证条款中，缺乏可规模化的证据汇集与合规筛查手段。
AI.method: 案例研究（钢厂焦化厂+区域环境服务机构）；简易烟羽轨迹模型将空气质量测量、气象与公众投诉对齐到同一排放事件；RAG流水线检索设施特定许可证条件，生成事件报告和周期报告并提供调查建议；引入基于规则的厂区标签进行厂区感知重排序；采用RAGAS与LLM评判指标评估；进行证据消融实验（移除空气质量数据、投诉细节等）；比较GPT-5-mini、GPT-5.1、GPT-5-nano。
AI.result: 2025年3月的74起事件中，厂区感知重排序使引用另一厂区许可证条件的报告比例由58.1%（混合检索）降至0%，同时保持较高RAGAS与LLM评判分数；GPT-5-mini表现与GPT-5.1相当，GPT-5-nano在法律依据与法律忠实度上较低。消融实验显示：移除空气质量数据对评判分数和周期建议影响最大；引用重叠在任何移除下变化很小；移除投诉细节无可测影响。
AI.conclusion: 该系统可支持对需进一步调查的事件进行筛查；建议制定规则与指南，将投诉与事件及许可证条件关联，使社区报告可作为证据；并提出让环境服务专家参与的设计启示。

title: HWRE-Bench: Can LLM Agents Understand Hardware They Did Not Design?
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Work in progress
summary: Hardware benchmarks for LLM agents all run the design flow forward, from a specification to RTL, a layout or a bug fix. We ask the reverse question: given an implemented artifact, such as a layout, a gate-level netlist or a protected simulation model, can an agent work out what it does well enough to act on that knowledge? We introduce HWRE-Bench, a benchmark for agentic hardware reverse engineering built on one observation. Each step of the forward flow discards information (names, hierarchy, word-level structure, generator parameters, the programming model), and a reverse-engineering task asks the agent to recover what was lost and to prove it with an executable deliverable that the artifact alone cannot supply. Since layout extraction is now mechanical and a correct netlist is already a cycle-exact model, every task carries a mandatory copy-the-netlist control that must score zero. HWRE-Bench spans five tracks (Extract, Abstract, Audit, Interoperate, Modify), four information-loss levels and white- versus black-box access, all on original designs. We report a pilot of 148 rollouts from two agents on four seed tasks under 16 conditions, with stage-annotated trajectories. Agents built their own layout extractors and audited a sanitized layout as reliably as a netlist, at about 27% more turns. Keyless, equivalence-preserving obfuscation changed neither pass rates nor defect-repair scores. Whether agents read the structure at all depended on task framing rather than on necessity, so pass rate alone does not show understanding. Provider safety filters stopped 16% of one agent's runs on the audit tasks. These results argue for deliverables beyond equivalence and for reporting run validity explicitly.

AI.tldr: 提出HWRE-Bench，一个面向智能体硬件逆向工程的基准：考察智能体能否从版图、门级网表或受保护仿真模型中恢复丢失的信息（命名、层次、字级结构、生成参数、编程模型），并用可执行交付物证明。含五条赛道、四个信息损失等级、白盒/黑盒访问，并强制设置"抄网表"对照。试点148次rollout显示：智能体可自建版图提取器，去密钥等价保持混淆未改变通过率，且通过率本身不足以证明"理解"。
AI.motivation: 现有硬件基准只沿正向设计流程（规格→RTL/版图/修复）评测智能体，缺少逆向问题的统一评测；而正向流程每一步都丢弃信息，逆向正是恢复这些信息的任务，需可执行交付物而非等价性来验证。
AI.method: 构建HWRE-Bench：五条赛道（Extract、Abstract、Audit、Interoperate、Modify）×四个信息损失等级×白/黑盒访问，全部基于原创设计；因版图提取已机械化、正确网表本身即周期精确模型，每项任务附强制"复制网表"对照且必须得零分；试点为2个智能体×4个种子任务×16种条件的148次带阶段标注轨迹的rollout。
AI.result: 智能体自建版图提取器，对净化版图的审计可靠性接近网表，但多耗约27%轮次；无密钥、保持等价的混淆既未改变通过率也未影响缺陷修复得分；智能体是否真正读取结构取决于任务表述而非必要性，故仅看通过率无法体现理解；某智能体16%的审计运行被供应商安全过滤器中断。
AI.conclusion: 硬件逆向评测应要求超越等价性的交付物，并显式报告运行有效性（如被安全过滤器中断的run），以避免用通过率误判理解程度。

title: Cost-Sensitive Reversibility of Non-Deterministic Actions
summary:
Determining action reversibility requires checking whether the effects of an action can be undone. Recent work has extended reversibility to fully observable non-deterministic (FOND) planning. It distinguishes weak reversibility, where reversal may succeed, from strong-cyclic reversibility, where reversal is guaranteed under fairness. These notions are qualitative: they say whether reversal is possible, but not how costly it is.
  We introduce cost-sensitive reversibility for non-deterministic actions. Given positive action costs, we define weak and strong reversal budgets, $k$-bounded reversibility, and a distinction between finite strong reversal and strong-cyclic reversal with unbounded worst-case cost. We relate the resulting notions in a reversibility lattice, prove cost-aware policy-merging results, and show how to compute restricted weak and strong universal uniform reversal budgets using cost-optimal classical planning and worst-case-optimal FOND search, respectively. We also give an admissible lower-bound test for rejecting $k$-bounded reversibility. These notions support finer-grained safety decisions: a small finite strong budget bounds recovery cost, whereas a small weak budget certifies only a cheap possible recovery path. Actions without an acceptable strong bound may therefore warrant human approval, as in tool-using agent systems.

AI.tldr: 该文将可逆性概念推广到考虑代价的非确定性动作，提出弱/强反转预算、$k$-有界可逆性等定量刻画，并给出计算方法与判定格结构。
AI.motivation: 已有FOND规划中的弱可逆与强循环可逆都是定性概念，只说明反转是否可能，未刻画反转的代价，无法支持更细粒度的安全决策。
AI.method: 给定正的动作代价，定义弱反转预算与强反转预算、$k$-有界可逆性，并区分有限强反转与最坏情况代价无界的强循环反转；构建可逆性格，证明代价感知的策略合并结果；用代价最优经典规划计算受限弱通用一致反转预算，用最坏情况最优FOND搜索计算强通用一致反转预算；提出可采纳的下界检验以排除$k$-有界可逆性。
AI.result: 建立了可逆性的定量格结构，给出代价感知策略合并定理，提供分别基于经典规划与FOND搜索的两类预算计算方法，以及可采纳的$k$-有界可逆性否定检验。
AI.conclusion: 小的有限强预算可界定恢复代价，而小的弱预算仅证明存在一条廉价恢复路径；缺少可接受强界的动作应引入人工审批，适用于工具使用型智能体系统等安全敏感场景。

title: Learning Multimodal Representations from Partially Paired, Small-Scale Data
summary: Modeling multimodal data from partially paired samples is critical for advancing domains like biomedicine, where vast unimodal datasets and foundation models exist but paired data remains scarce. Existing fusion methods rely on large-scale paired datasets, limiting their use in scenarios with incomplete pairing. We introduce CAMEO, an adversarial learning-based modality fusion framework that integrates modalities from small, partially paired datasets. Combining any pre-trained unimodal encoder with a cross-modal latent alignment mechanism, CAMEO learns shared representations requiring only minimal paired samples. Evaluated on computational pathology tasks such as niche classification and cell type composition prediction, CAMEO achieves superior data efficiency, outperforming contrastive approaches like CLIP in low paired-data regimes, and highlighting the benefits of adversarial alignment when paired annotations are scarce. To facilitate further research, we additionally release a fully annotated HuggingFace dataset comprising three organs and paired image and gene expression modalities. By extending fusion methods to address limited pairing and small-scale datasets, we provide a framework that advances multimodal learning and broadens its applicability to real-world biomedical problems.

AI.tldr: CAMEO：一种基于对抗学习的多模态融合框架，仅需少量配对样本即可整合部分配对、小规模数据集中的模态，在计算病理任务上数据效率优于CLIP等对比方法。
AI.motivation: 生物医学领域存在大量单模态数据集与基础模型，但配对数据稀缺；现有融合方法依赖大规模配对数据，难以适用于配对不完整的场景。
AI.method: CAMEO将任意预训练单模态编码器与跨模态潜在对齐机制结合，通过对抗学习学习共享表征，仅需极少配对样本。
AI.result: 在生态位分类、细胞类型组成预测等计算病理任务上，CAMEO展现更优数据效率，在低配对数据条件下超过CLIP等对比方法，并验证了配对标注稀缺时对抗对齐的优势；同时发布涵盖三个器官、图像与基因表达配对模态的HuggingFace全标注数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将融合方法拓展至有限配对与小规模数据场景，提供了推进多模态学习并扩展其在真实生物医学问题中适用性的框架。

title: GameDojo: Benchmarking Real-Time Interactive Agents in Video Games
comment: 28 pages. Project page: https://gamedojo-benchmark.github.io/ , and code: https://github.com/THUSI-Lab/GameDojo
summary: Interactive intelligence requires agents to act on observations and adapt to the consequences of actions. Studying these abilities calls for diverse, challenging tasks under controlled conditions. We introduce GameDojo, a controllable interactive gameplay benchmark of 120 boss encounters across 20 games for evaluating model capabilities, learning algorithms, and agent harnesses. Coding agents reconstruct the environments and write gameplay scripts, producing GameDojo-Data with 600 hours of gameplay trajectories. Experiments reveal substantial challenges for frontier models, especially in real-time interaction. Training on GameDojo-Data brings GameDojo-4B to frontier performance, with the strongest real-time performance. We also find joint training improves individual tasks, and learned policies transfer across bosses. Together, these findings establish GameDojo as a challenging and valuable interactive gameplay benchmark for the community. Our project page is at https://gamedojo-benchmark.github.io/ , and our code is at https://github.com/THUSI-Lab/GameDojo .

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GameDojo：一个包含 20 款游戏、120 场 Boss 战的可控交互式游戏基准，用于评测模型能力、学习算法与智能体框架，并构建 600 小时游玩轨迹数据集 GameDojo-Data；实验表明前沿模型在实时交互上仍面临显著挑战，基于该数据训练的 GameDojo-4B 达到前沿水平并具备最强实时表现，联合训练与策略跨 Boss 迁移均有效。
AI.motivation: 交互智能要求智能体基于观测行动并适应行动后果，而研究此类能力需要多样、有挑战且在可控条件下可复现的任务环境，现有基准难以同时满足多样性与可控性需求。
AI.method: 由编码智能体重建游戏环境并编写游玩脚本，构建 120 场 Boss 遭遇、覆盖 20 款游戏的可控基准，并采集生成 600 小时游玩轨迹数据集 GameDojo-Data，用于评测模型能力、学习算法与智能体框架（agent harness）。
AI.result: 前沿模型在该基准上仍存在显著挑战，尤以实时交互为甚；在 GameDojo-Data 上训练得到 GameDojo-4B，达到前沿性能且实时表现最佳；联合训练可提升单项任务表现，学到的策略可跨 Boss 迁移。
AI.conclusion: GameDojo 作为一个具挑战性且有价值的交互式游戏基准，可为社区研究交互智能提供可控评测与数据支撑。

title: Reducing Order Sensitivity in Decision Models
summary: Decision models are emerging as fast components of larger AI systems. Yet recent decision models, such as Jev, process options sequentially, leading to different predictions based on their ordering. Across ten open- and closed-source decision models, we find that \emph{order-sensitivity} is pervasive, causing substantial accuracy degradation and unreliable decision-making. These effects become more pronounced as the number of options grows and can compound across multi-step decisions. To address this problem, we systematically compare eight methods for mitigating order sensitivity in terms of robustness, predictive accuracy, and inference efficiency. Among these methods, we find that \emph{tree attention} is a surprisingly effective and efficient method. It achieves order invariance by processing options as parallel branches of a shared context. When used during training, it matches the baseline's average accuracy. Applied to the baseline without retraining, it also eliminates order sensitivity with only a 1.1-point drop in accuracy. Our findings demonstrate that order invariance can be enforced directly in decision models with little or no loss in predictive accuracy.

AI.tldr: 决策模型（如Jev）逐序处理选项导致顺序敏感性，本文系统评估八种缓解方法，发现tree attention能以极小精度损失实现顺序不变性。
AI.motivation: 决策模型正成为大型AI系统的快速组件，但现有决策模型顺序处理选项，预测结果依赖选项排列顺序，造成显著精度下降与决策不可靠，且随选项数量增加和多步决策累积而恶化。
AI.method: 在十个开源与闭源决策模型上量化顺序敏感性；系统比较八种缓解顺序敏感性的方法，从鲁棒性、预测精度与推理效率三维度评估；重点分析tree attention——将选项作为共享上下文的并行分支处理以实现顺序不变性，并分别在训练阶段使用与不重训练直接应用于基线两种设置下检验。
AI.result: 顺序敏感性普遍存在并导致显著精度退化；tree attention意外地有效且高效：训练时使用可匹配基线平均精度；直接在基线模型上使用（不重训练）可消除顺序敏感性，仅损失1.1个精度点。
AI.conclusion: 顺序不变性可直接在决策模型中强制实现，且几乎不损失预测精度，tree attention是一种高效可行的方案。

title: When Does Overriding the Majority Vote Help?
summary: When should additional reasoning or verification replace a majority-vote answer? We call such a replacement an override. We examine two obstacles: the availability of correct alternatives and the reliability of methods that produce or select them. We compare additional reasoning, executed programs, and cross-model reasoning on 150 competition-mathematics questions with three open reasoning models. Starting from a majority vote over 16 responses, we measure how often overrides occur and how many errors they correct or introduce across agreement thresholds. When the vote is incorrect, the correct answer is often absent from the original responses. Additional same-model reasoning rarely overrides, while executed programs correct more errors than they introduce at every evaluated threshold. Cross-model overrides improve some weaker baselines but do not establish an advantage over the more accurate model alone, even with only eight standalone responses. Stricter agreement reduces how often overrides occur but does not consistently increase the fraction that correct errors. At the strictest thresholds, overrides occur on few distinct questions, limiting conclusions about their reliability.

AI.tldr: 论文研究"覆盖"(override)——即用额外推理或验证替代多数投票答案的时机问题，比较额外推理、可执行程序与跨模型推理三种机制在竞赛数学题上的纠错效果。
AI.motivation: 多数投票是聚合大模型多答案的常用手段，但投票错误时是否应被额外推理或验证"覆盖"缺乏实证依据；需要考察两个障碍：正确备选答案是否可得，以及产生/选择备选答案的方法是否可靠。
AI.method: 在150道竞赛数学题上使用3个开放推理模型，以16次回答的多数投票为起点，对比额外推理、可执行程序、跨模型推理三种覆盖机制，并在不同一致性阈值下统计覆盖发生频率及纠正/引入错误的数量。
AI.result: 投票错误时正确答案常不在原始回答中；同模型额外推理很少触发覆盖；可执行程序在所有阈值下纠正错误多于引入错误；跨模型覆盖改善较弱基线但未优于单独使用更准确模型（即使仅用8个独立回答）；更严格阈值降低覆盖频率但未稳定提升纠错比例；最严阈值下覆盖仅涉及少数题目，可靠性结论受限。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖并非普遍有效：其收益依赖备选答案可得性与方法可靠性，程序执行是最稳定的纠错来源，而同模型推理与跨模型推理的增益有限，且严格阈值下的覆盖样本过少，难以评估其可靠性。

title: Revisiting Learning to Delegate: LLM Discovered Heuristics for Large-Scale Vehicle Routing
summary: Efficient vehicle routing is critical to logistics and transportation, yet solving large-scale capacitated vehicle routing problems (CVRP) remains computationally challenging due to their combinatorial complexity. One approach to solve large-scale vehicle routing optimization is to identify promising subproblems and then optimize them using solvers. In this paper, we propose a framework of automatic heuristic design (AHD) in which a large language model (LLM) autonomously refines heuristics for selecting subproblems, enabling effective optimization of large-scale CVRP instances. Compared to prior approaches that train task-specific neural networks to select among heuristically constructed subproblems, our method discovers generalizable, interpretable LLM-generated heuristics to directly construct subproblems. Experiments show that our approach achieves comparable in-distribution performance while outperforming neural network-based policies on out-of-distribution instances with large-scale problems.

AI.tldr: 提出自动启发式设计(AHD)框架，利用大语言模型自主迭代精炼启发式，直接构造子问题以求解大规模容量约束车辆路径问题(CVRP)，在分布外大规模算例上优于神经网络子问题选择策略。
AI.motivation: 大规模CVRP因组合复杂度高而难以求解，常用思路是先识别有前景的子问题再交由求解器优化；但已有方法依赖训练任务专用神经网络在启发式构造的候选子问题中做选择，泛化性差、可解释性弱。作者希望让LLM自动生成可直接构造子问题的可泛化启发式。
AI.method: 构建AHD框架：由LLM自主迭代精炼用于子问题选择的启发式，从而直接构造子问题并交给求解器优化；与以往训练任务特定网络在启发式候选集中做选择的做法不同，本方法产出可解释、可泛化的LLM生成启发式。实验对比神经网络策略，评估同分布与分布外（含大规模）性能。
AI.result: 同分布性能与神经网络策略相当；在分布外的大规模算例上表现更优。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的自动启发式设计可有效求解大规模CVRP，其生成的启发式兼具可解释性与泛化性，是替代任务专用神经子问题选择策略的可行方案。

title: Decoupling Solving from Abstention: Single-Rollout Conformal Risk Control for Hard-Budget LLM Reasoning
summary: Hard token budgets often interrupt LLM reasoning before an answer is produced. Forcing reasoning to terminate recovers correct solutions but also increases confident errors, creating a joint challenge of solving within budget and deciding when to abstain. Existing remedies are costly or lack guarantees: supervised fine-tuning offers no error control, penalizing wrong answers during reinforcement learning (RL) can suppress exploration, and multi-sample conformal methods multiply inference cost. We propose Tail-CRC, a single-rollout framework that separates candidate generation from submission control. We first adapt the solver to budget forcing with pure binary correctness rewards; after freezing it, we apply conformal risk control to upper-tail token surprise in the answer span. Each rollout yields both an answer and an uncertainty score from token log probabilities, enabling finite-sample control of expected wrong submissions under exchangeability and recalibration across risk targets or domains without retraining. We show that wrong-answer penalties create failure-only comparisons in group-relative RL, derive an exploration-starvation boundary, and identify length-induced ranking reversals and single-token spike sensitivity in answer scores. Across Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3-8B, 50 RL updates on 400 problems improve correct-submission rates by 15.0--29.6 points on DAPO and 4.3--12.8 points on out-of-domain Omni-MATH over inference-only budget forcing, while reducing generation cost by 3.5--12.6\%. On 8B Omni-MATH, target-domain calibration cuts wrong submissions from 30.3\% to 5.8\% at 4K and from 41.8\% to 6.5\% at 8K. At 4K, generation is 2.05$\times$ faster for 4B and 2.23$\times$ faster for 8B than unforced 8K decoding in local amortized batch time. Tail-CRC thus enables reliable, efficient budgeted reasoning from a single rollout.

AI.tldr: Tail-CRC：单次rollout框架，先以预算强制+纯二元正确性奖励适配求解器并冻结，再用保形风险控制对答案span的上尾token惊讶度进行校准，实现有限样本的错答提交控制，兼顾预算内求解与弃答决策。
AI.motivation: 硬token预算常在答案产出前打断LLM推理；强制终止虽能挽回部分正确答案，却增加"自信错误"，形成"预算内求解+何时弃答"的联合挑战。现有方案代价高或缺乏保证：SFT无错误控制，RL惩罚错答抑制探索，多样本保形方法成倍增加推理开销。
AI.method: 将候选生成与提交控制解耦：①用预算强制与纯二元正确性奖励适配求解器；②冻结后对答案span的上尾token惊讶度施加保形风险控制，每次rollout由答案与token对数概率得到不确定性分数；理论分析错答惩罚在group-relative RL中造成"仅失败样本参与比较"、推导探索饥饿边界，并指出答案分数的长度诱导排序反转与单token尖峰敏感问题。
AI.result: Qwen3.5-4B与Qwen3-8B上，400题50次RL更新相比仅推理预算强制，正确提交率在DAPO上提升15.0–29.6点、域外Omni-MATH提升4.3–12.8点，生成成本降3.5–12.6%。8B Omni-MATH上目标域校准将错答提交从30.3%降至5.8%（4K）、41.8%降至6.5%（8K）；4K下本地摊销批处理时间较未强制8K解码快2.05×（4B）与2.23×（8B）。
AI.conclusion: Tail-CRC以单次rollout实现可靠、高效的预算受限推理：在校准域内可有限样本控制期望错答提交，并支持跨风险目标或域的重校准而无需重训练。

title: Boltz-Flow: Generating High-Quality Robot Action from Boltzmann Machine
summary: Flow-matching policies integrate a velocity field from a fixed, observation-independent Gaussian source. However, since the source is unimodal and identical across all tasks, the limited representational capacity of Gaussian distributions constrains how far a policy can scale with growing task diversity. Moreover, the source factorizes over time steps and control dimensions, discarding the coordination that manipulation requires. We introduce Boltz-Flow, which replaces Gaussian initialization with a more powerful, observation- and instruction-conditioned Boltzmann source while leaving the base VLA unchanged. Boltz-Flow parameterizes this source with a conditional Boltzmann machine that assigns an energy value to each binary source state. A listwise objective, supervised entirely by offline demonstrations, aligns this energy with the quality of actions produced after frozen flow integration. At inference, the energy defines an Ising instance whose solution is decoded into continuous noise before a single standard integration. We use a physical coherent Ising machine during training. Experiments show that Boltz-Flow improves $π_{0.5}$ across three benchmarks, outperforming the compared strong policy baselines and competing noise optimization methods on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 and ranking second only to LEAP on LIBERO-Plus. Additional experiments show gains under noise-adapted fine-tuning, with action-to-action warm starts, and on the SmolVLA backbone.

AI.tldr: Boltz-Flow 用"观测与指令条件化的玻尔兹曼机"替代 flow-matching VLA 策略中固定的高斯基始分布，通过 listwise 能量目标对齐动作质量，并在推理时把能量极小化解码为连续噪声以驱动冻结的 flow 积分，在 LIBERO 等基准上超过强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 flow-matching 策略的源分布是固定、与观测无关的高斯分布：(1) 单峰且任务间共享，限制了策略随任务多样性扩展的表征能力；(2) 在时间步与控制维度上因子化分解，丢弃了操作任务所需的维度间协调性。
AI.method: 保持基础 VLA 不变，仅替换初始化。用条件玻尔兹曼机为二值源状态赋予能量值，形成观测-指令条件化的玻尔兹曼源；以离线示教为唯一监督，用 listwise 目标使能量与"冻结 flow 积分后所得动作的质量"对齐；推理时能量定义一个 Ising 实例，求解后解码为连续噪声，再执行一次标准积分；训练阶段使用物理相干伊辛机求解。
AI.result: 在三个基准上提升 π0.5：LIBERO 与 RoboTwin 2.0 上优于所比较的强策略基线与噪声优化方法；LIBERO-Plus 上仅次于 LEAP 排名第二。另有噪声自适应微调、动作到动作热启动、以及 SmolVLA 骨干上的增益。
AI.conclusion: 将固定的高斯源替换为学习得到的、条件化的玻尔兹曼源，可在不改动骨干的前提下提升 flow-matching VLA 策略的表征能力与多任务可扩展性，说明源分布设计是策略扩展的关键瓶颈之一。

title: AI-Assisted Auto-formalization for Trustworthy Scientific Computing: Case Studies and Lessons Learned
summary: Agentic AI tools have recently had success in mathematical reasoning. Both general purpose coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex, and specialized mathematics agents such as Aristotle, have been used for formalizing mathematical problems such as Fermat's last theorem, Erdős problems and several IMO level math problems. However, much of these efforts are concentrated in the pure mathematics domain, which benefits from relatively self-contained theorem statements, fixed mathematical representation and extensive support in existing formal libraries. Applied mathematics, on the other hand, presents additional challenges because the source may describe a computational procedure or modeling transformation rather than a declarative theorem. In this work, we present a systematic study of AI-assisted auto-formalization for scientific computing (SC), a domain in applied mathematics central to U.S. Department of Energy applications. Through case studies spanning hierarchical abstraction layers in SC software stack, we evaluate not only whether AI agents can complete numerical proofs, but also where and why they fail across the stack. Our primary contribution is a cross-layer taxonomy of failure modes and an analysis of the form of expert feedback required at each layer to recover mathematical soundness. From these observations, we derive a workflow for recurring proof patterns and practical guidance for using AI agents while preserving mathematical soundness. Our results characterize both the practical value and the current limitations of AI-assisted formalization for trustworthy scientific computing.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了智能体AI在科学计算（SC）这一应用数学领域的自动形式化能力，提出跨层次的失败模式分类学，并分析各层次所需专家反馈形式，进而总结可复用证明模式的工作流与实践指南。
AI.motivation: 现有AI辅助形式化工作集中于纯数学（如费马大定理、Erdős问题、IMO题目），因其定理陈述自包含、表示固定且有成熟形式库支持；而应用数学（尤其科学计算）的源材料常为计算过程或建模变换而非陈述式定理，带来额外挑战，相关研究尚属空白。
AI.method: 以科学计算软件栈的多个层次抽象为案例，对通用编码智能体（Claude Code、Codex）与专用数学智能体（Aristotle）开展系统性案例研究；评估其能否完成数值证明，并定位失败发生的位置与原因，进而归纳跨层失败模式分类学与所需专家反馈形式。
AI.result: 得到跨层次的失败模式分类体系，明确各抽象层恢复数学严谨性所需的专家反馈类型；并据此提炼出针对重复性证明模式的工作流及使用AI智能体的实践指导。
AI.conclusion: 研究既刻画了AI辅助形式化对可信科学计算的实用价值，也揭示了其当前局限，为在保持数学严谨性的前提下应用AI智能体提供了可操作指南。

title: Aggregation Rules Induced by KL-Regularised Preference Dynamics on Networks
summary: We study agents that each align a model to their own preference data while observing one another, and ask which aggregation rule the resulting policies implement. Each round, an agent takes one KL-regularised step. The step involves a reference that the agent is penalised for leaving and a challenger against which its responses are compared, and each of the two may be the agent's own or an average over the agents it observes; attention need not be reciprocal. Aggregating the reference makes the rule collective. Agent $v$ then has the weight $π_v/β_v$, its share of the network's long-run attention divided by its temperature. If, in addition, the challenger is fixed, the agents concentrate on the response maximising $\sum_v(π_v/β_v)r_v(y)$, where $r_v$ is agent $v$'s reward, and the rule is cardinal. If the reference is fixed and the challenger aggregated, the agents' policies at a fixed point generally differ, and any weighted mean of them is an approximate maximal lottery whatever the weights, so the dynamics select no weighting. If both are aggregated, the rule is ordinal: averaged over rounds, the collective policy is a maximal lottery of the influence-weighted preference kernel, up to a slack that we bound. Where a collective rule exists, its weights depend only on the attention weights and the temperatures.

AI.tldr: 研究多个互相观察的智能体各自用自身偏好数据对齐模型时，所实现的聚合规则：参考模型聚合→集体（基数）规则，挑战者聚合→序数（极大彩票）规则，权重仅由注意力权重与温度决定。
AI.motivation: 多智能体场景下，各智能体在观察彼此的同时用各自偏好数据做 KL 正则化对齐，缺乏对"最终集体策略对应哪种社会选择/聚合规则"的刻画与理论保证。
AI.method: 将每轮对齐建模为一次 KL 正则化更新，含被惩罚偏离的参考模型与用于比较的挑战者，两者可各自为本体或所观察智能体的平均；按参考/挑战者是否聚合分四种情形分析不动点与长程注意力分布。
AI.result: 参考聚合时规则为集体性，智能体 v 权重为 π_v/β_v（长程注意力份额除以温度）；挑战者固定时聚焦于最大化 Σ_v(π_v/β_v)r_v(y) 的响应，规则为基数型；参考固定、挑战者聚合时各策略一般不相等，其加权平均在任意权重下均为近似极大彩票，动力学不选出权重；两者均聚合时为序数规则，按轮平均的集体策略是影响力加权偏好核的极大彩票（差一个可界定的松弛量）。
AI.conclusion: 存在集体规则时其权重仅取决于注意力权重与温度；聚合何种组件决定规则是基数还是序数，挑战者聚合情形下不存在唯一的权重选择。

title: Uncovering Hidden Behaviours in Language Models via Limited-Parameter Finetuning
comment: Published at NeurIPS 2026. 53 pages, 19 figures, 6 tables
summary: Large language models can have behaviours which only arise in hard-to-anticipate contexts. These hidden behaviours pose a challenge to alignment audits, which seek to uncover problematic model behaviour but are limited by the scenarios the auditor can anticipate. To address this challenge, we explore limited-parameter finetuning (LPF) on examples of a target behaviour. While training 3-25% of LoRA parameters, LPF reveals whether the model has a hidden behaviour, even when standard behavioural evaluations cannot. LPF succeeds on a suite of model organisms with hidden behaviours (8-14B parameters), and also surfaces naturally occurring hidden behaviours in open-weight models (27-35B parameters). LPF can thus distinguish between models which appear behaviourally identical to an auditor, and does not require the context in which the hidden behaviour surfaces. LPF provides a novel affordance that may be useful for auditing frontier AI models. However, we do not evaluate LPF against baselines in a realistic auditing setting, so further work is needed to determine its practicality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出对目标行为的示例做有限参数微调（LPF，训练3–25%的LoRA参数），可揭示标准行为评估无法发现的隐藏行为，并区分表观行为相同的模型。
AI.motivation: 大模型存在仅在难以预料情境下才显现的隐藏行为，而对齐审计受限于审计者所能预想的场景，因此需要一种不依赖触发情境的隐藏行为探测手段。
AI.method: 在目标行为的示例上做有限参数微调（LPF）：仅训练3–25%的LoRA参数，通过微调过程中的可学习性/适配难易来暴露模型是否已具备该隐藏行为。
AI.result: 在8–14B参数的"模型生物"隐藏行为测试集上成功；在27–35B参数的开源权重模型中还发现了自然出现的隐藏行为；且无需知道隐藏行为显现的上下文，即可区分行为上看似相同的模型。
AI.conclusion: LPF为审计前沿AI模型提供了新的可利用能力，但尚未在真实审计环境中与基线方法对比，其实用性有待进一步验证。

title: Beyond the Black Box: A Diagnosis-Driven Agent for Interpretable MIP Solver Tuning
summary:
Tuning a mixed-integer programming (MIP) solver is an instance-specific problem, where a poor configuration can increase solving time by orders of magnitude.
  Existing Bayesian optimization tuners treat solver tuning as a black-box optimization problem: each evaluation returns a single score, allowing the tuner to learn which configuration is faster, but not why.
  Inspired by the use of profilers in GPU-kernel optimization, we introduce APEC (Agent for Per-instance Explainable Configuration), a log-grounded tuning agent for MIP solvers.
  APEC has three layers: a deterministic layer that profiles each log, an interpretation layer that guides hypothesis-driven diagnosis, and a system layer that controls evaluation, enabling more reliable and interpretable solver tuning.
  On the full MIPLIB 2017 benchmark set, APEC achieves a 1.58X improvement over the default configuration with over 38% fewer parameter changes than the baselines, making the results easier to read.

AI.tldr: APEC 是一个基于日志的可解释 MIP 求解器调参智能体，通过“确定性剖析—解释性诊断—系统控制”三层结构实现实例特异性的求解器配置，在 MIPLIB 2017 全集上较默认配置取得 1.58 倍加速，且参数改动比基线减少 38% 以上。
AI.motivation: MIP 求解器的调参是实例特异性的，糟糕配置可使求解时间增加数个数量级。现有贝叶斯优化调参器将求解器视为黑箱，每次评估只返回单一分数，因此只能学到“哪种配置更快”，却无法解释“为什么更快”，导致调参结果缺乏可解释性、参数改动多且不易阅读。
AI.method: 受 GPU 内核优化中 profiler 的启发，提出 APEC 调参智能体，采用三层架构：(1) 确定性层：对每条求解日志进行剖析（profiling），提取结构化特征；(2) 解释层：引导假设驱动的诊断，形成可解释的因果推断；(3) 系统层：控制评估流程与实验调度。整体将调参从黑箱优化转变为基于日志证据的假设—验证闭环。
AI.result: 在完整的 MIPLIB 2017 基准集上，APEC 相对默认配置实现 1.58 倍加速，同时参数改动数量比基线方法减少超过 38%，使调参结果更易解读。
AI.conclusion: 将日志剖析与假设驱动诊断引入求解器调参，可在提升性能的同时显著降低配置复杂度和提高可解释性，表明“白箱化”的日志依据式调参是黑箱贝叶斯优化之外的有效替代路线。

title: Testing Quantized KV-Cache Maintenance: Encoding Layout and Historical Restoration
summary: Repeating rows then selecting originals retains layout-dependent drift despite equal encoding counts. We measure when existing checks fail to establish preservation contracts in fixed quantized KV-cache implementations. In four-bit HQQ axis zero at sixteen cycles, median paired relative-L2 increases over same-shape re-encoding are 7.22 percentage points for Qwen3-1.7B and 11.59 for SmolLM3-3B. Matched encoded states cover sixteen shared questions per model at one and sixteen cycles. Axis one matches the shape-preserving control; lazy reorders preserve the initial state. On one known input, fixed update counts retain the difference; preserving group members removes it. Our prefix-view extension passes current-prefix checks yet changes history and next logits in six model/codec settings at residual capacities four and 128. Public lookup reaches this boundary, including one of four precommitted project-new GPU inputs; fixed query swaps isolate a conditional old-history effect. Checkpoint/dense rollback is exact. An explicit delayed lookup client admits a supported 129-token path excluded by native AR on one known context. Failed task-harm expansion precludes population failure-rate or general answer-degradation claims. Native MLX-LM fixtures expose stale caller caches; synchronization restores the tested in-place contract with native computations preserved. In rejection tests, stale callers change logits but not greedy tokens.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究固定量化KV-cache实现中“编码计数相同却仍存在布局相关漂移”的问题：重复行后取原始行，即便编码次数相等，也无法保持状态不变，现有检查无法建立保留契约。
AI.motivation: 在固定量化KV-cache中，通常以“编码次数相等”或当前前缀校验作为状态保持的判据；作者指出这些检查不足以建立 preservation contract，需要实证测量其失效边界。
AI.method: 构造配对实验（重复行再取原始行 vs. 同形状重编码），在4-bit HQQ的axis 0/axis 1、1与16周期、两模型多名共享问题上比较相对L2；并设计prefix-view扩展、固定query交换、延迟lookup客户端、MLX-LM原生fixture与拒绝测试等消融与边界探测。
AI.result: 4-bit HQQ axis 0、16周期下，配对相对L2中位数较同形状重编码分别升高7.22个百分点（Qwen3-1.7B）与11.59（SmolLM3-3B）；axis 1与保形对照一致，惰性重排保持初始状态。单已知输入上固定更新次数保留差异，移除组成员后差异消失。prefix-view在6个模型/编解码设置、残差容量4与128下通过当前前缀检查却改变历史与下一token logits；公开lookup可触及该边界（含4个预注册新GPU输入中的1个）。checkpoint/dense回滚精确；显式延迟lookup客户端在单已知上下文上支持129-token路径（原生AR排除）；任务危害扩展失败，故不作总体失败率或普遍退化结论；MLX-LM fixture暴露陈旧caller缓存，同步后恢复in-place契约且保持原生计算；拒绝测试中陈旧caller改变logits但未改变贪心token。
AI.conclusion: 相等编码计数不构成KV-cache状态保持的充分契约，现有前缀检查存在可触达盲区；需以组保持、精确回滚与显式同步的契约来界定可验证范围，且结论限于已知输入与设定，不宜外推到总体退化率。

title: How Many Parameters Does Forecasting Need? A Survey and Code-Level Audit of Lightweight Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
summary: Long-term time series forecasting supports decisions in energy, transportation, weather and finance, where forecasts are produced continuously and often on constrained hardware. Recent work has moved in two directions. One scales Transformers and pre-trained foundation models to millions or hundreds of millions of parameters. The other shows that models with only hundreds to tens of thousands of parameters remain competitive on the standard benchmarks. Existing surveys organize forecasting models by backbone and treat efficiency as a side topic, so the reasons these small models work, and the way their sizes are reported, remain unexamined. This survey focuses on lightweight long-term forecasting. It provides a taxonomy of about thirty-five models in six families, with a common notation and an architecture diagram for each core model. It offers a structured-linear view in which the smallest models are linear maps restricted by frequency truncation or period folding, and it tests each restriction in closed form on eight benchmarks. It complements the literature review with an audit of sixteen official code repositories, which reproduces published parameter counts and reveals reporting gaps of up to 289 times. Finally, it gives practical guidance on model selection and reporting, and summarizes open problems.

AI.tldr: 综述聚焦轻量级长期时间序列预测，将约35个模型归为六大家族，提出"结构化线性"视角，并在八个基准上以闭式方法检验各约束，同时审计16个官方代码库，发现参数报告存在最高289倍的偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有综述按骨干网络组织模型、将效率视为次要话题，未考察小模型为何有效，也未审视其规模报告方式；而当前研究同时向超大模型（百万至数亿参数）与极小模型（数百至数万参数）两端发展，亟需对轻量长期预测进行系统梳理。
AI.method: 对约35个模型构建六大家族分类体系，统一符号并为每个核心模型给出架构图；提出结构化线性视角——将最小模型视为受频率截断或周期折叠约束的线性映射，并在八个基准上以闭式形式逐一检验这些约束；对16个官方代码库进行参数复现审计。
AI.result: 复现了已发表的参数计数，并揭示最高达289倍的报告差距；在八个基准上以闭式形式验证了频率截断与周期折叠等线性约束的作用。
AI.conclusion: 小参数模型在标准基准上仍具竞争力且其有效性可由线性映射加结构性约束解释；参数报告的显著不一致问题需规范；综述给出模型选择与报告的实践指南，并总结开放问题。

title: Seeking in Space: Benchmarking Purposeful Active Exploration of Vision-Language Models for Spatial Reasoning
summary: Humans explore unfamiliar spaces with purpose, deciding where to look until they have gathered the evidence a spatial question requires. However, can vision-language models (VLMs), which reason increasingly well over curated images and videos, also seek in space when the evidence is not handed to them? We present ActSpace-Bench, a benchmark of 994 questions across 234 exploration episodes in 72 real-scanned indoor scenes, where a model starts from a single view, navigates real captured frames, and must gather evidence before answering. To assess whether such exploration is purposeful, we introduce a controlled evaluation protocol that fixes each model as the reasoner and compares its own exploration against a same-budget random walk and an oracle route, separating evidence seeking from spatial reasoning. Every question is verified to require exploration and answered from 3D annotations, masked-evidence questions test whether models know when to abstain, and over 95% of sampled questions are confirmed correct by human verification. Evaluations of 23 proprietary, open-weight, and spatially specialized VLMs reveal that the strongest models do seek evidence with purpose but lose much of it to limited memory, whereas weaker and specialized models explore no better than a random walk or fail to reason over the evidence they are given, pointing to memory and evidence-grounded reasoning as the next targets for active spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出ActSpace-Bench：994题/234探索回合/72个真实室内场景，模型从单视角出发主动导航采集证据后回答；用同预算随机游走与oracle路线作为对照，分离"证据搜寻"与"空间推理"。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在精心整理的图像/视频上推理能力增强，但尚不清楚其在证据未被直接给出时能否主动在空间中搜寻证据；需一个能区分"主动探索"与"空间推理"能力的评测。
AI.method: 构建包含994个问题、234个探索回合、72个真实扫描室内场景的基准，模型从单视图起始、跟随真实采集帧导航并收集证据后作答。设计受控评测协议：将模型固定为推理器，将其自身探索与同等预算的随机游走及oracle路线对比。每道题经验证必须依赖探索，答案来自3D标注；设置掩蔽证据题检验弃答能力；95%以上抽样题经人工确认正确。
AI.result: 评测23个闭源、开源及空间专用VLM：最强模型确实有目的地寻找证据，但因记忆受限而大量丢失已获取信息；较弱及专用模型探索效果不优于随机游走，或无法对已给证据进行推理。
AI.conclusion: 记忆与证据 grounded 推理是主动空间智能的关键瓶颈与下一步攻关方向。

title: Know When to Abstain: Conformal Confidence Estimation for Text-to-SQL
summary: Text-to-SQL systems often return queries that execute successfully but answer the wrong question. Detecting these errors at deployment is hard because execution correctness is defined against a gold query, which exists only in labeled data. We formulate confidence estimation for Text-to-SQL as probabilistic query validation under a latent correctness variable that is observable at calibration time through gold-SQL execution and latent at deployment. Our estimator separates generation from validation. A generator LLM writes and executes the query, and a different critic LLM judges the query and its execution result. The critic's validation and execution-grounded alignment scores are fused with the generator's verbalized confidence, token-level uncertainty, and SQL-structural features in a Random Forest, using two sequential LLM calls. Two calibration steps give finite-sample guarantees. A Learn-then-Test threshold ensures, with probability $1-δ$, that the error rate among accepted queries stays below a user-chosen budget. A conformal p-value bounds the false abstention rate. On Spider we use GPT-OSS-120B as generator and Gemma-4-31B as critic. The estimator obtains an AUARC of 0.899. Without abstention, 22.6% of queries are wrong. With a 15% risk budget ($δ=0.1$), a threshold is certified on all 10 resampled splits, and the system accepts 52.4% of queries on average with 9.1% observed error. Five different critic models give similar results. In a controlled comparison on Spider with Olmo-3-32B as generator, the estimator obtains an AUARC of 89.5, compared with 81.2 for the strongest logit-based baseline. Applied to BIRD without retraining, the confidence scores remain informative (AUROC 0.72, against 0.79 on Spider), but the risk guarantee does not transfer, as expected without exchangeability.

AI.tldr: 该论文将Text-to-SQL的置信度估计建模为隐变量正确性下的概率查询验证问题，通过生成器-批评器分离架构与两阶段校准，实现对部署期查询错误的检测并给出有限样本风险保证。
AI.motivation: Text-to-SQL系统常返回"能执行但答非所问"的查询，而执行正确性只能依赖标注数据中的gold query来定义，部署时不可观测，导致错误难以检测。
AI.method: 将置信度估计形式化为潜正确性变量下的概率验证：正确性在校准时可通过gold-SQL执行观测、部署时潜隐。估计器分离生成与验证：生成器LLM写出并执行SQL，另一批评器LLM评判查询及其执行结果；将批评器的验证分与执行对齐分，与生成器的言语化置信度、token级不确定性、SQL结构特征融合入随机森林（两次顺序LLM调用）。随后两步校准：Learn-then-Test阈值以1−δ概率保证被接受查询的错误率低于用户预算；共形p值约束误弃权率。
AI.result: Spider上以GPT-OSS-120B为生成器、Gemma-4-31B为批评器，AUARC达0.899；不弃权时22.6%查询错误；15%风险预算（δ=0.1）下10个重采样划分均认证出阈值，平均接受52.4%查询、观测错误率9.1%；5种批评器结果相近。以Olmo-3-32B为生成器的受控比较中AUARC为89.5，强于最强logit基线81.2。迁移至BIRD（不重训练）置信度仍有信息量（AUROC 0.72，Spider为0.79），但因缺乏可交换性风险保证不迁移。
AI.conclusion: 生成-验证分离结合统计校准可在有限样本下提供可控的弃权风险保证，优于logit基线；但该保证依赖可交换性假设，跨数据集迁移时仅置信度排序信息可保留。

title: Needwise: Generation-Free Conversational Recommendation from Need-Level Typed Decisions
summary: Conversational recommenders must rank items against needs that catalogs record only in part, while users add, withdraw and reverse needs and switch between requests. LLM rankers re-read the dialogue at every turn: they are slow, and their ordering does not show which needs an item meets. We show that a conversational recommender can be built from typed decisions instead: named questions over fixed options, answered with option probabilities rather than generated text. On each turn, one typed request maps the message onto the catalog's fields, keeps what no field expresses in the user's words, and decides how the turn changes each earlier need. Needwise then ranks candidates must-first: the needs on the kind of item, its place and its price form a tier, and within it one holistic decision and need-level verdicts (supported, contradicted or unknown) are combined with equal weight (Needwise-HF). With the graded attributes withheld from the records, so that needs must be inferred from names, descriptions and reviews, Needwise-HF ranks Google Local requests significantly better than GPT-6 Sol (0.383 against 0.343 nDCG@10) and is not significantly different from the strongest LLM ranker on Google Local and Yelp; these comparisons keep their sign under every treatment of unrecorded attributes we test. It costs a fraction of GPT-6 Sol's API price and answers in 2.5 s at the median on Google Local, against 5.6 s for GPT-6 Sol. In conversations, the typed state keeps the ranking across switches and returns, but it recognizes only 19-27% of withdrawn needs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用"类型化决策"（typed decisions）替代生成式文本重读来构建对话式推荐器：每轮用一个类型化请求把用户消息映射到商品目录字段，并判断该轮如何改变既有需求；排序采用"must-first"分层策略（Needwise-HF），在Google Local上显著优于GPT-6 Sol（nDCG@10 0.383 vs 0.343），成本与延迟远低，但撤回需求识别率仅19–27%。
AI.motivation: LLM排序器每轮都要重读整段对话，速度慢、API成本高，且其排序结果不揭示商品满足了哪些需求。而对话推荐中用户会新增、撤回、反转需求并频繁切换请求，目录又只记录了部分需求，因此需要一种更高效、可解释的状态表示方式。
AI.method: 用命名问题+固定选项的类型化决策代替文本生成，以选项概率作答。每轮：一个类型化请求把消息映射到目录字段，将无法用字段表达的内容保留为用户原话，并判定该轮对每个既有需求的变更。排序为must-first：先按商品类别、地点、价格形成需求层级，层内将整体性判断与需求级判定（支持/矛盾/未知）等权融合（Needwise-HF）。实验中还将梯度属性从记录中剔除，迫使模型从名称、描述、评论推断需求。
AI.result: Google Local上Needwise-HF的nDCG@10为0.383，显著超过GPT-6 Sol的0.343；在Google Local与Yelp上与最强LLM排序器无显著差异，且该结论在对未记录属性的各种处理方式下符号保持一致。成本仅为GPT-6 Sol API价格的一小部分，Google Local中位响应时间2.5 s（GPT-6 Sol为5.6 s）。多轮对话中类型化状态可在切换与返回时保持排序，但仅能识别19–27%的已撤回需求。
AI.conclusion: 类型化决策是一种可行且高效的对话推荐范式，在准确性、成本、延迟上具备竞争力，并提供了需求级可解释性；主要短板是对需求撤回的检测能力不足，是后续改进方向。

title: Self-Upgrading Embodied Agents
summary: An embodied agent built on a language model goes to work with the weights it was given and keeps them for life. To get better, it needs more training, or reflection, memory, search or prompts that cost every step and are lost when the task changes. Editing weights by reasoning, weight-space programming, could end this, but has stayed with models that only reason or relied on a far larger commercial model. We introduce the self-upgrading embodied agent, to our knowledge the first that learns from its own experience by upgrading its own weights on the job, between its tasks, with no training, no gradient, no reward model, no second model, no test-time scaling and no harness or prompt engineering. By day a 27B agent works in a household environment. At night it reads its record, finds many of its steps wasted on replies that reach the token limit before any action, traces the habit to one direction in its hidden states, and rewrites one tensor of its weights. An agent that rewrites itself must first never break itself, so it is its own examiner: it tests every change against its unchanged self on practice tasks and keeps only what holds. When an edit holds, the next day it is a better agent, at the same cost per step: over thousands of held-out episodes, 48 fresh seeds a task, its one kept edit makes it complete significantly more tasks, in fewer steps, with fewer wasted and fewer tokens. This self-improvement is multi-round, stable and continual: through the nights that follow, the upgrade holds, without collapse. Of four sizes of its family, only the 27B agent does this. From here on, an embodied agent need not keep training and inference apart: as it works, it gathers its own experience and upgrades itself, with no separate pre-training or post-training and no human intervention. We believe this opens lifelong continual learning for robots: stable, continual, recursive self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“自我升级具身智能体”，让27B模型在任务间隙通过推理直接改写自身权重（无需训练、梯度、奖励模型、第二模型或测试时扩展），并以自任考官的方式验证每次编辑，实现稳定、持续、多轮的递归自我改进。
AI.motivation: 基于语言模型的具身智能体权重终身固定，提升表现需额外训练、反思、记忆、搜索或提示工程，这些手段每步都有成本且任务切换后失效。已有的权重编辑（weight-space programming）方法局限于只会推理的模型，或依赖更大的商业模型。
AI.method: 让智能体白天在家庭环境中工作，夜间读取自身记录，发现许多步骤因回复触达token上限而未产生动作；将这一习惯追溯到隐状态中的某一方向，并改写某个权重张量。为保证不自毁，智能体充当自身考官：在练习题上把每次改动与未改动的自身对比测试，仅保留经得起检验的编辑。
AI.result: 在数千个留出回合（每任务48个新种子）上，一次保留的编辑使其显著完成更多任务、步数更少、浪费步骤与token更少；自我改进具多轮、稳定、持续特性，后续夜晚升级保持而不崩溃；其家族四个规模中仅27B模型具备此能力。
AI.conclusion: 具身智能体无需再区分训练与推理：在工作过程中收集自身经验并自我升级，无需独立预训练/后训练与人工干预，为机器人终身持续学习（稳定、持续、递归的自我改进）开辟了路径。

title: Preflight: Agentic Last-Mile Verification for AI Software Supply Chains
summary: Software dependencies execute within the trust boundary of downstream applications, yet provenance, static analysis, and package-level behavioral approaches do not directly determine how a released artifact behaves for a specific program. We present Preflight, a program-scoped pre-execution verifier for Python dependencies that extracts application-referenced symbols, iteratively synthesizes and validates function-level harnesses, executes resolved artifacts in a restricted environment, records behavioral fingerprints, and compares target behavior against prior versions when suitable baselines exist. We evaluate Preflight on four real software-supply-chain incidents under five application contexts, a 100-package benign corpus, and a controlled function-level versus import-only ablation. Preflight returns malicious verdicts in four incident contexts and a clean verdict in the LiteLLM client context, where the affected proxy-server path is not exercised. All 100 evaluated benign packages receive clean verdicts, with zero observed false positives. In a controlled ablation on Ultralytics and ctx, function-level harnesses expose malicious behavior in both incidents, whereas import-only probing exposes neither. Together, these results show that conditioning behavioral verification on the downstream program can expose security-relevant dependency behavior while remaining selective on benign workloads.

AI.tldr: 提出 Preflight——面向 Python 依赖的"程序作用域"预执行验证器：提取应用实际引用的符号，迭代合成并校验函数级 harness，在受限环境中执行解析后的构件、记录行为指纹并与历史版本基线比对。在 4 起真实供应链事件、5 种应用上下文、100 个良性包及函数级 vs 仅导入消融实验中，4 个事件上下文判恶意、LiteLLM 客户端上下文判清白（未触达受影响路径），100 个良性包全部判清白（零误报）；消融显示函数级 harness 能暴露仅导入探测发现不了的恶意行为。
AI.motivation: 软件依赖在下游应用的信任边界内执行，但 provenance（来源溯源）、静态分析和包级行为分析都无法直接判定"某已发布构件在特定程序中会如何表现"。行为是否被触发高度依赖下游程序如何调用依赖，因此需要以程序为作用域来条件化地验证依赖行为，同时避免对良性负载产生过多干扰。
AI.method: 1) 提取应用引用的依赖符号；2) 迭代合成函数级 harness 并验证其有效性；3) 在受限（沙箱）环境中执行解析后的构件；4) 记录行为指纹（behavioral fingerprints）；5) 存在合适基线时，将目标行为与先前版本比对。另设受控消融：函数级 harness 对比 import-only 探测。
AI.result: 在 4 起真实软件供应链事件 × 5 个应用上下文上：4 个事件上下文返回恶意判定，LiteLLM 客户端上下文返回清白判定（受影响的 proxy-server 路径未被触发）。100 个良性包全部判清白，零观察到误报。在 Ultralytics 与 ctx 的受控消融中，函数级 harness 均暴露恶意行为，而 import-only 探测两者均未暴露。
AI.conclusion: 将行为验证条件化于下游程序，可以在保持对良性负载有选择性的同时，暴露具有安全相关性的依赖行为；程序作用域的执行验证可作为对 provenance、静态分析与包级行为方法的有力补充。

title: Orthogonally Mixed Sign Coding with Progressive Residual Refinement for Transformer Weight Compression
summary: LLM quantization reduces storage but often degrades predictive fidelity at low bit rates. We propose a training-free, CDF-free, Gaussian-CLT-motivated progressive residual-sign quantization framework that uses randomized orthogonal mixing to promote Gaussian-like residual distributions and improve sign based reconstruction of Transformer weights. Each stage independently normalizes residuals and analytically calibrates reconstruction, progressively recovering quantization errors. The framework enables flexible storage-fidelity trade-offs without learned codebooks, empirical CDFs, or trellis optimization. We evaluate GPT-2 Large and Llama-3-8B across attention and MLP projections. At five residual stages, joint quantization preserves near-baseline predictive fidelity, achieving perplexities of 32.16 and 12.73, compared with full-precision values of 29.89 and 11.07, respectively. Ablations further demonstrate that orthogonal mixing substantially improves reconstruction over identity-based sign coding, while activation-aware scaling improves output fidelity and reduced-precision statistics lower storage overhead with negligible perplexity degradation. Comparisons with conventional quantizers establish the method's progressive fidelity recovery and characterize its storage-quality and runtime trade-offs. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of orthogonally mixed residual-sign coding for flexible, training-free Transformer weight compression.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练、免CDF、受高斯中心极限定理启发的渐进式残差符号量化框架，用随机正交混合使残差分布趋于高斯，从而以符号编码重建Transformer权重，在GPT-2 Large与Llama-3-8B上实现近基线保真度。
AI.motivation: LLM量化可降低存储，但低比特率下常损害预测保真度；现有方法依赖学习码本、经验CDF或网格优化，复杂度高且不够灵活。
AI.method: 免训练、免CDF的渐进式残差符号量化：采用随机正交混合促使残差分布近似高斯，提升基于符号的重建质量；每一阶段独立归一化残差并解析地校准重建，逐级恢复量化误差；无需学习码本与经验CDF，可实现灵活的存储-保真度权衡。
AI.result: 在GPT-2 Large与Llama-3-8B的注意力与MLP投影上评估，五个残差阶段下联合量化困惑度为32.16与12.73（全精度为29.89与11.07），接近基线。消融表明正交混合显著优于恒等式符号编码，激活感知缩放提升输出保真度，降精度统计降低存储开销且困惑度退化可忽略；与传统量化器比较验证了渐进式保真度恢复及存储-质量-运行时权衡。
AI.conclusion: 正交混合残差符号编码对灵活、免训练的Transformer权重压缩有效。

title: AlphaDefect: Expert-Level AI for Slay the Spire 2
summary: Slay the Spire 2 (STS2) is a single-player deck-building game that requires long-term planning under heavy randomness. We present AlphaDefect, an expert-level AI system for STS2: for each character, one network trained with proximal policy optimization (PPO) makes every decision of a run, in combat and outside it. At the highest difficulty, Ascension 10, on two versions of the game current in November 2026 and on test seeds not played in training, AlphaDefect wins 62-77% of runs across six characters with greedy play and 68-80% with test-time search, after 1.3 to 6.7 billion decisions of training per character; runs uploaded by human players of all levels are won 11-20% of the time at the same difficulty. The networks read the game as entity records that identify each card, relic and enemy through a learned embedding and attributes from the game data, together with consequences of public information computed by the engine. Ablations show how much the agent depends on this encoding: without these identities, the network did not win a single run, and without the computed consequences it won 8.3 points fewer. To our knowledge, AlphaDefect is the strongest publicly reported STS2 agent as of November 2026.

AI.tldr: AlphaDefect——面向《Slay the Spire 2》每个角色训练一个 PPO 网络统一完成战斗内外全部决策的专家级智能体，在最高难度 Ascension 10 的未见测试种子上通关率达 62–77%（贪心）与 68–80%（测试时搜索），远超人类玩家上传对局的 11–20%。
AI.motivation: STS2 是强随机性下的单人卡组构筑游戏，要求跨回合、跨战斗的长期规划，现有方法难以在高难度下稳定通关；作者希望构建一个能覆盖全部决策（战斗内与战斗外）的专家级 AI，并验证表征设计对性能的关键作用。
AI.method: 每个角色使用单个 PPO 训练的网络，统一决策整局所有动作；输入为实体记录（卡牌、遗物、敌人经学习嵌入标识，附游戏数据属性）与引擎计算的公开信息后果；辅以测试时搜索；通过消融实验考察身份嵌入与后果计算的贡献；训练量 13–67 亿决策/角色。
AI.result: 在 2026 年 11 月的两个游戏版本、训练未见的测试种子上，Ascension 10 难度六角色贪心通关率 62–77%、测试时搜索 68–80%；同难度下人类各级玩家上传对局通关率仅 11–20%。消融：去掉实体身份嵌入后一局未胜；去掉引擎计算的公开信息后果后通关率下降 8.3 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: AlphaDefect 据称是截至 2026 年 11 月公开报道中最强的 STS2 智能体，且表明结构化实体嵌入与引擎计算的公开信息后果是强随机性卡牌游戏中不可或缺的表征要素。

title: AeroJEPA: A Two-Stage Framework for Aerosol Forecasting with Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning
summary: Aerosol forecasting requires integrating sparse ground observations and modeling meteorologically driven concentration evolution and spatial structure. However, analysis-initialized forecasts make limited explicit use of historical observations, while pointwise regression tends to smooth local variations and provides limited constraints on fine spatial structures. In this work, we propose AeroJEPA, a two-stage joint-embedding predictive framework for regional surface PM$_{2.5}$ forecasting. Specifically, Stage I fuses historical observations, model backgrounds, and meteorological information to predict an initial future state, meteorological conditions, and multi-scale structures. Morphology-guided encoding and joint-embedding predictive supervision support learning future spatial representations, supplementing concentration regression with structural constraints. Stage II uses predicted meteorology to guide state refinement and incorporates coarse- and fine-scale structures into state updates and decoding to generate the concentration field at a single future time step. Experiments show that AeroJEPA reduces gridded and independent-station RMSE by 17.23\% and 7.90\%, respectively, relative to PFGNet, while improving spatial consistency with analysis fields. In a 48 h recursive forecasting case study, AeroJEPA generally achieves lower RMSE and MAE than the numerical forecasts across the forecast period, indicating promising short- to medium-range forecasting performance.

AI.tldr: AeroJEPA：两阶段联合嵌入预测框架用于区域地面PM2.5预报，融合历史观测、模式背景与气象信息，并通过形态引导编码与多尺度结构监督提升空间一致性与精度。
AI.motivation: 气溶胶预报需整合稀疏地面观测与气象驱动的浓度演变及空间结构；但分析场初始化预报对历史观测利用不足，逐点回归易平滑局地变化、对精细空间结构约束有限。
AI.method: 两阶段联合嵌入预测框架。第一阶段融合历史观测、模式背景与气象信息，预测初始未来状态、气象条件及多尺度结构，采用形态引导编码与联合嵌入预测监督学习未来空间表征，以结构约束补充浓度回归；第二阶段以预测气象引导状态细化，将粗、细尺度结构引入状态更新与解码，输出单步未来时刻浓度场。
AI.result: 相对PFGNet，网格RMSE降低17.23%、独立站点RMSE降低7.90%，与分析场的空间一致性提升；48小时递归预报案例中，多数时段RMSE与MAE低于数值预报。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入结构监督与气象引导的两阶段联合嵌入预测可有效改善PM2.5短中期预报的精度与空间结构真实性。

title: Transport-Safe Evaluation of LLM Agents: Trajectory-Dependent Judge Error and Anytime-Valid Auditing
comment: Author's accepted version (without the publisher's template) of a paper accepted at ICAART 2027 (paper \#38). The final version will be published by SCITEPRESS; DOI to be added upon publication
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are often ranked by an LLM judge whose error rates are measured once and reused for every agent. The corrected success rates can then be biased when the judge's errors depend on the trajectory and agents differ in the trajectories they produce for successes or failures. We derive the exact asymptotic bias and give a chain of checks from identification to simultaneous ranks. On a four-agent semi-synthetic benchmark, a scalar correction with oracle calibration has maximum bias 0.245 and mean pointwise coverage 0.016, and never recovers the full ranking (0/250 replications). Augmented inverse-probability weighting (AIPW) with a uniform or a design-aware random audit keeps the maximum bias below 0.003, with mean pointwise coverage of 0.939 and 0.950. In a 48-cell stress test, effective target support rises only from 0.209 to 0.805 as calibration grows from 600 to 4,800 labels, while audited AIPW keeps a mean absolute error of 0.018-0.020. Without calibration support, or with judge dependence within an externally justified bound, we report valid bounds or sensitivity sets and carry them into rank sets. An e-process confidence sequence stays valid, for a stable target, under predictable adaptive auditing and arbitrary stopping.

AI.tldr: 论文指出，用一次测量得到的LLM评审误差率去校正所有agent的成功率会因轨迹相关的评审误差产生偏倚；作者推导了精确的渐近偏倚，并提出从可识别性到同时排序的检验链，使用AIPW结合随机审计获得低偏倚、覆盖良好的排序，并在无标定支撑或依赖有界时给出有效界与敏感性集合。
AI.motivation: 现有做法将LLM评审的错误率一次性测量后复用于所有agent，但当评审误差依赖轨迹、且不同agent在成功/失败时产生的轨迹分布不同，校正后的成功率会产生偏倚，且可能无法恢复真实排序。
AI.method: 推导校正成功率的精确渐近偏倚；构造从可识别性到同时排序的一系列检验；在半合成基准上比较标量校正与增广逆概率加权（AIPW，配合统一或设计感知的随机审计）；进行48单元压力测试考察标定支撑与标签量的影响；在缺乏标定支撑或评审依赖有外部合理界时，报告有效界或敏感性集合并传递到秩集合；使用e-process置信序列保证在可预测自适应审计与任意停止下的有效性。
AI.result: 四agent基准上，带oracle标定的标量校正最大偏倚0.245、平均逐点覆盖0.016，250次重复中0次恢复完整排序；AIPW最大偏倚低于0.003，平均逐点覆盖分别为0.939和0.950。48单元压力测试中，标定标签从600增至4800时有效目标支撑仅从0.209升至0.805，而审计AIPW的平均绝对误差保持在0.018–0.020。
AI.conclusion: 标量式一次性误差校正不可靠；基于审计的AIPW在偏倚与覆盖上显著更优，且在标定支撑不足时可通过有效界、敏感性集合与秩集合给出稳健推断，e-process置信序列支持自适应审计与任意停止下的有效性。

title: ActField: Learning Action Effects as Continuous-Time Latent Dynamics
summary: Learning how actions change visual states is essential for prediction and decision-making in embodied tasks. Existing action-conditioned JEPA world models typically predict future representations at discrete observation intervals, leaving the temporal evolution of action effects implicit. We introduce ActField, a continuous-time JEPA world model that explicitly models latent state evolution through an action-conditioned vector field integrated over physical time. ActField separates action-independent evolution from action-induced changes, with the latter modulated by the latent context. A reference-conditioned representation and multi-step dynamics loss further support accurate long-horizon prediction. Together, these components provide a structured and temporally continuous formulation for predicting action-conditioned visual dynamics. Experiments across LIBERO, DROID, and BEHAVIOR demonstrate improved visual prediction fidelity and more accurate action-induced motion prediction over existing world models. Further evaluations on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate the utility of ActField in improving downstream policy planning through VLM-guided action selection.

AI.tldr: 提出ActField——一种连续时间的JEPA世界模型，用动作条件向量场在物理时间上积分来显式建模潜状态演化，在LIBERO、DROID、BEHAVIOR上提升视觉预测与动作诱导运动预测精度，并改善下游策略规划。
AI.motivation: 具身任务中预测与决策需要对"动作如何改变视觉状态"有准确建模。现有动作条件JEPA世界模型仅在离散观测间隔上预测未来表征，使动作效应的时序演化隐含不可见，难以刻画动作作用在时间上的连续展开，也影响长时程预测与下游规划。
AI.method: 将潜状态演化建模为动作条件向量场，并在物理时间上积分以实现连续时间推演；把与动作无关的演化与动作诱导变化解耦，后者由潜上下文调制；引入参考条件表征（reference-conditioned representation）与多步动力学损失以支持长时程预测。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、DROID、BEHAVIOR上，相比现有世界模型取得更高的视觉预测保真度与更准确的动作诱导运动预测；在仿真与真实机器人操作任务中，经VLM引导的动作选择验证了其对下游策略规划的增益。
AI.conclusion: 显式连续时间、解耦式动作条件动力学为动作条件的视觉动力学预测提供了结构化且时间连续的建模范式，既能提升表征预测质量，也能实际改善具身策略规划。

title: LiveLoRA: Exact KV Cache Migration Across LoRA Updates for LLM Agents
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop AgenticOS: Co-designing Systems and ML Foundations of an OS Layer for Agentic AI
summary: Updating an LLM adapter should not require replaying the full interaction history of every active session. Yet reusing key-value (KV) cache entries computed under an earlier version mixes model versions, while full-history re-prefill becomes increasingly costly as histories and session fleets grow. We introduce LiveLora, a model-runtime co-design for exact final-block KV cache migration. Frozen lower decoder blocks and fixed K/V adapter down-projections preserve each token's base projections and low-rank coordinates across adapter versions. The runtime reconstructs candidate K/V, reevaluates the latest token through the final block, and commits the adapter, cache, and next-token logits together. We prove continuation equivalence to full-history re-prefill in exact arithmetic under the stated model assumptions. On Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, median paired publication speedups over full-history re-prefill average $68.98\times$ across five runs for 32 active sessions with 8K tokens each. Serving benchmarks show approximately 4.8% decoding overhead relative to native cached decoding. Compared with retained-boundary replay, compact retention gives a $3.42\times$ reduction in additional session storage at 8K, with similar measured publication-plus-decoding cost. LiveLora allows persistent LLM agents to adopt new adapter versions without replaying their full interaction histories.

AI.tldr: LiveLora 提出一种模型-运行时协同设计，通过冻结下层解码块与固定 K/V adapter 下投影，实现仅对最后一个 block 的 KV 缓存迁移，从而在更新 LLM adapter 时避免重放全部交互历史，并证明其与原全历史重预填充等价。
AI.motivation: 持续运行的 LLM agent 在更换 adapter 版本时面临两难：复用旧版本计算出的 KV 缓存会混用模型版本，破坏一致性；而全历史 re-prefill 随历史长度与并发会话数增长成本急剧上升。
AI.method: 采用模型-运行时协同设计：冻结下层解码块，并固定 K/V adapter 的下投影，使每个 token 的 base 投影与低秩坐标在各 adapter 版本间保持不变；运行时重建候选 K/V，仅通过最后一个 block 重新评估最新 token，并将 adapter、缓存与下一 token logits 原子性一并提交。
AI.result: 理论证明在给定模型假设与精确算术下，结果与全历史 re-prefill 等价。在 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 上，32 个各含 8K token 的活跃会话，五次运行中位数配对发布加速平均达 68.98×；解码开销约为原生缓存解码的 4.8%；相比 retained-boundary replay，compact retention 在 8K 时额外会话存储减少 3.42×，发布+解码成本相近。
AI.conclusion: LiveLora 使持久化 LLM agent 无需重放完整交互历史即可采纳新 adapter 版本，实现高加速、低开销且存储友好的精确 KV 缓存迁移。

title: Tradeoffs between objective outcomes and human enjoyment of work in human-AI task allocation
summary: For people, tasks at work are defined by more than their outcome: they are colored by the experience of engaging in that task. As AI systems become increasingly capable of performing human-level work they may be deployed to tasks that people find enjoyable while simultaneously creating comparatively more aversive tasks such as monitoring AI outputs. This creates a thorny tradeoff for managers: whether work should be assigned purely based on the expected performance of the workers in question, or also account for the subjective experience of the person potentially doing the task. Most economic accounts focus on expected utility calculations based on the former. Here, we assess how people balance objective outcomes and more subjective qualities like enjoyment. In a series of large-scale (N=800) behavioral studies in which people allocate tasks to either an AI or human worker we find that people's allocation decisions are best captured by a model that systematically balances relative objective performance with the human worker's expected enjoyment, weighting human experience higher when a task is framed as inducing less enjoyment and adjusting based on the stakes of the task. As AI also makes decisions about work allocation, we compare a set of LLMs. We find many models also deviate from purely objective decisions, particularly when the project stakes are low, but there is wide heterogeneity as to how much and in what manner they weigh enjoyment. These results raise questions about what role human experience may play in decisions around where and how to integrate AI into workplaces. Integration may be jagged across settings due to consideration not only of the relative capabilities of workers, but also the human experience of work, the valence of that experience (e.g., more strongly weighing aversion), the context (e.g., stakes), and who is making or guiding such choices (human or LLM).

AI.tldr: 人类在AI/人类任务分配中并非纯按客观绩效决策，而是系统性地权衡相对绩效与人类员工的任务体验（享受度），对"低享受度"任务给予更高权重，并随任务利害调整；LLM也部分偏离纯客观决策，但异质性大。
AI.motivation: AI能力提升使其可承担人类觉得愉快的任务，同时产生监控AI输出等更令人厌恶的任务，管理者面临"按预期绩效分配"还是"兼顾主观体验"的两难；既有经济学解释多聚焦期望效用，缺乏对人类如何在客观结果与主观享受之间权衡的实证刻画，也缺乏对AI替代人类做此类分配决策时的行为考察。
AI.method: 大规模行为实验（N=800），被试需将任务分配给AI或人类工作者；用计算建模比较不同分配模型的拟合优度，检验"相对客观绩效 + 人类预期享受度"的加权模型；同时向多个LLM呈现同类分配情境进行比较。
AI.result: 人类分配决策最佳由系统权衡相对客观绩效与人类享受度的模型解释：任务被框定为更不愉快时，对人类体验的权重更高；权重还随任务利害（stakes）调整。LLM中多数模型也偏离纯客观决策，尤其在低利害项目中，但各模型在"权衡多少、如何权衡"上差异显著。
AI.conclusion: AI融入职场的路径可能呈"锯齿状"不均衡：分配结果不仅取决于人机相对能力，还取决于工作体验、体验效价（更重视厌恶感）、情境（利害）以及决策主体（人类或LLM）；这为AI在工作场所的部署与治理提出了关于人类体验应扮演何种角色的问题。

title: ChiProgramBench: Can LLM Agents Rebuild Efficient Circuits from Pin-Level Experiments?
summary: Understanding a system that can be run but not inspected is a core engineering skill: one designs experiments, forms hypotheses about hidden state and timing, discards those that observations refute, and finally builds a replacement that works and is efficient. To evaluate this capability of LLM agents in the hardware domain, we present ChiProgramBench, 18 tasks derived from open-source processors, accelerators, codecs, transforms, interconnects, and control circuits. Agents can only drive and read the pins of a hidden, stateful simulated reference, then submit a gate-level netlist made of public library cells. Agents work in two settings: black-box discovery gives only anonymized functional pins and the interfaces of fixed memories, while function-guided reconstruction adds the circuit's purpose and each pin's role. Hidden test cases compare outputs with the reference cycle by cycle; power, delay, and area earn credit relative to the reference only when every case passes. Across 432 trials of 6 LLM agent configurations, successful agents recover algorithms and numerical conventions, yet only 12.0% of black-box and 14.8% of function-guided trials pass every case. Function-guided reconstruction raises the mean functional score, the cycle-weighted share of passed cases, from 24.6% to 30.9%. Of the 58 fully passing designs, only three improve on the reference's combined power, area, and delay, so behavioral recovery and efficient implementation remain distinct challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChiProgramBench：18个源自开源处理器、加速器、编解码器、变换、互连与控制电路的基准任务，要求LLM智能体仅通过驱动和读取隐藏有状态仿真参考模型的引脚，反推出其行为，并提交由公共库单元构成的门级网表。在两种设定（黑盒发现 vs. 功能引导重构）下以逐周期隐藏测试评估，发现即便成功智能体也仅12.0%（黑盒）与14.8%（功能引导）的试验通过全部用例，行为复原与高效实现仍是两项独立挑战。
AI.motivation: “能运行但不可查看”的系统理解是核心工程能力，但在硬件领域缺乏针对LLM智能体这一能力的系统性评测基准；现有工作难以同时考察黑盒实验设计、隐藏状态与时序推断以及门级可综合实现。
AI.method: 构建18个源自开源处理器、加速器、codec、变换、互连与控制电路的任务；智能体只能驱动并读取隐藏的、有状态的仿真参考模型的引脚，随后提交基于公共标准单元库的门级网表。设置两种模式：黑盒发现仅提供匿名功能引脚与固定存储器接口；功能引导重构额外给出电路用途及各引脚角色。用隐藏测试用例与参考逐周期比对输出，仅当全部用例通过时，才按功耗、延迟、面积相对参考值计分。
AI.result: 在6种LLM智能体配置的432次试验中，成功智能体能够复原算法与数值约定，但全用例通过率仅黑盒12.0%、功能引导14.8%。功能引导将功能得分（通过用例的周期加权占比）均值从24.6%提升至30.9%。58个完全通过的设计中仅3个在功耗、面积、延迟综合指标上优于参考。
AI.conclusion: 硬件域的黑盒逆向工程对LLM智能体仍具显著难度；提供功能线索可部分缓解但不足以解决问题；行为级复原与高效门级实现是可分离的两类挑战，需要分别针对性改进。

title: ComputeWise: Measuring and Fixing GPU Waste by AI Research Agents
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Preliminary version; a revised version is in preparation. Code: https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/computewise. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Salesforce/computewise
summary: AI agents are given GPUs to do AI research on their own. Do they use those GPUs well? A busy GPU does not tell us, because it can be busy with work the answer did not need. This matters, because the tokens the agent spends cost almost nothing next to the GPUs its experiments run on, so using those GPUs better has a huge impact. So we built ComputeWise, an open benchmark of research tasks on which this waste can be measured and reduced. For it we developed our own simulated GPU, which replays recorded runs to the agent's code. With no real GPU needed, we ran hundreds of experiments, far more than would be reasonable on real GPUs. With no help, the agents put only 52% of their GPU time into work the answer needed. Another 22% went to work it did not need, and 26% sat idle. Asking the agent to finish the work faster, telling it to keep every GPU busy, or giving it a job scheduler does not fix this. So we built an open-source harness, part prompting and part deterministic code. Across five models, it removed over 80% of the extra time to the answer.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ComputeWise 基准（含模拟 GPU，可回放记录运行），测得无辅助时 AI 智能体的 GPU 时间仅 52% 用于答案所需工作，22% 无用、26% 闲置；提示"更快完成"、"保持 GPU 忙碌"或提供调度器均无效；作者构建开源 harness（提示+确定性代码），在五个模型上将"额外时间"削减逾 80%。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体被赋予 GPU 自主开展 AI 研究，而 GPU 占用率（busy）无法反映其工作是否对答案有用；由于 token 成本相对 GPU 实验成本几乎可忽略，提升 GPU 使用效率收益巨大，但缺少可度量并削减此类浪费的基准。
AI.method: 构建开放基准 ComputeWise；自研模拟 GPU，将已记录的运行结果回放给智能体代码，无需真实 GPU 即可开展数百次实验；对多种干预（催促加速、要求 GPU 常忙、提供作业调度器）进行对照；提出开源 harness，结合提示设计与确定性代码。
AI.result: 无辅助的智能体仅将 52% 的 GPU 时间用于答案所需工作，22% 用于无用工作，26% 处于闲置；催促更快、强制 GPU 常忙、提供调度器均未改善；该 harness 在五个模型上平均消除超过 80% 的"通往答案的额外时间"。
AI.conclusion: GPU 忙碌程度是误导性指标，需以"有效计算占比"度量智能体算力效率；简单提示或调度工具无效，而提示+确定性代码的组合 harness 可显著降低计算浪费，为自主 AI 研究的高效算力使用提供可度量、可复现的路径。

title: DMC-5: Dual-Model Collaboration with Cache-aware Context Compression for Long-horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents repeatedly feed an ever-growing interaction trajectory to a specialized agent model. Prefix caching reuses computation over repeated history, but cannot prevent context growth or remove information irrelevant to the current decision. This is especially costly when the specialized agent lacks the cached-input discounts available to general-purpose models, making trajectory compression a natural alternative. However, existing compression methods on selective context risk losing global information, recursively rewriting summary leads to semantic drift, while repeatedly recompressing the full history shifts the growing cost to the compressor. Therefore, we introduce DMC-5 (Dual-Model Collaboration with CaChe-aware Context Compression), an asymmetric framework that assigns full-history integration to a general compression model and action generation to a specialized agent model. DMC-5 maintains the raw trajectory as an Append-only Canonical View, preserving global access while allowing the compressor to reuse a stable historical prefix instead of recursively rewriting or recomputing prior context. The agent operates only on a compact Decision View with recent raw interactions, reducing repeated input while retaining the information needed for the next action. DMC-5 further incorporates YAMATO (integritY-Aware Memory Abstractions for Tool Operations) to preserve execution-critical information during lossy compression. Experiments on AppWorld, OfficeBench, and 8-objective QA show that DMC-5 reduces agent model input by 38.5-57.0% and end-to-end cost by 14.5-28.0% with 78.0-85.0% compressor cache-hit rates, while improving task performance by 1.0-5.8% over the uncompressed baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出 DMC-5 双模型协同框架，用通用压缩模型整合全历史、专用智能体模型仅基于紧凑决策视图行动，在保留全局信息的同时降低输入与成本。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体不断累积交互轨迹，前缀缓存只能复用重复计算，无法抑制上下文膨胀或剔除无关信息；且专用智能体模型往往不享受通用模型的缓存输入折扣。已有压缩方法存在三类问题：选择性上下文压缩易丢失全局信息，递归改写摘要导致语义漂移，反复压缩全历史则把增长成本转移给压缩器。
AI.method: 非对称双模型架构：通用压缩模型负责全历史整合，专用智能体模型负责动作生成。维护原始轨迹为 Append-only Canonical View（仅追加规范视图）以保留全局可访问性，压缩器可复用稳定历史前缀而非递归改写或重算；智能体仅在含近期原始交互的紧凑 Decision View 上工作。并引入 YAMATO（完整性感知的工具操作记忆抽象）在有损压缩中保留执行关键信息。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld、OfficeBench 与 8-objective QA 上，智能体模型输入减少 38.5–57.0%，端到端成本降低 14.5–28.0%，压缩器缓存命中率 78.0–85.0%，相比未压缩基线任务性能提升 1.0–5.8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将全历史整合与动作生成解耦、以仅追加视图支撑前缀缓存复用，DMC-5 实现了压缩收益与任务性能的双重改善，验证了缓存感知上下文压缩在长时程智能体场景中的有效性。

title: Splitting Belief Bases Conditionally based on Constraints for c-Representations and their Solutions
summary: Splitting notions for conditional belief bases aim at localizing reasoning and computation tasks to subbases containing only the relevant parts of the belief base. Among the different reasoning mechanisms, c-representations, a special kind of Spohn's ranking models, have been shown to provide high-quality inferences. c-Representations can be conveniently specified via a constraint satisfaction problem. In this article, we introduce the notion of conditional constraint splittings, extending constraint splittings by also allowing the subbases to share conditionals. Taking inspiration from conditional syntax splittings, we identify the subclasses of safe and fully localized conditional constraint splittings, allowing us to locally and independently solve the constraint system on the subbases. We also generalize solution splittings for c-representations to safe conditional c-solution splittings and provide an in-depth analysis of their relationship to conditional constraint splittings. Additionally, we elaborate on the relationship of these new splitting notions to safe and generalized safe conditional syntax splittings and also to safe covers, which have been proposed for localized computation of c-representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"条件约束分裂"（conditional constraint splittings），推广约束分裂以允许子基共享条件句，并识别出安全与完全局域化两个子类，使c-表示（c-representations）的约束系统可在子基上局部独立求解；同时将解分裂推广为安全条件c-解分裂，并系统分析其与条件约束分裂、安全/广义安全条件语法分裂及安全覆盖的关系。
AI.motivation: 条件信念基的分裂概念旨在将推理与计算任务局域化到仅含相关部分的子基上。c-表示作为Spohn排序模型的特例能提供高质量推理且可通过约束满足问题方便地指定，但已有约束分裂要求子基条件句不相交，限制了对实际基的适用性，因此需要一种允许子基共享条件句的分裂框架。
AI.method: 在约束分裂基础上引入条件约束分裂，允许子基间共享条件句；借鉴条件语法分裂，界定"安全"与"完全局域化"两个子类，从而在子基上独立求解约束系统；并把c-表示的解分裂推广为安全条件c-解分裂；随后进行关系分析，刻画新分裂概念与条件约束分裂、安全及广义安全条件语法分裂、以及为c-表示局域计算而提出的安全覆盖之间的相互联系。
AI.result: 给出了条件约束分裂的形式定义及安全、完全局域化子类的性质，证明这些子类支持约束系统的局部独立求解；建立了安全条件c-解分裂的概念并深入分析其与条件约束分裂的对应关系；明确了新分裂概念与安全/广义安全条件语法分裂及安全覆盖之间的关系。
AI.conclusion: 条件约束分裂在不要求子基条件句不相交的前提下实现了c-表示推理的局域化，安全与完全局域化子类提供了可独立求解的充分条件；该框架统一并细化了既有分裂与安全覆盖方法，为条件信念基的局域化计算提供了更一般的理论基础。

title: NavDecision: Parallel Multi-Step Action Prediction with Persistent Self-Referential Learning for Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) requires timely decisions based on instructions and visual observations. However, autoregressive VLN models generate action descriptions token by token, introducing substantial inference overhead. Decision models offer an efficient alternative but face challenges in maintaining short-horizon action coherence and long-horizon goal alignment. To address these challenges, we propose NavDecision, an efficient multi-step VLN decision model. We introduce parallel multi-step action prediction (PMAP) to predict multiple action distributions from a shared vision-language state, and memory-augmented self-referential policy optimization (M-SRPO) to learn from unsuccessful trajectories using successful trajectories as references. A cross-iteration success memory further accumulates historical successful trajectories to provide informative training feedback. NavDecision achieves success rates of 64.60% on R2R-CE and 64.57% on RxR-CE with a 4B backbone. Compared with existing autoregressive VLN methods, it delivers significant inference speedups of up to $22.28\times$ and $18.96\times$ while maintaining comparable navigation performance.

AI.tldr: 提出高效多步VLN决策模型NavDecision，通过并行多步动作预测与记忆增强自参考策略优化，在R2R-CE/RxR-CE上取得64.60%/64.57%成功率，推理加速最高达22.28×/18.96×。
AI.motivation: 自回归VLN模型逐token生成动作描述，推理开销大；而决策模型虽高效，却难以兼顾短时动作连贯性与长时目标对齐。
AI.method: 并行多步动作预测（PMAP）：从共享视觉-语言状态一次性预测多步动作分布；记忆增强自参考策略优化（M-SRPO）：以成功轨迹为参考，从失败轨迹中学习；跨迭代成功记忆：累积历史成功轨迹提供训练反馈。
AI.result: 4B骨干下R2R-CE成功率64.60%、RxR-CE成功率64.57%；相较现有自回归VLN方法，在性能相当情况下推理加速最高22.28×与18.96×。
AI.conclusion: 将VLN建模为多步并行决策并辅以参考式策略优化与成功记忆，可在保持导航性能的同时显著降低推理开销，为高效VLN提供可行范式。

title: Frozen by the Mean: Early Temporal Guidance Unfreezes Motion in Video Diffusion Models
summary: Video diffusion models can render convincing frames while failing to produce the requested action. Increasing classifier-free guidance (CFG) can strengthen motion, but also saturates and shifts colors. Scalar CFG assigns the same coefficient to the averaged and frame-varying components of its prediction difference, limiting independent control of temporal variation. THAW, Temporal Harmonic Amplification during Warm-up, retains stock CFG and adds a separately weighted residual during an initial denoising window. Its dose specifies the added norm relative to the current CFG difference, giving the extra guidance a consistent relative budget across sampling steps. THAW is training-free and reuses CFG's two model predictions with an unchanged network evaluation count. It improves cost-matched motion over scalar and scheduled CFG on five video models, with positive point estimates against existing guidance methods on three of them. On VBench, THAW raises dynamic degree by about 14 to 15 points over stock CFG while increasing total scores on a different set of three models.

AI.tldr: THAW是一种免训练的视频扩散引导方法，在去噪初期窗口内以单独加权残差的形式增强运动，剂量按相对CFG差值范数定义，可在不改变网络评估次数的前提下提升动作强度且避免CFG饱和导致的偏色。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型能生成逼真帧但常无法产生所请求的动作。提高无分类器引导（CFG）系数可增强运动，但会饱和并导致色彩漂移；标量CFG对预测差中的平均分量与帧变化分量赋同一系数，限制了时间变化的独立控制。
AI.method: 提出THAW（Warm-up期间的时间谐波放大）：保留原始CFG，仅在初始去噪窗口内叠加一个单独加权的残差项；其"剂量"定义为相对于当前CFG差值范数的增量，使额外引导在各采样步具有一致的相对预算。方法免训练，复用CFG的两次模型预测，网络评估次数不变。
AI.result: 在五个视频模型上，THAW在同等计算成本下优于标量CFG与调度CFG；其中三个模型上相对现有引导方法的点估计为正。在VBench上，THAW较原始CFG将动态程度提升约14–15点，同时在另一组三个模型上提高总分。
AI.conclusion: 通过将时间变化引导从标量CFG中解耦并在预热窗口内按相对剂量注入，可在零额外推理成本下改善运动生成，缓解CFG的饱和与偏色问题，具有良好的可移植性。

title: From Pairwise to Collective: Encoder Collections Make Unpaired Vision-Language Alignment Reliable
summary: Strong vision and text encoders can be trained independently, but their representations are not directly comparable. Connecting them usually requires paired image-text data, which may be unavailable. Unpaired alignment instead fits a map between a vision and a text encoder from feature-space geometry alone, enabling text-based retrieval and zero-shot classification without paired data. Treating each pair independently leads to fragile searches, repeated fitting, and uncertain map quality. A collection of encoders supplies additional supervision: all vision encoders embed the same images and all text encoders the same texts. Correspondences within each modality are therefore known exactly, while the cross-modal correspondence remains hidden. ConsensusAlign pools each modality into a shared space, fits one unpaired cross-modal bridge, and transfers it in closed form to every encoder pair. New encoders join through same-modality fitting without repeating the cross-modal search. On 21 vision-text encoder pairs and five seeds, pooled fitting aligns every pair, whereas pairwise fits fail in 68 of 105 pair-seed cells. Mean alignment error (FOSCTTM) falls from 0.1457 to 0.0099, and zero-shot accuracy nearly doubles on ten datasets. Gains persist across the tested within-modality pooling constructions with a WP bridge. New corpora reuse the bridge through native maps fitted to unlabeled target features from every source encoder. Agreement with separately fitted reference maps detects failures on COCO.

AI.tldr: 提出 ConsensusAlign：将同一模态的多个编码器池化到共享空间，仅拟合一个跨模态无配对桥接映射，并闭式迁移到所有编码器对，显著降低对齐误差并提升零样本性能。
AI.motivation: 独立训练的视觉与文本编码器表征不可直接比较，配对图文数据常不可得；现有无配对对齐对每个编码器对独立拟合，导致搜索脆弱、重复拟合、映射质量不确定。
AI.method: 利用多编码器集合提供的额外监督：同模态内所有视觉（文本）编码器嵌入相同图像（文本），模态内对应关系精确已知，仅跨模态对应未知。方法将各模态池化为一个共享空间，拟合单一无配对跨模态桥接，并闭式迁移至每一编码器对；新编码器仅需同模态拟合，无需重做跨模态搜索。新语料通过将各源编码器的原生映射拟合到未标注目标特征来复用桥接。
AI.result: 在21个视觉-文本编码器对、5个随机种子上，池化拟合对全部编码器对成功对齐，而逐对拟合在105个"对-种子"单元中有68个失败；平均对齐误差（FOSCTTM）由0.1457降至0.0099，十个数据集上的零样本准确率近乎翻倍。增益在多种模态内池化构造与WP桥接下均保持；与单独拟合的参考映射的一致性可在COCO上检测失败。
AI.conclusion: 多编码器集合的模态内精确对应可作为强监督，替代脆弱的逐对无配对搜索；ConsensusAlign实现一次拟合、闭式迁移、可扩展复用，并具备基于参考映射一致性的失败检测能力。

title: Fill in the Blanks: Non-Autoregressive Schema-Parallel Key Information Extraction with CTC Decoding
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) extract structured data from documents by generating the requested JSON one token at a time, so their sequential steps grow with the length of the answer. Yet in key information extraction (KIE) the schema already fixes the answer's structure: keys, nesting and lists are known before decoding, and only the values are unknown. We exploit this with a non-autoregressive extractor that writes the structure from the schema, sizes every list with a count pass, and predicts all values in parallel, in a fixed number of passes that does not grow with the document. Each value is decoded with connectionist temporal classification (CTC) in its own block of slots, so its length never has to be predicted, and a value that is still open after its block gets a larger token budget. Zero-shot on VAREX, CORD and FUNSD, our 4B extractor is 3.5$\times$ faster than the diffusion-VLM competition on average (up to 5.6$\times$) and more accurate, with 4--6 forward passes per document where block diffusion needs 12--74. The same extractor also drafts for speculative decoding with its own autoregressive base: it runs 8.3$\times$ faster than autoregressive decoding (up to 10.4$\times$) within 0.4 points of its accuracy, and 3.3$\times$ faster than speculative diffusion decoding while 13.0 points more accurate. We release the model and code.

AI.tldr: 提出一种利用KIE模式先验的非自回归抽取器：结构由schema直接写出、列表长度用计数pass确定、所有值并行预测，每个值用CTC在独立槽块内解码，固定pass数不随文档增长；4B模型零样本下较扩散VLM快3.5倍且更准，并可作推测解码草稿器。
AI.motivation: VLM从文档提取结构化数据时逐token生成JSON，解码步数随答案长度线性增长；但在关键信息抽取（KIE）中，schema已预先确定答案结构（键、嵌套、列表），唯一未知的是值，因此逐token自回归生成存在大量冗余计算。
AI.method: 1) 非自回归抽取器：直接从schema写出输出结构；2) 用一次计数pass预测每个列表的长度；3) 并行预测所有值，总前向pass数固定且与文档长度无关；4) 每个值在专属slot块内用CTC解码，无需预测其长度；5) 对块结束后仍未闭合的值分配更大token预算；6) 同一模型作为推测解码（speculative decoding）草稿器，服务于其自回归基座。
AI.result: 零样本在VAREX、CORD、FUNSD上，4B抽取器平均比扩散VLM基线快3.5倍（最高5.6倍）且准确率更高，每文档仅需4–6次前向pass（block diffusion需12–74次）。作草稿器时，比自回归解码快8.3倍（最高10.4倍），精度差距在0.4点内；比推测扩散解码快3.3倍且准确率高13.0点。
AI.conclusion: 利用KIE的schema结构先验可显著压缩解码开销：非自回归+CTC槽块解码在固定pass数下实现高精度与高速度；同一模型兼具独立抽取与推测解码草稿双重用途，并已开源模型与代码。

title: AgroVG+: Generalized Visual Grounding in Agriculture with Region-Supervised Action Generation
summary: Generalized visual grounding in agriculture requires localizing all objects that match a natural-language description and recognizing when no matching target is present. We introduce AgroVG+, a dataset whose referring expressions are all written and reviewed by agricultural experts based on image content and corresponding target sets. The dataset comprises 7,404 images and 10,081 query records across six agricultural scene families, covering single-target, multi-target, and target-absent cases. We also propose ReSAG (Region-Supervised Action Generation), a framework that couples regional evidence supervision with explicit box-generation and termination decisions. ReSAG assigns each target an equally weighted supervision term on a shared spatial evidence distribution computed before answer generation. The BOX/END protocol exposes a choice between generating another box and terminating the response at box boundaries, while coordinates are generated using the original language vocabulary. Regional and sequence objectives jointly train a shared language decoder. On AgroVG+, ReSAG outperforms coordinate-only fine-tuning on single- and multi-target exact-set accuracy, and achieves higher aggregate accuracy than either component alone in ablations.

AI.tldr: 提出农业广义视觉定位数据集AgroVG+（7,404图像、10,081查询，含单目标/多目标/无目标）与ReSAG框架：区域证据监督+BOX/END显式终止决策，在AgroVG+上优于纯坐标微调。
AI.motivation: 农业场景需要"广义"视觉定位：既要定位所有符合自然语言描述的目标，也要能识别并报告"无匹配目标"的情况。现有设定与数据缺乏专家标注的指代表达及目标集，难以支撑该能力。
AI.method: 构建AgroVG+：指代表达由农业专家基于图像内容与对应目标集撰写并复核，覆盖六类农业场景族。提出ReSAG（Region-Supervised Action Generation）：在答案生成前计算共享空间证据分布，每个目标在该分布上获得等权监督项；采用BOX/END协议在框边界处显式选择"继续生成框"或"终止回答"；坐标以原始语言词表生成；区域目标与序列目标联合训练同一语言解码器。
AI.result: 在AgroVG+上，ReSAG的单目标与多目标精确集合准确率均优于仅坐标微调；消融显示其总体准确率高于单独使用任一组件。
AI.conclusion: 区域证据监督与显式生成/终止决策互补，可统一处理多目标与目标缺失的广义视觉定位；专家标注的AgroVG+为该任务提供评测基础。

title: A Multi-Criteria Evaluation of Color Normalization Methods in Histopathology: Nuclei Preservation, Artifact Sensitivity, Background Fidelity, and Downstream Performanc
summary: Deep learning models for nuclei detection and classification may generalize poorly across medical centers because of variations in staining and scanning. Although color normalization aims to reduce these variations, its effects on nuclear structure, background preservation, artifact sensitivity, and nuclei detection and classification performance have not been systematically evaluated. We present a procedure to benchmark 11 classical and deep learning normalization methods using 7 public and private nuclei datasets. Additionally, we investigate the effect of 7 input color spaces. The normalization methods differed in their effects on nuclear structure, background, and sensitivity to artifacts. However, detection and classification performance varied more across datasets than across normalization methods, and the input color space had limited influence. No single method performed best on all criteria, and image-level metrics did not reliably predict downstream performance, highlighting the need for nuclei- and structure-aware normalization methods. To support this work, we introduce WSI Quality Control and Normalization (WSI-QCN), a publicly available pipeline for robust whole-slide image quality assessment and color normalization; the source code is available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 该文系统评测了11种经典与深度学习颜色归一化方法及7种输入色彩空间在7个细胞核数据集上对核结构、背景、伪影敏感性及检测/分类性能的影响，并提出公开流程WSI-QCN。
AI.motivation: 深度学习细胞核检测与分类模型因染色与扫描差异在不同医学中心间泛化性差；颜色归一化虽旨在减少此类变异，但其对核结构、背景保留、伪影敏感性以及下游检测/分类性能的影响尚未被系统评估。
