AI.method: 构建基准评测流程，在7个公开与私有细胞核数据集上比较11种经典与深度学习方法，并额外考察7种输入色彩空间的影响；评估指标涵盖核结构、背景保留、伪影敏感性及检测与分类性能。
AI.result: 各归一化方法在核结构、背景与伪影敏感性上的效果存在差异；但检测与分类性能在数据集间的差异大于方法间差异，输入色彩空间影响有限；无单一方法在所有指标上最优，且图像级指标无法可靠预测下游性能。
AI.conclusion: 需要面向细胞核与结构感知的归一化方法；作者发布WSI-QCN开源流程，用于稳健的全切片图像质量评估与颜色归一化。

title: MIMORPHEUS: Rethinking Cross-Modal Supervision for Human Pose Estimation from Radar Signals
summary: Deep learning has shown promise for estimating human pose with multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) radar through walls. Building paired radar and pose datasets demands considerable time and manual effort, while large visual pose datasets provide no corresponding radar echoes. Physical simulation can supply synthetic signals, but requires expertise in scattering models and can leave a gap between simulated and real data. To address this challenge, we introduce MIMORPHEUS, a framework that generates radar echoes from 3D human poses through conditional diffusion. To prepare echo and pose representations, MIMO-VAE compresses the echoes according to their channel and fast time sample structure, while SkeleCoder learns pose features through contrastive alignment with echo features. These pose features then guide diffusion in the MIMO-VAE latent space, and the VAE decoder reconstructs echoes from the generated latents. Once trained, the generator augments radar data by producing different echoes for a recorded pose and supplies the radar modality for pose annotations in existing visual datasets. In data augmentation experiments, our method reduces MPJPE by 6.8%-11.2% across four radar pose estimators. Transfer experiments with three public pose datasets also show that visual pose annotations can supply useful radar training data. Code will be made publicly available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 提出MIMORPHEUS框架，用条件扩散从3D人体姿态生成穿墙MIMO雷达回波，缓解配对雷达-姿态数据稀缺问题，可用于数据增强与跨模态迁移。
AI.motivation: 穿墙MIMO雷达人体姿态估计缺乏配对数据：采集耗时长、人工成本高；视觉姿态数据集无对应雷达回波；物理仿真依赖散射建模专业知识且存在仿真-真实域差距。
AI.method: 条件扩散框架：MIMO-VAE按通道与快时间采样结构压缩回波；SkeleCoder通过对比学习将姿态特征与回波特征对齐；姿态特征作为条件引导MIMO-VAE隐空间中的扩散过程，VAE解码器由生成隐变量重建回波。训练后可为一姿态生成多样回波，并为视觉数据集的姿态标注合成雷达模态。
AI.result: 数据增强实验中，四个雷达姿态估计器的MPJPE降低6.8%–11.2%；在三个公开姿态数据集上迁移实验表明视觉姿态标注可提供有效的雷达训练数据。
AI.conclusion: 基于姿态条件的回波生成可替代昂贵的实测采集，为穿墙雷达姿态估计提供数据增强与跨模态标注迁移途径；代码将于GitHub公开。

title: AERIN: Aerial Instance Navigation with a Visual World Model
summary: Searching from high altitude and navigating to a target instance specified by a reference image is a common application for UAVs. In such tasks, high-altitude observations provide broad ground coverage for efficient search, but targets occupy fewer pixels, making instance verification and action selection more difficult. We present AERIN, a visual world model that uses action-conditioned prediction to guide the UAV toward the target while adjusting its viewpoint to obtain higherquality observations for subsequent instance verification. Highaltitude navigation requires fine-grained target details and scene context relevant to visibility, but repeatedly predicting dense visual representations of this information is computationally expensive. AERIN addresses this challenge with a compact, fixedsize, target-conditioned latent state that separately represents both for efficient action evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that AERIN outperforms the evaluated baselines in target approach and observation quality, while requiring substantially less decision time than similar world models.

AI.tldr: AERIN 是一个面向无人机高空目标搜索与逼近的行动条件视觉世界模型，用紧凑的固定尺寸、目标条件化潜在状态分别表征目标细节与场景上下文，以较低计算代价引导无人机接近目标并主动调整视角。
AI.motivation: 无人机需从高空依据参考图像搜索并导航至目标实例：高空观测覆盖范围大、搜索效率高，但目标像素占比小，实例验证与动作选择困难。同时，这类任务依赖细粒度目标细节与影响可见性的场景上下文，若反复预测稠密视觉表征则计算开销过大。
AI.method: 提出 AERIN，基于行动条件预测（action-conditioned prediction）的世界模型：以行动为条件预测未来观测以评估候选动作，引导无人机接近目标并调整视角以获得更高质量观测，便于后续实例验证。核心是用紧凑、固定尺寸、目标条件化的潜在状态，将目标细节与场景上下文分开表征，从而高效进行动作评估，避免稠密视觉预测。
AI.result: 实验表明，AERIN 在目标逼近与观测质量上优于所评估的基线方法，且决策时间显著少于同类世界模型。
AI.conclusion: 以目标条件化的紧凑潜在状态结合行动条件预测，可在高空小目标场景中实现高质量导航与观测，并兼顾决策效率，为世界模型用于无人机视觉导航提供了可行路径。

title: Polytropos: What Do Vision-Language Model Descriptions Make of a Cultural Object?
summary: Vision-language models have become a new kind of describer, writing about almost anything people see, and their descriptions now shape how cultures are known by people and by other models. Descriptions of cultures tend to turn particular things into types, and what a description loses shows what its describer lacks. We introduce Polytropos, a benchmark that measures what model descriptions of cultural objects keep of the particular object by turning each description back into an image and comparing it with the original photograph. On 374 objects from the Metropolitan Museum of Art and the Getty, with 1,870 descriptions from five models and 230 written by curators, reconstructions are recognised as the recorded culture more often than the photographs, at 54.55% to 59.09% against 52.14%, yet 16% to 21% of objects change outcome and only 0.49% of reconstructions are identified as the specific object. On the same objects, models lose recorded cultures at a rate similar to curators but gain more. Model descriptions give each object many faces, each typical of its culture and almost none the object itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Polytropos基准，通过"描述→重建图像→与原照片比对"的方式，量化多模态模型对文化物件描述中保留了多少"独特性"（particularity）。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型已成为人们认知文化的重要"描述者"，而描述往往把特定个体泛化为文化类型，丢失的信息恰恰揭示了描述者的缺失。现有评估缺乏对"描述保留物件独特性"的直接度量。
AI.method: 构建Polytropos基准：选取大都会艺术博物馆与盖蒂博物馆的374件物件，收集5个模型的1,870条描述与策展人撰写的230条描述；将每条描述通过图像重建回可视化结果，并与原始照片比较，考察(1)重建图是否被识别为所记录的文化，(2)物件判定结果是否改变，(3)重建图能否被识别为特定物件。
AI.result: 重建图被认作该记录文化的比例（54.55%–59.09%）高于原照片（52.14%）；但16%–21%的物件在重建后判定结果发生变化，仅0.49%的重建图被识别为特定原型物件。模型与策展人丢失文化的比率相近，但模型"增益"更多。
AI.conclusion: 模型描述为每个物件赋予"多副面孔"，每副面孔都典型地代表其文化，却几乎无一代表物件本身——即描述高度类型化、丢失个体独特性。

title: Contrastive Gradient Guidance for Test-Time Multi-Preference Alignment of Diffusion Models
summary: Aligning pre-trained diffusion models with multiple context-dependent preferences requires adapting generation at test time rather than relying on offline fine-tuning, which requires hyperparameter tuning and a new training run for each preference trade-off. Existing approaches compress diverse preferences into a single scalar reward objective for fine-tuning or test-time guidance rather than directly reusing existing generative experts released for different purposes and obtained through different fine-tuning methods. In this work, we propose Contrastive Gradient Guidance (CGG), a test-time compositional generative framework that reformulates multi-preference alignment as a composition of distributions. CGG represents each preference as a contrastive preference pair of favored experts and unfavored anti-experts, whose score difference forms a contrastive gradient guidance signal that combines denoising directions (gradients) from off-the-shelf diffusion models during sampling. Experiments show that CGG reuses pre-trained and fine-tuned models as favored experts or anti-experts to control output style and safety, and that it can be combined with existing sampling-based reward guidance. With a single fixed scale per pair, CGG composes five preferences at once and gives a more balanced trade-off across text-image preference, concept control, photographic fidelity, and safety than offline fine-tuning, weight-space merging, and reward steering.

AI.tldr: 提出对比梯度引导（CGG），将多偏好对齐重构为分布组合，用"偏好专家—反专家"对的分数差构成对比梯度引导信号，在采样时组合多个现成扩散模型的去噪方向，无需针对每种偏好权衡重新微调。
AI.motivation: 多上下文相关偏好的对齐需在测试时适配生成，而离线微调需超参调优且每种偏好权衡都要重训；现有方法把多样偏好压缩为单一标量奖励目标，无法直接复用为不同目的、经不同微调方式得到的现有生成专家。
AI.method: CGG 把多偏好对齐表述为分布组合：每个偏好表示为一个"受偏好专家—不受偏好反专家"的对比偏好对，二者分数差形成对比梯度引导信号，在采样过程中组合来自现成扩散模型的去噪方向（梯度），可复用预训练与微调模型，并能与现有基于采样的奖励引导结合。
AI.result: CGG 可复用预训练/微调模型作为专家或反专家来控制输出风格与安全性；每个偏好对仅需单一固定尺度即可同时组合五个偏好，在文—图偏好、概念控制、照片保真与安全性权衡上优于离线微调、权重空间合并与奖励引导。
AI.conclusion: 通过分布组合式的对比梯度引导，CGG 提供了一种无需逐偏好重训、可复用现成生成专家的测试时多偏好对齐框架，并获得更均衡的权衡。

title: Robust Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Models via Simulating Brain Functional Localization
summary: Concept erasure in text-to-image models aims to prevent a target concept from appearing in generated images while preserving general image generation capability. However, erased concepts can still be reactivated by attacks. Prior attacks mainly search text or image input spaces, leaving the initial latent space underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce IVO (Initial latent Variable Optimization), a new concept reactivation attack that changes the starting point of image generation by optimizing the initial latent. Comprehensive experiments across 8 erasure methods show that IVO reactivates erased concepts more effectively than the attack baselines, revealing a blind spot in erasure robustness evaluation. This motivates us to localize model components associated with the target concept and then treat them as intervention sites for more robust concept erasure. We propose CeFlune (Concept Erasure via Functional Localization of Unit Neurons), which adapts brain functional localization to text-to-image models. CeFlune defines linear modules as Unit Neurons and localizes concept-responsive ones by comparing their response trajectories in the model's task and resting states. It then updates the localized Unit Neurons to constrain their responses and the erased model's predictions. Across U-Net diffusion and flow-matching transformer architectures, CeFlune achieves a favorable balance between concept erasure and general image generation capability in comparisons with up to 15 baseline methods. Under IVO and 4 other evaluated attacks, CeFlune also shows lower concept reactivation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出初始潜变量优化攻击IVO，揭示概念擦除模型的鲁棒性盲区，并据此提出基于功能定位的CeFlune擦除方法。
AI.motivation: 现有概念擦除方法擦除的概念仍可被攻击重新激活，而以往攻击主要搜索文本或图像输入空间，忽视了初始潜空间这一盲区；同时现有擦除评估的鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 1) IVO攻击：优化初始潜变量改变图像生成起点以重激活被擦除概念；2) CeFlune：借鉴大脑功能定位，将线性模块定义为"单元神经元"，通过比较任务态与静息态的响应轨迹定位概念响应单元，再更新这些单元以约束其响应及模型预测。
AI.result: 在8种擦除方法上，IVO的重激活效果优于基线攻击；CeFlune在U-Net扩散与流匹配Transformer架构上，与多达15种基线相比，在概念擦除与通用生成能力间取得良好平衡，并在IVO及另外4种攻击下表现出更低的概念重激活。
AI.conclusion: 初始潜空间是擦除鲁棒性的重要盲点；通过功能定位定位并干预概念相关单元神经元，可实现更鲁棒的概念擦除。

title: Unleashing the Value of Raw Point Clouds for 3D Understanding with LLMs
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. Tailai Chen and Jiawei Yu contributed equally
summary: Standard 3D point cloud language models typically rely on pretrained point encoders to extract 3D features and project them into representations processable by large language models (LLMs). However, these encoders are often originally optimized for pre-defined tasks, resulting in a representation bottleneck that may lead to a substantial mismatch with downstream 3D understanding. Moreover, existing models largely follow a single pass closed-book generation, limiting their ability to actively inspect task-relevant 3D regions or retrieve necessary external knowledge. In this work, we present PointTool, an encoder-free and tool-augmented framework for 3D reasoning. PointTool introduces Alignment-Free Patch Tokenization (AFPT) to locally aggregate raw point clouds while preserving fine-grained geometric structure, and Decoupled Point-Text LoRA (DPL) to facilitate global aggregation and 3D knowledge internalization within a frozen LLM. Building upon these designs, Program-Supervised Tool Reasoning (PSTR) enables the model to explicitly operate on raw 3D data and external resources through executable tools, supporting interactive 3D reasoning grounded in spatial evidence. We further introduce PointCloud-TR, a benchmark comprising 13K 3D objects, 39.8K questions, and 35.6K tool trajectories to facilitate training and evaluation of complex 3D reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that PointTool achieves strong performance on both standard and complex 3D understanding tasks, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: PointTool：一个免编码器、工具增强的3D推理框架，通过无对齐patch分词、解耦点-文本LoRA与程序监督工具推理，实现可交互、基于空间证据的3D理解，并配套PointCloud-TR基准。
AI.motivation: 现有3D点云语言模型依赖预训练点编码器，其表征常针对预定义任务优化，形成表征瓶颈并与下游3D理解不匹配；且模型多为单次"闭卷"生成，无法主动检视任务相关3D区域或检索外部知识。
AI.method: 提出PointTool：1) Alignment-Free Patch Tokenization (AFPT) 局部聚合原始点云并保留细粒度几何结构；2) Decoupled Point-Text LoRA (DPL) 在冻结LLM内实现全局聚合与3D知识内化；3) Program-Supervised Tool Reasoning (PSTR) 借助可执行工具显式操作原始3D数据与外部资源，实现基于空间证据的交互推理。同时构建PointCloud-TR基准（13K 3D物体、39.8K问题、35.6K工具轨迹）。
AI.result: 在标准与复杂3D理解任务上均取得强劲性能，验证了框架有效性。
AI.conclusion: 免编码器+工具增强的范式可有效缓解表征瓶颈与闭卷生成局限，实现可交互、证据驱动的3D推理；配套基准为复杂3D推理的训练与评测提供支撑。

title: PhyCoVE: Benchmarking Physical Counterfactual Video Editing across Diverse Material Dynamics
summary: Physical counterfactual video editing turns a source video and a language-specified physical edit at a given execution frame into a counterfactual video that shows how the scene would evolve after the edit. Existing evaluations with counterfactual target videos mainly cover object removal or specific rigid-body motions, although real scenes also involve elastic deformation, fluid flow, and interactions among rigid bodies, elastic solids, and fluids. We introduce PhyCoVE, a benchmark of 533 cases on 110 source videos that covers rigid, elastic, and fluid dynamics in five interaction patterns, with edits that remove an object, change a physical quantity, or insert a new object. For the simulated cases, a language model proposes scene designs, coding agents build them with solvers suited to each material and physically based rendering and then simulate each edit from the source scene state, and humans check every stage. For the real cases, we record continuously from one camera position before and after each edit. We also propose counterfactual fidelity, a metric that applies across materials and their interactions and measures how much of the physical change from the source video to the target video a generated video reproduces. We evaluate seven open-source and commercial video editing models and find that counterfactual fidelity ranks them nearly as human preference does, but even the best model reproduces only about one seventh of the physical change. The models change how a scene looks but rarely how it evolves, whereas a physical edit requires understanding the dynamics that it changes. Physical counterfactual video editing thus remains far from solved, and PhyCoVE provides a foundation for developing and evaluating methods for it.

AI.tldr: 提出PhyCoVE基准（110个源视频、533个案例），覆盖刚体、弹性体、流体的五类交互模式的反事实物理视频编辑，并提出跨材料的"反事实保真度"指标；评测7个开闭源视频编辑模型，最好模型仅复现约1/7的物理变化。
AI.motivation: 现有反事实目标视频评测主要局限于物体移除或特定刚体运动，而真实场景还包含弹性形变、流体流动以及刚体-弹性体-流体的相互作用，缺乏覆盖多材料与多交互模式的评测基准与统一度量。
AI.method: 构建PhyCoVE基准：533个案例、110个源视频，覆盖刚体/弹性/流体三类动力学与五种交互模式，编辑类型包括移除物体、改变物理量、插入新物体。仿真案例由语言模型提出场景设计、编码智能体用适配各材料的求解器与基于物理的渲染构建并从源场景状态出发模拟编辑，全流程人工核验；真实案例在同一机位连续拍摄编辑前后。同时提出反事实保真度指标，衡量生成视频对源→目标物理变化的复现比例。
AI.result: 评测7个开源与商业视频编辑模型：反事实保真度与人类偏好排序几乎一致，但最佳模型仅复现约1/7的物理变化。
AI.conclusion: 模型只改变场景外观而非演化方式，而物理编辑要求理解被改变的动力学；物理反事实视频编辑远未解决，PhyCoVE为方法开发与评测提供基础。

title: Decoupling Perception from Generation for Agentic 3D CT Report Generation
summary: Chest CT reports repeatedly assess the same anatomical regions for findings and their attributes, such as whether a lung nodule is present and where it is located. These assessments suggest learning to answer visual questions directly, rather than coupling perception to open-ended text generation. Yet current CT report generation models largely follow generic vision-language modeling, which may miss subtle abnormalities when training data are limited. We therefore formulate report generation as a set of visual question-answering decisions coordinated by a large language model (LLM) agent. This decouples visual perception from reasoning and report writing: perception can be learned as a discriminative, non-generative task, while the LLM focuses on reasoning over patient context and posing relevant visual queries. We introduce Rad-VL-JEPA, which unifies report retrieval, finding recognition, and fine-grained attribute characterization through vision-language joint-embedding prediction. Building on this perception module, an agent trained with reinforcement learning (RL) acquires patient-specific visual evidence, while a separate editor incorporates the evidence into the final report, further separating evidence acquisition from report realization. Experiments show that Rad-VL-JEPA achieves strong performance on fine-grained CT understanding tasks with lower amortized per-query inference time than a generative VLM baseline trained with the same CT encoder and VQA data. The resulting reporting system outperforms strong VLM-based and agentic baselines.

AI.tldr: 将CT报告生成重构为一组由LLM智能体协调的视觉问答决策，提出用视觉-语言联合嵌入预测统一报告检索、征象识别与属性刻画，实现感知与推理/书写解耦。
AI.motivation: 现有CT报告生成模型沿用通用视觉-语言建模，把感知与开放式文本生成耦合，在训练数据有限时易漏检细微异常；而CT报告本身反复评估同一解剖区域的征象及属性，更适合作直接视觉问答。
AI.method: 把报告生成分解为可协调的VQA决策：用Rad-VL-JEPA以联合嵌入预测统一报告检索、征象识别和细粒度属性刻画，作为判别式非生成的感知模块；RL训练的智能体据此主动获取患者特异视觉证据；再由独立编辑模块将证据写入最终报告，进一步分离证据获取与报告生成。
AI.result: Rad-VL-JEPA在细粒度CT理解任务上表现强，且单查询摊销推理时间低于使用相同CT编码器与VQA数据训练的生成式VLM基线；整体报告系统优于强VLM基线与智能体基线。
AI.conclusion: 将CT报告生成表述为智能体协调的判别式VQA决策流程，可有效解耦感知与推理，在性能与推理效率上均优于生成式方法。

title: Can an Agent Trust Its Own Zoom? Cross-Magnification Provenance Verification for Whole-Slide Images
summary: Visual agents navigate whole-slide images through magnified observations associated with claimed locations. However, a visually plausible observation does not necessarily originate from its claimed location, particularly across magnifications and in regions with similar tissue structures. We formulate cross-magnification provenance verification (CMPV) to evaluate whether visual evidence supports a claimed spatial association, recover the source when possible, and abstain when evidence is insufficient. We introduce PyraFault, a benchmark of 3.06 million coordinate-supervised examples from 2,200 cases across five TCGA cohorts, covering within-context substitutions, absent-source faults, and geometric perturbations. We further propose ZoomTrace, a claim-independent verifier that estimates the observation's source before evaluating its agreement with the claimed location. It combines physical-scale alignment, visual retrieval, geometric refinement, and reliability estimation using spatially disjoint competing matches. On 503,320 test examples, ZoomTrace achieves 0.969 AUPRC and 0.987 AUROC, compared with 0.789 and 0.903 for Efficient LoFTR. Further evaluations reveal trade-offs in reliability estimation and limitations in vision-language models, cross-dataset retrieval, and calibration. Integrating ZoomTrace into visual agent tool paths reduces exposure to corrupted observations and silent failures, while downstream accuracy improvements depend on the agent and verification threshold.

AI.tldr: 论文提出跨放大倍率来源验证任务（CMPV），构建PyraFault基准（306万坐标监督样本、2200例、五个TCGA队列），并提出与声明无关的验证器ZoomTrace，在503,320测试样本上达到0.969 AUPRC与0.987 AUROC。
AI.motivation: 视觉智能体在全切片图像中依赖"带声明位置的放大观测"进行导航，但视觉上合理的观测未必来自其声称位置，跨倍率及组织相似区域尤甚，存在被污染观测与静默失效风险。
AI.method: 形式化CMPV任务：判定视觉证据是否支持声明的空间关联、尽可能恢复真实来源、证据不足时弃权；构建PyraFault基准，涵盖上下文内替换、来源缺失故障与几何扰动；提出ZoomTrace验证器，先估计观测来源再与声明位置比对，融合物理尺度对齐、视觉检索、几何精化，以及基于空间不相交竞争匹配的可靠性估计。
AI.result: 测试集AUPRC 0.969、AUROC 0.987，显著优于Efficient LoFTR（0.789/0.903）；揭示可靠性估计的权衡，以及视觉语言模型、跨数据集检索与校准方面的局限。
AI.conclusion: 将ZoomTrace嵌入视觉智能体工具路径可降低对污染观测的暴露与静默失败；下游精度提升取决于具体智能体与验证阈值。

title: Projecting Beauty: Transferring Image Aesthetic Analysis onto 3D Heritage and Urban Scenes
summary: Judgments about the beauty of buildings and streets inform architectural design, urban planning, and heritage conservation, yet increasingly rely on scanned 3D models over material fabric. Automatic aesthetic assessment remains largely confined to 2D photographs. We ask what survives when image aesthetic assessment crosses this dimensional gap to produce dense, per-point aesthetic descriptions of heritage and urban point clouds. We examine three routes that sidestep costly, and sometimes ethically dubious, human labeling at scale: (1) lifting scalar scores from image aesthetic models (NIMA, SAAN) onto geometry; (2) training Aesthetic Visual Analysis (AVA) regression heads on frozen vision backbones (DINOv3, TIPS, SigLIP2, PE, RADSeg) or, in a 3D-native variant, a generalist point encoder on feed-forward AVA reconstructions; and (3) querying lifted vision-language features with a natural-language aesthetic label, taking similarity as a score. The two supervised routes transfer poorly: heads fitting AVA in-domain produce architectural class profiles that neither reproduce one another nor track other signals, while the 3D-native probe stays near chance due to reconstruction geometry quality. Text querying is markedly more coherent. Projecting out the class-text direction from point features raises mean cross-model agreement on architectural part profiles from +0.035 to +0.352, and from +0.113 to +0.293 per point; the four backbones passing a semantic sanity check correlate at 0.31-0.73, while the failing one remains an outlier. Since model agreement is not agreement with human aesthetic perception, we detail a part-aware rating protocol to clarify where human and automatic ratings disagree. We provide a reproducible transfer protocol, an account of which pseudo-labeling routes carry signal, and dense aesthetic pseudo-labels meant as hypotheses rather than ground truth.

AI.tldr: 该文考察2D图像美学评估跨越维度鸿沟迁移到3D点云的表现，比较三种免人工标注路线，发现监督迁移失效而文本查询路线一致性显著更强。
AI.motivation: 建筑与街道美学判断服务于建筑设计、城市规划和遗产保护，但实践日益依赖扫描3D模型而非实体材质信息；而自动美学评估仍基本局限于2D照片，缺乏面向点云的稠密逐点美学描述。同时，大规模人工美学标注成本高且存在伦理争议，因此需要评估何种无标注"伪标签"迁移路线真正携带有效信号。
AI.method: 提出三条规避规模化人工标注的迁移路线：(1) 将图像美学模型（NIMA、SAAN）的标量分数"提升"（lifting）到几何点上；(2) 在冻结视觉骨干（DINOv3、TIPS、SigLIP2、PE、RADSeg）上训练AVA回归头，或采用3D原生变体——在前馈AVA重建结果上训练通用点编码器；(3) 以自然语言美学标签查询提升后的视觉-语言特征，取相似度作为分数。此外设计部件感知（part-aware）人工评分协议用于人机对照，并通过从点特征中投影剔除类别-文本方向来净化特征。
AI.result: 两条监督路线迁移效果差：AVA域内拟合的回归头产生互不一致、也不与其他信号相关的建筑类别画像；3D原生探针因重建几何质量差而接近随机水平。文本查询明显更连贯：剔除类别-文本方向后，建筑部件画像的平均跨模型一致性从+0.035升至+0.352，逐点层面从+0.113升至+0.293；通过语义合理性检验的四个骨干相关性为0.31–0.73，未通过者仍为离群值。
AI.conclusion: 文本查询式伪标注是三条路线中唯一具有实质信号的路线，且模型间一致性不等于与人类美学感知一致。作者给出可复现的迁移协议、各伪标注路线的信号判别结论，并将稠密美学伪标签定位为待验证假设而非真值。

title: Demystifying Classifier-Free Guidance for Auto-Regressive Image Generation
summary: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) has been widely adopted in autoregressive (AR) models for high-quality image generation. Despite its strong empirical performance, its mechanism in AR models remains unclear. This paper demystifies the mechanism of CFG through both empirical and theoretical studies. By examining the top-ranked semantics of different components in CFG, we show that texture information is primarily encoded in the difference between the conditional and unconditional logits, whereas both logits share previous-token repetition as their leading semantics. This strong repetition semantics obscures the desired texture information, causing greedy decoding from the conditional logits alone to produce nearly pure-color images. Through a training-dynamics analysis of shallow transformers, we prove that this shared repetition semantics does not arise from limitations or failures of pretraining, but instead originates from the texture sparsity of images. We further show that CFG improves generation quality by rectifying this repetition bias during inference. Motivated by the shared semantics between conditional and unconditional logits, we propose Attention Weight Reuse (AttnReuse), which reuses intermediate attention computations from the conditional-logit forward pass to accelerate the unconditional-logit computation. AttnReuse reduces about $25\%$ of attention computation with little performance degradation across different models.

AI.tldr: 本文通过经验与理论研究揭示自回归模型中无分类器引导(CFG)的机制：条件与无条件logits的差异主要编码纹理信息，而两者共享的领先语义是前文token重复；该重复语义源自图像纹理稀疏性而非预训练失败，CFG通过推理时校正该重复偏置提升生成质量，并据此提出复用条件分支注意力计算的AttnReuse方法。
AI.motivation: CFG在自回归图像生成中经验效果显著，但其作用机制尚不清晰；同时无条件分支的前向计算带来额外开销，需要更有针对性的理解与加速方案。
AI.method: 分析CFG各分量中排名靠前的语义(top-ranked semantics)；对浅层Transformer进行训练动力学分析，从理论上解释共享重复语义的成因；基于条件与无条件logits共享语义的观察，提出Attention Weight Reuse (AttnReuse)，复用条件logit前向过程中的中间注意力计算以加速无条件分支。
AI.result: 纹理信息主要编码于条件与无条件logits之差，而两个logits的首要语义均为前文token重复，掩盖了纹理信息，使得仅从条件logits贪心解码几乎生成纯色图像；理论证明该重复语义源于图像纹理稀疏性；CFG通过推理时校正重复偏置提升生成质量；AttnReuse在多种模型上减少约25%的注意力计算且性能几乎不降。
AI.conclusion: CFG的有效性可归因于其对共享重复偏置的推理时校正，而非额外的生成能力；条件与无条件分支的语义共享为计算复用提供了依据，AttnReuse在保持生成质量的同时显著降低注意力计算成本。

title: Separating Action Allocation from Image Matching in Visual Token Routing
summary: Adaptive visual token routers aim to save computation while preserving the image detail needed to answer each question. A higher average score could reflect better choices for individual images or more frequent use of high resolution on tasks that need it. We distinguish the two by keeping action counts fixed within each task and comparing the router's assignments with random pairings of the same actions and images. On equally weighted ChartQA and TextVQA, both Qwen2.5-VL-3B and -7B gain from matching but lose more from their action frequencies relative to a task table, with a 1.71-point gain and a 3.95-point loss on 7B. Exchanging the continuous resolutions chosen by the external selector CARES also lowers quality on 7B. When requests arrive with task labels, the table outscores the discrete router by 1.92 points and saves 31.76 ms per complete 7B request on average.

AI.tldr: 该文将自适应视觉token路由器的收益分解为"单图匹配质量"与"动作频率选择"两部分，发现路由器的增益主要来自匹配而非频率选择，按任务固定动作预算的查表策略反而优于离散路由器。
AI.motivation: 视觉token路由器的平均分提升可能源于对单张图像做出更优的个性化决策，也可能仅因在需要高分辨率的任务上更频繁地调用高分辨率。二者混淆使得无法判断路由器本身的价值，因此需要一种能分离两者的评估方法。
AI.method: 在每个任务内固定动作计数，将路由器的动作-图像分配与同一批动作和图像的随机配对进行对比，从而隔离"匹配"效应与"频率"效应；在等权重的ChartQA与TextVQA上，对Qwen2.5-VL-3B和7B进行评估，并进一步考察外部选择器CARES所选连续分辨率的交换实验，以及带任务标签时查表策略与离散路由器的比较（含延迟测量）。
AI.result: 1）匹配本身带来正收益，但动作频率分配相对任务查表造成更大损失：7B上匹配增益+1.71分，频率损失−3.95分。2）交换CARES选择的连续分辨率同样降低7B的生成质量。3）在有任务标签时，查表策略比离散路由器高1.92分，且每个完整7B请求平均节省31.76 ms。
AI.conclusion: 现有自适应视觉token路由器的优势主要来自将合适动作匹配到合适图像，而非其动作频率决策；其频率选择甚至劣于简单的按任务查表，且连续分辨率选择器未见收益。带任务标签场景下，轻量查表在质量与效率上均更优。

title: Seeing Through Preferences: Recovering Hidden Local Preference Neighborhoods for Text-to-Image Alignment
summary: Aligning text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models with human preferences typically relies on large-scale pairwise annotations, which are expensive to obtain and provide only sparse supervision. Moreover, not all preference comparisons contribute equally to learning: comparisons between semantically distant images often reveal little about the fine-grained perceptual factors underlying human judgments. We argue that informative supervision can arise from local preference neighborhoods surrounding human-preferred images, where semantically aligned alternatives expose meaningful perceptual and structural differences. Motivated by this observation, we propose PrefLens, a framework that recovers local preference neighborhoods from sparse human feedback. Specifically, PrefLens generates controlled perceptual variations around preferred images that largely retain semantic identity and selects compact sets of informative neighbors in a reward-defined preference space induced by pretrained reward models. By transforming each human preference annotation into a structured neighborhood of informative comparisons, PrefLens enriches supervision without requiring additional human labeling. Our experiments and diagnostic evaluations show that the recovered neighborhoods capture human-relevant preference characteristics and provide effective supervision for preference alignment across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 PrefLens 框架，从稀疏人类偏好标注中恢复“局部偏好邻域”，把单条偏好标注转化为结构化、富含细粒度感知信息的比较集合，在无需额外人工标注的情况下丰富监督信号。
AI.motivation: 现有 T2I 扩散模型偏好对齐依赖大规模成对标注，成本高昂且监督稀疏；同时并非所有偏好比较等价——语义差异大的图像对难以揭示细粒度的感知判断依据。作者认为，围绕人类偏好图像的“局部偏好邻域”中，语义对齐的备选样本能暴露有意义的感知与结构差异，因此是更具信息量的监督来源。
AI.method: PrefLens 先在偏好图像周围生成受控的感知扰动变体，使其基本保持语义一致性；再借助预训练奖励模型构建的、由奖励定义的偏好空间，从中筛选出紧凑且具信息量的邻居集合；从而将每条人类偏好标注转化为结构化的邻域比较，扩充监督而不增加新的人工标注。
AI.result: 实验与诊断性评估表明，恢复出的邻域能够刻画与人类判断相关的偏好特征，并在多种设置下为偏好对齐提供有效监督。
AI.conclusion: 局部偏好邻域是一种低成本、高信息密度的偏好监督形式，可在稀疏标注条件下提升 T2I 偏好对齐效果；PrefLens 为偏好数据的放大与结构化利用提供了可行路径。

title: Ride on Anything: Contact-Coupled Monocular 4D Reconstruction of a Rider and Horse in Camera and World Frames
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Code and interactive results: https://wengzehang.github.io/rideonanything/
summary: We address the reconstruction of a horse and its rider from a single video. When a human estimator and a horse estimator are applied independently, both meshes can fit their silhouettes well while the rider hovers beside or passes through the horse, slides along its back and jitters relative to it. These errors lie along the camera axis and are not visible in the input view. We present Ride on Anything (RoA), a general, training-free methodology for reconstructing a person riding an animal, which couples frozen estimators of the rider and the mount at test time. We instantiate it for horseback riding with SAM 3D Body and 4DEquine. RoA aligns both estimators on a common frame index, projects both subjects through one pixel-isotropic camera initialized from the horse estimator, and jointly optimizes bounded corrections under interaction terms defined in the horse's body frame, including a collision term based on generalized winding numbers that remains valid on the non-watertight horse mesh. The result is lifted to a levelled world frame using the camera rotation from the background and the field of view from MoGe-2. On our riding clips, the raw outputs of the two estimators leave the rider's pelvis 15 cm from the horse's back on average. RoA reduces this seat gap to 1 cm, the drift of the seat along and across the spine by 64% and 89%, the 90th-percentile penetration depth by 57%, and the share of rider surface inside the horse from 12.1% to 7.9%. The motion is markedly smoother (94% lower acceleration of the rider relative to the horse, 80% lower horse jerk), while the rider's silhouette IoU decreases from 0.59 to 0.52. Qualitatively, the rider stays seated on the horse and moves together with it. A quantitative evaluation of 3D accuracy awaits calibrated recordings of ridden animals. We also test a clip outside the task, a horse led on foot, and analyse the failure modes.

AI.tldr: RoA：一种免训练的通用方法，在测试时耦合冻结的人体与动物估计器，从单段视频重建骑手与坐骑的三维网格，并对齐、引入碰撞约束联合优化，将“坐垫间隙”从15 cm降至1 cm、显著降低穿透与抖动。
AI.motivation: 独立运行人体估计器与马匹估计器时，二者各自都能拟合轮廓，但在相机轴向上出现骑手悬空于马旁、穿模、沿马背滑动与相对抖动等误差，这些误差在输入视角下不可见，因此需要一种能在测试时耦合两个主体、消除轴向歧义的重建方法。
AI.method: 方法为免训练、通用的测试时耦合框架：统一两者的帧索引；用马估计器初始化单一像素各向同性相机，将两个主体投影到同一相机；在马体坐标系下定义交互项（含基于广义绕数、适用于非水密马网格的碰撞项），联合优化有界修正量；再利用背景估计的相机旋转与 MoGe-2 的视场角将结果提升到水平世界坐标系。以 SAM 3D Body 与 4DEquine 实例化骑乘场景。
AI.result: 原始输出下骑手骨盆距马背平均15 cm；RoA将坐垫间隙降至1 cm，沿脊柱与横向漂移分别降低64%与89%，90分位穿透深度降低57%，骑手表面位于马体内的比例由12.1%降至7.9%；相对加速度降低94%、马的 jerk 降低80%，运动显著平滑，但骑手轮廓IoU由0.59降至0.52。定性上骑手保持坐姿并与马同步运动。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在不训练估计器的前提下有效缓解相机轴向歧义与主体间交互错误，但以轻微轮廓IoU下降为代价；三维精度定量评测仍需标定录制数据，论文还分析了画面外任务（徒步牵马）案例及其失效模式。

title: HorizonFlow: Few-Step Video Distillation in 600 Iterations
comment: 21 pages, 10 figures, 14 tables, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/XIANGLONGGUO/HorizonFlow-repo
summary: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) enables fast video generation by distilling a multi-step teacher into a few-step student. However, DMD-based methods often suffer from unnatural motion and costly training. We trace these limitations to the DMD gradient, which jointly optimizes appearance, layout, and motion without distinguishing their learning dynamics. Its static component, which carries appearance and layout, has a much higher signal-to-noise ratio than its motion component. As a result, per-frame quality converges within a few hundred iterations, whereas motion lags far behind. Beyond being noisy, the gradient also lacks two signals. (1) Video VAEs encode several frames into one latent frame (four in Wan2.1), and the gradient provides little guidance for spreading motion over these frames, causing periodic stutter. (2) DMD does not constrain the final sampling step to preserve the layout set by earlier steps, so objects merge and drift once the video moves. We propose HorizonFlow, which decouples the correction of motion from that of layout. It keeps the DMD loss and only shifts its regression target, with one training-only correction in the motion component and one in the orthogonal layout component. Chunk Evenness addresses (1) by spreading the motion of each latent chunk evenly over its frames, and Semantic Commitment addresses (2) by anchoring the coarse layout to the teacher's completion of the student's last step. In only 600 iterations, HorizonFlow distills Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B into a 4-step model using 8.4k training samples, 4.6-304$\times$ fewer than prior work. On VBench, HorizonFlow outperforms all released few-step Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B models. The same recipe transfers to Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B, where our student outperforms NVIDIA's distilled model. Code: https://github.com/XIANGLONGGUO/HorizonFlow-repo

AI.tldr: 提出 HorizonFlow，将 DMD 蒸馏中运动与布局的校正解耦，仅用 600 次迭代、8.4k 样本即可把 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 蒸馏为 4 步模型，并在 VBench 上超越所有已开源的少步 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 模型。
AI.motivation: 基于 DMD 的视频蒸馏存在两大问题：生成的运动不自然、训练成本高。作者将其归因于 DMD 梯度同时优化外观、布局与运动却不区分各自的学习动态——静态分量（外观/布局）信噪比远高于运动分量，导致逐帧质量数百次迭代即收敛而运动严重滞后。此外梯度还缺失两类信号：(1) 视频 VAE 将多帧编码为一个 latent 帧（Wan2.1 为 4 帧），梯度缺乏指导运动在这些帧间均匀铺开的信号，造成周期性卡顿；(2) DMD 不约束最后采样步保持前序步骤的布局，视频一旦运动物体便合并、漂移。
AI.method: 保留原 DMD 损失形式，仅平移其回归目标，在运动分量与正交的布局分量上各引入一个仅训练期使用的校正项：Chunk Evenness 将每个 latent chunk 的运动在其对应帧间均匀铺开以解决周期性卡顿；Semantic Commitment 以教师模型对学生最后一步的完成为锚定，约束粗粒度布局以解决物体合并与漂移。
AI.result: 仅 600 次迭代、使用 8.4k 训练样本即完成蒸馏（比先前工作少 4.6–304×）。在 VBench 上优于所有已发布的少步 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 模型；同一配方迁移至 Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B 后，学生模型性能超过 NVIDIA 的蒸馏模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过将运动校正与布局校正解耦、并改正 DMD 梯度缺失的帧间运动均匀性与末步布局保持信号，可在极低训练成本下获得高质量少步视频生成模型，且方法具备跨基座模型的可迁移性。

title: Prompt-Consistent Cross-View Object Geo-Localization
summary: Cross-view object geo-localization (CVOGL) aims to locate an object indicated by a click point in a ground or drone query image within a satellite reference image. Through a quantitative prompt-sensitivity evaluation, we find that existing CVOGL methods suffer from a prompt-disobeying overfitting problem: when the click point is moved or removed, their predictions barely respond, indicating that the models rely on spurious feature correlations rather than genuinely following the prompt semantics. We trace this behavior to the limited scale of the benchmark dataset, which contains only 4,343 prompt-object pairs per task, so that the models simply memorize the object associated with each scene instead of learning the true prompt-to-object correspondence. To address this, we propose two plug-and-play components. First, we construct the CVOGL-MO dataset by expanding the existing training and test sets with diverse multi-object annotations, mitigating the memorization that induces shortcut learning. Second, we propose the Cross-View Co-Scene Multi-Object Contrastive Loss (CVMCL), which enforces distinct feature representations for different click points within the same scene, compelling the model to follow prompt instructions. We further design a prompt-sensitivity evaluation protocol with prediction-shift metrics, providing the first quantitative measurement of prompt-following capability for CVOGL. Both components are architecture-agnostic and can be integrated into existing methods without any architectural modification. Experiments on three representative backbones show that our components substantially improve prompt-following accuracy on the new multi-object test sets and markedly increase prompt sensitivity. Our dataset and code will be publicly released at https://github.com/Sunny-Fresher/CVOGL-MO.

AI.tldr: 论文发现跨视角目标地理定位(CVOGL)模型存在"不遵从提示的过拟合"问题：移动或删除点击点后预测几乎不变，模型依赖虚假特征关联而非提示语义词。为此提出可插拔组件CVOGL-MO数据集与跨视角共景多目标对比损失(CVMCL)，并设计提示敏感性评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现有CVOGL方法存在提示不遵从的过拟合：预测对点击点的移动/移除几乎不响应，说明模型依赖场景-目标的虚假相关而非提示语义。作者将其归因于基准数据规模有限（每任务仅4,343个提示-目标对），导致模型记忆"场景对应目标"而非学习"提示-目标"的真实对应关系。
AI.method: 两个即插即用组件：(1) CVOGL-MO数据集——在现有训练/测试集上扩展多样的多目标标注，缓解诱发捷径学习(shortcut learning)的记忆问题；(2) 跨视角共景多目标对比损失CVMCL——对同一场景内不同点击点强制产生差异化特征表示，迫使模型遵从提示指令。此外设计带预测偏移(prediction-shift)指标的提示敏感性评估协议。两组件与架构无关，无需修改网络结构。
AI.result: 在三个代表性骨干网络上实验表明：组件在新的多目标测试集上显著提升提示遵从准确率，并明显提高提示敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 通过数据集扩展与对比学习约束，可有效缓解CVOGL中的捷径学习与提示不遵从问题；所提评估协议首次实现CVOGL提示遵从能力的定量度量。数据集与代码将公开。

title: CLASP: Complementary Layer Selection and Profiling for Zero-Shot OOD Detection using Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) enable zero-shot out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in medical imaging, yet existing approaches often rely on final-layer confidence or entropy-based layer selection, potentially missing complementary information. We show that low in-distribution (ID) confidence entropy does not reliably predict OOD discrimination. We introduce CLASP (Complementary Layer Selection and Profiling), an ID-only framework that jointly models layer--prompt responses and visual features. CLASP ranks visual encoder layers using Gaussian conditional mutual information and selects a compact subset through anchored spectral selection, without fixing the number of layers. It then combines the selected layer--prompt profiles with PCA-compressed visual embeddings and fits a single shrinkage-regularized Gaussian. OOD scores are computed using squared Mahalanobis distance, without fine-tuning, OOD training data, or test-time adaptation. Across histopathology, chest X-ray, and brain MRI benchmarks with UniMedCLIP and BioMedCLIP, CLASP performs strongly under varied distribution shifts. On MIDOG near-OOD, it achieves 87.54% AUROC with UniMedCLIP, outperforming confidence-based baselines; with BioMedCLIP, it remains competitive but trails visual-only Mahalanobis modeling. Ablations highlight the value of layer--prompt interactions and cross-feature dependencies, while exposing shift-dependent contributions and limitations under semantic shifts.

AI.tldr: 提出仅用ID数据的CLASP框架，联合建模视觉编码器各层-提示响应与视觉特征，实现医学影像零样本OOD检测。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM医学OOD检测多依赖末层置信度或基于熵的层选择，可能遗漏互补信息；作者证明ID置信熵低并不总能可靠预测OOD判别能力，因此需要更合理的层选择与特征利用方式。
AI.method: CLASP采用高斯条件互信息对视觉编码器层排序，并通过锚定谱选择（不预设层数）挑选紧凑层子集；将选中层的层-提示（layer-prompt）剖面与PCA压缩的视觉嵌入拼接，拟合单个收缩正则化高斯；以平方马氏距离作为OOD分数，无需微调、OOD训练数据或测试时自适应。
AI.result: 在组织病理、胸片、脑MRI基准上用UniMedCLIP与BioMedCLIP评测：MIDOG近OOD任务上UniMedCLIP达87.54% AUROC，优于基于置信度的基线；BioMedCLIP下具竞争力但逊于纯视觉马氏距离建模。消融显示层-提示交互与跨特征依赖有效，但贡献随分布漂移类型变化，语义漂移下存在局限。
AI.conclusion: 层-提示联合剖面可提供超越置信度/熵的互补OOD判别信号，且无需OOD监督；但收益依赖漂移类型，语义漂移场景仍是瓶颈。

title: What the Background Hides: Thresholds, Vocabularies and Collisions in Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation
comment: 33 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables. Submitted to Computer Vision and Image Understanding. Code: https://github.com/WendongYao/ovss-background-audit ; data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24338613
summary: Training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) built on CLIP has advanced rapidly, with methods typically ranked by mean intersection-over-union (mIoU) across standard benchmarks. On datasets with a background class, however, implementations rely on per-dataset thresholds and background word lists that are rarely documented or unified (11 of 13 surveyed methods configure per-dataset background decisions). We audit configurations and papers of 13 training-free OVSS methods, re-run seven from official codebases, and compare official settings against a strict unified protocol under pre-registered contracts. The protocol gap depends strongly on the benchmark---ranging from 22.8 mIoU points on PASCAL VOC (VOC21) to 0.1 points (indistinguishable from zero) on ADE20K---and alters pairwise method rankings. Despite large shifts in absolute mIoU, most of the reported improvement of later CLIP-only methods over SCLIP remains under the unified protocol (roughly 79% of the published gain). Decomposing official background handling shows that it combines numeric settings and class-name files whose dominant component reverses across benchmarks, while no tested tuning-free rule transfers reliably across all datasets. Moreover, exact collisions between background words and target names---present in six of seven official COCO-Object configurations through "bed"---make affected classes unpredictable under official post-processing, while the main per-class drops under language-model-generated vocabularies on VOC21 are largely attributable to a few generated terms. We offer reporting recommendations and release our evaluation code, frozen configurations, contracts, and a collision-check tool.

AI.tldr: 该文审计13个免训练开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）方法的背景类处理配置，揭示官方逐数据集阈值/背景词表与统一协议之间存在显著mIoU差距并影响排名，提出报告建议并开源评测工具。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CLIP的免训练OVSS方法普遍依赖未公开、未统一的逐数据集背景阈值与背景词表（13个方法中11个如此配置），导致mIoU比较与排名可能不可比、不可复现。
AI.method: 审计13个免训练OVSS方法的配置与论文，从官方代码库复跑其中7个，在预注册契约下将官方设置与严格统一协议对比；分解官方背景处理的数值设置与类名文件贡献，测试多种免调参规则的跨数据集可迁移性，并检查背景词与类别名的精确碰撞及语言模型生成词表的影响。
AI.result: 协议差距高度依赖基准：VOC21达22.8 mIoU，ADE20K仅0.1（与零不可区分），并改变方法两两排名；但后续纯CLIP方法相对SCLIP的改进约79%在统一协议下仍保留。官方背景处理的主导成分随基准反转，无免调参规则可靠迁移；6/7官方COCO-Object配置存在背景词与类别名碰撞（如"bed"），VOC21上生成词表造成的逐类下降主要归因于少数生成词。
AI.conclusion: 免训练OVSS的绝对mIoU与排名对背景处理协议敏感，需统一并透明报告背景配置；作者给出报告建议并开源评测代码、冻结配置、契约与碰撞检查工具。

title: Where Does a Weight-Editing Agent Help? Blind Diagnosis and Repair of Deployment Faults in Vision Models
summary: Language-model agents can read and edit the weights of neural networks without gradients, and this is increasingly presented as a new way of repairing models. We ask what such an agent adds, in a setting with a known answer. A vision model moved into a new system may be broken by a preprocessing, weight-conversion or output-convention fault; an agent restricted to forward passes must decide whether a fault exists, name it, and undo it by editing the weights. Over 183 runs on classification, segmentation and detection, scored against the fault-free model, we find three things. When the kind of fault is known, the agent is not needed: a script written afterwards repairs 30 of 48 faults against the agent's 33. But the agent did not have to be told: on five fault types outside every script it repairs 15 of 15 where that script repairs 4, and it never edits any of 21 fault-free models. And its limits are predictable: it needs a trustworthy per-layer reference for the model's activations and a fault that is an invertible structured transformation; without them, small faults are missed and repairs stay partial. We derive guidance on when to use an agent and when a script.

AI.tldr: 本文在一个"有已知答案"的受控设定下，检验语言模型智能体通过无梯度权重编辑修复损坏视觉模型的能力，并给出何时用智能体、何时用脚本的判据。
AI.motivation: "语言模型智能体可读取并编辑网络权重、无需梯度"正被宣传为一种新的模型修复方式，但其相对传统脚本修复的实际增量价值尚不清楚。作者希望在故障类型可控、可对照无故障模型的设定下，量化智能体到底带来了什么。
AI.method: 将视觉模型迁移到新系统，并注入预处理、权重转换或输出约定三类故障；智能体仅被允许前向推理，需自行判断是否存在故障、指出故障类型，并通过编辑权重撤销故障。共183次运行，覆盖分类、分割、检测任务，均以无故障模型为评分基准；并与"事后针对已知故障类型编写的脚本"进行对比。
AI.result: 一，故障类型已知时智能体并无必要：事后脚本修复48个故障中的30个，智能体为33个，差距有限；二，智能体无需被告知故障类型：在五种超出脚本覆盖范围的故障类型上，智能体修复15/15，而脚本仅4个；三，智能体对21个无故障模型从未做任何编辑，无误伤；四，其能力边界可预测：需要可信的逐层激活参考，且故障须为可逆的结构化变换，否则会漏检小故障、修复不完整。
AI.conclusion: 智能体的核心价值不在于替代脚本，而在于零先验情况下的故障识别与泛化；其适用条件可明确刻画（有可信逐层参考、故障可逆且结构化）。作者据此提出在何种情形下使用智能体、何种情形下使用脚本的实践指南。

title: Diagnosing Verbalized Confidence in a Medical Vision-Language Model for Selective Prediction on Colorectal Histopathology Patches
comment: 39 pages, 7 figures; supplementary material in ancillary files. Under review at Scientific Reports. Code and artifacts: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23676823
summary: Flagging uncertain histopathology patches for specialist review needs a confidence that is higher when the model is right. We test whether an open medical vision-language model emits one. MedGemma-27b-it and its base Gemma-3-27b-it were run zero-shot under one prompt on 10,004 PathMNIST validation patches and 7,180 patches of a patient-disjoint external cohort. Both are too inaccurate to deploy (40.6% and 35.5%); the object of study is the confidence. MedGemma's verbalized confidence puts 96% of patches at one value; its confidence-correctness AUROC is 0.499 and 0.528, and routing by it moves selective-accuracy AUC by -0.004 and +0.037. Gemma-3 spreads its confidence over nine values, reaches AUROC 0.70, and gains +0.114 and +0.115. MedGemma's label-token probabilities do not rescue it: their validation advantage reverses where the top-20 alternatives include every class. On 1,800-patch subsets of each cohort, stratified on correctness and reweighted to the full splits, agreement across five prompt variants beats random by +0.123 and +0.106, and wording-only paraphrases give +0.100 and, externally and in direction only, +0.054; agreement's external margins over confidence do not survive slide-level clustering. Under one restructured prompt variant, MedGemma's stated confidence routes (+0.112, +0.141), so the failure is tied to a prompt chosen for macro F1.

AI.tldr: MedGemma-27b-it 的言语化置信度几乎不退化为单一取值且与正确性无关，无法用于不确定病理切片的复核分流；提示措辞与多提示一致性是更可靠的信号。
AI.motivation: 将高不确定的病理切片标记出来交专家复核，需要一个"模型答对时更高、答错时更低"的置信度信号。作者检验开源医学视觉语言模型 MedGemma 是否具备这种可信置信度。
AI.method: 零样本、固定单一提示下比较 MedGemma-27b-it 与基座 Gemma-3-27b-it，在 10,004 个 PathMNIST 验证切片与 7,180 个患者不交叉外部队列切片上评测；指标包括置信度分布、置信度—正确性 AUROC、按置信度路由的选择性准确率 AUC；并分析标签 token 概率、多个提示变体的回答一致性（在 1,800 切片子集上按正确性分层并加权回全量）。
AI.result: 两模型精度均过低（40.6%、35.5%），不宜部署。MedGemma 将 96% 切片置于同一置信度值，AUROC 仅 0.499/0.528，路由增益 -0.004/+0.037；Gemma-3 置信度分布跨越 9 个取值，AUROC 0.70，增益 +0.114/+0.115。MedGemma 的标签 token 概率亦无改善，其优势在 top-20 备选含全部类别时反转。五提示一致性优于随机（+0.123/+0.106），仅改措辞的改写为 +0.100，外部仅方向一致 +0.054，且其相对置信度的外部优势在切片级聚类下不成立。改用重构提示后 MedGemma 置信度可路由（+0.112/+0.141）。
AI.conclusion: MedGemma 的置信度失效与为追求 macro F1 而选定的提示强绑定；言语化置信度不可直接用于病理复核分流，多提示一致性和提示重构是更可行的替代信号。

title: Gaze Graphs: A Scene-Level Representation of Visual Attention in the Operating Room
summary: Purpose: Analyzing clinicians' visual attention from exocentric camera views can support surgical scene understanding without requiring wearable eye trackers. However, existing gaze-following research in the operating room (OR) estimates only 2D gaze locations without identifying attended scene entities or localizing gaze targets in 3D space. In this work, we investigate gaze graphs as a scene-level representation of visual attention that connects clinicians to attended scene entities, and evaluate their utility for fine-grained surgical action recognition and semantic scene graph (SSG) generation. Methods: We extend the public EgoExOR dataset with gaze annotations to create EgoExOR-Gaze, the first benchmark for multi-view gaze graph generation in the OR. We propose a novel architecture that jointly estimates 3D gaze targets and predicts attended entities using only exocentric camera views. Specifically, our approach exploits 3D gaze geometry to sample local visual features across multiple views for attended entity prediction. We further utilize predicted gaze graphs for fine-grained surgical action recognition and SSG generation. Results: For gaze graph generation, our model outperforms both exocentric-only and combined exocentric-egocentric baselines. For surgical action recognition, our model incorporating predicted gaze graphs outperforms both exocentric and egocentric baselines across all evaluated metrics, with particularly strong gains in temporal metrics. For SSG generation, incorporating gaze graphs improves macro-F1 from 0.42 to 0.52 compared to exocentric inputs alone, although performance remains below that achieved with egocentric inputs. Conclusion: Our results demonstrate the value of gaze graphs for surgical action recognition and SSG generation, highlighting the importance of explicitly modeling scene-level visual attention even when egocentric views are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出“gaze graph”（注视图）作为手术室场景级视觉注意力表示，在仅用外中心视角的条件下联合估计3D注视目标与受注意实体，并构建EgoExOR-Gaze基准，验证其对细粒度手术动作识别与语义场景图生成的增益。
AI.motivation: 现有手术室注视跟随研究仅估计2D注视点，既不能识别被注视的场景实体，也无法在3D空间定位注视目标；同时希望在不依赖可穿戴眼动仪的前提下，从外中心相机视角理解临床医生的视觉注意力与手术场景。
AI.method: 扩展公开EgoExOR数据集并加入注视标注，构建首个多视角手术室注视图生成基准EgoExOR-Gaze；提出新架构，仅用外中心视角联合估计3D注视目标并预测受注意实体，利用3D注视几何在多视角下采样局部视觉特征用于实体预测；再将预测的注视图用于细粒度手术动作识别与SSG生成。
AI.result: 注视图生成上优于纯外中心基线与外中心-内中心融合基线；动作识别上，引入预测注视图后在所有指标上超过外中心与内中心基线，时间相关指标提升尤为明显；SSG生成上，相比仅外中心输入，macro-F1由0.42提升至0.52，但仍低于内中心输入的表现。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明注视图对手术动作识别与语义场景图生成具有价值，说明即使缺少内中心视角，显式建模场景级视觉注意力仍然重要。

title: 3DCodeFactory: Scaling Training Data for 3D Code Agents
summary: As code agents evolve, their scope is expanding from generating simple static 3D meshes to constructing structurally complete, complex, interactive 3D scenes. However, existing datasets mainly rely on converting or captioning pre-existing 3D assets, consisting mostly of single-turn code data for static single objects and struggling to scale task diversity and scene complexity, leaving such training data scarce. We present 3DCodeFactory, an automated framework that directly constructs diverse, complex 3D training data from abundant raw text (e.g., diffusion prompts and product descriptions). The framework first leverages an image generator to synthesize 3D reference images from raw text as visual anchors, guiding the generation of concrete modeling specifications and interactive functional requirements; meanwhile, it jointly constructs visual, specification, and functional rubrics from the reference images and requirements to automatically score and filter multi-turn agent rollouts. Based on this framework, we release 3DCodeFactory-Data, comprising 5,045 high-quality task instances and multi-turn interaction trajectories. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B on 3DCodeFactory-Data significantly improves performance on BlenderWorld, P3D-Bench, and 3DCodeBench, consistently outperforming models trained on existing open-source 3D code datasets, with our 27B model further surpassing the same-series 2.4T flagship Qwen3.8-Max in overall performance.

AI.tldr: 提出自动化框架 3DCodeFactory，从原始文本构建结构完整、可交互的复杂 3D 场景代码训练数据，并发布 5,045 条高质量任务实例与多轮轨迹，微调后的 9B/27B 模型在三个 3D 代码基准上超越现有开源数据训练模型及同系列旗舰。
AI.motivation: 代码智能体任务已从生成简单静态 3D 网格扩展到构建结构完整、可交互的复杂 3D 场景，但现有数据集多通过转换或标注已有 3D 资产得到，以单轮、单物体静态代码数据为主，任务多样性与场景复杂度难以扩展，导致此类训练数据稀缺。
AI.method: 3DCodeFactory 直接以丰富原始文本（扩散提示词、商品描述等）为源：先用图像生成器由文本合成 3D 参考图像作为视觉锚点，引导生成具体建模规格与交互功能需求；同时基于参考图像与需求联合构建视觉、规格、功能三类评分规则（rubrics），用于自动打分与筛选多轮智能体 rollout，从而完成数据构建与过滤。
AI.result: 发布 3DCodeFactory-Data，含 5,045 个高质量任务实例及多轮交互轨迹。在 3DCodeFactory-Data 上微调 Qwen3.5-9B 与 Qwen3.8-27B，在 BlenderWorld、P3D-Bench、3DCodeBench 上性能显著提升，一致优于在现有开源 3D 代码数据集上训练的模型；27B 模型整体表现进一步超过同系列 2.4T 旗舰 Qwen3.8-Max。
AI.conclusion: 以文本为源头、参考图像为视觉锚点、多维评分规则驱动的自动化数据构建与过滤流程，可有效规模化生成复杂交互式 3D 场景代码训练数据，并带来显著且可迁移的模型能力提升，为 3D 代码智能体训练数据瓶颈提供可行解法。

title: Imagine Smarter, Drive Faster: Efficient World Modeling for Decision-Aware Autonomous Driving
comment: 23 pages total, 8 pages main text (4 figures, 8 tables), 12 pages supplementary material (9 figures, 5 tables)
summary: World models hold great promise for autonomous driving planning, yet their ability to imagine the future often comes at a formidable computational cost. Efficiency efforts, such as knowledge distillation and domain-specific pre-training, often shift this burden to costly teachers or training pipelines, leaving lightweight world modeling an open challenge. We introduce FastWorld, a natively lightweight world-model framework for efficient autonomous driving planning. FastWorld reduces computation through compact scene representations, short-horizon action-conditioned prediction, and selective candidate verification and score refinement. These designs support efficient future-informed planning without teacher distillation or additional domain-specific pre-training. On NAVSIMv1, FastWorld achieves 92.2 PDMS at 132 FPS on a single 4090 GPU. It also achieves 89.4 EPDMS on NAVSIMv2 and an average L2 of 0.40 over 3 seconds at 17 FPS on nuScenes. Code and models can be found at https://github.com/MoyangSensei/FastWorld.

AI.tldr: 提出 natively lightweight 的世界模型框架 FastWorld，无需教师蒸馏或领域预训练，在 NAVSIMv1 上以 132 FPS 达 92.2 PDMS。
AI.motivation: 世界模型对自动驾驶规划很有前景，但"想象未来"的计算开销巨大；现有的提效手段（知识蒸馏、领域特定预训练）只是把负担转移到昂贵的教师模型或训练流程上，轻量化世界建模仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 三项设计：紧凑场景表示（compact scene representation）、短时域动作条件预测（short-horizon action-conditioned prediction）、选择性候选验证与分数精修（selective candidate verification and score refinement）；整体为原生轻量化框架，不依赖教师蒸馏与额外领域预训练。
AI.result: NAVSIMv1：92.2 PDMS，单张 4090 上 132 FPS；NAVSIMv2：89.4 EPDMS；nuScenes：3 秒平均 L2 误差 0.40，17 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 轻量化世界模型可在不引入蒸馏或额外预训练的前提下实现高精度与高帧率的未来感知规划，为高效自动驾驶规划提供可行范式。

title: JevNavAgent: A Single-Forward Visual Navigation Agent with Trajectory-Level RL for Gigapixel Pathology
summary: Gigapixel whole-slide images (WSIs) exceed single-pass vision-language model (VLM) capacity at cellular resolution, while multiple instance learning relies on query-agnostic offline patching without interactive reasoning. Multi-step VLM navigation agents inspect regions on demand, yet face two bottlenecks: (1) autoregressive action decoding incurs heavy latency, throttling exploration and online multi-trajectory RL; and (2) offline distillation suffers from an existential-versus-universal stopping asymmetry between positive detection and negative exclusion, inducing thumbnail and kinematic shortcuts while leaving policies prone to passing metastases without stopping. Under the Jev (System One) paradigm, a model predicts distributions over predefined decision spaces in one forward pass (0 generated tokens) while deterministic code executes navigation. We build JevNavAgent, a 2B-parameter agent combining factorized stopping, spatial-candidate, and contextual-bilinear answer heads with overview modality dropout. We pair Stage-1 offline counterfactual trajectory alignment (mitigating depth and panning shortcuts) with Stage-2 online trajectory-level GRPO (Traj-GRPO), using decoding-free rollouts to optimize branch-level lesion discovery, in-polygon stopping, and step-wise confidence gain. On Clean Visual WSI-VQA, JevNavAgent achieves 51.57% multi-scale (50.43% terminal-step) overall and 51.39% focal accuracy, outperforming frontier VLM agents and 4B-11B open-source cascades while running nearly 12x faster than frontier APIs (5.63s vs. 66.64-70.04s). On CAMELYON16 Official Test, Traj-GRPO reaches 22.45% localization (converting 11/12, or 91.7%, of visited tumors into grounded stops) with 93.75% specificity and 69.77% slide accuracy, surpassing Stage-1 SFT under matched stopping rules alongside zero-shot budget scaling.

AI.tldr: JevNavAgent 是一个 2B 参数的全切片图像（WSI）导航智能体，采用 System One 范式在一次前向中预测决策分布（0 生成 token），结合离线反事实轨迹对齐与在线 Traj-GRPO，在多尺度 WSI-VQA 与 CAMELYON16 上以近 12 倍加速取得优于前沿 VLM 智能体的性能。
AI.motivation: 千兆像素 WSI 超出单次 VLM 处理能力；多实例学习依赖查询无关的离线切块，缺乏交互推理；多步导航智能体存在两大瓶颈：自回归动作解码延迟高，限制探索与在线多轨迹 RL；离蒸馏存在“存在性—普适性”停止不对称，导致缩略图与运动学捷径，策略易漏检转移灶。
AI.method: 提出 Jev（System One）范式：模型一次前向预测预定义决策空间上的分布（不生成任何 token），由确定性代码执行导航。构建 JevNavAgent，融合因子化停止头、空间候选头与上下文双线性答案头，并引入概览模态 dropout。训练分两阶段：Stage-1 离线反事实轨迹对齐（缓解深度与平移捷径）+ Stage-2 在线轨迹级 GRPO（Traj-GRPO），以无解码 rollout 优化分支级病灶发现、多边形内停止与逐步置信增益。
AI.result: Clean Visual WSI-VQA 上多尺度总体 51.57%（终步 50.43%）、焦点准确率 51.39%，优于前沿 VLM 智能体与 4B–11B 开源级联，且比前沿 API 快近 12 倍（5.63s vs 66.64–70.04s）。CAMELYON16 官方测试上 Traj-GRPO 定位率 22.45%（将 11/12，即 91.7% 的已访问肿瘤转化为有依据停止），特异性 93.75%，切片准确率 69.77%，在相同停止规则下优于 Stage-1 SFT，并具备零样本预算伸缩能力。
AI.conclusion: 解码无关的 System One 决策分布预测可有效规避自回归延迟与离线蒸馏的停止不对称，结合反事实对齐与轨迹级 GRPO 实现高效、可解释且可预算伸缩的 WSI 导航，在精度与延迟上同时优于前沿 VLM 智能体。

title: A colour-marker tracker for pose estimation of slender surgical instruments: vision-language-model-guided adaptive colour calibration
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Extended version of a manuscript submitted to a journal
summary: Slender surgical instruments need small, narrow markers for camera-based pose estimation. A colour-stripe marker fits this requirement, but its colours in the image drift from the design values with lighting, printing and camera settings. Because the colours can only be corrected after the marker has been found, methods that rely on the design colours face a circular problem. We propose vision-language-model (VLM)-based adaptive colour calibration and compare it with two rule-based methods, which re-measure the colours from detections made with the design colours: Initial colour update does so once after tracking starts, and Colour adaptation continuously during tracking. VLM guidance uses a fine-tuned VLM to find the markers without relying on the design colours and builds the colour profile from their pixels. Recall/F1 (%) for Initial colour update, Colour adaptation and VLM guidance were 92.0/95.7, 87.8/93.3 and 98.2/99.1 on 672 synthetic image pairs; 51.3/67.2, 48.8/65.0 and 83.8/87.0 on eight degraded laboratory videos; and 38.9/55.2, 19.7/29.7 and 100/100 on a surgical-robot (da Vinci) video with strongly shifted colours. In that video the rule-based methods never found the purple/cyan marker, whereas VLM guidance found all 234 markers with no false positives. In a simulation, the hue boundary between the two stripes moved by less than 0.1 pixel for exposure gains of 0.5-2.0, compared with 2.9-4.0 pixels for a boundary found with a fixed brightness threshold. When the degradation is mild, the rule-based methods, which need no training and no GPU, are sufficient. When the colours change greatly, the gain comes from a VLM-guided candidate search that does not rely on the design colours. Combining colour-stripe markers with adaptive colour calibration enables tracking of slender surgical instruments with small markers.

AI.tldr: 提出基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的自适应颜色校准方法，解决细长手术器械彩色条纹标记因光照、打印和相机设置导致的颜色漂移问题，并系统对比两种基于规则的颜色更新方法。
AI.motivation: 细长手术器械需要小而窄的标记用于基于相机的位姿估计，彩色条纹标记虽满足尺寸要求，但其成像颜色会随光照、打印与相机设置偏离设计值。由于颜色只能在标记被检出后才能校正，依赖设计颜色的方法存在"先有鸡还是先有蛋"的循环困境。
AI.method: 提出VLM引导的自适应颜色校准：用微调后的VLM在不依赖设计颜色的情况下定位标记，并基于其像素构建颜色轮廓。对比两种规则方法——初始颜色更新（跟踪开始后一次性重测颜色）与颜色自适应（跟踪过程中持续更新），二者均基于按设计颜色得到的检测结果重新测量颜色。
AI.result: Recall/F1（%）：672组合成图像对上，初始更新、颜色自适应、VLM引导分别为92.0/95.7、87.8/93.3、98.2/99.1；八段退化实验室视频上为51.3/67.2、48.8/65.0、83.8/87.0；颜色强烈偏移的达芬奇手术机器人视频上为38.9/55.2、19.7/29.7、100/100，其中规则方法从未检出紫/青色标记，而VLM引导检出全部234个标记且无假阳性。仿真中，曝光增益0.5–2.0时VLM方案两条纹色相边界漂移小于0.1像素，固定亮度阈值则为2.9–4.0像素。
AI.conclusion: 轻度退化时，无需训练与GPU的规则方法已足够；颜色变化剧烈时，收益来自不依赖设计颜色的VLM引导候选搜索。彩色条纹标记结合自适应颜色校准可实现小标记下细长手术器械的跟踪。

title: PINE: Point, Instance and Normal Estimation in One-Step Diffusion Model
summary: Understanding a scene requires both geometry and semantics: geometry recovers its spatial structure, and semantics separates it into objects. Current models obtain the two from separate networks or separate passes. We present PINE, a one-step Omni Diffusion Transformer that predicts the point map, the surface normals, and the instance map of an image in one forward pass. PINE treats each map as a token stream, and a stream mask decides which streams interact. A camera-aware ray encoding positions every token by its camera ray rather than its pixel. Grounding attention adds the affinity of pretrained DINOv3 features to the attention logits. Trained on only 139K synthetic images for geometry, PINE achieves state-of-the-art point maps whether or not intrinsics are given and the best average rank on surface normals. It also exceeds SAM on large objects with less than 1 percent of its training images, and it predicts all three maps 5.7x faster than MoGe-3 with SAM.

AI.tldr: PINE是一个单步Omni Diffusion Transformer，通过一次前向传播同时预测图像的点图、表面法线与实例图，在几何与语义任务上均取得领先或极具竞争力的结果，且速度显著更快。
AI.motivation: 理解场景需要几何（恢复空间结构）与语义（分割物体）两方面信息，而现有模型通常依赖分离的网络或分离的多轮推理来获得这两类输出，效率低且不统一。
AI.method: PINE将每种图视为一个token流，用stream mask决定哪些流之间交互；采用相机感知的射线编码，按相机射线而非像素位置对每个token进行定位；引入grounding attention，将预训练DINOv3特征的亲和度加入注意力logits；仅在约139K张合成图像上训练几何部分。
AI.result: 无论是否给定内参，PINE均取得最先进的点图结果，表面法线平均排名最佳；在大物体上超过SAM，而训练图像不足其1%；预测三张图的速度比MoGe-3加SAM快5.7倍。
AI.conclusion: 统一的一次性生成架构可同时高质量地完成几何与语义预测，兼具精度与效率优势，验证了多流token交互与相机射线编码设计的有效性。

title: SpectralGS: Spectral Gaussian Splatting for Unsupervised Spectral Super-Resolution
summary: Unsupervised spectral super-resolution aims to recover spectral information from RGB images without paired hyperspectral data. However, the limited spectral information in RGB observations makes learning an effective spatial-spectral representation challenging, requiring the incorporation of structured spectral modeling with sensor imaging. In this paper, we propose SpectralGS, a spectral Gaussian splatting framework comprising two components: Shared Spectral Gaussian Representation and Spectral Response Projection Rendering. The representation module constructs a continuous spatial-spectral representation via shared spectral and local spatial Gaussian primitives, exploiting the low-rank spectral structure of hyperspectral images. The rendering module utilizes the spectral response function (SRF) to apply integral projection to the continuous representation, blending it to generate an RGB image. Consistency between the rendered and observed RGB images provides training supervision. Our main contribution is a Gaussian splatting framework that integrates structured continuous spatial-spectral representation with imaging response-based rendering, enabling unsupervised spectral reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms current state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出SpectralGS——一个结合共享光谱高斯表示与光谱响应投影渲染的无监督光谱超分辨框架，利用HSI低秩结构构建连续空谱表示，并通过SRF积分投影渲染RGB实现自监督训练，性能超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: RGB观测中光谱信息有限，难以学习有效的空谱表示，且需将结构化光谱建模与传感器成像过程结合，以支撑无配对高光谱数据下的无监督重建。
AI.method: 框架含两模块：(1) 共享光谱高斯表示，以共享光谱基元与局部空间高斯基元构建连续空谱表示，利用高光谱图像的低秩光谱结构；(2) 光谱响应投影渲染，用光谱响应函数（SRF）对连续表示做积分投影并混合生成RGB图像，以渲染RGB与观测RGB的一致性作为监督。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 将结构化连续空谱表示与基于成像响应的渲染相统一的高斯溅射框架，可实现无监督光谱重建，验证了“表示—成像”耦合建模的有效性。

title: Scenario Compliant Indoor Pedestrian Trajectory Reconstruction from Partial Observation
summary: Pedestrian trajectory reconstruction is vital for applications ranging from security surveillance to indoor navigation. While existing probabilistic and generative frameworks have shown success in outdoor GPS-based trajectory imputation, they often fail in indoor settings where movement is strictly governed by dense geometric constraints such as walls and corridors. Standard models typically treat trajectories as unconstrained coordinate sequences, leading to physically infeasible paths with high collision rates. To address this, we propose a map-conditioned generative framework based on conditional diffusion models. Our approach explicitly integrates dense scenario maps as structured spatial inputs via a CNN-based encoder, allowing environmental geometry to guide the iterative denoising process. Furthermore, we employ an endpoint-aware mechanism by embedding observations (start and end points) directly into the scenario map, providing critical spatial anchors through image-level features. Experiments on simulated indoor trajectories and the real-world Shopper trajectory dataset, with three training seeds, show that our method achieves the lowest errors among the compared generative methods. Scene conditioning reduces the collision and invalid rates by 19\% and 46\% on the simulated dataset, whereas on real shopper data the gains are consistent but small, mainly because the model rarely learns to route around obstacles between the endpoints. Compared with a shortest-path planner, which never collides, our method better captures the variability of real motion (31\% lower CRPS), but the timing of stops is reconstructed only partially. These results show that explicit environmental context improves physical consistency, while reconstructing realistic human motion in real indoor spaces remains challenging. Our code is available at https://github.com/dang-qi/trajectory_reconstruction

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于条件扩散模型的场景地图条件生成框架，用CNN编码稠密室内地图并将起止点嵌入地图作为空间锚点，引导去噪过程，显著降低碰撞与无效轨迹率，但真实数据上避障绕行与停留时序重建仍有不足。
AI.motivation: 室内行人的移动受墙壁、走廊等稠密几何约束严格限制，而现有概率/生成式轨迹插补方法多面向室外GPS场景，将轨迹视为无约束坐标序列，导致生成路径物理不可行、碰撞率高。论文希望显式引入环境几何先验以提升轨迹的物理一致性。
AI.method: 构建基于条件扩散模型的、以地图为条件的生成式框架。使用CNN编码器将稠密场景地图作为结构化空间输入融入去噪网络，使环境几何指导迭代去噪；同时采用端点感知机制，将观测到的起点与终点直接嵌入场景地图，以图像级特征形式提供空间锚点。
AI.result: 在仿真室内轨迹与真实Shopper轨迹数据集上，各用3个训练种子，本方法在所比较的生成式方法中误差最低。场景条件使仿真数据上的碰撞率与无效率分别下降19%和46%；真实购物者数据上收益一致但幅度较小，主要因为模型很少学会在端点之间绕开障碍物路由。与从不碰撞的最短路径规划器相比，本方法更好地刻画真实运动的多样性（CRPS低31%），但对停留时序的重建仅为部分成功。
AI.conclusion: 显式环境上下文能有效提升轨迹的物理一致性，但在真实室内空间中重建符合实际的人类运动仍具挑战性。

title: Beyond Attention Maps: Understanding and Improving Medical MLLMs via Visual Values
summary: Current MLLM methods largely focus on whether models attend to the right visual regions, implicitly treating spatial attention map as the primary key of effective visual perception. To examine this assumption, we introduce a medical VQA dataset with paired non-contrast (NC) and contrast-enhanced (CE) images that share corresponding anatomy while providing different cues. We show that this view is incomplete: across paired NC and CE medical images, MLLMs often exhibit similar attention patterns despite producing contrasting answers, while controlled bidirectional interventions induce substantially larger prediction changes on visual values than attention weights. These results identify the visual content retrieved through values as a critical factor in improving perception beyond spatial attention alone. Guided by this finding, we propose VIVID (VIsual Value Intervention Distillation), which uses enhanced visual values to identify and refine teacher corrections aligned with useful visual evidence to improve on-policy distillation from CE to NC images. Across six internal and external test sets, VIVID consistently outperforms existing on-policy distillation methods across different model scales and architectures, requires only NC images at inference, and maintains strong zero-shot performance on general-domain VQA benchmarks. The project page is available at https://qiuzyc.github.io/VIVID.

AI.tldr: 本文提出配对的NC/CE医学VQA数据集，证明MLLM视觉感知瓶颈不止于空间注意力，更在于通过value检索到的视觉内容；据此提出VIVID（视觉Value干预蒸馏），用增强图像提升NC图像上的on-policy蒸馏效果。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM方法多默认"注意力图对准正确视觉区域"即等同于有效视觉感知，忽略了注意力权重之外的因素。作者希望检验这一假设是否完整。
AI.method: 构建配对非增强(NC)与对比增强(CE)医学VQA数据集（解剖结构对应、视觉线索不同），进行注意力和双向干预（attention weights vs. visual values）的受控实验；基于发现提出VIVID：利用增强视觉value识别并筛选与有用视觉证据对齐的教师纠正，改进去往NC图像的on-policy蒸馏。
AI.result: NC/CE配对图像上MLLM常表现出相似注意力模式却给出对比性答案；对visual values的干预引起的预测变化显著大于对attention weights的干预。VIVID在六个内部与外部测试集上一致优于现有on-policy蒸馏方法，跨模型规模与架构有效，推理时仅需NC图像，并在通用域VQA上保持较强zero-shot性能。
AI.conclusion: 空间注意力不是有效视觉感知的唯一关键，value通道检索的视觉内容是更关键的改进点；以value为核心的蒸馏策略在实际医学VQA与泛化场景中均获验证。

title: Probe Before You Learn: Allocating Prompts from Initial Gradients under Label Noise
summary: Prompt learning provides a parameter-efficient way to adapt pretrained vision--language models through text and visual prompts, but noisy labels prevalent in real-world data inevitably bias prompt updates and thereby undermine adaptation effectiveness. Prior work on robust prompt learning focuses on suppressing unreliable updates under noisy supervision. We uncover a pivotal yet overlooked aspect--prompt allocation: shifting the parameter budget between text and visual prompts can substantially enhance robustness while keeping the training objective and total budget fixed. However, suitable prompt allocations vary across tasks and are unknown a priori, rendering brute-force candidate training computationally prohibitive. We propose GPrompt, a training-free method that derives allocation between text and visual prompts using only loss gradients at initialization before prompt optimization. Using a small sample of images and generated pseudo-labels as shared supervision, GPrompt performs an initialization probe to extract paired text and visual loss gradients, and characterizes the geometry of their trace-normalized Gram matrices through both concentration within each modality and overlap between modalities. GPrompt then derives a closed-form allocation, and projects it onto feasible prompt counts under the exact parameter budget, enabling task-specific selection without training candidate configurations. Experiments across eleven datasets show that GPrompt outperforms the strongest baseline by up to 7.75% while selecting configurations close to the best allocation identified through exhaustive training. The average runtime of gradient probe across datasets is 99.9% lower than that of exhaustive candidate training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 GPrompt，一种无需训练的方法，通过在初始化阶段利用损失梯度确定文本提示与视觉提示之间的参数预算分配，从而提升提示学习在噪声标签下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 真实数据中的噪声标签会偏置提示更新，削弱提示学习（prompt learning）的适应效果；已有鲁棒提示学习工作集中于抑制不可靠更新，而忽视了文本提示与视觉提示之间参数预算分配（prompt allocation）这一关键因素。
AI.method: GPrompt 在提示优化前的初始化阶段，仅用小样本图像与生成的伪标签作为共享监督，进行一次初始化探针，提取成对的文本与视觉损失梯度；通过对迹归一化 Gram 矩阵的几何特性（模态内集中度与模态间重叠度）刻画，推导出闭式分配解，并在精确参数预算下投影到可行的提示数量上。
AI.result: 在 11 个数据集上，GPrompt 相比最强基线最高提升 7.75%，且所选配置接近穷举训练得到的最优分配；梯度探针的平均运行时间比穷举候选训练低 99.9%。
AI.conclusion: 提示分配是提升鲁棒性的被忽视但关键维度；GPrompt 以无需训练、低成本的方式实现任务自适应分配，兼具性能与效率优势。

title: SKIA: Spatial-Knowledge Informed Attention for Robust Remote Photoplethysmography under Lower-Face Motion Artifacts
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables contactless physiological monitoring from facial videos, but facial motion, particularly mouth and jaw movements during cognitive and communicative tasks, can severely degrade signal reconstruction. We present SKIA, a lightweight, mask-guided framework that suppresses motion-prone lower-face regions while preserving physiological cues from the forehead and cheeks. Using the UBFC-rPPG benchmark, we first investigate static lower-face suppression in the classical CHROM pipeline. Static masking improves waveform Pearson correlation from 0.3507 to 0.4166 (p < 0.001) and reduces heart-rate mean absolute error (MAE) from 33.50 to 23.44 bpm. Building on this finding, we introduce SKIA-Net, a compact spatiotemporal architecture that combines raw facial frames, statically masked representations, and temporal motion differences to reconstruct blood volume pulse (BVP) waveforms. The full model achieves a Pearson correlation of 0.7522 and a heart-rate MAE of 3.73 bpm on UBFC-rPPG, outperforming single-stream variants. Ablation studies show that the static mask provides complementary information to raw appearance and that static anatomical priors outperform the tested dynamic optical-flow-based masking strategy. These results suggest that spatially informed, temporally stable masking can improve motion-robust rPPG estimation. Code: https://github.com/lee-vtruong/SKIA-rPPG

AI.tldr: SKIA：一种轻量级掩膜引导框架，通过抑制易受运动干扰的下半脸区域、保留额头与脸颊的生理线索，提升运动鲁棒的远程光电容积脉搏波（rPPG）估计性能。
AI.motivation: rPPG 可从面部视频实现无接触生理监测，但面部运动（尤其认知与交流任务中的嘴部、下颌运动）会严重破坏信号重建质量，因此需要抑制运动伪影来源区域。
AI.method: 先在经典 CHROM 流程中研究静态下半脸抑制；再提出 SKIA-Net，一种紧凑的时空架构，融合原始面部帧、静态掩膜表示与时间运动差分三类输入以重建 BVP 波形；并进行单流对比、消融及与传统动态光流掩膜策略的比较。
AI.result: UBFC-rPPG 上，静态掩膜使波形 Pearson 相关从 0.3507 提升至 0.4166（p < 0.001），心率 MAE 从 33.50 降至 23.44 bpm；完整 SKIA-Net 达到 Pearson 0.7522、心率 MAE 3.73 bpm，优于单流变体，且静态解剖先验优于所测试的动态光流掩膜策略。
AI.conclusion: 空间上具有先验信息、时间上稳定的掩膜策略可有效提升运动鲁棒的 rPPG 估计；静态掩膜为原始外观提供互补信息，代码已开源。

title: ContinuLoc: Continuous Pose Inference over Neural Fields for UAV Geo-Localization
summary:
Cross-view UAV geo-localization involves three design choices: how to represent the UAV observation, how to represent the geo-referenced map, and how to infer pose from their interaction. The dominant paradigm organizes the map as a discretized 2DoF candidate library, coupling map representation to pose inference and thus bounding spatial localization precision by candidate sampling resolution. We decouple map representation from pose inference by encoding the geo-referenced map as a continuously queryable semantic neural field, enabling localization to be formulated as explicit optimization over a continuous 4DoF pose space parameterized by 2D ground position, in-plane heading, and viewing scale. Pose hypotheses are evaluated on demand using global descriptors in a shared semantic feature space, bypassing the sampling bottleneck of retrieval. We learn 4DoF pose-sensitive visual representations under full 4DoF supervision provided by ContinuScenes, a multi-city benchmark with dense near-nadir UAV imagery and complete pose annotations. Inference proceeds hierarchically, progressing from broad pose-space coverage to adaptive concentration on high-compatibility regions. Experiments demonstrate substantial gains over representative localization paradigms under progressively stricter 4DoF accuracy criteria.
  Code is available at https://github.com/ZhouWeikun/ContinuLoc/

AI.tldr: 本文将地理参考地图编码为可连续查询的语义神经场，把跨视角UAV地理定位从"离散候选库检索"重构为连续4DoF位姿空间上的显式优化，摆脱候选采样分辨率对定位精度的绑定，并提出ContinuScenes基准与层次化推理。
AI.motivation: 主流跨视角地理定位范式把地图组织成离散的2DoF候选库，将地图表示与位姿推断耦合在一起，导致空间定位精度被候选采样分辨率上界所限制；同时位姿仅覆盖2DoF，无法表达旋转与尺度等自由度。
AI.method: 三方面设计：1）地图表示——将地图编码为连续可查询的语义神经场，使地图表示与位姿推断解耦；2）位姿推断——定位被表述为连续4DoF（2D地面位置、平面内朝向、观察尺度）空间上的显式优化，位姿假设按需在共享语义特征空间中用全局描述子评估，绕过检索式采样瓶颈；3）表示学习与数据——在ContinuScenes（多城市、密集近垂直UAV影像、完整位姿标注）提供的全4DoF监督下学习位姿敏感的视觉表示；推理采用由粗到细的层次化策略，从广域覆盖逐步自适应聚焦高兼容区域。
AI.result: 在逐步收紧的4DoF精度准则下，相比代表性定位范式取得显著性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 将地图表示为连续神经场并把定位改写为连续4DoF优化，可有效解除采样分辨率对精度的约束，配合全4DoF监督与层次化搜索构成可行且更精确的跨视角UAV地理定位框架。

title: DriveOddsBench: Are Driving Video World Models Aligned with Real-World Odds?
comment: 22 pages, 16 figures, 8 tables. Project page: https://hhjj233.github.io/DriveOddsBench-page/ Code: https://github.com/hhjj233/DriveOddsBench
summary: Video world models predict how a scene will evolve, and their sampled futures are increasingly used in place of the real one, from planning to simulation. These uses assume that the samples are aligned with real-world odds, with each future appearing among them as often as it would follow the same history in reality, yet current evaluations only score how real each sample looks. Testing this assumption on real driving data is hard for three reasons. Each recorded history has only one real future, so the true probabilities are unknown. Physical quantities must be read from video, where reading errors can look like model errors. Finally, the many possible analyses invite selective reporting. We introduce DriveOddsBench, a pre-registered benchmark that addresses all three. First, if the samples follow the real distribution, the rank of the real outcome among them is uniform in every history, so pooled ranks test them without probability labels. Second, one validated instrument reads the same quantities, such as the lead-vehicle gap and the ego motion, from the generated futures and from the real future, which first passes through the world model's autoencoder so that both are read alike. Third, all confirmatory analyses were frozen before any test clip was measured. We test eleven general and driving world models on 200 held-out Argoverse 2 histories in five scenario families, with 35,200 generated futures. None is aligned, and every model underestimates its uncertainty. The real outcome falls outside the range of all 16 samples in 28-61% of cases instead of the 11.8% expected under the real distribution. Five models are significantly skewed, in opposite directions, and the largest errors are in the ego motion. Nine models beat climatology without being aligned, and among these models neither type nor scale predicts which comes closest.

AI.tldr: 提出预注册基准DriveOddsBench，用秩统计检验视频世界模型采样未来是否与真实分布对齐；11个模型在200条Argoverse 2历史、35,200个生成未来上均未对齐，且普遍低估不确定性。
AI.motivation: 世界模型采样的未来被用于规划与仿真，隐含假设"样本频率=真实发生概率"，但现有评估只打"样本像不像真实"，从不检验概率校准；而真实驾驶数据上难以检验，原因有三：每条历史只有一个真实未来（无概率标签）、物理量需从视频读出（读数误差混淆模型误差）、分析维度多易选择性报告。
AI.method: 1）分布自由检验：若样本服从真实分布，真实结果在16个样本中的秩在每条历史上均匀分布，因此汇总秩无需概率标签即可检验；2）统一测量仪器：用同一验证过的工具从生成未来与真实未来中读取前车间距、自车运动等量（真实未来先过世界模型的autoencoder，保证读数方式一致）；3）预注册：所有确证性分析在测量任何测试片段前冻结。11个通用与驾驶世界模型、5类场景族。
AI.result: 无一模型对齐，全部低估不确定性：真实结果落在全部16个样本范围之外的比例为28–61%，而真实分布下期望仅11.8%；5个模型显著偏斜且方向相反；误差最大处为自车运动；9个模型优于气候学基线但未对齐，且模型类型与规模都不能预测谁更接近对齐。
AI.conclusion: "看起来真实"不等同于"概率正确"：当前视频世界模型普遍无法校准其采样分布，且可靠性不可由模型类型或规模推断；需将分布对齐（秩校准）作为标准评估维度。

title: MM-DataLoop: Closing the Data-Side Loop for Recursive Self-Improvement in MLLM Post-Training
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a path toward improving models through repeated evaluation and revision. We study its data side in multimodal language model (MLLM) post-training, where heterogeneous operations and cross-round evidence must be coordinated. MMDataLoop organizes data interventions into five operation families and connects them through an Observe-Diagnose-Plan-Execute-Verify-Reflect cycle with shared rule memory. Across 34 candidate rounds on Qwen3.5-0.8B and five benchmarks, we hold the base initialization, shared training schedule and evaluation protocol fixed while varying data recipes. The five-benchmark mean reaches 63.04 at R33, up 5.32 points from the zero-shot baseline; R29, R32, and R33 form a close top cluster within 0.09 points. In eightcandidate comparisons, guided search reaches the preselected target in six candidates and identifies the top observed candidate, while random arms show higher means and lower dispersion. The selected R29 recipe also scores above two full-pool baselines under the same epoch schedule. Together, these findings establish MM-DataLoop as a traceable workflow and provide an empirical basis for studying how data-side decisions shape outcomes across MLLM post-training recipes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MM-DataLoop，将多模态语言模型后训练中的"数据侧递归自我改进"组织为五类操作族，并以 ODPEV-R（观察-诊断-规划-执行-验证-反思）循环配合共享规则记忆串联。在 Qwen3.5-0.8B、五个基准、34 轮候选配方上固定初始化与训练评估协议，仅变动数据配方；五基准均值在 R33 达 63.04（较零样本 +5.32），R29/R32/R33 构成 0.09 分内的紧密头部簇；八候选对比中引导式搜索 6/8 命中预设目标并识别出观测最优候选，而随机臂表现为均值更高、离散度更低；最终选定的 R29 配方在同 epoch 计划下亦优于两个全池基线。
AI.motivation: RSI 通常被用于模型能力的迭代提升，但其"数据侧"作用机制研究不足：MLLM 后训练涉及异质数据操作（采样、清洗、配比、标注、难度调度等），且需跨轮次证据协调，缺乏可追溯的流程框架与实证依据，难以判断数据决策如何影响最终效果。
AI.method: 提出 MM-DataLoop：将数据干预归纳为五个操作族，通过 Observe-Diagnose-Plan-Execute-Verify-Reflect 六阶段循环驱动，并以共享规则记忆（rule memory）复用跨轮经验。实验控制变量设计：固定基座初始化、统一训练计划与评测协议，仅在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 上变化数据配方，遍历 34 轮候选；另做 8 候选的引导式搜索 vs 随机搜索对照，以及与两个全池（full-pool）基线在同 epoch 计划下的比较。
AI.result: 五基准均值 R33 为 63.04，较零样本基线提升 5.32 分；R29、R32、R33 构成差距 ≤0.09 分的头部簇，提示性能进入平台期。8 候选对照中，引导式搜索在 6 个候选中达到预设目标并成功定位观测最优候选；随机臂均值更高但方差更小。选定的 R29 配方在相同 epoch 计划下优于两个全池基线。
AI.conclusion: MM-DataLoop 可作为一种可追溯的数据侧 RSI 工作流，为研究数据决策如何塑造 MLLM 后训练配方效果提供实证基础。同时结果也暴露出需谨慎解读之处：引导式搜索的命中率优势与随机臂更高的均值/更低离散度并存，说明搜索有效性与搜索稳健性未必同向；且头部候选簇过于接近，提示收益可能已趋饱和。

title: loopxDINO: Dense Visual Prediction via Iterative Latent Reasoning
summary:
Standard dense visual prediction architectures scale representation capacity by stacking deep feedforward decoders (6-16 transformer layers with 50M-200M parameters). This explicit layer stacking brings substantial activation memory overhead during backpropagation, requires high off-chip memory bandwidth for non-tied weights, and uses static computational allocation that cannot adapt to spatial image complexity.
  We propose loopxDINO, which replaces physical decoder depth with iterative latent reasoning. It has two decoupled components: (1) a frozen DINOv2-Base backbone extracting spatial features in one forward pass and caching static Key-Value representations in GPU memory; (2) a compact weight-tied Looped Cross-Attention Decoder (7.96M core, 14.85M total trainable parameters) that recurrently updates queries across T iterations. Recurrence is stabilized by step-conditioned adaLN, LayerNorm-based hyper-ellipsoid manifold regularization, and learnable residual contraction damping. Intermediate mask predictions are fed back as spatial attention biases to guide queries toward ambiguous contours with no extra parameters.
  On Pascal VOC 2012 semantic segmentation with a single RTX 5060 Ti 16GB GPU, loopxDINO (T=2) achieves 85.66% mIoU and 65.01% Boundary IoU. It outperforms 6-layer DINO-Trans6L (54.06M params) by +1.09% mIoU and +7.41% Boundary IoU with 72.5% fewer parameters. Compared to 4-layer DINO-FCN4L probe (2.43M params, 83.82% mIoU), loopxDINO improves boundary delineation by +6.43% bIoU and occlusion resilience by +6.76% mIoU (60% patch masking). With Adaptive Computation Time (ACT), it reaches 87.3 FPS and retains 29.64% mIoU under 60% occlusion (+5.83% over DINO-Trans6L).
  Source code, pre-trained weights and evaluation suites are open-sourced under Apache 2.0 at https://github.com/loopxDINO/loopxDINO

AI.tldr: loopxDINO用权重共享的循环交叉注意力解码器替代深层前馈解码器栈，在仅7.96M核心参数下于Pascal VOC 2012取得85.66% mIoU与65.01% Boundary IoU，兼顾精度、边界质量与遮挡鲁棒性。
