AI.motivation: 标准稠密视觉预测依赖堆叠6-16层Transformer解码器（50M-200M参数）扩展表征容量，带来三方面缺陷：反向传播时激活内存开销大；非共享权重需高片外访存带宽；静态计算分配无法随图像空间复杂度自适应。
AI.method: 以迭代隐式推理替代物理解码器深度，含两个解耦模块：(1) 冻结的DINOv2-Base主干单次前向提取空间特征并将静态Key-Value缓存于GPU显存；(2) 紧凑权重共享的Looped Cross-Attention Decoder（7.96M核心/14.85M总可训练参数），跨T次迭代循环更新查询。循环稳定性由步条件adaLN、基于LayerNorm的超椭球流形正则、可学习残差收缩阻尼保障；中间掩码预测回馈为空间注意力偏置，无额外参数地引导查询聚焦模糊轮廓。并引入Adaptive Computation Time实现动态迭代。
AI.result: 单张RTX 5060 Ti 16GB上，Pascal VOC 2012语义分割T=2时达85.66% mIoU、65.01% Boundary IoU；相比6层DINO-Trans6L（54.06M参数）mIoU+1.09%、bIoU+7.41%，参数减少72.5%；相比DINO-FCN4L探针（2.43M参数，83.82% mIoU）bIoU+6.43%、60% patch遮挡下mIoU+6.76%。结合ACT达87.3 FPS，60%遮挡下保持29.64% mIoU（较DINO-Trans6L+5.83%）。
AI.conclusion: 递归共享参数+迭代潜在推理是替代深栈解码器的有效范式：以极少参数量同时提升分割精度、边界精细度与遮挡鲁棒性，并通过ACT实现复杂度自适应计算。代码、权重与评测套件以Apache 2.0开源。

title: RVLM: Fewer Tokens, Better Resolution Scaling, Fine-Grained Spatial Grounding
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) tokenize images using fixed spatial grids, so visual token count grows with pixel area rather than scene content. We propose to group neighboring patches based on their visual appearance, allowing tokens to represent coherent image regions rather than fixed spatial windows. We introduce RVLM, a VLM trained to use regions rather than patches as its visual units. Analyzing region construction for general-purpose VLMs, we find that regions must cover the full image, stay spatially connected during end-to-end training, and preserve fine structure such as small text, while semantic grouping adds little. RVLM therefore partitions images using training-free Felzenszwalb-Huttenlocher segmentation, assigns each ViT patch to a region, and pools patches within each region into a variable-length sequence of visual tokens. The patch-to-region assignment is retained to support spatially precise prediction through coarse-to-fine decoding. Across tasks spanning VQA, pointing, counting, segmentation, and depth estimation, RVLM matches or improves example-weighted task performance while using 21.5% fewer visual tokens than an identically trained patch baseline. The advantage grows with image resolution, reaching a 5.3-point gain while using 51.8% fewer visual tokens at the highest-resolution setting. The gains are largest on spatially demanding tasks, where prior token-reduction methods degrade most sharply. RVLM adds no model parameters and improves inference throughput by up to 35.9%. On unseen pathology and satellite images and on video benchmarks without any video training, RVLM performs on par with the patch baseline while using 2-3$\times$ fewer visual tokens. These results establish regions as a scalable alternative to patch-based visual representations while preserving the spatial precision required for grounded prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出RVLM，用基于外观的区域（Felzenszwalb-Huttenlocher分割）替代固定patch网格作为视觉单元，在减少视觉token的同时保持空间精度，在VQA、定位、计数、分割、深度估计等任务上匹配或超过patch基线。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM以固定空间网格对图像token化，导致视觉token数随像素面积增长而非随场景内容变化，冗余高、效率低。
AI.method: 基于视觉外观将相邻patch分组为区域：使用免训练的Felzenszwalb-Huttenlocher分割划分图像，将每个ViT patch分配到对应区域，并在区域内池化为变长视觉token序列；保留patch到区域的分配关系，通过由粗到细解码支持空间精确预测。设计分析得出区域应覆盖全图、端到端训练中保持空间连通、保留小文字等细节结构，而语义分组收益有限。
AI.result: 在VQA、pointing、计数、分割、深度估计等任务上，RVLM以少21.5%视觉token达到或超过同训练条件的patch基线；高分辨率下增益达5.3分且token减少51.8%；空间要求高的任务增益最大；无额外参数，推理吞吐最高提升35.9%；在未见过的病理、卫星图像及无视频训练的视频基准上以2-3倍更少token持平基线。
AI.conclusion: 区域可作为patch视觉表示的可扩展替代方案，在显著降低token数量的同时保留grounded预测所需的空间精度。

title: T2ISpec: Benchmarking Speculative Decoding for Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) generators produce detailed images but remain slow at inference. Speculative decoding can reduce this cost, yet its behavior across the rendering requirements of T2I prompts remains insufficiently understood. We introduce T2ISpec, a benchmark of 1,400 prompts balanced across seven rendering topics and two difficulty levels. It evaluates autoregressive and diffusion/flow accelerators by latency, work performed by the target model, and image quality. Our study reveals three key findings: (1) aggregate results hide large differences between topics, (2) alignment and preference scores can disagree with prompt constraint satisfaction, and (3) large reductions in target work can yield limited latency gains. Motivated by these findings, we propose TopicRoute, a plugin that combines prompt routing with speculative and cache controls without retraining the generator. Across six model--method pairs, it achieves a geometric mean speedup of 1.0308x over the native methods, and the speedup carries over to external prompts with the same settings, while quality gains and losses vary across configurations.

AI.tldr: 提出T2ISpec基准（1400提示词，覆盖7类渲染主题×2难度），系统评测T2I投机解码；发现聚合指标掩盖主题差异、对齐/偏好分数与提示约束满足度不一致、目标模型工作量大幅减少但延迟收益有限三点问题；据此提出免重训插件TopicRoute，六组模型-方法组合上几何平均加速1.0308x。
AI.motivation: T2I生成器图像质量高但推理慢，投机解码虽可降本，但其在T2I提示词不同渲染需求下的表现缺乏充分理解，现有评测多以聚合指标衡量，掩盖了细粒度差异。
AI.method: 构建T2ISpec基准：1400条提示词，按7个渲染主题、2个难度等级均衡分布；以延迟、目标模型实际计算量、图像质量三个维度评测自回归与扩散/流式加速器。基于发现设计TopicRoute，通过提示词路由结合投机与缓存控制，无需重训生成器。
AI.result: 三项发现：聚合结果掩盖主题间巨大差异；对齐分数与偏好分数可能同提示约束满足度相悖；目标模型计算量大幅下降仅带来有限延迟收益。TopicRoute在六组模型-方法对上取得几何平均1.0308x加速，相同设置下可迁移至外部提示词，质量增益/损失因配置而异。
AI.conclusion: T2I投机加速需按主题与难度分层评测，单一聚合指标与单一质量分数不可靠；轻量级路由+投机/缓存控制插件可在不重训的前提下获得稳定但幅度有限的加速，质量影响取决于具体配置。

title: Beyond Binary Correctness: A Surrogate for Confidence Learning in Large Language and Vision-Language Models
summary: Confidence estimation for large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) aims to assess how likely a particular generated response is to be correct. We investigate how learning this assessment can benefit from the model's predictive reliability on the underlying query. Binary correctness supervision, however, assigns identical labels to occasional errors and frequent failures, as well as isolated successes and consistent success. These outcomes can arise from substantially different predictive behavior under stochastic decoding. We propose a confidence-learning framework that supplements realized response correctness with query-level predictive reliability. We estimate reliability through repeated generations under a fixed model and decoding configuration, then combine the empirical success rate with individual correctness to construct a graded confidence surrogate. The surrogate differentiates responses sharing the same correctness label while preserving the average predictive reliability of the sampled response pool. To learn this target, we condition an independent confidence estimator on the query and its full generated response, and optimize backbone LoRA adapters together with a projection and scalar confidence head using mean squared error. Repeated sampling is required only for supervision construction; inference scores an individual response without additional generations. We establish ordering and mean preservation properties of the surrogate and derive a selective-risk bound connecting population surrogate prediction error to the error rate among accepted responses. We evaluate the framework across language and vision-language models, examining confidence calibration and selective prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种置信度学习框架，用查询级预测可靠性（重复采样的经验成功率）与单次正确性组合构造分级置信度代理目标，替代二元正确性监督，并证明其排序与均值保持性质及选择性风险界。
AI.motivation: 对LLM/VLM的置信度估计（判断生成回答是否正确）可利用模型在底层查询上的预测可靠性。但二元正确性监督会把偶发错误与频繁失败、孤立成功与稳定成功赋予相同标签，而这些结果在随机解码下对应显著不同的预测行为，导致监督信号信息损失。
AI.method: 在固定模型与解码配置下重复生成，估计查询级可靠性（经验成功率），再与单次正确性结合构造分级置信度代理目标，保留采样响应池的平均预测可靠性。用独立的置信度估计器以查询和完整生成响应为条件，结合LoRA适配器、投影层与标量置信度头，以MSE优化。重复采样仅用于监督构建，推理时单次响应即可打分。
AI.result: 建立了代理目标的排序性质与均值保持性质，并推导出将总体代理预测误差与接受响应错误率联系的选择性风险界；在语言模型与视觉语言模型上评估了置信度校准与选择性预测。
AI.conclusion: 以查询级预测可靠性补充二元正确性监督，可在不增加推理成本的前提下提供更细粒度的置信度学习信号，并为选择性预测提供理论保障。

title: RMR-VLA: Recurrent Memory Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Long-horizon, history-dependent robotic manipulation often requires acting on visual cues that have disappeared, such as an object indicated earlier or a target hidden under a moving cup. The key challenge is to maintain what past evidence means for the next action as the scene changes. We introduce Recurrent Memory Reasoning (RMR), an explicit reasoning step that connects memory to action inside a vision-language-action model (VLA), with no external reasoning model. At each update, the VLA first infers an event from visual evidence, then revises the task state and grounds a subgoal in the current scene to guide action generation. Carrying the state and subgoal across updates lets remembered identities and task progress determine the current target, doubling RoboMME success over an otherwise identical model without recurrence. Joint training lets one VLA both reason and act; because its memory decisions are text tokens with exact likelihoods, GRPO refines them from rollout rewards without making action generation stochastic. Among the compared methods, RMR-VLA achieves the best results on RoboMME (66.46% overall, 79.83% on the Reference category) and LIBERO-Mem (90.08%).

AI.tldr: 提出Recurrent Memory Reasoning (RMR)，在VLA模型内部用显式推理步骤把记忆与动作连接，无需外部推理模型，在RoboMME和LIBERO-Mem上取得最佳结果。
AI.motivation: 长时程、依赖历史的机器人操作常需依据已消失的视觉线索行动（如先前指示的物体、移动杯子下的目标），核心挑战是在场景变化中保持"过去证据对下一步动作意味着什么"。现有方法缺乏将记忆显式连接到动作的机制。
AI.method: 在VLA内部加入显式推理步骤：每次更新时，VLA先由视觉证据推断事件，再修正任务状态，并在当前场景中落地子目标以引导动作生成；状态与子目标跨更新传递。采用联合训练使同一VLA兼具推理与动作能力；由于记忆决策为具有精确似然的文本token，可用GRPO基于 rollout 奖励精炼，且不使动作生成随机化。
AI.result: 相较同构但无循环记忆的模型，RoboMME成功率翻倍；RMR-VLA在RoboMME上总体66.46%、Reference类别79.83%，在LIBERO-Mem上达90.08%，为对比方法中最佳。
AI.conclusion: 显式循环记忆推理能有效把记忆中的身份与任务进度转化为当前目标，联合训练+GRPO可在保持动作确定性的同时优化记忆决策，验证了内嵌式记忆推理在长时程操作任务中的有效性。

title: Separating Protocol Effects from Spatio-Temporal Evidence in Person Re-Identification Re-Ranking
summary: Spatio-temporal priors re-rank person re-identification matches using the camera pair and the time gap, and are reported to add large gains on Market-1501. We ask how much of such a gain encodes the evaluation protocol rather than learned spatio-temporal evidence. Starting from a course-project re-ranker that adds log camera-transition and log time-gap terms to cosine similarity, we train a strong ResNet-50 baseline (Rank-1 94.3 %, mAP 86.2 % over three seeds), choose the fusion weights on an identity-disjoint validation split and evaluate on the official test set with control priors. The repository form adds 2.30 mAP points, but a one-parameter penalty on same-camera pairs alone adds 2.19: the protocol never places a true match in the query's camera, so the penalty removes distractors for free. The time term of that form is almost unused; a pair-level diagnostic traces this to its modelling the time gap given a match without dividing by the gap distribution of all candidate pairs. A likelihood-ratio prior adds 4.04 points without the penalty and 5.62 with it; shuffling the time stamps removes the extra gain, so about 3.43 points are tied to identity. The prior fixes the first-ranked match of 4.2 % of the queries and breaks it for 0.1 %. The gain shrinks as the visual baseline improves (11.9 to 5.62 points between a 70.5 % and a 86.2 % mAP model) and concentrates on queries whose true matches share the query's video sequence. The study covers one dataset, one backbone and three seeds.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地将时空重排序在Market-1501上的增益分解为"协议红利"与"真实时空证据"，发现同相机惩罚单一参数即贡献2.19 mAP，而真正的身份相关增益约3.43点且随视觉基线增强而显著衰减。
AI.motivation: 时空先验（相机对+时间间隔）在以Market-1501为代表的ReID评测中被报道带来大幅mAP提升，但该增益有多少来自评测协议本身的漏洞、多少来自真实的时空证据未被区分。作者质疑在协议从不把真实匹配放入查询相机的设定下，先验增益可能被高估。
AI.method: 从课程项目的重排序器出发，在余弦相似度上叠加log相机转移项与log时间间隔项；训练强ResNet-50基线（三seed平均Rank-1 94.3%、mAP 86.2%）；在身份不相交的验证集上选取融合权重，并在官方测试集上用对照先验评测。进一步引入仅针对同相机对的单参数惩罚作为消融，构造似然比先验（以全体候选对的时间间隔分布做归一化），并做时间戳打乱、pair级诊断、以及不同强度基线（70.5%→86.2% mAP）的对比实验。
AI.result: 仓库形式先验提升2.30 mAP，而仅加同相机对单参数惩罚即得2.19，表明增益主要来自协议中真实匹配永不与查询同相机的设定；原时间项几乎无效，pair级诊断归因于其只建模"给定匹配下的时间间隔"而未除以候选对的间隔分布。似然比先验无惩罚下提升4.04、加惩罚后提升5.62；打乱时间戳后额外增益消失，约3.43点与身份相关。先验修正了4.2%查询的首位匹配，仅破坏0.1%。增益随视觉基线增强而收缩（70.5%→86.2% mAP时由11.9降至5.62点），且集中于真实匹配与查询共享视频序列的查询。
AI.conclusion: 时空先验的报道增益在很大程度上是评测协议伪影，而非可迁移的时空证据；剩余的身份相关增益有限、随基线增强而衰减，并受单数据集、单骨干、三seed的实验规模限制。

title: DictaRashi: A State-of-the-Art OCR Model For Rashi Script
summary: We release DictaRashi, a Tesseract OCR model for scanned Hebrew books printed in the so-called "Rashi" font. We trained DictaRashi on over one million manually corrected lines of text from over 100 different books of Rabbinic and post-Rabbinic literature. On a held-out set of 1,120 manually transcribed lines from scanned Rashi-script pages, DictaRashi reaches a character error rate (CER) of 0.86% and a word error rate (WER) of 3.38%, setting a new state-of-the-art for publicly-available Tesseract models. We provide a full comparison of our results to those of the 31 other publicly available Hebrew Tesseract models; the best of those models achieves a 2.98% CER and 11.86% WER. We further demonstrate that DictaRashi outperforms the current frontier LLMs on this OCR task. We release the test set of Rashi-script documents so that it may be used as a benchmark for future work in this area. We are pleased to release the model and test set to the community under a CC BY NC 4.0 license.

AI.tldr: 发布DictaRashi：一个面向"Rashi"字体希伯来文古籍扫描件的Tesseract OCR模型，在自建测试集上取得0.86% CER与3.38% WER，优于31个公开希伯来文Tesseract模型及当前前沿LLM，并以CC BY NC 4.0许可开源模型与测试集。
AI.motivation: "Rashi"字体印刷的希伯来文古籍扫描件缺少高质量OCR支持，现有公开Tesseract模型性能不足（最佳者CER 2.98%、WER 11.86%），且缺乏统一评测基准。
AI.method: 基于Tesseract框架训练专用OCR模型；训练数据为来自100余本拉比及后拉比文献、经人工校正的超过一百万行文本；在1,120行人工转写、书目留出的Rashi字体扫描页上评测，并与31个公开希伯来文Tesseract模型及前沿LLM进行对比。
AI.result: 在留出测试集上CER为0.86%、WER为3.38%，刷新公开Tesseract模型的最优水平；显著优于最佳基线模型（CER 2.98%、WER 11.86%），并在该OCR任务上超越当前前沿LLM。
AI.conclusion: DictaRashi为Rashi字体希伯来文古籍OCR确立了新的性能基准；作者以CC BY NC 4.0许可开放模型与测试集，供后续研究作为基准使用。

title: DREAM: Dual-Memory Reasoning for Anticipatory 3D Perception in Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving systems must not only interpret the current scene but also anticipate perceptual challenges such as occlusions, sparse observations, and recurring failure patterns. However, most existing LiDAR semantic segmentation methods operate in a frame-centric manner, processing each scan independently and discarding past contextual experience, which limits robustness under dynamic scene changes. We propose DREAM, a Dual-memory REAsoning framework for continual LiDAR seMantic segmentation that reframes perception as an experience-driven and anticipatory process. DREAM maintains two complementary memory banks in a strictly online setting: a latent memory that stores compact semantic abstractions of previously observed scenes, and an error memory that records representations associated with uncertain predictions. At each timestep, relevant memory entries are retrieved via cosine similarity and integrated into the feature space through a lightweight modulation mechanism, enabling the model to reinforce consistent semantic patterns while suppressing recurring failure modes. The backbone remains frozen and no past scans are replayed, ensuring computational efficiency and bounded memory growth. Extensive experiments on multiple large-scale LiDAR benchmarks demonstrate that DREAM achieves state-of-the-art performance, with consistent improvements on dynamic and small-scale objects, highlighting the effectiveness of persistent and error-aware memory for robust long-horizon perception.

AI.tldr: DREAM：一种面向连续LiDAR语义分割的双记忆推理框架，将感知重构为经验驱动与前瞻性过程，通过潜记忆与错误记忆在严格在线设定下增强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有LiDAR语义分割多为帧中心处理，每帧独立且丢弃历史上下文经验，难以应对遮挡、稀疏观测与重复性失败模式，在动态场景变化下鲁棒性受限。
AI.method: 在严格在线设定下维护两个互补记忆库：潜记忆存储既往场景的紧凑语义抽象，错误记忆记录与不确定预测相关的表示。每时刻以余弦相似度检索相关记忆条目，经轻量调制机制融入特征空间，强化一致语义模式、抑制重复失败模式；骨干网络冻结且不重放历史扫描，保证计算效率与有界内存增长。
AI.result: 在多个大规模LiDAR基准上取得SOTA性能，在动态目标与小尺度目标上表现出一致提升，验证了持久化与错误感知记忆对长时程鲁棒感知的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 持久化且错误感知的双记忆机制可有效替代帧独立处理，在不重放历史数据、冻结骨干的约束下实现前瞻性、经验驱动的长时程LiDAR语义分割。

title: DeclareViT: Decoupling Early Classification from Feature Refinement with Exit Query for Efficient ViTs
summary: Vision Transformers achieve remarkable recognition performance but incur substantial computational cost during inference, limiting their use in latency- and compute-constrained deployment scenarios. Early-exit inference offers a promising solution by allowing easy samples to terminate at intermediate layers. However, existing approaches typically couple early classification with the shared backbone, requiring intermediate representations to support both early classification and subsequent feature refinement. Under joint training, the corresponding optimization objectives jointly update shared backbone parameters, which can lead to conflicting gradient directions. Motivated by this observation, we introduce DeclareViT, a framework that decouples early classification from feature refinement. Each exit uses a dedicated query to read intermediate features through one-way cross-attention without modifying the backbone token stream. The query branches are optimized for early classification while the backbone and final classifier remain frozen. Across ViT, DeiT, and Swin on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-1K, and Food-101, DeclareViT consistently establishes a state-of-the-art accuracy-efficiency trade-off: It achieves 1.58 times to 2.57 times multiply-accumulate (MAC)-based speed-up with only a 0.39-1.91 percentage-point accuracy drop. Wall-clock measurements on CPU and GPU further demonstrate practical inference acceleration. Code is available at https://github.com/TUDa-HWAI/DeclareViT.

AI.tldr: DeclareViT将早期分类与特征细化解耦：冻结主干与最终分类器，仅用独立query分支通过单向交叉注意力读取中间特征做早退预测，在ViT/DeiT/Swin上取得1.58–2.57倍MAC加速且精度仅降0.39–1.91个百分点。
AI.motivation: ViT推理计算开销大，限制延迟与算力受限场景部署；现有早退方法将早期分类与共享主干耦合，中间表示需同时服务早分类与后续特征细化，联合训练时优化目标共同更新主干参数，易产生梯度方向冲突。
AI.method: 提出DeclareViT框架：每个出口使用专用query，通过单向交叉注意力读取中间特征，不修改主干token流；仅优化query分支用于早期分类，主干与最终分类器保持冻结，从而避免梯度冲突。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-1K、Food-101上，ViT、DeiT、Swin均获得一致的SOTA精度-效率权衡：MAC加速1.58–2.57倍，精度仅下降0.39–1.91个百分点；CPU与GPU实测墙钟时间亦验证了实际推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过在表征层面解耦早退分类与主干细化，可有效规避联合训练的梯度冲突，以极低精度代价换取显著推理加速，为ViT在受限场景下提供实用早退方案。

title: Contamination at the Operating Point: Train-Test Identity Overlap Inflates Low-FMR Face Recognition Accuracy by an Order of Magnitude
summary: Face verification systems are deployed by selecting a decision threshold that achieves a target false match rate (FMR); performance is then reported as the corresponding false non-match rate (FNMR). In practice, deployed systems operate at FMR $\le 10^{-6}$, but widely used benchmarks can share identities with the models' training corpora. Prior work (Wu et al., 2024) measures the resulting optimistic bias as a small additive change in 10-fold accuracy (up to 1.01 percentage points). We show that the bias is neither small nor constant: it is a multiplicative error that grows as FMR falls. First, we audit train-test overlap with a detector calibrated against a null distribution (rather than a hand-tuned threshold). Relative to WebFace42M, we flag 88.6% of MS1MV3 identities and 14.3% of IJB-C subjects as present, despite WebFace260M's published de-overlap explicitly naming IJB-C. Manual review of 100 flagged IJB-C subjects confirms 69.2%, implying a residual overlap of roughly 9.9%. Second, holding the model fixed, removing only the contaminated identities from the test set increases FNMR by 3.6$\times$ at FMR=$10^{-4}$, 6.3$\times$ at FMR=$10^{-5}$, and 13.9$\times$ at FMR=$10^{-6}$, while a same-size random removal does not. The effect is traced to a shorter impostor tail that lowers the threshold. The magnitude of the shift depends on the training corpus and does not cancel betweent margin between our model and a publicbaseline by half. Third, we give the first direct measurement of the effective number of independent impostor comparisons in IJB-C: only 2.7 million effectively independent comparisons at FMR=$10^{-6}$, which is below all commonly accepted reporting rules. Finallyth a known training corpus, we build areal-face protocol with audited zero overlap that resolves FMR=$10^{-8}$.

AI.tldr: 人脸验证中训练-测试集重叠会导致FMR越低偏差越大的乘性误差；去除污染身份后FNMR在FMR=1e-6处增大13.9倍，且IJB-C在1e-6处有效独立冒认比较仅约270万次。
AI.motivation: 实际部署的人脸验证系统工作在FMR≤1e-6，但常用基准可能与训练语料共享身份，导致性能被乐观高估。已有工作（Wu等，2024）将偏差视为10折精度上不超过1.01个百分点的加性小幅变化，本文认为该偏差既不小也不恒定，需重新刻画其随FMR下降而增长的乘性本质，并审计重叠程度。
AI.method: (1) 用基于零分布校准的检测器（而非手工调阈值）审计训练-测试重叠：相对WebFace42M标记MS1MV3身份88.6%、IJB-C受试者14.3%，并对100个被标记的IJB-C受试者人工复核（确认69.2%，推断残余重叠约9.9%）；(2) 固定模型、仅从测试集移除受污染身份，在FMR=1e-4/1e-5/1e-6下测量FNMR变化，并与同规模随机移除作对照，同时分析冒认尾部分布与阈值漂移；(3) 首次直接估计IJB-C中有效独立冒认比较数量；(4) 构建经审计零重叠的真实人脸协议以分辨FMR=1e-8。
AI.result: 去除污染身份后FNMR在FMR=1e-4增3.6倍、1e-5增6.3倍、1e-6增13.9倍，而等量随机移除无此效应；机制是冒认尾部变短导致阈值降低。偏差幅度依赖训练语料，且不会在模型间抵消——本文模型与公开基线的间隔因此缩小一半。IJB-C在FMR=1e-6处仅有约270万次有效独立比较，低于常用报告规则要求。最终给出审计零重叠、可分辨FMR=1e-8的新协议。
AI.conclusion: 训练-测试重叠引起的偏差是随FMR下降而放大的乘性误差，而非可忽略的加性误差；它既扭曲绝对性能也影响模型间相对比较的可信度。常用基准（如IJB-C）在极低FMR下缺乏足够的有效独立冒认比较，报告的1e-6级性能统计上不可靠。因此需要在审计零重叠的协议上、按有效独立比较数评估极低FMR性能。

title: CAR: Reducing Decoder Output Shift in Visual Token Pruning via Coverage Selection and Attention Reallocation
summary: Visual token pruning is an effective way to accelerate multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing methods degrade substantially under aggressive pruning, especially on visual grounding (VG). We analyze the sources of this degradation from the perspective of the output shift that pruning causes in decoder layers, and decompose this shift in closed form into two terms, an image summary error and an attention allocation error. The summary error stems from the loss of visual information, and the allocation error from the drop in the share of attention assigned to visual tokens. To reduce both errors, we propose CAR (Coverage selection and Attention Reallocation), a token pruning framework that restores attention share while maintaining information. Specifically, to minimize the summary error, whose upper bound tightens as the retained tokens better cover all visual tokens, our coverage selection retains tokens that are both salient and non-redundant, with saliency from encoder heads chosen by a label-free probe. To minimize the allocation error, our attention reallocation reassigns the attention of the discarded tokens to the retained ones through a closed-form logit bias. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B with $90\%$ of the visual tokens pruned, CAR retains $93.0\%$ of the unpruned accuracy on visual question answering (VQA) and $77.9\%$ on VG, against $26.5\%$ for the best existing method on VG; the logit bias alone raises the VG accuracy of existing methods by up to $24$ points. Experiments on multiple MLLMs across VQA, VG and video understanding show that CAR generalizes well and consistently outperforms existing methods.

AI.tldr: CAR 将剪枝引起的解码器输出偏移分解为"图像摘要误差"和"注意力分配误差"，分别用覆盖式选择与注意力重分配来抑制，在 90% 视觉 token 剪枝下大幅提升 MLLM 的 VQA/VG 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉 token 剪枝方法在激进剪枝率下性能显著退化，尤其在视觉定位（VG）任务上表现糟糕，作者希望从解码层输出偏移的角度解释退化来源并加以修正。
AI.method: 以闭式形式将剪枝导致的解码层输出偏移分解为图像摘要误差（信息丢失引起）与注意力分配误差（视觉 token 注意力份额下降引起）。据此提出 CAR 框架：(1) 覆盖选择——用无标签探针筛选编码器头，基于显著性与非冗余性选取能覆盖全部视觉 token 的保留子集，以收紧摘要误差上界；(2) 注意力重分配——通过闭式 logit bias 将丢弃 token 的注意力转移给保留 token，恢复注意力份额。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上剪除 90% 视觉 token 时，CAR 保留 VQA 未剪枝精度的 93.0%、VG 的 77.9%，而最佳现有方法 VG 仅 26.5%；仅 logit bias 一项即可使现有方法 VG 精度提升最多 24 个百分点。在多款 MLLM 的 VQA、VG 与视频理解任务上均一致优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模并补偿剪枝引起的输出偏移，CAR 在极端剪枝率下显著缓解 VG 退化，且具备良好的模型与任务泛化性；注意力重分配（logit bias）可作为通用插件提升已有剪枝方法。

title: Data-Quality-Aware Fundus Classification with Anatomy-Guided Glaucoma Assessment and Cross-Dataset Evaluation
summary: Background: Deep learning fundus classifiers often perform well internally, but duplicated images, inconsistent labels, acquisition differences and poor threshold transfer can undermine their reliability. We assess nine-class classifiers beyond internal accuracy, using a data audit, frozen-model external evaluation and an anatomy-guided specialist. Methods: Nine-class experts (ConvNeXt-Small, EfficientNetV2-Small, DenseNet169) were trained with three seeds. Auditing 5,318 images for exact duplicates and cross-label conflicts removed 464 conflict groups (942 images) and six same-label copies, leaving 4,370 images. An anatomy-guided glaucoma specialist read disc-centred crops with vessel and disc/cup segmentation maps, plus cup-to-disc features. Frozen models were evaluated on RFMiD and JSIEC, and a prespecified comparison on REFUGE was replicated on ORIGA, G1020 and PAPILA. Results: ConvNeXt-Small reached an internal accuracy of 0.910, macro-F1 of 0.917 and AUC of 0.982; disc and cup Dice scores were 0.966 and 0.915. Across seeds, the fixed anatomy-guided mix left internal accuracy unchanged relative to equal soft voting (-0.001) but raised mean external closed-set accuracy by 4.9 percentage points on RFMiD (positive in two of three seeds) and 2.3 on JSIEC. On REFUGE (800 photographs) it improved balanced accuracy by 7.4 percentage points (95% CI 5.1 to 9.5), and by 2.1 on ORIGA, with positive gains on G1020 and PAPILA. Thresholds transferred poorly (REFUGE sensitivity 0.950, specificity 0.411). Conclusions: Retinal classifiers should be judged by data-quality auditing, anatomy-informed modelling and multi-cohort evaluation. Anatomy-guided fusion improved transfer at no internal cost, but gains varied by cohort and thresholds did not transfer, so internal metrics alone do not establish reliable performance.

AI.tldr: 本文对九分类眼底分类器进行数据审计、冻结模型外部评估与解剖结构引导的专家融合，发现数据审计剔除464个冲突组后，解剖引导融合在不损失内部性能的前提下提升外部迁移，但阈值迁移性差。
AI.motivation: 深度学习眼底分类器内部表现好，但重复图像、标签不一致、采集差异与阈值迁移不良会损害其可靠性；仅凭内部准确率不足以证明性能可靠，需超越内部精度进行评估。
AI.method: 训练ConvNeXt-Small、EfficientNetV2-Small、DenseNet169三个九分类专家（各3个随机种子）。对5,318张图像做精确重复与跨标签冲突审计，剔除464个冲突组（942张）及6张同标签副本，剩余4,370张。构建解剖引导的青光眼专家，输入视盘中心裁剪图、血管与视盘/视杯分割图及杯盘比特征。冻结模型在RFMiD、JSIEC上评估，REFUGE上的预设比较在ORIGA、G1020、PAPILA上复现。
AI.result: ConvNeXt-Small内部准确率0.910、宏F1 0.917、AUC 0.982，视盘/视杯Dice为0.966/0.915。相较等权软投票，固定解剖引导融合内部准确率变化-0.001，但外部封闭集准确率在RFMiD提升4.9个百分点（3个种子中2个为正）、JSIEC提升2.3；REFUGE（800张）平衡准确率提升7.4个百分点（95%CI 5.1–9.5），ORIGA提升2.1，G1020与PAPILA亦有正向增益。阈值迁移差：REFUGE敏感度0.950、特异度0.411。
AI.conclusion: 视网膜分类器应通过数据质量审计、解剖信息引导建模与多队列评估来评判。解剖引导融合在无内部代价下改善迁移，但增益随队列变化且阈值不可迁移，内部指标本身不能确立可靠性能。

title: AirVT-15k: A Query-Diverse UAV Video-Text Dataset and Query-Adaptive Evidence Alignment Network for Retrieval
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle video-text retrieval (UAV-TVR) requires matching language to both scene context and subtle object changes. A harbor-layout query relies on global scene context, whereas a departing-vessel query requires local functional cues and motion states. Existing benchmarks provide diverse aerial descriptions but give limited attention to distinct evidence needs within the same video. We introduce AirVT-15k, a benchmark of 15,504 UAV videos and 155,040 captions, with ten complementary bilingual captions per video describing scenes, object states, and temporal changes. We also propose AirFocus-CST, which selects query-relevant frames and patches, encodes temporal feature differences, and combines coarse-to-fine interaction (CFI) with optimal-transport alignment (OTA). Average mean recall reaches 63.67% on AirVT-15k and 24.41% on CapERA, improving over the strongest baselines by 2.96 and 1.91 percentage points, respectively. The dataset and code are available at https://chenxi000233.github.io/AirVT-15k-site/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出无人机视频-文本检索基准 AirVT-15k 及方法 AirFocus-CST，强调同一视频内不同的证据需求（全局场景 vs. 局部目标状态/运动），并在两个数据集上取得领先。
AI.motivation: UAV-TVR 需同时匹配语言与场景上下文和细粒度目标变化：如"港口布局"类查询依赖全局场景上下文，而"离港船只"类查询依赖局部功能线索与运动状态。现有基准虽提供多样的航拍描述，但对同一视频内不同证据需求的区分关注不足。
AI.method: 构建 AirVT-15k 基准：15,504 段无人机视频、155,040 条描述，每视频 10 条互补双语字幕，覆盖场景、目标状态与时间变化。提出 AirFocus-CST：选取查询相关帧与图像块，编码时序特征差异，并将由粗到细交互（CFI）与最优传输对齐（OTA）相结合。
AI.result: 平均平均召回率在 AirVT-15k 上达 63.67%，在 CapERA 上达 24.41%，分别较最强基线提升 2.96 与 1.91 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模查询相关的帧/块证据与时序差异，并结合粗到细交互与最优传输对齐，可有效提升 UAV 视频-文本检索性能；新基准为细粒度、多证据需求的航拍检索研究提供支撑。

title: SafeRank-ReID: Candidate-Conditioned Re-Ranking under Identity Conflicts for Multimodal Person Re-Identification
comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia Asia 2026 (MMAsia 2026). 8 pages, 5 figures
summary: Multimodal Person Re-Identification (ReID) exploits complementary identity cues from different sensing modalities to mitigate the performance degradation caused by challenging imaging conditions. Existing methods typically estimate Modality Reliability at the query level, making it difficult to identify conflicting inputs that retain normal visual quality but correspond to an incorrect identity. Such inputs may receive high confidence, promote irrelevant gallery candidates, and lead to negative fusion. To address this issue, we propose SafeRank-ReID, a candidate-conditioned safe re-ranking framework for Multimodal Person Re-Identification (ReID). To capture the varying support of the same modality for different candidates, we introduce a candidate-conditioned evidence arbitration mechanism that integrates unimodal retrieval evidence, input quality, and cross-modal consistency to estimate trust and conflict logits for each modality-candidate pair. Together, these logits contribute to the normalized modality weights, allowing support strength to vary across modalities and candidates while reducing the contribution of potentially unreliable evidence. A candidate-set refinement module subsequently applies self-attention to jointly model candidate representations and predicts residual scores from their competitive relations, thereby refining the initial fused ranking. For fusion results that remain uncertain after refinement, a query-level fallback gate estimates an interpolation coefficient from the overall conflict level and cross-modal uncertainty, adaptively combining the fused scores with those of the most reliable unimodal branch. Experiments on RGBNT201 and MSVR310 show that SafeRank-ReID maintains competitive clean-input retrieval while improving robustness to Identity Conflicts across person and vehicle benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SafeRank-ReID，一种以候选为条件的多模态行人重识别安全重排序框架，通过候选级证据仲裁、候选集精炼与查询级回退门控，缓解身份冲突输入导致的负融合问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态ReID方法通常在查询层面估计模态可靠性，难以识别"视觉质量正常但身份错误"的冲突输入；这类输入会获得高置信度、助推无关候选，造成负融合性能下降。
AI.method: 1）候选条件证据仲裁机制：融合单模态检索证据、输入质量与跨模态一致性，为每个"模态—候选"对估计信任与冲突logit，归一化为候选相关的模态权重；2）候选集精炼模块：用自注意力联合建模候选表示，依据候选间竞争关系预测残差分数，修正初始融合排序；3）查询级回退门控：针对精炼后仍不确定的结果，由整体冲突水平与跨模态不确定性估计插值系数，将融合分数与最可靠单模态分支分数自适应结合。
AI.result: 在RGBNT201与MSVR310数据集上，SafeRank-ReID在保持有竞争力的干净输入检索性能的同时，提升了对身份冲突的鲁棒性，并在行人与车辆基准上均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 将可靠性估计从查询级下沉到候选级，并结合候选集关系精炼与不确定性回退，可有效抑制多模态ReID中的负融合，为冲突输入场景提供更安全的检索。

title: AIGI-26: A Benchmark for AI-Generated Image Detection Across Diverse Modern Generators
summary: Existing AI-generated image (AIGI) detection benchmarks predominantly rely on earlier synthesis systems with limited content diversity and conspicuous artifacts, failing to fully reflect the detection challenges posed by high-fidelity images from contemporary models. We introduce AIGI-26, a benchmark of 253,200 images covering 26 recent open- and closed-source generators. Its novel, diverse, and heterogeneous sources provide a basis for systematically evaluating detection methods on modern generated imagery. Additionally, to capture subtle statistical discrepancies across complementary forensic views, we propose the multi-aspect forensic detection network (MAFDNet). Its fixed forensic operators expose complementary texture, local prediction, resampling, and chromatic responses, summarized by a hierarchical encoder using multiscale means and standard deviations. In parallel, a spectral branch captures Fourier log-magnitude and neighboring-frequency phase variation across radial bands and directional axes. Fusing these descriptors combines local inconsistencies with global spectral organization for authenticity detection. Trained on 12,660 AIGI-26 images, MAFDNet achieves 88.5% accuracy and 94.9% average precision on the 240,540-image test set, with only 1.04M parameters and 1.39 GFLOPs per $256\times256$ input. MAFDNet also demonstrates effective cross-dataset generalization on DailyBench and Treasure-37.

AI.tldr: 提出AIGI-26基准（25.32万张图、26个近期生成器）与MAFDNet多视角取证检测网络，在仅1.04M参数下取得88.5%准确率、94.9% AP，并具跨数据集泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGI检测基准多基于早期合成系统，内容多样性有限、伪影明显，难以反映当代高保真生成图像的检测挑战，因此需要新基准与更精细的取证方法。
AI.method: 构建AIGI-26基准，覆盖26个近期开源/闭源生成器、共253,200张图像。提出MAFDNet：固定取证算子提取纹理、局部预测、重采样、色度响应，经分层编码器以多尺度均值/标准差汇总；并行谱分支捕获傅里叶对数幅度与邻域相位变化（按径向带与方向轴）；融合局部不一致性与全局谱组织。
AI.result: 用12,660张训练图像，在240,540张测试集上达88.5%准确率、94.9% AP；每张256×256输入仅1.04M参数、1.39 GFLOPs；在DailyBench与Treasure-37上展现有效跨数据集泛化。
AI.conclusion: 高保真现代生成器检测需依托多样化新基准与多视角取证融合；MAFDNet以轻量结构实现强性能与泛化，验证了局部伪影与全局谱特征互补的有效性。

title: PathStream: Towards Streaming Diagnostic Copilots for Whole-Slide Pathology
summary: Pathologists reach a diagnosis by integrating morphological evidence across regions and magnifications along viewing trajectories. Existing pathology AI rarely reflects this process: models predict from selected image regions, answer questions within fixed visual contexts, or navigate slides autonomously. We formalize pathologist-led streaming diagnosis, in which the pathologist controls navigation while a copilot selectively describes incoming views and synthesizes accumulated evidence into a final diagnosis. We record five pathologists' viewing trajectories on 1,791 TCGA whole-slide images (WSIs) spanning ten organs, with response labels, morphological descriptions, and session-level findings and diagnoses. We construct PathStreamBench to assess response timing, morphological description, and session-level diagnosis, alongside auxiliary video understanding. We introduce PathStream, which jointly learns streaming responses and diagnosis through two-stage training, with a diagnosis-attention loss guiding attention during diagnosis to relevant visual and textual evidence accumulated as the examination unfolds. PathStream outperforms 14 vision-language models and three domain-fine-tuned baselines on the core tasks, achieving a trajectory WSI Relevance score of 77.87, surpassing the strongest domain-fine-tuned baseline's 62.76. Without additional training, its diagnostic capabilities generalize to new educational pathology videos, three external centers, and an unseen organ.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"病理学家主导的流式诊断"任务与PathStreamBench基准，并构建PathStream模型，在轨迹级WSI相关性等核心任务上显著超越14个视觉语言模型与3个域内微调基线。
AI.motivation: 现有病理AI多以选定图像区域预测、在固定视觉上下文中答题或自主漫游切片，未能体现病理学家沿观察轨迹整合跨区域、跨放大倍数形态学证据的真实诊断过程，缺乏对响应时序与累积证据综合的建模与评测。
AI.method: 记录5位病理学家在10个器官、1,791张TCGA全切片图像(WSI)上的观察轨迹，配以响应标签、形态学描述及会话级发现与诊断；构建PathStreamBench评估响应时机、形态描述与会话级诊断（含辅助视频理解）；提出PathStream，通过两阶段训练联合学习流式响应与诊断，并引入诊断注意力损失，引导诊断时关注随检查推进所累积的相关视觉与文本证据。
AI.result: PathStream在核心任务上优于14个视觉语言模型和3个域内微调基线，轨迹WSI相关性得分77.87，最强微调基线为62.76；无需额外训练即可泛化到新的教学病理视频、三个外部中心数据及未见器官。
AI.conclusion: 将病理学家导航控制权与AI副驾驶的选择性描述、证据整合相结合，是可行且有效的诊断范式；轨迹级评测与诊断注意力引导能提升流式诊断性能并具备跨中心、跨器官泛化能力。

title: Multimodal View Training: Learning More Through Different Modalities
summary: Can a language model learn more from the same information simply by encountering it in different forms? We answer this in the affirmative by introducing Multimodal View Training (MVT), a simple training approach that presents identical information through text, speech, and images, without requiring new facts or supervision. Starting from a text sample, MVT generates corresponding audio and rendered-text image views, and trains a multimodal language model to produce the same target output across all three views. To further bring these benefits to text-only large language models (LLMs), we train lightweight connector modules to pretrained audio and vision encoders, allowing the LLM to learn from multimodal inputs while retaining its text-only architecture at inference. Across question answering, machine unlearning, and knowledge editing, adaptive MVT improves QA recall by +15.2 percentage points, forget quality by +40.7 points, and editing generality by +25.2 points over text-only training. Combining MVT with standard augmentation further improves QA and editing generality. Our theoretical analysis illustrates how training across modalities can shift weight updates toward shared factual content and reduce their reliance on features specific to each view.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态视图训练（MVT）：将同一信息以文本、语音、图像三种视图呈现，训练模型对三视图输出一致的目标，并借助轻量连接器把多模态收益迁移到纯文本LLM，在问答、机器遗忘、知识编辑上均显著优于纯文本训练。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型能否仅通过改变同一信息的呈现形式（而非引入新事实或新监督）学到更多，从而提升事实性知识的习得效率，并把这种收益扩展到推理时仍为纯文本架构的LLM。
AI.method: 从文本样本出发生成对应音频与渲染文本图像视图，构成同一信息的三视图；训练多模态语言模型在三种视图下产生相同目标输出（视图一致性目标）。为让纯文本LLM受益，训练轻量连接器模块接入预训练音频/视觉编码器，使LLM在训练时接收多模态输入，推理时保持纯文本架构。另提出adaptive MVT并与标准数据增强结合，配合理论分析说明跨模态训练如何将权重更新导向共享事实内容、降低对视图特异特征的依赖。
AI.result: 相较纯文本训练，adaptive MVT使问答召回提升15.2个百分点，遗忘质量提升40.7分，编辑泛化性提升25.2分；MVT与标准增强结合可进一步提升问答与编辑泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 同一信息的多视图一致训练可有效增强事实知识学习，且通过轻量连接器可将收益迁移至纯文本LLM而不改变推理架构；理论分析表明其机制在于促使权重更新聚焦跨模态共享的事实内容。

title: Preserve to Compress: Beyond Low-Dimensional Latents in One-Step Diffusion Codec
summary: Pretrained latent diffusion models bring powerful generative priors to ultra-low-bitrate image compression, but their latent spaces reflect a reconstruction--generation tradeoff. Low-dimensional latents reduce modeling cost but can discard image details, while higher-dimensional latents improve reconstruction yet make diffusion optimization harder under a fixed computational budget. Generative codecs that adopt these pretrained spaces also inherit this compromise, even though compression requires fidelity to a specific source image. In particular, low-dimensional latent interfaces can discard source details before coding and restrict how much decoded information reaches the image decoder. We propose Preserving Information for Compression and Synthesis (PICS), a one-step generative image compression framework that adapts these interfaces to preserve source information. Our Information-Preserving Adaptors (IPAs) expose richer features for coding and retain decoded information throughout reconstruction, while deferred decoder adaptation stabilizes training and helps the image decoder exploit the expanded representations. Experiments on Kodak, DIV2K, and CLIC 2020 show average BD-rate savings of 52.64% and 39.61% over StableCodec at matched LPIPS and DISTS, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出PICS一步式生成式图像压缩框架，通过信息保持适配器与延迟解码器适配，缓解预训练潜空间重建—生成权衡带来的源信息损失，在Kodak/DIV2K/CLIC2020上相对StableCodec同LPIPS/DISTS下分别平均节省52.64%和39.61% BD-rate。
AI.motivation: 预训练潜扩散模型的潜空间存在重建—生成权衡：低维潜变量降低建模成本但丢失细节，高维潜变量提升重建质量却在固定算力下使扩散优化更困难。生成式编解码器继承该潜空间即继承此折中，而压缩任务要求对特定源图像保真；低维潜接口在编码前就丢弃源细节，并限制到达图像解码器的信息量。
AI.method: PICS为一步生成式压缩框架，核心为信息保持适配器（Information-Preserving Adaptors, IPAs）：为编码暴露更丰富的特征，并在重建全过程保留已解码信息；同时采用延迟解码器适配（deferred decoder adaptation）稳定训练，使图像解码器能够利用扩展后的表征。
AI.result: 在Kodak、DIV2K与CLIC 2020上，于匹配LPIPS和DISTS的条件下，相对StableCodec分别取得52.64%与39.61%的平均BD-rate节省。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，针对预训练潜接口进行信息保持改造可有效缓解重建—生成权衡对压缩保真的制约，在一步生成式压缩设定下获得显著码率增益，说明适配接口而非替换潜空间是提升潜扩散压缩效率的可行路径。

title: AxE: Benchmarking Agent-Environment Generalization of Video World Models via Grounded Events
summary: Edge cases are not the long tail; they are the norm. An embodied system deployed across changing environments, bodies, objects, and tasks will routinely encounter combinations that were absent from its training data. General-purpose physical intelligence therefore requires world models that reuse prior knowledge, predict consequences, and adapt with little or no additional training. Yet current evaluations of conditional video generation emphasize visual quality, prompt alignment, or isolated physical plausibility, leaving systematic generalization difficult to measure. We introduce AxE Bench, a benchmark that organizes condition changes along eight factors of the acting agent and of its environment, and pairs every original condition with controlled variants that change one side or both. WBench-plus applies the same structure to an existing multi-turn benchmark, pairing each WBench scenario with variants on the environment side, through its world setting or camera behavior, or on the agent side, through its interaction instructions. Additionally, to score generated futures, we develop an evaluation harness that combines vision-language reasoning with targeted computer-vision evidence, converting each video into temporally localized events and comparing generated events with reference events in both time and semantics. We summarize each model with the AxE Score, event Fidelity weighted by its Stability across original-variant pairs. Across twenty models, generated events match reference events far more often in timing than in content: no model exceeds a Fidelity of 13.01, the highest Stability is 0.55, and the highest AxE Score is 7.10. Together, these components turn world-model generalization from an informal aspiration into a falsifiable evaluation program for real and simulated interactions. Our project website can be found at: AxEBench.github.io

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AxE Bench（含 WBench-plus），沿作用主体与环境的八个因素构造“原始—受控变体”条件对，并设计结合视觉语言推理与计算机视觉证据的事件级评测流程，用 AxE Score（事件保真度按稳定性加权）系统衡量世界模型的泛化能力；20 个模型均表现不佳，最高 AxE Score 仅 7.10。
AI.motivation: 具身系统在变化的环境、身体、物体与任务中会常态性遇到训练分布外的条件组合，因此通用物理智能需要能复用先验、预测后果并低样本适应的世界模型。然而现有条件视频生成评测侧重视觉质量、提示对齐或孤立物理合理性，缺乏对系统性泛化的可测量评估。
AI.method: 构建 AxE Bench：按作用主体的 8 个因素组织条件变化，为每个原始条件配对改变单侧或双侧的受控变体；WBench-plus 将同一结构迁移至现有多轮基准，为每个场景配对环境侧（世界设定/相机行为）或主体侧（交互指令）变体。评测流程融合 VLM 推理与定向 CV 证据，将视频转为时间定位事件，在时间与语义两维度对比生成事件与参考事件；以 AxE Score 汇总，即按原始—变体对的稳定性加权的事件保真度。
AI.result: 在 20 个模型上，生成事件在时间上匹配参考事件的频率远高于内容匹配；无一模型 Fidelity 超过 13.01，最高 Stability 为 0.55，最高 AxE Score 为 7.10。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将世界模型泛化从非正式愿景转为可证伪的评测纲领，适用于真实与模拟交互；结果揭示当前模型在条件变化下的内容保真与跨变体稳定性均显著不足。

title: QSRadar: Query-Conditioned Sparse Radar-Camera Fusion for Efficient 3D Object Detection
comment: Radar-camera fusion, 3D object detection, autonomous driving
summary: Reliable 3D object detection for autonomous trucks requires both the semantic detail provided by cameras and the geometric and motion cues measured by 4D radar. Existing radar-camera detectors commonly construct global radar bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations, whose computational and memory costs grow with the perception range. Sparse query-based detectors offer greater efficiency, but global feature construction can obscure point-level radar geometry and motion information. We present QSRadar, a query-conditioned sparse radar fusion framework for efficient long-range 3D detection. Built on a Sparse4Dv3-style visual-temporal detector, QSRadar retrieves a compact set of raw radar points around each evolving object hypothesis. The selected points are represented in an anchor-aligned coordinate frame, augmented with motion residuals, radar cross section, and sweep timing, and aggregated by a query-conditioned set encoder. Radar neighborhoods are retrieved again after each anchor refinement, coupling evidence selection with object estimation. Under the official MAN TruckScenes validation protocol, QSRadar achieves 38.09 mAP and 52.20 NDS, compared with 37.08 mAP and 50.78 NDS for our reproduced Sparse4D-Radar global Radar-BEV baseline. In matched tests on an RTX 4090 D, QSRadar reduces latency by 45%, peak memory usage by 49%, and GFLOPs by 43%.

AI.tldr: 提出QSRadar——一种查询条件化的稀疏雷达融合框架，在Sparse4Dv3式视觉-时序检测器上按查询检索原始雷达点，实现高效长距3D检测。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶卡车需相机语义与4D雷达几何/运动信息；现有雷达-相机检测器构建全局雷达BEV，计算与显存开销随感知距离增长；稀疏查询式检测器虽高效，但全局特征构建会掩盖点级几何与运动信息。
AI.method: 基于Sparse4Dv3，对每个演化中的目标假设检索其周围少量原始雷达点；将点表示在锚对齐坐标系中，并附加运动残差、雷达散射截面与扫描时序信息，由查询条件化的集合编码器聚合；每次锚框精炼后重新检索雷达邻域，使证据选择与目标估计耦合。
AI.result: MAN TruckScenes官方验证协议下达到38.09 mAP、52.20 NDS，优于复现的Sparse4D-Radar全局Radar-BEV基线（37.08 mAP、50.78 NDS）；RTX 4090 D对比测试中时延降低45%、峰值显存降低49%、GFLOPs降低43%。
AI.conclusion: 以查询条件化的局部稀疏雷达点融合替代全局Radar-BEV，在保持精度的同时显著提升长距3D检测的精度与计算/存储效率。

title: MOVER: Planning Beyond Motion
summary: Residual world models forecast a driving scene through its temporal change, so feature components that stay constant over time vanish from the residual pathway. We ask whether evidence with weak temporal change, such as a waiting pedestrian or a stopped vehicle, can be used more effectively for planning, and introduce MOVER, a complementary event-routing mechanism. A training-time teacher measures how each spatially grounded event query responds when a past frame is removed from shared history and contrasts that sensitivity with the event's pooled temporal residual, prioritizing events that depend on history but receive weak residual evidence. A student predicts the resulting priorities from unperturbed history, so the teacher adds no inference cost. Under fixed total routing mass, one distribution scales a low-rank future bird's-eye-view update and biases trajectory-conditioned event reading. On nuScenes, MOVER reduces ResWorld's UniAD-style average L2 from 0.65 to 0.55 m and its collision rate from 0.23% to 0.12% without direct planner ego status (0.50 m and 0.09% with it), adding 4.1 ms per frame. Matched controls show that the complementary teacher outperforms either signal alone and that the allocation acts mainly during training. Adapted to BridgeDrive-LEAD, MOVER reaches a 96.52 +/- 0.65 driving score over three seeds on the 220-route Bench2Drive closed-loop benchmark, exceeding matched controls in each paired seed by a margin within seed variation.

AI.tldr: 提出 MOVER 事件路由机制，弥补残差世界模型对弱时序变化事件（等待行人、静止车辆）的忽略，提升自动驾驶规划的 L2 与碰撞率指标。
AI.motivation: 残差世界模型通过时序变化预测驾驶场景，因而在时间上保持恒定的特征分量会从残差通路中消失；等待中的行人、静止车辆等弱时序变化证据因此被弱化，而这类证据对规划可能很重要。作者据此提出如何更有效地利用弱时序变化证据的问题。
AI.method: MOVER 作为残差世界模型的互补事件路由机制：训练时引入教师，逐个移除历史帧并测量每个空间锚定的 event query 的响应敏感性，再与该事件的时序残差池化值对比，优先选出"依赖历史但残差证据弱"的事件；学生模型从无扰动历史预测这些优先级，故教师不增加推理开销。在固定总路由质量下，该分布一方面缩放低秩的未来 BEV 更新，一方面偏置轨迹条件的事件读取。
AI.result: nuScenes 上，MOVER 将 ResWorld 的 UniAD 式平均 L2 从 0.65 m 降至 0.55 m，碰撞率从 0.23% 降至 0.12%（不输入规划器自车状态）；输入自车状态时为 0.50 m 与 0.09%；每帧仅增加 4.1 ms。对照实验显示互补教师优于单独使用任一信号，且该分配主要在训练期起作用。迁移至 BridgeDrive-LEAD 后，在 220 条路线的 Bench2Drive 闭环基准上三个随机种子取得 96.52 ± 0.65 驾驶分数。
AI.conclusion: 残差通路的固有盲区可通过"历史敏感性"与"残差强度"互补的教师信号识别并补偿；MOVER 以可忽略的推理开销显著改善开环精度、安全性与闭环驾驶分数，且结论在匹配对照与跨模型迁移中得到支持。

title: 3AGameFactory-Motion: Agentic Rigging and Reliable Complex Motion Generation for Diverse 3D Assets
summary: Animating arbitrary 3D assets from instructions requires both structural inference and motion control, yet existing motion benchmarks mostly cover conventional human or animal skeletons with simple instructions. We introduce DivDynBench, which evaluates rigging and motion generation across six morphology categories, with instructions requiring multi-phase part coordination and explicit timing, angle, repetition, and trajectory constraints. With large language models, we systematically compare three common paradigms: specialized motion generation, video generation followed by motion recovery, and direct agent-driven generation. We analyze their control capabilities, cross-morphology adaptability, and generation costs. Guided by this comparison, we propose an Agentic Motion Framework in which an agent writes compact parametric skeleton and motion programs, and a deterministic executor performs rigging, kinematic solving, and geometric correction. Compact parameter control reduces generation overhead and improves rigging reliability and motion-control accuracy, providing practical guidance for deploying complex 3D motion generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DivDynBench，从六个形态类别评测任意3D资产的骨骼绑定与运动生成，指令包含多阶段部件协调及显式时间、角度、重复次数与轨迹约束；基于大模型系统比较三类范式后，提出 Agentic Motion Framework（智能体编写紧凑参数化骨骼与运动程序，确定性执行器完成绑定、运动学求解与几何校正）。
AI.motivation: 从指令驱动任意3D资产的动画同时需要结构推理与运动控制，但现有运动基准多局限于常规人/动物骨架与简单指令，缺乏对非常规形态、多阶段协调与精确约束控制的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 DivDynBench 基准：覆盖六类形态，指令含多阶段部件协调及时间、角度、重复次数、轨迹等显式约束；用大语言模型系统对比三种范式（专用运动生成、先生成视频再恢复运动、智能体直接生成）；据此提出 Agentic Motion Framework——智能体输出紧凑参数化骨架与运动程序，由确定性执行器执行绑定、运动学求解与几何校正。
AI.result: 对比刻画了三类范式在控制能力、跨形态适应性与生成成本上的差异；所提框架借助紧凑参数控制在降低生成开销的同时提升了绑定可靠性与运动控制精度。
AI.conclusion: 参数化程序化生成加确定性执行是应对复杂形态3D运动生成的有效路径，并为相关系统部署提供实践性指导。

title: FASCIA: Seeing Beneath the Surface with Queryable, Personalized Anatomy in Any Pose
summary: We present FASCIA (*Functional Anatomical Structures and Composition via Implicit Atlas*), a Momentum Human Rig (MHR)-anchored framework that predicts and poses a person's internal anatomy from their external body shape and skeletal proportions. FASCIA maps a single 290-structure population template onto each individual through a smooth, invertible warp. As people with the same shape can differ internally, a body-dependent Gaussian prior predicts both average warp coordinates and their inter-subject variability. The warp deforms a learned base template into bones, muscles, organs, and fat depots. Extending MHR skinning into the interior enables direct supervision of this model across four automatically labeled CT cohorts and one whole-body MRI cohort. On 82 held-out CT scans, FASCIA reaches a mean volumetric Dice (volume agreement) of 0.48 on named bones and 0.63 on muscles, keeps the majority of bones and muscles in one piece, and yields calibrated voxel probabilities. On 33 held-out whole-body MRI subjects, FASCIA's pointwise field improves tissue overlap over HIT across all compartments, predicts between-person differences in whole-body adipose percentage ($R^2 = 0.88$ vs. $0.38$ in women and $0.54$ vs. $-0.01$ in men), and recovers segment centers of mass within 1.1 mm. Because it needs only an MHR fit, FASCIA can be driven from images, video, or any system that outputs MHR. This opens the door to fitting individualized calibrated musculoskeletal digital twins to video motion data.

AI.tldr: FASCIA 是一个以 MHR（人体表示模型）为锚点的框架，仅凭外部体型与骨骼比例即可预测并摆姿个体内部解剖结构。
AI.motivation: 现有外部人体建模（如 MHR、视频动作捕捉）无法获得内部解剖信息，而同一体型的人内部结构可能不同，缺乏一个能从体型驱动、可监督且具不确定性校准的个体化内部解剖预测方法。
AI.method: 构建含 290 个结构的人群模板，通过光滑可逆 warp 映射到个体；用与体型相关的高斯先验预测平均 warp 坐标及其个体间变异，将学习到的基模板变形为骨骼、肌肉、器官与脂肪；将 MHR 蒙皮扩展至内部以实现直接监督，训练于四个自动标注 CT 队列与一个全身 MRI 队列。
AI.result: 82 例留出 CT 上：命名骨骼平均体积 Dice 0.48、肌肉 0.63，多数骨骼与肌肉保持单体连通，体素概率经校准；33 例留出全身 MRI 上：点向场在所有分区上组织重叠优于 HIT，全身脂肪百分比个体差异预测 R²=0.88（女，对比 0.38）与 0.54（男，对比 -0.01），分区质心恢复误差约 1.1 mm。
AI.conclusion: FASCIA 仅需一个 MHR 拟合即可驱动，可源自图像、视频或任何输出 MHR 的系统，为从视频运动数据构建个体化、校准的肌骨数字孪生铺路。

title: When Should We Trust Medical Image Models? Evaluating Confidence Reliability under Cross-Dataset Shift
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Course research project, CS585 Image and Video Computing, Boston University, Spring 2026
summary:
Deep learning models for chest X-ray analysis often achieve strong performance on benchmark datasets, but their reliability under cross-dataset deployment remains unclear. In clinical practice, models trained in one hospital system may be applied to data from another, where distributional and labeling differences can affect both prediction accuracy and model confidence.
  We conduct a controlled empirical study of model confidence under cross-dataset transfer. We train ResNet-50 and DenseNet-121 on CheXpert and evaluate them on MIMIC-CXR across five experimental settings, focusing on Pneumothorax and Pleural Effusion. We measure predictive performance using AUC and confidence reliability using Expected Calibration Error (ECE), Brier score, and average confidence on incorrect predictions, all reported with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. We further evaluate post-hoc temperature scaling fit on the source validation set and use Grad-CAM to examine the mechanism behind cross-domain performance differences.
  Cross-domain AUC drops 7-13 percentage points, and the best in-domain model is not the best cross-domain model. Source-domain temperature scaling produces marginal ECE changes but systematically increases confidence on incorrect predictions across all four model-pathology combinations. Grad-CAM reveals that DenseNet relies on a concentrated spatial prior that fails to transfer, while ResNet's more distributed attention generalizes better. These findings argue for cross-site validation and safety-specific calibration metrics in medical AI evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该研究在CheXpert训练ResNet-50与DenseNet-121，跨数据集在MIMIC-CXR上评估，发现跨域AUC下降7–13个百分点，源域温度缩放虽对ECE影响甚微，却系统性提高错误预测的置信度，且DenseNet的空间先验难以迁移而ResNet的分散注意力泛化更好。
AI.motivation: 胸片深度学习模型在基准数据集上表现优异，但跨院部署时的可靠性（精度与置信度）尚不明确；分布漂移与标注差异可能同时损害预测准确性和模型置信度校准。
AI.method: 开展受控实证研究：以CheXpert为源域训练ResNet-50和DenseNet-121，在MIMIC-CXR上测试，覆盖5种实验设置，聚焦气胸与胸腔积液两类病变；用AUC衡量预测性能，用ECE、Brier分数及错误预测的平均置信度衡量置信可靠性，均报告95% bootstrap置信区间；进一步评估在源域验证集上拟合的后处理温度缩放，并用Grad-CAM分析跨域性能差异的机制。
AI.result: 跨域AUC下降7–13个百分点，且域内最优模型并非跨域最优模型；源域温度缩放对ECE改变有限，但在全部四种"模型-病变"组合中均系统性提升错误预测的置信度；Grad-CAM显示DenseNet依赖集中式空间先验且难以迁移，而ResNet的分散注意力泛化更佳。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持在医学AI评估中引入跨站点验证以及面向安全性的校准指标，而非仅依赖域内基准性能与常规校准误差。

title: Dynamic Gaussian Scene Reconstruction by Integrating Events and Structural Priors
summary: Existing approaches to event-based dynamic Gaussian reconstruction rely on two assumptions for support augmentation and reliability estimation. First, existing Gaussians can absorb reconstruction errors. Second, photometric optimization has converged sufficiently to estimate reliability using analytical variance. Both assumptions can fail under fast motion. When the first fails, regions without Gaussian support cannot generate densification candidates. When the second fails, Gaussians in moving regions where optimization has not converged may be excluded as motion references. We propose Event-Structure Collaborative Dynamic Gaussian Reconstruction (ESC-DGR), using event observations independent of both conditions. Events first identify changes that require additional support, placed only where rendered depth is valid. The augmented representation still needs reliable motion references. Online rendering statistics and historical event evidence therefore propagate displacement estimates from reliable Gaussians to weakly observed neighborhoods. These references describe dominant motion at the frame-interval timescale. Target-time events therefore further condition bounded position residuals for active Gaussians. Support placement, reference selection, and residual prediction thus operate on the same evolving representation within one optimization run. For event-driven monocular dynamic scene reconstruction, our method achieves the best reconstruction quality among the evaluated methods on the E-D3DGS benchmark. Relative to E-D3DGS, dynamic-region PSNR (dPSNR) improves by 1.02 and 1.45 dB on synthetic and real scenes, respectively. The total dynamic Gaussian count across eight synthetic scenes decreases by 8.5%. Although mean frame rate decreases by about 21%-25% relative to E-D3DGS, rendering remains above 80 FPS in all twelve scenes. Code: https://github.com/zh-yu1/ESC-DGR.

AI.tldr: ESC-DGR利用事件观测独立于"高斯可吸收误差"与"光度优化已收敛"两个假设，协同完成支撑放置、运动参考选择与残差预测，在E-D3DGS基准上取得最优动态重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有事件驱动动态高斯重建依赖两个假设：已有高斯能吸收重建误差；光度优化已充分收敛以便用解析方差估计可靠性。快速运动时二者均可能失效——前者失效导致无高斯支撑区域无法产生致密化候选，后者失效导致未收敛运动区域高斯被排除为运动参考。
AI.method: 提出ESC-DGR，使用独立于上述两条件的事件观测：先由事件识别需额外支撑的变化，且仅在渲染深度有效处放置；再借助在线渲染统计与历史事件证据，将位移估计从可靠高斯传播至弱观测邻域；最后用目标时刻事件对活跃高斯的有限位置残差进行条件化。支撑放置、参考选择与残差预测在同一次优化中作用于同一演化表示。
AI.result: 在E-D3DGS基准上，事件驱动单目动态场景重建质量在评测方法中最优；相较E-D3DGS，合成与真实场景动态区域PSNR（dPSNR）分别提升1.02 dB和1.45 dB；八个合成场景动态高斯总数减少8.5%；平均帧率下降约21%–25%，但十二个场景渲染均高于80 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 以事件观测替代对致密化与可靠性估计的收敛性假设，可统一支撑增广与运动参考选择，在保持实时渲染的前提下提升动态重建质量并减少动态高斯冗余。

title: SF-Flow: Spectral Flow Matching with High Structural Fidelity for Hallucination-Suppressed Scientific Image Generation
summary: Scientific image generation focuses on reproducing experimental appearance while following a prescribed spatial layout. A key challenge is acute data sparsity, which requires operating with unpaired collections of materials (real images and prescribed layouts), where no direct supervision is feasible. Work on unpaired translation has shown that it is possible to reproduce the texture and intensity variations of real images, but it is extremely hard to retain the intended phase boundaries in the prescribed locations. This paper tackles this challenge and introduces SF-Flow, a flow-matching model trained only on real material images that imposes spectral constraints during generation, producing images that are high-fidelity and consistent with the prescribed layouts. Because layouts enter only at generation time, the approach extends to layout maps outside the distribution of any available training layouts. We evaluate the method on synchrotron tomography of concrete, lens-coupled laboratory microCT of powders, and industrial XCT of additively manufactured metal. Without instrument-specific modeling, we show that SF-Flow achieves substantially higher template agreement and joint fidelity--structure score than previous methods, including contrastive unpaired translation.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 SF-Flow，一种仅在真实材料图像上训练的流匹配生成模型，通过在生成过程中施加频谱约束，实现遵循指定空间布局的高保真科学图像生成，并可推广到训练分布外的布局。
AI.motivation: 科学图像生成需在复现实验外观的同时遵循给定空间布局，但数据极其稀疏：仅有材料真实图像与布局的非配对集合，缺乏直接监督。现有非配对翻译方法虽能复现纹理与强度变化，却难以在指定位置保持相位边界。
AI.method: 提出 SF-Flow：基于流匹配（flow-matching）的生成模型，仅用真实材料图像训练，在生成阶段引入频谱约束以保持相位边界；布局仅在生成时输入，因此可处理训练布局分布之外的模板。
AI.result: 在混凝土同步辐射断层成像、透镜耦合实验室微CT粉末成像、增材制造金属工业XCT三类任务上，无需针对仪器专门建模，SF-Flow 在模板一致性（template agreement）与联合保真度指标（structure score）上显著优于先前方法，包括对比非配对翻译（CUT）。
AI.conclusion: 频谱约束的流匹配可在非配对、数据稀疏条件下生成兼具高保真纹理与严格布局一致性的科学图像，并具备跨仪器、跨布局分布的泛化能力。

title: Pixel as the Common Language: Unified Multimodal Embedding via Visual Rendering
summary: Multimodal embedding models map heterogeneous inputs into a shared representation space, yet text-only, image-only, and composed inputs are still presented in distinct formats and follow different routes through the model. This fragmentation prevents heterogeneous tasks from jointly optimizing the same end-to-end encoding process, limiting supervision transfer across input configurations. To address this issue, we propose unification before encoding and instantiate this paradigm in RenderEmbed. The framework uses Visual Substrate Rendering to convert heterogeneous inputs into a common visual substrate for encoding with a VLM. From the resulting visual tokens, Progressive Hierarchical Anchor Encoding produces compact retrieval representations by interleaving learnable anchors and fusing their states across layers, retaining broad context and fine-grained cues. Interventional Rendering Learning trains these representations to remain sensitive to content changes and stable across rendering variations through complementary semantic and rendering interventions. Extensive experiments on MMEB and ViDoRe v2, spanning diverse retrieval tasks, show that RenderEmbed outperforms prior state-of-the-art models at the same scale and exhibits strong out-of-domain generalization. Compared with MetaEmbed, RenderEmbed improves MMEB Overall Precision@1 by 1.7 points, with a larger 2.1-point gain on out-of-domain tasks. Transfer and scaling analyses further show that a shared visual pathway enables more effective learning from heterogeneous supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出"编码前统一"(unification before encoding)范式并实例化为RenderEmbed：将文本、图像、组合输入统一渲染为视觉基底，经VLM编码，配合渐进式层级锚点编码与干预式渲染学习，在MMEB与ViDoRe v2上超越同规模SOTA，并具更强域外泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态嵌入模型中，纯文本、纯图像与组合输入格式各异、走不同模型路径，这种碎片化导致异构任务无法在同一端到端编码过程中联合优化，跨输入配置的监督迁移受限。
AI.method: 1) Visual Substrate Rendering：把异构输入统一渲染为共同视觉基底，再由VLM编码；2) Progressive Hierarchical Anchor Encoding：在视觉token中交错插入可学习锚点并跨层融合其状态，生成紧凑检索表示，兼顾全局上下文与细粒度线索；3) Interventional Rendering Learning：通过语义干预与渲染干预，使表示对内容变化敏感、对渲染扰动稳定。
AI.result: 在MMEB与ViDoRe v2多类检索任务上优于同规模先前SOTA，域外泛化强；相较MetaEmbed，MMEB Overall Precision@1提升1.7个百分点，域外任务提升2.1个百分点；迁移与扩展性分析表明共享视觉通路能更有效利用异构监督。
AI.conclusion: 以"编码前统一"替代"编码后对齐"的碎片化路线，单一共享视觉通路可实现异构监督的有效联合学习，并在检索性能与泛化性上取得一致收益。

title: FolioWeaver: A LayerGraph-Grounded Agent for Layered Image Generation and Editing
summary: Layered image generation separates images into compositable layers, allowing users to manipulate individual elements independently. However, such asset-level editability does not enable the generation system to interpret successive feedback, perform targeted edits, and preserve unaffected content. We introduce FolioWeaver, a LayerGraph-grounded agent that unifies layered-image generation and iterative editing through a persistent Executable Scene State. FolioWeaver constructs a LayerGraph and generates independent visual assets conditioned on a shared scene reference. An Editing Agent performs feedback-driven modifications and self-repair through scoped actions, selective layer execution, and visual verification, enabling targeted updates while reusing unchanged assets. We also publicly release LayerFolio, a dataset of 100,377 human-reviewed layered scenes spanning six visual domains, together with two evaluation protocols: AtomicQA for measuring requirement satisfaction and CBLP for assessing layer organization. Experiments demonstrate that FolioWeaver achieves superior layer organization and composite fidelity compared with direct layered-generation methods. Analyses validate the contributions of component adaptation, execution-grounded repair, and cross-domain training. FolioWeaver advances layered-image generation toward persistent, controllable, and iterative visual creation. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/FolioWeaver/LayerFolio.

AI.tldr: FolioWeaver：以LayerGraph为基底、通过可执行场景状态统一分层图像生成与迭代编辑的智能体，并发布LayerFolio数据集与两项评测协议。
AI.motivation: 现有分层图像生成仅提供资产级可编辑性，系统无法理解连续反馈、执行定向编辑并保持未受影响内容不变，缺乏持久、可控的迭代创作能力。
AI.method: 构建LayerGraph，并基于共享场景参考生成相互独立的视觉资产；由Editing Agent通过作用域动作、选择性图层执行与视觉验证完成反馈驱动的修改与自我修复，复用未变更资产；同时发布含100,377个人工审核分层场景、覆盖六个视觉域的数据集LayerFolio，以及AtomicQA（需求满足度）与CBLP（图层组织）两项评测协议。
AI.result: 相比直接分层生成方法，FolioWeaver在图层组织与合成保真度上更优；消融分析验证了组件适配、执行性修复与跨域训练的贡献。
AI.conclusion: FolioWeaver推动分层图像生成向持久、可控、可迭代的视觉创作发展；数据集与协议公开可用。

title: Hierarchical Reasoning Action Head for Tiny Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Real-time onboard robot control calls for a lightweight vision-language-action (VLA) model, yet shrinking the backbone leaves less capacity for deliberation at inference time. Chain-of-thought decoding, dual-system architectures, and larger backbones can restore deliberation but reintroduce the latency and memory costs that motivated going small. Recurrent action heads offer a lighter alternative by iterating in latent space before committing to an action, but existing designs refine a single undifferentiated state that must simultaneously encode slowly evolving task context and rapidly changing motor commands. We propose the Hierarchical Reasoning Action Head (HR-AH), which maintains two latent states updated at different frequencies: a low-level state that updates fast, grounded in action tokens and proprioception, and a high-level state that updates slowly, grounded in visual understanding and the instruction-informed low-level state. The two states exchange information through nested reasoning cycles. Because all iteration occurs in the compact head after a single backbone pass, HR-AH adds hierarchical reasoning without increasing the backbone size. With a 22.5M-parameter head, 3-4.3x smaller than those of RD-VLA and VLA-Adapter on the same backbone, HR-AH reaches 97.0% success rate on LIBERO and a 4.40 average chain length on CALVIN ABC->D, at the lowest latency among compared methods. We show that this hierarchy improves performance over a parameter-matched single-state head, and that routing distinct modalities to each level yields further gains in both accuracy and inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出分层推理动作头 HR-AH，在单次骨干前向之后于紧凑的头部内进行双频潜状态迭代推理，以22.5M参数实现LIBERO 97.0%成功率与CALVIN 4.40平均链长，且延迟最低。
AI.motivation: 实时机载机器人控制需要轻量VLA模型，但缩小骨干会削弱推理时的深思能力；而思维链解码、双系统架构与增大骨干虽能恢复深思，却重新引入延迟与显存开销。循环动作头是更轻量的替代方案，但现有设计仅精炼单一未分化状态，需同时编码慢变任务上下文与快变运动指令，存在表征冲突。
AI.method: 提出分层推理动作头（HR-AH）：维护两个以不同频率更新的潜状态——低层状态快速更新，以动作token和本体感觉为依据；高层状态缓慢更新，以视觉理解和受指令引导的低层状态为依据；两状态通过嵌套推理循环交换信息。所有迭代均在单次骨干前向后的紧凑头部中完成，因此不增加骨干规模。
AI.result: 头部仅22.5M参数，较同骨干下RD-VLA与VLA-Adapter的头部小3–4.3倍；在LIBERO上达97.0%成功率，在CALVIN ABC->D上平均链长4.40，且在对比方法中延迟最低。参数匹配的单状态头对比实验表明分层带来性能提升；将不同模态路由至不同层级可进一步提升精度并降低推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过在紧凑动作头内部实现快慢双频的分层潜空间推理，可在不扩大骨干的前提下为轻量VLA补充推理能力，并兼得高成功率、长任务链与低延迟；分层结构与模态分层路由均是有效且低成本的设计要素。

title: LexiDet-OVD: Benchmarking Lexical Sensitivity in Open-Vocabulary Object Detection
summary: Open-vocabulary object detectors localize objects from free-form text prompts, but their reliability depends on how users describe the target. Standard evaluations usually test a fixed class name, leaving prompt-induced failure modes underexplored. We introduce LexiDet-OVD, a benchmark and metric suite for studying lexical sensitivity in open-vocabulary object detection. We organize prompt sets into equivalent, conditional, and broad semantic scopes, and evaluate four detector families on fixed COCO and LVIS samples, each covering 30 classes (800 held-out COCO images and 1,000 LVIS images). Beyond mean and worst-prompt AP50, we report P10, CVaR at 20%, leave-one-prompt-out influence, detection agreement, box consistency, and confidence variance using one-to-one multi-instance matching. Equivalent-prompt best-to-worst gaps range from 5.3 to 23.4 points on COCO1000 and from 5.1 to 29.9 points on LVIS1000-30c, showing that strong average accuracy and lexical stability are distinct properties. We compare maximum-score selection, weighted-box fusion, Prompt Consensus, and an exploratory fusion rule. Aggregation recovers performance in several settings, but no method dominates all model-dataset pairs. A controlled Detic/SHiNe comparison further shows that semantic hierarchy enrichment does not by itself eliminate lexical sensitivity. These results support reporting prompt-distribution robustness alongside conventional open-vocabulary detection accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出LexiDet-OVD基准与指标套件，系统研究开放词汇目标检测中的词汇敏感性（等价/条件/宽泛语义提示），并通过多种聚合方法分析提示诱导的失效模式。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇检测器依赖用户自由文本描述目标，但标准评测通常只用固定类名，导致提示诱导的失效模式未被充分探索；平均精度高与词汇稳定性可能是两种不同属性。
AI.method: 构建LexiDet-OVD，将提示集划分为等价、条件、宽泛语义三类；在固定COCO（800张留出图像）与LVIS（1000张、30类）样本上评测四类检测器；除均值与最差提示AP50外，报告P10、20% CVaR、留一提示影响、检测一致性、框一致性、置信度方差，采用一对一多实例匹配；比较最大分数选择、加权框融合、Prompt Consensus及一种探索性融合规则，并进行Detic/SHiNe受控对比。
AI.result: 等价提示最佳-最差差距在COCO1000上为5.3–23.4点，在LVIS1000-30c上为5.1–29.9点；聚合可部分恢复性能但无方法在全部模型-数据集组合上占优；语义层级增强（SHiNe）本身不能消除词汇敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 应常规报告开放词汇检测精度之外，同时报告提示分布鲁棒性。

title: Bi-Refine: Semantic Verification-Guided Progressive Refinement for Moment Retrieval
summary: Moment Retrieval (MR) aims to identify the temporal segment in an untrimmed video that corresponds to a natural language query. Existing approaches commonly refine temporal predictions within the localization pathway, without explicitly verifying candidate-level semantic consistency. Moreover, directly reusing semantic scores as feedback can cause over-correction when the verification signal is unreliable. To address these issues, we propose Bi-Refine, a semantic verification-guided progressive refinement framework that formulates MR as a closed-loop verification-and-refinement process. A Heuristic Localization Branch first generates candidate moments, while a Semantic Verification Branch evaluates their query consistency in a semantically enriched latent space. Query supervision further trains the verifier with the same candidate moment but different queries, encouraging it to distinguish the matched query from semantically similar mismatched queries. The resulting verification features are incorporated into a Progressive Refinement Loop that updates both query representations and multimodal features. To suppress potentially harmful updates, a lightweight reliability estimator gates query updates and reweights candidate contributions in feature feedback. A convergence-based adaptive stopping strategy additionally terminates unnecessary refinement during inference. Experiments on three standard MR benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and state-of-the-art performance of our method.

AI.tldr: 提出Bi-Refine，将时刻检索(MR)建模为闭环的“验证-精炼”过程：语义验证支路评估候选时刻与查询的一致性，并通过渐进精炼环路反馈更新查询与多模态特征，配合可靠性门控与自适应停止策略，在三个标准基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有MR方法仅在定位路径内细化时间预测，缺乏对候选级别语义一致性的显式验证；且将语义分数直接作为反馈时，若验证信号不可靠会导致过度校正(over-correction)。
AI.method: 1) 启发式定位支路(Heuristic Localization Branch)生成候选时刻；2) 语义验证支路在语义增强的隐空间中评估候选与查询的一致性，并采用查询监督——同一候选时刻配不同查询，训练验证器区分匹配查询与语义相似的不匹配查询；3) 渐进精炼环路(Progressive Refinement Loop)将验证特征用于更新查询表示与多模态特征；4) 轻量级可靠性估计器对查询更新做门控并对特征反馈中的候选贡献重新加权，抑制有害更新；5) 基于收敛的自适应停止策略在推理时终止冗余精炼。
AI.result: 在三个标准MR基准上的实验验证了方法的有效性，并达到state-of-the-art性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式候选级语义验证并结合可靠性门控的闭环渐进精炼，可有效缓解反馈不可靠导致的过度校正，为MR提供更稳健的定位与精炼机制。

title: Teaching How to Reason, Beyond What to Answer: Evidence-Faithful On-Policy Distillation for streaming video understanding
summary: Moment Retrieval (MR) aims to localize the temporal segment in a video that corresponds to a given textual description. However, a textual query often provides only a sparse semantic description of the target event, whereas the video contains rich and fine-grained visual variations. This mismatch creates an inherent gap between textual semantics and visual content, making a single textual input insufficient for precise cross-modal alignment. As a result, when multiple temporally adjacent or semantically similar segments exist, the model may struggle to distinguish the target moment from confusing candidates. To address this challenge, we propose a Multi-Perspective Auxiliary Representation (MPAR) framework, which aims to bridge this alignment gap by enriching a single textual input with complementary visual cues from multiple perspectives. Specifically, MPAR consists of three key components: (1) Auxiliary Representation Initialization (ARI) constructs multiple learnable representation slots from the original query, preserving the query intent while preparing flexible carriers for subsequent visual cue injection; (2) Visual-Induced Semantic Structuring (VISS) injects target-specific visual attributes into each representation while preserving semantic coherence with the original query; and (3) Multi-Perspective Semantic Aligner (MPSA) aligns each auxiliary representation with corresponding video regions to enhance discriminative localization. By constructing multi-perspective auxiliary representations and guiding the model to attend to relevant visual regions across these representations, our model achieves more accurate moment localization. Extensive experiments on MR benchmarks demonstrate that our MPAR outperforms state-of-the-art methods, validating the effectiveness of MPAR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多视角辅助表示框架MPAR，通过在原始文本查询基础上注入多视角视觉线索，缓解文本语义稀疏与视频视觉信息丰富之间的对齐鸿沟，从而提升时刻检索的定位精度。
AI.motivation: 时刻检索中，文本查询往往只提供稀疏的语义描述，而视频包含丰富细粒度视觉变化，二者存在固有语义-视觉鸿沟，单一文本输入难以实现精确跨模态对齐；当存在时间相邻或语义相似的多个片段时，模型易将目标与混淆候选混淆。
AI.method: MPAR包含三个组件：(1) 辅助表示初始化ARI：从原始查询构建多个可学习表示槽，在保留查询意图的同时为后续视觉线索注入提供灵活载体；(2) 视觉引导语义结构化VISS：向每个表示注入目标特定视觉属性，并保持与原始查询的语义一致性；(3) 多视角语义对齐器MPSA：将各辅助表示与对应视频区域对齐，增强判别性定位。
AI.result: 在时刻检索基准上的大量实验表明，MPAR优于现有最先进方法，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过构建多视角辅助表示并引导模型跨表示关注相关视觉区域，MPAR可实现更精确的时刻定位，是弥合文本-视觉对齐鸿沟的有效方案。

title: MORSE: Optimizing Streaming Memory Design via Open-World Auto-Research
summary: A streaming video system must decide in a single pass what evidence to retain under bounded frame storage, before it knows which details a future question will require. Recent recursive self-improvement methods automate the design of the harness that stores and retrieves this evidence. They revise the harness in response to failures, but the editor must still devise each repair from its prior knowledge and a predefined set of tools. A failure that recurs across videos, however, may point to a problem that prior work has already addressed. We introduce MORSE (Memory Optimization with Recursive Self-Evolvement), an open-world auto-research framework that uses recurring failures to guide an online search for solutions. Its editor groups failures in training traces by cause, then searches papers, model cards, and code for methods it can adapt or pretrained perception models it can use. When the editor introduces a new perceptual capability, it can also revise how the harness stores and retrieves the resulting evidence for a frozen video-language model. On held-out validation streams, MORSE first selects revisions that improve answer quality, then seeks faster revisions that preserve those gains within a specified tolerance. Across three streaming video benchmarks, MORSE consistently achieves the highest answer accuracy within each frozen-backbone comparison. On OVO-Bench, our Qwen3-VL-8B harness answers queries in 0.30 seconds on average while achieving 75.1% accuracy, 3.1 percentage points ahead of the next-best evaluated harness using the same frozen backbone.

AI.tldr: MORSE：一个开放世界自动研究框架，利用跨视频复现的失败来在线检索论文、模型卡与代码，自适应改造流式视频系统的证据存储/检索harness，并按"先提精度、再提速度"两阶段筛选修订，在三个流式视频基准上取得同类冻结骨干中的最高准确率。
AI.motivation: 流式视频系统必须在单遍处理、帧存储受限的条件下决定保留哪些证据，而未来问题需要什么细节事先未知；现有递归自我改进方法在修订harness时仅依赖编辑器的先验知识与预设工具集，无法利用"跨视频复现的失败"所对应的、已有工作中已解决的方案。
AI.method: 1) 编辑器按原因对训练轨迹中的失败聚类；2) 基于这些复现失败在开放世界中检索论文、模型卡与代码，寻找可适配的方法或可直接使用的预训练感知模型；3) 引入新感知能力时，同步修订harness对相应证据的存储与检索方式（面向冻结的视频-语言模型）；4) 在留出验证流上做两阶段选择：先选提升答案质量的修订，再在给定容差内寻找保持收益的更快修订。
AI.result: 在三个流式视频基准的每个冻结骨干对比中，MORSE均取得最高答案准确率；在OVO-Bench上，基于Qwen3-VL-8B的harness平均响应时间0.30秒、准确率75.1%，比同冻结骨干的次优harness高3.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将"复现失败"作为开放世界检索的查询信号，可自动发现并整合外部感知能力与配套的证据管理策略，从而在冻结骨干条件下同时改善流式视频问答的质量与延迟。

title: KGLP-Net: Kalman-Reliable Global--Local Learning With Group Fisher Pruning for Hyperspectral Image Classification
summary: Accurate hyperspectral image (HSI) classification requires both the effective integration of broad spatial context and fine-grained spectral--spatial information surrounding target pixels. However, the reliability of these complementary representations may vary considerably across heterogeneous scenes, and uncertainty estimates obtained during feature fusion are rarely exploited to guide subsequent model compression. To address these challenges, we propose Kalman-Reliable Global--Local Learning with Group Fisher Pruning (KGLP-Net), a unified framework that couples uncertainty-aware feature fusion with reliability-guided structured pruning. Specifically, an asymmetric dual-view architecture employs a Global Mamba Encoder to capture long-range spatial dependencies and a Local CNN Encoder to extract fine-grained spectral--spatial features from target neighborhoods. To adaptively integrate these complementary representations, Kalman-Reliable Fusion (KRF) estimates their relative uncertainties in feature space and performs a Kalman-inspired posterior update, treating global features as a contextual prior and local features as an observation. Building upon the resulting posterior uncertainty, Kalman-Reliable Group Fisher Pruning (KRGF) quantifies group-level reliability through normalized posterior precision and integrates it with Group Fisher importance to identify and prune Kalman-coupled channel groups, enabling structurally consistent model compression. Experiments on four public HSI datasets demonstrate that the resulting Compact48 model, with a hidden width of 48, achieves the highest overall accuracy among ten representative competing classifiers. Compared with the unpruned Dense64 model, Compact48 reduces the number of parameters, FLOPs, and inference time by 38.5%, 34.8% and 37.6% on average, respectively, while incurring only a 0.03-percentage-point decrease in mean overall accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出KGLP-Net，将不确定性感知的全局-局部特征融合（Kalman-Reliable Fusion）与可靠性引导的结构化剪枝（Kalman-Reliable Group Fisher Pruning）统一，实现高光谱图像分类的精度与效率兼顾。
AI.motivation: HSI分类需同时整合大范围空间上下文与目标像素邻域的精细光谱-空间信息，但这两类互补表示在异质场景中的可靠性差异显著；且特征融合过程中产生的不确定性估计很少被用于指导后续模型压缩。
AI.method: 采用非对称双视图架构：Global Mamba Encoder捕获长程空间依赖，Local CNN Encoder提取邻域精细光谱-空间特征。KRF在特征空间估计二者相对不确定性，以全局特征为上下文先验、局部特征为观测，进行Kalman式后验更新。基于后验不确定性，KRGF用归一化后验精度量化组级可靠性，并与Group Fisher重要性结合，识别并剪除Kalman耦合通道组，实现结构一致的压缩。
AI.result: 在四个公开HSI数据集上，隐藏宽度48的Compact48模型在十个代表性对比分类器中取得最高总体精度；相较未剪枝Dense64，参数量、FLOPs与推理时间平均分别降低38.5%、34.8%、37.6%，平均总体精度仅下降0.03个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以后验不确定性为桥梁，可将融合可靠性自然传导至剪枝决策，在几乎不损失精度的前提下实现显著轻量化，验证了不确定性引导压缩在HSI分类中的有效性。

title: SpectralRoute: Adaptive Spectral Routing for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Hyperspectral Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation enables the recognition of arbitrary categories through natural language descriptions and has recently been extended from natural images to remote sensing. However, existing approaches primarily focus on three-channel optical imagery or limited-band multispectral data, while pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to directly exploit the rich spectral information of hyperspectral imagery (HSI) without additional adaptation. More importantly, different land-cover categories rely on distinct spectral cues, which may be weakened by uniform fusion. To address these challenges, we propose SpectralRoute, a training-free framework for open-vocabulary hyperspectral segmentation. Specifically, we construct complementary spectral views from HSI and enrich category descriptions with external spectral knowledge, enabling frozen vision-language models to extract diverse spectral-semantic responses. We then introduce a class-adaptive spectral routing mechanism that selectively amplifies discriminative spectral responses for each category, overcoming the limitations of uniform fusion. Furthermore, physical spectral priors are incorporated to refine predictions for visually similar land-cover categories. Experiments on three hyperspectral benchmarks demonstrate that SpectralRoute consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods without additional training.

AI.tldr: SpectralRoute 是免训练的开放词汇高光谱语义分割框架，利用互补光谱视图、外部光谱知识增强的类别描述、类别自适应光谱路由和物理光谱先验，在三个基准上免训练超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇语义分割方法主要基于三通道光学影像或有限波段多光谱数据；预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）难以直接利用高光谱影像（HSI）丰富的光谱信息，且统一融合会削弱不同地物类别所依赖的差异化光谱线索。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架 SpectralRoute：从HSI构建互补光谱视图，并用外部光谱知识丰富类别描述，使冻结VLM提取多样化光谱-语义响应；引入类别自适应光谱路由机制，为每类选择性放大判别性光谱响应以替代统一融合；再结合物理光谱先验细化视觉相似类别的预测。
AI.result: 在三个高光谱基准数据集上，SpectralRoute 在无需额外训练的情况下持续优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过互补光谱视图、类别自适应光谱路由与物理光谱先验，可在免训练条件下有效将VLM扩展到开放词汇高光谱语义分割。

title: Seeing vs. Knowing: Counterfactual Supervision and Correction for 3D-Aware Object Editing
summary: Rotating, translating, or rescaling an object in a photograph requires revealing unseen surfaces, preserving visible appearance, and updating shadows and reflections. Reconstructed 3D assets, rendered at the target pose as a 3D state, provide explicit geometric guidance, but their imperfect textures may conflict with the photograph, while standard paired training does not explicitly teach the editor which source to trust. To address this, we propose counterfactual state supervision, which constructs controlled photo--state conflicts through hidden-surface repainting, hidden geometry with re-rendered shadows and reflections, and visible-surface texture replacement. This teaches the editor to follow the 3D state for unseen content while preserving photograph-visible appearance. However, learning this distinction does not ensure that it is maintained during sampling. We therefore introduce symmetric counterfactual correction, which uses state-side and photo-side twins, which share the photograph and the state respectively, to construct directed latent perturbations toward condition-inconsistent targets and train recovery toward the target specified by the current condition. Both strategies operate only during training, requiring no architectural changes or additional inference steps. Experiments on OBJect and SpatialEdit-Bench demonstrate strong spatial editing performance and content preservation, while controlled ablations show improved source selection and sustained responsiveness to conditioning during sampling.

AI.tldr: 提出反事实状态监督与对称反事实校正两种训练策略，使图像编辑器在空间编辑中正确区分应信任3D状态还是照片信息，无需改变架构或少步推理。
AI.motivation: 旋转、平移、缩放物体需生成未见表面并保持可见外观、更新阴影反射；3D重建资产可提供几何引导但纹理不完美会与照片冲突，而常规配对训练未显式教会编辑器信任哪一信息源。
AI.method: 1) 反事实状态监督：通过隐藏表面重绘、隐藏几何重渲染阴影反射、可见表面纹理替换，构造受控的照片—状态冲突；2) 对称反事实校正：利用分别共享照片与状态的孪生样本，构造指向条件不一致目标的定向潜空间扰动，并训练向当前条件指定目标恢复。二者仅用于训练。
AI.result: 在OBJect与SpatialEdit-Bench上表现强空间编辑性能与内容保持；受控消融显示源选择能力提升，采样过程中对条件响应持续保持。
AI.conclusion: 反事实监督可使编辑器学习未见内容遵循3D状态、可见外观保持照片，对称校正保证采样阶段维持该区分；无需架构修改或额外推理步骤。

title: Shift by Analogy for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
summary: Compositional zero-shot learning recognizes attribute-object pairs absent from training. An unseen pair has a semantic description but lacks an observed visual reference.
