We propose Shift by Analogy (SBA) to make unseen compositions visually seen through a shift-then-match process. Its core add-subtract-add rule transfers an attribute change between two seen image-text residuals on a source object to a reference residual on the target object. This shifts the target's own text feature toward its visual center; learned refinement produces a proxy for matching query images. During training, each target is excluded from its supports, and recognition is learned using references constructed from other pairs. An analogy library and same-object attention extend this construction across candidates, while joint learning integrates proxy matching with semantic and primitive evidence. Visual-center analysis confirms substantially improved correspondence for unseen compositions. Experiments across three standard benchmarks show that SBA consistently outperforms strong CZSL baselines under both closed- and open-world evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Shift by Analogy (SBA)，通过"平移-匹配"流程为未见属性-对象组合构造视觉代理，使其在推理时"可见"，在三个 CZSL 基准上于闭世界与开放世界设定均超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 组合零样本学习需识别训练中未出现的属性-对象组合；未见组合仅有语义描述而缺乏观测到的视觉参照，导致文本特征与视觉中心失配。
AI.method: 核心为"加-减-加"规则：将源对象上两对已见图文残差间的属性变化迁移至目标对象的一个参照残差上，从而把目标自身的文本特征平移到其视觉中心；再经学习式精炼生成用于匹配查询图像的代理特征。训练时每个目标从其支持集中排除，用其他组合构建参照进行识别学习；辅以类比库与同对象注意力在候选间扩展该构造，并通过联合学习融合代理匹配与语义、原语证据。
AI.result: 视觉中心分析显示未见组合的特征对应性显著提升；三个标准基准实验表明 SBA 在闭世界与开放世界评测下均稳定优于强 CZSL 基线。
AI.conclusion: 以类比平移构造视觉代理可有效弥补未见组合的视觉参照缺失，是一种通用且稳健的 CZSL 方案。

title: TAED: Trajectory-Aligned Encoder--Decoder Distillation for Detection Transformers
summary: Distilling localization knowledge into compact detection transformers (DETRs) requires consistent teacher-student query correspondence across decoder layers. However, in DETRs with encoder-based query selection, the teacher and student select top-K proposals independently. Same-rank queries can originate from different spatial locations and correspond to different objects, making rank-based layer-wise supervision unreliable. To address this problem, we propose Trajectory-Aligned Encoder-Decoder Distillation (TAED), a framework for knowledge transfer between DETRs of different capacities. Encoder feature distillation matches normalized multi-scale features to strengthen student representations and increase the number of teacher-student query pairs from the same encoder locations. Source-indexed query alignment pairs native queries from the same encoder locations and retains pairs associated with the same object for which the teacher provides reliable and more accurate final localization than the student. Trajectory-aligned localization distillation maintains these correspondences and uses teacher proposals and corresponding decoder-layer box predictions to guide student refinement, without introducing additional queries. On COCO, TAED improves DINO-R18 and two-stage Deformable DETR-R18 by 2.5 and 1.7 AP, respectively. Further gains on D-FINE and ECDet demonstrate applicability to recent real-time DETRs at no additional inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出轨迹对齐编码器-解码器蒸馏框架TAED，解决DETR中基于排名的逐层蒸馏对应关系不可靠的问题，在COCO上显著提升多种DETR检测器。
AI.motivation: 将定位知识蒸馏进紧凑DETR需要跨解码层的师生查询一致对应，但采用编码器查询选择的DETR中，教师与学生独立选择top-K候选，同排名查询可能来自不同空间位置、对应不同目标，使基于排名的逐层监督不可靠。
AI.method: TAED包含三部分：1）编码器特征蒸馏，匹配归一化多尺度特征以增强学生表示并增加来自相同编码器位置的师生查询对；2）源索引查询对齐，配合同一编码器位置的原始查询并保留对应同一目标且教师最终定位比学生更可靠更准确的配对；3）轨迹对齐定位蒸馏，维持该对应关系，用教师候选框及对应解码层框预测指导学生细化，且不引入额外查询。
AI.result: 在COCO上，TAED使DINO-R18和两阶段Deformable DETR-R18分别提升2.5和1.7 AP；在D-FINE和ECDet上进一步取得增益，表明可适用于近期实时DETR且无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过以编码器源位置为索引建立稳定的师生查询与轨迹对应，TAED实现了可靠的逐层定位蒸馏，在不同容量与实时DETR上均有效且不增加推理成本。

title: ToWo-VTON: Take-Off Wear-On Virtual Try-On via Topology-aware Decoupling
summary: Virtual Try-On (VTON) aims to synthesize garment transfer without physical trials. Although recent methods perform well on upper-body garments, they still struggle in lower-body and full-body scenarios with complex occlusions and large silhouette changes. To address this limitation, we introduce ToWo (Take-Off Wear-On), a two-stage paradigm that decouples body structure estimation from garment synthesis. Take-Off first generates a tight-fitting body proxy that provides estimated structural guidance, and Wear-On then synthesizes the target garment conditioned on this prior. This decoupling reduces source-garment interference, supporting garment placement under substantial silhouette variations. Built on this paradigm, we propose ToWo-VTON, a unified topology-aware framework with structure-aware supervision. We construct the Body-Fitting DressCode (BFDC) dataset via body-aware diffusion and VLM-based filtering to provide body-proxy supervision across upper-, lower-, and full-body cases. We instantiate ToWo-VTON on both diffusion-based and MLLM-guided backbones. For diffusion-based models, we fine-tune on BFDC using the body proxy as the person input. For the MLLM-guided model, we use native backbone conditioning for the body proxy and target garment, and add Garment Boosting Attention (GBA) to preserve garment details. Experiments on VITON-HD and DressCode demonstrate improvements over the evaluated baselines, with KID reductions of 26.1% and 58.6% for diffusion-based and MLLM-guided implementations, respectively. The combined BFDC-training and Take-Off/Wear-On strategy also produces more coherent limb layouts and garment boundaries across the evaluated garment categories.

AI.tldr: 提出ToWo两阶段范式（Take-Off/Wear-On），将身体结构估计与服装合成解耦，并构建BFDC数据集，实现上/下/全身虚拟试衣的统一拓扑感知框架。
AI.motivation: 现有VTON方法在上衣场景表现良好，但在下装与全身场景中，面对复杂遮挡与大幅轮廓变化仍存在困难，主要因源服装对结构估计产生干扰。
AI.method: ToWo范式：Take-Off先生成紧身身体代理提供结构引导，Wear-On再以此先验合成目标服装。基于此提出ToWo-VTON统一拓扑感知框架与结构感知监督；通过身体感知扩散与VLM过滤构建Body-Fitting DressCode（BFDC）数据集；在扩散模型与MLLM引导骨干上分别实例化，后者引入Garment Boosting Attention（GBA）保留服装细节。
AI.result: 在VITON-HD和DressCode上优于评估基线，扩散实现与MLLM引导实现的KID分别降低26.1%和58.6%；BFDC训练与Take-Off/Wear-On组合策略在各服装类别下产生更连贯的肢体布局与服装边界。
AI.conclusion: 解耦结构估计与服装合成可有效支持大幅轮廓变化下的服装放置，结合身体代理监督显著提升下装与全身场景的试衣质量。

title: WaDiS: Boundary-Preserving Diffusion Segmentation via Multi-Scale Wavelet Conditioning and Frequency-Aware Gating
summary: Diffusion models have shown strong potential in medical image segmentation due to their generative capabilities and robustness. However, existing methods often struggle to preserve fine anatomical boundaries and to retain multi-scale structural information due to the loss of spatial and frequency details during feature encoding, particularly in complex clinical imaging conditions. This work presents WaDiS, a wavelet-powered conditional latent diffusion framework for medical image segmentation that addresses these limitations through multi-scale wavelet conditioning and frequency-aware information filtering for boundary preservation. The model adopts a multi-scale wavelet conditioning encoder to retain rich structural features, leveraging its lossless nature to better preserve semantic priors critical to the diffusion process. In addition, a Frequency-Aware Gating Block (FAGB) is introduced into the skip connections of the diffusion U-Net, enabling adaptive spectral filtering and residual fusion to better emphasize boundary structures while reducing irrelevant content. To improve generalization across clinical domains, we adopt a structure-preserving color augmentation strategy during training. Specifically, global color statistics are transferred between samples in the LAB color space, allowing the model to decouple appearance from structure and focus more on anatomical shape rather than color bias. Experiments on five benchmark datasets demonstrate that WaDiS consistently outperforms existing diffusion-based and conventional segmentation methods, with notable improvements in boundary accuracy, robustness to noise, and generalization under color variation. The code for this work will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: WaDiS：小波驱动的条件潜空间扩散分割框架，通过多尺度小波条件编码、频域感知门控与结构保持颜色增强，提升医学图像分割的边界精度、抗噪性与跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式医学图像分割方法在特征编码中丢失空间与频域细节，难以保持精细解剖边界及多尺度结构信息，在复杂临床成像条件下尤为明显；同时模型易受颜色偏置影响，跨临床域泛化不足。
AI.method: 1) 多尺度小波条件编码器：利用小波变换的无损特性保留丰富结构特征与语义先验；2) 频域感知门控块（FAGB）：嵌入扩散U-Net跳跃连接，进行自适应谱域滤波与残差融合，突出边界结构、抑制无关内容；3) 结构保持颜色增强：在LAB空间于样本间迁移全局颜色统计量，解耦外观与结构，使模型聚焦解剖形状；4) 整体为条件潜空间扩散分割框架。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上，WaDiS 一致优于现有基于扩散的分割方法与常规分割方法，在边界准确率、噪声鲁棒性及颜色变化下的泛化性方面均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度小波条件建模与频域自适应滤波可有效缓解扩散分割中的空间/频域细节损失，配合结构保持颜色增强可提升跨域泛化；该框架为边界敏感、鲁棒的医学图像分割提供了有效方案（代码将在接收后公开）。

title: Thermal-Guided Low-Light UAV Image Enhancement: A Reliability-Aware Guidance Network and a Unified Benchmark
summary: Thermal-guided low-light image enhancement (LLIE) is promising for nighttime unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) perception because thermal imagery remains informative under severe visible degradation. However, the degraded visible image serves as both the alignment reference and the enhancement target, making thermal guidance uncertain in its spatial correspondence and local utility under low illumination, sensor differences, and UAV motion. Misaligned or unsuitable thermal cues may introduce artifacts, while spatially varying degradation requires region-specific restoration rather than uniform enhancement. To address these challenges, we propose a Reliability-Aware Multi-Strategy Guidance Network (RMGNet) for thermal-guided UAV LLIE under weak optical-thermal alignment. Its Reliability-Aware Guidance Calibration Module (RAGCM) performs coarse-to-fine displacement estimation and jointly evaluates the reliability of aligned thermal guidance and the usability of degraded visible evidence. Based on calibrated guidance, degradation, and reliability cues, the Multi-Strategy Enhancement Routing Module (MSERM) generates candidates for detail preservation, highlight-protected relighting, and thermal compensation, then spatially routes their contributions. We further construct the UAV weakly aligned Optical-Thermal dataset (UWOT), the largest UAV-oriented benchmark to date for weakly aligned optical-thermal low-light enhancement, containing 5,000 triplets. Extensive experiments show that RMGNet outperforms representative single-modal and multimodal state-of-the-art methods in enhancement quality while retaining competitive computational efficiency and greater robustness to practical cross-modal misalignment. The dataset and code will be publicly available at https://github.com/mmic-lcl/Datasets-and-benchmark-code.

AI.tldr: 提出可靠性感知多策略引导网络RMGNet，解决弱光-热对齐下UAV低照度图像增强中热引导不确定问题，并构建UWOT数据集。
AI.motivation: 夜间UAV感知中热成像在可见光严重退化时仍有信息量，但退化可见光图像同时充当配准参考与增强目标，加之低照度、传感器差异与UAV运动，导致热引导的空间对应关系与局部效用不确定；错位或不合适的热线索会引入伪影，且空间变化的退化需要区域自适应恢复而非统一增强。
AI.method: RAGCM模块执行由粗到细的位移估计，并联合评估对齐后热引导的可靠性与退化可见光证据的可用性；MSERM模块基于校准后的引导、退化与可靠性线索，生成细节保持、高光保护重光照、热补偿三类候选，并对其贡献进行空间路由。同时构建UWOT弱对齐光学-热数据集，含5000组三元组。
AI.result: 在增强质量上优于代表性单模态与多模态SOTA方法，同时保持有竞争力的计算效率，并对实际跨模态错位具有更强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 通过可靠性感知的引导校准与多策略空间路由，可有效缓解弱对齐条件下热引导的不确定性，实现区域自适应的UAV低照度增强；UWOT数据集与代码将公开，为弱对齐光学-热低照度增强提供基准。

title: Reasoning Beyond Imitation: Observation Conditioned Distillation for Video LLMs
summary: Reasoning distillation offers a promising approach to transfer temporal reasoning capabilities of powerful Video-LLMs to open-source student models. However, teacher and student Video-LLMs may construct different temporal observations from the same video due to the adoption of distinct video sampling pipelines. A reasoning trajectory valid under the teacher's observations may rely on evidence inaccessible to the student and thus cannot be directly executed based on the student's observations. We formalize this as a conditional target mismatch, thereby revealing the Reasoning Acquisition-Execution Gap. To bridge this gap, we propose an acquisition-to-execution framework that first distills teacher trajectories into a student reasoning prior and then further optimizes the execution capability of this prior across multiple observations. We further introduce Execution-Aware Reference Regularization, which retains the existing prior when it is executable under current observations, while allowing a greater degree of adaptive adjustment when it is not. Experiments across multiple Video-LLM backbones and six video reasoning benchmarks show that explicitly optimizing observation-conditioned execution consistently outperforms supervised distillation and standard RL-based optimization, with gains extending to held-out out-of-domain benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 针对教师与学生Video-LLM因采样流程不同而产生的时序观测不一致，论文形式化为条件目标不匹配（Reasoning Acquisition-Execution Gap），提出"获取-执行"两阶段框架及执行感知参考正则化，在多骨干、六基准上超过监督蒸馏与标准RL优化。
AI.motivation: 强大Video-LLM的时序推理能力希望通过推理蒸馏迁移到开源学生模型，但师生视频采样管线不同，导致同一视频构建的时序观测不同；教师观测下有效的推理轨迹可能依赖学生无法获取的证据，无法直接执行，构成"获取-执行鸿沟"。
AI.method: 将上述问题形式化为条件目标不匹配；提出acquisition-to-execution框架：先将教师轨迹蒸馏为学生推理先验，再在多种观测下优化该先验的执行能力；并引入Execution-Aware Reference Regularization——当先验在当前观测下可执行时保留先验，不可执行时允许更大自适应调整。
AI.result: 在多种Video-LLM骨干与六个视频推理基准上，显式优化以观测为条件的执行能力稳定优于监督蒸馏与标准RL优化，且收益可泛化到留出的域外基准。
AI.conclusion: 推理蒸馏需区分"获取"与"执行"两个环节；显式建模观测条件并优化执行能力是弥合师生观测差异、提升学生Video-LLM时序推理的有效途径。

title: UniDR: Learning To Generate Anatomical Deformations From Images via Unified Diffusion Modeling and Registration
summary: This paper presents a novel framework, Unified Diffusion modeling and Registration (UniDR), which learns to generate arbitrary anatomical deformations from images with preserved topology. Existing approaches often model the generative process separately from registration-based deformation estimation; hence making them prone to propagated errors from the registration stage. To address this limitation, we propose a unified paradigm based on a conditional diffusion model over deformation fields that are jointly optimized from the registration process. A principled registration-guided score-matching objective function is then introduced to align the diffusion process with the deformation distribution induced by registration. As a result, our UniDR establishes an explicit connection between generation and registration: the diffusion model enables exploration of the space of plausible anatomical deformations, whereas registration provides structured supervision for learning transformations consistent with observed images. Once trained, UniDR is able to sample diverse, anatomically plausible transformations conditioned on any single input image. We evaluate UniDR across multiple real-world applications and demonstrate its effectiveness in generating high-fidelity image samples compared to the state-of-the-art. Additionally, we demonstrate that these generated samples improve performance in downstream medical image analysis and vision tasks.

AI.tldr: UniDR 提出统一扩散建模与配准的框架，以配准引导的得分匹配目标学习保拓扑的任意解剖变形生成，可基于单张输入图像采样多样、解剖合理的变换，并在下游任务中提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将生成过程与基于配准的变形估计分离建模，误差会在配准阶段传播，导致生成质量受限。
AI.method: 构建作用于变形场上的条件扩散模型，使其与配准过程联合优化；提出配准引导的得分匹配目标函数，将扩散过程与配准诱导的变形分布对齐，从而在生成（探索合理解剖变形空间）与配准（提供结构化监督）之间建立显式联系。
AI.result: 在多个真实应用中验证，UniDR 相较最先进方法可生成高保真图像样本，且生成的样本能提升下游医学图像分析与视觉任务的表现。
AI.conclusion: 统一扩散建模与配准的范式可有效避免分离建模带来的误差传播，实现保拓扑、多样化的解剖变形生成，并对下游任务具有实用价值。

title: Mass Forcing: On-Policy Mass-Aware Distillation for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for real-time video synthesis, distilling pretrained diffusion models into few-step autoregressive generators. However, its reverse-KL objective is mode-seeking and can collapse the student's conditional video distribution onto a narrow subset of modes, leading to reduced sample diversity, diminished temporal dynamics, and color oversaturation. Existing methods mitigate this issue mainly via coverage-oriented student initialization, but we observe that such coverage is transient: across three initializations, the fraction of dynamic videos drops sharply during subsequent DMD training, indicating that the mode-seeking objective, not the initialization, drives this degradation. We propose Mass Forcing, a probability-mass-aware framework that moves on-policy DMD supervision from whole videos to individual states. Each update branches several continuations from a shared student-generated prefix, making the student's probability mass at that state measurable against the teacher. First, Mass Forcing estimates relative teacher-to-student density ratios among these continuations through latent-space score integration and uses them to rebalance conditional DMD updates, amplifying rollouts underrepresented relative to the teacher. Second, since mismatched mode probabilities do not necessarily induce strong local score corrections, it aligns generated rollout sets with a reweighted reference distribution defined by the same mass estimates, providing cross-rollout supervision. Experiments on MovieGen and VBench show that Mass Forcing improves video fidelity and sustains temporal dynamics throughout training, achieving the highest Total scores among compared methods and a Dynamic Degree of 83% after 1,000 generator updates, versus 12-32% for the baselines, with no additional inference-time overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Mass Forcing，一种概率质量感知的 DMD 蒸馏框架，将 on-policy 监督从整段视频细化到单个状态层级的重加权，从而缓解 reverse-KL 模式塌缩，显著提升视频动态度与保真度。
AI.motivation: DMD 的 reverse-KL 目标具有 mode-seeking 特性，易使学生条件视频分布塌缩到少数模式，造成样本多样性下降、时序动态减弱与色彩过饱和。现有方法多依赖 coverage 导向的学生初始化，但作者观察到这种覆盖是瞬态的——三种初始化下动态视频比例在后续 DMD 训练中均急剧下降，说明退化由 mode-seeking 目标本身而非初始化导致。
AI.method: Mass Forcing 以概率质量为出发点，在 on-policy DMD 监督中从整段视频下沉到单个状态：(1) 每次更新从共享的学生生成前缀分叉出多条 continuation，使学生在某状态的概率质量可与教师对比；通过潜空间 score 积分估计各 continuation 间教师/学生相对密度比，据此重加权条件 DMD 更新，放大相对教师被低估的 rollout；(2) 由于模式概率失配未必产生强局部 score 修正，进一步将生成 rollout 集合与由同一质量估计定义的加权参考分布对齐，提供跨 rollout 监督。
AI.result: 在 MovieGen 与 VBench 上，Mass Forcing 提升视频保真度并在整个训练过程中维持时序动态，Total 分数在对比方法中最高；1,000 次生成器更新后 Dynamic Degree 达 83%，而基线仅 12–32%，且无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 视频 DMD 蒸馏中的多样性/动态退化源于 mode-seeking 目标而非初始化；在状态层级引入可测的概率质量估计与重加权监督可有效缓解该问题，且不增加推理成本，为实时少步自回归视频生成提供更稳健的蒸馏方案。

title: GravHMR: Coupling SLAM and Human Mesh Recovery in a Shared Gravity Frame
summary: Recovering globally consistent 3D human motion from monocular videos remains challenging under dynamic camera motion. Although SLAM and human mesh recovery (HMR) provide complementary camera and body estimates, directly combining them often leads to inconsistent orientations and accumulated trajectory drift. We present GravHMR, a training-free, plug-and-play framework that couples SLAM and HMR through a shared gravity-aligned reference. By allowing gravity to be estimated independently of the HMR backbone, GravHMR accommodates world-grounded HMR models with or without explicit gravity-view representations. Specifically, Yaw-Aware Orientation Optimization (YAOO) resolves heading inconsistencies by correcting body and velocity orientations about the shared gravity axis. Conditioned on these corrected orientations, Gravity-Aware Trajectory Optimization (GATO) anchors root trajectories in the metric SLAM world by jointly leveraging 2D reprojection, the metric scale implicit in the human body, and the body's own motion. On EMDB-2, GravHMR achieves state-of-the-art performance with 154.0 mm W-MPJPE100 using ViPE and 189.8 mm using masked DROID-SLAM, outperforming TRAM (222.4 mm) under the same masked DROID-SLAM camera estimates. It further reduces W-MPJPE100 by 44.3% over GVHMR (276.5 mm) and by 20.0% over GVHMR + HTD-Refine (192.4 mm) with the same HMR backbone.

AI.tldr: GravHMR：一种免训练、即插即用框架，通过共享重力对齐参考耦合SLAM与HMR，实现单目视频中全局一致的三维人体运动恢复。
AI.motivation: 动态相机运动下的单目视频全局一致3D人体运动恢复仍具挑战。SLAM与人体网格恢复(HMR)提供互补的相机与人体估计，但直接组合常导致朝向不一致与轨迹累积漂移。
AI.method: 以共享重力对齐参考为纽带耦合SLAM与HMR；重力可独立于HMR主干估计，兼容有/无显式重力视角表示的世界接地HMR模型。包含两部分：Yaw-Aware Orientation Optimization (YAOO) 绕共享重力轴校正人体与速度朝向，消解航向不一致；Gravity-Aware Trajectory Optimization (GATO) 在这些校正朝向条件下，联合利用2D重投影、人体隐含的度量尺度及自身运动，将根轨迹锚定于度量SLAM世界。
AI.result: EMDB-2上达到SOTA：使用ViPE为154.0 mm W-MPJPE100，使用masked DROID-SLAM为189.8 mm，优于相同masked DROID-SLAM相机估计下的TRAM(222.4 mm)；相同HMR主干下较GVHMR(276.5 mm)降低44.3%，较GVHMR+HTD-Refine(192.4 mm)降低20.0%。
AI.conclusion: 以重力对齐作为共享参考可有效缓解朝向不一致与轨迹漂移，GravHMR以免训练、即插即用的方式显著提升全局一致的人体运动恢复精度。

title: STAGE: Structured Test-Time Adaptation with Global Entropic Soft-coupling for Cross-Subject Brain-to-Image Retrieval
comment: 38 pages, including the main paper and appendix
summary: Cross-subject brain-to-image retrieval aims to identify viewed images from unseen subjects' brain signals. However, inter-subject variability hinders alignment of brain-image representations, while independent query ranking tends to concentrate predictions on a few candidates, making accurate retrieval difficult without target labels. We propose STAGE (Structured Test-Time Adaptation with Global Entropic Soft-coupling), a structured test-time adaptation framework for recovering cross-subject alignment from uncertain brain-image correspondences. Moment calibration reduces statistical discrepancies between features, while coupling-weighted initialization establishes initial alignment. Coupling-guided adaptation further refines residual feature mismatches, and soft-coupling ranking coordinates candidate competition across queries to prevent overly concentrated matching assignments. Using only unlabeled target batches, STAGE maintains consistent matching from feature calibration to image retrieval while keeping both encoders frozen. Experiments on three public datasets validate STAGE's retrieval performance. On THINGS-EEG2, STAGE achieves 68.25% Top-1 and 90.47% Top-5, improving Top-1 by 18.52 percentage points over SCORE recovery and CSLS on identical frozen NICE features. Calibrated on 200 queries and a 200-image gallery covering their identities, STAGE retains 42.05% Top-1 when ranking 1,854 images with the transform frozen.

AI.tldr: 提出STAGE框架，用无标签目标批次实现跨被试脑信号-图像检索的结构化测试时适配。
AI.motivation: 跨被试脑-图检索中，被试间差异阻碍脑-图表示对齐；同时独立查询排序易使预测集中于少数候选，在无目标标签下难以准确检索。
AI.method: STAGE包含四部分：矩校准（moment calibration）减小特征统计差异；耦合加权初始化建立初始对齐；耦合引导适配细化残余特征失配；软耦合排序协调跨查询候选竞争，防止匹配过度集中。仅用无标签目标批次，两编码器保持冻结。
AI.result: 三个公开数据集验证检索性能。THINGS-EEG2上Top-1 68.25%、Top-5 90.47%，在相同冻结NICE特征下较SCORE recovery+CSLS提升Top-1 18.52个百分点；以200查询、200图库校准后冻结变换，在1,854张图像中仍保持42.05% Top-1。
AI.conclusion: 结构化测试时适配可在无标签条件下从特征校准到图像检索保持一致的匹配，有效恢复跨被试对齐并提升检索鲁棒性。

title: STAR: Structure-Aware Temporal Action Recovery for Point Supervised Temporal Action Localization
summary: Point supervised temporal action localization is becoming the need of time in this era of ever growing and non-stop video data. Existing method mainly rely on snippet level action response to generate pseudo labels. However, these labels often suffer from boundary ambiguity, over extended proposals, and weak temporal structure. To address these issues, we propose STAR, a structure-aware Temporal Action Recovery framework for point supervised temporal action localization. STAR works by enhancing the base S model with temporal difference interaction with attention module to capture forward and backward snippet changes, and introduces the learning of start, core, and end roles to model the internal temporal structure of actions. In addition, STAR further improves the pseudo label generation through All point proposal ranking and Rolebank based structural re-ranking, which suppress neighbor crossing and structurally inconsistent proposals. Finally, temporal action detector to STAR feedback supervision transfers high quality detector prediction back to the STAR model through soft start, core, end, action, and background targets. This helps to further refine the pseudo labels. Extensive experiments on four standard benchmarks shows the effectiveness of STAR. By using I3D features, STAR achieves 67.2% at AVG@0.1:0.7 on THUMOS'14, 58.1% on GTEA, 74.6% on BEOID, and 31.7% at AVG@0.5:0.95 on ActivityNet-1.3, outperforming previous point supervised methods across multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出STAR——结构感知的时序动作恢复框架，用于点监督时序动作定位，通过时序差分交互、start/core/end角色建模、全点提案排序与Rolebank结构重排序、以及检测器反馈监督，缓解伪标签边界模糊与结构弱的问题，并在四个基准上取得领先。
AI.motivation: 点监督时序动作定位在视频数据激增背景下需求上升，但现有方法依赖片段级动作响应生成伪标签，存在边界模糊、提案过度延伸、时序结构弱等问题，限制了定位精度。
AI.method: 以基础S模型（base S model）为骨干，引入带注意力模块的时序差分交互以捕捉前后片段变化；学习start、core、end三类角色建模动作内部时序结构；伪标签生成采用全点提案排序（All point proposal ranking）与基于Rolebank的结构重排序，抑制交叉邻居与结构不一致提案；再由时序动作检测器向STAR反馈软start/core/end/action/background目标实现闭环监督，精化伪标签。
AI.result: 在四个基准上验证有效性：使用I3D特征，THUMOS'14 AVG@0.1:0.7 达67.2%，GTEA 58.1%，BEOID 74.6%，ActivityNet-1.3 AVG@0.5:0.95 达31.7%，在多个基准上超越现有点监督方法。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知的时序建模与结构重排序结合检测器反馈闭环，可有效缓解点监督伪标签的边界模糊与结构弱问题，提升时序动作定位性能。

title: Video Generalized Category Discovery
summary: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) aims to categorize unlabeled data from both known and unknown classes using labeled data from only the known classes. While recent GCD methods have shown promise on static images, their performance degrades in videos due to temporal dynamics, larger intra-class variation, and the lack of temporal consistency in existing approaches. We introduce VideoGCD, a framework tailored for video action recognition under the GCD setting. Our method integrates (i) a partitioned Mixture-of-Experts module that encourages specialization for known and novel categories, (ii) a novel-class balancing loss to reduce bias toward known classes, and (iii) a temporal optimal transport loss that promotes consistent routing across frames. Experiments on three video benchmarks demonstrate that VideoGCD significantly improves performance over existing GCD methods, particularly on novel categories. Our findings highlight the importance of combining temporal modeling and expert specialization for video GCD.

AI.tldr: 提出 VideoGCD 框架，将广义类别发现（GCD）从静态图像扩展到视频动作识别，通过分区混合专家、新类平衡损失与时间最优传输损失，在三个视频基准上显著优于现有 GCD 方法，尤其在未知类别上提升明显。
AI.motivation: 现有 GCD 方法在静态图像上有效，但迁移到视频时性能下降，原因在于时间动态性、更大的类内差异，以及既有方法缺乏时间一致性建模。
AI.method: (1) 分区式 Mixture-of-Experts 模块，促使专家分别对已知类与新类形成特化；(2) 新类平衡损失，缓解对已知类的偏置；(3) 时间最优传输损失，促进跨帧路由结果的一致性。
AI.result: 在三个视频基准上，VideoGCD 相较现有 GCD 方法显著提升性能，且在新类上的增益尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 将时间建模与专家特化相结合对视频 GCD 至关重要，是该场景下提升性能的关键设计方向。

title: Uncovering Separable and Composable Skill Mechanisms in Vision-Language Models
summary: Recent work has sought to localize the internal mechanisms underlying visual reasoning skills in vision-language models. These methods largely overlook separability and composability in both mechanism identification and evaluation. We propose separability and composability as two important desiderata for skill localization. Separability requires identified mechanisms to contribute primarily to their target skills while having limited effects on other skills, enabling precise diagnosis and targeted intervention. Composability requires skill mechanisms to be combinable to support complex tasks, allowing a small set of mechanisms to account for broader capabilities. In this work, we propose a multi-skill interpretability framework DISCO, built around these two properties. For identification, we propose Separable Head Selection, which selects skill-specific attention heads based on their contributions across skills. For evaluation, we are the first to design metrics for measuring separability and composability of identified heads. Extensive experiments on three VLMs and four fundamental visual reasoning skills demonstrate the effectiveness of DISCO. It achieves the highest separability, outperforming the strongest baseline by 24.80, 18.38, and 13.75 points across the three models, respectively, while also achieving the highest composability on all three models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多技能可解释性框架DISCO，以"可分性"和"可组合性"两项准则定位视觉语言模型中的视觉推理技能机制。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉推理技能的内部机制定位工作在机制识别与评估两方面均忽视了可分性与可组合性，导致机制难以精确诊断、难以组合支持复杂任务。
AI.method: DISCO包含两部分：识别端提出Separable Head Selection，依据注意力头在各技能上的贡献差异挑选技能专属头；评估端首次设计用于度量所识别注意力头可分性与可组合性的指标。
AI.result: 在3个视觉语言模型、4项基础视觉推理技能上实验，DISCO取得最高可分性，三个模型分别较最强基线提升24.80、18.38、13.75分，并在三个模型上均取得最高可组合性。
AI.conclusion: 可分性与可组合性可作为技能定位的有效准则，DISCO通过可分离头选择与配套指标实现了更精确的技能机制定位与更广的能力覆盖。

title: RoomTokens: Masked Diffusion over Structured Tokens for Indoor Scene Synthesis
summary: Generating 3D indoor scenes requires a representation that captures object semantics, instance identity, height structure, and orientation while respecting room geometry. Methods that model scenes as sequences of object vectors learn spatial constraints implicitly, leaving collisions and boundary violations to losses or post-processing; semantic-map methods make occupancy explicit, but collapse instance and directional structure. We introduce RoomTokens, a sliced structured-token representation in which each token stores semantic class, instance-color identity, and facing field. This representation allows a scene to be generated as a discrete grid while preserving cues for instance grouping, orientation estimation, and 3D extent prediction. To learn the RoomToken distribution, we propose MDIRT (Masked Diffusion over RoomTokens), a masked discrete diffusion model that denoises semantic/instance-color/facing channels jointly with a shared cross-slice backbone. Architectural tokens are clamped as explicit floor- plan constraints, so the model samples furniture layouts that respect room geometry while retaining instance and object-attribute structure. Experiments on 3D-FRONT show that RoomTokens with MDIRT improve layout fidelity and physical consistency over sequence/vector- and map-based methods, suggesting structured spatial tokens as a practical choice for discrete 3D scene synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出RoomTokens切片结构化token表示与MDIRT掩码离散扩散模型，在离散网格上生成3D室内场景，联合建模语义、实例与朝向。
AI.motivation: 现有3D室内场景生成表示存在两难：以对象向量序列建模的方法隐式学习空间约束，碰撞与越界问题需依赖损失函数或后处理解决；语义地图方法显式表达占据，却丢失实例身份与朝向结构。
AI.method: RoomTokens将场景表示为切片网格token，每个token编码语义类别、实例颜色身份与朝向场；采用MDIRT（RoomTokens上的掩码离散扩散），以共享跨切片主干联合去噪语义/实例颜色/朝向三个通道；并将建筑token钳制为显式平面布局约束。
AI.result: 在3D-FRONT数据集上，RoomTokens+MDIRT在布局保真度与物理一致性上优于序列/向量方法与地图方法。
AI.conclusion: 结构化空间token是离散3D场景合成的实用选择，兼具显式占据与实例、朝向结构表达能力。

title: Quantization for Action, Execution for Deployment: Joint Precision and Execution Selection for World Action Models
summary: World action models guide robots by predicting the effects of actions or generating commands from observations. A model may compare hundreds of candidate futures before acting, repeatedly reading weights that must fit in device memory. Post-training quantization reduces the number of bits used to store pretrained weights, but a smaller model is not necessarily a deployable one: temporary tensors can exceed graphics processing unit (GPU) memory limits, while even small prediction errors can change the selected action. This creates two coupled challenges: identifying bit assignments that preserve task performance and determining which of them meet real execution constraints, without exhausting costly task trials. We present PTQ4WAM, a framework for choosing layer-wise bit assignments and execution routes under memory, latency and task-evaluation budgets. Calibration measurements guide candidate proposals, optionally with a language model agent. We profile full-model routes on the GPU before spending task trials on feasible assignments. Fusing group rescaling and reading visual history in place can make an otherwise infeasible assignment deployable. Across 15 workloads from four model families, the median task score is 99.2% of the corresponding 32-bit floating-point (FP32) score. On fixed GPU replays, the median speedup over FP32 is 2.36 times and the median reduction in peak allocated memory is 71.5%. The code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: PTQ4WAM：面向世界动作模型的后训练量化框架，联合选择逐层位宽分配与执行路径，在内存、延迟与任务评测预算约束下保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型需在设备内存内反复读取权重、比较大量候选未来；PTQ 虽降低权重比特数，但临时张量可能超出 GPU 显存，且微小预测误差可能改变所选动作。因此需同时解决"位宽分配保性能"与"满足真实执行约束"两个耦合问题，且避免耗尽昂贵的任务试验。
AI.method: 构建在内存、延迟与任务评测预算下的逐层位宽分配与执行路径选择框架；以校准测量指导候选提案（可选引入语言模型智能体）；先在 GPU 上对全模型路径做剖析筛选，再对可行分配投入任务试验；并采用分组重缩放融合与视觉历史原地读取等手段，使原本不可行的分配变得可部署。
AI.result: 在四个模型族的 15 个负载上，任务得分中位数为对应 FP32 得分的 99.2%；固定 GPU 回放中相对 FP32 加速中位数 2.36×，峰值显存分配中位下降 71.5%。
AI.conclusion: 量化模型的可部署性不等同于比特数减少，需将性能保持与执行约束联合优化；将执行路线剖析前置可显著节省任务评测成本，融合与原地读取等实现级优化能扩大可行解空间。代码即将开源。

title: Visual-RFT++: Extending Visual Reinforcement Fine-Tuning to Multimodal Tool Use
comment: Our code is available at https://github.com/Liuziyu77/Visual-RFT
summary: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) has recently become a central paradigm for advancing Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), as demonstrated by systems such as OpenAI's o3 and the R1 series. Despite significant progress in LLMs, how to leverage RFT to unify visual perception, step-by-step reasoning, and agentic tool use into one coherent training paradigm remains an open challenge. In this work, we present Visual Reinforcement Fine-Tuning++ (Visual-RFT++), a unified framework that extends RFT to both visual perception tasks and multimodal agentic workflows, enabling LVLMs to reason with images, act upon images, and evaluate their own outputs using verifiable reward. With Visual-RFT++, open-source LVLMs not only show significant gains on diverse visual perception tasks, but also acquire agentic abilities such as web searching for real-time information and code-based image manipulation (e.g., cropping, rotation, and analysis). Across visual perception tasks, including fine-grained classification, few-shot detection, reasoning grounding, and open-vocabulary detection, Visual-RFT++ delivers strong gains over SFT, including a +24.3 percentage points improvement in one-shot fine-grained classification and +21.0 percentage points on COCO's 4-shot setting and +15.4 percentage points on LVIS with around several hundred samples. To evaluate agentic behaviors, we introduce the Multimodal Agentic Tool Bench (MAT) with MAT-Search and MAT-Coding. Visual-RFT++ surpasses its baseline by +18.6 F1 / +13.0 EM percentage points on MAT-Coding and +10.3 F1 / +8.7 EM percentage points on MAT-Search. It also shows gains of 29.3 F1 and 25.9 EM percentage points on multi-hop QA benchmarks such as 2Wiki and HotpotQA, demonstrating strong cross-modal generalization. Visual-RFT++ introduces a data-efficient and reward-driven framework that strengthens both visual reasoning and agentic adaptability.

AI.tldr: 提出 Visual-RFT++，将强化微调(RFT)扩展至视觉感知任务与多模态智能体工作流，并用可验证奖励驱动训练；同时构建 MAT-Search/MAT-Coding 基准，在视觉感知与智能体任务上均显著超越 SFT 基线。
AI.motivation: 强化微调已成为大型推理模型的核心范式，但如何用 RFT 将视觉感知、逐步推理与智能体工具调用统一到同一训练框架仍是开放问题。
AI.method: 统一框架 Visual-RFT++：扩展 RFT 至视觉感知任务与多模态智能体流程，使 LVLM 能基于图像推理、对图像执行操作并利用可验证奖励自评输出；新增 MAT 基准（MAT-Search 实时检索、MAT-Coding 代码化图像操作）。
AI.result: 细粒度分类单样本 +24.3 个百分点，COCO 4-shot +21.0，LVIS 数百样本 +15.4；MAT-Coding +18.6 F1/+13.0 EM，MAT-Search +10.3 F1/+8.7 EM；2Wiki/HotpotQA 多跳问答 +29.3 F1/+25.9 EM。
AI.conclusion: Visual-RFT++ 提供数据高效、奖励驱动的训练框架，同时增强视觉推理与智能体适应性，并具跨模态泛化能力。

title: Audio-Visual Rearrangement
summary: We introduce Audio-Visual Rearrangement (AVR), a novel task in which an agent hears a spoken request, retrieves a suitable object, and delivers it to the requesting user or an instruction-specified destination. AVR requires the agent to understand the spoken request and acoustically localize the speaker for delivery. To support this task, we construct a dataset covering three query types: explicit target specification, speaker-relative spatial references, and implicit user intent, spanning eight subtypes with diverse object selection and delivery requirements. Moreover, we propose a framework that integrates a motion-aware spatial audio module into an audio-visual large language model to encode spatial cues from the spoken request and update them as the agent moves. We further incorporate auxiliary supervision for speech understanding, spatial audio perception, and visual grounding through multitask instruction tuning to improve action prediction. Experiments establish baseline performance in both seen and unseen environments, laying the groundwork for future research on embodied intelligence and human-robot interaction. The code will be publicly available soon.

AI.tldr: 论文提出新任务 Audio-Visual Rearrangement (AVR)：智能体根据语音请求检索合适物体并送达请求者或指定地点，需理解语音并对说话者进行声学定位；构建涵盖三类查询（显式目标、说话者相对空间指代、隐含意图）、八种子类型的数据集，并提出将运动感知空间音频模块融入音视频大语言模型的框架，配合多任务指令微调（语音理解、空间音频感知、视觉定位）辅助监督，在可见与未见环境中建立基线。
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能任务多依赖视觉或文本指令，缺乏对"语音请求理解+说话者声学定位+移动过程中的空间线索动态更新"这一组合能力的系统研究；为推进具身智能与人机交互研究，需要引入新的任务定义、基准数据与基线方法。
AI.method: 1) 定义 AVR 任务：听取语音请求、检索物体、送达请求者或指令指定目的地；2) 构建数据集，覆盖三类查询（显式目标指定、说话者相对空间指代、隐含用户意图）与八种子类型；3) 提出框架：将运动感知空间音频模块集成到音视频大语言模型中，编码语音请求中的空间线索并随智能体移动更新；4) 通过多任务指令微调引入语音理解、空间音频感知与视觉定位的辅助监督以改进动作预测。
AI.result: 在可见（seen）与未见（unseen）环境中均建立了基线性能，验证了所提框架在该任务上的可行性，并为后续研究提供参照基准。
AI.conclusion: AVR 作为结合语音理解、空间音频感知与视觉定位的物体重排新任务，为具身智能与人机交互研究奠定基础；代码将公开。当前工作侧重任务定义与基线建立，尚未报告具体性能数值。

title: A Cascaded Framework with a Cross-Attention-Guided Mamba-CNN Model for Pre- and Post-Treatment Glioma Segmentation
summary: Accurate glioma segmentation is vital for diagnosis and follow-up, but manual segmentation is time-consuming, subjective, and variable across interpreters. Gliomas are heterogeneous in size, shape, and location. Deep learning has therefore emerged as a potential solution. CNNs excel at local features but may struggle with long-range dependencies, whereas Vision Transformers capture global context efficiently but incur higher computational complexity. Most previous studies focused on pre-treatment gliomas; post-treatment cases with resection cavities (RCs) remain less explored. This study proposes a Cross-Attention-Guided Mamba-CNN (CMC-Seg) model within a cascaded framework for pre- and post-treatment diffuse glioma segmentation, aiming to balance accuracy and computational cost. Experiments used BraTS 2025 mpMRI of diffuse glioma patients. After preprocessing, a coarse segmentation model extracted tumor-centered patches, which were fed to CMC-Seg for fine-grained segmentation. CMC-Seg was compared with 3D U-Net, SegResNet, SwinUNETR, UNETR, nnFormer, and SegMamba. On the test set, CMC-Seg achieved the highest mean Dice (81.20%) and non-enhancing tumor core (NETC) Dice (77.09%). It also achieved an RC Dice of 78.63% and the lowest 95% Hausdorff distance (HD95; 4.39 mm). Results were comparable to CNN and Mamba baselines and significantly better than Transformer-based baselines (P < 0.05). CMC-Seg required the fewest inference GFLOPs (381.49). Ablation experiments indicated that multi-direction scanning and cross-attention improved performance, particularly for RC (P < 0.05). Grad-CAM explainability experiments showed that CMC-Seg focuses on diagnostically relevant tumor regions.

AI.tldr: 提出级联框架下的交叉注意力引导 Mamba-CNN 模型 CMC-Seg，兼顾治疗前后弥漫性胶质瘤分割的精度与计算成本。
AI.motivation: 胶质瘤分割对诊断与随访至关重要，但人工勾画耗时、主观且一致性差；肿瘤在大小、形状、位置上高度异质。CNN 擅长局部特征但长程依赖建模不足，ViT 虽能捕获全局上下文却计算复杂度高；且既往研究多聚焦治疗前病例，含切除腔（RC）的治疗后病例研究不足。
AI.method: 在级联框架中实现分割：先由粗分割模型提取以肿瘤为中心的 patch，再输入 CMC-Seg 进行细粒度分割；模型将 Mamba（多方向扫描）与 CNN 结合，并以交叉注意力进行引导。基于 BraTS 2025 弥漫性胶质瘤 mpMRI 数据，与 3D U-Net、SegResNet、SwinUNETR、UNETR、nnFormer、SegMamba 对比，并进行消融与 Grad-CAM 可解释性实验。
AI.result: 测试集上平均 Dice 最高（81.20%），NETC Dice 77.09%，RC Dice 78.63%，HD95 最低（4.39 mm）；性能与 CNN、Mamba 基线相当，显著优于 Transformer 基线（P<0.05）；推理 GFLOPs 最少（381.49）。消融显示多方向扫描与交叉注意力提升性能，尤其在 RC 上显著（P<0.05）；Grad-CAM 显示模型聚焦于诊断相关肿瘤区域。
AI.conclusion: CMC-Seg 在治疗前后弥漫性胶质瘤分割中实现了精度与计算效率的良好平衡，多方向扫描与交叉注意力机制（尤其对切除腔）贡献显著，具备临床可解释性。

title: Ref2Light: From One Image to Interactive Glasses-Free 3D Characters
summary: Animating character illustrations on light-field displays demands coherent binocular parallax, real-time pose articulation, and fine-grained expression control. However, existing 2D animation and 3D reconstruction pipelines cannot combine these with rapid character switching. We present Ref2Light, a feed-forward framework that maps a single A-pose illustration and continuous pose and expression controls to display-native light-field animation, without per-character 3D reconstruction, rigging, or test-time optimization. Our key insight is to decompose light-field synthesis into static identity, view-dependent parallax, and control-driven articulation. A shared encoder caches multi-scale identity features once per character for rapid switching. A conditional decoder then synthesizes ordered angular anchors from these features via backward texture transport and direct color synthesis. A global-local control scheme deforms the anchors with head-body controls and uses the updated correspondence fields to track facial regions across views for masked local facial refinement. Finally, calibrated differentiable subpixel interlacing converts the anchors into the native panel raster, enabling end-to-end native supervision without rendering all views at full resolution. On held-out VRoid identities, Ref2Light reduces head-body LPIPS by 20.1%-55.6% over 2D and 3D baselines and lowers non-target change MAE in mouth closure by 95.6%-96.5% versus monolithic decoding, while running at 34.0-40.1 FPS for 1440x2560 native rasters on a consumer GPU. Code and demo are in the Supplementary Material.

AI.tldr: Ref2Light：前馈式单一A-pose插画到光场原生动画生成的框架，无需逐角色3D重建/绑骨/测试时优化，支持快速切换角色、连续姿态表情控制与实时渲染。
AI.motivation: 光场显示上的角色插画动画需同时满足双目视差连贯、实时姿态驱动与细粒度表情控制，而现有2D动画流程与3D重建流程难以兼顾这些需求并支持快速角色切换。
AI.method: 将光场合成解耦为静态身份、视角相关视差与控制驱动关节三部分：共享编码器对每个角色只缓存一次多尺度身份特征以支持快速切换；条件解码器经反向纹理传输与直接颜色合成生成有序角度锚点视图；全局-局部控制方案以头体控制变形锚点，并用更新后的对应场跨视角追踪面部区域做掩码局部细化；最后用标定可微亚像素交织把锚点转为原生面板栅格，实现无需全分辨率渲染全部视角的端到端原生监督。
AI.result: 在留出的VRoid身份上，头体LPIPS较2D与3D基线降低20.1%–55.6%；嘴部闭合的非目标变化MAE较单体解码降低95.6%–96.5%；消费级GPU上1440x2560原生栅格达34.0–40.1 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 通过身份-视差-关节的解耦与原生栅格端到端监督，Ref2Light在无需逐角色重建与绑骨的前提下实现了高质量、可控、实时的光场角色动画，并显著优于2D/3D基线。

title: PROPS: Can Visual Generators Keep the Current Look of a Prop?
summary: Many generation tasks draw the next image from a visual history, such as storyboards, illustrated stories and multi-turn editing. A new request often states what happens next without restating how earlier objects look. Instead of recovering an object's current look from the history, generators often redraw it from the request alone or bring back an outdated look, and the error can carry into later steps. We call this failure prop drift. Existing evaluations rarely isolate it, because similarity to the history rewards copying and a judge that sees a single history cannot tell a look recovered from that history from one the generator happens to prefer. We introduce PROPS, a benchmark of 2,257 pairs of twin histories that end on the same request but show one prop in two different looks. A pair passes only if the generator draws the matching look on each side and carries out the request, so a look preferred by the generator or the judge passes at most one side. All 34 open and closed systems we test show prop drift, and even systems that carry out the requested action on most sides often lose the current look of the prop. Swapping the planners and editors of agents further shows that both history understanding and image generation limit agent performance. We also build PROPS-Train, 80,250 training chains in four tracks whose targets recover an earlier state or carry scripted changes forward, and fine-tuning on it clearly improves all four tested models. Both datasets will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"属性漂移"(prop drift)问题并构建PROPS基准：2,257对孪生历史序列，同终点请求下同一物体呈两种外观，要求生成器从历史中恢复正确外观；测试的34个系统均存在该问题，同时发布PROPS-Train训练集并验证微调可显著改善。
AI.motivation: 在故事板、连环画、多轮编辑等按视觉历史生成下一张图的任务中，新请求往往只说明接下来发生什么，而不重述物体先前外观。生成器要么仅凭请求重绘物体，要么回退到过时外观，且错误会传播到后续步骤。现有评测难以隔离该失败，因为与历史的相似度会奖励"照抄"，而只看单一历史的评判器无法区分"从历史恢复的外观"与"生成器自身偏好的外观"。
AI.method: 构建PROPS基准：2,257对孪生历史，两条历史以相同请求结尾，但其中同一道具以两种不同外观出现；一对样本只有在两侧分别画出与各自历史匹配的外观且完成请求动作时才算通过，从而排除生成器或评判器偏好的干扰。另构建PROPS-Train：80,250条训练链，分四个赛道，目标为恢复先前状态或将脚本化变化向前传递。
AI.result: 全部34个开源与闭源系统均表现出属性漂移；即使多数样本能正确执行请求动作的系统，也常丢失道具的当前外观。通过交换智能体的规划器与编辑器，表明历史理解与图像生成两方面都制约着智能体性能。在PROPS-Train上微调使四个受测模型均有明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 属性漂移是视觉历史生成中的普遍且被现有评测掩盖的失败模式，需借助孪生历史式的对照设计加以隔离；该问题同时源于历史理解与图像生成能力，而针对性的状态恢复与变化传递训练数据可有效缓解。两个数据集将公开发布。

title: Inspect Before You Decide: Evidence-Guided Visual Search for Industrial Anomaly Detection
summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential for industrial anomaly detection and understanding. However, reliably identifying subtle anomalies remains challenging, as existing approaches often struggle to acquire and verify fine-grained visual evidence beyond global observations. To address this challenge, we propose EVAD, an evidence-guided visual search framework that enables MLLMs to actively seek and examine diagnostically informative visual evidence for reliable anomaly reasoning. Specifically, EVAD begins with a global visual assessment to identify potentially anomalous regions for further inspection. Building upon this observation, we introduce a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-guided exploration strategy that progressively acquires visual evidence through two complementary operations: semantic refinement for fine-grained inspection and spatial expansion for contextual verification. The acquired evidence is subsequently evaluated and integrated to support more informed and reliable anomaly decisions. Extensive experiments across multiple industrial anomaly detection tasks demonstrate that EVAD achieves state-of-the-art performance in most evaluated settings, highlighting the effectiveness of active evidence exploration for fine-grained anomaly understanding and reasoning. The code will be publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: EVAD：证据引导的视觉搜索框架，让MLLM主动获取并核验细粒度视觉证据以进行工业异常检测与推理。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在工业异常检测上潜力显著，但仅凭全局观测难以获取与核验细粒度视觉证据，导致细微异常识别不可靠。
AI.method: 先做全局视觉评估定位疑似异常区域；再用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）引导的探索策略，通过两种互补操作逐步获取证据：语义细化（细粒度检查）与空间扩展（上下文核验）；随后对获取的证据进行评估与融合。
AI.result: 在多个工业异常检测任务的广泛实验中，多数评测设置下达到SOTA性能，验证了主动证据探索对细粒度异常理解与推理的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 证据引导的主动视觉搜索可提升MLLM异常推理的细粒度与可靠性；代码将在论文发表后公开。

title: Align the Pair, Not the Sample: Representation Alignment for Faster and Better One-Step Generato
summary: Representation alignment markedly accelerates diffusion training, but one-step generators raise a question that diffusion does not: \emph{which training path should receive the loss?} A one-step generator sees two kinds of inputs. Corrupted real images come with their clean counterpart, which provides an instance-paired target. Samples generated from pure noise have no corresponding real image, yet this is where the final model operates. We study this question on Priming, which trains one-step generators from scratch by reconstructing corrupted images and then matching feature distributions with optimal transport. Aligning the generative path, the natural choice, collapses recall ($0.45\!\to\!0.15$--$0.25$) in all 17 configurations we test, including five target constructions and loss weights down to $0.05$. Aligning the paired reconstruction path with a frozen DINOv2 encoder instead helps in every setting we test. A short analysis explains this asymmetry: when the target carries no instance information about the input, the optimal aligned feature is constant within each class, so the loss pulls samples toward class prototypes. A control confirms this: aligning the paired path to a random same-class image instead of the input's own image removes most of the gain. Inside the generator, paired-path alignment creates an interface block through which post-training routes noise, and the image semantics carried through it predict sample quality across 16 models. The resulting recipe, \method, accelerates \emph{both} training stages on ImageNet $256\!\times\!256$: it matches the 160-epoch baseline with $2\times$ fewer priming epochs, surpasses its final quality with $4\times$ fewer post-training updates, and lowers FID to 1.30 (B) and 1.155 (L) at the standard budget. A joint single-stage variant trains native one-step generators and reaches FID 1.22 with 115M parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一步生成器训练中"应对哪条路径施加表征对齐损失"这一问题，发现在Priming框架下对齐生成路径会导致召回崩塌，而对齐配对重建路径（冻结DINOv2编码器）在所有设置下均有益，据此提出\method方法显著加速两阶段训练并将FID降至1.30(B)/1.155(L)。
AI.motivation: 表征对齐能显著加速扩散训练，但一步生成器存在扩散模型没有的问题：它同时接收两种输入——带干净对应图像的损坏真实图像（实例配对目标），以及无对应真实图像的纯噪声生成样本（最终部署时的实际输入）。因此需明确：对齐损失应施加在哪条训练路径上。
AI.method: 以Priming为研究对象，其从零训练一步生成器：先重建损坏图像，再用最优传输匹配特征分布。作者对比两类对齐路径：(1) 生成路径（纯噪声→样本，自然选择）；(2) 配对重建路径（以冻结DINOv2编码器为目标），并设置5种目标构造、损失权重低至0.05共17种配置进行比较，辅以理论分析（目标不含实例信息时类内最优对齐特征为常数，损失将样本拉向类原型）和对照实验（对齐到同类随机图像而非自身图像），并分析生成器内部的"接口块"机制。
AI.result: 对齐生成路径在全部17种配置下使召回率从0.45崩塌至0.15–0.25；对齐配对重建路径则在所有设置下均带来增益。对照实验证实：对齐到同类随机图像会消除大部分收益。配对路径对齐在生成器内形成接口块，后训练通过该块路由噪声，其携带的图像语义可跨16个模型预测样本质量。\method在ImageNet 256×256上同时加速两个阶段：以2×更少的priming轮数匹配160轮基线，以4×更少的后训练更新超越其最终质量，标准预算下FID降至1.30(B)与1.155(L)；单阶段联合变体以115M参数达到FID 1.22。
AI.conclusion: 表征对齐应施加于实例配对的 reconstructive 路径而非生成路径；该选择通过避免向类原型坍缩、并在生成器内形成可路由语义的接口块而产生稳定收益，由此得到的方法可同时加速一步生成器训练的两个阶段并刷新FID表现。

title: LMnOP: Pruning 3D Gaussian Splatting via Leave-Many-Out Importance
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting renders photorealistic views in real time. However, a single scene often needs millions of Gaussians, so these models are costly to store and render. Pruning reduces this cost by keeping a subset of the Gaussians. A common score is the leave-one-out importance, which is the loss increase when a Gaussian alone is removed. At high pruning ratios, many Gaussians are removed together, so Gaussians that are redundant alone but essential together are lost. We present LMnOP (Leave-Many-Out Pruning), which estimates the importance of each Gaussian under the removal of the other Gaussians. This leave-many-out importance is the average loss increase when a Gaussian is removed while the others are also removed at random. We compute the exact mean and variance of each pixel's color under random removal in closed form, and approximate the importance from them without sampling removal patterns. We refine each Gaussian's probability of remaining with its importance and prune once at the end. Without fine-tuning, LMnOP achieves the best results in 16 of 18 metrics on three datasets at 90% and 99% removal. It improves SSIM and LPIPS over GaussianPOP in all 13 scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出 LMnOP 剪枝方法，用闭式解估计"共同移除随机其他高斯"下的重要性，在 90%/99% 高剪枝率下无需微调即超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting 单场景常需数百万高斯，存储与渲染成本高。现有 leave-one-out 重要性评分在剪枝率高时失效：许多高斯被一起移除，那些"单独看冗余、但组合在一起不可或缺"的高斯会被误删。
AI.method: 将重要性定义为 leave-many-out：在随机移除其他高斯的同时移除目标高斯所引起的平均损失增量。对随机移除下每个像素颜色的均值与方差进行闭式推导，从而无需采样移除模式即可近似计算重要性；再用该重要性迭代修正每个高斯的保留概率，最后一次性剪枝。
AI.result: 无需微调，在三个数据集、90% 与 99% 移除率下，18 项指标中 16 项取得最优；在全部 13 个场景中 SSIM 与 LPIPS 均优于 GaussianPOP。
AI.conclusion: 以"共同移除"视角重定义剪枝重要性，并借助闭式矩估计避免采样开销，为高压缩率 3DGS 剪枝提供了高效且即插即用的方案。

title: SalivaryHSI-Seg: A New Challenging Benchmark for Ex Vivo Salivary Gland Hyperspectral Tissue Segmentation
summary: Salivary gland tumors are common lesions in oral and maxillofacial practice, and accurate identification of tumor regions and surrounding salivary gland tissues is important for tissue assessment, pathological sampling, and clinical decision support. Hyperspectral imaging (HSI) records continuous spectral responses together with spatial imaging information, providing a promising way to capture fine-grained tissue-discriminative information. Nevertheless, the development of salivary gland HSI tissue segmentation remains limited due to the lack of standardized benchmarks with pixel-level annotations and unified evaluation protocols. To address this issue, we introduce SalivaryHSI-Seg, a hyperspectral tissue segmentation benchmark for ex vivo salivary gland specimens, containing 119 HSI samples from 31 patients with multi-class pixel-level annotations. We establish a patient-level five-fold cross-validation protocol and evaluate different input representations, model architectures, and challenging subsets with small tumor and complex boundary. Based on this benchmark, we further propose HyBSD, a hyperspectral boundary-guided spectral-difference network for full-HSI salivary gland tissue segmentation. HyBSD exploits boundary-guided spectral-difference cues to improve tissue delineation in ambiguous transition regions. Extensive experiments show that full-HSI input provides more discriminative information than sampled spectrums, and that HyBSD achieves 74.97% mDice and 87.76% Tumor Dice, with further advantages on the challenging subsets. Dataset and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文构建涎腺高光谱组织分割基准SalivaryHSI-Seg（31例患者、119个样本、像素级多类标注、患者级五折交叉验证），并提出边界引导光谱差异网络HyBSD用于全高光谱（full-HSI）涎腺组织分割。
AI.motivation: 涎腺肿瘤在口腔颌面临床常见，准确识别肿瘤区域与周边腺体组织对组织评估、病理取材和临床决策支持意义重大；高光谱成像可同时获取连续光谱响应与空间信息，有望提供细粒度组织判别线索，但缺少像素级标注的标准基准与统一评测协议，限制了该方向的发展。
AI.method: 发布SalivaryHSI-Seg离体涎腺高光谱组织分割基准，建立患者级五折交叉验证协议，系统评测不同输入表示、模型架构及小肿瘤、复杂边界等困难子集；在此基础上提出HyBSD网络，利用边界引导的光谱差异线索，改善模糊过渡区域的组织勾画，并采用full-HSI输入。
AI.result: 实验表明full-HSI输入比采样光谱提供更具判别力的信息；HyBSD取得74.97% mDice与87.76% Tumor Dice，并在困难子集上表现出进一步优势。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了涎腺高光谱组织分割在基准数据与评测协议上的空白，验证了全波段高光谱输入与边界引导光谱差异建模的有效性；数据集与代码将公开。

title: Segment Anything In-Context via Visual Demonstrations
summary: We present the Segment Anything Model via Visual Demonstrations (SAYD), a foundation model for in-context segmentation. Given visual demos comprising prompt images and their segmentation masks, SAYD segments coherent regions (e.g., objects or their parts) in a query image by establishing visual correspondences between the prompts and the query. SAYD generalizes to previously-unseen segmentation tasks, including those requiring tacit visual knowledge or involving concepts that are difficult to articulate unambiguously in language. We train SAYD on 12 public datasets originally curated for panoptic segmentation using our proposed techniques, including a lightweight mask decoder for prompt-agnostic mask generation and a learning mechanism for recognizing novel query classes absent in the prompts. These innovations enhance both computational efficiency and out-of-domain generalization. Consequently, SAYD significantly outperforms existing methods of in-context segmentation and open-vocabulary segmentation across 24 out-of-domain benchmarks, spanning natural, biological, ecological, cosmological, medical, pathological, and satellite imagery.

AI.tldr: 提出 SAYD（Segment Anything Model via Visual Demonstrations），一个基于视觉演示的上下文分割基础模型，通过建立提示图像与查询图像间的视觉对应实现分割，并在24个域外基准上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 许多分割任务依赖难以用语言清晰表达的隐性视觉知识，语言提示（如开放词汇分割）难以胜任；因此需要一种仅凭视觉演示即可泛化的上下文分割范式。
AI.method: 以提示图像及其分割掩码作为视觉演示，通过视觉对应将提示中的目标概念迁移到查询图像；在12个全景分割公开数据集上训练，并提出两项技术：用于提示无关掩码生成的轻量级掩码解码器，以及识别提示中未出现的新查询类别的学习机制。
AI.result: 在24个域外基准上（涵盖自然、生物、生态、宇宙、医学、病理及卫星影像）显著优于现有上下文分割与开放词汇分割方法；两项创新同时提升了计算效率与域外泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 视觉演示驱动的上下文分割是可行的统一范式，SAYD 可泛化至未见分割任务，兼具高效性与强域外迁移能力。

title: Reparameterizing Your Object Detectors for Weight Space Programming
summary: Weight-Space Programming (WSP) edits network weights without backpropagation, yet directly editing converged object detectors stalls or collapses because set prediction penalizes duplicate boxes as false positives while compact parameterizations trap weights in an isotropic Euclidean minimum. We propose Inverse-Reparameterized Object-Detection WSP (IR-ODWSP), lifting detector layers via exact function-preserving operators (E, C) into decoupled moment, 2D-DCT, PCA, and Stiefel-Procrustes subspaces. Solving winner-exclusive updates and folding back (Delta Params=0%, Delta FLOPs=0%) induces an anisotropic Riemannian metric, improving all 26/26 MS COCO settings across 17 YOLO26, EdgeCrafter, and RF-DETR detectors (up to +0.31 APs), +1.42 mAP cross-basin COCO-O, zeroimage repair (+2.95 mAP), and label-free weather adaptation (+2.79 AP). Without retraining, IR-ODWSP supports -100% to +100% latency budgets across bridged contraction, 1.00x folding, dynamic (IR-ODWSP-DYN), and static (IR-ODWSP-SG) graphs: -10% retains 51.62 AP / 33.48 mAP, while positive budgets scale monotonically (+0.30 AP at +10%, +1.12 on RF-DETR-N; 54.83 AP at +100%; 55.91 AP / 35.44 mAP in IR-ODWSP+). Source code is released at https://github.com/WongKinYiu/ODWSP.

AI.tldr: 提出IR-ODWSP，通过函数保持算子在解耦子空间中对检测器权重做无反向传播的编辑，在不增加参数和FLOPs的前提下诱导各向异性黎曼度量，实现目标检测器的多任务性能提升与延迟预算可调。
AI.motivation: 直接对已收敛检测器做权重空间编程（WSP）会停滞或崩溃：一是集合预测会把重复框当作假阳性惩罚，二是紧凑参数化使权重陷入各向同性欧氏极小值，导致编辑无效。
AI.method: 用精确函数保持算子(E, C)将检测器层提升到解耦的矩、2D-DCT、PCA与Stiefel-Procrustes子空间中；在子空间内求解winner-exclusive更新，再折回原空间（ΔParams=0%、ΔFLOPs=0%），由此诱导各向异性黎曼度量。进一步提供桥接收缩、1.00x折叠、动态图(IR-ODWSP-DYN)与静态图(IR-ODWSP-SG)等多种形式以支持延迟预算。
AI.result: 在17个YOLO26、EdgeCrafter、RF-DETR检测器上，26/26个MS COCO设置全部提升（最高+0.31 APs）；跨盆地COCO-O提升+1.42 mAP；零图像修复+2.95 mAP；无标签天气适配+2.79 AP。延迟预算-100%~+100%无需重训：-10%仍保持51.62 AP/33.48 mAP；正向预算单调扩展（+10%时+0.30 AP，RF-DETR-N上+1.12，+100%时54.83 AP，IR-ODWSP+达55.91 AP/35.44 mAP）。
AI.conclusion: IR-ODWSP证明无需反向传播即可有效编辑收敛检测器，且不增加参数与计算量，兼顾精度提升、跨域鲁棒性与可从收缩到扩展的连续延迟预算控制，为检测器的权重空间编程提供了可用范式。

title: Towards Agentic Video Corpus Moment Retrieval
summary: Video corpus moment retrieval (VCMR) requires finding the video and time interval that match a text query in a corpus of videos. We present RELAY, a training-free framework for VCMR that shares memory across queries. RELAY processes a batch of queries in three stages: search with a query bank, ranking with video notes, and localization with video prompt caching. In the search stage, an embedding model scores each video by its best-matching frame. The query bank penalizes videos that score highly for many other queries in the batch. In the ranking stage, a vision-language model (VLM) writes notes on each candidate video's scenes, people, objects, and actions once. Then, a large language model (LLM) reranks the candidates from these notes. In the localization stage, a VLM predicts the time interval of the moment in the top-ranked video. When multiple queries select the same video, prompt caching lets the VLM reuse its frames. On the three VERIFIED benchmarks, RELAY outperforms the trained baselines in video retrieval R@1 without training. Without any labeled moment, its predicted intervals are shorter than the annotated ones. In VCMR, it achieves similar performance to VideoSearch-R1 on one benchmark and trails it at IoU 0.5 on the other two. Human annotators also mark shorter moments than the original annotations of the benchmarks. A single margin, calibrated on a few labeled queries, widens the predicted interval to the annotation convention of the benchmarks. With it, RELAY outperforms the trained baselines in VCMR at IoU 0.5.

AI.tldr: RELAY 是一个无需训练的 VCMR 框架，通过查询库、视频笔记与视频提示缓存三个阶段在批内共享记忆，在三个基准上检索 R@1 超越训练基线，并经单一边际校准后在 IoU 0.5 上超越训练基线。
AI.motivation: VCMR 需在视频库中同时定位视频与时间区间，现有方法依赖训练；且不同查询常命中同一视频，存在重复计算与跨查询可利用的共享信息未被利用。
AI.method: 三阶段流水线：搜索阶段用嵌入模型按最佳匹配帧打分，并用查询库对“对批内多个查询均高分”的视频施加惩罚；排序阶段由 VLM 一次性为候选视频生成场景/人物/物体/动作笔记，再由 LLM 基于笔记重排；定位阶段由 VLM 预测 Top-1 视频内的时间区间，同一视频被多查询选中时通过 prompt caching 复用帧。另引入一个在少量标注查询上校准的单一边际以扩展预测区间。
AI.result: 在三个 VERIFIED 基准上，视频检索 R@1 无训练即超越训练基线；无标注时刻时预测区间短于标注；VCMR 上在一个基准与 VideoSearch-R1 相当，另两个在 IoU 0.5 落后；人工标注者也倾向于标注更短的片段。
AI.conclusion: 训练-free 的批内记忆共享可有效替代训练；预测区间偏短源于基准标注约定与人类标注偏好差异，经单一边际校准后 RELAY 在 IoU 0.5 下超越训练基线。

title: ApexID: Hierarchical Learning for Multi-Species Animal Re-Identification
summary: Animal re-identification (Re-ID) must distinguish individuals across species and capture conditions. We introduce ApexID, a hierarchical SphereFace2-based loss that integrates global identity discrimination with balanced animal-category supervision. Using 132,533 images curated from 19 public datasets, we evaluate three model families and four objectives on four external datasets with observation-aware retrieval protocols. ApexID achieves a dataset-averaged Rank-1 accuracy of 64.89% with ConvNeXt-Small and an mAP of 32.54% with MIEW-ID, outperforming their pretrained reference models. On elephants, a category absent from animal Re-ID training, our ConvNeXt-Small variant achieves the highest retrieval performance among the fourteen evaluated configurations. Scores vary by backbone and dataset, and open-set evaluation reveals remaining discovery challenges. These findings support hierarchical category-identity learning to improve transfer to unseen datasets and species.

AI.tldr: 提出ApexID——一种基于SphereFace2的层次化损失，将全局身份判别与均衡的动物类别监督结合，在19个公开数据集共132,533张图像上训练，在四个外部数据集上以观察感知检索协议评测，取得数据集平均Rank-1 64.89%（ConvNeXt-Small）与mAP 32.54%（MIEW-ID），并在训练中未出现的大象类别上于14种配置中检索性能最优。
AI.motivation: 动物重识别（Re-ID）需跨物种、跨观测条件区分个体，现有方法多面向单一物种或数据集，身份判别与类别信息未被统一建模，导致跨数据集、跨物种（未见过类别）迁移能力不足。
AI.method: 设计ApexID层次化SphereFace2损失，在全局身份判别目标之上叠加均衡的动物类别监督，形成类别—身份的两级约束；从19个公开数据集整理132,533张图像构建训练集；对三种模型家族与四种目标函数进行评测，并在四个外部数据集上采用感知观测条件的检索协议，含开集评估。
AI.result: ConvNeXt-Small配合ApexID获得数据集平均Rank-1 64.89%，MIEW-ID取得mAP 32.54%，均优于各自预训练参考模型；在大象（动物Re-ID训练中缺失的类别）上，ConvNeXt-Small变体在14种评测配置中检索性能最高；分数随骨干与数据集变化，开集评估显示新个体发现仍具挑战。
AI.conclusion: 层次化类别—身份联合学习有助于提升对未见数据集与未见物种的迁移能力，为跨物种动物Re-ID提供了有效范式；但仍需针对开放集发现与骨干/数据依赖性问题进一步研究。

title: TriSegAgent: Context-Efficient 3D Annotation with MLLMs via Tri-Planes
summary: Interactive segmentation models turn a few clicks into a segmentation prediction across domains, so annotators only decide where the prediction still needs correction. Annotation thus becomes a loop of inspecting the prediction and clicking again. Each step of this loop is a visual judgment, which suits general-purpose multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents. In this work, we focus on letting these agents run this loop on 3D volumes. However, the MLLM in such an agent takes only 2D images as input, so the agent must observe the 3D volume in 2D. Since the loop calls the MLLM many times, this observation must be token-compact enough to keep every call cheap, yet informative enough to show error regions in the 3D prediction. We meet both needs with tri-planes, the three orthogonal planes that cross at one point in the volume. We show, both theoretically and empirically, that tri-planes are context-efficient yet keep sufficient detail to show error regions in the 3D prediction. Building on tri-planes, we introduce TriSegAgent, an MLLM agent that refines the 3D prediction iteratively. Within the agent, the MLLM only judges the prediction on tri-planes, while a visual harness turns each judgment into a 3D action in code. To make the loop reliable, the harness places each click at an exact voxel in the volume and checks whether to accept the 3D prediction. To evaluate the agent, we build a diverse benchmark of 690 regions of interest (ROIs) from 35 public medical datasets across three imaging modalities. With frontier MLLMs, TriSegAgent reaches an overall Dice about 10 points above the strongest baseline, and its lead is even larger on targets below 3 cm. With flash-level MLLMs, it outperforms a recent 3D segmentation agent built on a frontier MLLM.

AI.tldr: 提出 TriSegAgent：以三正交平面（tri-planes）作为 3D 体数据的 token 紧凑 2D 观测，驱动通用多模态大模型智能体在 3D 交互式分割中迭代修正预测。
AI.motivation: 交互式分割本质是"检查预测—点击修正"的视觉判断循环，天然适合 MLLM 智能体；但 MLLM 仅接受 2D 输入，而循环需多次调用模型，故 3D 体数据的 2D 观测必须既 token 紧凑（每次调用便宜）又信息充分（能显现 3D 预测的错误区域）。
AI.method: 采用经过一点相交的三张正交平面作为观测表示，并从理论与实验两方面论证其在上下文效率与错误可见性上的优势；构建 TriSegAgent，MLLM 仅在 tri-planes 上做判断，由视觉 harness 将判断转为代码化的 3D 动作，将点击定位到精确体素并校验是否接受该 3D 预测；另建含 690 个 ROI、覆盖 35 个公开医学数据集与三种成像模态的基准。
AI.result: 使用前沿 MLLM 时整体 Dice 较最强基线高约 10 分，在小于 3 cm 的目标上优势更明显；使用 flash 级 MLLM 时仍优于基于前沿 MLLM 的近期 3D 分割智能体。
AI.conclusion: tri-planes 是兼顾上下文效率与细节保留的有效 3D 观测表示，配合精确到体素的视觉 harness，可使 MLLM 智能体可靠地完成 3D 交互式分割迭代修正，并在多模态医学基准上显著领先。

title: S1Arena-MM: Which Multimodal Decisions Can Be Left to System 1?
comment: 26 pages. Lang Lin, Tianyu Chen, Yi Gu, Yang Zhao, Xinran Song and Xinyang Liu contributed equally. Code and data: https://github.com/zhaoyang02/S1Arena-MM ; media: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Swindl/S1Arena-MM
summary: Perception systems often make discrete decisions: flag a hateful meme, predict whether a pedestrian will cross, detect a spoofed voice, or select the next move in a game. System-1 models, such as OneJev and Jev-Omni, read the media and return probabilities over the options in a single forward pass, while multimodal large language models (MLLMs) generate text. Which multimodal decisions can System-1 models handle, and where do MLLMs perform better? We introduce S1Arena-MM, a benchmark that gives every model the same decision requests and scores the probabilities it returns. It contains 51,060 questions across 94 tasks with image, video, and audio input, drawn from 94 public datasets and three program-generated ones. It also includes 102 closed-loop game environments that a model plays from screenshots; in real-time mode, the game continues while the model decides. We evaluate 33 open models: 12 System-1 models and 21 MLLMs read at the answer token. On static decisions, the best System-1 model leads the best MLLM by 4.9 percentage points on images and is within one point of it on video and audio. Post-training for decisions mainly improves the probabilities: on video, a System-1 model has a lower Brier score than the MLLM that it is post-trained from in 10 of 12 pairs. With up to 2,048 thought tokens per question, the most accurate MLLMs pass the best System-1 models only slightly, and thinking raises the Brier score of most MLLMs. Closed loops separate the models: three System-1 models built on a 27B MLLM reach 22.0-33.3% progression in BALROG, and no other model exceeds 9.7% with thinking off. In real-time GameWorld, latencies of up to 1.1 s per decision cause no measurable loss of progress for System-1 models. Code and data: https://github.com/zhaoyang02/S1Arena-MM.

AI.tldr: 提出 S1Arena-MM 基准，统一比较 System-1 模型与多模态大模型（MLLM）在离散多模态决策上的表现。
AI.motivation: 感知系统常需做离散决策，但尚不清楚 System-1 模型与 MLLM 各自擅长的决策类型与场景。
AI.method: 构建含 51,060 题、94 任务、覆盖图像/视频/音频的基准（源自 94 个公开数据集与 3 个程序生成集），并设 102 个截图闭环游戏环境（含实时模式）；对 33 个开放模型（12 个 System-1、21 个 MLLM，按答案 token 读取概率）统一打分。
AI.result: 静态决策上最佳 System-1 在图像领先最佳 MLLM 4.9 个百分点，视频与音频差距在 1 点内；决策后训练主要提升概率质量（12 对中 10 对 Brier 分数更低）；2048 thought token 下最强 MLLM 仅略微超过 System-1，且思维链使多数 MLLM 的 Brier 分数变差；闭环中基于 27B MLLM 的三个 System-1 模型在 BALROG 达 22.0–33.3% 进度，其余模型（关闭思维）不超过 9.7%；实时 GameWorld 中每决策 1.1 s 延迟未见明显进度损失。
AI.conclusion: System-1 模型在静态决策概率校准与闭环/实时交互中具优势，MLLM 的思维链收益有限甚至损害校准；该基准可区分两类范式的能力边界。

title: CivicBench: Robust Detection of AI-Generated Political Video
summary: AI-generated video of politicians can pass for real footage, and once such fakes are common, real footage can be dismissed as fake. Platforms address both problems with detectors, but whoever uploads a clip controls its pixels. Existing datasets of political video are small, show real politicians, and test no attacks. We introduce CivicBench, with 10,800 generated clips of invented politicians from eight open generators and 2,632 public-domain or openly licensed real clips. Each clip can be attacked, to hide a fake or to frame real footage. Published detectors trained on a general benchmark reach at most .781 AUC on CivicBench. Adversarial changes of 1 gray level per pixel hide nearly every generated clip from the detectors not built to resist attacks. An attack's reach is how far it can move a clip's score. A clip keeps its label when its margin from the threshold exceeds this reach, and we find that the reach grows almost linearly with the budget. On this basis, we propose Tau-Anchor, which fine-tunes an encoder pretrained on attacked images. It attacks real and generated clips during training and adds a margin term at its deployed threshold. It reaches .941 AUC on CivicBench. It also keeps .668 of generated clips flagged at 2 gray levels, against at most .289 for published detectors. When real clips are framed at the same 2 gray levels, Tau-Anchor's false alarms rise only from 8% to 14%, whereas four published detectors flag nearly every framed real clip at just 1 gray level. External political footage and two general benchmarks show the same pattern under attack. Code and data are available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/CivicBench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CivicBench政治视频检测基准（10,800个虚构政治人物生成片段与2,632个真实片段，均支持对抗攻击），指出现有检测器最高仅.781 AUC且每像素1灰阶的扰动即可隐藏几乎所有生成片段；并基于"攻击可达范围随预算近似线性增长"提出Tau-Anchor，在CivicBench上达.941 AUC，2灰阶下仍能保留.668的生成片段告警率，而现有检测器对伪造真实片段的误报几乎全满。
AI.motivation: AI生成政治人物视频可冒充真实影像，真实影像亦可被诬为伪造，平台依赖检测器应对，但上传者掌控像素即可实施规避或栽赃攻击。现有政治视频数据集规模小、仅含真实政治人物、且不评测攻击，无法衡量检测器在对抗条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建CivicBench基准：8个开源生成器产生的10,800个虚构人物片段＋2,632个公有领域或开放许可真实片段，每片段可施加双向攻击（隐藏伪造／栽赃真实）。提出"攻击可达范围（reach）"概念，即攻击可推动片段得分的幅度；若片段与阈值的间隔大于reach则标签保持，并观察到reach随预算近似线性增长。据此提出Tau-Anchor：微调在受攻击图像上预训练的编码器，训练时同时攻击真实与生成片段，并在部署阈值处加入间隔（margin）项。
AI.result: 通用基准训练的已发表检测器在CivicBench上AUC最高.781；每像素仅1灰阶的对抗改动即可使非抗攻击检测器漏检几乎所有生成片段。Tau-Anchor达.941 AUC；2灰阶下对生成片段保持.668的检出率（已发表检测器至多.289）；对2灰阶栽赃的真实片段，虚警率仅从8%升至14%，而四个已发表检测器在1灰阶下即几乎对所有栽赃真实片段报警。外部政治素材与两个通用基准上呈现相同规律。
AI.conclusion: 政治视频检测必须在对等攻击条件下评测；仅靠通用基准训练的检测器在微小扰动下即失效。Tau-Anchor表明将攻击纳入训练并在部署阈值处显式建模间隔，可同时提升干净与对抗条件下的检测鲁棒性，且对真实片段的误报代价可控。代码与数据已开源。

title: SuperFine3D: Efficient Global-Local Recursive Refinement for Extremely Detailed 3D Geometry Generation
summary: High-resolution images contain rich visual details that require fine geometric structures for faithful 3D reconstruction. However, generating extremely detailed 3D geometry from images requires substantial computational resources and training data, making high-resolution geometry generation challenging for existing state-of-the-art models. In this paper, we present SuperFine3D, an efficient framework for generating extremely detailed 3D geometry through global-local recursive refinement. SuperFine3D learns a shared refinement operator from paired coarse-to-fine representations and recursively reuses it to progressively synthesize finer geometry beyond the training resolutions, without requiring additional paired supervision at target resolutions. To make recursive refinement computationally efficient, we introduce spatial-cell attention, which restricts high-resolution interactions to local spatial neighborhoods while maintaining bounded communication across neighboring cells. We further propose spatially anchored cross-scale guidance, which leverages globally contextualized coarse geometry to guide local detail synthesis and preserve structural consistency. In addition, geometry-aware training objectives encourage the refinement process to preserve stable geometric structures while introducing fine-grained surface details. Experiments demonstrate that SuperFine3D generates geometry at a $4096^3$ decoder-grid resolution, corresponding to a sparse $256^3$ latent lattice, using a shared refinement operator trained only on $512^3$--$1024^3$ representations. Compared with a full-attention recursive baseline, SuperFine3D achieves a $9.4\times$ speedup in end-to-end inference and reduces peak GPU memory usage by $23.0\%$, while improving cross-scale structural consistency and producing cleaner surfaces with finer geometric details.

AI.tldr: SuperFine3D 通过全局-局部递归细化，用仅在 512³–1024³ 表示上训练的共享细化算子，从图像生成 4096³ 解码网格分辨率的高细节 3D 几何，无需目标分辨率配对监督。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率图像含丰富视觉细节，忠实重建需精细几何结构；但生成极细节 3D 几何消耗大量算力与训练数据，现有最先进模型难以直接生成高分辨率几何。
AI.method: 1) 从粗到细配对表示中学习共享细化算子并递归复用，逐步合成超出训练分辨率的更细几何；2) 空间单元注意力（spatial-cell attention），将高分辨率交互限制在局部空间邻域，同时保持相邻单元间的有界通信；3) 空间锚定跨尺度引导，用全局上下文化的粗几何引导局部细节合成并保持结构一致性；4) 几何感知训练目标，在引入细粒度表面细节的同时保持稳定几何结构。
AI.result: 在 4096³ 解码网格分辨率（对应稀疏 256³ 潜格点）上生成几何；相比全注意力递归基线端到端推理加速 9.4×，峰值 GPU 显存降低 23.0%，并提升跨尺度结构一致性，生成表面更干净、几何细节更细。
AI.conclusion: 递归复用共享细化算子结合局部注意力与跨尺度引导，可在有限算力与训练监督下高效实现超训练分辨率的高细节 3D 几何生成。

title: Continuous-time 4D Reconstruction via Event-guided Latent Feature Interpolation
summary: Recent geometric foundation models can successfully convert a video sequence into frames of registered point clouds, but cannot predict moments beyond the observed temporal resolution. We propose a continuous-time 4D reconstruction method that extracts 3D structure and camera poses at any time instant, with additional guidance from event-camera measurements. While event cameras provide evidence at microsecond resolution to continuously fill the temporal gap, integrating them into existing RGB-based foundation models remains challenging. We formulate the problem as interpolation in the latent feature space and augment event-based losses in the image space as an auxiliary task to boost accuracy. Operating in the latent space leverages the powerful geometric priors of foundation models, while the event loss provides physically grounded guidance. To effectively address the lack of paired training data, we further propose a self-supervised training framework that uses pseudo-ground-truth labels of estimated geometry and simulated events generated from high-frame-rate RGB videos. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that the proposed pipeline outperforms baselines that temporally interpolate either the input RGB videos or the estimated geometry, and that it generalizes to unseen real-world scenarios. Controlled experiments with synthetic corruptions show that it remains robust under motion-blur and low-light conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出连续时间4D重建方法，在潜空间插值并融合事件相机，实现任意时刻的3D结构与相机位姿估计。
AI.motivation: 现有几何基础模型只能将视频转换为配准点云帧，无法预测超出观测时间分辨率的时刻；事件相机虽具微秒级分辨率，但难以融入基于RGB的基座模型。
AI.method: 将问题建模为潜特征空间插值，并在图像空间引入事件损失作为辅助任务；为解决配对数据缺失，提出自监督训练框架，利用估计几何的伪真值与由高帧率RGB视频生成的事件仿真作为监督。
AI.result: 实验表明该流程优于对输入RGB视频或估计几何进行时间插值的基线，可泛化至未见真实场景；在运动模糊与低光照的合成退化控制实验中保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间操作可利用基础模型几何先验，事件损失提供物理依据引导，二者结合可在无配对数据下实现高精度连续时间4D重建。

title: Revisiting RadioGalaxyNET: modern detectors for radio galaxy detection and host identification
summary: RadioGalaxyNET is the public benchmark for finding extended radio galaxies in EMU pilot-survey images, classifying them and locating their infrared hosts. Its best published results date from 2023: 54.5 box AP (Gal-YOLOv8) and 48.1 host keypoint AP (Gal-DINO). We train three current detectors, D-FINE-seg, YOLO26-pose and RF-DETR, on the same data and score them with the benchmark's own evaluation code, which reproduces the published Gal-DINO numbers exactly. All exceed the published results. D-FINE-seg M reaches 67.1 box AP and 72.4 host AP, 12.6 and 24.3 points above the best published results, and the highest host AP of the detectors we tested; on boxes it is level with YOLO26. Its host lead over YOLO26 comes from host-centered images, which make up most of the benchmark. End to end, D-FINE-seg S is the fastest model at 1.9 ms per image; engine against engine, YOLO26 is faster at the same size. We also report what matters for anyone using the benchmark: its scoring protocol adds 5 to 10 AP, its host labels sit at the image center, its box labels are offset from the image by 1.5 pixels, and its images can be rebuilt from the public survey data, which recovers sky positions and doubles as extra training data. We suggest that future work report host identification F1, as a measure closer to catalog use: D-FINE-seg M 71.8, YOLO26-pose M 70.5, RF-DETR 63.8, Gal-DINO 59.2.

AI.tldr: 在 RadioGalaxyNET 基准上训练 D-FINE-seg、YOLO26-pose、RF-DETR 三个当前检测器，全部超越 2023 年已发表结果（box AP 67.1、host AP 72.4），并揭示基准协议与标注缺陷及可复原性。
AI.motivation: RadioGalaxyNET 是寻找延展射电星系、分类并定位其红外宿主天体的公开基准，但最优已发表结果停留在 2023 年（Gal-YOLOv8 54.5 box AP、Gal-DINO 48.1 host keypoint AP），亟需用当前检测器重新评估并审视基准自身的评测协议与标注质量。
AI.method: 在相同数据上训练 D-FINE-seg、YOLO26-pose、RF-DETR 三种检测器，使用基准自带的评测代码评分（其精确复现 Gal-DINO 已发表数值以保证可比性）；并分析评分协议、宿主标签位置、box 标签偏移，及从公开巡天数据重建图像以恢复天球坐标并作为额外训练数据。
AI.result: D-FINE-seg M 达 67.1 box AP 与 72.4 host AP，较最优已发表结果提升 12.6 与 24.3 点，host AP 为所测最高、box 上与 YOLO26 持平；其宿主优势主要来自占多数的宿主居中图像。端到端 D-FINE-seg S 最快（1.9 ms/图），同尺寸引擎对引擎时 YOLO26 更快。基准评分协议会额外抬高 5–10 AP；宿主标签位于图像中心；box 标签相对图像偏移 1.5 像素；图像可由公开巡天数据重建。按宿主识别 F1 计：D-FINE-seg M 71.8、YOLO26-pose M 70.5、RF-DETR 63.8、Gal-DINO 59.2。
AI.conclusion: 当前检测器显著优于 2023 年基准成绩，D-FINE-seg M 为综合最优；同时基准本身存在协议抬高与标注几何偏差问题，建议后续工作报告更贴近编目用途的宿主识别 F1。

title: SceneCast: Learning Indoor Scene Synthesis from Curated Synthetic Videos with LLM Reward
summary: 3D indoor scene synthesis requires generating objects to form a complete and coherent scene. Existing approaches rely heavily on manually annotated datasets, leading to high costs and limited generalization. We present SceneCast, an annotation-free framework that trains on large-scale, unlabeled videos, addressing two key challenges: (1) Videos provide only partial views of a scene, requiring the model to extrapolate unseen 3D regions, which is inherently error-prone; (2) Raw videos available online are uncurated, suffering from uncontrolled conditions and variable data quality. First, we design a Transformer-based model that predicts objects sequentially and is fine-tuned with reinforcement learning (RL), where an LLM acts as a spatial common-sense evaluator. The LLM provides reward signals through chain-of-thought reasoning and code-executable geometric checks to refine object configurations. Second, we introduce \trim, a data curation approach that generates training videos with controllable video generation models. Crucially, it retains only high-quality prefix clips via multi-criteria quality assessment with an entropy-based weighting strategy. Evaluated on curated synthetic video sets, our annotation-free approach outperforms state-of-the-art supervised methods in scene quality.

AI.tldr: SceneCast：无需人工标注，基于大规模无标注视频训练3D室内场景合成，通过强化学习+LLM空间常识评估与可控视频数据筛选（trim）提升场景质量。
AI.motivation: 现有3D室内场景合成方法高度依赖人工标注数据集，成本高且泛化性有限；同时直接使用网络视频存在两大挑战：视频仅有部分视角、需外推未见3D区域（易出错），以及原始视频未经筛选、条件不可控、质量参差。
AI.method: (1) 设计基于Transformer的模型顺序预测物体，并用强化学习微调，以LLM作为空间常识评估器，通过链式思维推理与可执行代码的几何校验生成奖励信号，优化物体配置；(2) 提出trim数据筛选方法，用可控视频生成模型合成训练视频，再经多准则质量评估与基于熵的加权策略仅保留高质量前缀片段。
AI.result: 在筛选后的合成视频集上评估，该无标注方法在场景质量上优于当前最先进的监督方法。
AI.conclusion: 表明以合成/未标注视频结合LLM评估的强化学习，可替代人工标注数据，实现高质量3D室内场景合成，并具更好泛化潜力。

title: Accuracy Is Not Evidence: Measuring and Training Evidence Dependence in Video Temporal Grounding
comment: Preprint, 47 pages. Code, models and data: https://jinzijie-bupt.github.io/Accuracy-Is-Not-Evidence/
summary: In video temporal grounding, a correct interval can come from finding the event, answering blind or fitting one annotation style, and Recall at IoU scores them alike. We measure evidence dependence, how much the answer rests on the event's frames. Our fixed-answer audit edits either the frames inside the annotated interval or, as a placebo, as many frames elsewhere in the same video, and compares the two drops in the annotated answer's likelihood. Supervised fine-tuning and three public checkpoints trained with IoU-reward reinforcement learning raise the accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-7B by 9 to 20 points, partly by answering blind and by fitting one annotation. Yet their answers rest on the event no more than the base model's, and the same holds for IoU-reward training on our data at the audit's frame rate. This comparison is a difference of the model's own likelihoods, so we can train on it. A placebo contrast and a bound on the placebo drop rule out learning to react to any edit. With them, evidence dependence rises in all five base models we train, and the weight on clean supervision controls how much. Added to IoU-reward training, the objective raises evidence dependence while keeping the accuracy gain. Masking the event's frames makes the trained models decline or miss the event more often than their base; masking as many other frames does not. The dependence moves to another event when the query names it, and holds on a second dataset and under patch scrambling, an edit never used in training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"证据依赖度"（evidence dependence）度量：视频时序定位中，正确答案可能来自找事件、盲答或拟合标注风格，而Recall@IoU一视同仁。作者用"固定答案审计"——分别编辑标注区间内帧与同视频等量其他帧（安慰剂），比较答案似然下降幅度，发现SFT与IoU奖励RL虽提升9–20点准确率，但对事件的依赖不高于基座模型；将该对比差作为可训练目标（配安慰剂对比与安慰剂下降上界约束），可在五个基座模型上提升证据依赖度并保持精度，且可迁移到新事件、第二数据集和patch打乱扰动。
AI.motivation: 现有视频时序定位评测以Recall@IoU为准，无法区分模型是真正依据事件帧作答，还是通过盲答（不看视频）或拟合单一标注风格而得分。因此需要一种能度量"答案在多大程度上依赖事件帧"的评估与训练信号，避免指标虚高掩盖不可靠的定位行为。
AI.method: 1) 定义证据依赖度：在固定答案设定下，对标注区间内的帧做编辑，与在同一视频中随机编辑等量区间外帧（安慰剂）作对照，比较二者导致的答案似然下降差值。2) 审计对象包括Qwen2.5-VL-7B的监督微调模型与三个采用IoU奖励强化学习的公开检查点。3) 由于该量是模型自身似然的差分，可直接作为训练目标；并引入安慰剂对比项与安慰剂下降上界约束，防止模型学成"对任何编辑都敏感"。4) 将该目标与IoU奖励训练联合使用，并进行帧遮挡、patch打乱等泛化检验。
AI.result: SFT与IoU奖励RL将Qwen2.5-VL-7B准确率提升9–20点，但其中部分收益来自盲答与拟合单一标注风格；这些模型的证据依赖度并不高于基座模型，在审计帧率下用本文数据做IoU奖励训练亦然。加入本文目标后，五个基座模型的证据依赖度均提升，提升幅度由干净监督的权重控制，同时保留IoU奖励带来的精度增益。遮挡事件帧时，训练后模型比基座更常拒答或漏检事件，而遮挡等量其他帧无此效应；当查询指向另一事件时依赖随之转移，并在第二数据集与训练中未见的patch打乱扰动下依然成立。
AI.conclusion: Recall@IoU不足以刻画视频时序定位模型的可靠性，需辅以证据依赖度这类因果式审计。该依赖度可由模型似然差直接优化，配合安慰剂约束后可稳定提升事件的真实利用，且不牺牲精度，并具备跨事件、跨数据集与跨扰动的泛化性。

title: PinGround: Pinning Queries to Points for Parallel Grounding in Vision-Language Models
