summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can localize through their text interface, grounding open-vocabulary objects, complex referring expressions, text lines and layout regions with strong semantic understanding. They write the boxes one after another as a single sequence, although the instances of a query, unlike the words of a sentence, form an unordered set with no sequential dependence. The number of decoding steps therefore grows with the number of instances, which makes dense scenes the most expensive. Decoding the instances in parallel avoids this growth, but streams that cannot see each other duplicate some instances and miss others. We propose \method, which writes a single point into each query as a spatial anchor and asks for the matching instance nearest to that point within a local radius, or \none. Given the image, the anchored queries are independent, so they are decoded in parallel as leaves of a prefix tree that shares the image and the query, and the model is trained on the same tree. Coarse-to-fine anchors refine only the regions where instances are found, duplicate suppression keeps one box per instance, and set-level reinforcement learning optimizes the set F1. Only the prompt and the attention mask change, not the architecture. On three different VLMs and 12 benchmarks covering detection, OCR, layout and referring, \method is at most 5.5 F1 below sequential decoding trained on the same data, while its speedup grows with instance density and reaches 21.9$\times$ on dense scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出\method，将实例定位从"单序列自回归"改为"锚点查询的并行解码"，在不改架构的前提下显著加速密集场景，精度接近顺序解码。
AI.motivation: VLM 通过文本接口做定位时把实例当作文本序列逐个输出，但实例是无序集合、无序列依赖；解码步数随实例数增长，密集场景代价最高。并行解码虽可避免这种增长，但各流彼此不可见，导致实例重复与漏检。
AI.method: 在每个 query 中写入一个单点作为空间锚，要求模型输出局部半径内离该点最近的匹配实例，或输出 \none；给定图像后各锚定 query 相互独立，可作为共享图像与前缀树（prefix tree）的叶子并行解码，训练也在同一树上进行。辅以粗到细锚点仅在有实例的区域细化、去重抑制保证每实例一框、集合级强化学习优化 set-F1；仅改动 prompt 与 attention mask，不改架构。
AI.result: 在 3 个不同 VLM 与 12 个基准（检测、OCR、布局、指代）上，\method 比同数据训练的序列解码最多低 5.5 F1，且加速比随实例密度增长，密集场景最高 21.9×。
AI.conclusion: 将定位建模为"独立锚点查询 + 并行解码"可在保持接近顺序解码精度的同时，把密集场景的计算成本大幅降低，且无需修改模型架构，具有良好通用性。

title: RigidAnchor: Cross-View Geo-Localization for UAV via Iterative Planar Rigid Alignment
summary: A UAV that flies without GNSS has to estimate its absolute position and heading without any external signal. Most existing methods for UAV-to-satellite cross-view geo-localization (U-S CVGL) treat the task as image retrieval: they compress the UAV image and each satellite tile into separate descriptors, rank the tiles by their similarity, and return the center of the best tile. The output can therefore only lie on a pre-defined grid, its accuracy is limited by the tile size, and no heading is produced. Regressing the pose in a single pass removes the grid, but it leaves no chance to correct the estimate afterwards. We observe that satellite tiles are not independent samples. They are laid on the map at a fixed spacing, scale and orientation, so neighboring tiles join into one continuous satellite block with a consistent metric, and a nadir UAV view of that block differs from it by a planar rigid transform only, i.e. a 2D translation plus an in-plane rotation. We therefore reformulate U-S CVGL as solving for this transform between two images of different sizes. Position and heading then become parts of one geometric quantity, and the accuracy is no longer limited by the tile grid. We propose RigidAnchor, which solves the transform iteratively. The network encodes the two images and builds a multi-level correlation pyramid between them. At each iteration, it indexes the pyramid with every aerial cell carried through the current estimate, pools the descriptors of all cells into one hidden state, and lets two decoupled heads predict a translation increment and a rotation increment, the latter being composed rather than added. On Bearing-UAV-90K, the cross-view mean errors are 78.6% lower in position and 69.7% lower in heading than Bearing-UAV, and HSR@15 increases by 19.06 points. Code is available at https://github.com/wwsource/RigidAnchor.

AI.tldr: 将无人机-卫星跨视角地理定位(U-S CVGL)重新表述为求解两张异尺寸图像间的平面刚体变换(2D平移+面内旋转)，提出迭代式 RigidAnchor，摆脱瓦片网格对精度的限制并同时输出位置与航向。
AI.motivation: 现有 U-S CVGL 多按图像检索处理：将无人机图与每个卫星瓦片压缩为描述子、按相似度排序并取最优瓦片中心，导致输出只能落在预定义网格上、精度受瓦片尺寸限制且不产生航向；单次回归虽可去除网格，却无法事后修正估计。
AI.method: 观察到卫星瓦片按固定间距、尺度与朝向铺设，相邻瓦片拼接成具有一致度量的连续卫星块，正射无人机视图与该块仅差一个平面刚体变换。据此将任务转为求解该变换：网络编码两张图像并构建多级相关金字塔；每次迭代用当前估计将每个空中单元索引到金字塔中，将所有单元描述子池化为一个隐状态，由两个解耦头分别预测平移增量与旋转增量，旋转以复合(compose)而非相加方式更新。
AI.result: 在 Bearing-UAV-90K 上，跨视角平均误差相比 Bearing-UAV 位置降低 78.6%、航向降低 69.7%，HSR@15 提升 19.06 个点。
AI.conclusion: 以刚体变换为核心、迭代式索引-池化-增量预测的框架使位置与航向统一为单一几何量，精度不再受瓦片网格约束，为无GNSS无人机绝对定位与定向提供更精确的可修正方案。

title: OCCA-Seg: Object and Channel Context Aggregation for Semantic Segmentation of Remote Sensing Images
summary: Semantic segmentation, which assigns a class label to each pixel, is a key task in computer vision. However, semantic segmentation of remote sensing images (RSIs) remains challenging because of complex scenes and objects at multiple scales, which limits segmentation accuracy. To address these challenges, we propose a context aggregation scheme called object and channel context aggregation (OCCA), consisting of three components: object contextual attention module (OCAM), channel contextual attention module (CCAM), and aggregation module (AM). Firstly, motivated by the observation that each pixel shares the class label of the object to which it belongs, object-level context represents each pixel through aggregating context from its corresponding object class. Secondly, because feature channels are correlated with object categories, channel-wise context models channel-wise contextual dependencies conditioned on object categories. Finally, the context information from OCAM and CCAM are fed into AM and used to weight and modulate the object context, enhancing the discriminative ability of the segmentation model. The experiments on several public remote sensing datasets including LoveDA, UAVid, ISPRS Potsdam, and Vaihingen datasets demonstrate competitive improvements over existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出对象与通道上下文聚合方案OCCA，用于提升遥感图像语义分割精度。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像存在场景复杂、目标多尺度的问题，现有语义分割精度受限，需要有效聚合上下文信息。
AI.method: OCCA由三部分组成：对象上下文注意力模块（OCAM，基于"像素与其所属对象共享类标签"的观察，按对象类别聚合上下文表示每个像素）、通道上下文注意力模块（CCAM，以对象类别为条件建模通道间上下文依赖）、聚合模块（AM，将两模块上下文加权并调制对象上下文）。
AI.result: 在LoveDA、UAVid、ISPRS Potsdam、Vaihingen等公开遥感数据集上取得相较现有方法的竞争性提升。
AI.conclusion: 对象级与通道级上下文联合建模可有效增强分割模型的判别能力，适用于复杂遥感场景的语义分割。

title: What Remains After Concept Erasure? Sparse Autoencoder Probes for Auditing Diffusion Models
summary: Concept erasure aims to remove selected visual concepts from text-to-image diffusion models while preserving the generation of non-target concepts. Evaluation typically measures target suppression and non-target preservation in generated images, but a concept's absence from these outputs does not establish its removal from the model. We introduce SAE-Audit, a white-box audit using sparse autoencoder (SAE) probes to test whether activation interventions can restore target-concept generation without changing model weights or test prompts. After verifying target suppression, we compare the original and edited models using a shared SAE representation learned from original-model activations, identifying features whose target-related responses weaken after erasure. We inject sparse directions derived from the original-model responses into the edited model, keeping these directions fixed across test prompts, and evaluate recovery on held-out scene families. Experiments span six erasure methods and four domains: objects, artistic styles, copyrighted content, and nudity. Interventions using a few dozen selected SAE features yield higher average recovery rates than matched random-feature interventions, with recovery concentrated in objects and nudity following cross-attention edits. Most styles and copyrighted concepts show limited recovery under the tested intervention settings. These findings show that output suppression can coexist with responsiveness to sparse concept directions supplied from the original model.

AI.tldr: 提出SAE-Audit白盒审计方法，用稀疏自编码器探针检验概念擦除后的扩散模型是否仍保留目标概念的可恢复性。
AI.motivation: 现有评估仅看生成图像中目标概念的抑制与无关概念的保留，但"输出中不出现"不等于"模型内部已删除"，缺乏对擦除彻底性的直接检验。
AI.method: 基于原始模型激活训练共享SAE，识别擦除后目标相关响应减弱的特征；将原始模型响应得到的稀疏方向固定注入编辑模型（不改权重、不改提示），在留出场景族上测恢复率；覆盖6种擦除方法与4类域（物体、艺术风格、版权内容、裸露）。
AI.result: 数十个选定SAE特征的干预平均恢复率高于匹配的随机特征干预；恢复主要集中于跨注意力编辑后的物体与裸露域；多数风格与版权概念在测试设置下恢复有限。
AI.conclusion: 输出层面的抑制可与对原始模型稀疏概念方向的响应性共存，说明概念擦除可能只是隐藏而非真正移除概念表征。

title: RadarOSV: Unified 3D Scene and Motion Perception from mmWave Radars
summary: Millimeter-wave radar offers weather-resilient sensing for 3D occupancy prediction. Existing radar occupancy methods mainly model geometry, with limited joint modeling of semantics and motion. Cascaded imaging radar provides fine spatial detail but has a limited unambiguous velocity range, whereas single-chip radar offers a wider range but coarser spatial resolution. We propose RadarOSV, to our knowledge the first radar-only framework that jointly predicts occupancy, dynamic object semantics, and ground-relative velocity from raw radar data in unified voxels, by exploiting complementary measurements from both radars. Its Polar-to-Cartesian Geometry (PCG) backbone maps polar imaging-radar features into Cartesian voxels through fixed and deformable sampling, guiding cross-radar fusion for geometry and attribute prediction. Single-chip detection outputs provide class evidence, while raw Doppler spectra supply motion features and radial-velocity candidates. The velocity readout selects from these candidates using fused features to resolve aliasing, then combines the selected radial estimate with learned motion. Ego-motion compensation uses radar-estimated velocity, so inference requires no external odometry or other sensors. On K-Radar, single-frame PCG achieves 40.7% mIoU within 12.8 m, compared with RadarOcc's reported 34.3%. On the BRIDGE-Liv dataset, compared with a cascaded-radar baseline predicting the same outputs with external ego velocity, RadarOSV improves macro-averaged accuracy across four dynamic object classes within annotated object regions from 63.1% to 75.5% and reduces object radial-velocity MAE against manual Doppler annotations from 1.03 to 0.51 m/s, while maintaining geometric occupancy mIoU.

AI.tldr: RadarOSV是首个仅用原始雷达数据、在统一体素中联合预测占据、动态目标语义与地相对速度的框架，利用成像雷达与单芯片雷达的互补测量。
AI.motivation: 现有雷达占据方法主要建模几何，语义与运动的联合建模不足；级联成像雷达空间细节精细但无模糊速度范围有限，单芯片雷达速度范围宽但空间分辨率粗，二者互补未被充分联合利用，且通常依赖外部里程计。
AI.method: 提出PCG（极坐标到笛卡尔几何）主干，通过固定与可变形采样将极坐标成像雷达特征映射到笛卡尔体素，引导跨雷达融合；单芯片检测输出提供类别证据，原始多普勒谱提供运动特征与径向速度候选；速度读出用融合特征从候选中选择以解模糊，再与学习运动结合；自车运动补偿使用雷达估计速度，无需外部里程计或其他传感器。
AI.result: K-Radar上单帧PCG在12.8 m内mIoU达40.7%（RadarOcc报告为34.3%）；BRIDGE-Liv上相比使用外部自车速度的级联雷达基线，四类动态目标宏观平均精度由63.1%提升至75.5%，目标径向速度MAE由1.03降至0.51 m/s，并保持几何占据mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模几何、语义与运动并融合两类雷达可显著提升雷达占据预测的语义与速度精度，且无需外部里程计即可完成自车运动补偿。

title: Antiphony: A Dual-Process Agent for Deepfake Video Detection with Real-Video Calibration
summary: Reliable video deepfake detection requires generalization to unseen generators while limiting false alarms on authentic footage. Although existing detectors capture diverse visual cues, they may produce overconfident errors under generator shift, limiting the reliability of confidence-based fusion. Threshold calibration is further complicated by shifts in authentic capture domains and the lack of future-generator examples. To address these challenges, we present Antiphony, a framework that combines calibrated fusion of four visual experts with selective investigation. Authentic videos serve as a shared reference for score fusion and threshold calibration, enabling threshold updates without target deepfakes. For this expert-fusion stage, we establish finite-sample false-alarm control when the scoring procedure is fixed independently of calibration and authentic samples are exchangeable. To refine decisions near the calibrated threshold, a tool-using multimodal investigator examines these videos and contributes an additional fusion score. We train the investigator on generator-held-out predictions and counterfactual expert outputs, to improve robustness to unreliable expert evidence. Across six benchmark protocols, Antiphony achieves a mean benchmark score of 88.3%, exceeding the strongest evaluated MLLM and conventional detector baselines by 14.7 and 11.5 points, respectively. It also outperforms ARGUS by 20.2 points on average and by 3.6 balanced-accuracy points on FaceVid's 20 unseen generators.

AI.tldr: 提出 Antiphony 框架，通过四个视觉专家的校准融合与选择性调查实现未见生成器的可靠深度伪造检测与误报控制。
AI.motivation: 现有检测器在生成器迁移下易产生过度自信的错误，影响基于置信度融合的可靠性；真实视频拍摄域偏移及缺乏未来生成器样本使阈值标定困难。
AI.method: 以真实视频作为共享参考进行分数融合与阈值标定（无需目标深伪样本）；在评分流程独立于标定且真实样本可交换的假设下建立有限样本误报控制；对接近阈值的样本由工具增强的多模态调查器复检并贡献额外融合分数；调查器在生成器留出预测与反事实专家输出上训练。
AI.result: 六个基准协议平均分 88.3%，分别超出最强 MLLM 与传统检测器基线 14.7 与 11.5 分，平均超出 ARGUS 20.2 分；在 FaceVid 的 20 个未见生成器上平衡准确率高出 3.6 分。
AI.conclusion: 结合校准融合与选择性调查可提升跨生成器泛化与误报可控性，实现无需目标深伪样本的阈值更新。

title: Benchmarking VLM Medical Hallucination across 5 Modalities
summary: Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) within the medical domain remain a difficult and not well-understood problem, and it is still unclear where these models break down. Although several benchmarks targeting medical hallucination have been introduced, they often lack broad coverage across different medical imaging modalities. We introduce Multi-Med, a medical hallucination benchmark containing 1,000 image-question pairs spanning five distinct modalities. Using this benchmark, we perform an in-depth experimental study of 10 widely used VLMs across five modalities and four question categories. Our findings indicate that model performance differs substantially depending on the imaging modality and question type, and that the differences among the best-performing models are not statistically significant.

AI.tldr: 提出覆盖五种医学影像模态、1000个图文问答对的幻觉评测基准 Multi-Med，并对10个主流视觉语言模型做深入实验分析。
AI.motivation: 医学领域视觉语言模型（VLM）的幻觉问题困难且理解不足，模型在何处失效仍不清楚；已有医学幻觉基准缺乏跨影像模态的广泛覆盖。
AI.method: 构建 Multi-Med 基准，包含跨五种模态的1000个图像-问题对；在此基础上对10个广泛使用的VLM按五种模态与四类问题类型进行系统实验评估。
AI.result: 模型表现随影像模态与问题类型存在显著差异；表现最佳的几个模型之间差异在统计上不显著。
AI.conclusion: 医学VLM幻觉高度依赖模态与问题类型，需按模态与问题类型细化评估；当前领先模型间差距有限，说明进一步提升需超越现有范式。

title: Boosting zero-shot learning through neuro-symbolic integration
summary: Zero-shot learning (ZSL) aims to train deep neural networks to recognize objects from unseen classes, starting from a semantic description of the concepts. Neuro-symbolic (NeSy) integration refers to a class of techniques that incorporate symbolic knowledge representation and reasoning with the learning capabilities of deep neural networks. However, to date, few studies have explored how to leverage NeSy techniques to inject prior knowledge during the training process to boost ZSL capabilities. Here, we present Fuzzy Logic Prototypical Network (FLPN) that formulates the classification task as prototype matching in a visual-semantic embedding space, which is trained by optimizing a NeSy loss. Specifically, FLPN exploits the Logic Tensor Network (LTN) framework to incorporate background knowledge in the form of logical axioms by grounding a first-order logic language as differentiable operations between real tensors. This prior knowledge includes class hierarchies (classes and macroclasses) along with robust high-level inductive biases. The latter allow, for instance, to handle exceptions in class-level attributes and to enforce similarity between images of the same class, preventing premature overfitting to seen classes and improving overall performance. % CHECK: original sentence had no verb ("Both class-level and attribute-level prototypes through an attention mechanism ...") FLPN learns both class-level and attribute-level prototypes, the latter through an attention mechanism specialized for either convolutional- or transformer-based backbones. FLPN achieves state-of-the-art performance on the GZSL benchmarks AWA2 and SUN, matching or exceeding the performance of competing algorithms with minimal computational overhead. The code is available at https://github.com/FrancescoManigrass/FLPN

AI.tldr: 提出模糊逻辑原型网络（FLPN），将零样本学习（ZSL）建模为视觉-语义嵌入空间中的原型匹配，并用基于逻辑张量网络（LTN）的神经符号损失训练，注入类层次与高层归纳偏置，在AWA2和SUN上达到GZSL的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有研究较少探索如何利用神经符号（NeSy）技术在训练中注入先验知识以提升ZSL能力；作者希望弥合符号知识推理与深度网络学习之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: FLPN将分类任务表述为视觉-语义嵌入空间中的原型匹配；通过逻辑张量网络（LTN）把一阶逻辑语言落地为真实张量间的可微操作，从而以逻辑公理形式引入背景知识，包括类层次（类与宏类）及鲁棒的高层归纳偏置（处理类级属性例外、约束同类图像相似性）；同时学习类级原型与属性级原型，后者经注意力机制获得，并针对卷积或Transformer骨干分别特化。整体通过优化NeSy损失训练。
AI.result: 在GZSL基准AWA2与SUN上取得SOTA性能，匹配或超越竞争算法，且计算开销很小。
AI.conclusion: 符号化先验知识（尤其是类层次与归纳偏置）经可微逻辑损失注入，可有效防止对已见类的过早过拟合并提升ZSL泛化性能，为NeSy与ZSL结合提供了高效范例。

title: Benchmarking Geospatial Foundation Models under Calibrated Label Errors
comment: 100 pages (15 pages main text and references, 85 pages appendix), 78 figures, 68 tables. Extended version including supplementary material
summary: Earth-observation labels from maps, older products or hurried annotation arrive misaligned, coarse, loosely outlined or incomplete. Geospatial foundation models (GFMs) are nevertheless benchmarked with labels taken as correct. A practitioner therefore cannot tell which encoder to choose when the labels are imperfect. We present a benchmark protocol for fine-tuning under such labels. Four spatially structured error types are calibrated to equal label mIoU and applied identically to every model and seed. Every contrast is paired and read against an equivalence margin of $\pm 3$ points and a minimum detectable effect. We apply it to nine encoders, six decoder heads and ten datasets. In an exploratory reading at a matched learning rate the satellite-pretrained and web-pretrained DINOv3 encoders are equivalent within the margin on 8 of 9 datasets. Multispectral GFMs and an ImageNet ResNet-50 are equivalent within the margin on about half of them. Labels with random offsets cost the least at equal label quality. Under other decoder heads the verdicts mostly hold on FLAIR-2 and are decoder dependent on HLS Burn Scars. On four of five real label pairs the real label costs more than its matched simulated type. No choice of pretraining data makes an encoder consistently more robust, so the encoder is better chosen by its accuracy under imperfect labels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套标签不完美条件下的遥感基础模型微调基准协议：将四类空间结构化标签误差校准到相同标签mIoU并一致施加于所有模型与随机种子，采用配对比较和±3分等价边界判定，覆盖9个编码器、6种解码头和10个数据集。
AI.motivation: 真实遥感标签常因地图、旧产品或仓促标注而错位、粗糙、边界松散或不完整，但地理空间基础模型（GFM）普遍以"正确标签"为假设进行评测，导致实践者无法判断标签不完美时该选哪个编码器。
AI.method: 构建标签噪声下的微调基准协议：四类空间结构化误差在等标签mIoU条件下校准，并以完全相同方式施加到每个模型与种子；所有对比采用配对设计，并以±3分等价边界与最小可检测效应进行判定；实验涵盖9个编码器（卫星预训练/网络预训练DINOv3、多光谱GFM、ImageNet ResNet-50）、6种解码头与10个数据集，并在5对真实标签上进行仿真对照。
AI.result: 在匹配学习率的探索性读数中，卫星预训练与网络预训练DINOv3编码器在9个数据集中的8个上处于等价边界内；多光谱GFM与ImageNet ResNet-50约在一半数据集上等价；等标签质量下随机偏移类误差代价最小；其他解码头下结论在FLAIR-2上基本保持，而在HLS Burn Scars上依赖解码器；5对真实标签中有4对真实标签的代价高于其匹配的模拟误差类型。
AI.conclusion: 不存在某种预训练数据能使编码器持续更鲁棒，因此编码器应依据其在标签不完美条件下的准确率来选择，而非依据预训练数据来源；该协议为标签不完美场景下的模型选型提供了可复现、可判定的比较框架。

title: Beyond Language Optimization: Enhancing Visual Representations for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Accurate chest X-ray radiology report generation (RRG) requires recognizing clinically relevant abnormalities and accurately describing them. Although Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves the clinical accuracy of generated reports, our analyses suggest limited improvements in visual representations for abnormality recognition. To address this limitation, we propose a selective regional visual distillation framework that enhances visual representations of challenging abnormalities while preserving existing visual capabilities. Specifically, we train a region-aware teacher with targeted supervision on challenging anatomical regions to acquire complementary visual knowledge. Rather than transferring all teacher features, we verify their utility through regional feature replacement and select only those that improve the original student's performance. We further introduce a Spatially Gated Residual Adapter (SGRA) to distill these verified features while minimizing interference with the student's existing visual representations. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray demonstrate improved clinical report accuracy and region-level abnormality recognition across different multimodal large language model backbones, while largely preserving performance on non-target findings.

AI.tldr: 提出选择性区域视觉蒸馏框架，通过对困难解剖区域训练区域感知教师并用空间门控残差适配器迁移经验证的特征，提升胸片报告生成的异常识别能力。
AI.motivation: GRPO虽提升生成报告的临床准确性，但对异常识别的视觉表征改进有限。
AI.method: 以目标监督训练区域感知教师获取互补视觉知识；通过区域特征替换验证教师特征有效性，仅挑选能提升学生性能的特征；引入空间门控残差适配器（SGRA）蒸馏这些特征，减少对学生原有表征的干扰。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-CXR与IU-Xray上，跨多种多模态大模型骨干均提升了临床报告准确性与区域级异常识别，同时基本保持非目标征象性能。
AI.conclusion: 选择性、可验证的区域视觉蒸馏可在不损害既有视觉能力的前提下增强困难异常的识别与报告质量。

title: MISeg-Agent: A Human-in-the-Loop Agentic Framework for Error Diagnosis and Executable Prompt Review in 3D Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Despite the strong performance of modern medical image segmentation models, their predictions can still contain localized errors that compromise segmentation quality. Identifying and correcting these errors is therefore essential for improving the reliability of existing segmentation results. While interactive segmentation models enable targeted corrections, identifying potential errors, determining where to intervene, and evaluating corrective actions remain challenging. Moreover, each correction changes the current mask, requiring subsequent error diagnosis and recommendations to adapt accordingly. To address these challenges, we propose MISeg-Agent, a human-in-the-loop agentic framework that diagnoses segmentation errors and provides evidence-based correction recommendations. MISeg-Agent first selects a suitable pretrained segmentation model based on benchmark performance and computational requirements. Given its predicted mask, the framework identifies potential missing and excess foreground regions and recommends suspicious slices and corrective points for review. The framework then evaluates candidate point prompts using an interactive segmentation model and presents the resulting corrections for human verification before applying them. By operating directly on images and predicted masks, the error diagnosis process remains independent of the underlying segmentation model architecture. Evaluations on CT datasets demonstrate that MISeg-Agent improves initial segmentation results and produces final masks closely aligned with reference annotations. By integrating adaptive error diagnosis with validated correction recommendations, MISeg-Agent provides an interpretable approach to identifying and reducing residual errors in existing medical image segmentations.

AI.tldr: MISeg-Agent是一个人在回路（human-in-the-loop）的智能体框架，用于诊断医学图像分割错误并给出有证据支撑的校正建议，在CT数据集上提升初始分割结果并使其接近参考标注。
AI.motivation: 现有医学图像分割模型即使性能强劲，预测结果仍存在局部错误，损害分割质量；交互式分割虽支持定向修正，但"识别错误位置、判断干预点、评估修正效果"仍具挑战，且每次修正都会改变当前掩码，要求后续错误诊断与建议随之自适应更新。
AI.method: 框架首先依据基准性能与计算需求选择预训练分割模型；针对其预测掩码，识别潜在的前景缺失区域与多余区域，并推荐可疑切片与校正点；随后利用交互式分割模型评估候选点提示（point prompts），在人工核验后才应用校正。诊断过程直接作用于图像与预测掩码，因而与底层分割模型架构无关。
AI.result: 在CT数据集上的评估表明，MISeg-Agent能够改善初始分割结果，生成的最终掩码与参考标注高度对齐。
AI.conclusion: 通过将自适应错误诊断与经验证的校正建议相结合，MISeg-Agent为识别并减少现有医学图像分割中的残余错误提供了一种可解释的方法。

title: Seeing Beyond Names: Image-Grounded Concept Linking for Robust Vision-Language Recognition
summary: A zero-shot vision-language classifier is highly sensitive to the class names it receives. Even when images remain unchanged, replacing familiar labels with synonyms, abbreviations, or ontology terms can significantly alter predictions. We investigate this \emph{vocabulary shift} using a leakage-free evaluation protocol across Tiny ImageNet, ImageNet-R, ImageNet-A, and ImageNetV2. With CLIP ViT-B/16, alternative class names reduce top-1 accuracy by $14.8$--$17.6$ percentage points. To address this issue, we propose \emph{image-grounded concept linking}, a training-free method that maps class names to visual concepts and uses a reliability gate to improve predictions. The method outperforms a template ensemble across all four datasets, achieving a pooled gain of $1.8$ points. We further evaluate five vision-language backbones across four datasets. Our method improves performance in $16$ of $20$ backbone--dataset combinations, with no significantly negative results. It also reduces pooled negative log-likelihood across all five backbones. Stronger text linking and transductive refinement provide no consistent improvements, suggesting that accurate visual class-name linking remains the main challenge. A second CLIP ViT-B/16 seed confirms the improvement on ImageNetV2, but not on ImageNet-A.

AI.tldr: 零样本视觉-语言分类器对类别名称高度敏感；本文提出免训练的"图像锚定概念链接"方法缓解词汇漂移，在多数骨干-数据集组合上稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 即使图像不变，仅将熟悉标签替换为同义词、缩写或本体术语，也会显著改变CLIP等零样本分类器的预测（词汇漂移问题）。作者希望量化该脆弱性并给出无需训练的稳健化方案。
AI.method: 采用无泄漏评测协议，在Tiny ImageNet、ImageNet-R、ImageNet-A、ImageNetV2上评测；提出image-grounded concept linking：将类别名映射到视觉概念，并用可靠性门控（reliability gate）融合预测，全程免训练；与模板集成（template ensemble）对比，并在5个骨干×4个数据集上验证，另测试更强的文本链接与直推式精炼。
AI.result: CLIP ViT-B/16下替代类别名使top-1准确率下降14.8–17.6个百分点；所提方法在四个数据集上均优于模板集成，合并增益1.8点；20个骨干-数据集组合中16个提升且无显著负结果，5个骨干的合并负对数似然均下降；更强文本链接与直推式精炼无一致收益；第二个随机种子的CLIP ViT-B/16在ImageNetV2上复现提升，但ImageNet-A上未复现。
AI.conclusion: 零样本分类器的词汇敏感性显著且可部分缓解；免训练的图像锚定概念链接是一种简单有效的稳健化手段，但准确的视觉-类别名链接仍是核心瓶颈，方法效果存在数据集依赖的复现性差异。

title: HandiVid: A High-Quality Dataset for Hand-Driven Interactive Video Generation
summary: Hand-driven egocentric interactive video generation aims to generate dynamic scenes with realistic interaction responses conditioned on hand movements and camera motion. However, existing egocentric video datasets struggle to provide scene diversity, meaningful hand-object interactions, and reliable motion annotations simultaneously. To address these limitations, we introduce HandiVid, a high-quality dataset comprising 200K curated and annotated egocentric interaction video clips for hand-driven interactive video generation. We develop a unified data processing pipeline that integrates public datasets, online videos and synthetic videos. Through video quality assessment, hand detection filtering, and multi-stage interaction validation using vision-language models (VLMs), we select high-quality video clips with meaningful hand-object interactions. Since 3D hand reconstruction relies on initial hand detections, we integrate SAM 3 into the hand detection pipeline to reduce missed detections and improve the completeness of 3D hand annotations. Each video clip is provided with high-quality hand renderings, camera trajectories, and interaction descriptions. Comprehensive dataset analysis and downstream video generation experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of HandiVid in terms of data diversity, annotation quality, and controllable video generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出HandiVid，一个包含20万条高质量、带标注的第一视角手-物交互视频片段的数据集，用于手驱动的交互式视频生成；其数据由公开数据、网络视频和合成视频经统一流程筛选整合，并借助SAM 3改进3D手部标注完整性，显著提升了数据多样性、标注质量与可控生成效果。
AI.motivation: 现有第一视角视频数据集难以同时满足场景多样性、有意义的真实手-物交互以及可靠的相机与手部运动标注这三项需求，制约了手驱动交互式视频生成任务的发展。
AI.method: 构建统一的处理流程：整合公开数据集、在线视频与合成视频，依次进行视频质量评估、手部检测滤波，并利用视觉语言模型（VLM）进行多阶段交互验证以筛出高质量交互片段；在检测环节引入SAM 3以降低漏检，从而提升3D手部重建与标注的完整性；每条片段附带高质量手部渲染、相机轨迹和交互描述。
AI.result: 数据集规模达200K条经筛选与标注的第一视角交互视频；数据集分析表明其在数据多样性和标注质量上优于现有数据集，下游视频生成实验证明了其在可控、真实交互响应生成上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: HandiVid有效缓解了第一视角交互数据在多样性、交互语义和运动标注方面的不足，可作为手驱动交互式视频生成的可靠数据基座，并为后续数据构建提供了可复用的pipeline范式。

title: SCRA-CLIP: Spherical-Contextual Representation Adaptation for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
summary: Recent advances in vision-language models have facilitated zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) through transferable visual-semantic representations. However, detecting fine-grained anomalies remains challenging due to inadequate modeling of diverse anomaly patterns and their spatial context. To address these challenges, we propose SCRA-CLIP, a Spherical-Contextual Representation Adaptation framework that jointly enhances anomaly-aware textual semantics and context-sensitive visual representations. Specifically, we introduce Spherical Prototype-Conditioned Prompting (SPCP), which employs von Mises--Fisher mixtures to model the directional distributions of normal and abnormal patch features. These state-specific prototypes are incorporated into textual contexts to guide the learning of more discriminative textual representations. Furthermore, we develop Context-Deviation Guided Visual Adaptation (CGVA), which captures local feature deviations relative to multi-scale neighborhood contexts and refines patch representations through adaptive gating. By integrating distribution-aware semantic modeling with context-sensitive visual adaptation, SCRA-CLIP facilitates more discriminative cross-modal matching for fine-grained anomaly detection and localization. Extensive experiments on 11 industrial and medical benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization capability of SCRA-CLIP across diverse unseen categories and domains. The code will be publicly available upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出 SCRA-CLIP 框架，通过球面原型条件提示与上下文偏差引导的视觉适配，共同增强文本语义与视觉表示，实现细粒度零样本异常检测与定位。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型已支持零样本异常检测（ZSAD），但对多样异常模式及其空间上下文建模不足，细粒度异常检测仍然困难。
AI.method: 包含两个模块：(1) SPCP（Spherical Prototype-Conditioned Prompting），用 von Mises–Fisher 混合分布对正常/异常 patch 特征的方向分布建模，得到状态特定原型并注入文本上下文以学习更具判别性的文本表示；(2) CGVA（Context-Deviation Guided Visual Adaptation），捕获相对多尺度邻域上下文的局部特征偏差，并通过自适应门控精炼 patch 表示。
AI.result: 在 11 个工业与医学基准上验证了有效性，在多样化的未见类别与跨域场景下展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将分布感知的语义建模与上下文敏感的视觉适配相结合，可提升跨模态匹配的判别性，从而改进细粒度零样本异常检测与定位。

title: OmniSenMo: A Unified Multisensory Language Model for Generalizable Human Motion Estimation, Understanding, and Prediction
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) estimate, understand, and predict human motion, but mainly from RGB cameras. Depth, LiDAR, mmWave, and WiFi complement RGB under poor lighting, through occlusions, and in privacy-sensitive applications, but existing multisensory models cover only some of these sensing tasks. Covering all of them from any sensor subset is challenging, since the tokens of heterogeneous sensors are semantically inconsistent and spatially misaligned, paired multisensory data are scarce, and the tasks need different temporal granularities. We present OmniSenMo, a multisensory language model that takes the human skeleton as a common reference for all sensors. Its skeleton-grounded motion representation turns each sensor into joint tokens, one per body joint, so that any sensor subset is fused joint by joint and expressed in the motion vocabulary that the language model learned from motion capture and text. We pretrain it on all five sensors generated by our multisensory simulator, and Multi-Granularity Observation gives each task the frames it needs. On a cross-action split of MM-Fi, the same model with all five sensors outperforms the models compared on each task, including LEO-Fuse in pose estimation (84.1 vs. 89.0 mm MPJPE) and HoloLLM in unseen-action recognition (69.2% vs. 42.8%). Even without RGB, it outperforms both methods that use RGB, and in a cross-dataset validation on XRF55, it recognizes unseen actions far better than HoloLLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OmniSenMo，一个以人体骨架为共同参照的多传感器语言模型，可将任意传感器子集的异构建模为逐关节 token 并融合，在 MM-Fi 与 XRF55 上优于 LEO-Fuse 与 HoloLLM。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 RGB 相机的人体运动理解大模型在弱光、遮挡和隐私敏感场景下受限；深度、LiDAR、mmWave、WiFi 等传感可互补，但已有多传感模型仅覆盖部分传感任务。要"从任意传感器子集完成全部任务"存在三大难点：异质传感器 token 语义不一致且空间未对齐、多传感配对数据稀缺、不同任务需不同时间粒度。
AI.method: 以人体骨架作为所有传感器的共同参照，提出 skeleton-grounded 运动表征，将每个传感器转换为"每个身体关节一个"的关节 token，从而实现逐关节的任意子集融合，并映射到语言模型从动作捕捉与文本中学到的运动词表；用自研多传感模拟器生成五类传感器数据做预训练，并以 Multi-Granularity Observation 为不同任务提供所需时间帧。
AI.result: 在 MM-Fi 的 cross-action 划分上，五传感器版本在各任务上均优于对比模型：姿态估计 MPJPE 84.1 vs. LEO-Fuse 89.0 mm；未见动作识别 69.2% vs. HoloLLM 42.8%。即使不使用 RGB，仍优于两种使用 RGB 的方法；在 XRF55 跨数据集验证中，未见动作识别显著优于 HoloLLM。
AI.conclusion: 以骨架为统一参照的关节级 token 化，是解决异质多传感语义不一致与空间错位的有效途径，可在传感器子集缺失（含无 RGB）时保持强泛化能力，并通过模拟器预训练缓解配对数据稀缺问题。

title: When "A or B" Is Less Likely than A: Coherent Probabilities for Vision Decision Models
summary: Vision decision models answer a multiple-choice question about an image with one probability per option, and software uses them directly. We show that the probabilities depend on how the options are grouped: a merged option "A or B" receives on average 11.5 points less probability than the sum of A and B. This under-additivity appears at every model size from 0.85B to 26B and remains after fine-tuning on labels. We propose CORE, which asks each training question with its options regrouped and trains the answers to all these questions toward one target distribution over the original options, summed into each question's groups. On 1,050 items from seven benchmarks, CORE reduces the total variation distance between the answer to a regrouped question and the original answer summed into the same groups from 14.8 to 5.8 points on the 0.85B model, against 9.4 for the best baseline trained on the same questions. At all five model sizes, CORE reduces this distance without lowering accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示视觉决策模型输出的选项概率依赖选项分组方式，合并选项" A or B "的概率系统性低于 A 与 B 概率之和（平均低 11.5 个百分点），并将该现象命名为"次可加性"，贯穿 0.85B–26B 全部模型规模且微调后仍存在。作者提出 CORE 方法予以校正。
AI.motivation: 软件直接使用视觉决策模型对图像多选题给出的逐选项概率，但这些概率被证实并非与分组无关的稳定量：选项合并后概率不守恒（次可加性），这意味着下游系统的决策依据存在系统性偏差，且该偏差跨模型规模普遍、微调后残留，需要针对性训练目标来修正。
AI.method: 提出 CORE：对每个训练问题以重新分组（合并）的选项形式重复提问，将同一目标分布（在原始选项上定义）按各问题的分组求和后作为监督信号，使模型对不同分组表述的答案相互一致。
AI.result: 在 7 个基准共 1,050 个样本上，0.85B 模型上"重分组问题答案"与"原答案按同组求和"之间的总变差距离由 14.8 降至 5.8 个百分点（同问题训练的最佳基线为 9.4）；在全部 5 种模型规模上均降低该距离，且不降低准确率。
AI.conclusion: 选项概率的分组依赖性是可测量、可训练的缺陷；CORE 通过分组重述的一致性监督有效缓解次可加性，在不牺牲准确率的前提下提升概率校准与分组一致性，提示下游使用概率的软件应关注该偏差。

title: FireDesmoke: Fire Smoke Removal via Real Smoke Transfer and Semantic Rectification
summary: Fire smoke removal must restore dense and medium smoke regions while preserving the clear (smoke-free) content. Existing methods either leave the smoke or alter the visible content, and generative models may hallucinate people or remove flames. Real fire smoke is spatially local: the degradation and its corruption of semantic features are both concentrated in the smoke regions. We propose FireDesmoke, built on this locality: Real Smoke Transfer calibrates smoke fields on real-fire recordings and transfers their spatial layout onto clean images to synthesize training pairs, and Semantic Rectification uses pixel features to rectify the tokens of a frozen foundation encoder where smoke corrupts them. With matched training budgets, replacing the transferred pairs with SmokeBench pairs lowers dense-smoke PSNR by 0.74 dB, and removing Semantic Rectification leaves clear regions 1.31 dB below the input. On what is, to the best of our knowledge, the first paired dataset of real fire smoke for image restoration, with 1,500 test frames from a held-out viewpoint, FireDesmoke improves dense- and medium-smoke PSNR by 3.73 and 2.63 dB while keeping clear regions at the input level (+0.41 dB); no other compared method gains at least 1 dB in dense smoke without lowering clear-region PSNR, and no hallucinated person is found in its outputs. It achieves state-of-the-art overall results on this benchmark and, trained on SmokeBench, the highest PSNR with the second-best SSIM and LPIPS.

AI.tldr: FireDesmoke利用火灾烟雾的空间局部性，通过真实烟雾迁移合成训练对并用像素特征校正冻结基础编码器的语义令牌，在首个真实火灾烟雾配对数据集上显著提升浓/中烟雾去烟效果且不损伤清晰区域、无幻觉生成。
AI.motivation: 现有去烟方法要么残留烟雾、要么改变清晰内容，生成式模型还可能幻觉出人物或抹除火焰。作者观察到真实火灾烟雾具有空间局部性：退化与其对语义特征的破坏均集中在烟雾区域，但缺乏针对该特性的方法与真实配对数据。
AI.method: 提出FireDesmoke，基于烟雾局部性设计两模块：(1) Real Smoke Transfer，在真实火灾录像上标定烟雾场，并将其空间布局迁移到干净图像上合成训练对；(2) Semantic Rectification，用像素特征校正冻结基础编码器中被烟雾污染的令牌。同时构建了据称首个真实火灾烟雾图像复原配对数据集（1,500帧测试，来自留出视角）。
AI.result: 同等训练预算下，用SmokeBench配对替换迁移配对使浓烟PSNR下降0.74 dB；去除Semantic Rectification使清晰区域比输入低1.31 dB。在新基准上浓烟与中烟PSNR分别提升3.73与2.63 dB，清晰区域维持输入水平(+0.41 dB)；无其他方法能在浓烟上增益≥1 dB且不降低清晰区域PSNR，输出中未检测到幻觉人物。在SmokeBench训练下取得最高PSNR、次优SSIM与LPIPS。
AI.conclusion: 真实烟雾迁移与语义校正对火灾去烟均不可或缺；FireDesmoke在新真实配对基准上达到SOTA，兼顾浓/中烟雾恢复、清晰区域保真与幻觉抑制，并在SmokeBench上具备良好泛化。

title: ReplaySAM: Zero-Shot 3D Particle-Pack Segmentation with SAM 2
summary: X-ray computed tomography (XCT) provides non-destructive three-dimensional (3D) images of particle packs, making their internal structure accessible for quantitative analysis. Extracting particle-level measurements from these volumes first requires identifying and separating individual particles, a task that remains challenging in dense, irregular packs. Existing workflows often require manual correction or task-specific training, while promptable models need a strategy for automatically locating individual particles and recovering their instance masks. We present ReplaySAM, which adapts the pretrained Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) to three-dimensional particle-pack segmentation without additional training. It generates point prompts from foreground geometry and fuses SAM2 predictions across orthogonal slice sequences to recover particle instances. On XCT volumes of real quartz and iron-ore particle packs, ReplaySAM achieves higher mean instance Dice scores than expert-assisted watershed and nnInteractive under the evaluated protocols. ReplaySAM thus provides a training-free framework for 3D particle-pack instance segmentation, with geometry-based prompting that eliminates manual prompt placement.

AI.tldr: ReplaySAM 是一个免训练框架，将预训练的 SAM2 适配到三维颗粒堆积的实例分割：由前景几何自动生成点提示，并融合正交切片序列上的 SAM2 预测以恢复颗粒实例。
AI.motivation: XCT 可获得颗粒堆积的非破坏性三维图像，但密集、不规则堆积中单个颗粒的识别与分离仍很困难。现有流程常需人工修正或任务特定训练，而可提示模型（如 SAM 系列）缺乏自动定位单个颗粒并恢复其实例掩码的策略。
AI.method: 在无需额外训练的前提下适配预训练 SAM2：基于前景几何生成点提示以替代人工放置提示；将 SAM2 在正交切片序列上的预测进行融合，从而重建三维颗粒实例。
AI.result: 在真实石英与铁矿颗粒堆积的 XCT 体数据上，在所评估协议下，ReplaySAM 的平均实例 Dice 分数高于专家辅助的分水岭方法与 nnInteractive。
AI.conclusion: ReplaySAM 为三维颗粒堆积实例分割提供了免训练框架，其几何驱动的提示方式消除了手动提示放置，具备实用价值。

title: FlexGaze: Weakly Supervised Gaze Estimation at Scale
comment: 23 pages, including 12 pages of supplementary material
summary: Most gaze estimation models are trained on data collected using specialized equipment. The limited diversity of subjects, scenes, and head poses in these datasets hinders generalization to new conditions. We present FlexGaze, a family of 3D gaze estimators pretrained with weak supervision from gaze labels (pseudo-labels) automatically generated from in-the-wild images. We use off-the-shelf models to predict 2D gaze targets and scene depth, then combine these predictions to generate 3D gaze labels for approximately 3.24 million head instances. At inference, FlexGaze predicts gaze from a head crop alone and can handle profile and rear views without requiring face detection or head pose estimation. We use data augmentation during training to improve robustness to variations in crop position and scale. Pretrained using only these generated gaze labels, FlexGaze generalizes to unseen benchmarks. After supervised fine-tuning on public gaze datasets, we evaluate FlexGaze on eight benchmarks under a unified evaluation protocol. Our models match or outperform publicly available gaze estimators with several times as many parameters on most benchmarks. We release our dataset of generated gaze labels, all trained models, and code via https://github.com/ihp-lab/FlexGaze.

AI.tldr: FlexGaze：利用现成模型从野外图像自动生成伪3D注视标签（约324万头部件实例），以弱监督预训练一组3D注视估计器，仅输入头部裁剪即可在侧脸/后视场景工作，并在八个基准上以更少参数达到或超越公开模型。
AI.motivation: 现有注视估计模型多在专用设备采集的数据上训练，受试者、场景和头部姿态多样性有限，难以泛化到新条件。
AI.method: 用现成模型预测2D注视目标与场景深度，组合生成约324万头部件实例的3D注视伪标签；以此弱监督预训练3D注视估计器。推理时仅用头部裁剪图预测注视，无需人脸检测或头部姿态估计，可处理侧脸与后视；训练中采用数据增强提升对裁剪位置与尺度的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 仅用生成标签预训练即可泛化到未见基准；在公开数据集监督微调后，按统一评估协议在八个基准上评估，多数基准上以数倍更少参数匹配或超越公开注视估计器。
AI.conclusion: 自动化伪标签弱监督可有效突破专用数据集的多样性瓶颈，构建轻量且泛化性强的3D注视估计模型；作者开源了生成标签数据集、模型与代码。

title: NNS-GS: Non-Local Neural Scattering for Relightable Gaussian Splatting
summary: Creating relightable 3D assets of translucent objects is challenging because changing the illumination at one surface location can affect the appearance elsewhere through subsurface scattering. Existing Gaussian-based scattering models typically predict scattering from local features, making this dependence difficult to capture. We present Non-Local Neural Scattering for Gaussian Splatting (NNS-GS), which learns non-local scattering together with geometry-guided local reflection. The scattering module learns how illumination from light-visible surface regions in light space contributes to the shading point in view space, conditioned on regional diffuse responses and spatial relationships. The reflection module supplies these diffuse responses and uses additional geometric guidance to better capture specular highlights and sharp shadow boundaries. To reduce component mixing and support controllable scattering appearance, anchor-based progressive training establishes the diffuse-scattering base before introducing specular reflection and supervises the components separately. Under calibrated point lighting, NNS-GS improves mean PSNR over existing methods by 2.47 dB and 0.81 dB on the synthetic and real translucent scenes, respectively. Additional synthetic comparisons further show that NNS-GS better matches the reference when adjusting scattering attenuation.

AI.tldr: 提出 NNS-GS，将非局部神经散射与几何引导的局部反射结合的高斯泼溅表示，实现半透明物体的可重光照 3D 资产重建。
AI.motivation: 半透明物体的可重光照 3D 资产构建困难：改变某一表面位置的照明会通过次表面散射影响其他区域外观，而现有基于高斯的散射模型通常仅由局部特征预测散射，难以刻画这种非局部依赖关系。
AI.method: 散射模块在光空间中学习光照可见表面区域对视图空间着色点的贡献，并以区域漫反射响应与空间关系为条件；反射模块提供这些漫反射响应，并借助额外几何引导捕捉高光与锐利阴影边界。采用基于锚点的渐进式训练，先建立漫反射-散射基底，再引入镜面反射，并对各分量分别监督，以减少分量混合并支持可控散射外观。
AI.result: 在标定点光源下，合成与真实半透明场景上的平均 PSNR 分别较现有方法提升 2.47 dB 与 0.81 dB；额外合成对比显示 NNS-GS 在调整散射衰减时更贴合参考图像。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模非局部散射并结合几何引导的局部反射与渐进式分量分离训练，可有效提升半透明物体的重光照质量与散射外观可控性。

title: Draft Forcing: Target-guided Speculative Drafting and Learned Verifier for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models enable streaming synthesis chunk by chunk, yet invoking the large model for every chunk remains costly. While chunk-level speculative decoding can offload chunks to a lightweight draft model, existing approaches suffer from two limitations: (1) an off-the-shelf draft diverges from the target's trajectory, compounding errors in history; and (2) they either omit verification or rely on costly post-decode aesthetic scores rather than verifying consistency against the target. We address both with Draft Forcing, a framework coupling target-guided drafting with an on-policy trained verifier. Specifically, to align the draft for high acceptance, we opt for feature-level drafting, conditioning it on multi-layer target hidden states persisted from committed chunks, whose outputs are pushed to match target trajectories with multi-aspect losses. For verification, we propose an on-policy trained feature-space verifier predicting CDF-calibrated frame-wise relative RMSE against the target. It is trained on speculative rollouts as contexts anneal from random to inference-aligned mixtures, and gates proposals without VAE decoding. On the 14B Self-Forcing target, Draft Forcing achieves $1.63\times$ DiT and $1.57\times$ end-to-end speedups on VBench with minimal quality loss, and up to $1.93\times$ DiT ($1.82\times$ end-to-end) when combined with orthogonal KV compression. It generalizes to accelerate a streaming variant of MiniMax-H3, generating over $50\%$ draft frames with competitive quality.

AI.tldr: 提出 Draft Forcing 框架，将目标引导的特征级草稿（drafting）与在线策略训练的验证器结合，实现自回归视频扩散模型的块级投机解码加速，在 14B Self-Forcing 上取得 1.63× DiT 与 1.57× 端到端加速且质量损失极小。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型可逐块流式生成，但每个块都调用大模型代价高。块级投机解码虽可将块卸载给轻量草稿模型，但现有方法存在两点不足：(1) 现成草稿偏离目标轨迹，历史误差累积；(2) 要么省略验证，要么依赖解码后昂贵的审美评分，而非针对目标的一致性验证。
AI.method: 1) 特征级草稿：以从已提交块中持久化的多层目标隐状态为条件，并通过多方面损失将其输出对齐目标轨迹，提高接受率；2) 验证：设计在线策略训练的特征空间验证器，预测经 CDF 校准的逐帧相对 RMSE（相对目标），在投机 rollout 上训练且上下文从随机逐步退火至与推理对齐的混合分布，无需 VAE 解码即可门控候选。
AI.result: 在 14B Self-Forcing 目标模型上，VBench 上获得 1.63× DiT 与 1.57× 端到端加速，质量损失极小；与正交的 KV 压缩结合后可达 1.93× DiT（1.82× 端到端）。并可泛化至加速 MiniMax-H3 的流式变体，生成超过 50% 的草稿帧且质量具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过目标引导的特征级草稿与在线训练的特征空间验证器协同设计，Draft Forcing 在不牺牲生成质量的前提下显著降低自回归视频扩散的推理成本，并与 KV 压缩等正交技术叠加，且具备跨模型泛化能力。

title: AdvMTO: Multimodal and Temporal Adversarial Object Attacks via 2D Gaussian Splatting for BEV-Based 3D Object Detection
summary: Adversarial object attacks pose a threat to BEV-based 3D object detectors in autonomous driving. Existing attacks typically target a single modality, coordinate camera and LiDAR observations at the current timestamp, or model temporal persistence mainly in camera streams. Without a unified construction of current and historical observations, attacks can leave part of the detector's accumulated evidence unsuppressed, limiting their effectiveness. In this paper, we propose AdvMTO, a 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) framework for suppressing detection of persistent adversarial objects. Its oriented surfels encode appearance, geometry, and opacity in one object state, from which camera images and scanline LiDAR returns are generated. AdvMTO then constructs current and historical inputs through detector-native processing, regenerating LiDAR returns in each native source sweep for fusion detectors. We optimize bounded appearance perturbations for each detector, propagating gradients through historical BEV memory for temporal camera detectors. For fusion detectors, bounded geometry refinement along local normals further perturbs both sensing modalities. Experiments on nuScenes demonstrate effective suppression of traffic-cone detection across three BEV detectors. Temporal ablations further highlight the importance of detector-native history modeling for both attack construction and optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AdvMTO，一个基于 2D 高斯泼溅（2DGS）的对抗物体攻击框架，通过统一建模当前与历史观测来抑制 BEV 3D 检测器对持续性对抗目标的检测。
AI.motivation: 现有针对 BEV 3D 检测器的对抗物体攻击通常只针对单一模态、仅在当前时间戳协调相机与 LiDAR 观测，或主要在相机流中建模时间持续性。由于缺乏对当前与历史观测的统一构建，检测器累积的证据无法被完全抑制，从而限制了攻击效果。
AI.method: AdvMTO 用带方向的 surfels 将外观、几何与不透明度编码于单一物体状态，并由此生成相机图像与扫描线式 LiDAR 回波。随后通过检测器原生处理流程构建当前与历史输入，对融合检测器在每个原生源扫描中重新生成 LiDAR 回波。针对时间相机检测器，优化有界外观扰动并将梯度通过历史 BEV 记忆回传；针对融合检测器，则沿局部法线进行有界几何细化，以同时扰动两种感知模态。
AI.result: 在 nuScenes 数据集上的实验表明，该方法能有效抑制三种 BEV 检测器对交通锥的检测；时间维度消融实验进一步凸显了检测器原生历史建模在攻击构建与优化中的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 统一的当前-历史观测建模与检测器原生处理流程是提升持续性对抗物体攻击有效性的关键，2DGS 为跨模态、跨时间的攻击构建提供了有效的统一表示。

title: PixelOne: From Options to Pixels in a Single Forward for GUI Grounding
summary: GUI grounding requires precise clicks at low latency. Recent models such as GUI-Decisions and GUI-Swift predict coordinates in one forward pass using fixed global bins with local refinement. However, screenshot downsampling removes detail needed to locate small controls, while fixed bins cover larger pixel ranges at higher resolutions. We introduce PixelOne, which transfers spatial knowledge from a search teacher to a student that predicts clicks directly from screenshots at native resolution. The teacher uses VideoJEV's text-option scorer to select rows and columns and progressively zoom into candidate regions. The student inherits the teacher's parameters and matches its distributions over explored regions through spatial distillation alongside box supervision. At inference, the same decision head selects a visual token, and a lightweight pixel head predicts the click within it, all in one forward pass. A click-aligned loss encourages pixels inside the target box to score above those outside. Across four benchmarks, PixelOne-Pro-35B-A3B achieves 83.8% mean accuracy, the highest among the evaluated single-forward grounders, with a mean latency of 0.43 s per target.

AI.tldr: PixelOne将搜索式教师的空间知识蒸馏到直接预测点击的学生模型，在原生分辨率截图上单次前向完成精确定位，Pro-35B-A3B在四个基准上取得83.8%平均精度，平均延迟0.43秒/目标。
AI.motivation: GUI定位需要在低延迟下实现精确点击。现有方法（如GUI-Decisions、GUI-Swift）用固定全局bin加局部细化做单次前向坐标预测，但截图下采样会丢失定位小控件所需的细节，而固定bin在高分辨率下覆盖的像素范围过大，导致精度与效率难以兼顾。
AI.method: 提出PixelOne：教师模型基于VideoJEV的文本选项打分器选择行与列，并逐级放大候选区域进行搜索；学生模型继承教师参数，通过空间蒸馏匹配教师在已探索区域上的分布，并结合框监督训练。推理时同一决策头选择视觉token，轻量像素头在该token内预测具体点击，单次前向完成。同时引入点击对齐损失，使目标框内像素得分高于框外像素。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，PixelOne-Pro-35B-A3B达到83.8%平均准确率，为所评估的单次前向grounder中最高，平均延迟为0.43秒/目标。
AI.conclusion: 以搜索教师引导的、基于原生分辨率token级选择加像素级回归的范式，可在单次前向中同时获得高精度与低延迟，优于固定bin方案的GUI定位方法。

title: EditGRN: Inversion-Free Image Editing by Source-Target Generative Synchronization
summary: Text-guided image editing faces a persistent trade-off between preserving source content and realizing coherent target semantics. We explore this challenge through training- and inversion-free image editing based on discrete generative models. Existing inversion-free discrete editors primarily rely on post-hoc probability correction, creating a disconnect between local token-level adjustments and globally coherent semantic generation. To bridge this gap, we introduce EditGRN, a training- and inversion-free framework with trajectory-wide source-target generative synchronization in discrete space. EditGRN adopts a dual-branch design---the source branch constructs source references and the target branch generates the target image-enabling trajectory-wide synchronization between the two. Exploiting GRN's ability to recover clean tokens from arbitrary binary corruptions, the source branch directly constructs corrupted source states at each refinement step to extract useful editing features, without recovering a specific source-generation trajectory. The target branch synchronizes with the source branch through the same corruption schedule, fusing the corresponding source context with editable representations intra-model. By synchronizing source context with target generation along the entire trajectory, our approach faithfully preserves the background while producing high-quality edits that blend seamlessly with the surrounding scene through intra-model fusion. PIE-Bench show state-of-the-art performance on background preservation and text alignment across diverse editing tasks against continuous and discrete baselines.

AI.tldr: EditGRN 是一种免训练、免反演（training- and inversion-free）的离散空间文本引导图像编辑框架，通过双分支设计与全轨迹的源-目标生成同步，在保持背景的同时实现高保真编辑。
AI.motivation: 文本引导图像编辑长期存在"保持源内容"与"实现目标语义一致性"之间的权衡。现有免反演的离散编辑器主要依赖事后概率校正（post-hoc probability correction），导致局部 token 级调整与全局语义生成之间出现割裂。
AI.method: 提出 EditGRN，采用双分支结构：源分支构造源参考，目标分支生成目标图像，并在离散空间中实现两条轨迹的全程同步。利用 GRN 能从任意二值损坏中恢复干净 token 的能力，源分支在每个细化步骤直接构造损坏的源状态以提取有用的编辑特征，而无需恢复特定源生成轨迹；目标分支通过相同损坏调度与源分支同步，在模型内部（intra-model）将对应源上下文与可编辑表示融合。
AI.result: 在 PIE-Bench 上，与连续和离散基线相比，EditGRN 在背景保持与文本对齐方面取得 state-of-the-art 性能，并在多种编辑任务中生成与周围场景自然融合的高质量编辑。
AI.conclusion: 通过沿整条轨迹同步源上下文与目标生成，EditGRN 有效弥合了局部 token 调整与全局语义生成之间的差距，在免训练、免反演设定下兼顾背景保真与编辑质量。

title: GUI-Q: Task-Sensitive Granularity and Relation-Preserving Quantization for GUI Agents
summary: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents enable automated interactions with mobile, web, and desktop interfaces. However, their large memory footprint and repeated model calls hinder deployment on resource-constrained devices, motivating post-training quantization (PTQ) without full retraining. Quantization can degrade GUI response accuracy and distort the instruction-vision affinities and local spatial relations needed for GUI target selection. Small coordinate errors can cause missed clicks, while early action errors can alter subsequent interface states and disrupt task execution. Local reconstruction error alone does not directly assess whether these responses and relations are preserved. We propose GUI-Q, a PTQ framework that targets response and relation preservation with 4-bit weights and 16-bit activations (W4A16). Task-Sensitive Granularity Allocation (TSGA) allocates finer groups under a scale-byte budget by combining response sensitivity with the measured reduction in activation-weighted distortion. Relation-Preserving Symmetry Selection (RPSS) then selects symmetric or asymmetric grids to preserve instruction-vision affinities and local spatial relations in GUIs. Across three GUI-capable models, GUI-Q improves mean grounding TargetHit by 8.04 to 12.55 points over the strongest evaluated 4-bit configurations, while reducing static peak graphics processing unit (GPU) memory by 49.9% to 56.2% relative to bfloat16 (BF16). Fixed-output replay with packed 4-bit execution provides 1.7 to 2.8 times model-call speedups. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出 GUI-Q，一种面向 GUI 智能体的权重量化训练后量化（PTQ）框架，采用 W4A16，在保持响应与关系的前提下降低显存占用并加速推理。
AI.motivation: GUI 智能体需在资源受限设备部署，但其显存占用大、模型调用频繁。PTQ 无需全量重训练，然而量化会损害 GUI 响应精度，并扭曲目标选择所需的指令-视觉亲和性与局部空间关系；微小坐标误差导致点击失败，早期动作错误又会改变后续界面状态。仅用局部重建误差无法直接评估这些响应与关系是否被保留。
AI.method: 提出 GUI-Q 框架：TSGA（任务敏感粒度分配）在尺度字节预算下，结合响应敏感度与激活加权失真下降量，为更细粒度分组分配资源；RPSS（关系保持对称选择）选取对称或非对称量化网格，以保留指令-视觉亲和性与局部空间关系。量化配置为 4-bit 权重、16-bit 激活。
AI.result: 在三个具备 GUI 能力的模型上，GUI-Q 较最强 4-bit 配置平均 grounding TargetHit 提升 8.04–12.55 点；静态峰值 GPU 显存较 BF16 降低 49.9%–56.2%；配合打包 4-bit 执行与固定输出回放，模型调用加速 1.7–2.8 倍。
AI.conclusion: GUI-Q 表明面向响应与关系保持的任务敏感 PTQ 可有效缓解 GUI 智能体量化退化，在显著降低显存与加速推理的同时提升定位精度，代码将开源。

title: UUBench: Understanding the Unspoken toward Full-Duplex Multimodal Interaction
comment: 49 pages, 37 figures, 9 tables, including appendices. Preview version; work in progress
summary: Effective real-time, full-duplex multimodal interaction requires systems to understand not only what users say, but also the communicative needs conveyed through prosody, facial expressions, gestures, and context, and to generate audiovisual responses that appropriately address those needs. Existing evaluations offer limited insight into whether systems translate an understanding of such unspoken needs into effective responses. We introduce UUBench, a benchmark for assessing how well multimodal interactive systems Understand the Unspoken intent and address users' implicit communicative needs. The inherent subjectivity of implicit intent inference poses a key challenge for evaluation. To address this, we introduce Process-Oriented Scoring, which grounds the assessment of intent fulfillment in observable auditory and visual cues, such as prosody and gestures. Rather than relying solely on a single overall score, it evaluates how well a response addresses the communicative needs conveyed by each applicable primitive dimension. We aggregate the dimension-level scores according to each dimension's relevance to the annotated evidence. Beyond intent fulfillment, Outcome-Oriented Scoring evaluates the naturalness, appropriateness, and human-likeness of the reply itself under audio-only, visual-only, and audiovisual conditions. To make these judgments traceable to observable evidence, we propose a Fact-Grounded Scoring JEV module, which uses structured, timestamped audiovisual observations of the user and the digital human's reply to assess one dimension or criterion at a time. UUBench provides a foundation for assessing whether multimodal interactive systems respond effectively to meaning beyond literal wording, supporting progress toward context-aware, real-time, full-duplex interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出UUBench基准，用于评估多模态交互系统理解"未言明意图"（韵律、表情、手势、上下文）并做出有效回应的能力，配套过程导向评分、结果导向评分及JEV事实锚定评分模块。
AI.motivation: 实时全双工多模态交互要求系统不仅理解字面内容，还要把握韵律、面部表情、手势与语境传达的交际需求，并生成恰当的视听回应；现有评估难以判断系统是否将隐式需求的理解转化为有效回应，且隐式意图推断本身具有主观性，缺乏可观测证据支撑的评测方法。
AI.method: 构建UUBench基准；提出Process-Oriented Scoring，将意图满足度评估锚定于可观测的听觉与视觉线索（韵律、手势等），按每个原始维度分别评分，并依据各维度与标注证据的相关性加权聚合；提出Outcome-Oriented Scoring，在纯音频、纯视觉、视听三条件下评估回应的自然性、恰当性与拟人性；提出Fact-Grounded Scoring JEV模块，基于带时间戳的用户与数字人回应的结构化视听观测，逐维度/逐准则进行判定以保证可追溯性。
AI.result: 该文为基准/方法类工作，摘要未给出具体实验数字结果，主要贡献是提供了一套可将隐式意图满足判定追溯到可观测视听证据的评测框架与多维评分体系。
AI.conclusion: UUBench为评估多模态交互系统能否有效回应字面之外的意义提供了基础，推动面向上下文感知的实时全双工交互研究进展。

title: Ego2Wrist: Bootstrapping Wrist-View Synthesis from Egocentric Video
comment: 27 pages (13 main + 14 appendix), 9 figures, 20 tables. Project page: https://adonis-galaxy.github.io/Ego2Wrist/
summary: Wrist cameras provide an action-centric view that is directly relevant to robot manipulation. However, collecting human wrist-camera videos at scale is challenging due to cumbersome setups that can interfere with natural hand movements. In contrast, head-mounted human egocentric videos are much easier to scale. We introduce Ego2Wrist, which synthesizes synchronized wrist-camera views from human egocentric videos and task descriptions. Trained on approximately 940 hours of paired head- and wrist-camera recordings, Ego2Wrist jointly generates three views. To evaluate generated wrist views without ground truth, we propose hand-centric cross-view consistency (HCC), which measures consistency between generated wrist views and corresponding hand regions in the input head view. HCC ranks model checkpoints comparably to ground-truth-based LPIPS, and human evaluators prefer HCC-selected generations in 77% of responses. Evaluated on four datasets, Ego2Wrist outperforms fine-tuned WorldWander, reducing LPIPS by 28% and receiving human preference in 76% of responses. More importantly, HCC facilitates recursive self-improvement on in-the-wild egocentric videos by selecting generated wrist views for further training. Generation quality progressively improves over three rounds. These results demonstrate a scalable approach to generating real-world wrist-view human manipulation videos for robot policy training.

AI.tldr: 提出 Ego2Wrist，从人类头戴式第一视角视频合成同步的手腕视角视频，并提出无真值的 HCC 跨视角一致性指标，可用于递归自提升。
AI.motivation: 手腕相机提供与机器人操作直接相关的动作中心视角，但大规模采集人类手腕视频因设备笨重、干扰手部自然运动而困难；而头戴式第一视角视频易于规模化，故需由头视角视频合成手腕视角视频。
AI.method: Ego2Wrist 基于约940小时配对的头戴相机与手腕相机录像训练，结合任务描述联合生成三个视角；同时提出手部中心跨视角一致性指标 HCC，用于在无真值情况下评估生成的手腕视角（度量其与输入头视角中手部区域的一致性），并用于在野外第一视角视频上筛选生成样本进行递归自训练。
AI.result: HCC 的模型检查点排序效果与基于真值的 LPIPS 相当，77% 的人工评价中选择 HCC 挑选的生成结果；在四个数据集上 Ego2Wrist 优于微调的 WorldWander，LPIPS 降低 28%，获 76% 的人工偏好；在野外视频上三轮递归自提升中生成质量逐步提高。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了可扩展的真实世界手腕视角人类操作视频生成途径，可用于机器人策略训练。

title: Dynamics Forcing: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Causal Video World Models
summary: Causal video world models generate block by block from their own previous outputs. Small errors in early blocks are fed back as history and grow until the scene and the robot fall apart. Teacher forcing trains on clean ground-truth history, so the model never sees the history it will actually condition on, and it also finds a shortcut: copying the previous frame instead of predicting how the scene changes. We present Dynamics Forcing, a training scheme that keeps real video as the only supervision and reshapes how history is presented. History is perturbed in three ways: random noising, self-resampling by the model itself, and joint denoising, in which the most recent blocks are still partly noisy when the next block is predicted. On top of this we move history guidance and first-frame anchor guidance from inference into training, so that the model is pushed to use its history and its reference frame rather than ignore them. Dynamics Forcing needs no teacher model, no distillation, and no additional model at inference. Applied to a 5B video model with LoRA on 77 hours of manipulation video on a single GPU, it better matches unseen real continuations and reduces error accumulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Dynamics Forcing 训练方案，通过扰动历史、将推理期引导移入训练，缓解因果视频世界模型的误差累积与"复制上一帧"捷径，无需教师模型/蒸馏/额外推理模型。
AI.motivation: 因果视频世界模型逐块自回归生成，早期块的微小误差作为历史被反馈并放大，导致场景与机器人崩坏；同时教师强制（teacher forcing）只用干净真值历史训练，模型从未见过真实推理时的历史分布，并学会复制上一帧而非预测场景动态。
AI.method: 仅以真实视频为监督，重塑历史的呈现方式：①随机加噪；②模型自重采样（self-resampling）；③联合去噪（joint denoising），即预测下一块时最近的历史块仍部分含噪。此外把历史引导与首帧锚点引导从推理阶段移入训练。无需教师模型、蒸馏或额外推理模型。以 LoRA 在单卡、77 小时操作视频上微调 5B 视频模型。
AI.result: 在未见真实后续片段上匹配更好，并降低误差累积。
AI.conclusion: Dynamics Forcing 以轻量方式（单卡 LoRA、无额外模型）有效抑制自回归视频世界模型的曝光偏差与复制捷径，提升长程生成稳定性。

title: REACT: Response-based Expert Assembly from Contextual Trajectories
summary: Dense feed-forward networks are unaffected by how their neurons are grouped: every neuron is evaluated. Sparse execution makes this grouping consequential, because each input can access only a few experts. An arbitrary partition can therefore retain pretrained weights while separating computations that an input needs together. We argue that upcycling should organize neurons according to their responses to similar inputs. To establish this correspondence, we introduce a context-guided upcycling approach REACT, Response-based Expert Assembly from Contextual Trajectories, that uses frozen denoising trajectories to connect input contexts with pretrained neuron responses. We first identify contexts after timestep-wise centering to account for distribution shifts across noise levels, then use their associated responses to allocate intact neurons to routed experts. The same contexts initialize the corresponding router entries, aligning expert contents with their intended inputs, while global activation statistics select an always-active shared expert. Layer-wise reconstruction and end-to-end adaptation refine this initialization for sparse execution. On ImageNet-1K, our approach achieves better generation quality while activating only 37.5% of the original FFN parameters and reducing total per-token activated parameters by 27.6%.

AI.tldr: 提出REACT方法，依据神经元对相似输入的响应来组织神经元，实现上下文引导的upcycling，从而在稀疏执行下保持生成质量同时大幅降低激活参数。
AI.motivation: 稠密前馈网络对神经元分组不敏感，但稀疏执行（MoE）下每个输入只能访问少数专家，任意划分虽保留预训练权重，却会把本应一起计算的内容拆开。因此需要按神经元对相似输入的响应来组织分组。
AI.method: REACT（Response-based Expert Assembly from Contextual Trajectories）：利用冻结的去噪轨迹将输入上下文与预训练神经元响应关联；先经逐步（timestep-wise）中心化识别上下文以处理不同噪声水平的分布偏移；再用对应响应将完整神经元分配给路由专家，并用同一上下文初始化路由条目；用全局激活统计选择常驻共享专家；最后通过逐层重构与端到端适配精调。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K上，仅激活原FFN参数的37.5%，每token总激活参数减少27.6%，同时取得更优的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 基于响应的 neuron 分组可使upcycling在稀疏执行下兼顾生成质量与效率，验证了上下文-响应对应关系的有效性。

title: One Size Doesn't Fit All: Input Adaptive Class Activation Mapping for Improved Visual Explanations
summary: Despite their widespread use in tasks such as image classification, object detection and semantic segmentation, the limited interpretability of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) can undermine trust and hinder adoption in safety-critical applications. Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) methods seek to address this by providing human-understandable explanations for model predictions. Class Activation Maps (CAM) constitute one such widely used XAI technique for visualizing discriminative regions. However, existing CAM methods may exhibit limitations in channel weighting, localization, and adaptability across network architectures potentially resulting in noisy or imprecise explanations. To address these issues, we propose ADAPT-CAM, a gradient-based, parameter-adaptive CAM framework. The method combines first-order gradient energy with activation-weighted second-order curvature to derive channel contributions. It further incorporates adaptive local contrast normalization and knee-guided soft channel selection to refine the resulting explanations. Importantly, key parameters are estimated independently for each input, allowing the framework to adapt to variations in feature representations across network architectures. We validate ADAPT-CAM on ImageNet and Oxford 102 Flowers across CNN and ViT architectures. Quantitative results demonstrate competitive or superior performance against established CAM methods across multiple evaluation metrics. In parallel, qualitative comparisons illustrate its ability to highlight discriminative image regions. Further parameter analysis and ablation experiments examine the behaviour and contributions of the individual adaptive components. These findings demonstrate the applicability of ADAPT-CAM across different architectures and datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出梯度驱动的参数自适应类激活图框架ADAPT-CAM，融合一阶梯度能量与激活加权二阶曲率计算通道贡献，并引入自适应局部对比度归一化与膝点引导的软通道选择，在ImageNet与Oxford 102 Flowers上跨CNN与ViT均取得有竞争力或更优的定位与解释效果。
AI.motivation: CNN与ViT在图像分类、目标检测、语义分割中广泛使用，但可解释性不足影响信任与安全攸关场景的落地。CAM类方法虽常用，却在通道加权、定位精度及跨架构适应性上存在局限，易产生噪声大或不精确的解释。
AI.method: 提出ADAPT-CAM，一种基于梯度、参数自适应的CAM框架：(1) 结合一阶梯度能量与激活加权二阶曲率推导通道贡献；(2) 引入自适应局部对比度归一化；(3) 采用膝点（knee）引导的软通道选择精炼解释；(4) 关键参数对每个输入独立估计，以适应不同网络架构的特征表示差异。
AI.result: 在ImageNet与Oxford 102 Flowers数据集上、覆盖CNN与ViT架构进行验证，多项评价指标上表现与主流CAM方法持平或更优；定性对比显示其能有效突出判别性图像区域；参数分析与消融实验考察了各自适应组件的行为与贡献。
AI.conclusion: ADAPT-CAM在跨架构与跨数据集场景下均具备适用性，通过参数自适应机制缓解了传统CAM在通道加权与定位上的不足，提升了可解释性质量。

title: Mind the Gaps: State-Guided Supervision Allocation for Object Detection Dataset Distillation
comment: Jiehui Xie and Zhengxun Jin contributed equally. Corresponding authors: Sung-Ho Bae and Chaoning Zhang
summary: Recent advances in dataset distillation have enabled large-scale training datasets to be compressed into compact synthetic sets. However, dataset distillation for object detection remains challenging, as it requires preserving diverse classification and localization signals under limited image budgets. Existing approaches often emphasize individual-image informativeness without explicitly accounting for supervision accumulated across the distilled dataset, potentially leading to redundant supervision and uneven class-scale coverage. To address this limitation, we propose State-Guided Supervision Allocation (SGSA), a framework that formulates object detection dataset distillation as a dataset-level progressive supervision allocation problem. SGSA establishes class-scale supervision quotas and maintains a global state that tracks detector predictions accumulated from previously selected synthetic images. The remaining gaps between the target quotas and accumulated supervision guide adaptive object sampling, detector-guided canvas refinement, and marginal-gain-based candidate selection, encouraging complementary supervision across images. On MS COCO, SGSA outperforms a matched OD3 baseline by 3.73-4.06 mAP points across three image budgets (0.25%-1.0%). On PASCAL VOC, SGSA outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline by 4.53-6.90 mAP50 points across three image budgets. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of dataset-level supervision allocation guided by accumulated detector feedback under limited image budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出状态引导监督分配框架SGSA，将目标检测数据集蒸馏建模为数据集级渐进式监督分配问题，在COCO和VOC上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 目标检测数据集蒸馏需在有限图像预算下同时保留分类与定位信号；现有方法强调单图信息量，未显式考虑整个蒸馏数据集累积的监督，导致监督冗余与类别-尺度覆盖不均。
AI.method: 将检测数据蒸馏表述为数据集级渐进监督分配：设定类别-尺度监督配额，维护记录已选合成图检测器预测累积的全局状态；以目标配额与累积监督之间的剩余差距指导自适应目标采样、检测器引导的画布精炼，以及基于边际增益的候选筛选。
AI.result: MS COCO上三个图像预算（0.25%–1.0%）下较匹配的OD3基线提升3.73–4.06 mAP；PASCAL VOC三个预算下较最强基线提升4.53–6.90 mAP50。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明在有限图像预算下，以累积检测器反馈引导的数据集级监督分配是有效的。

title: CineAct: Interaction-State Agents for Playable, Branching Film Generation
summary: Open video generators such as MiniMax-H3 produce short clips of only several to a dozen seconds per run. To synthesize longer sequences, existing methods either rely on agentic systems following preset scripts, or roll out autoregressively from the previous clip's last frame, losing off-screen states and accumulating hallucinations across turns. Consequently, users still cannot take an explicit goal, choose how to accomplish it, and see that choice persist across subsequent clips. We study goal-grounded interactive video generation, where one goal admits multiple valid approaches, the user's chosen approach must be executed on screen, and its consequences must persist across clips. To this end, we propose CineAct, a state-first agentic framework in which language-model agents handle reasoning while frozen image and video generators serve purely as renderers. Before interaction, the Architect initializes the world as a spatial layout with cameras, an asset library, and a scene graph; at each turn, the system deduces the planned state change, generates a target end frame with an image generator and rigorously verifies it, and synthesizes intermediate motion with an FL2V model. We further introduce a multi-space benchmark covering two suites: long-horizon step execution and open-intent branching admissibility. Experiments show that explicit world-state modeling boosts multi-step rollout consistency over the pixel-only baseline (+11.4 automated, +23.1 human points) and raises paired branching success toward a shared goal by +30.8 points.

AI.tldr: 提出CineAct：一种"状态优先"的智能体框架，用语言模型做推理、冻结的图像/视频生成器仅作渲染器，实现目标驱动、可选择路径且在跨片段间保持一致性的交互式视频生成，并构建多空间基准验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有开放视频生成器单次仅能生成数秒至十几秒短片。延长序列的方法要么依赖按预设脚本运行的智能体系统，要么从上一片段末帧自回归滚出，导致屏幕外状态丢失、误差跨轮累积幻觉。用户因而无法给定明确目标、选择实现方式，并使该选择在后续片段中保持一致。
AI.method: 定义"目标锚定交互式视频生成"任务：一个目标存在多种可行方案，用户选定方案须在画面上执行且后果跨片段持续。据此提出CineAct：架构师（Architect）在交互前以空间布局、相机、资产库与场景图初始化世界；每轮推理计划的状态变化，用图像生成器产出目标末帧并严格校验，再由FL2V模型合成中间运动。
AI.result: 构建覆盖两套件的多空间基准：长程步骤执行与开放意图分支可采纳性。实验显示，显式世界状态建模相对纯像素基线在多步 rollout 一致性上提升 +11.4（自动）/ +23.1（人工）分，并将共享目标下的成对分支成功率提高 +30.8 分。
AI.conclusion: 显式世界状态建模优于纯像素自回归，是维持长程一致性与多方案分支可行性的关键；将生成器解耦为渲染器、以语言模型承担状态推理，可让用户的目标选择跨片段稳定延续。

title: JONES-19: A Cultural Image Dataset Based on The Grammar of Ornament
comment: 13 pages. Published in the Proceedings of the 22nd International Conference on Culture and Computer Science (KUI '25), Berlin, Germany, September 2025. Dataset available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/harvardseas-cultural-ornaments/JONES-19
summary: We introduce JONES-19, a high-quality image dataset documenting 1,901 ornament designs belonging to nineteen human cultures. The images and their annotations are based on an open access archive of The Grammar of Ornament (London, 1856), by Owen Jones. The dataset poses numerous challenges as a benchmark for computer vision classification tasks and for research at the intersection of machine learning and art and design: a small sample size, image samples of human-designed artifacts rather than common objects in-context or natural scenes, imbalanced class distribution, and image distinctions based on fine details involving line patterns, reliefs, and colors. As a design-inspired dataset, JONES-19 can serve as a benchmark for various research fields, such as visual recognition, data-efficient learning, art-historical research, architectural style analysis, and cultural heritage. This paper describes the curation of the JONES-19 dataset and reports a baseline classification benchmark that evaluates the suitability of the dataset for training classifiers and exposes insights into inter-class relationships--particularly cultural similarities--by examining patterns in misclassification errors. The dataset and its accompanying documentation are available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/harvardseas-cultural-ornaments/JONES-19.

AI.tldr: JONES-19 是一个包含1901张装饰图案、涵盖19个人类文化的高质量图像数据集，基于 Owen Jones《装饰语法》（1856）开放档案构建，并提供分类基线基准。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机视觉分类基准多基于自然场景或常见物体，缺乏面向人工设计制品、细粒度线纹/浮雕/色彩差异的研究平台；该数据集旨在为视觉识别、数据高效学习、艺术史与建筑风格分析、文化遗产等交叉研究提供具挑战性的基准。
AI.method: 从《装饰语法》开放获取档案中整理并标注1901件装饰设计，构成19个文化类别的JONES-19数据集，刻画其样本量小、非自然场景、类别分布不均衡、区分依赖细粒度细节等挑战；并构建分类基线基准，评估数据集的适用性，同时通过分析误分类错误模式揭示类间关系（尤其文化相似性）。
AI.result: 数据集完成整理与文档化并公开（Hugging Face 链接）；基线实验表明数据集可用于训练分类器，且误分类模式能反映类间与文化间的相似关系。
AI.conclusion: JONES-19 可作为视觉识别、数据高效学习、艺术史研究、建筑风格分析与文化遗产等多领域的设计启发型基准数据集。

title: VeriOrigin: A Proactive Image Protection Framework for Provenance, Tamper Localization, and Lossless Recovery
summary: Versatile watermarking, which seamlessly integrates provenance and tamper detection, has recently attracted widespread attention. In this paper, we propose \textbf{VeriOrigin}, a comprehensive and unified image protection framework that not only robustly achieves provenance and highly precise tamper localization under various complex distortions, but also guarantees perfect recovery of the original cover in lossless channels. To realize this framework, we depart from conventional flow based architectures. Instead, we design \textbf{XOnet}, a CNN based invertible encoder. XOnet comprises two standard CNN based watermarking sub networks, Xnet and Onet, which achieve reversibility through cross residual prediction. Based on XOnet, we train the proactive protection scheme via a two stage strategy: first optimizing the watermarking branch, followed by the tamper localization branch. During inference, the cover image undergoes sequential watermarking and tamper residual embedding. Extensive experimental results on four datasets demonstrate that VeriOrigin achieves precise tamper localization and strong robustness, while guaranteeing lossless cover recovery for integrity authentication. Project page is available at https://veriorigin.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出VeriOrigin统一图像保护框架，基于CNN可逆编码器XOnet实现溯源水印、精准篡改定位与无损原图恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有"通用水印"难以同时兼顾多失真下的鲁棒溯源、高精度篡改定位与无损信道下的原图完美恢复，且传统架构多依赖可逆流（flow）模型。
AI.method: 设计XOnet——基于CNN的可逆编码器，由两个标准CNN水印子网络Xnet与Onet构成，通过交叉残差预测实现可逆性；基于XOnet采用两阶段训练策略，先优化水印分支再优化篡改定位分支；推理时对载体图像依次进行水印嵌入与篡改残差嵌入。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上的实验表明，VeriOrigin实现精准篡改定位与强鲁棒性，同时保证用于完整性认证的无损载体恢复。
AI.conclusion: VeriOrigin为集溯源与篡改检测于一体的综合性统一图像保护框架，验证了以CNN可逆网络替代流式架构的可行性与优越性。

title: GeoRead3D: Grounding Part Descriptions for 3D Pointing and Reorientation
summary: Language often refers to an object by its parts, as in asking to point to a part or to turn an arbitrarily posed object so that two named parts lie in given directions. Both tasks need the direction from the object's center to the part's center, not the part's own orientation. A natural approach segments the part and takes the centroid of its mask. However, high mask overlap predicts the pointing direction poorly when a part is spread out relative to its distance from the object center. Language-guided part segmentation is trained and evaluated by mask overlap, which leaves a gap between the masks it produces and the part geometry that these tasks use. We close this gap by learning point evidence, weights over the observed points whose weighted centroid gives the part's location. Geometric Readout Supervision (GRS) trains these weights through the centroid's position and adds direction supervision on the parts used in reorientation commands. GRS improves both tasks even with a single frozen encoder and a single input pose. We implement this supervision in GeoRead3D, a system for pointing and reorientation from part descriptions. A language model maps each description to a known part name. Dual-Route Part Evidence combines refined segmentation evidence with directly predicted point evidence to locate each part. On PartNeXt and Artiverse, GeoRead3D points within $22.5^\circ$ for 74.1% and 60.0% of queries, 5.8 and 7.3 percentage points above the strongest baselines. Its reorientation success exceeds the strongest baselines by 10.4 and 7.8 points.

AI.tldr: 论文提出几何读出监督（GRS）：通过在学习到的观测点权重上取加权质心以定位部件，并以质心位置与方向监督训练这些权重，从而弥合"掩码重叠"训练目标与"部件几何"任务需求之间的差距；实现系统GeoRead3D完成指认与重定向任务。
AI.motivation: 语言常以部件指称物体（如指向某部件、或旋转任意姿态物体使两个命名部件处于给定方向），这两类任务都需要从物体中心指向部件中心的方向，而非部件自身朝向。分割方法的掩码重叠指标高并不保证指向方向准确，尤其当部件相对其与物体中心距离较为分散时；而语言引导的部件分割又以掩码重叠为训练与评估目标，导致掩码与任务实际使用的部件几何之间存在鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出几何读出监督（GRS）：学习观测点上的证据权重，其加权质心给出部件位置；通过质心位置对权重施加监督，并对重定向指令涉及的部件额外加入方向监督。在GeoRead3D系统中实现：用语言模型将描述映射为已知部件名；Dual-Route Part Evidence将精化后的分割证据与直接预测的点证据结合以定位部件。仅使用单一冻结编码器与单一输入视角。
AI.result: 在PartNeXt与Artiverse上，GeoRead3D分别对74.1%与60.0%的查询指向误差在22.5°以内，比最强基线高5.8与7.3个百分点；重定向成功率分别比最强基线高10.4与7.8个百分点。即使使用单一冻结编码器与单一输入姿态，GRS仍同时提升两类任务。
AI.conclusion: 以几何读出（加权质心）替代掩码重叠作为监督信号，可有效对齐训练目标与下游几何任务需求，显著提升语言引导的部件指认与物体重定向性能。

title: Inclusion of obstacles in ground point classification in ALS data for terrain models used for analysis of vehicle traversability
summary: Classification of ALS point clouds has been studied for decades, but it remains challenging in forest contexts due to the great variety of terrain types, sensor equipment, flight parameters, and resulting point densities. Point cloud density has increased significantly in recent years, and existing algorithms, developed for lower density point clouds, may no longer be effective. It is beyond the scope of most existing algorithms to classify obstacles, such as boulders, while also distinguishing non-obstacles, such as bushes and undergrowth. We evaluate the performance of different algorithms for ground point classification in ALS data in a context where obstacles are included in the ground class, resulting in terrain models useful for offroad machinery route planning and navigation. The evaluation is performed using metrics directly on the point clouds (Precision, Recall, $F_1$-score) and on resulting terrain models (RMSE and maps of differences). The results show that there are several algorithms that perform well, but performance is highly affected by the parameters used. The best results in terms of terrain model RMSE are obtained with the CSF-algorithm, with an average RMSE of 0.08 meters. The results indicate that existing algorithms can be adapted to include obstacles in the ground class under the tested conditions.

AI.tldr: 在森林场景ALS点云中，评估多种地面点分类算法（将障碍物归入地面类）的性能，发现CSF算法地形模型RMSE最优（平均0.08 m），但性能高度依赖参数设置。
AI.motivation: 森林环境下ALS点云分类因地形类型、传感器、飞行参数及点密度差异大而困难；近年点密度显著提高，为低密度点云设计的算法可能失效；且多数算法无法在区分灌木、下层植被等非障碍物的同时识别巨石等障碍物。目标是获得可用于越野机械路径规划与导航的地形模型。
AI.method: 将障碍物纳入地面类，评估多种ALS地面点分类算法；评价指标包括直接在点云上的Precision、Recall、F1-score，以及基于生成地形模型的RMSE与差异图。
AI.result: 多种算法表现良好，但性能受参数影响显著；地形模型RMSE最优为CSF算法，平均RMSE为0.08 m。结果表明现有算法在测试条件下可经调整后将障碍物纳入地面类。
AI.conclusion: 现有地面分类算法可通过参数调整适应含障碍物的地面类定义，CSF为最优选择，但参数敏感性仍是关键问题。

title: LiveMirror: Real-Time Diffusion Virtual Try-On on a Consumer GPU and Its Self-Supervised Adaptation to Indian Ethnic Wear
summary: Diffusion virtual try-on (VTO) models produce convincing garment transfers from a single product photograph, but at hundreds of milliseconds to seconds per image every deployment today is offline or falls back to AR mirrors that need a rigged 3D asset per product. We present LiveMirror, a live-camera try-on mirror that renders a flat garment photograph onto a moving person with a diffusion model on one 16 GB consumer GPU. Its core is asynchronous keyframe try-on: generation never blocks the display, every displayed frame is an optical-flow warp of the latest generated keyframe, and keyframes are replaced only through a cross-fade. The display runs at camera rate (25 FPS at 720p) while a new try-on arrives every 370-490 ms; we measure the residual flicker, give a stage-by-stage latency budget, and report which accelerations (step count, consistency LoRA, tiny decoder, compilation) keep garment prints intact. We then show that the same GPU fixes the model's biggest cultural blind spot: try-on models trained on VITON-HD and DressCode render a knee-length kurta or sherwani as a torso-length top or a dress over bare legs. A thigh-covering mask, self-supervised pairs built automatically from 24.9k on-model e-commerce photographs, and 3.2 GPU-hours of attention-only fine-tuning of CatVTON halve the perceptual error on ethnic wear (LPIPS 0.137 to 0.077 on IndoFashion, 0.135 to 0.073 on Atlas; 200 held-out pairs per source) with no regression on Western tops. A two-pass hem-aware mask then removes the remaining failure, recoloured trousers below the hem, on all but 3-4% of pairs at no training cost; in the mirror the hem comes from the previous keyframe for free. The adapted model beats FASHN VTON 1.5 on every aggregate ethnic-wear metric at about $20\times$ lower inference cost, and its weights drop straight into the mirror.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LiveMirror：在单张 16 GB 消费级 GPU 上用扩散模型实现实时摄像头虚拟试穿，核心是"异步关键帧试穿"——生成不阻塞显示，每帧显示由光流把最新关键帧扭曲到当前姿态，关键帧仅通过交叉淡入替换；显示达 720p/25 FPS，新关键帧每 370–490 ms 到达。作者同时用 3.2 GPU 小时的注意力层微调 + 大腿覆盖掩码修正了族裔服饰（kurta/sherwani）被误渲染的偏差，LPIPS 减半，并进一步用两遍下摆感知掩码消除裤装被重着色问题。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散试穿模型质量好但速度慢（数百毫秒到数秒/张），只能离线运行或退化为需要每款产品配 3D 绑定的 AR 镜；同时 VITON-HD/DressCode 训练的模型存在文化盲点，会把及膝 kurta 或 sherwani 渲染成短上衣或裸露双腿的连衣裙。
AI.method: 1) 异步关键帧试穿：显示端不做生成，用光流将最新关键帧 warp 到当前帧，关键帧交叉淡入替换，兼容帧率；2) 给出分阶段延迟预算，并评测步数蒸馏、一致性 LoRA、微型解码器、编译等加速对印花保真度的影响；3) 数据侧用 24.9k 带模特电商图自动构建自监督成对数据，设计大腿覆盖掩码，对 CatVTON 仅做注意力层微调 3.2 GPU 小时；4) 两遍下摆感知掩码，将下摆以下裤装从重着色中剔除，镜像中下摆可直接复用上一关键帧。
AI.result: 显示 720p/25 FPS，关键帧更新周期 370–490 ms；族裔服饰 LPIPS 由 0.137→0.077（IndoFashion）、0.135→0.073（Atlas，每源 200 对留出集），西式上衣无退化；下摆感知掩码使除 3–4% 外全部样本消除裤装重着色且零训练开销；聚合族裔服饰指标全面优于 FASHN VTON 1.5，推理成本低约 20×，权重可直接嵌入镜像。
AI.conclusion: 生成与显示解耦的异步关键帧范式可用单张消费卡实现实时试穿镜，且同一算力预算下能低成本修正数据集导致的文化偏差；模型改进与实时系统互为闭环，适配权重可直接部署到 LiveMirror。

title: Decompose and Describe: Narrowing the Diagnosis-to-Report Gap in 3D CT Report Generation
