summary: Automated 3D CT report generation could support radiology workflows, yet medical vision-language models (MedVLMs) often omit diagnostic findings from generated reports. We ask whether the diagnostic ability of these models carries over to free-form reporting. Across five MedVLMs, diagnostic VQA achieves higher macro-F1 than reports generated from the same CT studies and evaluated on the same disease categories. We call this task-dependent discrepancy the diagnosis-to-report gap. Conventional Report Adaptation improves reporting for most models but does not close the gap. To investigate and narrow it, we introduce DeCAD (Decompose CT Analysis and Describe), which progressively decomposes CT report generation at diagnostic, regional textual, and regional visual levels. The model identifies positive findings before writing a report, organizes diagnosis and description into regional tasks, and restricts each task to visual tokens from the corresponding region. Diagnostic and regional textual decomposition improve report-level diagnostic performance across the five MedVLMs, whereas regional visual decomposition provides limited additional gains. In a standard VLM without medical VQA pretraining, the first two levels remain effective; regional visual decomposition also provides further gains with a region-level contrastively pretrained encoder. Full DeCAD achieves state-of-the-art performance on CT-RATE and Merlin. Analyses show greater CT-token attention during diagnosis and higher recall of reference-positive findings in both the diagnostic output and final report than with Report Adaptation. These results show that explicitly organizing diagnosis improves diagnostic reporting and helps narrow the diagnosis-to-report gap.

AI.tldr: MedVLM在诊断VQA上表现优于其生成的CT报告（"诊断-报告差距"）；提出DeCAD，按诊断级、区域文本级、区域视觉级逐步分解CT报告生成，在CT-RATE和Merlin上达到SOTA并缩小该差距。
AI.motivation: 自动3D CT报告生成可支持影像工作流，但MedVLM生成的报告常遗漏诊断发现。作者追问：模型的诊断能力是否能迁移到自由形式报告生成？实验发现在相同CT及疾病类别上，诊断VQA的macro-F1一致高于报告生成，作者将此任务依赖的差异命名为diagnosis-to-report gap，并旨在研究并缩小它。
AI.method: 提出DeCAD（Decompose CT Analysis and Describe），将CT报告生成在三个层级逐步分解：（1）诊断级——写报告前先识别阳性发现；（2）区域文本级——将诊断与描述组织为区域性子任务；（3）区域视觉级——每个子任务仅使用对应区域的视觉token。对比基线为常规Report Adaptation。在五个MedVLM及一个无医学VQA预训练的通用VLM上验证，并测试区域级对比预训练编码器的作用。
AI.result: 五个MedVLM上，诊断级与区域文本级分解均提升报告级诊断性能，区域视觉级分解增益有限；通用VLM上前两级仍有效，且配合区域级对比预训练编码器时区域视觉分解带来额外增益。完整DeCAD在CT-RATE与Merlin上取得SOTA。分析显示：诊断阶段CT token注意力更强，诊断输出与最终报告中对参考阳性发现的召回率均高于Report Adaptation。
AI.conclusion: 显式组织诊断过程可提升诊断性报告质量并有助于缩小diagnosis-to-report差距；分解的收益具有层级依赖性与模型依赖性。

title: SWAM: State-aware World Action Model for Multi-Agent 3D Environments
summary: Interactive world models generate virtual environments autoregressively from player actions and visual history. However, visual history alone cannot reliably capture the evolving states of independently acting non-player characters (NPCs) in real games, particularly when they are outside the camera view. Recent multi-agent world models address this challenge through joint multi-view generation or persistent shared state, but often rely on external observations, like maps or scene geometry, or predefined state transitions. We present SWAM, a State-aware World Action Model that separates agent-state evolution from autoregressive visual generation in interactive 3D environments. A lightweight state model propagates character dynamics from actions without consuming generated frames, combining motion priors with learned scene-dependent corrections. The predicted states then guide an autoregressive diffusion transformer alongside visual history through a novel conditioning scheme. Rather than requiring an explicit scene geometry map or visibility tests, the conditioning indicates where characters may appear, allowing the diffusion model to learn their appearance and occlusion. This design enables NPCs to evolve independently of visual generation while maintaining consistent observations across visibility changes, interactions, and respawns. Evaluations in a custom Godot-based first-person shooter game demonstrate improvements in visual fidelity, NPC consistency, and long-horizon stability over existing approaches.

AI.tldr: SWAM将NPC状态演化与自回归视觉生成解耦：轻量状态模型仅由动作传播角色动力学，预测状态再通过新式条件注入自回归扩散Transformer，实现视野外NPC的一致演化。
AI.motivation: 仅凭视觉历史难以可靠刻画独立行动的NPC状态，尤其当其处于相机视野外；现有视频式多智能体世界模型依赖地图、场景几何等外部观测或预定义状态转移。
AI.method: 提出状态感知世界动作模型SWAM。轻量状态模型不消耗生成帧，仅从动作传播角色动力学，融合运动先验与学习的场景相关校正；预测状态经新式条件方案与视觉历史一同引导自回归扩散Transformer。条件编码指示角色可能出现的位置，无需显式场景几何图或可见性测试，由扩散模型自行学习外观与遮挡。
AI.result: 在自建Godot第一人称射击游戏上评估，相较现有方法在视觉保真度、NPC一致性与长时程稳定性上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 将智能体状态演化与视觉生成分离，可使NPC独立于视觉生成而演化，并在可见性变化、交互与重生过程中保持一致观测，为交互式3D世界模型提供了有效范式。

title: World Models as Native Latent Action Models
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://pawteam-eai.github.io/native-lam/
summary: Large and diverse video sources, such as egocentric human video and heterogeneous robot recordings, carry rich dynamics but come either without actions or without a shared action space. Latent action models (LAMs) can recover these dynamics, but they train their inverse- and forward-dynamics models (IDM, FDM) from scratch, trading off pixel reconstruction against latent capacity and accuracy. Pretrained video world models natively generate high-fidelity dynamics, yet represent them densely, entangled across all layers. Viewing the world model as a LAM, we show that these dynamics can be extracted with minimal changes to the model. Native LAM operates one pretrained video diffusion transformer as both IDM and FDM, with learnable dynamics registers as the only causal bridge between the two, and trains on counterfactual temporal pairs that differ in motion alone, so that the registers distill a video's dynamics into a compact native latent action. We further propose a pretraining paradigm for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, Pretraining Actions from World models (PAWlicy), in which Native LAM serves as a dynamics teacher on large-scale video; unlike world action models, it never generates video. Native latent actions outperform existing LAMs on the LARY benchmark in both action classification and control regression, and replay the same motion on new robots, in new scenes, and from human hands to robots, although no transfer objective is used in training. With a 3.8B model, PAWlicy reaches a 93.6% average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 trained with domain-randomized demonstrations, the highest among VLAs. On RoboDojo, it is competitive on every dimension we evaluate, and its Precision, evaluated by us, is on par with the leading leaderboard entries. On real robots, it improves over the pi_0.5 baseline on both tasks. Both stages use only public data and a publicly released world model.

AI.tldr: 提出 Native LAM：将预训练视频扩散 Transformer 同时作为逆动力学模型（IDM）与正动力学模型（FDM），仅有可学习 dynamics registers 作为因果桥梁，在"仅运动不同"的反事实时序对上训练，从而把视频动态蒸馏为紧凑潜动作；并据此提出 VLA 预训练范式 PAWlicy。
AI.motivation: 大规模异构视频（第一视角人类视频、异构机器人数据）蕴含丰富动态，但或缺动作标注、或缺乏共享动作空间。已有潜动作模型（LAM）从零训练 IDM/FDM，需在像素重建、潜空间容量与精度间权衡；而预训练视频世界模型虽能生成高保真动态，却以稠密、跨层纠缠的方式表示。
AI.method: 把世界模型视作 LAM，以最小改动提取其动态：单一预训练视频扩散 Transformer 兼任 IDM 与 FDM，learnable dynamics registers 为二者唯一因果通道；训练数据为仅在运动上不同的反事实时序对，使 registers 将动态蒸馏为紧凑 native latent action。第二阶段 PAWlicy 将 Native LAM 作为大规模视频上的动态教师来预训练 VLA 策略，且不生成视频。
AI.result: 在 LARY 基准上，潜动作在动作分类与控制回归上均优于现有 LAM；在无任何迁移目标训练的情况下，可在新机器人、新场景中重放同一运动，并实现人手到机器人的迁移。3.8B 模型在 RoboTwin 2.0（域随机化示范训练）上平均成功率 93.6%，为 VLA 中最高；RoboDojo 上各项指标具竞争力，Precision 与榜首条目相当；真实机器人上两项任务均优于 pi_0.5 基线。两阶段仅使用公开数据与公开世界模型。
AI.conclusion: 预训练视频世界模型的动态可经极少改动高效抽取为紧凑潜动作表示，并可作为 VLA 策略预训练的动态教师，在仿真与真实机器人上取得领先或具竞争力的表现，且无需视频生成与专用迁移目标。

title: Speak When You See It: Proactive Task Assistants Should Wait for Evidence, Not the Clock
summary: Proactive assistants that guide people through physical tasks must decide, every few seconds, whether a step is complete and whether a mistake has occurred. We find that two benchmarks for this task largely reward knowing when rather than seeing what: a timer that never looks at the video, raising an alarm at 25 s and confirming each step at 30 s, reaches a mistake F1 of 0.373 on Ego-MC-Bench, above every published result (at most 0.27). We formalize this as the video-blind frontier, the best trade-off between completion accuracy and mistake F1 that policies reach from the elapsed time, the instruction and training statistics alone: every published per-step result on Ego-MC-Bench lies inside it, and so do all twelve zero-shot models we run on QICD. To move beyond it, we introduce Evidence-Contrastive Training (ECT): fine-tune on the benchmark's own questions, and pair its positives with negatives from the same recording at the same elapsed time, so that elapsed time cannot separate the two sides of a pair. Trained on 209 QICD videos in about 15 GPU-hours, a 2B model with ECT crosses the frontier on both benchmarks in all four seeds; transferred to Ego-MC-Bench without adaptation, it confirms 59% of mistake-free steps in time, against 30% for a published model with the same backbone trained on about 25k synthetic counterfactuals and real recordings. Its decisions follow the video beyond what timing explains: at equal elapsed time it tells a finished step from an unfinished one in 90-92% of test pairs, where the instruction's typical duration reaches 65%, rescaling the time stamps between the frames leaves it essentially unchanged, and swapping in another recording, of the same recipe where one exists, cuts its completion accuracy by two thirds. The code and model weights will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 论文指出Ego-MC-Bench与QICD两个基准上的"步骤完成/错误检测"任务主要奖励"知道何时"而非"看见什么"，提出video-blind frontier刻画仅凭时间/指令/统计能达到的性能上界，并提出Evidence-Contrastive Training (ECT)使模型真正依赖视频证据。
AI.motivation: 主动式助手需每隔数秒判断步骤是否完成、是否出错。作者发现现有基准的评测设计存在捷径：定时器完全不看视频（25秒报警、30秒确认每步）即可在Ego-MC-Bench取得0.373的错误F1，超过所有已发表结果（≤0.27）。因此需要形式化这种"视频盲"上界，并提出真正依赖视觉信息的训练方法。
AI.method: 1) 形式化video-blind frontier：由已过时间、指令和训练统计量所得完成准确率与错误F1的最优权衡边界；2) 提出Evidence-Contrastive Training (ECT)：在基准自身问题上微调，并将正样本与同一录像、同一已过时间处的负样本配对，使时间无法区分正负；3) 在209个QICD视频上训练约15 GPU小时，用2B模型在4个随机种子上验证；4) 迁移至Ego-MC-Bench（无适配），并进行时间戳重缩放、等时配对判别、跨录像替换等消融/诊断实验。
AI.result: 所有已发表的Ego-MC-Bench逐步结果及12个在QICD上零样本运行的模型均落在该边界内。带ECT的2B模型在4个种子上于两个基准均突破frontier；零适配迁移到Ego-MC-Bench时，及时确认59%的无错步骤（同骨干、用约25k合成反事实与真实录像训练的已发表模型仅30%）。等已过时间条件下，判别完成/未完成步骤的配对准确率达90-92%（指令典型时长基线为65%）；时间戳重缩放后结果基本不变；换成同配方另一录像后完成准确率下降约三分之二。
AI.conclusion: 现有基准的逐步骤指标可被"计时器"捷径大幅满足，需以video-blind frontier作为对照基线评估方法真实视觉理解能力；ECT通过时间对齐的对比负样本有效突破该边界，且模型决策确实基于视频而非时间先验。代码与模型权重将公开。

title: PestWeave: Linking Semantic Modeling and Evidence-Guided Text Modulation through Visual Prototypes for Fine-Grained Pest Learning
summary: Agricultural pests threaten crop yield and quality, making accurate pest recognition essential for targeted management and sustainable agriculture. Their diverse appearances complicate recognition and motivate multimodal approaches incorporating complementary species knowledge from text. However, complex backgrounds can obscure discriminative visual cues, while textual descriptions may contain information unsupported by the current image, limiting effective cross-modal fusion. To address these challenges, we propose PestWeave, a multimodal framework connecting content-adaptive visual organization with text fusion through visual prototypes. Its visual pathway augments a Receptance Weighted Key Value (RWKV) architecture with semantic token grouping and three types of auxiliary tokens, enabling content-adaptive scanning and contextual modeling while preserving spatial structure. Feature-similar tokens are reordered into adjacent scanning positions, while cluster prototype, global, and register tokens provide group-level summaries, global context, and additional interaction capacity, respectively. These prototypes also guide text modulation by assessing visual support for semantic components and regulating their relative contributions and overall fusion strength, reducing interference from unsupported descriptions. Extensive experiments on multiple pest recognition datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of PestWeave and its potential for practical pest management.

AI.tldr: 提出PestWeave多模态害虫识别框架，通过视觉原型连接内容自适应视觉组织与文本融合，缓解复杂背景与文本-图像不一致问题。
AI.motivation: 农业害虫外观多样，需结合文本物种知识进行多模态识别；但复杂背景会遮蔽判别性视觉线索，且文本描述可能包含当前图像不支持的信息，导致跨模态融合失效。
AI.method: 视觉通路在RWKV架构上引入语义token分组与三类辅助token（聚类原型token、全局token、寄存器token）：将特征相似的token重排至相邻扫描位置以实现内容自适应扫描并保留空间结构，辅助token分别提供组级摘要、全局上下文和额外交互容量；这些原型进一步用于引导文本调制，评估视觉对语义成分的支持度并调节其相对贡献与整体融合强度。
AI.result: 在多个害虫识别数据集上的大量实验验证了PestWeave的有效性，并显示其在实际害虫管理中的应用潜力。
AI.conclusion: 以视觉原型为枢纽的内容自适应视觉组织与受控文本融合可有效提升害虫识别的多模态鲁棒性，具备实用价值。

title: Speculate in the Right Order: Efficient Self-Speculative Decoding for Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: Self-speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive image generation by leveraging the same model for parallel drafting and sequential verification, without requiring an additional draft model. While existing methods primarily focus on improving drafting and verification strategies, recent advances in random-order autoregressive modeling introduce an additional degree of freedom: the generation order. In this work, we theoretically analyze how generation order affects self-speculative decoding efficiency, identifying two key factors: draft-target mismatch, which determines token rejection probabilities, and early-rejection cost, which reflects the higher cost of rejecting tokens earlier in a speculative round. Motivated by these insights, we propose Speculation-Aware Ordering (SAO), a training-free framework for offline optimization of generation orders. Instead of evaluating candidate orders through costly speculative decoding, SAO uses simple pairwise conditional-TV statistics to formulate a rejection-cost-aware objective and efficiently construct speculation-friendly generation orders offline. Extensive experiments across different backbones and speculative widths demonstrate that SAO improves decoding efficiency, with the additional benefit of improved generation quality. Furthermore, SAO provides complementary efficiency gains when combined with existing self-speculative decoding methods. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to identify generation order as a new optimization dimension for efficient self-speculative decoding in autoregressive image generation.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将生成顺序（generation order）识别为自推测解码效率的新优化维度，提出免训练框架SAO，通过成对条件TV统计构建顾及拒绝代价的目标，离线构造对推测友好的生成顺序，在提升解码效率的同时改善生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有自推测解码研究主要聚焦于改进草稿（drafting）与验证（verification）策略，而随机顺序自回归建模引入的生成顺序这一额外自由度尚未被利用。理论上，生成顺序会影响草稿-目标不匹配（决定token拒绝概率）与早期拒绝代价（一轮推测中越早拒绝成本越高），因此可作为新的效率优化维度。
AI.method: 提出Speculation-Aware Ordering（SAO），一个免训练的离线生成顺序优化框架。它不通过昂贵的推测解码来评估候选顺序，而是利用简单的成对条件TV（total variation）统计，构建拒绝代价感知的目标函数，从而高效地离线构造对推测友好的生成顺序。
AI.result: 在不同骨干网络与推测宽度上的大量实验表明，SAO提升了自回归图像生成的解码效率，并附带改善生成质量；与现有自推测解码方法结合时还能带来互补的效率增益。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个将生成顺序确立为自回归图像生成中高效自推测解码新优化维度的工作，为无需额外草稿模型的高效解码提供了新的研究方向。

title: SPROUT: Predicting Objective-Grounded Prompt Utility for Efficient Text-to-Image Preference Tuning
summary: Preference tuning of text-to-image diffusion models spends most of its compute generating candidate images, yet training prompts are typically sampled uniformly at random, wasting compute generating images that provide too little signal for model alignment. To best utilize the available compute, we study prompt selection, where at each iteration we identify the most useful prompts for preference tuning. We separate prompt selection into a utility score, an estimator of that utility score, and batch selection. Within this framework, we propose Selection by PRedicting Objective-grounded UTility (SPROUT). The utility score is predicted on every prompt in the pool, including unseen prompts, by a text-only model, refit after every iteration on all utilities observed so far. A randomized acceptance rule then turns these predictions into a batch, so no images are generated beyond those used for training. For direct group preference optimization (DGPO), the objective-grounded utility is the norm of the gradient that the objective produces from a prompt's group of images. Fine-tuning Stable Diffusion 1.5 with DGPO on GenEval, SPROUT matches the final score of uniform sampling in about 44% of the iterations and improves the area under the learning curve with respect to both uniform sampling and CGPO, a recent variance-based prompt sampler. The efficiency gains hold under four held-out reward models never used in training, and the ranking of methods carries over to DPG-Bench and T2I-CompBench++. Our code is available at https://github.com/ADDAPT-ML/SPROUT.

AI.tldr: 提出SPROUT提示词选择方法，通过预测目标grounded效用并随机接受规则构建批次，在DGPO偏好微调中显著提升计算效率。
AI.motivation: 偏好微调text-to-image扩散模型的计算主要消耗在生成候选图像上，但训练提示词通常均匀随机采样，导致大量计算浪费在提供对齐信号过弱的提示词上，因此需要最优利用计算资源的提示词选择策略。
AI.method: 将提示词选择分解为效用分数、效用估计器和批次选择三部分，提出SPROUT：用纯文本模型对提示词池中所有提示词（含未见提示词）预测效用，每轮迭代后基于已观测效用重新拟合；再用随机接受规则将预测转为批次，避免额外生成图像。对DGPO，目标grounded效用定义为目标函数由提示词图像组产生的梯度范数。
AI.result: 在GenEval上用DGPO微调Stable Diffusion 1.5，SPROUT约用44%的迭代次数达到均匀采样的最终分数，并相比均匀采样和基于方差的CGPO提升学习曲线下面积；效率增益在四个未参与训练的留出奖励模型下成立，方法排序也在DPG-Bench和T2I-CompBench++上保持。
AI.conclusion: 通过预测目标grounded效用的提示词选择可显著减少偏好调优所需迭代与图像生成，实现更高效且跨奖励模型、跨基准稳健的模型对齐。

title: Leakage-Safe Auditing of Attribution-Driven Data Curation in Medical Imaging
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the Findings Track of the Machine Learning for Health (ML4H) Symposium 2026
summary: When can an attribution-derived anomaly justify changing a medical-imaging training set? We formulate attribution-driven curation as three separately testable claims: anomaly detection, harmfulness estimation, and intervention utility. We test the first and third using a patient-disjoint, identifier-preserving audit of a 3D convolutional classifier for computed tomography angiography aneurysm candidates. We identify 232 exactly zero-valued arrays among 1,201 positive patches, including 170 training positives, and invalidate a historical 321-patch attention-failure subgroup whose identifier-free records were joined to files by position. On the held-out test set, GradCAM++ spatial concentration is central for every candidate class, reversing the historical pattern. GradCAM++ and Integrated Gradients show negative rank-order agreement for positives, limiting method-independent anatomical interpretation. Across five paired training seeds, removing the 170 corrupted training positives yields AUC 0.9617 +/- 0.0044 versus 0.9652 +/- 0.0039 for full-data training (difference -0.0035; 95% CI -0.0082 to 0.0007). Excluding 34 raw-zero test positives widens rather than closes the gap, countering a blank-memorization explanation. Budget-matched random-removal controls suggest the result is not simply an effect of reducing training size. Input corruption does not necessarily imply that deletion improves generalization. Our framework makes leakage control, sample identity, and intervention testing explicit in attribution-driven medical-imaging data curation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将"归因驱动的数据策展"拆解为异常检测、危害性估计与干预效用三个可独立检验的命题，并对 3D CTA 动脉瘤分类器做患者不相交、保留标识的审计，发现删除 170 个全零训练正样本并未提升泛化（AUC 0.9617 vs 0.9652），说明输入损坏不等价于删除有益。
AI.motivation: 归因方法常被用来发现"异常样本"并据此修改训练集，但从"检测到异常"到"删除有益于泛化"之间存在未被验证的跳跃；作者希望把这一链条显式化、可检验化，并检验历史性结论（如某注意力失败子群）是否可靠。
AI.method: 以 3D 卷积分类器（CTA 动脉瘤候选）为对象，构建患者不相交、保留样本标识的审计流程；在 1,201 个正样本 patch 中识别 232 个精确全零数组（含 170 个训练正样本）；复核历史上 321 个 patch 的"注意力失败"子群（其无标识记录按位置与文件连接）；对比 GradCAM++ 与 Integrated Gradients 的空间集中度与排序一致性；用 5 个配对训练种子做删除 170 个损坏正样本的干预实验，并配合排除 34 个原始全零测试正样本、训练预算匹配的随机删除对照。
AI.result: 删除 170 个损坏训练正样本得 AUC 0.9617±0.0044，全量训练为 0.9652±0.0039（差值 -0.0035，95% CI -0.0082~0.0007）；排除 34 个原始全零测试正样本反而扩大而非缩小差距，否定"记忆空白图"解释；预算匹配随机删除对照表明结果并非仅由训练集规模减小所致。GradCAM++ 空间集中度对所有候选类别均位于中心区域，与历史模式相反；与 IG 在正样本上呈负的排序一致性，限制了解剖学解释的方法独立性；历史注意力失败子群被证伪。
AI.conclusion: 输入损坏并不必然意味着删除能改善泛化；归因驱动的医学影像数据策展必须显式包含泄漏控制、样本身份核验与干预实验验证。

title: CTLink: A Text-Prompted Segmentation Model for Linking Radiology Report Findings to 3D Chest CT Scans
summary: Radiology reports describe findings in text only, without visually marking them on the scan, so readers cannot directly see which abnormality each reported finding refers to. We introduce CTLink, a text-prompted 3D segmentation model that segments findings described in a chest CT report. CTLink was trained on 4123 noncontrast chest CT scans with 9547 segmented report findings, including ReXGroundingCTv2, a newly annotated dataset of 1134 scans and 1895 findings with every instance of each finding segmented. On the 200 ReXGroundingCT validation scans, CTLink achieved a hit rate of 0.816, an instance F1 score of 0.456, and a mean Dice score of 0.400, compared with 0.533, 0.175, and 0.234 for VoxTell, a publicly available text-prompted segmentation model (P < .001 for all). On the test set of the MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding challenge, an ensemble of seven CTLink models achieved the highest hit rate (0.782) and instance F1 score (0.386) of all 48 participating teams. On 50 test scans segmented twice by independent radiologists, CTLink matched or exceeded inter-rater agreement. Diffuse non-focal findings remained the main limitation, partly because their extent is outlined inconsistently even between radiologists. The CTLink model weights are available at https://huggingface.co/rajpurkarlab/CTLink, and the dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/rajpurkarlab/ReXGroundingCT.

AI.tldr: CTLink 是一个文本提示驱动的 3D 分割模型，可将胸部 CT 报告中的发现定位并分割到扫描图像上；其在 ReXGroundingCT 验证集和 MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding 挑战赛上显著优于基线 VoxTell 并获得最佳成绩，对弥漫性非局灶病变仍存在局限。
AI.motivation: 放射学报告仅以文本描述发现，未在影像上做视觉标记，读者无法直接看出每条发现对应的异常区域，缺乏报告文本与图像病灶间的显式对应。
AI.method: 提出 CTLink，文本提示驱动的 3D 分割模型，用于分割胸部 CT 报告中描述的发现。训练于 4123 例平扫胸部 CT、9547 个已分割报告发现，含新标注数据集 ReXGroundingCTv2（1134 例扫描、1895 个发现，每个发现的每个实例均被分割）。评估采用 hit rate、instance F1 与平均 Dice，并与公开模型 VoxTell 比较；挑战赛中使用 7 模型集成。
AI.result: 200 例 ReXGroundingCT 验证扫描上，CTLink 的 hit rate 0.816、instance F1 0.456、平均 Dice 0.400，VoxTell 分别为 0.533、0.175、0.234（均 P < .001）。MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding 测试集中，7 模型集成取得全部 48 支参赛队中最高的 hit rate（0.782）和 instance F1（0.386）。50 例由两位独立放射科医师重复分割的测试扫描上，CTLink 达到或超过评分者间一致性。
AI.conclusion: CTLink 能有效将报告文本发现映射为 3D 分割，性能显著优于现有基线并具临床可用的一致性水平；主要局限为弥漫性非局灶发现，部分因其范围即使在放射科医师间标注也不一致。模型权重与数据集已公开。

title: Tokens as Locality-Preserving Anchors: Scalable Novel View Synthesis with Target-Adaptive Token Routing
summary: Transformer-based view synthesis models render each target viewpoint from the source images, without an explicit 3D representation, which lets them reproduce fine detail and view-dependent effects. However, their decoder attends to every source token for every frame, so rendering slows with each source image. Rasterization avoids this by culling primitives that the viewpoint does not see, but source tokens cannot be culled this way, as they have no explicit position or extent. Our key insight is that source tokens are nonetheless spatial anchors: each encodes a local region of the scene, so the decoder's attention for any viewpoint concentrates on a few of them. A lightweight router predicts these tokens from the source tokens and the viewpoint, and the decoder attends only to a fixed budget of top-ranked tokens, so its cost no longer depends on the number of source tokens. We supervise the router with the decoder's attention, using non-maximum suppression to demote redundant tokens. With 24 source images and two views' worth of tokens, our model renders 6.4 times faster than LagerNVS, at a PSNR only 0.68 dB lower. One ranking serves every budget, so the budget can change at render time.

AI.tldr: 提出用轻量路由器从源图像token与目标视角中预测少量关键token，解码器只对固定预算的top-ranked token做注意力，使渲染开销与源图像数量解耦。
AI.motivation: 基于Transformer的视角合成模型无显式3D表示，能复现精细细节与视角相关效果，但解码器对每一帧都要对所有源token做注意力，渲染速度随源图像数量增加而变慢。光栅化可用视锥剔除不可见图元，而源token无显式位置与范围，无法直接剔除。
AI.method: 关键洞察：源token本质上是空间锚点，每个编码场景的局部区域，因此任一视角的解码注意力只集中在少数token上。据此设计轻量路由器，输入源token与目标视角，预测token的相关性排序；解码器仅对固定预算的top-ranked token做注意力。路由器以解码器注意力作为监督信号，并用非最大抑制（NMS）降权冗余token。
AI.result: 在24张源图像、两个视角等量token的设置下，相比LagerNVS渲染速度快6.4倍，PSNR仅低0.68 dB。单一排序可服务任意预算，预算可在渲染时动态调整。
AI.conclusion: 通过将源token视为可被视角条件化排序的空间锚点，实现了类似图元剔除的token级剔除，使Transformer视角合成的解码开销不再随源图像数量增长，并在近乎无损的画质下获得显著加速，且支持运行时灵活调整计算预算。

title: SRCWDNet: Semantic-Relational Cross-Window Dual-Graph Network for Multi-Label Remote Sensing Scene Classification
summary: Multi-label remote sensing scene classification remains a challenging task due to complex spatial-spectral patterns, extreme class imbalance, and inter-label dependencies that are often insufficiently modeled. To address these challenges, we introduce a Semantic-Relational Cross-Window Dual-Graph Network (SRCWDNet), which integrates three key modules: (1) a Cross-Window Attention module that captures local and global visual context through learnable global tokens; (2) a Dual Label-Graph module that adaptively combines statistical co-occurrence graphs and learned semantic-embedding graphs to facilitate label-relational reasoning; and (3) a Neural Classifier Chain that sequentially predicts labels to exploit inter-label dependencies. Evaluated using five-fold cross-validation and trained with an Asymmetric-Graph-Consistency loss, SRCWDNet achieves accuracies of 98.93% and 96.53%, with corresponding F1-scores of 0.9365 and 0.8723 on the MLRSNet and China-MAS50k datasets, respectively, outperforming CNN, transformer, and lightweight baselines. These findings demonstrate that jointly modeling visual attention and adaptive label correlations can substantially improve multi-label remote sensing scene classification, particularly under long-tailed class distributions.

AI.tldr: 提出SRCWDNet，通过跨窗口注意力、双标签图与神经分类器链联合建模视觉上下文与标签相关性，在MLRSNet和China-MAS50k上取得98.93%/96.53%准确率。
AI.motivation: 多标签遥感场景分类面临复杂空间-光谱模式、极端类别不平衡以及标签间依赖建模不足三大难题，现有方法对标签相关性的利用不充分。
AI.method: SRCWDNet含三个模块：(1) 跨窗口注意力模块，借助可学习全局令牌捕获局部与全局视觉上下文；(2) 双标签图模块，自适应融合统计共现图与学习型语义嵌入图以进行标签关系推理；(3) 神经分类器链，顺序预测标签以利用标签间依赖。训练采用非对称图一致性损失，评估采用五折交叉验证。
AI.result: 在MLRSNet与China-MAS50k上准确率分别为98.93%和96.53%，F1分数为0.9365和0.8723，优于CNN、Transformer及轻量级基线；在长尾类别分布下提升尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模视觉注意力与自适应标签相关性可显著提升多标签遥感场景分类性能，尤其适用于长尾分布场景。

title: WildAnySplat: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting in the Wild
comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 (Conference Papers). Project page: https://wildanysplat.github.io/ ; Supplementary material: https://wildanysplat.github.io/wildanysplat_supp.pdf
summary:
We present WildAnySplat, a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that enables robust novel-view synthesis from in-the-wild multi-view images. Unlike controlled captures, real-world images often contain multi-view inconsistencies caused by transient occluders, illumination changes, and camera ISP, which degrade the quality of existing feed-forward reconstruction methods.
  To address this challenge, we introduce a student-teacher framework that learns transient-robust and appearance-consistent 3D representations. A teacher network operates on clean images, while a student processes the corresponding in-the-wild inputs. The teacher provides clean supervision to guide the student toward a consistent canonical representation. Since paired clean and in-the-wild data are scarce, we use a hybrid data strategy, combining real paired captures, synthetic augmentations, and pseudo-clean labels generated from optimization-based reconstructions, bridging the domain gap between synthetic and real-world data.
  We adopt a transformer architecture with dedicated DPT heads for camera pose, depth, and Gaussian prediction. We additionally predict per-view transient masks to reweight photometric supervision and suppress unreliable Gaussians. To account for cross-view appearance variation, we incorporate a bilateral grid module that models per-image color transformations and enables recovery of a canonical radiance representation.
  Experiments on challenging in-the-wild benchmarks show that WildAnySplat improves robustness to transient occlusions and appearance variation while retaining the fast inference of feed-forward Gaussian Splatting.

AI.tldr: WildAnySplat 是一个前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting 框架，通过师生蒸馏、瞬态掩码与双边网格颜色校正，实现野外多视角图像的高鲁棒新视角合成。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈重建方法假设多视角一致，而真实（in-the-wild）图像常含瞬态遮挡物、光照变化与相机 ISP 差异导致的跨视角不一致，显著劣化重建质量；同时成对的"干净—野外"数据稀缺。
AI.method: 采用师生框架：教师网络处理干净图像，学生网络处理对应野外输入，教师提供干净监督以引导学生学习一致的规范表示。数据上混合三类来源——真实配对采集、合成增广、以及由优化式重建生成的伪干净标签，以弥合合成与真实域差距。网络为 transformer 架构，配 DPT 头分别预测相机位姿、深度与 Gaussian；并预测逐视角瞬态掩码以重加权光度监督、抑制不可靠 Gaussian；引入双边网格模块建模逐图像颜色变换，恢复规范辐射表示。
AI.result: 在具挑战性的野外基准上，对瞬态遮挡与外观变化的鲁棒性提升，同时保持前馈 Gaussian Splatting 的快速推理特性。
AI.conclusion: 师生蒸馏 + 混合数据策略 + 瞬态掩码与双边网格外观建模，可在单一前馈网络中同时获得鲁棒性与效率，为野外多视角重建设定新范式。

title: torchtsetlin: Fast, Interpretable Tsetlin Machines for PyTorch
summary: The Tsetlin machine learns propositional rules with teams of Tsetlin automata that are driven by reward and penalty rather than gradients, so its models are interpretable by construction and cheap to evaluate. Its software, however, consists of C and CUDA kernels behind scikit-learn-style wrappers that sit outside the deep learning ecosystem. torchtsetlin implements the Tsetlin machine family as ordinary PyTorch modules: vanilla and weighted, coalesced, regression, convolutional over sequences, images and volumes, and dense per-pixel segmentation. The automata are a tensor buffer, so a model moves with .to(device), is saved with state_dict() and learns from a mini-batch with one update(x,y) call. Its core technique is a batched formulation of Type I and Type II feedback, in which automaton transitions become event counts realised as binomial draws, with one commit per mini-batch. On ten benchmarks taken from the existing libraries, it matches their accuracy, and on all but the two smallest it trains 2.4-10.9X faster than PyTsetlinMachineCUDA and 10.3-81.2X faster than tmu on the same GPU. The package is pure Python, MIT-licensed and on PyPI; every number in this paper is reproduced by one script. Code: https://github.com/vlbthambawita/torchtsetlin; package: https://pypi.org/project/torchtsetlin/.

AI.tldr: torchtsetlin 将 Tsetlin Machine 家族实现为原生 PyTorch 模块，其核心是把 Type I/II 反馈批量化：自动机状态存为张量缓冲区，转移以二项分布采样的事件计数形式实现，每个 mini-batch 提交一次。在与现有库相同的十个基准上精度持平，除两个最小基准外，训练速度比 PyTsetlinMachineCUDA 快 2.4–10.9 倍、比 tmu 快 10.3–81.2 倍。
AI.motivation: Tsetlin Machine 基于 Tsetlin 自动机的奖励/惩罚机制而非梯度学习命题规则，模型天生可解释且推理成本低。但其现有软件以 C 与 CUDA kernel 实现，仅通过 scikit-learn 风格封装暴露，游离于深度学习生态之外，难以复用 PyTorch 的设备管理、自动微分生态与模型保存流程。
AI.method: 将 Tsetlin Machine 家族实现为普通 PyTorch 模块，涵盖 vanilla、weighted、coalesced、回归、面向序列/图像/体数据的卷积版本以及逐像素稠密分割。自动机以张量缓冲区形式存在，因而模型支持 .to(device) 迁移、state_dict() 持久化，并通过一次 update(x,y) 调用完成 mini-batch 学习。关键技术是 Type I 与 Type II 反馈的批量化公式：把自动机状态转移转化为事件计数，用二项分布抽样实现，每个 mini-batch 仅提交一次状态更新。
AI.result: 在取自现有库的十个基准上，精度与现有实现持平；除两个最小基准外，在同一 GPU 上训练速度分别比 PyTsetlinMachineCUDA 快 2.4–10.9 倍、比 tmu 快 10.3–81.2 倍。软件为纯 Python 实现，MIT 许可，已发布于 PyPI，论文中所有数值均可由单一脚本复现。
AI.conclusion: 通过批量化自动机反馈并将 Tsetlin Machine 融入 PyTorch 原生模块范式，可在不牺牲精度的前提下显著提升训练效率，并使该可解释模型家族直接获得深度学习生态的工程便利。

title: Walks2Maps: Learning Indoor Geometry from Crowdsourced Wi-Fi RTT and Motion Trajectories
comment: This paper is accepted to NeurIPS 2026 PhysWorldAI Workshop
summary: Everyday smartphone walks offer a scalable source of indoor geometry, but their motion traces drift and their radio measurements are distorted by multipath. We present Walks2Maps, a physics-guided framework that reconstructs a shared metric map from Wi-Fi round-trip-time (RTT) and motion observations, without a floor plan, surveyed access-point (AP) coordinates, or position labels. Walks2Maps jointly estimates pedestrian trajectories, AP locations, and per-trajectory stride scales, then recovers the pathway layout from the reconstructed paths. Shared AP observations connect walks recorded in different local frames, while metric ranges constrain their relative geometry and scale. An asymmetric range loss accommodates multipath-induced excess delay. On 22 phone trajectories collected along 11 routes on an office floor with 30 APs, Walks2Maps achieves median AP and trajectory errors of 0.87 m and 0.89 m, respectively, and a walked-area F1 score of 0.985. Ablations show that radio similarity can recognize places while still producing a distorted map; retaining the metric information in RTT resolves this ambiguity. Asymmetric modeling further reduces AP error by 54% relative to a symmetric loss. These results demonstrate how radio and motion measurements can jointly reveal indoor geometry without a dedicated mapping survey. We will release the dataset and toolkit.

AI.tldr: Walks2Maps 是一个物理引导框架，仅利用日常智能手机行走中的 Wi-Fi RTT 与运动观测，在无平面图、无 AP 坐标、无位置标签条件下联合重建室内度量地图。
AI.motivation: 日常手机行走可规模化采集室内几何数据，但运动轨迹漂移、多径导致无线电测距失真，难以直接用于建图。
AI.method: 联合估计行人轨迹、AP 位置与每条轨迹的步幅尺度，再由重建路径恢复通道布局；不同局部坐标系下的行走通过共享 AP 观测关联，度量距离约束相对几何与尺度；采用非对称距离损失以容忍多径引起的超额时延；通过消融区分无线电相似性（地点识别）与 RTT 度量信息的作用。
AI.result: 在 30 个 AP 的办公室楼层、11 条路线的 22 条手机轨迹上，AP 与轨迹中位误差分别为 0.87 m 和 0.89 m，行走区域 F1 为 0.985；消融表明仅靠无线电相似性会产生畸变地图，保留 RTT 度量信息可消除该歧义；非对称建模使 AP 误差较对称损失降低 54%。
AI.conclusion: 无线电与运动测量可协同揭示室内几何，无需专门测绘巡测；作者将公开数据集与工具包。

title: MVAgent: Per-Video Agents under Global Coordination for Multi-Video Understanding
summary: Multi-video understanding requires systems to combine evidence from different videos for cross-video reasoning. Answering such questions involves two kinds of decisions. Observation decisions must adapt to each video's content, whereas cross-video judgments require relating evidence from different videos based on the question. Most existing agents make both kinds of decisions in one controller, whose context accumulates observations from every video. We separate them in MVAgent, a training-free Multi-Video Understanding Agent framework with one LocalAgent per video. Each LocalAgent plans observations of its own video and keeps a private observation history. A GlobalAgent coordinates cross-video reasoning by instructing the LocalAgents and combining their reports with joint observation. We evaluate MVAgent on CVBench, MVU-Eval, and CrossVid, using three Qwen3.5 models of different sizes and GPT-6-sol. With Qwen3.5, our framework improves aggregate benchmark scores by 5.1 points on average over Single-pass inference with the same model and by 5.0 points over the strongest prior agent using the same model. With GPT-6-sol, the average gain over Single-pass inference with the same model is 4.3 points. On the same hardware, MVAgent also runs 1.8-2.7 times faster than prior agents of comparable size.

AI.tldr: MVAgent 是一个免训练的"多视频理解"智能体框架，为每个视频配置独立的 LocalAgent 负责本视频的观察规划并维护私有观察历史，由 GlobalAgent 通过指令调度与报告汇总完成跨视频推理，从而把"观察决策"与"跨视频判断"解耦。
AI.motivation: 多视频理解需要融合多个视频的证据进行跨视频推理，涉及两类决策：观察决策需随各视频内容自适应，跨视频判断需依据问题关联不同视频证据。现有智能体把两类决策放在同一控制器中，导致上下文被所有视频的观察记录不断累积、相互干扰。
AI.method: 提出免训练的 Multi-Video Understanding Agent 框架 MVAgent：每个视频对应一个 LocalAgent，自主规划对本视频的观察并保留私有观察历史；GlobalAgent 负责跨视频推理，向各 LocalAgent 下发指令并将其报告与联合观察结果整合。在 CVBench、MVU-Eval、CrossVid 三个基准上，用三种不同规模的 Qwen3.5 模型及 GPT-6-sol 进行评测。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5 下，框架使各基准综合得分较同模型单遍推理平均提升 5.1 分，较同模型下最强的已有智能体方法平均提升 5.0 分；在 GPT-6-sol 下，较同模型单遍推理平均提升 4.3 分。相同硬件条件下，MVAgent 运行速度比规模相当的已有智能体快 1.8–2.7 倍。
AI.conclusion: 将局部观察与全局协调分离、以私有观察历史替代共享累积上下文，可在无需训练的前提下同时提升多视频理解的准确性与推理效率，说明决策解耦是该任务的有效设计原则。

title: GSDet: Gaussian Splatting for Oriented Object Detection
summary: Oriented object detection has advanced with the development of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transformers. However, modern detectors still rely on predefined object candidates, such as anchors in CNN-based methods or queries in transformer-based methods, which struggle to capture spatial information effectively. To address the limitations, we propose GSDet, a novel framework that formulates oriented object detection as Gaussian splatting. Specifically, our approach performs detection within a 3D feature space constructed from image features, where 3D Gaussians are employed to represent oriented objects. These 3D Gaussians are projected onto the image plane to form 2D Gaussians, which are then transformed into oriented boxes. Furthermore, we optimize the mean, anisotropic covariance, and confidence scores of these randomly initialized 3D Gaussians, using a decoder that incorporates 3D Gaussian sampling. Moreover, our method exhibits flexibility, enabling adaptive control and a dynamic number of Gaussians during inference. Experiments on 3 datasets indicate that GSDet achieves AP$_{50}$ gains of 0.7\% on DIOR-R, 0.3\% on DOTA-v1.0, and 0.55\% on DOTA-v1.5 when evaluated with adaptive control and outperforms mainstream detectors.

AI.tldr: 提出 GSDet，将定向目标检测表述为高斯泼溅：在3D特征空间中用3D高斯表示定向目标，投影为2D高斯并转换为定向框，随机初始化后经含3D高斯采样的解码器优化其均值、各向异性协方差与置信度。
AI.motivation: 现代定向检测器依赖预定义的候选表示（CNN 的锚框、Transformer 的 query），难以有效捕获空间信息，因此需要一种无需预定义候选、能更好建模空间结构的检测范式。
AI.method: 构建由图像特征组成的3D特征空间，在空间内以随机初始化的3D高斯表示定向目标；将3D高斯投影到图像平面得到2D高斯并转换为定向框；使用集成3D高斯采样的解码器优化高斯的均值、各向异性协方差与置信度；支持自适应控制与动态数量的高斯。
AI.result: 在3个数据集上采用自适应控制评估：DIOR-R AP50 提升0.7%，DOTA-v1.0 提升0.3%，DOTA-v1.5 提升0.55%，并优于主流检测器。
AI.conclusion: GSDet 以高斯泼溅替代锚框/查询式候选表示，验证了3D高斯建模在定向目标检测中的有效性，且具备高斯数量动态可控的灵活性，性能超越主流方法。

title: ViDiHand2: Unifying Video Diffusion Priors and Hand Geometry for 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild
comment: Main text 8 pages with supplementary material, 54 pages in total
summary: Learning robot manipulation from egocentric human videos requires accurate metric 3D hand motion. Recent methods leverage pretrained video diffusion model (VDM) priors to recover occluded hands directly from full-frame videos, but their appearance-based depth regression generalizes poorly to unseen cameras. In this work, we propose ViDiHand2, a geometry-driven framework that reformulates VDM-based hand depth estimation from direct regression into fine-grained geometric constraint solving. Specifically, we introduce Fine-Grained Geometric Lifting and Clip-Level Ray Fitting, which recover metric depth by enforcing geometric consistency between pixel-aligned 2D joints and the metric structure of MANO hands, while leveraging temporal observations across the clip. Since the lifting relies on these 2D joints, to improve robustness under occlusion and image truncation, we further develop Confidence-Gated Fusion to adaptively combine geometrically lifted joints with MANO predictions according to localization confidence. Finally, we enhance the VDM backbone to better capture spatial-temporal representations and produce the per-frame 2D joint and MANO predictions that both steps rely on. Extensive experiments on seven public datasets demonstrate that ViDiHand2 consistently outperforms 18 baselines, reducing in-the-wild absolute joint error by 42% and detection failures by 8.82x compared with the best baseline on each metric, while running at 57 FPS. The code is available at https://github.com/NTUYWANG103/ViDiHand.

AI.tldr: ViDiHand2 将基于视频扩散模型的单手度量深度估计从"外观回归"重构为"几何约束求解"，通过几何抬升、片段级射线拟合与置信度门控融合，显著提升跨相机泛化性，在七个数据集上超越18个基线，野外关节误差降低42%、检测失败减少8.82倍，速度57 FPS。
AI.motivation: 从第一视角人类视频学习机器人操作需要准确的度量3D手部运动。现有方法借助预训练视频扩散模型（VDM）先验直接从全帧视频恢复被遮挡的手部，但其基于外观的深度回归对未见相机泛化差，因此需要更几何化、相机无关的方案。
AI.method: 提出几何驱动的ViDiHand2：(1) Fine-Grained Geometric Lifting与Clip-Level Ray Fitting，通过强制像素对齐2D关节与MANO手部度量结构之间的几何一致性，并利用片段内时序观测恢复度量深度；(2) Confidence-Gated Fusion，依据定位置信度自适应融合几何抬升关节与MANO预测，提升遮挡与图像截断下的鲁棒性；(3) 增强VDM骨干以更好捕捉时空表征，输出上述两步所需的逐帧2D关节与MANO预测。
AI.result: 在七个公开数据集上一致优于18个基线；相对于各指标上的最佳基线，野外场景绝对关节误差降低42%，检测失败数降低8.82倍，运行速度达57 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 将VDM手部深度估计表述为细粒度几何约束求解问题，可有效缓解外观回归的相机泛化缺陷，为第一视角视频驱动的机器人操作学习提供高精度、实时且鲁棒的度量3D手部运动估计方案，代码已开源。

title: DARE: Dual-Level Adversarial Learning with Domain-Aware Regularization for Whole Slide Image Classification
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 22 pages, 7 figures, including the appendix
summary: Pathological whole slide images (WSIs) exhibit substantial domain shifts across hospitals due to variations in scanning devices, staining protocols, and tissue preparation procedures, leading to significant performance degradation when models are applied to data from different sources. Although unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) has shown strong performance in transferring models from a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain in natural images, it remains relatively underexplored in computational pathology. The ultra-high resolution of WSIs and their pronounced inter-slide and intra-slide heterogeneity pose unique challenges for domain adaptation, often rendering existing UDA methods unstable and susceptible to negative transfer. To address these challenges, we propose Dual-level Adversarial learning with domain-aware REgularization (DARE), a plug-and-play UDA framework for WSI classification. DARE incorporates adaptive pseudo-labeling within a teacher-student architecture to provide stable supervision for the target domain, alongside adversarial alignment of both patch-level and slide-level embeddings. Together, these components enable the joint optimization of semantic representations at both levels for cross-domain alignment. We further introduce domain-aware attention masking to regularize attention and improve cross-domain generalization. Extensive experiments on four public WSI datasets demonstrate that DARE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across various domain shifts.

AI.tldr: 提出即插即用的无监督域适应框架DARE，通过教师-学生架构下的自适应伪标签、patch与slide双层级对抗对齐及域感知注意力掩码，缓解病理全切片图像跨医院域偏移，在四个公开WSI数据集上稳定优于SOTA。
AI.motivation: 病理全切片图像（WSI）因扫描设备、染色方案与组织制备差异，在不同医院间存在显著域偏移，导致模型跨源应用时性能明显下降。虽无监督域适应（UDA）在自然图像中表现良好，但在计算病理中研究不足；WSI的超高分辨率及切片间、切片内的强异质性使现有UDA方法不稳定且易发生负迁移。
AI.method: 提出DARE（Dual-level Adversarial learning with domain-aware REgularization），一种面向WSI分类的即插即用UDA框架，包含三部分：(1) 在教师-学生架构中引入自适应伪标签，为目标域提供稳定监督；(2) 对patch级与slide级嵌入同时进行对抗对齐，实现两个层级语义表示的联合优化与跨域对齐；(3) 域感知注意力掩码，对注意力进行正则化以提升跨域泛化。
AI.result: 在四个公开WSI数据集上的大量实验表明，DARE在多种域偏移设定下均持续优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: DARE通过双层级对抗学习与域感知正则化有效应对WSI的跨域异质性，为计算病理中的WSI分类提供了一种通用、可插拔的UDA解决方案，并验证了其在多样域偏移下的鲁棒性与优越性。

title: Do learned image captioning metrics generalize? Auditing duplicated samples in human-judgment benchmarks
summary: Learned image captioning metrics are trained and tested on human judgments, so their reported correlation is a claim about generalization. We audit this claim for the three most recent collections of such judgments, Polaris, Nebula, and Spica, matching images at the pixel level. First, test samples reappear in training sets: the Spica training set contains about two-thirds of the Polaris test set, with identical human ratings. Second, controlled retraining shows that duplicates can inflate a metric: for Pearl, the gain is confined to the duplicated samples and grows with every epoch; for DENEB, it stays below one point. The gain depends on the learner and on how often a training set repeats a sample. Third, Kendall's $τ$ over all samples is the sum of two terms, detecting captions with the lowest human score and ranking the others; the first supplies most of the reported correlation and is nearly saturated. The recent test sets cannot order Polos, DENEB and Pearl consistently, and a ridge regression on frozen features matches or exceeds all three. Fourth, we propose a protocol that ranks a learned metric only with a model trained without test samples, reports both terms, and compares metrics by paired tests. Under it, zero-shot vision--language judges rank first on the three recent test sets, and a fine-tuned judge ranks first on the three earlier benchmarks. The same analysis applies to any evaluator learned from human judgments; filter lists and code are released at https://github.com/morninghut/ic-dataset-audit .

AI.tldr: 该文审计了三个最新图像描述评测数据集（Polaris、Nebula、Spica）的泛化性主张，发现测试样本大规模泄漏进训练集、重复样本会虚高指标、Kendall τ的相关性主要来自"识别最差样本"这一近乎饱和项，并提出更严格的评测协议。
AI.motivation: 学习型图像描述（image captioning）指标以与人类判断的相关性作为泛化性声明，但训练与测试数据可能重叠、评测指标本身可能被污染，此前的相关性报告缺乏对该声明的审计。
AI.method: 按像素级匹配图像，对 Polaris、Nebula、Spica 三个最新人类判断数据集做重叠检测；通过受控重训练（Pearl、DENEB）量化重复样本带来的增益及其随训练轮次、学习器和重复频率的变化；将 Kendall τ 分解为"识别最低分样本"与"对其余样本排序"两项；并以冻结特征上的岭回归作为基线对照。
AI.result: Spica 训练集约含 Polaris 测试集的三分之二且人类评分完全相同；重复样本带来的增益仅局限于被复制样本，Pearl 随 epoch 增长、DENEB 低于 1 分；Kendall τ 中第一项（识别最差样本）贡献了大部分报告相关性且接近饱和；近期测试集无法稳定区分 Polos、DENEB 与 Pearl，冻结特征岭回归可持平或超过三者；新协议下零样本视觉-语言评判器在三个最新测试集上排名第一，微调评判器在三个更早基准上排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 学习型指标的报告相关性存在数据泄漏与统计结构性问题，应仅在剔除测试样本的模型上对指标排名、同时报告 τ 的两个分解项并以配对检验比较指标；该分析框架适用于任何从人类判断中学习的评测器。

title: Replay Before You Reply: Second-Look Prompting for Unified Multimodal Encoding
summary: Solving multimodal tasks requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to form a unified understanding of the image and the question text. However, under causal attention in current VLMs, a token can attend only to what precedes it. Whichever modality comes first is therefore encoded under partial observation of the input, uninformed by the rest of the multimodal context. We introduce Second-Look Prompting (SLP), a training-free method that repeats the image-question pair in the input. In the repeated copy, every visual and textual token can attend to the complete input, yielding a unified multimodal encoding of the pair. Moreover, the added visual tokens contribute computation beyond re-exposing the image: even a blank image in their place can improve reasoning. Across 12 benchmarks, SLP improves the overall average score of every evaluated model, spanning nine open-source models (3B-72B) and three proprietary frontier models, with gains reaching 5.6 points for Gemini 3 Flash on MATH-Vision. Our analysis reveals two complementary mechanisms: the question guides where the second image attends, and the added visual tokens act as a prefill scratchpad whose hidden states retain answer-relevant information from the image and question. These findings highlight input presentation as a simple yet effective way to improve VLM performance.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练方法 Second-Look Prompting（SLP），通过重复输入中的图像-问题对，使因果注意力下的每个 token 都能看到完整多模态上下文，从而形成统一编码；在 12 个基准、9 个开源与 3 个闭源模型上普遍提升，最高增益 5.6 分。
AI.motivation: 当前 VLM 采用因果注意力，token 只能关注其之前的上下文，因此先出现的模态只能在不完整的信息下编码，无法被后续多模态上下文更新，导致图文缺乏统一理解。
AI.method: SLP 为免训练方法：将图像-问题对在输入中重复一次。重复副本中的每个视觉与文本 token 都可关注到完整输入，形成统一的多模态编码；同时新增视觉 token 本身也带来额外计算，即使替换为空白图像仍可提升推理表现。
AI.result: 在 12 个基准上，所有被评估模型的平均分均有提升，涵盖 9 个开源模型（3B–72B）和 3 个闭源前沿模型，Gemini 3 Flash 在 MATH-Vision 上增益达 5.6 分。机理分析显示两种互补机制：问题引导第二张图像的注意力位置；新增视觉 token 充当 prefill 草稿本，其隐藏状态保留图像与问题中与答案相关的信息。
AI.conclusion: 输入呈现方式（input presentation）是提升 VLM 性能的简单而有效的途径，SLP 以零训练成本缓解了因果注意力带来的模态编码不对称问题。

title: A High-Resolution UAV Benchmark Dataset and Baseline Evaluation for Teak Crown Segmentation in Western Ghats Tropical Forests
summary: Accurate teak-tree segmentation from high-resolution drone imagery is critical for sustainable plantation management, yet lacks dedicated benchmarks. We introduce TeakTreeNet, a comprehensive dataset and evaluation protocol for binary teak-tree segmentation at native 2cm resolution. Four state-of-the-art architectures: U-Net, PSPNet, DeepLabV3, and SegFormer were rigorously benchmarked across scratch and ImageNet-pretrained settings with three-seed reproducibility. SegFormer establishes new SOTA performance with F1 0.938 +/- 0.002 (Teak), IoU 0.968 +/- 0.001 (Teak), and Accuracy 0.986 +/- 0.001, outperforming all pretrained CNNs. Domain-adaptive training suffices, as the scratch SegFormer outperforms ImageNet pretrained baselines, avoiding large-scale pretraining overhead. Comprehensive analysis reveals Transformer's superior boundary delineation for dense plantation scenarios. TeakTreeNet provides researchers with 6391 expertly annotated drone patches (224x224) and establishes reproducible evaluation protocols, enabling direct comparison of future methods. Our benchmark demonstrates SegFormer's optimal balance of accuracy, efficiency, and deployability for operational forestry monitoring of teak plantations for India's western tropical forests.

AI.tldr: 提出柚木树分割数据集与评测协议 TeakTreeNet，基准测试四种架构，SegFormer 以 F1 0.938、IoU 0.968、Acc 0.986 达到 SOTA，且从零训练即可超越 ImageNet 预训练的 CNN。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率无人机影像的柚木树精确分割对可持续人工林管理至关重要，但此前缺乏专用基准数据集与可复现的评测协议。
AI.method: 构建 TeakTreeNet 数据集（6391 个 224×224 专家标注无人机影像块，原生 2cm 分辨率）与二分类分割评测协议；在从零训练与 ImageNet 预训练两种设置下，以三种子重复性实验对 U-Net、PSPNet、DeepLabV3、SegFormer 进行基准评测，并开展边界刻画与部署性分析。
AI.result: SegFormer 取得最佳性能：Teak F1 0.938±0.002、IoU 0.968±0.001、Accuracy 0.986±0.001，优于所有预训练 CNN；从零训练的 SegFormer 亦超过 ImageNet 预训练基线；Transformer 在密集人工林场景下边界刻画更优。
AI.conclusion: 域自适应训练即可满足需求，无需大规模预训练开销；SegFormer 在精度、效率与可部署性间取得最优平衡，适用于西热带森林柚木人工林的业务化林业监测。

title: XFreq: Geometry-Aligned Cross-View Residual Learning for Sparse 3D Ultrasound Reconstruction
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) ultrasound provides valuable volumetric context for anatomical assessment, motivating reconstruction from widely available two-dimensional (2D) slices. Sparse slices leave much of the volume unobserved, even when their acquisition poses are known. Existing methods interpolate observed intensities or incorporate learned 2D image features into 3D reconstruction, but their complementary roles in predicting smooth structure and residual details remain less explored. We introduce XFreq, a geometry-aligned framework for sparse 3D ultrasound reconstruction. It uses known slice poses and finite footprints to query 2D image features at 3D locations, complementing splatted intensities and sampling geometry. A low-frequency decoder predicts a smooth 3D field from the splat representation, while a high-frequency decoder additionally incorporates the queried 2D features to predict residual details. A learned gating module regulates the residual contribution based on geometry and cross-slice feature variation. We evaluate XFreq on an in-house fetal brain dataset and the public CETUS cardiac dataset, using slices resampled from 3D ultrasound volumes and fivefold cross-validation. Among the compared methods, XFreq achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM in most settings across both datasets, reaching 26.82 dB PSNR on CETUS with 32 input slices. Ablation studies further show the contributions of local feature querying, geometric cues, and residual prediction, with gains generally increasing as more input slices are used. Our findings highlight the value of geometry-aligned cross-view feature integration for reconstructing 3D ultrasound volumes from sparse 2D slices.

AI.tldr: 提出XFreq——几何对齐的稀疏3D超声重建框架，低频解码器从splat表示预测平滑3D场，高频解码器结合查询到的2D特征预测残差细节，并用学习门控调节残差贡献。
AI.motivation: 3D超声能提供解剖评估所需的体数据上下文，但常只能获得2D切片，稀疏切片使大部分体数据未被观测。现有方法或插值观测强度、或将学习的2D特征并入3D重建，但二者在预测平滑结构与残差细节上的互补作用尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 利用已知切片位姿与有限足迹（finite footprints），在3D位置查询2D图像特征，与splat强度及采样几何互补。低频解码器由splat表示预测平滑3D场；高频解码器额外引入查询的2D特征预测残差细节；学习门控模块依据几何与跨切片特征变化调节残差贡献。
AI.result: 在自建胎儿脑数据集与公开CETUS心脏数据集上评估，使用从3D体数据重采样的切片并采用五折交叉验证。多数设置下PSNR与SSIM最高，CETUS上32张输入切片达到26.82 dB PSNR。消融实验表明局部特征查询、几何线索与残差预测各有贡献，且增益随输入切片增多而总体提升。
AI.conclusion: 几何对齐的跨视角特征融合对从稀疏2D切片重建3D超声体数据具有重要价值。

title: CableMoE: Harm-Regularized Mean-Residual Expert Fusion for Transmission-Corridor Segmentation
summary: Semantic mapping of transmission corridors benefits from heterogeneous LiDAR and image-guided predictors, but replacing a strong ensemble with a learned router can damage rare electrical assets. We introduce CableMoE, a post-hoc mixture of four frozen segmentation experts. Its deployable prediction is a calibrated residual around availability-aware probability averaging, while a harm penalty discourages extra loss on points that the mean already classifies correctly. A matched component study shows why each design choice is needed: an unconstrained learned mixture loses 1.032 mIoU points relative to probability mean, harm regularization restores 0.359 points at fixed capacity, and removing an unnecessary point-wise gate slightly improves accuracy and stability. With three zones for fitting, two disjoint zones for residual-strength selection, and router-untouched t5b5 for final reporting, CableMoE obtains 84.906% mIoU and 98.140 % overall accuracy. This is +10.000 points over SPT and +0.263 over probability mean; all three seeds improve the latter. Across pylon, conductor, structural-cable, and insulator classes, macro-IoU rises from 84.517% for SPT and 97.153% for probability mean to 98.144 %. The results support conservative residual composition, not a claim of a new segmentation backbone or universal state of the art

AI.tldr: CableMoE 是一种事后（post-hoc）混合方案：组合四个冻结的分割专家，以"可用性感知概率平均"为基准，叠加经校准的残差并施加 harm 惩罚，在输电走廊语义分割上取得 84.906% mIoU、98.140% OA，三随机种子均优于概率平均。
AI.motivation: 异构 LiDAR 与图像引导的预测器对输电走廊语义制图有益，但用"学习式路由器"替换强集成（probability mean）时，稀有电力资产（如绝缘子、导线）易受损伤。作者意在验证一种保守、低风险的事后组合策略是否必要且有效。
AI.method: CableMoE：四个冻结分割专家的事后混合。可部署预测 = 以可用性感知概率平均为中心的校准残差；引入 harm penalty，惩罚对均值已正确分类点的额外损失。进行匹配的组件消融：无约束学习式混合 vs. 概率平均；harm 正则（固定容量）；移除逐点门控。数据划分：3 个区域用于拟合、2 个不相交区域用于残差强度选择、router 未触碰的 t5b5 作最终报告。
AI.result: 最终 84.906% mIoU、98.140% OA；较 SPT +10.000 点，较概率平均 +0.263 点，三个种子均提升。消融：无约束学习式混合较概率平均损失 1.032 mIoU 点；harm 正则在固定容量下恢复 0.359 点；移除多余逐点门控在精度与稳定性上略有提升。pylon/conductor/structural-cable/insulator 四类 macro-IoU 由 SPT 的 84.517%、概率平均的 97.153% 提升至 98.144%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持"保守式残差组合"这一结论，而非宣称新的分割骨干网络或普适 SOTA。核心价值在于：受限的残差学习 + harm 正则能在保护稀有类别的同时超越概率平均，且不引入额外训练开销。

title: Reconstructing 3D+t Cardiovascular Flow From Sparse Planar Velocity Fields With Neural Fields
summary: Reconstructing time-resolved three-dimensional (3D+t) cardiovascular flow from sparse planar measurements is challenging because each plane observes only the two in-plane velocity components, on a small part of the volume. We propose a plane-aware neural-field framework that learns a continuous 3D velocity field from space and time coordinates through a per-plane projection, and then investigate the potential benefits of physics constraints. We evaluate the framework on computational aortic and aneurysm datasets, and on planes resampled from a real cardiac 4D Flow MRI scan. A plain multi-layer perceptron (MLP) was more accurate than classical radial basis function (RBF) interpolation on both computational datasets. For the aorta, a physics-constrained SIREN (PC-SIREN) reduced the rRMSE further to $0.3756$, compared with $0.4273$ for the plain MLP and $0.7256$ for RBF, and it was the most accurate model in every anatomical segment of the MRI data. For the aneurysms the plain MLP remained the most accurate model, with an rRMSE of $0.07$ to $0.16$ against $0.55$ to $0.71$ for PC-SIREN. Further experiments investigated scanning configuration, number of scans, and spatial resolution. These findings show that continuous neural fields can reconstruct volumetric cardiovascular flow from sparse planar measurements, and that physics constraints have to be matched to the flow.

AI.tldr: 提出平面感知神经场框架，从稀疏平面测量重建3D+t心血管流场，并系统考察物理约束的增益。
AI.motivation: 每个测量平面仅能观测到体积内一小部分的二维面内速度分量，从稀疏平面数据重建时间分辨的三维血流具有挑战性。
AI.method: 构建平面感知神经场：以时空坐标为输入学习连续三维速度场，并经由逐平面投影与平面测量匹配；在此基础上引入物理约束（PC-SIREN）。在计算的主动脉与动脉瘤数据集及由真实心脏4D Flow MRI重采样的平面上评估，并与RBF插值对比，进一步分析扫描配置、扫描数量与空间分辨率的影响。
AI.result: 主动脉数据上，普通MLP优于RBF；PC-SIREN将rRMSE降至0.3756（普通MLP为0.4273，RBF为0.7256），并在MRI数据的各解剖节段中最准确。动脉瘤数据上普通MLP最优，rRMSE为0.07–0.16，PC-SIREN为0.55–0.71。
AI.conclusion: 连续神经场可由稀疏平面测量重建体积性心血管流场，但物理约束需与具体流场特性相匹配。

title: Same Seed, Different Picture? Deciding Early at Low Resolution for Seed-Faithful Few-Step Flow Sampling
comment: 43 pages, 27 figures, 38 tables. Project page: https://duanhuiran.github.io/DtR
summary: Few-step samplers make large text-to-image flow models fast, but from the same noise they no longer generate the image of the standard 50-step sampler. Subjects, attributes and layout change, not just fine detail. We trace this loss of seed fidelity to the start of sampling. The coarse part of the initial noise decides coarse structure first, while the noise level is still above 0.9. Few-step samplers cross this range in their first steps, which account for 25-52% of their distance to the 50-step reference. Because this decision is coarse, a half-resolution run from the same coarse noise can make nearly the same decision at a third of the cost. We therefore propose Decide-then-Render (DtR), a training-free sampler that decides the composition in a few low-resolution steps, rebuilds the full-resolution state with the seed's own noise and renders the details. On 4 large models, DtR runs 11-25$\times$ faster than the reference sampler. At each speed-up, it is closer to the reference and rated higher by ImageReward than every compared sampler, including few-step schedules calibrated per budget and published multi-resolution samplers. On FLUX.1-dev, it remains the most faithful sampler down to about $8\times$, ahead of caching accelerators. A user study on this model found DtR's samples closer to the reference in 86% of pairwise trials. DtR transfers to a held-out model and to video, and distilled models can serve as its renderers. Project link: https://duanhuiran.github.io/DtR

AI.tldr: 本文提出Decide-then-Render (DtR)，一种无需训练的采样器：先用种子自身的粗粒度噪声在低分辨率下决定图像的粗结构（"决定"阶段），再用种子全分辨率噪声重建状态并渲染细节，从而在11-25×加速下保持与50步参考采样器的种子一致性。
AI.motivation: 少步采样器虽能加速大型文生图流模型，但在相同噪声下无法复现标准50步采样器的图像：主体、属性和布局都会改变，而非仅细节差异。作者将这种"种子保真度"损失追溯到采样起始阶段——初始噪声的粗粒度部分在噪声水平仍高于0.9时首先决定粗结构，而少步采样器往往在最初几步就跨越了这一区间（占其到50步参考轨迹距离的25-52%）。
AI.method: 基于"该决策是粗粒度"的观察，从同一粗噪声出发的半分辨率运行可在约三分之一成本下做出几乎相同的决策。据此设计DtR：分两阶段——(1) 在少量低分辨率步骤中决定构图；(2) 用种子自身的噪声重建全分辨率状态，再渲染细节。整个方法无需训练。
AI.result: 在4个大型模型上，DtR比参考采样器快11-25×；在每个加速比下，其与参考图像的接近程度和ImageReward评分均优于所有对比采样器（包括按预算校准的少步调度和已发表的多分辨率采样器）。在FLUX.1-dev上，直至约8×加速仍是最忠实的采样器，优于缓存类加速器；用户研究中86%的成对比较认为DtR样本更接近参考。此外，DtR可迁移到留出模型与视频任务，蒸馏模型可作为其渲染器。
AI.conclusion: DtR通过将"构图决策"与"细节渲染"解耦，在显著加速的同时保持种子保真度，兼具无需训练、跨模型与跨模态迁移、可复用蒸馏模型等优势，为少步高保真采样提供了新范式。

title: Co-speech Gesture Attribute Annotation with 3D Human Mesh Recovery
summary: Co-speech gestures convey meaning alongside speech, but annotating their physical attributes in video is labour-intensive. We propose two approaches to automate annotation of ten gesture attributes using human mesh recovery (HMR), which estimates a full 3D body skeleton from a single video frame: AI-assisted geometrical rules and a graph convolutional network (SL-GCN). Both use pose estimates from SAM 3D Body, evaluated on 2,020 gestures from the GESRes dataset. For physically defined attributes such as height, arm swivel and movement speed, both methods achieve agreement with expert annotation comparable to that between human annotators. For attributes whose annotation requires higher-level multimodal contextual inference, performance remains lower. The rule-based approach requires substantially less annotated data, is fully transparent, and can be adapted to different annotation schemes, offering a practical and interpretable complement to data-driven methods

AI.tldr: 论文提出用人体网格恢复(HMR)自动标注10种手势物理属性，比较几何规则法与SL-GCN两种方法，在GESRes数据集2020个手势上评估：物理定义属性已达人际一致水平，需多模态上下文推断的属性仍较差。
AI.motivation: 伴随手势(co-speech gesture)承载语义信息，但逐帧标注其物理属性耗时费力，需要自动化手段降低标注成本。
AI.method: 以SAM 3D Body从单帧视频估计完整3D人体骨架(HMR)，据此提出两种标注路径：(1)AI辅助的几何规则方法；(2)图卷积网络SL-GCN；在GESRes数据集2,020个手势上，针对10种手势属性与专家标注做一致性评估。
AI.result: 对高度、手臂旋转幅度、运动速度等物理定义明确的属性，两种方法与专家标注的一致性接近人类标注者之间的一致性；对需高层多模态上下文推理的标注属性，性能明显下降。
AI.conclusion: 规则法所需标注数据显著更少、完全可解释、且可适配不同标注体系，可作为数据驱动方法实用且可解释的补充。

title: Optimising VLM Harnesses to Localise Errors in Generated Videos
summary: Identifying subtle errors in generated videos is an important step toward automated video generation, where errors must be detected to assess and refine generated clips. Recent work shows that pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) can localise such errors, but their effectiveness depends strongly on the workflow used: choices about which frames to inspect, which tools and model calls to make, and how to combine predictions can lead to substantially different results. We study VLM harnesses for video error localisation. Instead of relying on manually designed harnesses, we propose Harness Search and Merge (HSM), an algorithm that automatically constructs them by searching over executable evaluation programs. An LLM orchestrator refines candidate harnesses independently on random training subsets, records findings in a memory, and constructively merges complementary candidates. We evaluate HSM on Spotlight, a recently proposed benchmark for localising errors in generated videos. HSM achieves 0.234 +- 0.012 F1, exceeding the strongest benchmark strategy (0.173 +- 0.016), and retains its lead on an unseen video generator (0.213 +- 0.008 versus 0.140 +- 0.003). On IPV-Bench, it achieves strong localisation performance with lower false-alarm rates than existing optimisation baselines. Together, these results show that searching over complete VLM harnesses can outperform existing evaluation strategies, transfer to an unseen video generator, and reduce false alarms on real videos.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Harness Search and Merge (HSM)，通过在可执行评估程序空间上自动搜索并融合 VLM 评测外壳（harness），用于生成视频中的细粒度错误定位，在 Spotlight 与 IPV-Bench 上优于人工设计与既有优化策略。
AI.motivation: 生成视频中的细微错误检测是自动化视频生成评估与改进的关键环节。已有研究表明预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）可定位此类错误，但其效果高度依赖 workflow 设计（选帧策略、工具与模型调用方式、预测组合方式），不同设计差异巨大，而人工设计 harness 成本高且次优。
AI.method: 将 VLM 评测外壳建模为可执行评估程序的搜索问题。由 LLM 编排器（orchestrator）在随机训练子集上独立精炼候选 harness，将发现记录到 memory 中，并对互补的候选进行构造性合并（constructive merge），从而自动构建 harness 而非依赖手工设计。
AI.result: 在 Spotlight 基准上取得 0.234 ± 0.012 F1，超过最强基准策略（0.173 ± 0.016）；在未见过的视频生成器上保持领先（0.213 ± 0.008 对比 0.140 ± 0.003）。在 IPV-Bench 上取得较强定位性能，且误报率低于现有优化基线。
AI.conclusion: 在完整 VLM harness 层面进行搜索可优于现有评估策略，并能迁移到未见视频生成器、在真实视频上降低误报率，说明 harness 级自动搜索是提升生成视频错误定位的有效途径。

title: BASE: A Backend-Agnostic Streaming Embodiment Layer for Full-Duplex Conversational Avatars
summary: Many end-to-end spoken dialogue models can now converse in real time and full duplex, and turning them into 3D avatars requires full-body gestures, listening feedback, and turn-taking. Existing methods couple the motion generator tightly to one dialogue model by reading its internal states or training speech and motion jointly. The motion module must then be retrained whenever the dialogue model changes, cannot be attached to cloud APIs that expose only audio, and entangles role, voice, and motion style. We propose BASE, a backend-agnostic streaming embodiment layer whose only interface to the dialogue model is its emitted speech. First, a conversation state manager driven solely by audio handles speaking, listening, idling, barge-in, and proactive turns on one timeline, while role, voice, motion style, and 3D appearance are set independently. Second, to run an offline 2 s flow-matching gesture model on live audio, we reformulate inference as sliding-window continuation with overlapped look-ahead ensembling, which removes seam jitter. Third, we show that the remaining streaming gap comes from errors accumulating in the self-generated motion history rather than missing future speech; our Drift-Aware History Perturbation (DAHP) reduces this gap in about 50 min on one GPU by injecting inference-like drift into ground-truth training histories, and transfers to a second generator. On BEAT2, streaming BASE reaches an FGD of 0.342, on par with the tightly coupled MIBURI (0.333), and viewers prefer its body motion over MIBURI's in 82% of forced-choice judgments. Without retraining, the same layer drives a cascaded pipeline, three open full-duplex models, and a cloud API in real time.

AI.tldr: BASE 是一个与对话后端解耦的流式化身（embodiment）层，仅以对话模型输出的语音为接口，实现实时全身手势、倾听反馈与轮次切换，且在 BEAT2 上达到与紧耦合 MIBURI 相当的 FGD（0.342 vs 0.333）。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 化身方法将运动生成器与某一对话模型紧耦合：读取其内部状态或联合训练语音与动作。因此对话模型一更新运动模块就需重训；无法接入仅暴露音频的云 API；且角色、音色、动作风格相互纠缠。
AI.method: （1）仅由音频驱动的对话状态管理器，在统一时间线上处理说话、倾听、闲置、打断与主动轮次，角色、音色、动作风格与 3D 外观独立设定；（2）将离线 2 秒 flow-matching 手势模型的推理重构为带重叠前瞻集成的滑动窗口续接，消除接缝抖动；（3）提出 Drift-Aware History Perturbation（DAHP），向真实训练历史注入类推理漂移，单 GPU 约 50 分钟即可缩小剩余流式差距，并可迁移至第二个生成器。
AI.result: BEAT2 上流式 BASE 的 FGD 为 0.342，与紧耦合 MIBURI（0.333）相当；在强制二选一判断中，82% 的受试者更偏好 BASE 的身体动作。无需重训，同一层即可实时驱动级联流水线、三个开放式全双工模型以及一个云 API。
AI.conclusion: 化身运动生成可与对话模型解耦，仅凭音频接口即可实现实时、全双工兼容的流式 3D 化身；剩余流式差距主要源于自生成运动历史中的误差累积而非未来语音缺失，DAHP 可低成本缓解该问题。

title: Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations
summary: Recent unified multimodal models aim to combine visual understanding and generation within a single model, yet effectively integrating the two capabilities remains challenging. Leveraging pretrained vision-language models offers a way to build on already learned multimodal knowledge, but making this knowledge effectively accessible to visual generation remains nontrivial. We find that a central challenge lies in the heterogeneous visual representations used for understanding and generation. To address this challenge, we introduce Integral, which converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space across the two capabilities. Integral implements this design through two complementary components. Abstraction Fusion constructs shared visual tokens by aggregating hierarchical representations from the frozen vision encoder, while Block-wise MoT introduces a lightweight generative stream that interacts with the vision-language model only at block boundaries. Our approach effectively preserves the pretrained understanding capability while extending it to strong visual generation. Controlled comparisons further demonstrate that sharing visual representations between understanding and generation substantially improves generative learning compared with using a separate visual representation space, despite comparable reconstruction fidelity. These results suggest that representations learned by pretrained vision-language models already provide an effective foundation for visual generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 Integral，通过构建理解与生成共享的视觉表征空间，将预训练视觉语言模型转为统一多模态模型。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型需融合视觉理解与生成，但两类能力使用的视觉表征异质，导致预训练多模态知识难以有效支撑视觉生成。
AI.method: Integral 包含两部分：(1) Abstraction Fusion，聚合冻结视觉编码器的层级表征以构建共享视觉 token；(2) Block-wise MoT，引入轻量生成流，仅在块边界与视觉语言模型交互。
AI.result: 在保留预训练理解能力的同时获得较强视觉生成能力；控制实验表明，在重建保真度相当的情况下，共享视觉表征比独立表征空间显著提升生成学习效果。
AI.conclusion: 预训练视觉语言模型学到的表征已可为视觉生成提供有效基础，关键是将理解与生成统一到同一视觉表征空间。

title: TowerBridge: Bridging the Dual-Encoder Modality Gap via Weight-Space Programming
summary: CLIP-style dual encoders map images and text through two separate towers into a shared embedding space, where the two modalities occupy distinct regions separated by a modality gap. Retrieval fails when wrong matches, or hard negatives, outrank the correct one, and the gap is the usual suspect. Yet removing it post hoc degrades retrieval on every CLIP checkpoint we test. We introduce a paired statistic that identifies directions where the two towers agree more on hard negatives than on matched pairs. Mildly attenuating these directions improves retrieval while largely preserving the gap. We arrive at this correction through weight-space programming: guided by the statistic, an LLM agent inspects both towers and writes closed-form weight edits without backpropagation. Free to edit any component, the agent improves COCO test retrieval on all 13 CLIP checkpoints and edits an output projection in 12 of the 13. We distill and refine its recurring correction into TowerBridge, a closed-form recipe motivated by a first-order analysis of the hard-negative margin. Computed in seconds from 25,000 labelled pairs, it requires no model-specific tuning and leaves the architecture and inference cost unchanged. TowerBridge improves COCO test retrieval by 16.8 RSUM and Flickr30k test retrieval by 6.6 on average across all 21 evaluated CLIP checkpoints, including 8 unseen by the agent, while limiting any drop in ImageNet zero-shot accuracy to 0.5 points. It also reduces hubness on all 21 checkpoints and improves retrieval on 4 of 5 dual encoders from other families.

AI.tldr: 提出TowerBridge：一种基于配对统计量的闭式权重修正方法，通过轻微衰减"难负样本上双塔一致性高于匹配对"的方向，在基本保留模态间隙的同时显著提升CLIP类双编码器的检索性能。
AI.motivation: CLIP式双编码器存在模态间隙（modality gap），检索失败常被归因于难负样本（hard negatives）压过正确匹配，且间隙被视为主要嫌疑。然而作者实验发现，事后消除模态间隙会在所有测试的CLIP检查点上降低检索性能，说明"去间隙"并非正确方向，需要重新定位问题根源。
AI.method: 1）提出一种配对统计量，用于识别双塔在难负样本对上比在匹配对上一致性更高的方向；2）通过"权重空间编程"：由LLM智能体依据该统计量检查双塔并写出闭式权重编辑，无需反向传播；3）将该反复出现的修正蒸馏为TowerBridge——基于难负样本间隔的一阶分析得到的闭式配方，仅需25,000对标注数据、数秒内计算完成，无需模型特定调参，不改变架构与推理成本。
AI.result: LLM智能体在全部13个CLIP检查点上提升COCO测试检索，其中12个的编辑落在输出投影层。蒸馏后的TowerBridge在全部21个CLIP检查点（含8个智能体未见过）上平均提升COCO测试RSUM 16.8、Flickr30k测试6.6，ImageNet零样本精度下降不超过0.5个点；同时在全部21个检查点上降低hubness，并在其他家族的5个双编码器中4个上取得检索提升。
AI.conclusion: 模态间隙并非检索失败的真正病灶；真正的问题在于部分方向上双塔对难负样本的判别一致性过强。对这些方向进行温和衰减即可兼顾检索提升与间隙保留，且可推广为一种轻量、免训练、跨模型通用的闭式修正方案TowerBridge。

title: CrownFusion: 3D Dental Crown Generation Using Geometry Images and Latent Diffusion
comment: Accepted at MICCAI 2026. 11 pages, 6 figures. Equal contribution: J. Z. Ye and X. Yan. Project page: https://crownfusion.github.io/
summary: We introduce CrownFusion, a latent diffusion model to generate 3D dental crown designs from geometry images, a 2D-grid encoding of surface coordinates. Departing from traditional approaches that use point clouds, our "CrownImage" representation not only unlocks the full power of image-based generative architectures, but also preserves fine geometric detail by operating at far higher spatial resolutions than point clouds to alleviate smoothing artifacts in the 3D generation. Conditioned on jointly learned embeddings of the surrounding dentition, our probabilistic diffusion model produces anatomically plausible crowns with morphological variations tailored to individual patient cases. To accommodate multiple valid designs, we propose an occlusal fit metric based on proximity to the antagonist teeth. We evaluate our method through quantitative experiments and qualitative studies involving expert testimonials. We also release the FDI 16 Crown Dataset, comprising 11,513 annotated intra-oral scans, to support future research in dental CAD.

AI.tldr: 提出CrownFusion——一种基于latent diffusion与geometry image（"CrownImage"）表示的3D牙冠生成框架，以周边牙列联合学习的嵌入为条件，生成解剖合理且具个体化形变的牙冠，并发布FDI 16 Crown Dataset（11,513例标注口内扫描）。
AI.motivation: 传统3D牙冠生成多采用点云表示，空间分辨率受限，易产生平滑伪影、丢失细粒度几何细节；同时需适配同一病例多种有效设计的评估需求，且缺乏公开的大规模牙科CAD数据。
AI.method: 以geometry image（2D网格编码表面坐标）作为"切CrownImage"表示，替代点云以在更高空间分辨率下保留几何细节；采用latent diffusion概率模型，以周边牙列经联合学习得到的embedding为条件进行生成；提出基于与对颌牙邻近度的occlusal fit（咬合匹配）度量以容纳多种有效设计。
AI.result: 定量实验与专家参与的定性评估表明，该方法可生成解剖上合理、形态具患者个体化差异的牙冠；并发布FDI 16 Crown Dataset（11,513例标注口内扫描）以支撑牙科CAD后续研究。
AI.conclusion: 将几何图像表示与latent diffusion结合可有效缓解点云方法的平滑伪影并实现条件化牙冠生成，配合面向多解设计的咬合匹配度量与公开数据集，为牙科CAD生成式设计提供了新范式。

title: Token Pruning Needs a Protected Sink Token: Coherent Spatial Aggregation in Vision Transformers
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) are a predominant architecture for computer vision, with token reduction emerging as a popular paradigm to improve their efficiency. Prior work compares reduction algorithms, but not how models respond to them, nor how their response changes with model depth. We propose Monte Carlo Token Pruning (MCTP), which estimates each token's impact on the prediction when tokens are explicitly removed during the forward pass. Applying MCTP to recent pretrained models, we observe that most, such as DINOv3, maintain a similar ranking of token importance at every depth (high Coherent Aggregation), while SigLIP 2 does not. This coherence requires predictions to survive pruning, which depends on keeping high-norm "sink" tokens: prefix tokens are kept by design, while prefix-free SigLIP 2 forms them on patch tokens, which pruning may remove. We show that in removing DINOv3's prefix tokens, its predictions and coherence collapse, while protecting only 5 tokens for SigLIP 2 cuts the token impact outside the object's bounding box by up to 62%. Beyond this, MCTP offers a post-hoc method to evaluate how a pretrained ViT responds to pruning, and suggests that token reduction methods should keep "sinks".

AI.tldr: 提出MCTP（蒙特卡洛Token剪枝）用于事后评估预训练ViT对token剪枝的响应，发现DINOv3具高"连贯聚合"（各深度token重要性排序一致），SigLIP 2则不具；差异源于高范数"sink"token的保留与否。
AI.motivation: 现有工作多比较不同token缩减算法的优劣，却缺乏对模型本身如何响应剪枝、以及这种响应随深度如何变化的研究；需要一种衡量token对预测影响的统一手段。
AI.method: MCTP在前向传播中显式移除token，并多次采样以蒙特卡洛方式估计每个token对预测的影响（impact）；用该指标在多个深度上计算token重要性排序的一致性，定义为"连贯聚合"（Coherent Aggregation）；对DINOv3、SigLIP 2等近期预训练模型进行对照分析，并做移除前缀token、保护少量sink token的干预实验。
AI.result: DINOv3等多数模型在各深度保持相似的token重要性排序（高连贯性），SigLIP 2则不然。连贯性依赖预测在剪枝下存活，而这取决于保留高范数"sink"token：前缀token按设计被保留，无前缀的SigLIP 2则在patch token上形成sink，易被剪枝移除。移除DINOv3的前缀token导致其预测与连贯性崩塌；仅保护SigLIP 2的5个token，可使物体边界框外的token影响最多降低62%。
AI.conclusion: MCTP提供了一种事后评估预训练ViT剪枝响应的有效方法；模型间连贯性差异主要由sink token的存留决定，因此token缩减方法应显式保留"sink"token。

title: SAMA: Training-Free Consensus Ridge Tracking for Camera-Based Heart Rate on Five Public Datasets
summary: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) is usually benchmarked by one heart rate per video, a figure that hides the short windows in which a tele-consultation would actually read the pulse. We present SAMA, a training-free estimator that (i) forms a quality-weighted consensus of POS and CHROM chrominance spectra, (ii) discounts frequencies occupied by pulse-free references derived from the same frames (frame motion, skin-mask geometry and background brightness), (iii) follows the heart rate through time with a Viterbi ridge under a random-walk prior, and (iv) returns a track-filtered, amplitude-normalised waveform with a per-window confidence. No parameter is learned and no dataset-specific tuning is used. On 218 recordings from 111 participants in five public datasets (UBFC-rPPG, PURE, SUMS, M3PD and a two-participant subset of MMPD), all processed with the same fixed face box and scored with a re-implementation of the rPPG-Toolbox protocol, SAMA has the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) averaged over datasets at every protocol level: 4.40 against 5.13,bpm for POS per video, 4.80 against 5.43 on 30,s windows and 5.05 against 6.59 on 10,s windows. Pooled over participants, the bootstrap interval of its paired difference from POS excludes zero on 30,s and 10,s windows (Wilcoxon p=0.11 and 0.004) but not per video, and it does not beat POS on SUMS per video or on the MMPD subset. Withholding the 20\% least confident windows lowers the pooled 10,s error from 4.06 to 2.33,bpm. We also show that the per-video protocol has a floor of 1.2--1.6,bpm on datasets where heart rate drifts, and that skin tone cannot be recovered from uncalibrated video, which motivates the instrumented, skin-tone-stratified collection we propose for the Indian population. The method does not surpass the best published neural networks on UBFC-rPPG; we report where it stands against them without re-running them.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的rPPG短窗估计器SAMA，在五个公开数据集上各类协议层级均取得最低MAE，并揭示逐视频协议的性能下限与肤色不可恢复问题。
AI.motivation: 现有rPPG评测通常以整段视频单一心率衡量，掩盖了远程问诊实际所需的短窗读数表现；同时缺乏免训练、无数据集特异调参的稳健估计方法，且肤色偏差评测条件不足。
AI.method: SAMA为免训练框架：对POS与CHROM色度谱做质量加权共识；利用同帧无脉搏参考（帧间运动、皮肤掩膜几何、背景亮度）扣除其占据的频段；在随机游走先验下用Viterbi脊线跟踪心率随时间变化；输出经轨迹滤波、幅度归一化的波形及逐窗置信度。全程无参数学习、无数据集特异调优；218段录制、111名被试、5个数据集统一固定人脸框，采用rPPG-Toolbox协议重实现评测。
AI.result: 数据集中平均MAE在所有协议层级最低：逐视频4.40 vs POS 5.13 bpm，30 s窗4.80 vs 5.43，10 s窗5.05 vs 6.59。被试池化后，与POS配对差的bootstrap区间在30 s与10 s窗不含零（Wilcoxon p=0.11与0.004），逐视频则不含零结论不成立；SUMS逐视频与MMPD子集上未优于POS。剔除置信度最低20%窗口后，10 s窗池化误差由4.06降至2.33 bpm。另显示逐视频协议在心率漂移数据集上存在1.2–1.6 bpm下限，且未标定视频无法恢复肤色，据此提出面向印度人群的仪器化、分肤色采集方案。在UBFC-rPPG上未超过最佳已发表神经网络（引用对比，未复跑）。
AI.conclusion: SAMA以零训练、零调参方式提升短窗rPPG心率估计并给出逐窗置信度，可用于筛选可靠读数；但其增益未在所有数据集与协议层级上显著，逐视频协议本身存在评测下限，肤色公平性需依赖仪器化分层采集。

title: Modern Self-Supervised Vision Transformers Are Pareidolic
summary: In human perception, pareidolia is the tendency to perceive a meaningful pattern, such as a face, in a random or ambiguous stimulus.We find a similar phenomenon in modern self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs): on white noise, which contains neither objects nor spatial structure, a few directions of their features still form spatially coherent patterns across the patches, imposed by the features themselves.We call this behavior pareidolia, and the span of these directions the pareidolic subspace.On natural images, it holds most of the feature variance in DINOv2 and DINOv3 but little in DINO.This excess explains why DINOv2 and DINOv3, despite stronger dense features, fall far behind DINO in object emergence, the hallmark ability of self-supervised ViTs to identify the patches of an object on their own.Our experiments further show that scaling down their pareidolic subspaces steadily restores their ability to discover objects, so their object emergence is hindered rather than lost.These findings naturally lead to a training-free calibration: Pareidolia Subspace Calibration(PSC) measures the pareidolic subspace only on a noise input and then calibrates the features of natural inputs by scaling its directions down to the variance level of the remaining directions.Across diverse object emergence tasks, PSC improves DINOv2 and DINOv3 by up to 31.7 CorLoc on object discovery, 30.2 maxF on saliency detection and 59.9~$\mathcal{J}$ on video object segmentation.To identify the cause of pareidolia, we trace it block by block and find that it forms in the middle blocks of every self-supervised model we examine but stays strong to the last block only in models trained with a patch-level loss; controlled training confirms that an image-level loss alone lets it fade.

AI.tldr: 论文提出自监督ViT中的"幻想性视错觉"(pareidolia)现象：在白噪声上特征仍有空间连贯方向，形成占主导方差的"pareidolic子空间"，它阻碍了物体的突出涌现；提出无需训练的子空间校准(PSC)，在DINOv2/DINOv3上显著提升物体发现、显著性检测与视频目标分割性能。
AI.motivation: DINOv2与DINOv3的稠密特征更强，却在"物体涌现"(object emergence，即模型自发生成物体patch聚类)能力上远落后于DINO。作者希望找出这一反差的成因并加以修正。
AI.method: 1) 在纯白噪声输入上探测特征方向，发现其仍形成跨patch的空间连贯模式，定义为pareidolia，对应方向张成pareidolic子空间；2) 量化该子空间在自然图像特征方差中的占比；3) 通过按比例缩小其方向验证其对物体涌现的因果作用；4) 提出Pareidolia Subspace Calibration(PSC)：仅在噪声输入上测量该子空间，对自然输入特征将该方向方差缩放到其余方向的方差水平，无需训练；5) 逐block追踪该现象的形成位置，并用受控训练验证损失类型的影响。
AI.result: 该子空间在DINOv2/DINOv3中占据大部分特征方差，而在DINO中较少；逐步缩小它可稳定恢复物体发现能力；PSC在多种物体涌现任务上带来最多31.7 CorLoc(物体发现)、30.2 maxF(显著性检测)、59.9 𝒥(视频目标分割)的提升。逐block分析显示该现象在所有自监督模型的中层块形成，但仅在使用patch级损失的模型中持续到最后一层；受控实验表明仅用图像级损失可使其衰减。
AI.conclusion: DINOv2/DINOv3的物体涌现能力是被pareidolic子空间"遮蔽"而非丧失；该子空间源于patch级训练损失；PSC作为一种即插即用、无需训练的校准方法可有效释放其物体发现潜力。

title: WorldLatent: A Unified 4D Latent Space for World Perception and Generation
summary: Generative Pre-Training (GPT) represents a profound milestone in natural language processing, serving as the foundation for most of today's state-of-the-art large language models. By casting diverse understanding and generation problems into a shared token representation, GPT enables a single architecture and unified optimization loop to master heterogeneous tasks across massive corpora, giving rise to powerful foundation models for natural language. In contrast, 4D spatiotemporal vision lacks a common representational protocol: perception (such as depth and camera estimation) and generation are either handled by separate one-way pipelines or bolted together from unaligned single-modality spaces. In this work, we introduce WorldLatent, a framework that formulates a unified 4D latent space as a common protocol for both world perception and generation. Rather than relying on fragmented, task-specific models or stacked single-modality representations, our framework proposes a multimodal VAE architecture that compresses and fuses complex 4D visual appearance, geometry, and dynamics into a single structured latent representation. Within this formulation, perception and generation operate as complementary denoising processes over the same latent space, enabling one generative model to learn both capabilities simultaneously within a single training loop. Experiments across representative 4D benchmarks verify that our fused latent protocol achieves specialist-level zero-shot 4D perception, coherent 4D generation, and controllable editing from a single model. By demonstrating that diverse 4D tasks can be seamlessly unified under a shared representational protocol, our work provides a scalable foundation for general-purpose 4D spatial intelligence.

AI.tldr: WorldLatent 提出统一的 4D 潜空间协议，用多模态 VAE 将外观、几何与动态压缩融合为结构化潜表示，使感知与生成成为同一潜空间上的互补去噪过程，并由单一生成模型在一个训练循环中同时学习。
AI.motivation: GPT 通过共享 token 表示统一了自然语言的理解与生成任务，但 4D 时空视觉缺乏通用表示协议：感知（如深度、相机估计）与生成要么被拆成单向流水线，要么由未对齐的单模态空间拼接而成，导致模型碎片化、任务专用化。
AI.method: 构建多模态 VAE 架构，将 4D 视觉的外观、几何与动力学压缩并融合为单一结构化潜表示，作为感知与生成的共同协议；在该公式下，感知与生成均被建模为同一潜空间上的去噪过程，从而由单一生成模型在单次训练循环中同时习得两类能力。
