AI.result: 在代表性 4D 基准上，融合潜协议实现专家级零样本 4D 感知、连贯的 4D 生成以及可控编辑，且全部来自单一模型。
AI.conclusion: 多样的 4D 任务可在统一表示协议下无缝整合，为通用 4D 空间智能提供了可扩展的基础范式。

title: Analyzing and Improving FlowMap Distillation of Autoregressive Video Models
summary: FlowMap distillation offers a natural route to few-step generative modeling by directly learning a teacher's denoising trajectories. Yet for autoregressive (AR) video generation, existing few-step models still rely on distribution matching distillation (DMD) to remain competitive, sacrificing sample diversity and requiring a large bidirectional teacher. In this work, we analyze what limits standalone AR FlowMap distillation and introduce two complementary guidance mechanisms to close this gap: (1) anti-drifting guidance, which helps the AR teacher correct drifted student rollouts by training an auxiliary model to mimic student drift and using it as a negative guidance branch; and (2) motion-aware guidance, which makes motion easier for a FlowMap student to learn by locating motion patches and selectively applying skip-layer guidance. Empirically, our approach applies to $π$-Flow, MeanFlow, and consistency distillation with 1.3B AR teachers, improving generation quality and reducing drift over 30 s rollouts. Notably, our 4-step $π$-Flow students match DMD students distilled from 14B teachers on VBench while preserving the sample diversity of their AR teachers, demonstrating that pure FlowMap distillation is effective for few-step autoregressive video generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析并突破自回归视频生成中FlowMap蒸馏的限制，提出"反漂移引导"与"运动感知引导"两种互补引导机制，使纯FlowMap蒸馏在少步AR视频生成上首次达到DMD水平，同时保留样本多样性。
AI.motivation: FlowMap蒸馏通过直接学习教师的去噪轨迹，是少步生成建模的自然路径。但在自回归（AR）视频生成中，现有少步模型仍需依赖分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）才能保持竞争力，代价是牺牲样本多样性，且需要大规模双向教师模型。因此需要弄清：是什么限制了独立的AR FlowMap蒸馏。
AI.method: 提出两种互补引导机制：(1) 反漂移引导（anti-drifting guidance）：训练一个辅助模型模仿学生漂移行为，将其作为负向引导分支，帮助AR教师纠正已漂移的学生rollout；(2) 运动感知引导（motion-aware guidance）：定位运动patch并有选择地施加skip-layer引导，降低FlowMap学生学习运动的难度。方法可通用于π-Flow、MeanFlow与一致性蒸馏。
AI.result: 在1.3B AR教师下，方法适用于π-Flow、MeanFlow和一致性蒸馏，提升了生成质量并在30秒rollout中减少漂移。4步π-Flow学生在VBench上与从14B教师蒸馏的DMD学生相当，同时保留了其AR教师的样本多样性。
AI.conclusion: 纯FlowMap蒸馏可有效用于少步自回归视频生成，无需依赖DMD即可兼顾质量与多样性，并可用更小的教师模型达到大模型DMD的蒸馏效果。

title: DriveDreamer-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Driving Perception and Agentic Data Generation
summary: Controllable generation can expand training data for driving perception, but visual realism alone does not ensure learning gains. Effective generation must adapt both what data to generate and how to construct them as the perception model evolves. In this paper, we present DriveDreamer-RSI, a framework for recursive self-improvement of driving perception and agentic data generation through feedback between perception learning and data construction. Its outer loop implements Gap-Guided Target Adaptation, generating labeled videos from current perception gaps and updating targets after training. Its inner loop uses a vision-language agent to iteratively edit scenes through observation and execution feedback. Across rounds, Learning-Feedback-Driven Strategy Refinement derives reusable construction advice from execution experience and downstream learning outcomes. On the nuScenes validation set, DriveDreamer-RSI surpasses the dataset-replay baseline by 4.09 mAP and 4.13 NDS points using approximately half the synthetic frames.

AI.tldr: DriveDreamer-RSI：以感知学习与数据构建之间的反馈闭环实现驾驶感知的递归自我提升与智能体化数据生成，用约一半合成帧在nuScenes val上超过数据回放基线4.09 mAP与4.13 NDS。
AI.motivation: 可控生成可扩充驾驶感知训练数据，但仅追求视觉真实感并不能保证学习收益；有效生成必须随感知模型演化，同时适配"生成什么数据"与"如何构建数据"。
AI.method: 统一框架含双向反馈与双层循环：外循环为Gap-Guided Target Adaptation，依据当前感知差距生成带标注视频，训练后更新目标；内循环使用视觉-语言智能体，通过观测反馈与执行反馈迭代编辑场景；跨轮次由Learning-Feedback-Driven Strategy Refinement从执行经验与下游学习结果中提炼可复用的构建策略建议。
AI.result: nuScenes验证集上，相较数据集回放基线提升4.09 mAP与4.13 NDS，且仅使用约一半的合成帧。
AI.conclusion: 数据生成应以感知模型的动态差距与下游学习反馈为驱动，闭环式自提升范式可在更低数据成本下获得更优感知性能。

title: WeMM-Ecom: Advancing Multimodal Content Understanding for WeChat E-Commerce
summary: We present WeMM-Ecom, a family of multimodal large language models that deliver frontier e-commerce capabilities while achieving state-of-the-art general-purpose performance at their respective scales. The family spans five sizes, from a 0.8B dense model to a 35B mixture-of-experts model with 3B active parameters. Our training pipeline begins with two-stage continued pre-training that progressively raises the proportion of e-commerce data within a diverse multimodal data mixture, followed by hybrid-thinking post-training that combines on-policy distillation and reinforcement learning to support both non-thinking and thinking modes. For evaluation, we construct a comprehensive suite of 28 e-commerce benchmarks (23 in-house and five open-source) covering eight business scenarios and complement it with 64 public general-purpose benchmarks. On the e-commerce suite, WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B surpasses substantially larger open-source flagship models, including Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, HY4, and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. On the general-purpose suite, every WeMM-Ecom model surpasses its similarly sized Qwen3.5 counterpart, with the lightweight variants (e.g., WeMM-Ecom-2B) showing clear advantages over leading lightweight models such as Qwen3.5-2B, MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B, and LFM3-VL-2B. Beyond benchmarks, WeMM-Ecom now powers hundreds of production use cases in WeChat, including catalog management, multimodal product search, and livestream commerce, serving billion-scale requests per day. We publicly release all model weights and detail our data curation, training recipe, and benchmark construction to facilitate future work on domain-specialized multimodal models. We have released the model weights and code to facilitate future research at https://github.com/Tencent/WeMM-Ecom.

AI.tldr: 提出电商多模态大模型系列 WeMM-Ecom（0.8B稠密—35B MoE/3B激活），经两阶段续训+混合思考后训练，在28项电商与64项通用基准上表现领先，并已在微信大规模落地。
AI.motivation: 现有通用多模态大模型在电商领域能力不足，而领域专用模型往往牺牲通用性能；本文旨在同时获得前沿的电商能力与同规模下最优的通用性能。
AI.method: 构建五个规模（0.8B稠密至35B MoE、激活3B）的模型族。训练流程：①两阶段继续预训练，在多模态数据混合中渐进提高电商数据比例；②混合思考后训练，结合on-policy蒸馏与强化学习，同时支持非思考与思考两种模式。评测方面自建28个电商基准（23个内部+5个开源，覆盖8类业务场景）及64个公开通用基准。
AI.result: WeMM-Ecom-35B-A3B在电商套件上显著超越更大规模开源旗舰模型；通用套件上每个规模均优于同规模 Qwen3.5 对应版本，轻量版本（如2B）优于 Qwen3.5-2B、MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B、LFM3-VL-2B 等。模型已在微信数百个生产场景（商品目录管理、多模态商品搜索、直播电商）落地，日请求量达十亿级。
AI.conclusion: 公开全部模型权重，并详述数据构建、训练配方与基准构建方法，为领域专用多模态模型研究提供参考（GitHub: Tencent/WeMM-Ecom）。

title: Motion on Demand: Adaptive Optical Excitation for Event Cameras
summary: Event cameras respond only to brightness changes, so whether an edge is visible depends on image motion perpendicular to it---a motion that constantly shifts with camera and scene dynamics. Rotating a wedge prism in front of the lens introduces controlled image motion to reveal static or slow edges. However, a fixed rotation speed cannot adapt to changing motion conditions: when natural motion is already sufficient, additional optical excitation generates redundant events and introduces unnecessary alignment errors. Inspired by the division of labor between fast haltere feedforward and slower visual feedback in fly gaze control, we present EvGaze, an event camera system that adaptively regulates prism rotation speed. EvGaze employs a learned multimodal controller that integrates luminance, event, and inertial observations, with a fast inertial pathway that refines speed decisions between visual updates. To preserve geometric consistency during speed changes, we compensate for prism-induced image motion at individual event timestamps using measured encoder angles. On EvMotion, EvGaze recovers more edges than full-speed prism rotation with 39% fewer events. On DSEC with simulated optical modulation, it reaches 0.73 feature-tracking success (compared with 0.55 on native events and 0.67 at 180 RPM) while generating 26% fewer events than 360 RPM. Real-device experiments further demonstrate online closed-loop adaptation, reducing average event rates by 17% relative to full-speed rotation.

AI.tldr: EvGaze 是受苍蝇平衡棒前馈与视觉反馈分工启发的旋转楔形棱镜事件相机系统，通过多模态学习控制器自适应调节棱镜转速，在边缘恢复与特征跟踪指标上兼顾事件稀疏性与几何一致性。
AI.motivation: 事件相机仅响应亮度变化，边缘可见性取决于垂直于边缘的图像运动，而该运动随相机与场景动态不断变化，导致静态或慢速边缘无法被激发。旋转楔形棱镜可引入受控图像运动以显露边缘，但固定转速无法适应变化：自然运动已充足时，额外光学激励会产生冗余事件并带来不必要的对齐误差。
AI.method: 提出 EvGaze：利用学习型多模态控制器融合亮度、事件与惯性观测来自适应调节棱镜转速，其中快速惯性通路在两次视觉更新之间细化速度决策；在转速变化时，依据编码器实测角度在单个事件时间戳上补偿棱镜引起的图像运动，以保持几何一致性。
AI.result: 在 EvMotion 上，EvGaze 相比全速棱镜旋转恢复更多边缘且事件数减少 39%；在 DSEC（模拟光学调制）上特征跟踪成功率达 0.73（原生事件 0.55，180 RPM 时 0.67），同时事件数比 360 RPM 少 26%；真机实验展示在线闭环自适应，平均事件率相比全速旋转降低 17%。
AI.conclusion: 以生物启发的快慢分工结构与事件级几何补偿，实现棱镜转速的自适应闭环调控，在提升边缘可见性与特征跟踪性能的同时显著降低事件冗余，兼顾了性能与带宽效率。

title: Advancements in Diabetic Retinopathy Classification Using Novel Multi-Stacked U-Net Architectures
summary: Diabetes leads to several health complications throughout the body, with the complication in the eyes being Diabetic Retinopathy. It leads to damaging or abnormal changes in the blood vessels' structure, causing vision loss. The need for massive screening of a large population of diabetic patients has created a necessity for computer-aided, fully automatic diagnosis of DR. CNNs have shown great promise in the classification of DR based on the Fundus images. Building a reliable model faces considerable challenges due to the limited availability of high-quality annotated datasets and issues with varying image quality and class imbalances. This paper aims to demonstrate the UNET, and its Stacked Architecture variant and their performance across several datasets. This paper has compared and studied the UNET architecture's performance across multiple stacks and has come to a soft conclusion that the architecture performs its best at three stacks, and any more leads to deterioration of its performance. The model aims at classifying the images into five categories, 0 to 4, where 0 is no DR, and 4 is proliferative DR.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了UNET及其堆叠（Stacked）变体在多个眼底图像数据集上进行糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）五分类的性能。
AI.motivation: 糖尿病视网膜病变会导致血管结构异常改变并引起视力丧失，大规模筛查糖尿病患者需要计算机辅助的全自动DR诊断。CNN在基于眼底图像的DR分类中表现良好，但高质量标注数据有限、图像质量差异大以及类别不平衡等问题带来挑战。
AI.method: 采用UNET及其堆叠架构（Stacked Architecture）变体，在不同堆叠层数（stacks）下进行实验，并在多个数据集上比较其性能，任务为将图像分为0至4五类（0为无DR，4为增殖性DR）。
AI.result: 实验显示，模型在三个堆叠（three stacks）时性能最佳，继续增加堆叠层数会导致性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 作者给出较为温和（soft）的结论：UNET堆叠架构在三堆叠时表现最优，过多堆叠会带来性能退化。

title: HOSE: Hierarchical Orthogonal Subspace Erasure for Concept Unlearning in Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate harmful or sensitive content, such as pornographic or violent imagery, raising serious security concerns. Model editing has recently emerged as an efficient approach to mitigate this issue. It modifies pretrained models with minimal parameter updates to alter specific concepts while preserving overall model capabilities. However, due to the entangled representations of different concepts in diffusion models, direct modifications inevitably disrupt non-target concepts. Meanwhile, U-Net's hierarchical heterogeneity hinders unified strategies from balancing erasure and quality. To address these issues, we propose Hierarchical Orthogonal Subspace Erasure (HOSE). This method projects parameter updates into the subspace orthogonal to general knowledge, thereby eliminating interference with non-target concepts. Considering the hierarchical heterogeneity of the U-Net architecture, we further propose a hierarchical adaptive mechanism, constructing differentiated subspace projections for different layers to precisely adapt to the model's hierarchical structure, thereby resolving the inherent trade-off between erasure and image quality in unified constraints. Experimental results demonstrate the proposed method reduces harmful content generation by 80% compared with the unedited model. While it inevitably incurs some image quality degradation, it still outperforms other editing-based baselines in terms of quality preservation, and achieves a significantly better trade-off between harmful content suppression and quality loss than these baselines. Notably, our approach demonstrates higher adversarial robustness than existing SOTA method, indicating that the target concepts have been more thoroughly erased. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/sevenqiiu/HOSE.

AI.tldr: 提出层次正交子空间擦除（HOSE），通过将参数更新投影至与通用知识正交的子空间，并按U-Net层级构建差异化子空间约束，在抑制有害内容生成的同时尽量保持图像质量。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型可能生成色情、暴力等有害内容，存在安全隐患。模型编辑虽能以少量参数更新高效改写特定概念，但扩散模型中概念表征相互纠缠，直接修改会破坏非目标概念；同时U-Net的层次异质性使统一编辑策略难以兼顾概念擦除与图像质量。
AI.method: 1）正交子空间擦除：将编辑时的参数更新投影到与通用知识子空间正交的方向，从而消除对非目标概念的干扰；2）层次自适应机制：针对U-Net不同层构建差异化的子空间投影，精确适配其层次结构，缓解统一约束下擦除效果与图像质量之间的内在权衡。
AI.result: 相比未编辑模型，有害内容生成降低约80%；虽存在一定图像质量下降，但质量保持优于其他基于编辑的基线，在有害内容抑制与质量损失之间取得显著更优的权衡；对抗鲁棒性高于现有SOTA方法，说明目标概念被更彻底地擦除。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: HOSE通过正交子空间投影与层次自适应约束，有效缓解概念纠缠与U-Net层次异质性问题，实现了更彻底且更鲁棒的有害概念擦除，并保持了较好的生成质量与更优的擦除—质量权衡。

title: Foundation Model and Radiomics Distance Scores for Post-Hoc Segmentation Failure Detection
comment: Accepted at the UNSURE MICCAI 2026 Workshop
summary: Medical image segmentation models can fail silently when clinical data differs from training data. Deployed models rarely ship with quality control, and are often black boxes. Prior methods that work in this post-hoc failure detection setting still need a separate regression or segmentation model, registration, or access to model internals. We instead propose two failure scores based on the Mahalanobis distance to a labeled reference set. The first uses radiomic shape features of the predicted mask. The second uses frozen foundation model (FM) features, made mask-aware by overlaying the mask on the image, encoding it with a frozen DINOv3, and pooling patch features with more weight on the mask region. We test on multi-site prostate and hippocampus MRI under imaging-protocol and population shift. Ranking cases by predicted failure risk within each site, both scores are competitive with the registration-based (Atlas-RCA) and ensemble-based (pairwise Dice) baselines, without registration that can fail silently or access to individual predictions. Our results show that pooling all test cases into one ranking, as prior work does, rewards ordering sites by difficulty, so a detector can rank sites well, miss failures within them, and still look strong. Within-site evaluation measures true per-case failure. The two evaluation schemes reward different behavior, so we recommend reporting both. The code is available at https://github.com/imigraz/fm-radiomics-failure-detection.

AI.tldr: 提出两种基于马氏距离的失败分数（放射组学形状特征、冻结DINOv3掩码感知特征），在无配准、无需模型内部信息的条件下，与Atlas-RCA和成对Dice基线竞争；并指出全局混排评测会因站点难易排序而虚高，主张同站点内评测并同时报告两种方案。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割模型在临床数据偏离训练分布时会静默失败，部署模型通常缺少质量控制且为黑箱。既有事后失败检测方法依赖额外回归/分割模型、配准或模型内部信息，这些环节本身可能静默失败或不可得。
AI.method: 以标注参考集为基准，计算测试样本到参考集的马氏距离作为两种失败分数：(1) 预测掩码的放射组学形状特征；(2) 冻结基础模型特征——将掩码叠加到图像上形成掩码感知输入，用冻结DINOv3编码，并对图像块特征按与掩码区域的重叠程度加权池化。在多中心前列腺与海马MRI上，考察成像协议偏移与人群偏移，并在站点内按预测失败风险排序评测。
AI.result: 在站点内排序下，两种分数与基于配准的Atlas-RCA和基于集成的成对Dice基线具有竞争力，且无需可能静默失败的配准，也无需访问个体预测。分析表明，将所有测试病例合并为单一排序会奖励"按站点难度排序"，检测器可仅凭站点层面排序良好而漏检站点内失败病例仍表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 站点内评测才能反映真实的逐例失败检测能力，而全局混排与站点内评测奖励不同行为，建议两者同时报告。所提方法提供了轻量、无需配准与模型内部信息的失败检测方案。

title: Write, Evolve, Read: Streaming Cameras into a Persistent World State for 4D Occupancy Forecasting
summary: 4D occupancy forecasting predicts the 3D semantic occupancy of a driving scene seconds ahead. Over a few seconds, the scene changes little while the vehicle moves, so most of the space ahead has already been seen. Sorting the future into unchanged, changed, and unseen space, we find that current camera-based world models fall short on the unchanged part: they fail to hold on to what they have already seen, rather than to forecast what will change. We therefore make what the model has seen its state. PersistWorld streams camera frames into a persistent 3D world state anchored in the scene, writing each frame once instead of rebuilding the state from past frames. The state is learned end to end with the forecast, and an evolver predicts it at any queried time along the ego trajectory. On Occ3D-nuScenes, PersistWorld raises the IoU of the best camera-based world model by 19 points at 1-3 s and by 18 to 24 points up to 8 s, while running more than twice as fast. Code and models: https://github.com/wangzian828/PersistWorld. Project page: https://wangzian828.github.io/PersistWorld

AI.tldr: 提出 PersistWorld，将相机帧流式写入以场景为锚的持久 3D 世界状态，用演化器预测任意查询时刻的占据状态，在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上大幅超越现有相机世界模型。
AI.motivation: 4D 占据预测中，未来空间可分为不变、变化与未见三类；场景数秒内变化很小，未来大部分区域已被观测。现有基于相机的世界模型在"不变空间"上表现最差——无法保持已观测内容，而是一味去预测变化，因此应把"已观测内容"作为模型状态。
AI.method: 构建持久 3D 世界状态，锚定于场景坐标系；每帧相机图像仅写入一次，而非从历史帧重建状态；该状态与预测任务端到端联合学习；由 evolver 沿自车轨迹在任意查询时间点演化该状态以完成预测。
AI.result: 在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上，1–3 s 预测的 IoU 比最佳相机世界模型提升 19 点，8 s 内提升 18–24 点，且运行速度快两倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 将已观测场景显式持久化为世界状态并直接演化，是提升相机端 4D 占据预测精度与效率的有效范式。

title: SVUBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Proactive Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Proactive streaming video understanding requires models to interpret unfolding events, respond timely, and retrieve relevant historical evidence. To systematically evaluate these capabilities, we introduce SVUBench, a comprehensive proactive streaming video benchmark comprising 12,131 questions and 62,881 answer points across ten proactive tasks spanning Perception, Understanding, and Reasoning. Constructed through model-assisted annotation and human verification, SVUBench introduces two complementary interaction modes. Basic evaluates sustained proactive responses from video onset, while Trajectory requires historical recovery and continuous response updates following task activation during streaming. A Duration-Scaled Challenge further evaluates these capabilities across four video duration tiers. We develop the Proactive Response Score (PRS) with task-adaptive answer windows to jointly assess answer correctness, response timeliness, historical consistency, and content quality. Extensive experiments and analysis reveal the strengths and limitations of existing models, highlighting directions for advancing proactive streaming video understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出SVUBench，一个面向主动式流式视频理解的综合基准，含12,131个问题、62,881个答案点、10项任务，并配套Proactive Response Score（PRS）评测指标。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解模型多针对离线整段视频，难以评测流式场景下的实时响应、历史证据回溯与持续更新能力，缺少系统化基准与兼顾正确性、及时性的评价指标。
AI.method: 构建覆盖感知、理解、推理三类共10种主动任务的基准；采用模型辅助标注加人工校验；设计Basic（从视频起始持续响应）与Trajectory（流中任务激活后需回溯历史并持续更新）两种交互模式；引入四档时长分层的Duration-Scaled Challenge；提出带任务自适应答案窗口的PRS指标，联合评估答案正确性、响应及时性、历史一致性与内容质量。
AI.result: 在现有模型上开展大量实验与分层分析，揭示其在主动流式视频理解中的优势与不足，并指明改进方向。
AI.conclusion: SVUBench为主动式流式视频理解提供了系统评测框架，指出模型在及时响应、历史证据检索与持续一致性方面仍存在明显短板。

title: Where Compositionality Hides: Shared-Content Interference in Vision-Language Retrieval
comment: 18 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Code in ancillary files
summary: Paired compositional benchmarks such as Winoground ask each image to prefer its matching caption and each caption to prefer its matching image. A failed Group decision can come from a wrong caption preference or from the cross-image comparison alone, and Group Score merges the two. Choosing between retraining the encoder and changing the scoring rule therefore requires separating them. We study mean-erasure, which projects each frozen image embedding away from the mean of the two normalized candidate captions. We prove that the projection preserves every within-image caption ranking and makes Group Score equal baseline Text Score. On Winoground, mean-erasure raises CLIP ViT-B/32 Group Score from 9% to 31%, and five CLIP and SigLIP checkpoints gain 21 to 27 percentage points. ColorSwap shows a similar gain for color-object binding. A score decomposition shows that about 60% of Image failures already score the correct joint assignment above the swapped one and fail only on an offset between the two images. Fixed corrections and a learned bilinear scorer gain under one point. A direction estimated from retrieved captions gains about five points with two captions and falls below baseline with sixteen. Before retraining an encoder for paired retrieval, measure the Group loss that mean-erasure recovers: gains beyond baseline Text Score require changing the caption decisions themselves.

AI.tldr: 提出 mean-erasure：将冻结图像嵌入向远离两候选字幕均值的方向投影，可在保持图内字幕排序不变的前提下使 Group Score 等于 Text Score，在 Winoground 上将 CLIP ViT-B/32 从 9% 提升到 31%，并指出进一步增益必须来自改变字幕判别本身。
AI.motivation: 成对组合基准（如 Winoground）的 Group 失败可能源于字幕偏好错误，也可能仅源于跨图像比较偏差，Group Score 将二者混在一起，导致无法在"重训编码器"与"改评分规则"之间做出判断，需要将这两种损失来源分离。
AI.method: mean-erasure：对每个冻结图像嵌入，减去两幅归一化候选字幕嵌入均值方向上的投影分量，从而消除跨图像偏移；理论上证明该投影保持每幅图像内的字幕排序不变，并使 Group Score 等于基线 Text Score。另用分数分解定位失败来源，并与固定校正、学习式双线性打分器、由检索字幕估计方向的方案进行对比。
AI.result: Winoground 上 CLIP ViT-B/32 Group Score 由 9% 升至 31%，五个 CLIP 与 SigLIP 检查点提升 21–27 个百分点；ColorSwap 上颜色-物体绑定亦有类似增益。分数分解显示约 60% 的 Image 失败本身已给出正确联合赋值，仅败于两图间偏移。固定校正与学习双线性打分器增益不足 1 点；检索字幕估计方向的方案在两字幕时约提升 5 点，十六字幕时低于基线。
AI.conclusion: 在为成对检索重训编码器之前，应先测量 mean-erasure 可恢复的 Group 损失；超过基线 Text Score 的增益必须通过改变字幕判别决策本身才能获得，单纯改评分规则存在理论上限。

title: Assembly-JEPA: Using World Models for Fine-Grained Industrial Image Verification
summary: Automated verification of industrial assembly processes remains a challenging problem due to substantial visual variability, limited availability of labeled defect data, and the fine-grained nature of many assembly errors. Existing approaches often rely on object detection, CAD models, or supervised classification pipelines, which can struggle to generalize across changing products and assembly configurations. In this work, we propose a novel self-supervised assembly verification framework based on Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs). Starting from the JEPA-based world model LeWorldModel, we investigate how the architecture must be adapted to verify the correctness of fine-grained assembly operations. To this end, we formulate assembly verification as a predictive world modeling task operating on before-and-after observations of assembly processes. Experimental results on industrial assembly tasks demonstrate that the proposed approach reliably detects both fine-grained incorrect assembly states and action-state mismatches, achieving an AUROC of 86.9% on a newly introduced assembly verification dataset. These results indicate that JEPA-based predictive representations constitute a promising foundation for robust and data-efficient industrial assembly verification.

AI.tldr: 提出基于JEPA自监督世界模型的装配验证框架，将装配正确性判定建模为前后观测的预测式世界建模任务，在新建数据集上AUROC达86.9%。
AI.motivation: 工业装配自动验证面临视觉变化大、缺陷标注数据稀缺、错误粒度细微等困难；现有依赖目标检测、CAD模型或监督分类的方法难以跨产品与装配配置泛化。因此需要数据高效、可泛化的自监督方案。
AI.method: 以JEPA-based世界模型LeWorldModel为起点，针对细粒度装配操作验证需求改造架构；将装配验证重构为在装配过程"前—后"观测上运行的预测式世界建模任务，利用自监督预测表征检测错误装配状态及动作—状态不匹配。
AI.result: 在工业装配任务实验中，方法能可靠检测细粒度错误装配状态与动作-状态不匹配；在新引入的装配验证数据集上取得86.9%的AUROC。
AI.conclusion: JEPA式预测表征可作为稳健、数据高效的工业装配验证基础，为减少对标注缺陷数据与CAD模型的依赖提供了可行路径。

title: Field-Level Crop Classification via Similarity-Induced Supervision from Imperfect Labels
summary: Regional-scale crop mapping is critical for food production monitoring, yet remains challenging in tropical regions, where persistent cloud cover limits optical imagery. Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) enables continuous observation throughout the agricultural cycle, but a second obstacle is label quality: national-scale land cover products exhibit systematic biases that underestimate less prevalent crops, and training directly on them inherits and amplifies their errors. This work proposes a methodology to build large-scale crop classification models from imperfect public land cover products, requiring no new field campaign, ground survey, or manual label correction. The approach combines two mechanisms. The first reduces the semantic inconsistency of the labels by shifting supervision from the sample level to the group level: a similarity-based clustering model organizes SAR time series into coherent groups, and noisy labels are used only to assign each group its most representative class. The resulting clusters are highly pure with respect to the reference classes (89.0% and 91.2% in the two study regions). The second reduces the spatial inconsistency of the predictions: a segmentation model delineates crop field boundaries from optical imagery, and patch-level predictions are consolidated by majority voting within each field, yielding spatially coherent maps. Evaluated in two Brazilian municipalities, Campo Verde (Mato Grosso) and Luís Eduardo Magalhães (Bahia), the approach consistently outperforms the noisy baseline in mean class accuracy, with gains of up to 10.14 percentage points, especially for minority crops. A state-scale analysis across Mato Grosso and Bahia shows stable behavior without further model adjustment, and the derived municipal crop areas are consistent with official IBGE/PAM statistics, an independent estimate the model never observes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅依赖不完美公共土地覆盖产品的区域尺度热带作物制图方法：用相似度聚类将SAR时序分组并以组级标签降噪，用光学影像分割田块并以田内多数投票平滑预测，在巴西两市区平均类别精度提升最多10.14个百分点，州级面积与官方统计一致。
AI.motivation: 热带地区持久云覆盖限制光学观测，SAR可全生育期连续观测；但国家尺度土地覆盖产品存在系统性偏差（低估稀有作物），直接训练会继承并放大标签误差，且无新野外调查或人工纠错条件。
AI.method: 双机制：(1) 语义一致性——将监督从样本级上移至组级，用基于相似度的聚类模型把SAR时序组织为一致簇，噪声标签仅用于为每簇分配最具代表性类别；(2) 空间一致性——用分割模型从光学影像勾绘田块边界，在田块内对像元级预测进行多数投票整合。
AI.result: 两个研究区簇相对参考类别的纯度达89.0%和91.2%；在Campo Verde（马托格罗索）与Luís Eduardo Magalhães（巴伊亚）平均类别精度较噪声基线提升至多10.14个百分点，少数作物受益明显；跨两州州级分析无需再调参即稳定，且推得的市域作物面积与模型从未观测的IBGE/PAM官方统计一致。
AI.conclusion: 无需新地面调查或人工标注修正，即可从不完美公共产品构建大尺度、空间连贯的SAR作物分类模型，具备跨区域可迁移性，并以独立官方统计验证了可靠性。

title: Test-Time Latent Computation to Improve Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Recent work on Large Language Models (LLMs) suggests that reasoning capabilities can be enhanced at test time not only through longer token-level reasoning traces, but also through additional computation in latent space. This raises a natural question for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs): can additional computation in latent space improve visual perception at test time? In this work, we first verify that MLLMs contain stable reusable layers that can be re-forwarded at inference time without disrupting normal generation. Based on this observation, we propose \textbf{Lo}ok \textbf{Ba}ck in the \textbf{L}atent \textbf{S}pace (\textbf{Lobals}), a training-free decoding method that identifies the contiguous layer window with the strongest visual-token attention and re-forwards through it, allowing the model to revisit visual evidence in latent space. We demonstrate that this latent-space revisit strategy can improve MLLMs' performance across diverse multimodal settings, including general vision-language tasks, visual hallucination tasks, and vision-centric tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的Lobals解码方法，通过在潜空间重放视觉注意力最强的连续层窗口，增强MLLM的视觉感知能力。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明LLM可在测试时通过潜空间额外计算提升推理能力，作者由此提问：潜空间额外计算能否同样提升MLLM的视觉感知？
AI.method: 先验证MLLM中存在可复用、可在推理时重新前向而不破坏正常生成的稳定层；据此提出Lobals：免训练解码方法，识别对视觉token注意力最强的连续层窗口，并对该窗口重新前向，使模型在潜空间"回看"视觉证据。
AI.result: 在通用视觉语言任务、视觉幻觉任务与视觉中心任务等多类多模态场景中，该潜空间回看策略均带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间计算扩展可有效增强MLLM视觉感知，且无需额外训练，为多模态推理时计算提供新思路。

title: Target-Part Preference Optimization for Part-Aware 3D Generation
summary: Part-aware 3D generation requires not only globally plausible objects but also complete, well-separated semantic parts, yet high-quality part decompositions remain too scarce to support large-scale supervised fine-tuning. We study whether preference fine-tuning based on Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) can adapt a pretrained part-aware generator from limited part-annotated data without architectural changes. We rank candidates generated with different random seeds against ground-truth (GT) geometric metrics, and select the (object, target-part) examples with the largest across-seed quality gap. Each selected example stores a seed pair whose two flow trajectories share one clean GT compositional latent and differ only in Gaussian noise. We derive a reference-relative target-block preference loss from FlowDPO that compares the two trajectories against a frozen reference model. GT flow-matching losses on the target block and complete part set provide absolute supervision, while only the diffusion transformer (DiT) is updated. Human-ranked controls test an alternative ordering source, and synthetic cropping provides controlled loser targets that are incomplete by construction. Among the three training-set scales, the medium-scale setting gives the strongest result on held-out Objaverse and outperforms both the pretrained generator and the reported direct supervised fine-tuning baseline on the multi-part aggregate. Further analysis shows sensitivity to pair ordering, target-part coverage, and the balance between pairwise and GT supervision. Cross-dataset experiments show less consistent gains under distribution shift.

AI.tldr: 本文研究能否在不改动架构的前提下，用基于DPO的偏好微调，将预训练部件感知3D生成器从有限的部件标注数据中适配出来；通过筛选跨随机种子质量差距最大的(object, target-part)样本构造偏好对，仅更新DiT，在中等规模训练集上取得最佳效果。
AI.motivation: 部件感知3D生成需要全局合理且完整、分离良好的语义部件，但高质量部件分解数据稀缺，难以支撑大规模监督微调。
AI.method: 用不同随机种子生成候选并与GT几何指标比较排序，选出跨种子质量差距最大的(object, target-part)样本；每个样本存储一对共享同一干净GT组合潜变量、仅高斯噪声不同的种子流轨迹。由FlowDPO导出参考模型相对的target-block偏好损失，比较两条轨迹与冻结参考模型；同时用GT flow-matching损失在target block和完整部件集上提供绝对监督，仅更新DiT。另设人工排序对照与合成裁剪（构造性不完整loser）实验。
AI.result: 三种训练规模中，中等规模在留出Objaverse上表现最强，在多部件聚合指标上优于预训练生成器与已报告的直接监督微调基线；分析显示对配对顺序、目标部件覆盖度及成对监督与GT监督的平衡较敏感；跨数据集实验显示分布偏移下增益不一致。
AI.conclusion: DPO式偏好微调可在无架构改动下有效适配部件感知生成器，但效果受数据规模、样本构造与分布一致性影响，泛化到新分布时收益不稳定。

title: Struct2Det: Grounding Category Structure in Visual Evidence for Few-Shot Object Detection
summary: Few-shot detectors struggle to distinguish categories that look alike but differ in local components, because a few examples rarely reveal which differences determine category identity. Category descriptions specify components and relations but do not establish their presence in an image. We propose Struct2Det, which uses category structure to guide detection and verify candidates in three stages. Relational Structure Encoding maps category graphs to component embeddings and a global condition. Component-Grounded Detection uses component queries to retrieve multi-scale image evidence that, with the global condition, modulates category text embeddings for initial detection. Verification-Guided Refinement matches candidate regions with components expected by their top-scoring categories; when class scores are close and matches are reliable, matched pairs correct region features before the shared detector predicts again. Category structure informs both classification inputs: text embeddings integrate image-wide component evidence, while region features incorporate candidate-specific matches. We also construct InduSym, with 88,912 symbol instances across 275 categories from 674 engineering drawings and a structural graph per category. Struct2Det improves few-shot-category AP over the strongest baseline by 6.02 points on InduSym and 9.68 on Digitize-PID, with the highest base-category AP on both. InduSym ablations show few-shot gains from correct category structure, image-level retrieval, and candidate verification. Further tests show gains in few-shot natural-object detection and zero-shot Chinese character recognition.

AI.tldr: 提出Struct2Det，利用类别的部件-关系结构图引导少样本检测，通过关系结构编码、部件接地检测与验证引导精化三阶段，将类别结构同时注入文本嵌入与区域特征；并构建包含275类、88,912个实例的工程图纸数据集InduSym，少样本类别AP分别提升6.02与9.68点。
AI.motivation: 少样本检测器难以区分外观相似但局部部件不同的类别，因为少量样本难以揭示决定类别身份的关键差异；而现有类别描述虽给出部件与关系，却无法确认这些部件是否真实出现在图像中。
AI.method: 三阶段框架：(1) 关系结构编码（Relational Structure Encoding）将类别图映射为部件嵌入与全局条件；(2) 部件接地检测（Component-Grounded Detection）用部件查询检索多尺度图像证据，并结合全局条件调制类别文本嵌入以完成初始检测；(3) 验证引导精化（Verification-Guided Refinement）将候选区域与其最高分类别所预期的部件进行匹配，在类别分数接近且匹配可靠时用匹配对修正区域特征，再由共享检测器重新预测。
AI.result: 在InduSym上少样本类别AP较最强基线提升6.02点，在Digitize-PID上提升9.68点，且两者均取得最高基类AP；消融显示增益来自正确的类别结构、图像级检索与候选验证；在少样本自然物体检测与零样本汉字识别上亦有提升。
AI.conclusion: 类别结构可同时为分类的两类输入提供信息（文本嵌入融合全图部件证据，区域特征融合候选特定匹配），从而有效缓解少样本下细粒度部件差异的判别困难；新构建的InduSym数据集（674张工程图纸、275类、88,912个符号实例及每类结构图）为该方向提供了评测基准。

title: Spatial-Zero: Self-Evolving Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models from Zero Data
comment: 19 pages, including appendices. 4 figures and 3 tables in the main text
summary: Spatial reasoning requires a vision-language model~(VLM) to understand metric distances, three-dimensional relationships, and viewpoint-dependent geometry. Learning these capabilities typically requires externally curated training data. This paper introduces Spatial-Zero, a VLMs' training framework that can self-evolve through autonomous spatial exploration with zero data. Spatial-Zero addresses two key challenges in autonomous spatial exploration: reliably generating valid spatial interaction tasks and providing accurate supervision for learning from these tasks. Specifically, a proposer specifies object configurations and questions, and a Coder turns them into executable scene programs that produce multi-view images and explicit scene geometry. A Geometric Oracle checks spatial constraints, visibility, and answer uniqueness and derives ground-truth labels from executed geometry; these labels supervise the Solver and ground difficulty feedback, while validation outcomes guide subsequent task generation. Across six spatial reasoning benchmarks and three VLM backbones, Spatial-Zero yields consistent gains through iterative self-evolution. After three iterations, Qwen3.5-9B improves average accuracy by 3.23 percentage points; with Qwen3.5-4B, Spatial-Zero also outperforms existing VLM self-evolution methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/YutongLi2024/Spatial-Zero

AI.tldr: Spatial-Zero：零数据、通过自主空间探索自演化的VLM训练框架，用可执行场景程序+几何预言机自动生成并校验空间任务，三次迭代使Qwen3.5-9B平均准确率提升3.23个百分点。
AI.motivation: 空间推理要求VLM理解度量距离、三维关系与视角依赖几何，而现有方法通常依赖人工外部策划的训练数据，成本高且难以规模化。作者希望实现零人工数据下的空间能力自我演化。
AI.method: 框架由四部分组成：Proposer指定物体配置与问题；Coder将配置转成可执行场景程序，渲染多视角图像并输出显式场景几何；Geometric Oracle校验空间约束、可见性与答案唯一性，并从执行几何中推导真值标签；这些标签用于监督Solver并给出难度反馈，校验结果反过来引导后续任务生成，形成迭代自演化闭环。
AI.result: 在六个空间推理基准、三个VLM主干上均取得一致提升；迭代三次后Qwen3.5-9B平均准确率提升3.23个百分点；在Qwen3.5-4B上亦优于现有VLM自演化方法。
AI.conclusion: 可执行程序+几何校验可替代人工标注，为空间推理提供可靠自监督信号；任务生成与验证的闭环迭代可持续提升VLM空间推理能力，实现零外部数据的自我演化。

title: Go Far, Look Less: Active Multi-Room Reconstruction with Persistent Goals and Selective Views
summary: Active 3D reconstruction aims to allocate a sparse view budget to recover complete geometry and high-fidelity renderings. However, existing methods degrade sharply in multi-room homes: myopic next-best-view scoring gives transit no credit for distant rooms and over-polishes irreducible nearby residuals, whereas dense mappers reach far rooms only by streaming thousands of frames. We propose ROAM-GS, a training-free active multi-room reconstruction framework that couples persistent goals with selective views: each decision selects a goal and a variable-horizon prefix toward it, capturing only at its endpoint. A Surface Reconstruction Memory scores poses by projecting post-update defects and viewing directions. Persistent goals credit transit with their remaining value and are released once arrivals stop measurably improving them. Without per-scene tuning, ROAM-GS achieves state-of-the-art multi-room reconstruction while preserving single-room Replica fidelity, raising mean coverage from 74% to 93% on HSSD and from 47% to 96% (+11.7 dB PSNR) on HM3D, and matching 90-minute dense mapping using $173\times$ fewer views.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的主动多房间重建框架ROAM-GS，以持久目标+变长前缀视图调度替代近视式下一最佳视角评分，在HSSD/HM3D上覆盖率提升至93%/96%，并用少173倍的视图达到90分钟稠密建图效果。
AI.motivation: 现有主动3D重建方法在多房间家居场景中严重退化：近视式下一最佳视角（NBV）评分不对前往远处房间的通行（transit）给予收益，且过度优化近距离不可消除的残差；而稠密建图方法只能靠流式传入数千帧才覆盖远处房间。因此需要一种兼顾远距离探索与视图效率的主动重建方案。
AI.method: ROAM-GS为免训练框架，将持久目标（persistent goals）与选择性视图相结合：每次决策同时选择一个目标和朝其前进的变长视界前缀（variable-horizon prefix），仅在前缀终点采集视图。使用表面重建记忆（Surface Reconstruction Memory）通过投影更新后的缺陷与观察方向对位姿打分；持久目标按其剩余价值为通行赋予信用，并在到达后目标不再产生可测改进时释放该目标。
AI.result: 无需逐场景调参即达到多房间重建SOTA，同时保持单房间Replica的保真度：HSSD平均覆盖率由74%提升至93%，HM3D由47%提升至96%（PSNR +11.7 dB），并以少173倍的视图数量匹配90分钟稠密建图的效果。
AI.conclusion: 将"目标选择+变长前缀采集"与带剩余价值信用的持久目标机制引入免训练主动重建，可有效解决多房间场景中通行不被奖励和视图浪费的问题，在覆盖率和渲染保真度上显著优于现有方法且具备跨场景泛化性。

title: GRAIN: Shared-Budget Complementary Re-observation for Object Detection
summary:
Re-running a frozen detector on enlarged image crops recovers small and crowded objects without retraining, yet every crop costs an extra detector call. Existing slicing and adaptive-cropping pipelines plan crops per image in isolation, even though inspection demand varies widely across an image collection. We present GRAIN, which unifies cross-image call allocation and bounded-output admission around cross-image comparable resolution-closure gains over boundary-safe crop interiors. Coarse hypotheses carry resolution deficits, crops close a geometric share of those deficits for hypotheses enclosed in their interior positive region, and multiplicative residuals discount covered evidence within a monotone submodular surrogate. Prefix sums and a global max-heap execute this collection-wide plan on CPU before crop inference, and Positive-Region Fusion aligns post-inference spatial admission with the planned interior support before class-balanced top-
  selection. Across 17 frozen detectors from five families on COCO, CrowdHuman, and VisDrone-DET, GRAIN beats call-matched tiling in 100 of 102 AP@100 settings and transfers to AI-TOD-v2. With RF-DETR-S on CrowdHuman, it nearly matches two-crop tiling using one eighth of the crop calls. At fixed budgets, the surrogate orders candidate plans with Spearman correlations of 0.95 to 0.99 while the sweep attains at least 98% of the exact surrogate optimum. Code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: GRAIN：一种无需重训的推理期裁剪规划方法，将跨图像的裁剪调用分配与有界输出准入统一为可比的“分辨率闭合增益”，在冻结检测器上以极少裁剪调用恢复小目标与密集目标。
AI.motivation: 在放大图像裁剪上重跑冻结检测器可恢复小目标与密集目标且无需重训，但每个裁剪都带来额外检测调用开销；现有切片/自适应裁剪流程按单张图像孤立规划裁剪，忽略了整个图像集合内检测需求差异极大这一事实。
AI.method: 1) 以跨图像可比较的分辨率闭合增益（resolution-closure gain）为统一度量，定义于边界安全裁剪内部区域上；2) 粗假设携带分辨率亏空，裁剪为其内部正区域内的假设闭合几何比例的亏空，乘性残差在单调子模替代目标中折扣已覆盖证据；3) 用前缀和与全局最大堆在CPU上、裁剪推理前完成集合级规划；4) 推理后采用Positive-Region Fusion，使空间准入与规划的内部支撑对齐，再进行类平衡top-k选择。
AI.result: 在COCO、CrowdHuman、VisDrone-DET上对5个家族17个冻结检测器评测：GRAIN在102个AP@100设置中的100个优于调用匹配的切片法，并可迁移到AI-TOD-v2；RF-DETR-S在CrowdHuman上以1/8裁剪调用几乎匹配两裁剪切片；固定预算下替代目标对候选方案的排序Spearman相关为0.95–0.99，扫描达到精确替代最优的≥98%。
AI.conclusion: 跨图像统一的裁剪调用分配与有界输出准入，可在不重训检测器的前提下显著提升小/密集目标检测的调用效率，并具备良好排序保真度与跨数据集迁移性；代码将公开。

title: EgoDepth-Bench: Benchmarking Metric Depth for Egocentric Manipulation
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Project page: https://egodepth-bench.github.io/
summary: We introduce EgoDepth-Bench, comprising 941,233 synchronized samples collected across 37 distinct physical environments. Each sample combines six calibrated RGB views with metric depth in the native fisheye view, reconstructed from five active-infrared stereo modules. A calibrated ball-bar confirms millimeter-level geometric accuracy, with a median error of 1.27 mm on a known sphere spacing. Environment-held-out splits enable evaluation of generalization to unseen environments. Across monocular, stereo, and multi-view models, the benchmark measures both depth accuracy and prediction coverage, including on hands and objects. Fine-tuning MapAnything on EgoDepth-Bench reduces metric AbsRel from 0.708 to 0.091 and scale-aligned AbsRel from 0.327 to 0.072 on unseen environments. These results demonstrate that EgoDepth-Bench provides effective supervision and enables rigorous evaluation of metric and relative depth estimation in egocentric manipulation. The project page provides the evaluation code and interactive RGB-depth sequences.

AI.tldr: 提出EgoDepth-Bench，一个面向第一人称操作场景的大规模度量深度基准：包含941,233个同步样本、覆盖37个物理环境，每样本含6路标定RGB视图与原生鱼眼视图的度量深度（由5个主动红外立体模块重建），并用标定球杆验证毫米级几何精度。
AI.motivation: 第一人称操作场景缺乏兼具大规模、度量精度与几何标定验证的深度数据与评测平台，难以严格评估单目、立体与多视图模型在未见环境中的度量与相对深度估计能力。
AI.method: 构建多相机同步采集系统（每样本6路标定RGB + 鱼眼度量深度，源自5个主动红外立体模块）；用标定球杆在已知球间距上校验几何精度；设计留出环境（environment-held-out）划分以评测泛化；统一评测单目、立体、多视图模型的深度精度与预测覆盖率（含手部与物体区域）；并在该基准上微调MapAnything。
AI.result: 球杆校验中位误差1.27 mm，达毫米级几何精度；在未见环境上微调MapAnything后，度量AbsRel由0.708降至0.091，尺度对齐AbsRel由0.327降至0.072。
AI.conclusion: EgoDepth-Bench能提供有效的监督信号，并支持对第一人称操作中度量与相对深度估计的严格评测；项目页已开放评测代码与可交互RGB-深度序列。

title: Intra-Class Diversity Loss for Person Re-Identification
summary: Person re-identification (ReID) aims to retrieve images of the same pedestrian across different cameras. However, the non-overlapping identities between training and testing sets, together with large intra-class variation, make it challenging to learn generalizable pedestrian representations. Most existing ReID loss functions mainly focus on intra-class compactness and inter-class separation, which may overlook useful intra-class differences. To address these issues, we propose a novel Intra-Class Diversity (ICD) loss that aims to maximize intra-class differences in classification-irrelevant directions. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to introduce this class-weight-orthogonal diversity learning objective for person ReID. Specifically, based on the geometric relationship between the learned representation and its corresponding class-weight vector, we decompose each representation into the component along the class-weight direction and its orthogonal component. This decomposition provides a clear and interpretable geometric basis for modeling intra-class diversity. ICD then encour- ages larger differences among the orthogonal components of samples belonging to the same identity, while the classification loss maintains identity discrimination. The proposed ICD loss can be incorporated into existing ReID frameworks as an additional regularization term without modifying the feature extraction network. Extensive experiments on three widely used ReID datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of ICD and its complementarity with existing metric learning losses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出类内多样性损失ICD，通过最大化与分类权重正交方向上的类内差异，作为正则项提升行人重识别的泛化性。
AI.motivation: 训练集与测试集身份不重叠且类内差异大，使可泛化行人表示学习困难；现有ReID损失多只关注类内紧凑与类间分离，忽视了有用的类内差异信息。
AI.method: 基于表示与类权重向量的几何关系，将每个表示分解为沿类权重方向的分量与其正交分量；ICD在同身份样本的正交分量间鼓励更大差异，同时由分类损失保持身份判别性。该损失可作为附加正则项嵌入现有ReID框架，无需改动特征提取网络。
AI.result: 在三个广泛使用的ReID数据集上的大量实验验证了ICD的有效性，以及与现有度量学习损失的互补性。
AI.conclusion: ICD首次将类权重正交的多样性学习目标引入行人ReID，提供清晰可解释的几何建模基础，且易于集成、可与其他损失互补。

title: BEND: Spectral Bregman Losses for Multi-Image Unlearning in Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models memorize training images and reproduce them almost verbatim when prompted, creating copyright and privacy liabilities. Data unlearning erases the influence of specific training samples from a trained model without retraining, and is two-sided: it must forget the targets while preserving generation quality on everything else. Prior methods use the squared-L2 diffusion loss, at most with a hand-set frequency mask; however, it is known that every Bregman divergence is a mathematically valid choice and the squared-L2 is only the simplest example. BEND is the first to search this family: it fits a spectral Bregman divergence to the unlearning task through a bilevel loop, so the loss itself is shaped to forget thoroughly while protecting quality. It also redirects a memorized image to the mean of its retain images, where ReTrack, the state of the art, redirects it to a single near-copy. On Stable Diffusion, a single BEND model erases all 48 verifiably memorized benchmark images at once. It forgets at least as much as per-target, sequential, and jointly trained ReTrack (SSCD 0.084 versus 0.094-0.120), at the quality of the model before unlearning (CLIP-IQA 0.81 versus 0.64-0.69). BEND also outperforms the state of the art on CelebA-HQ in all three measures of the benchmark, and matches or exceeds it on MNIST and CIFAR-10.

AI.tldr: BEND首次在Bregman散度族中针对扩散模型遗忘任务搜索谱域Bregman散度，通过双层优化塑造损失函数本身，实现"彻底遗忘+保持生成质量"的双向目标。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型会记忆并近乎逐字复现训练图像，带来版权与隐私风险。数据遗忘需在不重新训练的前提下消除特定样本影响，且必须双向兼顾：既遗忘目标样本，又保持其余生成质量。已有方法仅用平方L2扩散损失（至多手工设置频域掩码），而理论上任何Bregman散度都是合法选择，平方L2只是最简特例，这一设计空间尚未被探索。
AI.method: BEND以双层（bilevel）循环拟合一个谱域Bregman散度，使损失函数本身被塑形以在彻底遗忘的同时保护质量；此外将记忆图像重定向至其保留图像集合的均值（而非如SOTA方法ReTrack那样重定向至单一近复制样本）。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion上，单个BEND模型一次性遗忘全部48张可验证记忆基准图像：遗忘程度不逊于逐目标、顺序及联合训练的ReTrack（SSCD 0.084 vs 0.094–0.120），且保持遗忘前模型的生成质量（CLIP-IQA 0.81 vs 0.64–0.69）。在CelebA-HQ上三项指标均超越SOTA，在MNIST与CIFAR-10上持平或更优。
AI.conclusion: 损失函数族的选择本身是扩散模型遗忘的关键设计维度；可学习的谱域Bregman散度结合均值重定向策略，能在单模型多目标场景下同时取得更强遗忘与更高保真度，验证了"搜索损失"范式的有效性。

title: SIAMBA: A Pseudo-Siamese Mamba-based Deep Learning Network for Multimodal Flood Change Detection
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, presented at SPIE Environmental Remote Sensing, 2026
summary: Flood change detection from bi-temporal multispectral and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images is essential for rapid disaster response. In this context, Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery provides discriminative spectral observations, whereas Sentinel-1 SAR provides weather-independent structural information. Using these modalities jointly requires modelling temporal evidence while accounting for cross-modal heterogeneity. In particular, change detection is complicated by cloud contamination, illumination variability, acquisition geometry and speckle, and heterogeneous land-cover responses. To address these challenges, we propose SIAMBA, a pseudo-siamese Mamba-based network for bi-temporal flood change detection from paired Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 observations. SIAMBA uses dedicated modality-specific encoders with dual-pooling squeeze-and-excitation recalibration and selective state-space processing for long-range spatial context. A gated cross-modal change module derives absolute, signed, and relative log-ratio differences at multiple semantic levels, and attention-refined skip connections support progressive multi-scale decoding. Experiments are carried out on OMBRIA benchmark, which includes an independent test set and geographically diverse subsets in France, Albania, Guyana, and Timor. SIAMBA achieves 81.98% IoU, and 93.57% OA on the independent test set, reaching the highest values in the considered comparison. It also provides the highest unweighted average IoU and OA across four regional subsets spatially disjuncted. These results indicate that combining selective state-space contextual modelling with gated multiscale discrepancy learning effectively improves flood change mapping across the evaluated geographic settings.

AI.tldr: 提出伪孪生Mamba网络SIAMBA，融合Sentinel-1 SAR与Sentinel-2多光谱双时相影像，实现洪水变化检测，在OMBRIA基准上取得81.98% IoU与93.57% OA的最优结果。
AI.motivation: 洪水变化检测对快速灾害响应至关重要：Sentinel-2多光谱提供判别性光谱信息，Sentinel-1 SAR提供不受天气影响的结构信息，但联合使用需在建模时序证据的同时处理跨模态异质性。云污染、光照变化、成像几何与相干斑、地物响应异质等因素使检测困难。
AI.method: SIAMBA采用模态专用的伪孪生编码器，含双池化SE重标定与选择性状态空间（Mamba）长程空间上下文建模；引入门控跨模态变化模块，在多个语义层级计算绝对、带符号及相对对数比差异；并通过注意力细化跳跃连接支持渐进式多尺度解码。
AI.result: 在OMBRIA基准（含独立测试集及法国、阿尔巴尼亚、圭亚那、东帝汶的区域子集）上，独立测试集达到81.98% IoU、93.57% OA，为对比方法中最高；在四个空间不相交区域子集上的平均IoU与OA同样最高。
AI.conclusion: 将选择性状态空间上下文建模与门控多尺度差异学习相结合，可有效提升跨地理场景的洪水变化制图性能。

title: FGSCalib: Targetless Camera-LiDAR Extrinsic Calibration from Foreground Segmentation
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, and 4 pages of supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/zsungi/fgscalib
summary: Camera-LiDAR pairs installed as fixed infrastructure need periodic recalibration, but a calibration target takes the installation out of service. We present FGSCalib, a targetless method that calibrates a stationary camera-LiDAR pair from the objects moving in its view. We only assume that arbitrary moving objects are present in the scene: each sensor separates the moving foreground from the static background, without relying on object classes. With the correct extrinsic, the LiDAR foreground points project onto the camera foreground. FGSCalib turns the camera mask into a boundary-proximity field and finds the extrinsic by two-stage simulated annealing over selected frame pairs. It needs no measured initial extrinsic (random starts give similar results) and works with both rotating and non-repetitive LiDARs. We evaluate it on 21 simulated scenarios with exact ground truth and on 72 real ones (nine camera-LiDAR pairs in eight scenes), with a reference averaged from 43 manual calibrations. In simulation the median error is 5.3 cm and 0.19°. On real data we use a tolerance of 18 cm and 1.8°, met by 93% of single manual calibrations. Keeping the lowest-cost of five runs, FGSCalib meets it in 51 of the 72 scenarios: in 20 of 24 with the Livox, where the strongest of five baselines reaches 11, and in 31 of 48 with the two rotating LiDARs, where only one baseline estimate does. Its median error is 9.5 cm and 0.9°, against 7.3 cm and 0.7° for a single manual calibration. The code and the dataset are available online.

AI.tldr: FGSCalib：一种无需标定靶、无需初始外参的相机-激光雷达无目标外参标定方法，利用场景中任意运动物体（不依赖类别）的前景对应关系，通过边界邻近场与两阶段模拟退火求解外参。
AI.motivation: 作为固定基础设施安装的相机-LiDAR对需要定期重标定，但使用标定靶会使设备停用。现有方法多依赖标定靶或需已知初始外参，难以满足在线、免停机维护需求。
AI.method: 假设场景中存在任意运动物体：各传感器不作类别区分地将运动前景与静态背景分离；在正确外参下，LiDAR前景点应投影到相机前景上。将相机运动掩膜转换为边界邻近场（boundary-proximity field），在选定帧对上用两阶段模拟退火搜索外参。无需测量初始外参（随机初值结果相近），并兼容旋转式与非重复扫描（Livox）LiDAR。
AI.result: 在21个有精确真值的仿真场景与72个真实场景（8个场景中9对相机-LiDAR，参考值由43次人工标定平均得到）上评测。仿真中位误差5.3 cm、0.19°；真实数据容忍阈值为18 cm与1.8°（93%的单次人工标定可满足）。取五次运行中代价最低者，72个真实场景中51个达标：Livox 24个中20个达标（最强基线仅11个），两台旋转式LiDAR 48个中31个达标（基线仅1个估计达标）。中位误差9.5 cm、0.9°，单次人工标定为7.3 cm、0.7°。
AI.conclusion: FGSCalib证明利用无类别标签的运动前景即可实现无目标、免初值的相机-LiDAR在线重标定，精度接近单次人工标定，显著优于基线，尤其适用于非重复扫描LiDAR；代码与数据集已公开。

title: Part-wise Certified State Estimation of Articulated Objects from Passive Stereo
summary: Robots in manufacturing often handle thin, hinged objects known from CAD models that change shape during the task, like folding cartons. Monitoring such tasks requires estimating the object's articulation state, its pose and the shape of any semi-deformable part. Learning-based estimators generalise across objects but lose precision while handling thin parts. Model-based fitting is precise but often needs accurate depth, a close initial estimate and a clean object mask. We present part-wise certification of an articulated object's state, estimated from passive stereo. Our estimator rivals the precision of the best model-based fitting method without using depth, a close initial estimate or a mask. We detect the corners that the CAD model defines in both stereo images and fit the articulated model to them. Geometric certificates, which we extend from rigid to articulated objects, then tell whether to trust each part, because the fit returns a state even for hidden parts. Certified estimates on unlabelled video become labels that improve sim-to-real transfer. On five of seven simulated objects, we locate the parts we certify three to five times more precisely than the strongest learned baseline on the same readings, given depth and true masks. On a real folding carton, our median corner error on the end panels is 2.1% of the carton's size, at least 40% lower than every learned baseline and also lower than a depth-based fit initialised near the true state.

AI.tldr: 提出对铰接物体状态的按部件认证估计方法，仅用被动双目图像即可达到甚至超越最优模型拟合方法的精度。
AI.motivation: 制造场景中薄壁铰接物体（如折叠纸盒）在任务中会变形，需估计其关节状态、位姿及半变形部件形状。学习型估计器泛化好但薄件精度低；模型拟合精确但依赖准确深度、接近的初始估计和干净掩码。
AI.method: 在双目图像中检测CAD模型定义的角点，将铰接模型拟合到这些角点上；把几何认证从刚体扩展到铰接物体，逐部件判定估计是否可信（因拟合对遮挡部件也会输出状态）；利用无标注视频上的认证估计作为标签，改善仿真到现实迁移。
AI.result: 在7个仿真物体中的5个上，定位认证部件的精度比最强学习基线高3–5倍（基线即使给定深度和真值掩码）；真实折叠纸盒端板角点中位误差为纸盒尺寸的2.1%，比所有学习基线低至少40%，也低于以真值状态初始化的深度拟合方法。
AI.conclusion: 按部件几何认证的被动双目估计可在无需深度、近初始估计和掩码的条件下实现高精度铰接状态估计，并可自监督地改进sim-to-real迁移。

title: Beyond Naming Accuracy: Template Composition and Species-Name Decisions
summary: Vision-language classifiers identify species by matching images to text prompts containing species names. BioCLIP2 changes its predicted species less often than BioCLIP 2.5 Huge across four photographic templates, but the ranking reverses across a bank of 80 templates. This comparison leaves open whether the reversal depends on the number of templates or their wording. We hold the count at four and compare the classifiers on every four-template subset of the 80-template bank and of a second pool of 24 reviewed photographic templates, keeping images and candidate names fixed. Huge is more consistent across the reviewed pool as a whole, yet 19.09% of its four-template subsets favor Bio-CLIP2 on iWildCam and 5.10% do so on Rare Species. We then test whether both rankings hold on 5,487 frames from previously unused iWildCam sequences. Among 4,356 subsets containing two photo and two photograph templates, simultaneous 95% intervals support lower disagreement for Huge in 1,526 subsets and for BioCLIP2 in 43. Even with the same prompt count and noun mixture, the choice of sentences can determine which classifier appears more consistent.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过控制模板数量（固定为4）与词汇（photo/photograph）并穷举子集与独立帧数据，证明视觉-语言分类器的“一致性”排名高度依赖具体提示句的措辞，而非模板数量。
AI.motivation: 先前观察到BioCLIP2在4个模板上比BioCLIP 2.5 Huge预测物种更少变化，但在80个模板库上排名反转，但该对比无法区分反转究竟源于模板数量还是具体措辞，因此需要受控实验厘清。
AI.method: 固定模板数量为4，在80模板库与另一由24个经审校摄影模板组成的池中枚举全部四模板子集，保持图像与候选物种名不变，比较两个分类器；随后在来自未使用过的iWildCam序列的5,487帧上复现检验，并对含两个photo与两个photograph模板的4,356个子集构造同时95%置信区间。
AI.result: 在审校模板池整体上Huge更一致，但其四模板子集中仍有19.09%（iWildCam）与5.10%（Rare Species）支持BioCLIP2；新帧上4,356个混合子集中，1,526个子集的同时95%区间支持Huge不一致度更低，43个支持BioCLIP2。
AI.conclusion: 即使提示数量与名词搭配相同，具体句子的选择即可决定哪个分类器看起来更一致，说明仅以有限模板集得出的鲁棒性结论不可靠，需报告模板子集分布而非单一汇总。

title: RAPID: Codec-Aware Video Decoding for Efficient Long-Video Understanding
summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) can process hour-long videos, but the large number of input frames incurs substantial inference overhead. Existing approaches to efficient long-video understanding largely overlook video decoding, which can take longer than LLM prefill. We propose RAPID (Reference- and Access-Point-Informed Decoding), a codec-aware framework that exploits information embedded in compressed bitstreams to reduce both frame decoding and selection costs. RAPID consists of two components. RAPID-Dec exploits reference-frame information and random access points to skip unnecessary frames and decode the retained frames in parallel while preserving exact reconstruction of the target frames. It achieves up to a 3.7x decoding speedup over the fastest baseline on H.264/AVC videos. RAPID-Sel uses keyframes as coarse representatives of video segments, avoiding the dense candidate decoding and scoring required by existing frame selection methods. It achieves comparable accuracy with up to a 3.0x preprocessing speedup. Together, RAPID achieves a 4.9x time to first token (TTFT) speedup on hour-long videos over a state-of-the-art frame selection method using the fastest baseline decoder.

AI.tldr: RAPID 是一个编解码器感知框架，利用压缩码流中的参考帧与随机访问点信息，同时加速长视频解码与帧选择，在小时级视频上实现最高 4.9x 的首 token 延迟（TTFT）加速。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 可处理小时级视频，但大量输入帧带来显著推理开销；已有高效长视频方法普遍忽略视频解码环节，而解码耗时可能超过 LLM 预填充（prefill），成为被忽视的瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出 RAPID（Reference- and Access-Point-Informed Decoding），含两部分：RAPID-Dec 利用参考帧信息与随机访问点，跳过不必要帧并并行解码保留帧，同时保证目标帧的精确重建；RAPID-Sel 以关键帧作为视频片段的粗粒度代表，避免现有帧选择方法所需的稠密候选解码与打分。
AI.result: 在 H.264/AVC 视频上，RAPID-Dec 相较最快的基线解码器最高达 3.7x 解码加速；RAPID-Sel 在精度相当的情况下实现最高 3.0x 预处理加速；两者结合在小时级视频上，相对使用最快基线解码器的最先进帧选择方法实现 4.9x 的 TTFT 加速。
AI.conclusion: 将解码环节纳入长视频理解的高效化设计，并借助码流元信息即可在无损重建前提下显著降低端到端延迟，说明编解码器感知是长视频 VLM 推理优化的重要方向。

title: Do Waste Classifiers Recognise Items They Have Never Seen? Object-Disjoint Evaluation on Household and Medical Waste
summary: Automatic waste classification supports source separation, which enables recycling and keeps hazardous medical items out of household waste. Waste classification studies often report near-perfect accuracy on random image splits, which put photographs of one item in both training and test sets. To measure how well classifiers recognise items they have never seen, we built BanglaWaste-23, with 4,160 images of 172 objects in 23 household and medical waste classes from Bangladesh. Every image also records which physical item it shows. We evaluated 11 ImageNet-pretrained models and two models trained from scratch (a compact custom network and MobileNetV3-L) using object-disjoint five-fold cross-validation and a random split. On unseen objects, the best pretrained model reached a macro-averaged F1 score of 98.8%, and six models were statistically tied. The random split overstated from-scratch accuracy by 15 to 19 percentage points. The from-scratch models also missed 11 to 13% of medical items, against under 1% for pretrained models. On a second dataset from Dhaka, pretrained accuracy fell by 15 to 22 points. Classifiers should therefore be evaluated on unseen objects, with random-split results read as an upper bound. The data are on Zenodo and the code at https://github.com/saadbaust/BanglaWaste-23.

AI.tldr: 该文构建BanglaWaste-23数据集（4,160张图像、172个物体、23类），采用按物体不重叠的五折交叉验证与随机划分对比评估11个ImageNet预训练模型和2个从零训练模型，发现随机划分高估从零模型15–19个百分点，预训练模型在未见物体上宏平均F1达98.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有垃圾分类研究多在随机图像划分上报告近乎完美的准确率，但随机划分会把同一物体的照片同时放入训练集和测试集，导致评估高估模型对未见物体的识别能力，缺乏衡量真实泛化性能的评测协议。
AI.method: 构建BanglaWaste-23数据集：来自孟加拉国23个家庭与医疗废物类别的172个物理物体、4,160张图像，每张图像标注其对应物体身份；评估11个ImageNet预训练模型及2个从零训练模型（紧凑自定义网络与MobileNetV3-L），在物体不重叠五折交叉验证与随机划分两种协议下对比；并在达卡另一数据集上做跨域验证。
AI.result: 未见物体条件下最佳预训练模型宏平均F1为98.8%，6个模型统计上无显著差异；随机划分将从零模型的准确率虚高15–19个百分点；从零模型漏检医疗废物11–13%，预训练模型低于1%；在达卡第二数据集上预训练准确率下降15–22个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 垃圾分类模型应在未见物体上评估，随机划分结果只应作为性能上界；预训练迁移对医疗废物识别与跨域泛化尤为重要。数据集已发布于Zenodo，代码见https://github.com/saadbaust/BanglaWaste-23。

title: Age and Gender Estimation from Face and Ocular Smartphone Images via Identity Transfer and Ordinal Learning
comment: Accepted for publication at 16th International Conference on Pattern Recognition Applications and Methods, ICPRAM 2027
summary: We investigate the transferability of identity-recognition representations to gender and age estimation from face and ocular images. Three CNNs of varying complexity, pre-trained for face or ocular identity recognition, are evaluated using fixed features with SVMs and end-to-end adaptation. Experiments use 11,299 frontal smartphone images from Adience, following its predefined five-fold protocol and subject-disjoint validation. Results show that domain-matched identity pre-training outperforms direct ImageNet and scratch initialisation in end-to-end training, while combining both ocular regions narrows the gap with full-face estimation, especially for age. We additionally introduce an ordinal loss that exploits the ordering of age groups and consistently improves 1-off accuracy across architectures and input regions. Across the evaluated configurations, best gender accuracies reach 88.1% for the face and 82.9% for combined ocular regions, while age estimation reaches 59.0% exact and 93.1% 1-off accuracy for ocular images, versus 57.6% and 95.2% for the full face. To our knowledge, these are the highest ocular age accuracies reported on Adience.

AI.tldr: 研究人脸/眼部身份识别预训练表征迁移到性别与年龄估计的有效性，并提出序数损失提升年龄估计精度。
AI.motivation: 探索身份识别表征能否迁移至软生物特征（性别、年龄）估计，并比较人脸与眼部区域、不同预训练初始化及两种使用范式（固定特征+SVM、端到端微调）的差异。
AI.method: 基于Adience数据集11,299张正面手机图像，遵循其五折与受试者不重叠协议；采用三种不同复杂度、分别针对人脸或眼部身份识别预训练的CNN，比较固定特征+SVM与端到端适配，并对比ImageNet预训练与随机初始化；引入利用年龄组有序性的序数损失。
AI.result: 领域匹配的身份预训练在端到端训练中优于ImageNet与随机初始化；融合两个眼部区域可缩小与全脸估计的差距（尤其年龄）。序数损失在各架构与输入区域上一致提升1-off精度。最佳性别准确率：人脸88.1%、双眼组合82.9%；年龄：眼部59.0% exact/93.1% 1-off，全脸57.6%/95.2%。
AI.conclusion: 身份识别表征可有效迁移至性别与年龄估计，眼部区域具备显著潜力；所报眼部年龄精度为Adience上已公开的最高水平。

title: Certified Defense against Adversarial Patches on Traffic Signs via Mask-Aware Training
summary: Adversarial patches are a practical threat to traffic-sign recognition: a small sticker on a sign can change a classifier's decision. PatchCleanser is a certified defense that applies two rounds of masking and, for every image it certifies, provably returns the correct label for any patch that fits inside one mask. We show that on traffic signs the defense certifies almost nothing when paired with a normally trained classifier (1.7% to 4.8% certified accuracy on GTSRB), because a single mask can hide the small central symbol that distinguishes sign classes. We propose mask-aware training, which trains the classifier on images occluded by random pairs drawn from the defense's own mask set, with a sampling bias toward masks over the sign's centre. The defense, mask set and certification procedure are unchanged, so the guarantee is preserved. For an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50, mask-aware training raises certified accuracy from 4.8% to 60.0%. Under real per-image adversarial patches, the defended ResNet-50 reaches 85.7% accuracy, versus 74.6% for the original PatchCleanser with a normally trained ResNet-50.

AI.tldr: 论文将PatchCleanser认证防御与"掩码感知训练"结合，解决了交通标志识别中正常训练分类器导致认证几乎无效的问题，显著提升可认证准确率与真实对抗补丁下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 对抗补丁是对交通标志识别的现实威胁。PatchCleanser两轮掩码认证防御理论上可对落在单个掩码内的任意补丁给出正确标签保证，但与常规训练分类器搭配时，在GTSRB上认证准确率仅1.7%–4.8%，原因在于单个掩码会遮住区分类别所需的小型中心符号，使认证几乎失效。
AI.method: 提出掩码感知训练（mask-aware training）：利用防御自身的掩码集合随机抽取成对掩码对图像进行遮挡，生成训练样本，并对标志中心区域的掩码施加采样偏置。防御、掩码集与认证流程均保持不变，因此认证保证得以保留。
AI.result: 在ImageNet预训练ResNet-50上，认证准确率由4.8%提升至60.0%；在逐图像真实对抗补丁攻击下，防御后的ResNet-50准确率达85.7%，而原始PatchCleanser配合常规训练ResNet-50仅为74.6%。
AI.conclusion: 分类器训练策略与认证防御的掩码机制必须协同设计；无需改动防御与认证流程即可大幅提升可认证准确率，为交通标志识别的补丁鲁棒性提供实用方案。

title: BridgeMVS: Bridging Multi-View Stereo and Monodepth via Bidirectional Dynamic Fusion
summary: Multi-View Stereo (MVS) and Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) provide complementary cues for dense 3D reconstruction. While MVS leverages explicit geometry for metric depth, it struggles in challenging regions where feature matching is unreliable. Conversely, MDE provides robust structural priors but typically yields scale-ambiguous results. Existing hybrid methods mainly exploit monocular cues in a unidirectional manner, leaving the mutual enhancement between MDE and MVS insufficiently explored. To address this limitation, we propose BridgeMVS, a unified cascaded multi-stage MVS framework that bridges monocular depth features and multi-view cost volume representations through Bidirectional Dynamic Fusion (BDF). At each stage, BDF performs dynamic mono-to-cost and cost-to-mono updates, where monocular structural features guide cost volume refinement for more robust MVS depth estimation, while multi-view geometric evidence recalibrates monocular representations to improve their metric-scale consistency. Furthermore, the fused monocular and multi-view representations are progressively propagated from coarse to fine stages and constrained by stage-wise relative-scale MDE supervision and metric-scale MVS supervision, enabling cross-branch interactions to benefit subsequent high-resolution depth estimation. In addition, BDF is designed as a plug-and-play module that can be conveniently integrated into existing cascaded MVS frameworks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BridgeMVS achieves state-of-the-art performance on the DTU, Tanks-and-Temples, and ETH3D benchmarks, while simultaneously boosting the accuracy of monocular depth estimation. Notably, BridgeMVS ranks first on both the Tanks-and-Temples Intermediate and Advanced benchmarks. The source code is available at \href{https://github.com/JianfeiJ/BridgeMVS}{https://github.com/JianfeiJ/BridgeMVS}.

AI.tldr: BridgeMVS是一个级联多阶段MVS框架，通过双向动态融合（BDF）在同一流程中互相增强单目深度特征与多视图代价体表示，在DTU、Tanks-and-Temples、ETH3D上达到SOTA，并在T&T Intermediate与Advanced榜单排名第一。
AI.motivation: MVS依赖显式几何可获度量深度，但在特征匹配不可靠区域失效；MDE提供稳健结构先验但尺度模糊。已有混合方法多为单向利用单目线索，MDE与MVS的双向互增强未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出统一的级联多阶段MVS框架BridgeMVS，核心为双向动态融合（BDF）：每个阶段执行动态的mono-to-cost与cost-to-mono更新，用单目结构特征引导代价体精化以提升MVS稳健性，同时用多视图几何证据重新校准单目表示以改善其度量尺度一致性；融合表示由粗到细逐级传递，并以阶段级相对尺度MDE监督与度量尺度MVS监督联合约束。BDF设计为可即插即用模块，可集成到现有级联MVS框架中。
AI.result: 在DTU、Tanks-and-Temples、ETH3D基准上取得SOTA性能，同时提升单目深度估计精度；在Tanks-and-Temples Intermediate与Advanced两个榜单均排名第一。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过双向动态融合实现单目与多视图线索的互增强，并以级联跨阶段传播与分支特定监督保证高分辨率深度估计质量，验证了双向融合范式的有效性与可移植性。

title: AvatarAnyone: Agentic Reconstruction of Mesh-Based Layered Avatars from YouTube Video
summary: We introduce AvatarAnyone, a method for reconstructing avatars from casual YouTube videos as layered meshes, with each garment and footwear as a separate mesh layered on top of the body mesh. In such videos, people differ in garment classes, clothing types, and layers, and each combination needs a different reconstruction. A single fixed layered reconstruction pipeline therefore fails. AvatarAnyone solves this problem with AI agents that plan a custom optimization for each person's reconstruction. The agents predict the garment classes, the clothing type, and the layering. They use these predictions to choose an initialization and stage the optimization. Because the avatars are layered meshes, they support applications such as virtual try-on and cloth simulation. We change the clothing layers of an avatar and render it in different garments and poses. We can also simulate a clothing layer as cloth over the animated body with a standard cloth simulator. Most existing avatars are one fused surface or a set of Gaussians and cannot do this. We load the avatars directly into Blender, Unreal Engine, and robotics simulators such as MuJoCo. As the avatars are meshes, they support contact modeling with other objects. We show results from around 150 YouTube videos. On four datasets, AvatarAnyone outperforms existing mesh-based methods for animatable monocular reconstruction. Our project page is available at https://miraymen.github.io/avataranyone.

AI.tldr: AvatarAnyone 从普通 YouTube 视频重建分层网格化身，每件衣物与鞋类作为独立网格叠加于身体网格之上，并用 AI 智能体为每人生成定制优化方案。
AI.motivation: YouTube 视频中人物在服装类别、款式与层数上差异巨大，每种组合都需要不同的重建策略，因此单一固定的分层重建流水线必然失效。
AI.method: 用 AI 智能体预测服装类别、衣物类型与分层关系，据此选择初始化并分阶段安排优化流程，输出各衣物/鞋类独立分层网格。
AI.result: 在约 150 个 YouTube 视频及四个数据集上，优于现有基于网格的可动画单目重建方法；化身可直接导入 Blender、Unreal Engine 及 MuJoCo 等机器人仿真器。
AI.conclusion: 分层网格表示支持虚拟试衣、标准布料仿真与接触建模，克服了单一融合表面或高斯表示无法实现的功能。

title: Learning Dense Head-Object Contact Estimation with Synthetic Data
summary: Head serves a critical role in human cognitive and perceptual functions while remaining vulnerable to external impacts, making the understanding of head contact essential for human safety. Despite its importance, dense head-object contact estimation remains largely unexplored, primarily due to the absence of head-object contact data. Recently, it has been shown that synthetic data can serve as powerful training data in limited data scenario, implying the potential of synthetic data in head-object contact estimation. There are two core challenges for dense head-object contact estimation. First, head-object interactions are highly diverse, resulting in substantial variations in contact regions and patterns across different objects and interaction types. Second, head contact regions are often heavily occluded by hair, making direct visual observation of the actual contact regions difficult. To address these issues, we introduce HEad COntact estimation (HECO) with synthetic data. To handle diverse head-object interactions, we leverage semantic context from text features that encode semantic relationships between head regions and interacting objects. To resolve hair occlusion issue of actual head contact regions, we introduce occlusion-aware contact learning that learns to infer head contact beyond visible information from images via amodal inpainting. As a result, we enable head-object contact estimation with HECO trained with our synthetic dataset, overcoming the issue of absence of contact data. The codes will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出HECO方法，利用合成数据实现密集的头部-物体接触估计，通过文本语义上下文与遮挡感知（非模态补全）学习解决交互多样性与头发遮挡两大难题。
AI.motivation: 头部在人类认知与感知中至关重要且易受外部冲击，理解头部-物体接触对人类安全意义重大；但密集头部接触估计鲜有研究，核心障碍是缺乏头部-物体接触数据。合成数据在少数据场景下已被证明有效，因此有望用于该任务。
AI.method: (1) 使用合成数据训练HECO（HEad COntact estimation）模型以弥补真实接触数据缺失；(2) 针对头部-物体交互多样、接触区域与模式差异大的问题，引入文本特征编码的语义上下文，建模头部区域与交互物体间的语义关系；(3) 针对头发严重遮挡真实接触区域的问题，提出遮挡感知接触学习，借助非模态图像补全（amodal inpainting）从图像可信息之外推断头部接触。
AI.result: HECO仅依赖合成数据集训练即可实现头部-物体接触估计，克服了接触数据缺失的限制，能够应对多样交互与头发遮挡；代码将开源。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据结合语义上下文与遮挡感知学习，是解决密集头部-物体接触估计数据缺失问题的可行路径，为后续研究提供了方法与数据基础。

title: Pruning Autonomous Driving VLAs: What to Preserve for Reasoning and Action
summary: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving use chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to guide action generation, but incur substantial memory and computational costs. We study structured pruning for these models, focusing on preserving both scene understanding and trajectory prediction. Our analysis of Taylor importance in Alpamayo-1.5-10B shows that reasoning and trajectory objectives assign different importance to the same vision-language model (VLM) structures. In the action expert, MLP channels exhibit more stable importance rankings across denoising steps than query heads, and a small fraction of channels accounts for most of the measured importance. Based on these findings, we propose MoOP, which combines importance ranks from both objectives for VLM pruning and aggregates stepwise importance to select a fixed subset of expert MLP channels. At 24.0% total parameter reduction, VLM-only pruning with MoOP performs comparably to or slightly better than the strongest baselines in driving, while retaining 94.0% of the dense model's LingoQA score, far above all other methods. At a higher reduction of 30.0%, MoOP degrades much less than every other method, as it is the only one whose reasoning does not collapse. Removing 93.75% of expert MLP channels increases total parameter reduction to 39.4%, with nearly unchanged open-loop errors relative to VLM-only pruning and competitive closed-loop performance. The resulting model achieves a 1.37x end-to-end inference speedup and 36.6% lower peak memory than the dense model, without post-pruning fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出 MoOP 结构化剪枝方法，为推理式 VLA 自动驾驶模型同时保留场景理解与轨迹预测能力，在 24.0%–39.4% 参数削减下保持性能，并获得 1.37x 加速和 36.6% 峰值显存下降。
AI.motivation: 基于 CoT 推理的 VLA 自动驾驶模型存在显著显存与计算开销；需在结构化剪枝中同时保护场景理解（推理）与轨迹预测两类目标，而二者对同一 VLM 结构的重要性分配并不一致。
AI.method: 在 Alpamayo-1.5-10B 上做 Taylor 重要性分析：发现推理与轨迹目标对 VLM 结构重要性排序不同；action expert 中 MLP 通道重要性在去噪步间比 query head 更稳定，且少数通道贡献大部分重要性。据此提出 MoOP：VLM 剪枝融合两目标的重要性排名；action expert 聚合逐步重要性以选取固定 MLP 通道子集。
AI.result: 24.0% 总参数削减下，仅剪 VLM 的 MoOP 在驾驶指标上与最强基线相当或略优，保留稠密模型 94.0% 的 LingoQA 分数；30.0% 削减下退化幅度最小，是唯一推理能力未崩塌的方法；移除 93.75% 专家 MLP 通道使总削减达 39.4%，开环误差几乎不变、闭环表现具竞争力；最终模型端到端推理加速 1.37x、峰值显存降低 36.6%，且无需剪枝后微调。
AI.conclusion: 多目标重要性融合与跨去噪步聚合是推理式 VLA 高效结构化剪枝的有效准则，可在不微调条件下实现显著效率收益并避免推理能力崩塌。

title: On-Policy Codec Distillation for Efficient All-in-One Video Generation
summary: Modern visual generative models operate on tokens, and every visual asset they receive, whether an identity, a scribble, a depth map, or a motion video, is tokenized and appended to the input token sequence. Consequently, conditioning quickly dominates the computation cost. Yet most of these tokens carry redundant spatiotemporal information. Our key insight is that identifying what is genuinely new is exactly the problem that classical video codecs have long solved. Thus, we first introduce a codec-based token pruning method that discards redundant tokens. Then, we propose an on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) strategy to train a DiT adapter capable of learning the codec pruning pattern well without quality degradation. Together, they form On-Policy Codec Distillation (CodecOPSD). We scale CodecOPSD to 16 condition modalities on our own video diffusion model, where it prunes 66% of the condition tokens on average with almost no quality drop. Therefore, denoising becomes 2x faster, and the cache memory shrinks by up to 73% in KV cache mode. CodecOPSD also extends to other state-of-the-art pretrained image and video generative models, where its benefit grows further with more conditions, longer frames, and higher resolution.

AI.tldr: 提出CodecOPSD：用视频编解码器的时空冗余判别来做条件token剪枝，并配以on-policy自蒸馏训练DiT适配器，在16种条件模态上平均剪掉66%条件token而几乎无损，使去噪加速2倍、KV cache内存最多缩减73%。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉生成模型将所有条件（身份、涂鸦、深度图、运动视频等）token化后拼接到输入序列，条件token迅速主导计算成本，而其中大量token携带冗余的时空信息。作者洞察到"识别真正新增信息"正是经典视频编解码器长期解决的问题。
AI.method: 两步法：(1) 基于codec的token剪枝，丢弃冗余条件token；(2) on-policy self-distillation（OPSD），训练一个DiT适配器使模型适应codec剪枝模式且不降质。二者合称On-Policy Codec Distillation（CodecOPSD）。
AI.result: 在自研视频扩散模型的16种条件模态上，平均剪枝66%条件token，质量几乎无损；去噪速度提升2倍，KV cache模式下缓存内存最多降低73%。在其它SOTA预训练图像/视频生成模型上同样有效，且条件越多、帧越长、分辨率越高收益越大。
AI.conclusion: 借助经典codec的冗余判别能力实现条件token高效剪枝，并通过on-policy自蒸馏弥补剪枝带来的分布偏移，可作为一种模型无关的条件计算加速方案，随条件规模与分辨率增长而扩展性更佳。

title: Head Anything: Correspondence-Guided Joint Generation of 3D Heads from Few Images
summary: Large image-to-3D generators recover detailed heads from a single photograph but treat every image as a new object. For several images of one person, they hallucinate unseen regions independently without using information from the other images. We present Head Anything, which generates detailed head meshes from a few images with changing expressions and viewpoints. Instead of training a multi-image prior, we turn a pretrained single-image generator with a native 3D latent space into a joint generator that denoises all images together. Since global attention between images is hard to learn from scarce 3D head data, lightweight correspondence-attention adapters let every 3D token attend only to its corresponding points in the other images. We obtain correspondences by fitting a neural parametric head model to the generator's own single-image outputs, requiring no ground truth at test time. Training on both ground-truth and fitted correspondences makes the adapters robust to fitting errors. Each mesh stays pixel-aligned with its own image and borrows the unseen regions from all others. On head scans, Head Anything lowers the head Chamfer distance of the best image-to-3D generator by 32% and its cross-frame inconsistency by 47%, and its meshes improve face tracking. Code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出 Head Anything，将预训练单图 3D 生成器的 3D 隐空间扩展为联合去噪多图生成器，通过基于拟合对应关系的轻量对应注意力适配器，从少量变表情、变视角图像重建高细节头部网格。
AI.motivation: 现有图像到 3D 生成器把每张图视作独立物体，对同一人的多张图像各自独立地幻觉未见区域，未利用图像间互补信息，导致重建不完整且跨帧不一致。
AI.method: 不训练多图先验，而是把具备原生 3D 隐空间的预训练单图生成器改造为对全部图像联合去噪的生成器；因多图间全局注意力在稀缺 3D 头部数据上难以学习，引入轻量对应注意力适配器，使每个 3D token 只关注其他图像中的对应点。对应关系通过将神经参数化头部模型拟合到生成器自身的单图输出获得，测试时无需真值；训练同时使用真值与拟合对应关系，使适配器对拟合误差鲁棒。
AI.result: 每个网格与自身图像保持像素对齐并借用其他图像中的未见区域。在头部扫描数据上，相比最佳图像到 3D 生成器，头部 Chamfer 距离降低 32%，跨帧不一致性降低 47%，网格还能提升人脸跟踪效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过将单图生成器升级为带对应注意力的联合生成器，可在无多图训练先验、无测试时真值的条件下实现多图一致的高细节头部重建，并在几何精度、跨帧一致性及下游人脸跟踪任务上取得显著提升。

title: OmniV-Bench: Can MLLMs Comprehend Immersive Spatio-temporal Scenes?
summary: Omnidirectional videos (ODVs) capture dynamic environments with a full $360^\circ$ field of view, providing rich spatial context and temporal dynamics for applications such as virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and embodied intelligence. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made great progress in spatial and temporal understanding, yet their ability to comprehend the immersive 360 spatio-temporal information conveyed by ODVs remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we first introduce OmniV-Bench, a Benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate the capabilities of MLLMs on spatio-temporal Omnidirectional Video understanding. OmniV-Bench contains 4,123 high-quality ODVs collected from diverse scenes, along with 8,923 human-annotated question-answer pairs spanning 11 fine-grained tasks across three categories, i.e., general, spatial, and spatio-temporal understanding. Extensive benchmark experiments reveal that the spatio-temporal complexity of ODVs poses significant challenges for current MLLMs. To address these limitations, we further propose OmniV-Harness, an agentic harness that enhances ODV understanding through viewpoint-guided evidence initialization and task-relevant evidence acquisition with adaptive tool use. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that OmniV-Harness consistently improves immersive spatio-temporal reasoning ability of MLLMs. Both OmniV-Bench and OmniV-Harness will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 论文提出OmniV-Bench（4,123段全景视频、8,923条人工标注QA、11项细粒度任务的360°时空理解基准）与OmniV-Harness（基于视点引导证据初始化与自适应工具调用的智能体框架），系统评估并提升了MLLM对全景视频的沉浸式时空理解能力。
AI.motivation: 全景视频（ODV）具备360°视场，蕴含丰富的空间上下文与时序动态，但现有多模态大模型（MLLM）对这类沉浸式360°时空信息的理解能力尚缺乏系统评估，也缺少有效增强手段。
AI.method: 构建OmniV-Bench基准：采集多场景高质量ODV并人工标注多任务QA，任务划分为通用、空间、时空理解三大类共11项细粒度任务；同时提出OmniV-Harness智能体式框架，通过视点引导的证据初始化与任务相关证据获取，并结合自适应工具调用增强模型推理。
AI.result: 基准实验表明ODV的时空复杂性对现有MLLM构成显著挑战；引入OmniV-Harness后，模型在沉浸式时空推理能力上取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: OmniV-Bench填补了全景视频时空理解评测的空白，OmniV-Harness提供了有效的增强范式，二者将在论文发表后公开。

title: LiquidGazeNet: Towards Event-Based Near-Eye Gaze Estimation under Low-Light Conditions
summary: Near-eye gaze estimation under low-light nighttime conditions is challenging because the quality and effective temporal resolution of conventional intensity frames can be reduced. This paper presents LiquidGazeNet, an event-only gaze-estimation framework that combines polarity-aware spike-latency encoding with a custom LTC-based recurrent module. Positive- and negative-polarity events are represented in separate channels, while exponentially decayed time surfaces retain per-pixel temporal recency across successive event windows. A shared convolutional encoder extracts spatial features from each window, and a two-layer recurrent module composed of LTC-inspired cells integrates them causally over short temporal sequences. The network is trained using a hybrid objective that combines screen-space coordinate regression with centre-referenced directional consistency. The framework is evaluated on Gaze-FELL under cross-subject and cross-scene protocols and is further assessed through event-representation, temporal-module, window-duration, and computational ablations. LiquidGazeNet achieves mean errors of 3.75 degrees and 2.41 degrees under cross-subject and cross-scene evaluation, respectively. The results indicate that polarity-aware temporal-recency encoding, together with recurrent integration, is effective for event-only gaze estimation under the evaluated low-light nighttime conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出LiquidGazeNet，一种仅使用事件相机的低光夜间视线估计框架，融合极性感知脉冲延迟编码与LTC递归模块，跨被试/跨场景平均误差分别为3.75°和2.41°。
AI.motivation: 传统强度帧在低光夜间条件下质量下降、有效时间分辨率降低，导致近眼视线估计困难，因此需要不依赖强度帧的仅事件（event-only）方案。
AI.method: 采用极性感知的脉冲延迟/时间表面编码：正负极性事件分通道表示，指数衰减时间面保留逐像素时间新近性；共享卷积编码器逐窗口提取空间特征；两层LTC（液体时间常数）启发的递归单元对短时序进行因果积分；训练目标为屏幕空间坐标回归与以中心为参考的方向一致性组成的混合损失。
AI.result: 在Gaze-FELL数据集上，跨被试协议平均误差3.75°，跨场景协议2.41°；并通过事件表示、时间模块、窗口时长与计算量消融实验验证各组件贡献。
AI.conclusion: 极性感知的时间新近性编码结合递归时序积分，在所评估的低光夜间条件下对仅事件视线估计是有效的。

title: ColonoWorld: Camera-Controlled Full-Procedure Colonoscopy Video Generation
comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld
summary: Navigation systems in colonoscopy are advancing from guiding the endoscopist to steering the scope autonomously. Since an incorrect motion can injure the patient, developing and evaluating these systems calls for a world model of colonoscopy. Such a model must follow a commanded scope motion, keep the colon anatomy consistent, and show lesions and procedural events. Yet camera-controlled generators trained on general scenes lose the colon's structure under motion, and endoscopic generators offer no camera control. We present ColonoWorld, a colonoscopy world model conditioned on a camera trajectory and a coarse 3D tube of the colon, trained on in vivo videos. From a whole-colon tube, it generates a full cecum-to-rectum procedure, even for unseen colon shapes. It also places polyps, instruments, and irrigation at specified locations and times. ColonoWorld outperforms state-of-the-art video generators, reducing camera trajectory error by 32% and FVD by 29%. Our code and annotations will be released at https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld.

AI.tldr: ColonoWorld 是一个以相机轨迹和结肠粗三维管状结构为条件的结肠镜世界模型，可在体内视频上训练，从全结肠管生成盲肠到直肠的完整操作视频，并按指定位置与时序插入息肉、器械和冲洗，其相机轨迹误差降低32%、FVD降低29%。
AI.motivation: 结肠镜导航系统正从引导内镜医师转向自主操控镜体，错误动作可能造成患者损伤，因此需要可评估的结肠镜世界模型。现有模型存在两类缺陷：基于通用场景训练的相机可控生成器在运动下会丢失结肠结构；内镜生成器则不具备相机控制能力。
AI.method: 提出 ColonoWorld，以相机轨迹与结肠粗三维管（3D tube）为条件、在体内视频上训练的结肠镜世界模型；支持由全结肠管生成完整盲肠—直肠操作序列（含未见过的结肠形状），并可在指定位置与时间放置息肉、器械与冲洗。
AI.result: 相比最先进视频生成器，相机轨迹误差降低32%，FVD降低29%；可对未见过结肠形状生成完整操作视频。
AI.conclusion: ColonoWorld 通过显式结合解剖结构先验与相机控制，兼顾解剖一致性与可控生成，为结肠镜导航系统的开发与评估提供了世界模型基础；代码与标注将开源。
