title: CARE-3D: Reinforcement Learning for Evidence Grounded Agentic Reasoning in Situated 3D Scenes
summary: Situated 3D reasoning requires embodied agents to interpret objects, scene geometry, and viewpoint dependent spatial relations. Existing methods learn grounded interactions from supervised traces, but largely imitate prescribed evidence acquisition patterns rather than optimizing the support that the returned evidence provides for the correct answer. Moreover, outcome rewards provide limited credit for intermediate tool choices and may leave infrequent tools underexplored. An effective agent should instead adaptively decide what to ground, which tool to invoke, and how to assess the utility of returned evidence. To this end, this paper presents CARE-3D, a reinforcement post-training framework for adaptive grounded reasoning. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on grounding instructions first establishes valid interactions, after which Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) optimizes the agent while keeping the 3D grounding module frozen. CARE-3D combines Counterfactual Attribution of Returned Evidence for evidence sensitive credit assignment, and Group Coverage Sampling to preserve tool coverage. Experiments on MSQA and Beacon3D show consistent gains over SFT and GRPO using only answer and format rewards, especially in spatial reasoning and grounding answer coherence. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/xiaoqian-UQ/CARE-3D}{CARE-3D}.

AI.tldr: 提出 CARE-3D 强化后训练框架，用反事实证据归因与组覆盖采样改进具身智能体的 3D 定位推理。
AI.motivation: 现有具身 3D 推理方法从监督轨迹中学习定位交互，主要模仿既定的证据获取模式，而非优化所返回证据对正确答案的支持度；同时结果型奖励对中间工具选择的信用分配不足，导致低频工具探索不充分。因此智能体需要自适应决定定位对象、调用工具并评估证据效用。
AI.method: CARE-3D 采用两阶段强化后训练：先在 grounding 指令上做 SFT 建立有效交互，再用 GRPO 优化策略且保持 3D grounding 模块冻结。框架引入两项机制：(1) Counterfactual Attribution of Returned Evidence，对返回证据做反事实归因以实现证据敏感的信用分配；(2) Group Coverage Sampling，维持工具覆盖度。
AI.result: 在 MSQA 与 Beacon3D 上，相比仅使用答案与格式奖励的 SFT 和 GRPO 取得一致提升，尤其在空间推理与定位答案一致性方面表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 显式的证据级信用分配与工具覆盖采样能有效提升具身 3D 定位推理的自适应性与证据-答案一致性，为 3D 场景强化后训练提供可行范式。

title: GlanceNav: Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation with Streaming Memory and Counterfactual Rewind
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong policies for vision-and-language navigation (VLN). However, most of them encode a sample of past frames again at every decision and are trained on isolated decisions, so computation is redundant and the usable history is short. They also learn from their own mistakes through outcome rewards that give one scalar to a whole episode. We ask whether a navigator can encode each frame only once, at a constant cost per step, and still remember what matters and learn efficiently from its mistakes. We present GlanceNav, a streaming navigator built on a hybrid MLLM. Its Gated DeltaNet layers carry a recurrent state through the whole episode, while its attention layers keep a short window of recent observations and a small bank of keyframes, selected by how much each frame changes the recurrent state. This constant-size memory keeps the cost per step fixed and allows training on whole episodes with the same memory as at inference. Because the entire memory can also be copied in constant time, we further propose Counterfactual Rewind (CoRe), a reinforcement learning stage that rewinds a drifting rollout to its closest approach to the goal, lets an expert correct a few actions, and credits decisions by the resulting change in outcome. Trained only on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE training splits, with 1,000 instructions for reinforcement learning, a 4B GlanceNav reaches success rates of 71.9% and 73.6% on R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen. On R2R-CE, it outperforms the strongest previous single-RGB method trained without external data by 9.1 points, while running at 104 ms per step.

AI.tldr: GlanceNav 是一个基于混合 MLLM 的流式视觉语言导航器，通过每帧只编码一次、常数代价的恒定大小记忆，并结合反事实回溯强化学习实现高效长程记忆与纠错。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 导航器在每一步都重新编码历史帧样本，计算冗余且可用历史短；同时基于整条轨迹单一标量结果奖励的训练方式，难以从自身错误中高效学习。作者希望导航器能以每步常数代价仅编码每帧一次，同时保留关键历史并高效纠错。
AI.method: 提出 GlanceNav：混合 MLLM 架构，Gated DeltaNet 层在整个 episode 中维持循环状态，注意力层保留近期观测的短窗口及由"帧对循环状态的改变量"选出的小型关键帧库，形成常数大小记忆，训练与推理记忆一致。进一步提出 Counterfactual Rewind (CoRe) 强化学习阶段：将漂移 rollout 回溯至最接近目标的时刻，由专家纠正少量动作，并按结果变化为决策分配信用。
AI.result: 仅用 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE 训练集（强化学习使用 1,000 条指令），4B 参数 GlanceNav 在 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE val-unseen 上成功率分别达 71.9% 和 73.6%；在 R2R-CE 上比无外部数据训练的最强单 RGB 方法高 9.1 个点，运行速度为每步 104 ms。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，恒定代价的流式记忆配合细粒度信用分配的反事实回溯强化学习，可在不依赖外部数据条件下显著提升 VLN 性能并保持高效推理，为 MLLM 导航器提供可行范式。

title: DyLoMo-DiT: Dynamic Looped Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Transformers
comment: 46 pages, 29 figures, 33 tables. Code, weights and project page: https://oneboxcream.github.io/DyLoMo-DiT/
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) scale model capacity by increasing both parameter count and computation. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants expand parameter capacity while keeping per-token computation roughly fixed, but still require substantial parameter storage. In this paper, we propose Dynamic Looped MoE DiT (DyLoMo-DiT), which reuses parameters rather than adding them: a weight-shared loop repeatedly applies the middle layers, while sparse experts allocate parameter capacity across tokens. This design deepens the network without adding parameters, freeing the parameter budget for other uses, such as more experts or more distinct layers. It also allocates compute dynamically, varying the number of passes across noise levels. Experiments show that DyLoMo-DiT makes more effective use of parameter and compute budgets, with further gains from assigning more passes to low-noise steps. On ImageNet $256\times256$, DyLoMo-DiT reduces FID by 11-24% relative to DiT and 36-56% relative to DiT-MoE at matched parameter and compute budgets. For text-to-image generation, a scaled DyLoMo-DiT achieves a higher GenEval score than FLUX.1 (0.714 vs. 0.673), with less than one tenth of its active parameters (1.05B vs. 12B).

AI.tldr: 提出DyLoMo-DiT，通过权重共享循环复用中间层并配合稀疏专家，在不增加参数的情况下加深网络，并随噪声水平动态分配计算量，在参数与计算预算匹配下显著降低FID。
AI.motivation: DiT通过增加参数与计算扩展容量；MoE变体虽在固定单token计算下扩大参数容量，但仍需大量参数存储。作者希望在不增加参数的前提下提升模型表达能力，并把节省的参数量预算用于更多专家或更多独立层。
AI.method: 动态循环MoE DiT：对中间层进行权重共享的循环复用（repeatedly apply middle layers），从而在参数量不变时加深网络；同时用稀疏专家为不同token分配参数容量；并按噪声水平动态调整循环次数（passes），将更多passes分配给低噪声阶段。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256上，参数与计算预算匹配时，相较DiT降低FID 11–24%，相较DiT-MoE降低36–56%；为低噪声步分配更多passes可带来额外收益。文生图任务中，放大的DyLoMo-DiT在GenEval上得分0.714，高于FLUX.1的0.673，而激活参数不足其十分之一（1.05B vs 12B）。
AI.conclusion: 参数复用（循环共享）与稀疏专家的结合能更高效地利用参数与计算预算，动态计算分配（尤其偏向低噪声步）进一步增益，并在文生图任务上以小激活参数量超越大模型基线。

title: Screening for nonrigidity in structure from motion using projected reprojection residuals
comment: 34 pages including 19 pages of supplementary material. 5 main figures and 5 supplementary figures
summary: Sparse structure from motion (SfM) assumes a static scene, yet deformation may still yield plausible reconstructions. Reprojection-error summaries discard how errors are arranged across points and views. We propose a diagnostic that first removes residual components explainable by small point and camera adjustments and simple spatial trends that change over time. It then measures alignment with fixed spatial and temporal patterns. The diagnostic uses one estimated SfM reconstruction and provides screening evidence rather than a physical deformation estimate. Across four synthetic tubular families, the diagnostic detected all eight acquisitions with prescribed motion, compared with five or six for summaries of reprojection-error magnitude. Each family's cutoff was the highest static score among the other three families, so the static acquisition with the highest score also screened positive. With the same cutoffs, the diagnostic retained positive detections in 19 of 20 reconstruction variants spanning changes in appearance and reconstruction pipeline, with one numerical abstention. These findings show that the arrangement of reprojection errors across points and views can reveal inconsistencies that their magnitudes alone miss. The four families were known during development, and the transfer variants reused two of them. Within this setting, the diagnostic offers a practical way to flag a plausible reconstruction for closer inspection using only its estimated cameras, 3D points and image observations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于重投影误差空间-时间排列模式的诊断方法，用于在静态场景假设下筛查可能存在的形变。
AI.motivation: 稀疏SfM假设场景静态，但形变场景仍可能产生看似合理的重建；而重投影误差的幅值统计量丢弃了误差在点与视图间的排列信息，无法识别此类不一致。
AI.method: 先剔除可由点与相机微调及随时间变化的简单空间趋势所解释的残差分量，再度量残差与固定空间、时间模式的对齐程度；仅使用一次估计的SfM重建结果，作为筛查证据而非物理形变估计。
AI.result: 在四个合成管状族中，诊断检出全部8个含预设运动的采集，而误差幅值统计仅检出5–6个；各族的截断值取其余三族中最高的静态得分，故静态采集中得分最高者亦被判为阳性；沿用同一截断值，20个重建变体（外观与流水线变化）中19个保持阳性检出，1个数值性弃权。
AI.conclusion: 重投影误差在点与视图间的排列方式能揭示幅值所遗漏的不一致性；在四族均于开发阶段已知、迁移变体复用其中两族的设定下，该诊断可仅凭估计的相机、三维点与图像观测标记出需进一步检查的“貌似合理”重建。

title: Zhengrong: World Models with Pole-Based Action-Response Factorization for Direct Visual Planning
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Technical report, Beijing Freedo Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Direct visual world models predict the effects of candidate action sequences without recursive latent rollout, yet they leave the temporal structure of action effects unspecified. We introduce Zhengrong (Zhengrong-PoleWM), a world model that decomposes a latent trajectory into an initial-condition anchor, a free response, and delayed responses to action innovations. Nonlinear networks map visual history and causal action prefixes to response coefficients. A shared bank of stable conjugate poles determines how each response evolves with elapsed time. This factorization preserves nonlinear interactions across actions, anchors predictions exactly at the initial state, prevents future actions from affecting earlier predictions, and yields bounded responses to finite control plans. We derive an exact re-anchoring identity that identifies the additional basis direction $Ψ_κ(s)$ needed to represent shifted trajectory tails. Across four offline image-goal control benchmarks (Cube, TwoRoom, PushT, and Reacher), Zhengrong-PoleWM achieves $90.83\% \pm 0.47\%$ macro-average success over two training seeds at epoch 20, exceeding the strongest baseline (QQWorld) by 6.08 percentage points. Selecting checkpoints by validation loss yields $91.21\% \pm 1.00\%$. In a controlled first-epoch Cube study without restart regularization, neural and pole response heads outperform a generic direct predictor by 20.67 and 23.34 percentage points, respectively. On an NVIDIA A100 GPU, median latency for a full 30-iteration cross-entropy method search ranges from 74 to 87 ms across the four tasks. The mean of these medians is 77.5 ms, a 15.8% latency reduction relative to Fast-LeWM and a $7.1\times$ speedup over autoregressive LeWM.

AI.tldr: 提出Zhengrong-PoleWM世界模型，将潜在轨迹分解为初始锚点、自由响应与对动作创新的延迟响应，用共享稳定共轭极点刻画时间演化，实现精确锚定、因果一致与有界响应，在四个图像目标控制基准上取得90.83%宏平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 直接视觉世界模型虽无需递归潜在滚动即可预测候选动作序列的效果，但未明确刻画动作效应的时间结构，缺乏对初始状态锚定、时序因果性与有限控制计划下有界响应的结构性保证。
AI.method: 将潜在轨迹分解为初始条件锚点、自由响应和对动作创新的延迟响应三部分；用非线性网络将视觉历史与因果动作前缀映射为响应系数；以共享的稳定共轭极点库决定各响应随时间的演化；并推导出精确重锚定恒等式，识别表示平移轨迹尾部所需的额外基方向Ψ_κ(s)。
AI.result: 在Cube、TwoRoom、PushT、Reacher四个离线图像目标控制基准上，第20轮两训练种子宏平均成功率达90.83%±0.47%，超过最强基线QQWorld 6.08个百分点；按验证损失选检查点达91.21%±1.00%。无重启正则的首轮Cube对照中，神经与极点响应头分别比通用直接预测器高20.67与23.34个百分点。A100上30步CEM搜索中位延迟74–87 ms，均值77.5 ms，较Fast-LeWM降低15.8%，较自回归LeWM加速7.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 极点分解为直接世界模型引入了可解释的时间结构归纳偏置，在保持高成功率的同时显著提升规划推理效率，是兼顾精度与实时性的有效方案。

title: Tri-DNO: Trilateral Diffusion Noise Optimization for 3D Human Object Interaction
summary:
Generating realistic 3D human object interactions (HOI) is essential for applications, such as augmented or virtual reality (AR/VR) or character animation of interactive entertainment. A particular challenge lies in the faithful generation of hand grasps in human object interaction scenes, where even minor geometric inconsistencies, such as insufficient contact or interpenetration, can significantly compromise realism. While diffusion-based generative models have shown promising results in HOI synthesis, ensuring physically plausible hand-object interactions remains challenging.
  We present Tri-DNO, a diffusion noise optimization strategy to sample from a pretrained multimodal HOI diffusion model, improving hand-object contact. Rather than modifying or retraining the generative model, our approach iteratively optimizes the initial noise of the diffusion generator, thereby generating firm hand object contact, while mitigating penetration and keeping the hand position realistic. Experiments on the GRAB dataset demonstrate improvements over the baseline in grasp quality without additional model training or increased computational cost compared to existing methods. We further demonstrate the applicability of our approach to practical media production scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出 Tri-DNO，一种扩散噪声优化策略：在不修改或重训预训练多模态 HOI 扩散模型的前提下，迭代优化生成器的初始噪声以提升手-物接触质量，兼顾抑制穿透与保持手部位姿合理，在 GRAB 数据集上改善抓取质量且不增加训练或计算开销。
AI.motivation: 在 AR/VR 与角色动画等应用中，人-物交互（HOI）生成中的手部抓取对真实感至关重要；接触不足或相互穿透等细微几何不一致会显著破坏真实感。现有扩散式 HOI 生成模型在物理合理的手-物交互（尤其是接触保真度）上仍存在不足。
AI.method: Tri-DNO 采用"测试时噪声优化"思路：保持预训练多模态 HOI 扩散模型参数冻结，仅对扩散采样过程中的初始噪声进行迭代优化，目标函数同时约束手-物稳定接触、惩罚穿透并保持手部位置合理；从而以采样端优化替代模型修改或再训练。
AI.result: 在 GRAB 数据集上，相比基线在抓取质量指标上取得提升，穿透得到缓解且手部位姿保持合理；方法无需额外模型训练，相较现有方法也未增加计算开销。作者进一步验证了其在实际媒体制作场景中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 通过优化初始噪声即可在冻结的预训练扩散模型上实现更物理可信的手-物交互生成，是一种低成本、可即插即用的后处理式改进方案，并具备面向实际内容生产的落地潜力。

title: Towards an Armenian Epigraphic Corpus
summary: The Divan hay vimagrut'yan (1960-2017), the printed corpus of Armenian inscriptions, comprises nearly 7,600 records; a growing number of the inscriptions they describe, damaged or destroyed in recent decades, survive only in its pages. Armenian epigraphy nevertheless lacks a digital resource of the kind available for Greek, Latin or Georgian. This paper presents the Corpus Inscriptionum Armenicarum Electronicum, which turns the ten volumes of the Divan into an open digital corpus. Layout detection, OCR and a vision-language model produce a first structured reading of each record, which specialists then check on a proofreading platform. First corrections show that letters are read reliably and that residual errors concentrate in the editorial signs. The corpus is designed as a lasting platform for documenting Armenian inscriptions and as a source of silver data in Classical and Middle Armenian for language models and computational linguistics.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了亚美尼亚铭文电子语料库（CIAE），将十卷本《Divan hay vimagrut'yan》转为开放数字语料，通过版面检测、OCR与视觉语言模型生成初步结构化转写，并由专家在校对平台核验。
AI.motivation: 亚美尼亚铭文缺乏类似希腊、拉丁或格鲁吉亚语已有的数字资源；且《Divan》收录的近7600条记录中，许多铭文近年已被损坏或毁坏，仅存于纸本中，亟需数字化保存。
AI.method: 对十卷《Divan》进行版面检测、OCR及视觉语言模型处理，生成每条记录的首版结构化释读；再由专家在专用校对平台上逐条核验修正。
AI.result: 初步校订显示字母识别可靠，残余错误集中于编辑符号（editorial signs）层面。
AI.conclusion: 该语料库定位为亚美尼亚铭文记录的长期平台，并可作为古典亚美尼亚语与中亚美尼亚语的"银数据"（silver data），服务于语言模型与计算语言学研究。

title: A Search Worth a Billion Pixels: Explaining Gigapixel Classifiers
summary: Perturbation-based attribution methods explain model predictions without accessing their internal representations, but scaling them to high-resolution images requires balancing perturbation granularity and computational cost. Fine-grained perturbations require many model evaluations, whereas coarse masks may overlook small but relevant evidence. We introduce Wavelet Find-and-Refine (WaFR), a model-agnostic attribution method combining adaptive hierarchical search with sparse multiscale regression. By selectively refining regions that influence the prediction, WaFR maintains fine-grained localisation with a computational cost that depends on the spatial distribution of the evidence. As image resolution increases to 8,192 pixels per side, WaFR maintains a Pointing Game score of at least .995 in controlled localisation experiments, including at matched forward-pass budgets. On gigapixel whole-slide images, it requires a median of 176 forward passes and achieves the highest mean patch-level AUROC among the evaluated perturbation-based methods (.949).

AI.tldr: 提出WaFR（Wavelet Find-and-Refine），一种模型无关的扰动归因方法，结合自适应层次搜索与稀疏多尺度回归，在高分辨率图像上兼顾细粒度定位与低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 扰动归因方法无需访问模型内部表征，但在高分辨率图像上面临扰动粒度与计算成本的权衡：细粒度扰动需大量前向评估，粗粒度掩码又会遗漏小而关键的证据。
AI.method: WaFR由两部分组成：自适应层次搜索（find），仅对影响预测的区域进行选择性细化；稀疏多尺度回归（refine），在小波多尺度表示上以稀疏方式估计归因。整体为模型无关（model-agnostic），计算成本随证据的空间分布而非图像尺寸增长。
AI.result: 在单边8,192像素的受控定位实验中，WaFR的Pointing Game得分至少为.995，且在同等前向次数预算下同样成立；在千兆像素全切片图像上，中位前向次数为176，取得所评估扰动类方法中最高的平均patch级AUROC（.949）。
AI.conclusion: WaFR证明按证据空间分布自适应的层次细化可有效缓解扰动归因的粒度—成本权衡，在超高分辨率与千兆像素场景下实现高定位精度与高计算效率的统一。

title: Reliable Recursive Memory for Causal Multi-scale Video Polyp Segmentation
comment: 13 pages, 9 figures, 9 tables. Extended version of CMSA-Net (MICCAI 2026). Submitted to Medical Image Analysis
summary: Video polyp segmentation (VPS) is essential for computer-aided colonoscopy, as it localizes and tracks polyps frame by frame. However, VPS remains challenging because polyps resemble the mucosa and change quickly in scale, which calls for history beyond a short clip, and because blur, specular highlights, and occlusion often degrade only part of a frame. Existing methods keep history as whole frames, so their cost grows with the history length, and a partly degraded frame carries its degraded content to later predictions. To address these issues, we propose STREAM, a streaming framework for VPS that extends the causal multi-scale aggregation (CMA) of our conference work from a fixed clip to an online stream. STREAM introduces a Recursive Slot Memory (RSM) that summarizes multi-scale features and soft foreground and background cues into a constant number of slots, which the current features read and pass to CMA, supplying long-range history at a constant cost. Furthermore, we design Reliability-Aware Slot Writing (RASW), which estimates a pixel-level quality map from the current frame, supervised by its local error, and uses it to control which locations are written into RSM and how much each slot is updated. Experiments on SUN-SEG and CVC-ClinicDB demonstrate that STREAM achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving the Dice of the conference model from 81.3% to 85.7% on the hardest subset while running at 48 FPS with a constant state of 0.32 MB. Code will be released at https://github.com/wangtong627/STREAM.

AI.tldr: STREAM将视频息肉分割中的因果多尺度聚合从固定片段扩展为在线流式框架，通过递归槽记忆以恒定代价提供长程历史，并用可靠性感知槽写入抑制局部退化帧的影响，在SUN-SEG与CVC-ClinicDB上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: VPS中息肉与黏膜相似且尺度变化快，需要超出短片段的长程历史；同时模糊、镜面高光和遮挡往往只退化帧的局部。现有方法以完整帧保存历史，存储代价随历史长度线性增长，且局部退化内容会被带入后续预测。
AI.method: 提出STREAM流式框架：1) 递归槽记忆（RSM），将多尺度特征及软前景/背景线索压缩为恒定数量的槽，当前特征读取槽并传入CMA，以恒定开销供给长程历史；2) 可靠性感知槽写入（RASW），以局部误差监督从当前帧估计像素级质量图，据此控制写入位置及每个槽的更新幅度。
AI.result: 在SUN-SEG与CVC-ClinicDB上取得SOTA；在最难子集上Dice由会议模型的81.3%提升至85.7%，运行速度48 FPS，状态内存恒定为0.32 MB。
AI.conclusion: 以槽式记忆替代整帧历史，可在恒定内存与高帧率下实现长程时序建模，并通过质量图门控写入抑制局部退化帧的误差传播，为在线VPS提供了高效且鲁棒的方案。

title: ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusion Model for Oriented Object Detection
summary: The diffusion model has been successfully applied to various detection tasks. However, it still faces several challenges when used for oriented object detection: objects that are arbitrarily rotated require the diffusion model to encode their orientation information; uncontrollable random boxes inaccurately locate objects with dense arrangements and extreme aspect ratios; oriented boxes result in the misalignment between them and image features. To overcome these limitations, we propose ReDiffDet, a framework that formulates oriented object detection as a rotation-equivariant denoising diffusion process. First, we represent an oriented box as a 2D Gaussian distribution, forming the basis of the denoising paradigm. The reverse process can be proven to be rotation-equivariant within this representation and model framework. Second, we design a conditional encoder with conditional boxes to prevent boxes from being randomly placed across the entire image. Third, we propose an aligned decoder for alignment between oriented boxes and image features. The extensive experiments demonstrate ReDiffDet achieves promising performance and significantly outperforms the diffusion model baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReDiffDet，将旋转目标检测建模为旋转等变去噪扩散过程，用2D高斯表示有向框，并配条件框条件编码器与对齐解码器，性能显著优于扩散基线。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型用于有向目标检测存在三方面问题：任意旋转目标需编码方向信息；不可控随机框难以准确定位密集排列与极端长宽比目标；有向框与图像特征之间存在错位。
AI.method: （1）将每个有向框表示为2D高斯分布作为去噪范式基础，并在该表示与模型框架下证明反向过程具有旋转等变性；（2）设计带条件框的条件编码器，避免框在全图随机放置；（3）提出对齐解码器，实现有向框与图像特征的对齐。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 ReDiffDet 取得有前景的性能，并显著优于扩散模型基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过旋转等变高斯去噪表示、条件框引导与特征对齐解码，ReDiffDet 有效缓解了旋转目标检测中方向编码、框初始化不可控及特征错位问题。

title: When Do Spatial Plans Help Text-to-Image Generation? Causal Control, System Utility, and Text Responsiveness
summary: A generator can follow a spatial plan, but the benefit of supplying that plan depends on what the model can already do from text. In a controlled study with 18 paired training seeds, correcting predicted positions and sizes improves spatial intersection-over-union by 0.030, yet direct text is non-inferior at matched training compute. In a pretrained generator, a fixed rule layout improves two-object task success over the same text-only adapter by 12.50 percentage points, mostly by separating objects that already appear in the correct order. We then ask whether a more precise instruction can achieve the same separation across conditioning paths. On 288 new task families, adding a minimum-gap instruction improves success by 37.15 points with the text-only adapter, by at most 0.69 points with widely spaced regions, and by 6.94 points with tightly spaced regions. Under tight regions, 230 of 288 baseline images have the correct objects and direction yet miss the required gap, ruling out a high baseline success rate as the sole explanation for the weak text response.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控实验比较“空间布局条件”与“纯文本条件”对生成器空间控制的作用，发现布局的收益依赖于模型现有能力与条件路径：位置/尺寸修正可提升空间IoU 0.030，但在匹配算力下纯文本不劣；固定规则布局在预训练生成器上将双物体任务成功率提升12.50个百分点，主要来自分离已按正确顺序出现的物体；更精确的间隔指令在纯文本适配器上带来37.15个百分点提升，而宽间距区域最多0.69、紧间距区域6.94。
AI.motivation: 探究生成器虽能遵循空间计划，但提供该计划的额外收益在多大程度上取决于模型仅凭文本已能完成的能力，即厘清空间条件与文本条件两类路径的相对价值。
AI.method: 采用受控实验：以18个配对训练种子比较位置与尺寸修正对空间IoU的影响；在预训练生成器上比较固定规则布局与纯文本适配器；再在288个新任务族上，跨不同条件路径（纯文本、宽间距区域、紧间距区域）施加最小间隔指令，并分析基线图像的失败模式。
AI.result: 修正预测位置与尺寸使空间IoU提升0.030，但匹配训练算力下直接文本不劣；固定规则布局使双物体任务成功率较纯文本适配器提升12.50个百分点；最小间隔指令使纯文本适配器成功率提升37.15个百分点，宽间距区域最多提升0.69，紧间距区域提升6.94；紧间距条件下288张基线图像中有230张物体与方向正确但缺失所需间隔。
AI.conclusion: 空间计划的收益高度依赖于模型已有能力与条件路径，而非普遍优于文本；文本路径在指令更精确时具有更大提升空间，布局生成的弱响应不能简单以高基线成功率解释。

title: Graph2Scene: Relation-Aware Text-to-Image Generation with Graph-Guided Diffusion Model
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models still struggle with complex prompts containing many elements and interactions. Existing attention-control methods mainly focus on controlling where elements appear, but often ignore how objects interact with each other. As a result, relation tokens describing interactions between elements may assign high attention to irrelevant regions, leading to missing or incorrect interactions. In this paper, we propose Graph2Scene, a training-free framework that treats scene graphs as a core control signal for diffusion generation. It represents elements as nodes and their relations as edges, and translates these element-relation dependencies into selective attention guidance. It grounds each element to its corresponding region and guides relational interactions among the involved elements. To achieve appropriate relation control without over-constraining the generation process, Graph2Scene further adapts the control duration to scene complexity and progressively relaxes graph guidance during denoising. Experiments on T2I-CompBench and ConceptMix show clear improvements in compositional generation, especially for object relations. On ConceptMix, Graph2Scene improves relationship accuracy from 0.59 to 0.84 over the strongest FLUX.1-based regional-control baseline. Results on LongBench-T2I further show its advantage on long and complex prompts.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 Graph2Scene 框架，将场景图（节点=元素、边=关系）作为扩散生成的核心控制信号，转化为选择性注意力引导，并随场景复杂度自适应控制时长、逐步松弛图引导。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型难以处理元素多、交互复杂的提示词；既有注意力控制方法只关注元素“出现在哪里”，忽略“元素之间如何交互”，导致描述关系的 token 把注意力分配到无关区域，造成关系缺失或错误。
AI.method: 免训练框架：将场景图作为控制信号，用节点表示元素、边表示关系，将元素-关系依赖翻译为选择性注意力引导；一方面把每个元素锚定到对应区域，另一方面引导参与交互元素之间的关系生成；同时根据场景复杂度自适应调整控制时长，并在去噪过程中逐步松弛图引导，以避免过度约束生成。
AI.result: 在 T2I-CompBench 与 ConceptMix 上组合式生成（尤其物体关系）明显提升；ConceptMix 上关系准确率由最强 FLUX.1 区域控制基线的 0.59 提升至 0.84；在 LongBench-T2I 上对长而复杂提示词亦具优势。
AI.conclusion: 以场景图为显式控制信号、结合自适应时长与渐进松弛策略，可在不额外训练的前提下有效改善复杂提示词中的关系与组合式生成质量。

title: Diffutoon-2: Toon Shading with Video Diffusion Models
summary: Toon shading renders objects with a flat, stylized appearance. Diffusion models open a new route to this task by transforming photorealistic videos into an anime style. However, existing approaches often rely on curated source and style training pairs or additional visual references. Diffutoon avoids these requirements through structure guidance and colorization, but builds on an image diffusion backbone with short-window motion modules and repeated overlapping-window denoising. We present Diffutoon-2, a video diffusion framework that learns toon shading through animation reconstruction. Two complementary modules independently reconstruct animation clips from outlines and blurred colors, with the video backbone frozen. At inference, the modules jointly guide generation using the same types of conditions extracted from photorealistic footage, requiring neither cross-domain training pairs nor external style references. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Diffutoon-2 outperforms both general-purpose and domain-specific baselines, across quantitative metrics and human evaluation.

AI.tldr: Diffutoon-2 是一个通过"动画片段重建"来学习卡通渲染的视频扩散框架，无需跨域训练对或外部风格参考。
AI.motivation: 现有卡通渲染方法依赖成对的源-风格训练数据或额外视觉参考；Diffutoon 虽规避了这些要求，但基于图像扩散骨干、使用短时窗运动模块和重复的重叠窗口去噪，存在局限。作者希望以原生视频扩散框架实现更高质量的卡通化转换。
AI.method: 在冻结视频扩散骨干的前提下，训练两个互补模块，分别从"线稿轮廓"和"模糊颜色"独立重建动画片段；推理时用从真实视频中提取的同类条件（轮廓与模糊颜色）联合引导生成，实现跨域卡通着色。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Diffutoon-2 在量化指标与人工评估上均优于通用基线和领域专用基线。
AI.conclusion: 以动画重建为监督信号、冻结视频骨干的双条件引导方案，可在无配对数据和风格参考的条件下实现高质量视频卡通渲染，验证了该范式的有效性与通用性。

title: GeLiFiSH: Recursive LiDAR Keypoint Estimation with Ground and Moving Object Segmentation
summary: LiDAR registration and loop closure often rely on sparse keypoints, which must remain repeatable across sessions, viewpoints, and sensors. To handle differing scan patterns, detectors typically operate on accumulated submaps, which introduces latency and processes each submap independently, so repeated observations are never fused. Height-based detectors also reference structure to an estimated ground, so its inconsistency across sessions propagates into the keypoints. Moreover, dynamic objects leave ghost trails that can be mistaken for static structure. We present GeLiFiSH (Geometric LiDAR Filtering with Sequential Hypothesis testing), a learning-free filter that recursively estimates persistent keypoints at scan rate. A height-structure detector runs on a rolling voxel map, and detections initialize tracks with a position, covariance, and existence probability, accepted or rejected by a sequential probability ratio test. Ground segmentation provides a sensor-agnostic height reference, and moving object segmentation removes dynamic points before map insertion. On SemanticKITTI, HeLiMOS, and HeLiPR, spanning five LiDARs and multiple sessions, GeLiFiSH attains the highest average keypoint repeatability among the compared detectors and the second-highest cross-session registration recall from keypoints alone, behind ISS which extracts four times as many keypoints. With one parameter set and no sensor-height prior, both ground and moving object segmentation modules outperform their baselines on average.

AI.tldr: 提出无监督（learning-free）的LiDAR关键点滤波框架GeLiFiSH，以滚动体素图上的递归跟踪+序贯假设检验在scan rate下估计持久关键点，实现高可重复性关键点与跨会话配准。
AI.motivation: LiDAR配准与回环检测依赖稀疏关键点，关键点需跨会话、视角与传感器可重复。现有检测器存在四类问题：(1)为兼容不同扫描模式而在累积子图上运行，带来延迟且各子图独立处理、重复观测无法融合；(2)基于高度的检测器依赖估计地面作为结构参考，地面跨会话不一致会传播到关键点；(3)动态物体留下"鬼影"轨迹，易被误判为静态结构。
AI.method: GeLiFiSH（Geometric LiDAR Filtering with Sequential Hypothesis testing）：1) 高度-结构检测器在滚动体素图上运行；2) 检测结果初始化轨迹（位置、协方差、存在概率），由序贯概率比检验(SPRT)接受或拒绝，实现scan rate的递归持久关键点估计；3) 地面分割提供与传感器无关的高度参考；4) 插入地图前用运动物体分割剔除动态点。
AI.result: 在SemanticKITTI、HeLiMOS、HeLiPR（覆盖5种LiDAR、多会话）上：平均关键点可重复性为对比检测器中最优；仅用关键点的跨会话配准召回率第二，仅次于提取关键点数量为其4倍的ISS；单一参数集、无传感器高度先验条件下，地面分割与运动物体分割模块平均性能均优于各自基线。
AI.conclusion: 将关键点提取转化为序贯滤波/多观测融合问题，可有效提升重复性与跨会话一致性；SPRT+滚动体素图+地面与动态点分割的组合是一种无需学习、传感器无关且参数统一的方案。

title: Distill the Correction, Not the Rewrite: Hindsight Twins for Self-Improving Text-to-Image Models
summary: Text-to-image models can learn from their own mistakes by distilling a self-teacher conditioned on a vision-language critic's revised prompt. However, such self-teachers barely improve alignment, and both they and their hindsight-contrast variants absorb the critic's unintended additions to the scene, such as lighting or scenery. We attribute this to two factors: (1) the prompt already specifies the desired fix, so a useful revision must go beyond the failed span, often rewriting the entire scene and adding details that overshadow the fix; (2) although the critic localizes the error to a single span, self-teachers condition on the rewrite, entangling the intended fix with unintended additions. Motivated by these insights, we propose Hindsight Twins (HinT), which fills the critic's revision template once with the intended fix and once with the observed error and distills only their velocity difference, anchored at the user's prompt. Because text encoders spread the edit of a single slot to all other tokens, HinT further aligns the twins' token states outside the slot. Across Qwen-Image-2512, SD3.5-M, and FLUX.2-klein, HinT keeps the rate of critic-induced bias at the base-model level while matching or exceeding the alignment gains of prior self-distillation, and it keeps improving over twelve rounds of self-training where contrastive baselines decay.

AI.tldr: HinT通过构造"修正/错误"双胞胎提示词并只蒸馏其速度差、并对槽位外token状态做对齐，抑制评论器引入的无关偏置，在多个文生图模型上稳定提升对齐性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法让自教师以视觉-语言评论器改写后的提示词为条件进行自蒸馏，但自教师几乎不提升对齐性，且自教师及其"事后对比"变体会吸收评论器带入的无关细节（如光照、场景）。作者归因于两点：一是提示词已给出期望修正，有用改写必须超出失败片段、甚至重写整场景，新增细节淹没修正；二是自教师以整段改写为条件，把意图修正与无关新增纠缠在一起。
AI.method: 提出Hindsight Twins (HinT)：将评论器的改写模板分别填充"意图修正"与"观测到的错误"，仅蒸馏两者的速度差，并以用户原始提示词为锚点；针对文本编码器会将单槽位编辑扩散到其他token的问题，进一步对齐双胞胎在槽位之外的token状态。
AI.result: 在Qwen-Image-2512、SD3.5-M与FLUX.2-klein上，HinT将评论器诱导偏置率维持在基座模型水平，同时对齐性增益匹配或超过既有自蒸馏方法；并在十二轮自训练中持续提升，而对比类基线出现衰减。
AI.conclusion: 通过"双子差值蒸馏+槽位外token对齐"，HinT解耦了意图修正与评论器无关新增，实现了低偏置、可持续的自训练对齐改进。

title: Déjà VAE: When Do Autoencoder Traces Reveal Generated Images?
comment: 29 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Code and per-image scores: https://github.com/iamsaugatpandey/deja-vae
summary: A latent diffusion model's output has already passed through its autoencoder, so a second round trip changes it very little. This "déjà vu" underlies reconstruction-based detectors of generated images; we analyse when it reveals a generated image and when it does not. Read by a frozen vision foundation model without training, the trace is strongest in intermediate layers, and, unlike pixel-level reconstruction error, it treats blur as a sign of a real image. It belongs to the generator's exact decoder: on Synthbuster, the exact decoders of Stable Diffusion 1.3, 1.4, 2 and XL are the strongest of eight autoencoders and catch 94-100% of their generators' images at a 5% false-alarm rate (SDXL's version identified post hoc), while near-identical versions catch 7-42%. A detector trained only on real photographs and their autoencoder copies matches one trained on 162k generated images on GenImage (+2.3 points, 95% CI [0.9, 3.7]) and complements it in fusion, but one resize with JPEG re-save, or a mild blur, costs it 19-27 points. Two lessons concern benchmarks. The in-the-wild benchmark Chameleon can be solved from image width alone. And on Synthbuster, how the real photographs are matched to the generated images' size decides whether our detector leads or trails (+4.4 or -9.7 points): the matching protocol alone can reverse a detector comparison. Code and per-image scores: https://github.com/iamsaugatpandey/deja-vae

AI.tldr: 利用潜扩散模型输出经过自编码器后二次往返变化极小的"既视感"(déjà vu)现象，分析何种情况下可据此识别生成图像：冻结视觉基础模型中间层特征、且需匹配生成器的精确解码器；在Synthbuster上对SD 1.3/1.4/2/XL的对应解码器可在5%误报率下检出94–100%图像。
AI.motivation: 现有基于重建的生成图像检测器依赖"自编码器二次往返几乎不改变潜扩散输出"这一假设，但该痕迹何时可靠、何时失效缺乏系统分析；同时需要审视基准评测协议本身对结论的影响。
AI.method: 用冻结的视觉基础模型（无需训练）读取往返痕迹并考察各层强度；将痕迹归因到生成器特定解码器，比较八种自编码器；训练仅用真实照片及其自编码器副本的检测器，与用16.2万张生成图像训练的检测器在GenImage上对比及融合；进行退化鲁棒性测试（缩放+JPEG重存、轻度模糊）；审查Chameleon与Synthbuster的基准协议（图像宽度、真实图与生成图的尺寸匹配方式）。
AI.result: 痕迹在中间层最强，且将模糊视为真实信号（区别于像素级重建误差）；Synthbuster上SD 1.3/1.4/2/XL的精确解码器在八种自编码器中表现最强，5%误报率下检出94–100%，而近似版本仅7–42%（SDXL版本为事后识别）；仅用真实照片训练的检测器在GenImage上与大规模生成图像训练者相当（+2.3点，95% CI [0.9, 3.7]）并可融合互补；但一次缩放加JPEG重存或轻度模糊即损失19–27点；Chameleon可仅凭图像宽度解出；Synthbuster上真实图与生成图的尺寸匹配协议可使检测器排名反转（+4.4或−9.7点）。
AI.conclusion: 该重建痕迹是有效但脆弱的生成图像证据，关键在于解码器精确匹配与视觉基础模型中间层读取；检测器对常见后处理敏感，且基准构建协议（尺寸匹配、图像宽度）足以改变甚至反转检测器比较结论，故需审慎评估基准设计。

title: Lyris: Layout-Guided Long Video Generation with Persistent 3D Memory
summary: Exploring a scene from as little as a single photo requires generating a long, camera-controlled walkthrough that extends far beyond what was captured, yet remains consistent upon return. Memory-based video generation methods preserve what they have already seen, but have no anchor beyond it, where the camera drifts from its path and a text prompt can name objects but not place them. Layout-conditioned methods provide such an anchor and precise control over what appears where, but rely on layouts that are typically authored by hand. Both limitations arise because, beyond what was captured, nothing anchors the video model unless a human authors one. To overcome both, we propose Lyris, a long video generation framework that never leaves the video model without an anchor: a persistent point-cloud memory where the scene has been observed or generated, and a 3D layout that a vision-language model authors where it has not. Our key insight is that the interface between the two models can be surprisingly coarse. A layout of one labeled 3D box per object is simple enough for a vision-language model to author (and for a user to edit), yet expressive enough for a video model to follow once rendered along the camera path. We demonstrate walkthroughs of over three minutes and 50 meters from a single photo, passing through doorways into rooms it never shows. When evaluated on minute-long round trips across four datasets, Lyris outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a wide margin, reducing camera error by 3.8x and improving consistency upon return by 22% on average.

AI.tldr: Lyris提出长视频生成框架，用持久点云记忆锚定已观测/生成区域，用VLM撰写的3D布局锚定未观测区域，实现单图出发的超3分钟、50米可控漫游。
AI.motivation: 单图生成长期、相机可控且回访一致的漫游视频存在两类方法缺陷：基于记忆的方法只保留已见内容、无外部锚点，导致相机漂移，且文本提示能命名物体却无法定位；布局条件方法可控但依赖人工撰写布局。根源在于超出已捕获区域后缺少锚点。
AI.method: 提出Lyris框架，保证模型始终有锚点：在已观测或已生成区域维护持久点云记忆；在未探索区域由视觉语言模型撰写3D布局。核心洞见是两模型接口可极粗粒度——每个物体一个带标签的3D框，简单到VLM可撰写、用户可编辑，又足以在沿相机路径渲染后供视频模型遵循。
AI.result: 实现单图出发超过三分钟、50米的漫游，可穿过门洞进入原图未展示的房间。在四个数据集的一分钟往返评测中大幅超越SOTA，相机误差降低3.8倍，回访一致性平均提升22%。
AI.conclusion: 以“点云记忆+粗粒度3D框布局”的双锚点接口，弥合了记忆法与布局法的局限，实现长程可控且回访一致的单图场景漫游生成。

title: Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization
summary: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to compress a large dataset into a small synthetic one that remains effective for training neural networks. Despite its success in supervised learning, DD remains underexplored in self-supervised learning (SSL), where distilled data must preserve the information needed to learn representations that remain consistent across augmentations. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mutual Information Prototype Alignment (MIPA), an efficient SSL dataset distillation approach that optimizes synthetic images to preserve augmentation-invariant information. Specifically, MIPA treats synthetic images as learnable prototypes and uses a frozen encoder to assign real samples to them based on feature similarity. A synthetic dataset that preserves such augmentation invariance should yield stable prototype assignments across multiple augmented views of the same real image. MIPA encourages this by maximizing mutual information between cross-view assignments while avoiding trivial solutions in which all real samples are assigned to only a few synthetic prototypes. Evaluations on image classification benchmarks show that synthetic data generated by MIPA yield higher-quality representations than existing distillation approaches while reducing time and storage demands during distillation.

AI.tldr: MIPA：把合成图像视为可学习原型，用冻结编码器按特征相似度分配真实样本，通过最大化跨视图分配的互信息（并避免坍缩）来蒸馏保留增强不变信息的自监督数据。
AI.motivation: 数据集蒸馏（DD）在监督学习中成效显著，但在自监督学习（SSL）中探索不足。SSL 场景下蒸馏数据须保留学习增强不变表征所需的信息，即同一真实图像不同增强视图应产生一致表征，而现有方法未针对该目标设计。
AI.method: 提出互信息原型对齐（MIPA）：将合成图像作为可学习原型，用冻结编码器依据特征相似度把真实样本分配到原型；对同一真实图像的多个增强视图，最大化跨视图原型分配的互信息，以促使分配在增强下保持稳定；同时引入机制避免平凡解（所有样本坍缩到少数原型），从而在蒸馏阶段降低时间与存储开销。
AI.result: 在图像分类基准上，MIPA 生成的合成数据所训练出的表征质量优于现有蒸馏方法，同时减少了蒸馏过程中的时间与存储需求。
AI.conclusion: MIPA 以原型对齐＋跨视图互信息最大化的高效框架，将 DD 拓展到 SSL 场景，实现高质量、低成本的数据集蒸馏。

title: LeJEPA Features Are Not Isotropic, and Should Not Be
summary: The SIGReg term in LeJEPA regularizes features to have an isotropic Gaussian distribution. Our first result is to show that this regularizer, in practice, cannot achieve its goal. We design a modified regularizer to enforce the objective better. This leads to slightly improved performance. For example, on ImageNet-100, our modified regularizer reaches the final accuracy of SIGReg in 1.3$\times$ fewer epochs. Our second result argues that self-supervised encoders should not have isotropic Gaussian features. We show that the alignment term in LeJEPA conflicts with SIGReg, because it couples the magnitude of the features with their directions. In contrast, isotropic Gaussian features would entail independent magnitude and directions. Features obtained with LeJEPA are, in fact, not isotropic. So LeJEPA has two issues. Its regularizer is weak, and the isotropic Gaussian target is too strict. Our third result is about reformulating the isotropic Gaussian regularizer to enforce only the marginal distributions of the magnitude and direction, without enforcing independence. This leads to a simple regularization term, PolarReg, that can be optimized reliably across many different datasets, batch sizes and embedding dimensions without any hyper-parameter changes. On ImageNet-1k, our technique matches the accuracy of LeJEPA and its variants in 4.7$\times$ fewer epochs. It improves the final accuracy by 1.8 points.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出LeJEPA的SIGReg正则器实际无法实现各向同性高斯特征，且该目标与对齐项冲突、过于严格；作者提出仅约束幅值与方向边缘分布的PolarReg，可在无需调参的情况下稳定优化并显著加速收敛、提升精度。
AI.motivation: LeJEPA依赖SIGReg将特征正则化为各向同性高斯分布，但作者认为该正则器在实践中难以达成目标；同时自监督编码器是否应具备各向同性高斯特征本身值得质疑——对齐项会使特征幅值与方向耦合，与各向同性假设（幅值方向独立）相矛盾。因此需要重新审视正则目标与正则器设计。
AI.method: 1) 实证分析SIGReg无法达到各向同性目标，并设计改进正则器以更好实现原目标；2) 分析对齐项与SIGReg的冲突，指出LeJEPA学到的特征并非各向同性；3) 将各向同性高斯正则器重构为仅约束幅值与方向边缘分布、不强制独立性的形式，提出简单正则项PolarReg。
AI.result: 改进版SIGReg在ImageNet-100上以1.3×更少epoch达到SIGReg最终精度；PolarReg在多种数据集、batch size与嵌入维度下无需调参即可稳定优化；在ImageNet-1k上以4.7×更少epoch达到LeJEPA及其变体的精度，并将最终精度提升1.8个点。
AI.conclusion: LeJEPA存在两个问题：正则器较弱，且各向同性高斯目标过于严格。放松为仅约束幅值与方向边缘分布的PolarReg更符合自监督学习实际需求，兼具鲁棒性、收敛效率与精度优势。

title: HoloSplat: Real-Time Token Streaming for Feed-Forward Human Reconstruction
comment: 43 pages including supplementary material, 20 figures. Project page: https://heaticy.github.io/HoloSplat/
summary: Live free-viewpoint video streaming of humans enables immersive telepresence and interactive XR applications. However, this requires reconstructing each frame in real time, transmitting the data within strict bandwidth budgets, and decoding it on lightweight client GPUs. Existing approaches, whether relying on per-frame optimization or feed-forward inference, generate massive 3D Gaussian payloads that exceed practical streaming limits, while aggressive compression severely degrades rendering quality. In this work, we present HoloSplat, a real-time streaming framework for human-centric volumetric video. HoloSplat splits a feed-forward reconstructor before its Gaussian head, introducing a multi-rate streaming codec driven by server-side token compression and client-side token restoration. On the server side, we apply opacity-guided token pruning, PCA-based dimensionality reduction, and lossless geometry coding for token anchors. On the client side, a feature reconstruction hypernetwork is fused into the Gaussian head to recover compression-induced quality loss. Furthermore, we introduce Neural Session Calibration (NSC), which rapidly fine-tunes the Gaussian head online using incoming camera views during a warm-up phase. This resolves quality degradation from novel camera parameters and varying capture conditions with zero per-frame overhead. In our evaluations, HoloSplat averages 32.2 FPS on four RTX 5090 GPUs at 50 Mbit/s. It decodes each frame into 3D Gaussians in 22.1 ms on an RTX 3050 Ti laptop GPU, transmitting 22.8$\times$ less data than uncompressed float32 Gaussians, while calibrated decoding improves PSNR by 1.050 dB.

AI.tldr: HoloSplat 是一个面向人体体积视频的实时流式框架，通过将前馈重建器在 Gaussian head 之前拆分，引入服务端 token 压缩与客户端 token 恢复的多码率编解码，实现低带宽、低延迟的实时自由视角视频流。
AI.motivation: 人体自由视角实时流媒体是沉浸式远程呈现与交互 XR 的关键，但需逐帧实时重建、在严格带宽预算内传输、并在轻量客户端 GPU 上解码。现有逐帧优化或前馈推理方法产生庞大的 3D Gaussian 数据量，超出实用流式传输极限，而激进压缩又严重损害渲染质量。
AI.method: 提出 HoloSplat：在前馈重建器的 Gaussian head 之前进行切分，构建多码率流式编解码。服务端采用不透明度引导的 token 剪枝、PCA 降维以及 token 锚点的无损几何编码；客户端将特征重建超网络融合进 Gaussian head 以恢复压缩导致的质量损失。此外提出神经会话校准（NSC），在预热阶段利用到达的相机视角在线快速微调 Gaussian head，以零逐帧开销缓解新相机参数与不同采集条件带来的质量下降。
AI.result: 在 50 Mbit/s 下，HoloSplat 在四块 RTX 5090 GPU 上平均达 32.2 FPS；在 RTX 3050 Ti 笔记本 GPU 上每帧解码为 3D Gaussian 仅需 22.1 ms；相比未压缩 float32 Gaussian 减少 22.8 倍传输数据；校准解码使 PSNR 提升 1.050 dB。
AI.conclusion: HoloSplat 通过 token 级分层的服务端压缩与客户端特征恢复，结合在线会话校准，在严格带宽与轻量硬件约束下实现了高质量、实时的以人为中心的体积视频流式传输。

title: Can Multimodal Fusion MakeSense for Embodied Vision in Degraded Sensing?
summary: Embodied vision systems rely on complementary sensors to perceive and act as conditions change. Even models that accept arbitrary sensor subsets can exhibit negative fusion: adding a sensor increases prediction error. We propose MakeSense, a multimodal fusion framework that preserves sensor-specific evidence in private streams and combines information through shared bottleneck tokens. Training pairs full and subset views of the same degraded observations, penalizing higher error with more sensors. Where geometry permits, the distance readout uses range measurements alone, while the rest of the prediction draws on all available inputs. Paired tests across five datasets reveal helpful and harmful sensor additions. MakeSense reduces negative fusion on MM-Fi. With lightweight adapters and per-dataset training, the same design improves UAV localization on MMAUD, cooperative 3D detection on V2X-Real, few-shot pose transfer to RELI11D, and command prediction on Humanoid-Everyday, where a world model trained on the frozen core's outputs forecasts future fused states more accurately than a linear baseline at longer tested horizons. MakeSense supports embodied sensing across human activity, aerial systems, robotics, and autonomous driving.

AI.tldr: 提出MakeSense多模态融合框架，用私有流保留各传感器证据、共享瓶颈token做信息交换，并通过配对训练（完整视图 vs 子集视图）抑制"负融合"现象；在五个数据集（人体活动、无人机定位、协同3D检测、姿态迁移、人形机器人指令预测）上验证有效性并可接世界模型预测未来融合状态。
AI.motivation: 具身视觉系统依赖互补传感器应对条件变化，但即使支持任意传感器子集的模型也会出现"负融合"：增加传感器反而提高预测误差。需要一种在保留传感器特异证据的同时实现稳健融合、并可直接惩罚负融合的框架。
AI.method: 1) 私有流保留各传感器特异证据，经共享瓶颈token进行跨模态信息交换；2) 训练时配对同一退化观测的完整视图与子集视图，以"传感器越多误差越大"为惩罚项；3) 在几何条件允许时，距离读出仅使用测距测量，其余预测融合全部可用输入；4) 轻量适配器 + 各数据集独立训练，支持跨域迁移。
AI.result: 五数据集配对测试可识别"有益"与"有害"的传感器新增；在MM-Fi上降低负融合；同一设计经轻量适配器分别提升MMAUD无人机定位、V2X-Real协同3D检测、RELI11D少样本姿态迁移、Humanoid-Everyday指令预测；在Humanoid-Everyday上，基于冻结主干输出训练的世界模型在较长测试时域内优于线性基线。
AI.conclusion: MakeSense以私有流+瓶颈token+配对子集训练的结构化设计有效缓解负融合，具备跨人体活动、航空系统、机器人与自动驾驶的统一适用性，并可支撑下游世界模型的未来融合状态预测。

title: Unpacking the Evaluators: How Configuration Shapes the Evaluation of Alignment in Explainable AI
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track
summary: Explainable AI (XAI) evaluation fundamentally requires human-centered evaluation, assessing whether explanations align with human reasoning and expert knowledge. However, such evaluations often require expert-driven manual validation and are difficult to scale, leading to the widespread use of alignment-based metrics, where attribution maps are compared against predefined ground-truth (GT) representations. Despite their popularity, alignment evaluations are implicitly bias towards multiple design choices made during the evaluation process, for example GT representations, metric families, metric formulations (soft vs. hard), and thresholding strategies. In this paper, we formalize alignment evaluation as a structured evaluation configuration space through which the influence of these design choices can be systematically analyzed. We further introduce a structured alignment evaluation framework that models interactions between XAI methods, GT representations, metric families, metric formulations, and thresholding strategies across 2D and 3D synthetic and real-world datasets. In addition, we propose a novel taxonomy of XAI output behavior based on local entropy and boundary mass ratio, enabling structured characterization of attribution patterns for alignment evaluation. Our experiments reveal systematic flows (triples of XAI-GT-metric configurations), showing that alignment outcomes provide distinct behavior patterns under certain configurations, such as soft/hard metric implementations. We further observe varying levels of threshold sensitivity across metric families and attribution structures. These findings demonstrate that alignment evaluation cannot be treated as a fixed or invariant measure of explanation quality, and provide practical guidance for designing more reliable and behavior-aware XAI evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: 本文将对齐式XAI评估形式化为结构化配置空间，系统分析GT表示、指标族、软/硬指标形式及阈值策略等设计选择的影响，并提出基于局部熵与边界质量比的输出行为分类体系。
AI.motivation: 以人为中心的XAI评估需专家手动验证、难以规模化，因而广泛采用对齐式指标（归因图对比预定义GT）。但这类评估隐含偏向GT表示、指标族、软/硬形式与阈值策略等设计选择，其影响缺乏系统分析。
AI.method: 将对齐评估形式化为结构化评估配置空间；构建结构化对齐评估框架，在2D/3D合成与真实数据集上建模XAI方法、GT表示、指标族、指标形式与阈值策略之间的交互；并提出基于局部熵和边界质量比的XAI输出行为分类taxonomy。
AI.result: 实验揭示系统性"流"（XAI-GT-指标三元组配置），表明特定配置（如软/硬指标实现）下对齐结果呈现不同行为模式；不同指标族与归因结构表现出不同程度的阈值敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 对齐评估不能被视为解释质量的固定不变度量；研究结果为设计更可靠、行为感知的XAI评估协议提供实践指导。

title: Self-Evolving Evaluation Environments for Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet their evaluation remains largely static. Existing benchmarks provide a strong foundation, but fixed difficulty ceilings, limited feature coverage, and coarse aggregate scores progressively weaken their discriminative and diagnostic value. We introduce CUA-SEE, a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers from rollout evidence. It disentangles three objectives: benchmark evolution expands evaluation scope through cohort-calibrated difficulty and coverage growth; diagnostic evolution increases resolution through agent-conditional capability-boundary probes; and verifier evolution improves precision by translating changing requirements into state-grounded checkpoints with adversarial validation. Across multiple agents, applications, and rounds, CUA-SEE generates challenging, measurable tasks while preserving process-level evidence. Our results position adaptive evaluation as a scalable counterpart to self-evolving agents, continuously tracking what agents can do, where their boundaries lie, and how reliably progress is measured.

AI.tldr: 提出CUA-SEE闭环评测环境，通过任务与可执行验证器的协同进化，实现基准扩展、诊断扩展、验证器扩展三重目标，使评测从静态走向自适应。
AI.motivation: 计算机使用智能体（CUA）能力快速提升，但评测仍是静态的：固定难度上限、特征覆盖有限、聚合分数粗糙，导致基准的区分度与诊断价值随智能体进步而持续衰减。作者主张评测应作为自进化智能体的可扩展对偶物而同步演进。
AI.method: 构建闭环评测环境，从rollout证据中协同进化任务与可执行验证器，并显式解耦三项目标：(1) 基准进化——通过队列校准难度与覆盖增长扩大评测范围；(2) 诊断进化——通过智能体条件化的能力边界探针提升分辨率；(3) 验证器进化——将变化的需求翻译为状态锚定的检查点，并辅以对抗性验证提升精度。
AI.result: 在多个智能体、多种应用与多轮迭代中，CUA-SEE能够持续生成具有挑战性且可度量的任务，同时保留过程级证据，维持较高的区分度与诊断信息量。
AI.conclusion: 自适应评测可作为自进化智能体的可扩展对应物，持续追踪智能体能做什么、能力边界在哪、以及进展被测量的可靠程度，从而弥补静态基准的退化问题。
